1.sanskrit: athAto~abhayAmalakIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
1.commentary: pUrvasthAnoktalakShaNAbhAvenAvadhAritAyuShmadbhAvena cikitsA dharmArthayashaskarI kartavyetyanantaraM cikitsAbhidhAyakaM sthAnamucyate| rasAyanavAjIkaraNasAdhanamapi yathA cikitsocyate, tathA~anantarameva vakShyati| tatrApi jvarAdicikitsAyAH prAgrasAyanavAjIkaraNayormahAphalatvenAdAvabhidhAnam| tayorapi ca rasAyanameva varShasahasrAyuShTvAdikAraNatayA mahAphalamiti tadabhidhIyate, tatrApi cAbhayAmalakIyashcikitsAsthAnArthasUtrAbhidhAyakatayA~agre~abhidhIyate||1-2||

1.sanskrit: cikitsitaM vyAdhiharaM pathyaM sAdhanamauShadham| prAyashcittaM prashamanaM prakRutisthApanaM hitam||3|| vidyAdbheShajanAmAni, ...|4|
1.commentary: tatrAdau vyavahArArthaM sthAnAbhidheyasya bheShajasya paryAyAnAha- cikitsitamityAdi| karoti caivamAdau pradhAnAbhidheyaparyAyAbhidhAnaM, yathA- nidAne heturUpAdiparyAyakathanam| etacca paryAyAbhidhAnaM prAdhAnyena catuShpAdasyaiva bheShajasya, yaduktaM- “catuShpAdaM ShoDashakalaM bheShajamiti bhiShajo bhAShante” (sU.a.10) iti| evambhUtabheShajA~ggarUpatayA tu sthAvaraja~ggamadravyarUpasya bheShajasya bheShajatvamevAntaravyavahArakRutaM j~jeyam| prAyashcittamiti bheShajasa~jj~jA prAyashcittavadbheShajasyAdharmakAryavyAdhiharatvena||3||-

1.sanskrit: ... bheShajaM dvividhaM ca tat| svasthasyorjaskaraM ki~jcit ki~jcidArtasya roganut||4||
1.commentary: dvaividhyaM vivRuNoti- svasthasyetyAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| svasthatvena vyavahriyamANasya puMso jarAdisvAbhAvikavyAdhiharatvena tathA~apraharShavyayAyakShayitvAnupacitashukratvAdyaprashastashArIrabhAvaharatvena UrjaH prashastaM bhAvamAdadhAtIti svasthasyorjaskaram| Artasya roganuditi visheShaNena jvarAdinA~a~artasya jvarAdiharam| roganuditi vacanenaivArtavisheShatAyAM labdhAyAM yat ‘Artasya’ iti karoti, tena sahajajarAdikRutAM pIDAmanudvejikAM parityajya jvarAdinA~asvAbhAvikena rogeNa pIDitasyeti darshayati||4||

1.sanskrit: abheShajaM ca dvividhaM bAdhanaM sAnubAdhanam|5|
1.commentary: bheShajaprasa~ggAdabheShajadvaividhyamAha- abheShajamityAdi| bAdhanamiha tadAtvamAtrabAdhakaM, yathA- svalpamapathyam| sAnubAdhanaM ca dIrghakAlAvasthAyikuShThAdivikArakAri||-

1.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam||5|| prAyaH, prAyeNa rogANAM dvitIyaM prashame matam| prAyaHshabdo visheShArtho hyubhayaM hyubhayArthakRut||6||
1.commentary: dvividhaM bheShajamuktaM vibhajate- svasthasyetyAdi| tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanaM prAya iti cchedaH| yadvRuShyaM prAyo bhavati, tathA rasAyanaM yat prAyo bhavati, Artasya rogaharaM yadbAhulyena, tat svasthorjaskaramucyate; yattu dvitIyamArtarogaharaM, tat prAyeNa jvarAdishamanaM rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavati; yathA- kShatakShINoktaM sarpirguDAdi rasAyanaM vRuShyaM ca bhavati, tathA pANDurogokto yogarAjo rasAyanatvenoktaH, tathA kAsAdhikAre~agastyaharItakI rasAyanatvenoktetyAdyanusaraNIyam| rasAyanoktAnAM ca jvarAdiharatvamatra suvyaktameva rasAyanagrantheShu| anye tu bruvate- yadvyAdhimAtraharaM na tadrasAyanaM, kintu sharIrasaMyogadArDhyAddIrghAyuHkartRutvasAdhAraNadharmayogAdupacaritavyAdhiharaM rasAyanamihocyata iti| nanu yadi svasthorjaskaramapi vyAdhiharaM, vyAdhiharaM ca svasthorjaskaraM tat kiM ki~jciditi padena bheShajakarmavyavasthAdarshakena kriyate? brUmaH- bAhulyena svasthorjaskaratvaM vyAdhiharatvaM ca vyavasthApyate, na ceha sarvArtarogaharasya svasthorjaskaratvamiti pratij~jAyate, yena pAThAsaptaparNAdInAmapi rasAyanatvaM sAdhanIyashaktitvAdArttarogaharatvena yaducyate tadapi rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavatIti lavamAtropadarshanaM kriyate, tat svasthArtayorubhayArthakartRutvam| prAyaHshabdatAtparyaM vivRuNoti- prAya ityAdi| visheShArtha iti bAhulyArtha ityarthaH||5-6||

1.sanskrit: dIrghamAyuH smRutiM medhAmArogyaM taruNaM vayaH| prabhAvarNasvaraudAryaM dehendriyabalaM param||7|| vAksiddhiM praNatiM kAntiM labhate nA rasAyanAt| lAbhopAyo hi shastAnAM rasAdInAM rasAyanam||8||
1.commentary: rasAyanakAryamAha- dIrghamityAdi| prabhAdInAM trayANAmaudAryaM yojanIyam| vAksiddhiH yaducyate tadavashyaM bhavatItyarthaH| praNatiH lokavandyatA| kathametadrasAyanena kriyata ityAha- lAbhetyAdi| rasAdigrahaNena smRutyAdayo~api gRuhyante||7-8||

1.sanskrit: apatyasantAnakaraM yat sadyaH sampraharShaNam| vAjIvAtibalo yena yAtyapratihataH striyaH||9|| bhavatyatipriyaH strINAM yena yenopacIyate| jIryato~apyakShayaM shukraM phalavadyena dRushyate||10|| prabhUtashAkhaH shAkhIva yena caityo yathA mahAn| bhavatyarcyo bahumataH prajAnAM subahuprajaH||11|| santAnamUlaM yeneha pretya cAnantyamashnute| yashaH shriyaM balaM puShTiM vAjIkaraNameva tat||12||
1.commentary: vAjIkaraNakAryamAha- apatyetyAdi| apatyasantAnaH apatyaparamparA, tena putrapautrakaramityarthaH; vAjIkaraNajanitAcchukrAjjAtaH putraH putrajananasamartho bhavatItyarthaH| atipriyatvaM cehopacitashukratayA nirantaravyavAyakartRutvAt; yaduktaM- “virUpamapi yoddhAraM bhRutyamicchanti pArthivAH| vyavAyavyAyataM mUrkhaM dhRuShTaM patimiva striyaH” iti| upacIyata iti puShTiM prApnoti| akShayamivAkShayam| phalavaditi garbhajanakam| caityo devatAyatanam| arcyaH arcanIyaH | AnantyamivAnantyaM; dIrghasantAnatAmityarthaH||9-12||

1.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM tvetaddvividhaM proktamauShadham| yadvyAdhinirghAtakaraM vakShyate taccikitsite||13|| cikitsitArtha etAvAn vikArANAM yadauShadham| rasAyanavidhishcAgre vAjIkaraNameva ca||14||
1.commentary: cikitsita iti jvarAdicikitsite| nanu rasAyanavAjIkaraNe api jvarAdicikitsite eva, tat kiM vishiShyocyate- ‘vakShyate taccikitsite’ ityAha- cikitsitArtha ityAdi| satyaM, rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca jvarAdivyAdhiharatvAccikitsitashabdenocyata ityarthaH| atha vyAdhiharatvAccikitsite vaktavyatvAcca rasAyanavAjIkaraNe kva nu vaktavye ityAha- rasAyanetyAdi| vidhiH vidhAnaM rasAyanAbhidhAnamityarthaH | agre iti anantaram| vAjIkaraNaM cAgre ‘abhidhAsyate’ iti sheShaH||13-14||

1.sanskrit: abheShajamiti j~jeyaM viparItaM yadauShadhAt| tadasevyaM niShevyaM tu pravakShyAmi yadauShadham||15||
1.commentary: abheShajamapi pUrvoddiShTaM vivRuNoti- abheShajamityAdi| viparItaM rogajananalakShaNArthakAri||15||

1.sanskrit: rasAyanAnAM dvividhaM prayogamRuShayo viduH| kuTIprAveshikaM caiva vAtAtapikameva ca||16|| kuTIprAveshikasyAdau vidhiH samupadekShyate| nRupavaidyadvijAtInAM sAdhUnAM puNyakarmaNAm||17|| nivAse nirbhaye shaste prApyopakaraNe pure| dishi pUrvottarasyAM ca subhUmau kArayet kuTIm||18|| vistArotsedhasampannAM trigarbhAM sUkShmalocanAm| ghanabhittimRutusukhAM suspaShTAM manasaH priyAm||19|| shabdAdInAmashastAnAmagamyaM strIvivarjitAm| iShTopakaraNopetAM sajjavaidyauShadhadvijAm ||20|| athodagayane shukle tithinakShatrapUjite| muhUrtakaraNopete prashaste kRutavApanaH||21|| dhRutismRutibalaM kRutvA shraddadhAnaH samAhitaH| vidhUya mAnasAn doShAn maitrIM bhUteShu cintayan||22|| devatAH pUjayitvA~agre dvijAtIMshca pradakShiNam| devagobrAhmaNAn kRutvA tatastAM pravishet kuTIm||23|| tasyAM saMshodhanaiH shuddhaH sukhI jAtabalaH punaH| rasAyanaM prayu~jjIta tatpravakShyAmi shodhanam||24||
1.commentary: kuTIpraveshena yat kriyate tat kuTIprAveshikam| vAtAtapasevayA~api yat kriyate tad vAtAtapikam| trigarbhAM prathamamekaM gRuhaM, tasyAbhyantare dvitIyam, evaM trigarbhAstrayo garbhA antarANi yasyAM sA; trigarbhAmiti antastriprakoShThAm| sUkShmalocanAmiti alpadvArajAlakAm| shukle shuklapakShe| sajjA vaidyAdayo yasyAM sA tathA| tithinakShatrapUjita iti shubhatithinakShatrayogAt pUjite| kRutavApana iti kRutakShauraH| mAnasAn doShAniti kAmakrodhAdIn| saMshodhanairiti vamanavirecanAsthApanashirovirecanaiH| sukhIti arogaH| jAtabala iti saMshodhanApahRutamalatayA saMsarjanAdikrameNa punarjAtabalaH| yadyapIha saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaprayogAt sarvANyeva saMshodhanAni sammatAni, tathA~apIha rasAyane visheSheNa yaugikatvAddharItakyAdiprayoga evoktaH; anye tu harItakyAdiprayogeNaiva paraM saMshodhanaM kartavyamityAhuH, saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaM punaryAvacchuddherharItakyAdiprayogasyaiva karaNaM darshayati||16-24||

1.sanskrit: harItakInAM cUrNAni saindhavAmalake guDam| vacAM viDa~ggaM rajanIM pippalIM vishvabheShajam||25|| pibeduShNAmbunA jantuH snehasvedopapAditaH| tena shuddhasharIrAya kRutasaMsarjanAya ca||26|| trirAtraM yAvakaM dadyAt pa~jcAhaM vA~api sarpiShA| saptAhaM vA purANasya yAvacchuddhestu varcasaH||27|| shuddhakoShThaM tu taM j~jAtvA rasAyanamupAcaret| vayaHprakRutisAtmyaj~jo yaugikaM yasya yadbhavet||28||
1.commentary: yAvakamiti yavAnnam| trirAtrAdivikalpatrayaM hInamadhyottamashuddhiviShayam||25-28||

1.sanskrit: harItakIM pa~jcarasAmuShNAmalavaNAM shivAm| doShAnulomanIM laghvIM vidyAddIpanapAcanIm||29|| AyuShyAM pauShTikIM dhanyAM vayasaH sthApanIM parAm| sarvarogaprashamanIM buddhIndriyabalapradAm||30|| kuShThaM gulmamudAvartaM shoShaM pANDvAmayaM madam| arshAMsi grahaNIdoShaM purANaM viShamajvaram||31|| hRudrogaM sashirorogamatIsAramarocakam| kAsaM pramehamAnAhaM plIhAnamudaraM navam||32|| kaphaprasekaM vaisvaryaM vaivarNyaM kAmalAM krimIn| shvayathuM tamakaM chardiM klaibyama~ggAvasAdanam||33|| srotovibandhAn vividhAn pralepaM hRudayorasoH| smRutibuddhipramohaM ca jayecchIghraM harItakI||34|| (ajIrNino rUkShabhujaH strImadyaviShakarshitAH| severannAbhayAmete kShuttRuShNoShNArditAshca ye)||35|| tAn guNAMstAni karmANi vidyAdAmalakIShvapi| yAnyuktAni harItakyA vIryasya tu viparyayaH||36|| atashcAmRutakalpAni vidyAt karmabhirIdRushaiH| harItakInAM shasyAni bhiShagAmalakasya ca||37||
1.commentary: yadyapi dravyAntarANi dashavarShashatAyuShkararasAyanAdhikRutAni santi, tathA~api harItakyAmalake eva rogaharatvAyuShkaratvarUpobhayadharmayogAdadhyAyAdau guNakarmabhyAmucyete; tatrApi yadyapi “AmalakaM vayaHsthApanAnAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktam, tathA~api rogaharatve harItakI prakarShavatIti kRutvA harItakyagre~abhihitA| harItakyAdiShu pa~jcarasatvAdyutpAdo~adRuShTavashAdbhUtasanniveshavisheShaprabhAvakRutaH; tena nAtropapattayaH kramante| shivAmiti kalyANakAriNIM, prashastaguNayuktatvAt| sarvarogaprashamanImiti saMyogasaMskArAdinA| sarvarogaharatvamabhidhAyApi kuShThAdihantRutvAbhidhAnaM visheSheNa kuShThAdihantRutvopadarshanArtham| pravartakatve~apyatIsAragrahaNIharatvaM vibaddhadoShapravartakatayA j~jeyaM; yaduktaM- “stokaM stokaM vibaddhaM vA sashUlaM yo~atisAryate| abhayApippalIkalkaiH sukhoShNaistaM virecayet” iti| buddhismRutipradatvamabhidhAyApi smRutibuddhipramohaharatvAbhidhAnaM tatra vishiShTashaktyupadarshanArtham| vIryasya tu viparyaya ityanenAmalakasya shItavIryatvamuktam| shasyAnIti asthirahitAni phalAni||29-37||

1.sanskrit: oShadhInAM parA bhUmirhimavA~j shailasattamaH| tasmAtphalAni tajjAni grAhayetkAlajAni tu||38|| ApUrNarasavIryANi kAle kAle yathAvidhi| AdityapavanacchAyAsalilaprINitAni ca||39|| yAnyajagdhAnyapUtIni nirvraNAnyagadAni ca| teShAM prayogaM vakShyAmi phalAnAM karma cottamam||40||
1.commentary: yadyapi “himavAnauShadhabhUmInAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktaM, tathA~api rasAyane himavatprabhavANyeva bheShajAni grAhyANIti darshayitumauShadhInAmityAdyabhidhAnam| kAle kAle iti phalapAkakAle ityarthaH| yathAvidhIti yathA bheShajagrahaNaM ma~ggaladevatArcanAdipUrvakaM syAttathA~avashyaM rasAyane karttavyam| agadAnItyanena pavanadahanAdyadoShaM phalasya darshayati||38-40||

1.sanskrit: pa~jcAnAM pa~jcamUlAnAM bhAgAn dashapalonmitAn| harItakIsahasraM ca triguNAmalakaM navam||41|| vidArigandhAM bRuhatIM pRushniparNIM nidigdhikAm| vidyAdvidArigandhAdyaM shvadaMShTrApa~jcamaM gaNam||42|| bilvAgnimanthashyonAkaM kAshmaryamatha pATalAm| punarnavAM shUrpaparNyau balAmeraNDameva ca||43|| jIvakarShabhakau medAM jIvantIM sashatAvarIm| sharekShudarbhakAshAnAM shAlInAM mUlameva ca||44|| ityeShAM pa~jcamUlAnAM pa~jcAnAmupakalpayet| bhAgAn yathoktAMstatsarvaM sAdhyaM dashaguNe~ambhasi||45|| dashabhAgAvasheShaM tu pUtaM taM grAhayedrasam| harItakIshca tAH sarvAH sarvANyAmalakAni ca||46|| tAni sarvANyanasthIni phalAnyApothya kUrcanaiH| vinIya tasminniryUhe cUrNAnImAni dApayet||47|| maNDUkaparNyAH pippalyAH sha~gkhapuShpyAH plavasya ca| mustAnAM saviDa~ggAnAM candanAguruNostathA||48|| madhukasya haridrAyA vacAyAH kanakasya ca| bhAgAMshcatuShpalAn kRutvA sUkShmailAyAstvacastathA||49|| sitopalAsahasraM ca cUrNitaM tulayA~adhikam| tailasya dvyADhakaM tatra dadyAttrINi ca sarpiShaH||50|| sAdhyamaudumbare pAtre tat sarvaM mRudunA~agninA| j~jAtvA lehyamadagdhaM ca shItaM kShaudreNa saMsRujet||51|| kShaudrapramANaM snehArdhaM tat sarvaM ghRutabhAjane| tiShThetsammUrcchitaM tasya mAtrAM kAle prayojayet||52|| yA noparundhyAdAhAramekaM mAtrA jarAM prati| ShaShTikaH payasA cAtra jIrNe bhojanamiShyate||53|| vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAstathA cAnye tapodhanAH| rasAyanamidaM prAshya babhUvuramitAyuShaH||54|| muktvA jIrNaM vapushcAgryamavApustaruNaM vayaH| vItatandrAklamashvAsA nirAta~gkAH samAhitAH||55|| medhAsmRutibalopetAshcirarAtraM tapodhanAH| brAhmaM tapo brahmacaryaM cerushcAtyantaniShThayA||56|| rasAyanamidaM brAhmamAyuShkAmaH prayojayet| dIrghamAyurvayashcAgryaM kAmAMshceShTAn samashnute||57|| (iti brAhmarasAyanam)|
1.commentary: pa~jcAnAmityAdau pratidravyaM dashapalabhAgagrahaNam , uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “iti pa~jca pa~jcamUlAni, teShAM pratidravyaM dashapalAni” iti| harItakIsahasramiti harItakIphalasahasram| shUrpaparNyau mudgamAShaparNyau| vIrA jAlandharaM shAkam| kUrcanaM jarjarIkaraNasAdhanaM shilAputrakamusalAdi| vinIyeti prakShipya| plavaH kaivartamustakam| kanakaM nAgakesharam| tvak guDatvak| audumbare iti tAmramaye| snehArdhamiti sarpistailArdham| ekam anaparAhNikamAhAram||41-57||

1.sanskrit: yathoktaguNAnAmAmalakAnAM sahasraM piShTasvedanavidhinA payasa UShmaNA susvinnamanAtapashuShkamanasthi cUrNayet| tadAmalakasahasrasvarasaparipItaM sthirApunarnavAjIvantInAgabalAbrahmasuvarcalAmaNDUkaparNIshatAvarIsha~gkhapuShpIpippalIvacAviDa~ggasvaya~gguptAmRutA- candanAgurumadhukamadhUkapuShpotpalapadmamAlatIyuvatIyUthikAcUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktaM punarnAgabalAsahasrapalasvarasaparipItamanAtapashuShkaM dviguNitasarpiShA kShaudrasarpiShA vA kShudraguDAkRutiM kRutvA shucau dRuDhe ghRutabhAvite kumbhe bhasmarAsheradhaH sthApayedantarbhUmeH pakShaM kRutarakShAvidhAnamatharvavedavidA, pakShAtyaye coddhRutya kanakarajatatAmrapravAlakAlAyasacUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktamardhakarShavRuddhyA yathoktena vidhinA prAtaH prAtaH prayu~jjAno~agnibalamabhisamIkShya, jIrNe ca ShaShTikaM payasA sasarpiShkamupasevamAno yathoktAn guNAn samashnuta iti||58|| bhavanti cAtra- idaM rasAyanaM brAhmaM maharShigaNasevitam| bhavatyarogo dIrghAyuH prayu~jjAno mahAbalaH||59|| kAntaH prajAnAM siddhArthashcandrAdityasamadyutiH| shrutaM dhArayate sattvamArShaM cAsya pravartate||60|| dharaNIdharasArashca vAyunA samavikramaH| sa bhavatyaviShaM cAsya gAtre sampadyate viSham||61|| (iti dvitIyaM brAhmarasAyanam)|
1.commentary: piShTasvedanavidhineti yathA piShTakaM toyaparipUritapAtroparidattatRuNAdisaMsthitaM svedyate, tathA tat svedanIyamityarthaH| svarasaparipItamiti svarasabhAvitam| brahmasuvarcalAdyauShadhAnyAyurvedasamutthAnIye vakShyamANAni| yuvatiH navamAlikA| aShTamo bhAgo~aShTabhAgaH| kShudraguDAkRutimiti phANitAkRutim| ardhakarShavRuddhyeti ardhakarShAtprabhRuti vardhayet| yathoktavidhineti kuTIprAveshikena vidhinA| yathoktAn guNAniti pUrvaprayogaphalashrutipaThitAn| dharaNIdharasAra iti uShTramukhavat; tena dharaNIdharAH parvatAH, teShAM sAro lauhaM, tadvatsAra ityarthaH| aviShamiti viShamavikAri||58-61||

1.sanskrit: bilvo~agnimanthaH shyonAkaH kAshmaryaH pATalirbalA| parNyashcatasraH pippalyaH shvadaMShTrA bRuhatIdvayam||62|| shRu~ggI tAmalakI drAkShA jIvantI puShkarAguru| abhayA cAmRutA RuddhirjIvakarShabhakau shaTI||63|| mustaM punarnavA medA sailA candanamutpalam| vidArI vRuShamUlAni kAkolI kAkanAsikA||64|| eShAM palonmitAn bhAgA~jchatAnyAmalakasya ca| pa~jca dadyAttadaikadhyaM jaladroNe vipAcayet||65|| j~jAtvA gatarasAnyetAnyauShadhAnyatha taM rasam| taccAmalakamuddhRutya niShkulaM tailasarpiShoH||66|| paladvAdashake bhRuShTvA dattvA cArdhatulAM bhiShak| matsyaNDikAyAH pUtAyA lehavatsAdhu sAdhayet||67|| ShaTpalaM madhunashcAtra siddhashIte pradApayet| catuShpalaM tugAkShIryAH pippalIdvipalaM tathA||68|| palamekaM nidadhyAcca tvagelApatrakesharAt| ityayaM cyavanaprAshaH paramukto rasAyanaH||69|| kAsashvAsaharashcaiva visheSheNopadishyate| kShINakShatAnAM vRuddhAnAM bAlAnAM cA~ggavardhanaH||70|| svarakShayamurorogaM hRudrogaM vAtashoNitam| pipAsAM mUtrashukrasthAn doShAMshcApyapakarShati||71|| asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta yoparundhyAnna bhojanam| asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA||72|| medhAM smRutiM kAntimanAmayatvamAyuHprakarShaM balamindriyANAm| strIShu praharShaM paramagnivRuddhiM varNaprasAdaM pavanAnulomyam||73|| rasAyanasyAsya naraH prayogAllabheta jIrNo~api kuTIpraveshAt| jarAkRutaM rUpamapAsya sarvaM bibharti rUpaM navayauvanasya||74|| (iti cyavanaprAshaH)|
1.commentary: parNyashcatasra iti shAlaparNI, pRushniparNI, mudgaparNI, mAShaparNI ca| tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI| kAkanAsA nAsAphalA, ‘kAkatuNDaka’ ityanye| gatarasatvamiha dravyANAM caturbhAgasthitajale bhavati| niShkulamiti nirasthi| tailasarpiShoriti samAsanirdeshAdubhAbhyAmeva dvAdashapalAni, na pRuthak pRuthak| matsyaNDikA khaNDasaMhatiH| atra ShaTpalatvena samayorapi madhusarpiShordravyAntarayuktatvenAviruddhatvam||62-74||

1.sanskrit: athAmalakaharItakInAmAmalakabibhItakAnAM harItakIbibhItakAnAmAmalakaharItakIbibhItakAnAM vA palAshatvagavanaddhAnAM mRudA~avaliptAnAM kukUlasvinnAnAmakulakAnAM palasahasramulUkhale sampothya dadhighRutamadhupalalatailasharkarAsaMyuktaM bhakShayedanannabhugyathoktena vidhinA; tasyAnte yavAgvAdibhiH pratyavasthApanam , abhya~ggotsAdanaM sarpiShA yavacUrNaishca, ayaM ca rasAyanaprayogaprakarSho dvistAvadagnibalamabhisamIkShya , pratibhojanaM yUSheNa payasA vA ShaShTikaH sasarpiShkaH, ataH paraM yathAsukhavihAraH kAmabhakShyaH syAt| anena prayogeNarShayaH punaryuvatvamavApurbabhUvushcAnekavarShashatajIvino nirvikArAH paraM sharIrabuddhIndriyabalasamuditAshcerushcAtyantaniShThayA tapaH||75|| (iti caturthAmalakarasAyanam)|
1.commentary: kukUlakaH karIShAgniH| akulakAnAmiti anasthnAm| dravyAdInAmatra mAnaM noktaM, tena pradhAnasya cUrNasya dadhyAdibhirmilitaiH samAnamAnatvaM; kiMvA pratyekameva dadhyAdInAM cUrNasamatvam| palalaM tilacUrNam| bhakShayediti vacanaM lehye~api alpAbhyavaharaNamAtrArthatvAdupapannam| anannabhugiti sarvathA~a~ahArAntarAbhuk| tasyAnta iti etatprayogaparityAgakAle| pratyavasthApanamiti yavAgvAdikramavisheShaNaM; tena prayogAnte yadA annasaMsarjanaM kartavyaM, tadA yavAgvAdikrameNetyuktasyArthasya pratyavasthApanaM kriyata ityarthaH| yUSheNa payasA veti vikalpo~agnibalApekShayA||75||

1.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakapa~jcapa~jcamUlaniryUhe pippalImadhukamadhUkakAkolIkShIrakAkolyAtmaguptAjIvakarShabhakakShIrashuklAkalkasamprayuktena vidArIsvarasena kShIrAShTaguNasamprayuktena ca sarpiShaH kumbhaM sAdhayitvA prayu~jjAno~agnibalasamAM mAtrAM jIrNe ca kShIrasarpirbhyAM shAliShaShTikamuShNodakAnupAnamashna~jjarAvyAdhipApAbhicAravyapagatabhayaH sharIrendriyabuddhibalamatulamupalabhyApratihatasarvArambhaH paramAyuranavApnuyAt||76|| (iti pa~jcamo harItakIyogaH)|
1.commentary: atra harItakyAdau kShIrashuklA kShIravidArikA| atra harItakyAdikvAthasya tveko bhAgaH, kShIrasyAShTau bhAgAH, sarpiSha eko bhAgaH| kumbho droNadvayam| vacanaM hi- “droNastu dviguNaH sUrpo vij~jeyaH kumbha eva ca” iti||76||

1.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakaharidrAsthirAbalAviDa~ggAmRutavallIvishvabheShajamadhukapippalIsomavalkasiddhena kShIrasarpiShA madhusharkarAbhyAmapi ca sannIyAmalakasvarasashataparipItamAmalakacUrNamayashcUrNacaturbhAgasamprayuktaM pANitalamAtraM prAtaH prAtaH prAshya yathoktena vidhinA sAyaM mudgayUSheNa payasA vA sasarpiShkaM shAliShaShTikAnnamashnIyAt, trivarShaprayogAdasya varShashatamajaraM vayastiShThati, shrutamavatiShThate, sarvAmayAH prashAmyanti, viShamaviShaM bhavati gAtre, gAtramashmavat sthirIbhavati, adhRuShyo bhUtAnAM bhavati||77|| bhavanti cAtra- yathA~amarANAmamRutaM yathA bhogavatAM sudhA| tathA~abhavanmaharShINAM rasAyanavidhiH purA||78|| na jarAM na ca daurbalyaM nAturyaM nidhanaM na ca| jagmurvarShasahasrANi rasAyanaparAH purA||79|| na kevalaM dIrghamihAyurashnute rasAyanaM yo vidhivanniShevate| gatiM sa devarShiniShevitAM shubhAM prapadyate brahma tatheti cAkShayam ||80||
1.commentary: amRutavallI guDUcI| somavalkaH viTkhadiraH| kShIrasarpiH kShIrasamutthitasarpiH| ayashcUrNasya caturtho bhAgaH, yata etadayashcUrNaM caturthabhAgamata evAsmin prayoge jatUkarNena “ayashcUrNapAdayuktam” iti kRutam| amarANAmamRutaM jarAdiharaM, nAgAnAM ca sudhA jarAmaraNaharI, ityubhayopAdAnaM dRuShTAnte| brahma mokShaH| mokShasAdhanatvaM ceha rasAyanasya vishuddhasattvakartRutayocyate|| 77-80||

1.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- abhayAmalakIye~asmin ShaDyogAH parikIrtitAH| rasAyanAnAM siddhAnAmAyuryairanuvartate||81||
1.commentary: abhayetyAdinA sandehanirAsArthamuktaprayogasa~gkhyAM darshayati| evamanyatrApi sa~gkhyApraNayanamante j~jeyam|| 81||

1.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH||1||
1.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH|| 1||

2.sanskrit: athAto~abhayAmalakIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
2.commentary: pUrvasthAnoktalakShaNAbhAvenAvadhAritAyuShmadbhAvena cikitsA dharmArthayashaskarI kartavyetyanantaraM cikitsAbhidhAyakaM sthAnamucyate| rasAyanavAjIkaraNasAdhanamapi yathA cikitsocyate, tathA~anantarameva vakShyati| tatrApi jvarAdicikitsAyAH prAgrasAyanavAjIkaraNayormahAphalatvenAdAvabhidhAnam| tayorapi ca rasAyanameva varShasahasrAyuShTvAdikAraNatayA mahAphalamiti tadabhidhIyate, tatrApi cAbhayAmalakIyashcikitsAsthAnArthasUtrAbhidhAyakatayA~agre~abhidhIyate||1-2||

2.sanskrit: cikitsitaM vyAdhiharaM pathyaM sAdhanamauShadham| prAyashcittaM prashamanaM prakRutisthApanaM hitam||3|| vidyAdbheShajanAmAni, ...|4|
2.commentary: tatrAdau vyavahArArthaM sthAnAbhidheyasya bheShajasya paryAyAnAha- cikitsitamityAdi| karoti caivamAdau pradhAnAbhidheyaparyAyAbhidhAnaM, yathA- nidAne heturUpAdiparyAyakathanam| etacca paryAyAbhidhAnaM prAdhAnyena catuShpAdasyaiva bheShajasya, yaduktaM- “catuShpAdaM ShoDashakalaM bheShajamiti bhiShajo bhAShante” (sU.a.10) iti| evambhUtabheShajA~ggarUpatayA tu sthAvaraja~ggamadravyarUpasya bheShajasya bheShajatvamevAntaravyavahArakRutaM j~jeyam| prAyashcittamiti bheShajasa~jj~jA prAyashcittavadbheShajasyAdharmakAryavyAdhiharatvena||3||-

2.sanskrit: ... bheShajaM dvividhaM ca tat| svasthasyorjaskaraM ki~jcit ki~jcidArtasya roganut||4||
2.commentary: dvaividhyaM vivRuNoti- svasthasyetyAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| svasthatvena vyavahriyamANasya puMso jarAdisvAbhAvikavyAdhiharatvena tathA~apraharShavyayAyakShayitvAnupacitashukratvAdyaprashastashArIrabhAvaharatvena UrjaH prashastaM bhAvamAdadhAtIti svasthasyorjaskaram| Artasya roganuditi visheShaNena jvarAdinA~a~artasya jvarAdiharam| roganuditi vacanenaivArtavisheShatAyAM labdhAyAM yat ‘Artasya’ iti karoti, tena sahajajarAdikRutAM pIDAmanudvejikAM parityajya jvarAdinA~asvAbhAvikena rogeNa pIDitasyeti darshayati||4||

2.sanskrit: abheShajaM ca dvividhaM bAdhanaM sAnubAdhanam|5|
2.commentary: bheShajaprasa~ggAdabheShajadvaividhyamAha- abheShajamityAdi| bAdhanamiha tadAtvamAtrabAdhakaM, yathA- svalpamapathyam| sAnubAdhanaM ca dIrghakAlAvasthAyikuShThAdivikArakAri||-

2.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam||5|| prAyaH, prAyeNa rogANAM dvitIyaM prashame matam| prAyaHshabdo visheShArtho hyubhayaM hyubhayArthakRut||6||
2.commentary: dvividhaM bheShajamuktaM vibhajate- svasthasyetyAdi| tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanaM prAya iti cchedaH| yadvRuShyaM prAyo bhavati, tathA rasAyanaM yat prAyo bhavati, Artasya rogaharaM yadbAhulyena, tat svasthorjaskaramucyate; yattu dvitIyamArtarogaharaM, tat prAyeNa jvarAdishamanaM rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavati; yathA- kShatakShINoktaM sarpirguDAdi rasAyanaM vRuShyaM ca bhavati, tathA pANDurogokto yogarAjo rasAyanatvenoktaH, tathA kAsAdhikAre~agastyaharItakI rasAyanatvenoktetyAdyanusaraNIyam| rasAyanoktAnAM ca jvarAdiharatvamatra suvyaktameva rasAyanagrantheShu| anye tu bruvate- yadvyAdhimAtraharaM na tadrasAyanaM, kintu sharIrasaMyogadArDhyAddIrghAyuHkartRutvasAdhAraNadharmayogAdupacaritavyAdhiharaM rasAyanamihocyata iti| nanu yadi svasthorjaskaramapi vyAdhiharaM, vyAdhiharaM ca svasthorjaskaraM tat kiM ki~jciditi padena bheShajakarmavyavasthAdarshakena kriyate? brUmaH- bAhulyena svasthorjaskaratvaM vyAdhiharatvaM ca vyavasthApyate, na ceha sarvArtarogaharasya svasthorjaskaratvamiti pratij~jAyate, yena pAThAsaptaparNAdInAmapi rasAyanatvaM sAdhanIyashaktitvAdArttarogaharatvena yaducyate tadapi rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavatIti lavamAtropadarshanaM kriyate, tat svasthArtayorubhayArthakartRutvam| prAyaHshabdatAtparyaM vivRuNoti- prAya ityAdi| visheShArtha iti bAhulyArtha ityarthaH||5-6||

2.sanskrit: dIrghamAyuH smRutiM medhAmArogyaM taruNaM vayaH| prabhAvarNasvaraudAryaM dehendriyabalaM param||7|| vAksiddhiM praNatiM kAntiM labhate nA rasAyanAt| lAbhopAyo hi shastAnAM rasAdInAM rasAyanam||8||
2.commentary: rasAyanakAryamAha- dIrghamityAdi| prabhAdInAM trayANAmaudAryaM yojanIyam| vAksiddhiH yaducyate tadavashyaM bhavatItyarthaH| praNatiH lokavandyatA| kathametadrasAyanena kriyata ityAha- lAbhetyAdi| rasAdigrahaNena smRutyAdayo~api gRuhyante||7-8||

2.sanskrit: apatyasantAnakaraM yat sadyaH sampraharShaNam| vAjIvAtibalo yena yAtyapratihataH striyaH||9|| bhavatyatipriyaH strINAM yena yenopacIyate| jIryato~apyakShayaM shukraM phalavadyena dRushyate||10|| prabhUtashAkhaH shAkhIva yena caityo yathA mahAn| bhavatyarcyo bahumataH prajAnAM subahuprajaH||11|| santAnamUlaM yeneha pretya cAnantyamashnute| yashaH shriyaM balaM puShTiM vAjIkaraNameva tat||12||
2.commentary: vAjIkaraNakAryamAha- apatyetyAdi| apatyasantAnaH apatyaparamparA, tena putrapautrakaramityarthaH; vAjIkaraNajanitAcchukrAjjAtaH putraH putrajananasamartho bhavatItyarthaH| atipriyatvaM cehopacitashukratayA nirantaravyavAyakartRutvAt; yaduktaM- “virUpamapi yoddhAraM bhRutyamicchanti pArthivAH| vyavAyavyAyataM mUrkhaM dhRuShTaM patimiva striyaH” iti| upacIyata iti puShTiM prApnoti| akShayamivAkShayam| phalavaditi garbhajanakam| caityo devatAyatanam| arcyaH arcanIyaH | AnantyamivAnantyaM; dIrghasantAnatAmityarthaH||9-12||

2.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM tvetaddvividhaM proktamauShadham| yadvyAdhinirghAtakaraM vakShyate taccikitsite||13|| cikitsitArtha etAvAn vikArANAM yadauShadham| rasAyanavidhishcAgre vAjIkaraNameva ca||14||
2.commentary: cikitsita iti jvarAdicikitsite| nanu rasAyanavAjIkaraNe api jvarAdicikitsite eva, tat kiM vishiShyocyate- ‘vakShyate taccikitsite’ ityAha- cikitsitArtha ityAdi| satyaM, rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca jvarAdivyAdhiharatvAccikitsitashabdenocyata ityarthaH| atha vyAdhiharatvAccikitsite vaktavyatvAcca rasAyanavAjIkaraNe kva nu vaktavye ityAha- rasAyanetyAdi| vidhiH vidhAnaM rasAyanAbhidhAnamityarthaH | agre iti anantaram| vAjIkaraNaM cAgre ‘abhidhAsyate’ iti sheShaH||13-14||

2.sanskrit: abheShajamiti j~jeyaM viparItaM yadauShadhAt| tadasevyaM niShevyaM tu pravakShyAmi yadauShadham||15||
2.commentary: abheShajamapi pUrvoddiShTaM vivRuNoti- abheShajamityAdi| viparItaM rogajananalakShaNArthakAri||15||

2.sanskrit: rasAyanAnAM dvividhaM prayogamRuShayo viduH| kuTIprAveshikaM caiva vAtAtapikameva ca||16|| kuTIprAveshikasyAdau vidhiH samupadekShyate| nRupavaidyadvijAtInAM sAdhUnAM puNyakarmaNAm||17|| nivAse nirbhaye shaste prApyopakaraNe pure| dishi pUrvottarasyAM ca subhUmau kArayet kuTIm||18|| vistArotsedhasampannAM trigarbhAM sUkShmalocanAm| ghanabhittimRutusukhAM suspaShTAM manasaH priyAm||19|| shabdAdInAmashastAnAmagamyaM strIvivarjitAm| iShTopakaraNopetAM sajjavaidyauShadhadvijAm ||20|| athodagayane shukle tithinakShatrapUjite| muhUrtakaraNopete prashaste kRutavApanaH||21|| dhRutismRutibalaM kRutvA shraddadhAnaH samAhitaH| vidhUya mAnasAn doShAn maitrIM bhUteShu cintayan||22|| devatAH pUjayitvA~agre dvijAtIMshca pradakShiNam| devagobrAhmaNAn kRutvA tatastAM pravishet kuTIm||23|| tasyAM saMshodhanaiH shuddhaH sukhI jAtabalaH punaH| rasAyanaM prayu~jjIta tatpravakShyAmi shodhanam||24||
2.commentary: kuTIpraveshena yat kriyate tat kuTIprAveshikam| vAtAtapasevayA~api yat kriyate tad vAtAtapikam| trigarbhAM prathamamekaM gRuhaM, tasyAbhyantare dvitIyam, evaM trigarbhAstrayo garbhA antarANi yasyAM sA; trigarbhAmiti antastriprakoShThAm| sUkShmalocanAmiti alpadvArajAlakAm| shukle shuklapakShe| sajjA vaidyAdayo yasyAM sA tathA| tithinakShatrapUjita iti shubhatithinakShatrayogAt pUjite| kRutavApana iti kRutakShauraH| mAnasAn doShAniti kAmakrodhAdIn| saMshodhanairiti vamanavirecanAsthApanashirovirecanaiH| sukhIti arogaH| jAtabala iti saMshodhanApahRutamalatayA saMsarjanAdikrameNa punarjAtabalaH| yadyapIha saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaprayogAt sarvANyeva saMshodhanAni sammatAni, tathA~apIha rasAyane visheSheNa yaugikatvAddharItakyAdiprayoga evoktaH; anye tu harItakyAdiprayogeNaiva paraM saMshodhanaM kartavyamityAhuH, saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaM punaryAvacchuddherharItakyAdiprayogasyaiva karaNaM darshayati||16-24||

2.sanskrit: harItakInAM cUrNAni saindhavAmalake guDam| vacAM viDa~ggaM rajanIM pippalIM vishvabheShajam||25|| pibeduShNAmbunA jantuH snehasvedopapAditaH| tena shuddhasharIrAya kRutasaMsarjanAya ca||26|| trirAtraM yAvakaM dadyAt pa~jcAhaM vA~api sarpiShA| saptAhaM vA purANasya yAvacchuddhestu varcasaH||27|| shuddhakoShThaM tu taM j~jAtvA rasAyanamupAcaret| vayaHprakRutisAtmyaj~jo yaugikaM yasya yadbhavet||28||
2.commentary: yAvakamiti yavAnnam| trirAtrAdivikalpatrayaM hInamadhyottamashuddhiviShayam||25-28||

2.sanskrit: harItakIM pa~jcarasAmuShNAmalavaNAM shivAm| doShAnulomanIM laghvIM vidyAddIpanapAcanIm||29|| AyuShyAM pauShTikIM dhanyAM vayasaH sthApanIM parAm| sarvarogaprashamanIM buddhIndriyabalapradAm||30|| kuShThaM gulmamudAvartaM shoShaM pANDvAmayaM madam| arshAMsi grahaNIdoShaM purANaM viShamajvaram||31|| hRudrogaM sashirorogamatIsAramarocakam| kAsaM pramehamAnAhaM plIhAnamudaraM navam||32|| kaphaprasekaM vaisvaryaM vaivarNyaM kAmalAM krimIn| shvayathuM tamakaM chardiM klaibyama~ggAvasAdanam||33|| srotovibandhAn vividhAn pralepaM hRudayorasoH| smRutibuddhipramohaM ca jayecchIghraM harItakI||34|| (ajIrNino rUkShabhujaH strImadyaviShakarshitAH| severannAbhayAmete kShuttRuShNoShNArditAshca ye)||35|| tAn guNAMstAni karmANi vidyAdAmalakIShvapi| yAnyuktAni harItakyA vIryasya tu viparyayaH||36|| atashcAmRutakalpAni vidyAt karmabhirIdRushaiH| harItakInAM shasyAni bhiShagAmalakasya ca||37||
2.commentary: yadyapi dravyAntarANi dashavarShashatAyuShkararasAyanAdhikRutAni santi, tathA~api harItakyAmalake eva rogaharatvAyuShkaratvarUpobhayadharmayogAdadhyAyAdau guNakarmabhyAmucyete; tatrApi yadyapi “AmalakaM vayaHsthApanAnAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktam, tathA~api rogaharatve harItakI prakarShavatIti kRutvA harItakyagre~abhihitA| harItakyAdiShu pa~jcarasatvAdyutpAdo~adRuShTavashAdbhUtasanniveshavisheShaprabhAvakRutaH; tena nAtropapattayaH kramante| shivAmiti kalyANakAriNIM, prashastaguNayuktatvAt| sarvarogaprashamanImiti saMyogasaMskArAdinA| sarvarogaharatvamabhidhAyApi kuShThAdihantRutvAbhidhAnaM visheSheNa kuShThAdihantRutvopadarshanArtham| pravartakatve~apyatIsAragrahaNIharatvaM vibaddhadoShapravartakatayA j~jeyaM; yaduktaM- “stokaM stokaM vibaddhaM vA sashUlaM yo~atisAryate| abhayApippalIkalkaiH sukhoShNaistaM virecayet” iti| buddhismRutipradatvamabhidhAyApi smRutibuddhipramohaharatvAbhidhAnaM tatra vishiShTashaktyupadarshanArtham| vIryasya tu viparyaya ityanenAmalakasya shItavIryatvamuktam| shasyAnIti asthirahitAni phalAni||29-37||

2.sanskrit: oShadhInAM parA bhUmirhimavA~j shailasattamaH| tasmAtphalAni tajjAni grAhayetkAlajAni tu||38|| ApUrNarasavIryANi kAle kAle yathAvidhi| AdityapavanacchAyAsalilaprINitAni ca||39|| yAnyajagdhAnyapUtIni nirvraNAnyagadAni ca| teShAM prayogaM vakShyAmi phalAnAM karma cottamam||40||
2.commentary: yadyapi “himavAnauShadhabhUmInAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktaM, tathA~api rasAyane himavatprabhavANyeva bheShajAni grAhyANIti darshayitumauShadhInAmityAdyabhidhAnam| kAle kAle iti phalapAkakAle ityarthaH| yathAvidhIti yathA bheShajagrahaNaM ma~ggaladevatArcanAdipUrvakaM syAttathA~avashyaM rasAyane karttavyam| agadAnItyanena pavanadahanAdyadoShaM phalasya darshayati||38-40||

2.sanskrit: pa~jcAnAM pa~jcamUlAnAM bhAgAn dashapalonmitAn| harItakIsahasraM ca triguNAmalakaM navam||41|| vidArigandhAM bRuhatIM pRushniparNIM nidigdhikAm| vidyAdvidArigandhAdyaM shvadaMShTrApa~jcamaM gaNam||42|| bilvAgnimanthashyonAkaM kAshmaryamatha pATalAm| punarnavAM shUrpaparNyau balAmeraNDameva ca||43|| jIvakarShabhakau medAM jIvantIM sashatAvarIm| sharekShudarbhakAshAnAM shAlInAM mUlameva ca||44|| ityeShAM pa~jcamUlAnAM pa~jcAnAmupakalpayet| bhAgAn yathoktAMstatsarvaM sAdhyaM dashaguNe~ambhasi||45|| dashabhAgAvasheShaM tu pUtaM taM grAhayedrasam| harItakIshca tAH sarvAH sarvANyAmalakAni ca||46|| tAni sarvANyanasthIni phalAnyApothya kUrcanaiH| vinIya tasminniryUhe cUrNAnImAni dApayet||47|| maNDUkaparNyAH pippalyAH sha~gkhapuShpyAH plavasya ca| mustAnAM saviDa~ggAnAM candanAguruNostathA||48|| madhukasya haridrAyA vacAyAH kanakasya ca| bhAgAMshcatuShpalAn kRutvA sUkShmailAyAstvacastathA||49|| sitopalAsahasraM ca cUrNitaM tulayA~adhikam| tailasya dvyADhakaM tatra dadyAttrINi ca sarpiShaH||50|| sAdhyamaudumbare pAtre tat sarvaM mRudunA~agninA| j~jAtvA lehyamadagdhaM ca shItaM kShaudreNa saMsRujet||51|| kShaudrapramANaM snehArdhaM tat sarvaM ghRutabhAjane| tiShThetsammUrcchitaM tasya mAtrAM kAle prayojayet||52|| yA noparundhyAdAhAramekaM mAtrA jarAM prati| ShaShTikaH payasA cAtra jIrNe bhojanamiShyate||53|| vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAstathA cAnye tapodhanAH| rasAyanamidaM prAshya babhUvuramitAyuShaH||54|| muktvA jIrNaM vapushcAgryamavApustaruNaM vayaH| vItatandrAklamashvAsA nirAta~gkAH samAhitAH||55|| medhAsmRutibalopetAshcirarAtraM tapodhanAH| brAhmaM tapo brahmacaryaM cerushcAtyantaniShThayA||56|| rasAyanamidaM brAhmamAyuShkAmaH prayojayet| dIrghamAyurvayashcAgryaM kAmAMshceShTAn samashnute||57|| (iti brAhmarasAyanam)|
2.commentary: pa~jcAnAmityAdau pratidravyaM dashapalabhAgagrahaNam , uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “iti pa~jca pa~jcamUlAni, teShAM pratidravyaM dashapalAni” iti| harItakIsahasramiti harItakIphalasahasram| shUrpaparNyau mudgamAShaparNyau| vIrA jAlandharaM shAkam| kUrcanaM jarjarIkaraNasAdhanaM shilAputrakamusalAdi| vinIyeti prakShipya| plavaH kaivartamustakam| kanakaM nAgakesharam| tvak guDatvak| audumbare iti tAmramaye| snehArdhamiti sarpistailArdham| ekam anaparAhNikamAhAram||41-57||

2.sanskrit: yathoktaguNAnAmAmalakAnAM sahasraM piShTasvedanavidhinA payasa UShmaNA susvinnamanAtapashuShkamanasthi cUrNayet| tadAmalakasahasrasvarasaparipItaM sthirApunarnavAjIvantInAgabalAbrahmasuvarcalAmaNDUkaparNIshatAvarIsha~gkhapuShpIpippalIvacAviDa~ggasvaya~gguptAmRutA- candanAgurumadhukamadhUkapuShpotpalapadmamAlatIyuvatIyUthikAcUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktaM punarnAgabalAsahasrapalasvarasaparipItamanAtapashuShkaM dviguNitasarpiShA kShaudrasarpiShA vA kShudraguDAkRutiM kRutvA shucau dRuDhe ghRutabhAvite kumbhe bhasmarAsheradhaH sthApayedantarbhUmeH pakShaM kRutarakShAvidhAnamatharvavedavidA, pakShAtyaye coddhRutya kanakarajatatAmrapravAlakAlAyasacUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktamardhakarShavRuddhyA yathoktena vidhinA prAtaH prAtaH prayu~jjAno~agnibalamabhisamIkShya, jIrNe ca ShaShTikaM payasA sasarpiShkamupasevamAno yathoktAn guNAn samashnuta iti||58|| bhavanti cAtra- idaM rasAyanaM brAhmaM maharShigaNasevitam| bhavatyarogo dIrghAyuH prayu~jjAno mahAbalaH||59|| kAntaH prajAnAM siddhArthashcandrAdityasamadyutiH| shrutaM dhArayate sattvamArShaM cAsya pravartate||60|| dharaNIdharasArashca vAyunA samavikramaH| sa bhavatyaviShaM cAsya gAtre sampadyate viSham||61|| (iti dvitIyaM brAhmarasAyanam)|
2.commentary: piShTasvedanavidhineti yathA piShTakaM toyaparipUritapAtroparidattatRuNAdisaMsthitaM svedyate, tathA tat svedanIyamityarthaH| svarasaparipItamiti svarasabhAvitam| brahmasuvarcalAdyauShadhAnyAyurvedasamutthAnIye vakShyamANAni| yuvatiH navamAlikA| aShTamo bhAgo~aShTabhAgaH| kShudraguDAkRutimiti phANitAkRutim| ardhakarShavRuddhyeti ardhakarShAtprabhRuti vardhayet| yathoktavidhineti kuTIprAveshikena vidhinA| yathoktAn guNAniti pUrvaprayogaphalashrutipaThitAn| dharaNIdharasAra iti uShTramukhavat; tena dharaNIdharAH parvatAH, teShAM sAro lauhaM, tadvatsAra ityarthaH| aviShamiti viShamavikAri||58-61||

2.sanskrit: bilvo~agnimanthaH shyonAkaH kAshmaryaH pATalirbalA| parNyashcatasraH pippalyaH shvadaMShTrA bRuhatIdvayam||62|| shRu~ggI tAmalakI drAkShA jIvantI puShkarAguru| abhayA cAmRutA RuddhirjIvakarShabhakau shaTI||63|| mustaM punarnavA medA sailA candanamutpalam| vidArI vRuShamUlAni kAkolI kAkanAsikA||64|| eShAM palonmitAn bhAgA~jchatAnyAmalakasya ca| pa~jca dadyAttadaikadhyaM jaladroNe vipAcayet||65|| j~jAtvA gatarasAnyetAnyauShadhAnyatha taM rasam| taccAmalakamuddhRutya niShkulaM tailasarpiShoH||66|| paladvAdashake bhRuShTvA dattvA cArdhatulAM bhiShak| matsyaNDikAyAH pUtAyA lehavatsAdhu sAdhayet||67|| ShaTpalaM madhunashcAtra siddhashIte pradApayet| catuShpalaM tugAkShIryAH pippalIdvipalaM tathA||68|| palamekaM nidadhyAcca tvagelApatrakesharAt| ityayaM cyavanaprAshaH paramukto rasAyanaH||69|| kAsashvAsaharashcaiva visheSheNopadishyate| kShINakShatAnAM vRuddhAnAM bAlAnAM cA~ggavardhanaH||70|| svarakShayamurorogaM hRudrogaM vAtashoNitam| pipAsAM mUtrashukrasthAn doShAMshcApyapakarShati||71|| asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta yoparundhyAnna bhojanam| asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA||72|| medhAM smRutiM kAntimanAmayatvamAyuHprakarShaM balamindriyANAm| strIShu praharShaM paramagnivRuddhiM varNaprasAdaM pavanAnulomyam||73|| rasAyanasyAsya naraH prayogAllabheta jIrNo~api kuTIpraveshAt| jarAkRutaM rUpamapAsya sarvaM bibharti rUpaM navayauvanasya||74|| (iti cyavanaprAshaH)|
2.commentary: parNyashcatasra iti shAlaparNI, pRushniparNI, mudgaparNI, mAShaparNI ca| tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI| kAkanAsA nAsAphalA, ‘kAkatuNDaka’ ityanye| gatarasatvamiha dravyANAM caturbhAgasthitajale bhavati| niShkulamiti nirasthi| tailasarpiShoriti samAsanirdeshAdubhAbhyAmeva dvAdashapalAni, na pRuthak pRuthak| matsyaNDikA khaNDasaMhatiH| atra ShaTpalatvena samayorapi madhusarpiShordravyAntarayuktatvenAviruddhatvam||62-74||

2.sanskrit: athAmalakaharItakInAmAmalakabibhItakAnAM harItakIbibhItakAnAmAmalakaharItakIbibhItakAnAM vA palAshatvagavanaddhAnAM mRudA~avaliptAnAM kukUlasvinnAnAmakulakAnAM palasahasramulUkhale sampothya dadhighRutamadhupalalatailasharkarAsaMyuktaM bhakShayedanannabhugyathoktena vidhinA; tasyAnte yavAgvAdibhiH pratyavasthApanam , abhya~ggotsAdanaM sarpiShA yavacUrNaishca, ayaM ca rasAyanaprayogaprakarSho dvistAvadagnibalamabhisamIkShya , pratibhojanaM yUSheNa payasA vA ShaShTikaH sasarpiShkaH, ataH paraM yathAsukhavihAraH kAmabhakShyaH syAt| anena prayogeNarShayaH punaryuvatvamavApurbabhUvushcAnekavarShashatajIvino nirvikArAH paraM sharIrabuddhIndriyabalasamuditAshcerushcAtyantaniShThayA tapaH||75|| (iti caturthAmalakarasAyanam)|
2.commentary: kukUlakaH karIShAgniH| akulakAnAmiti anasthnAm| dravyAdInAmatra mAnaM noktaM, tena pradhAnasya cUrNasya dadhyAdibhirmilitaiH samAnamAnatvaM; kiMvA pratyekameva dadhyAdInAM cUrNasamatvam| palalaM tilacUrNam| bhakShayediti vacanaM lehye~api alpAbhyavaharaNamAtrArthatvAdupapannam| anannabhugiti sarvathA~a~ahArAntarAbhuk| tasyAnta iti etatprayogaparityAgakAle| pratyavasthApanamiti yavAgvAdikramavisheShaNaM; tena prayogAnte yadA annasaMsarjanaM kartavyaM, tadA yavAgvAdikrameNetyuktasyArthasya pratyavasthApanaM kriyata ityarthaH| yUSheNa payasA veti vikalpo~agnibalApekShayA||75||

2.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakapa~jcapa~jcamUlaniryUhe pippalImadhukamadhUkakAkolIkShIrakAkolyAtmaguptAjIvakarShabhakakShIrashuklAkalkasamprayuktena vidArIsvarasena kShIrAShTaguNasamprayuktena ca sarpiShaH kumbhaM sAdhayitvA prayu~jjAno~agnibalasamAM mAtrAM jIrNe ca kShIrasarpirbhyAM shAliShaShTikamuShNodakAnupAnamashna~jjarAvyAdhipApAbhicAravyapagatabhayaH sharIrendriyabuddhibalamatulamupalabhyApratihatasarvArambhaH paramAyuranavApnuyAt||76|| (iti pa~jcamo harItakIyogaH)|
2.commentary: atra harItakyAdau kShIrashuklA kShIravidArikA| atra harItakyAdikvAthasya tveko bhAgaH, kShIrasyAShTau bhAgAH, sarpiSha eko bhAgaH| kumbho droNadvayam| vacanaM hi- “droNastu dviguNaH sUrpo vij~jeyaH kumbha eva ca” iti||76||

2.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakaharidrAsthirAbalAviDa~ggAmRutavallIvishvabheShajamadhukapippalIsomavalkasiddhena kShIrasarpiShA madhusharkarAbhyAmapi ca sannIyAmalakasvarasashataparipItamAmalakacUrNamayashcUrNacaturbhAgasamprayuktaM pANitalamAtraM prAtaH prAtaH prAshya yathoktena vidhinA sAyaM mudgayUSheNa payasA vA sasarpiShkaM shAliShaShTikAnnamashnIyAt, trivarShaprayogAdasya varShashatamajaraM vayastiShThati, shrutamavatiShThate, sarvAmayAH prashAmyanti, viShamaviShaM bhavati gAtre, gAtramashmavat sthirIbhavati, adhRuShyo bhUtAnAM bhavati||77|| bhavanti cAtra- yathA~amarANAmamRutaM yathA bhogavatAM sudhA| tathA~abhavanmaharShINAM rasAyanavidhiH purA||78|| na jarAM na ca daurbalyaM nAturyaM nidhanaM na ca| jagmurvarShasahasrANi rasAyanaparAH purA||79|| na kevalaM dIrghamihAyurashnute rasAyanaM yo vidhivanniShevate| gatiM sa devarShiniShevitAM shubhAM prapadyate brahma tatheti cAkShayam ||80||
2.commentary: amRutavallI guDUcI| somavalkaH viTkhadiraH| kShIrasarpiH kShIrasamutthitasarpiH| ayashcUrNasya caturtho bhAgaH, yata etadayashcUrNaM caturthabhAgamata evAsmin prayoge jatUkarNena “ayashcUrNapAdayuktam” iti kRutam| amarANAmamRutaM jarAdiharaM, nAgAnAM ca sudhA jarAmaraNaharI, ityubhayopAdAnaM dRuShTAnte| brahma mokShaH| mokShasAdhanatvaM ceha rasAyanasya vishuddhasattvakartRutayocyate|| 77-80||

2.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- abhayAmalakIye~asmin ShaDyogAH parikIrtitAH| rasAyanAnAM siddhAnAmAyuryairanuvartate||81||
2.commentary: abhayetyAdinA sandehanirAsArthamuktaprayogasa~gkhyAM darshayati| evamanyatrApi sa~gkhyApraNayanamante j~jeyam|| 81||

2.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH||1||
2.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH|| 1||

3.sanskrit: athAto~abhayAmalakIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
3.commentary: pUrvasthAnoktalakShaNAbhAvenAvadhAritAyuShmadbhAvena cikitsA dharmArthayashaskarI kartavyetyanantaraM cikitsAbhidhAyakaM sthAnamucyate| rasAyanavAjIkaraNasAdhanamapi yathA cikitsocyate, tathA~anantarameva vakShyati| tatrApi jvarAdicikitsAyAH prAgrasAyanavAjIkaraNayormahAphalatvenAdAvabhidhAnam| tayorapi ca rasAyanameva varShasahasrAyuShTvAdikAraNatayA mahAphalamiti tadabhidhIyate, tatrApi cAbhayAmalakIyashcikitsAsthAnArthasUtrAbhidhAyakatayA~agre~abhidhIyate||1-2||

3.sanskrit: cikitsitaM vyAdhiharaM pathyaM sAdhanamauShadham| prAyashcittaM prashamanaM prakRutisthApanaM hitam||3|| vidyAdbheShajanAmAni, ...|4|
3.commentary: tatrAdau vyavahArArthaM sthAnAbhidheyasya bheShajasya paryAyAnAha- cikitsitamityAdi| karoti caivamAdau pradhAnAbhidheyaparyAyAbhidhAnaM, yathA- nidAne heturUpAdiparyAyakathanam| etacca paryAyAbhidhAnaM prAdhAnyena catuShpAdasyaiva bheShajasya, yaduktaM- “catuShpAdaM ShoDashakalaM bheShajamiti bhiShajo bhAShante” (sU.a.10) iti| evambhUtabheShajA~ggarUpatayA tu sthAvaraja~ggamadravyarUpasya bheShajasya bheShajatvamevAntaravyavahArakRutaM j~jeyam| prAyashcittamiti bheShajasa~jj~jA prAyashcittavadbheShajasyAdharmakAryavyAdhiharatvena||3||-

3.sanskrit: ... bheShajaM dvividhaM ca tat| svasthasyorjaskaraM ki~jcit ki~jcidArtasya roganut||4||
3.commentary: dvaividhyaM vivRuNoti- svasthasyetyAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| svasthatvena vyavahriyamANasya puMso jarAdisvAbhAvikavyAdhiharatvena tathA~apraharShavyayAyakShayitvAnupacitashukratvAdyaprashastashArIrabhAvaharatvena UrjaH prashastaM bhAvamAdadhAtIti svasthasyorjaskaram| Artasya roganuditi visheShaNena jvarAdinA~a~artasya jvarAdiharam| roganuditi vacanenaivArtavisheShatAyAM labdhAyAM yat ‘Artasya’ iti karoti, tena sahajajarAdikRutAM pIDAmanudvejikAM parityajya jvarAdinA~asvAbhAvikena rogeNa pIDitasyeti darshayati||4||

3.sanskrit: abheShajaM ca dvividhaM bAdhanaM sAnubAdhanam|5|
3.commentary: bheShajaprasa~ggAdabheShajadvaividhyamAha- abheShajamityAdi| bAdhanamiha tadAtvamAtrabAdhakaM, yathA- svalpamapathyam| sAnubAdhanaM ca dIrghakAlAvasthAyikuShThAdivikArakAri||-

3.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam||5|| prAyaH, prAyeNa rogANAM dvitIyaM prashame matam| prAyaHshabdo visheShArtho hyubhayaM hyubhayArthakRut||6||
3.commentary: dvividhaM bheShajamuktaM vibhajate- svasthasyetyAdi| tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanaM prAya iti cchedaH| yadvRuShyaM prAyo bhavati, tathA rasAyanaM yat prAyo bhavati, Artasya rogaharaM yadbAhulyena, tat svasthorjaskaramucyate; yattu dvitIyamArtarogaharaM, tat prAyeNa jvarAdishamanaM rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavati; yathA- kShatakShINoktaM sarpirguDAdi rasAyanaM vRuShyaM ca bhavati, tathA pANDurogokto yogarAjo rasAyanatvenoktaH, tathA kAsAdhikAre~agastyaharItakI rasAyanatvenoktetyAdyanusaraNIyam| rasAyanoktAnAM ca jvarAdiharatvamatra suvyaktameva rasAyanagrantheShu| anye tu bruvate- yadvyAdhimAtraharaM na tadrasAyanaM, kintu sharIrasaMyogadArDhyAddIrghAyuHkartRutvasAdhAraNadharmayogAdupacaritavyAdhiharaM rasAyanamihocyata iti| nanu yadi svasthorjaskaramapi vyAdhiharaM, vyAdhiharaM ca svasthorjaskaraM tat kiM ki~jciditi padena bheShajakarmavyavasthAdarshakena kriyate? brUmaH- bAhulyena svasthorjaskaratvaM vyAdhiharatvaM ca vyavasthApyate, na ceha sarvArtarogaharasya svasthorjaskaratvamiti pratij~jAyate, yena pAThAsaptaparNAdInAmapi rasAyanatvaM sAdhanIyashaktitvAdArttarogaharatvena yaducyate tadapi rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavatIti lavamAtropadarshanaM kriyate, tat svasthArtayorubhayArthakartRutvam| prAyaHshabdatAtparyaM vivRuNoti- prAya ityAdi| visheShArtha iti bAhulyArtha ityarthaH||5-6||

3.sanskrit: dIrghamAyuH smRutiM medhAmArogyaM taruNaM vayaH| prabhAvarNasvaraudAryaM dehendriyabalaM param||7|| vAksiddhiM praNatiM kAntiM labhate nA rasAyanAt| lAbhopAyo hi shastAnAM rasAdInAM rasAyanam||8||
3.commentary: rasAyanakAryamAha- dIrghamityAdi| prabhAdInAM trayANAmaudAryaM yojanIyam| vAksiddhiH yaducyate tadavashyaM bhavatItyarthaH| praNatiH lokavandyatA| kathametadrasAyanena kriyata ityAha- lAbhetyAdi| rasAdigrahaNena smRutyAdayo~api gRuhyante||7-8||

3.sanskrit: apatyasantAnakaraM yat sadyaH sampraharShaNam| vAjIvAtibalo yena yAtyapratihataH striyaH||9|| bhavatyatipriyaH strINAM yena yenopacIyate| jIryato~apyakShayaM shukraM phalavadyena dRushyate||10|| prabhUtashAkhaH shAkhIva yena caityo yathA mahAn| bhavatyarcyo bahumataH prajAnAM subahuprajaH||11|| santAnamUlaM yeneha pretya cAnantyamashnute| yashaH shriyaM balaM puShTiM vAjIkaraNameva tat||12||
3.commentary: vAjIkaraNakAryamAha- apatyetyAdi| apatyasantAnaH apatyaparamparA, tena putrapautrakaramityarthaH; vAjIkaraNajanitAcchukrAjjAtaH putraH putrajananasamartho bhavatItyarthaH| atipriyatvaM cehopacitashukratayA nirantaravyavAyakartRutvAt; yaduktaM- “virUpamapi yoddhAraM bhRutyamicchanti pArthivAH| vyavAyavyAyataM mUrkhaM dhRuShTaM patimiva striyaH” iti| upacIyata iti puShTiM prApnoti| akShayamivAkShayam| phalavaditi garbhajanakam| caityo devatAyatanam| arcyaH arcanIyaH | AnantyamivAnantyaM; dIrghasantAnatAmityarthaH||9-12||

3.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM tvetaddvividhaM proktamauShadham| yadvyAdhinirghAtakaraM vakShyate taccikitsite||13|| cikitsitArtha etAvAn vikArANAM yadauShadham| rasAyanavidhishcAgre vAjIkaraNameva ca||14||
3.commentary: cikitsita iti jvarAdicikitsite| nanu rasAyanavAjIkaraNe api jvarAdicikitsite eva, tat kiM vishiShyocyate- ‘vakShyate taccikitsite’ ityAha- cikitsitArtha ityAdi| satyaM, rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca jvarAdivyAdhiharatvAccikitsitashabdenocyata ityarthaH| atha vyAdhiharatvAccikitsite vaktavyatvAcca rasAyanavAjIkaraNe kva nu vaktavye ityAha- rasAyanetyAdi| vidhiH vidhAnaM rasAyanAbhidhAnamityarthaH | agre iti anantaram| vAjIkaraNaM cAgre ‘abhidhAsyate’ iti sheShaH||13-14||

3.sanskrit: abheShajamiti j~jeyaM viparItaM yadauShadhAt| tadasevyaM niShevyaM tu pravakShyAmi yadauShadham||15||
3.commentary: abheShajamapi pUrvoddiShTaM vivRuNoti- abheShajamityAdi| viparItaM rogajananalakShaNArthakAri||15||

3.sanskrit: rasAyanAnAM dvividhaM prayogamRuShayo viduH| kuTIprAveshikaM caiva vAtAtapikameva ca||16|| kuTIprAveshikasyAdau vidhiH samupadekShyate| nRupavaidyadvijAtInAM sAdhUnAM puNyakarmaNAm||17|| nivAse nirbhaye shaste prApyopakaraNe pure| dishi pUrvottarasyAM ca subhUmau kArayet kuTIm||18|| vistArotsedhasampannAM trigarbhAM sUkShmalocanAm| ghanabhittimRutusukhAM suspaShTAM manasaH priyAm||19|| shabdAdInAmashastAnAmagamyaM strIvivarjitAm| iShTopakaraNopetAM sajjavaidyauShadhadvijAm ||20|| athodagayane shukle tithinakShatrapUjite| muhUrtakaraNopete prashaste kRutavApanaH||21|| dhRutismRutibalaM kRutvA shraddadhAnaH samAhitaH| vidhUya mAnasAn doShAn maitrIM bhUteShu cintayan||22|| devatAH pUjayitvA~agre dvijAtIMshca pradakShiNam| devagobrAhmaNAn kRutvA tatastAM pravishet kuTIm||23|| tasyAM saMshodhanaiH shuddhaH sukhI jAtabalaH punaH| rasAyanaM prayu~jjIta tatpravakShyAmi shodhanam||24||
3.commentary: kuTIpraveshena yat kriyate tat kuTIprAveshikam| vAtAtapasevayA~api yat kriyate tad vAtAtapikam| trigarbhAM prathamamekaM gRuhaM, tasyAbhyantare dvitIyam, evaM trigarbhAstrayo garbhA antarANi yasyAM sA; trigarbhAmiti antastriprakoShThAm| sUkShmalocanAmiti alpadvArajAlakAm| shukle shuklapakShe| sajjA vaidyAdayo yasyAM sA tathA| tithinakShatrapUjita iti shubhatithinakShatrayogAt pUjite| kRutavApana iti kRutakShauraH| mAnasAn doShAniti kAmakrodhAdIn| saMshodhanairiti vamanavirecanAsthApanashirovirecanaiH| sukhIti arogaH| jAtabala iti saMshodhanApahRutamalatayA saMsarjanAdikrameNa punarjAtabalaH| yadyapIha saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaprayogAt sarvANyeva saMshodhanAni sammatAni, tathA~apIha rasAyane visheSheNa yaugikatvAddharItakyAdiprayoga evoktaH; anye tu harItakyAdiprayogeNaiva paraM saMshodhanaM kartavyamityAhuH, saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaM punaryAvacchuddherharItakyAdiprayogasyaiva karaNaM darshayati||16-24||

3.sanskrit: harItakInAM cUrNAni saindhavAmalake guDam| vacAM viDa~ggaM rajanIM pippalIM vishvabheShajam||25|| pibeduShNAmbunA jantuH snehasvedopapAditaH| tena shuddhasharIrAya kRutasaMsarjanAya ca||26|| trirAtraM yAvakaM dadyAt pa~jcAhaM vA~api sarpiShA| saptAhaM vA purANasya yAvacchuddhestu varcasaH||27|| shuddhakoShThaM tu taM j~jAtvA rasAyanamupAcaret| vayaHprakRutisAtmyaj~jo yaugikaM yasya yadbhavet||28||
3.commentary: yAvakamiti yavAnnam| trirAtrAdivikalpatrayaM hInamadhyottamashuddhiviShayam||25-28||

3.sanskrit: harItakIM pa~jcarasAmuShNAmalavaNAM shivAm| doShAnulomanIM laghvIM vidyAddIpanapAcanIm||29|| AyuShyAM pauShTikIM dhanyAM vayasaH sthApanIM parAm| sarvarogaprashamanIM buddhIndriyabalapradAm||30|| kuShThaM gulmamudAvartaM shoShaM pANDvAmayaM madam| arshAMsi grahaNIdoShaM purANaM viShamajvaram||31|| hRudrogaM sashirorogamatIsAramarocakam| kAsaM pramehamAnAhaM plIhAnamudaraM navam||32|| kaphaprasekaM vaisvaryaM vaivarNyaM kAmalAM krimIn| shvayathuM tamakaM chardiM klaibyama~ggAvasAdanam||33|| srotovibandhAn vividhAn pralepaM hRudayorasoH| smRutibuddhipramohaM ca jayecchIghraM harItakI||34|| (ajIrNino rUkShabhujaH strImadyaviShakarshitAH| severannAbhayAmete kShuttRuShNoShNArditAshca ye)||35|| tAn guNAMstAni karmANi vidyAdAmalakIShvapi| yAnyuktAni harItakyA vIryasya tu viparyayaH||36|| atashcAmRutakalpAni vidyAt karmabhirIdRushaiH| harItakInAM shasyAni bhiShagAmalakasya ca||37||
3.commentary: yadyapi dravyAntarANi dashavarShashatAyuShkararasAyanAdhikRutAni santi, tathA~api harItakyAmalake eva rogaharatvAyuShkaratvarUpobhayadharmayogAdadhyAyAdau guNakarmabhyAmucyete; tatrApi yadyapi “AmalakaM vayaHsthApanAnAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktam, tathA~api rogaharatve harItakI prakarShavatIti kRutvA harItakyagre~abhihitA| harItakyAdiShu pa~jcarasatvAdyutpAdo~adRuShTavashAdbhUtasanniveshavisheShaprabhAvakRutaH; tena nAtropapattayaH kramante| shivAmiti kalyANakAriNIM, prashastaguNayuktatvAt| sarvarogaprashamanImiti saMyogasaMskArAdinA| sarvarogaharatvamabhidhAyApi kuShThAdihantRutvAbhidhAnaM visheSheNa kuShThAdihantRutvopadarshanArtham| pravartakatve~apyatIsAragrahaNIharatvaM vibaddhadoShapravartakatayA j~jeyaM; yaduktaM- “stokaM stokaM vibaddhaM vA sashUlaM yo~atisAryate| abhayApippalIkalkaiH sukhoShNaistaM virecayet” iti| buddhismRutipradatvamabhidhAyApi smRutibuddhipramohaharatvAbhidhAnaM tatra vishiShTashaktyupadarshanArtham| vIryasya tu viparyaya ityanenAmalakasya shItavIryatvamuktam| shasyAnIti asthirahitAni phalAni||29-37||

3.sanskrit: oShadhInAM parA bhUmirhimavA~j shailasattamaH| tasmAtphalAni tajjAni grAhayetkAlajAni tu||38|| ApUrNarasavIryANi kAle kAle yathAvidhi| AdityapavanacchAyAsalilaprINitAni ca||39|| yAnyajagdhAnyapUtIni nirvraNAnyagadAni ca| teShAM prayogaM vakShyAmi phalAnAM karma cottamam||40||
3.commentary: yadyapi “himavAnauShadhabhUmInAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktaM, tathA~api rasAyane himavatprabhavANyeva bheShajAni grAhyANIti darshayitumauShadhInAmityAdyabhidhAnam| kAle kAle iti phalapAkakAle ityarthaH| yathAvidhIti yathA bheShajagrahaNaM ma~ggaladevatArcanAdipUrvakaM syAttathA~avashyaM rasAyane karttavyam| agadAnItyanena pavanadahanAdyadoShaM phalasya darshayati||38-40||

3.sanskrit: pa~jcAnAM pa~jcamUlAnAM bhAgAn dashapalonmitAn| harItakIsahasraM ca triguNAmalakaM navam||41|| vidArigandhAM bRuhatIM pRushniparNIM nidigdhikAm| vidyAdvidArigandhAdyaM shvadaMShTrApa~jcamaM gaNam||42|| bilvAgnimanthashyonAkaM kAshmaryamatha pATalAm| punarnavAM shUrpaparNyau balAmeraNDameva ca||43|| jIvakarShabhakau medAM jIvantIM sashatAvarIm| sharekShudarbhakAshAnAM shAlInAM mUlameva ca||44|| ityeShAM pa~jcamUlAnAM pa~jcAnAmupakalpayet| bhAgAn yathoktAMstatsarvaM sAdhyaM dashaguNe~ambhasi||45|| dashabhAgAvasheShaM tu pUtaM taM grAhayedrasam| harItakIshca tAH sarvAH sarvANyAmalakAni ca||46|| tAni sarvANyanasthIni phalAnyApothya kUrcanaiH| vinIya tasminniryUhe cUrNAnImAni dApayet||47|| maNDUkaparNyAH pippalyAH sha~gkhapuShpyAH plavasya ca| mustAnAM saviDa~ggAnAM candanAguruNostathA||48|| madhukasya haridrAyA vacAyAH kanakasya ca| bhAgAMshcatuShpalAn kRutvA sUkShmailAyAstvacastathA||49|| sitopalAsahasraM ca cUrNitaM tulayA~adhikam| tailasya dvyADhakaM tatra dadyAttrINi ca sarpiShaH||50|| sAdhyamaudumbare pAtre tat sarvaM mRudunA~agninA| j~jAtvA lehyamadagdhaM ca shItaM kShaudreNa saMsRujet||51|| kShaudrapramANaM snehArdhaM tat sarvaM ghRutabhAjane| tiShThetsammUrcchitaM tasya mAtrAM kAle prayojayet||52|| yA noparundhyAdAhAramekaM mAtrA jarAM prati| ShaShTikaH payasA cAtra jIrNe bhojanamiShyate||53|| vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAstathA cAnye tapodhanAH| rasAyanamidaM prAshya babhUvuramitAyuShaH||54|| muktvA jIrNaM vapushcAgryamavApustaruNaM vayaH| vItatandrAklamashvAsA nirAta~gkAH samAhitAH||55|| medhAsmRutibalopetAshcirarAtraM tapodhanAH| brAhmaM tapo brahmacaryaM cerushcAtyantaniShThayA||56|| rasAyanamidaM brAhmamAyuShkAmaH prayojayet| dIrghamAyurvayashcAgryaM kAmAMshceShTAn samashnute||57|| (iti brAhmarasAyanam)|
3.commentary: pa~jcAnAmityAdau pratidravyaM dashapalabhAgagrahaNam , uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “iti pa~jca pa~jcamUlAni, teShAM pratidravyaM dashapalAni” iti| harItakIsahasramiti harItakIphalasahasram| shUrpaparNyau mudgamAShaparNyau| vIrA jAlandharaM shAkam| kUrcanaM jarjarIkaraNasAdhanaM shilAputrakamusalAdi| vinIyeti prakShipya| plavaH kaivartamustakam| kanakaM nAgakesharam| tvak guDatvak| audumbare iti tAmramaye| snehArdhamiti sarpistailArdham| ekam anaparAhNikamAhAram||41-57||

3.sanskrit: yathoktaguNAnAmAmalakAnAM sahasraM piShTasvedanavidhinA payasa UShmaNA susvinnamanAtapashuShkamanasthi cUrNayet| tadAmalakasahasrasvarasaparipItaM sthirApunarnavAjIvantInAgabalAbrahmasuvarcalAmaNDUkaparNIshatAvarIsha~gkhapuShpIpippalIvacAviDa~ggasvaya~gguptAmRutA- candanAgurumadhukamadhUkapuShpotpalapadmamAlatIyuvatIyUthikAcUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktaM punarnAgabalAsahasrapalasvarasaparipItamanAtapashuShkaM dviguNitasarpiShA kShaudrasarpiShA vA kShudraguDAkRutiM kRutvA shucau dRuDhe ghRutabhAvite kumbhe bhasmarAsheradhaH sthApayedantarbhUmeH pakShaM kRutarakShAvidhAnamatharvavedavidA, pakShAtyaye coddhRutya kanakarajatatAmrapravAlakAlAyasacUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktamardhakarShavRuddhyA yathoktena vidhinA prAtaH prAtaH prayu~jjAno~agnibalamabhisamIkShya, jIrNe ca ShaShTikaM payasA sasarpiShkamupasevamAno yathoktAn guNAn samashnuta iti||58|| bhavanti cAtra- idaM rasAyanaM brAhmaM maharShigaNasevitam| bhavatyarogo dIrghAyuH prayu~jjAno mahAbalaH||59|| kAntaH prajAnAM siddhArthashcandrAdityasamadyutiH| shrutaM dhArayate sattvamArShaM cAsya pravartate||60|| dharaNIdharasArashca vAyunA samavikramaH| sa bhavatyaviShaM cAsya gAtre sampadyate viSham||61|| (iti dvitIyaM brAhmarasAyanam)|
3.commentary: piShTasvedanavidhineti yathA piShTakaM toyaparipUritapAtroparidattatRuNAdisaMsthitaM svedyate, tathA tat svedanIyamityarthaH| svarasaparipItamiti svarasabhAvitam| brahmasuvarcalAdyauShadhAnyAyurvedasamutthAnIye vakShyamANAni| yuvatiH navamAlikA| aShTamo bhAgo~aShTabhAgaH| kShudraguDAkRutimiti phANitAkRutim| ardhakarShavRuddhyeti ardhakarShAtprabhRuti vardhayet| yathoktavidhineti kuTIprAveshikena vidhinA| yathoktAn guNAniti pUrvaprayogaphalashrutipaThitAn| dharaNIdharasAra iti uShTramukhavat; tena dharaNIdharAH parvatAH, teShAM sAro lauhaM, tadvatsAra ityarthaH| aviShamiti viShamavikAri||58-61||

3.sanskrit: bilvo~agnimanthaH shyonAkaH kAshmaryaH pATalirbalA| parNyashcatasraH pippalyaH shvadaMShTrA bRuhatIdvayam||62|| shRu~ggI tAmalakI drAkShA jIvantI puShkarAguru| abhayA cAmRutA RuddhirjIvakarShabhakau shaTI||63|| mustaM punarnavA medA sailA candanamutpalam| vidArI vRuShamUlAni kAkolI kAkanAsikA||64|| eShAM palonmitAn bhAgA~jchatAnyAmalakasya ca| pa~jca dadyAttadaikadhyaM jaladroNe vipAcayet||65|| j~jAtvA gatarasAnyetAnyauShadhAnyatha taM rasam| taccAmalakamuddhRutya niShkulaM tailasarpiShoH||66|| paladvAdashake bhRuShTvA dattvA cArdhatulAM bhiShak| matsyaNDikAyAH pUtAyA lehavatsAdhu sAdhayet||67|| ShaTpalaM madhunashcAtra siddhashIte pradApayet| catuShpalaM tugAkShIryAH pippalIdvipalaM tathA||68|| palamekaM nidadhyAcca tvagelApatrakesharAt| ityayaM cyavanaprAshaH paramukto rasAyanaH||69|| kAsashvAsaharashcaiva visheSheNopadishyate| kShINakShatAnAM vRuddhAnAM bAlAnAM cA~ggavardhanaH||70|| svarakShayamurorogaM hRudrogaM vAtashoNitam| pipAsAM mUtrashukrasthAn doShAMshcApyapakarShati||71|| asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta yoparundhyAnna bhojanam| asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA||72|| medhAM smRutiM kAntimanAmayatvamAyuHprakarShaM balamindriyANAm| strIShu praharShaM paramagnivRuddhiM varNaprasAdaM pavanAnulomyam||73|| rasAyanasyAsya naraH prayogAllabheta jIrNo~api kuTIpraveshAt| jarAkRutaM rUpamapAsya sarvaM bibharti rUpaM navayauvanasya||74|| (iti cyavanaprAshaH)|
3.commentary: parNyashcatasra iti shAlaparNI, pRushniparNI, mudgaparNI, mAShaparNI ca| tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI| kAkanAsA nAsAphalA, ‘kAkatuNDaka’ ityanye| gatarasatvamiha dravyANAM caturbhAgasthitajale bhavati| niShkulamiti nirasthi| tailasarpiShoriti samAsanirdeshAdubhAbhyAmeva dvAdashapalAni, na pRuthak pRuthak| matsyaNDikA khaNDasaMhatiH| atra ShaTpalatvena samayorapi madhusarpiShordravyAntarayuktatvenAviruddhatvam||62-74||

3.sanskrit: athAmalakaharItakInAmAmalakabibhItakAnAM harItakIbibhItakAnAmAmalakaharItakIbibhItakAnAM vA palAshatvagavanaddhAnAM mRudA~avaliptAnAM kukUlasvinnAnAmakulakAnAM palasahasramulUkhale sampothya dadhighRutamadhupalalatailasharkarAsaMyuktaM bhakShayedanannabhugyathoktena vidhinA; tasyAnte yavAgvAdibhiH pratyavasthApanam , abhya~ggotsAdanaM sarpiShA yavacUrNaishca, ayaM ca rasAyanaprayogaprakarSho dvistAvadagnibalamabhisamIkShya , pratibhojanaM yUSheNa payasA vA ShaShTikaH sasarpiShkaH, ataH paraM yathAsukhavihAraH kAmabhakShyaH syAt| anena prayogeNarShayaH punaryuvatvamavApurbabhUvushcAnekavarShashatajIvino nirvikArAH paraM sharIrabuddhIndriyabalasamuditAshcerushcAtyantaniShThayA tapaH||75|| (iti caturthAmalakarasAyanam)|
3.commentary: kukUlakaH karIShAgniH| akulakAnAmiti anasthnAm| dravyAdInAmatra mAnaM noktaM, tena pradhAnasya cUrNasya dadhyAdibhirmilitaiH samAnamAnatvaM; kiMvA pratyekameva dadhyAdInAM cUrNasamatvam| palalaM tilacUrNam| bhakShayediti vacanaM lehye~api alpAbhyavaharaNamAtrArthatvAdupapannam| anannabhugiti sarvathA~a~ahArAntarAbhuk| tasyAnta iti etatprayogaparityAgakAle| pratyavasthApanamiti yavAgvAdikramavisheShaNaM; tena prayogAnte yadA annasaMsarjanaM kartavyaM, tadA yavAgvAdikrameNetyuktasyArthasya pratyavasthApanaM kriyata ityarthaH| yUSheNa payasA veti vikalpo~agnibalApekShayA||75||

3.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakapa~jcapa~jcamUlaniryUhe pippalImadhukamadhUkakAkolIkShIrakAkolyAtmaguptAjIvakarShabhakakShIrashuklAkalkasamprayuktena vidArIsvarasena kShIrAShTaguNasamprayuktena ca sarpiShaH kumbhaM sAdhayitvA prayu~jjAno~agnibalasamAM mAtrAM jIrNe ca kShIrasarpirbhyAM shAliShaShTikamuShNodakAnupAnamashna~jjarAvyAdhipApAbhicAravyapagatabhayaH sharIrendriyabuddhibalamatulamupalabhyApratihatasarvArambhaH paramAyuranavApnuyAt||76|| (iti pa~jcamo harItakIyogaH)|
3.commentary: atra harItakyAdau kShIrashuklA kShIravidArikA| atra harItakyAdikvAthasya tveko bhAgaH, kShIrasyAShTau bhAgAH, sarpiSha eko bhAgaH| kumbho droNadvayam| vacanaM hi- “droNastu dviguNaH sUrpo vij~jeyaH kumbha eva ca” iti||76||

3.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakaharidrAsthirAbalAviDa~ggAmRutavallIvishvabheShajamadhukapippalIsomavalkasiddhena kShIrasarpiShA madhusharkarAbhyAmapi ca sannIyAmalakasvarasashataparipItamAmalakacUrNamayashcUrNacaturbhAgasamprayuktaM pANitalamAtraM prAtaH prAtaH prAshya yathoktena vidhinA sAyaM mudgayUSheNa payasA vA sasarpiShkaM shAliShaShTikAnnamashnIyAt, trivarShaprayogAdasya varShashatamajaraM vayastiShThati, shrutamavatiShThate, sarvAmayAH prashAmyanti, viShamaviShaM bhavati gAtre, gAtramashmavat sthirIbhavati, adhRuShyo bhUtAnAM bhavati||77|| bhavanti cAtra- yathA~amarANAmamRutaM yathA bhogavatAM sudhA| tathA~abhavanmaharShINAM rasAyanavidhiH purA||78|| na jarAM na ca daurbalyaM nAturyaM nidhanaM na ca| jagmurvarShasahasrANi rasAyanaparAH purA||79|| na kevalaM dIrghamihAyurashnute rasAyanaM yo vidhivanniShevate| gatiM sa devarShiniShevitAM shubhAM prapadyate brahma tatheti cAkShayam ||80||
3.commentary: amRutavallI guDUcI| somavalkaH viTkhadiraH| kShIrasarpiH kShIrasamutthitasarpiH| ayashcUrNasya caturtho bhAgaH, yata etadayashcUrNaM caturthabhAgamata evAsmin prayoge jatUkarNena “ayashcUrNapAdayuktam” iti kRutam| amarANAmamRutaM jarAdiharaM, nAgAnAM ca sudhA jarAmaraNaharI, ityubhayopAdAnaM dRuShTAnte| brahma mokShaH| mokShasAdhanatvaM ceha rasAyanasya vishuddhasattvakartRutayocyate|| 77-80||

3.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- abhayAmalakIye~asmin ShaDyogAH parikIrtitAH| rasAyanAnAM siddhAnAmAyuryairanuvartate||81||
3.commentary: abhayetyAdinA sandehanirAsArthamuktaprayogasa~gkhyAM darshayati| evamanyatrApi sa~gkhyApraNayanamante j~jeyam|| 81||

3.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH||1||
3.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH|| 1||

4.sanskrit: athAto~abhayAmalakIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
4.commentary: pUrvasthAnoktalakShaNAbhAvenAvadhAritAyuShmadbhAvena cikitsA dharmArthayashaskarI kartavyetyanantaraM cikitsAbhidhAyakaM sthAnamucyate| rasAyanavAjIkaraNasAdhanamapi yathA cikitsocyate, tathA~anantarameva vakShyati| tatrApi jvarAdicikitsAyAH prAgrasAyanavAjIkaraNayormahAphalatvenAdAvabhidhAnam| tayorapi ca rasAyanameva varShasahasrAyuShTvAdikAraNatayA mahAphalamiti tadabhidhIyate, tatrApi cAbhayAmalakIyashcikitsAsthAnArthasUtrAbhidhAyakatayA~agre~abhidhIyate||1-2||

4.sanskrit: cikitsitaM vyAdhiharaM pathyaM sAdhanamauShadham| prAyashcittaM prashamanaM prakRutisthApanaM hitam||3|| vidyAdbheShajanAmAni, ...|4|
4.commentary: tatrAdau vyavahArArthaM sthAnAbhidheyasya bheShajasya paryAyAnAha- cikitsitamityAdi| karoti caivamAdau pradhAnAbhidheyaparyAyAbhidhAnaM, yathA- nidAne heturUpAdiparyAyakathanam| etacca paryAyAbhidhAnaM prAdhAnyena catuShpAdasyaiva bheShajasya, yaduktaM- “catuShpAdaM ShoDashakalaM bheShajamiti bhiShajo bhAShante” (sU.a.10) iti| evambhUtabheShajA~ggarUpatayA tu sthAvaraja~ggamadravyarUpasya bheShajasya bheShajatvamevAntaravyavahArakRutaM j~jeyam| prAyashcittamiti bheShajasa~jj~jA prAyashcittavadbheShajasyAdharmakAryavyAdhiharatvena||3||-

4.sanskrit: ... bheShajaM dvividhaM ca tat| svasthasyorjaskaraM ki~jcit ki~jcidArtasya roganut||4||
4.commentary: dvaividhyaM vivRuNoti- svasthasyetyAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| svasthatvena vyavahriyamANasya puMso jarAdisvAbhAvikavyAdhiharatvena tathA~apraharShavyayAyakShayitvAnupacitashukratvAdyaprashastashArIrabhAvaharatvena UrjaH prashastaM bhAvamAdadhAtIti svasthasyorjaskaram| Artasya roganuditi visheShaNena jvarAdinA~a~artasya jvarAdiharam| roganuditi vacanenaivArtavisheShatAyAM labdhAyAM yat ‘Artasya’ iti karoti, tena sahajajarAdikRutAM pIDAmanudvejikAM parityajya jvarAdinA~asvAbhAvikena rogeNa pIDitasyeti darshayati||4||

4.sanskrit: abheShajaM ca dvividhaM bAdhanaM sAnubAdhanam|5|
4.commentary: bheShajaprasa~ggAdabheShajadvaividhyamAha- abheShajamityAdi| bAdhanamiha tadAtvamAtrabAdhakaM, yathA- svalpamapathyam| sAnubAdhanaM ca dIrghakAlAvasthAyikuShThAdivikArakAri||-

4.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam||5|| prAyaH, prAyeNa rogANAM dvitIyaM prashame matam| prAyaHshabdo visheShArtho hyubhayaM hyubhayArthakRut||6||
4.commentary: dvividhaM bheShajamuktaM vibhajate- svasthasyetyAdi| tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanaM prAya iti cchedaH| yadvRuShyaM prAyo bhavati, tathA rasAyanaM yat prAyo bhavati, Artasya rogaharaM yadbAhulyena, tat svasthorjaskaramucyate; yattu dvitIyamArtarogaharaM, tat prAyeNa jvarAdishamanaM rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavati; yathA- kShatakShINoktaM sarpirguDAdi rasAyanaM vRuShyaM ca bhavati, tathA pANDurogokto yogarAjo rasAyanatvenoktaH, tathA kAsAdhikAre~agastyaharItakI rasAyanatvenoktetyAdyanusaraNIyam| rasAyanoktAnAM ca jvarAdiharatvamatra suvyaktameva rasAyanagrantheShu| anye tu bruvate- yadvyAdhimAtraharaM na tadrasAyanaM, kintu sharIrasaMyogadArDhyAddIrghAyuHkartRutvasAdhAraNadharmayogAdupacaritavyAdhiharaM rasAyanamihocyata iti| nanu yadi svasthorjaskaramapi vyAdhiharaM, vyAdhiharaM ca svasthorjaskaraM tat kiM ki~jciditi padena bheShajakarmavyavasthAdarshakena kriyate? brUmaH- bAhulyena svasthorjaskaratvaM vyAdhiharatvaM ca vyavasthApyate, na ceha sarvArtarogaharasya svasthorjaskaratvamiti pratij~jAyate, yena pAThAsaptaparNAdInAmapi rasAyanatvaM sAdhanIyashaktitvAdArttarogaharatvena yaducyate tadapi rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavatIti lavamAtropadarshanaM kriyate, tat svasthArtayorubhayArthakartRutvam| prAyaHshabdatAtparyaM vivRuNoti- prAya ityAdi| visheShArtha iti bAhulyArtha ityarthaH||5-6||

4.sanskrit: dIrghamAyuH smRutiM medhAmArogyaM taruNaM vayaH| prabhAvarNasvaraudAryaM dehendriyabalaM param||7|| vAksiddhiM praNatiM kAntiM labhate nA rasAyanAt| lAbhopAyo hi shastAnAM rasAdInAM rasAyanam||8||
4.commentary: rasAyanakAryamAha- dIrghamityAdi| prabhAdInAM trayANAmaudAryaM yojanIyam| vAksiddhiH yaducyate tadavashyaM bhavatItyarthaH| praNatiH lokavandyatA| kathametadrasAyanena kriyata ityAha- lAbhetyAdi| rasAdigrahaNena smRutyAdayo~api gRuhyante||7-8||

4.sanskrit: apatyasantAnakaraM yat sadyaH sampraharShaNam| vAjIvAtibalo yena yAtyapratihataH striyaH||9|| bhavatyatipriyaH strINAM yena yenopacIyate| jIryato~apyakShayaM shukraM phalavadyena dRushyate||10|| prabhUtashAkhaH shAkhIva yena caityo yathA mahAn| bhavatyarcyo bahumataH prajAnAM subahuprajaH||11|| santAnamUlaM yeneha pretya cAnantyamashnute| yashaH shriyaM balaM puShTiM vAjIkaraNameva tat||12||
4.commentary: vAjIkaraNakAryamAha- apatyetyAdi| apatyasantAnaH apatyaparamparA, tena putrapautrakaramityarthaH; vAjIkaraNajanitAcchukrAjjAtaH putraH putrajananasamartho bhavatItyarthaH| atipriyatvaM cehopacitashukratayA nirantaravyavAyakartRutvAt; yaduktaM- “virUpamapi yoddhAraM bhRutyamicchanti pArthivAH| vyavAyavyAyataM mUrkhaM dhRuShTaM patimiva striyaH” iti| upacIyata iti puShTiM prApnoti| akShayamivAkShayam| phalavaditi garbhajanakam| caityo devatAyatanam| arcyaH arcanIyaH | AnantyamivAnantyaM; dIrghasantAnatAmityarthaH||9-12||

4.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM tvetaddvividhaM proktamauShadham| yadvyAdhinirghAtakaraM vakShyate taccikitsite||13|| cikitsitArtha etAvAn vikArANAM yadauShadham| rasAyanavidhishcAgre vAjIkaraNameva ca||14||
4.commentary: cikitsita iti jvarAdicikitsite| nanu rasAyanavAjIkaraNe api jvarAdicikitsite eva, tat kiM vishiShyocyate- ‘vakShyate taccikitsite’ ityAha- cikitsitArtha ityAdi| satyaM, rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca jvarAdivyAdhiharatvAccikitsitashabdenocyata ityarthaH| atha vyAdhiharatvAccikitsite vaktavyatvAcca rasAyanavAjIkaraNe kva nu vaktavye ityAha- rasAyanetyAdi| vidhiH vidhAnaM rasAyanAbhidhAnamityarthaH | agre iti anantaram| vAjIkaraNaM cAgre ‘abhidhAsyate’ iti sheShaH||13-14||

4.sanskrit: abheShajamiti j~jeyaM viparItaM yadauShadhAt| tadasevyaM niShevyaM tu pravakShyAmi yadauShadham||15||
4.commentary: abheShajamapi pUrvoddiShTaM vivRuNoti- abheShajamityAdi| viparItaM rogajananalakShaNArthakAri||15||

4.sanskrit: rasAyanAnAM dvividhaM prayogamRuShayo viduH| kuTIprAveshikaM caiva vAtAtapikameva ca||16|| kuTIprAveshikasyAdau vidhiH samupadekShyate| nRupavaidyadvijAtInAM sAdhUnAM puNyakarmaNAm||17|| nivAse nirbhaye shaste prApyopakaraNe pure| dishi pUrvottarasyAM ca subhUmau kArayet kuTIm||18|| vistArotsedhasampannAM trigarbhAM sUkShmalocanAm| ghanabhittimRutusukhAM suspaShTAM manasaH priyAm||19|| shabdAdInAmashastAnAmagamyaM strIvivarjitAm| iShTopakaraNopetAM sajjavaidyauShadhadvijAm ||20|| athodagayane shukle tithinakShatrapUjite| muhUrtakaraNopete prashaste kRutavApanaH||21|| dhRutismRutibalaM kRutvA shraddadhAnaH samAhitaH| vidhUya mAnasAn doShAn maitrIM bhUteShu cintayan||22|| devatAH pUjayitvA~agre dvijAtIMshca pradakShiNam| devagobrAhmaNAn kRutvA tatastAM pravishet kuTIm||23|| tasyAM saMshodhanaiH shuddhaH sukhI jAtabalaH punaH| rasAyanaM prayu~jjIta tatpravakShyAmi shodhanam||24||
4.commentary: kuTIpraveshena yat kriyate tat kuTIprAveshikam| vAtAtapasevayA~api yat kriyate tad vAtAtapikam| trigarbhAM prathamamekaM gRuhaM, tasyAbhyantare dvitIyam, evaM trigarbhAstrayo garbhA antarANi yasyAM sA; trigarbhAmiti antastriprakoShThAm| sUkShmalocanAmiti alpadvArajAlakAm| shukle shuklapakShe| sajjA vaidyAdayo yasyAM sA tathA| tithinakShatrapUjita iti shubhatithinakShatrayogAt pUjite| kRutavApana iti kRutakShauraH| mAnasAn doShAniti kAmakrodhAdIn| saMshodhanairiti vamanavirecanAsthApanashirovirecanaiH| sukhIti arogaH| jAtabala iti saMshodhanApahRutamalatayA saMsarjanAdikrameNa punarjAtabalaH| yadyapIha saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaprayogAt sarvANyeva saMshodhanAni sammatAni, tathA~apIha rasAyane visheSheNa yaugikatvAddharItakyAdiprayoga evoktaH; anye tu harItakyAdiprayogeNaiva paraM saMshodhanaM kartavyamityAhuH, saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaM punaryAvacchuddherharItakyAdiprayogasyaiva karaNaM darshayati||16-24||

4.sanskrit: harItakInAM cUrNAni saindhavAmalake guDam| vacAM viDa~ggaM rajanIM pippalIM vishvabheShajam||25|| pibeduShNAmbunA jantuH snehasvedopapAditaH| tena shuddhasharIrAya kRutasaMsarjanAya ca||26|| trirAtraM yAvakaM dadyAt pa~jcAhaM vA~api sarpiShA| saptAhaM vA purANasya yAvacchuddhestu varcasaH||27|| shuddhakoShThaM tu taM j~jAtvA rasAyanamupAcaret| vayaHprakRutisAtmyaj~jo yaugikaM yasya yadbhavet||28||
4.commentary: yAvakamiti yavAnnam| trirAtrAdivikalpatrayaM hInamadhyottamashuddhiviShayam||25-28||

4.sanskrit: harItakIM pa~jcarasAmuShNAmalavaNAM shivAm| doShAnulomanIM laghvIM vidyAddIpanapAcanIm||29|| AyuShyAM pauShTikIM dhanyAM vayasaH sthApanIM parAm| sarvarogaprashamanIM buddhIndriyabalapradAm||30|| kuShThaM gulmamudAvartaM shoShaM pANDvAmayaM madam| arshAMsi grahaNIdoShaM purANaM viShamajvaram||31|| hRudrogaM sashirorogamatIsAramarocakam| kAsaM pramehamAnAhaM plIhAnamudaraM navam||32|| kaphaprasekaM vaisvaryaM vaivarNyaM kAmalAM krimIn| shvayathuM tamakaM chardiM klaibyama~ggAvasAdanam||33|| srotovibandhAn vividhAn pralepaM hRudayorasoH| smRutibuddhipramohaM ca jayecchIghraM harItakI||34|| (ajIrNino rUkShabhujaH strImadyaviShakarshitAH| severannAbhayAmete kShuttRuShNoShNArditAshca ye)||35|| tAn guNAMstAni karmANi vidyAdAmalakIShvapi| yAnyuktAni harItakyA vIryasya tu viparyayaH||36|| atashcAmRutakalpAni vidyAt karmabhirIdRushaiH| harItakInAM shasyAni bhiShagAmalakasya ca||37||
4.commentary: yadyapi dravyAntarANi dashavarShashatAyuShkararasAyanAdhikRutAni santi, tathA~api harItakyAmalake eva rogaharatvAyuShkaratvarUpobhayadharmayogAdadhyAyAdau guNakarmabhyAmucyete; tatrApi yadyapi “AmalakaM vayaHsthApanAnAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktam, tathA~api rogaharatve harItakI prakarShavatIti kRutvA harItakyagre~abhihitA| harItakyAdiShu pa~jcarasatvAdyutpAdo~adRuShTavashAdbhUtasanniveshavisheShaprabhAvakRutaH; tena nAtropapattayaH kramante| shivAmiti kalyANakAriNIM, prashastaguNayuktatvAt| sarvarogaprashamanImiti saMyogasaMskArAdinA| sarvarogaharatvamabhidhAyApi kuShThAdihantRutvAbhidhAnaM visheSheNa kuShThAdihantRutvopadarshanArtham| pravartakatve~apyatIsAragrahaNIharatvaM vibaddhadoShapravartakatayA j~jeyaM; yaduktaM- “stokaM stokaM vibaddhaM vA sashUlaM yo~atisAryate| abhayApippalIkalkaiH sukhoShNaistaM virecayet” iti| buddhismRutipradatvamabhidhAyApi smRutibuddhipramohaharatvAbhidhAnaM tatra vishiShTashaktyupadarshanArtham| vIryasya tu viparyaya ityanenAmalakasya shItavIryatvamuktam| shasyAnIti asthirahitAni phalAni||29-37||

4.sanskrit: oShadhInAM parA bhUmirhimavA~j shailasattamaH| tasmAtphalAni tajjAni grAhayetkAlajAni tu||38|| ApUrNarasavIryANi kAle kAle yathAvidhi| AdityapavanacchAyAsalilaprINitAni ca||39|| yAnyajagdhAnyapUtIni nirvraNAnyagadAni ca| teShAM prayogaM vakShyAmi phalAnAM karma cottamam||40||
4.commentary: yadyapi “himavAnauShadhabhUmInAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktaM, tathA~api rasAyane himavatprabhavANyeva bheShajAni grAhyANIti darshayitumauShadhInAmityAdyabhidhAnam| kAle kAle iti phalapAkakAle ityarthaH| yathAvidhIti yathA bheShajagrahaNaM ma~ggaladevatArcanAdipUrvakaM syAttathA~avashyaM rasAyane karttavyam| agadAnItyanena pavanadahanAdyadoShaM phalasya darshayati||38-40||

4.sanskrit: pa~jcAnAM pa~jcamUlAnAM bhAgAn dashapalonmitAn| harItakIsahasraM ca triguNAmalakaM navam||41|| vidArigandhAM bRuhatIM pRushniparNIM nidigdhikAm| vidyAdvidArigandhAdyaM shvadaMShTrApa~jcamaM gaNam||42|| bilvAgnimanthashyonAkaM kAshmaryamatha pATalAm| punarnavAM shUrpaparNyau balAmeraNDameva ca||43|| jIvakarShabhakau medAM jIvantIM sashatAvarIm| sharekShudarbhakAshAnAM shAlInAM mUlameva ca||44|| ityeShAM pa~jcamUlAnAM pa~jcAnAmupakalpayet| bhAgAn yathoktAMstatsarvaM sAdhyaM dashaguNe~ambhasi||45|| dashabhAgAvasheShaM tu pUtaM taM grAhayedrasam| harItakIshca tAH sarvAH sarvANyAmalakAni ca||46|| tAni sarvANyanasthIni phalAnyApothya kUrcanaiH| vinIya tasminniryUhe cUrNAnImAni dApayet||47|| maNDUkaparNyAH pippalyAH sha~gkhapuShpyAH plavasya ca| mustAnAM saviDa~ggAnAM candanAguruNostathA||48|| madhukasya haridrAyA vacAyAH kanakasya ca| bhAgAMshcatuShpalAn kRutvA sUkShmailAyAstvacastathA||49|| sitopalAsahasraM ca cUrNitaM tulayA~adhikam| tailasya dvyADhakaM tatra dadyAttrINi ca sarpiShaH||50|| sAdhyamaudumbare pAtre tat sarvaM mRudunA~agninA| j~jAtvA lehyamadagdhaM ca shItaM kShaudreNa saMsRujet||51|| kShaudrapramANaM snehArdhaM tat sarvaM ghRutabhAjane| tiShThetsammUrcchitaM tasya mAtrAM kAle prayojayet||52|| yA noparundhyAdAhAramekaM mAtrA jarAM prati| ShaShTikaH payasA cAtra jIrNe bhojanamiShyate||53|| vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAstathA cAnye tapodhanAH| rasAyanamidaM prAshya babhUvuramitAyuShaH||54|| muktvA jIrNaM vapushcAgryamavApustaruNaM vayaH| vItatandrAklamashvAsA nirAta~gkAH samAhitAH||55|| medhAsmRutibalopetAshcirarAtraM tapodhanAH| brAhmaM tapo brahmacaryaM cerushcAtyantaniShThayA||56|| rasAyanamidaM brAhmamAyuShkAmaH prayojayet| dIrghamAyurvayashcAgryaM kAmAMshceShTAn samashnute||57|| (iti brAhmarasAyanam)|
4.commentary: pa~jcAnAmityAdau pratidravyaM dashapalabhAgagrahaNam , uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “iti pa~jca pa~jcamUlAni, teShAM pratidravyaM dashapalAni” iti| harItakIsahasramiti harItakIphalasahasram| shUrpaparNyau mudgamAShaparNyau| vIrA jAlandharaM shAkam| kUrcanaM jarjarIkaraNasAdhanaM shilAputrakamusalAdi| vinIyeti prakShipya| plavaH kaivartamustakam| kanakaM nAgakesharam| tvak guDatvak| audumbare iti tAmramaye| snehArdhamiti sarpistailArdham| ekam anaparAhNikamAhAram||41-57||

4.sanskrit: yathoktaguNAnAmAmalakAnAM sahasraM piShTasvedanavidhinA payasa UShmaNA susvinnamanAtapashuShkamanasthi cUrNayet| tadAmalakasahasrasvarasaparipItaM sthirApunarnavAjIvantInAgabalAbrahmasuvarcalAmaNDUkaparNIshatAvarIsha~gkhapuShpIpippalIvacAviDa~ggasvaya~gguptAmRutA- candanAgurumadhukamadhUkapuShpotpalapadmamAlatIyuvatIyUthikAcUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktaM punarnAgabalAsahasrapalasvarasaparipItamanAtapashuShkaM dviguNitasarpiShA kShaudrasarpiShA vA kShudraguDAkRutiM kRutvA shucau dRuDhe ghRutabhAvite kumbhe bhasmarAsheradhaH sthApayedantarbhUmeH pakShaM kRutarakShAvidhAnamatharvavedavidA, pakShAtyaye coddhRutya kanakarajatatAmrapravAlakAlAyasacUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktamardhakarShavRuddhyA yathoktena vidhinA prAtaH prAtaH prayu~jjAno~agnibalamabhisamIkShya, jIrNe ca ShaShTikaM payasA sasarpiShkamupasevamAno yathoktAn guNAn samashnuta iti||58|| bhavanti cAtra- idaM rasAyanaM brAhmaM maharShigaNasevitam| bhavatyarogo dIrghAyuH prayu~jjAno mahAbalaH||59|| kAntaH prajAnAM siddhArthashcandrAdityasamadyutiH| shrutaM dhArayate sattvamArShaM cAsya pravartate||60|| dharaNIdharasArashca vAyunA samavikramaH| sa bhavatyaviShaM cAsya gAtre sampadyate viSham||61|| (iti dvitIyaM brAhmarasAyanam)|
4.commentary: piShTasvedanavidhineti yathA piShTakaM toyaparipUritapAtroparidattatRuNAdisaMsthitaM svedyate, tathA tat svedanIyamityarthaH| svarasaparipItamiti svarasabhAvitam| brahmasuvarcalAdyauShadhAnyAyurvedasamutthAnIye vakShyamANAni| yuvatiH navamAlikA| aShTamo bhAgo~aShTabhAgaH| kShudraguDAkRutimiti phANitAkRutim| ardhakarShavRuddhyeti ardhakarShAtprabhRuti vardhayet| yathoktavidhineti kuTIprAveshikena vidhinA| yathoktAn guNAniti pUrvaprayogaphalashrutipaThitAn| dharaNIdharasAra iti uShTramukhavat; tena dharaNIdharAH parvatAH, teShAM sAro lauhaM, tadvatsAra ityarthaH| aviShamiti viShamavikAri||58-61||

4.sanskrit: bilvo~agnimanthaH shyonAkaH kAshmaryaH pATalirbalA| parNyashcatasraH pippalyaH shvadaMShTrA bRuhatIdvayam||62|| shRu~ggI tAmalakI drAkShA jIvantI puShkarAguru| abhayA cAmRutA RuddhirjIvakarShabhakau shaTI||63|| mustaM punarnavA medA sailA candanamutpalam| vidArI vRuShamUlAni kAkolI kAkanAsikA||64|| eShAM palonmitAn bhAgA~jchatAnyAmalakasya ca| pa~jca dadyAttadaikadhyaM jaladroNe vipAcayet||65|| j~jAtvA gatarasAnyetAnyauShadhAnyatha taM rasam| taccAmalakamuddhRutya niShkulaM tailasarpiShoH||66|| paladvAdashake bhRuShTvA dattvA cArdhatulAM bhiShak| matsyaNDikAyAH pUtAyA lehavatsAdhu sAdhayet||67|| ShaTpalaM madhunashcAtra siddhashIte pradApayet| catuShpalaM tugAkShIryAH pippalIdvipalaM tathA||68|| palamekaM nidadhyAcca tvagelApatrakesharAt| ityayaM cyavanaprAshaH paramukto rasAyanaH||69|| kAsashvAsaharashcaiva visheSheNopadishyate| kShINakShatAnAM vRuddhAnAM bAlAnAM cA~ggavardhanaH||70|| svarakShayamurorogaM hRudrogaM vAtashoNitam| pipAsAM mUtrashukrasthAn doShAMshcApyapakarShati||71|| asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta yoparundhyAnna bhojanam| asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA||72|| medhAM smRutiM kAntimanAmayatvamAyuHprakarShaM balamindriyANAm| strIShu praharShaM paramagnivRuddhiM varNaprasAdaM pavanAnulomyam||73|| rasAyanasyAsya naraH prayogAllabheta jIrNo~api kuTIpraveshAt| jarAkRutaM rUpamapAsya sarvaM bibharti rUpaM navayauvanasya||74|| (iti cyavanaprAshaH)|
4.commentary: parNyashcatasra iti shAlaparNI, pRushniparNI, mudgaparNI, mAShaparNI ca| tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI| kAkanAsA nAsAphalA, ‘kAkatuNDaka’ ityanye| gatarasatvamiha dravyANAM caturbhAgasthitajale bhavati| niShkulamiti nirasthi| tailasarpiShoriti samAsanirdeshAdubhAbhyAmeva dvAdashapalAni, na pRuthak pRuthak| matsyaNDikA khaNDasaMhatiH| atra ShaTpalatvena samayorapi madhusarpiShordravyAntarayuktatvenAviruddhatvam||62-74||

4.sanskrit: athAmalakaharItakInAmAmalakabibhItakAnAM harItakIbibhItakAnAmAmalakaharItakIbibhItakAnAM vA palAshatvagavanaddhAnAM mRudA~avaliptAnAM kukUlasvinnAnAmakulakAnAM palasahasramulUkhale sampothya dadhighRutamadhupalalatailasharkarAsaMyuktaM bhakShayedanannabhugyathoktena vidhinA; tasyAnte yavAgvAdibhiH pratyavasthApanam , abhya~ggotsAdanaM sarpiShA yavacUrNaishca, ayaM ca rasAyanaprayogaprakarSho dvistAvadagnibalamabhisamIkShya , pratibhojanaM yUSheNa payasA vA ShaShTikaH sasarpiShkaH, ataH paraM yathAsukhavihAraH kAmabhakShyaH syAt| anena prayogeNarShayaH punaryuvatvamavApurbabhUvushcAnekavarShashatajIvino nirvikArAH paraM sharIrabuddhIndriyabalasamuditAshcerushcAtyantaniShThayA tapaH||75|| (iti caturthAmalakarasAyanam)|
