27.sanskrit: bilvo~agnimanthaH shyonAkaH kAshmaryaH pATalirbalA| parNyashcatasraH pippalyaH shvadaMShTrA bRuhatIdvayam||62|| shRu~ggI tAmalakI drAkShA jIvantI puShkarAguru| abhayA cAmRutA RuddhirjIvakarShabhakau shaTI||63|| mustaM punarnavA medA sailA candanamutpalam| vidArI vRuShamUlAni kAkolI kAkanAsikA||64|| eShAM palonmitAn bhAgA~jchatAnyAmalakasya ca| pa~jca dadyAttadaikadhyaM jaladroNe vipAcayet||65|| j~jAtvA gatarasAnyetAnyauShadhAnyatha taM rasam| taccAmalakamuddhRutya niShkulaM tailasarpiShoH||66|| paladvAdashake bhRuShTvA dattvA cArdhatulAM bhiShak| matsyaNDikAyAH pUtAyA lehavatsAdhu sAdhayet||67|| ShaTpalaM madhunashcAtra siddhashIte pradApayet| catuShpalaM tugAkShIryAH pippalIdvipalaM tathA||68|| palamekaM nidadhyAcca tvagelApatrakesharAt| ityayaM cyavanaprAshaH paramukto rasAyanaH||69|| kAsashvAsaharashcaiva visheSheNopadishyate| kShINakShatAnAM vRuddhAnAM bAlAnAM cA~ggavardhanaH||70|| svarakShayamurorogaM hRudrogaM vAtashoNitam| pipAsAM mUtrashukrasthAn doShAMshcApyapakarShati||71|| asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta yoparundhyAnna bhojanam| asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA||72|| medhAM smRutiM kAntimanAmayatvamAyuHprakarShaM balamindriyANAm| strIShu praharShaM paramagnivRuddhiM varNaprasAdaM pavanAnulomyam||73|| rasAyanasyAsya naraH prayogAllabheta jIrNo~api kuTIpraveshAt| jarAkRutaM rUpamapAsya sarvaM bibharti rUpaM navayauvanasya||74|| (iti cyavanaprAshaH)|
27.commentary: parNyashcatasra iti shAlaparNI, pRushniparNI, mudgaparNI, mAShaparNI ca| tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI| kAkanAsA nAsAphalA, ‘kAkatuNDaka’ ityanye| gatarasatvamiha dravyANAM caturbhAgasthitajale bhavati| niShkulamiti nirasthi| tailasarpiShoriti samAsanirdeshAdubhAbhyAmeva dvAdashapalAni, na pRuthak pRuthak| matsyaNDikA khaNDasaMhatiH| atra ShaTpalatvena samayorapi madhusarpiShordravyAntarayuktatvenAviruddhatvam||62-74||

27.sanskrit: athAmalakaharItakInAmAmalakabibhItakAnAM harItakIbibhItakAnAmAmalakaharItakIbibhItakAnAM vA palAshatvagavanaddhAnAM mRudA~avaliptAnAM kukUlasvinnAnAmakulakAnAM palasahasramulUkhale sampothya dadhighRutamadhupalalatailasharkarAsaMyuktaM bhakShayedanannabhugyathoktena vidhinA; tasyAnte yavAgvAdibhiH pratyavasthApanam , abhya~ggotsAdanaM sarpiShA yavacUrNaishca, ayaM ca rasAyanaprayogaprakarSho dvistAvadagnibalamabhisamIkShya , pratibhojanaM yUSheNa payasA vA ShaShTikaH sasarpiShkaH, ataH paraM yathAsukhavihAraH kAmabhakShyaH syAt| anena prayogeNarShayaH punaryuvatvamavApurbabhUvushcAnekavarShashatajIvino nirvikArAH paraM sharIrabuddhIndriyabalasamuditAshcerushcAtyantaniShThayA tapaH||75|| (iti caturthAmalakarasAyanam)|
27.commentary: kukUlakaH karIShAgniH| akulakAnAmiti anasthnAm| dravyAdInAmatra mAnaM noktaM, tena pradhAnasya cUrNasya dadhyAdibhirmilitaiH samAnamAnatvaM; kiMvA pratyekameva dadhyAdInAM cUrNasamatvam| palalaM tilacUrNam| bhakShayediti vacanaM lehye~api alpAbhyavaharaNamAtrArthatvAdupapannam| anannabhugiti sarvathA~a~ahArAntarAbhuk| tasyAnta iti etatprayogaparityAgakAle| pratyavasthApanamiti yavAgvAdikramavisheShaNaM; tena prayogAnte yadA annasaMsarjanaM kartavyaM, tadA yavAgvAdikrameNetyuktasyArthasya pratyavasthApanaM kriyata ityarthaH| yUSheNa payasA veti vikalpo~agnibalApekShayA||75||

27.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakapa~jcapa~jcamUlaniryUhe pippalImadhukamadhUkakAkolIkShIrakAkolyAtmaguptAjIvakarShabhakakShIrashuklAkalkasamprayuktena vidArIsvarasena kShIrAShTaguNasamprayuktena ca sarpiShaH kumbhaM sAdhayitvA prayu~jjAno~agnibalasamAM mAtrAM jIrNe ca kShIrasarpirbhyAM shAliShaShTikamuShNodakAnupAnamashna~jjarAvyAdhipApAbhicAravyapagatabhayaH sharIrendriyabuddhibalamatulamupalabhyApratihatasarvArambhaH paramAyuranavApnuyAt||76|| (iti pa~jcamo harItakIyogaH)|
27.commentary: atra harItakyAdau kShIrashuklA kShIravidArikA| atra harItakyAdikvAthasya tveko bhAgaH, kShIrasyAShTau bhAgAH, sarpiSha eko bhAgaH| kumbho droNadvayam| vacanaM hi- “droNastu dviguNaH sUrpo vij~jeyaH kumbha eva ca” iti||76||

27.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakaharidrAsthirAbalAviDa~ggAmRutavallIvishvabheShajamadhukapippalIsomavalkasiddhena kShIrasarpiShA madhusharkarAbhyAmapi ca sannIyAmalakasvarasashataparipItamAmalakacUrNamayashcUrNacaturbhAgasamprayuktaM pANitalamAtraM prAtaH prAtaH prAshya yathoktena vidhinA sAyaM mudgayUSheNa payasA vA sasarpiShkaM shAliShaShTikAnnamashnIyAt, trivarShaprayogAdasya varShashatamajaraM vayastiShThati, shrutamavatiShThate, sarvAmayAH prashAmyanti, viShamaviShaM bhavati gAtre, gAtramashmavat sthirIbhavati, adhRuShyo bhUtAnAM bhavati||77|| bhavanti cAtra- yathA~amarANAmamRutaM yathA bhogavatAM sudhA| tathA~abhavanmaharShINAM rasAyanavidhiH purA||78|| na jarAM na ca daurbalyaM nAturyaM nidhanaM na ca| jagmurvarShasahasrANi rasAyanaparAH purA||79|| na kevalaM dIrghamihAyurashnute rasAyanaM yo vidhivanniShevate| gatiM sa devarShiniShevitAM shubhAM prapadyate brahma tatheti cAkShayam ||80||
27.commentary: amRutavallI guDUcI| somavalkaH viTkhadiraH| kShIrasarpiH kShIrasamutthitasarpiH| ayashcUrNasya caturtho bhAgaH, yata etadayashcUrNaM caturthabhAgamata evAsmin prayoge jatUkarNena “ayashcUrNapAdayuktam” iti kRutam| amarANAmamRutaM jarAdiharaM, nAgAnAM ca sudhA jarAmaraNaharI, ityubhayopAdAnaM dRuShTAnte| brahma mokShaH| mokShasAdhanatvaM ceha rasAyanasya vishuddhasattvakartRutayocyate|| 77-80||

27.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- abhayAmalakIye~asmin ShaDyogAH parikIrtitAH| rasAyanAnAM siddhAnAmAyuryairanuvartate||81||
27.commentary: abhayetyAdinA sandehanirAsArthamuktaprayogasa~gkhyAM darshayati| evamanyatrApi sa~gkhyApraNayanamante j~jeyam|| 81||

27.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH||1||
27.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH|| 1||

28.sanskrit: athAto~abhayAmalakIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
28.commentary: pUrvasthAnoktalakShaNAbhAvenAvadhAritAyuShmadbhAvena cikitsA dharmArthayashaskarI kartavyetyanantaraM cikitsAbhidhAyakaM sthAnamucyate| rasAyanavAjIkaraNasAdhanamapi yathA cikitsocyate, tathA~anantarameva vakShyati| tatrApi jvarAdicikitsAyAH prAgrasAyanavAjIkaraNayormahAphalatvenAdAvabhidhAnam| tayorapi ca rasAyanameva varShasahasrAyuShTvAdikAraNatayA mahAphalamiti tadabhidhIyate, tatrApi cAbhayAmalakIyashcikitsAsthAnArthasUtrAbhidhAyakatayA~agre~abhidhIyate||1-2||

28.sanskrit: cikitsitaM vyAdhiharaM pathyaM sAdhanamauShadham| prAyashcittaM prashamanaM prakRutisthApanaM hitam||3|| vidyAdbheShajanAmAni, ...|4|
28.commentary: tatrAdau vyavahArArthaM sthAnAbhidheyasya bheShajasya paryAyAnAha- cikitsitamityAdi| karoti caivamAdau pradhAnAbhidheyaparyAyAbhidhAnaM, yathA- nidAne heturUpAdiparyAyakathanam| etacca paryAyAbhidhAnaM prAdhAnyena catuShpAdasyaiva bheShajasya, yaduktaM- “catuShpAdaM ShoDashakalaM bheShajamiti bhiShajo bhAShante” (sU.a.10) iti| evambhUtabheShajA~ggarUpatayA tu sthAvaraja~ggamadravyarUpasya bheShajasya bheShajatvamevAntaravyavahArakRutaM j~jeyam| prAyashcittamiti bheShajasa~jj~jA prAyashcittavadbheShajasyAdharmakAryavyAdhiharatvena||3||-

28.sanskrit: ... bheShajaM dvividhaM ca tat| svasthasyorjaskaraM ki~jcit ki~jcidArtasya roganut||4||
28.commentary: dvaividhyaM vivRuNoti- svasthasyetyAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| svasthatvena vyavahriyamANasya puMso jarAdisvAbhAvikavyAdhiharatvena tathA~apraharShavyayAyakShayitvAnupacitashukratvAdyaprashastashArIrabhAvaharatvena UrjaH prashastaM bhAvamAdadhAtIti svasthasyorjaskaram| Artasya roganuditi visheShaNena jvarAdinA~a~artasya jvarAdiharam| roganuditi vacanenaivArtavisheShatAyAM labdhAyAM yat ‘Artasya’ iti karoti, tena sahajajarAdikRutAM pIDAmanudvejikAM parityajya jvarAdinA~asvAbhAvikena rogeNa pIDitasyeti darshayati||4||

28.sanskrit: abheShajaM ca dvividhaM bAdhanaM sAnubAdhanam|5|
28.commentary: bheShajaprasa~ggAdabheShajadvaividhyamAha- abheShajamityAdi| bAdhanamiha tadAtvamAtrabAdhakaM, yathA- svalpamapathyam| sAnubAdhanaM ca dIrghakAlAvasthAyikuShThAdivikArakAri||-

28.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam||5|| prAyaH, prAyeNa rogANAM dvitIyaM prashame matam| prAyaHshabdo visheShArtho hyubhayaM hyubhayArthakRut||6||
28.commentary: dvividhaM bheShajamuktaM vibhajate- svasthasyetyAdi| tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanaM prAya iti cchedaH| yadvRuShyaM prAyo bhavati, tathA rasAyanaM yat prAyo bhavati, Artasya rogaharaM yadbAhulyena, tat svasthorjaskaramucyate; yattu dvitIyamArtarogaharaM, tat prAyeNa jvarAdishamanaM rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavati; yathA- kShatakShINoktaM sarpirguDAdi rasAyanaM vRuShyaM ca bhavati, tathA pANDurogokto yogarAjo rasAyanatvenoktaH, tathA kAsAdhikAre~agastyaharItakI rasAyanatvenoktetyAdyanusaraNIyam| rasAyanoktAnAM ca jvarAdiharatvamatra suvyaktameva rasAyanagrantheShu| anye tu bruvate- yadvyAdhimAtraharaM na tadrasAyanaM, kintu sharIrasaMyogadArDhyAddIrghAyuHkartRutvasAdhAraNadharmayogAdupacaritavyAdhiharaM rasAyanamihocyata iti| nanu yadi svasthorjaskaramapi vyAdhiharaM, vyAdhiharaM ca svasthorjaskaraM tat kiM ki~jciditi padena bheShajakarmavyavasthAdarshakena kriyate? brUmaH- bAhulyena svasthorjaskaratvaM vyAdhiharatvaM ca vyavasthApyate, na ceha sarvArtarogaharasya svasthorjaskaratvamiti pratij~jAyate, yena pAThAsaptaparNAdInAmapi rasAyanatvaM sAdhanIyashaktitvAdArttarogaharatvena yaducyate tadapi rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavatIti lavamAtropadarshanaM kriyate, tat svasthArtayorubhayArthakartRutvam| prAyaHshabdatAtparyaM vivRuNoti- prAya ityAdi| visheShArtha iti bAhulyArtha ityarthaH||5-6||

28.sanskrit: dIrghamAyuH smRutiM medhAmArogyaM taruNaM vayaH| prabhAvarNasvaraudAryaM dehendriyabalaM param||7|| vAksiddhiM praNatiM kAntiM labhate nA rasAyanAt| lAbhopAyo hi shastAnAM rasAdInAM rasAyanam||8||
28.commentary: rasAyanakAryamAha- dIrghamityAdi| prabhAdInAM trayANAmaudAryaM yojanIyam| vAksiddhiH yaducyate tadavashyaM bhavatItyarthaH| praNatiH lokavandyatA| kathametadrasAyanena kriyata ityAha- lAbhetyAdi| rasAdigrahaNena smRutyAdayo~api gRuhyante||7-8||

28.sanskrit: apatyasantAnakaraM yat sadyaH sampraharShaNam| vAjIvAtibalo yena yAtyapratihataH striyaH||9|| bhavatyatipriyaH strINAM yena yenopacIyate| jIryato~apyakShayaM shukraM phalavadyena dRushyate||10|| prabhUtashAkhaH shAkhIva yena caityo yathA mahAn| bhavatyarcyo bahumataH prajAnAM subahuprajaH||11|| santAnamUlaM yeneha pretya cAnantyamashnute| yashaH shriyaM balaM puShTiM vAjIkaraNameva tat||12||
28.commentary: vAjIkaraNakAryamAha- apatyetyAdi| apatyasantAnaH apatyaparamparA, tena putrapautrakaramityarthaH; vAjIkaraNajanitAcchukrAjjAtaH putraH putrajananasamartho bhavatItyarthaH| atipriyatvaM cehopacitashukratayA nirantaravyavAyakartRutvAt; yaduktaM- “virUpamapi yoddhAraM bhRutyamicchanti pArthivAH| vyavAyavyAyataM mUrkhaM dhRuShTaM patimiva striyaH” iti| upacIyata iti puShTiM prApnoti| akShayamivAkShayam| phalavaditi garbhajanakam| caityo devatAyatanam| arcyaH arcanIyaH | AnantyamivAnantyaM; dIrghasantAnatAmityarthaH||9-12||

28.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM tvetaddvividhaM proktamauShadham| yadvyAdhinirghAtakaraM vakShyate taccikitsite||13|| cikitsitArtha etAvAn vikArANAM yadauShadham| rasAyanavidhishcAgre vAjIkaraNameva ca||14||
28.commentary: cikitsita iti jvarAdicikitsite| nanu rasAyanavAjIkaraNe api jvarAdicikitsite eva, tat kiM vishiShyocyate- ‘vakShyate taccikitsite’ ityAha- cikitsitArtha ityAdi| satyaM, rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca jvarAdivyAdhiharatvAccikitsitashabdenocyata ityarthaH| atha vyAdhiharatvAccikitsite vaktavyatvAcca rasAyanavAjIkaraNe kva nu vaktavye ityAha- rasAyanetyAdi| vidhiH vidhAnaM rasAyanAbhidhAnamityarthaH | agre iti anantaram| vAjIkaraNaM cAgre ‘abhidhAsyate’ iti sheShaH||13-14||

28.sanskrit: abheShajamiti j~jeyaM viparItaM yadauShadhAt| tadasevyaM niShevyaM tu pravakShyAmi yadauShadham||15||
28.commentary: abheShajamapi pUrvoddiShTaM vivRuNoti- abheShajamityAdi| viparItaM rogajananalakShaNArthakAri||15||

28.sanskrit: rasAyanAnAM dvividhaM prayogamRuShayo viduH| kuTIprAveshikaM caiva vAtAtapikameva ca||16|| kuTIprAveshikasyAdau vidhiH samupadekShyate| nRupavaidyadvijAtInAM sAdhUnAM puNyakarmaNAm||17|| nivAse nirbhaye shaste prApyopakaraNe pure| dishi pUrvottarasyAM ca subhUmau kArayet kuTIm||18|| vistArotsedhasampannAM trigarbhAM sUkShmalocanAm| ghanabhittimRutusukhAM suspaShTAM manasaH priyAm||19|| shabdAdInAmashastAnAmagamyaM strIvivarjitAm| iShTopakaraNopetAM sajjavaidyauShadhadvijAm ||20|| athodagayane shukle tithinakShatrapUjite| muhUrtakaraNopete prashaste kRutavApanaH||21|| dhRutismRutibalaM kRutvA shraddadhAnaH samAhitaH| vidhUya mAnasAn doShAn maitrIM bhUteShu cintayan||22|| devatAH pUjayitvA~agre dvijAtIMshca pradakShiNam| devagobrAhmaNAn kRutvA tatastAM pravishet kuTIm||23|| tasyAM saMshodhanaiH shuddhaH sukhI jAtabalaH punaH| rasAyanaM prayu~jjIta tatpravakShyAmi shodhanam||24||
28.commentary: kuTIpraveshena yat kriyate tat kuTIprAveshikam| vAtAtapasevayA~api yat kriyate tad vAtAtapikam| trigarbhAM prathamamekaM gRuhaM, tasyAbhyantare dvitIyam, evaM trigarbhAstrayo garbhA antarANi yasyAM sA; trigarbhAmiti antastriprakoShThAm| sUkShmalocanAmiti alpadvArajAlakAm| shukle shuklapakShe| sajjA vaidyAdayo yasyAM sA tathA| tithinakShatrapUjita iti shubhatithinakShatrayogAt pUjite| kRutavApana iti kRutakShauraH| mAnasAn doShAniti kAmakrodhAdIn| saMshodhanairiti vamanavirecanAsthApanashirovirecanaiH| sukhIti arogaH| jAtabala iti saMshodhanApahRutamalatayA saMsarjanAdikrameNa punarjAtabalaH| yadyapIha saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaprayogAt sarvANyeva saMshodhanAni sammatAni, tathA~apIha rasAyane visheSheNa yaugikatvAddharItakyAdiprayoga evoktaH; anye tu harItakyAdiprayogeNaiva paraM saMshodhanaM kartavyamityAhuH, saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaM punaryAvacchuddherharItakyAdiprayogasyaiva karaNaM darshayati||16-24||

28.sanskrit: harItakInAM cUrNAni saindhavAmalake guDam| vacAM viDa~ggaM rajanIM pippalIM vishvabheShajam||25|| pibeduShNAmbunA jantuH snehasvedopapAditaH| tena shuddhasharIrAya kRutasaMsarjanAya ca||26|| trirAtraM yAvakaM dadyAt pa~jcAhaM vA~api sarpiShA| saptAhaM vA purANasya yAvacchuddhestu varcasaH||27|| shuddhakoShThaM tu taM j~jAtvA rasAyanamupAcaret| vayaHprakRutisAtmyaj~jo yaugikaM yasya yadbhavet||28||
28.commentary: yAvakamiti yavAnnam| trirAtrAdivikalpatrayaM hInamadhyottamashuddhiviShayam||25-28||

28.sanskrit: harItakIM pa~jcarasAmuShNAmalavaNAM shivAm| doShAnulomanIM laghvIM vidyAddIpanapAcanIm||29|| AyuShyAM pauShTikIM dhanyAM vayasaH sthApanIM parAm| sarvarogaprashamanIM buddhIndriyabalapradAm||30|| kuShThaM gulmamudAvartaM shoShaM pANDvAmayaM madam| arshAMsi grahaNIdoShaM purANaM viShamajvaram||31|| hRudrogaM sashirorogamatIsAramarocakam| kAsaM pramehamAnAhaM plIhAnamudaraM navam||32|| kaphaprasekaM vaisvaryaM vaivarNyaM kAmalAM krimIn| shvayathuM tamakaM chardiM klaibyama~ggAvasAdanam||33|| srotovibandhAn vividhAn pralepaM hRudayorasoH| smRutibuddhipramohaM ca jayecchIghraM harItakI||34|| (ajIrNino rUkShabhujaH strImadyaviShakarshitAH| severannAbhayAmete kShuttRuShNoShNArditAshca ye)||35|| tAn guNAMstAni karmANi vidyAdAmalakIShvapi| yAnyuktAni harItakyA vIryasya tu viparyayaH||36|| atashcAmRutakalpAni vidyAt karmabhirIdRushaiH| harItakInAM shasyAni bhiShagAmalakasya ca||37||
28.commentary: yadyapi dravyAntarANi dashavarShashatAyuShkararasAyanAdhikRutAni santi, tathA~api harItakyAmalake eva rogaharatvAyuShkaratvarUpobhayadharmayogAdadhyAyAdau guNakarmabhyAmucyete; tatrApi yadyapi “AmalakaM vayaHsthApanAnAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktam, tathA~api rogaharatve harItakI prakarShavatIti kRutvA harItakyagre~abhihitA| harItakyAdiShu pa~jcarasatvAdyutpAdo~adRuShTavashAdbhUtasanniveshavisheShaprabhAvakRutaH; tena nAtropapattayaH kramante| shivAmiti kalyANakAriNIM, prashastaguNayuktatvAt| sarvarogaprashamanImiti saMyogasaMskArAdinA| sarvarogaharatvamabhidhAyApi kuShThAdihantRutvAbhidhAnaM visheSheNa kuShThAdihantRutvopadarshanArtham| pravartakatve~apyatIsAragrahaNIharatvaM vibaddhadoShapravartakatayA j~jeyaM; yaduktaM- “stokaM stokaM vibaddhaM vA sashUlaM yo~atisAryate| abhayApippalIkalkaiH sukhoShNaistaM virecayet” iti| buddhismRutipradatvamabhidhAyApi smRutibuddhipramohaharatvAbhidhAnaM tatra vishiShTashaktyupadarshanArtham| vIryasya tu viparyaya ityanenAmalakasya shItavIryatvamuktam| shasyAnIti asthirahitAni phalAni||29-37||

28.sanskrit: oShadhInAM parA bhUmirhimavA~j shailasattamaH| tasmAtphalAni tajjAni grAhayetkAlajAni tu||38|| ApUrNarasavIryANi kAle kAle yathAvidhi| AdityapavanacchAyAsalilaprINitAni ca||39|| yAnyajagdhAnyapUtIni nirvraNAnyagadAni ca| teShAM prayogaM vakShyAmi phalAnAM karma cottamam||40||
28.commentary: yadyapi “himavAnauShadhabhUmInAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktaM, tathA~api rasAyane himavatprabhavANyeva bheShajAni grAhyANIti darshayitumauShadhInAmityAdyabhidhAnam| kAle kAle iti phalapAkakAle ityarthaH| yathAvidhIti yathA bheShajagrahaNaM ma~ggaladevatArcanAdipUrvakaM syAttathA~avashyaM rasAyane karttavyam| agadAnItyanena pavanadahanAdyadoShaM phalasya darshayati||38-40||

28.sanskrit: pa~jcAnAM pa~jcamUlAnAM bhAgAn dashapalonmitAn| harItakIsahasraM ca triguNAmalakaM navam||41|| vidArigandhAM bRuhatIM pRushniparNIM nidigdhikAm| vidyAdvidArigandhAdyaM shvadaMShTrApa~jcamaM gaNam||42|| bilvAgnimanthashyonAkaM kAshmaryamatha pATalAm| punarnavAM shUrpaparNyau balAmeraNDameva ca||43|| jIvakarShabhakau medAM jIvantIM sashatAvarIm| sharekShudarbhakAshAnAM shAlInAM mUlameva ca||44|| ityeShAM pa~jcamUlAnAM pa~jcAnAmupakalpayet| bhAgAn yathoktAMstatsarvaM sAdhyaM dashaguNe~ambhasi||45|| dashabhAgAvasheShaM tu pUtaM taM grAhayedrasam| harItakIshca tAH sarvAH sarvANyAmalakAni ca||46|| tAni sarvANyanasthIni phalAnyApothya kUrcanaiH| vinIya tasminniryUhe cUrNAnImAni dApayet||47|| maNDUkaparNyAH pippalyAH sha~gkhapuShpyAH plavasya ca| mustAnAM saviDa~ggAnAM candanAguruNostathA||48|| madhukasya haridrAyA vacAyAH kanakasya ca| bhAgAMshcatuShpalAn kRutvA sUkShmailAyAstvacastathA||49|| sitopalAsahasraM ca cUrNitaM tulayA~adhikam| tailasya dvyADhakaM tatra dadyAttrINi ca sarpiShaH||50|| sAdhyamaudumbare pAtre tat sarvaM mRudunA~agninA| j~jAtvA lehyamadagdhaM ca shItaM kShaudreNa saMsRujet||51|| kShaudrapramANaM snehArdhaM tat sarvaM ghRutabhAjane| tiShThetsammUrcchitaM tasya mAtrAM kAle prayojayet||52|| yA noparundhyAdAhAramekaM mAtrA jarAM prati| ShaShTikaH payasA cAtra jIrNe bhojanamiShyate||53|| vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAstathA cAnye tapodhanAH| rasAyanamidaM prAshya babhUvuramitAyuShaH||54|| muktvA jIrNaM vapushcAgryamavApustaruNaM vayaH| vItatandrAklamashvAsA nirAta~gkAH samAhitAH||55|| medhAsmRutibalopetAshcirarAtraM tapodhanAH| brAhmaM tapo brahmacaryaM cerushcAtyantaniShThayA||56|| rasAyanamidaM brAhmamAyuShkAmaH prayojayet| dIrghamAyurvayashcAgryaM kAmAMshceShTAn samashnute||57|| (iti brAhmarasAyanam)|
28.commentary: pa~jcAnAmityAdau pratidravyaM dashapalabhAgagrahaNam , uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “iti pa~jca pa~jcamUlAni, teShAM pratidravyaM dashapalAni” iti| harItakIsahasramiti harItakIphalasahasram| shUrpaparNyau mudgamAShaparNyau| vIrA jAlandharaM shAkam| kUrcanaM jarjarIkaraNasAdhanaM shilAputrakamusalAdi| vinIyeti prakShipya| plavaH kaivartamustakam| kanakaM nAgakesharam| tvak guDatvak| audumbare iti tAmramaye| snehArdhamiti sarpistailArdham| ekam anaparAhNikamAhAram||41-57||

28.sanskrit: yathoktaguNAnAmAmalakAnAM sahasraM piShTasvedanavidhinA payasa UShmaNA susvinnamanAtapashuShkamanasthi cUrNayet| tadAmalakasahasrasvarasaparipItaM sthirApunarnavAjIvantInAgabalAbrahmasuvarcalAmaNDUkaparNIshatAvarIsha~gkhapuShpIpippalIvacAviDa~ggasvaya~gguptAmRutA- candanAgurumadhukamadhUkapuShpotpalapadmamAlatIyuvatIyUthikAcUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktaM punarnAgabalAsahasrapalasvarasaparipItamanAtapashuShkaM dviguNitasarpiShA kShaudrasarpiShA vA kShudraguDAkRutiM kRutvA shucau dRuDhe ghRutabhAvite kumbhe bhasmarAsheradhaH sthApayedantarbhUmeH pakShaM kRutarakShAvidhAnamatharvavedavidA, pakShAtyaye coddhRutya kanakarajatatAmrapravAlakAlAyasacUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktamardhakarShavRuddhyA yathoktena vidhinA prAtaH prAtaH prayu~jjAno~agnibalamabhisamIkShya, jIrNe ca ShaShTikaM payasA sasarpiShkamupasevamAno yathoktAn guNAn samashnuta iti||58|| bhavanti cAtra- idaM rasAyanaM brAhmaM maharShigaNasevitam| bhavatyarogo dIrghAyuH prayu~jjAno mahAbalaH||59|| kAntaH prajAnAM siddhArthashcandrAdityasamadyutiH| shrutaM dhArayate sattvamArShaM cAsya pravartate||60|| dharaNIdharasArashca vAyunA samavikramaH| sa bhavatyaviShaM cAsya gAtre sampadyate viSham||61|| (iti dvitIyaM brAhmarasAyanam)|
28.commentary: piShTasvedanavidhineti yathA piShTakaM toyaparipUritapAtroparidattatRuNAdisaMsthitaM svedyate, tathA tat svedanIyamityarthaH| svarasaparipItamiti svarasabhAvitam| brahmasuvarcalAdyauShadhAnyAyurvedasamutthAnIye vakShyamANAni| yuvatiH navamAlikA| aShTamo bhAgo~aShTabhAgaH| kShudraguDAkRutimiti phANitAkRutim| ardhakarShavRuddhyeti ardhakarShAtprabhRuti vardhayet| yathoktavidhineti kuTIprAveshikena vidhinA| yathoktAn guNAniti pUrvaprayogaphalashrutipaThitAn| dharaNIdharasAra iti uShTramukhavat; tena dharaNIdharAH parvatAH, teShAM sAro lauhaM, tadvatsAra ityarthaH| aviShamiti viShamavikAri||58-61||

28.sanskrit: bilvo~agnimanthaH shyonAkaH kAshmaryaH pATalirbalA| parNyashcatasraH pippalyaH shvadaMShTrA bRuhatIdvayam||62|| shRu~ggI tAmalakI drAkShA jIvantI puShkarAguru| abhayA cAmRutA RuddhirjIvakarShabhakau shaTI||63|| mustaM punarnavA medA sailA candanamutpalam| vidArI vRuShamUlAni kAkolI kAkanAsikA||64|| eShAM palonmitAn bhAgA~jchatAnyAmalakasya ca| pa~jca dadyAttadaikadhyaM jaladroNe vipAcayet||65|| j~jAtvA gatarasAnyetAnyauShadhAnyatha taM rasam| taccAmalakamuddhRutya niShkulaM tailasarpiShoH||66|| paladvAdashake bhRuShTvA dattvA cArdhatulAM bhiShak| matsyaNDikAyAH pUtAyA lehavatsAdhu sAdhayet||67|| ShaTpalaM madhunashcAtra siddhashIte pradApayet| catuShpalaM tugAkShIryAH pippalIdvipalaM tathA||68|| palamekaM nidadhyAcca tvagelApatrakesharAt| ityayaM cyavanaprAshaH paramukto rasAyanaH||69|| kAsashvAsaharashcaiva visheSheNopadishyate| kShINakShatAnAM vRuddhAnAM bAlAnAM cA~ggavardhanaH||70|| svarakShayamurorogaM hRudrogaM vAtashoNitam| pipAsAM mUtrashukrasthAn doShAMshcApyapakarShati||71|| asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta yoparundhyAnna bhojanam| asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA||72|| medhAM smRutiM kAntimanAmayatvamAyuHprakarShaM balamindriyANAm| strIShu praharShaM paramagnivRuddhiM varNaprasAdaM pavanAnulomyam||73|| rasAyanasyAsya naraH prayogAllabheta jIrNo~api kuTIpraveshAt| jarAkRutaM rUpamapAsya sarvaM bibharti rUpaM navayauvanasya||74|| (iti cyavanaprAshaH)|
28.commentary: parNyashcatasra iti shAlaparNI, pRushniparNI, mudgaparNI, mAShaparNI ca| tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI| kAkanAsA nAsAphalA, ‘kAkatuNDaka’ ityanye| gatarasatvamiha dravyANAM caturbhAgasthitajale bhavati| niShkulamiti nirasthi| tailasarpiShoriti samAsanirdeshAdubhAbhyAmeva dvAdashapalAni, na pRuthak pRuthak| matsyaNDikA khaNDasaMhatiH| atra ShaTpalatvena samayorapi madhusarpiShordravyAntarayuktatvenAviruddhatvam||62-74||

28.sanskrit: athAmalakaharItakInAmAmalakabibhItakAnAM harItakIbibhItakAnAmAmalakaharItakIbibhItakAnAM vA palAshatvagavanaddhAnAM mRudA~avaliptAnAM kukUlasvinnAnAmakulakAnAM palasahasramulUkhale sampothya dadhighRutamadhupalalatailasharkarAsaMyuktaM bhakShayedanannabhugyathoktena vidhinA; tasyAnte yavAgvAdibhiH pratyavasthApanam , abhya~ggotsAdanaM sarpiShA yavacUrNaishca, ayaM ca rasAyanaprayogaprakarSho dvistAvadagnibalamabhisamIkShya , pratibhojanaM yUSheNa payasA vA ShaShTikaH sasarpiShkaH, ataH paraM yathAsukhavihAraH kAmabhakShyaH syAt| anena prayogeNarShayaH punaryuvatvamavApurbabhUvushcAnekavarShashatajIvino nirvikArAH paraM sharIrabuddhIndriyabalasamuditAshcerushcAtyantaniShThayA tapaH||75|| (iti caturthAmalakarasAyanam)|
28.commentary: kukUlakaH karIShAgniH| akulakAnAmiti anasthnAm| dravyAdInAmatra mAnaM noktaM, tena pradhAnasya cUrNasya dadhyAdibhirmilitaiH samAnamAnatvaM; kiMvA pratyekameva dadhyAdInAM cUrNasamatvam| palalaM tilacUrNam| bhakShayediti vacanaM lehye~api alpAbhyavaharaNamAtrArthatvAdupapannam| anannabhugiti sarvathA~a~ahArAntarAbhuk| tasyAnta iti etatprayogaparityAgakAle| pratyavasthApanamiti yavAgvAdikramavisheShaNaM; tena prayogAnte yadA annasaMsarjanaM kartavyaM, tadA yavAgvAdikrameNetyuktasyArthasya pratyavasthApanaM kriyata ityarthaH| yUSheNa payasA veti vikalpo~agnibalApekShayA||75||

28.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakapa~jcapa~jcamUlaniryUhe pippalImadhukamadhUkakAkolIkShIrakAkolyAtmaguptAjIvakarShabhakakShIrashuklAkalkasamprayuktena vidArIsvarasena kShIrAShTaguNasamprayuktena ca sarpiShaH kumbhaM sAdhayitvA prayu~jjAno~agnibalasamAM mAtrAM jIrNe ca kShIrasarpirbhyAM shAliShaShTikamuShNodakAnupAnamashna~jjarAvyAdhipApAbhicAravyapagatabhayaH sharIrendriyabuddhibalamatulamupalabhyApratihatasarvArambhaH paramAyuranavApnuyAt||76|| (iti pa~jcamo harItakIyogaH)|
28.commentary: atra harItakyAdau kShIrashuklA kShIravidArikA| atra harItakyAdikvAthasya tveko bhAgaH, kShIrasyAShTau bhAgAH, sarpiSha eko bhAgaH| kumbho droNadvayam| vacanaM hi- “droNastu dviguNaH sUrpo vij~jeyaH kumbha eva ca” iti||76||

28.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakaharidrAsthirAbalAviDa~ggAmRutavallIvishvabheShajamadhukapippalIsomavalkasiddhena kShIrasarpiShA madhusharkarAbhyAmapi ca sannIyAmalakasvarasashataparipItamAmalakacUrNamayashcUrNacaturbhAgasamprayuktaM pANitalamAtraM prAtaH prAtaH prAshya yathoktena vidhinA sAyaM mudgayUSheNa payasA vA sasarpiShkaM shAliShaShTikAnnamashnIyAt, trivarShaprayogAdasya varShashatamajaraM vayastiShThati, shrutamavatiShThate, sarvAmayAH prashAmyanti, viShamaviShaM bhavati gAtre, gAtramashmavat sthirIbhavati, adhRuShyo bhUtAnAM bhavati||77|| bhavanti cAtra- yathA~amarANAmamRutaM yathA bhogavatAM sudhA| tathA~abhavanmaharShINAM rasAyanavidhiH purA||78|| na jarAM na ca daurbalyaM nAturyaM nidhanaM na ca| jagmurvarShasahasrANi rasAyanaparAH purA||79|| na kevalaM dIrghamihAyurashnute rasAyanaM yo vidhivanniShevate| gatiM sa devarShiniShevitAM shubhAM prapadyate brahma tatheti cAkShayam ||80||
28.commentary: amRutavallI guDUcI| somavalkaH viTkhadiraH| kShIrasarpiH kShIrasamutthitasarpiH| ayashcUrNasya caturtho bhAgaH, yata etadayashcUrNaM caturthabhAgamata evAsmin prayoge jatUkarNena “ayashcUrNapAdayuktam” iti kRutam| amarANAmamRutaM jarAdiharaM, nAgAnAM ca sudhA jarAmaraNaharI, ityubhayopAdAnaM dRuShTAnte| brahma mokShaH| mokShasAdhanatvaM ceha rasAyanasya vishuddhasattvakartRutayocyate|| 77-80||

28.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- abhayAmalakIye~asmin ShaDyogAH parikIrtitAH| rasAyanAnAM siddhAnAmAyuryairanuvartate||81||
28.commentary: abhayetyAdinA sandehanirAsArthamuktaprayogasa~gkhyAM darshayati| evamanyatrApi sa~gkhyApraNayanamante j~jeyam|| 81||

28.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH||1||
28.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH|| 1||

29.sanskrit: athAto~abhayAmalakIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
29.commentary: pUrvasthAnoktalakShaNAbhAvenAvadhAritAyuShmadbhAvena cikitsA dharmArthayashaskarI kartavyetyanantaraM cikitsAbhidhAyakaM sthAnamucyate| rasAyanavAjIkaraNasAdhanamapi yathA cikitsocyate, tathA~anantarameva vakShyati| tatrApi jvarAdicikitsAyAH prAgrasAyanavAjIkaraNayormahAphalatvenAdAvabhidhAnam| tayorapi ca rasAyanameva varShasahasrAyuShTvAdikAraNatayA mahAphalamiti tadabhidhIyate, tatrApi cAbhayAmalakIyashcikitsAsthAnArthasUtrAbhidhAyakatayA~agre~abhidhIyate||1-2||

29.sanskrit: cikitsitaM vyAdhiharaM pathyaM sAdhanamauShadham| prAyashcittaM prashamanaM prakRutisthApanaM hitam||3|| vidyAdbheShajanAmAni, ...|4|
29.commentary: tatrAdau vyavahArArthaM sthAnAbhidheyasya bheShajasya paryAyAnAha- cikitsitamityAdi| karoti caivamAdau pradhAnAbhidheyaparyAyAbhidhAnaM, yathA- nidAne heturUpAdiparyAyakathanam| etacca paryAyAbhidhAnaM prAdhAnyena catuShpAdasyaiva bheShajasya, yaduktaM- “catuShpAdaM ShoDashakalaM bheShajamiti bhiShajo bhAShante” (sU.a.10) iti| evambhUtabheShajA~ggarUpatayA tu sthAvaraja~ggamadravyarUpasya bheShajasya bheShajatvamevAntaravyavahArakRutaM j~jeyam| prAyashcittamiti bheShajasa~jj~jA prAyashcittavadbheShajasyAdharmakAryavyAdhiharatvena||3||-

29.sanskrit: ... bheShajaM dvividhaM ca tat| svasthasyorjaskaraM ki~jcit ki~jcidArtasya roganut||4||
29.commentary: dvaividhyaM vivRuNoti- svasthasyetyAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| svasthatvena vyavahriyamANasya puMso jarAdisvAbhAvikavyAdhiharatvena tathA~apraharShavyayAyakShayitvAnupacitashukratvAdyaprashastashArIrabhAvaharatvena UrjaH prashastaM bhAvamAdadhAtIti svasthasyorjaskaram| Artasya roganuditi visheShaNena jvarAdinA~a~artasya jvarAdiharam| roganuditi vacanenaivArtavisheShatAyAM labdhAyAM yat ‘Artasya’ iti karoti, tena sahajajarAdikRutAM pIDAmanudvejikAM parityajya jvarAdinA~asvAbhAvikena rogeNa pIDitasyeti darshayati||4||

29.sanskrit: abheShajaM ca dvividhaM bAdhanaM sAnubAdhanam|5|
29.commentary: bheShajaprasa~ggAdabheShajadvaividhyamAha- abheShajamityAdi| bAdhanamiha tadAtvamAtrabAdhakaM, yathA- svalpamapathyam| sAnubAdhanaM ca dIrghakAlAvasthAyikuShThAdivikArakAri||-

29.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam||5|| prAyaH, prAyeNa rogANAM dvitIyaM prashame matam| prAyaHshabdo visheShArtho hyubhayaM hyubhayArthakRut||6||
29.commentary: dvividhaM bheShajamuktaM vibhajate- svasthasyetyAdi| tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanaM prAya iti cchedaH| yadvRuShyaM prAyo bhavati, tathA rasAyanaM yat prAyo bhavati, Artasya rogaharaM yadbAhulyena, tat svasthorjaskaramucyate; yattu dvitIyamArtarogaharaM, tat prAyeNa jvarAdishamanaM rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavati; yathA- kShatakShINoktaM sarpirguDAdi rasAyanaM vRuShyaM ca bhavati, tathA pANDurogokto yogarAjo rasAyanatvenoktaH, tathA kAsAdhikAre~agastyaharItakI rasAyanatvenoktetyAdyanusaraNIyam| rasAyanoktAnAM ca jvarAdiharatvamatra suvyaktameva rasAyanagrantheShu| anye tu bruvate- yadvyAdhimAtraharaM na tadrasAyanaM, kintu sharIrasaMyogadArDhyAddIrghAyuHkartRutvasAdhAraNadharmayogAdupacaritavyAdhiharaM rasAyanamihocyata iti| nanu yadi svasthorjaskaramapi vyAdhiharaM, vyAdhiharaM ca svasthorjaskaraM tat kiM ki~jciditi padena bheShajakarmavyavasthAdarshakena kriyate? brUmaH- bAhulyena svasthorjaskaratvaM vyAdhiharatvaM ca vyavasthApyate, na ceha sarvArtarogaharasya svasthorjaskaratvamiti pratij~jAyate, yena pAThAsaptaparNAdInAmapi rasAyanatvaM sAdhanIyashaktitvAdArttarogaharatvena yaducyate tadapi rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavatIti lavamAtropadarshanaM kriyate, tat svasthArtayorubhayArthakartRutvam| prAyaHshabdatAtparyaM vivRuNoti- prAya ityAdi| visheShArtha iti bAhulyArtha ityarthaH||5-6||

29.sanskrit: dIrghamAyuH smRutiM medhAmArogyaM taruNaM vayaH| prabhAvarNasvaraudAryaM dehendriyabalaM param||7|| vAksiddhiM praNatiM kAntiM labhate nA rasAyanAt| lAbhopAyo hi shastAnAM rasAdInAM rasAyanam||8||
29.commentary: rasAyanakAryamAha- dIrghamityAdi| prabhAdInAM trayANAmaudAryaM yojanIyam| vAksiddhiH yaducyate tadavashyaM bhavatItyarthaH| praNatiH lokavandyatA| kathametadrasAyanena kriyata ityAha- lAbhetyAdi| rasAdigrahaNena smRutyAdayo~api gRuhyante||7-8||

29.sanskrit: apatyasantAnakaraM yat sadyaH sampraharShaNam| vAjIvAtibalo yena yAtyapratihataH striyaH||9|| bhavatyatipriyaH strINAM yena yenopacIyate| jIryato~apyakShayaM shukraM phalavadyena dRushyate||10|| prabhUtashAkhaH shAkhIva yena caityo yathA mahAn| bhavatyarcyo bahumataH prajAnAM subahuprajaH||11|| santAnamUlaM yeneha pretya cAnantyamashnute| yashaH shriyaM balaM puShTiM vAjIkaraNameva tat||12||
29.commentary: vAjIkaraNakAryamAha- apatyetyAdi| apatyasantAnaH apatyaparamparA, tena putrapautrakaramityarthaH; vAjIkaraNajanitAcchukrAjjAtaH putraH putrajananasamartho bhavatItyarthaH| atipriyatvaM cehopacitashukratayA nirantaravyavAyakartRutvAt; yaduktaM- “virUpamapi yoddhAraM bhRutyamicchanti pArthivAH| vyavAyavyAyataM mUrkhaM dhRuShTaM patimiva striyaH” iti| upacIyata iti puShTiM prApnoti| akShayamivAkShayam| phalavaditi garbhajanakam| caityo devatAyatanam| arcyaH arcanIyaH | AnantyamivAnantyaM; dIrghasantAnatAmityarthaH||9-12||

29.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM tvetaddvividhaM proktamauShadham| yadvyAdhinirghAtakaraM vakShyate taccikitsite||13|| cikitsitArtha etAvAn vikArANAM yadauShadham| rasAyanavidhishcAgre vAjIkaraNameva ca||14||
29.commentary: cikitsita iti jvarAdicikitsite| nanu rasAyanavAjIkaraNe api jvarAdicikitsite eva, tat kiM vishiShyocyate- ‘vakShyate taccikitsite’ ityAha- cikitsitArtha ityAdi| satyaM, rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca jvarAdivyAdhiharatvAccikitsitashabdenocyata ityarthaH| atha vyAdhiharatvAccikitsite vaktavyatvAcca rasAyanavAjIkaraNe kva nu vaktavye ityAha- rasAyanetyAdi| vidhiH vidhAnaM rasAyanAbhidhAnamityarthaH | agre iti anantaram| vAjIkaraNaM cAgre ‘abhidhAsyate’ iti sheShaH||13-14||

29.sanskrit: abheShajamiti j~jeyaM viparItaM yadauShadhAt| tadasevyaM niShevyaM tu pravakShyAmi yadauShadham||15||
29.commentary: abheShajamapi pUrvoddiShTaM vivRuNoti- abheShajamityAdi| viparItaM rogajananalakShaNArthakAri||15||

29.sanskrit: rasAyanAnAM dvividhaM prayogamRuShayo viduH| kuTIprAveshikaM caiva vAtAtapikameva ca||16|| kuTIprAveshikasyAdau vidhiH samupadekShyate| nRupavaidyadvijAtInAM sAdhUnAM puNyakarmaNAm||17|| nivAse nirbhaye shaste prApyopakaraNe pure| dishi pUrvottarasyAM ca subhUmau kArayet kuTIm||18|| vistArotsedhasampannAM trigarbhAM sUkShmalocanAm| ghanabhittimRutusukhAM suspaShTAM manasaH priyAm||19|| shabdAdInAmashastAnAmagamyaM strIvivarjitAm| iShTopakaraNopetAM sajjavaidyauShadhadvijAm ||20|| athodagayane shukle tithinakShatrapUjite| muhUrtakaraNopete prashaste kRutavApanaH||21|| dhRutismRutibalaM kRutvA shraddadhAnaH samAhitaH| vidhUya mAnasAn doShAn maitrIM bhUteShu cintayan||22|| devatAH pUjayitvA~agre dvijAtIMshca pradakShiNam| devagobrAhmaNAn kRutvA tatastAM pravishet kuTIm||23|| tasyAM saMshodhanaiH shuddhaH sukhI jAtabalaH punaH| rasAyanaM prayu~jjIta tatpravakShyAmi shodhanam||24||
29.commentary: kuTIpraveshena yat kriyate tat kuTIprAveshikam| vAtAtapasevayA~api yat kriyate tad vAtAtapikam| trigarbhAM prathamamekaM gRuhaM, tasyAbhyantare dvitIyam, evaM trigarbhAstrayo garbhA antarANi yasyAM sA; trigarbhAmiti antastriprakoShThAm| sUkShmalocanAmiti alpadvArajAlakAm| shukle shuklapakShe| sajjA vaidyAdayo yasyAM sA tathA| tithinakShatrapUjita iti shubhatithinakShatrayogAt pUjite| kRutavApana iti kRutakShauraH| mAnasAn doShAniti kAmakrodhAdIn| saMshodhanairiti vamanavirecanAsthApanashirovirecanaiH| sukhIti arogaH| jAtabala iti saMshodhanApahRutamalatayA saMsarjanAdikrameNa punarjAtabalaH| yadyapIha saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaprayogAt sarvANyeva saMshodhanAni sammatAni, tathA~apIha rasAyane visheSheNa yaugikatvAddharItakyAdiprayoga evoktaH; anye tu harItakyAdiprayogeNaiva paraM saMshodhanaM kartavyamityAhuH, saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaM punaryAvacchuddherharItakyAdiprayogasyaiva karaNaM darshayati||16-24||

29.sanskrit: harItakInAM cUrNAni saindhavAmalake guDam| vacAM viDa~ggaM rajanIM pippalIM vishvabheShajam||25|| pibeduShNAmbunA jantuH snehasvedopapAditaH| tena shuddhasharIrAya kRutasaMsarjanAya ca||26|| trirAtraM yAvakaM dadyAt pa~jcAhaM vA~api sarpiShA| saptAhaM vA purANasya yAvacchuddhestu varcasaH||27|| shuddhakoShThaM tu taM j~jAtvA rasAyanamupAcaret| vayaHprakRutisAtmyaj~jo yaugikaM yasya yadbhavet||28||
29.commentary: yAvakamiti yavAnnam| trirAtrAdivikalpatrayaM hInamadhyottamashuddhiviShayam||25-28||

29.sanskrit: harItakIM pa~jcarasAmuShNAmalavaNAM shivAm| doShAnulomanIM laghvIM vidyAddIpanapAcanIm||29|| AyuShyAM pauShTikIM dhanyAM vayasaH sthApanIM parAm| sarvarogaprashamanIM buddhIndriyabalapradAm||30|| kuShThaM gulmamudAvartaM shoShaM pANDvAmayaM madam| arshAMsi grahaNIdoShaM purANaM viShamajvaram||31|| hRudrogaM sashirorogamatIsAramarocakam| kAsaM pramehamAnAhaM plIhAnamudaraM navam||32|| kaphaprasekaM vaisvaryaM vaivarNyaM kAmalAM krimIn| shvayathuM tamakaM chardiM klaibyama~ggAvasAdanam||33|| srotovibandhAn vividhAn pralepaM hRudayorasoH| smRutibuddhipramohaM ca jayecchIghraM harItakI||34|| (ajIrNino rUkShabhujaH strImadyaviShakarshitAH| severannAbhayAmete kShuttRuShNoShNArditAshca ye)||35|| tAn guNAMstAni karmANi vidyAdAmalakIShvapi| yAnyuktAni harItakyA vIryasya tu viparyayaH||36|| atashcAmRutakalpAni vidyAt karmabhirIdRushaiH| harItakInAM shasyAni bhiShagAmalakasya ca||37||
29.commentary: yadyapi dravyAntarANi dashavarShashatAyuShkararasAyanAdhikRutAni santi, tathA~api harItakyAmalake eva rogaharatvAyuShkaratvarUpobhayadharmayogAdadhyAyAdau guNakarmabhyAmucyete; tatrApi yadyapi “AmalakaM vayaHsthApanAnAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktam, tathA~api rogaharatve harItakI prakarShavatIti kRutvA harItakyagre~abhihitA| harItakyAdiShu pa~jcarasatvAdyutpAdo~adRuShTavashAdbhUtasanniveshavisheShaprabhAvakRutaH; tena nAtropapattayaH kramante| shivAmiti kalyANakAriNIM, prashastaguNayuktatvAt| sarvarogaprashamanImiti saMyogasaMskArAdinA| sarvarogaharatvamabhidhAyApi kuShThAdihantRutvAbhidhAnaM visheSheNa kuShThAdihantRutvopadarshanArtham| pravartakatve~apyatIsAragrahaNIharatvaM vibaddhadoShapravartakatayA j~jeyaM; yaduktaM- “stokaM stokaM vibaddhaM vA sashUlaM yo~atisAryate| abhayApippalIkalkaiH sukhoShNaistaM virecayet” iti| buddhismRutipradatvamabhidhAyApi smRutibuddhipramohaharatvAbhidhAnaM tatra vishiShTashaktyupadarshanArtham| vIryasya tu viparyaya ityanenAmalakasya shItavIryatvamuktam| shasyAnIti asthirahitAni phalAni||29-37||

29.sanskrit: oShadhInAM parA bhUmirhimavA~j shailasattamaH| tasmAtphalAni tajjAni grAhayetkAlajAni tu||38|| ApUrNarasavIryANi kAle kAle yathAvidhi| AdityapavanacchAyAsalilaprINitAni ca||39|| yAnyajagdhAnyapUtIni nirvraNAnyagadAni ca| teShAM prayogaM vakShyAmi phalAnAM karma cottamam||40||
29.commentary: yadyapi “himavAnauShadhabhUmInAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktaM, tathA~api rasAyane himavatprabhavANyeva bheShajAni grAhyANIti darshayitumauShadhInAmityAdyabhidhAnam| kAle kAle iti phalapAkakAle ityarthaH| yathAvidhIti yathA bheShajagrahaNaM ma~ggaladevatArcanAdipUrvakaM syAttathA~avashyaM rasAyane karttavyam| agadAnItyanena pavanadahanAdyadoShaM phalasya darshayati||38-40||

29.sanskrit: pa~jcAnAM pa~jcamUlAnAM bhAgAn dashapalonmitAn| harItakIsahasraM ca triguNAmalakaM navam||41|| vidArigandhAM bRuhatIM pRushniparNIM nidigdhikAm| vidyAdvidArigandhAdyaM shvadaMShTrApa~jcamaM gaNam||42|| bilvAgnimanthashyonAkaM kAshmaryamatha pATalAm| punarnavAM shUrpaparNyau balAmeraNDameva ca||43|| jIvakarShabhakau medAM jIvantIM sashatAvarIm| sharekShudarbhakAshAnAM shAlInAM mUlameva ca||44|| ityeShAM pa~jcamUlAnAM pa~jcAnAmupakalpayet| bhAgAn yathoktAMstatsarvaM sAdhyaM dashaguNe~ambhasi||45|| dashabhAgAvasheShaM tu pUtaM taM grAhayedrasam| harItakIshca tAH sarvAH sarvANyAmalakAni ca||46|| tAni sarvANyanasthIni phalAnyApothya kUrcanaiH| vinIya tasminniryUhe cUrNAnImAni dApayet||47|| maNDUkaparNyAH pippalyAH sha~gkhapuShpyAH plavasya ca| mustAnAM saviDa~ggAnAM candanAguruNostathA||48|| madhukasya haridrAyA vacAyAH kanakasya ca| bhAgAMshcatuShpalAn kRutvA sUkShmailAyAstvacastathA||49|| sitopalAsahasraM ca cUrNitaM tulayA~adhikam| tailasya dvyADhakaM tatra dadyAttrINi ca sarpiShaH||50|| sAdhyamaudumbare pAtre tat sarvaM mRudunA~agninA| j~jAtvA lehyamadagdhaM ca shItaM kShaudreNa saMsRujet||51|| kShaudrapramANaM snehArdhaM tat sarvaM ghRutabhAjane| tiShThetsammUrcchitaM tasya mAtrAM kAle prayojayet||52|| yA noparundhyAdAhAramekaM mAtrA jarAM prati| ShaShTikaH payasA cAtra jIrNe bhojanamiShyate||53|| vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAstathA cAnye tapodhanAH| rasAyanamidaM prAshya babhUvuramitAyuShaH||54|| muktvA jIrNaM vapushcAgryamavApustaruNaM vayaH| vItatandrAklamashvAsA nirAta~gkAH samAhitAH||55|| medhAsmRutibalopetAshcirarAtraM tapodhanAH| brAhmaM tapo brahmacaryaM cerushcAtyantaniShThayA||56|| rasAyanamidaM brAhmamAyuShkAmaH prayojayet| dIrghamAyurvayashcAgryaM kAmAMshceShTAn samashnute||57|| (iti brAhmarasAyanam)|
29.commentary: pa~jcAnAmityAdau pratidravyaM dashapalabhAgagrahaNam , uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “iti pa~jca pa~jcamUlAni, teShAM pratidravyaM dashapalAni” iti| harItakIsahasramiti harItakIphalasahasram| shUrpaparNyau mudgamAShaparNyau| vIrA jAlandharaM shAkam| kUrcanaM jarjarIkaraNasAdhanaM shilAputrakamusalAdi| vinIyeti prakShipya| plavaH kaivartamustakam| kanakaM nAgakesharam| tvak guDatvak| audumbare iti tAmramaye| snehArdhamiti sarpistailArdham| ekam anaparAhNikamAhAram||41-57||

29.sanskrit: yathoktaguNAnAmAmalakAnAM sahasraM piShTasvedanavidhinA payasa UShmaNA susvinnamanAtapashuShkamanasthi cUrNayet| tadAmalakasahasrasvarasaparipItaM sthirApunarnavAjIvantInAgabalAbrahmasuvarcalAmaNDUkaparNIshatAvarIsha~gkhapuShpIpippalIvacAviDa~ggasvaya~gguptAmRutA- candanAgurumadhukamadhUkapuShpotpalapadmamAlatIyuvatIyUthikAcUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktaM punarnAgabalAsahasrapalasvarasaparipItamanAtapashuShkaM dviguNitasarpiShA kShaudrasarpiShA vA kShudraguDAkRutiM kRutvA shucau dRuDhe ghRutabhAvite kumbhe bhasmarAsheradhaH sthApayedantarbhUmeH pakShaM kRutarakShAvidhAnamatharvavedavidA, pakShAtyaye coddhRutya kanakarajatatAmrapravAlakAlAyasacUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktamardhakarShavRuddhyA yathoktena vidhinA prAtaH prAtaH prayu~jjAno~agnibalamabhisamIkShya, jIrNe ca ShaShTikaM payasA sasarpiShkamupasevamAno yathoktAn guNAn samashnuta iti||58|| bhavanti cAtra- idaM rasAyanaM brAhmaM maharShigaNasevitam| bhavatyarogo dIrghAyuH prayu~jjAno mahAbalaH||59|| kAntaH prajAnAM siddhArthashcandrAdityasamadyutiH| shrutaM dhArayate sattvamArShaM cAsya pravartate||60|| dharaNIdharasArashca vAyunA samavikramaH| sa bhavatyaviShaM cAsya gAtre sampadyate viSham||61|| (iti dvitIyaM brAhmarasAyanam)|
29.commentary: piShTasvedanavidhineti yathA piShTakaM toyaparipUritapAtroparidattatRuNAdisaMsthitaM svedyate, tathA tat svedanIyamityarthaH| svarasaparipItamiti svarasabhAvitam| brahmasuvarcalAdyauShadhAnyAyurvedasamutthAnIye vakShyamANAni| yuvatiH navamAlikA| aShTamo bhAgo~aShTabhAgaH| kShudraguDAkRutimiti phANitAkRutim| ardhakarShavRuddhyeti ardhakarShAtprabhRuti vardhayet| yathoktavidhineti kuTIprAveshikena vidhinA| yathoktAn guNAniti pUrvaprayogaphalashrutipaThitAn| dharaNIdharasAra iti uShTramukhavat; tena dharaNIdharAH parvatAH, teShAM sAro lauhaM, tadvatsAra ityarthaH| aviShamiti viShamavikAri||58-61||

29.sanskrit: bilvo~agnimanthaH shyonAkaH kAshmaryaH pATalirbalA| parNyashcatasraH pippalyaH shvadaMShTrA bRuhatIdvayam||62|| shRu~ggI tAmalakI drAkShA jIvantI puShkarAguru| abhayA cAmRutA RuddhirjIvakarShabhakau shaTI||63|| mustaM punarnavA medA sailA candanamutpalam| vidArI vRuShamUlAni kAkolI kAkanAsikA||64|| eShAM palonmitAn bhAgA~jchatAnyAmalakasya ca| pa~jca dadyAttadaikadhyaM jaladroNe vipAcayet||65|| j~jAtvA gatarasAnyetAnyauShadhAnyatha taM rasam| taccAmalakamuddhRutya niShkulaM tailasarpiShoH||66|| paladvAdashake bhRuShTvA dattvA cArdhatulAM bhiShak| matsyaNDikAyAH pUtAyA lehavatsAdhu sAdhayet||67|| ShaTpalaM madhunashcAtra siddhashIte pradApayet| catuShpalaM tugAkShIryAH pippalIdvipalaM tathA||68|| palamekaM nidadhyAcca tvagelApatrakesharAt| ityayaM cyavanaprAshaH paramukto rasAyanaH||69|| kAsashvAsaharashcaiva visheSheNopadishyate| kShINakShatAnAM vRuddhAnAM bAlAnAM cA~ggavardhanaH||70|| svarakShayamurorogaM hRudrogaM vAtashoNitam| pipAsAM mUtrashukrasthAn doShAMshcApyapakarShati||71|| asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta yoparundhyAnna bhojanam| asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA||72|| medhAM smRutiM kAntimanAmayatvamAyuHprakarShaM balamindriyANAm| strIShu praharShaM paramagnivRuddhiM varNaprasAdaM pavanAnulomyam||73|| rasAyanasyAsya naraH prayogAllabheta jIrNo~api kuTIpraveshAt| jarAkRutaM rUpamapAsya sarvaM bibharti rUpaM navayauvanasya||74|| (iti cyavanaprAshaH)|
29.commentary: parNyashcatasra iti shAlaparNI, pRushniparNI, mudgaparNI, mAShaparNI ca| tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI| kAkanAsA nAsAphalA, ‘kAkatuNDaka’ ityanye| gatarasatvamiha dravyANAM caturbhAgasthitajale bhavati| niShkulamiti nirasthi| tailasarpiShoriti samAsanirdeshAdubhAbhyAmeva dvAdashapalAni, na pRuthak pRuthak| matsyaNDikA khaNDasaMhatiH| atra ShaTpalatvena samayorapi madhusarpiShordravyAntarayuktatvenAviruddhatvam||62-74||

29.sanskrit: athAmalakaharItakInAmAmalakabibhItakAnAM harItakIbibhItakAnAmAmalakaharItakIbibhItakAnAM vA palAshatvagavanaddhAnAM mRudA~avaliptAnAM kukUlasvinnAnAmakulakAnAM palasahasramulUkhale sampothya dadhighRutamadhupalalatailasharkarAsaMyuktaM bhakShayedanannabhugyathoktena vidhinA; tasyAnte yavAgvAdibhiH pratyavasthApanam , abhya~ggotsAdanaM sarpiShA yavacUrNaishca, ayaM ca rasAyanaprayogaprakarSho dvistAvadagnibalamabhisamIkShya , pratibhojanaM yUSheNa payasA vA ShaShTikaH sasarpiShkaH, ataH paraM yathAsukhavihAraH kAmabhakShyaH syAt| anena prayogeNarShayaH punaryuvatvamavApurbabhUvushcAnekavarShashatajIvino nirvikArAH paraM sharIrabuddhIndriyabalasamuditAshcerushcAtyantaniShThayA tapaH||75|| (iti caturthAmalakarasAyanam)|
29.commentary: kukUlakaH karIShAgniH| akulakAnAmiti anasthnAm| dravyAdInAmatra mAnaM noktaM, tena pradhAnasya cUrNasya dadhyAdibhirmilitaiH samAnamAnatvaM; kiMvA pratyekameva dadhyAdInAM cUrNasamatvam| palalaM tilacUrNam| bhakShayediti vacanaM lehye~api alpAbhyavaharaNamAtrArthatvAdupapannam| anannabhugiti sarvathA~a~ahArAntarAbhuk| tasyAnta iti etatprayogaparityAgakAle| pratyavasthApanamiti yavAgvAdikramavisheShaNaM; tena prayogAnte yadA annasaMsarjanaM kartavyaM, tadA yavAgvAdikrameNetyuktasyArthasya pratyavasthApanaM kriyata ityarthaH| yUSheNa payasA veti vikalpo~agnibalApekShayA||75||

29.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakapa~jcapa~jcamUlaniryUhe pippalImadhukamadhUkakAkolIkShIrakAkolyAtmaguptAjIvakarShabhakakShIrashuklAkalkasamprayuktena vidArIsvarasena kShIrAShTaguNasamprayuktena ca sarpiShaH kumbhaM sAdhayitvA prayu~jjAno~agnibalasamAM mAtrAM jIrNe ca kShIrasarpirbhyAM shAliShaShTikamuShNodakAnupAnamashna~jjarAvyAdhipApAbhicAravyapagatabhayaH sharIrendriyabuddhibalamatulamupalabhyApratihatasarvArambhaH paramAyuranavApnuyAt||76|| (iti pa~jcamo harItakIyogaH)|
29.commentary: atra harItakyAdau kShIrashuklA kShIravidArikA| atra harItakyAdikvAthasya tveko bhAgaH, kShIrasyAShTau bhAgAH, sarpiSha eko bhAgaH| kumbho droNadvayam| vacanaM hi- “droNastu dviguNaH sUrpo vij~jeyaH kumbha eva ca” iti||76||

29.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakaharidrAsthirAbalAviDa~ggAmRutavallIvishvabheShajamadhukapippalIsomavalkasiddhena kShIrasarpiShA madhusharkarAbhyAmapi ca sannIyAmalakasvarasashataparipItamAmalakacUrNamayashcUrNacaturbhAgasamprayuktaM pANitalamAtraM prAtaH prAtaH prAshya yathoktena vidhinA sAyaM mudgayUSheNa payasA vA sasarpiShkaM shAliShaShTikAnnamashnIyAt, trivarShaprayogAdasya varShashatamajaraM vayastiShThati, shrutamavatiShThate, sarvAmayAH prashAmyanti, viShamaviShaM bhavati gAtre, gAtramashmavat sthirIbhavati, adhRuShyo bhUtAnAM bhavati||77|| bhavanti cAtra- yathA~amarANAmamRutaM yathA bhogavatAM sudhA| tathA~abhavanmaharShINAM rasAyanavidhiH purA||78|| na jarAM na ca daurbalyaM nAturyaM nidhanaM na ca| jagmurvarShasahasrANi rasAyanaparAH purA||79|| na kevalaM dIrghamihAyurashnute rasAyanaM yo vidhivanniShevate| gatiM sa devarShiniShevitAM shubhAM prapadyate brahma tatheti cAkShayam ||80||
29.commentary: amRutavallI guDUcI| somavalkaH viTkhadiraH| kShIrasarpiH kShIrasamutthitasarpiH| ayashcUrNasya caturtho bhAgaH, yata etadayashcUrNaM caturthabhAgamata evAsmin prayoge jatUkarNena “ayashcUrNapAdayuktam” iti kRutam| amarANAmamRutaM jarAdiharaM, nAgAnAM ca sudhA jarAmaraNaharI, ityubhayopAdAnaM dRuShTAnte| brahma mokShaH| mokShasAdhanatvaM ceha rasAyanasya vishuddhasattvakartRutayocyate|| 77-80||

29.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- abhayAmalakIye~asmin ShaDyogAH parikIrtitAH| rasAyanAnAM siddhAnAmAyuryairanuvartate||81||
29.commentary: abhayetyAdinA sandehanirAsArthamuktaprayogasa~gkhyAM darshayati| evamanyatrApi sa~gkhyApraNayanamante j~jeyam|| 81||

29.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH||1||
29.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH|| 1||

30.sanskrit: athAto~abhayAmalakIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
30.commentary: pUrvasthAnoktalakShaNAbhAvenAvadhAritAyuShmadbhAvena cikitsA dharmArthayashaskarI kartavyetyanantaraM cikitsAbhidhAyakaM sthAnamucyate| rasAyanavAjIkaraNasAdhanamapi yathA cikitsocyate, tathA~anantarameva vakShyati| tatrApi jvarAdicikitsAyAH prAgrasAyanavAjIkaraNayormahAphalatvenAdAvabhidhAnam| tayorapi ca rasAyanameva varShasahasrAyuShTvAdikAraNatayA mahAphalamiti tadabhidhIyate, tatrApi cAbhayAmalakIyashcikitsAsthAnArthasUtrAbhidhAyakatayA~agre~abhidhIyate||1-2||

30.sanskrit: cikitsitaM vyAdhiharaM pathyaM sAdhanamauShadham| prAyashcittaM prashamanaM prakRutisthApanaM hitam||3|| vidyAdbheShajanAmAni, ...|4|
30.commentary: tatrAdau vyavahArArthaM sthAnAbhidheyasya bheShajasya paryAyAnAha- cikitsitamityAdi| karoti caivamAdau pradhAnAbhidheyaparyAyAbhidhAnaM, yathA- nidAne heturUpAdiparyAyakathanam| etacca paryAyAbhidhAnaM prAdhAnyena catuShpAdasyaiva bheShajasya, yaduktaM- “catuShpAdaM ShoDashakalaM bheShajamiti bhiShajo bhAShante” (sU.a.10) iti| evambhUtabheShajA~ggarUpatayA tu sthAvaraja~ggamadravyarUpasya bheShajasya bheShajatvamevAntaravyavahArakRutaM j~jeyam| prAyashcittamiti bheShajasa~jj~jA prAyashcittavadbheShajasyAdharmakAryavyAdhiharatvena||3||-

30.sanskrit: ... bheShajaM dvividhaM ca tat| svasthasyorjaskaraM ki~jcit ki~jcidArtasya roganut||4||
30.commentary: dvaividhyaM vivRuNoti- svasthasyetyAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| svasthatvena vyavahriyamANasya puMso jarAdisvAbhAvikavyAdhiharatvena tathA~apraharShavyayAyakShayitvAnupacitashukratvAdyaprashastashArIrabhAvaharatvena UrjaH prashastaM bhAvamAdadhAtIti svasthasyorjaskaram| Artasya roganuditi visheShaNena jvarAdinA~a~artasya jvarAdiharam| roganuditi vacanenaivArtavisheShatAyAM labdhAyAM yat ‘Artasya’ iti karoti, tena sahajajarAdikRutAM pIDAmanudvejikAM parityajya jvarAdinA~asvAbhAvikena rogeNa pIDitasyeti darshayati||4||

30.sanskrit: abheShajaM ca dvividhaM bAdhanaM sAnubAdhanam|5|
30.commentary: bheShajaprasa~ggAdabheShajadvaividhyamAha- abheShajamityAdi| bAdhanamiha tadAtvamAtrabAdhakaM, yathA- svalpamapathyam| sAnubAdhanaM ca dIrghakAlAvasthAyikuShThAdivikArakAri||-

30.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam||5|| prAyaH, prAyeNa rogANAM dvitIyaM prashame matam| prAyaHshabdo visheShArtho hyubhayaM hyubhayArthakRut||6||
30.commentary: dvividhaM bheShajamuktaM vibhajate- svasthasyetyAdi| tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanaM prAya iti cchedaH| yadvRuShyaM prAyo bhavati, tathA rasAyanaM yat prAyo bhavati, Artasya rogaharaM yadbAhulyena, tat svasthorjaskaramucyate; yattu dvitIyamArtarogaharaM, tat prAyeNa jvarAdishamanaM rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavati; yathA- kShatakShINoktaM sarpirguDAdi rasAyanaM vRuShyaM ca bhavati, tathA pANDurogokto yogarAjo rasAyanatvenoktaH, tathA kAsAdhikAre~agastyaharItakI rasAyanatvenoktetyAdyanusaraNIyam| rasAyanoktAnAM ca jvarAdiharatvamatra suvyaktameva rasAyanagrantheShu| anye tu bruvate- yadvyAdhimAtraharaM na tadrasAyanaM, kintu sharIrasaMyogadArDhyAddIrghAyuHkartRutvasAdhAraNadharmayogAdupacaritavyAdhiharaM rasAyanamihocyata iti| nanu yadi svasthorjaskaramapi vyAdhiharaM, vyAdhiharaM ca svasthorjaskaraM tat kiM ki~jciditi padena bheShajakarmavyavasthAdarshakena kriyate? brUmaH- bAhulyena svasthorjaskaratvaM vyAdhiharatvaM ca vyavasthApyate, na ceha sarvArtarogaharasya svasthorjaskaratvamiti pratij~jAyate, yena pAThAsaptaparNAdInAmapi rasAyanatvaM sAdhanIyashaktitvAdArttarogaharatvena yaducyate tadapi rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavatIti lavamAtropadarshanaM kriyate, tat svasthArtayorubhayArthakartRutvam| prAyaHshabdatAtparyaM vivRuNoti- prAya ityAdi| visheShArtha iti bAhulyArtha ityarthaH||5-6||

30.sanskrit: dIrghamAyuH smRutiM medhAmArogyaM taruNaM vayaH| prabhAvarNasvaraudAryaM dehendriyabalaM param||7|| vAksiddhiM praNatiM kAntiM labhate nA rasAyanAt| lAbhopAyo hi shastAnAM rasAdInAM rasAyanam||8||
30.commentary: rasAyanakAryamAha- dIrghamityAdi| prabhAdInAM trayANAmaudAryaM yojanIyam| vAksiddhiH yaducyate tadavashyaM bhavatItyarthaH| praNatiH lokavandyatA| kathametadrasAyanena kriyata ityAha- lAbhetyAdi| rasAdigrahaNena smRutyAdayo~api gRuhyante||7-8||

30.sanskrit: apatyasantAnakaraM yat sadyaH sampraharShaNam| vAjIvAtibalo yena yAtyapratihataH striyaH||9|| bhavatyatipriyaH strINAM yena yenopacIyate| jIryato~apyakShayaM shukraM phalavadyena dRushyate||10|| prabhUtashAkhaH shAkhIva yena caityo yathA mahAn| bhavatyarcyo bahumataH prajAnAM subahuprajaH||11|| santAnamUlaM yeneha pretya cAnantyamashnute| yashaH shriyaM balaM puShTiM vAjIkaraNameva tat||12||
30.commentary: vAjIkaraNakAryamAha- apatyetyAdi| apatyasantAnaH apatyaparamparA, tena putrapautrakaramityarthaH; vAjIkaraNajanitAcchukrAjjAtaH putraH putrajananasamartho bhavatItyarthaH| atipriyatvaM cehopacitashukratayA nirantaravyavAyakartRutvAt; yaduktaM- “virUpamapi yoddhAraM bhRutyamicchanti pArthivAH| vyavAyavyAyataM mUrkhaM dhRuShTaM patimiva striyaH” iti| upacIyata iti puShTiM prApnoti| akShayamivAkShayam| phalavaditi garbhajanakam| caityo devatAyatanam| arcyaH arcanIyaH | AnantyamivAnantyaM; dIrghasantAnatAmityarthaH||9-12||

30.sanskrit: svasthasyorjaskaraM tvetaddvividhaM proktamauShadham| yadvyAdhinirghAtakaraM vakShyate taccikitsite||13|| cikitsitArtha etAvAn vikArANAM yadauShadham| rasAyanavidhishcAgre vAjIkaraNameva ca||14||
30.commentary: cikitsita iti jvarAdicikitsite| nanu rasAyanavAjIkaraNe api jvarAdicikitsite eva, tat kiM vishiShyocyate- ‘vakShyate taccikitsite’ ityAha- cikitsitArtha ityAdi| satyaM, rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca jvarAdivyAdhiharatvAccikitsitashabdenocyata ityarthaH| atha vyAdhiharatvAccikitsite vaktavyatvAcca rasAyanavAjIkaraNe kva nu vaktavye ityAha- rasAyanetyAdi| vidhiH vidhAnaM rasAyanAbhidhAnamityarthaH | agre iti anantaram| vAjIkaraNaM cAgre ‘abhidhAsyate’ iti sheShaH||13-14||

30.sanskrit: abheShajamiti j~jeyaM viparItaM yadauShadhAt| tadasevyaM niShevyaM tu pravakShyAmi yadauShadham||15||
30.commentary: abheShajamapi pUrvoddiShTaM vivRuNoti- abheShajamityAdi| viparItaM rogajananalakShaNArthakAri||15||

30.sanskrit: rasAyanAnAM dvividhaM prayogamRuShayo viduH| kuTIprAveshikaM caiva vAtAtapikameva ca||16|| kuTIprAveshikasyAdau vidhiH samupadekShyate| nRupavaidyadvijAtInAM sAdhUnAM puNyakarmaNAm||17|| nivAse nirbhaye shaste prApyopakaraNe pure| dishi pUrvottarasyAM ca subhUmau kArayet kuTIm||18|| vistArotsedhasampannAM trigarbhAM sUkShmalocanAm| ghanabhittimRutusukhAM suspaShTAM manasaH priyAm||19|| shabdAdInAmashastAnAmagamyaM strIvivarjitAm| iShTopakaraNopetAM sajjavaidyauShadhadvijAm ||20|| athodagayane shukle tithinakShatrapUjite| muhUrtakaraNopete prashaste kRutavApanaH||21|| dhRutismRutibalaM kRutvA shraddadhAnaH samAhitaH| vidhUya mAnasAn doShAn maitrIM bhUteShu cintayan||22|| devatAH pUjayitvA~agre dvijAtIMshca pradakShiNam| devagobrAhmaNAn kRutvA tatastAM pravishet kuTIm||23|| tasyAM saMshodhanaiH shuddhaH sukhI jAtabalaH punaH| rasAyanaM prayu~jjIta tatpravakShyAmi shodhanam||24||
30.commentary: kuTIpraveshena yat kriyate tat kuTIprAveshikam| vAtAtapasevayA~api yat kriyate tad vAtAtapikam| trigarbhAM prathamamekaM gRuhaM, tasyAbhyantare dvitIyam, evaM trigarbhAstrayo garbhA antarANi yasyAM sA; trigarbhAmiti antastriprakoShThAm| sUkShmalocanAmiti alpadvArajAlakAm| shukle shuklapakShe| sajjA vaidyAdayo yasyAM sA tathA| tithinakShatrapUjita iti shubhatithinakShatrayogAt pUjite| kRutavApana iti kRutakShauraH| mAnasAn doShAniti kAmakrodhAdIn| saMshodhanairiti vamanavirecanAsthApanashirovirecanaiH| sukhIti arogaH| jAtabala iti saMshodhanApahRutamalatayA saMsarjanAdikrameNa punarjAtabalaH| yadyapIha saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaprayogAt sarvANyeva saMshodhanAni sammatAni, tathA~apIha rasAyane visheSheNa yaugikatvAddharItakyAdiprayoga evoktaH; anye tu harItakyAdiprayogeNaiva paraM saMshodhanaM kartavyamityAhuH, saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaM punaryAvacchuddherharItakyAdiprayogasyaiva karaNaM darshayati||16-24||

30.sanskrit: harItakInAM cUrNAni saindhavAmalake guDam| vacAM viDa~ggaM rajanIM pippalIM vishvabheShajam||25|| pibeduShNAmbunA jantuH snehasvedopapAditaH| tena shuddhasharIrAya kRutasaMsarjanAya ca||26|| trirAtraM yAvakaM dadyAt pa~jcAhaM vA~api sarpiShA| saptAhaM vA purANasya yAvacchuddhestu varcasaH||27|| shuddhakoShThaM tu taM j~jAtvA rasAyanamupAcaret| vayaHprakRutisAtmyaj~jo yaugikaM yasya yadbhavet||28||
30.commentary: yAvakamiti yavAnnam| trirAtrAdivikalpatrayaM hInamadhyottamashuddhiviShayam||25-28||

30.sanskrit: harItakIM pa~jcarasAmuShNAmalavaNAM shivAm| doShAnulomanIM laghvIM vidyAddIpanapAcanIm||29|| AyuShyAM pauShTikIM dhanyAM vayasaH sthApanIM parAm| sarvarogaprashamanIM buddhIndriyabalapradAm||30|| kuShThaM gulmamudAvartaM shoShaM pANDvAmayaM madam| arshAMsi grahaNIdoShaM purANaM viShamajvaram||31|| hRudrogaM sashirorogamatIsAramarocakam| kAsaM pramehamAnAhaM plIhAnamudaraM navam||32|| kaphaprasekaM vaisvaryaM vaivarNyaM kAmalAM krimIn| shvayathuM tamakaM chardiM klaibyama~ggAvasAdanam||33|| srotovibandhAn vividhAn pralepaM hRudayorasoH| smRutibuddhipramohaM ca jayecchIghraM harItakI||34|| (ajIrNino rUkShabhujaH strImadyaviShakarshitAH| severannAbhayAmete kShuttRuShNoShNArditAshca ye)||35|| tAn guNAMstAni karmANi vidyAdAmalakIShvapi| yAnyuktAni harItakyA vIryasya tu viparyayaH||36|| atashcAmRutakalpAni vidyAt karmabhirIdRushaiH| harItakInAM shasyAni bhiShagAmalakasya ca||37||
30.commentary: yadyapi dravyAntarANi dashavarShashatAyuShkararasAyanAdhikRutAni santi, tathA~api harItakyAmalake eva rogaharatvAyuShkaratvarUpobhayadharmayogAdadhyAyAdau guNakarmabhyAmucyete; tatrApi yadyapi “AmalakaM vayaHsthApanAnAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktam, tathA~api rogaharatve harItakI prakarShavatIti kRutvA harItakyagre~abhihitA| harItakyAdiShu pa~jcarasatvAdyutpAdo~adRuShTavashAdbhUtasanniveshavisheShaprabhAvakRutaH; tena nAtropapattayaH kramante| shivAmiti kalyANakAriNIM, prashastaguNayuktatvAt| sarvarogaprashamanImiti saMyogasaMskArAdinA| sarvarogaharatvamabhidhAyApi kuShThAdihantRutvAbhidhAnaM visheSheNa kuShThAdihantRutvopadarshanArtham| pravartakatve~apyatIsAragrahaNIharatvaM vibaddhadoShapravartakatayA j~jeyaM; yaduktaM- “stokaM stokaM vibaddhaM vA sashUlaM yo~atisAryate| abhayApippalIkalkaiH sukhoShNaistaM virecayet” iti| buddhismRutipradatvamabhidhAyApi smRutibuddhipramohaharatvAbhidhAnaM tatra vishiShTashaktyupadarshanArtham| vIryasya tu viparyaya ityanenAmalakasya shItavIryatvamuktam| shasyAnIti asthirahitAni phalAni||29-37||

30.sanskrit: oShadhInAM parA bhUmirhimavA~j shailasattamaH| tasmAtphalAni tajjAni grAhayetkAlajAni tu||38|| ApUrNarasavIryANi kAle kAle yathAvidhi| AdityapavanacchAyAsalilaprINitAni ca||39|| yAnyajagdhAnyapUtIni nirvraNAnyagadAni ca| teShAM prayogaM vakShyAmi phalAnAM karma cottamam||40||
30.commentary: yadyapi “himavAnauShadhabhUmInAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktaM, tathA~api rasAyane himavatprabhavANyeva bheShajAni grAhyANIti darshayitumauShadhInAmityAdyabhidhAnam| kAle kAle iti phalapAkakAle ityarthaH| yathAvidhIti yathA bheShajagrahaNaM ma~ggaladevatArcanAdipUrvakaM syAttathA~avashyaM rasAyane karttavyam| agadAnItyanena pavanadahanAdyadoShaM phalasya darshayati||38-40||

30.sanskrit: pa~jcAnAM pa~jcamUlAnAM bhAgAn dashapalonmitAn| harItakIsahasraM ca triguNAmalakaM navam||41|| vidArigandhAM bRuhatIM pRushniparNIM nidigdhikAm| vidyAdvidArigandhAdyaM shvadaMShTrApa~jcamaM gaNam||42|| bilvAgnimanthashyonAkaM kAshmaryamatha pATalAm| punarnavAM shUrpaparNyau balAmeraNDameva ca||43|| jIvakarShabhakau medAM jIvantIM sashatAvarIm| sharekShudarbhakAshAnAM shAlInAM mUlameva ca||44|| ityeShAM pa~jcamUlAnAM pa~jcAnAmupakalpayet| bhAgAn yathoktAMstatsarvaM sAdhyaM dashaguNe~ambhasi||45|| dashabhAgAvasheShaM tu pUtaM taM grAhayedrasam| harItakIshca tAH sarvAH sarvANyAmalakAni ca||46|| tAni sarvANyanasthIni phalAnyApothya kUrcanaiH| vinIya tasminniryUhe cUrNAnImAni dApayet||47|| maNDUkaparNyAH pippalyAH sha~gkhapuShpyAH plavasya ca| mustAnAM saviDa~ggAnAM candanAguruNostathA||48|| madhukasya haridrAyA vacAyAH kanakasya ca| bhAgAMshcatuShpalAn kRutvA sUkShmailAyAstvacastathA||49|| sitopalAsahasraM ca cUrNitaM tulayA~adhikam| tailasya dvyADhakaM tatra dadyAttrINi ca sarpiShaH||50|| sAdhyamaudumbare pAtre tat sarvaM mRudunA~agninA| j~jAtvA lehyamadagdhaM ca shItaM kShaudreNa saMsRujet||51|| kShaudrapramANaM snehArdhaM tat sarvaM ghRutabhAjane| tiShThetsammUrcchitaM tasya mAtrAM kAle prayojayet||52|| yA noparundhyAdAhAramekaM mAtrA jarAM prati| ShaShTikaH payasA cAtra jIrNe bhojanamiShyate||53|| vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAstathA cAnye tapodhanAH| rasAyanamidaM prAshya babhUvuramitAyuShaH||54|| muktvA jIrNaM vapushcAgryamavApustaruNaM vayaH| vItatandrAklamashvAsA nirAta~gkAH samAhitAH||55|| medhAsmRutibalopetAshcirarAtraM tapodhanAH| brAhmaM tapo brahmacaryaM cerushcAtyantaniShThayA||56|| rasAyanamidaM brAhmamAyuShkAmaH prayojayet| dIrghamAyurvayashcAgryaM kAmAMshceShTAn samashnute||57|| (iti brAhmarasAyanam)|
30.commentary: pa~jcAnAmityAdau pratidravyaM dashapalabhAgagrahaNam , uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “iti pa~jca pa~jcamUlAni, teShAM pratidravyaM dashapalAni” iti| harItakIsahasramiti harItakIphalasahasram| shUrpaparNyau mudgamAShaparNyau| vIrA jAlandharaM shAkam| kUrcanaM jarjarIkaraNasAdhanaM shilAputrakamusalAdi| vinIyeti prakShipya| plavaH kaivartamustakam| kanakaM nAgakesharam| tvak guDatvak| audumbare iti tAmramaye| snehArdhamiti sarpistailArdham| ekam anaparAhNikamAhAram||41-57||

30.sanskrit: yathoktaguNAnAmAmalakAnAM sahasraM piShTasvedanavidhinA payasa UShmaNA susvinnamanAtapashuShkamanasthi cUrNayet| tadAmalakasahasrasvarasaparipItaM sthirApunarnavAjIvantInAgabalAbrahmasuvarcalAmaNDUkaparNIshatAvarIsha~gkhapuShpIpippalIvacAviDa~ggasvaya~gguptAmRutA- candanAgurumadhukamadhUkapuShpotpalapadmamAlatIyuvatIyUthikAcUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktaM punarnAgabalAsahasrapalasvarasaparipItamanAtapashuShkaM dviguNitasarpiShA kShaudrasarpiShA vA kShudraguDAkRutiM kRutvA shucau dRuDhe ghRutabhAvite kumbhe bhasmarAsheradhaH sthApayedantarbhUmeH pakShaM kRutarakShAvidhAnamatharvavedavidA, pakShAtyaye coddhRutya kanakarajatatAmrapravAlakAlAyasacUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktamardhakarShavRuddhyA yathoktena vidhinA prAtaH prAtaH prayu~jjAno~agnibalamabhisamIkShya, jIrNe ca ShaShTikaM payasA sasarpiShkamupasevamAno yathoktAn guNAn samashnuta iti||58|| bhavanti cAtra- idaM rasAyanaM brAhmaM maharShigaNasevitam| bhavatyarogo dIrghAyuH prayu~jjAno mahAbalaH||59|| kAntaH prajAnAM siddhArthashcandrAdityasamadyutiH| shrutaM dhArayate sattvamArShaM cAsya pravartate||60|| dharaNIdharasArashca vAyunA samavikramaH| sa bhavatyaviShaM cAsya gAtre sampadyate viSham||61|| (iti dvitIyaM brAhmarasAyanam)|
30.commentary: piShTasvedanavidhineti yathA piShTakaM toyaparipUritapAtroparidattatRuNAdisaMsthitaM svedyate, tathA tat svedanIyamityarthaH| svarasaparipItamiti svarasabhAvitam| brahmasuvarcalAdyauShadhAnyAyurvedasamutthAnIye vakShyamANAni| yuvatiH navamAlikA| aShTamo bhAgo~aShTabhAgaH| kShudraguDAkRutimiti phANitAkRutim| ardhakarShavRuddhyeti ardhakarShAtprabhRuti vardhayet| yathoktavidhineti kuTIprAveshikena vidhinA| yathoktAn guNAniti pUrvaprayogaphalashrutipaThitAn| dharaNIdharasAra iti uShTramukhavat; tena dharaNIdharAH parvatAH, teShAM sAro lauhaM, tadvatsAra ityarthaH| aviShamiti viShamavikAri||58-61||

30.sanskrit: bilvo~agnimanthaH shyonAkaH kAshmaryaH pATalirbalA| parNyashcatasraH pippalyaH shvadaMShTrA bRuhatIdvayam||62|| shRu~ggI tAmalakI drAkShA jIvantI puShkarAguru| abhayA cAmRutA RuddhirjIvakarShabhakau shaTI||63|| mustaM punarnavA medA sailA candanamutpalam| vidArI vRuShamUlAni kAkolI kAkanAsikA||64|| eShAM palonmitAn bhAgA~jchatAnyAmalakasya ca| pa~jca dadyAttadaikadhyaM jaladroNe vipAcayet||65|| j~jAtvA gatarasAnyetAnyauShadhAnyatha taM rasam| taccAmalakamuddhRutya niShkulaM tailasarpiShoH||66|| paladvAdashake bhRuShTvA dattvA cArdhatulAM bhiShak| matsyaNDikAyAH pUtAyA lehavatsAdhu sAdhayet||67|| ShaTpalaM madhunashcAtra siddhashIte pradApayet| catuShpalaM tugAkShIryAH pippalIdvipalaM tathA||68|| palamekaM nidadhyAcca tvagelApatrakesharAt| ityayaM cyavanaprAshaH paramukto rasAyanaH||69|| kAsashvAsaharashcaiva visheSheNopadishyate| kShINakShatAnAM vRuddhAnAM bAlAnAM cA~ggavardhanaH||70|| svarakShayamurorogaM hRudrogaM vAtashoNitam| pipAsAM mUtrashukrasthAn doShAMshcApyapakarShati||71|| asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta yoparundhyAnna bhojanam| asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA||72|| medhAM smRutiM kAntimanAmayatvamAyuHprakarShaM balamindriyANAm| strIShu praharShaM paramagnivRuddhiM varNaprasAdaM pavanAnulomyam||73|| rasAyanasyAsya naraH prayogAllabheta jIrNo~api kuTIpraveshAt| jarAkRutaM rUpamapAsya sarvaM bibharti rUpaM navayauvanasya||74|| (iti cyavanaprAshaH)|
30.commentary: parNyashcatasra iti shAlaparNI, pRushniparNI, mudgaparNI, mAShaparNI ca| tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI| kAkanAsA nAsAphalA, ‘kAkatuNDaka’ ityanye| gatarasatvamiha dravyANAM caturbhAgasthitajale bhavati| niShkulamiti nirasthi| tailasarpiShoriti samAsanirdeshAdubhAbhyAmeva dvAdashapalAni, na pRuthak pRuthak| matsyaNDikA khaNDasaMhatiH| atra ShaTpalatvena samayorapi madhusarpiShordravyAntarayuktatvenAviruddhatvam||62-74||

30.sanskrit: athAmalakaharItakInAmAmalakabibhItakAnAM harItakIbibhItakAnAmAmalakaharItakIbibhItakAnAM vA palAshatvagavanaddhAnAM mRudA~avaliptAnAM kukUlasvinnAnAmakulakAnAM palasahasramulUkhale sampothya dadhighRutamadhupalalatailasharkarAsaMyuktaM bhakShayedanannabhugyathoktena vidhinA; tasyAnte yavAgvAdibhiH pratyavasthApanam , abhya~ggotsAdanaM sarpiShA yavacUrNaishca, ayaM ca rasAyanaprayogaprakarSho dvistAvadagnibalamabhisamIkShya , pratibhojanaM yUSheNa payasA vA ShaShTikaH sasarpiShkaH, ataH paraM yathAsukhavihAraH kAmabhakShyaH syAt| anena prayogeNarShayaH punaryuvatvamavApurbabhUvushcAnekavarShashatajIvino nirvikArAH paraM sharIrabuddhIndriyabalasamuditAshcerushcAtyantaniShThayA tapaH||75|| (iti caturthAmalakarasAyanam)|
30.commentary: kukUlakaH karIShAgniH| akulakAnAmiti anasthnAm| dravyAdInAmatra mAnaM noktaM, tena pradhAnasya cUrNasya dadhyAdibhirmilitaiH samAnamAnatvaM; kiMvA pratyekameva dadhyAdInAM cUrNasamatvam| palalaM tilacUrNam| bhakShayediti vacanaM lehye~api alpAbhyavaharaNamAtrArthatvAdupapannam| anannabhugiti sarvathA~a~ahArAntarAbhuk| tasyAnta iti etatprayogaparityAgakAle| pratyavasthApanamiti yavAgvAdikramavisheShaNaM; tena prayogAnte yadA annasaMsarjanaM kartavyaM, tadA yavAgvAdikrameNetyuktasyArthasya pratyavasthApanaM kriyata ityarthaH| yUSheNa payasA veti vikalpo~agnibalApekShayA||75||

30.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakapa~jcapa~jcamUlaniryUhe pippalImadhukamadhUkakAkolIkShIrakAkolyAtmaguptAjIvakarShabhakakShIrashuklAkalkasamprayuktena vidArIsvarasena kShIrAShTaguNasamprayuktena ca sarpiShaH kumbhaM sAdhayitvA prayu~jjAno~agnibalasamAM mAtrAM jIrNe ca kShIrasarpirbhyAM shAliShaShTikamuShNodakAnupAnamashna~jjarAvyAdhipApAbhicAravyapagatabhayaH sharIrendriyabuddhibalamatulamupalabhyApratihatasarvArambhaH paramAyuranavApnuyAt||76|| (iti pa~jcamo harItakIyogaH)|
30.commentary: atra harItakyAdau kShIrashuklA kShIravidArikA| atra harItakyAdikvAthasya tveko bhAgaH, kShIrasyAShTau bhAgAH, sarpiSha eko bhAgaH| kumbho droNadvayam| vacanaM hi- “droNastu dviguNaH sUrpo vij~jeyaH kumbha eva ca” iti||76||

30.sanskrit: harItakyAmalakabibhItakaharidrAsthirAbalAviDa~ggAmRutavallIvishvabheShajamadhukapippalIsomavalkasiddhena kShIrasarpiShA madhusharkarAbhyAmapi ca sannIyAmalakasvarasashataparipItamAmalakacUrNamayashcUrNacaturbhAgasamprayuktaM pANitalamAtraM prAtaH prAtaH prAshya yathoktena vidhinA sAyaM mudgayUSheNa payasA vA sasarpiShkaM shAliShaShTikAnnamashnIyAt, trivarShaprayogAdasya varShashatamajaraM vayastiShThati, shrutamavatiShThate, sarvAmayAH prashAmyanti, viShamaviShaM bhavati gAtre, gAtramashmavat sthirIbhavati, adhRuShyo bhUtAnAM bhavati||77|| bhavanti cAtra- yathA~amarANAmamRutaM yathA bhogavatAM sudhA| tathA~abhavanmaharShINAM rasAyanavidhiH purA||78|| na jarAM na ca daurbalyaM nAturyaM nidhanaM na ca| jagmurvarShasahasrANi rasAyanaparAH purA||79|| na kevalaM dIrghamihAyurashnute rasAyanaM yo vidhivanniShevate| gatiM sa devarShiniShevitAM shubhAM prapadyate brahma tatheti cAkShayam ||80||
30.commentary: amRutavallI guDUcI| somavalkaH viTkhadiraH| kShIrasarpiH kShIrasamutthitasarpiH| ayashcUrNasya caturtho bhAgaH, yata etadayashcUrNaM caturthabhAgamata evAsmin prayoge jatUkarNena “ayashcUrNapAdayuktam” iti kRutam| amarANAmamRutaM jarAdiharaM, nAgAnAM ca sudhA jarAmaraNaharI, ityubhayopAdAnaM dRuShTAnte| brahma mokShaH| mokShasAdhanatvaM ceha rasAyanasya vishuddhasattvakartRutayocyate|| 77-80||

30.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- abhayAmalakIye~asmin ShaDyogAH parikIrtitAH| rasAyanAnAM siddhAnAmAyuryairanuvartate||81||
30.commentary: abhayetyAdinA sandehanirAsArthamuktaprayogasa~gkhyAM darshayati| evamanyatrApi sa~gkhyApraNayanamante j~jeyam|| 81||

30.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH||1||
30.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM cikitsAsthAne rasAyanAdhyAye~abhayAmalakIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH prathamaH|| 1||

1.sanskrit: athAto varNasvarIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
1.commentary: shArIre cikitsAdhikaraNaM sharIraM pratipAdya cikitsA vaktavyA, sA ca sAdhya eva roge vaktavyA nAsAdhyaroge, yaduktaM- “arthavidyAyashohAnimupakroshamasa~ggraham| prApnuyAnniyataM vaidyo yo~asAdhyaM samupAcaret” (sU.a.10) iti; na ca riShTapratipattimantarA~asAdhyatvapratipattiriti riShTapratipAdakamindriyasthAnameva cikitsAsthAnAt prAgucyate | indrashabdena prANa ucyate, tasyAntagatasya li~ggaM riShTAkhyamindriyaM; yaduktaM vyAkaraNe- “indriyamindrali~ggaM” (pA.a.5.2.13) ityAdi; tasyendriyasya sthAnamindriyasthAnam| tatrApi cendriyasthAne vaktavye vyaktatamariShTAbhidhAyakatayA varNasvarIyamindriyamucyate, atra hi yAni riShTAni vaktavyAni tAnItarariShTebhyashcakShurAdigrAhyatayA vyaktatamAni| varNasvarAvadhikRutya kRuto varNasvarIyaH, indriyasya riShTarUpasya pratipAdako~adhyAya indriyaH, taM vyAkhyAsyAmaH| evamanyatrApi puShpitakamityAdyapIndriyavisheShaNaM vyAkhyeyam||1-2||

1.sanskrit: iha khalu varNashca svarashca gandhashca rasashca sparshashca cakShushca shrotraM ca ghrANaM ca rasanaM ca sparshanaM ca sattvaM ca bhaktishca shaucaM ca shIlaM cAcArashca smRutishcAkRutishca prakRutishca vikRutishca balaM ca glAnishca medhA ca harShashca raukShyaM ca snehashca tandrA cArambhashca gauravaM ca lAghavaM ca guNAshcAhArashca vihArashcAhArapariNAmashcopAyashcApAyashca vyAdhishca vyAdhipUrvarUpaM ca vedanAshcopadravAshca cchAyA ca praticchAyA ca svapnadarshanaM ca dUtAdhikArashca pathi cautpAtikaM cAturakule bhAvAvasthAntarANi ca bheShajasaMvRuttishca bheShajavikArayuktishceti parIkShyANi pratyakShAnumAnopadeshairAyuShaH pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAnena bhiShajA||3||
1.commentary: indriyasthAnapratipAdyaM kRutsnaM viShayamAha- ihetyAdi| iha indriyasthAne| khalushabdo vAkyAla~gkAre| iha ca yadyapIndriyANyeva viShayavarNAdigrAhakatayA agre vaktuM yujyante, tathA~api teShAmatIndriyatvena tadAshrayariShTAnAmavyaktatvaM ; tena, pravyaktAni varNAdInyeva pravyaktariShTAdhikaraNAnyagre~abhidhIyante| varNAdiShvapi ca yathA vyaktatvaM tathA pUrvanipAtaH| meghAdishabdastu yadyapi varNAdapi vyaktastathA~api shabdavisheSha eveha tAlvAdisampAdyaH svarashabdAbhidheyo riShTAdhikaraNatvenAbhimataH, sa ca varNApekShayA~avyakta eva| ihetyAdAvasamAsena pratyekamapi varNAdInAM riShTAdhikaraNatvaM darshayati; samAse hi samudAyasyaiva riShTAdhikaraNakatayA parIkShitavyatvaM sha~gkyeta| varNashabdena ca varNasahacaritAshcakShurgrAhyA raukShyAdayo~api gRuhyante; ata eva varNaprastAva eva vakShyati- yat- “varNagrahaNena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH” iti| svarAdigrahaNena ca svarAdyabhAvo~api gRuhyate, tenA~gguliparvashabdAbhAva-gandhAbhAvAdayo~api riShTAnyavarudhyante| sparshagrahaNena ca sparshopalabhyakAThinyAdyavarodhaH| sattvaM manaH; sattvavikRuterudAharaNaM yathA- “autsukyaM bhajate sattvaM ceto bhIrAvishatyapi” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bhaktiH icchA| shIlaM sahajaM vRuttam| AcAraH shAstrashikShAkRuto vyavahAraH| bhaktyAdayo yadyapi sattvavikAratvena sattvagrahaNenaiva labhyante; yaduktaM- “bhaktiH shIlaM shaucaM dveShaH smRutirmohastyAgo~amAtsaryaM bhayaM krodhastandrotsAhastaikShNyaM mArdavaM gAmbhIryamanavasthitatvamityevamAdayaH sattvavikArAH” (shA.a.3) iti; tathA~api bhaktyAdInAmapi pRuthagariShTAdhikaraNatveneha pRuthakkaraNam| nidrAdaurbalyAttandreti tandrAshabdena nidrocyate; atra ca riShTamuktaM yathA- “nidrA nityA bhavati vA na vA” (iM.a.11) iti| Arambha iti ariShTavyAdhyutpAdArambhaH ; yaduktaM- “shvayathuryasya kukShistho hastapAdaM pradhAvati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| gaurave riShTaM yathA- “niShThyUtaM ca purIShaM ca retashcAmbhasi majjati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| lAghave riShTaM- gurUNAma~ggAnAM lAghavaM j~jeyam| guNariShTaM yathA- “guNAH sharIradeshAnAM shItoShNamRududAruNAH| viparyAsena lakShyante sthAneShvanyeShu tadvidhAH” (iM.a.12) iti| AhArariShTaM yathA- “AhAramupayu~jjAno bhiShajA sUpakalpitam” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| AhArapariNAmariShTaM yathA- “durbalo bahu bhu~gkte yo prAgabhuktvA~annamAturaH| alpamUtrapurIShashca” (iM.a.7) iti| upAya upagamanaM vyAdhimelaka ityarthaH; yaduktaM- “sahasA jvarasantApastRuShNA mUrcchA balakShayaH| vishleShaNaM ca sandhInAM” (iM.a.8) iti| vyAdhyapagamanamapAyaH; yaduktaM- “yaM naraM sahasA rogo durbalaM parimu~jcati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| vyAdhishceti vyAdhireva riShTaM yathA- “vAtAShThIlA susaMvRuttA dAruNA hRudi tiShThati” (iM.a.10) iti| chAyA bhautikI pa~jcarUpA, praticchAyA tu dehacchAyA; praticchAyayA ca netrakumArikA~api praticchAyArUpA gRuhItavyA| ayaM ca chAyAdibhedaH pannarUpIyendriye darshayitavyaH | Aturakule bhAvAvasthAriShTaM yathA- “agnipUrNAni pAtrANi bhinnAni vishikhAni ca| bhiSha~gmumUrShatAM veshma pravishanneva pashyati” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bheShajasaMvRuttau riShTaM yathA- “yamuddishyAturaM vaidyaH saMvartayitumauShadham| yatamAno na shaknoti durlabhaM tasya jIvitam” (iM.a.12) iti| bheShajasya vikAreNa samaM yuktirbheShajavikArayuktiH; tatra riShTaM yathA- “vij~jAtaM bahushaH siddhaM vidhivaccAvacAritam| na sidhyatyauShadhaM yasya tasya nAsti cikitsitam” (iM.a.12) iti| sheShaM tu riShTodAharaNaM vyaktam| iti samAptau| pratyakShapUrvakatvAt sarvapramANAnAmihAdau pratyakShaM kRutam| yadyapi varNAdaya AyurlakShaNapratipAditA dIrghAyuHpramANajij~jAsAyAmapi parIkShyante, tathA~apIha riShTaprakaraNe AyuHpramANAvasheShaj~jAnArthameva parIkShaNIyAH, ata uktaM- pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAneneti||3||

1.sanskrit: tatra tu khalveShAM parIkShyANAM kAnicit puruShamanAshritAni, kAnicicca puruShasaMshrayANi| tatra yAni puruShamanAshritAni tAnyupadeshato yuktitashca parIkSheta, puruShasaMshrayANi punaH prakRutito vikRutitashca||4||
1.commentary: puruShamanAshritAni dUtAdyAshrayANi riShTAni| yuktitashcetyanumAnata ityarthaH, atra yukterapi riShTatvAvadhAraNe kShamatvAt| pratyakShaM hi dUtAdInAM svarUpamAtraM gRuhNAti, riShTaM tu dUtAdInAmAgamAdeva j~jAyate| puruShAshrayivarNAdigatariShTagrahaNe tu pratyakShamapi tattadariShTavisheShagrahaNe tattadvisheSheNa vyApriyata iti matvA~atra tatpratiShiddham| anumAnaM tu riShTatvena pratipAditamanimittatvAdidharmavicAre vyApriyate, evaM sarvatra| prakRutitashceti puruShAshrayavikRutij~jAnahetutayA prakRutI riShTaj~jAne vyApriyate, yataH prakRutij~jAnAdhInaM vikRutij~jAnaM bhavati; prakRutivikRutiparIkShA tvatrAdhikRutaiH prasiddhaiH pratyakShAdibhireva j~jeyA||4||

1.sanskrit: tatra prakRutirjAtiprasaktA ca, kulaprasaktA ca, deshAnupAtinI ca, kAlAnupAtinI ca vayo~anupAtinI ca, pratyAtmaniyatA ceti| jAtikuladeshakAlavayaHpratyAtmaniyatA hi teShAM teShAM puruShANAM te te bhAvavisheShA bhavanti||5||
1.commentary: prakRutiM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| jAtiprasaktA yathA- brAhmaNajAtau shaucaM, kulaprasaktA yathA- ki~jcideva kulaM shucyAcAravadbhavati, deshAnupAtinI yathA- antarvedivAsinaH shucayo bhavanti, kAlAnupAtinI yathA- kRutayuge shaucaM, vayo~anupAtinI yathA- bAlye~ashaucaM, pratyAtmaniyatA yathA- kashcideva puruShaH prakRutyA shucirbhavati; ityAdyudAharaNIyam| kutaH punarjAtyAdiniyatA prakRutirbhavatItyatra hetumAha- jAtikuletyAdi| te te bhAvavisheShA iti shucitvAshaucAdayaH ||5||

1.sanskrit: vikRutiH punarlakShaNanimittA ca, lakShyanimittA ca, nimittAnurUpA ca||6||
1.commentary: riShTAdhikArAdhikRutAM vikRutiM vivecayituM sarvAneva vikRutibhedAnAha- vikRutirityAdi||6||

1.sanskrit: tatra lakShaNanimittA nAma sA yasyAH sharIre lakShaNAnyeva hetubhUtAni bhavanti daivAt; lakShaNAni hi kAniciccharIropanibaddhAni bhavanti, yAni hi tasmiMstasmin kAle tatrAdhiShThAnamAsAdya tAM tAM vikRutimutpAdayanti|7|
1.commentary: hetubhUtAnIti hetusadRushAni| tena daivameva nakharekhApadmAdisAmudrikoktalakShaNayukte sharIre rAjyadhanagamanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutiprAptau hetuH, lakShaNAni tu daivanimittAni bodhakamAtrANi, ata eva daivAdityuktaM; daivaM ca prAktanaM karmocyate| vikRutimutpAdayantItyatrApi daivAditi yojanIyaM; tena, daivabalAdeva lakShaNAnAM rAjyadhanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutikartRutvam| tasmiMstasmin kAle ityanena lakShaNasUcitAdRuShTaparipAkakAle niyatatvaM vikRuterdarshayati| lakShaNAsUcitAshca rAjyAdaya iha puruShasya kadAcidbhavanto~asvAbhAvikA eveti kRutvA vikRutishabdenocyante||7(1)||

1.sanskrit: lakShyanimittA tu sA yasyA upalabhyate nimittaM yathoktaM nidAneShu|7|
1.commentary: yathoktaM nidAneShviti yathA- rUkShAdisevayA vAtAdiprakoparUpA vikRutirnidAnoktetyarthaH||7(2)||

1.sanskrit: nimittAnurUpA tu nimittArthAnukAriNI yA, tAmanimittAM nimittamAyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyecchanti bhiShajo bhUyashcAyuShaH kShayanimittAM preteli~ggAnurUpAM, yAmAyuSho~antargatasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti dhIrAH| yAM cAdhikRutya puruShasaMshrayANi mumUrShatAM lakShaNAnyupadekShyAmaH| ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||7||
1.commentary: nimittAnurUpeti nimittasadRushI| tadeva sphoTayati- nimittArthAnukAriNIti|- nimittasya yo~arthaH kAryajananarUpaH kAryabodhanarUpo vA tamanukarotIti nimittArthAnukAriNI| riShTAkhyA hi vikRutirmaraNe tasyaivAvabodhane vA nimittaM bhavati| aparamapi nimittAnurUpAyA vikRutervisheShamAha- tAmityAdi| animittAmiti tadAtve~anupalabhyamAnanimittAM, na tu punaH sarvathaivAhetukIM, yata ‘AyuShaH kShayanimittAm’ ityanantaramasya visheShaNaM kathayiShyati; riShTasya hi na raukShyAdinA sharIrasambandhAdi nimittamupalabhyate| yadvA, AyuHkShayarUpaM yannimittaM tadvidyamAnamapi nAnyairupalabhyate , kintu tadeva hi riShTAdunnIyate; tena, avyaktanimittatvamihAnimittatvaM j~jeyam| atra gatAyuShTvameva sakalapuruShasaMshritariShTavyApakaM kAraNaM sAdhu| yattu vakShyati- “kriyApathamatikrAntAH kevalaM dehamAshritAH| cihnaM kurvanti yaddoShAstadariShTaM pracakShate” (iM.a.11) iti, taddUtAdigatariShTAvyApakatayA puruShAshrayiriShTamAtrAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam| AyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyeti AyuHsheShapramANaj~jAnasyetyarthaH| bhUya iti atyartham| tenAtyarthamAyuHkShayanimittAM pratyAsannAyuHkShayajanyAmiti yAvat| yAmiti kShINAyuHkAryAm| pretali~ggAnurUpAmiti pretasadRushIM; “malA danteShu jAyante pretAkRutirudIryate” (iM.a.12) ityAdigranthavakShyamANAm| imAM hi vikRutimAyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthaM vadanti| yA tvanyA pretali~ggAnanurUpA varNAshrayA sA pratyAsannamaraNabodhikA; tena sA nAtyarthannAtyarthakShINAyuHkAryetyarthaH| evaM ‘bhUyashca’ ityAdinA ‘dhIrAH’ ityantena nimittAnurUpavikRutivisheShasya kAryavisheShaM maraNalakShaNamabhidhAya punaH sAmAnyenAnimittAyA dharmAntaramAha- yAmadhikRutyetyAdi| puruShasaMshrayANIti visheShaNena puruShAnAshritadUtAdiriShTe nAvashyamanimittatA~astIti darshayati| yato dUtAdhikArAdau yAni riShTAni tAni dRushyamAnanimittAnyapyAgamAdeva riShTatvenAvadhAryante| yathA- “muktakeshe~athavA nagne rudatyaprayate~athavA| bhiShagabhyAgataM dRuShTvA dUtaM maraNamAdishet” (iM.a.12) iti| atra ca bhiShajo muktakeshavacanAddRushyata eva kAraNaM, tathA dUtAgamane cAturasya preraNAdi kAraNamastyeva, tenAnimittatvamAturAshrayiriShTa eva| anye tu, evambhUtavaidyadUtasamAgamaH parihartavyatvena j~jAtaH san yadA daivAdbhavati, tadA daivanimittaH san riShTaM bhavati; tena, sarvariShTavyApikaiveyamanimittatA; bhUyashcetyAdigranthena tu pretali~ggAnurUpAM vikRutiM bhUya AyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti, tathA puruShasaMshrayANi bhUya upadekShyante, puruShAnAshrayANi tu svalpagranthenopadekShyante iti vyAkhyAnayanti| ityuddesha indriyasthAnArthoddesha ityarthaH||7||

1.sanskrit: tatrAdita eva varNAdhikAraH| tadyathA- kRuShNaH, shyAmaH , shyAmAvadAtaH, avadAtashceti prakRutivarNAH sharIrasya bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH||8||
