tatra riShTaM yathA- “vij~jAtaM bahushaH siddhaM vidhivaccAvacAritam| na sidhyatyauShadhaM yasya tasya nAsti cikitsitam” (iM.a.12) iti| sheShaM tu riShTodAharaNaM vyaktam| iti samAptau| pratyakShapUrvakatvAt sarvapramANAnAmihAdau pratyakShaM kRutam| yadyapi varNAdaya AyurlakShaNapratipAditA dIrghAyuHpramANajij~jAsAyAmapi parIkShyante, tathA~apIha riShTaprakaraNe AyuHpramANAvasheShaj~jAnArthameva parIkShaNIyAH, ata uktaM- pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAneneti||3||

6.sanskrit: tatra tu khalveShAM parIkShyANAM kAnicit puruShamanAshritAni, kAnicicca puruShasaMshrayANi| tatra yAni puruShamanAshritAni tAnyupadeshato yuktitashca parIkSheta, puruShasaMshrayANi punaH prakRutito vikRutitashca||4||
6.commentary: puruShamanAshritAni dUtAdyAshrayANi riShTAni| yuktitashcetyanumAnata ityarthaH, atra yukterapi riShTatvAvadhAraNe kShamatvAt| pratyakShaM hi dUtAdInAM svarUpamAtraM gRuhNAti, riShTaM tu dUtAdInAmAgamAdeva j~jAyate| puruShAshrayivarNAdigatariShTagrahaNe tu pratyakShamapi tattadariShTavisheShagrahaNe tattadvisheSheNa vyApriyata iti matvA~atra tatpratiShiddham| anumAnaM tu riShTatvena pratipAditamanimittatvAdidharmavicAre vyApriyate, evaM sarvatra| prakRutitashceti puruShAshrayavikRutij~jAnahetutayA prakRutI riShTaj~jAne vyApriyate, yataH prakRutij~jAnAdhInaM vikRutij~jAnaM bhavati; prakRutivikRutiparIkShA tvatrAdhikRutaiH prasiddhaiH pratyakShAdibhireva j~jeyA||4||

6.sanskrit: tatra prakRutirjAtiprasaktA ca, kulaprasaktA ca, deshAnupAtinI ca, kAlAnupAtinI ca vayo~anupAtinI ca, pratyAtmaniyatA ceti| jAtikuladeshakAlavayaHpratyAtmaniyatA hi teShAM teShAM puruShANAM te te bhAvavisheShA bhavanti||5||
6.commentary: prakRutiM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| jAtiprasaktA yathA- brAhmaNajAtau shaucaM, kulaprasaktA yathA- ki~jcideva kulaM shucyAcAravadbhavati, deshAnupAtinI yathA- antarvedivAsinaH shucayo bhavanti, kAlAnupAtinI yathA- kRutayuge shaucaM, vayo~anupAtinI yathA- bAlye~ashaucaM, pratyAtmaniyatA yathA- kashcideva puruShaH prakRutyA shucirbhavati; ityAdyudAharaNIyam| kutaH punarjAtyAdiniyatA prakRutirbhavatItyatra hetumAha- jAtikuletyAdi| te te bhAvavisheShA iti shucitvAshaucAdayaH ||5||

6.sanskrit: vikRutiH punarlakShaNanimittA ca, lakShyanimittA ca, nimittAnurUpA ca||6||
6.commentary: riShTAdhikArAdhikRutAM vikRutiM vivecayituM sarvAneva vikRutibhedAnAha- vikRutirityAdi||6||

6.sanskrit: tatra lakShaNanimittA nAma sA yasyAH sharIre lakShaNAnyeva hetubhUtAni bhavanti daivAt; lakShaNAni hi kAniciccharIropanibaddhAni bhavanti, yAni hi tasmiMstasmin kAle tatrAdhiShThAnamAsAdya tAM tAM vikRutimutpAdayanti|7|
6.commentary: hetubhUtAnIti hetusadRushAni| tena daivameva nakharekhApadmAdisAmudrikoktalakShaNayukte sharIre rAjyadhanagamanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutiprAptau hetuH, lakShaNAni tu daivanimittAni bodhakamAtrANi, ata eva daivAdityuktaM; daivaM ca prAktanaM karmocyate| vikRutimutpAdayantItyatrApi daivAditi yojanIyaM; tena, daivabalAdeva lakShaNAnAM rAjyadhanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutikartRutvam| tasmiMstasmin kAle ityanena lakShaNasUcitAdRuShTaparipAkakAle niyatatvaM vikRuterdarshayati| lakShaNAsUcitAshca rAjyAdaya iha puruShasya kadAcidbhavanto~asvAbhAvikA eveti kRutvA vikRutishabdenocyante||7(1)||

6.sanskrit: lakShyanimittA tu sA yasyA upalabhyate nimittaM yathoktaM nidAneShu|7|
6.commentary: yathoktaM nidAneShviti yathA- rUkShAdisevayA vAtAdiprakoparUpA vikRutirnidAnoktetyarthaH||7(2)||

6.sanskrit: nimittAnurUpA tu nimittArthAnukAriNI yA, tAmanimittAM nimittamAyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyecchanti bhiShajo bhUyashcAyuShaH kShayanimittAM preteli~ggAnurUpAM, yAmAyuSho~antargatasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti dhIrAH| yAM cAdhikRutya puruShasaMshrayANi mumUrShatAM lakShaNAnyupadekShyAmaH| ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||7||
6.commentary: nimittAnurUpeti nimittasadRushI| tadeva sphoTayati- nimittArthAnukAriNIti|- nimittasya yo~arthaH kAryajananarUpaH kAryabodhanarUpo vA tamanukarotIti nimittArthAnukAriNI| riShTAkhyA hi vikRutirmaraNe tasyaivAvabodhane vA nimittaM bhavati| aparamapi nimittAnurUpAyA vikRutervisheShamAha- tAmityAdi| animittAmiti tadAtve~anupalabhyamAnanimittAM, na tu punaH sarvathaivAhetukIM, yata ‘AyuShaH kShayanimittAm’ ityanantaramasya visheShaNaM kathayiShyati; riShTasya hi na raukShyAdinA sharIrasambandhAdi nimittamupalabhyate| yadvA, AyuHkShayarUpaM yannimittaM tadvidyamAnamapi nAnyairupalabhyate , kintu tadeva hi riShTAdunnIyate; tena, avyaktanimittatvamihAnimittatvaM j~jeyam| atra gatAyuShTvameva sakalapuruShasaMshritariShTavyApakaM kAraNaM sAdhu| yattu vakShyati- “kriyApathamatikrAntAH kevalaM dehamAshritAH| cihnaM kurvanti yaddoShAstadariShTaM pracakShate” (iM.a.11) iti, taddUtAdigatariShTAvyApakatayA puruShAshrayiriShTamAtrAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam| AyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyeti AyuHsheShapramANaj~jAnasyetyarthaH| bhUya iti atyartham| tenAtyarthamAyuHkShayanimittAM pratyAsannAyuHkShayajanyAmiti yAvat| yAmiti kShINAyuHkAryAm| pretali~ggAnurUpAmiti pretasadRushIM; “malA danteShu jAyante pretAkRutirudIryate” (iM.a.12) ityAdigranthavakShyamANAm| imAM hi vikRutimAyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthaM vadanti| yA tvanyA pretali~ggAnanurUpA varNAshrayA sA pratyAsannamaraNabodhikA; tena sA nAtyarthannAtyarthakShINAyuHkAryetyarthaH| evaM ‘bhUyashca’ ityAdinA ‘dhIrAH’ ityantena nimittAnurUpavikRutivisheShasya kAryavisheShaM maraNalakShaNamabhidhAya punaH sAmAnyenAnimittAyA dharmAntaramAha- yAmadhikRutyetyAdi| puruShasaMshrayANIti visheShaNena puruShAnAshritadUtAdiriShTe nAvashyamanimittatA~astIti darshayati| yato dUtAdhikArAdau yAni riShTAni tAni dRushyamAnanimittAnyapyAgamAdeva riShTatvenAvadhAryante| yathA- “muktakeshe~athavA nagne rudatyaprayate~athavA| bhiShagabhyAgataM dRuShTvA dUtaM maraNamAdishet” (iM.a.12) iti| atra ca bhiShajo muktakeshavacanAddRushyata eva kAraNaM, tathA dUtAgamane cAturasya preraNAdi kAraNamastyeva, tenAnimittatvamAturAshrayiriShTa eva| anye tu, evambhUtavaidyadUtasamAgamaH parihartavyatvena j~jAtaH san yadA daivAdbhavati, tadA daivanimittaH san riShTaM bhavati; tena, sarvariShTavyApikaiveyamanimittatA; bhUyashcetyAdigranthena tu pretali~ggAnurUpAM vikRutiM bhUya AyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti, tathA puruShasaMshrayANi bhUya upadekShyante, puruShAnAshrayANi tu svalpagranthenopadekShyante iti vyAkhyAnayanti| ityuddesha indriyasthAnArthoddesha ityarthaH||7||

6.sanskrit: tatrAdita eva varNAdhikAraH| tadyathA- kRuShNaH, shyAmaH , shyAmAvadAtaH, avadAtashceti prakRutivarNAH sharIrasya bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH||8||
6.commentary: prakRutij~jAnAntarIyakatvAdvikRutij~jAnasya prakRutivarNAneva tAvadAha- kRuShNa ityAdi| avadAto gauraH| iha ca prAyeNa ye varNAH prakRutyA bhavanti te prakRutivarNA ucyante, ye tu prAyeNa vikRutyA bhavanti te vikRutivarNA ucyante, iti j~jeyam| tena prakRutivarNA api kadAcidvikRutivarNA bhavanti, tathA vikRutivarNA api janmaprabhRutijAyamAnatayA kadAcit prakRutivarNA bhavantIti j~jeyam| anuktaprakRutivarNAtideshArthamAha- yAMshcetyAdi| upetya IkShamANa iti upekShamANaH| anUkata iti sAdRushyataH; anena ca shyAmetyAdivarNashabdena nirdishyamAnAn vidyAditi yojanA| tajj~jairiti varNabhedanAmaj~jaiH||8||

6.sanskrit: nIlashyAvatAmraharitashuklAshca varNAH sharIrasya vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutivarNA bhavantyuktAH sharIrasya| tatra prakRutivarNamardhasharIre vikRutivarNamardhasharIre, dvAvapi varNau maryAdAvibhaktau dRuShTvA; yadyevaM savyadakShiNavibhAgena, yadyevaM pUrvapashcimavibhAgena, yadyuttarAdharavibhAgena, yadyantarbahirvibhAgena, AturasyAriShTamiti vidyAt; evameva varNabhedo mukhe~apyanyatra vartamAno maraNAya bhavati||9||
6.commentary: nIletyAdinA (vikRutijAyamAnatayA ) vikRutivarNAnAha| iha, ‘aparAn’ iti vacanena vikRutivarNasa~gkarajA varNA j~jeyAH| vikRutivarNAntaramAha- prAgityAdi| prAgvikRutAniti pUrvavarNAdanyathAbhUtAnityarthaH| tenApi, yena shyAmena satA rasAyanopayogAdgauravarNatvaM prAptaM, sa ca tyaktarasAyanaH kAlavashAt punaH shyAmavarNo bhavati tasyApi pUrvagauravarNAdvikRutiH shyAmavarNo bhavan riShTaM syAdityAha- abhUtvotpannAniti; tena nAyaM doShaH; atra hi pUrvabhUta eva varNaH punarbhavati, tena na riShTam| maryAdAvibhaktAviti samasImAvyavasthApitau| pUrvapashcimavibhAgeneti abhimukhapRuShThabhAgenetyarthaH| antarbahirvibhAgeneti atrAntargato varNo mukhanAsAkarNashrotrAntargatatayA unneyaH| anyatreti avAntare hastapAdAdau||9||

6.sanskrit: varNabhedena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH||10||
6.commentary: varNabhedeneti yathA varNavibhAgena riShTaM, tathA glAnyAdivibhAgenApItyarthaH| harSha ihopacayo j~jeyaH, mAnasaharShasyeha cAkShuShAdhikAre~asa~ggatatvAt||10||

6.sanskrit: tathA pipluvya~ggatilakAlakapiDakAnAmanyatamasyAnane janmAturasyaivamevAprashastaM vidyAt||11||
6.commentary: tathetyAdau pipluprabhRutInAmapi varNavat savyadakShiNAdivibhAgena janma riShTaM bhavatItyevamevashabdenocyate||11||

6.sanskrit: nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShahastapAdauShThAdiShvapi ca vaikArikoktAnAM varNAnAmanyatamasya prAdurbhAvo hInabalavarNendriyeShu lakShaNamAyuShaH kShayasya bhavati||12||
6.commentary: nakhetyAdau balahAnyAdyabhAve sati na riShTam||12||

6.sanskrit: yaccAnyadapi ki~jcidvarNavaikRutamabhUtapUrvaM sahasotpadyetAnimittameva hIyamAnasyAturasya shashvat, tadariShTamiti vidyAt| iti varNAdhikAraH||13||
6.commentary: yaccetyAdinA~anuktavarNariShTaM sa~ggRuhNAti| abhUtapUrvamiti pUrvavyAkRutarasAyanavihitavarNaprAdurbhAvavyudAsArtham| sahasotpadyata ityanena riShTAnAM shIghrasvabhAvaM darshayati| animittamiti pUrvoktArthameva| hIyamAnasya shashvaditi svabhAvakathanaM, riShTotpattyA hIyamAnatA shashvadavashyaM bhavati||13||

6.sanskrit: svarAdhikArastu- haMsakrau~jcanemidundubhikalavi~gkakAkakapotajarjarAnukArAH prakRutisvarA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH| eDakakalagrastAvyaktagadgadakShAmadInAnukIrNAstvAturANAM svarA vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutisvarA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||14||
6.commentary: kramAgataM svaramAha- svaretyAdi| jarjaraH vAdyabhANDavisheShaH| yAMshcetyAdi pUrvavad vyAkhyeyam| eDako meShaH, kiMvA araNyacchAgalaH; kalaH sUkShmaH; grastaH sarvathA~anuccAraH; kShAmaH rUkShaH; dInaH duHkhoccAryamANasvaraH; anukIrNa uparyuparyuccAryamANaH||14||

6.sanskrit: tatra prakRutivaikArikANAM svarANAmAshvabhinirvRuttiH svarAnekatvamekasya cAnekatvamaprashastam| iti svarAdhikAraH||15|| iti varNasvarAdhikArau yathAvaduktau mumUrShatAM lakShaNaj~jAnArthamiti||16||
6.commentary: prakRutervaikArikA anyathAbhUtA iti prakRutivaikArikAH| svarAnekatvamiti kadAcideDakasvaratvaM, kadAcit kalasvaratvamityAdi| ekasya cAnekatvamiti ekasyaiva svarasya cAnekatvamiva pratibhAti| animittamiti sarvatra sambadhyate||15-16||

6.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- yasya vaikAriko varNaH sharIra upapadyate| ardhe vA yadi vA kRutsne nimittaM na ca nAsti saH||17|| nIlaM vA yadi vA shyAvaM tAmraM vA yadi vA~aruNam| mukhArdhamanyathA varNo mukhArdhe~ariShTamucyate||18|| sneho mukhArdhe suvyakto raukShyamardhamukhe bhRusham| glAnirardhe tathA harSho mukhArdhe pretalakShaNam||19|| tilakAH piplavo vya~ggA rAjayashca pRuthagvidhAH| AturasyAshu jAyante mukhe prANAn mumukShataH||20|| puShpANi nakhadanteShu pa~gko vA dantasaMshritaH| cUrNako vA~api danteShu lakShaNaM maraNasya tat||21|| oShThayoH pAdayoH pANyorakShNormUtrapurIShayoH| nakheShvapi ca vaivarNyametat kShINabale~antakRut||22|| yasya nIlAvubhAvoShThau pakvajAmbavasannibhau| mumUrShuriti taM vidyAnnaro dhIro gatAyuSham||23|| eko vA yadi vA~aneko yasya vaikArikaH svaraH| sahasotpadyate jantorhIyamAnasya nAsti saH||24|| yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdvaikRutaM svaravarNayoH| balamAMsavihInasya tat sarvaM maraNodayam ||25|| tatra shlokaH- iti varNasvarAvuktau lakShaNArthaM mumUrShatAm| yastau samyagvijAnAti nAyurj~jAne sa muhyati||26||
6.commentary: ayamevArtho gadyoktaH spaShTArthaM sukhagrahaNArthaM ca shlokenocyate- yasyetyAdinA| tilakA ityAdau mukhe iti mukhArdhe| oShThAviti dvivacanamuktvA~api yat ‘ubhau’ iti karoti, tena sakalauShThavyAptiM darshayati| mumUrShurityukatvA~api yat ‘gatAyuShaM’ iti karoti, tena riShTayukto mumUrShargatAyurIti darshayati; ajAtariShTastu pratikriyAbhAvAnmumUrShuragatAyurapi bhavati| maraNodayamiti maraNakAraNamiti j~jAnArtham||17-26||

6.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute indriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
6.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmindriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

7.sanskrit: athAto varNasvarIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
7.commentary: shArIre cikitsAdhikaraNaM sharIraM pratipAdya cikitsA vaktavyA, sA ca sAdhya eva roge vaktavyA nAsAdhyaroge, yaduktaM- “arthavidyAyashohAnimupakroshamasa~ggraham| prApnuyAnniyataM vaidyo yo~asAdhyaM samupAcaret” (sU.a.10) iti; na ca riShTapratipattimantarA~asAdhyatvapratipattiriti riShTapratipAdakamindriyasthAnameva cikitsAsthAnAt prAgucyate | indrashabdena prANa ucyate, tasyAntagatasya li~ggaM riShTAkhyamindriyaM; yaduktaM vyAkaraNe- “indriyamindrali~ggaM” (pA.a.5.2.13) ityAdi; tasyendriyasya sthAnamindriyasthAnam| tatrApi cendriyasthAne vaktavye vyaktatamariShTAbhidhAyakatayA varNasvarIyamindriyamucyate, atra hi yAni riShTAni vaktavyAni tAnItarariShTebhyashcakShurAdigrAhyatayA vyaktatamAni| varNasvarAvadhikRutya kRuto varNasvarIyaH, indriyasya riShTarUpasya pratipAdako~adhyAya indriyaH, taM vyAkhyAsyAmaH| evamanyatrApi puShpitakamityAdyapIndriyavisheShaNaM vyAkhyeyam||1-2||

7.sanskrit: iha khalu varNashca svarashca gandhashca rasashca sparshashca cakShushca shrotraM ca ghrANaM ca rasanaM ca sparshanaM ca sattvaM ca bhaktishca shaucaM ca shIlaM cAcArashca smRutishcAkRutishca prakRutishca vikRutishca balaM ca glAnishca medhA ca harShashca raukShyaM ca snehashca tandrA cArambhashca gauravaM ca lAghavaM ca guNAshcAhArashca vihArashcAhArapariNAmashcopAyashcApAyashca vyAdhishca vyAdhipUrvarUpaM ca vedanAshcopadravAshca cchAyA ca praticchAyA ca svapnadarshanaM ca dUtAdhikArashca pathi cautpAtikaM cAturakule bhAvAvasthAntarANi ca bheShajasaMvRuttishca bheShajavikArayuktishceti parIkShyANi pratyakShAnumAnopadeshairAyuShaH pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAnena bhiShajA||3||
7.commentary: indriyasthAnapratipAdyaM kRutsnaM viShayamAha- ihetyAdi| iha indriyasthAne| khalushabdo vAkyAla~gkAre| iha ca yadyapIndriyANyeva viShayavarNAdigrAhakatayA agre vaktuM yujyante, tathA~api teShAmatIndriyatvena tadAshrayariShTAnAmavyaktatvaM ; tena, pravyaktAni varNAdInyeva pravyaktariShTAdhikaraNAnyagre~abhidhIyante| varNAdiShvapi ca yathA vyaktatvaM tathA pUrvanipAtaH| meghAdishabdastu yadyapi varNAdapi vyaktastathA~api shabdavisheSha eveha tAlvAdisampAdyaH svarashabdAbhidheyo riShTAdhikaraNatvenAbhimataH, sa ca varNApekShayA~avyakta eva| ihetyAdAvasamAsena pratyekamapi varNAdInAM riShTAdhikaraNatvaM darshayati; samAse hi samudAyasyaiva riShTAdhikaraNakatayA parIkShitavyatvaM sha~gkyeta| varNashabdena ca varNasahacaritAshcakShurgrAhyA raukShyAdayo~api gRuhyante; ata eva varNaprastAva eva vakShyati- yat- “varNagrahaNena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH” iti| svarAdigrahaNena ca svarAdyabhAvo~api gRuhyate, tenA~gguliparvashabdAbhAva-gandhAbhAvAdayo~api riShTAnyavarudhyante| sparshagrahaNena ca sparshopalabhyakAThinyAdyavarodhaH| sattvaM manaH; sattvavikRuterudAharaNaM yathA- “autsukyaM bhajate sattvaM ceto bhIrAvishatyapi” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bhaktiH icchA| shIlaM sahajaM vRuttam| AcAraH shAstrashikShAkRuto vyavahAraH| bhaktyAdayo yadyapi sattvavikAratvena sattvagrahaNenaiva labhyante; yaduktaM- “bhaktiH shIlaM shaucaM dveShaH smRutirmohastyAgo~amAtsaryaM bhayaM krodhastandrotsAhastaikShNyaM mArdavaM gAmbhIryamanavasthitatvamityevamAdayaH sattvavikArAH” (shA.a.3) iti; tathA~api bhaktyAdInAmapi pRuthagariShTAdhikaraNatveneha pRuthakkaraNam| nidrAdaurbalyAttandreti tandrAshabdena nidrocyate; atra ca riShTamuktaM yathA- “nidrA nityA bhavati vA na vA” (iM.a.11) iti| Arambha iti ariShTavyAdhyutpAdArambhaH ; yaduktaM- “shvayathuryasya kukShistho hastapAdaM pradhAvati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| gaurave riShTaM yathA- “niShThyUtaM ca purIShaM ca retashcAmbhasi majjati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| lAghave riShTaM- gurUNAma~ggAnAM lAghavaM j~jeyam| guNariShTaM yathA- “guNAH sharIradeshAnAM shItoShNamRududAruNAH| viparyAsena lakShyante sthAneShvanyeShu tadvidhAH” (iM.a.12) iti| AhArariShTaM yathA- “AhAramupayu~jjAno bhiShajA sUpakalpitam” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| AhArapariNAmariShTaM yathA- “durbalo bahu bhu~gkte yo prAgabhuktvA~annamAturaH| alpamUtrapurIShashca” (iM.a.7) iti| upAya upagamanaM vyAdhimelaka ityarthaH; yaduktaM- “sahasA jvarasantApastRuShNA mUrcchA balakShayaH| vishleShaNaM ca sandhInAM” (iM.a.8) iti| vyAdhyapagamanamapAyaH; yaduktaM- “yaM naraM sahasA rogo durbalaM parimu~jcati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| vyAdhishceti vyAdhireva riShTaM yathA- “vAtAShThIlA susaMvRuttA dAruNA hRudi tiShThati” (iM.a.10) iti| chAyA bhautikI pa~jcarUpA, praticchAyA tu dehacchAyA; praticchAyayA ca netrakumArikA~api praticchAyArUpA gRuhItavyA| ayaM ca chAyAdibhedaH pannarUpIyendriye darshayitavyaH | Aturakule bhAvAvasthAriShTaM yathA- “agnipUrNAni pAtrANi bhinnAni vishikhAni ca| bhiSha~gmumUrShatAM veshma pravishanneva pashyati” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bheShajasaMvRuttau riShTaM yathA- “yamuddishyAturaM vaidyaH saMvartayitumauShadham| yatamAno na shaknoti durlabhaM tasya jIvitam” (iM.a.12) iti| bheShajasya vikAreNa samaM yuktirbheShajavikArayuktiH; tatra riShTaM yathA- “vij~jAtaM bahushaH siddhaM vidhivaccAvacAritam| na sidhyatyauShadhaM yasya tasya nAsti cikitsitam” (iM.a.12) iti| sheShaM tu riShTodAharaNaM vyaktam| iti samAptau| pratyakShapUrvakatvAt sarvapramANAnAmihAdau pratyakShaM kRutam| yadyapi varNAdaya AyurlakShaNapratipAditA dIrghAyuHpramANajij~jAsAyAmapi parIkShyante, tathA~apIha riShTaprakaraNe AyuHpramANAvasheShaj~jAnArthameva parIkShaNIyAH, ata uktaM- pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAneneti||3||

7.sanskrit: tatra tu khalveShAM parIkShyANAM kAnicit puruShamanAshritAni, kAnicicca puruShasaMshrayANi| tatra yAni puruShamanAshritAni tAnyupadeshato yuktitashca parIkSheta, puruShasaMshrayANi punaH prakRutito vikRutitashca||4||
7.commentary: puruShamanAshritAni dUtAdyAshrayANi riShTAni| yuktitashcetyanumAnata ityarthaH, atra yukterapi riShTatvAvadhAraNe kShamatvAt| pratyakShaM hi dUtAdInAM svarUpamAtraM gRuhNAti, riShTaM tu dUtAdInAmAgamAdeva j~jAyate| puruShAshrayivarNAdigatariShTagrahaNe tu pratyakShamapi tattadariShTavisheShagrahaNe tattadvisheSheNa vyApriyata iti matvA~atra tatpratiShiddham| anumAnaM tu riShTatvena pratipAditamanimittatvAdidharmavicAre vyApriyate, evaM sarvatra| prakRutitashceti puruShAshrayavikRutij~jAnahetutayA prakRutI riShTaj~jAne vyApriyate, yataH prakRutij~jAnAdhInaM vikRutij~jAnaM bhavati; prakRutivikRutiparIkShA tvatrAdhikRutaiH prasiddhaiH pratyakShAdibhireva j~jeyA||4||

7.sanskrit: tatra prakRutirjAtiprasaktA ca, kulaprasaktA ca, deshAnupAtinI ca, kAlAnupAtinI ca vayo~anupAtinI ca, pratyAtmaniyatA ceti| jAtikuladeshakAlavayaHpratyAtmaniyatA hi teShAM teShAM puruShANAM te te bhAvavisheShA bhavanti||5||
7.commentary: prakRutiM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| jAtiprasaktA yathA- brAhmaNajAtau shaucaM, kulaprasaktA yathA- ki~jcideva kulaM shucyAcAravadbhavati, deshAnupAtinI yathA- antarvedivAsinaH shucayo bhavanti, kAlAnupAtinI yathA- kRutayuge shaucaM, vayo~anupAtinI yathA- bAlye~ashaucaM, pratyAtmaniyatA yathA- kashcideva puruShaH prakRutyA shucirbhavati; ityAdyudAharaNIyam| kutaH punarjAtyAdiniyatA prakRutirbhavatItyatra hetumAha- jAtikuletyAdi| te te bhAvavisheShA iti shucitvAshaucAdayaH ||5||

7.sanskrit: vikRutiH punarlakShaNanimittA ca, lakShyanimittA ca, nimittAnurUpA ca||6||
7.commentary: riShTAdhikArAdhikRutAM vikRutiM vivecayituM sarvAneva vikRutibhedAnAha- vikRutirityAdi||6||

7.sanskrit: tatra lakShaNanimittA nAma sA yasyAH sharIre lakShaNAnyeva hetubhUtAni bhavanti daivAt; lakShaNAni hi kAniciccharIropanibaddhAni bhavanti, yAni hi tasmiMstasmin kAle tatrAdhiShThAnamAsAdya tAM tAM vikRutimutpAdayanti|7|
7.commentary: hetubhUtAnIti hetusadRushAni| tena daivameva nakharekhApadmAdisAmudrikoktalakShaNayukte sharIre rAjyadhanagamanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutiprAptau hetuH, lakShaNAni tu daivanimittAni bodhakamAtrANi, ata eva daivAdityuktaM; daivaM ca prAktanaM karmocyate| vikRutimutpAdayantItyatrApi daivAditi yojanIyaM; tena, daivabalAdeva lakShaNAnAM rAjyadhanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutikartRutvam| tasmiMstasmin kAle ityanena lakShaNasUcitAdRuShTaparipAkakAle niyatatvaM vikRuterdarshayati| lakShaNAsUcitAshca rAjyAdaya iha puruShasya kadAcidbhavanto~asvAbhAvikA eveti kRutvA vikRutishabdenocyante||7(1)||

7.sanskrit: lakShyanimittA tu sA yasyA upalabhyate nimittaM yathoktaM nidAneShu|7|
7.commentary: yathoktaM nidAneShviti yathA- rUkShAdisevayA vAtAdiprakoparUpA vikRutirnidAnoktetyarthaH||7(2)||

7.sanskrit: nimittAnurUpA tu nimittArthAnukAriNI yA, tAmanimittAM nimittamAyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyecchanti bhiShajo bhUyashcAyuShaH kShayanimittAM preteli~ggAnurUpAM, yAmAyuSho~antargatasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti dhIrAH| yAM cAdhikRutya puruShasaMshrayANi mumUrShatAM lakShaNAnyupadekShyAmaH| ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||7||
7.commentary: nimittAnurUpeti nimittasadRushI| tadeva sphoTayati- nimittArthAnukAriNIti|- nimittasya yo~arthaH kAryajananarUpaH kAryabodhanarUpo vA tamanukarotIti nimittArthAnukAriNI| riShTAkhyA hi vikRutirmaraNe tasyaivAvabodhane vA nimittaM bhavati| aparamapi nimittAnurUpAyA vikRutervisheShamAha- tAmityAdi| animittAmiti tadAtve~anupalabhyamAnanimittAM, na tu punaH sarvathaivAhetukIM, yata ‘AyuShaH kShayanimittAm’ ityanantaramasya visheShaNaM kathayiShyati; riShTasya hi na raukShyAdinA sharIrasambandhAdi nimittamupalabhyate| yadvA, AyuHkShayarUpaM yannimittaM tadvidyamAnamapi nAnyairupalabhyate , kintu tadeva hi riShTAdunnIyate; tena, avyaktanimittatvamihAnimittatvaM j~jeyam| atra gatAyuShTvameva sakalapuruShasaMshritariShTavyApakaM kAraNaM sAdhu| yattu vakShyati- “kriyApathamatikrAntAH kevalaM dehamAshritAH| cihnaM kurvanti yaddoShAstadariShTaM pracakShate” (iM.a.11) iti, taddUtAdigatariShTAvyApakatayA puruShAshrayiriShTamAtrAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam| AyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyeti AyuHsheShapramANaj~jAnasyetyarthaH| bhUya iti atyartham| tenAtyarthamAyuHkShayanimittAM pratyAsannAyuHkShayajanyAmiti yAvat| yAmiti kShINAyuHkAryAm| pretali~ggAnurUpAmiti pretasadRushIM; “malA danteShu jAyante pretAkRutirudIryate” (iM.a.12) ityAdigranthavakShyamANAm| imAM hi vikRutimAyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthaM vadanti| yA tvanyA pretali~ggAnanurUpA varNAshrayA sA pratyAsannamaraNabodhikA; tena sA nAtyarthannAtyarthakShINAyuHkAryetyarthaH| evaM ‘bhUyashca’ ityAdinA ‘dhIrAH’ ityantena nimittAnurUpavikRutivisheShasya kAryavisheShaM maraNalakShaNamabhidhAya punaH sAmAnyenAnimittAyA dharmAntaramAha- yAmadhikRutyetyAdi| puruShasaMshrayANIti visheShaNena puruShAnAshritadUtAdiriShTe nAvashyamanimittatA~astIti darshayati| yato dUtAdhikArAdau yAni riShTAni tAni dRushyamAnanimittAnyapyAgamAdeva riShTatvenAvadhAryante| yathA- “muktakeshe~athavA nagne rudatyaprayate~athavA| bhiShagabhyAgataM dRuShTvA dUtaM maraNamAdishet” (iM.a.12) iti| atra ca bhiShajo muktakeshavacanAddRushyata eva kAraNaM, tathA dUtAgamane cAturasya preraNAdi kAraNamastyeva, tenAnimittatvamAturAshrayiriShTa eva| anye tu, evambhUtavaidyadUtasamAgamaH parihartavyatvena j~jAtaH san yadA daivAdbhavati, tadA daivanimittaH san riShTaM bhavati; tena, sarvariShTavyApikaiveyamanimittatA; bhUyashcetyAdigranthena tu pretali~ggAnurUpAM vikRutiM bhUya AyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti, tathA puruShasaMshrayANi bhUya upadekShyante, puruShAnAshrayANi tu svalpagranthenopadekShyante iti vyAkhyAnayanti| ityuddesha indriyasthAnArthoddesha ityarthaH||7||

7.sanskrit: tatrAdita eva varNAdhikAraH| tadyathA- kRuShNaH, shyAmaH , shyAmAvadAtaH, avadAtashceti prakRutivarNAH sharIrasya bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH||8||
7.commentary: prakRutij~jAnAntarIyakatvAdvikRutij~jAnasya prakRutivarNAneva tAvadAha- kRuShNa ityAdi| avadAto gauraH| iha ca prAyeNa ye varNAH prakRutyA bhavanti te prakRutivarNA ucyante, ye tu prAyeNa vikRutyA bhavanti te vikRutivarNA ucyante, iti j~jeyam| tena prakRutivarNA api kadAcidvikRutivarNA bhavanti, tathA vikRutivarNA api janmaprabhRutijAyamAnatayA kadAcit prakRutivarNA bhavantIti j~jeyam| anuktaprakRutivarNAtideshArthamAha- yAMshcetyAdi| upetya IkShamANa iti upekShamANaH| anUkata iti sAdRushyataH; anena ca shyAmetyAdivarNashabdena nirdishyamAnAn vidyAditi yojanA| tajj~jairiti varNabhedanAmaj~jaiH||8||

7.sanskrit: nIlashyAvatAmraharitashuklAshca varNAH sharIrasya vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutivarNA bhavantyuktAH sharIrasya| tatra prakRutivarNamardhasharIre vikRutivarNamardhasharIre, dvAvapi varNau maryAdAvibhaktau dRuShTvA; yadyevaM savyadakShiNavibhAgena, yadyevaM pUrvapashcimavibhAgena, yadyuttarAdharavibhAgena, yadyantarbahirvibhAgena, AturasyAriShTamiti vidyAt; evameva varNabhedo mukhe~apyanyatra vartamAno maraNAya bhavati||9||
7.commentary: nIletyAdinA (vikRutijAyamAnatayA ) vikRutivarNAnAha| iha, ‘aparAn’ iti vacanena vikRutivarNasa~gkarajA varNA j~jeyAH| vikRutivarNAntaramAha- prAgityAdi| prAgvikRutAniti pUrvavarNAdanyathAbhUtAnityarthaH| tenApi, yena shyAmena satA rasAyanopayogAdgauravarNatvaM prAptaM, sa ca tyaktarasAyanaH kAlavashAt punaH shyAmavarNo bhavati tasyApi pUrvagauravarNAdvikRutiH shyAmavarNo bhavan riShTaM syAdityAha- abhUtvotpannAniti; tena nAyaM doShaH; atra hi pUrvabhUta eva varNaH punarbhavati, tena na riShTam| maryAdAvibhaktAviti samasImAvyavasthApitau| pUrvapashcimavibhAgeneti abhimukhapRuShThabhAgenetyarthaH| antarbahirvibhAgeneti atrAntargato varNo mukhanAsAkarNashrotrAntargatatayA unneyaH| anyatreti avAntare hastapAdAdau||9||

7.sanskrit: varNabhedena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH||10||
7.commentary: varNabhedeneti yathA varNavibhAgena riShTaM, tathA glAnyAdivibhAgenApItyarthaH| harSha ihopacayo j~jeyaH, mAnasaharShasyeha cAkShuShAdhikAre~asa~ggatatvAt||10||

7.sanskrit: tathA pipluvya~ggatilakAlakapiDakAnAmanyatamasyAnane janmAturasyaivamevAprashastaM vidyAt||11||
7.commentary: tathetyAdau pipluprabhRutInAmapi varNavat savyadakShiNAdivibhAgena janma riShTaM bhavatItyevamevashabdenocyate||11||

7.sanskrit: nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShahastapAdauShThAdiShvapi ca vaikArikoktAnAM varNAnAmanyatamasya prAdurbhAvo hInabalavarNendriyeShu lakShaNamAyuShaH kShayasya bhavati||12||
7.commentary: nakhetyAdau balahAnyAdyabhAve sati na riShTam||12||

7.sanskrit: yaccAnyadapi ki~jcidvarNavaikRutamabhUtapUrvaM sahasotpadyetAnimittameva hIyamAnasyAturasya shashvat, tadariShTamiti vidyAt| iti varNAdhikAraH||13||
7.commentary: yaccetyAdinA~anuktavarNariShTaM sa~ggRuhNAti| abhUtapUrvamiti pUrvavyAkRutarasAyanavihitavarNaprAdurbhAvavyudAsArtham| sahasotpadyata ityanena riShTAnAM shIghrasvabhAvaM darshayati| animittamiti pUrvoktArthameva| hIyamAnasya shashvaditi svabhAvakathanaM, riShTotpattyA hIyamAnatA shashvadavashyaM bhavati||13||

7.sanskrit: svarAdhikArastu- haMsakrau~jcanemidundubhikalavi~gkakAkakapotajarjarAnukArAH prakRutisvarA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH| eDakakalagrastAvyaktagadgadakShAmadInAnukIrNAstvAturANAM svarA vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutisvarA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||14||
7.commentary: kramAgataM svaramAha- svaretyAdi| jarjaraH vAdyabhANDavisheShaH| yAMshcetyAdi pUrvavad vyAkhyeyam| eDako meShaH, kiMvA araNyacchAgalaH; kalaH sUkShmaH; grastaH sarvathA~anuccAraH; kShAmaH rUkShaH; dInaH duHkhoccAryamANasvaraH; anukIrNa uparyuparyuccAryamANaH||14||

7.sanskrit: tatra prakRutivaikArikANAM svarANAmAshvabhinirvRuttiH svarAnekatvamekasya cAnekatvamaprashastam| iti svarAdhikAraH||15|| iti varNasvarAdhikArau yathAvaduktau mumUrShatAM lakShaNaj~jAnArthamiti||16||
7.commentary: prakRutervaikArikA anyathAbhUtA iti prakRutivaikArikAH| svarAnekatvamiti kadAcideDakasvaratvaM, kadAcit kalasvaratvamityAdi| ekasya cAnekatvamiti ekasyaiva svarasya cAnekatvamiva pratibhAti| animittamiti sarvatra sambadhyate||15-16||

7.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- yasya vaikAriko varNaH sharIra upapadyate| ardhe vA yadi vA kRutsne nimittaM na ca nAsti saH||17|| nIlaM vA yadi vA shyAvaM tAmraM vA yadi vA~aruNam| mukhArdhamanyathA varNo mukhArdhe~ariShTamucyate||18|| sneho mukhArdhe suvyakto raukShyamardhamukhe bhRusham| glAnirardhe tathA harSho mukhArdhe pretalakShaNam||19|| tilakAH piplavo vya~ggA rAjayashca pRuthagvidhAH| AturasyAshu jAyante mukhe prANAn mumukShataH||20|| puShpANi nakhadanteShu pa~gko vA dantasaMshritaH| cUrNako vA~api danteShu lakShaNaM maraNasya tat||21|| oShThayoH pAdayoH pANyorakShNormUtrapurIShayoH| nakheShvapi ca vaivarNyametat kShINabale~antakRut||22|| yasya nIlAvubhAvoShThau pakvajAmbavasannibhau| mumUrShuriti taM vidyAnnaro dhIro gatAyuSham||23|| eko vA yadi vA~aneko yasya vaikArikaH svaraH| sahasotpadyate jantorhIyamAnasya nAsti saH||24|| yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdvaikRutaM svaravarNayoH| balamAMsavihInasya tat sarvaM maraNodayam ||25|| tatra shlokaH- iti varNasvarAvuktau lakShaNArthaM mumUrShatAm| yastau samyagvijAnAti nAyurj~jAne sa muhyati||26||
7.commentary: ayamevArtho gadyoktaH spaShTArthaM sukhagrahaNArthaM ca shlokenocyate- yasyetyAdinA| tilakA ityAdau mukhe iti mukhArdhe| oShThAviti dvivacanamuktvA~api yat ‘ubhau’ iti karoti, tena sakalauShThavyAptiM darshayati| mumUrShurityukatvA~api yat ‘gatAyuShaM’ iti karoti, tena riShTayukto mumUrShargatAyurIti darshayati; ajAtariShTastu pratikriyAbhAvAnmumUrShuragatAyurapi bhavati| maraNodayamiti maraNakAraNamiti j~jAnArtham||17-26||

7.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute indriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
7.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmindriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

8.sanskrit: athAto varNasvarIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
8.commentary: shArIre cikitsAdhikaraNaM sharIraM pratipAdya cikitsA vaktavyA, sA ca sAdhya eva roge vaktavyA nAsAdhyaroge, yaduktaM- “arthavidyAyashohAnimupakroshamasa~ggraham| prApnuyAnniyataM vaidyo yo~asAdhyaM samupAcaret” (sU.a.10) iti; na ca riShTapratipattimantarA~asAdhyatvapratipattiriti riShTapratipAdakamindriyasthAnameva cikitsAsthAnAt prAgucyate | indrashabdena prANa ucyate, tasyAntagatasya li~ggaM riShTAkhyamindriyaM; yaduktaM vyAkaraNe- “indriyamindrali~ggaM” (pA.a.5.2.13) ityAdi; tasyendriyasya sthAnamindriyasthAnam| tatrApi cendriyasthAne vaktavye vyaktatamariShTAbhidhAyakatayA varNasvarIyamindriyamucyate, atra hi yAni riShTAni vaktavyAni tAnItarariShTebhyashcakShurAdigrAhyatayA vyaktatamAni| varNasvarAvadhikRutya kRuto varNasvarIyaH, indriyasya riShTarUpasya pratipAdako~adhyAya indriyaH, taM vyAkhyAsyAmaH| evamanyatrApi puShpitakamityAdyapIndriyavisheShaNaM vyAkhyeyam||1-2||

8.sanskrit: iha khalu varNashca svarashca gandhashca rasashca sparshashca cakShushca shrotraM ca ghrANaM ca rasanaM ca sparshanaM ca sattvaM ca bhaktishca shaucaM ca shIlaM cAcArashca smRutishcAkRutishca prakRutishca vikRutishca balaM ca glAnishca medhA ca harShashca raukShyaM ca snehashca tandrA cArambhashca gauravaM ca lAghavaM ca guNAshcAhArashca vihArashcAhArapariNAmashcopAyashcApAyashca vyAdhishca vyAdhipUrvarUpaM ca vedanAshcopadravAshca cchAyA ca praticchAyA ca svapnadarshanaM ca dUtAdhikArashca pathi cautpAtikaM cAturakule bhAvAvasthAntarANi ca bheShajasaMvRuttishca bheShajavikArayuktishceti parIkShyANi pratyakShAnumAnopadeshairAyuShaH pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAnena bhiShajA||3||
8.commentary: indriyasthAnapratipAdyaM kRutsnaM viShayamAha- ihetyAdi| iha indriyasthAne| khalushabdo vAkyAla~gkAre| iha ca yadyapIndriyANyeva viShayavarNAdigrAhakatayA agre vaktuM yujyante, tathA~api teShAmatIndriyatvena tadAshrayariShTAnAmavyaktatvaM ; tena, pravyaktAni varNAdInyeva pravyaktariShTAdhikaraNAnyagre~abhidhIyante| varNAdiShvapi ca yathA vyaktatvaM tathA pUrvanipAtaH| meghAdishabdastu yadyapi varNAdapi vyaktastathA~api shabdavisheSha eveha tAlvAdisampAdyaH svarashabdAbhidheyo riShTAdhikaraNatvenAbhimataH, sa ca varNApekShayA~avyakta eva| ihetyAdAvasamAsena pratyekamapi varNAdInAM riShTAdhikaraNatvaM darshayati; samAse hi samudAyasyaiva riShTAdhikaraNakatayA parIkShitavyatvaM sha~gkyeta| varNashabdena ca varNasahacaritAshcakShurgrAhyA raukShyAdayo~api gRuhyante; ata eva varNaprastAva eva vakShyati- yat- “varNagrahaNena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH” iti| svarAdigrahaNena ca svarAdyabhAvo~api gRuhyate, tenA~gguliparvashabdAbhAva-gandhAbhAvAdayo~api riShTAnyavarudhyante| sparshagrahaNena ca sparshopalabhyakAThinyAdyavarodhaH| sattvaM manaH; sattvavikRuterudAharaNaM yathA- “autsukyaM bhajate sattvaM ceto bhIrAvishatyapi” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bhaktiH icchA| shIlaM sahajaM vRuttam| AcAraH shAstrashikShAkRuto vyavahAraH| bhaktyAdayo yadyapi sattvavikAratvena sattvagrahaNenaiva labhyante; yaduktaM- “bhaktiH shIlaM shaucaM dveShaH smRutirmohastyAgo~amAtsaryaM bhayaM krodhastandrotsAhastaikShNyaM mArdavaM gAmbhIryamanavasthitatvamityevamAdayaH sattvavikArAH” (shA.a.3) iti; tathA~api bhaktyAdInAmapi pRuthagariShTAdhikaraNatveneha pRuthakkaraNam| nidrAdaurbalyAttandreti tandrAshabdena nidrocyate; atra ca riShTamuktaM yathA- “nidrA nityA bhavati vA na vA” (iM.a.11) iti| Arambha iti ariShTavyAdhyutpAdArambhaH ; yaduktaM- “shvayathuryasya kukShistho hastapAdaM pradhAvati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| gaurave riShTaM yathA- “niShThyUtaM ca purIShaM ca retashcAmbhasi majjati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| lAghave riShTaM- gurUNAma~ggAnAM lAghavaM j~jeyam| guNariShTaM yathA- “guNAH sharIradeshAnAM shItoShNamRududAruNAH| viparyAsena lakShyante sthAneShvanyeShu tadvidhAH” (iM.a.12) iti| AhArariShTaM yathA- “AhAramupayu~jjAno bhiShajA sUpakalpitam” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| AhArapariNAmariShTaM yathA- “durbalo bahu bhu~gkte yo prAgabhuktvA~annamAturaH| alpamUtrapurIShashca” (iM.a.7) iti| upAya upagamanaM vyAdhimelaka ityarthaH; yaduktaM- “sahasA jvarasantApastRuShNA mUrcchA balakShayaH| vishleShaNaM ca sandhInAM” (iM.a.8) iti| vyAdhyapagamanamapAyaH; yaduktaM- “yaM naraM sahasA rogo durbalaM parimu~jcati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| vyAdhishceti vyAdhireva riShTaM yathA- “vAtAShThIlA susaMvRuttA dAruNA hRudi tiShThati” (iM.a.10) iti| chAyA bhautikI pa~jcarUpA, praticchAyA tu dehacchAyA; praticchAyayA ca netrakumArikA~api praticchAyArUpA gRuhItavyA| ayaM ca chAyAdibhedaH pannarUpIyendriye darshayitavyaH | Aturakule bhAvAvasthAriShTaM yathA- “agnipUrNAni pAtrANi bhinnAni vishikhAni ca| bhiSha~gmumUrShatAM veshma pravishanneva pashyati” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bheShajasaMvRuttau riShTaM yathA- “yamuddishyAturaM vaidyaH saMvartayitumauShadham| yatamAno na shaknoti durlabhaM tasya jIvitam” (iM.a.12) iti| bheShajasya vikAreNa samaM yuktirbheShajavikArayuktiH; tatra riShTaM yathA- “vij~jAtaM bahushaH siddhaM vidhivaccAvacAritam| na sidhyatyauShadhaM yasya tasya nAsti cikitsitam” (iM.a.12) iti| sheShaM tu riShTodAharaNaM vyaktam| iti samAptau| pratyakShapUrvakatvAt sarvapramANAnAmihAdau pratyakShaM kRutam| yadyapi varNAdaya AyurlakShaNapratipAditA dIrghAyuHpramANajij~jAsAyAmapi parIkShyante, tathA~apIha riShTaprakaraNe AyuHpramANAvasheShaj~jAnArthameva parIkShaNIyAH, ata uktaM- pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAneneti||3||

8.sanskrit: tatra tu khalveShAM parIkShyANAM kAnicit puruShamanAshritAni, kAnicicca puruShasaMshrayANi| tatra yAni puruShamanAshritAni tAnyupadeshato yuktitashca parIkSheta, puruShasaMshrayANi punaH prakRutito vikRutitashca||4||
8.commentary: puruShamanAshritAni dUtAdyAshrayANi riShTAni| yuktitashcetyanumAnata ityarthaH, atra yukterapi riShTatvAvadhAraNe kShamatvAt| pratyakShaM hi dUtAdInAM svarUpamAtraM gRuhNAti, riShTaM tu dUtAdInAmAgamAdeva j~jAyate| puruShAshrayivarNAdigatariShTagrahaNe tu pratyakShamapi tattadariShTavisheShagrahaNe tattadvisheSheNa vyApriyata iti matvA~atra tatpratiShiddham| anumAnaM tu riShTatvena pratipAditamanimittatvAdidharmavicAre vyApriyate, evaM sarvatra| prakRutitashceti puruShAshrayavikRutij~jAnahetutayA prakRutI riShTaj~jAne vyApriyate, yataH prakRutij~jAnAdhInaM vikRutij~jAnaM bhavati; prakRutivikRutiparIkShA tvatrAdhikRutaiH prasiddhaiH pratyakShAdibhireva j~jeyA||4||

8.sanskrit: tatra prakRutirjAtiprasaktA ca, kulaprasaktA ca, deshAnupAtinI ca, kAlAnupAtinI ca vayo~anupAtinI ca, pratyAtmaniyatA ceti| jAtikuladeshakAlavayaHpratyAtmaniyatA hi teShAM teShAM puruShANAM te te bhAvavisheShA bhavanti||5||
8.commentary: prakRutiM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| jAtiprasaktA yathA- brAhmaNajAtau shaucaM, kulaprasaktA yathA- ki~jcideva kulaM shucyAcAravadbhavati, deshAnupAtinI yathA- antarvedivAsinaH shucayo bhavanti, kAlAnupAtinI yathA- kRutayuge shaucaM, vayo~anupAtinI yathA- bAlye~ashaucaM, pratyAtmaniyatA yathA- kashcideva puruShaH prakRutyA shucirbhavati; ityAdyudAharaNIyam| kutaH punarjAtyAdiniyatA prakRutirbhavatItyatra hetumAha- jAtikuletyAdi| te te bhAvavisheShA iti shucitvAshaucAdayaH ||5||

8.sanskrit: vikRutiH punarlakShaNanimittA ca, lakShyanimittA ca, nimittAnurUpA ca||6||
8.commentary: riShTAdhikArAdhikRutAM vikRutiM vivecayituM sarvAneva vikRutibhedAnAha- vikRutirityAdi||6||

8.sanskrit: tatra lakShaNanimittA nAma sA yasyAH sharIre lakShaNAnyeva hetubhUtAni bhavanti daivAt; lakShaNAni hi kAniciccharIropanibaddhAni bhavanti, yAni hi tasmiMstasmin kAle tatrAdhiShThAnamAsAdya tAM tAM vikRutimutpAdayanti|7|
8.commentary: hetubhUtAnIti hetusadRushAni| tena daivameva nakharekhApadmAdisAmudrikoktalakShaNayukte sharIre rAjyadhanagamanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutiprAptau hetuH, lakShaNAni tu daivanimittAni bodhakamAtrANi, ata eva daivAdityuktaM; daivaM ca prAktanaM karmocyate| vikRutimutpAdayantItyatrApi daivAditi yojanIyaM; tena, daivabalAdeva lakShaNAnAM rAjyadhanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutikartRutvam| tasmiMstasmin kAle ityanena lakShaNasUcitAdRuShTaparipAkakAle niyatatvaM vikRuterdarshayati| lakShaNAsUcitAshca rAjyAdaya iha puruShasya kadAcidbhavanto~asvAbhAvikA eveti kRutvA vikRutishabdenocyante||7(1)||

8.sanskrit: lakShyanimittA tu sA yasyA upalabhyate nimittaM yathoktaM nidAneShu|7|
8.commentary: yathoktaM nidAneShviti yathA- rUkShAdisevayA vAtAdiprakoparUpA vikRutirnidAnoktetyarthaH||7(2)||

8.sanskrit: nimittAnurUpA tu nimittArthAnukAriNI yA, tAmanimittAM nimittamAyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyecchanti bhiShajo bhUyashcAyuShaH kShayanimittAM preteli~ggAnurUpAM, yAmAyuSho~antargatasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti dhIrAH| yAM cAdhikRutya puruShasaMshrayANi mumUrShatAM lakShaNAnyupadekShyAmaH| ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||7||
8.commentary: nimittAnurUpeti nimittasadRushI| tadeva sphoTayati- nimittArthAnukAriNIti|- nimittasya yo~arthaH kAryajananarUpaH kAryabodhanarUpo vA tamanukarotIti nimittArthAnukAriNI| riShTAkhyA hi vikRutirmaraNe tasyaivAvabodhane vA nimittaM bhavati| aparamapi nimittAnurUpAyA vikRutervisheShamAha- tAmityAdi| animittAmiti tadAtve~anupalabhyamAnanimittAM, na tu punaH sarvathaivAhetukIM, yata ‘AyuShaH kShayanimittAm’ ityanantaramasya visheShaNaM kathayiShyati; riShTasya hi na raukShyAdinA sharIrasambandhAdi nimittamupalabhyate| yadvA, AyuHkShayarUpaM yannimittaM tadvidyamAnamapi nAnyairupalabhyate , kintu tadeva hi riShTAdunnIyate; tena, avyaktanimittatvamihAnimittatvaM j~jeyam| atra gatAyuShTvameva sakalapuruShasaMshritariShTavyApakaM kAraNaM sAdhu| yattu vakShyati- “kriyApathamatikrAntAH kevalaM dehamAshritAH| cihnaM kurvanti yaddoShAstadariShTaM pracakShate” (iM.a.11) iti, taddUtAdigatariShTAvyApakatayA puruShAshrayiriShTamAtrAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam| AyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyeti AyuHsheShapramANaj~jAnasyetyarthaH| bhUya iti atyartham| tenAtyarthamAyuHkShayanimittAM pratyAsannAyuHkShayajanyAmiti yAvat| yAmiti kShINAyuHkAryAm| pretali~ggAnurUpAmiti pretasadRushIM; “malA danteShu jAyante pretAkRutirudIryate” (iM.a.12) ityAdigranthavakShyamANAm| imAM hi vikRutimAyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthaM vadanti| yA tvanyA pretali~ggAnanurUpA varNAshrayA sA pratyAsannamaraNabodhikA; tena sA nAtyarthannAtyarthakShINAyuHkAryetyarthaH| evaM ‘bhUyashca’ ityAdinA ‘dhIrAH’ ityantena nimittAnurUpavikRutivisheShasya kAryavisheShaM maraNalakShaNamabhidhAya punaH sAmAnyenAnimittAyA dharmAntaramAha- yAmadhikRutyetyAdi| puruShasaMshrayANIti visheShaNena puruShAnAshritadUtAdiriShTe nAvashyamanimittatA~astIti darshayati| yato dUtAdhikArAdau yAni riShTAni tAni dRushyamAnanimittAnyapyAgamAdeva riShTatvenAvadhAryante| yathA- “muktakeshe~athavA nagne rudatyaprayate~athavA| bhiShagabhyAgataM dRuShTvA dUtaM maraNamAdishet” (iM.a.12) iti| atra ca bhiShajo muktakeshavacanAddRushyata eva kAraNaM, tathA dUtAgamane cAturasya preraNAdi kAraNamastyeva, tenAnimittatvamAturAshrayiriShTa eva| anye tu, evambhUtavaidyadUtasamAgamaH parihartavyatvena j~jAtaH san yadA daivAdbhavati, tadA daivanimittaH san riShTaM bhavati; tena, sarvariShTavyApikaiveyamanimittatA; bhUyashcetyAdigranthena tu pretali~ggAnurUpAM vikRutiM bhUya AyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti, tathA puruShasaMshrayANi bhUya upadekShyante, puruShAnAshrayANi tu svalpagranthenopadekShyante iti vyAkhyAnayanti| ityuddesha indriyasthAnArthoddesha ityarthaH||7||

8.sanskrit: tatrAdita eva varNAdhikAraH| tadyathA- kRuShNaH, shyAmaH , shyAmAvadAtaH, avadAtashceti prakRutivarNAH sharIrasya bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH||8||
8.commentary: prakRutij~jAnAntarIyakatvAdvikRutij~jAnasya prakRutivarNAneva tAvadAha- kRuShNa ityAdi| avadAto gauraH| iha ca prAyeNa ye varNAH prakRutyA bhavanti te prakRutivarNA ucyante, ye tu prAyeNa vikRutyA bhavanti te vikRutivarNA ucyante, iti j~jeyam| tena prakRutivarNA api kadAcidvikRutivarNA bhavanti, tathA vikRutivarNA api janmaprabhRutijAyamAnatayA kadAcit prakRutivarNA bhavantIti j~jeyam| anuktaprakRutivarNAtideshArthamAha- yAMshcetyAdi| upetya IkShamANa iti upekShamANaH| anUkata iti sAdRushyataH; anena ca shyAmetyAdivarNashabdena nirdishyamAnAn vidyAditi yojanA| tajj~jairiti varNabhedanAmaj~jaiH||8||

8.sanskrit: nIlashyAvatAmraharitashuklAshca varNAH sharIrasya vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutivarNA bhavantyuktAH sharIrasya| tatra prakRutivarNamardhasharIre vikRutivarNamardhasharIre, dvAvapi varNau maryAdAvibhaktau dRuShTvA; yadyevaM savyadakShiNavibhAgena, yadyevaM pUrvapashcimavibhAgena, yadyuttarAdharavibhAgena, yadyantarbahirvibhAgena, AturasyAriShTamiti vidyAt; evameva varNabhedo mukhe~apyanyatra vartamAno maraNAya bhavati||9||
8.commentary: nIletyAdinA (vikRutijAyamAnatayA ) vikRutivarNAnAha| iha, ‘aparAn’ iti vacanena vikRutivarNasa~gkarajA varNA j~jeyAH| vikRutivarNAntaramAha- prAgityAdi| prAgvikRutAniti pUrvavarNAdanyathAbhUtAnityarthaH| tenApi, yena shyAmena satA rasAyanopayogAdgauravarNatvaM prAptaM, sa ca tyaktarasAyanaH kAlavashAt punaH shyAmavarNo bhavati tasyApi pUrvagauravarNAdvikRutiH shyAmavarNo bhavan riShTaM syAdityAha- abhUtvotpannAniti; tena nAyaM doShaH; atra hi pUrvabhUta eva varNaH punarbhavati, tena na riShTam| maryAdAvibhaktAviti samasImAvyavasthApitau| pUrvapashcimavibhAgeneti abhimukhapRuShThabhAgenetyarthaH| antarbahirvibhAgeneti atrAntargato varNo mukhanAsAkarNashrotrAntargatatayA unneyaH| anyatreti avAntare hastapAdAdau||9||

8.sanskrit: varNabhedena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH||10||
8.commentary: varNabhedeneti yathA varNavibhAgena riShTaM, tathA glAnyAdivibhAgenApItyarthaH| harSha ihopacayo j~jeyaH, mAnasaharShasyeha cAkShuShAdhikAre~asa~ggatatvAt||10||

8.sanskrit: tathA pipluvya~ggatilakAlakapiDakAnAmanyatamasyAnane janmAturasyaivamevAprashastaM vidyAt||11||
8.commentary: tathetyAdau pipluprabhRutInAmapi varNavat savyadakShiNAdivibhAgena janma riShTaM bhavatItyevamevashabdenocyate||11||

8.sanskrit: nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShahastapAdauShThAdiShvapi ca vaikArikoktAnAM varNAnAmanyatamasya prAdurbhAvo hInabalavarNendriyeShu lakShaNamAyuShaH kShayasya bhavati||12||
8.commentary: nakhetyAdau balahAnyAdyabhAve sati na riShTam||12||

8.sanskrit: yaccAnyadapi ki~jcidvarNavaikRutamabhUtapUrvaM sahasotpadyetAnimittameva hIyamAnasyAturasya shashvat, tadariShTamiti vidyAt| iti varNAdhikAraH||13||
8.commentary: yaccetyAdinA~anuktavarNariShTaM sa~ggRuhNAti| abhUtapUrvamiti pUrvavyAkRutarasAyanavihitavarNaprAdurbhAvavyudAsArtham| sahasotpadyata ityanena riShTAnAM shIghrasvabhAvaM darshayati| animittamiti pUrvoktArthameva| hIyamAnasya shashvaditi svabhAvakathanaM, riShTotpattyA hIyamAnatA shashvadavashyaM bhavati||13||

8.sanskrit: svarAdhikArastu- haMsakrau~jcanemidundubhikalavi~gkakAkakapotajarjarAnukArAH prakRutisvarA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH| eDakakalagrastAvyaktagadgadakShAmadInAnukIrNAstvAturANAM svarA vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutisvarA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||14||
8.commentary: kramAgataM svaramAha- svaretyAdi| jarjaraH vAdyabhANDavisheShaH| yAMshcetyAdi pUrvavad vyAkhyeyam| eDako meShaH, kiMvA araNyacchAgalaH; kalaH sUkShmaH; grastaH sarvathA~anuccAraH; kShAmaH rUkShaH; dInaH duHkhoccAryamANasvaraH; anukIrNa uparyuparyuccAryamANaH||14||

8.sanskrit: tatra prakRutivaikArikANAM svarANAmAshvabhinirvRuttiH svarAnekatvamekasya cAnekatvamaprashastam| iti svarAdhikAraH||15|| iti varNasvarAdhikArau yathAvaduktau mumUrShatAM lakShaNaj~jAnArthamiti||16||
8.commentary: prakRutervaikArikA anyathAbhUtA iti prakRutivaikArikAH| svarAnekatvamiti kadAcideDakasvaratvaM, kadAcit kalasvaratvamityAdi| ekasya cAnekatvamiti ekasyaiva svarasya cAnekatvamiva pratibhAti| animittamiti sarvatra sambadhyate||15-16||

8.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- yasya vaikAriko varNaH sharIra upapadyate| ardhe vA yadi vA kRutsne nimittaM na ca nAsti saH||17|| nIlaM vA yadi vA shyAvaM tAmraM vA yadi vA~aruNam| mukhArdhamanyathA varNo mukhArdhe~ariShTamucyate||18|| sneho mukhArdhe suvyakto raukShyamardhamukhe bhRusham| glAnirardhe tathA harSho mukhArdhe pretalakShaNam||19|| tilakAH piplavo vya~ggA rAjayashca pRuthagvidhAH| AturasyAshu jAyante mukhe prANAn mumukShataH||20|| puShpANi nakhadanteShu pa~gko vA dantasaMshritaH| cUrNako vA~api danteShu lakShaNaM maraNasya tat||21|| oShThayoH pAdayoH pANyorakShNormUtrapurIShayoH| nakheShvapi ca vaivarNyametat kShINabale~antakRut||22|| yasya nIlAvubhAvoShThau pakvajAmbavasannibhau| mumUrShuriti taM vidyAnnaro dhIro gatAyuSham||23|| eko vA yadi vA~aneko yasya vaikArikaH svaraH| sahasotpadyate jantorhIyamAnasya nAsti saH||24|| yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdvaikRutaM svaravarNayoH| balamAMsavihInasya tat sarvaM maraNodayam ||25|| tatra shlokaH- iti varNasvarAvuktau lakShaNArthaM mumUrShatAm| yastau samyagvijAnAti nAyurj~jAne sa muhyati||26||
8.commentary: ayamevArtho gadyoktaH spaShTArthaM sukhagrahaNArthaM ca shlokenocyate- yasyetyAdinA| tilakA ityAdau mukhe iti mukhArdhe| oShThAviti dvivacanamuktvA~api yat ‘ubhau’ iti karoti, tena sakalauShThavyAptiM darshayati| mumUrShurityukatvA~api yat ‘gatAyuShaM’ iti karoti, tena riShTayukto mumUrShargatAyurIti darshayati; ajAtariShTastu pratikriyAbhAvAnmumUrShuragatAyurapi bhavati| maraNodayamiti maraNakAraNamiti j~jAnArtham||17-26||

8.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute indriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
8.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmindriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

9.sanskrit: athAto varNasvarIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
9.commentary: shArIre cikitsAdhikaraNaM sharIraM pratipAdya cikitsA vaktavyA, sA ca sAdhya eva roge vaktavyA nAsAdhyaroge, yaduktaM- “arthavidyAyashohAnimupakroshamasa~ggraham| prApnuyAnniyataM vaidyo yo~asAdhyaM samupAcaret” (sU.a.10) iti; na ca riShTapratipattimantarA~asAdhyatvapratipattiriti riShTapratipAdakamindriyasthAnameva cikitsAsthAnAt prAgucyate | indrashabdena prANa ucyate, tasyAntagatasya li~ggaM riShTAkhyamindriyaM; yaduktaM vyAkaraNe- “indriyamindrali~ggaM” (pA.a.5.2.13) ityAdi; tasyendriyasya sthAnamindriyasthAnam| tatrApi cendriyasthAne vaktavye vyaktatamariShTAbhidhAyakatayA varNasvarIyamindriyamucyate, atra hi yAni riShTAni vaktavyAni tAnItarariShTebhyashcakShurAdigrAhyatayA vyaktatamAni| varNasvarAvadhikRutya kRuto varNasvarIyaH, indriyasya riShTarUpasya pratipAdako~adhyAya indriyaH, taM vyAkhyAsyAmaH| evamanyatrApi puShpitakamityAdyapIndriyavisheShaNaM vyAkhyeyam||1-2||

9.sanskrit: iha khalu varNashca svarashca gandhashca rasashca sparshashca cakShushca shrotraM ca ghrANaM ca rasanaM ca sparshanaM ca sattvaM ca bhaktishca shaucaM ca shIlaM cAcArashca smRutishcAkRutishca prakRutishca vikRutishca balaM ca glAnishca medhA ca harShashca raukShyaM ca snehashca tandrA cArambhashca gauravaM ca lAghavaM ca guNAshcAhArashca vihArashcAhArapariNAmashcopAyashcApAyashca vyAdhishca vyAdhipUrvarUpaM ca vedanAshcopadravAshca cchAyA ca praticchAyA ca svapnadarshanaM ca dUtAdhikArashca pathi cautpAtikaM cAturakule bhAvAvasthAntarANi ca bheShajasaMvRuttishca bheShajavikArayuktishceti parIkShyANi pratyakShAnumAnopadeshairAyuShaH pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAnena bhiShajA||3||
9.commentary: indriyasthAnapratipAdyaM kRutsnaM viShayamAha- ihetyAdi| iha indriyasthAne| khalushabdo vAkyAla~gkAre| iha ca yadyapIndriyANyeva viShayavarNAdigrAhakatayA agre vaktuM yujyante, tathA~api teShAmatIndriyatvena tadAshrayariShTAnAmavyaktatvaM ; tena, pravyaktAni varNAdInyeva pravyaktariShTAdhikaraNAnyagre~abhidhIyante| varNAdiShvapi ca yathA vyaktatvaM tathA pUrvanipAtaH| meghAdishabdastu yadyapi varNAdapi vyaktastathA~api shabdavisheSha eveha tAlvAdisampAdyaH svarashabdAbhidheyo riShTAdhikaraNatvenAbhimataH, sa ca varNApekShayA~avyakta eva| ihetyAdAvasamAsena pratyekamapi varNAdInAM riShTAdhikaraNatvaM darshayati; samAse hi samudAyasyaiva riShTAdhikaraNakatayA parIkShitavyatvaM sha~gkyeta| varNashabdena ca varNasahacaritAshcakShurgrAhyA raukShyAdayo~api gRuhyante; ata eva varNaprastAva eva vakShyati- yat- “varNagrahaNena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH” iti| svarAdigrahaNena ca svarAdyabhAvo~api gRuhyate, tenA~gguliparvashabdAbhAva-gandhAbhAvAdayo~api riShTAnyavarudhyante| sparshagrahaNena ca sparshopalabhyakAThinyAdyavarodhaH| sattvaM manaH; sattvavikRuterudAharaNaM yathA- “autsukyaM bhajate sattvaM ceto bhIrAvishatyapi” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bhaktiH icchA| shIlaM sahajaM vRuttam| AcAraH shAstrashikShAkRuto vyavahAraH| bhaktyAdayo yadyapi sattvavikAratvena sattvagrahaNenaiva labhyante; yaduktaM- “bhaktiH shIlaM shaucaM dveShaH smRutirmohastyAgo~amAtsaryaM bhayaM krodhastandrotsAhastaikShNyaM mArdavaM gAmbhIryamanavasthitatvamityevamAdayaH sattvavikArAH” (shA.a.3) iti; tathA~api bhaktyAdInAmapi pRuthagariShTAdhikaraNatveneha pRuthakkaraNam| nidrAdaurbalyAttandreti tandrAshabdena nidrocyate; atra ca riShTamuktaM yathA- “nidrA nityA bhavati vA na vA” (iM.a.11) iti| Arambha iti ariShTavyAdhyutpAdArambhaH ; yaduktaM- “shvayathuryasya kukShistho hastapAdaM pradhAvati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| gaurave riShTaM yathA- “niShThyUtaM ca purIShaM ca retashcAmbhasi majjati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| lAghave riShTaM- gurUNAma~ggAnAM lAghavaM j~jeyam| guNariShTaM yathA- “guNAH sharIradeshAnAM shItoShNamRududAruNAH| viparyAsena lakShyante sthAneShvanyeShu tadvidhAH” (iM.a.12) iti| AhArariShTaM yathA- “AhAramupayu~jjAno bhiShajA sUpakalpitam” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| AhArapariNAmariShTaM yathA- “durbalo bahu bhu~gkte yo prAgabhuktvA~annamAturaH| alpamUtrapurIShashca” (iM.a.7) iti| upAya upagamanaM vyAdhimelaka ityarthaH; yaduktaM- “sahasA jvarasantApastRuShNA mUrcchA balakShayaH| vishleShaNaM ca sandhInAM” (iM.a.8) iti| vyAdhyapagamanamapAyaH; yaduktaM- “yaM naraM sahasA rogo durbalaM parimu~jcati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| vyAdhishceti vyAdhireva riShTaM yathA- “vAtAShThIlA susaMvRuttA dAruNA hRudi tiShThati” (iM.a.10) iti| chAyA bhautikI pa~jcarUpA, praticchAyA tu dehacchAyA; praticchAyayA ca netrakumArikA~api praticchAyArUpA gRuhItavyA| ayaM ca chAyAdibhedaH pannarUpIyendriye darshayitavyaH | Aturakule bhAvAvasthAriShTaM yathA- “agnipUrNAni pAtrANi bhinnAni vishikhAni ca| bhiSha~gmumUrShatAM veshma pravishanneva pashyati” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bheShajasaMvRuttau riShTaM yathA- “yamuddishyAturaM vaidyaH saMvartayitumauShadham| yatamAno na shaknoti durlabhaM tasya jIvitam” (iM.a.12) iti| bheShajasya vikAreNa samaM yuktirbheShajavikArayuktiH; tatra riShTaM yathA- “vij~jAtaM bahushaH siddhaM vidhivaccAvacAritam| na sidhyatyauShadhaM yasya tasya nAsti cikitsitam” (iM.a.12) iti| sheShaM tu riShTodAharaNaM vyaktam| iti samAptau| pratyakShapUrvakatvAt sarvapramANAnAmihAdau pratyakShaM kRutam| yadyapi varNAdaya AyurlakShaNapratipAditA dIrghAyuHpramANajij~jAsAyAmapi parIkShyante, tathA~apIha riShTaprakaraNe AyuHpramANAvasheShaj~jAnArthameva parIkShaNIyAH, ata uktaM- pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAneneti||3||

9.sanskrit: tatra tu khalveShAM parIkShyANAM kAnicit puruShamanAshritAni, kAnicicca puruShasaMshrayANi| tatra yAni puruShamanAshritAni tAnyupadeshato yuktitashca parIkSheta, puruShasaMshrayANi punaH prakRutito vikRutitashca||4||
9.commentary: puruShamanAshritAni dUtAdyAshrayANi riShTAni| yuktitashcetyanumAnata ityarthaH, atra yukterapi riShTatvAvadhAraNe kShamatvAt| pratyakShaM hi dUtAdInAM svarUpamAtraM gRuhNAti, riShTaM tu dUtAdInAmAgamAdeva j~jAyate| puruShAshrayivarNAdigatariShTagrahaNe tu pratyakShamapi tattadariShTavisheShagrahaNe tattadvisheSheNa vyApriyata iti matvA~atra tatpratiShiddham| anumAnaM tu riShTatvena pratipAditamanimittatvAdidharmavicAre vyApriyate, evaM sarvatra| prakRutitashceti puruShAshrayavikRutij~jAnahetutayA prakRutI riShTaj~jAne vyApriyate, yataH prakRutij~jAnAdhInaM vikRutij~jAnaM bhavati; prakRutivikRutiparIkShA tvatrAdhikRutaiH prasiddhaiH pratyakShAdibhireva j~jeyA||4||

9.sanskrit: tatra prakRutirjAtiprasaktA ca, kulaprasaktA ca, deshAnupAtinI ca, kAlAnupAtinI ca vayo~anupAtinI ca, pratyAtmaniyatA ceti| jAtikuladeshakAlavayaHpratyAtmaniyatA hi teShAM teShAM puruShANAM te te bhAvavisheShA bhavanti||5||
9.commentary: prakRutiM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| jAtiprasaktA yathA- brAhmaNajAtau shaucaM, kulaprasaktA yathA- ki~jcideva kulaM shucyAcAravadbhavati, deshAnupAtinI yathA- antarvedivAsinaH shucayo bhavanti, kAlAnupAtinI yathA- kRutayuge shaucaM, vayo~anupAtinI yathA- bAlye~ashaucaM, pratyAtmaniyatA yathA- kashcideva puruShaH prakRutyA shucirbhavati; ityAdyudAharaNIyam| kutaH punarjAtyAdiniyatA prakRutirbhavatItyatra hetumAha- jAtikuletyAdi| te te bhAvavisheShA iti shucitvAshaucAdayaH ||5||

9.sanskrit: vikRutiH punarlakShaNanimittA ca, lakShyanimittA ca, nimittAnurUpA ca||6||
9.commentary: riShTAdhikArAdhikRutAM vikRutiM vivecayituM sarvAneva vikRutibhedAnAha- vikRutirityAdi||6||

9.sanskrit: tatra lakShaNanimittA nAma sA yasyAH sharIre lakShaNAnyeva hetubhUtAni bhavanti daivAt; lakShaNAni hi kAniciccharIropanibaddhAni bhavanti, yAni hi tasmiMstasmin kAle tatrAdhiShThAnamAsAdya tAM tAM vikRutimutpAdayanti|7|
9.commentary: hetubhUtAnIti hetusadRushAni| tena daivameva nakharekhApadmAdisAmudrikoktalakShaNayukte sharIre rAjyadhanagamanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutiprAptau hetuH, lakShaNAni tu daivanimittAni bodhakamAtrANi, ata eva daivAdityuktaM; daivaM ca prAktanaM karmocyate| vikRutimutpAdayantItyatrApi daivAditi yojanIyaM; tena, daivabalAdeva lakShaNAnAM rAjyadhanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutikartRutvam| tasmiMstasmin kAle ityanena lakShaNasUcitAdRuShTaparipAkakAle niyatatvaM vikRuterdarshayati| lakShaNAsUcitAshca rAjyAdaya iha puruShasya kadAcidbhavanto~asvAbhAvikA eveti kRutvA vikRutishabdenocyante||7(1)||

9.sanskrit: lakShyanimittA tu sA yasyA upalabhyate nimittaM yathoktaM nidAneShu|7|
9.commentary: yathoktaM nidAneShviti yathA- rUkShAdisevayA vAtAdiprakoparUpA vikRutirnidAnoktetyarthaH||7(2)||

9.sanskrit: nimittAnurUpA tu nimittArthAnukAriNI yA, tAmanimittAM nimittamAyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyecchanti bhiShajo bhUyashcAyuShaH kShayanimittAM preteli~ggAnurUpAM, yAmAyuSho~antargatasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti dhIrAH| yAM cAdhikRutya puruShasaMshrayANi mumUrShatAM lakShaNAnyupadekShyAmaH| ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||7||
9.commentary: nimittAnurUpeti nimittasadRushI| tadeva sphoTayati- nimittArthAnukAriNIti|- nimittasya yo~arthaH kAryajananarUpaH kAryabodhanarUpo vA tamanukarotIti nimittArthAnukAriNI| riShTAkhyA hi vikRutirmaraNe tasyaivAvabodhane vA nimittaM bhavati| aparamapi nimittAnurUpAyA vikRutervisheShamAha- tAmityAdi| animittAmiti tadAtve~anupalabhyamAnanimittAM, na tu punaH sarvathaivAhetukIM, yata ‘AyuShaH kShayanimittAm’ ityanantaramasya visheShaNaM kathayiShyati; riShTasya hi na raukShyAdinA sharIrasambandhAdi nimittamupalabhyate| yadvA, AyuHkShayarUpaM yannimittaM tadvidyamAnamapi nAnyairupalabhyate , kintu tadeva hi riShTAdunnIyate; tena, avyaktanimittatvamihAnimittatvaM j~jeyam| atra gatAyuShTvameva sakalapuruShasaMshritariShTavyApakaM kAraNaM sAdhu| yattu vakShyati- “kriyApathamatikrAntAH kevalaM dehamAshritAH| cihnaM kurvanti yaddoShAstadariShTaM pracakShate” (iM.a.11) iti, taddUtAdigatariShTAvyApakatayA puruShAshrayiriShTamAtrAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam| AyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyeti AyuHsheShapramANaj~jAnasyetyarthaH| bhUya iti atyartham| tenAtyarthamAyuHkShayanimittAM pratyAsannAyuHkShayajanyAmiti yAvat| yAmiti kShINAyuHkAryAm| pretali~ggAnurUpAmiti pretasadRushIM; “malA danteShu jAyante pretAkRutirudIryate” (iM.a.12) ityAdigranthavakShyamANAm| imAM hi vikRutimAyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthaM vadanti| yA tvanyA pretali~ggAnanurUpA varNAshrayA sA pratyAsannamaraNabodhikA; tena sA nAtyarthannAtyarthakShINAyuHkAryetyarthaH| evaM ‘bhUyashca’ ityAdinA ‘dhIrAH’ ityantena nimittAnurUpavikRutivisheShasya kAryavisheShaM maraNalakShaNamabhidhAya punaH sAmAnyenAnimittAyA dharmAntaramAha- yAmadhikRutyetyAdi| puruShasaMshrayANIti visheShaNena puruShAnAshritadUtAdiriShTe nAvashyamanimittatA~astIti darshayati| yato dUtAdhikArAdau yAni riShTAni tAni dRushyamAnanimittAnyapyAgamAdeva riShTatvenAvadhAryante| yathA- “muktakeshe~athavA nagne rudatyaprayate~athavA| bhiShagabhyAgataM dRuShTvA dUtaM maraNamAdishet” (iM.a.12) iti| atra ca bhiShajo muktakeshavacanAddRushyata eva kAraNaM, tathA dUtAgamane cAturasya preraNAdi kAraNamastyeva, tenAnimittatvamAturAshrayiriShTa eva| anye tu, evambhUtavaidyadUtasamAgamaH parihartavyatvena j~jAtaH san yadA daivAdbhavati, tadA daivanimittaH san riShTaM bhavati; tena, sarvariShTavyApikaiveyamanimittatA; bhUyashcetyAdigranthena tu pretali~ggAnurUpAM vikRutiM bhUya AyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti, tathA puruShasaMshrayANi bhUya upadekShyante, puruShAnAshrayANi tu svalpagranthenopadekShyante iti vyAkhyAnayanti| ityuddesha indriyasthAnArthoddesha ityarthaH||7||

9.sanskrit: tatrAdita eva varNAdhikAraH| tadyathA- kRuShNaH, shyAmaH , shyAmAvadAtaH, avadAtashceti prakRutivarNAH sharIrasya bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH||8||
9.commentary: prakRutij~jAnAntarIyakatvAdvikRutij~jAnasya prakRutivarNAneva tAvadAha- kRuShNa ityAdi| avadAto gauraH| iha ca prAyeNa ye varNAH prakRutyA bhavanti te prakRutivarNA ucyante, ye tu prAyeNa vikRutyA bhavanti te vikRutivarNA ucyante, iti j~jeyam| tena prakRutivarNA api kadAcidvikRutivarNA bhavanti, tathA vikRutivarNA api janmaprabhRutijAyamAnatayA kadAcit prakRutivarNA bhavantIti j~jeyam| anuktaprakRutivarNAtideshArthamAha- yAMshcetyAdi| upetya IkShamANa iti upekShamANaH| anUkata iti sAdRushyataH; anena ca shyAmetyAdivarNashabdena nirdishyamAnAn vidyAditi yojanA| tajj~jairiti varNabhedanAmaj~jaiH||8||

9.sanskrit: nIlashyAvatAmraharitashuklAshca varNAH sharIrasya vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutivarNA bhavantyuktAH sharIrasya| tatra prakRutivarNamardhasharIre vikRutivarNamardhasharIre, dvAvapi varNau maryAdAvibhaktau dRuShTvA; yadyevaM savyadakShiNavibhAgena, yadyevaM pUrvapashcimavibhAgena, yadyuttarAdharavibhAgena, yadyantarbahirvibhAgena, AturasyAriShTamiti vidyAt; evameva varNabhedo mukhe~apyanyatra vartamAno maraNAya bhavati||9||
9.commentary: nIletyAdinA (vikRutijAyamAnatayA ) vikRutivarNAnAha| iha, ‘aparAn’ iti vacanena vikRutivarNasa~gkarajA varNA j~jeyAH| vikRutivarNAntaramAha- prAgityAdi| prAgvikRutAniti pUrvavarNAdanyathAbhUtAnityarthaH| tenApi, yena shyAmena satA rasAyanopayogAdgauravarNatvaM prAptaM, sa ca tyaktarasAyanaH kAlavashAt punaH shyAmavarNo bhavati tasyApi pUrvagauravarNAdvikRutiH shyAmavarNo bhavan riShTaM syAdityAha- abhUtvotpannAniti; tena nAyaM doShaH; atra hi pUrvabhUta eva varNaH punarbhavati, tena na riShTam| maryAdAvibhaktAviti samasImAvyavasthApitau| pUrvapashcimavibhAgeneti abhimukhapRuShThabhAgenetyarthaH| antarbahirvibhAgeneti atrAntargato varNo mukhanAsAkarNashrotrAntargatatayA unneyaH| anyatreti avAntare hastapAdAdau||9||

9.sanskrit: varNabhedena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH||10||
9.commentary: varNabhedeneti yathA varNavibhAgena riShTaM, tathA glAnyAdivibhAgenApItyarthaH| harSha ihopacayo j~jeyaH, mAnasaharShasyeha cAkShuShAdhikAre~asa~ggatatvAt||10||

9.sanskrit: tathA pipluvya~ggatilakAlakapiDakAnAmanyatamasyAnane janmAturasyaivamevAprashastaM vidyAt||11||
9.commentary: tathetyAdau pipluprabhRutInAmapi varNavat savyadakShiNAdivibhAgena janma riShTaM bhavatItyevamevashabdenocyate||11||

9.sanskrit: nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShahastapAdauShThAdiShvapi ca vaikArikoktAnAM varNAnAmanyatamasya prAdurbhAvo hInabalavarNendriyeShu lakShaNamAyuShaH kShayasya bhavati||12||
9.commentary: nakhetyAdau balahAnyAdyabhAve sati na riShTam||12||

9.sanskrit: yaccAnyadapi ki~jcidvarNavaikRutamabhUtapUrvaM sahasotpadyetAnimittameva hIyamAnasyAturasya shashvat, tadariShTamiti vidyAt| iti varNAdhikAraH||13||
9.commentary: yaccetyAdinA~anuktavarNariShTaM sa~ggRuhNAti| abhUtapUrvamiti pUrvavyAkRutarasAyanavihitavarNaprAdurbhAvavyudAsArtham| sahasotpadyata ityanena riShTAnAM shIghrasvabhAvaM darshayati| animittamiti pUrvoktArthameva| hIyamAnasya shashvaditi svabhAvakathanaM, riShTotpattyA hIyamAnatA shashvadavashyaM bhavati||13||

9.sanskrit: svarAdhikArastu- haMsakrau~jcanemidundubhikalavi~gkakAkakapotajarjarAnukArAH prakRutisvarA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH| eDakakalagrastAvyaktagadgadakShAmadInAnukIrNAstvAturANAM svarA vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutisvarA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||14||
9.commentary: kramAgataM svaramAha- svaretyAdi| jarjaraH vAdyabhANDavisheShaH| yAMshcetyAdi pUrvavad vyAkhyeyam| eDako meShaH, kiMvA araNyacchAgalaH; kalaH sUkShmaH; grastaH sarvathA~anuccAraH; kShAmaH rUkShaH; dInaH duHkhoccAryamANasvaraH; anukIrNa uparyuparyuccAryamANaH||14||

9.sanskrit: tatra prakRutivaikArikANAM svarANAmAshvabhinirvRuttiH svarAnekatvamekasya cAnekatvamaprashastam| iti svarAdhikAraH||15|| iti varNasvarAdhikArau yathAvaduktau mumUrShatAM lakShaNaj~jAnArthamiti||16||
9.commentary: prakRutervaikArikA anyathAbhUtA iti prakRutivaikArikAH| svarAnekatvamiti kadAcideDakasvaratvaM, kadAcit kalasvaratvamityAdi| ekasya cAnekatvamiti ekasyaiva svarasya cAnekatvamiva pratibhAti| animittamiti sarvatra sambadhyate||15-16||

9.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- yasya vaikAriko varNaH sharIra upapadyate| ardhe vA yadi vA kRutsne nimittaM na ca nAsti saH||17|| nIlaM vA yadi vA shyAvaM tAmraM vA yadi vA~aruNam| mukhArdhamanyathA varNo mukhArdhe~ariShTamucyate||18|| sneho mukhArdhe suvyakto raukShyamardhamukhe bhRusham| glAnirardhe tathA harSho mukhArdhe pretalakShaNam||19|| tilakAH piplavo vya~ggA rAjayashca pRuthagvidhAH| AturasyAshu jAyante mukhe prANAn mumukShataH||20|| puShpANi nakhadanteShu pa~gko vA dantasaMshritaH| cUrNako vA~api danteShu lakShaNaM maraNasya tat||21|| oShThayoH pAdayoH pANyorakShNormUtrapurIShayoH| nakheShvapi ca vaivarNyametat kShINabale~antakRut||22|| yasya nIlAvubhAvoShThau pakvajAmbavasannibhau| mumUrShuriti taM vidyAnnaro dhIro gatAyuSham||23|| eko vA yadi vA~aneko yasya vaikArikaH svaraH| sahasotpadyate jantorhIyamAnasya nAsti saH||24|| yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdvaikRutaM svaravarNayoH| balamAMsavihInasya tat sarvaM maraNodayam ||25|| tatra shlokaH- iti varNasvarAvuktau lakShaNArthaM mumUrShatAm| yastau samyagvijAnAti nAyurj~jAne sa muhyati||26||
9.commentary: ayamevArtho gadyoktaH spaShTArthaM sukhagrahaNArthaM ca shlokenocyate- yasyetyAdinA| tilakA ityAdau mukhe iti mukhArdhe| oShThAviti dvivacanamuktvA~api yat ‘ubhau’ iti karoti, tena sakalauShThavyAptiM darshayati| mumUrShurityukatvA~api yat ‘gatAyuShaM’ iti karoti, tena riShTayukto mumUrShargatAyurIti darshayati; ajAtariShTastu pratikriyAbhAvAnmumUrShuragatAyurapi bhavati| maraNodayamiti maraNakAraNamiti j~jAnArtham||17-26||

9.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute indriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
9.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmindriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

10.sanskrit: athAto varNasvarIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
10.commentary: shArIre cikitsAdhikaraNaM sharIraM pratipAdya cikitsA vaktavyA, sA ca sAdhya eva roge vaktavyA nAsAdhyaroge, yaduktaM- “arthavidyAyashohAnimupakroshamasa~ggraham| prApnuyAnniyataM vaidyo yo~asAdhyaM samupAcaret” (sU.a.10) iti; na ca riShTapratipattimantarA~asAdhyatvapratipattiriti riShTapratipAdakamindriyasthAnameva cikitsAsthAnAt prAgucyate | indrashabdena prANa ucyate, tasyAntagatasya li~ggaM riShTAkhyamindriyaM; yaduktaM vyAkaraNe- “indriyamindrali~ggaM” (pA.a.5.2.13) ityAdi; tasyendriyasya sthAnamindriyasthAnam| tatrApi cendriyasthAne vaktavye vyaktatamariShTAbhidhAyakatayA varNasvarIyamindriyamucyate, atra hi yAni riShTAni vaktavyAni tAnItarariShTebhyashcakShurAdigrAhyatayA vyaktatamAni| varNasvarAvadhikRutya kRuto varNasvarIyaH, indriyasya riShTarUpasya pratipAdako~adhyAya indriyaH, taM vyAkhyAsyAmaH| evamanyatrApi puShpitakamityAdyapIndriyavisheShaNaM vyAkhyeyam||1-2||

10.sanskrit: iha khalu varNashca svarashca gandhashca rasashca sparshashca cakShushca shrotraM ca ghrANaM ca rasanaM ca sparshanaM ca sattvaM ca bhaktishca shaucaM ca shIlaM cAcArashca smRutishcAkRutishca prakRutishca vikRutishca balaM ca glAnishca medhA ca harShashca raukShyaM ca snehashca tandrA cArambhashca gauravaM ca lAghavaM ca guNAshcAhArashca vihArashcAhArapariNAmashcopAyashcApAyashca vyAdhishca vyAdhipUrvarUpaM ca vedanAshcopadravAshca cchAyA ca praticchAyA ca svapnadarshanaM ca dUtAdhikArashca pathi cautpAtikaM cAturakule bhAvAvasthAntarANi ca bheShajasaMvRuttishca bheShajavikArayuktishceti parIkShyANi pratyakShAnumAnopadeshairAyuShaH pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAnena bhiShajA||3||
10.commentary: indriyasthAnapratipAdyaM kRutsnaM viShayamAha- ihetyAdi| iha indriyasthAne| khalushabdo vAkyAla~gkAre| iha ca yadyapIndriyANyeva viShayavarNAdigrAhakatayA agre vaktuM yujyante, tathA~api teShAmatIndriyatvena tadAshrayariShTAnAmavyaktatvaM ; tena, pravyaktAni varNAdInyeva pravyaktariShTAdhikaraNAnyagre~abhidhIyante| varNAdiShvapi ca yathA vyaktatvaM tathA pUrvanipAtaH| meghAdishabdastu yadyapi varNAdapi vyaktastathA~api shabdavisheSha eveha tAlvAdisampAdyaH svarashabdAbhidheyo riShTAdhikaraNatvenAbhimataH, sa ca varNApekShayA~avyakta eva| ihetyAdAvasamAsena pratyekamapi varNAdInAM riShTAdhikaraNatvaM darshayati; samAse hi samudAyasyaiva riShTAdhikaraNakatayA parIkShitavyatvaM sha~gkyeta| varNashabdena ca varNasahacaritAshcakShurgrAhyA raukShyAdayo~api gRuhyante; ata eva varNaprastAva eva vakShyati- yat- “varNagrahaNena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH” iti| svarAdigrahaNena ca svarAdyabhAvo~api gRuhyate, tenA~gguliparvashabdAbhAva-gandhAbhAvAdayo~api riShTAnyavarudhyante| sparshagrahaNena ca sparshopalabhyakAThinyAdyavarodhaH| sattvaM manaH; sattvavikRuterudAharaNaM yathA- “autsukyaM bhajate sattvaM ceto bhIrAvishatyapi” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bhaktiH icchA| shIlaM sahajaM vRuttam| AcAraH shAstrashikShAkRuto vyavahAraH| bhaktyAdayo yadyapi sattvavikAratvena sattvagrahaNenaiva labhyante; yaduktaM- “bhaktiH shIlaM shaucaM dveShaH smRutirmohastyAgo~amAtsaryaM bhayaM krodhastandrotsAhastaikShNyaM mArdavaM gAmbhIryamanavasthitatvamityevamAdayaH sattvavikArAH” (shA.a.3) iti; tathA~api bhaktyAdInAmapi pRuthagariShTAdhikaraNatveneha pRuthakkaraNam| nidrAdaurbalyAttandreti tandrAshabdena nidrocyate; atra ca riShTamuktaM yathA- “nidrA nityA bhavati vA na vA” (iM.a.11) iti| Arambha iti ariShTavyAdhyutpAdArambhaH ; yaduktaM- “shvayathuryasya kukShistho hastapAdaM pradhAvati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| gaurave riShTaM yathA- “niShThyUtaM ca purIShaM ca retashcAmbhasi majjati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| lAghave riShTaM- gurUNAma~ggAnAM lAghavaM j~jeyam| guNariShTaM yathA- “guNAH sharIradeshAnAM shItoShNamRududAruNAH| viparyAsena lakShyante sthAneShvanyeShu tadvidhAH” (iM.a.12) iti| AhArariShTaM yathA- “AhAramupayu~jjAno bhiShajA sUpakalpitam” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| AhArapariNAmariShTaM yathA- “durbalo bahu bhu~gkte yo prAgabhuktvA~annamAturaH| alpamUtrapurIShashca” (iM.a.7) iti| upAya upagamanaM vyAdhimelaka ityarthaH; yaduktaM- “sahasA jvarasantApastRuShNA mUrcchA balakShayaH| vishleShaNaM ca sandhInAM” (iM.a.8) iti| vyAdhyapagamanamapAyaH; yaduktaM- “yaM naraM sahasA rogo durbalaM parimu~jcati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| vyAdhishceti vyAdhireva riShTaM yathA- “vAtAShThIlA susaMvRuttA dAruNA hRudi tiShThati” (iM.a.10) iti| chAyA bhautikI pa~jcarUpA, praticchAyA tu dehacchAyA; praticchAyayA ca netrakumArikA~api praticchAyArUpA gRuhItavyA| ayaM ca chAyAdibhedaH pannarUpIyendriye darshayitavyaH | Aturakule bhAvAvasthAriShTaM yathA- “agnipUrNAni pAtrANi bhinnAni vishikhAni ca| bhiSha~gmumUrShatAM veshma pravishanneva pashyati” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bheShajasaMvRuttau riShTaM yathA- “yamuddishyAturaM vaidyaH saMvartayitumauShadham| yatamAno na shaknoti durlabhaM tasya jIvitam” (iM.a.12) iti| bheShajasya vikAreNa samaM yuktirbheShajavikArayuktiH; tatra riShTaM yathA- “vij~jAtaM bahushaH siddhaM vidhivaccAvacAritam| na sidhyatyauShadhaM yasya tasya nAsti cikitsitam” (iM.a.12) iti| sheShaM tu riShTodAharaNaM vyaktam| iti samAptau| pratyakShapUrvakatvAt sarvapramANAnAmihAdau pratyakShaM kRutam| yadyapi varNAdaya AyurlakShaNapratipAditA dIrghAyuHpramANajij~jAsAyAmapi parIkShyante, tathA~apIha riShTaprakaraNe AyuHpramANAvasheShaj~jAnArthameva parIkShaNIyAH, ata uktaM- pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAneneti||3||

10.sanskrit: tatra tu khalveShAM parIkShyANAM kAnicit puruShamanAshritAni, kAnicicca puruShasaMshrayANi| tatra yAni puruShamanAshritAni tAnyupadeshato yuktitashca parIkSheta, puruShasaMshrayANi punaH prakRutito vikRutitashca||4||
10.commentary: puruShamanAshritAni dUtAdyAshrayANi riShTAni| yuktitashcetyanumAnata ityarthaH, atra yukterapi riShTatvAvadhAraNe kShamatvAt| pratyakShaM hi dUtAdInAM svarUpamAtraM gRuhNAti, riShTaM tu dUtAdInAmAgamAdeva j~jAyate| puruShAshrayivarNAdigatariShTagrahaNe tu pratyakShamapi tattadariShTavisheShagrahaNe tattadvisheSheNa vyApriyata iti matvA~atra tatpratiShiddham| anumAnaM tu riShTatvena pratipAditamanimittatvAdidharmavicAre vyApriyate, evaM sarvatra| prakRutitashceti puruShAshrayavikRutij~jAnahetutayA prakRutI riShTaj~jAne vyApriyate, yataH prakRutij~jAnAdhInaM vikRutij~jAnaM bhavati; prakRutivikRutiparIkShA tvatrAdhikRutaiH prasiddhaiH pratyakShAdibhireva j~jeyA||4||

10.sanskrit: tatra prakRutirjAtiprasaktA ca, kulaprasaktA ca, deshAnupAtinI ca, kAlAnupAtinI ca vayo~anupAtinI ca, pratyAtmaniyatA ceti| jAtikuladeshakAlavayaHpratyAtmaniyatA hi teShAM teShAM puruShANAM te te bhAvavisheShA bhavanti||5||
10.commentary: prakRutiM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| jAtiprasaktA yathA- brAhmaNajAtau shaucaM, kulaprasaktA yathA- ki~jcideva kulaM shucyAcAravadbhavati, deshAnupAtinI yathA- antarvedivAsinaH shucayo bhavanti, kAlAnupAtinI yathA- kRutayuge shaucaM, vayo~anupAtinI yathA- bAlye~ashaucaM, pratyAtmaniyatA yathA- kashcideva puruShaH prakRutyA shucirbhavati; ityAdyudAharaNIyam| kutaH punarjAtyAdiniyatA prakRutirbhavatItyatra hetumAha- jAtikuletyAdi| te te bhAvavisheShA iti shucitvAshaucAdayaH ||5||

10.sanskrit: vikRutiH punarlakShaNanimittA ca, lakShyanimittA ca, nimittAnurUpA ca||6||
10.commentary: riShTAdhikArAdhikRutAM vikRutiM vivecayituM sarvAneva vikRutibhedAnAha- vikRutirityAdi||6||

10.sanskrit: tatra lakShaNanimittA nAma sA yasyAH sharIre lakShaNAnyeva hetubhUtAni bhavanti daivAt; lakShaNAni hi kAniciccharIropanibaddhAni bhavanti, yAni hi tasmiMstasmin kAle tatrAdhiShThAnamAsAdya tAM tAM vikRutimutpAdayanti|7|
10.commentary: hetubhUtAnIti hetusadRushAni| tena daivameva nakharekhApadmAdisAmudrikoktalakShaNayukte sharIre rAjyadhanagamanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutiprAptau hetuH, lakShaNAni tu daivanimittAni bodhakamAtrANi, ata eva daivAdityuktaM; daivaM ca prAktanaM karmocyate| vikRutimutpAdayantItyatrApi daivAditi yojanIyaM; tena, daivabalAdeva lakShaNAnAM rAjyadhanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutikartRutvam| tasmiMstasmin kAle ityanena lakShaNasUcitAdRuShTaparipAkakAle niyatatvaM vikRuterdarshayati| lakShaNAsUcitAshca rAjyAdaya iha puruShasya kadAcidbhavanto~asvAbhAvikA eveti kRutvA vikRutishabdenocyante||7(1)||

10.sanskrit: lakShyanimittA tu sA yasyA upalabhyate nimittaM yathoktaM nidAneShu|7|
10.commentary: yathoktaM nidAneShviti yathA- rUkShAdisevayA vAtAdiprakoparUpA vikRutirnidAnoktetyarthaH||7(2)||

10.sanskrit: nimittAnurUpA tu nimittArthAnukAriNI yA, tAmanimittAM nimittamAyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyecchanti bhiShajo bhUyashcAyuShaH kShayanimittAM preteli~ggAnurUpAM, yAmAyuSho~antargatasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti dhIrAH| yAM cAdhikRutya puruShasaMshrayANi mumUrShatAM lakShaNAnyupadekShyAmaH| ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||7||
10.commentary: nimittAnurUpeti nimittasadRushI| tadeva sphoTayati- nimittArthAnukAriNIti|- nimittasya yo~arthaH kAryajananarUpaH kAryabodhanarUpo vA tamanukarotIti nimittArthAnukAriNI| riShTAkhyA hi vikRutirmaraNe tasyaivAvabodhane vA nimittaM bhavati| aparamapi nimittAnurUpAyA vikRutervisheShamAha- tAmityAdi| animittAmiti tadAtve~anupalabhyamAnanimittAM, na tu punaH sarvathaivAhetukIM, yata ‘AyuShaH kShayanimittAm’ ityanantaramasya visheShaNaM kathayiShyati; riShTasya hi na raukShyAdinA sharIrasambandhAdi nimittamupalabhyate| yadvA, AyuHkShayarUpaM yannimittaM tadvidyamAnamapi nAnyairupalabhyate , kintu tadeva hi riShTAdunnIyate; tena, avyaktanimittatvamihAnimittatvaM j~jeyam| atra gatAyuShTvameva sakalapuruShasaMshritariShTavyApakaM kAraNaM sAdhu| yattu vakShyati- “kriyApathamatikrAntAH kevalaM dehamAshritAH| cihnaM kurvanti yaddoShAstadariShTaM pracakShate” (iM.a.11) iti, taddUtAdigatariShTAvyApakatayA puruShAshrayiriShTamAtrAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam| AyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyeti AyuHsheShapramANaj~jAnasyetyarthaH| bhUya iti atyartham| tenAtyarthamAyuHkShayanimittAM pratyAsannAyuHkShayajanyAmiti yAvat| yAmiti kShINAyuHkAryAm| pretali~ggAnurUpAmiti pretasadRushIM; “malA danteShu jAyante pretAkRutirudIryate” (iM.a.12) ityAdigranthavakShyamANAm| imAM hi vikRutimAyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthaM vadanti| yA tvanyA pretali~ggAnanurUpA varNAshrayA sA pratyAsannamaraNabodhikA; tena sA nAtyarthannAtyarthakShINAyuHkAryetyarthaH| evaM ‘bhUyashca’ ityAdinA ‘dhIrAH’ ityantena nimittAnurUpavikRutivisheShasya kAryavisheShaM maraNalakShaNamabhidhAya punaH sAmAnyenAnimittAyA dharmAntaramAha- yAmadhikRutyetyAdi| puruShasaMshrayANIti visheShaNena puruShAnAshritadUtAdiriShTe nAvashyamanimittatA~astIti darshayati| yato dUtAdhikArAdau yAni riShTAni tAni dRushyamAnanimittAnyapyAgamAdeva riShTatvenAvadhAryante| yathA- “muktakeshe~athavA nagne rudatyaprayate~athavA| bhiShagabhyAgataM dRuShTvA dUtaM maraNamAdishet” (iM.a.12) iti| atra ca bhiShajo muktakeshavacanAddRushyata eva kAraNaM, tathA dUtAgamane cAturasya preraNAdi kAraNamastyeva, tenAnimittatvamAturAshrayiriShTa eva| anye tu, evambhUtavaidyadUtasamAgamaH parihartavyatvena j~jAtaH san yadA daivAdbhavati, tadA daivanimittaH san riShTaM bhavati; tena, sarvariShTavyApikaiveyamanimittatA; bhUyashcetyAdigranthena tu pretali~ggAnurUpAM vikRutiM bhUya AyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti, tathA puruShasaMshrayANi bhUya upadekShyante, puruShAnAshrayANi tu svalpagranthenopadekShyante iti vyAkhyAnayanti| ityuddesha indriyasthAnArthoddesha ityarthaH||7||

10.sanskrit: tatrAdita eva varNAdhikAraH| tadyathA- kRuShNaH, shyAmaH , shyAmAvadAtaH, avadAtashceti prakRutivarNAH sharIrasya bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH||8||
10.commentary: prakRutij~jAnAntarIyakatvAdvikRutij~jAnasya prakRutivarNAneva tAvadAha- kRuShNa ityAdi| avadAto gauraH| iha ca prAyeNa ye varNAH prakRutyA bhavanti te prakRutivarNA ucyante, ye tu prAyeNa vikRutyA bhavanti te vikRutivarNA ucyante, iti j~jeyam| tena prakRutivarNA api kadAcidvikRutivarNA bhavanti, tathA vikRutivarNA api janmaprabhRutijAyamAnatayA kadAcit prakRutivarNA bhavantIti j~jeyam| anuktaprakRutivarNAtideshArthamAha- yAMshcetyAdi| upetya IkShamANa iti upekShamANaH| anUkata iti sAdRushyataH; anena ca shyAmetyAdivarNashabdena nirdishyamAnAn vidyAditi yojanA| tajj~jairiti varNabhedanAmaj~jaiH||8||

10.sanskrit: nIlashyAvatAmraharitashuklAshca varNAH sharIrasya vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutivarNA bhavantyuktAH sharIrasya| tatra prakRutivarNamardhasharIre vikRutivarNamardhasharIre, dvAvapi varNau maryAdAvibhaktau dRuShTvA; yadyevaM savyadakShiNavibhAgena, yadyevaM pUrvapashcimavibhAgena, yadyuttarAdharavibhAgena, yadyantarbahirvibhAgena, AturasyAriShTamiti vidyAt; evameva varNabhedo mukhe~apyanyatra vartamAno maraNAya bhavati||9||
10.commentary: nIletyAdinA (vikRutijAyamAnatayA ) vikRutivarNAnAha| iha, ‘aparAn’ iti vacanena vikRutivarNasa~gkarajA varNA j~jeyAH| vikRutivarNAntaramAha- prAgityAdi| prAgvikRutAniti pUrvavarNAdanyathAbhUtAnityarthaH| tenApi, yena shyAmena satA rasAyanopayogAdgauravarNatvaM prAptaM, sa ca tyaktarasAyanaH kAlavashAt punaH shyAmavarNo bhavati tasyApi pUrvagauravarNAdvikRutiH shyAmavarNo bhavan riShTaM syAdityAha- abhUtvotpannAniti; tena nAyaM doShaH; atra hi pUrvabhUta eva varNaH punarbhavati, tena na riShTam| maryAdAvibhaktAviti samasImAvyavasthApitau| pUrvapashcimavibhAgeneti abhimukhapRuShThabhAgenetyarthaH| antarbahirvibhAgeneti atrAntargato varNo mukhanAsAkarNashrotrAntargatatayA unneyaH| anyatreti avAntare hastapAdAdau||9||

10.sanskrit: varNabhedena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH||10||
10.commentary: varNabhedeneti yathA varNavibhAgena riShTaM, tathA glAnyAdivibhAgenApItyarthaH| harSha ihopacayo j~jeyaH, mAnasaharShasyeha cAkShuShAdhikAre~asa~ggatatvAt||10||

10.sanskrit: tathA pipluvya~ggatilakAlakapiDakAnAmanyatamasyAnane janmAturasyaivamevAprashastaM vidyAt||11||
10.commentary: tathetyAdau pipluprabhRutInAmapi varNavat savyadakShiNAdivibhAgena janma riShTaM bhavatItyevamevashabdenocyate||11||

10.sanskrit: nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShahastapAdauShThAdiShvapi ca vaikArikoktAnAM varNAnAmanyatamasya prAdurbhAvo hInabalavarNendriyeShu lakShaNamAyuShaH kShayasya bhavati||12||
10.commentary: nakhetyAdau balahAnyAdyabhAve sati na riShTam||12||

10.sanskrit: yaccAnyadapi ki~jcidvarNavaikRutamabhUtapUrvaM sahasotpadyetAnimittameva hIyamAnasyAturasya shashvat, tadariShTamiti vidyAt| iti varNAdhikAraH||13||
10.commentary: yaccetyAdinA~anuktavarNariShTaM sa~ggRuhNAti| abhUtapUrvamiti pUrvavyAkRutarasAyanavihitavarNaprAdurbhAvavyudAsArtham| sahasotpadyata ityanena riShTAnAM shIghrasvabhAvaM darshayati| animittamiti pUrvoktArthameva| hIyamAnasya shashvaditi svabhAvakathanaM, riShTotpattyA hIyamAnatA shashvadavashyaM bhavati||13||

10.sanskrit: svarAdhikArastu- haMsakrau~jcanemidundubhikalavi~gkakAkakapotajarjarAnukArAH prakRutisvarA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH| eDakakalagrastAvyaktagadgadakShAmadInAnukIrNAstvAturANAM svarA vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutisvarA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||14||
10.commentary: kramAgataM svaramAha- svaretyAdi| jarjaraH vAdyabhANDavisheShaH| yAMshcetyAdi pUrvavad vyAkhyeyam| eDako meShaH, kiMvA araNyacchAgalaH; kalaH sUkShmaH; grastaH sarvathA~anuccAraH; kShAmaH rUkShaH; dInaH duHkhoccAryamANasvaraH; anukIrNa uparyuparyuccAryamANaH||14||

10.sanskrit: tatra prakRutivaikArikANAM svarANAmAshvabhinirvRuttiH svarAnekatvamekasya cAnekatvamaprashastam| iti svarAdhikAraH||15|| iti varNasvarAdhikArau yathAvaduktau mumUrShatAM lakShaNaj~jAnArthamiti||16||
10.commentary: prakRutervaikArikA anyathAbhUtA iti prakRutivaikArikAH| svarAnekatvamiti kadAcideDakasvaratvaM, kadAcit kalasvaratvamityAdi| ekasya cAnekatvamiti ekasyaiva svarasya cAnekatvamiva pratibhAti| animittamiti sarvatra sambadhyate||15-16||
