10.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- yasya vaikAriko varNaH sharIra upapadyate| ardhe vA yadi vA kRutsne nimittaM na ca nAsti saH||17|| nIlaM vA yadi vA shyAvaM tAmraM vA yadi vA~aruNam| mukhArdhamanyathA varNo mukhArdhe~ariShTamucyate||18|| sneho mukhArdhe suvyakto raukShyamardhamukhe bhRusham| glAnirardhe tathA harSho mukhArdhe pretalakShaNam||19|| tilakAH piplavo vya~ggA rAjayashca pRuthagvidhAH| AturasyAshu jAyante mukhe prANAn mumukShataH||20|| puShpANi nakhadanteShu pa~gko vA dantasaMshritaH| cUrNako vA~api danteShu lakShaNaM maraNasya tat||21|| oShThayoH pAdayoH pANyorakShNormUtrapurIShayoH| nakheShvapi ca vaivarNyametat kShINabale~antakRut||22|| yasya nIlAvubhAvoShThau pakvajAmbavasannibhau| mumUrShuriti taM vidyAnnaro dhIro gatAyuSham||23|| eko vA yadi vA~aneko yasya vaikArikaH svaraH| sahasotpadyate jantorhIyamAnasya nAsti saH||24|| yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdvaikRutaM svaravarNayoH| balamAMsavihInasya tat sarvaM maraNodayam ||25|| tatra shlokaH- iti varNasvarAvuktau lakShaNArthaM mumUrShatAm| yastau samyagvijAnAti nAyurj~jAne sa muhyati||26||
10.commentary: ayamevArtho gadyoktaH spaShTArthaM sukhagrahaNArthaM ca shlokenocyate- yasyetyAdinA| tilakA ityAdau mukhe iti mukhArdhe| oShThAviti dvivacanamuktvA~api yat ‘ubhau’ iti karoti, tena sakalauShThavyAptiM darshayati| mumUrShurityukatvA~api yat ‘gatAyuShaM’ iti karoti, tena riShTayukto mumUrShargatAyurIti darshayati; ajAtariShTastu pratikriyAbhAvAnmumUrShuragatAyurapi bhavati| maraNodayamiti maraNakAraNamiti j~jAnArtham||17-26||

10.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute indriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
10.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmindriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

11.sanskrit: athAto varNasvarIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
11.commentary: shArIre cikitsAdhikaraNaM sharIraM pratipAdya cikitsA vaktavyA, sA ca sAdhya eva roge vaktavyA nAsAdhyaroge, yaduktaM- “arthavidyAyashohAnimupakroshamasa~ggraham| prApnuyAnniyataM vaidyo yo~asAdhyaM samupAcaret” (sU.a.10) iti; na ca riShTapratipattimantarA~asAdhyatvapratipattiriti riShTapratipAdakamindriyasthAnameva cikitsAsthAnAt prAgucyate | indrashabdena prANa ucyate, tasyAntagatasya li~ggaM riShTAkhyamindriyaM; yaduktaM vyAkaraNe- “indriyamindrali~ggaM” (pA.a.5.2.13) ityAdi; tasyendriyasya sthAnamindriyasthAnam| tatrApi cendriyasthAne vaktavye vyaktatamariShTAbhidhAyakatayA varNasvarIyamindriyamucyate, atra hi yAni riShTAni vaktavyAni tAnItarariShTebhyashcakShurAdigrAhyatayA vyaktatamAni| varNasvarAvadhikRutya kRuto varNasvarIyaH, indriyasya riShTarUpasya pratipAdako~adhyAya indriyaH, taM vyAkhyAsyAmaH| evamanyatrApi puShpitakamityAdyapIndriyavisheShaNaM vyAkhyeyam||1-2||

11.sanskrit: iha khalu varNashca svarashca gandhashca rasashca sparshashca cakShushca shrotraM ca ghrANaM ca rasanaM ca sparshanaM ca sattvaM ca bhaktishca shaucaM ca shIlaM cAcArashca smRutishcAkRutishca prakRutishca vikRutishca balaM ca glAnishca medhA ca harShashca raukShyaM ca snehashca tandrA cArambhashca gauravaM ca lAghavaM ca guNAshcAhArashca vihArashcAhArapariNAmashcopAyashcApAyashca vyAdhishca vyAdhipUrvarUpaM ca vedanAshcopadravAshca cchAyA ca praticchAyA ca svapnadarshanaM ca dUtAdhikArashca pathi cautpAtikaM cAturakule bhAvAvasthAntarANi ca bheShajasaMvRuttishca bheShajavikArayuktishceti parIkShyANi pratyakShAnumAnopadeshairAyuShaH pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAnena bhiShajA||3||
11.commentary: indriyasthAnapratipAdyaM kRutsnaM viShayamAha- ihetyAdi| iha indriyasthAne| khalushabdo vAkyAla~gkAre| iha ca yadyapIndriyANyeva viShayavarNAdigrAhakatayA agre vaktuM yujyante, tathA~api teShAmatIndriyatvena tadAshrayariShTAnAmavyaktatvaM ; tena, pravyaktAni varNAdInyeva pravyaktariShTAdhikaraNAnyagre~abhidhIyante| varNAdiShvapi ca yathA vyaktatvaM tathA pUrvanipAtaH| meghAdishabdastu yadyapi varNAdapi vyaktastathA~api shabdavisheSha eveha tAlvAdisampAdyaH svarashabdAbhidheyo riShTAdhikaraNatvenAbhimataH, sa ca varNApekShayA~avyakta eva| ihetyAdAvasamAsena pratyekamapi varNAdInAM riShTAdhikaraNatvaM darshayati; samAse hi samudAyasyaiva riShTAdhikaraNakatayA parIkShitavyatvaM sha~gkyeta| varNashabdena ca varNasahacaritAshcakShurgrAhyA raukShyAdayo~api gRuhyante; ata eva varNaprastAva eva vakShyati- yat- “varNagrahaNena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH” iti| svarAdigrahaNena ca svarAdyabhAvo~api gRuhyate, tenA~gguliparvashabdAbhAva-gandhAbhAvAdayo~api riShTAnyavarudhyante| sparshagrahaNena ca sparshopalabhyakAThinyAdyavarodhaH| sattvaM manaH; sattvavikRuterudAharaNaM yathA- “autsukyaM bhajate sattvaM ceto bhIrAvishatyapi” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bhaktiH icchA| shIlaM sahajaM vRuttam| AcAraH shAstrashikShAkRuto vyavahAraH| bhaktyAdayo yadyapi sattvavikAratvena sattvagrahaNenaiva labhyante; yaduktaM- “bhaktiH shIlaM shaucaM dveShaH smRutirmohastyAgo~amAtsaryaM bhayaM krodhastandrotsAhastaikShNyaM mArdavaM gAmbhIryamanavasthitatvamityevamAdayaH sattvavikArAH” (shA.a.3) iti; tathA~api bhaktyAdInAmapi pRuthagariShTAdhikaraNatveneha pRuthakkaraNam| nidrAdaurbalyAttandreti tandrAshabdena nidrocyate; atra ca riShTamuktaM yathA- “nidrA nityA bhavati vA na vA” (iM.a.11) iti| Arambha iti ariShTavyAdhyutpAdArambhaH ; yaduktaM- “shvayathuryasya kukShistho hastapAdaM pradhAvati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| gaurave riShTaM yathA- “niShThyUtaM ca purIShaM ca retashcAmbhasi majjati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| lAghave riShTaM- gurUNAma~ggAnAM lAghavaM j~jeyam| guNariShTaM yathA- “guNAH sharIradeshAnAM shItoShNamRududAruNAH| viparyAsena lakShyante sthAneShvanyeShu tadvidhAH” (iM.a.12) iti| AhArariShTaM yathA- “AhAramupayu~jjAno bhiShajA sUpakalpitam” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| AhArapariNAmariShTaM yathA- “durbalo bahu bhu~gkte yo prAgabhuktvA~annamAturaH| alpamUtrapurIShashca” (iM.a.7) iti| upAya upagamanaM vyAdhimelaka ityarthaH; yaduktaM- “sahasA jvarasantApastRuShNA mUrcchA balakShayaH| vishleShaNaM ca sandhInAM” (iM.a.8) iti| vyAdhyapagamanamapAyaH; yaduktaM- “yaM naraM sahasA rogo durbalaM parimu~jcati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| vyAdhishceti vyAdhireva riShTaM yathA- “vAtAShThIlA susaMvRuttA dAruNA hRudi tiShThati” (iM.a.10) iti| chAyA bhautikI pa~jcarUpA, praticchAyA tu dehacchAyA; praticchAyayA ca netrakumArikA~api praticchAyArUpA gRuhItavyA| ayaM ca chAyAdibhedaH pannarUpIyendriye darshayitavyaH | Aturakule bhAvAvasthAriShTaM yathA- “agnipUrNAni pAtrANi bhinnAni vishikhAni ca| bhiSha~gmumUrShatAM veshma pravishanneva pashyati” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bheShajasaMvRuttau riShTaM yathA- “yamuddishyAturaM vaidyaH saMvartayitumauShadham| yatamAno na shaknoti durlabhaM tasya jIvitam” (iM.a.12) iti| bheShajasya vikAreNa samaM yuktirbheShajavikArayuktiH; tatra riShTaM yathA- “vij~jAtaM bahushaH siddhaM vidhivaccAvacAritam| na sidhyatyauShadhaM yasya tasya nAsti cikitsitam” (iM.a.12) iti| sheShaM tu riShTodAharaNaM vyaktam| iti samAptau| pratyakShapUrvakatvAt sarvapramANAnAmihAdau pratyakShaM kRutam| yadyapi varNAdaya AyurlakShaNapratipAditA dIrghAyuHpramANajij~jAsAyAmapi parIkShyante, tathA~apIha riShTaprakaraNe AyuHpramANAvasheShaj~jAnArthameva parIkShaNIyAH, ata uktaM- pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAneneti||3||

11.sanskrit: tatra tu khalveShAM parIkShyANAM kAnicit puruShamanAshritAni, kAnicicca puruShasaMshrayANi| tatra yAni puruShamanAshritAni tAnyupadeshato yuktitashca parIkSheta, puruShasaMshrayANi punaH prakRutito vikRutitashca||4||
11.commentary: puruShamanAshritAni dUtAdyAshrayANi riShTAni| yuktitashcetyanumAnata ityarthaH, atra yukterapi riShTatvAvadhAraNe kShamatvAt| pratyakShaM hi dUtAdInAM svarUpamAtraM gRuhNAti, riShTaM tu dUtAdInAmAgamAdeva j~jAyate| puruShAshrayivarNAdigatariShTagrahaNe tu pratyakShamapi tattadariShTavisheShagrahaNe tattadvisheSheNa vyApriyata iti matvA~atra tatpratiShiddham| anumAnaM tu riShTatvena pratipAditamanimittatvAdidharmavicAre vyApriyate, evaM sarvatra| prakRutitashceti puruShAshrayavikRutij~jAnahetutayA prakRutI riShTaj~jAne vyApriyate, yataH prakRutij~jAnAdhInaM vikRutij~jAnaM bhavati; prakRutivikRutiparIkShA tvatrAdhikRutaiH prasiddhaiH pratyakShAdibhireva j~jeyA||4||

11.sanskrit: tatra prakRutirjAtiprasaktA ca, kulaprasaktA ca, deshAnupAtinI ca, kAlAnupAtinI ca vayo~anupAtinI ca, pratyAtmaniyatA ceti| jAtikuladeshakAlavayaHpratyAtmaniyatA hi teShAM teShAM puruShANAM te te bhAvavisheShA bhavanti||5||
11.commentary: prakRutiM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| jAtiprasaktA yathA- brAhmaNajAtau shaucaM, kulaprasaktA yathA- ki~jcideva kulaM shucyAcAravadbhavati, deshAnupAtinI yathA- antarvedivAsinaH shucayo bhavanti, kAlAnupAtinI yathA- kRutayuge shaucaM, vayo~anupAtinI yathA- bAlye~ashaucaM, pratyAtmaniyatA yathA- kashcideva puruShaH prakRutyA shucirbhavati; ityAdyudAharaNIyam| kutaH punarjAtyAdiniyatA prakRutirbhavatItyatra hetumAha- jAtikuletyAdi| te te bhAvavisheShA iti shucitvAshaucAdayaH ||5||

11.sanskrit: vikRutiH punarlakShaNanimittA ca, lakShyanimittA ca, nimittAnurUpA ca||6||
11.commentary: riShTAdhikArAdhikRutAM vikRutiM vivecayituM sarvAneva vikRutibhedAnAha- vikRutirityAdi||6||

11.sanskrit: tatra lakShaNanimittA nAma sA yasyAH sharIre lakShaNAnyeva hetubhUtAni bhavanti daivAt; lakShaNAni hi kAniciccharIropanibaddhAni bhavanti, yAni hi tasmiMstasmin kAle tatrAdhiShThAnamAsAdya tAM tAM vikRutimutpAdayanti|7|
11.commentary: hetubhUtAnIti hetusadRushAni| tena daivameva nakharekhApadmAdisAmudrikoktalakShaNayukte sharIre rAjyadhanagamanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutiprAptau hetuH, lakShaNAni tu daivanimittAni bodhakamAtrANi, ata eva daivAdityuktaM; daivaM ca prAktanaM karmocyate| vikRutimutpAdayantItyatrApi daivAditi yojanIyaM; tena, daivabalAdeva lakShaNAnAM rAjyadhanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutikartRutvam| tasmiMstasmin kAle ityanena lakShaNasUcitAdRuShTaparipAkakAle niyatatvaM vikRuterdarshayati| lakShaNAsUcitAshca rAjyAdaya iha puruShasya kadAcidbhavanto~asvAbhAvikA eveti kRutvA vikRutishabdenocyante||7(1)||

11.sanskrit: lakShyanimittA tu sA yasyA upalabhyate nimittaM yathoktaM nidAneShu|7|
11.commentary: yathoktaM nidAneShviti yathA- rUkShAdisevayA vAtAdiprakoparUpA vikRutirnidAnoktetyarthaH||7(2)||

11.sanskrit: nimittAnurUpA tu nimittArthAnukAriNI yA, tAmanimittAM nimittamAyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyecchanti bhiShajo bhUyashcAyuShaH kShayanimittAM preteli~ggAnurUpAM, yAmAyuSho~antargatasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti dhIrAH| yAM cAdhikRutya puruShasaMshrayANi mumUrShatAM lakShaNAnyupadekShyAmaH| ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||7||
11.commentary: nimittAnurUpeti nimittasadRushI| tadeva sphoTayati- nimittArthAnukAriNIti|- nimittasya yo~arthaH kAryajananarUpaH kAryabodhanarUpo vA tamanukarotIti nimittArthAnukAriNI| riShTAkhyA hi vikRutirmaraNe tasyaivAvabodhane vA nimittaM bhavati| aparamapi nimittAnurUpAyA vikRutervisheShamAha- tAmityAdi| animittAmiti tadAtve~anupalabhyamAnanimittAM, na tu punaH sarvathaivAhetukIM, yata ‘AyuShaH kShayanimittAm’ ityanantaramasya visheShaNaM kathayiShyati; riShTasya hi na raukShyAdinA sharIrasambandhAdi nimittamupalabhyate| yadvA, AyuHkShayarUpaM yannimittaM tadvidyamAnamapi nAnyairupalabhyate , kintu tadeva hi riShTAdunnIyate; tena, avyaktanimittatvamihAnimittatvaM j~jeyam| atra gatAyuShTvameva sakalapuruShasaMshritariShTavyApakaM kAraNaM sAdhu| yattu vakShyati- “kriyApathamatikrAntAH kevalaM dehamAshritAH| cihnaM kurvanti yaddoShAstadariShTaM pracakShate” (iM.a.11) iti, taddUtAdigatariShTAvyApakatayA puruShAshrayiriShTamAtrAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam| AyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyeti AyuHsheShapramANaj~jAnasyetyarthaH| bhUya iti atyartham| tenAtyarthamAyuHkShayanimittAM pratyAsannAyuHkShayajanyAmiti yAvat| yAmiti kShINAyuHkAryAm| pretali~ggAnurUpAmiti pretasadRushIM; “malA danteShu jAyante pretAkRutirudIryate” (iM.a.12) ityAdigranthavakShyamANAm| imAM hi vikRutimAyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthaM vadanti| yA tvanyA pretali~ggAnanurUpA varNAshrayA sA pratyAsannamaraNabodhikA; tena sA nAtyarthannAtyarthakShINAyuHkAryetyarthaH| evaM ‘bhUyashca’ ityAdinA ‘dhIrAH’ ityantena nimittAnurUpavikRutivisheShasya kAryavisheShaM maraNalakShaNamabhidhAya punaH sAmAnyenAnimittAyA dharmAntaramAha- yAmadhikRutyetyAdi| puruShasaMshrayANIti visheShaNena puruShAnAshritadUtAdiriShTe nAvashyamanimittatA~astIti darshayati| yato dUtAdhikArAdau yAni riShTAni tAni dRushyamAnanimittAnyapyAgamAdeva riShTatvenAvadhAryante| yathA- “muktakeshe~athavA nagne rudatyaprayate~athavA| bhiShagabhyAgataM dRuShTvA dUtaM maraNamAdishet” (iM.a.12) iti| atra ca bhiShajo muktakeshavacanAddRushyata eva kAraNaM, tathA dUtAgamane cAturasya preraNAdi kAraNamastyeva, tenAnimittatvamAturAshrayiriShTa eva| anye tu, evambhUtavaidyadUtasamAgamaH parihartavyatvena j~jAtaH san yadA daivAdbhavati, tadA daivanimittaH san riShTaM bhavati; tena, sarvariShTavyApikaiveyamanimittatA; bhUyashcetyAdigranthena tu pretali~ggAnurUpAM vikRutiM bhUya AyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti, tathA puruShasaMshrayANi bhUya upadekShyante, puruShAnAshrayANi tu svalpagranthenopadekShyante iti vyAkhyAnayanti| ityuddesha indriyasthAnArthoddesha ityarthaH||7||

11.sanskrit: tatrAdita eva varNAdhikAraH| tadyathA- kRuShNaH, shyAmaH , shyAmAvadAtaH, avadAtashceti prakRutivarNAH sharIrasya bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH||8||
11.commentary: prakRutij~jAnAntarIyakatvAdvikRutij~jAnasya prakRutivarNAneva tAvadAha- kRuShNa ityAdi| avadAto gauraH| iha ca prAyeNa ye varNAH prakRutyA bhavanti te prakRutivarNA ucyante, ye tu prAyeNa vikRutyA bhavanti te vikRutivarNA ucyante, iti j~jeyam| tena prakRutivarNA api kadAcidvikRutivarNA bhavanti, tathA vikRutivarNA api janmaprabhRutijAyamAnatayA kadAcit prakRutivarNA bhavantIti j~jeyam| anuktaprakRutivarNAtideshArthamAha- yAMshcetyAdi| upetya IkShamANa iti upekShamANaH| anUkata iti sAdRushyataH; anena ca shyAmetyAdivarNashabdena nirdishyamAnAn vidyAditi yojanA| tajj~jairiti varNabhedanAmaj~jaiH||8||

11.sanskrit: nIlashyAvatAmraharitashuklAshca varNAH sharIrasya vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutivarNA bhavantyuktAH sharIrasya| tatra prakRutivarNamardhasharIre vikRutivarNamardhasharIre, dvAvapi varNau maryAdAvibhaktau dRuShTvA; yadyevaM savyadakShiNavibhAgena, yadyevaM pUrvapashcimavibhAgena, yadyuttarAdharavibhAgena, yadyantarbahirvibhAgena, AturasyAriShTamiti vidyAt; evameva varNabhedo mukhe~apyanyatra vartamAno maraNAya bhavati||9||
11.commentary: nIletyAdinA (vikRutijAyamAnatayA ) vikRutivarNAnAha| iha, ‘aparAn’ iti vacanena vikRutivarNasa~gkarajA varNA j~jeyAH| vikRutivarNAntaramAha- prAgityAdi| prAgvikRutAniti pUrvavarNAdanyathAbhUtAnityarthaH| tenApi, yena shyAmena satA rasAyanopayogAdgauravarNatvaM prAptaM, sa ca tyaktarasAyanaH kAlavashAt punaH shyAmavarNo bhavati tasyApi pUrvagauravarNAdvikRutiH shyAmavarNo bhavan riShTaM syAdityAha- abhUtvotpannAniti; tena nAyaM doShaH; atra hi pUrvabhUta eva varNaH punarbhavati, tena na riShTam| maryAdAvibhaktAviti samasImAvyavasthApitau| pUrvapashcimavibhAgeneti abhimukhapRuShThabhAgenetyarthaH| antarbahirvibhAgeneti atrAntargato varNo mukhanAsAkarNashrotrAntargatatayA unneyaH| anyatreti avAntare hastapAdAdau||9||

11.sanskrit: varNabhedena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH||10||
11.commentary: varNabhedeneti yathA varNavibhAgena riShTaM, tathA glAnyAdivibhAgenApItyarthaH| harSha ihopacayo j~jeyaH, mAnasaharShasyeha cAkShuShAdhikAre~asa~ggatatvAt||10||

11.sanskrit: tathA pipluvya~ggatilakAlakapiDakAnAmanyatamasyAnane janmAturasyaivamevAprashastaM vidyAt||11||
11.commentary: tathetyAdau pipluprabhRutInAmapi varNavat savyadakShiNAdivibhAgena janma riShTaM bhavatItyevamevashabdenocyate||11||

11.sanskrit: nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShahastapAdauShThAdiShvapi ca vaikArikoktAnAM varNAnAmanyatamasya prAdurbhAvo hInabalavarNendriyeShu lakShaNamAyuShaH kShayasya bhavati||12||
11.commentary: nakhetyAdau balahAnyAdyabhAve sati na riShTam||12||

11.sanskrit: yaccAnyadapi ki~jcidvarNavaikRutamabhUtapUrvaM sahasotpadyetAnimittameva hIyamAnasyAturasya shashvat, tadariShTamiti vidyAt| iti varNAdhikAraH||13||
11.commentary: yaccetyAdinA~anuktavarNariShTaM sa~ggRuhNAti| abhUtapUrvamiti pUrvavyAkRutarasAyanavihitavarNaprAdurbhAvavyudAsArtham| sahasotpadyata ityanena riShTAnAM shIghrasvabhAvaM darshayati| animittamiti pUrvoktArthameva| hIyamAnasya shashvaditi svabhAvakathanaM, riShTotpattyA hIyamAnatA shashvadavashyaM bhavati||13||

11.sanskrit: svarAdhikArastu- haMsakrau~jcanemidundubhikalavi~gkakAkakapotajarjarAnukArAH prakRutisvarA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH| eDakakalagrastAvyaktagadgadakShAmadInAnukIrNAstvAturANAM svarA vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutisvarA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||14||
11.commentary: kramAgataM svaramAha- svaretyAdi| jarjaraH vAdyabhANDavisheShaH| yAMshcetyAdi pUrvavad vyAkhyeyam| eDako meShaH, kiMvA araNyacchAgalaH; kalaH sUkShmaH; grastaH sarvathA~anuccAraH; kShAmaH rUkShaH; dInaH duHkhoccAryamANasvaraH; anukIrNa uparyuparyuccAryamANaH||14||

11.sanskrit: tatra prakRutivaikArikANAM svarANAmAshvabhinirvRuttiH svarAnekatvamekasya cAnekatvamaprashastam| iti svarAdhikAraH||15|| iti varNasvarAdhikArau yathAvaduktau mumUrShatAM lakShaNaj~jAnArthamiti||16||
11.commentary: prakRutervaikArikA anyathAbhUtA iti prakRutivaikArikAH| svarAnekatvamiti kadAcideDakasvaratvaM, kadAcit kalasvaratvamityAdi| ekasya cAnekatvamiti ekasyaiva svarasya cAnekatvamiva pratibhAti| animittamiti sarvatra sambadhyate||15-16||

11.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- yasya vaikAriko varNaH sharIra upapadyate| ardhe vA yadi vA kRutsne nimittaM na ca nAsti saH||17|| nIlaM vA yadi vA shyAvaM tAmraM vA yadi vA~aruNam| mukhArdhamanyathA varNo mukhArdhe~ariShTamucyate||18|| sneho mukhArdhe suvyakto raukShyamardhamukhe bhRusham| glAnirardhe tathA harSho mukhArdhe pretalakShaNam||19|| tilakAH piplavo vya~ggA rAjayashca pRuthagvidhAH| AturasyAshu jAyante mukhe prANAn mumukShataH||20|| puShpANi nakhadanteShu pa~gko vA dantasaMshritaH| cUrNako vA~api danteShu lakShaNaM maraNasya tat||21|| oShThayoH pAdayoH pANyorakShNormUtrapurIShayoH| nakheShvapi ca vaivarNyametat kShINabale~antakRut||22|| yasya nIlAvubhAvoShThau pakvajAmbavasannibhau| mumUrShuriti taM vidyAnnaro dhIro gatAyuSham||23|| eko vA yadi vA~aneko yasya vaikArikaH svaraH| sahasotpadyate jantorhIyamAnasya nAsti saH||24|| yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdvaikRutaM svaravarNayoH| balamAMsavihInasya tat sarvaM maraNodayam ||25|| tatra shlokaH- iti varNasvarAvuktau lakShaNArthaM mumUrShatAm| yastau samyagvijAnAti nAyurj~jAne sa muhyati||26||
11.commentary: ayamevArtho gadyoktaH spaShTArthaM sukhagrahaNArthaM ca shlokenocyate- yasyetyAdinA| tilakA ityAdau mukhe iti mukhArdhe| oShThAviti dvivacanamuktvA~api yat ‘ubhau’ iti karoti, tena sakalauShThavyAptiM darshayati| mumUrShurityukatvA~api yat ‘gatAyuShaM’ iti karoti, tena riShTayukto mumUrShargatAyurIti darshayati; ajAtariShTastu pratikriyAbhAvAnmumUrShuragatAyurapi bhavati| maraNodayamiti maraNakAraNamiti j~jAnArtham||17-26||

11.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute indriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
11.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmindriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

12.sanskrit: athAto varNasvarIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
12.commentary: shArIre cikitsAdhikaraNaM sharIraM pratipAdya cikitsA vaktavyA, sA ca sAdhya eva roge vaktavyA nAsAdhyaroge, yaduktaM- “arthavidyAyashohAnimupakroshamasa~ggraham| prApnuyAnniyataM vaidyo yo~asAdhyaM samupAcaret” (sU.a.10) iti; na ca riShTapratipattimantarA~asAdhyatvapratipattiriti riShTapratipAdakamindriyasthAnameva cikitsAsthAnAt prAgucyate | indrashabdena prANa ucyate, tasyAntagatasya li~ggaM riShTAkhyamindriyaM; yaduktaM vyAkaraNe- “indriyamindrali~ggaM” (pA.a.5.2.13) ityAdi; tasyendriyasya sthAnamindriyasthAnam| tatrApi cendriyasthAne vaktavye vyaktatamariShTAbhidhAyakatayA varNasvarIyamindriyamucyate, atra hi yAni riShTAni vaktavyAni tAnItarariShTebhyashcakShurAdigrAhyatayA vyaktatamAni| varNasvarAvadhikRutya kRuto varNasvarIyaH, indriyasya riShTarUpasya pratipAdako~adhyAya indriyaH, taM vyAkhyAsyAmaH| evamanyatrApi puShpitakamityAdyapIndriyavisheShaNaM vyAkhyeyam||1-2||

12.sanskrit: iha khalu varNashca svarashca gandhashca rasashca sparshashca cakShushca shrotraM ca ghrANaM ca rasanaM ca sparshanaM ca sattvaM ca bhaktishca shaucaM ca shIlaM cAcArashca smRutishcAkRutishca prakRutishca vikRutishca balaM ca glAnishca medhA ca harShashca raukShyaM ca snehashca tandrA cArambhashca gauravaM ca lAghavaM ca guNAshcAhArashca vihArashcAhArapariNAmashcopAyashcApAyashca vyAdhishca vyAdhipUrvarUpaM ca vedanAshcopadravAshca cchAyA ca praticchAyA ca svapnadarshanaM ca dUtAdhikArashca pathi cautpAtikaM cAturakule bhAvAvasthAntarANi ca bheShajasaMvRuttishca bheShajavikArayuktishceti parIkShyANi pratyakShAnumAnopadeshairAyuShaH pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAnena bhiShajA||3||
12.commentary: indriyasthAnapratipAdyaM kRutsnaM viShayamAha- ihetyAdi| iha indriyasthAne| khalushabdo vAkyAla~gkAre| iha ca yadyapIndriyANyeva viShayavarNAdigrAhakatayA agre vaktuM yujyante, tathA~api teShAmatIndriyatvena tadAshrayariShTAnAmavyaktatvaM ; tena, pravyaktAni varNAdInyeva pravyaktariShTAdhikaraNAnyagre~abhidhIyante| varNAdiShvapi ca yathA vyaktatvaM tathA pUrvanipAtaH| meghAdishabdastu yadyapi varNAdapi vyaktastathA~api shabdavisheSha eveha tAlvAdisampAdyaH svarashabdAbhidheyo riShTAdhikaraNatvenAbhimataH, sa ca varNApekShayA~avyakta eva| ihetyAdAvasamAsena pratyekamapi varNAdInAM riShTAdhikaraNatvaM darshayati; samAse hi samudAyasyaiva riShTAdhikaraNakatayA parIkShitavyatvaM sha~gkyeta| varNashabdena ca varNasahacaritAshcakShurgrAhyA raukShyAdayo~api gRuhyante; ata eva varNaprastAva eva vakShyati- yat- “varNagrahaNena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH” iti| svarAdigrahaNena ca svarAdyabhAvo~api gRuhyate, tenA~gguliparvashabdAbhAva-gandhAbhAvAdayo~api riShTAnyavarudhyante| sparshagrahaNena ca sparshopalabhyakAThinyAdyavarodhaH| sattvaM manaH; sattvavikRuterudAharaNaM yathA- “autsukyaM bhajate sattvaM ceto bhIrAvishatyapi” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bhaktiH icchA| shIlaM sahajaM vRuttam| AcAraH shAstrashikShAkRuto vyavahAraH| bhaktyAdayo yadyapi sattvavikAratvena sattvagrahaNenaiva labhyante; yaduktaM- “bhaktiH shIlaM shaucaM dveShaH smRutirmohastyAgo~amAtsaryaM bhayaM krodhastandrotsAhastaikShNyaM mArdavaM gAmbhIryamanavasthitatvamityevamAdayaH sattvavikArAH” (shA.a.3) iti; tathA~api bhaktyAdInAmapi pRuthagariShTAdhikaraNatveneha pRuthakkaraNam| nidrAdaurbalyAttandreti tandrAshabdena nidrocyate; atra ca riShTamuktaM yathA- “nidrA nityA bhavati vA na vA” (iM.a.11) iti| Arambha iti ariShTavyAdhyutpAdArambhaH ; yaduktaM- “shvayathuryasya kukShistho hastapAdaM pradhAvati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| gaurave riShTaM yathA- “niShThyUtaM ca purIShaM ca retashcAmbhasi majjati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| lAghave riShTaM- gurUNAma~ggAnAM lAghavaM j~jeyam| guNariShTaM yathA- “guNAH sharIradeshAnAM shItoShNamRududAruNAH| viparyAsena lakShyante sthAneShvanyeShu tadvidhAH” (iM.a.12) iti| AhArariShTaM yathA- “AhAramupayu~jjAno bhiShajA sUpakalpitam” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| AhArapariNAmariShTaM yathA- “durbalo bahu bhu~gkte yo prAgabhuktvA~annamAturaH| alpamUtrapurIShashca” (iM.a.7) iti| upAya upagamanaM vyAdhimelaka ityarthaH; yaduktaM- “sahasA jvarasantApastRuShNA mUrcchA balakShayaH| vishleShaNaM ca sandhInAM” (iM.a.8) iti| vyAdhyapagamanamapAyaH; yaduktaM- “yaM naraM sahasA rogo durbalaM parimu~jcati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| vyAdhishceti vyAdhireva riShTaM yathA- “vAtAShThIlA susaMvRuttA dAruNA hRudi tiShThati” (iM.a.10) iti| chAyA bhautikI pa~jcarUpA, praticchAyA tu dehacchAyA; praticchAyayA ca netrakumArikA~api praticchAyArUpA gRuhItavyA| ayaM ca chAyAdibhedaH pannarUpIyendriye darshayitavyaH | Aturakule bhAvAvasthAriShTaM yathA- “agnipUrNAni pAtrANi bhinnAni vishikhAni ca| bhiSha~gmumUrShatAM veshma pravishanneva pashyati” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bheShajasaMvRuttau riShTaM yathA- “yamuddishyAturaM vaidyaH saMvartayitumauShadham| yatamAno na shaknoti durlabhaM tasya jIvitam” (iM.a.12) iti| bheShajasya vikAreNa samaM yuktirbheShajavikArayuktiH; tatra riShTaM yathA- “vij~jAtaM bahushaH siddhaM vidhivaccAvacAritam| na sidhyatyauShadhaM yasya tasya nAsti cikitsitam” (iM.a.12) iti| sheShaM tu riShTodAharaNaM vyaktam| iti samAptau| pratyakShapUrvakatvAt sarvapramANAnAmihAdau pratyakShaM kRutam| yadyapi varNAdaya AyurlakShaNapratipAditA dIrghAyuHpramANajij~jAsAyAmapi parIkShyante, tathA~apIha riShTaprakaraNe AyuHpramANAvasheShaj~jAnArthameva parIkShaNIyAH, ata uktaM- pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAneneti||3||

12.sanskrit: tatra tu khalveShAM parIkShyANAM kAnicit puruShamanAshritAni, kAnicicca puruShasaMshrayANi| tatra yAni puruShamanAshritAni tAnyupadeshato yuktitashca parIkSheta, puruShasaMshrayANi punaH prakRutito vikRutitashca||4||
12.commentary: puruShamanAshritAni dUtAdyAshrayANi riShTAni| yuktitashcetyanumAnata ityarthaH, atra yukterapi riShTatvAvadhAraNe kShamatvAt| pratyakShaM hi dUtAdInAM svarUpamAtraM gRuhNAti, riShTaM tu dUtAdInAmAgamAdeva j~jAyate| puruShAshrayivarNAdigatariShTagrahaNe tu pratyakShamapi tattadariShTavisheShagrahaNe tattadvisheSheNa vyApriyata iti matvA~atra tatpratiShiddham| anumAnaM tu riShTatvena pratipAditamanimittatvAdidharmavicAre vyApriyate, evaM sarvatra| prakRutitashceti puruShAshrayavikRutij~jAnahetutayA prakRutI riShTaj~jAne vyApriyate, yataH prakRutij~jAnAdhInaM vikRutij~jAnaM bhavati; prakRutivikRutiparIkShA tvatrAdhikRutaiH prasiddhaiH pratyakShAdibhireva j~jeyA||4||

12.sanskrit: tatra prakRutirjAtiprasaktA ca, kulaprasaktA ca, deshAnupAtinI ca, kAlAnupAtinI ca vayo~anupAtinI ca, pratyAtmaniyatA ceti| jAtikuladeshakAlavayaHpratyAtmaniyatA hi teShAM teShAM puruShANAM te te bhAvavisheShA bhavanti||5||
12.commentary: prakRutiM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| jAtiprasaktA yathA- brAhmaNajAtau shaucaM, kulaprasaktA yathA- ki~jcideva kulaM shucyAcAravadbhavati, deshAnupAtinI yathA- antarvedivAsinaH shucayo bhavanti, kAlAnupAtinI yathA- kRutayuge shaucaM, vayo~anupAtinI yathA- bAlye~ashaucaM, pratyAtmaniyatA yathA- kashcideva puruShaH prakRutyA shucirbhavati; ityAdyudAharaNIyam| kutaH punarjAtyAdiniyatA prakRutirbhavatItyatra hetumAha- jAtikuletyAdi| te te bhAvavisheShA iti shucitvAshaucAdayaH ||5||

12.sanskrit: vikRutiH punarlakShaNanimittA ca, lakShyanimittA ca, nimittAnurUpA ca||6||
12.commentary: riShTAdhikArAdhikRutAM vikRutiM vivecayituM sarvAneva vikRutibhedAnAha- vikRutirityAdi||6||

12.sanskrit: tatra lakShaNanimittA nAma sA yasyAH sharIre lakShaNAnyeva hetubhUtAni bhavanti daivAt; lakShaNAni hi kAniciccharIropanibaddhAni bhavanti, yAni hi tasmiMstasmin kAle tatrAdhiShThAnamAsAdya tAM tAM vikRutimutpAdayanti|7|
12.commentary: hetubhUtAnIti hetusadRushAni| tena daivameva nakharekhApadmAdisAmudrikoktalakShaNayukte sharIre rAjyadhanagamanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutiprAptau hetuH, lakShaNAni tu daivanimittAni bodhakamAtrANi, ata eva daivAdityuktaM; daivaM ca prAktanaM karmocyate| vikRutimutpAdayantItyatrApi daivAditi yojanIyaM; tena, daivabalAdeva lakShaNAnAM rAjyadhanavadhabandhanAdirUpavikRutikartRutvam| tasmiMstasmin kAle ityanena lakShaNasUcitAdRuShTaparipAkakAle niyatatvaM vikRuterdarshayati| lakShaNAsUcitAshca rAjyAdaya iha puruShasya kadAcidbhavanto~asvAbhAvikA eveti kRutvA vikRutishabdenocyante||7(1)||

12.sanskrit: lakShyanimittA tu sA yasyA upalabhyate nimittaM yathoktaM nidAneShu|7|
12.commentary: yathoktaM nidAneShviti yathA- rUkShAdisevayA vAtAdiprakoparUpA vikRutirnidAnoktetyarthaH||7(2)||

12.sanskrit: nimittAnurUpA tu nimittArthAnukAriNI yA, tAmanimittAM nimittamAyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyecchanti bhiShajo bhUyashcAyuShaH kShayanimittAM preteli~ggAnurUpAM, yAmAyuSho~antargatasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti dhIrAH| yAM cAdhikRutya puruShasaMshrayANi mumUrShatAM lakShaNAnyupadekShyAmaH| ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||7||
12.commentary: nimittAnurUpeti nimittasadRushI| tadeva sphoTayati- nimittArthAnukAriNIti|- nimittasya yo~arthaH kAryajananarUpaH kAryabodhanarUpo vA tamanukarotIti nimittArthAnukAriNI| riShTAkhyA hi vikRutirmaraNe tasyaivAvabodhane vA nimittaM bhavati| aparamapi nimittAnurUpAyA vikRutervisheShamAha- tAmityAdi| animittAmiti tadAtve~anupalabhyamAnanimittAM, na tu punaH sarvathaivAhetukIM, yata ‘AyuShaH kShayanimittAm’ ityanantaramasya visheShaNaM kathayiShyati; riShTasya hi na raukShyAdinA sharIrasambandhAdi nimittamupalabhyate| yadvA, AyuHkShayarUpaM yannimittaM tadvidyamAnamapi nAnyairupalabhyate , kintu tadeva hi riShTAdunnIyate; tena, avyaktanimittatvamihAnimittatvaM j~jeyam| atra gatAyuShTvameva sakalapuruShasaMshritariShTavyApakaM kAraNaM sAdhu| yattu vakShyati- “kriyApathamatikrAntAH kevalaM dehamAshritAH| cihnaM kurvanti yaddoShAstadariShTaM pracakShate” (iM.a.11) iti, taddUtAdigatariShTAvyApakatayA puruShAshrayiriShTamAtrAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam| AyuShaH pramANaj~jAnasyeti AyuHsheShapramANaj~jAnasyetyarthaH| bhUya iti atyartham| tenAtyarthamAyuHkShayanimittAM pratyAsannAyuHkShayajanyAmiti yAvat| yAmiti kShINAyuHkAryAm| pretali~ggAnurUpAmiti pretasadRushIM; “malA danteShu jAyante pretAkRutirudIryate” (iM.a.12) ityAdigranthavakShyamANAm| imAM hi vikRutimAyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthaM vadanti| yA tvanyA pretali~ggAnanurUpA varNAshrayA sA pratyAsannamaraNabodhikA; tena sA nAtyarthannAtyarthakShINAyuHkAryetyarthaH| evaM ‘bhUyashca’ ityAdinA ‘dhIrAH’ ityantena nimittAnurUpavikRutivisheShasya kAryavisheShaM maraNalakShaNamabhidhAya punaH sAmAnyenAnimittAyA dharmAntaramAha- yAmadhikRutyetyAdi| puruShasaMshrayANIti visheShaNena puruShAnAshritadUtAdiriShTe nAvashyamanimittatA~astIti darshayati| yato dUtAdhikArAdau yAni riShTAni tAni dRushyamAnanimittAnyapyAgamAdeva riShTatvenAvadhAryante| yathA- “muktakeshe~athavA nagne rudatyaprayate~athavA| bhiShagabhyAgataM dRuShTvA dUtaM maraNamAdishet” (iM.a.12) iti| atra ca bhiShajo muktakeshavacanAddRushyata eva kAraNaM, tathA dUtAgamane cAturasya preraNAdi kAraNamastyeva, tenAnimittatvamAturAshrayiriShTa eva| anye tu, evambhUtavaidyadUtasamAgamaH parihartavyatvena j~jAtaH san yadA daivAdbhavati, tadA daivanimittaH san riShTaM bhavati; tena, sarvariShTavyApikaiveyamanimittatA; bhUyashcetyAdigranthena tu pretali~ggAnurUpAM vikRutiM bhUya AyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya j~jAnArthamupadishanti, tathA puruShasaMshrayANi bhUya upadekShyante, puruShAnAshrayANi tu svalpagranthenopadekShyante iti vyAkhyAnayanti| ityuddesha indriyasthAnArthoddesha ityarthaH||7||

12.sanskrit: tatrAdita eva varNAdhikAraH| tadyathA- kRuShNaH, shyAmaH , shyAmAvadAtaH, avadAtashceti prakRutivarNAH sharIrasya bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH||8||
12.commentary: prakRutij~jAnAntarIyakatvAdvikRutij~jAnasya prakRutivarNAneva tAvadAha- kRuShNa ityAdi| avadAto gauraH| iha ca prAyeNa ye varNAH prakRutyA bhavanti te prakRutivarNA ucyante, ye tu prAyeNa vikRutyA bhavanti te vikRutivarNA ucyante, iti j~jeyam| tena prakRutivarNA api kadAcidvikRutivarNA bhavanti, tathA vikRutivarNA api janmaprabhRutijAyamAnatayA kadAcit prakRutivarNA bhavantIti j~jeyam| anuktaprakRutivarNAtideshArthamAha- yAMshcetyAdi| upetya IkShamANa iti upekShamANaH| anUkata iti sAdRushyataH; anena ca shyAmetyAdivarNashabdena nirdishyamAnAn vidyAditi yojanA| tajj~jairiti varNabhedanAmaj~jaiH||8||

12.sanskrit: nIlashyAvatAmraharitashuklAshca varNAH sharIrasya vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutivarNA bhavantyuktAH sharIrasya| tatra prakRutivarNamardhasharIre vikRutivarNamardhasharIre, dvAvapi varNau maryAdAvibhaktau dRuShTvA; yadyevaM savyadakShiNavibhAgena, yadyevaM pUrvapashcimavibhAgena, yadyuttarAdharavibhAgena, yadyantarbahirvibhAgena, AturasyAriShTamiti vidyAt; evameva varNabhedo mukhe~apyanyatra vartamAno maraNAya bhavati||9||
12.commentary: nIletyAdinA (vikRutijAyamAnatayA ) vikRutivarNAnAha| iha, ‘aparAn’ iti vacanena vikRutivarNasa~gkarajA varNA j~jeyAH| vikRutivarNAntaramAha- prAgityAdi| prAgvikRutAniti pUrvavarNAdanyathAbhUtAnityarthaH| tenApi, yena shyAmena satA rasAyanopayogAdgauravarNatvaM prAptaM, sa ca tyaktarasAyanaH kAlavashAt punaH shyAmavarNo bhavati tasyApi pUrvagauravarNAdvikRutiH shyAmavarNo bhavan riShTaM syAdityAha- abhUtvotpannAniti; tena nAyaM doShaH; atra hi pUrvabhUta eva varNaH punarbhavati, tena na riShTam| maryAdAvibhaktAviti samasImAvyavasthApitau| pUrvapashcimavibhAgeneti abhimukhapRuShThabhAgenetyarthaH| antarbahirvibhAgeneti atrAntargato varNo mukhanAsAkarNashrotrAntargatatayA unneyaH| anyatreti avAntare hastapAdAdau||9||

12.sanskrit: varNabhedena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH||10||
12.commentary: varNabhedeneti yathA varNavibhAgena riShTaM, tathA glAnyAdivibhAgenApItyarthaH| harSha ihopacayo j~jeyaH, mAnasaharShasyeha cAkShuShAdhikAre~asa~ggatatvAt||10||

12.sanskrit: tathA pipluvya~ggatilakAlakapiDakAnAmanyatamasyAnane janmAturasyaivamevAprashastaM vidyAt||11||
12.commentary: tathetyAdau pipluprabhRutInAmapi varNavat savyadakShiNAdivibhAgena janma riShTaM bhavatItyevamevashabdenocyate||11||

12.sanskrit: nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShahastapAdauShThAdiShvapi ca vaikArikoktAnAM varNAnAmanyatamasya prAdurbhAvo hInabalavarNendriyeShu lakShaNamAyuShaH kShayasya bhavati||12||
12.commentary: nakhetyAdau balahAnyAdyabhAve sati na riShTam||12||

12.sanskrit: yaccAnyadapi ki~jcidvarNavaikRutamabhUtapUrvaM sahasotpadyetAnimittameva hIyamAnasyAturasya shashvat, tadariShTamiti vidyAt| iti varNAdhikAraH||13||
12.commentary: yaccetyAdinA~anuktavarNariShTaM sa~ggRuhNAti| abhUtapUrvamiti pUrvavyAkRutarasAyanavihitavarNaprAdurbhAvavyudAsArtham| sahasotpadyata ityanena riShTAnAM shIghrasvabhAvaM darshayati| animittamiti pUrvoktArthameva| hIyamAnasya shashvaditi svabhAvakathanaM, riShTotpattyA hIyamAnatA shashvadavashyaM bhavati||13||

12.sanskrit: svarAdhikArastu- haMsakrau~jcanemidundubhikalavi~gkakAkakapotajarjarAnukArAH prakRutisvarA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH| eDakakalagrastAvyaktagadgadakShAmadInAnukIrNAstvAturANAM svarA vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutisvarA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||14||
12.commentary: kramAgataM svaramAha- svaretyAdi| jarjaraH vAdyabhANDavisheShaH| yAMshcetyAdi pUrvavad vyAkhyeyam| eDako meShaH, kiMvA araNyacchAgalaH; kalaH sUkShmaH; grastaH sarvathA~anuccAraH; kShAmaH rUkShaH; dInaH duHkhoccAryamANasvaraH; anukIrNa uparyuparyuccAryamANaH||14||

12.sanskrit: tatra prakRutivaikArikANAM svarANAmAshvabhinirvRuttiH svarAnekatvamekasya cAnekatvamaprashastam| iti svarAdhikAraH||15|| iti varNasvarAdhikArau yathAvaduktau mumUrShatAM lakShaNaj~jAnArthamiti||16||
12.commentary: prakRutervaikArikA anyathAbhUtA iti prakRutivaikArikAH| svarAnekatvamiti kadAcideDakasvaratvaM, kadAcit kalasvaratvamityAdi| ekasya cAnekatvamiti ekasyaiva svarasya cAnekatvamiva pratibhAti| animittamiti sarvatra sambadhyate||15-16||

12.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- yasya vaikAriko varNaH sharIra upapadyate| ardhe vA yadi vA kRutsne nimittaM na ca nAsti saH||17|| nIlaM vA yadi vA shyAvaM tAmraM vA yadi vA~aruNam| mukhArdhamanyathA varNo mukhArdhe~ariShTamucyate||18|| sneho mukhArdhe suvyakto raukShyamardhamukhe bhRusham| glAnirardhe tathA harSho mukhArdhe pretalakShaNam||19|| tilakAH piplavo vya~ggA rAjayashca pRuthagvidhAH| AturasyAshu jAyante mukhe prANAn mumukShataH||20|| puShpANi nakhadanteShu pa~gko vA dantasaMshritaH| cUrNako vA~api danteShu lakShaNaM maraNasya tat||21|| oShThayoH pAdayoH pANyorakShNormUtrapurIShayoH| nakheShvapi ca vaivarNyametat kShINabale~antakRut||22|| yasya nIlAvubhAvoShThau pakvajAmbavasannibhau| mumUrShuriti taM vidyAnnaro dhIro gatAyuSham||23|| eko vA yadi vA~aneko yasya vaikArikaH svaraH| sahasotpadyate jantorhIyamAnasya nAsti saH||24|| yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdvaikRutaM svaravarNayoH| balamAMsavihInasya tat sarvaM maraNodayam ||25|| tatra shlokaH- iti varNasvarAvuktau lakShaNArthaM mumUrShatAm| yastau samyagvijAnAti nAyurj~jAne sa muhyati||26||
12.commentary: ayamevArtho gadyoktaH spaShTArthaM sukhagrahaNArthaM ca shlokenocyate- yasyetyAdinA| tilakA ityAdau mukhe iti mukhArdhe| oShThAviti dvivacanamuktvA~api yat ‘ubhau’ iti karoti, tena sakalauShThavyAptiM darshayati| mumUrShurityukatvA~api yat ‘gatAyuShaM’ iti karoti, tena riShTayukto mumUrShargatAyurIti darshayati; ajAtariShTastu pratikriyAbhAvAnmumUrShuragatAyurapi bhavati| maraNodayamiti maraNakAraNamiti j~jAnArtham||17-26||

12.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute indriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
12.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmindriyasthAne varNasvarIyamindriyaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

1.sanskrit: athAto madanakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
1.commentary: cikitsitasthAne tu tatra tatra vihitavamanavirecanayoH prayogAn vistareNAbhidhAtuM cikitsAdhikRutayogasthAnarUpakalpasthAnamucyate| yadyapi cikitsAyAM basterapi pratipAditatvAdbastyabhidhAyakaM siddhisthAnamapi cikitsA~ggatayA~abhidhAtavyaM, tathA~api pa~jcakarmaNAmautsargikapravRuttau vamanavirecanapUrvikaiva bastikarmapravRuttirbhavatIti kRutvA vamanavirecanAbhidhAyakaM kalpasthAnameva bastyabhidhAyakasiddhisthAnAdagre~abhidhIyate| vamanavirecanAnAM kalpAstiShThantyasminniti kalpasthAnam| kalpAbhidhAne~api virecanasyautsargikapravRuttau vamanapUrvikaiva pravRuttirbhavatIti vamanapUrvakatvAdvirecanasya vamanakalpA evAgre~abhidhAtavyAH| vamanakalpeShvapi vamanadravyashreShThatvAnmadanaphalasyaivAdau kalpo~abhidhIyate; shreShThatvaM ca madanaphalasya ‘vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate~anapAyitvAt’ ityanenAtraiva vakShyati||1-2||

1.sanskrit: atha khalu vamanavirecanArthaM vamanavirecanadravyANAM sukhopabhogatamaiH sahAnyairdravyairvividhaiH kalpanArthaM bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyarthaH , tadyogAnAM ca kriyAvidheH sukhopAyasya samyagupakalpanArthaM kalpasthAnamupadekShyAmo~agnivesha!||3||
1.commentary: kalpArthaM darshayannAha- atha khalvityAdi| athashabdaH prAkprastute| khalushabdaH prakAshane| vamanavirecanArthamiti vamananimittaM virecananimittaM ca| vamanavirecanadravyANAmiti madanaphalAditrivRudAdInAm| anyairiti surAsauvIrakAdyaiH kovidArAdiprakAraishca| anyairityasya visheShaNaM- sukhopabhogatamairiti| atra sukhAyopabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, na tadAtvasukha upabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, tathAhi tadAtve~asukhopabhogAnAM kovidArAdInAmagrahaNaM syAt| kalpanArthamiti padasya kriyayA sambandhamadarshayitvaiva tadvyAkhyAnapratyayanArthaM vyAkaroti bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyartha iti; tatra bhedArthamiti vamanavirecanadravyaprayogabhedArthaM, te ca prayogabhedAH “trayastriMshadyogashataM praNItaM phaleShu” (sU.a.4) ityAdikAH; vibhAgArthamiti atra ‘phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa’, ityAdivakShyamANadravyavibhAgArtham| upodghAtaM samApya prakRutamAha- tadyogAnAmiti; vamanavirecanadravyaprayogANam| kriyAyA itikartavyatAyA vidhiH kriyAvidhiH, svarasAdirUpatayA karaNAnIti yAvat; tasya kriyAvidhervisheShaNaM- sukhopAyasyeti; sukhArthaH sukho vA upAyo yasya sa sukhopAyaH, tasya samyagupakalpanArthamiti samyagupadeshArtham||3||

1.sanskrit: tatra doShaharaNamUrdhvabhAgaM vamanasa~jj~jakam, adhobhAgaM virecanasa~jj~jakam; ubhayaM vA sharIramalavirecanAdvirecanasa~jj~jAM labhate||4||
1.commentary: vamanavirecanashabdArthaM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| UrdhvaM mukhena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti UrdhvabhAgam| adho gudena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti adhobhAgam| vamanavirecanayorapi kadAcidvirecanasa~jj~jAM ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktAM darshayannAha- ubhayamapItyAdi| na caivaM sati vamanavirecanavannirUhe~api virecanasa~jj~jAprasaktirudbhAvanIyA , yataH pa~gkajashabdavadiyaM virecanasa~jj~jA vamanavirecanayoreva yogarUDhyA vartate||4||

1.sanskrit: tatroShNa-tIkShNa-sUkShma-vyavAyi-vikAshInyauShadhAni svavIryeNa hRudayamupetya dhamanIranusRutya sthUlANusrotobhyaH kevalaM sharIragataM doShasa~gghAtamAgneyatvAd viShyandayanti, taikShNyAd vicchindanti, sa vicchinnaH pariplavan snehabhAvite kAye snehAktabhAjanasthamiva kShaudramasajjannaNupravaNabhAvAdAmAshayamAgamyodAnapraNunno~agnivAyvAtmakatvAdUrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAdauShadhasyordhvamutkShipyate, salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdadhobhAgaprabhAvAccauShadhasyAdhaH pravartate, ubhayatashcobhayaguNatvAt| iti lakShaNoddeshaH||5||
1.commentary: samprati dvayorapi vamanavirecanadravyayoH sAdhAraNoShNatIkShNatvAdiguNayogakRutadoShaviShyandanAdisAdhAraNakAryadarshanapUrvakamagnivAyvAtmakatvAdivishiShTadharmayogakRutaM vishiShTaM ca kAryaM vamanavirecanarUpaM darshayannAha- tatroShNetyAdi| uShNamiti uShNavIryam| svavIryeNeti svaprabhAveNa| dhamanIranusRutyeti sakaladehagatA dhamanIranusRutya; sakaladehagatadhamanyanusaraNaM ca vIryeNa j~jeyaM, na sAkShAt| AgneyatvAdviShyandayantIti vilInaM kurvanti| vicchindanti chinnaM kurvanti| pariplavan itastato gacchan| asajjanniti na kvacidapi sa~ggaM gacchan| aNupravaNabhAvAditi aNutvAt pravaNabhAvAcca; pravaNatvamiha koShThagamanonmukhatvam, aNutvaM ca aNumArgasa~jcAritvam| udAnapraNunna iti udAnavAyupreritaH| agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi agnivAyUtkarShavattvAt| UrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAditi UrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvarUpaprabhAvAt| evaM salilapRuthivyAtmakatvamapi vyAkhyeyam| ubhayatashceti Urdhvamadhashca kShipyata ityarthaH| ubhayaguNatvAditi agnivAyvAtmakatvAt salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdUrdhvAdhobhAgaprabhAvAccetyarthaH| iti lakShaNoddesha iti anantaragranthena vamanavirecanadravyasvarUpAbhidhAnaM kRutamityarthaH| atra ca prakaraNe sAmAnyenaiva vamanavirecanadravyANAm ‘AgneyatvAdviShyandayanti’ ityanenAgneyatvaM pratipAditaM; punashca visheSheNa ‘agnivAyvAtmakatvAt’ iti padena vamanadravyasyAgnyAtmakatvaM pratipAdyate; tena, sAmAnye visheShe ca vamanadravyANAmAgneyatvapratipAdanAt prakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati; virecanadravyANAM tu sAmAnyoktAgneyatvasambandhAd visheShaguNakathanaprastAve ca salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAbhidhAnAdvamanadravyApekShayA~apakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati| tathAhi sushrute~api vamanavirecanayorapyAgneyatvamuktaM- “saratva-saukShmya-taikShNyauShNya-vikAshitvairvirecanam| vamanaM ca hareddoShAn prakRutyA gatamanyathA” (su.ci.a.33) ityanena| yaccAtrocyate-vamanaM yadyUrdhvabhAgaharatvaprabhAvAdUrdhvayati, tadA~agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi hetuvarNanaM na yujyate; yataH, yat sopapattikaM kAryaM na bhavati tat prabhAvakRutamiti vyapadishyate; uktaM hi- “prabhAvo~acintya ucyate” (sU.a.26) iti| tanna, yataH prabhAvasyaiveha vamanakArye vAyvagnyAtmakaguNatayA vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM heturupadRu(di)shyate, na tu vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM svatantro vamanahetuH; tathAhi sati yadanyadapi vAyvagnyAtmakamUrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvaprabhAvarahitaM, tadapi vamanakaraM syAt; yathA- kaTukarase dravye tat syAt; tasmAt prabhAvaguNatayaiva hetuvarNanam| evaM virecanadravye~api pUrvapakShasiddhAntAvanusartavyau||5||

1.sanskrit: tatra phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAnAM, shyAmA-trivRuccatura~ggula-tilvaka-mahAvRukSha-saptalA-sha~gkhinI-dantI-dravantInAM ca, nAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAsvAda-rasa-vIrya-vipAka-prabhAvagrahaNAd deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcca , vicitragandha-varNa-rasa-sparshAnAmupayogasukhArthamasa~gkhyeyasaMyogAnAmapi ca satAM dravyANAM vikalpamArgopadarshanArthaM ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH||6||
1.commentary: samprati kalpasthAnavaktavyatayA ShaDvirecanaprayogashatAnyanatisa~gkShepavistaraprayogopadarshanapUrvakaM pratijAnIte- tatra phaletyAdinA ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAma ityantena| tatra kRutavedhanAntAnAM vicchedapAThena vamanaprayogaprayojyatvaM, shyAmAdInAM virecanaprayogaprayojyatvaM ca darshayati| atraiva vamane virecane caikaikeShAM punarvastUnAM madanaphalAdInAM shyAmAdInAM ca bahavaH prayogA abhidhIyante, na punarekaikameva dravyaM vamanakArakaM virecanakArakaM vA; svalpasa~gkhyAprayogeNa grahaNasukhatA vamanavirecanayogasya bhavati, kAryaM ca sidhyatItyAsha~gkyAha- nAnAvidhetyAdi yAvadrogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcceti| asyArthaH- yasmAnnAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAH, nAnAvidhAsvAdAH, nAnAvidhavIryAH, nAnAvidhavipAkAH, nAnAvidhaprabhAvAshca madanaphalAdikA oShadhyaH, tathA tatsaMskArakAH kovidArAdikA oShadhya upalabhyante; puruShAshca deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAbhinnA nAnAvidhA dRushyante; tena naikaM dravyaM sarvasmin dehadoShAdau yaugikaM, sarvatra kAle vA prApyate sarvatra deshe vA; tasmAddehadoShAdinA bhedavati puruShe bahUnyeva dravyANi bahubhishca prayogairupakalpitAni yathAyogyatayA yathAprApti ca prayoktuM shakyante; ato bahunAmeva madanAdidravyANAM bahuprakAraprayogANAmupanyAso yukta iti bhAvaH| grahaNAt upalambhAt| deho nAnA sthUlakRushAdibhedena, bhaktiH icchA, avasthAshabdeneha rogAvasthaiva grAhyA, Adishabdeneha sattvAhArayorgrahaNam| bhUrivirecanaprayogopadarshanaprayojanAntaramapyAha- vicitretyAdi| nAnAvidhagandha-varNa-rasatayA prayoge tatkAlamuttarakAlaM ca sukhArthamityarthaH| atha kiM prabhedAnmadanaphalAdInAM ShaTprayogashatAni bhavanti, yenAdhikAH prayogA nAbhidhIyanta ityAsha~gkyAha- asa~gkhyeyetyAdi| vikalpamArgopadarshanArthamiti adhikaprayogakalpanAsamarthAn bhiShajaH prati etat ShaTprayogashatopadarshanaM kartavyAdhikaprayogakalpanAmArgopadarshakaM, tenApare~apyatra prayogAH kalpanIyAH; granthe niHsheShaprayogAnabhidhAnaM prayogANAmasa~gkhyeyatvenAshakyatvAdeva| anativistareNa ShaTprayogashatAbhidhAnaM mandabuddhisaMvyavahArArthamiti bhAvaH| uktaM hyanyatra- “etAvanto hyalamalpabuddhInAM vyavahArAya, buddhimatAM ca svAlakShaNyAnumAnayuktikushalAnAmanuktArthaj~jAnAya” (sU.a.4) iti||6||

1.sanskrit: tAni tu dravyANi desha-kAla-guNa-bhAjana-sampadvIryabalAdhAnAt kriyAsamarthatamAni bhavanti||7||
1.commentary: samprati vamanavirecanadravyANAM deshAdisampattyA guNotkarShaM darshayannAha- tAnItyAdi| deshAdibhishcaturbhiH sampacchabdaH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bhAjanaM bheShajasthApanasthAnam| vIryasya balaM vIryAdhikatvameva||7||

1.sanskrit: trividhaH khalu deshaH- jA~ggalaH, AnUpaH, sAdhAraNashceti| tatra jA~ggalaH paryAkAshabhUyiShThaH, tarubhirapi ca kadara-khadirAsanAshvakarNa-dhava-tinisha-shallakI-sAla-somavalka-badarI-tindukAshvattha-vaTAmalakIvanagahanaH, anekashamI-kakubha-shiMshapAprAyaH, sthirashuShkapavanabalavidhUyamAnapranRutyattaruNaviTapaH, pratatamRugatRuShNikopagUDhatanukharaparuShasikatAsharkarAbahulaH, lAvatittiricakorAnucaritabhUmibhAgaH, vAtapittabahulaH, sthirakaThinamanuShyaprAyo j~jeyaH, athAnUpo hintAlatamAlanArikelakadalIvanagahanaH, saritsamudraparyantaprAyaH, shishirapavanabahulaH, va~jjulavAnIropashobhitatIrAbhiH saridbhirupagatabhUmibhAgaH, kShitidharaniku~jjopashobhitaH, mandapavanAnuvIjitakShitiruhagahanaH, anekavanarAjIpuShpitavanagahanabhUmibhAgaH, snigdhatarupratAnopagUDhaH, haMsa-cakravAka-balAkA-nandImukha-puNDarIka-kAdamba-madgu -bhRu~ggarAja-shatapatra-mattakokilAnunAditataruviTapaH, sukumArapuruShaH, pavanakaphaprAyo j~jeyaH; anayoreva dvayordeshayorvIrudvanaspativAnaspatyashakunimRugagaNayutaH sthirasukumArabalavarNasaMhananopapannasAdhAraNaguNayuktapuruShaH sAdhAraNo j~jeyaH||8||
1.commentary: deshAdi samyag vyAkurvannAha- tatra trividha ityAdi| atra kecijjA~ggalAdideshalakShaNagranthaM na paThanti, tattu janapadoddhvaMsanIye paThitamiti kRutvehAnArShaM vadanti| yaistu janapadoddhvaMsanIye jA~ggalAdilakShaNaM na paThyate, tairatra paThanIya evAyaM granthaH||8||

1.sanskrit: tatra deshe sAdhAraNe jA~ggale vA yathAkAlaM shishirAtapapavanasalilasevite same shucau pradakShiNodake shmashAna-caitya-devayajanAgAra-sabhA-shvabhrArAma-valmIkoSharavirahite kusharohiShAstIrNe snigdhakRuShNamadhuramRuttike suvarNavarNamadhuramRuttike vA mRudAvaphAlakRuShTe~anupahate~anyairbalavattarairdrumairauShadhAni jAtAni prashasyante||9||
1.commentary: yathAkAlamiti yathAkAlaM shishirAdibhiH sevite deshe| shmashAnAdibhiH pratyekaM virahitashabdaH sambadhyate| devayajanenAgArashabdaH sambadhyate| sabhA janamelakasthAnam| na phAlena kRuShTa iti aphAlakRuShTe||9||

1.sanskrit: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnyupAgatasampUrNapramANa-rasavIrya-gandhAni kAlAtapAgnisalilapavanajantubhiranupahatagandha-varNa-rasa-sparsha-prabhAvANi pratyagrANyudIcyAM dishi sthitAni; teShAM shAkhApalAshamaciraprarUDhaM varShAvasantayorgrAhyaM, grIShme mUlAni shishire vA shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAM, sharadi tvakkandakShIrANi, hemante sArANi, yathartu puShpaphalamiti; ma~ggalAcAraH kalyANavRuttaH shuciH shuklavAsAH sampUjya devatA ashvinau gobrAhmaNAMshca kRutopavAsaH prA~gmukha uda~gmukho vA gRuhNIyAt||10||
1.commentary: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnItyanenaiva kAlasampaducyate; kAlajAtAnIti svakAlabhUtAni| upAgatasampUrNetyAdinA pratyagrANItyantena guNasampaducyate| pratyagrANIti sampUrNaguNatayA niShpannAni| teShAM shAkhApalAshamityAdinA kAlasampadamuktAM prapa~jcayati| shAkhAgrahaNenaiva tvagAdInAmapi grahaNam| shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAmiti cchedaH| grIShme mUlAni shishire veti kathanena yAnyAgneyAni teShAM mUlAni grIShme, yAni saumyAni teShAM mUlAni shishire, grAhyANIti vyavasthAM sUcayati; uktaM hyanyatra- “saumyAnyauShadhAni saumyeShvRutuShvAdadIta, AgneyAnyAgneyeShu” (su.sU.a.36) iti| bheShajagrahaNavidhAnamAha- ma~ggaletyAdi||10||

1.sanskrit: gRuhItvA cAnurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnyAgAreShU prAgudagdvAreShu nivAtapravAtaikadesheShu nityapuShpopahArabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhUma-rajo-mUShaka-catuShpadAmanabhigamanIyAni svavacchannAni shikyeShvAsajya sthApayet||11||
1.commentary: bhAjanasampadamAha- gRuhItvetyAdi| anurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnIti anurUpaguNavattA ca bhAjanasya bheShajasamAnaguNatayaiva| svavacchannAnIti samyakpihitAni||11||

1.sanskrit: tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjIta surA-sauvIraka-tuShodaka-maireya-medaka-dhAnyAmla -phalAmla-dadhyamlAdibhirvAte, mRudvIkAmalaka -madhu-madhuka-parUShaka-phANitakShIrAdibhiH pitte, shleShmaNi tu madhu-mUtra-kaShAyAdibhirbhAvitAnyAloDitAni ca; ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNa dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdIni pravibhajya vyAkhyAsyAmaH||12||
1.commentary: sa~gkShepeNa madanaphalAdInAM vAtAdibhedena bhAvanAloDanadravyANyAha- tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjItetyAdi| dhAnyAmlaM kA~jjikaM, phalAmlaM dADimarasAdi| shleShmaNItyAdau kaShAyashabdena shleShmaharadravyakvAtho~abhipretaH| uddesha iti sa~gkShepAbhidhAnamityarthaH| dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdInItyatra Adishabdena prakRutibalAdInAM grahaNam||12||

1.sanskrit: vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate, anapAyitvAt| tAni vasantagrIShmayorantare puShyAshvayugbhyAM mRugashirasA vA gRuhNIyAnmaitre muhUrte| yAni pakvAnyakANAnyaharitAni pANDUnyakrimINyapUtInyajantujagdhAnyahrasvAni; tAni pramRujya , kushapuTe baddhvA, gomayenAlipya, yavatu(bu)ShamAShashAlikulatthamudgapalAnAmanyatame nidadhyAdaShTarAtram| ata UrdhvaM mRudUbhUtAni madhviShTagandhAnyuddhRutya shoShayet| sushuShkANAM phalapippalIruddharet | tAsAM ghRutadadhimadhupalalavimRuditAnAM punaH shuShkANAM navaM kalashaM supramRuShTavAlukamarajaskamAkaNThaM pUrayitvA svavacchannaM svanuguptaM shikyeShvAsajya samyak sthApayet||13||
1.commentary: vamanadravyANAmityAdinA madanaphalasya prAdhAnyopadarshanapUrvakaM prayogavidhimAha| anapAyitvAditi vamanadravyAntarApekShayA~alpavyApattikatvAt| antare iti madhye, sa ca grIShmavasantayorantarvartikatipayadinAnyeva madhyo j~jeyaH| ashvayuk ashvinI| maitre muhUrta iti shivabhujagamitrAdInAM madhye mitradevatAke, evaM maitre muhUrte| palAnAmiti rAshInAm| madhuvadiShTagandho yeShAM tAni, yAni madhviShTagandhAni bhavanti tAni grAhyANIti darshayati| phalapippalIriti madanaphalamadhyagatAni pippalIsaMsthAnAni bIjAni| tAsAmityAdi pUraNavAcakashabdayogAt karaNe ShaShThI| svanuguptamiti kRutarakShAvidhAnam||13||

1.sanskrit: atha cchardanIyamAturaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannaM shvashchardayitavyamiti grAmyAnUpaudakamAMsarasa-kShIra-dadhi-mASha-tila-shAkAdibhiH samutkleshitashleShmANaM vyuShitaM jIrNAhAraM pUrvAhNe kRutabalihomama~ggalaprAyashcittaM nirannamanatisnigdhaM yavAgvA ghRutamAtrAM pItavantaM, tAsAM phalapippalInAmantarnakhamuShTiM yAvadvA sAdhu manyeta jarjarIkRutya yaShTimadhukaShAyeNa kovidAra-karbudAra-nIpa-vidula-bimbI-shaNapuShpI-sadApuShpI-pratyakpuShpI-kaShAyANAmanyatamena vA rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtaM madhusaindhavayuktaM sukhoShNaM kRutvA pUrNaM sharAvaM mantreNAnenAbhimantrayet- ‘OM brahmadakShAshvirudrendrabhUcandrArkAnilAnalAH| RuShayaH sauShadhigrAmA bhUtasa~gghAshca pAntu te| rasAyanamivarShINAM devAnAmamRutaM yathA| sudhevottamanAgAnAM bhaiShajyamidamastu te’| ityevamabhimantryoda~gmukhaM prA~gmukhaM vA~a~aturaM pAyayecchleShmajvaragulmapratishyAyArtaM visheSheNa punaH punarApittAgamanAt, tena sAdhu vamati; hInavegaM tu pippalyAmalaka-sarShapa-vacAkalkalavaNoShNodakaiH punaH punaH pravartayedApittadarshanAt| ityeSha sarvashchardanayogavidhiH||14||
1.commentary: dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannamityanena abhya~gge kriyamANe snehasahacaritasvedopapAdanaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA vidhIyate, “tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya iShTaH” (si.a.1) ityanena pAnaprayujyamAnasnehasya saptarAtraM trirAtraM vA prakarSha ucyate iti na virodhaH| etaccAbhya~ggasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraNaM pAnasnehAntadivasamArabhya kriyate, tena snehapAnavishrAmadinena samaM dvyahatryahapUraNamabhya~ggasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati| snehapAnAcca yadvishrAmadinam, “ekAhoparatastadvadbhuktvA pracchardanaM pibet” (sU.a.13) ityanenoktaM, tathaivehApi| kaphotkleshakAribhojanamAha- shvashchardayitavyamityAdinA| shva iti parasminnahni| vyuShitamiti rAtrimatikrAntam| nirannamiti padacchedaH| anatisnigdhamityAdinA vamanadina eva ghRutamAtrAyuktayavAgUpAnapUrvakaM vamanamanatisnigdhapuruShaviShayaM brUte| anye tu pUrvadina evAnatisnigdhasya ghRutamAtrAM pItavata eva yavAgvAH pAnamAhuH, “peshalairvividhairannairdoShAnutkleshya dehinaH| snigdhasvinnAya vamanaM dattaM samyak pravartate|| athAparedyuH pUrvAhNe sAdhAraNe kAle vamanadravyakaShAyakalkacUrNasnehAnAmanyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ityAdi sushrutokteH| antarnakhamuShTimiti antarIkRutanakhamuShTiparimANam| yAvadvA sAdhu manyetetyanena mAtrAyA baladoShAdibhedenAsthiratvamityAha| yaShTImadhukasya kovidArAdiShu vicchedapATha uttaraprayogeShu kovidArAderyaShTImadhuvirahitasya grahaNArthaH| kovidAraH svanAmakhyAtaH, sa sharadi puShpati; karbudArastu kA~jcanAraH, sa vasante puShpati; nIpaH kadambaH, vidulaH vetasaH, shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA, sadApuShpI arkapuShpikA, pratyakpuShpI apAmArgaH| rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtamiti shRutakaShAyAt kaShAyAntaropadarshakaM pakShAntaraM; kiMvA, kaShAyapAna eva shItakaShAyavidhAnamihocyate| pUrNaM sharAvamiti ma~ggalArthaM pUrNakumbhavat| punaH punariti yAvat pittAgamanaM na bhavati tAvat punaH punaH kaShAyaM pibedityarthaH| anyatrApyuktaM- “pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhaM” (si.a.1) ityAdi| vamanAyogakArakahInavegapravRuttipratikArArthamAha- hInavegamityAdi||14||

1.sanskrit: sarveShu tu madhusaindhavaM kaphavilayanacchedArthaM vamaneShu vidadhyAt| na coShNavirodho madhunashchardanayogayuktasya, avipakvapratyAgamanAddoShanirharaNAcca||15||
1.commentary: yadyapi ca ghreyAdivamanayogeShu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathA~api ‘sarveShu’ iti padaM bAhulyArtham| vamanArthakaShAye uShNe madhuprakShepo virodhitvAnna yujyate, uktaM hi- “madhUShNamuShNArtamathavA” (sU.a.27) ityAdi, evamAsha~gkya samAdhAnamAha na coShNavirodho madhuna ityAdi| avipakvapratyAgamanAdityanena pacyamAnaM madhUShNayuktaM virudhyeteti darshayati| doShanirharaNAcceti madhUShNaviruddhamapi vamanayoge uShNe iShyate, tasya doShanirharaNAdeva na virodho bhavatIti darshayati| evaM bastiprayoge~api madhuna uShNAvirodho varNanIyaH| etena yaShTImadhvAdinavadravyakRutairnavabhiH kaShAyairnavayogAH||15||

1.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM dvau dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH srAvayet, tena rasena tRutIyaM bhAgaM piShTvA mAtrAM harItakIbhirbibhItakairAmalairvA tulyAM vartayet, tAsAmekAM dve vA pUrvoktAnAM kaShAyANAmanyatamasyA~jjalimAtreNa vimRudya balavacchleShmaprasekagranthijvarodarAruciShu pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||16||
1.commentary: phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgAvityAdau phalapippalInAM bhAgatrayaM kartavyaM; tatra bhAgadvayaM ShaDguNena kovidArAdikaShAyeNa kShAraparisrAvaNavidhivadekaviMshativArAn parisrAvaNIyam| kovidArAdInAM cAShTAnAmaShTau kaShAyAH pRuthak parisrAvaNe prayoktavyAH| yena ca kaShAyeNa phalapippalIbhAgadvayaM parisrAvya haritakyAdiparimANA mAtrA tRutIyabhAgaphalapippalIkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaShAyeNa mAtrAyogAH ; evamaShTau harItakyAdimAtrayA nirdiShTAH phalapippalIyogA bhavanti| mAtrAvikalpashca doShabalAdivikalpakRuto j~jeyaH| samAnaM pUrveNeti pUrvayogavadiha snehasvedAbhimantraNAdividhAnaM kartavyamityarthaH| evamanyatrApi pUrvavacchabdArtho j~jeyaH||16||

1.sanskrit: phalapippalIkShIraM, tena vA kShIrayavAgUmadhobhAge raktapitte hRuddAhe ca; tajjasya vA dadhna uttarakaM kaphaccharditamakaprasekeShu ; tasya vA payasaH shItasya santAnikA~jjaliM pitte prakupite uraHkaNThahRudaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samAnaM pUrveNa||17||
1.commentary: phalapippalyA kShIrapAkavidhinA sAdhitaM kShIraM phalapippalIkShIram; ayameko yogaH| teneti phalapippalIsAdhitakShIreNa| tajjasyeti phalapippalIkShIrajAtasya dadhnaH| uttarakamiti saram| santAnikA kShIroparisthaH styAno bhAgaH||17||

1.sanskrit: phalapippalIshRutakShIrAnnavanItamutpannaM phalAdikalkakaShAyasiddhaM kaphAbhibhUtAgniM vishuShyaddehaM ca mAtrayA pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||18||
1.commentary: phalAdIni phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAni ShaT| ete kShIrayogacatuShTayena ghRutayogena ca samaM pa~jca yogA adhyAyasa~ggrahe vaktavyA||18||

1.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH suparibhAvitena puShparajaHprakAshena cUrNena sarasi sa~jjAtaM bRuhatsaroruhaM sAyAhne~avacUrNayet, tadrAtrivyuShitaM prabhAte punaravacUrNitamuddhRutya haridrAkRusarakShIrayavAgUnAmanyatamaM saindhavaguDaphANitayuktamAkaNThaM pItavantamAghrApayet sukumAramutkliShTapittakaphamauShadhadveShiNamiti samAnaM pUrveNa||19||
1.commentary: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNetyAdinA ekaM ghreyayogamAha| puShparajaHprakAsheneti puShpadhUlisadRushena| haridrAbhidhAnaH kRusharo haridrAkRusharaH||19||

1.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM bhallAtakavidhiparisrutaM svarasaM paktvA phANitIbhUtamAtantulIbhAvAllehayet; AtapashuShkaM vA cUrNIkRutaM jImUtakAdikaShAyeNa pitte kaphasthAnagate pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||20||
1.commentary: bhallAtakavidhiparisrutamiti rasAyanoktabhallAtakasnehagrahaNavidhAnena parisrutaH svaraso grAhyaH| phANitayogo~ayamekaH| AtapashuShkaM vetyAdinA cUrNayogo~apyekaH||20||

1.sanskrit: phalapippalIcUrNAni pUrvavat phalAdInAM ShaNNAmanyatamakaShAyasrutAni vartikriyAH phalAdikaShAyopasarjanAH peyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||21||
1.commentary: phalapippalIcUrNAnItyAdau phalAdiShaTkaShAyabhedena kRutatvAt ShaD vartiprayogA j~jeyAH| vartikriyAyAM caturguNena kvAthena pAkAdvartyAkAratA kartavyA| atrApi ca tathA lehAdau ca sAmAnyoktena madhuprakShepo yuktaH; taM caike madhunaH pAkavirodhAnnAnumanyante||21||

1.sanskrit: phalapippalInAmAragvadha -vRukShaka-svAdukaNTaka-pAThA-pATalA-shAr~ggeShTA-mUrvA-saptaparNa-naktamAla-picumarda-paTola-suShavI-guDUcI-somavalka-dvIpikAnAM pippalI-pippalImUla-hastipippalI-citraka-shRu~ggaverANAM cAnyatamakaShAyeNa siddho leha iti samAnaM pUrveNa||22||
1.commentary: phalapippalInAmAragvadhetyAdinA AragvadhAdiviMshatidravyakvAthabhedena kRutatvAdviMshatirlehA j~jeyAH| vRukShakaH kuTajaH, svAdukaNTakaH vika~gkataH, shAr~ggeShTA gu~jjA, suShavI kAravellakaM, dvIpikA hiMsrA, ‘kaNTakArI’ ityanye||22||

1.sanskrit: phalapippalIShvelA-hareNukA-shatapuShpA-kustumburu-tagara-kuShTha-tvak-coraka-marubakAguru-guggulvelavAluka-shrIveShTaka-paripelava-mAMsI-shaileyaka-sthauNeyaka-sarala-pArAvatapadyashokarohiNInAM viMshateranyatamasya kaShAyeNa sAdhitotkArikA utkArikAkalpena, modakA vA modakakalpena, yathAdoSharogabhakti prayojyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||23||
1.commentary: phalapippalIShvityAdinotkArikA modakAshca pratyekaM viMshatiH| corakaH gandhadravyaM svanAmakhyAtaM, paripelavaM kaivartamustakaM, sthauNeyakaH granthiparNakaM, pArAvatapadI jyotiShmatI, ashokarohiNI ashokasadRushapatrA latA, ‘kaTurohiNI’ ityanye| kecidatra sthauNeyakaM parityajyApAkIpAdyA viMshatiM pUrayanti, apAkIpAdI svanAmakhyAtA| utkArikAkalpeneti sUdashAstroktotkArikAvidhAnena||23||

1.sanskrit: phalapippalIsvarasakaShAyaparibhAvitAni tilashAlitaNDulapiShTAni tatkaShAyopasarjanAni shaShkulIkalpena vA shaShkulyaH, pUpakalpena vA pUpAH iti samAnaM pUrveNa||24|| etenaiva ca kalpena sumukha-surasa-kuTheraka-kANDIra-kAlamAlaka-parNAsaka-kShavaka-phaNijjhaka-gRu~jjana-kAsamarda-bhRu~ggarAjAnAM poTekShuvAlikA-kAla~gkataka-daNDairakANAM cAnyatamasya kaShAyeNa kArayet||25||
1.commentary: phalapippalIsvarasenetyAdinA shaShkulyapUpayoH pRuthageko yogaH| etenaiva ca kalpenetyAdinA sumukhAdipa~jcadashadravyakaShAyeNa pRuthak shaShkulyapUpayoH karaNAt pa~jcadasha yogA bhavanti| evaM militvA shaShkulIpUpayoH pRuthak ShoDashayogA bhavanti| poTA ikShugandhA; daNDairakA gundrAkhyagulmaH, nalo vA||24-25||

1.sanskrit: tathA badaraShADava-rAga-leha-modakotkArikA-tarpaNa-pAnaka-mAMsarasa-yUSha-madyAnAM madanaphalAnyanyatamenopasRujya yathAdoSharogabhakti dadyAt; taiH sAdhu vamatIti||26||
1.commentary: tathA badaraShADavetyAdinA dasha yogAH| badarakRutaH ShADavo badaraShADavaH||26||

1.sanskrit: madanaH karahATashca rAThaH piNDItakaH phalam| shvasanashceti paryAyairucyate tasya kalpanA||27||
1.commentary: madanasya vyavahArArthaM paryAyAnAha- madanaH karahATashcetyAdi| tasya kalpaneti ya evambhUtaiH paryAyairvyAkhyAtastasyeyaM kalpanA| asya ca paryAyAbhidhAnaM bhUriprayogeShu vihitatvenAbhyarhitatvAjj~jeyam| evamanyatrApi paryAyAbhidhAne prayojanaM varNanIyam||27||

1.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- nava yogAH kaShAyeShu, mAtrAsvaShTau , payoghRute| pa~jca, phANitacUrNe dvau ghreye, vartikriyAsu ShaT||28|| viMshatirviMshatirlehamodakotkArikAsu ca| shaShkulIpUpayoshcoktA yogAH ShoDasha ShoDasha||29|| dashAnye ShADavAdyeShu trayastriMshadidaM shatam| yogAnAM vidhivaddiShTaM phalakalpe maharShiNA||30||
1.commentary: madanaphalayogAnAM navAdisa~gkhyotkarShanirAsArthaM sukhasmaraNArthaM ca tAn sa~ggraheNAha- nava yogA ityAdi| asya cArtho yathAsthAnaM vyAhRutaH||28-30||

1.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute~aprApte dRuDhabalasampUrite kalpasthAne madanakalpo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
1.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM kalpasthAne madanakalpo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

2.sanskrit: athAto madanakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
2.commentary: cikitsitasthAne tu tatra tatra vihitavamanavirecanayoH prayogAn vistareNAbhidhAtuM cikitsAdhikRutayogasthAnarUpakalpasthAnamucyate| yadyapi cikitsAyAM basterapi pratipAditatvAdbastyabhidhAyakaM siddhisthAnamapi cikitsA~ggatayA~abhidhAtavyaM, tathA~api pa~jcakarmaNAmautsargikapravRuttau vamanavirecanapUrvikaiva bastikarmapravRuttirbhavatIti kRutvA vamanavirecanAbhidhAyakaM kalpasthAnameva bastyabhidhAyakasiddhisthAnAdagre~abhidhIyate| vamanavirecanAnAM kalpAstiShThantyasminniti kalpasthAnam| kalpAbhidhAne~api virecanasyautsargikapravRuttau vamanapUrvikaiva pravRuttirbhavatIti vamanapUrvakatvAdvirecanasya vamanakalpA evAgre~abhidhAtavyAH| vamanakalpeShvapi vamanadravyashreShThatvAnmadanaphalasyaivAdau kalpo~abhidhIyate; shreShThatvaM ca madanaphalasya ‘vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate~anapAyitvAt’ ityanenAtraiva vakShyati||1-2||

2.sanskrit: atha khalu vamanavirecanArthaM vamanavirecanadravyANAM sukhopabhogatamaiH sahAnyairdravyairvividhaiH kalpanArthaM bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyarthaH , tadyogAnAM ca kriyAvidheH sukhopAyasya samyagupakalpanArthaM kalpasthAnamupadekShyAmo~agnivesha!||3||
2.commentary: kalpArthaM darshayannAha- atha khalvityAdi| athashabdaH prAkprastute| khalushabdaH prakAshane| vamanavirecanArthamiti vamananimittaM virecananimittaM ca| vamanavirecanadravyANAmiti madanaphalAditrivRudAdInAm| anyairiti surAsauvIrakAdyaiH kovidArAdiprakAraishca| anyairityasya visheShaNaM- sukhopabhogatamairiti| atra sukhAyopabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, na tadAtvasukha upabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, tathAhi tadAtve~asukhopabhogAnAM kovidArAdInAmagrahaNaM syAt| kalpanArthamiti padasya kriyayA sambandhamadarshayitvaiva tadvyAkhyAnapratyayanArthaM vyAkaroti bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyartha iti; tatra bhedArthamiti vamanavirecanadravyaprayogabhedArthaM, te ca prayogabhedAH “trayastriMshadyogashataM praNItaM phaleShu” (sU.a.4) ityAdikAH; vibhAgArthamiti atra ‘phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa’, ityAdivakShyamANadravyavibhAgArtham| upodghAtaM samApya prakRutamAha- tadyogAnAmiti; vamanavirecanadravyaprayogANam| kriyAyA itikartavyatAyA vidhiH kriyAvidhiH, svarasAdirUpatayA karaNAnIti yAvat; tasya kriyAvidhervisheShaNaM- sukhopAyasyeti; sukhArthaH sukho vA upAyo yasya sa sukhopAyaH, tasya samyagupakalpanArthamiti samyagupadeshArtham||3||

2.sanskrit: tatra doShaharaNamUrdhvabhAgaM vamanasa~jj~jakam, adhobhAgaM virecanasa~jj~jakam; ubhayaM vA sharIramalavirecanAdvirecanasa~jj~jAM labhate||4||
2.commentary: vamanavirecanashabdArthaM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| UrdhvaM mukhena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti UrdhvabhAgam| adho gudena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti adhobhAgam| vamanavirecanayorapi kadAcidvirecanasa~jj~jAM ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktAM darshayannAha- ubhayamapItyAdi| na caivaM sati vamanavirecanavannirUhe~api virecanasa~jj~jAprasaktirudbhAvanIyA , yataH pa~gkajashabdavadiyaM virecanasa~jj~jA vamanavirecanayoreva yogarUDhyA vartate||4||

2.sanskrit: tatroShNa-tIkShNa-sUkShma-vyavAyi-vikAshInyauShadhAni svavIryeNa hRudayamupetya dhamanIranusRutya sthUlANusrotobhyaH kevalaM sharIragataM doShasa~gghAtamAgneyatvAd viShyandayanti, taikShNyAd vicchindanti, sa vicchinnaH pariplavan snehabhAvite kAye snehAktabhAjanasthamiva kShaudramasajjannaNupravaNabhAvAdAmAshayamAgamyodAnapraNunno~agnivAyvAtmakatvAdUrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAdauShadhasyordhvamutkShipyate, salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdadhobhAgaprabhAvAccauShadhasyAdhaH pravartate, ubhayatashcobhayaguNatvAt| iti lakShaNoddeshaH||5||
2.commentary: samprati dvayorapi vamanavirecanadravyayoH sAdhAraNoShNatIkShNatvAdiguNayogakRutadoShaviShyandanAdisAdhAraNakAryadarshanapUrvakamagnivAyvAtmakatvAdivishiShTadharmayogakRutaM vishiShTaM ca kAryaM vamanavirecanarUpaM darshayannAha- tatroShNetyAdi| uShNamiti uShNavIryam| svavIryeNeti svaprabhAveNa| dhamanIranusRutyeti sakaladehagatA dhamanIranusRutya; sakaladehagatadhamanyanusaraNaM ca vIryeNa j~jeyaM, na sAkShAt| AgneyatvAdviShyandayantIti vilInaM kurvanti| vicchindanti chinnaM kurvanti| pariplavan itastato gacchan| asajjanniti na kvacidapi sa~ggaM gacchan| aNupravaNabhAvAditi aNutvAt pravaNabhAvAcca; pravaNatvamiha koShThagamanonmukhatvam, aNutvaM ca aNumArgasa~jcAritvam| udAnapraNunna iti udAnavAyupreritaH| agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi agnivAyUtkarShavattvAt| UrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAditi UrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvarUpaprabhAvAt| evaM salilapRuthivyAtmakatvamapi vyAkhyeyam| ubhayatashceti Urdhvamadhashca kShipyata ityarthaH| ubhayaguNatvAditi agnivAyvAtmakatvAt salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdUrdhvAdhobhAgaprabhAvAccetyarthaH| iti lakShaNoddesha iti anantaragranthena vamanavirecanadravyasvarUpAbhidhAnaM kRutamityarthaH| atra ca prakaraNe sAmAnyenaiva vamanavirecanadravyANAm ‘AgneyatvAdviShyandayanti’ ityanenAgneyatvaM pratipAditaM; punashca visheSheNa ‘agnivAyvAtmakatvAt’ iti padena vamanadravyasyAgnyAtmakatvaM pratipAdyate; tena, sAmAnye visheShe ca vamanadravyANAmAgneyatvapratipAdanAt prakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati; virecanadravyANAM tu sAmAnyoktAgneyatvasambandhAd visheShaguNakathanaprastAve ca salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAbhidhAnAdvamanadravyApekShayA~apakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati| tathAhi sushrute~api vamanavirecanayorapyAgneyatvamuktaM- “saratva-saukShmya-taikShNyauShNya-vikAshitvairvirecanam| vamanaM ca hareddoShAn prakRutyA gatamanyathA” (su.ci.a.33) ityanena| yaccAtrocyate-vamanaM yadyUrdhvabhAgaharatvaprabhAvAdUrdhvayati, tadA~agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi hetuvarNanaM na yujyate; yataH, yat sopapattikaM kAryaM na bhavati tat prabhAvakRutamiti vyapadishyate; uktaM hi- “prabhAvo~acintya ucyate” (sU.a.26) iti| tanna, yataH prabhAvasyaiveha vamanakArye vAyvagnyAtmakaguNatayA vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM heturupadRu(di)shyate, na tu vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM svatantro vamanahetuH; tathAhi sati yadanyadapi vAyvagnyAtmakamUrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvaprabhAvarahitaM, tadapi vamanakaraM syAt; yathA- kaTukarase dravye tat syAt; tasmAt prabhAvaguNatayaiva hetuvarNanam| evaM virecanadravye~api pUrvapakShasiddhAntAvanusartavyau||5||

2.sanskrit: tatra phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAnAM, shyAmA-trivRuccatura~ggula-tilvaka-mahAvRukSha-saptalA-sha~gkhinI-dantI-dravantInAM ca, nAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAsvAda-rasa-vIrya-vipAka-prabhAvagrahaNAd deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcca , vicitragandha-varNa-rasa-sparshAnAmupayogasukhArthamasa~gkhyeyasaMyogAnAmapi ca satAM dravyANAM vikalpamArgopadarshanArthaM ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH||6||
2.commentary: samprati kalpasthAnavaktavyatayA ShaDvirecanaprayogashatAnyanatisa~gkShepavistaraprayogopadarshanapUrvakaM pratijAnIte- tatra phaletyAdinA ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAma ityantena| tatra kRutavedhanAntAnAM vicchedapAThena vamanaprayogaprayojyatvaM, shyAmAdInAM virecanaprayogaprayojyatvaM ca darshayati| atraiva vamane virecane caikaikeShAM punarvastUnAM madanaphalAdInAM shyAmAdInAM ca bahavaH prayogA abhidhIyante, na punarekaikameva dravyaM vamanakArakaM virecanakArakaM vA; svalpasa~gkhyAprayogeNa grahaNasukhatA vamanavirecanayogasya bhavati, kAryaM ca sidhyatItyAsha~gkyAha- nAnAvidhetyAdi yAvadrogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcceti| asyArthaH- yasmAnnAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAH, nAnAvidhAsvAdAH, nAnAvidhavIryAH, nAnAvidhavipAkAH, nAnAvidhaprabhAvAshca madanaphalAdikA oShadhyaH, tathA tatsaMskArakAH kovidArAdikA oShadhya upalabhyante; puruShAshca deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAbhinnA nAnAvidhA dRushyante; tena naikaM dravyaM sarvasmin dehadoShAdau yaugikaM, sarvatra kAle vA prApyate sarvatra deshe vA; tasmAddehadoShAdinA bhedavati puruShe bahUnyeva dravyANi bahubhishca prayogairupakalpitAni yathAyogyatayA yathAprApti ca prayoktuM shakyante; ato bahunAmeva madanAdidravyANAM bahuprakAraprayogANAmupanyAso yukta iti bhAvaH| grahaNAt upalambhAt| deho nAnA sthUlakRushAdibhedena, bhaktiH icchA, avasthAshabdeneha rogAvasthaiva grAhyA, Adishabdeneha sattvAhArayorgrahaNam| bhUrivirecanaprayogopadarshanaprayojanAntaramapyAha- vicitretyAdi| nAnAvidhagandha-varNa-rasatayA prayoge tatkAlamuttarakAlaM ca sukhArthamityarthaH| atha kiM prabhedAnmadanaphalAdInAM ShaTprayogashatAni bhavanti, yenAdhikAH prayogA nAbhidhIyanta ityAsha~gkyAha- asa~gkhyeyetyAdi| vikalpamArgopadarshanArthamiti adhikaprayogakalpanAsamarthAn bhiShajaH prati etat ShaTprayogashatopadarshanaM kartavyAdhikaprayogakalpanAmArgopadarshakaM, tenApare~apyatra prayogAH kalpanIyAH; granthe niHsheShaprayogAnabhidhAnaM prayogANAmasa~gkhyeyatvenAshakyatvAdeva| anativistareNa ShaTprayogashatAbhidhAnaM mandabuddhisaMvyavahArArthamiti bhAvaH| uktaM hyanyatra- “etAvanto hyalamalpabuddhInAM vyavahArAya, buddhimatAM ca svAlakShaNyAnumAnayuktikushalAnAmanuktArthaj~jAnAya” (sU.a.4) iti||6||

2.sanskrit: tAni tu dravyANi desha-kAla-guNa-bhAjana-sampadvIryabalAdhAnAt kriyAsamarthatamAni bhavanti||7||
2.commentary: samprati vamanavirecanadravyANAM deshAdisampattyA guNotkarShaM darshayannAha- tAnItyAdi| deshAdibhishcaturbhiH sampacchabdaH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bhAjanaM bheShajasthApanasthAnam| vIryasya balaM vIryAdhikatvameva||7||

2.sanskrit: trividhaH khalu deshaH- jA~ggalaH, AnUpaH, sAdhAraNashceti| tatra jA~ggalaH paryAkAshabhUyiShThaH, tarubhirapi ca kadara-khadirAsanAshvakarNa-dhava-tinisha-shallakI-sAla-somavalka-badarI-tindukAshvattha-vaTAmalakIvanagahanaH, anekashamI-kakubha-shiMshapAprAyaH, sthirashuShkapavanabalavidhUyamAnapranRutyattaruNaviTapaH, pratatamRugatRuShNikopagUDhatanukharaparuShasikatAsharkarAbahulaH, lAvatittiricakorAnucaritabhUmibhAgaH, vAtapittabahulaH, sthirakaThinamanuShyaprAyo j~jeyaH, athAnUpo hintAlatamAlanArikelakadalIvanagahanaH, saritsamudraparyantaprAyaH, shishirapavanabahulaH, va~jjulavAnIropashobhitatIrAbhiH saridbhirupagatabhUmibhAgaH, kShitidharaniku~jjopashobhitaH, mandapavanAnuvIjitakShitiruhagahanaH, anekavanarAjIpuShpitavanagahanabhUmibhAgaH, snigdhatarupratAnopagUDhaH, haMsa-cakravAka-balAkA-nandImukha-puNDarIka-kAdamba-madgu -bhRu~ggarAja-shatapatra-mattakokilAnunAditataruviTapaH, sukumArapuruShaH, pavanakaphaprAyo j~jeyaH; anayoreva dvayordeshayorvIrudvanaspativAnaspatyashakunimRugagaNayutaH sthirasukumArabalavarNasaMhananopapannasAdhAraNaguNayuktapuruShaH sAdhAraNo j~jeyaH||8||
2.commentary: deshAdi samyag vyAkurvannAha- tatra trividha ityAdi| atra kecijjA~ggalAdideshalakShaNagranthaM na paThanti, tattu janapadoddhvaMsanIye paThitamiti kRutvehAnArShaM vadanti| yaistu janapadoddhvaMsanIye jA~ggalAdilakShaNaM na paThyate, tairatra paThanIya evAyaM granthaH||8||

2.sanskrit: tatra deshe sAdhAraNe jA~ggale vA yathAkAlaM shishirAtapapavanasalilasevite same shucau pradakShiNodake shmashAna-caitya-devayajanAgAra-sabhA-shvabhrArAma-valmIkoSharavirahite kusharohiShAstIrNe snigdhakRuShNamadhuramRuttike suvarNavarNamadhuramRuttike vA mRudAvaphAlakRuShTe~anupahate~anyairbalavattarairdrumairauShadhAni jAtAni prashasyante||9||
2.commentary: yathAkAlamiti yathAkAlaM shishirAdibhiH sevite deshe| shmashAnAdibhiH pratyekaM virahitashabdaH sambadhyate| devayajanenAgArashabdaH sambadhyate| sabhA janamelakasthAnam| na phAlena kRuShTa iti aphAlakRuShTe||9||

2.sanskrit: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnyupAgatasampUrNapramANa-rasavIrya-gandhAni kAlAtapAgnisalilapavanajantubhiranupahatagandha-varNa-rasa-sparsha-prabhAvANi pratyagrANyudIcyAM dishi sthitAni; teShAM shAkhApalAshamaciraprarUDhaM varShAvasantayorgrAhyaM, grIShme mUlAni shishire vA shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAM, sharadi tvakkandakShIrANi, hemante sArANi, yathartu puShpaphalamiti; ma~ggalAcAraH kalyANavRuttaH shuciH shuklavAsAH sampUjya devatA ashvinau gobrAhmaNAMshca kRutopavAsaH prA~gmukha uda~gmukho vA gRuhNIyAt||10||
2.commentary: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnItyanenaiva kAlasampaducyate; kAlajAtAnIti svakAlabhUtAni| upAgatasampUrNetyAdinA pratyagrANItyantena guNasampaducyate| pratyagrANIti sampUrNaguNatayA niShpannAni| teShAM shAkhApalAshamityAdinA kAlasampadamuktAM prapa~jcayati| shAkhAgrahaNenaiva tvagAdInAmapi grahaNam| shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAmiti cchedaH| grIShme mUlAni shishire veti kathanena yAnyAgneyAni teShAM mUlAni grIShme, yAni saumyAni teShAM mUlAni shishire, grAhyANIti vyavasthAM sUcayati; uktaM hyanyatra- “saumyAnyauShadhAni saumyeShvRutuShvAdadIta, AgneyAnyAgneyeShu” (su.sU.a.36) iti| bheShajagrahaNavidhAnamAha- ma~ggaletyAdi||10||

2.sanskrit: gRuhItvA cAnurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnyAgAreShU prAgudagdvAreShu nivAtapravAtaikadesheShu nityapuShpopahArabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhUma-rajo-mUShaka-catuShpadAmanabhigamanIyAni svavacchannAni shikyeShvAsajya sthApayet||11||
2.commentary: bhAjanasampadamAha- gRuhItvetyAdi| anurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnIti anurUpaguNavattA ca bhAjanasya bheShajasamAnaguNatayaiva| svavacchannAnIti samyakpihitAni||11||

2.sanskrit: tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjIta surA-sauvIraka-tuShodaka-maireya-medaka-dhAnyAmla -phalAmla-dadhyamlAdibhirvAte, mRudvIkAmalaka -madhu-madhuka-parUShaka-phANitakShIrAdibhiH pitte, shleShmaNi tu madhu-mUtra-kaShAyAdibhirbhAvitAnyAloDitAni ca; ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNa dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdIni pravibhajya vyAkhyAsyAmaH||12||
2.commentary: sa~gkShepeNa madanaphalAdInAM vAtAdibhedena bhAvanAloDanadravyANyAha- tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjItetyAdi| dhAnyAmlaM kA~jjikaM, phalAmlaM dADimarasAdi| shleShmaNItyAdau kaShAyashabdena shleShmaharadravyakvAtho~abhipretaH| uddesha iti sa~gkShepAbhidhAnamityarthaH| dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdInItyatra Adishabdena prakRutibalAdInAM grahaNam||12||

2.sanskrit: vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate, anapAyitvAt| tAni vasantagrIShmayorantare puShyAshvayugbhyAM mRugashirasA vA gRuhNIyAnmaitre muhUrte| yAni pakvAnyakANAnyaharitAni pANDUnyakrimINyapUtInyajantujagdhAnyahrasvAni; tAni pramRujya , kushapuTe baddhvA, gomayenAlipya, yavatu(bu)ShamAShashAlikulatthamudgapalAnAmanyatame nidadhyAdaShTarAtram| ata UrdhvaM mRudUbhUtAni madhviShTagandhAnyuddhRutya shoShayet| sushuShkANAM phalapippalIruddharet | tAsAM ghRutadadhimadhupalalavimRuditAnAM punaH shuShkANAM navaM kalashaM supramRuShTavAlukamarajaskamAkaNThaM pUrayitvA svavacchannaM svanuguptaM shikyeShvAsajya samyak sthApayet||13||
2.commentary: vamanadravyANAmityAdinA madanaphalasya prAdhAnyopadarshanapUrvakaM prayogavidhimAha| anapAyitvAditi vamanadravyAntarApekShayA~alpavyApattikatvAt| antare iti madhye, sa ca grIShmavasantayorantarvartikatipayadinAnyeva madhyo j~jeyaH| ashvayuk ashvinI| maitre muhUrta iti shivabhujagamitrAdInAM madhye mitradevatAke, evaM maitre muhUrte| palAnAmiti rAshInAm| madhuvadiShTagandho yeShAM tAni, yAni madhviShTagandhAni bhavanti tAni grAhyANIti darshayati| phalapippalIriti madanaphalamadhyagatAni pippalIsaMsthAnAni bIjAni| tAsAmityAdi pUraNavAcakashabdayogAt karaNe ShaShThI| svanuguptamiti kRutarakShAvidhAnam||13||

2.sanskrit: atha cchardanIyamAturaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannaM shvashchardayitavyamiti grAmyAnUpaudakamAMsarasa-kShIra-dadhi-mASha-tila-shAkAdibhiH samutkleshitashleShmANaM vyuShitaM jIrNAhAraM pUrvAhNe kRutabalihomama~ggalaprAyashcittaM nirannamanatisnigdhaM yavAgvA ghRutamAtrAM pItavantaM, tAsAM phalapippalInAmantarnakhamuShTiM yAvadvA sAdhu manyeta jarjarIkRutya yaShTimadhukaShAyeNa kovidAra-karbudAra-nIpa-vidula-bimbI-shaNapuShpI-sadApuShpI-pratyakpuShpI-kaShAyANAmanyatamena vA rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtaM madhusaindhavayuktaM sukhoShNaM kRutvA pUrNaM sharAvaM mantreNAnenAbhimantrayet- ‘OM brahmadakShAshvirudrendrabhUcandrArkAnilAnalAH| RuShayaH sauShadhigrAmA bhUtasa~gghAshca pAntu te| rasAyanamivarShINAM devAnAmamRutaM yathA| sudhevottamanAgAnAM bhaiShajyamidamastu te’| ityevamabhimantryoda~gmukhaM prA~gmukhaM vA~a~aturaM pAyayecchleShmajvaragulmapratishyAyArtaM visheSheNa punaH punarApittAgamanAt, tena sAdhu vamati; hInavegaM tu pippalyAmalaka-sarShapa-vacAkalkalavaNoShNodakaiH punaH punaH pravartayedApittadarshanAt| ityeSha sarvashchardanayogavidhiH||14||
2.commentary: dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannamityanena abhya~gge kriyamANe snehasahacaritasvedopapAdanaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA vidhIyate, “tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya iShTaH” (si.a.1) ityanena pAnaprayujyamAnasnehasya saptarAtraM trirAtraM vA prakarSha ucyate iti na virodhaH| etaccAbhya~ggasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraNaM pAnasnehAntadivasamArabhya kriyate, tena snehapAnavishrAmadinena samaM dvyahatryahapUraNamabhya~ggasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati| snehapAnAcca yadvishrAmadinam, “ekAhoparatastadvadbhuktvA pracchardanaM pibet” (sU.a.13) ityanenoktaM, tathaivehApi| kaphotkleshakAribhojanamAha- shvashchardayitavyamityAdinA| shva iti parasminnahni| vyuShitamiti rAtrimatikrAntam| nirannamiti padacchedaH| anatisnigdhamityAdinA vamanadina eva ghRutamAtrAyuktayavAgUpAnapUrvakaM vamanamanatisnigdhapuruShaviShayaM brUte| anye tu pUrvadina evAnatisnigdhasya ghRutamAtrAM pItavata eva yavAgvAH pAnamAhuH, “peshalairvividhairannairdoShAnutkleshya dehinaH| snigdhasvinnAya vamanaM dattaM samyak pravartate|| athAparedyuH pUrvAhNe sAdhAraNe kAle vamanadravyakaShAyakalkacUrNasnehAnAmanyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ityAdi sushrutokteH| antarnakhamuShTimiti antarIkRutanakhamuShTiparimANam| yAvadvA sAdhu manyetetyanena mAtrAyA baladoShAdibhedenAsthiratvamityAha| yaShTImadhukasya kovidArAdiShu vicchedapATha uttaraprayogeShu kovidArAderyaShTImadhuvirahitasya grahaNArthaH| kovidAraH svanAmakhyAtaH, sa sharadi puShpati; karbudArastu kA~jcanAraH, sa vasante puShpati; nIpaH kadambaH, vidulaH vetasaH, shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA, sadApuShpI arkapuShpikA, pratyakpuShpI apAmArgaH| rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtamiti shRutakaShAyAt kaShAyAntaropadarshakaM pakShAntaraM; kiMvA, kaShAyapAna eva shItakaShAyavidhAnamihocyate| pUrNaM sharAvamiti ma~ggalArthaM pUrNakumbhavat| punaH punariti yAvat pittAgamanaM na bhavati tAvat punaH punaH kaShAyaM pibedityarthaH| anyatrApyuktaM- “pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhaM” (si.a.1) ityAdi| vamanAyogakArakahInavegapravRuttipratikArArthamAha- hInavegamityAdi||14||

2.sanskrit: sarveShu tu madhusaindhavaM kaphavilayanacchedArthaM vamaneShu vidadhyAt| na coShNavirodho madhunashchardanayogayuktasya, avipakvapratyAgamanAddoShanirharaNAcca||15||
