2.commentary: yadyapi ca ghreyAdivamanayogeShu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathA~api ‘sarveShu’ iti padaM bAhulyArtham| vamanArthakaShAye uShNe madhuprakShepo virodhitvAnna yujyate, uktaM hi- “madhUShNamuShNArtamathavA” (sU.a.27) ityAdi, evamAsha~gkya samAdhAnamAha na coShNavirodho madhuna ityAdi| avipakvapratyAgamanAdityanena pacyamAnaM madhUShNayuktaM virudhyeteti darshayati| doShanirharaNAcceti madhUShNaviruddhamapi vamanayoge uShNe iShyate, tasya doShanirharaNAdeva na virodho bhavatIti darshayati| evaM bastiprayoge~api madhuna uShNAvirodho varNanIyaH| etena yaShTImadhvAdinavadravyakRutairnavabhiH kaShAyairnavayogAH||15||

2.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM dvau dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH srAvayet, tena rasena tRutIyaM bhAgaM piShTvA mAtrAM harItakIbhirbibhItakairAmalairvA tulyAM vartayet, tAsAmekAM dve vA pUrvoktAnAM kaShAyANAmanyatamasyA~jjalimAtreNa vimRudya balavacchleShmaprasekagranthijvarodarAruciShu pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||16||
2.commentary: phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgAvityAdau phalapippalInAM bhAgatrayaM kartavyaM; tatra bhAgadvayaM ShaDguNena kovidArAdikaShAyeNa kShAraparisrAvaNavidhivadekaviMshativArAn parisrAvaNIyam| kovidArAdInAM cAShTAnAmaShTau kaShAyAH pRuthak parisrAvaNe prayoktavyAH| yena ca kaShAyeNa phalapippalIbhAgadvayaM parisrAvya haritakyAdiparimANA mAtrA tRutIyabhAgaphalapippalIkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaShAyeNa mAtrAyogAH ; evamaShTau harItakyAdimAtrayA nirdiShTAH phalapippalIyogA bhavanti| mAtrAvikalpashca doShabalAdivikalpakRuto j~jeyaH| samAnaM pUrveNeti pUrvayogavadiha snehasvedAbhimantraNAdividhAnaM kartavyamityarthaH| evamanyatrApi pUrvavacchabdArtho j~jeyaH||16||

2.sanskrit: phalapippalIkShIraM, tena vA kShIrayavAgUmadhobhAge raktapitte hRuddAhe ca; tajjasya vA dadhna uttarakaM kaphaccharditamakaprasekeShu ; tasya vA payasaH shItasya santAnikA~jjaliM pitte prakupite uraHkaNThahRudaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samAnaM pUrveNa||17||
2.commentary: phalapippalyA kShIrapAkavidhinA sAdhitaM kShIraM phalapippalIkShIram; ayameko yogaH| teneti phalapippalIsAdhitakShIreNa| tajjasyeti phalapippalIkShIrajAtasya dadhnaH| uttarakamiti saram| santAnikA kShIroparisthaH styAno bhAgaH||17||

2.sanskrit: phalapippalIshRutakShIrAnnavanItamutpannaM phalAdikalkakaShAyasiddhaM kaphAbhibhUtAgniM vishuShyaddehaM ca mAtrayA pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||18||
2.commentary: phalAdIni phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAni ShaT| ete kShIrayogacatuShTayena ghRutayogena ca samaM pa~jca yogA adhyAyasa~ggrahe vaktavyA||18||

2.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH suparibhAvitena puShparajaHprakAshena cUrNena sarasi sa~jjAtaM bRuhatsaroruhaM sAyAhne~avacUrNayet, tadrAtrivyuShitaM prabhAte punaravacUrNitamuddhRutya haridrAkRusarakShIrayavAgUnAmanyatamaM saindhavaguDaphANitayuktamAkaNThaM pItavantamAghrApayet sukumAramutkliShTapittakaphamauShadhadveShiNamiti samAnaM pUrveNa||19||
2.commentary: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNetyAdinA ekaM ghreyayogamAha| puShparajaHprakAsheneti puShpadhUlisadRushena| haridrAbhidhAnaH kRusharo haridrAkRusharaH||19||

2.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM bhallAtakavidhiparisrutaM svarasaM paktvA phANitIbhUtamAtantulIbhAvAllehayet; AtapashuShkaM vA cUrNIkRutaM jImUtakAdikaShAyeNa pitte kaphasthAnagate pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||20||
2.commentary: bhallAtakavidhiparisrutamiti rasAyanoktabhallAtakasnehagrahaNavidhAnena parisrutaH svaraso grAhyaH| phANitayogo~ayamekaH| AtapashuShkaM vetyAdinA cUrNayogo~apyekaH||20||

2.sanskrit: phalapippalIcUrNAni pUrvavat phalAdInAM ShaNNAmanyatamakaShAyasrutAni vartikriyAH phalAdikaShAyopasarjanAH peyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||21||
2.commentary: phalapippalIcUrNAnItyAdau phalAdiShaTkaShAyabhedena kRutatvAt ShaD vartiprayogA j~jeyAH| vartikriyAyAM caturguNena kvAthena pAkAdvartyAkAratA kartavyA| atrApi ca tathA lehAdau ca sAmAnyoktena madhuprakShepo yuktaH; taM caike madhunaH pAkavirodhAnnAnumanyante||21||

2.sanskrit: phalapippalInAmAragvadha -vRukShaka-svAdukaNTaka-pAThA-pATalA-shAr~ggeShTA-mUrvA-saptaparNa-naktamAla-picumarda-paTola-suShavI-guDUcI-somavalka-dvIpikAnAM pippalI-pippalImUla-hastipippalI-citraka-shRu~ggaverANAM cAnyatamakaShAyeNa siddho leha iti samAnaM pUrveNa||22||
2.commentary: phalapippalInAmAragvadhetyAdinA AragvadhAdiviMshatidravyakvAthabhedena kRutatvAdviMshatirlehA j~jeyAH| vRukShakaH kuTajaH, svAdukaNTakaH vika~gkataH, shAr~ggeShTA gu~jjA, suShavI kAravellakaM, dvIpikA hiMsrA, ‘kaNTakArI’ ityanye||22||

2.sanskrit: phalapippalIShvelA-hareNukA-shatapuShpA-kustumburu-tagara-kuShTha-tvak-coraka-marubakAguru-guggulvelavAluka-shrIveShTaka-paripelava-mAMsI-shaileyaka-sthauNeyaka-sarala-pArAvatapadyashokarohiNInAM viMshateranyatamasya kaShAyeNa sAdhitotkArikA utkArikAkalpena, modakA vA modakakalpena, yathAdoSharogabhakti prayojyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||23||
2.commentary: phalapippalIShvityAdinotkArikA modakAshca pratyekaM viMshatiH| corakaH gandhadravyaM svanAmakhyAtaM, paripelavaM kaivartamustakaM, sthauNeyakaH granthiparNakaM, pArAvatapadI jyotiShmatI, ashokarohiNI ashokasadRushapatrA latA, ‘kaTurohiNI’ ityanye| kecidatra sthauNeyakaM parityajyApAkIpAdyA viMshatiM pUrayanti, apAkIpAdI svanAmakhyAtA| utkArikAkalpeneti sUdashAstroktotkArikAvidhAnena||23||

2.sanskrit: phalapippalIsvarasakaShAyaparibhAvitAni tilashAlitaNDulapiShTAni tatkaShAyopasarjanAni shaShkulIkalpena vA shaShkulyaH, pUpakalpena vA pUpAH iti samAnaM pUrveNa||24|| etenaiva ca kalpena sumukha-surasa-kuTheraka-kANDIra-kAlamAlaka-parNAsaka-kShavaka-phaNijjhaka-gRu~jjana-kAsamarda-bhRu~ggarAjAnAM poTekShuvAlikA-kAla~gkataka-daNDairakANAM cAnyatamasya kaShAyeNa kArayet||25||
2.commentary: phalapippalIsvarasenetyAdinA shaShkulyapUpayoH pRuthageko yogaH| etenaiva ca kalpenetyAdinA sumukhAdipa~jcadashadravyakaShAyeNa pRuthak shaShkulyapUpayoH karaNAt pa~jcadasha yogA bhavanti| evaM militvA shaShkulIpUpayoH pRuthak ShoDashayogA bhavanti| poTA ikShugandhA; daNDairakA gundrAkhyagulmaH, nalo vA||24-25||

2.sanskrit: tathA badaraShADava-rAga-leha-modakotkArikA-tarpaNa-pAnaka-mAMsarasa-yUSha-madyAnAM madanaphalAnyanyatamenopasRujya yathAdoSharogabhakti dadyAt; taiH sAdhu vamatIti||26||
2.commentary: tathA badaraShADavetyAdinA dasha yogAH| badarakRutaH ShADavo badaraShADavaH||26||

2.sanskrit: madanaH karahATashca rAThaH piNDItakaH phalam| shvasanashceti paryAyairucyate tasya kalpanA||27||
2.commentary: madanasya vyavahArArthaM paryAyAnAha- madanaH karahATashcetyAdi| tasya kalpaneti ya evambhUtaiH paryAyairvyAkhyAtastasyeyaM kalpanA| asya ca paryAyAbhidhAnaM bhUriprayogeShu vihitatvenAbhyarhitatvAjj~jeyam| evamanyatrApi paryAyAbhidhAne prayojanaM varNanIyam||27||

2.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- nava yogAH kaShAyeShu, mAtrAsvaShTau , payoghRute| pa~jca, phANitacUrNe dvau ghreye, vartikriyAsu ShaT||28|| viMshatirviMshatirlehamodakotkArikAsu ca| shaShkulIpUpayoshcoktA yogAH ShoDasha ShoDasha||29|| dashAnye ShADavAdyeShu trayastriMshadidaM shatam| yogAnAM vidhivaddiShTaM phalakalpe maharShiNA||30||
2.commentary: madanaphalayogAnAM navAdisa~gkhyotkarShanirAsArthaM sukhasmaraNArthaM ca tAn sa~ggraheNAha- nava yogA ityAdi| asya cArtho yathAsthAnaM vyAhRutaH||28-30||

2.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute~aprApte dRuDhabalasampUrite kalpasthAne madanakalpo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
2.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM kalpasthAne madanakalpo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

3.sanskrit: athAto madanakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
3.commentary: cikitsitasthAne tu tatra tatra vihitavamanavirecanayoH prayogAn vistareNAbhidhAtuM cikitsAdhikRutayogasthAnarUpakalpasthAnamucyate| yadyapi cikitsAyAM basterapi pratipAditatvAdbastyabhidhAyakaM siddhisthAnamapi cikitsA~ggatayA~abhidhAtavyaM, tathA~api pa~jcakarmaNAmautsargikapravRuttau vamanavirecanapUrvikaiva bastikarmapravRuttirbhavatIti kRutvA vamanavirecanAbhidhAyakaM kalpasthAnameva bastyabhidhAyakasiddhisthAnAdagre~abhidhIyate| vamanavirecanAnAM kalpAstiShThantyasminniti kalpasthAnam| kalpAbhidhAne~api virecanasyautsargikapravRuttau vamanapUrvikaiva pravRuttirbhavatIti vamanapUrvakatvAdvirecanasya vamanakalpA evAgre~abhidhAtavyAH| vamanakalpeShvapi vamanadravyashreShThatvAnmadanaphalasyaivAdau kalpo~abhidhIyate; shreShThatvaM ca madanaphalasya ‘vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate~anapAyitvAt’ ityanenAtraiva vakShyati||1-2||

3.sanskrit: atha khalu vamanavirecanArthaM vamanavirecanadravyANAM sukhopabhogatamaiH sahAnyairdravyairvividhaiH kalpanArthaM bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyarthaH , tadyogAnAM ca kriyAvidheH sukhopAyasya samyagupakalpanArthaM kalpasthAnamupadekShyAmo~agnivesha!||3||
3.commentary: kalpArthaM darshayannAha- atha khalvityAdi| athashabdaH prAkprastute| khalushabdaH prakAshane| vamanavirecanArthamiti vamananimittaM virecananimittaM ca| vamanavirecanadravyANAmiti madanaphalAditrivRudAdInAm| anyairiti surAsauvIrakAdyaiH kovidArAdiprakAraishca| anyairityasya visheShaNaM- sukhopabhogatamairiti| atra sukhAyopabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, na tadAtvasukha upabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, tathAhi tadAtve~asukhopabhogAnAM kovidArAdInAmagrahaNaM syAt| kalpanArthamiti padasya kriyayA sambandhamadarshayitvaiva tadvyAkhyAnapratyayanArthaM vyAkaroti bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyartha iti; tatra bhedArthamiti vamanavirecanadravyaprayogabhedArthaM, te ca prayogabhedAH “trayastriMshadyogashataM praNItaM phaleShu” (sU.a.4) ityAdikAH; vibhAgArthamiti atra ‘phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa’, ityAdivakShyamANadravyavibhAgArtham| upodghAtaM samApya prakRutamAha- tadyogAnAmiti; vamanavirecanadravyaprayogANam| kriyAyA itikartavyatAyA vidhiH kriyAvidhiH, svarasAdirUpatayA karaNAnIti yAvat; tasya kriyAvidhervisheShaNaM- sukhopAyasyeti; sukhArthaH sukho vA upAyo yasya sa sukhopAyaH, tasya samyagupakalpanArthamiti samyagupadeshArtham||3||

3.sanskrit: tatra doShaharaNamUrdhvabhAgaM vamanasa~jj~jakam, adhobhAgaM virecanasa~jj~jakam; ubhayaM vA sharIramalavirecanAdvirecanasa~jj~jAM labhate||4||
3.commentary: vamanavirecanashabdArthaM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| UrdhvaM mukhena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti UrdhvabhAgam| adho gudena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti adhobhAgam| vamanavirecanayorapi kadAcidvirecanasa~jj~jAM ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktAM darshayannAha- ubhayamapItyAdi| na caivaM sati vamanavirecanavannirUhe~api virecanasa~jj~jAprasaktirudbhAvanIyA , yataH pa~gkajashabdavadiyaM virecanasa~jj~jA vamanavirecanayoreva yogarUDhyA vartate||4||

3.sanskrit: tatroShNa-tIkShNa-sUkShma-vyavAyi-vikAshInyauShadhAni svavIryeNa hRudayamupetya dhamanIranusRutya sthUlANusrotobhyaH kevalaM sharIragataM doShasa~gghAtamAgneyatvAd viShyandayanti, taikShNyAd vicchindanti, sa vicchinnaH pariplavan snehabhAvite kAye snehAktabhAjanasthamiva kShaudramasajjannaNupravaNabhAvAdAmAshayamAgamyodAnapraNunno~agnivAyvAtmakatvAdUrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAdauShadhasyordhvamutkShipyate, salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdadhobhAgaprabhAvAccauShadhasyAdhaH pravartate, ubhayatashcobhayaguNatvAt| iti lakShaNoddeshaH||5||
3.commentary: samprati dvayorapi vamanavirecanadravyayoH sAdhAraNoShNatIkShNatvAdiguNayogakRutadoShaviShyandanAdisAdhAraNakAryadarshanapUrvakamagnivAyvAtmakatvAdivishiShTadharmayogakRutaM vishiShTaM ca kAryaM vamanavirecanarUpaM darshayannAha- tatroShNetyAdi| uShNamiti uShNavIryam| svavIryeNeti svaprabhAveNa| dhamanIranusRutyeti sakaladehagatA dhamanIranusRutya; sakaladehagatadhamanyanusaraNaM ca vIryeNa j~jeyaM, na sAkShAt| AgneyatvAdviShyandayantIti vilInaM kurvanti| vicchindanti chinnaM kurvanti| pariplavan itastato gacchan| asajjanniti na kvacidapi sa~ggaM gacchan| aNupravaNabhAvAditi aNutvAt pravaNabhAvAcca; pravaNatvamiha koShThagamanonmukhatvam, aNutvaM ca aNumArgasa~jcAritvam| udAnapraNunna iti udAnavAyupreritaH| agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi agnivAyUtkarShavattvAt| UrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAditi UrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvarUpaprabhAvAt| evaM salilapRuthivyAtmakatvamapi vyAkhyeyam| ubhayatashceti Urdhvamadhashca kShipyata ityarthaH| ubhayaguNatvAditi agnivAyvAtmakatvAt salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdUrdhvAdhobhAgaprabhAvAccetyarthaH| iti lakShaNoddesha iti anantaragranthena vamanavirecanadravyasvarUpAbhidhAnaM kRutamityarthaH| atra ca prakaraNe sAmAnyenaiva vamanavirecanadravyANAm ‘AgneyatvAdviShyandayanti’ ityanenAgneyatvaM pratipAditaM; punashca visheSheNa ‘agnivAyvAtmakatvAt’ iti padena vamanadravyasyAgnyAtmakatvaM pratipAdyate; tena, sAmAnye visheShe ca vamanadravyANAmAgneyatvapratipAdanAt prakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati; virecanadravyANAM tu sAmAnyoktAgneyatvasambandhAd visheShaguNakathanaprastAve ca salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAbhidhAnAdvamanadravyApekShayA~apakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati| tathAhi sushrute~api vamanavirecanayorapyAgneyatvamuktaM- “saratva-saukShmya-taikShNyauShNya-vikAshitvairvirecanam| vamanaM ca hareddoShAn prakRutyA gatamanyathA” (su.ci.a.33) ityanena| yaccAtrocyate-vamanaM yadyUrdhvabhAgaharatvaprabhAvAdUrdhvayati, tadA~agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi hetuvarNanaM na yujyate; yataH, yat sopapattikaM kAryaM na bhavati tat prabhAvakRutamiti vyapadishyate; uktaM hi- “prabhAvo~acintya ucyate” (sU.a.26) iti| tanna, yataH prabhAvasyaiveha vamanakArye vAyvagnyAtmakaguNatayA vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM heturupadRu(di)shyate, na tu vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM svatantro vamanahetuH; tathAhi sati yadanyadapi vAyvagnyAtmakamUrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvaprabhAvarahitaM, tadapi vamanakaraM syAt; yathA- kaTukarase dravye tat syAt; tasmAt prabhAvaguNatayaiva hetuvarNanam| evaM virecanadravye~api pUrvapakShasiddhAntAvanusartavyau||5||

3.sanskrit: tatra phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAnAM, shyAmA-trivRuccatura~ggula-tilvaka-mahAvRukSha-saptalA-sha~gkhinI-dantI-dravantInAM ca, nAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAsvAda-rasa-vIrya-vipAka-prabhAvagrahaNAd deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcca , vicitragandha-varNa-rasa-sparshAnAmupayogasukhArthamasa~gkhyeyasaMyogAnAmapi ca satAM dravyANAM vikalpamArgopadarshanArthaM ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH||6||
3.commentary: samprati kalpasthAnavaktavyatayA ShaDvirecanaprayogashatAnyanatisa~gkShepavistaraprayogopadarshanapUrvakaM pratijAnIte- tatra phaletyAdinA ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAma ityantena| tatra kRutavedhanAntAnAM vicchedapAThena vamanaprayogaprayojyatvaM, shyAmAdInAM virecanaprayogaprayojyatvaM ca darshayati| atraiva vamane virecane caikaikeShAM punarvastUnAM madanaphalAdInAM shyAmAdInAM ca bahavaH prayogA abhidhIyante, na punarekaikameva dravyaM vamanakArakaM virecanakArakaM vA; svalpasa~gkhyAprayogeNa grahaNasukhatA vamanavirecanayogasya bhavati, kAryaM ca sidhyatItyAsha~gkyAha- nAnAvidhetyAdi yAvadrogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcceti| asyArthaH- yasmAnnAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAH, nAnAvidhAsvAdAH, nAnAvidhavIryAH, nAnAvidhavipAkAH, nAnAvidhaprabhAvAshca madanaphalAdikA oShadhyaH, tathA tatsaMskArakAH kovidArAdikA oShadhya upalabhyante; puruShAshca deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAbhinnA nAnAvidhA dRushyante; tena naikaM dravyaM sarvasmin dehadoShAdau yaugikaM, sarvatra kAle vA prApyate sarvatra deshe vA; tasmAddehadoShAdinA bhedavati puruShe bahUnyeva dravyANi bahubhishca prayogairupakalpitAni yathAyogyatayA yathAprApti ca prayoktuM shakyante; ato bahunAmeva madanAdidravyANAM bahuprakAraprayogANAmupanyAso yukta iti bhAvaH| grahaNAt upalambhAt| deho nAnA sthUlakRushAdibhedena, bhaktiH icchA, avasthAshabdeneha rogAvasthaiva grAhyA, Adishabdeneha sattvAhArayorgrahaNam| bhUrivirecanaprayogopadarshanaprayojanAntaramapyAha- vicitretyAdi| nAnAvidhagandha-varNa-rasatayA prayoge tatkAlamuttarakAlaM ca sukhArthamityarthaH| atha kiM prabhedAnmadanaphalAdInAM ShaTprayogashatAni bhavanti, yenAdhikAH prayogA nAbhidhIyanta ityAsha~gkyAha- asa~gkhyeyetyAdi| vikalpamArgopadarshanArthamiti adhikaprayogakalpanAsamarthAn bhiShajaH prati etat ShaTprayogashatopadarshanaM kartavyAdhikaprayogakalpanAmArgopadarshakaM, tenApare~apyatra prayogAH kalpanIyAH; granthe niHsheShaprayogAnabhidhAnaM prayogANAmasa~gkhyeyatvenAshakyatvAdeva| anativistareNa ShaTprayogashatAbhidhAnaM mandabuddhisaMvyavahArArthamiti bhAvaH| uktaM hyanyatra- “etAvanto hyalamalpabuddhInAM vyavahArAya, buddhimatAM ca svAlakShaNyAnumAnayuktikushalAnAmanuktArthaj~jAnAya” (sU.a.4) iti||6||

3.sanskrit: tAni tu dravyANi desha-kAla-guNa-bhAjana-sampadvIryabalAdhAnAt kriyAsamarthatamAni bhavanti||7||
3.commentary: samprati vamanavirecanadravyANAM deshAdisampattyA guNotkarShaM darshayannAha- tAnItyAdi| deshAdibhishcaturbhiH sampacchabdaH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bhAjanaM bheShajasthApanasthAnam| vIryasya balaM vIryAdhikatvameva||7||

3.sanskrit: trividhaH khalu deshaH- jA~ggalaH, AnUpaH, sAdhAraNashceti| tatra jA~ggalaH paryAkAshabhUyiShThaH, tarubhirapi ca kadara-khadirAsanAshvakarNa-dhava-tinisha-shallakI-sAla-somavalka-badarI-tindukAshvattha-vaTAmalakIvanagahanaH, anekashamI-kakubha-shiMshapAprAyaH, sthirashuShkapavanabalavidhUyamAnapranRutyattaruNaviTapaH, pratatamRugatRuShNikopagUDhatanukharaparuShasikatAsharkarAbahulaH, lAvatittiricakorAnucaritabhUmibhAgaH, vAtapittabahulaH, sthirakaThinamanuShyaprAyo j~jeyaH, athAnUpo hintAlatamAlanArikelakadalIvanagahanaH, saritsamudraparyantaprAyaH, shishirapavanabahulaH, va~jjulavAnIropashobhitatIrAbhiH saridbhirupagatabhUmibhAgaH, kShitidharaniku~jjopashobhitaH, mandapavanAnuvIjitakShitiruhagahanaH, anekavanarAjIpuShpitavanagahanabhUmibhAgaH, snigdhatarupratAnopagUDhaH, haMsa-cakravAka-balAkA-nandImukha-puNDarIka-kAdamba-madgu -bhRu~ggarAja-shatapatra-mattakokilAnunAditataruviTapaH, sukumArapuruShaH, pavanakaphaprAyo j~jeyaH; anayoreva dvayordeshayorvIrudvanaspativAnaspatyashakunimRugagaNayutaH sthirasukumArabalavarNasaMhananopapannasAdhAraNaguNayuktapuruShaH sAdhAraNo j~jeyaH||8||
3.commentary: deshAdi samyag vyAkurvannAha- tatra trividha ityAdi| atra kecijjA~ggalAdideshalakShaNagranthaM na paThanti, tattu janapadoddhvaMsanIye paThitamiti kRutvehAnArShaM vadanti| yaistu janapadoddhvaMsanIye jA~ggalAdilakShaNaM na paThyate, tairatra paThanIya evAyaM granthaH||8||

3.sanskrit: tatra deshe sAdhAraNe jA~ggale vA yathAkAlaM shishirAtapapavanasalilasevite same shucau pradakShiNodake shmashAna-caitya-devayajanAgAra-sabhA-shvabhrArAma-valmIkoSharavirahite kusharohiShAstIrNe snigdhakRuShNamadhuramRuttike suvarNavarNamadhuramRuttike vA mRudAvaphAlakRuShTe~anupahate~anyairbalavattarairdrumairauShadhAni jAtAni prashasyante||9||
3.commentary: yathAkAlamiti yathAkAlaM shishirAdibhiH sevite deshe| shmashAnAdibhiH pratyekaM virahitashabdaH sambadhyate| devayajanenAgArashabdaH sambadhyate| sabhA janamelakasthAnam| na phAlena kRuShTa iti aphAlakRuShTe||9||

3.sanskrit: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnyupAgatasampUrNapramANa-rasavIrya-gandhAni kAlAtapAgnisalilapavanajantubhiranupahatagandha-varNa-rasa-sparsha-prabhAvANi pratyagrANyudIcyAM dishi sthitAni; teShAM shAkhApalAshamaciraprarUDhaM varShAvasantayorgrAhyaM, grIShme mUlAni shishire vA shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAM, sharadi tvakkandakShIrANi, hemante sArANi, yathartu puShpaphalamiti; ma~ggalAcAraH kalyANavRuttaH shuciH shuklavAsAH sampUjya devatA ashvinau gobrAhmaNAMshca kRutopavAsaH prA~gmukha uda~gmukho vA gRuhNIyAt||10||
3.commentary: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnItyanenaiva kAlasampaducyate; kAlajAtAnIti svakAlabhUtAni| upAgatasampUrNetyAdinA pratyagrANItyantena guNasampaducyate| pratyagrANIti sampUrNaguNatayA niShpannAni| teShAM shAkhApalAshamityAdinA kAlasampadamuktAM prapa~jcayati| shAkhAgrahaNenaiva tvagAdInAmapi grahaNam| shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAmiti cchedaH| grIShme mUlAni shishire veti kathanena yAnyAgneyAni teShAM mUlAni grIShme, yAni saumyAni teShAM mUlAni shishire, grAhyANIti vyavasthAM sUcayati; uktaM hyanyatra- “saumyAnyauShadhAni saumyeShvRutuShvAdadIta, AgneyAnyAgneyeShu” (su.sU.a.36) iti| bheShajagrahaNavidhAnamAha- ma~ggaletyAdi||10||

3.sanskrit: gRuhItvA cAnurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnyAgAreShU prAgudagdvAreShu nivAtapravAtaikadesheShu nityapuShpopahArabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhUma-rajo-mUShaka-catuShpadAmanabhigamanIyAni svavacchannAni shikyeShvAsajya sthApayet||11||
3.commentary: bhAjanasampadamAha- gRuhItvetyAdi| anurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnIti anurUpaguNavattA ca bhAjanasya bheShajasamAnaguNatayaiva| svavacchannAnIti samyakpihitAni||11||

3.sanskrit: tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjIta surA-sauvIraka-tuShodaka-maireya-medaka-dhAnyAmla -phalAmla-dadhyamlAdibhirvAte, mRudvIkAmalaka -madhu-madhuka-parUShaka-phANitakShIrAdibhiH pitte, shleShmaNi tu madhu-mUtra-kaShAyAdibhirbhAvitAnyAloDitAni ca; ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNa dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdIni pravibhajya vyAkhyAsyAmaH||12||
3.commentary: sa~gkShepeNa madanaphalAdInAM vAtAdibhedena bhAvanAloDanadravyANyAha- tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjItetyAdi| dhAnyAmlaM kA~jjikaM, phalAmlaM dADimarasAdi| shleShmaNItyAdau kaShAyashabdena shleShmaharadravyakvAtho~abhipretaH| uddesha iti sa~gkShepAbhidhAnamityarthaH| dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdInItyatra Adishabdena prakRutibalAdInAM grahaNam||12||

3.sanskrit: vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate, anapAyitvAt| tAni vasantagrIShmayorantare puShyAshvayugbhyAM mRugashirasA vA gRuhNIyAnmaitre muhUrte| yAni pakvAnyakANAnyaharitAni pANDUnyakrimINyapUtInyajantujagdhAnyahrasvAni; tAni pramRujya , kushapuTe baddhvA, gomayenAlipya, yavatu(bu)ShamAShashAlikulatthamudgapalAnAmanyatame nidadhyAdaShTarAtram| ata UrdhvaM mRudUbhUtAni madhviShTagandhAnyuddhRutya shoShayet| sushuShkANAM phalapippalIruddharet | tAsAM ghRutadadhimadhupalalavimRuditAnAM punaH shuShkANAM navaM kalashaM supramRuShTavAlukamarajaskamAkaNThaM pUrayitvA svavacchannaM svanuguptaM shikyeShvAsajya samyak sthApayet||13||
3.commentary: vamanadravyANAmityAdinA madanaphalasya prAdhAnyopadarshanapUrvakaM prayogavidhimAha| anapAyitvAditi vamanadravyAntarApekShayA~alpavyApattikatvAt| antare iti madhye, sa ca grIShmavasantayorantarvartikatipayadinAnyeva madhyo j~jeyaH| ashvayuk ashvinI| maitre muhUrta iti shivabhujagamitrAdInAM madhye mitradevatAke, evaM maitre muhUrte| palAnAmiti rAshInAm| madhuvadiShTagandho yeShAM tAni, yAni madhviShTagandhAni bhavanti tAni grAhyANIti darshayati| phalapippalIriti madanaphalamadhyagatAni pippalIsaMsthAnAni bIjAni| tAsAmityAdi pUraNavAcakashabdayogAt karaNe ShaShThI| svanuguptamiti kRutarakShAvidhAnam||13||

3.sanskrit: atha cchardanIyamAturaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannaM shvashchardayitavyamiti grAmyAnUpaudakamAMsarasa-kShIra-dadhi-mASha-tila-shAkAdibhiH samutkleshitashleShmANaM vyuShitaM jIrNAhAraM pUrvAhNe kRutabalihomama~ggalaprAyashcittaM nirannamanatisnigdhaM yavAgvA ghRutamAtrAM pItavantaM, tAsAM phalapippalInAmantarnakhamuShTiM yAvadvA sAdhu manyeta jarjarIkRutya yaShTimadhukaShAyeNa kovidAra-karbudAra-nIpa-vidula-bimbI-shaNapuShpI-sadApuShpI-pratyakpuShpI-kaShAyANAmanyatamena vA rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtaM madhusaindhavayuktaM sukhoShNaM kRutvA pUrNaM sharAvaM mantreNAnenAbhimantrayet- ‘OM brahmadakShAshvirudrendrabhUcandrArkAnilAnalAH| RuShayaH sauShadhigrAmA bhUtasa~gghAshca pAntu te| rasAyanamivarShINAM devAnAmamRutaM yathA| sudhevottamanAgAnAM bhaiShajyamidamastu te’| ityevamabhimantryoda~gmukhaM prA~gmukhaM vA~a~aturaM pAyayecchleShmajvaragulmapratishyAyArtaM visheSheNa punaH punarApittAgamanAt, tena sAdhu vamati; hInavegaM tu pippalyAmalaka-sarShapa-vacAkalkalavaNoShNodakaiH punaH punaH pravartayedApittadarshanAt| ityeSha sarvashchardanayogavidhiH||14||
3.commentary: dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannamityanena abhya~gge kriyamANe snehasahacaritasvedopapAdanaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA vidhIyate, “tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya iShTaH” (si.a.1) ityanena pAnaprayujyamAnasnehasya saptarAtraM trirAtraM vA prakarSha ucyate iti na virodhaH| etaccAbhya~ggasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraNaM pAnasnehAntadivasamArabhya kriyate, tena snehapAnavishrAmadinena samaM dvyahatryahapUraNamabhya~ggasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati| snehapAnAcca yadvishrAmadinam, “ekAhoparatastadvadbhuktvA pracchardanaM pibet” (sU.a.13) ityanenoktaM, tathaivehApi| kaphotkleshakAribhojanamAha- shvashchardayitavyamityAdinA| shva iti parasminnahni| vyuShitamiti rAtrimatikrAntam| nirannamiti padacchedaH| anatisnigdhamityAdinA vamanadina eva ghRutamAtrAyuktayavAgUpAnapUrvakaM vamanamanatisnigdhapuruShaviShayaM brUte| anye tu pUrvadina evAnatisnigdhasya ghRutamAtrAM pItavata eva yavAgvAH pAnamAhuH, “peshalairvividhairannairdoShAnutkleshya dehinaH| snigdhasvinnAya vamanaM dattaM samyak pravartate|| athAparedyuH pUrvAhNe sAdhAraNe kAle vamanadravyakaShAyakalkacUrNasnehAnAmanyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ityAdi sushrutokteH| antarnakhamuShTimiti antarIkRutanakhamuShTiparimANam| yAvadvA sAdhu manyetetyanena mAtrAyA baladoShAdibhedenAsthiratvamityAha| yaShTImadhukasya kovidArAdiShu vicchedapATha uttaraprayogeShu kovidArAderyaShTImadhuvirahitasya grahaNArthaH| kovidAraH svanAmakhyAtaH, sa sharadi puShpati; karbudArastu kA~jcanAraH, sa vasante puShpati; nIpaH kadambaH, vidulaH vetasaH, shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA, sadApuShpI arkapuShpikA, pratyakpuShpI apAmArgaH| rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtamiti shRutakaShAyAt kaShAyAntaropadarshakaM pakShAntaraM; kiMvA, kaShAyapAna eva shItakaShAyavidhAnamihocyate| pUrNaM sharAvamiti ma~ggalArthaM pUrNakumbhavat| punaH punariti yAvat pittAgamanaM na bhavati tAvat punaH punaH kaShAyaM pibedityarthaH| anyatrApyuktaM- “pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhaM” (si.a.1) ityAdi| vamanAyogakArakahInavegapravRuttipratikArArthamAha- hInavegamityAdi||14||

3.sanskrit: sarveShu tu madhusaindhavaM kaphavilayanacchedArthaM vamaneShu vidadhyAt| na coShNavirodho madhunashchardanayogayuktasya, avipakvapratyAgamanAddoShanirharaNAcca||15||
3.commentary: yadyapi ca ghreyAdivamanayogeShu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathA~api ‘sarveShu’ iti padaM bAhulyArtham| vamanArthakaShAye uShNe madhuprakShepo virodhitvAnna yujyate, uktaM hi- “madhUShNamuShNArtamathavA” (sU.a.27) ityAdi, evamAsha~gkya samAdhAnamAha na coShNavirodho madhuna ityAdi| avipakvapratyAgamanAdityanena pacyamAnaM madhUShNayuktaM virudhyeteti darshayati| doShanirharaNAcceti madhUShNaviruddhamapi vamanayoge uShNe iShyate, tasya doShanirharaNAdeva na virodho bhavatIti darshayati| evaM bastiprayoge~api madhuna uShNAvirodho varNanIyaH| etena yaShTImadhvAdinavadravyakRutairnavabhiH kaShAyairnavayogAH||15||

3.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM dvau dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH srAvayet, tena rasena tRutIyaM bhAgaM piShTvA mAtrAM harItakIbhirbibhItakairAmalairvA tulyAM vartayet, tAsAmekAM dve vA pUrvoktAnAM kaShAyANAmanyatamasyA~jjalimAtreNa vimRudya balavacchleShmaprasekagranthijvarodarAruciShu pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||16||
3.commentary: phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgAvityAdau phalapippalInAM bhAgatrayaM kartavyaM; tatra bhAgadvayaM ShaDguNena kovidArAdikaShAyeNa kShAraparisrAvaNavidhivadekaviMshativArAn parisrAvaNIyam| kovidArAdInAM cAShTAnAmaShTau kaShAyAH pRuthak parisrAvaNe prayoktavyAH| yena ca kaShAyeNa phalapippalIbhAgadvayaM parisrAvya haritakyAdiparimANA mAtrA tRutIyabhAgaphalapippalIkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaShAyeNa mAtrAyogAH ; evamaShTau harItakyAdimAtrayA nirdiShTAH phalapippalIyogA bhavanti| mAtrAvikalpashca doShabalAdivikalpakRuto j~jeyaH| samAnaM pUrveNeti pUrvayogavadiha snehasvedAbhimantraNAdividhAnaM kartavyamityarthaH| evamanyatrApi pUrvavacchabdArtho j~jeyaH||16||

3.sanskrit: phalapippalIkShIraM, tena vA kShIrayavAgUmadhobhAge raktapitte hRuddAhe ca; tajjasya vA dadhna uttarakaM kaphaccharditamakaprasekeShu ; tasya vA payasaH shItasya santAnikA~jjaliM pitte prakupite uraHkaNThahRudaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samAnaM pUrveNa||17||
3.commentary: phalapippalyA kShIrapAkavidhinA sAdhitaM kShIraM phalapippalIkShIram; ayameko yogaH| teneti phalapippalIsAdhitakShIreNa| tajjasyeti phalapippalIkShIrajAtasya dadhnaH| uttarakamiti saram| santAnikA kShIroparisthaH styAno bhAgaH||17||

3.sanskrit: phalapippalIshRutakShIrAnnavanItamutpannaM phalAdikalkakaShAyasiddhaM kaphAbhibhUtAgniM vishuShyaddehaM ca mAtrayA pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||18||
3.commentary: phalAdIni phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAni ShaT| ete kShIrayogacatuShTayena ghRutayogena ca samaM pa~jca yogA adhyAyasa~ggrahe vaktavyA||18||

3.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH suparibhAvitena puShparajaHprakAshena cUrNena sarasi sa~jjAtaM bRuhatsaroruhaM sAyAhne~avacUrNayet, tadrAtrivyuShitaM prabhAte punaravacUrNitamuddhRutya haridrAkRusarakShIrayavAgUnAmanyatamaM saindhavaguDaphANitayuktamAkaNThaM pItavantamAghrApayet sukumAramutkliShTapittakaphamauShadhadveShiNamiti samAnaM pUrveNa||19||
3.commentary: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNetyAdinA ekaM ghreyayogamAha| puShparajaHprakAsheneti puShpadhUlisadRushena| haridrAbhidhAnaH kRusharo haridrAkRusharaH||19||

3.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM bhallAtakavidhiparisrutaM svarasaM paktvA phANitIbhUtamAtantulIbhAvAllehayet; AtapashuShkaM vA cUrNIkRutaM jImUtakAdikaShAyeNa pitte kaphasthAnagate pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||20||
3.commentary: bhallAtakavidhiparisrutamiti rasAyanoktabhallAtakasnehagrahaNavidhAnena parisrutaH svaraso grAhyaH| phANitayogo~ayamekaH| AtapashuShkaM vetyAdinA cUrNayogo~apyekaH||20||

3.sanskrit: phalapippalIcUrNAni pUrvavat phalAdInAM ShaNNAmanyatamakaShAyasrutAni vartikriyAH phalAdikaShAyopasarjanAH peyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||21||
3.commentary: phalapippalIcUrNAnItyAdau phalAdiShaTkaShAyabhedena kRutatvAt ShaD vartiprayogA j~jeyAH| vartikriyAyAM caturguNena kvAthena pAkAdvartyAkAratA kartavyA| atrApi ca tathA lehAdau ca sAmAnyoktena madhuprakShepo yuktaH; taM caike madhunaH pAkavirodhAnnAnumanyante||21||

3.sanskrit: phalapippalInAmAragvadha -vRukShaka-svAdukaNTaka-pAThA-pATalA-shAr~ggeShTA-mUrvA-saptaparNa-naktamAla-picumarda-paTola-suShavI-guDUcI-somavalka-dvIpikAnAM pippalI-pippalImUla-hastipippalI-citraka-shRu~ggaverANAM cAnyatamakaShAyeNa siddho leha iti samAnaM pUrveNa||22||
3.commentary: phalapippalInAmAragvadhetyAdinA AragvadhAdiviMshatidravyakvAthabhedena kRutatvAdviMshatirlehA j~jeyAH| vRukShakaH kuTajaH, svAdukaNTakaH vika~gkataH, shAr~ggeShTA gu~jjA, suShavI kAravellakaM, dvIpikA hiMsrA, ‘kaNTakArI’ ityanye||22||

3.sanskrit: phalapippalIShvelA-hareNukA-shatapuShpA-kustumburu-tagara-kuShTha-tvak-coraka-marubakAguru-guggulvelavAluka-shrIveShTaka-paripelava-mAMsI-shaileyaka-sthauNeyaka-sarala-pArAvatapadyashokarohiNInAM viMshateranyatamasya kaShAyeNa sAdhitotkArikA utkArikAkalpena, modakA vA modakakalpena, yathAdoSharogabhakti prayojyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||23||
3.commentary: phalapippalIShvityAdinotkArikA modakAshca pratyekaM viMshatiH| corakaH gandhadravyaM svanAmakhyAtaM, paripelavaM kaivartamustakaM, sthauNeyakaH granthiparNakaM, pArAvatapadI jyotiShmatI, ashokarohiNI ashokasadRushapatrA latA, ‘kaTurohiNI’ ityanye| kecidatra sthauNeyakaM parityajyApAkIpAdyA viMshatiM pUrayanti, apAkIpAdI svanAmakhyAtA| utkArikAkalpeneti sUdashAstroktotkArikAvidhAnena||23||

3.sanskrit: phalapippalIsvarasakaShAyaparibhAvitAni tilashAlitaNDulapiShTAni tatkaShAyopasarjanAni shaShkulIkalpena vA shaShkulyaH, pUpakalpena vA pUpAH iti samAnaM pUrveNa||24|| etenaiva ca kalpena sumukha-surasa-kuTheraka-kANDIra-kAlamAlaka-parNAsaka-kShavaka-phaNijjhaka-gRu~jjana-kAsamarda-bhRu~ggarAjAnAM poTekShuvAlikA-kAla~gkataka-daNDairakANAM cAnyatamasya kaShAyeNa kArayet||25||
3.commentary: phalapippalIsvarasenetyAdinA shaShkulyapUpayoH pRuthageko yogaH| etenaiva ca kalpenetyAdinA sumukhAdipa~jcadashadravyakaShAyeNa pRuthak shaShkulyapUpayoH karaNAt pa~jcadasha yogA bhavanti| evaM militvA shaShkulIpUpayoH pRuthak ShoDashayogA bhavanti| poTA ikShugandhA; daNDairakA gundrAkhyagulmaH, nalo vA||24-25||

3.sanskrit: tathA badaraShADava-rAga-leha-modakotkArikA-tarpaNa-pAnaka-mAMsarasa-yUSha-madyAnAM madanaphalAnyanyatamenopasRujya yathAdoSharogabhakti dadyAt; taiH sAdhu vamatIti||26||
3.commentary: tathA badaraShADavetyAdinA dasha yogAH| badarakRutaH ShADavo badaraShADavaH||26||

3.sanskrit: madanaH karahATashca rAThaH piNDItakaH phalam| shvasanashceti paryAyairucyate tasya kalpanA||27||
3.commentary: madanasya vyavahArArthaM paryAyAnAha- madanaH karahATashcetyAdi| tasya kalpaneti ya evambhUtaiH paryAyairvyAkhyAtastasyeyaM kalpanA| asya ca paryAyAbhidhAnaM bhUriprayogeShu vihitatvenAbhyarhitatvAjj~jeyam| evamanyatrApi paryAyAbhidhAne prayojanaM varNanIyam||27||

3.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- nava yogAH kaShAyeShu, mAtrAsvaShTau , payoghRute| pa~jca, phANitacUrNe dvau ghreye, vartikriyAsu ShaT||28|| viMshatirviMshatirlehamodakotkArikAsu ca| shaShkulIpUpayoshcoktA yogAH ShoDasha ShoDasha||29|| dashAnye ShADavAdyeShu trayastriMshadidaM shatam| yogAnAM vidhivaddiShTaM phalakalpe maharShiNA||30||
3.commentary: madanaphalayogAnAM navAdisa~gkhyotkarShanirAsArthaM sukhasmaraNArthaM ca tAn sa~ggraheNAha- nava yogA ityAdi| asya cArtho yathAsthAnaM vyAhRutaH||28-30||

3.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute~aprApte dRuDhabalasampUrite kalpasthAne madanakalpo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
3.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM kalpasthAne madanakalpo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

4.sanskrit: athAto madanakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
4.commentary: cikitsitasthAne tu tatra tatra vihitavamanavirecanayoH prayogAn vistareNAbhidhAtuM cikitsAdhikRutayogasthAnarUpakalpasthAnamucyate| yadyapi cikitsAyAM basterapi pratipAditatvAdbastyabhidhAyakaM siddhisthAnamapi cikitsA~ggatayA~abhidhAtavyaM, tathA~api pa~jcakarmaNAmautsargikapravRuttau vamanavirecanapUrvikaiva bastikarmapravRuttirbhavatIti kRutvA vamanavirecanAbhidhAyakaM kalpasthAnameva bastyabhidhAyakasiddhisthAnAdagre~abhidhIyate| vamanavirecanAnAM kalpAstiShThantyasminniti kalpasthAnam| kalpAbhidhAne~api virecanasyautsargikapravRuttau vamanapUrvikaiva pravRuttirbhavatIti vamanapUrvakatvAdvirecanasya vamanakalpA evAgre~abhidhAtavyAH| vamanakalpeShvapi vamanadravyashreShThatvAnmadanaphalasyaivAdau kalpo~abhidhIyate; shreShThatvaM ca madanaphalasya ‘vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate~anapAyitvAt’ ityanenAtraiva vakShyati||1-2||

4.sanskrit: atha khalu vamanavirecanArthaM vamanavirecanadravyANAM sukhopabhogatamaiH sahAnyairdravyairvividhaiH kalpanArthaM bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyarthaH , tadyogAnAM ca kriyAvidheH sukhopAyasya samyagupakalpanArthaM kalpasthAnamupadekShyAmo~agnivesha!||3||
4.commentary: kalpArthaM darshayannAha- atha khalvityAdi| athashabdaH prAkprastute| khalushabdaH prakAshane| vamanavirecanArthamiti vamananimittaM virecananimittaM ca| vamanavirecanadravyANAmiti madanaphalAditrivRudAdInAm| anyairiti surAsauvIrakAdyaiH kovidArAdiprakAraishca| anyairityasya visheShaNaM- sukhopabhogatamairiti| atra sukhAyopabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, na tadAtvasukha upabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, tathAhi tadAtve~asukhopabhogAnAM kovidArAdInAmagrahaNaM syAt| kalpanArthamiti padasya kriyayA sambandhamadarshayitvaiva tadvyAkhyAnapratyayanArthaM vyAkaroti bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyartha iti; tatra bhedArthamiti vamanavirecanadravyaprayogabhedArthaM, te ca prayogabhedAH “trayastriMshadyogashataM praNItaM phaleShu” (sU.a.4) ityAdikAH; vibhAgArthamiti atra ‘phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa’, ityAdivakShyamANadravyavibhAgArtham| upodghAtaM samApya prakRutamAha- tadyogAnAmiti; vamanavirecanadravyaprayogANam| kriyAyA itikartavyatAyA vidhiH kriyAvidhiH, svarasAdirUpatayA karaNAnIti yAvat; tasya kriyAvidhervisheShaNaM- sukhopAyasyeti; sukhArthaH sukho vA upAyo yasya sa sukhopAyaH, tasya samyagupakalpanArthamiti samyagupadeshArtham||3||

4.sanskrit: tatra doShaharaNamUrdhvabhAgaM vamanasa~jj~jakam, adhobhAgaM virecanasa~jj~jakam; ubhayaM vA sharIramalavirecanAdvirecanasa~jj~jAM labhate||4||
4.commentary: vamanavirecanashabdArthaM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| UrdhvaM mukhena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti UrdhvabhAgam| adho gudena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti adhobhAgam| vamanavirecanayorapi kadAcidvirecanasa~jj~jAM ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktAM darshayannAha- ubhayamapItyAdi| na caivaM sati vamanavirecanavannirUhe~api virecanasa~jj~jAprasaktirudbhAvanIyA , yataH pa~gkajashabdavadiyaM virecanasa~jj~jA vamanavirecanayoreva yogarUDhyA vartate||4||

4.sanskrit: tatroShNa-tIkShNa-sUkShma-vyavAyi-vikAshInyauShadhAni svavIryeNa hRudayamupetya dhamanIranusRutya sthUlANusrotobhyaH kevalaM sharIragataM doShasa~gghAtamAgneyatvAd viShyandayanti, taikShNyAd vicchindanti, sa vicchinnaH pariplavan snehabhAvite kAye snehAktabhAjanasthamiva kShaudramasajjannaNupravaNabhAvAdAmAshayamAgamyodAnapraNunno~agnivAyvAtmakatvAdUrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAdauShadhasyordhvamutkShipyate, salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdadhobhAgaprabhAvAccauShadhasyAdhaH pravartate, ubhayatashcobhayaguNatvAt| iti lakShaNoddeshaH||5||
4.commentary: samprati dvayorapi vamanavirecanadravyayoH sAdhAraNoShNatIkShNatvAdiguNayogakRutadoShaviShyandanAdisAdhAraNakAryadarshanapUrvakamagnivAyvAtmakatvAdivishiShTadharmayogakRutaM vishiShTaM ca kAryaM vamanavirecanarUpaM darshayannAha- tatroShNetyAdi| uShNamiti uShNavIryam| svavIryeNeti svaprabhAveNa| dhamanIranusRutyeti sakaladehagatA dhamanIranusRutya; sakaladehagatadhamanyanusaraNaM ca vIryeNa j~jeyaM, na sAkShAt| AgneyatvAdviShyandayantIti vilInaM kurvanti| vicchindanti chinnaM kurvanti| pariplavan itastato gacchan| asajjanniti na kvacidapi sa~ggaM gacchan| aNupravaNabhAvAditi aNutvAt pravaNabhAvAcca; pravaNatvamiha koShThagamanonmukhatvam, aNutvaM ca aNumArgasa~jcAritvam| udAnapraNunna iti udAnavAyupreritaH| agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi agnivAyUtkarShavattvAt| UrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAditi UrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvarUpaprabhAvAt| evaM salilapRuthivyAtmakatvamapi vyAkhyeyam| ubhayatashceti Urdhvamadhashca kShipyata ityarthaH| ubhayaguNatvAditi agnivAyvAtmakatvAt salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdUrdhvAdhobhAgaprabhAvAccetyarthaH| iti lakShaNoddesha iti anantaragranthena vamanavirecanadravyasvarUpAbhidhAnaM kRutamityarthaH| atra ca prakaraNe sAmAnyenaiva vamanavirecanadravyANAm ‘AgneyatvAdviShyandayanti’ ityanenAgneyatvaM pratipAditaM; punashca visheSheNa ‘agnivAyvAtmakatvAt’ iti padena vamanadravyasyAgnyAtmakatvaM pratipAdyate; tena, sAmAnye visheShe ca vamanadravyANAmAgneyatvapratipAdanAt prakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati; virecanadravyANAM tu sAmAnyoktAgneyatvasambandhAd visheShaguNakathanaprastAve ca salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAbhidhAnAdvamanadravyApekShayA~apakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati| tathAhi sushrute~api vamanavirecanayorapyAgneyatvamuktaM- “saratva-saukShmya-taikShNyauShNya-vikAshitvairvirecanam| vamanaM ca hareddoShAn prakRutyA gatamanyathA” (su.ci.a.33) ityanena| yaccAtrocyate-vamanaM yadyUrdhvabhAgaharatvaprabhAvAdUrdhvayati, tadA~agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi hetuvarNanaM na yujyate; yataH, yat sopapattikaM kAryaM na bhavati tat prabhAvakRutamiti vyapadishyate; uktaM hi- “prabhAvo~acintya ucyate” (sU.a.26) iti| tanna, yataH prabhAvasyaiveha vamanakArye vAyvagnyAtmakaguNatayA vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM heturupadRu(di)shyate, na tu vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM svatantro vamanahetuH; tathAhi sati yadanyadapi vAyvagnyAtmakamUrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvaprabhAvarahitaM, tadapi vamanakaraM syAt; yathA- kaTukarase dravye tat syAt; tasmAt prabhAvaguNatayaiva hetuvarNanam| evaM virecanadravye~api pUrvapakShasiddhAntAvanusartavyau||5||

4.sanskrit: tatra phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAnAM, shyAmA-trivRuccatura~ggula-tilvaka-mahAvRukSha-saptalA-sha~gkhinI-dantI-dravantInAM ca, nAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAsvAda-rasa-vIrya-vipAka-prabhAvagrahaNAd deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcca , vicitragandha-varNa-rasa-sparshAnAmupayogasukhArthamasa~gkhyeyasaMyogAnAmapi ca satAM dravyANAM vikalpamArgopadarshanArthaM ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH||6||
4.commentary: samprati kalpasthAnavaktavyatayA ShaDvirecanaprayogashatAnyanatisa~gkShepavistaraprayogopadarshanapUrvakaM pratijAnIte- tatra phaletyAdinA ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAma ityantena| tatra kRutavedhanAntAnAM vicchedapAThena vamanaprayogaprayojyatvaM, shyAmAdInAM virecanaprayogaprayojyatvaM ca darshayati| atraiva vamane virecane caikaikeShAM punarvastUnAM madanaphalAdInAM shyAmAdInAM ca bahavaH prayogA abhidhIyante, na punarekaikameva dravyaM vamanakArakaM virecanakArakaM vA; svalpasa~gkhyAprayogeNa grahaNasukhatA vamanavirecanayogasya bhavati, kAryaM ca sidhyatItyAsha~gkyAha- nAnAvidhetyAdi yAvadrogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcceti| asyArthaH- yasmAnnAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAH, nAnAvidhAsvAdAH, nAnAvidhavIryAH, nAnAvidhavipAkAH, nAnAvidhaprabhAvAshca madanaphalAdikA oShadhyaH, tathA tatsaMskArakAH kovidArAdikA oShadhya upalabhyante; puruShAshca deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAbhinnA nAnAvidhA dRushyante; tena naikaM dravyaM sarvasmin dehadoShAdau yaugikaM, sarvatra kAle vA prApyate sarvatra deshe vA; tasmAddehadoShAdinA bhedavati puruShe bahUnyeva dravyANi bahubhishca prayogairupakalpitAni yathAyogyatayA yathAprApti ca prayoktuM shakyante; ato bahunAmeva madanAdidravyANAM bahuprakAraprayogANAmupanyAso yukta iti bhAvaH| grahaNAt upalambhAt| deho nAnA sthUlakRushAdibhedena, bhaktiH icchA, avasthAshabdeneha rogAvasthaiva grAhyA, Adishabdeneha sattvAhArayorgrahaNam| bhUrivirecanaprayogopadarshanaprayojanAntaramapyAha- vicitretyAdi| nAnAvidhagandha-varNa-rasatayA prayoge tatkAlamuttarakAlaM ca sukhArthamityarthaH| atha kiM prabhedAnmadanaphalAdInAM ShaTprayogashatAni bhavanti, yenAdhikAH prayogA nAbhidhIyanta ityAsha~gkyAha- asa~gkhyeyetyAdi| vikalpamArgopadarshanArthamiti adhikaprayogakalpanAsamarthAn bhiShajaH prati etat ShaTprayogashatopadarshanaM kartavyAdhikaprayogakalpanAmArgopadarshakaM, tenApare~apyatra prayogAH kalpanIyAH; granthe niHsheShaprayogAnabhidhAnaM prayogANAmasa~gkhyeyatvenAshakyatvAdeva| anativistareNa ShaTprayogashatAbhidhAnaM mandabuddhisaMvyavahArArthamiti bhAvaH| uktaM hyanyatra- “etAvanto hyalamalpabuddhInAM vyavahArAya, buddhimatAM ca svAlakShaNyAnumAnayuktikushalAnAmanuktArthaj~jAnAya” (sU.a.4) iti||6||

4.sanskrit: tAni tu dravyANi desha-kAla-guNa-bhAjana-sampadvIryabalAdhAnAt kriyAsamarthatamAni bhavanti||7||
4.commentary: samprati vamanavirecanadravyANAM deshAdisampattyA guNotkarShaM darshayannAha- tAnItyAdi| deshAdibhishcaturbhiH sampacchabdaH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bhAjanaM bheShajasthApanasthAnam| vIryasya balaM vIryAdhikatvameva||7||

4.sanskrit: trividhaH khalu deshaH- jA~ggalaH, AnUpaH, sAdhAraNashceti| tatra jA~ggalaH paryAkAshabhUyiShThaH, tarubhirapi ca kadara-khadirAsanAshvakarNa-dhava-tinisha-shallakI-sAla-somavalka-badarI-tindukAshvattha-vaTAmalakIvanagahanaH, anekashamI-kakubha-shiMshapAprAyaH, sthirashuShkapavanabalavidhUyamAnapranRutyattaruNaviTapaH, pratatamRugatRuShNikopagUDhatanukharaparuShasikatAsharkarAbahulaH, lAvatittiricakorAnucaritabhUmibhAgaH, vAtapittabahulaH, sthirakaThinamanuShyaprAyo j~jeyaH, athAnUpo hintAlatamAlanArikelakadalIvanagahanaH, saritsamudraparyantaprAyaH, shishirapavanabahulaH, va~jjulavAnIropashobhitatIrAbhiH saridbhirupagatabhUmibhAgaH, kShitidharaniku~jjopashobhitaH, mandapavanAnuvIjitakShitiruhagahanaH, anekavanarAjIpuShpitavanagahanabhUmibhAgaH, snigdhatarupratAnopagUDhaH, haMsa-cakravAka-balAkA-nandImukha-puNDarIka-kAdamba-madgu -bhRu~ggarAja-shatapatra-mattakokilAnunAditataruviTapaH, sukumArapuruShaH, pavanakaphaprAyo j~jeyaH; anayoreva dvayordeshayorvIrudvanaspativAnaspatyashakunimRugagaNayutaH sthirasukumArabalavarNasaMhananopapannasAdhAraNaguNayuktapuruShaH sAdhAraNo j~jeyaH||8||
4.commentary: deshAdi samyag vyAkurvannAha- tatra trividha ityAdi| atra kecijjA~ggalAdideshalakShaNagranthaM na paThanti, tattu janapadoddhvaMsanIye paThitamiti kRutvehAnArShaM vadanti| yaistu janapadoddhvaMsanIye jA~ggalAdilakShaNaM na paThyate, tairatra paThanIya evAyaM granthaH||8||

4.sanskrit: tatra deshe sAdhAraNe jA~ggale vA yathAkAlaM shishirAtapapavanasalilasevite same shucau pradakShiNodake shmashAna-caitya-devayajanAgAra-sabhA-shvabhrArAma-valmIkoSharavirahite kusharohiShAstIrNe snigdhakRuShNamadhuramRuttike suvarNavarNamadhuramRuttike vA mRudAvaphAlakRuShTe~anupahate~anyairbalavattarairdrumairauShadhAni jAtAni prashasyante||9||
4.commentary: yathAkAlamiti yathAkAlaM shishirAdibhiH sevite deshe| shmashAnAdibhiH pratyekaM virahitashabdaH sambadhyate| devayajanenAgArashabdaH sambadhyate| sabhA janamelakasthAnam| na phAlena kRuShTa iti aphAlakRuShTe||9||

4.sanskrit: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnyupAgatasampUrNapramANa-rasavIrya-gandhAni kAlAtapAgnisalilapavanajantubhiranupahatagandha-varNa-rasa-sparsha-prabhAvANi pratyagrANyudIcyAM dishi sthitAni; teShAM shAkhApalAshamaciraprarUDhaM varShAvasantayorgrAhyaM, grIShme mUlAni shishire vA shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAM, sharadi tvakkandakShIrANi, hemante sArANi, yathartu puShpaphalamiti; ma~ggalAcAraH kalyANavRuttaH shuciH shuklavAsAH sampUjya devatA ashvinau gobrAhmaNAMshca kRutopavAsaH prA~gmukha uda~gmukho vA gRuhNIyAt||10||
4.commentary: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnItyanenaiva kAlasampaducyate; kAlajAtAnIti svakAlabhUtAni| upAgatasampUrNetyAdinA pratyagrANItyantena guNasampaducyate| pratyagrANIti sampUrNaguNatayA niShpannAni| teShAM shAkhApalAshamityAdinA kAlasampadamuktAM prapa~jcayati| shAkhAgrahaNenaiva tvagAdInAmapi grahaNam| shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAmiti cchedaH| grIShme mUlAni shishire veti kathanena yAnyAgneyAni teShAM mUlAni grIShme, yAni saumyAni teShAM mUlAni shishire, grAhyANIti vyavasthAM sUcayati; uktaM hyanyatra- “saumyAnyauShadhAni saumyeShvRutuShvAdadIta, AgneyAnyAgneyeShu” (su.sU.a.36) iti| bheShajagrahaNavidhAnamAha- ma~ggaletyAdi||10||

4.sanskrit: gRuhItvA cAnurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnyAgAreShU prAgudagdvAreShu nivAtapravAtaikadesheShu nityapuShpopahArabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhUma-rajo-mUShaka-catuShpadAmanabhigamanIyAni svavacchannAni shikyeShvAsajya sthApayet||11||
4.commentary: bhAjanasampadamAha- gRuhItvetyAdi| anurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnIti anurUpaguNavattA ca bhAjanasya bheShajasamAnaguNatayaiva| svavacchannAnIti samyakpihitAni||11||

4.sanskrit: tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjIta surA-sauvIraka-tuShodaka-maireya-medaka-dhAnyAmla -phalAmla-dadhyamlAdibhirvAte, mRudvIkAmalaka -madhu-madhuka-parUShaka-phANitakShIrAdibhiH pitte, shleShmaNi tu madhu-mUtra-kaShAyAdibhirbhAvitAnyAloDitAni ca; ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNa dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdIni pravibhajya vyAkhyAsyAmaH||12||
4.commentary: sa~gkShepeNa madanaphalAdInAM vAtAdibhedena bhAvanAloDanadravyANyAha- tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjItetyAdi| dhAnyAmlaM kA~jjikaM, phalAmlaM dADimarasAdi| shleShmaNItyAdau kaShAyashabdena shleShmaharadravyakvAtho~abhipretaH| uddesha iti sa~gkShepAbhidhAnamityarthaH| dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdInItyatra Adishabdena prakRutibalAdInAM grahaNam||12||

4.sanskrit: vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate, anapAyitvAt| tAni vasantagrIShmayorantare puShyAshvayugbhyAM mRugashirasA vA gRuhNIyAnmaitre muhUrte| yAni pakvAnyakANAnyaharitAni pANDUnyakrimINyapUtInyajantujagdhAnyahrasvAni; tAni pramRujya , kushapuTe baddhvA, gomayenAlipya, yavatu(bu)ShamAShashAlikulatthamudgapalAnAmanyatame nidadhyAdaShTarAtram| ata UrdhvaM mRudUbhUtAni madhviShTagandhAnyuddhRutya shoShayet| sushuShkANAM phalapippalIruddharet | tAsAM ghRutadadhimadhupalalavimRuditAnAM punaH shuShkANAM navaM kalashaM supramRuShTavAlukamarajaskamAkaNThaM pUrayitvA svavacchannaM svanuguptaM shikyeShvAsajya samyak sthApayet||13||
4.commentary: vamanadravyANAmityAdinA madanaphalasya prAdhAnyopadarshanapUrvakaM prayogavidhimAha| anapAyitvAditi vamanadravyAntarApekShayA~alpavyApattikatvAt| antare iti madhye, sa ca grIShmavasantayorantarvartikatipayadinAnyeva madhyo j~jeyaH| ashvayuk ashvinI| maitre muhUrta iti shivabhujagamitrAdInAM madhye mitradevatAke, evaM maitre muhUrte| palAnAmiti rAshInAm| madhuvadiShTagandho yeShAM tAni, yAni madhviShTagandhAni bhavanti tAni grAhyANIti darshayati| phalapippalIriti madanaphalamadhyagatAni pippalIsaMsthAnAni bIjAni| tAsAmityAdi pUraNavAcakashabdayogAt karaNe ShaShThI| svanuguptamiti kRutarakShAvidhAnam||13||

4.sanskrit: atha cchardanIyamAturaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannaM shvashchardayitavyamiti grAmyAnUpaudakamAMsarasa-kShIra-dadhi-mASha-tila-shAkAdibhiH samutkleshitashleShmANaM vyuShitaM jIrNAhAraM pUrvAhNe kRutabalihomama~ggalaprAyashcittaM nirannamanatisnigdhaM yavAgvA ghRutamAtrAM pItavantaM, tAsAM phalapippalInAmantarnakhamuShTiM yAvadvA sAdhu manyeta jarjarIkRutya yaShTimadhukaShAyeNa kovidAra-karbudAra-nIpa-vidula-bimbI-shaNapuShpI-sadApuShpI-pratyakpuShpI-kaShAyANAmanyatamena vA rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtaM madhusaindhavayuktaM sukhoShNaM kRutvA pUrNaM sharAvaM mantreNAnenAbhimantrayet- ‘OM brahmadakShAshvirudrendrabhUcandrArkAnilAnalAH| RuShayaH sauShadhigrAmA bhUtasa~gghAshca pAntu te| rasAyanamivarShINAM devAnAmamRutaM yathA| sudhevottamanAgAnAM bhaiShajyamidamastu te’| ityevamabhimantryoda~gmukhaM prA~gmukhaM vA~a~aturaM pAyayecchleShmajvaragulmapratishyAyArtaM visheSheNa punaH punarApittAgamanAt, tena sAdhu vamati; hInavegaM tu pippalyAmalaka-sarShapa-vacAkalkalavaNoShNodakaiH punaH punaH pravartayedApittadarshanAt| ityeSha sarvashchardanayogavidhiH||14||
4.commentary: dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannamityanena abhya~gge kriyamANe snehasahacaritasvedopapAdanaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA vidhIyate, “tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya iShTaH” (si.a.1) ityanena pAnaprayujyamAnasnehasya saptarAtraM trirAtraM vA prakarSha ucyate iti na virodhaH| etaccAbhya~ggasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraNaM pAnasnehAntadivasamArabhya kriyate, tena snehapAnavishrAmadinena samaM dvyahatryahapUraNamabhya~ggasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati| snehapAnAcca yadvishrAmadinam, “ekAhoparatastadvadbhuktvA pracchardanaM pibet” (sU.a.13) ityanenoktaM, tathaivehApi| kaphotkleshakAribhojanamAha- shvashchardayitavyamityAdinA| shva iti parasminnahni| vyuShitamiti rAtrimatikrAntam| nirannamiti padacchedaH| anatisnigdhamityAdinA vamanadina eva ghRutamAtrAyuktayavAgUpAnapUrvakaM vamanamanatisnigdhapuruShaviShayaM brUte| anye tu pUrvadina evAnatisnigdhasya ghRutamAtrAM pItavata eva yavAgvAH pAnamAhuH, “peshalairvividhairannairdoShAnutkleshya dehinaH| snigdhasvinnAya vamanaM dattaM samyak pravartate|| athAparedyuH pUrvAhNe sAdhAraNe kAle vamanadravyakaShAyakalkacUrNasnehAnAmanyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ityAdi sushrutokteH| antarnakhamuShTimiti antarIkRutanakhamuShTiparimANam| yAvadvA sAdhu manyetetyanena mAtrAyA baladoShAdibhedenAsthiratvamityAha| yaShTImadhukasya kovidArAdiShu vicchedapATha uttaraprayogeShu kovidArAderyaShTImadhuvirahitasya grahaNArthaH| kovidAraH svanAmakhyAtaH, sa sharadi puShpati; karbudArastu kA~jcanAraH, sa vasante puShpati; nIpaH kadambaH, vidulaH vetasaH, shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA, sadApuShpI arkapuShpikA, pratyakpuShpI apAmArgaH| rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtamiti shRutakaShAyAt kaShAyAntaropadarshakaM pakShAntaraM; kiMvA, kaShAyapAna eva shItakaShAyavidhAnamihocyate| pUrNaM sharAvamiti ma~ggalArthaM pUrNakumbhavat| punaH punariti yAvat pittAgamanaM na bhavati tAvat punaH punaH kaShAyaM pibedityarthaH| anyatrApyuktaM- “pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhaM” (si.a.1) ityAdi| vamanAyogakArakahInavegapravRuttipratikArArthamAha- hInavegamityAdi||14||

4.sanskrit: sarveShu tu madhusaindhavaM kaphavilayanacchedArthaM vamaneShu vidadhyAt| na coShNavirodho madhunashchardanayogayuktasya, avipakvapratyAgamanAddoShanirharaNAcca||15||
4.commentary: yadyapi ca ghreyAdivamanayogeShu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathA~api ‘sarveShu’ iti padaM bAhulyArtham| vamanArthakaShAye uShNe madhuprakShepo virodhitvAnna yujyate, uktaM hi- “madhUShNamuShNArtamathavA” (sU.a.27) ityAdi, evamAsha~gkya samAdhAnamAha na coShNavirodho madhuna ityAdi| avipakvapratyAgamanAdityanena pacyamAnaM madhUShNayuktaM virudhyeteti darshayati| doShanirharaNAcceti madhUShNaviruddhamapi vamanayoge uShNe iShyate, tasya doShanirharaNAdeva na virodho bhavatIti darshayati| evaM bastiprayoge~api madhuna uShNAvirodho varNanIyaH| etena yaShTImadhvAdinavadravyakRutairnavabhiH kaShAyairnavayogAH||15||

4.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM dvau dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH srAvayet, tena rasena tRutIyaM bhAgaM piShTvA mAtrAM harItakIbhirbibhItakairAmalairvA tulyAM vartayet, tAsAmekAM dve vA pUrvoktAnAM kaShAyANAmanyatamasyA~jjalimAtreNa vimRudya balavacchleShmaprasekagranthijvarodarAruciShu pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||16||
4.commentary: phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgAvityAdau phalapippalInAM bhAgatrayaM kartavyaM; tatra bhAgadvayaM ShaDguNena kovidArAdikaShAyeNa kShAraparisrAvaNavidhivadekaviMshativArAn parisrAvaNIyam| kovidArAdInAM cAShTAnAmaShTau kaShAyAH pRuthak parisrAvaNe prayoktavyAH| yena ca kaShAyeNa phalapippalIbhAgadvayaM parisrAvya haritakyAdiparimANA mAtrA tRutIyabhAgaphalapippalIkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaShAyeNa mAtrAyogAH ; evamaShTau harItakyAdimAtrayA nirdiShTAH phalapippalIyogA bhavanti| mAtrAvikalpashca doShabalAdivikalpakRuto j~jeyaH| samAnaM pUrveNeti pUrvayogavadiha snehasvedAbhimantraNAdividhAnaM kartavyamityarthaH| evamanyatrApi pUrvavacchabdArtho j~jeyaH||16||

4.sanskrit: phalapippalIkShIraM, tena vA kShIrayavAgUmadhobhAge raktapitte hRuddAhe ca; tajjasya vA dadhna uttarakaM kaphaccharditamakaprasekeShu ; tasya vA payasaH shItasya santAnikA~jjaliM pitte prakupite uraHkaNThahRudaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samAnaM pUrveNa||17||
4.commentary: phalapippalyA kShIrapAkavidhinA sAdhitaM kShIraM phalapippalIkShIram; ayameko yogaH| teneti phalapippalIsAdhitakShIreNa| tajjasyeti phalapippalIkShIrajAtasya dadhnaH| uttarakamiti saram| santAnikA kShIroparisthaH styAno bhAgaH||17||

4.sanskrit: phalapippalIshRutakShIrAnnavanItamutpannaM phalAdikalkakaShAyasiddhaM kaphAbhibhUtAgniM vishuShyaddehaM ca mAtrayA pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||18||
4.commentary: phalAdIni phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAni ShaT| ete kShIrayogacatuShTayena ghRutayogena ca samaM pa~jca yogA adhyAyasa~ggrahe vaktavyA||18||

4.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH suparibhAvitena puShparajaHprakAshena cUrNena sarasi sa~jjAtaM bRuhatsaroruhaM sAyAhne~avacUrNayet, tadrAtrivyuShitaM prabhAte punaravacUrNitamuddhRutya haridrAkRusarakShIrayavAgUnAmanyatamaM saindhavaguDaphANitayuktamAkaNThaM pItavantamAghrApayet sukumAramutkliShTapittakaphamauShadhadveShiNamiti samAnaM pUrveNa||19||
4.commentary: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNetyAdinA ekaM ghreyayogamAha| puShparajaHprakAsheneti puShpadhUlisadRushena| haridrAbhidhAnaH kRusharo haridrAkRusharaH||19||

4.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM bhallAtakavidhiparisrutaM svarasaM paktvA phANitIbhUtamAtantulIbhAvAllehayet; AtapashuShkaM vA cUrNIkRutaM jImUtakAdikaShAyeNa pitte kaphasthAnagate pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||20||
4.commentary: bhallAtakavidhiparisrutamiti rasAyanoktabhallAtakasnehagrahaNavidhAnena parisrutaH svaraso grAhyaH| phANitayogo~ayamekaH| AtapashuShkaM vetyAdinA cUrNayogo~apyekaH||20||

4.sanskrit: phalapippalIcUrNAni pUrvavat phalAdInAM ShaNNAmanyatamakaShAyasrutAni vartikriyAH phalAdikaShAyopasarjanAH peyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||21||
4.commentary: phalapippalIcUrNAnItyAdau phalAdiShaTkaShAyabhedena kRutatvAt ShaD vartiprayogA j~jeyAH| vartikriyAyAM caturguNena kvAthena pAkAdvartyAkAratA kartavyA| atrApi ca tathA lehAdau ca sAmAnyoktena madhuprakShepo yuktaH; taM caike madhunaH pAkavirodhAnnAnumanyante||21||

4.sanskrit: phalapippalInAmAragvadha -vRukShaka-svAdukaNTaka-pAThA-pATalA-shAr~ggeShTA-mUrvA-saptaparNa-naktamAla-picumarda-paTola-suShavI-guDUcI-somavalka-dvIpikAnAM pippalI-pippalImUla-hastipippalI-citraka-shRu~ggaverANAM cAnyatamakaShAyeNa siddho leha iti samAnaM pUrveNa||22||
4.commentary: phalapippalInAmAragvadhetyAdinA AragvadhAdiviMshatidravyakvAthabhedena kRutatvAdviMshatirlehA j~jeyAH| vRukShakaH kuTajaH, svAdukaNTakaH vika~gkataH, shAr~ggeShTA gu~jjA, suShavI kAravellakaM, dvIpikA hiMsrA, ‘kaNTakArI’ ityanye||22||

4.sanskrit: phalapippalIShvelA-hareNukA-shatapuShpA-kustumburu-tagara-kuShTha-tvak-coraka-marubakAguru-guggulvelavAluka-shrIveShTaka-paripelava-mAMsI-shaileyaka-sthauNeyaka-sarala-pArAvatapadyashokarohiNInAM viMshateranyatamasya kaShAyeNa sAdhitotkArikA utkArikAkalpena, modakA vA modakakalpena, yathAdoSharogabhakti prayojyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||23||
4.commentary: phalapippalIShvityAdinotkArikA modakAshca pratyekaM viMshatiH| corakaH gandhadravyaM svanAmakhyAtaM, paripelavaM kaivartamustakaM, sthauNeyakaH granthiparNakaM, pArAvatapadI jyotiShmatI, ashokarohiNI ashokasadRushapatrA latA, ‘kaTurohiNI’ ityanye| kecidatra sthauNeyakaM parityajyApAkIpAdyA viMshatiM pUrayanti, apAkIpAdI svanAmakhyAtA| utkArikAkalpeneti sUdashAstroktotkArikAvidhAnena||23||

4.sanskrit: phalapippalIsvarasakaShAyaparibhAvitAni tilashAlitaNDulapiShTAni tatkaShAyopasarjanAni shaShkulIkalpena vA shaShkulyaH, pUpakalpena vA pUpAH iti samAnaM pUrveNa||24|| etenaiva ca kalpena sumukha-surasa-kuTheraka-kANDIra-kAlamAlaka-parNAsaka-kShavaka-phaNijjhaka-gRu~jjana-kAsamarda-bhRu~ggarAjAnAM poTekShuvAlikA-kAla~gkataka-daNDairakANAM cAnyatamasya kaShAyeNa kArayet||25||
4.commentary: phalapippalIsvarasenetyAdinA shaShkulyapUpayoH pRuthageko yogaH| etenaiva ca kalpenetyAdinA sumukhAdipa~jcadashadravyakaShAyeNa pRuthak shaShkulyapUpayoH karaNAt pa~jcadasha yogA bhavanti| evaM militvA shaShkulIpUpayoH pRuthak ShoDashayogA bhavanti| poTA ikShugandhA; daNDairakA gundrAkhyagulmaH, nalo vA||24-25||

4.sanskrit: tathA badaraShADava-rAga-leha-modakotkArikA-tarpaNa-pAnaka-mAMsarasa-yUSha-madyAnAM madanaphalAnyanyatamenopasRujya yathAdoSharogabhakti dadyAt; taiH sAdhu vamatIti||26||
4.commentary: tathA badaraShADavetyAdinA dasha yogAH| badarakRutaH ShADavo badaraShADavaH||26||

4.sanskrit: madanaH karahATashca rAThaH piNDItakaH phalam| shvasanashceti paryAyairucyate tasya kalpanA||27||
4.commentary: madanasya vyavahArArthaM paryAyAnAha- madanaH karahATashcetyAdi| tasya kalpaneti ya evambhUtaiH paryAyairvyAkhyAtastasyeyaM kalpanA| asya ca paryAyAbhidhAnaM bhUriprayogeShu vihitatvenAbhyarhitatvAjj~jeyam| evamanyatrApi paryAyAbhidhAne prayojanaM varNanIyam||27||

4.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- nava yogAH kaShAyeShu, mAtrAsvaShTau , payoghRute| pa~jca, phANitacUrNe dvau ghreye, vartikriyAsu ShaT||28|| viMshatirviMshatirlehamodakotkArikAsu ca| shaShkulIpUpayoshcoktA yogAH ShoDasha ShoDasha||29|| dashAnye ShADavAdyeShu trayastriMshadidaM shatam| yogAnAM vidhivaddiShTaM phalakalpe maharShiNA||30||
4.commentary: madanaphalayogAnAM navAdisa~gkhyotkarShanirAsArthaM sukhasmaraNArthaM ca tAn sa~ggraheNAha- nava yogA ityAdi| asya cArtho yathAsthAnaM vyAhRutaH||28-30||

4.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute~aprApte dRuDhabalasampUrite kalpasthAne madanakalpo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
4.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM kalpasthAne madanakalpo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

5.sanskrit: athAto madanakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
5.commentary: cikitsitasthAne tu tatra tatra vihitavamanavirecanayoH prayogAn vistareNAbhidhAtuM cikitsAdhikRutayogasthAnarUpakalpasthAnamucyate| yadyapi cikitsAyAM basterapi pratipAditatvAdbastyabhidhAyakaM siddhisthAnamapi cikitsA~ggatayA~abhidhAtavyaM, tathA~api pa~jcakarmaNAmautsargikapravRuttau vamanavirecanapUrvikaiva bastikarmapravRuttirbhavatIti kRutvA vamanavirecanAbhidhAyakaM kalpasthAnameva bastyabhidhAyakasiddhisthAnAdagre~abhidhIyate| vamanavirecanAnAM kalpAstiShThantyasminniti kalpasthAnam| kalpAbhidhAne~api virecanasyautsargikapravRuttau vamanapUrvikaiva pravRuttirbhavatIti vamanapUrvakatvAdvirecanasya vamanakalpA evAgre~abhidhAtavyAH| vamanakalpeShvapi vamanadravyashreShThatvAnmadanaphalasyaivAdau kalpo~abhidhIyate; shreShThatvaM ca madanaphalasya ‘vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate~anapAyitvAt’ ityanenAtraiva vakShyati||1-2||

5.sanskrit: atha khalu vamanavirecanArthaM vamanavirecanadravyANAM sukhopabhogatamaiH sahAnyairdravyairvividhaiH kalpanArthaM bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyarthaH , tadyogAnAM ca kriyAvidheH sukhopAyasya samyagupakalpanArthaM kalpasthAnamupadekShyAmo~agnivesha!||3||
5.commentary: kalpArthaM darshayannAha- atha khalvityAdi| athashabdaH prAkprastute| khalushabdaH prakAshane| vamanavirecanArthamiti vamananimittaM virecananimittaM ca| vamanavirecanadravyANAmiti madanaphalAditrivRudAdInAm| anyairiti surAsauvIrakAdyaiH kovidArAdiprakAraishca| anyairityasya visheShaNaM- sukhopabhogatamairiti| atra sukhAyopabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, na tadAtvasukha upabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, tathAhi tadAtve~asukhopabhogAnAM kovidArAdInAmagrahaNaM syAt| kalpanArthamiti padasya kriyayA sambandhamadarshayitvaiva tadvyAkhyAnapratyayanArthaM vyAkaroti bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyartha iti; tatra bhedArthamiti vamanavirecanadravyaprayogabhedArthaM, te ca prayogabhedAH “trayastriMshadyogashataM praNItaM phaleShu” (sU.a.4) ityAdikAH; vibhAgArthamiti atra ‘phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa’, ityAdivakShyamANadravyavibhAgArtham| upodghAtaM samApya prakRutamAha- tadyogAnAmiti; vamanavirecanadravyaprayogANam| kriyAyA itikartavyatAyA vidhiH kriyAvidhiH, svarasAdirUpatayA karaNAnIti yAvat; tasya kriyAvidhervisheShaNaM- sukhopAyasyeti; sukhArthaH sukho vA upAyo yasya sa sukhopAyaH, tasya samyagupakalpanArthamiti samyagupadeshArtham||3||

5.sanskrit: tatra doShaharaNamUrdhvabhAgaM vamanasa~jj~jakam, adhobhAgaM virecanasa~jj~jakam; ubhayaM vA sharIramalavirecanAdvirecanasa~jj~jAM labhate||4||
5.commentary: vamanavirecanashabdArthaM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| UrdhvaM mukhena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti UrdhvabhAgam| adho gudena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti adhobhAgam| vamanavirecanayorapi kadAcidvirecanasa~jj~jAM ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktAM darshayannAha- ubhayamapItyAdi| na caivaM sati vamanavirecanavannirUhe~api virecanasa~jj~jAprasaktirudbhAvanIyA , yataH pa~gkajashabdavadiyaM virecanasa~jj~jA vamanavirecanayoreva yogarUDhyA vartate||4||

5.sanskrit: tatroShNa-tIkShNa-sUkShma-vyavAyi-vikAshInyauShadhAni svavIryeNa hRudayamupetya dhamanIranusRutya sthUlANusrotobhyaH kevalaM sharIragataM doShasa~gghAtamAgneyatvAd viShyandayanti, taikShNyAd vicchindanti, sa vicchinnaH pariplavan snehabhAvite kAye snehAktabhAjanasthamiva kShaudramasajjannaNupravaNabhAvAdAmAshayamAgamyodAnapraNunno~agnivAyvAtmakatvAdUrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAdauShadhasyordhvamutkShipyate, salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdadhobhAgaprabhAvAccauShadhasyAdhaH pravartate, ubhayatashcobhayaguNatvAt| iti lakShaNoddeshaH||5||
5.commentary: samprati dvayorapi vamanavirecanadravyayoH sAdhAraNoShNatIkShNatvAdiguNayogakRutadoShaviShyandanAdisAdhAraNakAryadarshanapUrvakamagnivAyvAtmakatvAdivishiShTadharmayogakRutaM vishiShTaM ca kAryaM vamanavirecanarUpaM darshayannAha- tatroShNetyAdi| uShNamiti uShNavIryam| svavIryeNeti svaprabhAveNa| dhamanIranusRutyeti sakaladehagatA dhamanIranusRutya; sakaladehagatadhamanyanusaraNaM ca vIryeNa j~jeyaM, na sAkShAt| AgneyatvAdviShyandayantIti vilInaM kurvanti| vicchindanti chinnaM kurvanti| pariplavan itastato gacchan| asajjanniti na kvacidapi sa~ggaM gacchan| aNupravaNabhAvAditi aNutvAt pravaNabhAvAcca; pravaNatvamiha koShThagamanonmukhatvam, aNutvaM ca aNumArgasa~jcAritvam| udAnapraNunna iti udAnavAyupreritaH| agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi agnivAyUtkarShavattvAt| UrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAditi UrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvarUpaprabhAvAt| evaM salilapRuthivyAtmakatvamapi vyAkhyeyam| ubhayatashceti Urdhvamadhashca kShipyata ityarthaH| ubhayaguNatvAditi agnivAyvAtmakatvAt salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdUrdhvAdhobhAgaprabhAvAccetyarthaH| iti lakShaNoddesha iti anantaragranthena vamanavirecanadravyasvarUpAbhidhAnaM kRutamityarthaH| atra ca prakaraNe sAmAnyenaiva vamanavirecanadravyANAm ‘AgneyatvAdviShyandayanti’ ityanenAgneyatvaM pratipAditaM; punashca visheSheNa ‘agnivAyvAtmakatvAt’ iti padena vamanadravyasyAgnyAtmakatvaM pratipAdyate; tena, sAmAnye visheShe ca vamanadravyANAmAgneyatvapratipAdanAt prakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati; virecanadravyANAM tu sAmAnyoktAgneyatvasambandhAd visheShaguNakathanaprastAve ca salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAbhidhAnAdvamanadravyApekShayA~apakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati| tathAhi sushrute~api vamanavirecanayorapyAgneyatvamuktaM- “saratva-saukShmya-taikShNyauShNya-vikAshitvairvirecanam| vamanaM ca hareddoShAn prakRutyA gatamanyathA” (su.ci.a.33) ityanena| yaccAtrocyate-vamanaM yadyUrdhvabhAgaharatvaprabhAvAdUrdhvayati, tadA~agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi hetuvarNanaM na yujyate; yataH, yat sopapattikaM kAryaM na bhavati tat prabhAvakRutamiti vyapadishyate; uktaM hi- “prabhAvo~acintya ucyate” (sU.a.26) iti| tanna, yataH prabhAvasyaiveha vamanakArye vAyvagnyAtmakaguNatayA vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM heturupadRu(di)shyate, na tu vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM svatantro vamanahetuH; tathAhi sati yadanyadapi vAyvagnyAtmakamUrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvaprabhAvarahitaM, tadapi vamanakaraM syAt; yathA- kaTukarase dravye tat syAt; tasmAt prabhAvaguNatayaiva hetuvarNanam| evaM virecanadravye~api pUrvapakShasiddhAntAvanusartavyau||5||

5.sanskrit: tatra phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAnAM, shyAmA-trivRuccatura~ggula-tilvaka-mahAvRukSha-saptalA-sha~gkhinI-dantI-dravantInAM ca, nAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAsvAda-rasa-vIrya-vipAka-prabhAvagrahaNAd deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcca , vicitragandha-varNa-rasa-sparshAnAmupayogasukhArthamasa~gkhyeyasaMyogAnAmapi ca satAM dravyANAM vikalpamArgopadarshanArthaM ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH||6||
5.commentary: samprati kalpasthAnavaktavyatayA ShaDvirecanaprayogashatAnyanatisa~gkShepavistaraprayogopadarshanapUrvakaM pratijAnIte- tatra phaletyAdinA ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAma ityantena| tatra kRutavedhanAntAnAM vicchedapAThena vamanaprayogaprayojyatvaM, shyAmAdInAM virecanaprayogaprayojyatvaM ca darshayati| atraiva vamane virecane caikaikeShAM punarvastUnAM madanaphalAdInAM shyAmAdInAM ca bahavaH prayogA abhidhIyante, na punarekaikameva dravyaM vamanakArakaM virecanakArakaM vA; svalpasa~gkhyAprayogeNa grahaNasukhatA vamanavirecanayogasya bhavati, kAryaM ca sidhyatItyAsha~gkyAha- nAnAvidhetyAdi yAvadrogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcceti| asyArthaH- yasmAnnAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAH, nAnAvidhAsvAdAH, nAnAvidhavIryAH, nAnAvidhavipAkAH, nAnAvidhaprabhAvAshca madanaphalAdikA oShadhyaH, tathA tatsaMskArakAH kovidArAdikA oShadhya upalabhyante; puruShAshca deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAbhinnA nAnAvidhA dRushyante; tena naikaM dravyaM sarvasmin dehadoShAdau yaugikaM, sarvatra kAle vA prApyate sarvatra deshe vA; tasmAddehadoShAdinA bhedavati puruShe bahUnyeva dravyANi bahubhishca prayogairupakalpitAni yathAyogyatayA yathAprApti ca prayoktuM shakyante; ato bahunAmeva madanAdidravyANAM bahuprakAraprayogANAmupanyAso yukta iti bhAvaH| grahaNAt upalambhAt| deho nAnA sthUlakRushAdibhedena, bhaktiH icchA, avasthAshabdeneha rogAvasthaiva grAhyA, Adishabdeneha sattvAhArayorgrahaNam| bhUrivirecanaprayogopadarshanaprayojanAntaramapyAha- vicitretyAdi| nAnAvidhagandha-varNa-rasatayA prayoge tatkAlamuttarakAlaM ca sukhArthamityarthaH| atha kiM prabhedAnmadanaphalAdInAM ShaTprayogashatAni bhavanti, yenAdhikAH prayogA nAbhidhIyanta ityAsha~gkyAha- asa~gkhyeyetyAdi| vikalpamArgopadarshanArthamiti adhikaprayogakalpanAsamarthAn bhiShajaH prati etat ShaTprayogashatopadarshanaM kartavyAdhikaprayogakalpanAmArgopadarshakaM, tenApare~apyatra prayogAH kalpanIyAH; granthe niHsheShaprayogAnabhidhAnaM prayogANAmasa~gkhyeyatvenAshakyatvAdeva| anativistareNa ShaTprayogashatAbhidhAnaM mandabuddhisaMvyavahArArthamiti bhAvaH| uktaM hyanyatra- “etAvanto hyalamalpabuddhInAM vyavahArAya, buddhimatAM ca svAlakShaNyAnumAnayuktikushalAnAmanuktArthaj~jAnAya” (sU.a.4) iti||6||

5.sanskrit: tAni tu dravyANi desha-kAla-guNa-bhAjana-sampadvIryabalAdhAnAt kriyAsamarthatamAni bhavanti||7||
5.commentary: samprati vamanavirecanadravyANAM deshAdisampattyA guNotkarShaM darshayannAha- tAnItyAdi| deshAdibhishcaturbhiH sampacchabdaH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bhAjanaM bheShajasthApanasthAnam| vIryasya balaM vIryAdhikatvameva||7||

5.sanskrit: trividhaH khalu deshaH- jA~ggalaH, AnUpaH, sAdhAraNashceti| tatra jA~ggalaH paryAkAshabhUyiShThaH, tarubhirapi ca kadara-khadirAsanAshvakarNa-dhava-tinisha-shallakI-sAla-somavalka-badarI-tindukAshvattha-vaTAmalakIvanagahanaH, anekashamI-kakubha-shiMshapAprAyaH, sthirashuShkapavanabalavidhUyamAnapranRutyattaruNaviTapaH, pratatamRugatRuShNikopagUDhatanukharaparuShasikatAsharkarAbahulaH, lAvatittiricakorAnucaritabhUmibhAgaH, vAtapittabahulaH, sthirakaThinamanuShyaprAyo j~jeyaH, athAnUpo hintAlatamAlanArikelakadalIvanagahanaH, saritsamudraparyantaprAyaH, shishirapavanabahulaH, va~jjulavAnIropashobhitatIrAbhiH saridbhirupagatabhUmibhAgaH, kShitidharaniku~jjopashobhitaH, mandapavanAnuvIjitakShitiruhagahanaH, anekavanarAjIpuShpitavanagahanabhUmibhAgaH, snigdhatarupratAnopagUDhaH, haMsa-cakravAka-balAkA-nandImukha-puNDarIka-kAdamba-madgu -bhRu~ggarAja-shatapatra-mattakokilAnunAditataruviTapaH, sukumArapuruShaH, pavanakaphaprAyo j~jeyaH; anayoreva dvayordeshayorvIrudvanaspativAnaspatyashakunimRugagaNayutaH sthirasukumArabalavarNasaMhananopapannasAdhAraNaguNayuktapuruShaH sAdhAraNo j~jeyaH||8||
5.commentary: deshAdi samyag vyAkurvannAha- tatra trividha ityAdi| atra kecijjA~ggalAdideshalakShaNagranthaM na paThanti, tattu janapadoddhvaMsanIye paThitamiti kRutvehAnArShaM vadanti| yaistu janapadoddhvaMsanIye jA~ggalAdilakShaNaM na paThyate, tairatra paThanIya evAyaM granthaH||8||

5.sanskrit: tatra deshe sAdhAraNe jA~ggale vA yathAkAlaM shishirAtapapavanasalilasevite same shucau pradakShiNodake shmashAna-caitya-devayajanAgAra-sabhA-shvabhrArAma-valmIkoSharavirahite kusharohiShAstIrNe snigdhakRuShNamadhuramRuttike suvarNavarNamadhuramRuttike vA mRudAvaphAlakRuShTe~anupahate~anyairbalavattarairdrumairauShadhAni jAtAni prashasyante||9||
5.commentary: yathAkAlamiti yathAkAlaM shishirAdibhiH sevite deshe| shmashAnAdibhiH pratyekaM virahitashabdaH sambadhyate| devayajanenAgArashabdaH sambadhyate| sabhA janamelakasthAnam| na phAlena kRuShTa iti aphAlakRuShTe||9||

5.sanskrit: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnyupAgatasampUrNapramANa-rasavIrya-gandhAni kAlAtapAgnisalilapavanajantubhiranupahatagandha-varNa-rasa-sparsha-prabhAvANi pratyagrANyudIcyAM dishi sthitAni; teShAM shAkhApalAshamaciraprarUDhaM varShAvasantayorgrAhyaM, grIShme mUlAni shishire vA shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAM, sharadi tvakkandakShIrANi, hemante sArANi, yathartu puShpaphalamiti; ma~ggalAcAraH kalyANavRuttaH shuciH shuklavAsAH sampUjya devatA ashvinau gobrAhmaNAMshca kRutopavAsaH prA~gmukha uda~gmukho vA gRuhNIyAt||10||
5.commentary: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnItyanenaiva kAlasampaducyate; kAlajAtAnIti svakAlabhUtAni| upAgatasampUrNetyAdinA pratyagrANItyantena guNasampaducyate| pratyagrANIti sampUrNaguNatayA niShpannAni| teShAM shAkhApalAshamityAdinA kAlasampadamuktAM prapa~jcayati| shAkhAgrahaNenaiva tvagAdInAmapi grahaNam| shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAmiti cchedaH| grIShme mUlAni shishire veti kathanena yAnyAgneyAni teShAM mUlAni grIShme, yAni saumyAni teShAM mUlAni shishire, grAhyANIti vyavasthAM sUcayati; uktaM hyanyatra- “saumyAnyauShadhAni saumyeShvRutuShvAdadIta, AgneyAnyAgneyeShu” (su.sU.a.36) iti| bheShajagrahaNavidhAnamAha- ma~ggaletyAdi||10||

5.sanskrit: gRuhItvA cAnurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnyAgAreShU prAgudagdvAreShu nivAtapravAtaikadesheShu nityapuShpopahArabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhUma-rajo-mUShaka-catuShpadAmanabhigamanIyAni svavacchannAni shikyeShvAsajya sthApayet||11||
5.commentary: bhAjanasampadamAha- gRuhItvetyAdi| anurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnIti anurUpaguNavattA ca bhAjanasya bheShajasamAnaguNatayaiva| svavacchannAnIti samyakpihitAni||11||

5.sanskrit: tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjIta surA-sauvIraka-tuShodaka-maireya-medaka-dhAnyAmla -phalAmla-dadhyamlAdibhirvAte, mRudvIkAmalaka -madhu-madhuka-parUShaka-phANitakShIrAdibhiH pitte, shleShmaNi tu madhu-mUtra-kaShAyAdibhirbhAvitAnyAloDitAni ca; ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNa dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdIni pravibhajya vyAkhyAsyAmaH||12||
5.commentary: sa~gkShepeNa madanaphalAdInAM vAtAdibhedena bhAvanAloDanadravyANyAha- tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjItetyAdi| dhAnyAmlaM kA~jjikaM, phalAmlaM dADimarasAdi| shleShmaNItyAdau kaShAyashabdena shleShmaharadravyakvAtho~abhipretaH| uddesha iti sa~gkShepAbhidhAnamityarthaH| dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdInItyatra Adishabdena prakRutibalAdInAM grahaNam||12||

5.sanskrit: vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate, anapAyitvAt| tAni vasantagrIShmayorantare puShyAshvayugbhyAM mRugashirasA vA gRuhNIyAnmaitre muhUrte| yAni pakvAnyakANAnyaharitAni pANDUnyakrimINyapUtInyajantujagdhAnyahrasvAni; tAni pramRujya , kushapuTe baddhvA, gomayenAlipya, yavatu(bu)ShamAShashAlikulatthamudgapalAnAmanyatame nidadhyAdaShTarAtram| ata UrdhvaM mRudUbhUtAni madhviShTagandhAnyuddhRutya shoShayet| sushuShkANAM phalapippalIruddharet | tAsAM ghRutadadhimadhupalalavimRuditAnAM punaH shuShkANAM navaM kalashaM supramRuShTavAlukamarajaskamAkaNThaM pUrayitvA svavacchannaM svanuguptaM shikyeShvAsajya samyak sthApayet||13||
5.commentary: vamanadravyANAmityAdinA madanaphalasya prAdhAnyopadarshanapUrvakaM prayogavidhimAha| anapAyitvAditi vamanadravyAntarApekShayA~alpavyApattikatvAt| antare iti madhye, sa ca grIShmavasantayorantarvartikatipayadinAnyeva madhyo j~jeyaH| ashvayuk ashvinI| maitre muhUrta iti shivabhujagamitrAdInAM madhye mitradevatAke, evaM maitre muhUrte| palAnAmiti rAshInAm| madhuvadiShTagandho yeShAM tAni, yAni madhviShTagandhAni bhavanti tAni grAhyANIti darshayati| phalapippalIriti madanaphalamadhyagatAni pippalIsaMsthAnAni bIjAni| tAsAmityAdi pUraNavAcakashabdayogAt karaNe ShaShThI| svanuguptamiti kRutarakShAvidhAnam||13||

5.sanskrit: atha cchardanIyamAturaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannaM shvashchardayitavyamiti grAmyAnUpaudakamAMsarasa-kShIra-dadhi-mASha-tila-shAkAdibhiH samutkleshitashleShmANaM vyuShitaM jIrNAhAraM pUrvAhNe kRutabalihomama~ggalaprAyashcittaM nirannamanatisnigdhaM yavAgvA ghRutamAtrAM pItavantaM, tAsAM phalapippalInAmantarnakhamuShTiM yAvadvA sAdhu manyeta jarjarIkRutya yaShTimadhukaShAyeNa kovidAra-karbudAra-nIpa-vidula-bimbI-shaNapuShpI-sadApuShpI-pratyakpuShpI-kaShAyANAmanyatamena vA rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtaM madhusaindhavayuktaM sukhoShNaM kRutvA pUrNaM sharAvaM mantreNAnenAbhimantrayet- ‘OM brahmadakShAshvirudrendrabhUcandrArkAnilAnalAH| RuShayaH sauShadhigrAmA bhUtasa~gghAshca pAntu te| rasAyanamivarShINAM devAnAmamRutaM yathA| sudhevottamanAgAnAM bhaiShajyamidamastu te’| ityevamabhimantryoda~gmukhaM prA~gmukhaM vA~a~aturaM pAyayecchleShmajvaragulmapratishyAyArtaM visheSheNa punaH punarApittAgamanAt, tena sAdhu vamati; hInavegaM tu pippalyAmalaka-sarShapa-vacAkalkalavaNoShNodakaiH punaH punaH pravartayedApittadarshanAt| ityeSha sarvashchardanayogavidhiH||14||
5.commentary: dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannamityanena abhya~gge kriyamANe snehasahacaritasvedopapAdanaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA vidhIyate, “tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya iShTaH” (si.a.1) ityanena pAnaprayujyamAnasnehasya saptarAtraM trirAtraM vA prakarSha ucyate iti na virodhaH| etaccAbhya~ggasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraNaM pAnasnehAntadivasamArabhya kriyate, tena snehapAnavishrAmadinena samaM dvyahatryahapUraNamabhya~ggasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati| snehapAnAcca yadvishrAmadinam, “ekAhoparatastadvadbhuktvA pracchardanaM pibet” (sU.a.13) ityanenoktaM, tathaivehApi| kaphotkleshakAribhojanamAha- shvashchardayitavyamityAdinA| shva iti parasminnahni| vyuShitamiti rAtrimatikrAntam| nirannamiti padacchedaH| anatisnigdhamityAdinA vamanadina eva ghRutamAtrAyuktayavAgUpAnapUrvakaM vamanamanatisnigdhapuruShaviShayaM brUte| anye tu pUrvadina evAnatisnigdhasya ghRutamAtrAM pItavata eva yavAgvAH pAnamAhuH, “peshalairvividhairannairdoShAnutkleshya dehinaH| snigdhasvinnAya vamanaM dattaM samyak pravartate|| athAparedyuH pUrvAhNe sAdhAraNe kAle vamanadravyakaShAyakalkacUrNasnehAnAmanyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ityAdi sushrutokteH| antarnakhamuShTimiti antarIkRutanakhamuShTiparimANam| yAvadvA sAdhu manyetetyanena mAtrAyA baladoShAdibhedenAsthiratvamityAha| yaShTImadhukasya kovidArAdiShu vicchedapATha uttaraprayogeShu kovidArAderyaShTImadhuvirahitasya grahaNArthaH| kovidAraH svanAmakhyAtaH, sa sharadi puShpati; karbudArastu kA~jcanAraH, sa vasante puShpati; nIpaH kadambaH, vidulaH vetasaH, shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA, sadApuShpI arkapuShpikA, pratyakpuShpI apAmArgaH| rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtamiti shRutakaShAyAt kaShAyAntaropadarshakaM pakShAntaraM; kiMvA, kaShAyapAna eva shItakaShAyavidhAnamihocyate| pUrNaM sharAvamiti ma~ggalArthaM pUrNakumbhavat| punaH punariti yAvat pittAgamanaM na bhavati tAvat punaH punaH kaShAyaM pibedityarthaH| anyatrApyuktaM- “pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhaM” (si.a.1) ityAdi| vamanAyogakArakahInavegapravRuttipratikArArthamAha- hInavegamityAdi||14||

5.sanskrit: sarveShu tu madhusaindhavaM kaphavilayanacchedArthaM vamaneShu vidadhyAt| na coShNavirodho madhunashchardanayogayuktasya, avipakvapratyAgamanAddoShanirharaNAcca||15||
5.commentary: yadyapi ca ghreyAdivamanayogeShu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathA~api ‘sarveShu’ iti padaM bAhulyArtham| vamanArthakaShAye uShNe madhuprakShepo virodhitvAnna yujyate, uktaM hi- “madhUShNamuShNArtamathavA” (sU.a.27) ityAdi, evamAsha~gkya samAdhAnamAha na coShNavirodho madhuna ityAdi| avipakvapratyAgamanAdityanena pacyamAnaM madhUShNayuktaM virudhyeteti darshayati| doShanirharaNAcceti madhUShNaviruddhamapi vamanayoge uShNe iShyate, tasya doShanirharaNAdeva na virodho bhavatIti darshayati| evaM bastiprayoge~api madhuna uShNAvirodho varNanIyaH| etena yaShTImadhvAdinavadravyakRutairnavabhiH kaShAyairnavayogAH||15||

5.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM dvau dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH srAvayet, tena rasena tRutIyaM bhAgaM piShTvA mAtrAM harItakIbhirbibhItakairAmalairvA tulyAM vartayet, tAsAmekAM dve vA pUrvoktAnAM kaShAyANAmanyatamasyA~jjalimAtreNa vimRudya balavacchleShmaprasekagranthijvarodarAruciShu pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||16||
5.commentary: phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgAvityAdau phalapippalInAM bhAgatrayaM kartavyaM; tatra bhAgadvayaM ShaDguNena kovidArAdikaShAyeNa kShAraparisrAvaNavidhivadekaviMshativArAn parisrAvaNIyam| kovidArAdInAM cAShTAnAmaShTau kaShAyAH pRuthak parisrAvaNe prayoktavyAH| yena ca kaShAyeNa phalapippalIbhAgadvayaM parisrAvya haritakyAdiparimANA mAtrA tRutIyabhAgaphalapippalIkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaShAyeNa mAtrAyogAH ; evamaShTau harItakyAdimAtrayA nirdiShTAH phalapippalIyogA bhavanti| mAtrAvikalpashca doShabalAdivikalpakRuto j~jeyaH| samAnaM pUrveNeti pUrvayogavadiha snehasvedAbhimantraNAdividhAnaM kartavyamityarthaH| evamanyatrApi pUrvavacchabdArtho j~jeyaH||16||

5.sanskrit: phalapippalIkShIraM, tena vA kShIrayavAgUmadhobhAge raktapitte hRuddAhe ca; tajjasya vA dadhna uttarakaM kaphaccharditamakaprasekeShu ; tasya vA payasaH shItasya santAnikA~jjaliM pitte prakupite uraHkaNThahRudaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samAnaM pUrveNa||17||
5.commentary: phalapippalyA kShIrapAkavidhinA sAdhitaM kShIraM phalapippalIkShIram; ayameko yogaH| teneti phalapippalIsAdhitakShIreNa| tajjasyeti phalapippalIkShIrajAtasya dadhnaH| uttarakamiti saram| santAnikA kShIroparisthaH styAno bhAgaH||17||

5.sanskrit: phalapippalIshRutakShIrAnnavanItamutpannaM phalAdikalkakaShAyasiddhaM kaphAbhibhUtAgniM vishuShyaddehaM ca mAtrayA pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||18||
5.commentary: phalAdIni phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAni ShaT| ete kShIrayogacatuShTayena ghRutayogena ca samaM pa~jca yogA adhyAyasa~ggrahe vaktavyA||18||

5.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH suparibhAvitena puShparajaHprakAshena cUrNena sarasi sa~jjAtaM bRuhatsaroruhaM sAyAhne~avacUrNayet, tadrAtrivyuShitaM prabhAte punaravacUrNitamuddhRutya haridrAkRusarakShIrayavAgUnAmanyatamaM saindhavaguDaphANitayuktamAkaNThaM pItavantamAghrApayet sukumAramutkliShTapittakaphamauShadhadveShiNamiti samAnaM pUrveNa||19||
5.commentary: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNetyAdinA ekaM ghreyayogamAha| puShparajaHprakAsheneti puShpadhUlisadRushena| haridrAbhidhAnaH kRusharo haridrAkRusharaH||19||

5.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM bhallAtakavidhiparisrutaM svarasaM paktvA phANitIbhUtamAtantulIbhAvAllehayet; AtapashuShkaM vA cUrNIkRutaM jImUtakAdikaShAyeNa pitte kaphasthAnagate pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||20||
5.commentary: bhallAtakavidhiparisrutamiti rasAyanoktabhallAtakasnehagrahaNavidhAnena parisrutaH svaraso grAhyaH| phANitayogo~ayamekaH| AtapashuShkaM vetyAdinA cUrNayogo~apyekaH||20||

5.sanskrit: phalapippalIcUrNAni pUrvavat phalAdInAM ShaNNAmanyatamakaShAyasrutAni vartikriyAH phalAdikaShAyopasarjanAH peyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||21||
5.commentary: phalapippalIcUrNAnItyAdau phalAdiShaTkaShAyabhedena kRutatvAt ShaD vartiprayogA j~jeyAH| vartikriyAyAM caturguNena kvAthena pAkAdvartyAkAratA kartavyA| atrApi ca tathA lehAdau ca sAmAnyoktena madhuprakShepo yuktaH; taM caike madhunaH pAkavirodhAnnAnumanyante||21||

5.sanskrit: phalapippalInAmAragvadha -vRukShaka-svAdukaNTaka-pAThA-pATalA-shAr~ggeShTA-mUrvA-saptaparNa-naktamAla-picumarda-paTola-suShavI-guDUcI-somavalka-dvIpikAnAM pippalI-pippalImUla-hastipippalI-citraka-shRu~ggaverANAM cAnyatamakaShAyeNa siddho leha iti samAnaM pUrveNa||22||
