punashca visheSheNa ‘agnivAyvAtmakatvAt’ iti padena vamanadravyasyAgnyAtmakatvaM pratipAdyate; tena, sAmAnye visheShe ca vamanadravyANAmAgneyatvapratipAdanAt prakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati; virecanadravyANAM tu sAmAnyoktAgneyatvasambandhAd visheShaguNakathanaprastAve ca salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAbhidhAnAdvamanadravyApekShayA~apakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati| tathAhi sushrute~api vamanavirecanayorapyAgneyatvamuktaM- “saratva-saukShmya-taikShNyauShNya-vikAshitvairvirecanam| vamanaM ca hareddoShAn prakRutyA gatamanyathA” (su.ci.a.33) ityanena| yaccAtrocyate-vamanaM yadyUrdhvabhAgaharatvaprabhAvAdUrdhvayati, tadA~agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi hetuvarNanaM na yujyate; yataH, yat sopapattikaM kAryaM na bhavati tat prabhAvakRutamiti vyapadishyate; uktaM hi- “prabhAvo~acintya ucyate” (sU.a.26) iti| tanna, yataH prabhAvasyaiveha vamanakArye vAyvagnyAtmakaguNatayA vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM heturupadRu(di)shyate, na tu vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM svatantro vamanahetuH; tathAhi sati yadanyadapi vAyvagnyAtmakamUrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvaprabhAvarahitaM, tadapi vamanakaraM syAt; yathA- kaTukarase dravye tat syAt; tasmAt prabhAvaguNatayaiva hetuvarNanam| evaM virecanadravye~api pUrvapakShasiddhAntAvanusartavyau||5||

12.sanskrit: tatra phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAnAM, shyAmA-trivRuccatura~ggula-tilvaka-mahAvRukSha-saptalA-sha~gkhinI-dantI-dravantInAM ca, nAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAsvAda-rasa-vIrya-vipAka-prabhAvagrahaNAd deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcca , vicitragandha-varNa-rasa-sparshAnAmupayogasukhArthamasa~gkhyeyasaMyogAnAmapi ca satAM dravyANAM vikalpamArgopadarshanArthaM ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH||6||
12.commentary: samprati kalpasthAnavaktavyatayA ShaDvirecanaprayogashatAnyanatisa~gkShepavistaraprayogopadarshanapUrvakaM pratijAnIte- tatra phaletyAdinA ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAma ityantena| tatra kRutavedhanAntAnAM vicchedapAThena vamanaprayogaprayojyatvaM, shyAmAdInAM virecanaprayogaprayojyatvaM ca darshayati| atraiva vamane virecane caikaikeShAM punarvastUnAM madanaphalAdInAM shyAmAdInAM ca bahavaH prayogA abhidhIyante, na punarekaikameva dravyaM vamanakArakaM virecanakArakaM vA; svalpasa~gkhyAprayogeNa grahaNasukhatA vamanavirecanayogasya bhavati, kAryaM ca sidhyatItyAsha~gkyAha- nAnAvidhetyAdi yAvadrogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcceti| asyArthaH- yasmAnnAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAH, nAnAvidhAsvAdAH, nAnAvidhavIryAH, nAnAvidhavipAkAH, nAnAvidhaprabhAvAshca madanaphalAdikA oShadhyaH, tathA tatsaMskArakAH kovidArAdikA oShadhya upalabhyante; puruShAshca deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAbhinnA nAnAvidhA dRushyante; tena naikaM dravyaM sarvasmin dehadoShAdau yaugikaM, sarvatra kAle vA prApyate sarvatra deshe vA; tasmAddehadoShAdinA bhedavati puruShe bahUnyeva dravyANi bahubhishca prayogairupakalpitAni yathAyogyatayA yathAprApti ca prayoktuM shakyante; ato bahunAmeva madanAdidravyANAM bahuprakAraprayogANAmupanyAso yukta iti bhAvaH| grahaNAt upalambhAt| deho nAnA sthUlakRushAdibhedena, bhaktiH icchA, avasthAshabdeneha rogAvasthaiva grAhyA, Adishabdeneha sattvAhArayorgrahaNam| bhUrivirecanaprayogopadarshanaprayojanAntaramapyAha- vicitretyAdi| nAnAvidhagandha-varNa-rasatayA prayoge tatkAlamuttarakAlaM ca sukhArthamityarthaH| atha kiM prabhedAnmadanaphalAdInAM ShaTprayogashatAni bhavanti, yenAdhikAH prayogA nAbhidhIyanta ityAsha~gkyAha- asa~gkhyeyetyAdi| vikalpamArgopadarshanArthamiti adhikaprayogakalpanAsamarthAn bhiShajaH prati etat ShaTprayogashatopadarshanaM kartavyAdhikaprayogakalpanAmArgopadarshakaM, tenApare~apyatra prayogAH kalpanIyAH; granthe niHsheShaprayogAnabhidhAnaM prayogANAmasa~gkhyeyatvenAshakyatvAdeva| anativistareNa ShaTprayogashatAbhidhAnaM mandabuddhisaMvyavahArArthamiti bhAvaH| uktaM hyanyatra- “etAvanto hyalamalpabuddhInAM vyavahArAya, buddhimatAM ca svAlakShaNyAnumAnayuktikushalAnAmanuktArthaj~jAnAya” (sU.a.4) iti||6||

12.sanskrit: tAni tu dravyANi desha-kAla-guNa-bhAjana-sampadvIryabalAdhAnAt kriyAsamarthatamAni bhavanti||7||
12.commentary: samprati vamanavirecanadravyANAM deshAdisampattyA guNotkarShaM darshayannAha- tAnItyAdi| deshAdibhishcaturbhiH sampacchabdaH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bhAjanaM bheShajasthApanasthAnam| vIryasya balaM vIryAdhikatvameva||7||

12.sanskrit: trividhaH khalu deshaH- jA~ggalaH, AnUpaH, sAdhAraNashceti| tatra jA~ggalaH paryAkAshabhUyiShThaH, tarubhirapi ca kadara-khadirAsanAshvakarNa-dhava-tinisha-shallakI-sAla-somavalka-badarI-tindukAshvattha-vaTAmalakIvanagahanaH, anekashamI-kakubha-shiMshapAprAyaH, sthirashuShkapavanabalavidhUyamAnapranRutyattaruNaviTapaH, pratatamRugatRuShNikopagUDhatanukharaparuShasikatAsharkarAbahulaH, lAvatittiricakorAnucaritabhUmibhAgaH, vAtapittabahulaH, sthirakaThinamanuShyaprAyo j~jeyaH, athAnUpo hintAlatamAlanArikelakadalIvanagahanaH, saritsamudraparyantaprAyaH, shishirapavanabahulaH, va~jjulavAnIropashobhitatIrAbhiH saridbhirupagatabhUmibhAgaH, kShitidharaniku~jjopashobhitaH, mandapavanAnuvIjitakShitiruhagahanaH, anekavanarAjIpuShpitavanagahanabhUmibhAgaH, snigdhatarupratAnopagUDhaH, haMsa-cakravAka-balAkA-nandImukha-puNDarIka-kAdamba-madgu -bhRu~ggarAja-shatapatra-mattakokilAnunAditataruviTapaH, sukumArapuruShaH, pavanakaphaprAyo j~jeyaH; anayoreva dvayordeshayorvIrudvanaspativAnaspatyashakunimRugagaNayutaH sthirasukumArabalavarNasaMhananopapannasAdhAraNaguNayuktapuruShaH sAdhAraNo j~jeyaH||8||
12.commentary: deshAdi samyag vyAkurvannAha- tatra trividha ityAdi| atra kecijjA~ggalAdideshalakShaNagranthaM na paThanti, tattu janapadoddhvaMsanIye paThitamiti kRutvehAnArShaM vadanti| yaistu janapadoddhvaMsanIye jA~ggalAdilakShaNaM na paThyate, tairatra paThanIya evAyaM granthaH||8||

12.sanskrit: tatra deshe sAdhAraNe jA~ggale vA yathAkAlaM shishirAtapapavanasalilasevite same shucau pradakShiNodake shmashAna-caitya-devayajanAgAra-sabhA-shvabhrArAma-valmIkoSharavirahite kusharohiShAstIrNe snigdhakRuShNamadhuramRuttike suvarNavarNamadhuramRuttike vA mRudAvaphAlakRuShTe~anupahate~anyairbalavattarairdrumairauShadhAni jAtAni prashasyante||9||
12.commentary: yathAkAlamiti yathAkAlaM shishirAdibhiH sevite deshe| shmashAnAdibhiH pratyekaM virahitashabdaH sambadhyate| devayajanenAgArashabdaH sambadhyate| sabhA janamelakasthAnam| na phAlena kRuShTa iti aphAlakRuShTe||9||

12.sanskrit: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnyupAgatasampUrNapramANa-rasavIrya-gandhAni kAlAtapAgnisalilapavanajantubhiranupahatagandha-varNa-rasa-sparsha-prabhAvANi pratyagrANyudIcyAM dishi sthitAni; teShAM shAkhApalAshamaciraprarUDhaM varShAvasantayorgrAhyaM, grIShme mUlAni shishire vA shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAM, sharadi tvakkandakShIrANi, hemante sArANi, yathartu puShpaphalamiti; ma~ggalAcAraH kalyANavRuttaH shuciH shuklavAsAH sampUjya devatA ashvinau gobrAhmaNAMshca kRutopavAsaH prA~gmukha uda~gmukho vA gRuhNIyAt||10||
12.commentary: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnItyanenaiva kAlasampaducyate; kAlajAtAnIti svakAlabhUtAni| upAgatasampUrNetyAdinA pratyagrANItyantena guNasampaducyate| pratyagrANIti sampUrNaguNatayA niShpannAni| teShAM shAkhApalAshamityAdinA kAlasampadamuktAM prapa~jcayati| shAkhAgrahaNenaiva tvagAdInAmapi grahaNam| shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAmiti cchedaH| grIShme mUlAni shishire veti kathanena yAnyAgneyAni teShAM mUlAni grIShme, yAni saumyAni teShAM mUlAni shishire, grAhyANIti vyavasthAM sUcayati; uktaM hyanyatra- “saumyAnyauShadhAni saumyeShvRutuShvAdadIta, AgneyAnyAgneyeShu” (su.sU.a.36) iti| bheShajagrahaNavidhAnamAha- ma~ggaletyAdi||10||

12.sanskrit: gRuhItvA cAnurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnyAgAreShU prAgudagdvAreShu nivAtapravAtaikadesheShu nityapuShpopahArabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhUma-rajo-mUShaka-catuShpadAmanabhigamanIyAni svavacchannAni shikyeShvAsajya sthApayet||11||
12.commentary: bhAjanasampadamAha- gRuhItvetyAdi| anurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnIti anurUpaguNavattA ca bhAjanasya bheShajasamAnaguNatayaiva| svavacchannAnIti samyakpihitAni||11||

12.sanskrit: tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjIta surA-sauvIraka-tuShodaka-maireya-medaka-dhAnyAmla -phalAmla-dadhyamlAdibhirvAte, mRudvIkAmalaka -madhu-madhuka-parUShaka-phANitakShIrAdibhiH pitte, shleShmaNi tu madhu-mUtra-kaShAyAdibhirbhAvitAnyAloDitAni ca; ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNa dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdIni pravibhajya vyAkhyAsyAmaH||12||
12.commentary: sa~gkShepeNa madanaphalAdInAM vAtAdibhedena bhAvanAloDanadravyANyAha- tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjItetyAdi| dhAnyAmlaM kA~jjikaM, phalAmlaM dADimarasAdi| shleShmaNItyAdau kaShAyashabdena shleShmaharadravyakvAtho~abhipretaH| uddesha iti sa~gkShepAbhidhAnamityarthaH| dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdInItyatra Adishabdena prakRutibalAdInAM grahaNam||12||

12.sanskrit: vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate, anapAyitvAt| tAni vasantagrIShmayorantare puShyAshvayugbhyAM mRugashirasA vA gRuhNIyAnmaitre muhUrte| yAni pakvAnyakANAnyaharitAni pANDUnyakrimINyapUtInyajantujagdhAnyahrasvAni; tAni pramRujya , kushapuTe baddhvA, gomayenAlipya, yavatu(bu)ShamAShashAlikulatthamudgapalAnAmanyatame nidadhyAdaShTarAtram| ata UrdhvaM mRudUbhUtAni madhviShTagandhAnyuddhRutya shoShayet| sushuShkANAM phalapippalIruddharet | tAsAM ghRutadadhimadhupalalavimRuditAnAM punaH shuShkANAM navaM kalashaM supramRuShTavAlukamarajaskamAkaNThaM pUrayitvA svavacchannaM svanuguptaM shikyeShvAsajya samyak sthApayet||13||
12.commentary: vamanadravyANAmityAdinA madanaphalasya prAdhAnyopadarshanapUrvakaM prayogavidhimAha| anapAyitvAditi vamanadravyAntarApekShayA~alpavyApattikatvAt| antare iti madhye, sa ca grIShmavasantayorantarvartikatipayadinAnyeva madhyo j~jeyaH| ashvayuk ashvinI| maitre muhUrta iti shivabhujagamitrAdInAM madhye mitradevatAke, evaM maitre muhUrte| palAnAmiti rAshInAm| madhuvadiShTagandho yeShAM tAni, yAni madhviShTagandhAni bhavanti tAni grAhyANIti darshayati| phalapippalIriti madanaphalamadhyagatAni pippalIsaMsthAnAni bIjAni| tAsAmityAdi pUraNavAcakashabdayogAt karaNe ShaShThI| svanuguptamiti kRutarakShAvidhAnam||13||

12.sanskrit: atha cchardanIyamAturaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannaM shvashchardayitavyamiti grAmyAnUpaudakamAMsarasa-kShIra-dadhi-mASha-tila-shAkAdibhiH samutkleshitashleShmANaM vyuShitaM jIrNAhAraM pUrvAhNe kRutabalihomama~ggalaprAyashcittaM nirannamanatisnigdhaM yavAgvA ghRutamAtrAM pItavantaM, tAsAM phalapippalInAmantarnakhamuShTiM yAvadvA sAdhu manyeta jarjarIkRutya yaShTimadhukaShAyeNa kovidAra-karbudAra-nIpa-vidula-bimbI-shaNapuShpI-sadApuShpI-pratyakpuShpI-kaShAyANAmanyatamena vA rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtaM madhusaindhavayuktaM sukhoShNaM kRutvA pUrNaM sharAvaM mantreNAnenAbhimantrayet- ‘OM brahmadakShAshvirudrendrabhUcandrArkAnilAnalAH| RuShayaH sauShadhigrAmA bhUtasa~gghAshca pAntu te| rasAyanamivarShINAM devAnAmamRutaM yathA| sudhevottamanAgAnAM bhaiShajyamidamastu te’| ityevamabhimantryoda~gmukhaM prA~gmukhaM vA~a~aturaM pAyayecchleShmajvaragulmapratishyAyArtaM visheSheNa punaH punarApittAgamanAt, tena sAdhu vamati; hInavegaM tu pippalyAmalaka-sarShapa-vacAkalkalavaNoShNodakaiH punaH punaH pravartayedApittadarshanAt| ityeSha sarvashchardanayogavidhiH||14||
12.commentary: dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannamityanena abhya~gge kriyamANe snehasahacaritasvedopapAdanaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA vidhIyate, “tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya iShTaH” (si.a.1) ityanena pAnaprayujyamAnasnehasya saptarAtraM trirAtraM vA prakarSha ucyate iti na virodhaH| etaccAbhya~ggasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraNaM pAnasnehAntadivasamArabhya kriyate, tena snehapAnavishrAmadinena samaM dvyahatryahapUraNamabhya~ggasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati| snehapAnAcca yadvishrAmadinam, “ekAhoparatastadvadbhuktvA pracchardanaM pibet” (sU.a.13) ityanenoktaM, tathaivehApi| kaphotkleshakAribhojanamAha- shvashchardayitavyamityAdinA| shva iti parasminnahni| vyuShitamiti rAtrimatikrAntam| nirannamiti padacchedaH| anatisnigdhamityAdinA vamanadina eva ghRutamAtrAyuktayavAgUpAnapUrvakaM vamanamanatisnigdhapuruShaviShayaM brUte| anye tu pUrvadina evAnatisnigdhasya ghRutamAtrAM pItavata eva yavAgvAH pAnamAhuH, “peshalairvividhairannairdoShAnutkleshya dehinaH| snigdhasvinnAya vamanaM dattaM samyak pravartate|| athAparedyuH pUrvAhNe sAdhAraNe kAle vamanadravyakaShAyakalkacUrNasnehAnAmanyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ityAdi sushrutokteH| antarnakhamuShTimiti antarIkRutanakhamuShTiparimANam| yAvadvA sAdhu manyetetyanena mAtrAyA baladoShAdibhedenAsthiratvamityAha| yaShTImadhukasya kovidArAdiShu vicchedapATha uttaraprayogeShu kovidArAderyaShTImadhuvirahitasya grahaNArthaH| kovidAraH svanAmakhyAtaH, sa sharadi puShpati; karbudArastu kA~jcanAraH, sa vasante puShpati; nIpaH kadambaH, vidulaH vetasaH, shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA, sadApuShpI arkapuShpikA, pratyakpuShpI apAmArgaH| rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtamiti shRutakaShAyAt kaShAyAntaropadarshakaM pakShAntaraM; kiMvA, kaShAyapAna eva shItakaShAyavidhAnamihocyate| pUrNaM sharAvamiti ma~ggalArthaM pUrNakumbhavat| punaH punariti yAvat pittAgamanaM na bhavati tAvat punaH punaH kaShAyaM pibedityarthaH| anyatrApyuktaM- “pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhaM” (si.a.1) ityAdi| vamanAyogakArakahInavegapravRuttipratikArArthamAha- hInavegamityAdi||14||

12.sanskrit: sarveShu tu madhusaindhavaM kaphavilayanacchedArthaM vamaneShu vidadhyAt| na coShNavirodho madhunashchardanayogayuktasya, avipakvapratyAgamanAddoShanirharaNAcca||15||
12.commentary: yadyapi ca ghreyAdivamanayogeShu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathA~api ‘sarveShu’ iti padaM bAhulyArtham| vamanArthakaShAye uShNe madhuprakShepo virodhitvAnna yujyate, uktaM hi- “madhUShNamuShNArtamathavA” (sU.a.27) ityAdi, evamAsha~gkya samAdhAnamAha na coShNavirodho madhuna ityAdi| avipakvapratyAgamanAdityanena pacyamAnaM madhUShNayuktaM virudhyeteti darshayati| doShanirharaNAcceti madhUShNaviruddhamapi vamanayoge uShNe iShyate, tasya doShanirharaNAdeva na virodho bhavatIti darshayati| evaM bastiprayoge~api madhuna uShNAvirodho varNanIyaH| etena yaShTImadhvAdinavadravyakRutairnavabhiH kaShAyairnavayogAH||15||

12.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM dvau dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH srAvayet, tena rasena tRutIyaM bhAgaM piShTvA mAtrAM harItakIbhirbibhItakairAmalairvA tulyAM vartayet, tAsAmekAM dve vA pUrvoktAnAM kaShAyANAmanyatamasyA~jjalimAtreNa vimRudya balavacchleShmaprasekagranthijvarodarAruciShu pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||16||
12.commentary: phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgAvityAdau phalapippalInAM bhAgatrayaM kartavyaM; tatra bhAgadvayaM ShaDguNena kovidArAdikaShAyeNa kShAraparisrAvaNavidhivadekaviMshativArAn parisrAvaNIyam| kovidArAdInAM cAShTAnAmaShTau kaShAyAH pRuthak parisrAvaNe prayoktavyAH| yena ca kaShAyeNa phalapippalIbhAgadvayaM parisrAvya haritakyAdiparimANA mAtrA tRutIyabhAgaphalapippalIkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaShAyeNa mAtrAyogAH ; evamaShTau harItakyAdimAtrayA nirdiShTAH phalapippalIyogA bhavanti| mAtrAvikalpashca doShabalAdivikalpakRuto j~jeyaH| samAnaM pUrveNeti pUrvayogavadiha snehasvedAbhimantraNAdividhAnaM kartavyamityarthaH| evamanyatrApi pUrvavacchabdArtho j~jeyaH||16||

12.sanskrit: phalapippalIkShIraM, tena vA kShIrayavAgUmadhobhAge raktapitte hRuddAhe ca; tajjasya vA dadhna uttarakaM kaphaccharditamakaprasekeShu ; tasya vA payasaH shItasya santAnikA~jjaliM pitte prakupite uraHkaNThahRudaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samAnaM pUrveNa||17||
12.commentary: phalapippalyA kShIrapAkavidhinA sAdhitaM kShIraM phalapippalIkShIram; ayameko yogaH| teneti phalapippalIsAdhitakShIreNa| tajjasyeti phalapippalIkShIrajAtasya dadhnaH| uttarakamiti saram| santAnikA kShIroparisthaH styAno bhAgaH||17||

12.sanskrit: phalapippalIshRutakShIrAnnavanItamutpannaM phalAdikalkakaShAyasiddhaM kaphAbhibhUtAgniM vishuShyaddehaM ca mAtrayA pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||18||
12.commentary: phalAdIni phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAni ShaT| ete kShIrayogacatuShTayena ghRutayogena ca samaM pa~jca yogA adhyAyasa~ggrahe vaktavyA||18||

12.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH suparibhAvitena puShparajaHprakAshena cUrNena sarasi sa~jjAtaM bRuhatsaroruhaM sAyAhne~avacUrNayet, tadrAtrivyuShitaM prabhAte punaravacUrNitamuddhRutya haridrAkRusarakShIrayavAgUnAmanyatamaM saindhavaguDaphANitayuktamAkaNThaM pItavantamAghrApayet sukumAramutkliShTapittakaphamauShadhadveShiNamiti samAnaM pUrveNa||19||
12.commentary: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNetyAdinA ekaM ghreyayogamAha| puShparajaHprakAsheneti puShpadhUlisadRushena| haridrAbhidhAnaH kRusharo haridrAkRusharaH||19||

12.sanskrit: phalapippalInAM bhallAtakavidhiparisrutaM svarasaM paktvA phANitIbhUtamAtantulIbhAvAllehayet; AtapashuShkaM vA cUrNIkRutaM jImUtakAdikaShAyeNa pitte kaphasthAnagate pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||20||
12.commentary: bhallAtakavidhiparisrutamiti rasAyanoktabhallAtakasnehagrahaNavidhAnena parisrutaH svaraso grAhyaH| phANitayogo~ayamekaH| AtapashuShkaM vetyAdinA cUrNayogo~apyekaH||20||

12.sanskrit: phalapippalIcUrNAni pUrvavat phalAdInAM ShaNNAmanyatamakaShAyasrutAni vartikriyAH phalAdikaShAyopasarjanAH peyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||21||
12.commentary: phalapippalIcUrNAnItyAdau phalAdiShaTkaShAyabhedena kRutatvAt ShaD vartiprayogA j~jeyAH| vartikriyAyAM caturguNena kvAthena pAkAdvartyAkAratA kartavyA| atrApi ca tathA lehAdau ca sAmAnyoktena madhuprakShepo yuktaH; taM caike madhunaH pAkavirodhAnnAnumanyante||21||

12.sanskrit: phalapippalInAmAragvadha -vRukShaka-svAdukaNTaka-pAThA-pATalA-shAr~ggeShTA-mUrvA-saptaparNa-naktamAla-picumarda-paTola-suShavI-guDUcI-somavalka-dvIpikAnAM pippalI-pippalImUla-hastipippalI-citraka-shRu~ggaverANAM cAnyatamakaShAyeNa siddho leha iti samAnaM pUrveNa||22||
12.commentary: phalapippalInAmAragvadhetyAdinA AragvadhAdiviMshatidravyakvAthabhedena kRutatvAdviMshatirlehA j~jeyAH| vRukShakaH kuTajaH, svAdukaNTakaH vika~gkataH, shAr~ggeShTA gu~jjA, suShavI kAravellakaM, dvIpikA hiMsrA, ‘kaNTakArI’ ityanye||22||

12.sanskrit: phalapippalIShvelA-hareNukA-shatapuShpA-kustumburu-tagara-kuShTha-tvak-coraka-marubakAguru-guggulvelavAluka-shrIveShTaka-paripelava-mAMsI-shaileyaka-sthauNeyaka-sarala-pArAvatapadyashokarohiNInAM viMshateranyatamasya kaShAyeNa sAdhitotkArikA utkArikAkalpena, modakA vA modakakalpena, yathAdoSharogabhakti prayojyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||23||
12.commentary: phalapippalIShvityAdinotkArikA modakAshca pratyekaM viMshatiH| corakaH gandhadravyaM svanAmakhyAtaM, paripelavaM kaivartamustakaM, sthauNeyakaH granthiparNakaM, pArAvatapadI jyotiShmatI, ashokarohiNI ashokasadRushapatrA latA, ‘kaTurohiNI’ ityanye| kecidatra sthauNeyakaM parityajyApAkIpAdyA viMshatiM pUrayanti, apAkIpAdI svanAmakhyAtA| utkArikAkalpeneti sUdashAstroktotkArikAvidhAnena||23||

12.sanskrit: phalapippalIsvarasakaShAyaparibhAvitAni tilashAlitaNDulapiShTAni tatkaShAyopasarjanAni shaShkulIkalpena vA shaShkulyaH, pUpakalpena vA pUpAH iti samAnaM pUrveNa||24|| etenaiva ca kalpena sumukha-surasa-kuTheraka-kANDIra-kAlamAlaka-parNAsaka-kShavaka-phaNijjhaka-gRu~jjana-kAsamarda-bhRu~ggarAjAnAM poTekShuvAlikA-kAla~gkataka-daNDairakANAM cAnyatamasya kaShAyeNa kArayet||25||
12.commentary: phalapippalIsvarasenetyAdinA shaShkulyapUpayoH pRuthageko yogaH| etenaiva ca kalpenetyAdinA sumukhAdipa~jcadashadravyakaShAyeNa pRuthak shaShkulyapUpayoH karaNAt pa~jcadasha yogA bhavanti| evaM militvA shaShkulIpUpayoH pRuthak ShoDashayogA bhavanti| poTA ikShugandhA; daNDairakA gundrAkhyagulmaH, nalo vA||24-25||

12.sanskrit: tathA badaraShADava-rAga-leha-modakotkArikA-tarpaNa-pAnaka-mAMsarasa-yUSha-madyAnAM madanaphalAnyanyatamenopasRujya yathAdoSharogabhakti dadyAt; taiH sAdhu vamatIti||26||
12.commentary: tathA badaraShADavetyAdinA dasha yogAH| badarakRutaH ShADavo badaraShADavaH||26||

12.sanskrit: madanaH karahATashca rAThaH piNDItakaH phalam| shvasanashceti paryAyairucyate tasya kalpanA||27||
12.commentary: madanasya vyavahArArthaM paryAyAnAha- madanaH karahATashcetyAdi| tasya kalpaneti ya evambhUtaiH paryAyairvyAkhyAtastasyeyaM kalpanA| asya ca paryAyAbhidhAnaM bhUriprayogeShu vihitatvenAbhyarhitatvAjj~jeyam| evamanyatrApi paryAyAbhidhAne prayojanaM varNanIyam||27||

12.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- nava yogAH kaShAyeShu, mAtrAsvaShTau , payoghRute| pa~jca, phANitacUrNe dvau ghreye, vartikriyAsu ShaT||28|| viMshatirviMshatirlehamodakotkArikAsu ca| shaShkulIpUpayoshcoktA yogAH ShoDasha ShoDasha||29|| dashAnye ShADavAdyeShu trayastriMshadidaM shatam| yogAnAM vidhivaddiShTaM phalakalpe maharShiNA||30||
12.commentary: madanaphalayogAnAM navAdisa~gkhyotkarShanirAsArthaM sukhasmaraNArthaM ca tAn sa~ggraheNAha- nava yogA ityAdi| asya cArtho yathAsthAnaM vyAhRutaH||28-30||

12.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute~aprApte dRuDhabalasampUrite kalpasthAne madanakalpo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
12.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM kalpasthAne madanakalpo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

1.sanskrit: athAto jvaranidAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
1.commentary: sa~gkShepeNa hetuli~ggAbhidhAyakaM sUtrasthAnamanu prapa~jcena hetuli~ggAbhidhAyakaM nidAnasthAnamucyate; hetuli~ggaj~jAnapUrvikA hi cikitsA sAdhvI bhavati| yacca cikitsAsUtramAtramabhidhAtavyaM, tadupashayAntargatameveti kRutvA; kiMvA, hetuli~ggAbhidhAnasyApi cikitsArthatvAccikitsAsUtramAtrAbhidhAnamiha | tatrApi ca shArIravikAreShu pradhAnatvAjjvarasyaiva nidAnamAdAvucyate| yathA ca jvaraH pradhAnaM tathA~atraiva ‘jvarastu khalu’ ityAdinA vakShyati; tathA cikitsite~api vakShyati- “dehendriyamanastApI sarvarogAgrajo balI” (ci.a.3) ityAdi| yattu vakShyati- “purA gulmotpattirabhUt” (ni.a.8) iti; tatra purAshabda AdyAvirbhAve gulmasya vartate, natu jvarasya prAgbhAve; dakShAdhvaroddhvaMse hi jvaraparigRuhItAnAM prANinAM dikShu vidrAvaNAdinA gulmotpatteruktatvAt| nidAnaM kAraNamihocyate, tacceha vyAdhijanakaM vyAdhibodhakaM ca sAmAnyenocyate| tatra vyAdhijanakaM nidAnaM hetuH, vyAdhibodhakaM ca kAraNaM nidAnapUrvarUparUpopashayasamprAptirUpam| tatra heturUpaM nidAnaM janakaM ca bhavati, vyAdherbodhakaM ca bhavati| ata eva prathamam ‘iha khalu’ ityAdinA hetumabhidhAya tasyopalabdhirnidAnetyAdinA punarheturapyuktaH| jvarasya nidAnaM jvaranidAnam| kiMvA, nidAnashabdo janakakAraNavacana eva; taM jvarasya janakakAraNaM nidAnamadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyo jvaranidAnam| tena pUrvarUpAdInAmapi j~japtihetUnAM tathA cikitsAsUtrasya ca grahaNam||1-2||

1.sanskrit: iha khalu heturnimittamAyatanaM kartA kAraNaM pratyayaH samutthAnaM nidAnamityanarthAntaram| tattrividham- asAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH, praj~jAparAdhaH, pariNAmashceti||3||
1.commentary: tadevaM jvaranidAne vaktavye sarvavyAdhisAdhAraNameva nidAnaM vaktumudyataH sAmAnyapUrvakatvAdvisheShasya, tatrApyutpannasya vyAdherlakShaNaM yuktamiti kRutvA utpattihetumeva vyavahArArthaM lakShaNArthaM ca paryAyairAha- iha khalvityAdi| iheti iha prakaraNe kAraNAbhidhAyake hetvAdayo~anarthAntare ; prakaraNAntare arthAntare~api hetvAdishabdA bhavantIti darshayati; yathA- vakShyati- “heturakRutakatvAt” (vi.a.8) iti, tathA “dashaivAyatanAni syuH” (sU.a.29), tathA “kartA, mantA, veditA, boddhA” (shA.a.4) ityAdau, pratyayasya laDAdau, utthAnasya udgamanAdau| hetvAdibhUriparyAyakathanaM shAstre vyavahArArthaM, tathA hetvAdishabdAnAmarthAntare~api vartamAnatve paryAyAntareNa samaM sAmAnAdhikaraNyAt kAraNa eva vRuttirniyamyate; tena, ekasminnarthe yasmiMste shabdAH pravartante tat kAraNamitarahetvAdyarthebhyo vyavacchidyate; tena, lakShaNArthaM ca paryAyAbhidhAnaM bhavati| evamanyatrApi vyAdhyAdiparyAyAbhidhAne~api vyAkhyeyam| iha cAShTasa~gkhyAyA ma~ggalatvena, tathA~aShTavidhavyAdhijvarAdyabhidhAnAnuSha~ggAccAShTAveva hetuparyAyA uktAH; tenApare~api yonimUlamukhaprakRutyAdayo hetuparyAyA boddhavyAH, te ca tantravistarabhayAnnoktAH| evaM rogaparyAyAntarAnabhidhAne~api granthavistarabhayAdyanusaraNIyam| hetorbhedamAha- tat trividhamityAdi| etaccAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogAdi dIrgha~jjIvitIye tisraiShaNIye ca prapa~jcitamiti neha prapa~jcyate| atra pAThAdeva tritve siddhe trividhamitivacanaM bahuprapa~jcasyApyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogAdestraividhyAnatikramopadarshanArthaM, tathA pratyekamayogAtiyogamithyAyogabhedAttrividhatvadarshanArthaM ca| etacca hetutritayamuktamapi punaH prakaraNavashAducyamAnamiha na punaruktaM doShamAvahati| etaccAsAtmyendriyArthAdestraividhyaM mUlakAraNaM prati niyAmakaM, tena “jvarasantApAdraktapittamudIryate” (ni.a.8) ityAdyuktarogAdirUpapratyAsannakAraNAnavarodho nodbhAvanIyaH| kiMvA, raktapittAdikAraNe jvarAdAvapyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogAdyeva mUlakAraNaM, tena jvarAdikArye raktapittAdau jvarAdikAraNameva mUlakAraNaM bhavati| “kAlabuddhIndriyArthAnAM yogo mithyA na cAti ca” (sU.a.1) iti pUrvoktakramabhedenehAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogasyAdAvabhidhAnena sarveShAmevaiShAM rogakartRutve prAdhAnyaM darshayati, mA bhUdekAntAbhidhAnena pradhAnatAniyamaH| yadyapi ca mUlabhUtatvena praj~jAparAdhaH pradhAnaM bhavati , tathA~api pratyAsannakAraNatvena tathA~abuddhipUrvakasyApyutkaTashabdamithyAyogAderapi kAraNatvenAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogo~api pradhAnam| yadyapi kAlo duShpariharatvena pradhAnaM, tathA~api so~apIndriyArthaparAdhInatvenApradhAnaM, kAlAtiyogAdayo hIndriyArthashItAdyatiyogAdibhya eva prAyo bhavanti||3||

1.sanskrit: atastrividhA vyAdhayaH prAdurbhavanti- AgneyAH, saumyAH, vAyavyAshca; dvividhAshcApare- rAjasAH, tAmasAshca||4||
1.commentary: hetorhetutvaM kArye bhavatIti hetukAryaM vyAdhimAha- atastrividhA ityAdi| na cAtra yathAsa~gkhyam, ekarUpAdapi hetostrividhavyAdhyutpAdAt| atrApi trividhavacanamAnantye~api rogANAmAgneyatvAdyanatikramopadarshanArtham| AgneyAH paittikAH, saumyAH kaphajAH, vAyavyAH vAtajAH| yadyapi pradhAnatvena vAyavyA eva prathamaM nirdeShTuM yujyante, tathA~apIha jvare pittasya pradhAnatvAdAgneyAbhidhAnam| AgneyasaumyavAyavyA iti samAsenaikaikasmAdapyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogAdestrividharogotpattitvaM darshayati, asamAse hi yathAsa~gkhyamapi sha~gkyeta| anyathA~api vyAdhInuktahetujAnAha- dvividhAshcApare ityAdi| rAjasatAmasAnAM ca vicchidya pATheneha tantre shArIravyAdhyadhikArapravRutte~anadhikAratvenAprapa~jcanIyatvaM darshayati, abhidhAnaM ca rAjasatAmasayoriha vyAdhikathanasya nyUnatAparihArArtham| AgantavashcAbhighAtAdijA rogA AgneyAdiShvevAntarbhavanti; yatastatrApi hi doShaprakopo~avyapadeshyo~astyeva; kiMvA, apare iti apradhAnAH, paro hi shreShTha ucyate; apradhAnatve coktaivopapattiH||4||

1.sanskrit: tatra vyAdhirAmayo gada Ata~gko yakShmA jvaro vikAro roga ityanarthAntaram||5||
1.commentary: vyAdhInAmAgneyAdivibhAgaM darshayitvA vyavahArArthaM lakShaNArthaM ca paryAyAnAha- tatra vyAdhirityAdi| atrApi paryAyANAmanarthAntareNAta~gkAdishabdAnAM bhayAdyarthatAvyudAsAdvyAdhilakShaNatvaM bodhyam| Ata~gkashabdena hi bhayamapyucyate, vikArashabdena hi indriyAdayo~api ShoDasha vikArA ucyante| tathA vyAdhyAdishabdAnAM vyutpattyA rogadharmA lakShaNIyAH| tathA hi- vividhaM duHkhamAdadhAtIti vyAdhiH; prAyeNAmasamutthatvenAmaya ityucyate; Ata~gka iti duHkhayuktatvena kRucchrajIvanaM karoti, vacanaM hi- “Ata~gkaH kRucchrajIvane” iti; yakShmashabdena ca rAjayakShmavadanekarogayuktatvaM vikArANAM darshayati; jvarashabdena ca dehamanaHsantApakaratvaM; vikArashabdena ca sharIramanasoranyathAkaraNatvaM vyAdherdarshayati; rogashabdena ca rujAkartRutvam||5||

1.sanskrit: tasyopalabdhirnidAnapUrvarUpali~ggopashayasamprAptitaH||6||
1.commentary: idAnIM vyAdherjanakahetumabhidhAya tathA taddhetujanyaM ca vyAdhimuktvA tasya vyAdherj~jAnopAyamAha- tasyetyAdi| avij~jAte hi vyAdhau cikitsA na pravartate, ataH sAmAnyena vyAdhij~jAnopAyanidAnapa~jcakAbhidhAnaM yuktam||6||

1.sanskrit: tatra nidAnaM kAraNamityuktamagre||7||
1.commentary: nidAnaM vivRuNoti- tatretyAdi| agre uktamiti ‘iha khalu’ ityAdinA ‘pariNAmashca’ ityantena| kAraNaM ca vyAdhInAM sannikRuShTaM vAtAdi, viprakRuShTaM cArthAnAmayogAdi; punarviprakRuShTaM kAraNaM raktapittasya jvarasantApa ityAdi; punashca vyAdhInAM sAmAnyena viprakRuShTaM kAraNamuktaM yathA- “prAgapi cAdharmAdRute na rogotpattirabhUt” (vi.a.3) ityAdi; tadetat sarvamapi kAraNashabdena grAhyam| tatrAdharmakAryatvena vyAdhInAM daivavyapAshrayaprAyashcittabalima~ggaletyAdicikitsAsAdhyatvaM pratIyate, rudrakopabhavatvena ca jvarasya mahAprabhAvatvaM tathA~a~agneyatvaM ca pratIyate; krodho hyAgneyaH, tena tanmayo jvaro~apyAgneyaH| tathAca vacanam- “UShmA pittAdRute nAsti jvaro nAstyUShmaNA vinA| tasmAt pittaviruddhAni tyajet pittAdhike~adhikam” (vA.ci.a.1) iti| vAtAdijanyatvaj~jAnena ca vAtAdiviparItabheShajasAdhyatvaM tathA~anudbhUtavAtAdivikArAntarasambandho~api bhAvI kalpyate| asAtmyarUkShAdihetusevAdarshanena ca bhAvI vyAdhistajjanya unnIyate| vyAdhiparIkShAyAM ca sandehe jAte yasya vyAdherhetusevA dRushyate, sa parikalpyate; evamAdi hetunA vyAdhiparIkShaNam||7||

1.sanskrit: pUrvarUpaM prAgutpatti lakShaNaM vyAdheH||8||
1.commentary: nidAnAnantarIyakatvAt pUrvarUpAdInAM nidAnAnantaraM pUrvarUpAdInyucyante , ataH pUrvarUpalakShaNamAha- pUrvetyAdi| utpatteH prAk prAgutpatti| etena utpatteH pUrvaM yadbhaviShyadvyAdherlakShaNaM tat pUrvarUpam| nidAnasevA tu bhAvivyAdhibodhikA bhavatyapi nidAnashabdagRuhItatvAdeva tathA lakShaNashabdAnabhidheyatvAcca na pUrvarUpashabdenocyate| uktaM hyanyatra- “sthAnasaMshrayiNaH kruddhA bhAvivyAdhiprabodhakam| li~ggaM kurvanti yaddoShAH pUrvarUpaM taducyate” iti| na ca vAcyaM yadanutpannasyAvidyamAnasya vyAdheH kathaM lakShaNaM bhavatIti; yato meghAdapi bhAvinI vRuShTiranumIyate, tathA rohiNyudayaM dRuShTvA kRuttikodayo~anumIyate| tacca pUrvarUpaM dvividham- ekaM bhAvivyAdhyavyaktarUpaM, yaduktam- “avyaktaM lakShaNaM tasya pUrvarUpamiti smRutam” (ci.a.11) iti, tathA “li~ggamavyaktamalpatvAdvyAdhInAM tadyathAyatham” (vA. ni. a.1) iti ; dvitIyaM tu doShadUShyasammUrcchanAvasthAjanyamavyaktali~ggAdanyadeva; yathA- jvare bAlapradveSharomaharShAdi; na hyetat pUrvarUpaM jvarAvasthAyAM niyamena vyaktaM bhavati, kintu jvarapUrvakAla eva; yatra tu vyaktaM bhavati, sa cAsAdhyo mataH| ata evaivambhUtapUrvarUpAbhiprAyeNaivAriShTe vakShyati- “pUrvarUpANi sarvANi jvaroktAnyatimAtrayA| yaM vishanti vishatyenaM mRutyurjvarapurassaraH” (iM.a.5) iti; tathA- “anyasyApi ca rogasya pUrvarUpANi yaM naram| vishantyanena kalpena tasyApi maraNaM dhruvam” (iM.a.5) iti| etaddhi yadyavyaktalakShaNapUrvarUpAbhiprAyeNa vacanaM syAttadA sarvajvarANAmasAdhyatvaM syAt, yataH pUrvarUpAvasthAyAmavyaktAni lakShaNAni jvare jAte vyaktAni sarvANi sarvatraiva bhavanti; tasmAt pUrvarUpAvasthApratiniyatapUrvarUpAbhiprAyeNaivaitadvacanam| avyaktatA ca lakShaNAnAmiyameva- yadalpatvenAsphuTatvam| yattu pUrvarUpaM doShadUShyasammUrcchanAvasthAniyataM tad vyAdhimAtrasya gamakaM, na taddoShavisheShaM gamayati| etatpUrvarUpAbhiprAyeNa ca vAgbhaTe~apyuktaM yat- “prAgrUpaM yena lakShyate| utpitsurAmayo doShavisheSheNAnadhiShThitaH ” (vA. ni.a.1) iti| yattu avyaktali~ggaM rUpaM pUrvarUpaM, taddoShavisheShamapi vyAdhergamayati, yaduktaM hArIte- “iti pUrvarUpamaShTAnAM jvarANAM sAmAnyataH, visheShatastu jRumbhA~ggamardabhUyiShThaM hRudayodvegi vAtajam” ityAdi, tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “sAmAnyato, visheShAttu jRumbhA~atyarthaM samIraNAt| pittAnnayanayordAhaH kaphAnnAnnAbhinandanam” (su.u.a.39) iti, etaddhi pUrvarUpaM bhAvijvarali~ggamevAvyaktamalpatveneti j~jeyam| vyakte hi jvare vAtAdije jRumbhAdayaH pUrvarUpApekShayA~atyarthaM bhavanti| evaM pUrvarUpadvaividhye yatra vishiShTaM pUrvarUpamasti tatra sAkShAdevAbhidhIyate, yatra vishiShTaM nAsti tatra li~ggamAtraM vakShyati; tenAvyaktAnyeva li~ggAni pUrvarUpamiti tatra j~jAtavyam ||8||

1.sanskrit: prAdurbhUtalakShaNaM punarli~ggam| tatra li~ggamAkRutirlakShaNaM cihnaM saMsthAnaM vya~jjanaM rUpamityanarthAntaram||9||
1.commentary: lakShaNamAha- prAdurbhUtetyAdi| utpannavyAdheH svarUpaM, tathA vAtAdyAmapakvAdivisheShaNavishiShTaM vyAdhiM nidAnopashayasamprAptivyatiriktaM yadbodhayati, talli~ggam| anena ca vyAdhipratiniyataM li~ggaM yathA- jvarasya santApaH, tathA atisaraNamatIsArasyetyAdi gRuhyate; tathA vAtAdikRutaM ca vAtAdijvarasya viShamArambhavisargitvAdi gRuhyate; tathA AmapakvajIrNajvaralakShaNAdIni vishiShTavyAdhibodhakAni gRuhyante; tathA upadravAshcAsAdhyatAdyavasthApannavyAdhibodhakatvena lakShaNAnyeva| riShTaM tu maraNasya pUrvarUpameva| nidAnAdayastu yadyapyutpannavyAdhigamakA api bhavanti, tathA~api pRuthaglakShaNAnirdeshAnna te iha li~ggashabdenocyante| vyavahArArthaM tathA lakShaNArthaM ca li~ggaparyAyAnAha- tatra li~ggamityAdi| asminnarthe~anarthAntaramiti li~ggalakShaNe~arthe~abhidheye~anarthAntaraM, prakaraNAntare tvarthAntare~api li~ggAdayo bhavanti; yathA- “balI li~ggaM samarpayet” (ci.a.2) ityatra shepha ucyate, tathA “saMsthAnamAkRutirj~jeyA suShamA viShamA ca yA” (i.a.7); tathA “lakShaNavaccodAharaNavacca” (vi.a.8), tathA “tailasarpirbhyAM vya~jjanAnyupakalpayet”, tathA “rUpasya sattvasya ca santatiryA” (shA.a.2) ityAdau| nanu, yatheha ‘asminnarthe’ ityuktaM tathA hetuvyAdhisamprAptiparyAyAbhidhAne~api ‘asminnarthe’ iti vaktavyam| na, hetuparyAyAbhidhAne tAvat ‘iha khalu’ ityanenaiva tadartha ukta eva, samprAptiparyAyakathane ca vyAdheriti padenaiva ‘asminnarthe’ itipadasyArtho labhyata eva, gadaparyAyeShu tu nArthAntaratA prAyo dRushyate, tena tatra ‘asminnarthe’ iti na kRutam| ayaM cAcAryAbhiprAyo yat- yatrAnyArthatAM shabdasya pashyati, tatraiva ‘asminnarthe’ iti karoti, yathA- ‘samavetAnAM punardoShANAmaMshAMshavikalpo vikalpo~asminnarthe’ iti| vikalpashabdo hyayamanyatrApi vartate, yathA- “anyaishca vikalpairvikalpitAnAM” (vi.a.1), tathA “vikalpo na tvasAdhyAnAM” (sU.a.10) ityAdi| nanu pUrvarUpopashayayoH kimiti paryAyAnabhidhAnam? brUmaH- pUrvarUpasya tAvat paryAyAbhidhAnaM yadeva rUpasya tadeva; yataH, rUpAdaya eva hi pUrvashabdayuktAH pUrvarUpaparyAyA bhavanti; upashayastu cikitsA, tasyAstu paryAyAshcikitsita eva svAdhikAratvena vaktavyA iti neha punaruktAH||9||

1.sanskrit: upashayaH punarhetuvyAdhiviparItAnAM viparItArthakAriNAM cauShadhAhAravihArANAmupayogaH sukhAnubandhaH||10||
1.commentary: upashayamAha- upashaya ityAdi| upashayanamupashayaH sukhAnubandha ityarthaH| hetunA, tathA vyAdhinA, tathA hetuvyAdhibhyAM ca viparItA hetuvyAdhiviparItAH; teShAmauShadhAhAravihArANAM, tathA hetuvyAdhiviparItArthakAriNAM cauShadhAnnavihArANAM; sukhAnubandha iti sukharUpo~anubandhaH, anubandhashca sukhakAraNamityarthaH | ayaM copashayo gUDhali~gge ca vyAdhau j~jAnopAyo bhavati| yaduktaM- “gUDhali~ggaM vyAdhimupashayAnupashayAbhyAM parIkSheta” (vi.a.4) iti; uktaM ca trishothIye- “snehoShNamardanAbhyAM ca praNashyet sa ca vAtikaH” (sU.a.18)| atra ca viparItArthakAri tadevocyate yadaviparItatayA~a~apAtataH pratIyamAnaM viparItasyArthaM prashamalakShaNaM karoti| atrodAharaNAni likhyante- hetuviparItamauShadhaM yathA- shItakaphaje jvare shuNThyAdyuShNaM bheShajaM, hetuviparItamannaM yathA- shramAnilaje jvare rasaudanaH, hetuviparIto vihAro yathA- divAsvapnotthakaphe rAtrau jAgaraNaM, vyAdhiviparItamauShadhaM yathA- atIsAre stambhanaM pAThAdi, vyAdhiviparItamannaM yathA- atIsAre stambhanaM masUrAdi, vyAdhiviparIto vihAro yathA- udAvarte pravAhaNaM, hetuvyAdhiviparItamauShadhaM yathA- vAtashothe vAtaharaM shothaharaM ca dashamUlaM, hetuvyAdhiviparItamannaM yathA- shItotthajvare uShNA jvaraghnI ca yavAgUH, hetuvyAdhiviparIto vihAro yathA- snigdhadivAsvapnajAyAM tandrAyAM rUkShaM tandrAviparItaM ca rAtrijAgaraNaM , hetuviparItArthakAryauShadhaM yathA- pittapradhAne pacyamAne shothe pittakara uShNa upanAhaH, hetuviparItArthakAryannaM yathA- pacyamAne pittapradhAne shothe vidAhyannaM, hetuviparItArthakArI vihAro yathA- vAtonmAde santrAsanaM, vyAdhiviparItArthakAryauShadhaM yathA- chardyAM vamanakArakaM madanaphalAdi; vyAdhiviparItArthakAryannaM yathA- atIsAre virekakArakaM kShIraM, uktaM hi- “bahudoShasya dIptAgneH saprANasya na tiShThati| paittiko yadyatIsAraH payasA taM virecayet” (ci. a.19) iti; vyAdhiviparItArthakArI vihAro yathA- chardyAM vamanasAdhyAyAM vamanArthaM pravAhaNaM; hetuvyAdhiviparItArthakAryauShadhaM yathA- agninA pluShTe~agurvAdinA lepaH, uShNaM hi hetAvagnau vyAdhau ca dAhe~anuguNaM pratibhAti; hetuvyAdhiviparItArthakAryannaM yathA- madyapAnotthe madAtyaye madakArakaM madyaM; hetuvyAdhiviparItArthakArI vihAro yathA- vyAyAmajanitasammUDhavAte jalaprataraNAdirUpo vyAyAmaH, ayaM hetau vyAyAme vyAdhau ca sammUDhavAte~anuguNaH pratibhAti| nanUpashayavadanupashayo~api vyAdhiparIkShako~asti, ucyate ca- “gUDhali~ggaM vyAdhimupashayAnupashayAbhyAM parIkSheta” (vi. a.4), tathA vAgbhaTe~apyuktaM- “viparIto~anupashayaH sa hyasAtmyamiti smRutaH” (vA. ni. a.1) iti; satyamasti ca, paraM nidAnagrahaNenaiva gRuhItatvAnna pRuthagucyate; anupashayo~api hetusevayaiva bhavati||10||

1.sanskrit: samprAptirjAtirAgatirityanarthAntaraM vyAdheH||11||
1.commentary: yadyapi samprAptyanantaraM li~ggaprAdurbhAvaH, tathA~api samprAptervyAdhinirUpaNaM pratyalpaprayojanatvAccheShataH samprAptimAha- samprAptirityAdi| jAtiH janma; samprAtpyAgatijAtishabdairyo~artho~abhidhIyate sA vyAdheH samprAptirityarthaH| a(ta)traike vyAdhijanmamAtramantyakAraNavyApArajanyaM samprAptimAhuH| iyaM ca samprAptiryadyapi nidAnAdivad vyAdhibodhikA na bhavati, tathA~api nAnutpannasya vyAdherlakShaNaM bhavatIti kRutvA upapattervyAdhyupalambhakatvaM varNayanti| etaccAnye na manyante, yato naivaM sati samprAptitaH kashcidvisheSho vyAdheradhigamyate| na cAyaM niyamaH- yadutpanna eva paraM vyAdhirupalabhyate, yato nidAnapUrvarUpAbhyAmanutpanno~api vyAdhirbhAvitvena budhyate| tasmAd vyAdhijanakadoShavyApAravisheShayuktaM vyAdhijanmeha samprAptishabdena vAcyam, ata eva paryAye ‘AgatiH’ ityuktam| Agatirhi utpAdakAraNasya vyAdhijananaparyantaM gamanam| iyaM ca samprAptirvyAdhivisheShaM bodhayatveva| yathA jvare- ‘sa yadA prakupitaH pravishyAmAshayam’ ityArabhya ‘tadA jvaramabhinirvartayati’ ityantena yA samprAptirucyate, tayA jvarasyAmAshayadUShakatvAgnyupaghAtakatvarasadUShakatvAdayo dharmAH pratIyante| na ca vAcyaM- doShANAmayamAmAshayadUShakatvAdirdharmaH , tatashca kAraNadharmANAM nidAnagrahaNenaiva grahaNaM bhavatIti; yataH, kAraNadharmo~apyayaM vyAdhijanakadoShavyApArarUpaH samprAptishabdena visheShabodhanArthaM pRuthak kRutvocyate; yathA- li~ggatvAvisheShe~api bhAvivyAdhibodhakatvavisheShAt pUrvarUpaM pRuthagucyate, ata eva vAgbhaTe~apyevameva samprAptilakShaNamuktaM- “yathAduShTena doSheNa yathA cAnuvisarpatA| nirvRuttirAmayasyAsau samprAptirjAtirAgatiH ” (vA. ni.a.1) iti||11||

1.sanskrit: sA sa~gkhyAprAdhAnyavidhivikalpabalakAlavisheShairbhidyate|12|
1.commentary: samprati samprApteH prativyAdhivyaktibhinnAyAH sarvatra vyAdhau tatprayojanAbhAvAnna bhedo vaktavyaH, yastUpayukto bhavati samprAptivisheShastamabhidhAsyatyeva, “sa yadA prakupitaH pravishyAmAshayam” ityAdinA granthena; ataH sarvasamprAptyanabhidhAnAnnyUnatAdoShaparihArArthaM sarvavyAdhisAdhAraNAn samprAptibhedAnAha- sA sa~gkhyetyAdi|- sA samprAptiH sa~gkhyAdibhirbhidyate iti sa~gkhyAdibhinne vyAdhau bhinnA bhavatItyarthaH; yato na bhinnAnAM bhAvAnAmabhinnotpattirbhavati, kintarhi bhinnaiva bhavati; yadyapi ca prativyAdhi vyaktA~api samprAptirbhinnaiva bhavati, tathA~api sa bhedaH samprApteriha prayojanAbhAvAnnocyate; yataH, sa~gkhyAprAdhAnyavidhyAditulyAsu jvaravyaktiShu ekarUpanidAnali~ggacikitsitAsu bhedapratipAdane na ki~jcit prayojanamasti, sa~gkhyAdibhinne tu jvarAdau nidAnali~ggacikitsAbhedo~asti, ataH sa~gkhyAdibhedajanakAyAH samprApterbhedakathanamucitameva||12(1)||

1.sanskrit: sa~gkhyA tAvadyathA- aShTau jvarAH, pa~jca gulmAH, sapta kuShThAnyevamAdiH|12|
1.commentary: sa~gkhyAbhedamudAharati- sa~gkhyA tAvadityAdi| yadyapi prAdhAnyAdibhedabhinne~api vyAdhau sa~gkhyAbhedo~astyeva, tathA~apIha yaiva shAstrasiddhA aShTaudarIyAdipratipAditA sa~gkhyA saiva sa~gkhyAshabdena prAptA| ata evAShTau jvarA ityabhidhAya dvividhaM shoNitapittamiti kramAt prAptaM raktapittaM nodAhRutaM; yataH dvividhatvaM hi raktapittasya vidhibhede pravishati na sa~gkhyAyAM, ‘dvividhaM shoNitapittam’ iti vidhishabdenaivoktatvAt||12(2)||

1.sanskrit: prAdhAnyaM punardoShANAM taratamAbhyAmupalabhyate| tatra dvayostaraH, triShu tama iti|12|
1.commentary: prAdhAnyaM punarityAdau taratamAbhyAmiti taratamashabdAbhidheyAbhyAM vRuddhibhyAm| taratamashabdayorviShayaM vibhajate- dvayorityAdi|- dvayostara iti dvayordoShayorvRuddhayostaraprayogo bhavati- vRuddhatara iti| evaM triShu tama iti triShu doSheShu vRuddheShu satsu tamaprayogo bhavati- vRuddhatama iti| tadevaM dvandvArabdhe vikAre~anyataradoShasya tarashabdalakShitena prAdhAnyena samprAptirbhidyate, tathA tridoShArabdhe vikAre tamashabdalakShitAnyatamadoShaprAdhAnyAt samprAptirbhidyate, ityuktaM bhavati||12(3)||

1.sanskrit: vidhirnAma- dvividhA vyAdhayo nijAgantubhedena, trividhAstridoShabhedena, caturvidhAH sAdhyAsAdhyamRududAruNabhedena|12|
1.commentary: samprAptibhedaM kramAgataM vidhimAha- vidhirnAma dvividhA vyAdhayo nijAgantubhedenetyAdinA| vidhiriti vidhikRuta ityarthaH| tena dvividhatvAdayo bhedA yato bhavanti sa vidhiH; vidhishca prakAro bheda ityarthaH| sAdhyAsAdhyamRududAruNabhedeneti sAdhyAsAdhyagatena mRududAruNabhedena; tena, mRudusAdhyaM sukhasAdhyaM, dAruNasAdhyaM kRucchrasAdhyaM rohiNIvalayAdi, tathA mRudvasAdhyaM yApyaM, dAruNAsAdhyaM pratyAkhyeyamiti bhedacatuShTam| yadyapi ca sa~gkhyAprAdhAnyAdikRuto~api vyAdhervidhibhedo bhavatyeva, tathA~api sa~gkhyAdibhedAnAM svasa~jj~jayaiva gRuhItatvAdgobalIvardanyAyAt sa~gkhyAdyagRuhIte vyAdhiprakAre~ayaM vidhishabdo vartanIyaH||12(4)||

1.sanskrit: samavetAnAM punardoShANAmaMshAMshabalavikalpo vikalpo~asminnarthe|12|
1.commentary: kramAgataM vikalpamAha- samavetAnAmityAdi|- samavetAnAmiti sarveShAM; tena, ekasho dvisho militAnAM ca doShANAM grahaNam| aMshamaMshaM prati balamaMshAMshabalaM, tasya vikalpa utkarShApakarSharUpoM~ashAMshabalavikalpaH; evambhUto doShANAmaMshAMshabalavikalpo~asminnartha iti asmin prakaraNe vikalpa ucyate| prakaraNAntare tu vikalpashabdena bhedamAtramucyate; yathA- “vikalpo na tvasAdhyAnAM” (sU.a.10) ityAdAviti bhAvaH| tatra doShANAmaMshAMshavikalpo yathA- vAte prakupite~api kadAcidvAtasya shItAMsho balavAn bhavati, kadAcillaghvaMshaH, kadAcidrUkShAMshaH, kadAcillaghurUkShAMsha ityAdi; evaM pittakaphayorapyudAhAryoM~ashAMshavikalpaH; ayaM cAMshAMshabalavikalpo doShANAM shItAdiguNodbhUtahetubhedAdbhavati||12(5)||

1.sanskrit: balakAlavisheShaH punarvyAdhInAmRutvahorAtrAhArakAlavidhiviniyato bhavati||12||
1.commentary: balakAlavisheShamAha- baletyAdi|- balasya kAlo balakAlaH, tasya visheSho vasantapUrvAhNAdirbalakAlavisheShaH| RutavashcAhorAtrAhArayoH kAlAshca RutvahorAtrAhArakAlAH, teShAM bhedo vidhiH, tatra visheSheNa niyato balakAlavisheShaH RutvahorAtrAhArakAlavidhiviniyataH; tatra Rutuviniyato balakAlavisheSho yathA- shleShmajvarasya vasantaH, ahorAtraviniyato yathA- shleShmajvarasya pUrvAhNaH pradoShashca, AhAraviniyato yathA- shleShmajvarasya bhuktamAtrakAlaH, evamAdyunneyam| kecittu vidhishabdena pUrvakRutaM karma bruvate, tatrApi karmaniyato balakAlavisheShaH pacyamAnakarmakAla eva j~jeyaH| eShu ca balakAleShu yadyapi vyAdherabhUtaprAdurbhAvarUpA samprAptirna bhavati, tathA~api vyAdhisantAne tatkAlaM vyAdhyutpattau samprAptirbhinnaiva bhavatIti mantavyam| iyaM ca kAlavisheShaprAptyA balavadvyAdhijanikA samprAptirvyAdhervisheShaM sphuTameva bodhayati| yataH pUrvAhNe balasamprAptyA jvarasya kaphajatvamunnIyate, madhyAhne ca balaprAptyA pittajatvamityAdi| iha ca samprAptereva visheShAH sa~gkhyAdikRutA uktAH, na tu nidAnAdInAM visheShAH; yato nidAnAdivisheShAH prativyAdhivakShyamANabhedenaivopayuktAH| yato yAdRug jvare nidAnaM na tAdRug raktapitte; ye ca pUrvarUpAdivisheShA jvare, na te raktapittAdau, kintu bhinnajAtIyA eva| sa ca bhedo nidAnAdInAM vyAdhibhedagamakatvenopayukto vyAdhibhedakathana eva vaktavyaH| samprAptestu sa~gkhyAdibhedaH sarvavyAdhiShvekajAtIyatvena na visheShagamaka iti ihaiva sarvavyAdhinidAne kathyate; nidAnAdivisheShAstu prativyAdhivishiShTatvena neha prapa~jcenocyante| ata eva cAtraivAdhyAye samprApteH sAmAnyAbhidhAnenaivoktatvAt samprAptiM parityajya nidAnAdivisheShaM pratijAnIte- tasya nidAnapUrvarUpali~ggopashayavisheShAnanuvyAkhyAsyAma iti||12||

1.sanskrit: tasmAdvyAdhIn bhiShaganupahatasattvabuddhirhetvAdibhirbhAvairyathAvadanubuddhyeta||13||
1.commentary: yasmAdime nidAnAdaya uktena nyAyena vyAdhiparIkShAyAmupayuktAH, tasmAdvyAdhIn bhiShag hetvAdibhiH parIkSheteti yojanA| na ca vAcyaM yat- nidAnAdInAM madhye cedanyatamenApi vyAdhiparicchedaM kartuM samarthastat kiM pa~jcakAbhidhAneneti; yato yAvanto j~jAnopAyA vyAdhInAM te sarva evopadarshanIyAH| tatra yo nidAnaM vismRutavAn, tasya pUrvarUpAdibhirvyAdhiH parIkShyate; tathA yatra ca pUrvarUpAdayo vismRutAH sandigdhA vA, tatropashayena parIkShA bhavati; evaM kaphajatvasandehe jvarasya samprAptirapi pUrvAhNe bhuktamAtre vA bhavantI kaphajatvaM gamayatItyAdi prayojanamanusaraNIyam| tathA pUrvarUpeNApi li~ggasAmAnyanishcaya uktaH; yaduktaM- “hAridravarNaM rudhiraM ca mUtraM vinA pramehasya hi pUrvarUpaiH| yo mUtrayettaM na vadet pramehaM raktasya pittasya hi sa prakopaH” (ci.a.6) iti| tathA li~gganishcite~api vyAdhau pUrvarUpeNAsAdhyatvamuktaM, yathA- “pUrvarUpANi sarvANi jvaroktAnyatimAtrayA| yaM vishanti vishatyenaM mRutyurjvarapuraHsaraH” (i.a.5) iti| tasmAnnidAnAdipa~jcakamabhidhAtavyameva| nanu, li~ggena vyAdhiH parIkShaNIya iti vacanAlli~ggavyatirikto vyAdhirityuktaM bhavati; tatra ca na li~ggasamudAyavyatirikto vyAdhirupalabhyate, viShamArambhivisargitvAdayo hi santApasahitA jvarAH, tathA pratishyAyakAsAdyekAdasharUpamelaka eva yakShmA| naivaM, li~ggatvena shAstre pratipAditAnAM tadatiriktavyAdhyabhAve li~ggatvAnupapatteH, vacanaM hi- “viShamArambhamUlaishca jvara eko nirucyate” (ni.a.8) iti| vikArashcaiha doShadUShyamelakavisheSho jvarAdishabdenocyate| sa ca doShadUShyavisheShAtmA jvaro~arucyAdibhyo doShadUShyavaiShamyavisheShebhyo~arthAntarameva| na ca vAcyaM jvarali~ggArucya~ggamardAdirUpadhAtuvaiShamyavisheShamelako jvaro~astu, alaM tadatiriktajvarakalpanayA, li~ggali~ggibhAvashca samudAyasamudAyibhedAdbhaviShyatIti; yata evamapyarucya~ggamardAdidhAtuvaiShamyAnugato dhAtuvaiShamyavisheSho jvararUpo~avayavIti bhinna eva vaktavyaH; ja~gghAbAhushirontarAdhyavayavAnatiriktameva sharIramavayavirUpam| duHkhameva vyAdhiriti pUrvameva parAkRutaM, tena duHkharUpatvAdvyAdheravayavitvaM na sambhavatIti na vAcyam| li~ggAni tu svarUpeNa vyAdhayo bhavanti, te ca boddhavyavyAdhyapekShayA li~ggAni bhavanti| taduktaM- “vyAdhayaste tadAtve tu li~ggAnIShTAni nAmayAH” (ni.a.8) iti| li~ggali~ggibhAvashca jij~jAsAvashAdbhavati| yadvakShyati- “viShamArambhamUlAnAM li~ggamekaM jvaro mataH| viShamArambhamUlaishca jvara eko nirucyate” (ni.a.8) iti| asya cArthamapasmAranidAne prakaraNAgataM vyAkhyAsyAmaH| tasmAt susthitaM vyAdhigamakatvaM nidAnAdipa~jcakasyetyarthaH||13||

1.sanskrit: ityarthasa~ggraho nidAnasthAnasyoddiShTo bhavati| taM vistareNopadishanto bhUyastaramato~anuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||14||
1.commentary: itItyAdau iti parisamAptau| nidAnasthAnasyeti sarvavyAdhinidAnasya| arthasa~ggraha ityanenaiva sa~gkShepArthAbhidhAne labdhe uddiShTa iti sa~gkShepAbhidhAyipadakaraNena sa~gkShepasyApi sa~gkShepAbhidhAnametaditi darshayati| tamiti sAmAnyanidAnoddesham, ato nidAnoddeshamAtrato bhUyastaramupadishanto vistareNa vyAkhyAsyAma iti yojanA| tenaitadatisa~gkShepakathanApekShayA prapa~jcakathanameveha vistarashabdArtha iti darshayati; tena nidAnAdInAM yAvadvistarakathanamuttaratropapannaM bhavati||14||

1.sanskrit: tatra prathamata eva tAvadAdyA@mllobhAbhidrohakopaprabhavAnaShTau vyAdhInnidAnapUrveNa krameNa vyAkhyAsyAmaH, tathA sUtrasa~ggrahamAtraM cikitsAyAH| cikitsiteShu cottarakAlaM yathopacitavikArAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH ||15||
1.commentary: tatretyAdinA jvarAdyaShTavidharogasya nidAnasthAne kathanaM pratijAnIte| prathamata eva tAvadityanena pashcAccikitsAbhidheyAnarshaH- prabhRutIn sUcayati| Adya nityanena Adau dakShAdhvaroddhvaMse utpannA ye teShAmiha kathanaM darshayati| yadyapi ca rAjayakShmA pRuthagevotpannaH, vacanaM hi- “ativyavAyAt punarnakShatrarAjasya yakShmA” (ni.a.8) iti, tathA~apyasya prAdhAnyAdihAbhidhAnam| yadyapi ca dakShAdhvaroddhvaMsodbhUtAnapasmArAntAnabhidhAya pRuthagutpannasya yakShmaNo~abhidhAnamucitaM, tathA~apyunmAdApasmArayorAgantutvena shoShamapyabhidhAyAnte~abhidhAnam| lobhAbhidrohaprabhavAnityanena janapadoddhvaMsanIye “prAgapi cAdharmAdRute na rogotpattirabhUt” (vi.a.3) ityanena vakShyamANAnAM jvarAdInAM lobhAbhidrohajanyatAM darshayati, anenAdharmajatvaM jvarAdInAmuktaM bhavati| nidAnapUrveNeti nidAnaprathamena| krameNeti rogasAmAnyoktanidAnapUrvarUparUpopashayasamprAptirUpeNa| ayaM ca kramaH kvacit prayojanavashAdbAdhyate; yathA~atraiva jvare~agre hi rUpamabhidhAya pUrvarUpamabhidhAtavyam| kramabhedaprayojanaM ceha yat- rUpANyatra pratijvaramabhidhAtavyAni, na tu prAgrUpANi pratijvaramabhidhAtavyAni; tena sarvasAdhAraNatvAt sarvamabhidhAya prAgrUpaM sAmAnyamabhidhAtavyam| tathA, sUtrasa~ggrahamAtraM cikitsAyA vyAkhyAsyAma iti sambandhaH| nidAne ca cikitsAbhidhAnaprayojanaM prAgevoktam| sUtramiti kRutvA yat sa~ggrahamiti karoti tena sUtrasyApi sa~gkShepeNAbhidhAnaM darshayati; tathA cikitsAsUtramapIha ki~jcinna vaktavyaM, yathA- la~gghanakAlayavAgvAdayaH| cikitsiteShvityanenaiva cottarakAlatve labdhe punaruttarakAlamiti vacanaM cikitsitasthAne~api jvarAdyabhidhAnottarakAlameva yathopacitavikArANAM nidAnAdikathanaM darshayati| yathopacitamiti ye ye upacitA vikArAH shothArshaHprabhRutayastAn| kiMvA, ‘yathAcitam’ iti pAThaH, tatrApi yathApradhAnamityartha unneyaH| cikitsite ca vikArANAM nidAnAdyabhidhAnaM nidAnAdinA~avyavadhAnena pratIte viShaye cikitsA samyak pratIyata ityabhiprAyeNa| ata eva ca jvarAdInAmapi punarnidAnAdyabhidhAsyati, iha tu jvarAdInAM nidAnAdyabhidhAnaM bahuvaktavyatvena sthAnabhedaM kRutvA kRutam| sthAnabhedakaraNena ca cikitsAvadAyurvede nidAnasyApi j~jeyatvena prAdhAnyaM darshayati||15||

1.sanskrit: iha khalu jvara evAdau vikArANAmupadishyate, tatprathamatvAcchArIrANAm||16||
1.commentary: iha khalviti aShTavidhavyAdhinidAne vaktavye| shArIrANAmityanena kAmakrodhAdimAnasaM rogaM prati na jvarasya prathamatvamiti darshayati||16||

1.sanskrit: atha khalvaShTAbhyaH kAraNebhyo jvaraH sa~jjAyate manuShyANAM; tadyathA- vAtAt, pittAt, kaphAt, vAtapittAbhyAM, vAtakaphAbhyAM, pittakaphAbhyAM, vAtapittakaphebhyaH, AgantoraShTamAt kAraNAt||17||
1.commentary: jvarasya nirUpaNIyasya kAraNakRutaM bhedamAha- athetyAdi| etacca kAraNaM vAtAdi sannikRuShTam| manuShyANAmitivacanena gogajashakunyAdInAM nAvashyamidaM jvarAShTatvamanugAmIti darshayati; tathAhi- hastyAdInAM pAkalAdayo nAShTavidhAH pratipAdyante| Agantoriti vaktavye aShTamAditi vacanamAgantorabhighAtAdicatuShkAraNabhede~apyekatvopadarshanArtham| Aganturhi kAraNabhedotpanno~apyekarUpa eva, yata AgantuH sarvo vyathApUrvameva bhavati; yastu tatra, “kAmashokabhayAdvAyuH” (ci.a.3) ityAdinA bhedo vaktavyaH, sa vAtAdikRuta eveti bhAvaH||17||

1.sanskrit: tasya nidAnapUrvarUpali~ggopashayavisheShAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH ||18||
1.commentary: tasyetyAdau tasyeti jvarasya| visheShAniti nidAnAdibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate| nidAnAdivisheShAshceha rogAntararaktapittAdyapekShayA tathA parasparaM vAtAdijvarApekShayA ca yathAsambhavaM boddhavyAH| tena pUrvarUpavisheSha iha raktapittAdipUrvarUpApekShayA boddhavyaH, pUrvarUpasya visheSheNehAnabhidhAnAt| upashayavisheShAnabhidhAnaM ca nidAnavisheShAbhidhAnAdeva labhyate, yato nidAnaviparyayeNopashayamabhidhAsyati| pUrvarUpaM ceha vishiShTamavyaktali~ggavisheSharUpameva j~jeyam| samprAptestu vakShyamANAyA ihApratij~jAnaM, tasyAH sarvaroge samprAptibhedAbhidhAne ca kathitatvAt, tathA nidAnAdivat samprAptervyAdhibodhanaM pratyapradhAnatvAcca; yashca samprAptibhedo~abhidhAtavyaH sa sarvarogasAdhAraNa eva; bhedastu tasyA vAtAdidoShamAtrakRuta eva, vAtAdibhedashca nidAnabheda eva| anye tu bruvate- samprAptiM nAbhidhAsyatyevAyaM, yadetat ‘sa yadA prakupitaH’ ityAdyabhidhAsyati, tannidAnarUpavAtAdidharmakathanamiti kRutvA nidAnAntargatameva||18||

1.sanskrit: rUkShalaghushItavamanavirecanAsthApanashirovirecanAtiyogavyAyAmavegasandhAraNAnashanAbhighAta- vyavAyodvegashokashoNitAtiShekajAgaraNaviShamasharIranyAsebhyo~atisevitebhyo vAyuH prakopamApadyate||19||
1.commentary: rUkShetyAdi| vAtaprakopaNaM prati rUkShasya pradhAnatvenAgre~abhidhAnaM, rUkSho hi guNo vAtaguNeShu pradhAnam| AsthApanaM yadyapi vAtaharamuktam- “AsthApanAnuvAsanaM tu khalu sarvopakramebhyo vAtavikAreShu pradhAnam” (sU.a.20) iti vacanAt, tathA~apIhAsthApanasyAtiyogo vAtaheturukta eveti na doShaH| vacanaM hi- “utkleshAgnivadhau snehAnnirUhAt pavanAdbhayam” (si.a.4) iti| nirUhashcAnuvAsanaM kRutvA yukta eva, mAtrAkRutashca sAdhAraNavAtahara iti siddhAntaH||19||

1.sanskrit: sa yadA prakupitaH pravishyAmAshayamUShmaNA saha mishrIbhUyAdyamAhArapariNAmadhAtuM rasanAmAnamanvavetya rasasvedavahAni srotAMsi pidhAyAgnimupahatya paktisthAnAdUShmANaM bahirnirasya kevalaM sharIramanuprapadyate, tadA jvaramabhinirvartayati||20||
1.commentary: sa yadetyAdinA samprAptimAha| yadeti vacanAdeva~gkupito~api vAyuryadA~a~amAshayapraveshAdisamprAptiyukto bhavati tadaiva jvaraM karoti, nAnyadeti darshayati| pravishyAmAshayamityanena jvarakarturdoShasyAmAshayadUShakatvaM darshayati| ata eva sarvajvareShvAmAshayavishuddhyarthaM la~gghanamutsargato vadanti| yadyapi cAmAshayapraveshAdevoShmaNA~api mishratvaM labhyata eva, yata AmAshaya eva vahnisthAnaM, “nAbhistanAntaraM jantorAmAshaya iti smRutaH” (vi.a.2) iti vacanAt, tathA~api vahnisthAnasyAmAshayaikadeshatvenAmAshayapraveshe~api nAvashyaM grahaNIrUpavahnisthAnaduShTirvisheSheNa labhyata iti; ata evoktam- UShmaNA saha mishrIbhUyeti| rasanAmAnamityucyamAne AhArarase~api madhurarasAdau prasaktiH syAt, ata uktam- AhArapariNAmadhAtumiti; AhArapariNAmabhavo dhAturAhArapariNAmadhAtuH, tamiti| AhArapariNAmadhAtutvaM ca paramparayA raktAdiShvapyastItyAha- Adyamiti; prathamamityarthaH| rasamiti vaktavye rasanAmAnamiti yat karoti tena rasatIti rasa iti vyutpattimAtreNa raktAdiShu rasasa~jj~jAM niShedhayati, yatraiva rasasa~jj~jA rUDhA taM grAhayati; evamanyatrApi ca yat padamadhikArthamiha pratIyate tat spaShTArthameva, yatastrividhashiShyabuddhihitameva vispaShTArthaM tantraM yujyate| anviti yathoktakrameNa| avetyeti gatvA| pidhAyeti avarudhya| paktisthAnAt pAcakAgnisthAnAt| UShmANamiti pAcakavahnim| bahiriti paktisthAnavyatiriktasharIre| yadyapi coShmANaM nirasyetivacanAdeva paktisthAnAditi labhyate, tathA~api paktisthAnAditivacanena paktisthAnAt kRutsnasya vahnernirasanaM darshayati, iha coShmashabdena pAcakAgniM vyapadishan pAcakasya vahnerUShmarUpatAM darshayati, bAhyavahnisadRushajvAlAkaraM pittaM niShedhayati| ata eva ca vahnernirasanAdagnimAndyaM jvare darshitaM bhavati| vAyushcAtrAtivRuddhatvena vahnernirAsakaH, tenAgnidIptiM na karoti; yatra hi prerakamAtro bhavati vAyustatra vahnervRuddhiM karoti; yathA - medasvinaH koShThe caran vAyuragnivRuddhikaro bhavati||20||

1.sanskrit: tasyemAni li~ggAni bhavanti; tadyathA- viShamArambhavisargitvam, UShmaNo vaiShamyaM, tIvratanubhAvAnavasthAnAni jvarasya, jaraNAnte divasAnte nishAnte gharmAnte vA jvarasyAbhyAgamanamabhivRuddhirvA, visheSheNa paruShAruNavarNatvaM nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShatvacAmatyarthaM klRuptIbhAvashca; anekavidhopamAshcalAcalAshca vedanAsteShAM teShAma~ggAvayavAnAM; tadyathA- pAdayoH suptatA, piNDikayorudveShTanaM, jAnunoH kevalAnAM ca sandhInAM vishleShaNam, UrvoH sAdaH, kaTIpArshvapRuShThaskandhabAhvaMsorasAM ca bhagnarugNamRuditamathitacaTitAvapATitAvanunnatvamiva , hanvoshcAprasiddhiH, svanashca karNayoH, sha~gkhayornistodaH, kaShAyAsyatA AsyavairasyaM vA, mukhatAlukaNThashoShaH, pipAsA, hRudayagrahaH, shuShkacchardiH, shuShkakAsaH, kShavathUdgAravinigrahaH, annarasakhedaH, prasekArocakAvipAkAH, viShAdajRumbhAvinAmavepathushramabhramapralApaprajAgararomaharShadantaharShAH, uShNAbhiprAyatA, nidAnoktAnAmanupashayo viparItopashayashceti vAtajvarasya li~ggAni bhavanti||21||
1.commentary: li~ggAnyAha- tadyathA viShametyAdi| taditi sAmAnyena strIli~ggapuMli~gganapuMsakali~ggavakShyamANarUpapratyavamarshakaM , sarvali~ggapratyavamarshe hi taditi sarvanAma yuktam| yatheti udAharaNe| Arambha utpAdaH, visargo mokShaH, tau viShamau yasya sa viShamArambhavisargI; viShamatvaM ca kadAcicchiro gRuhItvA bhavati, kadAcit pRuShThaM, kadAcijja~gghe ityAdi; evaM mokSho~api kadAcicchiro~agre mucyate ityAdi; kiMvA, jvarArambhamokShakAlAnavasthitatvameva vaiShamyam| UShmaNo vaiShamyamiti kvaciccharIrapradeshe mahAnUShmA, kvacinmanda ityAdi| tIvratanubhAvAnavasthAnAnIti tIvrabhAvastanubhAvashca jvarasya kAlApratiniyata ityarthaH| etatsarvaM vAyoranavasthitatvenopapannam| yacca vAyorjaraNAntadivasAntAdiShu balavatkAryakartRutvamuktaM, tadapi prAyikatvena j~jeyam| anyathA, etadevArambhAdivaiShamyaM na syAt| yadi kAlavisheShe jaraNAntAdau sharIrapradeshavisheShe ca ja~gghAdau pratiniyamena vAtakopaH syAt, tadA sharIrapradeshavisheShe vAtasthAne ja~gghAdau kAlavisheShe jaraNAntAdau ca vAtaprakopaH prAyiko j~jeyaH| etameva prAyikavAtakAlamAshrityAha- jaraNAnta ityAdi| gharmAnta iti prAvRuShi muktibhAvavato jvarasya satatakAderabhyAgamanaM, nityAnuShaktasya tvativRuddhiriti vyavasthA| paruShAruNatvaM ca nakhAdiShveva pravyaktamupalabhyata iti kRutvA nakhAdaya ihocyante| tvaggrahaNenaiva vadanagrahaNe labdhe~api vadanagrahaNaM vadanatvaci visheSheNa paruShatvAdidarshanArtham| klRuptIbhAvaH apravRuttiH, sA ca yogyatayA mUtrapurIShayoreva nakhAdiShUktayormantavyA; kiMvA, klRuptIbhAvo bhedaH sphuTanamiti yAvat; sa ca nakhAdInAm| calAshca kAshcidvedanA acalAshca kAshcinnityAnuShaktatveneti calAcalAH; kiMvA atyarthaM calAshcalAH| piNDikA jAnvadho ja~gghAmadhyamAMsapiNDikA | bhagnaM ki~jcidavasheSheNa cchinnaM, rugNaM ki~jcicchinnaM, mRuditaM pArshvAvamoTitam, avapATitam ekadeshotpATitam, avanunnaM preritam; eShAM ca bhagnAdInAM lokata evArthAvagatiH, yato laukikairevaite shabdAH prasiddhatvena tatra tatra shAstre~abhidhIyante | hanvoraprasiddhiriti hanvoH svavyApArAkaraNam| Asyavairasyamiti arasaj~jatA| annarasakhedaH annarase khedo~avasAdo~annarasakhedaH, sarvaraseShvanicchetyarthaH| arucistu vakShyamANA vaktre praviShTAnnAnabhyavaharaNAdboddhavyA| uShNAbhiprAyatA uShNapriyatA| nidAnoktAnAmanupashaya iti vacanenaiva viparIta upashayo~arthalabdho~api spaShTArthamucyate; kiMvA, arthApatteranaikAntikatvena ucyate; yathA- navajvare divAsvapne pratiShiddhe~arthApattyA purANajvare divAsvapnaH prApnoti, atha ca tatra divAsvapno na vihita ityarthApatteranaikAntikatvaM vadanti| nidAnoktAnAmityatroktagrahaNAdyadeva nidAnatvenoktaM tasyaivAnupashayitvaM nidarshayati na punaryasyApAtato nidAnatvaM pratibhAti; tena, madAtyayAdau madyAdernidAnatvena pratIyamAnasyApi upashayitvameva||21||

1.sanskrit: uShNAmlalavaNakShArakaTukAjIrNabhojanebhyo~atisevitebhyastathA tIkShNAtapAgnisantApashramakrodhaviShamAhArebhyashca pittaM prakopamApadyate||22|| tadyadA prakupitamAmAshayAdUShmANamupasRujyAdyamAhArapariNAmadhAtuM rasanAmAnamanvavetya rasasvedavahAni srotAMsi pidhAya dravatvAdagnimupahatya paktisthAnAdUShmANaM bahirnirasya prapIDayat kevalaM sharIramanuprapadyate, tadA jvaramabhinirvartayati||23|| tasyemAni li~ggAni bhavanti; tadyathA- yugapadeva kevale sharIre jvarasyAbhyAgamanamabhivRuddhirvA bhuktasya vidAhakAle madhyandine~ardharAtre sharadi vA visheSheNa, kaTukAsyatA, ghrANamukhakaNThauShThatAlupAkaH, tRuShNA, mado, bhramo, mUrcchA, pittacchardanam, atIsAraH, annadveShaH, sadanaM, khedaH, pralApaH, raktakoThAbhinirvRuttiH sharIre, haritahAridratvaM nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShatvacAm, atyarthamUShmaNastIvrabhAvaH, atimAtraM dAhaH, shItAbhiprAyatA, nidAnoktAnupashayo viparItopashayashceti pittajvarali~ggAni bhavanti||24||
1.commentary: uShNetyAdinA pittajvaramAha- tadyathetyAdi|- pUrvavadvyAkhyeyam| dravatvAdagnimupahatyetivacanAduShNasyApi pittasya dravatvenAgniviparItena guNenAgnihantRutAM darshayati| vakShyati hi grahaNyadhyAye- “AplAvayaddhantyanalaM jalaM taptamivAnalam” (ci.a.15) iti| bahirnirasya prapIDayaditivacanena pittajvare vAtajvara iva na sahasA vahnikShepaNaM bhavati, kintu shanaiH stokakrameNeti darshayati| yugapadeveti na vaiShamyeNa| abhyAgamanamabhivRuddhirveti ca pUrveNa yugapadevetyAdinA pareNa ca visheSheNetyantena ca granthena sambadhyate| koThAbhinirvRuttiH sharIra iti cchedaH||22-24||

1.sanskrit: snigdhagurumadhurapicchilashItAmlalavaNadivAsvapnaharShAvyAyAmebhyo~atisevitebhyaH shleShmA prakopamApadyate||25|| sa yadA prakupitaH pravishyAmAshayamUShmaNA sahamishrIbhUyAdyamAhArapariNAmadhAtuM rasanAmAnamanvavetya rasasvedavahAni srotAMsi pidhAyAgnimupahatya paktisthAnAdUShmANaM bahirnirasya prapIDayan kevalaM sharIramanuprapadyate, tadA jvaramabhinirvartayati||26||
1.commentary: snigdhetyAdinA shleShmajvaramAha| sa yadetyAdi pUrvavat kaphajvare~api vyAkhyeyam| nanu, shleShmaNa AmAshayaH sthAnaM, tat kiM pravishyAmAshayamiti vacanena? naivaM, shleShmaNa uro~api pradhAnaM sthAnaM, tenehoraHsthasyApi shleShmaNa AmAshayapraveshaM darshayati| yatra kevalAmAshayavRutti pittaM, tatra ‘AmAshayaM pravishya’ iti na kRutaM, kintu ‘AmAshayAdUShmANamupasRujya’ iti kRutaM; pittaM hyAmAshayapraviShTameva bhavati, taccAmAshayaikadeshasthaM grahaNIrUpAmAshayaikadeshaM vahnisthAnaM svasthAnAdgacchatIti yuktam||25-26||

1.sanskrit: tasyemAni li~ggAni bhavanti; tadyathA- yugapadeva kevale sharIre jvarasyAbhyAgamanamabhivRuddhirvA bhuktamAtre pUrvAhNe pUrvarAtre vasantakAle vA visheSheNa, gurugAtratvam, anannAbhilAShaH, shleShmaprasekaH, mukhamAdhuryaM, hRullAsaH, hRudayopalepaH, stimitatvaM, chardiH, mRudvagnitA, nidrAdhikyaM, stambhaH, tandrA, kAsaH, shvAsaH, pratishyAyaH, shaityaM, shvaityaM ca nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShatvacAm, atyarthaM ca shItapiDakA bhRushama~ggebhya uttiShThanti, uShNAbhiprAyatA, nidAnoktAnupashayo viparItopashayashca; iti (shleShmajvarali~ggAni bhavanti)||27||
1.commentary: yugapaditi ekakAlam; ekadaiva kaphajvare sarvasharIravyAptyA AgamanamabhivRuddhirvA bhavatIti darshayati| shItapiDakAstantrAntare shvetapiDakA ucyante| ‘tasyemAni li~ggAni bhavanti’ ityetAvataiva kaphajvarali~ggatve labdhe punaH ‘shleShmajvarali~ggAni bhavanti’ iti vacanaM kimarthaM? brUmaH- tasyetipadena svadoShamAtrapratyavamarsho~api syAt, tena doShali~ggataiva paraM li~ggAnAM mA syAdityetadarthaM punarabhidhAnam; kiMvA, pUrvapratij~jayA li~ggAnAM prAgavaccheda uktaH, uttareNa shleShmajvarali~ggAni bhavantItyanenAntyAvaccheda ucyate; evamanyatrApi vAtajvarAdau pUrvarUpe ca punaruktiH parihartavyA||27||

1.sanskrit: viShamAshanAdanashanAdannaparivartAdRutuvyApatterasAtmyagandhopaghrANAdviShopahatasya codakasyopayogAdgarebhyo girINAM copashleShAt snehasvedavamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsanashirovirecanAnAmayathAvatprayogAt mithyAsaMsarjanAdvA strINAM ca viShamaprajananAt prajAtAnAM ca mithyopacArAd yathoktAnAM ca hetUnAM mishrIbhAvAdyathAnidAnaM dvandvAnAmanyatamaH sarve vA trayo doShA yugapat prakopamApadyante, te prakupitAstayaivAnupUrvyA jvaramabhinirvartayanti||28||
1.commentary: viShamAshanAdityAdinA dvAndvikasAnnipAtikajvarAnAha| anashanaM yadyapi na pittashleShmakaraM, tathA~apyagnimAndyakaratvAttridoShakaramapi bhavati; kiMvA eShu viShamAshanAdiShu yathAyogyatayA dvandvakAraNatvaM tridoShakAraNatvaM conneyaM, tenAnashanaM vAtapittakaraM boddhavyaM; yattu pittaharatvamuktamanashanasya, tattu pittadravAMshakShayAt| vacanaM hi- “kaphapitte drave dhAtU sahete la~gghanaM mahat” iti| annaparivartAditi sahasaivAkrameNa kRutAbhyastAnnaparivartAt| asAtmyagandho gandhadravyasya nAsikayA~antaHpraveshAdyathA doShakaro bhavati na tathA~asAtmyarUpAdayaH, te hi nAvashyaM sharIraM vishanti, tena nehAsAtmyarUpAdaya uktAH| yathAnidAnamiti yadA dvayornidAnaM sevyate tadA dvandvaH, yadA trayANAM nidAnaM sevyate tadA trayo doShAH; dvandve~api yadA vAtapittayornidAnaM sevyate tadA vAtapittarUpaM dvandvam; evamanyadapi kupyatItyarthaH| sarve trayo doShA ityanenaiva labdhe~api yugapaditivacanaM kramaprakopapratiShedhArthaM, yugapadeva prakopamApadyante na krameNetyarthaH||28||

1.sanskrit: tatra tathoktAnAM jvarali~ggAnAM mishrIbhAvavisheShadarshanAddvAndvikamanyatamaM jvaraM sAnnipAtikaM vA vidyAt||29||
1.commentary: jvarali~ggAnAmityAdau mishrIbhAvavisheSho vAtapittali~ggaM vA, vAtashleShmali~ggaM vA, pittashleShmali~ggaM vA| anyatamamiti vAtapittajvarAdikam||29||

1.sanskrit: abhighAtAbhiSha~ggAbhicArAbhishApebhya Aganturhi vyathApUrvo~aShTamo jvaro bhavati| sa ki~jcitkAlamAgantuH kevalo bhUtvA pashcAddoShairanubadhyate| tatrAbhighAtajo vAyunA duShTashoNitAdhiShThAnena, abhiSha~ggajaH punarvAtapittAbhyAm, abhicArAbhishApajau tu sannipAtenAnubadhyete||30||
1.commentary: AgantujvaramAha- abhighAtetyAdi| abhighAto laguDAdyabhighAtaH, abhiSha~ggaH kAmAdyabhiSha~ggaH, abhicAro~atharvamantrAdirjvarakaraH, abhishApastu gurusiddhAdyabhishapanam; etat pradhAnatvena caturvidhaM kAraNamihoktaM; tena, oShadhigandhabhUtAbhiSha~ggaduShTagrahanirIkShaNAdayo~apyAgantujvarahetavo boddhavyAH; kiMvA, abhighAtagrahaNena sharIrAbhihananavAcinA~asAtmyagandhAdayo grAhyAH, abhiSha~ggeNa tu bhUtAbhiSha~ggAdayaH| vyathApUrvamiti Agantau prathamaM vyathA bhavati, pashcAddoShAnubandhakRutAni lakShaNAnIti darshayati; kiMvA, vyathApUrvamitivacanAdAgantau jvare vyathaiva pUrvarUpamiti vadanti| rUpaM tu yadeva jvarasya prAtyAtmikaM santAparUpaM tadeva vAtajvarAdilakShaNarahitaM boddhavyaM prathamataH, uttarakAlInadoShAnubandhe tu yathAvakShyamANadoShali~ggAnyeva bhavanti| aShTama itivacanenAbhighAtAdihetucatuShTayayogaprAptaM cAturvidhyaM niShedhya vyathApUrvakatvenaikarUpayogAdekavidhatvaM caturNAM darshayati; cAturvidhye hyAgantornAShTamatvaM, navamatvAdayo~api syuH| ki~jcitkAlamiti stokakAlaM; kecit tryahaM vadanti, anye saptAhamAhuH| Agantau hi saptAhAdUrdhvaM doShali~ggAni bhavantIti dRuShTam| tatra yasyAgantoryAdRusho doShAnubandho bhavati tamAha- tatrAbhighAtetyAdi| vAtapittAbhyAmiti kashcidvAtena, kashcit pittena, kashcidvAtapittAbhyAm| vacanaM hi- “kAmashokabhayAdvAyuH, krodhAt pittaM, trayo malAH| bhUtAbhiSha~ggAt kupyanti bhUtasAmAnyalakShaNAH” (ci.a.3) iti| bhUtAbhiSha~gge tu yadyapi tridoShaprakopa uktaH, tathA~api tatra vAtapittayorevaitadvacanabalAt prAdhAnyam||30||

1.sanskrit: sa saptavidhAjjvarAdvishiShTali~ggopakramasamutthAnatvAdvishiShTo veditavyaH, karmaNA sAdhAraNena copacaryate | ityaShTavidhA jvaraprakRutiruktA||31||
1.commentary: AgantornijAdbhedamAha- sa ityAdi| visheShali~ggatA AgatorvyathApUrvakavyAkhyAne vyAkRutA, samutthAnavisheSho~apyabhighAtAdiruktaH, upakramavisheSho~api ‘sAdhAraNena karmaNA copacaryate’ iti vacanenaivAtra kathyate| sAdhAraNeneti daivayuktivyapAshrayeNa; daivavyapAshrayaM hi balima~ggalahomAdi, yuktivyapAshrayaM hi laghvashanApatarpaNayavAgUkaShAyapAnAdi| prakRutirukteti svabhAvo~api vAtAdijvarANAM nidAnAdyupahita ukta ityarthaH||31||

1.sanskrit: jvarastveka eva santApalakShaNaH| tamevAbhiprAyavisheShAddvividhamAcakShate, nijAgantuvisheShAcca| tatra nijaM dvividhaM trividhaM caturvidhaM saptavidhaM cAhurbhiShajo vAtAdivikalpAt||32||
1.commentary: nijAgantuvisheShAcca dvividhamiti sambandhaH| nijaM dvividhamityAdau dvaividhyaM (saMsRuShTAsaMsRuShTajanyatvena ) shItoShNAbhiprAyabhedAt, trividhaM tridoShabhedAt, caturvidhaM pratyekaM vAtAdidoShajanyabhedAt| tatra cAturvidhye dvandvajvarAH pratikShipyante, teShAM pratyekaM vAtAdijvarasadRushatvAt; tridoShajvarastu asAdhyatAyogAt kRucchrasAdhyatAyogAdvA pRuthagucyate||32||

1.sanskrit: tasyemAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti; tadyathA- mukhavairasyaM, gurugAtratvam, anannAbhilAShaH, cakShuShorAkulatvam, ashrvAgamanaM, nidrAdhikyam, aratiH, jRumbhA, vinAmaH, vepathuH, shramabhramapralApajAgaraNaromaharShadantaharShAH, shabdashItavAtAtapasahatvAsahatvam, arocakAvipAkau, daurbalyam, a~ggamardaH, sadanam, alpaprANatA, dIrghasUtratA, Alasyam, ucitasya karmaNo hAniH, pratIpatA svakAryeShu, gurUNAM vAkyeShvabhyasUyA, bAlebhyaH pradveShaH, svadharmeShvacintA, mAlyAnulepanabhojanaparikleshanaM, madhurebhyashca bhakShebhyaH pradveShaH, amlalavaNakaTukapriyatA ca, iti jvarasya pUrvarUpANi bhavanti prAksantApAt; api cainaM santApArtamanubadhnanti||33||
1.commentary: tasyemAnItyAdinA sarvajvarasAdhAraNaM pUrvarUpamAha| etAni ca pUrvarUpANyAgantorapItyeke vadanti; anye tu nijAnAmevaitAnIti vadanti, Agantostu vyathaiva pUrvarUpam| atrApyanannAbhilAShArocakayoH pUrvavadbhedaH| daurbalyaM sharIrabalahAniH, alpaprANatA ca mAnasabalahAnirboddhavyA; kiMvA daurbalyaM mAMsApacayaH| dIrghasUtratA cireNa kAryakartRutvam| jvarapUrvarUpANi bhavanti prAksantApAditi cchedaH, jvararUpasantApAt prAgetAni pUrvarUpANi bhavantItyarthaH| apica santApArtamanubadhnantItyanena pravyakte~api jvare kAnicitpUrvarUpANi mukhavairasyArucyAdIni bhavantIti darshayati| na caivaM pUrvarUpAnuvRuttau riShTatvaM vAcyaM; yataH sarvapUrvarUpANAmatimAtrAnuvartanaM riShTamuktam| vacanaM hi- “pUrvarUpANi sarvANi jvaroktAnyatimAtrayA| yaM vishanti vishatyenaM mRutyurjvarapuraHsaraH” (i.a.5) iti; kiMvA, asya shlokasyAnya evArthaH, tamindriye vakShyAmaH| na cArucyAdInAM vyaktajvarabhAvitvena pUrvarUpatvaM hanyate, yato li~ggAntarayuktAnyarucyAdIni li~ggAni bhavanti, li~ggAntaravirahitAni tu pUrvarUpANi||33||

1.sanskrit: ityetAnyekaikasho jvarali~ggAni vyAkhyAtAni bhavanti vistarasamAsAbhyAm||34||
1.commentary: ekaikasho jvarali~ggAnItyatra li~ggashabdena nidAnapUrvarUpAdInyucyante| vistarasamAsAbhyAmiti vistareNa vAtAdijvaroktAH, samAsena saMsargasannipAtajAH; yastvatra samAsenoktaH sa cikitsite prapa~jcanIya iti bhAvaH||34||

1.sanskrit: jvarastu khalu maheshvarakopaprabhavaH, sarvaprANabhRutAM prANaharo, dehendriyamanastApakaraH, praj~jAbalavarNaharShotsAhahrAsakaraH , shramaklamamohAhAroparodhasa~jjananaH; jvarayati sharIrANIti jvaraH, nAnye vyAdhayastathA dAruNA bahUpadravA dushcikitsyAshca yathA~ayam| sa sarvarogAdhipatiH, nAnAtiryagyoniShu ca bahuvidhaiH shabdairabhidhIyate| sarve prANabhRutaH sajvarA eva jAyante sajvarA eva mriyante ca; sa mahAmohaH, tenAbhibhUtAH prAgdaihikaM dehinaH karma ki~jcidapi na smaranti, sarvaprANabhRutAM ca jvara evAnte prANAnAdatte||35||
1.commentary: samprati jvarasya mahAprabhAvatAM darshayituM pUrvotpattiprakAramAha- jvarastvityAdi| maheshvarakopaprabhava ityanena jvaracikitsite “dvitIye hi yuge sharvamakrodhavratamAsthitam” (ci.a.3) ityAdigranthe vakShyamANAM jvarotpattimAha| krodhabhavatvena ca shleShmajanyasyApyAgneyatvaM darshayati; krodho hyagnirUpaH, tena tanmayo~api jvarastathaiva; ata evoktam- “UShmA pittAdRute nAsti jvaro nAstyUShmaNA vinA| tasmAt pittaviruddhAni tyajet pittAdhike~adhikam” (vA.ci.a.1) iti| na ca rudrakopabhavatvena lobhAbhidrohaprabhavatvaM jvarasya virudhyate; yato rudrakopodbhUta eva jvaro lobhAbhidrohasvarUpapApAcAraprAptyA purA manuShyeShu bhUtaH| sarvaprANinAM jvara eva prANahara iti maraNakAle sarvaprANinAM jvara eva prANahara iti darshayati| dehendriyamanastApakara ityatra pratyekaM tApalakShaNaM jvaracikitsite boddhavyaM “vaicittyamaratirglAnirmanaHsantApalakShaNam” (ci.a.3) ityAdinA| jvarayati santApayati| itishabdo hetau; tena, yasmAduktamaheshvarakrodhaprabhavatvAdiyuktaH, tasmAt| sarvarogANAmadhipatiriveti sarvarogAdhipatiH| nAnAvidhaiH shabdairiti hastiShu pAkalo, goShu kheriko , matsyAnAmindrajAlo, viha~ggAnAM bhrAmaraka ityAdishabdaiH| sarvaprANabhRutaH sajvarA eva jAyante sajvarA eva mriyante ca tat kimiti teShAM janmani maraNe vA santApAtmA jvaro na lakShyata ityAha- sa mahAmoha iti; janmamaraNayormahAmoharUpo jvaro bhavati, na santApAtmetyarthaH| ata evoktaM- “jvaraprabhAvo janmAdau nidhane ca mahattamaH” (ci.a.3) iti| janmani mahAmoharUpatAmAha- tenetyAdi| prAgdaihikaM janmAntarakRutam| nanu, shuddhasattvAnugamAt prAgdaihikaM smaraNaM yuktaM; vacanaM hi- “yadA tenaiva shuddhena manasA yujyate, tadA jAtimatikrAntAmapi smarati” (shA.a.3) iti| na, tasya shuddhamanaHsattvAnuvRutterapavAdatvAdetatparityajyAnyatra jvarasya prAgdaihikavismArakatvaM j~jeyam| maraNe mahAmohatAmAha- sarvaprANabhRutAmityAdi| jvara eva mahAmoharUpa eveti bhAvaH; tena mriyamANAH sarve mahAmohaM pravishantItyarthaH||35||

1.sanskrit: tatra pUrvarUpadarshane jvarAdau vA hitaM laghvashanamapatarpaNaM vA, jvarasyAmAshayasamutthatvAt; tataH kaShAyapAnAbhya~ggasnehasvedapradehapariShekAnulepanavamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsanopashamana- nastaHkarmadhUpadhUmapAnA~jjanakShIrabhojanavidhAnaM ca yathAsvaM yuktyA prayojyam||36||
1.commentary: samprati sUtritaM cikitsAsUtramAha- tatretyAdi| yadyapi cikitsite jvarAdau la~gghanaM vakShyati, tathA~apIha pAkShikalaghvashanavidhAnaM na virodhi, laghvashanasyApi lAghavakartRutvenaiva la~gghanatvAt; kiMvA, yatra vAtAdijvare la~gghanaM na kartavyaM tatra laghvashanaM boddhavyam, apatarpaNaM ca la~gghanameva| atha kimiti vAtike~api jvare vAtakArakaM laghvashanamapatarpaNaM vA kAryamityAha- AmAshayasamutthatvAdityAdi| AmAshayasambandhena vAto~api manAgla~gghanIyaH sthAnApekShayA bhavatIti bhAvaH| vacanaM hi- “sthAnaM jayeddhi pUrvaM sthAnasyAvirodhena” iti||36||

1.sanskrit: jIrNajvareShu tu sarveShveva sarpiShaH pAnaM prashasyate yathAsvauShadhasiddhasya; sarpirhi snehAdvAtaM shamayati, saMskArAt kaphaM, shaityAt pittamUShmANaM ca; tasmAjjIrNajvareShu sarveShveva sarpirhitamudakamivAgnipluShTeShu dravyeShviti||37|| bhavanti cAtra- yathA prajvalitaM veshma pariShi~jcanti vAriNA| narAH shAntimabhipretya tathA jIrNajvare ghRutam||38|| snehAdvAtaM shamayati, shaityAt pittaM niyacchati| ghRutaM tulyaguNaM doShaM saMskArAttu jayet kapham||39|| nAnyaH snehastathA kashcit saMskAramanuvartate| yathA sarpirataH sarpiH sarvasnehottamaM matam||40||
1.commentary: yathAsvauShadhasiddhasyeti vAtAdijvare vAtajvarAdiharadravyasiddhasya| kathaM sarpiH sarvatra kAryamityAha- sarpirhi snehAdityAdi| saMskArAt kaphamiti kaTutiktAdikaphaharasaMskArAt| yadyapi ca ‘yathAsvauShadhasiddhasya’ iti vacanAdvAte~api vAtaharasaMskRutameva sarpirvihitaM , tathA~api vAte rUkShaviparItena snehenApi sarpirvAtaharameva, pitte~apyuShNaviparItashaityAnvitaM, kaphe tu sarpiShaH snehashaityAdinA samAnena kashcinna svAbhAviko virodhiguNo~asti kintu saMskArAddhitameveti darshayati| UShmANaM ceti jvaraprabhAvabhUtamUShmANaM; na pittoShmANaM, tasya pittagrahaNenaiva grahaNAt| anena jvarasyoShmaharaNena sarpiSho jvaravyAdhipratyanIkatvaM darshitaM bhavati| atra vAtashamanaM sarpiSho~abhidhAya pittashamane~abhidhAtavye kaphashamanamucyate, sheShato vaktavyoShmarUpavyAdhipratyanIkatayA~api pittashamanahetoH shaityasya samAnaguNatvAt; yadi tviha madhye pittaprashamanamucyate, tadA punaH saMskArAt kaphamityuktvA shaityAdUShmANamiti vaktavyaM syAt| yatra tu shlokapAThe vyAdhipratyanIkatvaM ghRutasya pRutha~gnoktaM; tatra, ‘snehAdvAtaM shamayati’ ityAdau vAtamanu pittameva kRutamiti sAdhu kRutam| tasmAditi doShavyAdhipratyanIkatvAt| jIrNajvareShviti vacanenAmajvare niShedhayati, sAme hi samAnaguNatvAt sarpirahitam| shAntimiti santApashAntim| abhipretyeti buddhyA svIkRutya, tathA jIrNajvare ghRutaM ‘dadAti’ iti sheShaH| nanvatra, shloke sarpirguNakathane kimiti vyAdhirUpoShmashamanaM nocyate? brUmaH- pittoShmAvyatiriktatvena jvaroShmaNaH pittashamanenaiva labdhatvAt| nanu yadyevaM gadyapAThe pRutha~gna tarhi paThanIya UShmA? brUmaH- yAvAnUShmA shArIraH sa paitta eva, yato brUte- “UShmA pittAdRute nAsti” (vA.ci.a.1) ityAdi, tathA “pittAdUShmoShmaNaH paktirnarANAmupajAyate” (sU.a.17) iti; kintu, nAsAvUShmA kadAcit pittena sAmye~apyeko bhavati, yathA- kaphajvare; kadAcittvadhike pitte vahnirUpa UShmA mando bhavati, yathA- pittAgnimAndye; tadevamUShmA pittAdbhinno~abhinnashca bhavati; tatra bhedaM gRuhItvA gadyapAThe pRuthag jvaroShmA paThitaH, shlokapAThe tvabhedavivakShayA na pRuthak paThitaH| jvare tu pittoShmA jvaraprabhAveNa vardhate, sa ca prabhAvo jvarasya doShadUShyavisheShAtmakasya, tathA “jvarastripAdastrishiraH” ityAdyuktaprANivisheShasya j~jeyaH| nanu sarpiH kathaM pittaM hanti? yataH, yathA pittaviparItashaityaM sarpiShi, tathA pittasamAnaH sneho~apyasti| naivaM, pitte “sasnehaM” (sU.a.1) itIShadarthena sashabdenAlpasya snehasyAbhidhAnAt, uShNatvaM tu pitte pradhAnam| yadyapi pittaM jalenApyArabdhaM, tathA~api tatra shaityamabhibhUyAgnikRutamauShNyamevAdhikaM bhavati, tathA tejaso raukShyeNa jalakRutasneho~api pitte~abhibhUyate, dravatvaM tu jalakRutaM tejasA nAbhibhUyate, dRushyate hyagnisampRukte jale dravatvamalpasnehatA uShNatA ceti| kiMvA, kimanena taptajaladRuShTAntena, adRuShTakRuta evAyaM bhUtAnAmutpAdaH; tena, kashciteva guNaH pA~jcabhautikatve~api dravyANAmAvirbhUto bhavati, natu sarve; yathA- shAliShu toyakRutaM madhuratvaM, na tu gauravamityuktaM sUtrasthAne| utsargataH sasnehasyApi pittasya kadAcittejobhUyastvena rUkShatvamapi bhavati jIrNajvare, tena snigdhashItaM sarpirhitaM tatra bhavatIti na doShaH| ata evoktaM cikitsite- “rUkShaM tejo jvarakaraM” (ci.a.3) ityAdi| na ca vAcyaM- yat- sAMsiddhikamapi cet pittasya snigdhatvamapaiti tadA vAtasyApi raukShyaM kimiti nApaitIti; yato vicitrA eva hi guNA apratikShepaNIyAH pratikShepaNIyAshca; tatra ye na sarvadA dRushyante vAtashaitya-pittasnehAdayaH, ta eva pratikShepaNIyAH; nAnye, tathaiva dRuShTatvAt| tulyaguNamiti sarvathA tulyaguNam| nanu saMskArAt kaphahantRutve saMskAreNaiva kapho hanyate , kastatra sarpiSho vyApAra ityAha- nAnya ityAdi| nAnya iti tailAdiH| saMskAramanuvartata iti saMskArakadravyakAryaM karoti| etenaitaddarshayati- yat- tenaiva dravyeNa yAdRu~gmAnena ghRutaM saMskriyate, anyatra tailAdisnehastathaiva yadi saMskriyate tadA ghRutamevAnyasnehebhyo visheSheNa saMskArakadravyakAryaM karoti; ayaM ghRutaprabhAvo~adhikaH, tena saMskArAt kaphavijaye ghRutameva kartavyamityarthaH| prapa~jcitashcAyamarthaH snehAdhyAye||37-40||

1.sanskrit: gadyokto yaH punaH shlokairarthaH samanugIyate| tadvyaktivyavasAyArthaM dviruktaM tanna garhyate||41||
1.commentary: nanu snehAdvAtaM shamayatItyAdigrantho gadyenaivoktaH, tat kimarthaM shlokenocyata ityAha- gadyokto ya ityAdi| tadvyaktivyavasAyArthamityatra tadvyaktirgadyoktArthasya vyaktiH prasannateti yAvat, vyavasAyaH adhyavasAyo grahaNamityarthaH; yasmAt pUrvoktArthaspaShTIkaraNArthaM punaH shlokenAbhidhAnaM, tasmAt prayojanAntarayuktatvAnna punaruktidoSha iti bhAvaH| gadyoktApekShayA shlokAbhidhAnaM sukhagrahaNaM bhavatIti lokasiddhameva| atra ca gadyokta ityupalakShaNaM, tena shlokokto~api shlokenocyata iti boddhavyaM; yathA- AragvadhIye| evaM gadyokto~api gadyeneti boddhavyaM; yathA- prapa~jcena kAraNAdyabhidhAyoktam- “evamasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH praj~jAparAdhaH pariNAmashca” (sU.a.11) ityAdi| tathA shlokenokto~api gadyenocyate, yathA- “brahmaNA hi yathA proktaM” (sU.a.1) ityAdi shlokenAbhidhAya Adye~adhyAye punaranyatroktaM- “yamAyurvedamashvinau mahyaM prAyacchetAm” (ci.a.1.pA.4) ityAdi| atra shlokAbhidhAnameva sukhagrahaNArthamiti j~jeyam| kiMvA, tadvyaktivyavasAyArthamiti yathAyogyatayA boddhavyam| tena, prapa~jcAbhidhAnamarthavyaktyarthaM boddhavyaM, sa~gkShepAbhidhAnaM tu vyavasAyArthaM; tena gadyashlokAbhidhAnAbhyAM vyaktivyavasAyau kriyete| tatra prapa~jcAbhidhAne~arthasya vyaktiH sphuTaiveti, sa~gkShepAbhidhAnaM tu prapa~jcApekShayA sukhagrahaNaM bhavati||41||

1.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- trividhaM nAmaparyAyairhetuM pa~jcavidhaM gadam| gadalakShaNaparyAyAn vyAdheH pa~jcavidhaM graham||42|| jvaramaShTavidhaM tasya prakRuShTAsannakAraNam| pUrvarUpaM ca rUpaM ca bheShajaM sa~ggraheNa ca||43|| vyAjahAra jvarasyAgre nidAne vigatajvaraH| bhagavAnagniveshAya praNatAya punarvasuH||44||
1.commentary: sa~ggrahe yadyapi hetuparyAyAH pUrvamuktAstadanu hetutraividhyaM, tathA~api chando~anurodhena tadviparyayakathanam| nAmarUpA yogarUDhAH paryAyA nAmaparyAyAH| pa~jcavidhaM gadamiti AgneyAdibhedena| ‘gadaparyAyanAmAni’ iti pAThe yalli~ggaparyAyAbhidhAnaM tasya vyAdhipa~jcavidhagrahashabdenaiva ‘tasyopalabdhiH’ ityAdigranthAntarniviShTasakalArthasya gRuhItatvAdgrahaNam; ‘gadalakShaNaparyAyAn’ iti pAThe tu pUrvapakSho nAstyeva, pAThastu nAyamatiprasiddhaH| prakRuShTAsannakAraNaM jvarasya rUkShAdi prakRuShTam, AsannaM vAtAdi; tathA prakRuShTaM rudrakopaH, AsannaM tu rUkShAdi| yadyapi rUpAt pashcAt pUrvarUpamuktaM, tathA~api chandonurodhAt pUrvarUpamagre kRutaM; kiMvA, vAtAdijavishiShTajvaralakShaNAnAmavyaktAnAM vishiShTajvarapUrvarUpatAM sUcayatA pUrvarUpaM pUrva~gkRutaM; vAtAdijvaralakShaNAni hyavyaktAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti||42-44||

1.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute nidAnasthAne jvaranidAnaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
1.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM nidAnasthAne jvaranidAnaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

2.sanskrit: athAto jvaranidAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
