8.commentary: samprati jvarasya mahAprabhAvatAM darshayituM pUrvotpattiprakAramAha- jvarastvityAdi| maheshvarakopaprabhava ityanena jvaracikitsite “dvitIye hi yuge sharvamakrodhavratamAsthitam” (ci.a.3) ityAdigranthe vakShyamANAM jvarotpattimAha| krodhabhavatvena ca shleShmajanyasyApyAgneyatvaM darshayati; krodho hyagnirUpaH, tena tanmayo~api jvarastathaiva; ata evoktam- “UShmA pittAdRute nAsti jvaro nAstyUShmaNA vinA| tasmAt pittaviruddhAni tyajet pittAdhike~adhikam” (vA.ci.a.1) iti| na ca rudrakopabhavatvena lobhAbhidrohaprabhavatvaM jvarasya virudhyate; yato rudrakopodbhUta eva jvaro lobhAbhidrohasvarUpapApAcAraprAptyA purA manuShyeShu bhUtaH| sarvaprANinAM jvara eva prANahara iti maraNakAle sarvaprANinAM jvara eva prANahara iti darshayati| dehendriyamanastApakara ityatra pratyekaM tApalakShaNaM jvaracikitsite boddhavyaM “vaicittyamaratirglAnirmanaHsantApalakShaNam” (ci.a.3) ityAdinA| jvarayati santApayati| itishabdo hetau; tena, yasmAduktamaheshvarakrodhaprabhavatvAdiyuktaH, tasmAt| sarvarogANAmadhipatiriveti sarvarogAdhipatiH| nAnAvidhaiH shabdairiti hastiShu pAkalo, goShu kheriko , matsyAnAmindrajAlo, viha~ggAnAM bhrAmaraka ityAdishabdaiH| sarvaprANabhRutaH sajvarA eva jAyante sajvarA eva mriyante ca tat kimiti teShAM janmani maraNe vA santApAtmA jvaro na lakShyata ityAha- sa mahAmoha iti; janmamaraNayormahAmoharUpo jvaro bhavati, na santApAtmetyarthaH| ata evoktaM- “jvaraprabhAvo janmAdau nidhane ca mahattamaH” (ci.a.3) iti| janmani mahAmoharUpatAmAha- tenetyAdi| prAgdaihikaM janmAntarakRutam| nanu, shuddhasattvAnugamAt prAgdaihikaM smaraNaM yuktaM; vacanaM hi- “yadA tenaiva shuddhena manasA yujyate, tadA jAtimatikrAntAmapi smarati” (shA.a.3) iti| na, tasya shuddhamanaHsattvAnuvRutterapavAdatvAdetatparityajyAnyatra jvarasya prAgdaihikavismArakatvaM j~jeyam| maraNe mahAmohatAmAha- sarvaprANabhRutAmityAdi| jvara eva mahAmoharUpa eveti bhAvaH; tena mriyamANAH sarve mahAmohaM pravishantItyarthaH||35||

8.sanskrit: tatra pUrvarUpadarshane jvarAdau vA hitaM laghvashanamapatarpaNaM vA, jvarasyAmAshayasamutthatvAt; tataH kaShAyapAnAbhya~ggasnehasvedapradehapariShekAnulepanavamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsanopashamana- nastaHkarmadhUpadhUmapAnA~jjanakShIrabhojanavidhAnaM ca yathAsvaM yuktyA prayojyam||36||
8.commentary: samprati sUtritaM cikitsAsUtramAha- tatretyAdi| yadyapi cikitsite jvarAdau la~gghanaM vakShyati, tathA~apIha pAkShikalaghvashanavidhAnaM na virodhi, laghvashanasyApi lAghavakartRutvenaiva la~gghanatvAt; kiMvA, yatra vAtAdijvare la~gghanaM na kartavyaM tatra laghvashanaM boddhavyam, apatarpaNaM ca la~gghanameva| atha kimiti vAtike~api jvare vAtakArakaM laghvashanamapatarpaNaM vA kAryamityAha- AmAshayasamutthatvAdityAdi| AmAshayasambandhena vAto~api manAgla~gghanIyaH sthAnApekShayA bhavatIti bhAvaH| vacanaM hi- “sthAnaM jayeddhi pUrvaM sthAnasyAvirodhena” iti||36||

8.sanskrit: jIrNajvareShu tu sarveShveva sarpiShaH pAnaM prashasyate yathAsvauShadhasiddhasya; sarpirhi snehAdvAtaM shamayati, saMskArAt kaphaM, shaityAt pittamUShmANaM ca; tasmAjjIrNajvareShu sarveShveva sarpirhitamudakamivAgnipluShTeShu dravyeShviti||37|| bhavanti cAtra- yathA prajvalitaM veshma pariShi~jcanti vAriNA| narAH shAntimabhipretya tathA jIrNajvare ghRutam||38|| snehAdvAtaM shamayati, shaityAt pittaM niyacchati| ghRutaM tulyaguNaM doShaM saMskArAttu jayet kapham||39|| nAnyaH snehastathA kashcit saMskAramanuvartate| yathA sarpirataH sarpiH sarvasnehottamaM matam||40||
8.commentary: yathAsvauShadhasiddhasyeti vAtAdijvare vAtajvarAdiharadravyasiddhasya| kathaM sarpiH sarvatra kAryamityAha- sarpirhi snehAdityAdi| saMskArAt kaphamiti kaTutiktAdikaphaharasaMskArAt| yadyapi ca ‘yathAsvauShadhasiddhasya’ iti vacanAdvAte~api vAtaharasaMskRutameva sarpirvihitaM , tathA~api vAte rUkShaviparItena snehenApi sarpirvAtaharameva, pitte~apyuShNaviparItashaityAnvitaM, kaphe tu sarpiShaH snehashaityAdinA samAnena kashcinna svAbhAviko virodhiguNo~asti kintu saMskArAddhitameveti darshayati| UShmANaM ceti jvaraprabhAvabhUtamUShmANaM; na pittoShmANaM, tasya pittagrahaNenaiva grahaNAt| anena jvarasyoShmaharaNena sarpiSho jvaravyAdhipratyanIkatvaM darshitaM bhavati| atra vAtashamanaM sarpiSho~abhidhAya pittashamane~abhidhAtavye kaphashamanamucyate, sheShato vaktavyoShmarUpavyAdhipratyanIkatayA~api pittashamanahetoH shaityasya samAnaguNatvAt; yadi tviha madhye pittaprashamanamucyate, tadA punaH saMskArAt kaphamityuktvA shaityAdUShmANamiti vaktavyaM syAt| yatra tu shlokapAThe vyAdhipratyanIkatvaM ghRutasya pRutha~gnoktaM; tatra, ‘snehAdvAtaM shamayati’ ityAdau vAtamanu pittameva kRutamiti sAdhu kRutam| tasmAditi doShavyAdhipratyanIkatvAt| jIrNajvareShviti vacanenAmajvare niShedhayati, sAme hi samAnaguNatvAt sarpirahitam| shAntimiti santApashAntim| abhipretyeti buddhyA svIkRutya, tathA jIrNajvare ghRutaM ‘dadAti’ iti sheShaH| nanvatra, shloke sarpirguNakathane kimiti vyAdhirUpoShmashamanaM nocyate? brUmaH- pittoShmAvyatiriktatvena jvaroShmaNaH pittashamanenaiva labdhatvAt| nanu yadyevaM gadyapAThe pRutha~gna tarhi paThanIya UShmA? brUmaH- yAvAnUShmA shArIraH sa paitta eva, yato brUte- “UShmA pittAdRute nAsti” (vA.ci.a.1) ityAdi, tathA “pittAdUShmoShmaNaH paktirnarANAmupajAyate” (sU.a.17) iti; kintu, nAsAvUShmA kadAcit pittena sAmye~apyeko bhavati, yathA- kaphajvare; kadAcittvadhike pitte vahnirUpa UShmA mando bhavati, yathA- pittAgnimAndye; tadevamUShmA pittAdbhinno~abhinnashca bhavati; tatra bhedaM gRuhItvA gadyapAThe pRuthag jvaroShmA paThitaH, shlokapAThe tvabhedavivakShayA na pRuthak paThitaH| jvare tu pittoShmA jvaraprabhAveNa vardhate, sa ca prabhAvo jvarasya doShadUShyavisheShAtmakasya, tathA “jvarastripAdastrishiraH” ityAdyuktaprANivisheShasya j~jeyaH| nanu sarpiH kathaM pittaM hanti? yataH, yathA pittaviparItashaityaM sarpiShi, tathA pittasamAnaH sneho~apyasti| naivaM, pitte “sasnehaM” (sU.a.1) itIShadarthena sashabdenAlpasya snehasyAbhidhAnAt, uShNatvaM tu pitte pradhAnam| yadyapi pittaM jalenApyArabdhaM, tathA~api tatra shaityamabhibhUyAgnikRutamauShNyamevAdhikaM bhavati, tathA tejaso raukShyeNa jalakRutasneho~api pitte~abhibhUyate, dravatvaM tu jalakRutaM tejasA nAbhibhUyate, dRushyate hyagnisampRukte jale dravatvamalpasnehatA uShNatA ceti| kiMvA, kimanena taptajaladRuShTAntena, adRuShTakRuta evAyaM bhUtAnAmutpAdaH; tena, kashciteva guNaH pA~jcabhautikatve~api dravyANAmAvirbhUto bhavati, natu sarve; yathA- shAliShu toyakRutaM madhuratvaM, na tu gauravamityuktaM sUtrasthAne| utsargataH sasnehasyApi pittasya kadAcittejobhUyastvena rUkShatvamapi bhavati jIrNajvare, tena snigdhashItaM sarpirhitaM tatra bhavatIti na doShaH| ata evoktaM cikitsite- “rUkShaM tejo jvarakaraM” (ci.a.3) ityAdi| na ca vAcyaM- yat- sAMsiddhikamapi cet pittasya snigdhatvamapaiti tadA vAtasyApi raukShyaM kimiti nApaitIti; yato vicitrA eva hi guNA apratikShepaNIyAH pratikShepaNIyAshca; tatra ye na sarvadA dRushyante vAtashaitya-pittasnehAdayaH, ta eva pratikShepaNIyAH; nAnye, tathaiva dRuShTatvAt| tulyaguNamiti sarvathA tulyaguNam| nanu saMskArAt kaphahantRutve saMskAreNaiva kapho hanyate , kastatra sarpiSho vyApAra ityAha- nAnya ityAdi| nAnya iti tailAdiH| saMskAramanuvartata iti saMskArakadravyakAryaM karoti| etenaitaddarshayati- yat- tenaiva dravyeNa yAdRu~gmAnena ghRutaM saMskriyate, anyatra tailAdisnehastathaiva yadi saMskriyate tadA ghRutamevAnyasnehebhyo visheSheNa saMskArakadravyakAryaM karoti; ayaM ghRutaprabhAvo~adhikaH, tena saMskArAt kaphavijaye ghRutameva kartavyamityarthaH| prapa~jcitashcAyamarthaH snehAdhyAye||37-40||

8.sanskrit: gadyokto yaH punaH shlokairarthaH samanugIyate| tadvyaktivyavasAyArthaM dviruktaM tanna garhyate||41||
8.commentary: nanu snehAdvAtaM shamayatItyAdigrantho gadyenaivoktaH, tat kimarthaM shlokenocyata ityAha- gadyokto ya ityAdi| tadvyaktivyavasAyArthamityatra tadvyaktirgadyoktArthasya vyaktiH prasannateti yAvat, vyavasAyaH adhyavasAyo grahaNamityarthaH; yasmAt pUrvoktArthaspaShTIkaraNArthaM punaH shlokenAbhidhAnaM, tasmAt prayojanAntarayuktatvAnna punaruktidoSha iti bhAvaH| gadyoktApekShayA shlokAbhidhAnaM sukhagrahaNaM bhavatIti lokasiddhameva| atra ca gadyokta ityupalakShaNaM, tena shlokokto~api shlokenocyata iti boddhavyaM; yathA- AragvadhIye| evaM gadyokto~api gadyeneti boddhavyaM; yathA- prapa~jcena kAraNAdyabhidhAyoktam- “evamasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH praj~jAparAdhaH pariNAmashca” (sU.a.11) ityAdi| tathA shlokenokto~api gadyenocyate, yathA- “brahmaNA hi yathA proktaM” (sU.a.1) ityAdi shlokenAbhidhAya Adye~adhyAye punaranyatroktaM- “yamAyurvedamashvinau mahyaM prAyacchetAm” (ci.a.1.pA.4) ityAdi| atra shlokAbhidhAnameva sukhagrahaNArthamiti j~jeyam| kiMvA, tadvyaktivyavasAyArthamiti yathAyogyatayA boddhavyam| tena, prapa~jcAbhidhAnamarthavyaktyarthaM boddhavyaM, sa~gkShepAbhidhAnaM tu vyavasAyArthaM; tena gadyashlokAbhidhAnAbhyAM vyaktivyavasAyau kriyete| tatra prapa~jcAbhidhAne~arthasya vyaktiH sphuTaiveti, sa~gkShepAbhidhAnaM tu prapa~jcApekShayA sukhagrahaNaM bhavati||41||

8.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- trividhaM nAmaparyAyairhetuM pa~jcavidhaM gadam| gadalakShaNaparyAyAn vyAdheH pa~jcavidhaM graham||42|| jvaramaShTavidhaM tasya prakRuShTAsannakAraNam| pUrvarUpaM ca rUpaM ca bheShajaM sa~ggraheNa ca||43|| vyAjahAra jvarasyAgre nidAne vigatajvaraH| bhagavAnagniveshAya praNatAya punarvasuH||44||
8.commentary: sa~ggrahe yadyapi hetuparyAyAH pUrvamuktAstadanu hetutraividhyaM, tathA~api chando~anurodhena tadviparyayakathanam| nAmarUpA yogarUDhAH paryAyA nAmaparyAyAH| pa~jcavidhaM gadamiti AgneyAdibhedena| ‘gadaparyAyanAmAni’ iti pAThe yalli~ggaparyAyAbhidhAnaM tasya vyAdhipa~jcavidhagrahashabdenaiva ‘tasyopalabdhiH’ ityAdigranthAntarniviShTasakalArthasya gRuhItatvAdgrahaNam; ‘gadalakShaNaparyAyAn’ iti pAThe tu pUrvapakSho nAstyeva, pAThastu nAyamatiprasiddhaH| prakRuShTAsannakAraNaM jvarasya rUkShAdi prakRuShTam, AsannaM vAtAdi; tathA prakRuShTaM rudrakopaH, AsannaM tu rUkShAdi| yadyapi rUpAt pashcAt pUrvarUpamuktaM, tathA~api chandonurodhAt pUrvarUpamagre kRutaM; kiMvA, vAtAdijavishiShTajvaralakShaNAnAmavyaktAnAM vishiShTajvarapUrvarUpatAM sUcayatA pUrvarUpaM pUrva~gkRutaM; vAtAdijvaralakShaNAni hyavyaktAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti||42-44||

8.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute nidAnasthAne jvaranidAnaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
8.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM nidAnasthAne jvaranidAnaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

1.sanskrit: athAtaH katidhApuruShIyaM shArIraM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
1.commentary: nidAnasthAne j~jAtahetvAdinA tathA vimAne pratItarasadoShAdimAnena kartavyacikitsAyA adhikaraNaM sharIraM j~jAtavyaM bhavati; yato~apratipanne~asheShavisheShataH sharIre na sharIravij~jAnAdhInA cikitsA sAdhvI bhavati; ataH sharIraM kAraNotpattisthitivRuddhyAdivisheShaiH pratipAdayituM shArIraM sthAnamucyate| atrApi cAtyantaduHkhoparamamokShakAraNacikitsopayuktapuruShabhedAdipratipAdakatayA pradhAnatvena katidhApuruShIyo~adhyAyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

1.sanskrit: katidhA puruSho dhIman! dhAtubhedena bhidyate| puruShaH kAraNaM kasmAt, prabhavaH puruShasya kaH||3|| kimaj~jo j~jaH, sa nityaH kiM kimanityo nidarshitaH| prakRutiH kA, vikArAH ke, kiM li~ggaM puruShasya ca||4|| niShkriyaM ca svatantraM ca vashinaM sarvagaM vibhum| vadantyAtmAnamAtmaj~jAH kShetraj~jaM sAkShiNaM tathA||5|| niShkriyasya kriyA tasya bhagavan! vidyate katham| svatantrashcedaniShTAsu kathaM yoniShu jAyate||6|| vashI yadyasukhaiH kasmAdbhAvairAkramyate balAt| sarvAH sarvagatatvAcca vedanAH kiM na vetti saH||7|| na pashyati vibhuH kasmAcchailakuDyatiraskRutam| kShetraj~jaH kShetramathavA kiM pUrvamiti saMshayaH||8|| j~jeyaM kShetraM vinA pUrvaM kShetraj~jo hi na yujyate| kShetraM ca yadi pUrvaM syAt kShetraj~jaH syAdashAshvataH||9|| sAkShibhUtashca kasyAyaM kartA hyanyo na vidyate| syAt kathaM cAvikArasya visheSho vedanAkRutaH||10|| atha cArtasya bhagavaMstisRuNAM kAM cikitsati| atItAM vedanAM vaidyo vartamAnAM bhaviShyatIm||11|| bhaviShyantyA asamprAptiratItAyA anAgamaH| sAmpratikyA api sthAnaM nAstyarteH saMshayo hyataH||12|| kAraNaM vedanAnAM kiM, kimadhiShThAnamucyate| kva caitA vedanAH sarvA nivRuttiM yAntyasheShataH||13|| sarvavit sarvasannyAsI sarvasaMyoganiHsRutaH| ekaH prashAnto bhUtAtmA kairli~ggairupalabhyate||14|| ityagniveshasya vacaH shrutvA matimatAM varaH| sarvaM yathAvat provAca prashAntAtmA punarvasuH||15||
1.commentary: katidheti katiprakAraH| puruSha ityanena cAvisheSheNa puruShashabdAbhidheyo~arthobhidhIyate; yataH ‘khAdayashcetanAShaShThA’ ityAdinA, tathA caturviMshatikabhedabhinnashca karmapuruSha eva sharIrI vAcyaH, tathA ‘cetanAdhAturapyekaH smRutaH puruShasa~jj~jakaH’ ityanenAtmaiva sharIrarahitaH puruShashabdArthatvena vAcyaH| puruShadhAraNAddhAtuH; tena dhAtubhedeneti puruShadhAraNArthabhedena| dhImanniti visheShaNena ya eva dhImAn sa eva puruShabhedAdikamimaM vakShyamANaM susUkShmaM vaktuM samartha iti darshayati| puruShaH kAraNaM kasmAditi kasmAddhetoH puruShaH saMsAre pradhAnaM sthAyikAraNamityarthaH| prabhavatyasmAditi prabhavaH kAraNam| yoniShviti jAtiShu| sarvA iti parapuruShagatA api| kShetraj~jaH AtmA| kShetram avyaktavarjitaM sarvaM vakShyamANam| j~jeyamityAdi| asati kShetre kShetraj~jAnAbhAvAnna kShetraj~jatvamupapadyate iti bhAvaH| sAkShibhUta iti sAkShisadRushaH| visheSho vedanAkRuta iti putrAdij~jAnarUpavedanAjanito harShAdivisheSha ityarthaH| tisRuNAmiti atItAnAgatavartamAnAnAM duHkharUpANAM madhye kAM cikitsati| atItAmityAdau kiMshabdo~adhyAhAryaH, tena kimatItAM cikitsati, kiM vartamAnAM, kiMvA bhaviShyatImiti yojyam| sthAnaM nAstIti kShaNikatvena cikitsAyAH pravRuttiyogyakAlAvasthAnaM nAsti| vedanAnAM kAraNamadhiShThAnaM ca yadyapi dIrgha~jjIvitIye~apyuktaM, tathA~apIha prakaraNavashAdvisheShapratItyAkA~gkShayA ca vishiShTAH punaH prashnAH| prashnArthAshcAmI uttaragranthe AcAryeNa prapa~jcanIyA iti neha vyAkaraNIyAH||3-15||

1.sanskrit: khAdayashcetanAShaShThA dhAtavaH puruShaH smRutaH| cetanAdhAturapyekaH smRutaH puruShasa~jj~jakaH||16||
1.commentary: khAdaya ityAdi| khAdayaH “khaM vAyuragnirApaH kShitistathA” iti vakShyamANAH; cetanAShaShThA ityatra cetanAshabdena cetanAdhAraH samanaska AtmA gRuhyate; khAdigrahaNena cendriyANi khAdimayAnyavaruddhAni| ayaM ca vaisheShikadarshanaparigRuhItashcikitsAshAstraviShayaH puruShaH; ayameva “pa~jcamahAbhUtasharIrisamavAyaH puruShaH” (su. sU. 1) ityanena sushrutenApyuktaH| smRuta iti bhAShayA pUrvAcAryANAmapyayaM puruShashabdavAcyo~abhipreto nAsmatkalpita iti darshayati| puri sharIre shete iti vyutpattyA ya AtmA puruShashabdenocyate tamAha- cetanetyAdi| atra puruSha iti kartavye yat ‘puruShasa~jj~jaka’ iti karoti tena na cetanAdhAturUpaH puruShashcikitsAyamabhipretaH, kintu shAstrAntaravyavahArAnurodhAdihApyayaM puruShashabdena sa~jj~jita iti darshayati; cikitsAviShayastu ShaDdhAtuka eva puruShaH, ata eva tatra sa~jj~jitagrahaNaM na kRutam| ayaM ca puruShashabdo gavAdAvapi ShaDdhAtusamudAye yadyapi vartate, tathA~api sarvapradhAne nara eva visheSheNa vartate; tena nAtiprasiddho gavAdau puruShashabdaH||16||

1.sanskrit: punashca dhAtubhedena caturviMshatikaH smRutaH| mano dashendriyANyarthAH prakRutishcAShTadhAtukI||17||
1.commentary: ShaDdhAturUpameva puruShaM punaH sA~gkhyadarshanabhedAccaturviMshatikabhedenAha- punashcetyAdi| caturviMshatikameva vibhajate- mana ityAdi| yadyapi pa~jcaviMshatitattvamayo~ayaM puruShaH sA~gkhyairucyate, yadAha- “mUlaprakRutiravikRutirmahadAdyAH prakRutivikRutayaH sapta| ShoDashakastu vikAro na prakRutirna vikRutiH puruShaH” (sAM.kA.3) iti, tathA~apIha prakRutivyatiriktaM codAsInaM puruShamavyaktatvasAdharmyAdavyaktAyAM prakRutAveva prakShipya avyaktashabdenaiva gRuhNAti; tena ‘caturviMshatikaH puruShaH’ ityaviruddham| udAsInasya hi sUkShmasya bhedapratipAdanamihAnatiprayojanamiti na kRutam| dashendriyANIti pa~jca karmendriyANi, pa~jca buddhIndriyANi ca| aShTadhAtukIti khAdipa~jcakabuddhyavyaktAha~gkArarUpA; vakShyati hi- “khAdIni buddhiravyaktamaha~gkArastathA~aShTamaH” iti||17||

1.sanskrit: lakShaNaM manaso j~jAnasyAbhAvo bhAva eva ca| sati hyAtmendriyArthAnAM sannikarShe na vartate||18|| vaivRuttyAnmanaso j~jAnaM sAnnidhyAttacca vartate| aNutvamatha caikatvaM dvau guNau manasaH smRutau||19||
1.commentary: atra caturviMshatike prathamoddiShTaM mano lakShayitumAha- lakShaNamityAdi| yathA j~jAnasyAbhAvo j~jAnasya bhAvashca manogamako bhavati tadAha- satItyAdi| vaivRuttyAnmanasa iti indriyeNAsaMyogAt, sAnnidhyAditi indriyeNa manasaH sambandhAt| evaM manyate- yadA yugapadindriyArthA indriyaiH saMyujyante tadA kvacidindriyArthe j~jAnaM bhavati kvacinna bhavatIti dRuShTaM, tenemau j~jAnabhAvAbhAvau j~jAnakAraNAntaraM darshayataH; yacca tat kAraNAntaraM tanmanaH| tacca kAraNaM manorUpaM yadyAtmavadyugapat sarvendriyavyApakaM svIkriyate kiMvA anekasa~gkhyamindriyavat svIkriyate, tadA punarapi yugapadindriyArthasambandhe pa~jcabhirj~jAnairbhavitavyaM vibhunA vA manasA, anekairvA manobhiryugapadadhiShThitatvAdindriyANAM; na ca bhavanti yugapajj~jAnAni, tasmAdyugapajj~jAnAnudayAlli~ggAnmano~aNurUpamekaM ca sidhyatItyAha- aNutvamityAdi||18-19||

1.sanskrit: cintyaM vicAryamUhyaM ca dhyeyaM sa~gkalpyameva ca| yatki~jcinmanaso j~jeyaM tat sarvaM hyarthasa~jj~jakam||20|| indriyAbhigrahaH karma manasaH svasya nigrahaH| Uho vicArashca, tataH paraM buddhiH pravartate||21||
1.commentary: manoguNamabhidhAya manoviShayamAha- cintyamityAdi| cintyaM kartavyatayA akartavyatayA vA yanmanasA cintyate| vicAryam upapattyanupapattibhyAM yadvimRushyate| UhyaM ca yat sambhAvanayA Uhyate ‘evametadbhaviShyati ’ iti| dhyeyaM bhAvanAj~jAnaviShayam| sa~gkalpyaM guNavattayA doShavattayA vA~avadhAraNAviShayam| yat ki~jcidityanena sukhAdyanuktaviShayAvarodhaH| manaso j~jeyamiti indriyanirapekShamanogrAhyam| ete ca mano~arthAH shabdAdirUpA eva; tena ShaShThArthakalpanayA na caturviMshatisa~gkhyAtirekaH| sukhAdayastu shabdAdivyatiriktA mano~arthA buddhibhedagrahaNenaiva grAhyAH| manoviShayamabhidhAya manaH karmAha- indriyetyAdi| indriyAbhigrahaH indriyAdhiShThAnaM manasaH karma, tathA svasya nigraho manasaH karma; mano hyaniShTaviShayaprasRutaM manasaiva niyamyate, “manashca guNAntarayuktaM sadviShayAntarAnniyamayati” ityAhureke| yaduktam- “viShayapravaNaM cittaM dhRutibhraMshAnna shakyate| niyantumahitAdarthAddhRutirhi niyamAtmikA” iti| tena, dhRutyA kAraNabhUtayA (mana ) AtmAnaM niyamayatIti na svAtmani kriyAvirodhaH| manaH karmAntaramAha- Uho vicArashceti|- atroha Alocana(nA)j~jAnaM nirvikalpa(ka)m, vicAro heyopAdeyatayA vikalpanam| caturvidhaM hi vikalpakAraNaM sA~gkhyA manyante; tatra bAhyamindriyarUpam, AbhyantaraM tu mano~aha~gkAro buddhishceti tritayam| tatrendriyANyAlocayanti nirvikalpena gRuhNantItyarthaH, manastu sa~gkalpayati heyopAdeyatayA kalpayatItyarthaH, aha~gkAro~abhimanyate ‘mamedamahamatrAdhikRutaH’ iti manyata ityarthaH, buddhiradhyavasyati ‘tyajAmyenaM doShavantamupAdadAmyenaM guNavantam’ ityadhyavasAyaM karotItyarthaH| Uhastu yadyapi bAhyacakShurAdikarma, tathA~api tatrApi mano~adhiShThAnamastIti manaH- karmatayoktaH| vacanaM hi “sAntaHkaraNA buddhiH sarvaM viShayamavagAhate yasmAt| tasmAttrividhaM karaNaM dvAri, dvArANi sheShANi” (sAM. kA. 35) iti | tataH paraM buddhiH pravartata iti UhavicArAnantaraM buddhiradhyavasAyaM karotItyarthaH| aha~gkAravyApArashcAbhimananamihAnukto~api buddhivyApAreNaiva sUcito j~jeyaH| buddhirhityajAmyenamupAdadAmIti vA~adhyavasAyaM kurvatI aha~gkArAbhimata eva viShaye bhavati; tena buddhivyApAreNaivAha~gkAravyApAro~api gRuhyate| buddhau hi sarvakaraNavyApArArpaNaM bhavati| yaduktam- “ete pradIpakalpAH parasparavilakShaNA guNavisheShAH| kRutsnaM puruShasyArthaM prakAshya buddhau prayacchanti ” (sAM.kA.36)||20-21||

1.sanskrit: indriyeNendriyArtho hi samanaskena gRuhyate| kalpyate manasA tUrdhvaM guNato doShato~athavA||22|| jAyate viShaye tatra yA buddhirnishcayAtmikA| vyavasyati tayA vaktuM kartuM vA buddhipUrvakam||23||
1.commentary: etadevohavicArapUrvakatvaM buddhervivRuNoti- indriyeNetyAdi| gRuhyate iti UhamAtreNa nirvikalpena gRuhyate| guNata iti upAdeyatayA| doShata iti heyatayA| buddhyadhyavasAyaM vivRuNoti- jAyata ityAdi| viShaye tatreti manasA kalpite viShaye| nishcayAtmiketi sthirasvarUpA adhyavasAyarUpetyarthaH| vyavasyatIti anuShThAnaM karoti, udyukto bhavatItyarthaH; buddhyadhyavasitamarthaM vaktuM kartuM vA~anutiShThatIti yAvat| buddhipUrvakamityanena yadeva buddhipUrvakamanuShThAnaM tadevaivaMvidhaM bhavati nonmattAdyanuShThAnamiti darshayati||22-23||

1.sanskrit: ekaikAdhikayuktAni khAdInAmindriyANi tu| pa~jca karmAnumeyAni yebhyo buddhiH pravartate||24||
1.commentary: mano~abhidhAyendriyANyabhidhatte, tatrApi jyAyastvAd buddhIndriyANi, prAgAha- ekaiketyAdi| khAdInAM madhye ekaikenAdhikena bhUtena yuktAnIndriyANi pa~jca cakShurAdIni; ekaikAdhikapadena pa~jcApi pA~jcabhautikAni, paraM cakShuShi tejo~adhikamityAdyuktaM sUcayati| karmAnumeyAnIti kAryAnumeyAni; kAryaM cakShurbuddhyAdi| yebhyo buddhiH pravartata iti yAni buddhIndriyANi, tAnImAni pa~jceti darshayati| yadyapi ca sA~gkhye Aha~gkArikANIndriyANi, yaduktaM- “sAttvika ekAdashakaH pravartate vaikRutAdaha~gkArAt” (sAM.kA.25) iti, tathA~api matabhedAdbhautikatvamindriyANAM j~jeyaM; kiMvA, aupacArikametadbhautikatvamindriyANAM j~jeyam; upacArabIjaM ca yadguNabhUyiShThaM yadindriyaM gRuhNAti, tattadbhUyiShThamityucyate; cakShustejo gRuhNAti, tena taijasamucyata ityAdi j~jeyam||24||

1.sanskrit: hastau pAdau gudopasthaM vAgindriyamathApi ca| karmendriyANi pa~jcaiva pAdau gamanakarmaNi||25|| pAyUpasthaM visargArthaM hastau grahaNadhAraNe| jihvA vAgindriyaM vAk ca satyA jyotistamo~anRutA||26||
1.commentary: atha karmendriyANyAha- hastAvityAdi| hastAvekaM pAdau caikamindriyamekarUpakarmakartRutayA| gudopasthaM caikaikam| vAca upAdAnahAnArthaM bhedamAha- vAk cetyAdi| jyotiriva jyotiH, dharmakartRutvenobhayalokaprakAshakAritvAt ; etadviparyayeNa tamaH anRutA||25-26||

1.sanskrit: mahAbhUtAni khaM vAyuragnirApaH kShitistathA| shabdaH sparshashca rUpaM ca raso gandhashca tadguNAH||27||
1.commentary: sampratyuddeshakramAnurodhAdarthe~abhidhAtavye~arthAnAM prakRutigrahaNagRuhItapa~jcabhUtaguNatayA parAdhInatvAdaShTadhAtuprakRutigRuhItAni bhUtAnyeva tAvadAha- mahAbhUtAnItyAdi| shabdAdayo yathAsa~gkhyaM khAdInAM naisargikA guNA j~jeyAH| yastu guNotkarSho~abhidhAtavyaH sa hi anupraviShTabhUtasambandhAdeva | tena pRuthivyAM caturbhUtapraveshAt pa~jcaguNatvam, evaM jalAdAvapi caturguNatvAdi j~jeyam||27||

1.sanskrit: teShAmekaguNaH pUrvo guNavRuddhiH pare pare| pUrvaH pUrvaguNashcaiva kramasho guNiShu smRutaH||28||
1.commentary: naisargikaM guNamabhidhAya bhUtAntarapraveshakRutaM guNamAha- teShAmityAdi| ekaguNaH pUrva iti pUrvo dhAtuH kharUpaH shabdaikaguNaH| puMli~ggatA ca khAdInAM dhAturUpatAbuddhisthIkRutatvAt ; uktaM hi- “khAdayashcetanAShaShThA dhAtavaH” iti| yathA yathA ca paratvaM tathA tathA ca guNavRuddhiryathAsa~gkhyam| nanu, etAvatA~apyekaguNatvadviguNatvAdi na niyamena j~jAyate ko guNaH kva bhUte ityAha- pUrva ityAdi|- guNiShu khAdiShu dhAtuShu pUrvo guNaH krameNa yathAsa~gkhyaM vartate; na kevalaM pUrvaH kintu pUrvasyApi yo guNaH, sa ca pUrvaguNa uttare bhUte vartate| tena khe pUrve pUrvaH shabda(bdo)guNo vartate; vAyau tu sparshaH kramaprAptaH pUrvo bhavati, pUrvaguNashca shabda iti dviguNatvam; evamagnyAdau ca j~jeyam| gandhastUttaraguNAntarAbhAvAnna pUrvo bhavati, tathA~api ‘gandhashca tadguNAH’ iti granthe tadguNA itipadApekShayA gandhasya pUrvatvaM kalpanIyaM; kiMvA, pUrva iti chatriNo gacchantItinyAyenoktaM, tenApUrvo~api gandhaH kramAgataH pRuthivyAM j~jeyaH||28||

1.sanskrit: kharadravacaloShNatvaM bhUjalAnilatejasAm| AkAshasyApratIghAto dRuShTaM li~ggaM yathAkramam||29|| lakShaNaM sarvamevaitat sparshanendriyagocaram| sparshanendriyavij~jeyaH sparsho hi saviparyayaH||30||
1.commentary: bhUtAnAmasAdhAraNaM lakShaNamAha- kharetyAdi| apratIghAtaH apratihananamasparshatvamiti yAvat; sparshavaddhi gativighAtakaM bhavati nAkAshaH, asparshavattvAt| sarvamevaitaditi kharatvAdi| sparshanendriyagocaramiti sparshanendriyaj~jeyam| kathametat sarvaM sparshanendriyaj~jeyamityAha- sparshanetyAdi| saviparyaya iti sparshAbhAva ityarthaH| yadindriyaM yadgRuhNAti, tattasyAbhAvamapi gRuhNAti; tena, AkAshasyAsparshatvamapi sparshanendriyagrAhyamiti yuktam| dravatvaM calatvaM ca sA~gkhyamate sparshanagrAhyatvAt sthUlabhUtavAtadharmaH sparsha eva; yaddhi sparshanena gRuhyate, tat sarvaM mahAbhUtavAtapariNAma eva| etAni ca khAdIni sUkShmANi tanmAtrarUpANi j~jeyAni, sthUlabhUtAni tu khAdIni vikAratayA tatroktAni| prakRutivarge sUkShmarUpAstanmAtrA uktAH| vacanaM hi- “tanmAtrANyavisheShAstebhyo bhUtAni pa~jca pa~jcabhyaH| ete smRutA visheShAH shAntA ghorAshca mUDhAshca” (sAM.kA.38) iti; tenehApi khAdIni tanmAtrashabdoktAni sUkShmANi boddhavyAni||29-30||

1.sanskrit: guNAH sharIre guNinAM nirdiShTAshcihnameva ca|31|
1.commentary: bhUtAnAM sUkShmANAM sharIrasthAnAM li~ggAntarANyAha- guNA ityAdi| guNAH shabdAdayaH| guNinAmiti sUkShmarUpabhUtAnAm| evacagrahaNAt shabdAdayashca vyaktAH sUkShmANAM sharIrasthAnAM bhUtAnAM lakShaNaM bhavantIti vAkyArthaH|31|

1.sanskrit: arthAH shabdAdayo j~jeyA gocarA viShayA guNAH||31||
1.commentary: arthAnAha- arthA ityAdi| arthashabdena tu ye shabdAdayo~abhidhIyante te sthUlakhAdirUpA eva j~jeyAH; yenAkAshapariNAma eva shabdaH, vAtapariNAmaH sparsha ityAdi darshanam| shabdAdigrahaNenAtrAkAshAdigrahaNaM yat, tadAkAshAdipariNAmA eva shabdAdaya iti yuktameva| etena yacchrotragrAhyaM tat sarvamAkAshaM shabdashca, yat sparshena gRuhyate tat sarvaM vAyuH sparshashcetyAdi j~jeyam||31||

1.sanskrit: yA yadindriyamAshritya jantorbuddhiH pravartate| yAti sA tena nirdeshaM manasA ca manobhavA||32|| bhedAt kAryendriyArthAnAM bahvyo vai buddhayaH smRutAH| AtmendriyamanorthAnAmekaikA sannikarShajA||33|| a~ggulya~gguShThatalajastantrIvINAnakhodbhavaH| dRuShTaH shabdo yathA buddhirdRuShTA saMyogajA tathA||34||
1.commentary: samprati prakRutigaNapraviShTAyA buddherupadarshanArthaM tasyA buddhervRuttibhedAt j~jAnavisheSharUpANyAha- yetyAdi| yadindriyamAshrityeti yadindriyapraNAlikAmAshritya mahacchabdAkhyasya buddhitattvasya vRuttivisheSharUpANi j~jAnAnIndriyapraNAlikayA bhavanti, tadindriyajanyatvenaiva tAni vyapadishyante- cakShurbuddhiH, shrotrabuddhirityAdivyapadeshena | manobhavA ca buddhishcintyAdiviShayA manasA nirdishyate; manobuddhiriti vyapadishyata ityarthaH| indriyamanobhedena ShaTtvaM buddhInAM pratipAdya buddhibahutvaM prAha- bhedAdityAdi| kAryasya indriyArthasya ca bhedAt tatsambandhena bhidyamAnA bahvyo buddhayo bhavanti; kAryaM sukhaduHkhabhedAH; sukhaduHkhaprapa~jcena hi taktAryeNa kAraNaM j~jAnamapi bahu bhavati| idAnIM sarvabAhyaj~jAnasAdhanamAha- AtmetyAdi| AtmA avyaktam| ekaiketi pratyekam| buddheranekAtmAdimelakajanyatve dRuShTAntamAha - a~ggulItyAdi| anena dRuShTAntena shabdadvayamAha; a~ggulya~gguShThatalajashabda ekaH, ayaM cA~gguShThayantritamadhyamA~ggulyAH karatalasaMyogAjjAyamAnatalashabda ucyate; tantrIvINAnakhodbhavashca vINAshabda ekaH; anye tvekamevA~ggulyAdijaM vINAshabdaM varNayanti| etena, yathA shabdo~a~ggulAdyanyatamavaikalye~api na bhavati, tathA buddhirapyAtmAdInAmanyatamavaikalye~api na bhavatIti darshayati||32-34||

1.sanskrit: buddhIndriyamanorthAnAM vidyAdyogadharaM param| caturviMshatiko hyeSha rAshiH puruShasa~jj~jakaH||35||
1.commentary: atra ca buddhivRuttInAM j~jAnAnAM kathanenaivAha~gkAro~api sUcita eva; yato~aha~gkAropajIvitaivAtmAdisaMvaliteyaM buddhiH ‘ahaM pashyAmi’ ityAdirUpA bhavati; tena buddheraha~gkArasya coktatvAdavashiShTamavyakaM kAryadvArA brUte- buddhItyAdi| paramiti avyaktam| buddhyAdInAM yogaM melakaM dharatIti yogadharam; avyaktaM hi prakRutirUpaM puruShArthapravRuttaM buddhyAdimelakaM bhogasampAdakaM sRujati| evaM vyutpAditaM caturviMshatikamupasaMharati- caturviMshatika ityAdi| yadi vA karmendriyANyabhidhAya mahAbhUtAnItyAdinA arthA evAshrayabhUtakhAdikathanenocyante, yA yadindriyamAshrityetyAdinA tu sphuTopalabhyamAnA buddhivRuttibhedA ucyante, buddhyaha~gkAratanmAtrANyavyaktAni tu sUkShmANi noktAni, tAni sarvANyeva buddhIndriyamanorthAnAmityAdigranthe parashabdenocyante, tena yogadharaM paramityanena mUlaprakRutistathA prakRutivikRutayashca mahadAdayaH saptocyante; evaM caturviMshatiko rAshirbhavati| paratvaM ca vikArApekShayA prakRutInAmupapannameva||35||

1.sanskrit: rajastamobhyAM yuktasya saMyogo~ayamanantavAn| tAbhyAM nirAkRutAbhyAM tu sattvavRuddhyA nivartate||36||
1.commentary: sampratyevaMrUpapuruShasya sakAraNaM saMsaraNaM mokShahetuM cAha- raja ityAdi| saMyogo~ayamiti caturviMshatirAshirUpo melakaH| tAbhyAmiti rajastamobhyAm| sattvavRuddhyA kAraNabhUtayA rajastamonivRuttyA puruSharUpaH saMyogo nivartate mokSho bhavatItyarthaH| sattvaM vRuddhaM vishuddhaj~jAnajananAd rajastamasI saMsArakAraNe vijitya prakRutipuruShavivekaj~jAnAnmokShamAvahati||36||

1.sanskrit: atra karma phalaM cAtra j~jAnaM cAtra pratiShThitam| atra mohaH sukhaM duHkhaM jIvitaM maraNaM svatA||37|| evaM yo veda tattvena sa veda pralayodayau| pAramparyaM cikitsAM ca j~jAtavyaM yacca ki~jcana||38||
1.commentary: punashcaturviMshatike puruShe karmaphalAdi darshayan doShahIne puruShe karmaphalAdyabhAvamarthoddarshayati- atretyAdi| phalamatreti yathoktasamudAyapuruShe| karmeti adRuShTam| phalamiti adRuShTaphalam| svatA mamatA| j~jAnaM ca yadyapi caturviMshatitattvAtiriktasyodAsInasyaiva, tathA~api taccetanayA prakRutirapi cetanAmApadya cetanaiva bhavatIti yuktam ‘atra j~jAnam’ iti| vacanaM hi- “tasmAttatsaMyogAdacetanaM cetanAvadiva li~ggam ” (sAM. kA. 20) iti| pralayodayAviti jIvitamaraNe| pAramparyamiti sharIraparamparAm| cikitsAM ceti naiShThikI AtyantikaduHkhacikitsA mokShasAdhanA j~jAtavyA| yacca ki~jcanetyanenAnuktamapi kRutsnaM j~jeyamavaruNaddhi||37-38||

1.sanskrit: bhAstamaH satyamanRutaM vedAH karma shubhAshubham| na syuH kartA ca boddhA ca puruSho na bhavedyadi||39|| nAshrayo na sukhaM nArtirna gatirnAgatirna vAk| na vij~jAnaM na shAstrANi na janma maraNaM na ca||40|| na bandho na ca mokShaH syAt puruSho na bhavedyadi| kAraNaM puruShastasmAt kAraNaj~jairudAhRutaH||41|| na cet kAraNamAtmA syAdbhAdayaH syurahetukAH| na caiShu sambhavej j~jAnaM na ca taiH syAt prayojanam||42||
1.commentary: puruShaH kAraNaM kasmAditi prashnasyottaraM- bhAstama ityAdi| bhAH pratibhA| tamaH mohaH| puruSha iha prakaraNe AtmA~abhipretaH| AshrayaH sharIram| gatishca prayojanAnusandhAnAdbhavati , evamAgatirapi| kAraNaM puruShastasmAditi bhAstamaHsatyAdau kAraNaM puruSha ityarthaH| etadeva bhAAdikAraNatvamAtmana Aha- na cedityAdi| evaM manyate- bhAstamasI dharmAdharmajanye, dharmAdharmau cAsatyAtmani nirAshrayau na bhavitumarhataH; tathA satyaM dharmajanakatayA upAdeyam, anRutaM cAdharmajanakatayA~anupAdeyam, etaccAtmani sthire~asati dharmAdharmajanakatvaM nAsti, tatashca satyAsatyabhedo~apyaki~jcitkaratvAnnAsti; evaM shubhAshubhakarmaNyapi vAcyaM; tathA kartA ca kAraNapratisandhAtA na bhavati, pratisandhAturAtmano~abhAvAdityarthaH; tathA boddhA ca pUrvAparAvasthApratisandhAtaiva bhavati; sharIraM cAtmano bhogAyatanaM nAtmAnaM vinA bhavati; evaM sukhAdAvapyAtmanaH kAraNatvamunneyam; vij~jAnaM shAstrArthaj~jAnaM, shAstrANi pratisandhAtrA~a~atmanaiva kRutAni| na caiShu sambhavejj~jAnamiti AtmAnaM j~jAtAraM vinA na bhAdiShu j~jAnaM sambhavet, j~jAturAtmano~abhAvAdityarthaH| na ca taiH syAt prayojanamiti bhAdInAmAtmArthatvenAsatyAtmani bhAdyutpatteH prayojanaM na syAt, prayojanAbhAvAccotpAdo na syAt; sarveShAmeva hi bhAvAnAmAtmasthau dharmAdharmau puruShabhogArthamutpAdakau, asati bhoktari bhojyenApi na bhavitavyaM kAraNAbhAvAt||39-42||

1.sanskrit: kRutaM mRuddaNDacakraishca kumbhakArAdRute ghaTam| kRutaM mRuttRuNakAShThaishca gRuhakArAdvinA gRuham||43|| yo vadet sa vadeddehaM sambhUya karaNaiH kRutam| vinA kartAramaj~jAnAdyuktyAgamabahiShkRutaH||44||
1.commentary: AtmAnaM vinA sharIrAnutpAde dRuShTAntadvayaM prameyagauravAdAha- kRutaM mRuddaNDetyAdi| sambhUya karaNaiH kRutamityAtmanirapekShairbhUtaiH kRutamityarthaH| yuktyA anumAnarUpayA Agamena ca rahito yuktyAgamabahiShkRutaH; pratyakShaM cAtra noktaM, tasyAtmAnaM prati prAyo~ayogyatvAt||43-44||

1.sanskrit: kAraNaM puruShaH sarvaiH pramANairupalabhyate| yebhyaH prameyaM sarvebhya AgamebhyaH pramIyate||45||
1.commentary: sarvaiH pramANairiti pratyakShAdibhiH| yebhya iti karaNa evApAdAnavivakShayA pa~jcamI| Agamayanti bodhayantIti AgamAH pramANAnyeva; anye tvAgamapramANAbhyAM shAstrANyeva bruvate||45||

1.sanskrit: na te tatsadRushAstvanye pAramparyasamutthitAH| sArUpyAdye ta eveti nirdishyante navA navAH||46|| bhAvAsteShAM samudayo nirIshaH sattvasa~jj~jakaH| kartA bhoktA na sa pumAniti kecidvyavasthitAH||47||
1.commentary: nirAtmavAdimatamutthApayati- na te ityAdi| asmi~j sharIre te ka eva pRuthivIjalAdayo bhAvAH, ye ta eveti vyapadishyante; te na bhavanti pUrvAnubhUtA nAnubhavantItyarthaH| yadi te na bhavanti, kathaM tarhi ‘te’ ityabhij~jAnamityAha- tatsadRushAstvanye pUrvasadRushA ityarthaH| pAramparyasamutthitA iti sadRushasantAnavyavasthitAH| sArUpyAditi sadRusharUpatvAt| teShAM samudaya iti kShaNabha~gginAM melaka ityarthaH| nirIsha iti sthAyyAtmarahitaH| sattvasa~jj~jaka iti prANisa~jj~jakaH| keciditi bauddhAH| bauddhA hi nirAtmakaM kShaNikaj~jAnAdisamudAyamAtraM sharIramicchanti; pratisandhAnaM ca kShaNikAnAmapi j~jAnAdInAM kAryakAraNabhAvAdekaphalasantatAvicchanti||46-47||

1.sanskrit: teShAmanyaiH kRutasyAnye bhAvA bhAvairnavAH phalam| bhu~jjate sadRushAH prAptaM yairAtmA nopadishyate||48||
1.commentary: etaddUShayati- teShAmityAdi| teShAM j~jAnasantAnavAdinAm, anyena kRutasyaudanapAkAdeH phalamannAdi anye bhu~jjata iti prApnoti| etaccAsa~ggataM, yataH phalaM bhokShyAmIti kRutvA bhAviphalapratyAshayA pravRuttiryuktA, na tvanyasya bhogyatAM phalasya pashyan kashcit pravartate; yo~api sUpakArAdiH parArthaM pravartate, so~api parArthena svArthaM sAdhayitukAma eveti bhAvaH||48||

1.sanskrit: karaNAnyAnyatA dRuShTA kartuH kartA sa eva tu| kartA hi karaNairyuktaH kAraNaM sarvakarmaNAm||49||
1.commentary: paramataM dUShayitvA svamatamAha- karaNetyAdi| karaNasya sharIrasya pariNAmino~anyAnyatA dRuShTA| kartA cAtmA, sa eva na vinAshItyarthaH| atraiva dRuShTAntamAha- kartA hItyAdi| yathA~anekashilpavit kartA karaNairvAMshIsandaMshayantrAdibhiH kAShThapATanalauhaghaTanAdi karoti, tathA~a~atmA~apItyarthaH||49||

1.sanskrit: nimeShakAlAdbhAvAnAM kAlaH shIghrataro~atyaye| bhagnAnAM na punarbhAvaH kRutaM nAnyamupaiti ca||50|| mataM tattvavidAmetadyasmAttasmAt sa kAraNam| kriyopabhoge bhUtAnAM nityaH puruShasa~jj~jakaH||51||
1.commentary: athAyamAtmasadbhAvaH sthiro~astu, sharIrArambhakANAM bhUtAnAM kA vA gatirityAha- nimeShetyAdi| bhAvAnAmiti sharIrAdibhAvAnAm| atyaya iti vinAshe; sharIrasya svAgnipacyamAnasya nimeShakAlAdapi shIghraM vinAsho bhavatItyarthaH| amIShAM ca bhAvAnAM bhagnAnAM na punarbhAvaH punarAgamanaM nAstItyarthaH| tena, yena sharIreNa yat kRutaM taccharIraM tatphalaM na prApnotItyuktaM bhavati| atha mA bhavatvevaM tataH kimityAha- kRutamityAdi|- kRutaM karma yAgAdi na phalarUpatayA~anyamupaiti, evaM sati devadattakRutena shubhakarmaNA yaj~jadattAdayo~api sukhabhAjaH syuH; tasmAt kShaNabha~ggisharIrAdatiriktaH karmakartA tatphalabhoktA cAstIti bhAvaH| kriyopabhoga iti kriyAyAM tatphalabhoge ca| bhUtAnAmiti prANinAm||50-51||

1.sanskrit: aha~gkAraH phalaM karma dehAntaragatiH smRutiH| vidyate sati bhUtAnAM kAraNe dehamantarA||52||
1.commentary: AtmasadbhAve hetvantaramAha- aha~gkAra ityAdi| ete~aha~gkAradayaH sthira eva paramAtmani bhavanti, pUrvAparakAlAvasthAyivastudharmatvAditi bhAvaH| dehamantareti dehaM vinA; dehAtirikte kAraNe satyaha~gkAro bhavatItyarthaH||52||

1.sanskrit: prabhavo na hyanAditvAdvidyate paramAtmanaH| puruSho rAshisa~jj~jastu mohecchAdveShakarmajaH||53||
1.commentary: ‘prabhavaH puruShasya kaH’ ityasyottaraM- prabhava ityAdi| prabhavaH kAraNam| rAshisa~jj~ja iti ShaDdhAtusamudAyarUpashcaturviMshatirAshirUpo vA| mohecchAdveShajanitakarmajo mohecchAdveShakarmajaH| mohAddhi bhAveShu icchA dveShashca bhavati, tataH pravRuttiH, pravRutterdharmAdharmau, tau ca sharIraM janayato bhogArtham||53||

1.sanskrit: AtmA j~jaH karaNairyogAj j~jAnaM tvasya pravartate| karaNAnAmavaimalyAdayogAdvA na vartate||54|| pashyato~api yathA~a~adarshe sa~gkliShTe nAsti darshanam| tattvaM jale vA kaluShe cetasyupahate tathA||55||
1.commentary: ‘kimaj~jo j~jaH’ ityasyottaram- AtmetyAdi| karaNAnIha manobuddhIndriyANi| na vartate j~jAnamiti yojanA| nanu yadyayamAtmA j~jaH , tat kimityasya sarvadA j~jAnaM na bhavatItyAha- pashyato~apItyAdi| pashyato~apIti cakShuShmato~apItyarthaH| tattvamiti darshanavisheShaNam| tena, mlAne darpaNe jale vA darshanaM bhavadapyayathArthagrAhitayA na tattvarUpaM bhavatItyarthaH| cetasItyupalakShaNaM, tena cakShurAdAvapyupahata iti j~jeyam||54-55||

1.sanskrit: karaNAni mano buddhirbuddhikarmendriyANi ca| kartuH saMyogajaM karma vedanA buddhireva ca||56|| naikaH pravartate kartuM bhUtAtmA nAshnute phalam| saMyogAdvartate sarvaM tamRute nAsti ki~jcana||57||
1.commentary: karaNaprastAvAj j~jAne karmaNi vedanAyAM ca yAvat karaNamAtmanastadAha- karaNAnItyAdi| saMyogajamiti karmaNA vedanayA buddhyA ca yojyam| nAshnute phalameka iti yojyam| eka iti niShkaraNaH| saMyogAdvartata iti karaNasamudAyAdutpadyate | tamRuta iti saMyogaM vinA||56-57||

1.sanskrit: na hyeko vartate bhAvo vartate nApyahetukaH| shIghragatvAtsvabhAvAttvabhAvo na vyativartate||58||
1.commentary: atraiva sAmagrIjanyatve sarvakAryANAmupapattimAha- na hyeka ityAdi| eko bhAvaH kAraNarUpaH sahakArikAraNAntararahito na kAryakaraNe vartata ityarthaH; evaM tAvadekaM kAraNaM kArye na vartate, kAryaM ca hetuM vinA na bhavatItyAha- vartate nApyahetuka iti; hetuM vinA bhAva utpattidharmA na vartate na bhavatItyarthaH| tena karaNayuktAtmajanyaM kAryaM na kevalAdAtmano heturUpAdbhavatItyuktaM bhavati| atha hetuM vinA cedbhAvo na bhavati, tat kimabhAve~api shArIrANAM bhAvAnAM hetvapekShA na vetyAha- shIghragatvAdityAdi| shIghragatvAt svabhAvAllakShito~abhAvo na svabhAvaM vyativartate shIghragatvasvabhAvaM na tyajatItyarthaH| tena, ahetuka evAbhAvo bhavati, bhAvastu sahetukaH| uktaM hi “utpattiheturbhAvanAM na nirodhe~asti kAraNam” (sU.a.16) iti| kiMvA, shIghragatvAdasthiratvAdabhAvo nAvasthAntaramAtmanAshaM prati gacchatIti granthArthaH||58||

1.sanskrit: anAdiH puruSho nityo viparItastu hetujaH| sadakAraNavannityaM dRuShTaM hetujamanyathA||59||
1.commentary: ‘sa nityaH kimanityaH’ ityasyottaram- anAdirityAdi| anAdishca puruSho~avyaktarUpa AtmashabdAbhidheyaH| viparIta iti AdimAn rAshirUpaH puruSha ityarthaH| atraivAnAdernityatve shAstrAntarasammatimapyAha- sadityAdi| saditi trividhasamaye pramANagamyabhAvarUpam | etena, prAgabhAvasyAkAraNavato~apyabhAvarUpatayA~anityatvaM na vyabhicArakam| hetujamanyatheti atrApi bhAvarUpamiti yojanIyam| tena, hetujanyasyApi pradhvaMsasyAvinAshitvaM parihRutaM bhavati||59||

1.sanskrit: tadeva bhAvAdagrAhyaM nityatva na kutashcana| bhAvAjj~jeyaM tadavyaktamacintyaM vyaktamanyathA||60|| avyaktamAtmA kShetraj~jaH shAshvato vibhuravyayaH| tasmAdyadanyattadvyaktaM, vakShyate cAparaM dvayam||61|| vyaktamaindriyakaM caiva gRuhyate tadyadindriyaiH| ato~anyat punaravyaktaM li~ggagrAhyamatIndriyam||62||
1.commentary: kiM tannityatvamityAha- tadevetyAdi| bhAvAdutpattidharmakAt| tannityatvaM na kuto~api bhAvAdbhavati, nityaM hi na kuto~api bhavati| tatashcAtmA bhAvaM prati nirapekShatvAt sarvebhyo bhAvebhyo~apyagre nityaM sadeva| taccaivambhUtaM nityamavyaktaM j~jeyam| acintyamityavyaktavisheShaNam| avyaktaM ca mUlaprakRutiH| vyaktamanyatheti prakRuteranyatamakAryaM mahadAdikamanityam; AkAshamapi vikArarUpatayA~anityameva; udAsInapuruShastu nitya evAvyaktashabdenaiva lakShita ityuktameva| avyaktadharmAntaravyApakAn paryAyAnAha- avyaktamityAdi| punaH prakArAntareNa vyaktAvyaktArthamAha - vakShyata ityAdi| aparaM dvayamiti prakArAntarakRutaM vyaktAvyaktadvayam| li~ggagrAhyamiti anumAnagrahyam| atIndriyamityanena cendriyagrahaNAyogyaM yat kenApi shabdAdili~ggena gRuhyate na tadavyaktaM, kintu yannityAnumeyaM mano~aha~gkArAdi tadevAvyaktam||60-62||

1.sanskrit: khAdIni buddhiravyaktamaha~gkArastathA~aShTamaH| bhUtaprakRutiruddiShTA vikArAshcaiva ShoDasha||63|| buddhIndriyANi pa~jcaiva pa~jca karmendriyANi ca| samanaskAshca pa~jcArthA vikArA iti sa~jj~jitAH||64||
1.commentary: ‘prakRutiH kA vikArAH ke’ ityasyottaraM- khAdInItyAdi| khAdIni sUkShmabhUtakhAdIni tanmAtrashabdAbhidheyAni| buddhiH mahacchabdAbhidheyA| avyaktaM mUlaprakRutiH| aha~gkAraH buddhivikAraH; sa ca trividhaH- bhUtAdiH, taijasaH, vaikArikashca| bhUtAnAM sthAvaraja~ggamAnAM prakRutirbhUtaprakRutiH| atra cAvyaktaM prakRutireva paraM, buddhyAdayastu svakAraNavikRutirUpA api svakAryApekShayA prakRutirUpA iha prakRutitvenoktAH| yaduktaM- “mUlaprakRutiravikRutirmahadAdyAH prakRutivikRutayaH sapta” (sAM.kA.3) iti| vikArA nAha- vikArA ityAdi| evashabdo bhinnakrame~avadhAraNe, tena vikArA eva ShoDasha paraM na prakRutayaH| buddherindriyANi buddhIndriyANi| pa~jcArthA iti sthUlA AkAshAdayaH shabdAdirUpAH; guNaguNinorhi paramArthato bhedo nAstyevAsmin darshane||63-64||

1.sanskrit: iti kShetraM samuddiShTaM sarvamavyaktavarjitam| avyaktamasya kShetrasya kShetraj~jamRuShayo viduH||65||
1.commentary: enameva prakRutivikArasamUhaM kShetrakShetraj~jabhedena vibhajate- itItyAdi| avyaktavarjitamiti prakRutyudAsInavarjitaM, prakRuteshcodAsInapuruShacaitanyena caitanyamastyeva||65||

1.sanskrit: jAyate buddhiravyaktAdbuddhyA~ahamiti manyate| paraM khAdInyaha~gkArAdutpadyante yathAkramam||66|| tataH sampUrNasarvA~ggo jAto~abhyudita ucyate|67|
1.commentary: samprati mahApralayAntaraM yathA~a~adisarge buddhyAdyutpAdo bhavati tadAha- jAyata ityAdi| buddhyA~ahamiti manyata iti buddherjAtenAha~gkAreNAhamiti manyata ityarthaH| khAdInIti khAdIni sUkShmANi tanmAtrarUpANi, tathaikAdashendriyANi| vacanaM hi “prakRutermahAMstato~aha~gkArastasmAdgaNashca ShoDashakaH” (sAM.kA.22) iti| yathAkramamiti yasmAdaha~gkArAdutpadyate tena krameNa; tatra vaikRutAt sAttvikAdaha~gkArAttaijasasahAyAdekAdashendriyANi bhavanti, bhUtAdestvaha~gkArAttAmasAttaijasasahAyAt pa~jcatanmAtrANi| yaduktaM- “sAtvika ekAdashakaH pravartate vaikRutAdaha~gkArAt| bhUtAdestanmAtraH sa tAmasastaijasAdubhayam” (sAM.kA.25) iti| tata iti Aha~gkArikakAryAnantaraM tanmAtrebhya utpannasthUlabhUtasambandhAt| sampUrNasarvA~ggo jAta iti Adisargo(rge) jAtaH||66||

1.sanskrit: puruShaH pralaye ceShTaiH punarbhAvairviyujyate||67|| avyaktAdvyaktatAM yAti vyaktAdavyaktatAM punaH| rajastamobhyAmAviShTashcakravat parivartate||68|| yeShAM dvandve parA saktiraha~gkAraparAshca ye| udayapralayau teShAM na teShAM ye tvato~anyathA||69||
1.commentary: evamAdisarge prakRutermahadAdisargaM darshayitvA mahApralaye prakRutAvavyaktarUpAyAM buddhyAdInAM layamAha- puruSha ityAdi| iShTairbhAvairiti puruShopabhogArthamiShTairbuddhyAdibhiH| anye tu evambhUtasa~ggaM janmani , buddhyAdiviyogaM ca maraNe bruvate| tanna, janmamaraNayorbuddhyAdInAM vidyamAnatvAt| uktaM hi- “atIndriyaistairatisUkShmarUpairAtmA kadAcinna vimuktapUrvaH| naivendriyairnaiva manomatibhyAM na cApyaha~gkAravikAradoShaiH” (shA. a. 2) iti| tathA~anyatrApyuktaM- “pUrvotpannamasaktaM niyataM mahadAdisUkShmaparyantam| saMsarati nirupabhogaM bhAvairadhivAsitaM li~ggam” (sAM. kA. 40) iti| tasmAnmahApralaya eva prakRutau layaH, tathA~a~adisarga eva prakRutermahadAdisRuShTiriti| etadeva prapa~jcaM layaM ca prakRuterAha- avyaktAdityAdi| avyaktAditi prakRuteH, vyaktatAmiti mahadAdimahAbhUtaparyantaprapa~jcarUpatAM yAti| vyaktAditi mahAbhUtaprapa~jcAdyavasthAtaH punaravyaktarUpatAM yAti gacchati; mahApralaye hi mahAbhUtAni tanmAtreShu layaM yAnti, tanmAtrANi tathendriyANi cAha~gkAre layaM yAnti, aha~gkAro buddhau, buddhishca prakRutAviti layakramaH| ayaM ca layakramo mokShe~api bhavati| paraM tu tatra taM puruShaM prati punaH sargaM nArabhate prakRutiH| ayaM saMsAraH kuto bhavatItyAha- raja ityAdi| AviShTo yuktaH| cakravat parivartata iti punaH punarlayasargAbhyAM yujyate| dvandva iti rajastamorUpe mithune| aha~gkAraparA iti aha~gkArAnmamedamityAdimithyAj~jAnaparAH| udayapralayau janmamaraNe, kiMvA layasargau| ato~anyatheti ye rAgadveShavimuktA niraha~gkArAshca teShAM nodayapralayau bhavataH||67-69||

1.sanskrit: prANApAnau nimeShAdyA jIvanaM manaso gatiH| indriyAntarasa~jcAraH preraNaM dhAraNaM ca yat||70|| deshAntaragatiH svapne pa~jcatvagrahaNaM tathA| dRuShTasya dakShiNenAkShNA savyenAvagamastathA||71|| icchA dveShaH sukhaM duHkhaM prayatnashcetanA dhRutiH| buddhiH smRutiraha~gkAro li~ggAni paramAtmanaH||72|| yasmAt samupalabhyante li~ggAnyetAni jIvataH| na mRutasyAtmali~ggAni tasmAdAhurmaharShayaH||73|| sharIraM hi gate tasmi~j shUnyAgAramacetanam| pa~jcabhUtAvasheShatvAt pa~jcatvaM gatamucyate||74||
1.commentary: ‘kiM li~ggaM puruShasya ca’ ityasyottaraM- prANApAnAvityAdi| prANApAnau ucchvAsaniHshvAsau| nimeShAdyA iti AdyashabdagrahaNena unmeShAdyAH prekShaNavisheShA gRuhyante| manaso gatiriti manasA pATaliputragamanAdirUpA| indriyAntarasa~jcAro~api manasa eva, yathA cakShuH parityajya manaH sparshanamadhitiShThatItyAdi| preraNaM ca tathA dhAraNaM ca manasa eveti j~jeyam| deshAntaragatiH svapne iti chedaH| pa~jcatvagrahaNaM maraNaj~jAnam| savyenAvagama iti savyenAkShNA sa evAyaM dakShiNAkShidRuShTo ghaTa ityavagama ityarthaH| cetanA j~jAnamAtram| buddhistu UhApohaj~jAnam| atha kathametAnyAtmAnaM gamayantItyAha- yasmAdityAdi| jIvata iti pa~jcabhUtAtiriktAtmasaMyuktasya | pa~jcatvaM tu yadyapi jIvato na bhavati kintu mRutasyaiva, tathA~api pa~jcatvaM mRutasharIre dRushyamAnaM viparyayAt pa~jcatvAbhAvAjjIvaccharIrali~ggaM bhavatIti j~jeyam| atraivodAhRutAshca prANApAnAdayo na bhUtamAtre bhavanti, nirAtmakeShviShTakAmRutasharIrAdiShvadarshanAt| na ca mana eva bhUtAtiriktamAtmA bhavitumarhati, yatastasyApi karaNarUpasya preraNAdyAtmanA kartrA kartavyam| nApIndriyANyAtmatvena svIkartuM pAryante, yatastathA sati indriyAntaropalabdhamarthaM nendriyANi yaj~jadattopalabdhamarthaM devadatta iva pratisandhAtuM samarthAni bhaveyuH; asti cendriyAntaropalabdhArthapratisandhAnaM, yathA- surabhicandanaM spRushAmItyatra| tasmAnmana-indriya-bhUtAtirikta AtmA tiShThatIti j~jeyam| atra yadyapi buddhishabdena cetanAdhRutismRutyaha~gkArAH prApyanta eva buddhiprakAratvena, tathA~api pRuthakpRuthagarthagamakatvena punaH pRuthagupAttAH| tathAhi- cetanA guNatvena acetanakhAdibhUtAtiriktadharmeNAtmAnaM gamayati, dhRutistu niyamAtmikA niyantAramAtmAnaM gamayati, buddhistu UhApohayorekaM kAraNaM gamayatyAtmAnaM, smRutistu pUrvAnubhUtArthasmartAraM sthAyinamAtmAnaM gamayatItyAdyanusaraNIyam| AtmAdhiShThAnAbhAve sharIre prANAdyabhAvamAha- sharIramityAdi| shUnyAgAramiva shUnyAgAraM yathA adhiShThAtRushUnyam, evaM mRutasharIramapi| ShaDdhAtukaM sharIraM, tatra ShaShThe Atmani gate pa~jcabhUtAtmakaM sharIraM bhavati, tena pa~jcatvaM gatamucyate|||70-74||

1.sanskrit: acetanaM kriyAvacca manashcetayitA paraH| yuktasya manasA tasya nirdishyante vibhoH kriyAH||75|| cetanAvAn yatashcAtmA tataH kartA nirucyate| acetanatvAcca manaH kriyAvadapi nocyate||76||
1.commentary: ‘niShkriyasya kriyA tasya katham’ ityasyottaram- acetanamityAdi| cetayitA para iti para AtmA cetayitA paraM na tu sAkShAt kriyAvAn| nanu, yadyevaM kathaM tasya kriyetyAha- yuktasyetyAdi| AtmAdhiShThitasyaiva manasaH kriyA upacArAdAtmanaH kriyetyucyata ityarthaH| etadevopapAdayati- cetanAvAnityAdi| cetanena hyAtmanA~adhiShThitaM manaH kriyAsu pravartate, cetanAnadhiShThitaM tu manaH kriyAsu na pravartate; tena yatkRutA sA kriyA sa eva kriyAvAniti vyapadeShTuM yujyate, natvacetanaM manaH; tat parAdhInakriyatvena paramArthataH kriyAvadapi kartRutvena nocyata iti vAkyArthaH; nocyate iti ‘kartRu’ iti sheShaH||75-76||

1.sanskrit: yathAsvenAtmanA~a~atmAnaM sarvaH sarvAsu yoniShu| prANaistantrayate prANI nahyanyo~astyasya tantrakaH||77||
1.commentary: samprati svatantratve~apyaniShTayonigamanamAkShiptaM samAdadhAti- yathAsvenetyAdi| sarvAsu naragohastikITAdiyoniShu| prANaistantrayate prANairyojayati, AtmanaivAyaM dharmAdharmasahAyenAtmAnaM sarvayoniShu nayati, na paraprerito yAti; yato nAnyaH puruSho~asya prerako~asti IshvarAbhAvAt; kiMvA satyapi Ishvare tasyApi karmaparAdhInatvAt| idameva cAsyAniShTayonigamane svAtantryaM yad aniShTayonigamanahetvadharmakaraNe svAtantryam, adharmakaraNArabdhasvakarmaNaivAyamanicchannapi nIyata ityaniShTayonigamanaM bhavati; svAtantryaM ca yathoktaM bhavati||77||

1.sanskrit: vashI tat kurute karma yat kRutvA phalamashnute| vashI cetaH samAdhatte vashI sarvaM nirasyati||78||
1.commentary: ‘vashI yadyasukhaiH kasmAdbhAvairAkramyate’ ityasyottaraM- vashItyAdi| vashI svecchAdhInapravRuttiH (iShTe~aniShTe vA~a~atmA ,); tena, vashI sannayaM tAni karmANi karoti shubhAnyashubhAni vA ApAtaphalarAgAt, yAni kRutvA tatkarmaprabhAvAcchubhenAshubhena vA phalena yogamApnoti| etena kartavye karmaNyasya vashitvaM, kRutakarmaphalaM tvasyAnicchato~api bhavati; tena tatprati nAsya vashitvam| anyadapi vashitvaphalamAha- vashI cetaH samAdhatta iti| aniShTe~arthe vashI sannayaM mano nivartayati; yadi hyayaM vashI na syAt, na mano nivartayituM shaknuyAt| aparamapi vashitvagamakaM karmAha- vashI sarvaM nirasyatIti| vashI sannayaM mokShArthaM pravRuttaH sarvArambhaM shubhAshubhaphalaM tyajatItyarthaH| iha svatantraH parAtmanA IshvarAdinA preritapravRuttirucyate; vashI tu svayamapi pravartamAna icchAvashAt pravartate, na preritapravRuttirUpatvenepsite~anIpsite ca vartate iti svAtantryavashitvayorbhedaH||78||

1.sanskrit: dehI sarvagato~apyAtmA sve sve saMsparshanendriye| sarvAH sarvAshrayasthAstu nAtmA~ato vetti vedanAH||79||
1.commentary: ‘sarvAH sarvagatatvAcca vedanAH kiM na vetti saH’ ityasyottaramAha- dehItyAdi| sarvagata iti sarvagato~api san, saMsparshanendriya iti saMsparshanayukte sharIre, vedanAH sukhaduHkharUpA vetti, sarvAshrayasthAstu na vettIti yojanA| yasmAt sarvagato~apyAtmA svakIya eva sparshanavati sharIre paraM vedanA vetti, tena sarvAshrayasthAH sarvavedanA na vettIti vAkyArthaH| sarvAshrayasthA iti sarvaparasharIragatAH | parasharIre cAtmA khakarmopArjitendriyAbhAvAdvidyamAno~api nopalabhate sukhaduHkhe| sve sve sharIra iti vaktavye yat ‘saMsparshanendriye’ iti karoti, tena svasharIre~api yatra keshanakhAdau sparshanendriyaM nAsti tatra nAtmA ki~jcidupalabhata iti darshayati||79||

1.sanskrit: vibhutvamata evAsya yasmAt sarvagato mahAn| manasashca samAdhAnAt pashyatyAtmA tiraskRutam||80|| nityAnubandhaM manasA dehakarmAnupAtinA| sarvayonigataM vidyAdekayonAvapi sthitam||81||
1.commentary: ‘na pashyati vibhuH kasmAt’ ityAdiprashnasyottaraM vaktuM pravRutto vibhutvasAdhakArthaguNahetuprAptyA vibhutvameva tAvadAtmanaH sAdhayati- vibhutvamityAdi| vibhutvaM sarvagataparimANayogitvam| ata eveti uktasarvagatatvAt| etadeva spaShTArthaM sAkShAdbrUte- yasmAdityAdi| sarvagatatvaM sarvato~apyupalabhyamAnatvena sarvagatAkAshAdiparimANasyapyasti, tena tadvyavacchedArthaM ‘mahAn’ iti padaM; tena sarvatropalabhyamAnaM mahAparimANayogidravyaM vibhurucyata iti phalati| vibhutvaM vyutpAdya kuDyAditirohitaj~jAnaM naikAntena bhavatIti darshayannAha- manasa ityAdi| samAdhAnaM samAdhiH| anena, yoginaH samAdhibalAttirohitamapi pashyantIti darshayati| ye tu tirohitaM na pashyanti tatrApyupapattimAha- nityetyAdi| sarvayonigatamapyAtmAnaM manasA~anubandhagatamekayonAvavasthitaM vidyAditi yojyam| dehanirvartakena karmaNA anupAta Atmani sambandho yasya, tena manasA dehakarmAnupAtinA| etena, yadyapyAtmA kuDyAdibhiratirohitastathA~api yadasyopalabdhisAdhanaM manastasyaikasminneva sharIre vyavasthitasya vyavadhAnAnna pashyatyayaM tiraskRutamityuktaM bhavati||80-81||

1.sanskrit: AdirnAstyAtmanaH kShetrapAramparyamanAdikam| atastayoranAditvAt kiM pUrvamiti nocyate||82||
1.commentary: ‘kShetraj~jaH kShetramathavA’ ityAdiprashnasyottaram- AdirityAdi| kShetrapAramparyamiti kShetrasyAvyaktavarjitasya mahadAditrayoviMshatikasya paramparAsantateranAditvenaiva kShetrakShetraj~jayoridaM prathamamiti vyapadesho naiva bhavatItyarthaH| nanu yadi kShetraparamparA~apyanAdistadA tasyAtmavaducchedo na prApnoti, yadanAdi tannityaM bhavati, yathA- Atmeti dRuShTaM? brUmaH- anAditve~api yat svarUpenaivAnAdi tannocchidyate, yathA- AtmA; yattu ucchittidharmakaM buddhyAdi, taducchidyata eva; santAnastu paramArthataH santAnibhyo~atirikto nAstyeva, yadanAdiH syAt; tena, santAnasyAnAditvaM bhAktameva| ki~jcaivambhUtasya buddhyAdisantAnasyocchede mokShapratipAdaka Agama eva pramANatvena j~jeyaH||82||

1.sanskrit: j~jaH sAkShItyucyate nAj~jaH sAkShI tvAtmA yataH smRutaH| sarve bhAvA hi sarveShAM bhUtAnAmAtmasAkShikAH||83||
1.commentary: ‘sAkShibhUtashca kasyAyam’ ityasyottaraM- j~ja ityAdi| j~jo j~jAnavAn sAkShIti loke kathyate, natvaj~jaH pAShANAdiH| tena, j~jatvenAsatyapyanyasmin kartari sAkShItyucyate iti vAkyArthaH| sarveShAmiti khAdibhUtAnAm| sarve bhAvA iti sarve bhUtadharmA darshanayogyAH| AtmasAkShikA iti AtmopalabhyamAnAH||83||

1.sanskrit: naikaH kadAcidbhUtAtmA lakShaNairupalabhyate| visheSho~anupalabhyasya tasya naikasya vidyate||84|| saMyogapuruShasyeShTo visheSho vedanAkRutaH| vedanA yatra niyatA visheShastatra tatkRutaH||85||
1.commentary: ‘syAt kathaM cAvikArasya’ ityAdiprashnasyottaraM- naika ityAdi| avikArasya paramAtmano vedanAkRuto visheSho nAstyeva , yatra tu vedanAkRuto visheShaH sa rAshirUpaH paramAtmavyatirikta eveti vAkyArthaH| bhUtAnAmadhiShThAtA AtmA bhUtAtmA, ayaM bhUtAtmA eko bhUtavyatirikto na lakShaNaiH prANApAnAdibhiruktairupalabhyate| kuto nopalabhyata ityAha- visheSha ityAdi| ekasya bhUtarahitasya; yadAtmano visheSho vedanAdirnopalabhyata eva, tenAnupalabdhirevAtra pramANamityarthaH| saMyogapuruShaH caturviMshatikaH| nanvevamapi caturviMshatyantarniviShTasya bhUtAtmano~api vedanAkRutavisheSheNa bhavitavyaM, yataH samudAyadharmaH samudAyinAmeva bhavati, yathA- mASharAshergurutvaM pratyekaM mAShANAmeva gauraveNa bhavatItyAha- vedanetyAdi| vedanA sukhaduHkharUpA| yatra buddhyAdisamUhe niyatA vyavasthitA vedanA, tatraiva tatkRuto dainyaharShAdivisheSho~api niyataH; tatraiva buddhyAdirAshau vartate nAtmanIti bhAvaH| buddhyAdigatena guNatrayapariNAmarUpeNa sukhaduHkhAdinA asukhaduHkha evAtmA tatsambandhAt sukhaduHkhAdimAn bhavati||84-85||

1.sanskrit: cikitsati bhiShak sarvAstrikAlA vedanA iti| yayA yuktyA vadantyeke sA yuktirupadhAryatAm||86|| punastacchirasaH shUlaM jvaraH sa punarAgataH| punaH sa kAso balavAMshchardiH sA punarAgatA||87|| ebhiH prasiddhavacanairatItAgamanaM matam| kAlashcAyamatItAnAmartInAM punarAgataH||88|| tamartikAlamuddishya bheShajaM yat prayujyate| atItAnAM prashamanaM vedanAnAM taducyate||89|| ApastAH punarAgurmA yAbhiH shasyaM purA hatam| yathA prakriyate setuH pratikarma tathA~a~ashraye||90|| pUrvarUpaM vikArANAM dRuShTvA prAdurbhaviShyatAm| yA kriyA kriyate sA ca vedanAM hantyanAgatAm||91|| pAramparyAnabandhastu duHkhAnAM vinivartate| sukhahetUpacAreNa sukhaM cApi pravartate||92|| na samA yAnti vaiShamyaM viShamAH samatAM na ca| hetubhiH sadRushA nityaM jAyante dehadhAtavaH||93|| yuktimetAM puraskRutya trikAlAM vedanAM bhiShak| hantItyuktaM cikitsA tu naiShThikI yA vinopadhAm||94||
1.commentary: ‘athavA~a~artasya’ ityAdiprashnasyottaramAha- cikitsatItyAdi| atItavedanAcikitsA na mukhyA, kintu lokaprasiddhopacAreNocyata iti vAkyArthaH| prasiddhavacanairiti lokaprasiddhavacanaiH| pratikarma cikitsA| Ashraya iti sharIre| pUrvarUpamityAdinA anAgatavedanAcikitsAM samarthayati| pUrvarUpaM yadyapi bhaviShyatAmeva bhavati rogANAM, tathA~api bhaviShyatAmiti padena bhUte~api vyAdhau yAni rUpANi bhavanti tAni nirAkaroti| uktaM hi- “prAksantApAt, api cainaM santApArtamanubadhnanti” (ni. a. 1) ityanena rogAvasthAyAmapi pUrvarUpasadbhAvaH| evamatItAnAgatavedanAcikitsA vyutpAditA| vartamAnacikitsAmapi darshayan pAramArthikaM matamAha- pAramparyetyAdi| pAramparyAnubandhaH santAnanyAyenAnubandhaH| duHkhAnAmiti rogANAm| sukhahetUpacAreNeti ArogyahetucikitsAsevayA| sukhamiti Arogyam| evaM manyate- yadA cikitsA sukhahetuH sevyate tadA duHkhahetusevAbhAvAdduHkhaM notpadyate, utpannaM ca duHkhaM rogarUpaM kShaNabha~ggitvena svayameva nashyati, sukhahetusAnnidhyAt sukhamArogyamutpadyate; tena cikitsayA anAgataM duHkhaM hetupratibandhAnnirudhyate, sukhaM ca janyate iti siddhAntaH | etadevAha- na samA ityAdi| samAshca viShamAshca kShaNabha~ggitvasvabhAvAnna vaiShamyAvasthAM sAmyAvasthAM vA yAntItyarthaH| hetubhiH sadRushA iti samahetoH samAH, tathA viShamahetoshca viShamAH| etaccikitsAprAbhRutIye~adhyAye prapa~jcitameva| cikitsAprastAvena sakaladuHkhahAriNIM cikitsAM mokShaphalAmAha- cikitsA tvityAdi| niShThA atyantaduHkhamokSho mokSharUpaH, tadarthaM bhUtA naiShThikI| vinopadhAmiti tRuShNAM vinA, tRuShNAshUnyA pravRuttirmokShaphalA bhavatItyarthaH||86-94||

1.sanskrit: upadhA hi paro heturduHkhaduHkhAshrayapradaH| tyAgaH sarvopadhAnAM ca sarvaduHkhavyapohakaH||95|| koShakAro yathA hyaMshUnupAdatte vadhapradAn | upAdatte tathA~arthebhyastRuShNAmaj~jaH sadA~a~aturaH||96|| yastvagnikalpAnarthA~j j~jo j~jAtvA tebhyo nivartate| anArambhAdasaMyogAttaM duHkhaM nopatiShThate||97||
1.commentary: paro heturiti mUlakAraNam| duHkharUpeNaiva duHkhAshrayaH sharIram| bhogatRuShNayA hi pravartamAno dharmAdharmAn duHkhasharIrotpAdakAnupAdatte, sarvopadhAtyAgAttu na rAgadveShAbhyAM kvacit pravartate, apravartamAnashca na dharmAdharmAnupAdatte, evamanAgatadharmAdharmoparamaH, upAttadharmAdharmayostu rAgadveShashUnyasyopabhogAdeva kShayaH ; tena sarvathA karmakShayAdduHkhasharIrAbhAva iti bhAvaH| atraiva tRuShNAyA duHkhakAraNatve dRuShTAntamAha- koShakAra ityAdi| koShakAraH svanAmaprasiddhaH kITaH| sadA~a~atura iti sadA saMsAraduHkhagRuhItaH| anArambhAditi rAgadveShapUrvakArambhavirahAt| asaMyogAditi ArambhashUnyatvena dharmAdharmocchedakRutAccharIrAsaMyogAt; sharIrAbhAve ca nirAshrayamakAraNakaM duHkhaM na bhavatIti bhAvaH||95-97||

1.sanskrit: dhIdhRutismRutivibhraMshaH samprAptiH kAlakarmaNAm| asAtmyArthAgamashceti j~jAtavyA duHkhahetavaH||98||
1.commentary: ‘kAraNaM vedanAnAM kim’ ityasyottaramAha- dhIdhRutItyAdi| ayaM cArthaH prakaraNAgatatvAducyamAno na punaruktatAmAvahati| dhIdhRutismRutayaH praj~jAbhedAH| ete ca shiShyavyutpattyarthaM praj~jAbhedatvenAnyathA vyutpAdya ihocyante| samprAptiH kAlakarmaNAmiti kAlasya samprAptistathA karmaNashca samprAptiH| karmasamprAptiH pacyamAnakarmayogaH| kAlasamprAptigrahaNena ceha ye kAlavyaktAste gRuhyante, nAvashyaM kAlajanyAH; yataH svAbhAvikAnapi kAlajanyAn tathA tRutIyakAdInapyAsAtmyendriyArthAdijanyAn kAlajatvenaivehAbhidhAsyati| karmajAstu praj~jAparAdhajanyA eveha karmajanyatvena visheSheNa shiShyavyutpattyarthaM pRuthagucyante, kAlavya~jcyatvena ca karmajA iha kAlasamprAptijanyeShvavaroddhavyAH| praj~jAparAdhAvarodhashca yathA karmajAnAM, tathA prathamAdhyAya evoktam| ki~jcAcAryeNonmAdanidAne svayamevoktaM yat- “praj~jAparAdhAt sambhUte vyAdhau karmaja AtmanaH” (ni. 7) ityAdi, tathA janapadoddhvaMsanIye ca vimAne punaruktaM- “vAyvAdInAM yadvaiguNyamutpadyate tasya mUlamadharmaH, tanmUlaM vA~asatkarma pUrvakRutaM, tayoryoniH praj~jAparAdha eva” (vi. 3) iti| tasmAdiha samprAptiH kAlakarmaNAmityanena na kAlajanyA gadA ucyante, kiM tu kAlavya~jjyAH||98||

1.sanskrit: viShamAbhinivesho yo nityAnitye hitAhite| j~jeyaH sa buddhivibhraMshaH samaM buddhirhi pashyati||99||
1.commentary: dhIvibhraMshaM vivRuNoti- viShametyAdi| viShamAbhiniveshaH ayathAbhUtatvenAdhyavasAnaM nitye~anityamiti, evaM hite~ahitamahite vA hitamiti yA buddhiH sa buddhibhraMshaH| atha kathamayaM buddhivibhraMshashabdenocyata ityAha- samaM buddhirhi pashyati; ucitA buddhiH samaM yathAbhUtaM yasmAt pashyati, tasmAdasamadarshanaM buddhivibhraMsha ucita evetyarthaH||99||

1.sanskrit: viShayapravaNaM sattvaM dhRutibhraMshAnna shakyate| niyantumahitAdarthAddhRutirhi niyamAtmikA||100||
1.commentary: dhRutibhraMshamAha- viShayetyAdi| viShayapravaNaM viShayeShu prasajjat| niyantumiti vyAvartayitum| dhRutirhi niyamAtmiketi yasmAd dhRutirakAryaprasaktaM mano nivartayati svarUpeNa, tasmAnmanoniyamaM kartumashaktA dhRutiH svakarmabhraShTA bhavatItyarthaH||100||

1.sanskrit: tattvaj~jAne smRutiryasya rajomohAvRutAtmanaH| bhrashyate sa smRutibhraMshaH smartavyaM hi smRutau sthitam||101||
1.commentary: smRutibhraMshaM vivecayati- tattvetyAdi| tattvaj~jAne smRutiryasya bhrashyata iti yojanA| smartavyaM hi smRutau sthitamiti smartavyatvena sammatasyArthasya smaraNaM prashastasmRutidharmaH| tatra ca tattvaj~jAnasya shiShTAnAM smartavyatvena sammatasya yadasmaraNaM, tat smRutyaparAdhAdbhavatItyarthaH||101||

1.sanskrit: dhIdhRutismRutivibhraShTaH karma yat kurute~ashubham| praj~jAparAdhaM taM vidyAt sarvadoShaprakopaNam||102|| udIraNaM gatimatAmudIrNAnAM ca nigrahaH| sevanaM sAhasAnAM ca nArINAM cAtisevanam||103|| karmakAlAtipAtashca mithyArambhashca karmaNAm| vinayAcAralopashca pUjyAnAM cAbhidharShaNam||104|| j~jAtAnAM svayamarthAnAmahitAnAM niShevaNam| paramaunmAdikAnAM ca pratyayAnAM niShevaNam||105|| akAlAdeshasa~jcArau maitrI sa~gkliShTakarmabhiH| indriyopakramoktasya sadvRuttasya ca varjanam||106|| IrShyAmAnabhayakrodhalobhamohamadabhramAH| tajjaM vA karma yat kliShTaM kliShTaM yaddehakarma ca||107|| yaccAnyadIdRushaM karma rajomohasamutthitam| praj~jAparAdhaM taM shiShTA bruvate vyAdhikAraNam ||108||
1.commentary: evaM buddhyAdibhraMshatrayarUpapraj~jAparAdhajanyaM karma praj~jAparAdhatvena darshayannAha- dhItyAdi| sarvadoShashabdena vAtAdayo rajastamasI ca gRuhyante| karmakAlAtipAtaH cikitsAkAlAtivartanam| mithyArambha iti ayogAtiyogamithyAyogarUpaH| vinayAcAralopenaiva prAptamapi yat punaH pUjyAnAmabhidharShaNAdyabhidhIyate, tadvisheSheNa prakopakatvakhyApanArthamudAharaNArthaM ca| sa~gkliShTakarmabhiriti patitaiH| kliShTamiti ninditam||102-108||

1.sanskrit: buddhyA viShamavij~jAnaM viShamaM ca pravartanam| praj~jAparAdhaM jAnIyAnmanaso gocaraM hi tat||109||
1.commentary: sa~gkShepeNa praj~jAparAdhalakShaNamAha- buddhyetyAdi| viShamamiti anucitaM, viShamavij~jAnaM svarUpata eva praj~jAparAdhaH| viShamapravartanaM ca praj~jAparAdhakAryatvena praj~jAparAdhashabdenocyate| manaso gocaraM hi taditi tadviShamapravartanaM viShamaj~jAnaM ca manaHkAryapraj~jAviShayatvena manaso gocaramityarthaH| viShamapravartanaM ca manogocarajanyatvenopacArAduktaM, visadRushamanoviShayaj~jAnAdviShamavAgdehapravRuttirapi bhavati||109||

1.sanskrit: nirdiShTA kAlasamprAptirvyAdhInAM vyAdhisa~ggrahe| cayaprakopaprashamAH pittAdInAM yathA purA||110|| mithyAtihInali~ggAshca varShAntA rogahetavaH| jIrNabhuktaprajIrNAnnakAlAkAlasthitishca yA||111|| pUrvamadhyAparAhNAshca rAtryA yAmAstrayashca ye| eShu kAleShu niyatA ye rogAste ca kAlajAH||112||
1.commentary: vyAdhInAM kAlasamprAptimAha- nirdiShTetyAdi| vyAdhisa~ggraha iti kiyantaHshirasIye “cayaprakopaprashamAH pittAdInAM yathAkramam| bhavantyekaikashaH ShaTsu kAleShvabhragamAdiShu” (sU. 17) ityanena tathA hyudAharaNena ca| tena, kAlasamprAptirvyAdhInAM yathA- cayaprakopaprashamAH pittAdInAM purA nirdiShTA iti yojyam| udAharaNAntaramAha- mithyetyAdi| jIrNetyAdau jIrNAdyavasthAtrayavishiShTasyAnnasya kAlaH, tathA~annasyAkAlo~ajIrNAdyavasthAlakShitaH| prajIrNaM vidagdham| rAtreryAmAstrayashca ya iti trayo bhAgAH pUrvarAtramadhyarAtrApararAtrarUpAH, na tu yAmaH prahara iti j~jeyam| anyatrApi ca bhAgatraye yAmavibhAgaM kRutvA abhidhAnashAstre triyAmA nishA~abhidhIyate| teShu kAleShviti jIrNAnnakAlAdiShu; jIrNe aparAhNe rAtrisheShe ca vAtikA gadAH, bhuktamAtre pUrvAhNe pUrvarAtre ca kaphajA gadAH, prajIrNe madhyAhne madhyarAtre ca pittajA niyatA rogAH| annAkAle cAjIrNalakShaNe bhojanAt trayo~api doShA bhavantIti j~jeyam| kiMvA, ‘jIrNabhuktaprajIrNAnnakAlA’ iti cchedaH, tena jIrNAdyavasthAyuktAnnakAlAH pUrvavadeva j~jeyAH; tathA ‘kAlasthitishca yA’ iti yojanA; kAlasthitishabdena bAlyAdivayastraividhyamucyate| tatra bAlye shlaiShmikAH, yauvane paittikAH, vArdhakye vAtikA gadA vardhanta iti j~jeyam||110-112||

1.sanskrit: anyedyuShko dvyahagrAhI tRutIyakacaturthakau| sve sve kAle pravartante kAle hyeShAM balAgamaH||113||
1.commentary: viShamajvarAnapi kAlavisheShapravartamAnamAtratvena kAlaje darshayannAha- anyedyuShka ityAdi| dvyahagrAhI caturthakaviparyayaH| vakShyati hi- “viShamajvara evAnyashcaturthakaviparyayaH| madhye ahanI jvarayatyAdAvante ca mu~jcati” (ci. 3) iti| kathaM svakIya eva kAle pravartatanta ityAha- kAle hyeShAM balAgama iti| ukta eva kAle yasmAd balavanto bhavanti, tasmAttatraiva sa~jjAtabalAH santo vyajyanta ityarthaH||113||

1.sanskrit: ete cAnye ca ye kecit kAlajA vividhA gadAH| anAgate cikitsyAste balakAlau vijAnatA||114||
1.commentary: eteShAM cikitsAkramamAha- ete cetyAdi| anye cetyanenAnyAnapi kAlavisheShaprAptiprAdurbhAvinaH| shothakuShThAdIn sUcayati||114||

1.sanskrit: kAlasya pariNAmena jarAmRutyunimittajAH| rogAH svAbhAvikA dRuShTAH svabhAvo niShpratikriyaH||115||
1.commentary: svAbhAvikAnapi kAlapariNAmavyajyamAnatayA iha kAlaje~avarodhayitumAha- kAlasyetyAdi| jarAmRutyurUpAnnimittAjjAtA jarAmRutyunimittajAH, mRutyushabdeneha yugAnurUpAyuHparyavasAnabhavakAlamRutyurgrAhyaH ; kiMvA jarAmRutyvoryannimittaM tasmAjjAtA jarAmRutyunimittajAH, jarAmRutyunimittaM ca prANinAM sAdhAraNadehanivartakabhUtasvabhAvo~adRuShTaM ca| atha svAbhAvikAnAM kA cikitsetyAha- svabhAva ityAdi| niShpratikriya iti sAdhAraNacikitsayA rasAyanavarjyayA na pratikriyate, rasAyanena tu pratikriyata eva; tena, “asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA” (ci. 1 pA. 1) ityAdirasAyanaprayogeNa samaM na virodhaH; kiMvA, svAbhAvikA jarAdayo rasAyanajanitaprakarShAduttarakAlaM punaravashyaM bhavantIti niShpratikriyatvenoktAH||115||

1.sanskrit: nirdiShTaM daivashabdena karma yat paurvadehikam| hetustadapi kAlena rogANAmupalabhyate||116||
1.commentary: samprati karmasamprAptikRutamapi gadaM kAlavisheShavyajyamAnatayA darshayannAha- nirdiShTamityAdi| kAleneti pacyamAnatAlakShitena kAlena (yuktaM sat) karma kAraNaM bhavatItyarthaH||116||

1.sanskrit: na hi karma mahat ki~jcit phalaM yasya na bhujyate| kriyAghnAH karmajA rogAH prashamaM yAnti tatkShayAt||117||
1.commentary: karmaNaH phalasambandhiniyamamAha- na hItyAdi| mahaditi visheShaNena ki~jcidamahat karma prAyashcittabAdhanIyaphalaM na dadAtyapi phalamiti darshayati| karmajAnAmacikitsyatvamAha- kriyAghnA ityAdi| tatkShayAditi karmakShayAt; karmakShayashca karmaphalopabhogAdeva paraM bhavati||117||

1.sanskrit: atyugrashabdashravaNAcchravaNAt sarvasho na ca| shabdAnAM cAtihInAnAM bhavanti shravaNAjjaDAH||118|| paruShodbhIShaNAshastApriyavyasanasUcakaiH| shabdaiH shravaNasaMyogo mithyAsaMyoga ucyate||119|| asaMsparsho~atisaMsparsho hInasaMsparsha eva ca| spRushyAnAM sa~ggraheNoktaH sparshanendriyabAdhakaH||120|| yo bhUtaviShavAtAnAmakAlenAgatashca yaH| snehashItoShNasaMsparsho mithyAyoga sa ucyate||121|| rUpANAM bhAsvatAM dRuShTirvinashyatyatidarshanAt| darshanAccAtisUkShmANAM sarvashashcApyadarshanAt||122|| dviShTabhairavabIbhatsadUrAtishliShTadarshanAt | tAmasAnAM ca rUpANAM mithyAsaMyoga ucyate||123|| atyAdAnamanAdAnamokasAtmyAdibhishca yat| rasAnAM viShamAdAnamalpAdAnaM ca dUShaNam||124|| atimRudvatitIkShNAnAM gandhAnAmupasevanam| asevanaM sarvashashca ghrANendriyavinAshanam||125|| pUtibhUtaviShadviShTA gandhA ye cApyanArtavAH| tairgandhairghrANasaMyogo mithyAyogaH sa ucyate||126|| ityasAtmyArthasaMyogastrividho doShakopanaH|127|
1.commentary: kramAgatamasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaM vivRuNoti- atyugretyAdi| sarvasho na ceti sarvathograshabdAshravaNAt | spRushyAnAmiti spRushyatvenoktAnAM shAstre~abhya~ggotsAdanAdInAm| bhUtAH saviShikrimipi shAcAdayaH| yo bhUtaviShavAtAdInAM saMsparshaH, tathA~akAlenAgataH snehashItoShNasaMsparshashceti yojanA| tatrAkAle snehasaMsparsho yathA- ajIrNe kaphavRuddhikAle abhya~ggasparshaH, evaM shIte shItasparshaH, uShNe coShNasparsho~akAlenAgato j~jeyaH| sarvashashcApyadarshanAditi bhAsvatAM sUkShmANAM ca sarvathA~adarshanAt| atishliShTamiti netrapratyAsannam| tAmasAnAM ca rUpANAM darshanAdvinashyati dRuShTiriti sambandhaH| mithyAyogaH sa iti dviShTabhairavAdidarshanarUpaH| atisUkShmadarshanaM ca mithyAyoga eva j~jeyaH| okasAtmyAdibhiriti viShamAdAnamiti sambandhaH| okasAtmyAdivaiShamyeNa ca rAshidoShavarjaM prakRutyAdisaptadoShA grahItavyAH| trividha iti ayogAtiyogamithyAyogarUpaH||118-126||

1.sanskrit: asAtmyamiti tadvidyAdyanna yAti sahAtmatAm||127||
1.commentary: asAtmyArthaM darshayati- asAtmyamityAdi| saheti militaM sharIreNa| AtmatAm avikRutarUpatAM na yAti; etena, yadupayuktaM prAkRutarUpopadhAtakaM bhavati, tadasAtmyamiti||127||

1.sanskrit: mithyAtihInayogebhyo yo vyAdhirupajAyate| shabdAdInAM sa vij~jeyo vyAdhiraindriyako budhaiH||128||
1.commentary: itthamasAtmyArthajasya vyAdherindriyadvArabhUtatvenaindriyakatvaM darshayannAha- mithyetyAdi| hInayogenehAyogo grAhyaH| aindriyaka iti indriyadvArabhUtaH||128||

1.sanskrit: vedanAnAmashAntAnAmityete hetavaH smRutAH| sukhahetuH samastvekaH samayogaH sudurlabhaH||129||
1.commentary: duHkharUpavedanAhetuM prapa~jcoktamupasaMharati- vedanAnAmityAdi| ashAntAnAmiti duHkhAnAm| atha sukharUpavedanAhetuH ka ityAha- sukhetyAdi| samayoga iti kAlabuddhIndriyArthAnAM samyagyogaH| sudurlabha iti kAlAdisamyagyogasya ayogAdivirahatvena sudurlabhatvAt| prAyo hi kAlAdInAM madhye anyatareNApyayogAdinA puruShaH sambadhyate; tena ca nityAturA eva puruShA bhavanti, alpaM ca rogamanAdRutya svasthavyapadeshaH puruShANAM kriyata iti bhAvaH||129||

1.sanskrit: nendriyANi na caivArthAH sukhaduHkhasya hetavaH| hetustu sukhaduHkhasya yogo dRuShTashcaturvidhaH||130|| santIndriyANi santyarthA yogo na ca na cAsti ruk| na sukhaM, kAraNaM tasmAdyoga eva caturvadhaH||131||
1.commentary: samprati samyagyogasyopAdeyatAmayogAdInAM ca heyatAM darshayituM yogameva caturvidhaM kAraNatvena darshayannAha- nendriyANItyAdi| nanu kathamindriyArthayoH sukhaduHkhakAraNatvenopalabhyamAnayorapyakAraNatvamityAha- santItyAdi| yogo na ceti indriyArthayoH sambandho na ca| na sukhamiti cchedaH| indriyArthayoryogAbhAve akAraNatvena, sati tu yoge kAraNatvena, yoga evAnvayavyatirekAbhyAM kAraNamavadhAryata iti bhAvaH| ayaM ca yoga indriyArthAvadhikRutya spaShTatvenoktaH; tena, praj~jAkAlayorapi boddhavyaH| etacchendriyamarthaM cAnupAdeyaM kRutvA caturvidhayogasya kAraNatvaM yogAnAmeva heyopAdeyatvopadarshanArthaM kRutam||130-131||

1.sanskrit: nAtmendriyaM mano buddhiM gocaraM karma vA vinA| sukhaduHkhaM, yathA yacca boddhavyaM tattathocyate||132||
1.commentary: paramArthatastvAtmendriyamanobuddhyarthAdRuShTAnyeva tathAyuktAni sukhaduHkhakAraNAnIti darshayannAha- nAtmetyAdi| gocara indriyArthaH| karma adRuShTam| tatra AtmAnaM vinA na loShTAdau sukhaduHkhe bhavataH| indriyArthAdInAM ca sukhaduHkhakAraNatvaM spaShTameva| karmApi ca shubhaM sukhakAraNam, ashubhaM ca duHkhakAraNam| yadyAtmAdaya eva kAraNaM, tarhi kimarthaM kAlAdyayogAtiyogAdaya ihocyanta ityAha- yathetyAdi| yad boddhavyaM sukhaduHkhaM yathA boddhavyaM kAryavashAdbhavati, tattathaivocyate nAnyathA| tena sAtmyAsAtmyendriyArthajanyatvena sukhaduHkhe iha pratIyamAne cikitsAyAmupayukte bhavataH, nAtmAdijanyatveneha sukhaduHkhe abhidhIyete; na hyAtmAdayo duHkhahetutayA pratipannA apIha heyatayA pratipAdyante; kintvasAtmyendriyArthayogAdaya eva duHkhahetavastyajyante, sukhahetavaH sAtmyendiyArthayogAdayastUpAdIyanta iti bhAvaH||132||

1.sanskrit: sparshanendriyasaMsparshaH sparsho mAnasa eva ca| dvividhaH sukhaduHkhAnAM vedanAnAM pravartakaH||133||
1.commentary: idAnIM sakalakAraNavyApakaM yogaM vyutpAdayitumaindriyakaM mAnasaM ca sparshaM darshayitumAha- sparshanetyAdi| sparshanendriyasaMsparsha ityanenendriyANAmarthena sambandhaM sparshanendriyakRutaM darshayati; cakShurAdInyapi spRuShTamevArthaM jAnanti; yadi hyaspRuShTameva cakShuH shrotraM ghrANaM vA gRuhNAti, tadA vidUramapi gRuhNIyAt, na ca gRuhNAti, tasmAt spRuShTvaivendriyANyarthaM pratipadyate; mAnasastu sparshashcintyAdinA~arthena samaM sUkShmo~astyeva, yena manaH kishcideva cintayati, na sarvaM; tena yanmanasA spRushyate tadeva mano gRuhNAtIti sthitiH||133||

1.sanskrit: icchAdveShAtmikA tRuShNA sukhaduHkhAt pravartate| tRuShNA ca sukhaduHkhAnAM kAraNaM punarucyate||134|| upAdatte hi sA bhAvAn vedanAshrayasa~jj~jakAn| spRushyate nAnupAdAne nAspRuShTo vetti vedanAH||135||
1.commentary: sukhaduHkhotpattikramamAha- icchetyAdi| sukhAdicchArUpA tRuShNA, duHkhAcca dveSharUpA tRuShNA pravartate| iyaM cotpannA tRuShNA Ipsite~arthe pravartayantI dviShTe ca nivartayantI pravRuttinivRuttiviShayasya sukhaduHkhahetutAmapekShya sukhaduHkhe janayatIti vAkyArthaH| yathoktaM tRuShNAyAH sukhaduHkhahetutvaM darshayannAha- upAdatte hItyAdi| vedanAshrayasa~jj~jakAniti vedanAkAraNatvenoktAn kAlAdyayogAdirUpAn| atha tRuShNA cet sukhaduHkhakAraNaM, tat kimindriyArthenApareNa kAraNenetyAha- spRushyata ityAdi| anupAdAna iti avidyamAnArtharUpe sparshakAraNe arthaM vinA nArthasya sparsho bhavati| atha na bhavatvarthasparshaH, tataH kimityAha- nAspRuShTo vetti vedanA iti; arthasparshashUnyaH san na sukhaduHkhe anutpannatvAdeva vettItyarthaH||134-135||

1.sanskrit: vedanAnAmadhiShThAnaM mano dehashca sendriyaH| keshalomanakhAgrAnnamaladravaguNairvinA||136||
1.commentary: ‘vedanAnAM kimadhiShThAnam’ ityasyottaramAha- vedanAnAmityAdi| dehaH sendriya iti anena nirindriyo deho keshalemAdiko nirastaH| tadeva spaShTArthaM vivRuNoti- keshetyAdi| kiMvA, indriyANyapi prAdhAnyakhyApanArthaM prathag vedanAshrayatvenendriyagrahaNenocyante| vedanAyA dehendriyagatatvaM tadAdhAratvena pratIyamAnatvAjj~jeyam| dravaM mUtram| guNAH shabdAdayaH| sharIragatA ete hi keshAdayo na vedanAdhArA ityanubhava eva pramANam| yA tu mUtrapurIShagatA vedanA grahaNImUtrakRucchrAdau vaktavyA, sA mUtrapurIShAdhArasharIrapradeshasyaiva bodhyA||136||

1.sanskrit: yoge mokShe ca sarvAsAM vedanAnAmavartanam| mokShe nivRuttirniHsheShA yogo mokShapravartakaH||137||
1.commentary: ‘kva caitA vedanAH sarvA’ ityAdiprashnasyottaraM- yoga ityAdi| yogaH ‘anArambhAt’ ityAdigranthavakShyamANaH| mokSha AtyantikasharIrAdyucchedaH| niHsheSheti na punarbhavati| etena, yoge nivRuttA vedanA punarbhavatIti sUcayati| mokShapravartaka iti mokShakAraNam| kiMvA, ‘yogamokShau nivartakau’ iti pAThaH; tadA asmin pakShe yadyapi yogamokShayorvedanAnivartakatvaM ‘yoge mokShe ca’ ityAdinA shlokArdhenoktaM, tathA~api yogamokShayoriha kartRutA vedanAnivRuttiM prati dRushyata iti na paunaruktyam||137||

1.sanskrit: AtmendriyamanorthAnAM sannikarShAt pravartate| sukhaduHkhamanArambhAdAtmasthe manasi sthire||138|| nivartate tadubhayaM vashitvaM copajAyate| sasharIrasya yogaj~jAstaM yogamRuShayo viduH||139||
1.commentary: yathA yogo vedanAnivartako bhavati, yashca yogastamAha- AtmetyAdi| anArambhAditi viShayopAdAnArthaM manasA~anArambhAt | Atmasthe manasIti viShaye nivRute kevalAtmaj~jAnasthe| sthire iti acale, Atmaj~jAnaprasakta eveti yAvat| tadubhayamiti sukhaduHkhe| yoge yogadharmAntaraprAptimAha- vashitvamityAdi| vashitvaM vakShyamANamaShTavidhamaishvaryabalam| sasharIrasyetipadena sharIreNa sahaiva vashitvaM bhavatIti darshayati||138-139||

1.sanskrit: Aveshashcetaso j~jAnamarthAnAM chandataH kriyA| dRuShTiH shrotraM smRutiH kAntiriShTatashcApyadarshanam||140|| ityaShTavidhamAkhyAtaM yoginAM balamaishvaram| shuddhasattvasamAdhAnAttat sarvamupajAyate||141||
1.commentary: Avesha ityAdi| AveshaH parapurapraveshaH| cetaso j~jAnamiti paracittaj~jAnam| arthAnAM chandataH kriyeti arthAnAmicchAtaH karaNam| dRuShTiH atIndriyadarshanam| shrotram atIndriyashravaNam| smRutiH sarvabhAvatattvasmaraNam| kAntiH amAnuShI kAntiH| iShTatashcApyadarshanamiti yadecchati tadA darshanayogya eva na dRushyate, yadA cecchati tadA dRushyate| kiMvA, Aveshashcetasa iti paracetasaH praveshaH, j~jAnamiti sarvamatItAnAgatAdij~jAnaM, sheShaM pUrvavat| aishvaramiti yogaprabhAvAdupapannaishvaryakRutam| shuddhasattvasamAdhAnAditi nIrajastamaskasya manasa Atmani samyagAdhAnAt||140-141||

1.sanskrit: mokSho rajastamo~abhAvAt balavatkarmasa~gkShayAt| viyogaH sarvasaMyogairapunarbhava ucyate||142||
1.commentary: atha kathaM mokSho bhavati, kashcetyAha- mokSha ityAdi| balavatkarmasa~gkShayAditi avashyabhoktavyaphalasya karmaNaH kShayAt| sarvasaMyogairiti sarvairAtmasambandhibhiH sharIrabuddhyaha~gkArAdibhiH| na punaH sharIrAdisambandho bhavatItyapunarbhavaH ||142||

1.sanskrit: satAmupAsanaM samyagasatAM parivarjanam| vratacaryopavAsau ca niyamAshca pRuthagvidhAH||143|| dhAraNaM dharmashAstrANAM vij~jAnaM vijane ratiH| viShayeShvaratirmokShe vyavasAyaH parA dhRutiH||144|| karmaNAmasamArambhaH kRutAnAM ca parikShayaH| naiShkramyamanaha~gkAraH saMyoge bhayadarshanam||145|| manobuddhisamAdhAnamarthatattvaparIkShaNam| tattvasmRuterupasthAnAt sarvametat pravartate||146||
1.commentary: prastAvAnmokShopAyamAha- satAmityAdi| parA dhRutiriti atishayitaM manoniyamanam| karmaNAmasamArambha iti anAgatadharmAdharmasAdhanAnAmakaraNam| kRutAnAM ca parikShaya iti janmAntaraiH kRutAnAM karmaNAM phalopabhogAt parikShayaH| naiShkamyaM saMsAraniShkramaNecchA| anaha~gkAra iti mamedam, ahaM ‘karomi’ ityAdibuddhivarjanam| saMyoga iti AtmasharIrAdisaMyoge| manobuddhisamAdhAnamiti manobuddhyorAtmani samAdhAnam| sarvametaditi ‘karmaNAmasamArambhaH’ ityAdyuktam | tattvasmRutiH AtmAdInAM yathAbhUtAnusmaraNaM ; sA ca nAtmA sharIrAdyupakAryaH, sharIrAdayashcAmI AtmavyatiriktAH, ityAdismaraNarUpasmRutiH||143-146||

1.sanskrit: smRutiH satsevanAdyaishca dhRutyantairupajAyate| smRutvA svabhAvaM bhAvAnAM smaran duHkhAt pramucyate||147||
1.commentary: atha smRutiH kathaM duHkhapramoShe kAraNamityAha- smRutvetyAdi| svabhAvamiti pratyAtmaniyatarUpam| guruvacanAddhi prathamapratipannamAtmAdInAM rUpaM parasparabhinnaM parasparAnupakArakatvena vyavasthitaM smaran na kvacidapi pravartate, apravartamAnashca na duHkhena pravRuttijanyena yujyata ityarthaH||147||

1.sanskrit: vakShyante kAraNAnyaShTau smRutiryairupajAyate| nimittarUpagrahaNAt sAdRushyAt saviparyayAt||148|| sattvAnubandhAdabhyAsAjj~jAnayogAt punaH shrutAt| dRuShTashrutAnubhUtAnAM smAraNAt smRutirucyate||149||
1.commentary: idAnIM smRutiprastAvAt smRutikAraNAnyAha- vakShyanta ityAdi| nimittagrahaNaM kAraNaj~jAnaM, kAraNaM hi dRuShTvA kAryaM smarati| rUpagrahaNam AkAragrahaNam | yathA- vane gavayaM dRuShTvA gAM smarati| sAdRushyAd yathA- pituH sadRushaM puruShaM dRuShTvA pitaraM smarati| saviparyayAditi atyarthavaisAdRushyAdapi smaraNaM bhavati; yathA- atyarthakurUpaM dRuShTvA pratiyoginamatyarthasurUpaM smarati| sattvAnubandhAditi manasaH praNidhAnAt, smartavyasmaraNAya praNihitamanAH smartavyaM smarati| abhyAsAditi abhyastamarthamabhyAsabalAdeva smarati| j~jAnayogAditi tattvaj~jAnayogAt; upajAtatattvaj~jAno hi tadbalAdeva sarvaM smarati| punaH shrutAditi shruto~apyartho vismRutaH punarekadeshaM shrutvA smaryate| smRutikAraNamabhidhAya smRutirUpamAha- dRuShTetyAdi|- dRuShTaM pratyakShopalakShaNaM, shrutaM tvAgamapratItaM , tena sarvapUrvAnubhUtAvarodhaH| kvacit, ‘smaraNaM smRutirucyate’ iti pAThaH, tatrApi nArthabhedaH||148-149||

1.sanskrit: etattadekamayanaM muktairmokShasya darshitam| tattvasmRutibalaM, yena gatA na punarAgatAH||150|| ayanaM punarAkhyAtametadyogasya yogibhiH| sa~gkhyAtadharmaiH sA~gkhyaishca muktairmokShasya cAyanam||151||
1.commentary: evaM smRutiM sAmAnyena pratipAdya tattvasmRutermokShasAdhakatvaM darshayannAha- etadityAdi| ekamayanamiti shreShThaH panthAH| muktairiti jIvanmuktairiti j~jeyaM, sarvathAmuktAnAM sharIrAbhAvenopadarshakatvAbhAvAt| tattvasmRutibalamiti tattvasmRutirUpaM balaM; kiMvA, tattvasmRutirbalaM yatra mokShasAdhanamArge tattattvasmRutibalam| yeneti yena yathA| gatA iti mokShaM gatAH na punarAgatA iti muktiM yAtA na punarAgacchanti||150-151||

1.sanskrit: sarvaM kAraNavadduHkhamasvaM cAnityameva ca| na cAtmakRutakaM taddhi tatra cotpadyate svatA||152|| yAvannotpadyate satyA buddhirnaitadahaM yayA| naitanmameti vij~jAya j~jaH sarvamativartate||153||
1.commentary: idAnIM sa~gkShepeNa saMsArahetumaj~jAnaM, tathA mokShahetuM ca samyagaj~jAnaM darshayannAha - sarvamityAdi| sarvaM kAraNavaditi sarvamutpadyamAnaM buddhyaha~gkArasharIrAdi| duHkhamiti duHkhahetureva| asvamiti sarvaM kAraNavadevAtmavyatiriktaM paramArthataH| na cAtmakRutakamiti na cAtmanodAsInena kRutam| tatreti kAraNavati buddhisharIrAdau| svateti mamatA ‘mameyaM buddhiH’ ityAdirUpA| atha kiyantaM kAlamiyaM bhrAntyA yutotpadyate ityAha- yAvadityAdi| satyA buddhiH samyagaj~jAnam| yayA satyayA buddhyA| naitad buddhyAdyahaM, kintu bhinna evAhaM; tathA naitad buddhyAdi mama, kintu prakRuteH prapa~jca iti vij~jAya| j~jaH tattvasAkShAtkAravAn| sarvamativartata iti sarvaM buddhyAdi tyajati||152-153||

1.sanskrit: tasmiMshcaramasannyAse samUlAH sarvavedanAH| sasa~jj~jAj~jAnavij~jAnA nivRuttiM yAntyasheShataH||154||
1.commentary: caramasannyAsa iti pashcAdbhAvisakalakarmasannyAse| prathamaM hi mokShopayogitvena guruvacanAt kriyAsannyAsaH kRuta eva, paraM khAnubhavaviraktena na kRutaH; abhyAsAdudbhUtena j~jAnena sAkShAddRuShTabhAvasvabhAvena yaH sarvasannyAsaH kriyate, tatra samUlAH sarvavedanA j~jAnAdayashca sharIroparamAdevoparamante| samUlA iti sakAraNAH, kAraNaM ca buddhyAdayaH| sa~jj~jA AlocanaM nirvikalpakaM, j~jAnaM savikalpakaM, vij~jAnaM buddhyavasAyaH; kiMvA, sa~jj~jA nAmollekhena j~jAnaM, vij~jAnaM shAstraj~jAnam| tattvaj~jAnamapi hi mokShaM janayitvA nivartata eva, kAraNAbhAvAt||154||

1.sanskrit: ataH paraM brahmabhUto bhUtAtmA nopalabhyate| niHsRutaH sarvabhAvebhyashcihnaM yasya na vidyate| j~jAnaM brahmavidAM cAtra nAj~jastajj~jAtumarhati||155||
