12.commentary: siddhisthAnAbhidhAne~api sakalasiddhisthAnApekShaNIyapa~jcakarmakalpanAdyabhidhAyakatayA prAdhAnyAdAdau kalpanAsiddhirevocyate| atra ‘kA kalpanA’ ityAdIn shiShyasya dvAdashaprashnAnabhiniveshya tAn yathAkramaM vyAcaShTe prashnAnuguNagurubuddhiprakAshArtham| yaduktaM bharadvAjena- “apraduShTena bhAvena prasannenAntarAtmanA| shiShyeNa samyak pRuShTasya gurorbuddhiH prakAshate” iti| atra ‘kA kalpanA pa~jcasu karmasUktA’ iti prathamaH prashnaH, ‘kramashca kaH’ iti dvitIyaH, ‘ki~jca kRutAkRuteShu li~ggaM tathaivAtikRuteShu’ iti tRutIyaH, ‘sa~gkhyA kA’ iti caturthaH, ‘ki~gguNo bastiH’ iti pa~jcamaH, ‘keShu ca kashca bastiH’ iti ShaShThaH, ‘kiM varjanIyaM pratikarmakAle’ iti saptamaH, ‘kRute kiyAn vA parihArakAlaH’ ityaShTamaH, ‘praNIyamAnashca na yAti kena bastiH’ iti navamaH, ‘kenaiti shIghraM’ iti dashamaH, ‘sucirAcca kenaiti’ ityekAdashaH, ‘sAdhyAH’ ityAdiko dvAdashaH| sAdhyA ityAdiprashnasya yadyapyavakAsho nAsti, yato hi nAsAdhyA gadAH proktena yathAsvaM kriyamANena bheShajena prashAmyanti, tathA~apyasamyagbheShaje eva yathAsvaM bheShajAbhidhAnAdayaM prashnoboddhavyaH||3-5||-

12.sanskrit: tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya uktaH ||6|| nAtaH paraM snehanamAdishanti sAtmyIbhavet saptadinAt paraM tu|7|
12.commentary: kalpanAshabdeneha pa~jcakarmA~ggakalpanocyate, tena pa~jcakarmA~ggasnehasvedaprayogameva prAgAha| tryahAvaramityAdi prathamaprashnasyottaram| tryahAvaramiti tryaheNa tryahaM vA vyApya kriyamANasnehanena avaraM yathA bhavatIti tryahAvaraM snigdhaH| saptadinamiti saptadinaM vyApya snigdhH| paramiti snehaprakarShakAlAvadhinA saptadinaM vyApya snigdhaH| tatashca kAlotkarShAt kriyamANashodhanA~ggasnehanapakShe saptadinaM yAvat snigdhaH, kAlAprakarShapakShe tu tryahaM snigdhaH saMsvedayitavya ityarthaH| uktasaptadinasnehanakAlAnatikramaM sopapattikamAha- nAtaH paramityAdi| ataH paramiti saptadinAt param| kuto nAdishantItyAha- sAtmyIbhavedityAdi| saptadinAt pareNa kriyamANasnehaH saptarAtraprayogeNa sAtmyIbhUtatvAnna snehanamadhikaM sharIre karotItyarthaH; tena yAvanmAtrasnehaprayogeNa saptadinopayuktena snehanaM vRutaM, sA mAtrA sAtmyIbhUtaiva; adhikamAtrA yA sAtmyatAM na gatA sA saptarAtrAt pareNApi kartavyaiva; vedyAstu saptarAtrAdasnigdhe puruShe ki~jcidvishrAmaM kRutvA punaradhikamAtrayA snehaM prayu~jjate| etacca tryahasnehanaM saptarAtrasnehanaM ca mRudukrUrakoShThaviShayabhedena| yaduktaM- “mRudukoShThastrirAtreNa snihyatyacchopasevayA| snihyati krUrakoShThastu saptarAtreNa mAnavaH” (sU.a.13) iti| nanu yadi krUrakoShThastu saptarAtreNa snihyatIti vyavasthA, tat kathamiha ‘nAtaH paraM snehanamAdishanti’ ityanena saptarAtreNApyasnehanamucyate; brUmaH- satyaM, krUrakoShThaH saptarAtreNaiva snihyati, paraM krUrakoShThatAmapekShya kRutayA snehamAtrayA snihyati, yadA tu hInamAtrA prayujyate, tadA saptarAtreNApi na snihyati| yattu tantrAntare- “triShaTkanavarAtreNa snehapAnaM vidhIyate” ityanena saptarAtrAdUrdhvamapi snehanaM vihitaM, tadAcAryAnabhimatameva; kiMvA, saptarAtrAdUrdhvamasAtmyIbhUtAdhikamAtrAprayogAbhiprAyeNa tadvarNanIyam| atra ca saptarAtrAdUrdhvaM snehaprayogasya niShedhAt, tryahAdarvAk prayogasya vA niShedhAt, sadyaH snehaprayogeNaikadinenApi snehanamanujAnIta iti bruvate| madhyakoShThAntaraM prati snehanaprakarShakAlo yadyapi noktaH, tathA~api madhyavidhayA pa~jcadinena madhyakoShThasya snehanaM j~jeyam| yattu kaishcit ‘mRudukoShThaM prati tryahAdUrdhvaM na snehanaM kartavyaM sAtmyIbhAvAditi cArtho labhyate’ iti vyAkhyAyate, tanna naH prINAti; yataH sAtmyIbhAvaH saptadinanirvartyatayaivAcAryeNoktaH , tenAtyalpamAtrAprayuktena snehena tryahAdyadi na snihyati mRudukoShThastadA~adhikadinAnyapi tatra snehaH kartavyaH||6||-

12.sanskrit: sneho~anilaM hanti mRudUkaroti dehaM malAnAM vinihanti sa~ggam||7||
12.commentary: saMshodhanA~ggasnehaphalamAha- sneho~anilaM hantItyAdi||7||

12.sanskrit: snigdhasya sUkShmeShvayaneShu lInaM svedastu doShaM nayati dravatvam|8|
12.commentary: snehapUrvakasvedaphalamAha- snigdhasyetyAdi| sUkShmeShviti sUkShmeShvapi|8|

12.sanskrit: grAmyaudakAnUparasaiH samAMsairutkleshanIyaH payasA ca vamyaH||8|| rasaistathA jA~ggalajaiH sayUShaiH snigdhaiH kaphAvRuddhikarairvirecyaH|9|
12.commentary: samprati snigdhasya vAmanIyasya vamanAnuguNaM virecanIyasya ca virecanAnuguNaM bhojanaM pRuthagAha- grAmyaudaketyAdi| rasaistathetyAdinA virecanIyasyAhAravidhAnam| atra ca utkleshanIya iti yadA sambandho bhavettadA utkleshanaM pittasyaiva j~jeyaM; kiMvA ‘utkleshanIyaH’ iti nAnuvartata eva, tena kaphAvRuddhikarai rasairyUShaishca ‘bhojanIya’ iti sheShaH| etadvirecanArthaM pratibhojanaM tryahaM j~jeyaM, vamanArthaM tu pratibhojanamekAhameva; uktaM hi ‘snehAt praskandanaM jantustrirAtroparataH pibet| snehavaddravamuShNaM ca tryahaM bhuktvA rasaudanam| ekAhoparatastadvadbhuktvA pracchardanaM pibet” (sU.a.13) iti||8||-

12.sanskrit: shleShmottarashchardayati hyaduHkhaM viricyate mandakaphastu samyak||9|| adhaH kaphe~alpe vamanaM virecayedvirecanaM vRuddhakaphe tathordhvam|10|
12.commentary: vAmanIyasya shleShmottaratve kartavye virecanIyasya cAlpakaphatve sampAdye upapattimAha- shleShmottara ityAdi| uktaviparyaye hetumAha- adha ityAdi| kaphe~alpe sati vamanaM pItaM vamanamakRutvaivAdho yAti; vRuddhe kaphe tu virecanaM prayuktamUrdhvaM yAti, vamanAya sampadyata ityarthaH||9||-

12.sanskrit: snigdhAya deyaM vamanaM yathoktaM vAntasya peyAdiranukramashca||10|| snigdhasya susvinnatanoryathAvadvirecanaM yogyatamaM prayojyam |11|
12.commentary: samprati kramashca ka iti prashnasyottaramAha- snigdhAya deyaM vamanamiti; vamanapAnadine~abhya~ggena snigdhAya vamanaM deyamityarthaH, pAnajanitasnehastu pUrvamevoktatvAnna punarabhidhAnamarhati, anye tu ‘upajAtasnehaguNAya ’ iti vadanti| yathoktamiti madanakalpoktavidhinA deyam| vamanAnantaraM kartavyamAha- vAntasyetyAdi| peyAdiH “peyAM vilepI” ityAdinA vakShyamANaH| vamanakramamabhidhAya virecanakramamAha- snigdhasyetyAdi| susvinnatanoriti samyaksvinnadehasya| ayaM ca virecanA~ggaH snehasvedakramo vamanAnantarabhAvivirecane~api peyAdikramottarakAlaM kartavyaH; yaduktaM- ‘vilepyAH kramAgataM cainaM punareva snehasvedAbhyAmupapAdya virecayet’ iti| snehAnantaraM ca yattryahaM virecanArthaM pratibhojanaM, tadupakramAbhidhAnAnuSha~ggapratipAditameveti na punariha pratipAdyate| yathAvaditi kalpasthanoktavidhinA| yogyatamamiti sharIradoShAdyapekShayA yadvirecanaM yaugikaM bhavati taddeyam||10||-

12.sanskrit: peyAM vilepImakRutaM kRutaM ca yUShaM rasaM trirdvirathaikashashca||11|| krameNa seveta vishuddhakAyaH pradhAnamadhyAvarashuddhishuddhaH|12|
12.commentary: vamanavirecanottarabhAvipeyAdikramamAha- peyAM vilepImityAdi| yavAgUH bahusikthA| vilepI viraladravA| uktaM hi- ‘sikthakai rahito maNDaH, peyA sikthasamanvitA| yavAgUrbahusikthA syAdvilepI viraladravA’ iti| atra akRutayUShaH snehalavaNAdyasaMskRutaH, kRutayUShaH snehalavaNAdisaMskRutaH; evaM rase~api kRutAkRutavyavasthA| yaduktaM sUdashAstre ‘asnehalavaNaM sarvamakRutaM kaTukairvinA| vij~jeyaM lavaNasnehakaTukaiH saMskRutaM kRutam” iti| tririti annakAlatrayaM vyApya, dviriti annakAladvayam, ekasha iti ekAnnakAlam; etacca trirityAdi pratyekaM peyAdibhiH sambadhyate| etacca trirityAdi pakShatrayaM pradhAnashuddhishuddhAdyapekShayA yathAkramaM j~jeyam| tena, pradhAnashuddhishuddhe pratyekaM triH peyAdi kartavyaM, tenAnnakAlatraye peyA, tataH pareNAnnakAlatraye vilepI, tataH pareNAnnakAlatraye kRutAkRutayUShasahitamannaM , tato~api ca pareNa kRutAkRutarasenAnnamannakAlatraye deyam; evaM dvAdashabhirannakAlairvamanadinasAyAhnAt prabhRuti saptarAtreNa peyAdikramaH | ayameva krama upakalpanIye~api- “tataH sAyAhne lohitashAlitaNDulAnAM” ityAdinA, yAvat “dvAdashe cAnnakAle” (sU.a.15) ityanenoktaH | atra yUSharasayostu yadyapi kAlavibhAgo na pratipAditastathA~api yUShakAlatraye rasakAlatraye ca prathamamakRutasya uttarakAle ca kRutasya yUShasya, evaM rasasyApi kAlavibhAgaH kathanIyaH| evaM dviHpeyAdikramastathA ekashashca peyAdikramo varNanIya iti| ekakAle tu peyAdikrame yadyapi kRutAkRutayUSharasayoH kAlavibhAgo na prApyate, tathA~apyekasminneva kAle stokasaMskAreNa yUSharasayostatra kRutAkRutatvaM j~jeyam| pradhAnashuddhe bhUridoShagamanakShobhAdagnimAndyaM sambhavati, tena tatra peyAdikramashciraM kriyata iti j~jeyam| pradhAnashuddhyAdilakShaNaM cAgre vakShyamANam||11||-

12.sanskrit: yathA~aNuragnistRuNagomayAdyaiH sandhukShyamANo bhavati krameNa||12|| mahAn sthiraH sarvapacastathaiva shuddhasya peyAdibhirantaragniH|13|
12.commentary: peyAdikramasya vishodhanamandIkRutAgnerdIpakatvaM dRuShTAntena darshayannAha- yathetyAdi||12||-

12.sanskrit: jaghanyamadhyapravare tu vegAshcatvAra iShTA vamane ShaDaShTau||13|| dashaiva te dvitriguNA vireke prasthastathA dvitricaturguNashca| pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhaM kaphAntaM ca virekamAhuH||14|| dvitrAn saviTkAnapanIya vegAnmeyaM vireke vamane tu pItam|15|
12.commentary: pradhAnashuddhyAdilakShaNaM prAha- jaghanyetyAdi| caturbhirvegairyacchodhanaM vamanaM tajjaghanyaM, yattu ShaDbhistanmadhyamaM, yattvaShTabhistat pravaram| vireke jaghanye dasha, madhye tu virecane dviguNA dashaviMshatirityarthaH, pravare tu virecane triguNA dasha triMshadityarthaH| vegasa~gkhyAvibhedena jaghanyAdibhedamabhidhAya doShamAnabhedenApi virecanasya jaghanyamadhyapravaratAM yathAkramamAha- prasthastathetyAdi| dviguNaH prastho jaghanye virecane, triguNashca madhyame, caturguNastu pravare| atra ca prasthashabdena sArdhatrayodashapalAnyucyante; uktaM hi tantrAntare “vamane ca vireke ca tathA shoNitamokShaNe| sArdhatrayodashapalaM prasthamAhurmanIShiNaH” iti| pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhamiti vireke yanmAnaM jaghanyamadhyapravaravibhAge proktaM yathAkramaM tathA vamane~api jaghanyamadhyapravaravibhAge tadardhaM j~jeyaM, paraM tu yat pittAntatvaM vamanasya, kaphAntatvaM virekasya, tat trividhashuddhAvarthAgataM j~jeyam| yadA caturbhirvegaiH prasthamAne doShe gate pittAntatvaM samyagvamanashuddhijalakShaNamupalabhyate tadA jaghanyA shuddhiH, yadA ca vireke dashabhirvegerdviprasthamAnadoShagamane kaphAntatvaM virecanasamyagyogalakShaNamupalabhyate tadA virecanasya jaghanyA shuddhirbhavati; evaM madhyapravarashuddhAvapi vamane pittAntatvaM, virecane kaphAntatvaM, samyagyogalakShaNaM j~jeyam| vegasa~gkhyAdoShamAnAbhidhAnAnantaraM samyakshuddhilai~ggikashuddheH pittAntatvAdilakShaNapratipAdanArthamihAbhidhAnaM, tena yaducyate AntikI, vaigikI, mAnikI, lai~ggikI ceti caturvidhA shuddhirihocyate vamanavirecanayoH, tadasmAkamasammatameva; kintu lai~ggikI caikA shuddhiH| tatra ca pittAntatvaM tathA ‘kramAtkaphaH’ ityAdigranthavakShyamANaM ca li~ggaM vamane, virecane ca kaphAntatvaM tathA ‘srotovishuddhIndriya’ ityAdigranthavakShyamANaM ca li~ggaM j~jeyam| tena yadatra AShADhavarmaNA “samyagvishuddhili~ggaM lakShaNato~atha mAnAcca vegAcca doShAgamanAccoktaM, kimidaM vyastaM samastaM vA” ityAdinA~a~akShiptaM, tadanabhyupagamanirastameva| anyeShAM tvatra parihArA vistarabhayAnna likhitAH| jaghanyAdishuddhitraividhyaM cAtra jaghanyamadhyotkRuShTadoShaviShayatayA vyavasthApanIyam| jaghanyAdishuddhilakShaNe~api yadvegena jaghanyAdishuddhilakShaNAbhidhAnaM, tat prAyobhAvitayA j~jeyam| doShamAnabhedena jaghanyAdimAnabhedaH pAramArthikaH; tena yatra vamane~aShTAbhirvegairdviprasthadoShasrutirbhavati tatra pravaraiva shuddhiH, yatra vamane ShaDbhireva vegaiH sArdhaprasthadoShasrutirbhavati tatra madhyaiva shuddhi;, yatra ca caturbhirapi vegairekaprasthadoShasrutistatra jaghanyashuddhireva; evaM virecaneShvapyudAhAryam| pittapravRuttirante yasmin tat pittAntam, evaM kaphAntamapi vyAkhyeyam| tena ‘kramAt kaphaH pittamathAnilashca’ ityanena yat samyagvamanalakShaNaM vaktavyaM, tathA ‘prAptishca viTpittakaphAnilAnAM’ ityanena ca samyagvirecanalakShaNaM yadvaktavyaM, tadanena sahAviruddhaM bhavati| tatra ca yadanilAgamanamante vaktavyaM tat pittAntasya kaphAntasya ca sUcakatayA j~jeyaM, niHsheShakRute hyAshayagate pitte kaphe ca vAyuH kevalaH sarati; tena ca kevalavAyusaraNena pittAntatA kaphAntatA ca j~jAyate| nanu yadi ‘kramAt kaphaH” ityAdinaiva granthenAyamartho~abhihitastat kathamiha pittAntaM ca vamanaM, kaphAntaM ca virekamAhuriti kRutaM? bUmaH- vegasa~gkhyAdoShamAnabhedapratipAdyamAnajaghanyAdishuddhitraye pittAntatvAdyanugatipratipAdanArthamihAbhidhAnam; evaM tadvamanavirecanasamyagyogalakShaNAnabhidhAne hi shiShyasya prabaladoShe~api puruShe~ayogashuddhAveva jaghanyashuddhigatavegamAnodaye sati atha pittAntatvAdyanudaye jaghanyashuddhibhramaH syAt evamnyadapyudAhAryam| vamane ca vireke ca yathA doShamApanaM kartavyaM tadAha- dvitrAnityAdi| dvitrAnityavyavasthitabhAShaNena malabhAgasyAmeyatAM darshayati; vamane tu pItamiti vamane pItamauShadhaM varjayitvA sheSho meyaH||13-14||-

12.sanskrit: kramAt kaphaH pittamathAnilashca yasyaiti samyagvamitaH sa iShTaH||15|| hRutpArshvamUrdhendriyamArgashuddhau tathA laghutve~api ca lakShyamANe|16|
12.commentary: samprati ‘kiM ca kRutAkRuteShu’ ityAdiprashnasyottaraM yathAkramamAha- kramAdityAdi| kramAdityanena vacanena yathoktakramala~gghanena kaphAdyAgamanaM na samyagyogalakShaNamiti darshayati; yataH kaphAdUrdhvaM gataM yadA pittaM bhavati tadA tu pittAgamane~api sati na shuddhiH, kintu yadaivAmAshayAdhobhAgagataM pittaM vamanamAnayati tadaiva shuddhiH, tat pittAnayanaM ca kaphAnayanAnantarameva bhavati; evaM samyakkRutavirecanalakShaNe~api kramAditipadasyArtho~atra vyAkhyeyaH||15||-

12.sanskrit: dushchardite sphoTakakoThakaNDUhRutkhAvishuddhirgurugAtratAM ca||16||
12.commentary: dushchardite ityAdyayogakRutavamanalakShaNam||16||

12.sanskrit: tRuNmohamUrcchAnilakopanidrAbalAdihAnirvamane~ati ca syAt|17|
12.commentary: tRuNmohetyAdyatikRutavamanali~ggam| atrAdishabdena varNasvarAdigrahaNam| nidrAhAnishcAtrAnilakopakRutaiva|17|

12.sanskrit: srotovishuddhIndriyasamprasAdau laghutvamUrjo~agniranAmayatvam||17|| prAptishca viTpittakaphAnilAnAM samyagviriktasya bhavet krameNa|18|
12.commentary: srotovishuddhItyAdi samyagvirecanalakShaNam| Urjo~agniriti paTuragniH | anAmayatvamiti virecanajetavyadoShajanitavikAravyapagamaH| prAptishcetyAdigranthArthaH sthAnAntare vyAkhyAta eva||17||-

12.sanskrit: syAcchleShmapittAnilasamprakopaH sAdastathA~agnergurutA pratishyA||18|| tandrA tathA cchardirarocakashca vAtAnulomyaM na ca durvirikte|19|
12.commentary: syAdityAdyayogakRutavirekalakShaNam| na ca vAtAnulomyamityarthaH ||18||-

12.sanskrit: kaphAsrapittakShayajAnilotthAH suptya~ggamardaklamavepanAdyAH||19|| nidrAbalAbhAvatamaHpraveshAH sonmAdahikkAshca virecite~ati|20|
12.commentary: kaphAsretyAdi virekAtiyogalakShaNam| kShayashabdaH kaphAdibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate||19||-

12.sanskrit: saMsRuShTabhaktaM navame~ahni sarpistaM pAyayetApyanuvAsayedvA||20|| tailAktagAtrAya tato nirUhaM dadyAtryahAnnAtibubhukShitAya| prasyAgate dhanvarasena bhojyaH samIkShya vA doShabalaM yathArham||21|| narastato nishyanuvAsanArho nAtyAshitaH syAdanuvAsanIyaH |22|
12.commentary: vamanavirecanakalpanAprastAvAgatasamyagyogAdilakShaNamabhidhAya bastikalpanAmAha- saMsRuShTabhaktamityAdi| saptabhirdinaiH kRutasaMsarjanakramasyAShTame bhuktamupayuktasya navame~ahni sarpiHpAnamanuvAsanaM vA deyam; atra vikalpadvaye yadi vamanAnantaraM virecanaM kartavyaM tadA navame~ahni sarpiHpAnam, atha virecanAnantaraM yadA bastirdeyastadA~anuvAsanaM navame~ahni deyamiti vyavasthA| vamamAnantaraM navamadivase sarpiH pAnaM pUrvaM noktaM tenedAnIM virecanAnantarakartavyanirUhA~ggAnuvAsanasamAnakAlatayA sarpiH pAnamapi darshitaM, tena na nirUhA~ggatA sarpiHpAnasya kalpanIyA| navamashca divaso~atra shodhanadinamArabhyaiva j~jeyaH; uktaM ca jatUkaNa- ‘shodhanAnantaraM navame~ahni snehapAnamanuvAsanaM vA” iti, tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “virecanAt saptarAtre gate jAtabalAya ca| kRutAnnAyAnuvAsyAya samyagdeyo~anuvAsanaH” (su.ci.a.37) iti| uttarabasticikitsite ca yaH peyAdikramAnantaraM rasasaMsarjanakrama uktaH, sa sarvakarmAvasAne prakRutibhojanagamanArthaM kartavyaH, na vamanavirecanakarmaparisamAptAveva, tenehAkRutarasasaMsargasyaiva navame dine sarpiHpAnamanuvAsanaM copapannam| yattu bhadrashaunake- “saMsRuShTabhaktaH sumanAH snehapIto dRuDhAnalaH| saMshuddhaH parato mAsAdanuvAsyastato naraH” ityuktaM, tat prAganuvAsanaviShayaM rogavisheShaviShayaM veti naitadviruddhaM bhavati; bahUni cAtra vyAkhyAnAni TIkAkRutAma~ggiri-saindhava-jejjaTeshvarasenAdInAM santi; anyaistu tadvyAkhyAnAni doShoddhArAdeva nirastAni| tailAktagAtrAyeti vacanamabhya~ggenApi snehaprayogadarshanArtham| svedastvatra pa~jcakarmapUrvatayA vihito~anukto~apyAyAtyeva; yaduktaM ‘tAnyupasthitadoShaNAM snehasvedopapAdanaiH| pa~jcakarmANi kurvIta” (sU.a.2) iti| dadyAtryahAditi anuvAsanadinAdUrdhvaM tryahAt, tena yathAvakShyamANakrameNa ekAhAd dvyahAdadhikAdvA snehAttadaharvA nirUho deyaH| nAtibubhukShitAyetyanena atibubhukShitasya nirUho~atiyogAyordhvagamanAya ca bhavatIti sUcayati| tatra dhanvarasena pratibhojanaM virecanavadagnimAndyAbhAvAdbalAvahatvAcca yuktameva; yaduktaM bhoje- “AmastakAdvishuddhasya nirUheNa rasAdikam| kimarthaM vihitaM bhojyaM saMsargashca viriktavat|| virekaH pAvakaM hanti tadadhiShThAnasamplavAt| na tu bastistathA tasmAdyayonnayati pAvakam’ iti| nirUha eva doShAgnibalApekShayA rasAdinA peyAdinA vA bhojanaM darshayannAha- samIkShya vA doShabalaM yathArhamiti; balamiti agnibalam| narastata ityAdinA nirUDhasyAnuvAsanamAha| nishItyanena nirUhAnantaraM taddine kriyamANamanuvAsanaM nishyeva kartavyamiti darshayati, na shIte vasante ca sadyonirUDhasya rAtrAvevAnuvAsanaM na deyamiti anye tu nishItyanena tadahareva nirUDhAya sAyamanuvAsanaM deyamiti darshayati, tena yathAvakShyamANavibhAgena rAtrau divA vA deyamityAhuH| anuvAsanArha iti vacanena yadi sAmatA mando vA pAvako bhavati tadA tadaharanuvAsanaM na deyamiti sUcayati| ata eva jatUkarNe dvitIyadivasa evAnuvAsanamuktaM- “tatastryahAnnirUhe vyuShite bhuktavato~anuvAsanam” iti; hArIte~api- “vyuShTaM rajanyAM prasamIkShya tasmAdbalAbalaM vA~apyanuvAsanIyaH” ityuktam| “sadyo nirUDho~anuvAsyaH syAt” iti vacanaM nirUhajanitavAtakShobhayuktapuruShaviShayam||20-21||-

12.sanskrit: shIte vasante ca divA~anuvAsyo rAtrau sharadgrIShmaghanAgameShu||22|| tAneva doShAn parirakShatA ye snehasya pAne parikIrtitAH prAk|23|
12.commentary: nishItyanena yannishAsamIpe~anuvAsanaM vihitaM tadeva kAlabhedena bhinnakAlaM darshayannAha- shIte ityAdi| shItashabdena shishirahemantayorapi grahaNam| diveti nishAsamIpe divAbhAge, rAtrAvapi ca dinasamIpAyAM rAtrau| doShAn parirakShatA doShAn dRuShTvA, antaraM ca doShavarjanena parirakShatA; ye snehasya pAne parikIrtitAH snehAdhyAye- “shleShmAdhiko divA shIte” (sU.a.13) ityAdinA granthena, ya evAkAlapItasnehadoShA bhavanti ta eva yathoktakAlaviparyayakRutAnuvAsane~api doShA bhavantItyuktaM bhavati| snehAdhyAye yadvAtapittAdhikatvAdivisheSheNApi rAtrau divA ca snehapAnaM vihitaM tadihApi samAnanyAyatvAdekadeshAbhidhAnenAparaikadeshAnumAnAcca j~jeyam||22||-

12.sanskrit: pratyAgate cApyanuvAsanIye divA pradeyaM vyuShitAya bhojyam||23|| sAyaM ca bhojyaM parato dvyahe vA tryahe~anuvAsyo~ahani pa~jcame vA | tryahe tryahe vA~apyatha pa~jcame vA dadyAnnirUhAdanuvAsanaM ca||24||
12.commentary: pratyAgate cetyAdau anuvAsanIye iti anuvAsanasnehe| vyuShitAyeti nirvikAraM rAtrivyuShitAya divA bhojyaM deyaM, tathA sAyaM ca bhojyaM deyam| anuvAsanAnantaraM punaranuvAsanakAlamAha- tryahe vetyAdi| atrApi tryahapa~jcAhavyavasthA pUrvavat; aya~jcAnuvAsanakAlo nirUhadina eva dAtavyAnuvAsane parij~jeyaH| anye tu paThanti yat- ‘parato dvyahe vA tryahe~anuvAsyo~ahani pa~jcame vA’ iti; vyAkhyAnayanti ca- parato dvyahe vA tryahe~anuvAsyo~ahani pa~jcame veti; atra tu dvyahe~anuvAsanamatiprabalavAtasya, anativRuddhavAtasya tryahe, pa~jcame tu pravRuddhakaphapittasyeti vyavasthA| dvitIyadinAnuvAsanaM hArIte~apyuktaM; vacanaM hi- “dRuShTvA~ativRuddhaM pavanasya rUpaM dine dine bastimudAharanti” iti; sushrute~apyuktaM- “rUkShasya bahuvAtasya snehabastiM dine dine| dadyAdvaidyastato~anyeShAmagnyAbAdhabhayAtryahAt” (su.ci.a.37) iti| ihApi ‘rUkShanityastu” ityAdinA, ‘vAtArtAshca dine dine” (si.a.4) ityantena dvyahe dAnaM vidhAsyati, tena ‘dvyahe vA tryahe vA’ iti pAThaH sAdhuH; ‘dvyahashabdena cAtra dinadvayasambandhamAtramucyate, na dvyahapUraNaM; tena prathamadivasadattAnuvAsanAt prabhRuti pUrNe tRutIye divase~anuvAsanaM prApnoti’ iti yaducyate, tannirastam; evaM tryahe~api tRutIyAhasambandha eva vivakShito j~jeya iti||23-24||

12.sanskrit: ekaM tathA trIn kaphaje vikAre pittAtmake pa~jca tu sapta vA~api| vAte navaikAdasha vA punarvA bastInayugmAn kushalo vidadhyAt||25||
12.commentary: samprati doShabhedenAnuvAsananiyamamAha- ekaM tathA trInityAdi| etacca ‘sa~gkhyAH kati’ iti prashnasyottaram; aparaM sa~gkhyAprashnasyotaraM ‘triMshanmatAH karmasu ’ ityAdinA bhaviShyati| kaphapittayoshca yadyapyanuvAsanaM na vihitaM, tathA~api vAtAnugatakaphapittaviShayatayaitadboddhavyam| punarvetyanena vAte nava ekAdasha vA kuryAt| ayugmAnityanena dvicatuHShaDAdisa~gkhyayA yugmadAnaM niShedhayati, ayugmadAnaM prabhAvAdevAtropakArIti maharShivacanAdbodhyaM, yathA- “yugmeShvahaHsu putrakAmau saMvasetAm” (shA.a.8) iti; upapattishcAtrAtiprasa~ggabhItyA na kathitA~a~acAryeNa| yattu- “trIn pa~jca vA~a~ahushcaturo~atha ShaD vA” ityAdinA yugmabastidAnaM vakShyati, tannirUhA~ggatayA snehanArthakriyamANAnuvAsanaviShayayugmabastidAnaM j~jeyam, iha tu pradhAnatayA kriyamANAnuvAsanaviShayamayugmadAnamiti na virodhaH| etena, yaduktamAShADhavarmaNA- “nirUhakAryakAraNamayugmadAnamasminnoktaM niShiddhapUrva ca, yogasyAnte kramAdekaM tathA trInityAdIn snehAn prAha” (?) iti, tannirastaM j~jeyam| ki~jca, ayugmAnityanena punarvetyanena ca yatrAnuvRuttyA~anuvAsanaM deyaM tatrAyugmakaM nirUhAntaritaM ca kartavyamityarthaH, tena yathoktasa~gkhyAkAnnirUhAn dattvA yathoktasa~gkhyayA sneho deyaH| viShamasa~gkhyopAdAnaM tu madhyavidhayA~api dvyahacaturahAdigrAhakaM bhavati , tenottaratra vakShyamANasa~gkhyAnuvAsanaM na virodhIti brUte| jatUkarNe~apyuktaM- “nirUhe vyuShite bhuktavato~anuvAsanaM paraM dvitIye~ahani pa~jcame vA tathaikAdashAhe~apakarShato dvitricaturAdi(?) vAtAdiShUcyate” iti||25||

12.sanskrit: naro viriktastu nirUhadAnaM vivarjayet saptadinAnyavashyam| shuddho nirUheNa virecanaM ca taddhyasya shUnyaM vikaseccharIram||26||
12.commentary: samprati nirUhavirecanayorantare~avashyaparihartavyakAlamAha- naro viriktastvityAdi| avashyamiti vacanAdekAhasAdhye~api vyAdhAvavashyaM saptadinacchedaH kartavya iti darshayati| yadyapivirecanAnantaraM niShiddha eva nirUhaH pa~jcakarmIyAyAM siddhau, tathA nirUDhasya virecanaM niShiddhaM, tathA~api tatkAlameva sa niShedhaH; tena tricaturAdidine~api prasaktinirAsArthamidaM vacanam| yattu virecanAnantaraM navame~ahnyanuvAsanakAlAduttarakAlameva nirUhavidhAnaM, tenArvAgbasteH prasaktirapi na syAdityucyate; tanna, yato~anuvAsanashuddhyapekShasaMsarjanakramasyeyaM vidhA, yadA~avarashuddhyA tryaheNaiva peyAdikramaH samApyate, tadA caturthadine~anuvAsanadAnAt pa~jcame ShaShThe vA dine nirUhaH prasajjyeta, atastannirAsArthametadvacanam| nirUhAnantaraM tu saMsarjanakramo nAstyeva, tena tryahaM snehaM dattvA virecanaprasaktirastyeva| saptAhAdarvAk saptAhaM yAvacca nirUhavirecanavarjane hetumAha- taddhyasyetyAdi| vikasediti hiMsyAt| shUnyamiti pUrvashodhanashUnyasharIraM punaH shodhanAddhiMsyAditi bhAvaH| yattu “AsaptAhAdvireko vA tatashcApi nirUhaNam” iti tantrAntare proktaM, tacca saMsargavidhayA kriyamANasaMshodhanakrame j~jeyam| tatrApi ca saptAhapUraNaM saMsarjanasnehAdInAmanumatavikalpaparihArAd vyAkhyeyam||26||

12.sanskrit: bastirvayaHsthApayitA sukhAyurbalAgnimedhAsvaravarNakRucca| sarvArthakArI shishuvRuddhayUnAM niratyayaH sarvagadApahashca||27|| viTshleShmapittAnilamUtrakarShI dArDhyAvahaH shukrabalapradashca| vishvaksthitaM doShacayaM nirasya sarvAn vikArAn shamayennirUhaH||28||
12.commentary: ‘ki~gguNo bastiH’ itiprashnasyottaraM bastirvayaHsthApayitetyAdi| ayaM cAsthApanaguNaH, anuvAsanasya tu dehe nirUheNa’ ityAdinA granthena guNAn vakShyati| vayaH sthApayatIti vayaHsthApayitA; vayaHsthApanatvaM cAsya srotaHshuddhikaratvAt| sarvArthakArIti sthiratvApakarShAdiviruddhArthasyApi bheShajavisheShayogAt| shishuvRuddhayUnAM niratyaya ityanena vamanavirecanAbhyAmutkarSha ucyate, te hi shishuvRuddhayorniShiddhe| sarvagadApahatvaM saMshamanena j~jeyaM, sarvAn vikArAn shamayedityanena doShasaMshodhanadvArA sarvagadApahatvamucyata iti na paunaruktyaM; kiMvA sarvAn vikArAniti sarvAvasthAn vikArAniti visheShaH||27-28||

12.sanskrit: dehe nirUheNa vishuddhamArge saMsnehanaM varNabalapradaM ca| na tailadAnAt paramasti ki~jciddravyaM visheSheNa samIraNArte ||29|| snehena raukShyaM laghutAM gurutvAdauShNyAcca shaityaM pavanasya hatvA| tailaM dadAtyAshu manaHprasAdaM vIryaM balaM varNamathAgnipuShTim ||30|| mUle niShikto hi yathA drumaH syAnnIlacchadaH komalapallavAgryaH| kAle mahAn puShpaphalapradashca tathA naraH syAdanuvAsanena||31||
12.commentary: dehe ityAdinA~anuvAsanaguNamAha| nirUheNa vishuddhamArge iti vacanAnnirUhashodhita eva mArge saMsarjadanuvAsanaM yathoktaguNakartRu bhavatIti darshayati| na tailadAnAdityatra tailashabdena snehopalakShaNena kecidghRutamapi grAhayanti, kintu tailamevAtra vAtaharapradhAnatayA brUte iti yuktaM pashyAmaH; tathA hyatra auShNyAcchaityamityuktam, auShNyaM ca na sarpiShIti; snehA majjavarjitA anuvAsanAdhikRutA apyapradhAnatvAnnAtra ghRutamanumanyate| paramastItyAdau dravyamiti kAraNaM, tacca kAraNamanilaprashamanena j~jeyam, ‘nAnvAsanAt ki~jcidihAsti karma’ iti kecit paThanti| tailakRutyameva sakAraNaM vyAkaroti- snehenetyAdi| tailaM cAnuvAsane pakvameva j~jeyam; apakvasya tu ‘na cAmaM praNayet snehaM sa hyabhiShyandayedgudam’ (si.a.4) ityanena niShiddhatvAt| atra tailAnilayorviparItaguNayormelake dravyaprabhAvAttailameva vAtaM hanti, na vAtastailam; aNutvaM guNo yadyapi taile vAte cAsti, tathA~apIha prabhAvAdvAtasUkShmAvayavasambaddhaM tailaM snehAdinA vAtaM jayati, tena samAnamapyaNutvamiha viruddhArthakAryeveti| tailasya yathoktakAryakartRutve dRuShTAntamAha- mUle ityAdi| mUladRuShTAntena cAnuvAsanena sAkShAttarpaNIyasya gudasya dehamUlatvaM darshayati, uktaM hi parAshare- “mUlaM gudaM sharIrasya sirAstatra pratiShThitAH| sarvaM sharIraM puShNanti mUrdhAnaM yAvadAshritAH” iti; tathA~anuvAsanAdapi naro balavIryAdyupeto~apatyavAMshca syAdityarthaH||29-31||

12.sanskrit: stabdhAshca ye sa~gkucitAshca ye~api ye pa~ggavo ye~api ca bhagnarugNAH| yeShAM ca shAkhAsu caranti vAtAH shasto visheSheNa hi teShu bastiH||32|| AdhmApane vigrathite purIShe shUle ca bhaktAnabhinandane ca| evamprakArAshca bhavanti kukShau ye cAmayAsteShu ca bastiriShTaH||33|| yAshca striyo vAtakRutopasargA garbhaM na gRuhNanti nRubhiH sametAH| kShINendriyA ye ca narAH kRushAshca bastiH prashastaH paramaM ca teShu||34||
12.commentary: sAmAnyena nirUhAnuvAsanayorguNamAha- stabdhAshca ye ityAdi| bhagnA iti bhagnakAyAH ; rugNA iti sandhimuktAH| bhaktAnabhinandane arocake| vAtakRutopasargA iti vAtakRutopadravAH| kShINendriyA iti atikShINashukrAH| atra shuddhavAtAdiShvanuvAsanaM, bhaktAnabhinandanaprakAreShu ca nirUha ityAdyartho~anusaraNIyaH||32-34||

12.sanskrit: uShNAbhibhUteShu vadanti shItA~jchItAbhibhUteShu tathA sukhoShNAn| tatpratyanIkauShadhasamprayuktAn sarvatra bastIn pravibhajya yu~jjyAt ||35||
12.commentary: samprati keShu ca kashca bastiriti prashnasyotaram- uShNAbhibhUteShvityAdi| uShNAbhibhUte tathA shItAbhibhUte iti vaktavye, yena ‘sarvatra’ iti karoti, tena snigdharUkShaguruladhvabhibhUte~api tadviparItauShadhasampAdito vastirdeya iti darshayati||35||

12.sanskrit: na bRuMhaNIyAn vidadhIta bastIn vishodhanIyeShu gadeShu vaidyaH| kuShThapramehAdiShu medureShu nareShu ye cApi vishodhanIyAH||36||
12.commentary: nityavishodhanIyagadAnAha- kuShThapramehAdiShvityAdi| atra, AdishabdenArocakatandrAshlIpadAdInAM grahaNam| medureShviti medasviShu||36||

12.sanskrit: kShINakShatAnAM na vishodhanIyAnna shoShiNAM no bhRushadurbalAnAm| na mUrcchitAnAM na vishodhitAnAM yeShAM ca doSheShu nibaddhamAyuH||37||
12.commentary: kShINakShatAnAM neti kShINA rAjayakShmiprabhRutayo j~jeyAH| vishodhanIyAniti apakarShaNakArakAn| yeShAM ca doSheShu nibaddhamAyuriti ye saMshodhanaharaNamAtreNaiva prANA~jjahati||37||

12.sanskrit: shAkhAgatAH koShThagatAshca rogA marmordhvasarvAvayavA~ggajAshca| ye santi teShAM na hi kashcidanyo vAyoH paraM janmani heturasti||38|| viNmUtrapittAdimalAshayAnAM vikShepasa~gghAtakaraH sa yasmAt| tasyAtivRuddhasya shamAya nAnyadbastiM vinA bheShajamasti ki~jcit||39|| tasmAccikitsArdhamiti bruvanti sarvAM cikitsAmapi bastimeke|40|
12.commentary: basterbahuviShayAM stutimAcakShANaH ‘ki~gguNo bastiH’ iti prashnasyaivottaraM punarAha- shAkhAgatA ityAdi| shAkhAkoShThamarmagatA ityanena trividhashAkhAdirogamargo gRuhItaH; marmajashabdena hi madhyamarogamArgAshrayiNAM sandhijAnAmapi sAhacaryAdgrahaNam; iha marmAsthisndhayo hi madhyamo rogamArga uktaH| Urdhvasarvashabdena ca UrdhvAdhastiryagbhedAdapyuktarogamArgatrayagrahaNam| sarvAvayavA~ggajashabdena ca prAdeshikasarvA~ggabhedAdapyuktagrahaNam; vAyoH paramiti vAyoH paro na kashcit shreShTha iti yAvat| etena yadyapi kaphapitte api rogakAraNe bhavataH, tathA~api vAyureva shreShTha ityucyate| vAyoH shreShThatva eva hetumAha- viNmUtretyAdi| pittAdItyatrAdishabdena kaphasya grahaNaM, (na ca malashabdena kaphasya grahaNaM ,) malashabdena cetaradhAtumalAnAM khamalAdInAM ca grahaNam| Ashayashabdena malavyatiriktaprasAdAkhyAnAmAshayAnAM dhAtUnAM ca grahaNam| vikShepasa~gghAtakara iti viyogamelakakaraH; etena, yasmAdvAyureva doShamaladhAtUnAM saMyogavibhAgau karoti, tena doShadUShyaviNmalamelakarUpanikhilavyAdhikaraNe vAyureva pradhAnaM bhavatIti bhAvaH| kiMvA AshayashabdaH pratyekaM viDAdibhiH sambadhyate, sthAnena ca sthAnino labhyante, viDAdisaMyogavibhAgenaiva ca sarvavyAdhikaraNaparigraho bhavati| bhavatvevaM vAtasya prAdhAnyamataH kimityAha- tasyetyAdi| bheShajamiti pradhAnaM bheShajaM, yaduktaM- ‘bastirvAtaharANAm’ (sU.a.25) iti| ato bastAvardhacikitsArUpatA tathA sarvacikitsArUpatA ca yuktaiva||38-39||-

12.sanskrit: nAbhipradeshaM kaTipArshvakukShiM gatvA shakRuddoShacayaM viloDya ||40|| saMsnehya kAyaM sapurIShadoShaH samyak sukhenaiti ca yaH sa bastiH |41|
12.commentary: tatra basteH kRutAkRutalakShaNAni krameNAha- nAbhItyAdi| viloDyeti sa~gkShobhya| saMsnehya kAyamiti vIryarUpeNa sAreNa kAyaM vyApya, uktaM hi- “vIryeNa bastirAdatte doShAnApAdamastakAt” (su.ci.a.35) iti| snehashabdena ca sAro~abhidhIyate; yathA- “dehaH snehaparikShayAt” (ci.a.8) iti| samyagiti niravasheSheNa| sukheneti vikAramakRutvA||40||-

12.sanskrit: prasRuShTaviNmUtrasamIraNatvaM rucyagnivRuddhyAshayalAghavAni||41|| rogopashAntiH prakRutisthatA ca balaM ca tat syAt sunirUDhali~ggam|42|
12.commentary: tAdAtvikabastisamyagyogalakShaNamabhidhAyottarakAlabhavamAha- prasRuShTetyAdi| ‘AshayalAghavAni’ ityatra ‘AmayalAghavAni’ iti pAThe rogopashAntirityanantaraM vAshabdo j~jeyaH, tena rogopashAntiriha nirUhasAdhyavikArANAmupashAntiH||41||-

12.sanskrit: syAdrukchirohRudgudabastili~gge shophaH pratishyAyavikartike ca||42|| hRullAsikA mArutamUtrasa~ggaH shvAso na samyak ca nirUhite syuH|43|
12.commentary: syAdityAdi bastyayogalakShaNam| na samya~gnirUhite iti ayogena nirUhite||42||-

12.sanskrit: li~ggaM yadevAtivirecitasya bhavettadevAtinirUhitasya||43||
12.commentary: bastyatiyogalakShaNamatideshenAha- li~ggamityAdi||43||

12.sanskrit: pratyetyasaktaM sashakRucca tailaM raktAdibuddhIndriyasamprasAdaH | svapnAnuvRuttirlaghutA balaM ca sRuShTAshca vegAH svanuvAsite syuH||44||
12.commentary: anuvAsanasamyagyogalakShaNamAha- pratyetItyAdi| asaktamiti sa~ggaM vinA| raktAdayaH dhAtavaH| svapnAnuvRutiH nidrAnuvRuttiH| sRuShTA iti abaddhAH||44||

12.sanskrit: adhaHsharIrodarabAhupRuShThapArshveShu rugrUkShakharaM ca gAtram | grahashca viNmUtrasamIraNAnAmasamyagetAnyanuvAsitasya ||45|| hRullAsamohaklamasAdamUrcchAvikartikA cAtyanuvAsitasya|46|
12.commentary: adha ityAdyanuvAsanAyogalakShaNam| rUkShakharatA cAtra sharIrasyAsnehanAdeva| hRullAsAdi atiyogalakShaNam||45||-

12.sanskrit: yasyeha yAmAnanuvartate trIn sneho naraH syAt sa vishuddhadehaH||46|| AshvAgate~anyastu punarvidheyaH sneho na saMsnehayati hyatiShThan|47|
12.commentary: ucitasnehapratyAgamanakAlamAha- yasyetyAdi| yAmAniti praharAn| sa vishuddhadeha iti sa anuvAsanaprayogasamyagyogAdanuvAsanavyApattirahita ityarthaH| AshvAgate iti shIghraM pratyAgate, anyastu vidheya iti tadaivAnyaH sneho deyaH| punaH snehadAnopapattimAha- sneho na saMsnehayati hyatiShThanniti||46||-

12.sanskrit: triMshanmatAH karma nu bastayo hi kAlastato~ardhena tatashca yogaH||47|| sAnvAsanA dvAdasha vai nirUhAH prAk sneha ekaH paratashca pa~jca| kAle trayo~ante puratastathaikaH snehA nirUhAntaritAshca ShaT syuH||48|| yoge nirUhAstraya eva deyAH snehAshca pa~jcaiva parAdimadhyAH|49|
12.commentary: samprati sa~gkhyAprashnasyottaravisheShamAha- triMshadityAdi| karmakAlayogasa~jj~jA yathAkramaM triMshatShoDashAShTabastisamudayeShu j~jeyA| kAlastato~ardhenetyatra ardhashabdo na samaprativacanaH ; tena triMshadadha ShoDasha bhavanti| sAnvasanA ityAdinA karmAdInAM nirUhAnuvAsanavibhAgamAha| ekamanuvAsanaM dattvA dIyanta iti sAnvasanAH, evamanuvAsanena pratyekaM yogAd dvAdasha nirUhAshcaturviMshatirbastayo bhavanti| prAgiti Aramme| parata iti dvAdashanirUhottarakAle| nirUhAntaritAshca ShaT syuriti nirUheNAntarI kRutAH, evaM ca dvAdasha bastayaH pUraNIyAH| pa~jcaiva parAdimadhyA iti pa~jca snehA ante madhye Adau ca yeShAM vibhaktAste tathA; atra cAdau snehadvayam, ante ca snehadvayaM, nirUhatrayamadhye caikamanuvAsanam, evaM pa~jca snehA bhavanti| ye tu nirUhadina evAnuvAsanaM vadanti tanmate AdAveka eva, ante~api dinAntare ekaH, evaM pa~jca bhavanti; evaM karmakAlayorapi nirUhadina eva dinAntare vA~anuvAsanaM vyAkhyeyam| atra caikasnehAntaritAnAM nirUhANAM dAne vAtakShobho nAsha~gkanIyaH, karmAdiShu nirUhA yApanAbastirUpA dIyante, te snigdhA eveti kRutvA na vAtakShobhakA bhavanti| ete ca karmAdayo yadyapi shAstrapradesheShu na vyavahriyante, tathA~api tadvidyavyavahArArthameveyaM karmAdisa~jj~jA, yathA yamakamahAcchapAnAdisa~jj~jA; tena karmAdisa~jj~jAyAH shAstre vyavahArAdarshanAt karmAdipratipAdako grantho~anArSha iti yaducyate, tannirastam| karmAdisa~jj~jA ca tantrAntare~apyasti| tathAhi jatUkarNaH- “bastayastriMshat ShoDashAShTau ca karmakalayogAH; nirUhAH snehAntaritA dvAdasha ShaT trayaH; ekasnehArambhAH pa~jcatryekAntAH” iti; hArIte~api- “triMshakaM karma budhA vadanti” ityAdyuktam| karmAdInAM prayogaM kecidvAtAdiShu vadanti||47-48||-

12.sanskrit: trIn pa~jca vA~a~ahushcaturo~atha ShaDvA vAtAdikAnAmanuvAsanIyAn ||49|| snehAn pradAyAshu bhiShagvidadhyAt srotovishudyarthamato nirUhAn|50|
12.commentary: trIn pa~jcetyAdinA snehanArthamanuvAsanamAha| atra ye ‘vAtAdikAnAM’ iti paThanti, teShAmAdishabdena pittakaphayorapi grahaNaM; bahuvacanaM tu tadguNasaMvij~jAnabahuvrIhiNA vAtasya grahaNAdbahutvasa~gkhyAyogAdupapannam| yathoktaM kuShThanidAne- ‘vAtAdiShu praduShTeShu” (ni.a.5) iti, tathA kiyantaHshirasIye~api “vAtAdInAM rasAdInAM” (sU.a.17) iti bahutvaM nirdiShTam| anye tu- ‘vAtAdhikAnAM’ iti paThanti| atra caturNAM ShaNNAM ca snehAnAM yugmarUpANAmapi dAnamaviruddhameva, etadanuvAsanasya nirUhA~ggatayA snehanArthaM kriyamANatvAt; ayugmadAnaM tu ‘bastInayugmAn’ ityanena svapradhAnatayA~anuvAsanasya vihitamiti bhinnaviShayatayA na virodhaH; yataH snehanaprayojanamanuvAsanaM snehe bhUta evAyugmadAnena nivartanIyaM; kiMvA, ayugmA tantrato vyAkhyAnena sa~gkhyaivocyate, tathAhi- trIn, pa~jca, trIn catura iti sapta, pa~jca catura iti nava, pa~jca ShaDityekAdasha, iti pa~jca vikalpA iha vidhIyante| tantrAntare snehasya yugmadAnamuktaM, yathA- “rUkShasya bahuvAtasya dvau trIn vA~apyanuvAsanAn| dadyAt snigdhatanuM j~jAtvA tataH pashcAnnirUhayet” (su.ci.a.37) iti| srotaHshabdena vibaddhasirA~abhihitA||49||-

12.sanskrit: vishuddhadehasya tataH krameNa snigdhaM talasveditamuttamA~ggam||50|| virecayettrirdvirathaikasho vA balaM samIkShya trividhaM malAnAm| uraHshirolAghavamindriyAcchyaM srotovishuddhishca bhavedvishuddhe||51|| galopalepaH shiraso gurutvaM niShThIvanaM cApyatha durvirikte| shirokShisha~gkhashravaNArtitodAvatyarthashuddhe timiraM ca pashyet||52|| syAttarpaNaM tatra mRudu dravaM ca snigdhasya tIkShNaM tu punarna yoge|53|
12.commentary: samprati kramAgatashirovirecanasya kalpanAmasamyagyogAyegAtiyogalakShaNaM cAha- vishuddhetyAdi| vishuddhadehasyeti etacca pa~jcakarmasampAdanIyanRuviShayatvaM shuddhipUrvakatvaM shirovirecanasyehocyate; tena vamanAdinA~ashuddhe~api shirovirecanaikasampadyi puruShe~ayaM kramoj~jeyaH| snigdhamiti abhya~ggashirobastipAnAdinA| talasveditamiti hastatalasveditam| trirdvirathaikasha iti taddina eva doShANAmutkRuShTatvAdibalatraividhyamapekShya yathAyogyatayA yojyam| indriyAcchyamiti cakShurAdInAM svaviShaye pATavam| timiraM ca pashyediti tamovyAptaM sarvaM pashyedityarthaH| tasyAtiyogAyogayoshcikitsitamanu vaktavyatayA~anuSha~ggatAmAha- syAttarpaNamityAdi| mRudu dravaM cetyanenAtiyogacikitsitam| tIkShNaM tu punarna yoge iti ayoge shirovirecanasya punastIkShNaM shirovirecanaM deyam||50-52||-

12.sanskrit: ityAturasvasthasukhaH prayogo balAyuShorvRuddhikRudAmayaghnaH||53||
12.commentary: uktaM pa~jcakarmaprayogamupasaMharati- ityAturetyAdi| Aturasvasthasukha iti vacanena Ature AmayasyApahantRutayA, svasthe ca balAyurvRuddhikartRutayA yathoktapa~jcakarmaprayogaH sukhaheturbhavatIti j~jeyam| svasthe ca pa~jcakarmapravRuttiH “mAdhavaprathame mAsi” (sU.a.7) ityAdinA sUtrasthAne proktaiva j~jeyA||53||

12.sanskrit: kAlastu bastyAdiShu yAti yAvAMstAvAn bhaveddviH parihArakAlaH|54|
12.commentary: ‘kRute kiyAn vA parihArakAlaH’ ityasyottaramAha- kAlastvityAdi| tAvAn bhaveddviH parihArakAla iti bastyAdiprayoge yAvAn kAlo vyApyate, tataH kAlAddviguNaM kAlaM yAvat parihAryatvenoktaM parihartavyam| atra Adishabdena vamanavirecanashirovirecanAnAM grahaNaM, bastestvAdau vyutpAdanena prAdhAnyaM darshayati|54|

12.sanskrit: atyAsanasthAnavacAMsi yAnaM svapnaM divA maithunavegarodhAn||54|| shItopacArAtapashokaroShAMstyajedakAlAhitabhojanaM ca|55|
12.commentary: ‘kiM varjanIyaM’ iti prashnasyottaram- atyAsanetyAdi| Asanam upaviShTAvasthAnam| sthAnam UrdhvatayA sthAnam| yAnaM rathAshvAdinA yAnam| eta AviShkRutatamA ihoktAH; tena krodhAticintanAdayo ye~apyupakalpanIyAdau vamanAdiprayoge niShiddhAste~api na sevyA eva||54||-

12.sanskrit: baddhe praNIte viShamaM ca netre mArge tathA~arshaHkaphaviDvibaddhe ||55|| na yAti bastirna sukhaM nireti doShAvRuto~alpo yadi vA~alpavIryaH|56|
12.commentary: ‘praNIyamAnaH’ ityAdi prashnasyottaraM baddhe ityAdi| netre baddhe viShamaM praNIte ca gudAvayavaruddhatvAnna yAti| tathA ‘na sukhaM nireti’ ityAdinA ‘sucirAcca kena’ iti prashnasyottaram| na sukhaM niretIti cireNa duHkhaM kRutvA cAgacchatItyarthaH| doShAvRuta iti doSheNa balIyasA~avaruddhaH| alpa iti alpamAnaH| alpavIrya iti uShNalavaNAdyabhAvAnmRuduvIryaH||55||-

12.sanskrit: prApte tu varconilamUtravege vAte~ativRuddhe~alpabale gude vA||56|| atyuShNatIkShNashca mRudau ca koShThe praNItamAtraH punareti bastiH|57|
12.commentary: prApte cetyanena shIghrAgamanahetumAha| vAte~ativRuddhe sneho gude vAtena pratihatatvAnna yAtyAshayaM, tataH shIghramAgacchati; alpabale gude snehaM dhArayituM na shaknoti puruShaH, alpabalatvaM gudasya saMvaraNIvalIdArbalyAt||56||-

12.sanskrit: medaHkaphAbhyAmanilo niruddhaH shUlA~ggasuptishvayathUn karoti||57|| snehaM tu yu~jjannabudhastu tasmai saMvardhayatyeva hi tAn vikArAn| rogAstathA~anye~apyavitarkyamANAH paraspareNAvagRuhItamArgAH||58|| sandUShitA dhAtubhireva cAnyaiH svairbheShajairnopashamaM vrajanti|59|
12.commentary: ‘sAdhyAH’ ityAdi prashnasyottaraM- medaHkaphAbhyAmityAdi| medasA kaphena veti medaH kaphAbhyAm| atra shUlAdInnirIkShya shuddhavAtabhrAntyA snehaM prayu~gkte, nAvaraNaM jAnAti, ata eva ‘abudhaH’ iti kRutam| anyatrApyuktaM- “kupite mArgasaMrodhAnmedasA vA kaphena vA| ativRuddhe~anile nAdau shastaM snehena bRuMhaNam” iti| avitarkyamANA iti asamyagj~jAyamAnAH| asamyagj~jAyamAnatva eva hetumAha- paraspareNetyAdi| rogashabdenAtra doSho~abhipretaH| paraspareNa pratibaddhamArgA ato durgrahA bhavanti, tathA dhAtubhishca raktAdibhiH sandUShitAH sammUrcchitAH santo durj~jeyA bhavanti, avij~jAtAshca svairbheShajairna prashamaM vrajanti; svairbheShajairiti mArgAvarodhAdikAraNadoShadhAtvantaranirapekShakairekadoShabheShajaiH; taddhi tathAbhUtAnAM bheShajaM yaugikaM na bhavatyeva, ato~anupashamo yukta evaH evaM ca doShANAM parasparAvarodhAn tathA dhAtusammUrcchanavisheShAMshcAvagamyaiva vyAdhau prapa~jco~anusaraNIyaH||57-58||-

12.sanskrit: sarvaM ca rogaprashamAya karma hInAtimAtraM viparItakAlam||59|| mithyopacArAcca na taM vikAraM shAntiM nayet pathyamapi prayuktam|60|
12.commentary: atha vij~jAte~api vyAdhau bhiShajA~asamyakprayogAdibhirvardhamAne~asiddhimAha- sarvaM cetyAdi| viparItakAlamiti anucitakAlakRutam| mithyopacArAcceti bheShajAnAM tathA~akaraNAt, yathA- bheShajasya samyakpariNAme sati bhoktavyam| yadyaugikaM bheShajaM tat samyak prayuktaM sidhyatIti siddhAntaH||59||-

12.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- prashnAnimAn dvAdasha pa~jcakarmANyuddishya siddhAviha kalpanAyAm||60|| prajAhitArthaM bhagavAn mahArthAn samyagjagAdarShivaro~atriputraH||61||
12.commentary: prashnAnityAdinA~adhyAyArthaM sa~ggRuhNAti| sa~ggrahashca vyaktaH||60||-

12.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute~aprApte dRuDhabalasampUrite siddhisthAne kalpanAsiddhirnAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
12.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM siddhisthAne kalpanAsiddhirnAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

1.sanskrit: athAto dIrgha~jjIvitIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
1.commentary: guNatrayavibhedena mUrtitrayamupeyuShe| trayIbhuve trinetrAya trilokIpataye namaH||1|| sarasvatyai namo yasyAH prasAdAt puNyakarmabhiH| buddhidarpaNasa~gkrAntaM jagadadhyakShamIkShyate||2|| brahmadakShAshvideveshabharadvAjapunarvasuhutAshaveshacarakaprabhRutibhyo namo namaH||3|| pAta~jjalamahAbhAShyacarakapratisaMskRutaiH| manovAkkAyadoShANAM hartre~ahipataye namaH||4|| naradattagurUddiShTacarakArthAnugAminI| kriyate cakradattena TIkA~a~ayurvedadIpikA||5|| sabhyAH sadguruvAksudhAsrutiparisphItashrutInasmi vo nAlaM toShayituM payodapayasA nAmbhonidhistRupyati| vyAkhyAbhAsarasaprakAshanamidaM tvasmin yadi prApyate kvApi kvApi kaNo guNasya tadasau karNe kShaNaM dhIyatAm ||6|| iha hi dharmArthakAmamokShaparipanthirogopashamAya brahmaprabhRutibhiH praNItAyurvedatantreShvativistaratvena samprati vartamAnAlpAyurmedhasAM puruShANAM na samyagarthAdhigamaH, tadanadhigamAcca tadvihitArthAnAmananuShThAne tathaivopaplavo rujAmiti manvAnaH paramakAruNiko~atrabhavAnagnivesho~alpAyurmedhasAmapi sukhopalambhArthaM nAtisa~gkShepavistaraM kAyacikitsApradhAnamAyurvedatantraM praNetumArabdhavAn| tasmiMshca shlokanidAnavimAnashArIrendriyacikitsitakalpasiddhisthAnAtmake~abhidhAtavye nikhilatantrapradhAnArthAbhidhAyakatayA shlokasthAnamevAgre vaktavyamamanyata| vakShyati hi- “shlokasthAnaM samuddiShTaM tantrasyAsya shiraH shubham| catuShkANAM mahArthAnAM sthAne~asmin sa~ggrahaH kRutaH” (sU. a.30) iti| tatra ca sUtrasthAne~apyutpannarogagrahaNe tvarayA rogopaghAtibheShajAbhidhAyicatuShke~abhidhAtavye nikhilatantrabIjabhUtahetuli~ggauShadhAdyarthasya tathA tantrapravRuttya~ggaprayojanavadAyurvedAgamAderabhidhAyakaM dIrgha~jjIvitIyamadhyAyamabhidhAtumArabdhavAn| shrotRujanapravRuttihetvabhidheyaprayojanasambandhopadarshakaM shrotRubuddhisamAdhAnAya vyAkhyAnapratij~jAparamaShTapadamaShTasa~gkhyAyA ma~ggalatvenAdau sUtraM niveshitavAn- athAto dIrgha~jjIvitIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAma iti| yato nirabhidheye kacaTatapAdau sAbhidheye vA niShprayojane kAkadantaparIkShAdau prekShAvatAM pravRuttirnopalabhyate, tenAdAvabhidheyaprayojane abhidhAtavye| yaduktaM- “abhidheyaphalaj~jAnavirahastimitodyamAH| shrotumalpamapi granthaM nAdriyante hi sAdhavaH” iti| abhidheyavattvaprayojanavattvanirvAhArthaM cAbhidheyashAstrayorabhidhAnAbhidheyalakShaNaH sambandhaH, prayojanashAstrayoshca sAdhyasAdhanabhAvalakShaNo~abhidhAtavyaH| tatrehAbhidheyaM hitAhitAdirUpeNAyuH| vakShyati hi- “hitAhitaM sukhaM duHkhamAyustasya hitAhitam| mAnaM ca tacca yatroktamAyurvedaH sa ucyate” (sU. a.30) iti| atra ca sarvAbhidheyAvarodho yathAsthAnameva vyAkaraNIyaH| prayojanaM ca dhAtusAmyam| yathoktaM- “dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA tantrasyAsya prayojanam” (sU. a.1) iti| sambandho~apyAyuHshAstrayorabhidhAnAbhidheyalakShaNaH, prayojanena ca dhAtusAmyena samamasya shAstrasya heyopAdeyaj~jAnAvAntaravyApArasya sAdhyasAdhanabhAvalakShaNaH| tadetatsarvaM dIrgha~jjIvitIyamityanena padena dIrgha~jjIvitashabdamadhikRutya kRutaprayojanAbhidhAyaka ‘dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA’ ityAdivAkyAbhidhAyakena darshitaM mantavyam| nanu, prayojanAbhidhAnaM shAstrapravRuttyarthamiti yaduktaM tanna yuktaM, yato na prayojanAbhidhAnamAtreNa prayojanavattAvadhAraNaM, vipralambhakasaMsAramocanapratipAdakAdishAstreShu prayojanAbhidhAne~api niShprayojanatvadarshanAt| atha manyase, AptaprayojanAbhidhAnametadato~atra yathArthatvaM; nanu bho kathamayaM prayojanAbhidhAyI AptaH? tadabhihitashAstrasya yathArthatvAditi cet, hanta na yAvacchAstrasya prayojanavattvAvadhAraNaM na tAvacchAstrapravRuttiH, na yAvacchAstrapravRuttirna tAvacchAstrasya yathArthatvAvadhAraNaM, na yAvacchAstrasya yathArthatvAvadhAraNaM na tAvacchAstrasya karturAptatvamavadhAryate, AptatvAnavadhRutau ca kutastadabhihitaprayojanavattAvadhAraNamiti cakrakamApadyate ; atha manyase, mA bhavatu prayojanavattAvadhAraNam, artharUpaprayojanavattAsandeha eva pravartako bhaviShyati, kRuShyAdAvapi hi pravRuttirarthasandehAdeva; nahi tatra kRuShIvalAnAM phalalAbhAvadhAraNaM vidyate, antarA~avagrahAderapi sambhAvyamAnatvAt; nanvevamasatyapi prayojanAbhidhAne saprayojananiShprayojanashAstradarshanAcchAstratvameva prayojanavattAsandehopadarshakamastu, tathA~apyalaM prayojanAbhidhAnena| naivaM, nahi sAmAnyena prayojanasandehaH prayojanavisheShArthinaM tathA pravartayati yathA~abhipretaprayojanavisheShaviShayaH sandehaH; abhipretavisheShaviShayashca sandeho na visheShaviShayasmaraNamantarA bhavati, ato ye tAvadanavadhRutAgniveshaprAmANyAsteShAM dhAtusAmyasAdhanamidaM shAstraM na vetyevamAkAravisheShasandehotpAdanArthaM prayojanavisheShAbhidhAnaM; ye punaH paramarSheragniveshasyAdyata evAvadhRutaprAmANyAsteShAM tadabhihitaprayojanavattAvadhAraNenaiva pravRuttiriti yuktaM prayojanAbhidhAnam| prayojanAbhidhAyivAkye tu svalpaprayatnabodhye prayojanasAmAnyasandehAdeva pravRuttirupapannA, na punaranekasaMvatsarakleshabodhye shAstre| tadevaM yaducyate- ‘prayojanAbhidhAyivAkyapravRuttAvapi prayojanamabhidhAtavyaM, tathA cAnavasthA’ iti, tannirastaM bhavati| athetyAdisUtre~athashabdo brahmAdipraNItatantreShvalpAyurmedhasAmarthAnavadhAraNasya, tathA~abhIShTadevatAnamaskArashAstrakaraNArthagurvAj~jAlAbhayorAnantarye prayukto~api shAstrAdau svarUpeNa ma~ggalaM bhavatyudakAharaNapravRuttodakumbhadarshanamiva prasthitAnAm| granthAdau ma~ggalasevAnirastAntarAyANAM granthakartRushrotRUNAmavighneneShTalAbho bhavatIti yuktaM ma~ggalopAdAnam| athashabdasya ma~ggalatve smRutiH- “o~gkArashcAthashabdashca dvAvetau brahmaNaH purA| kaNThaM bhittvA viniryAtau tena mA~ggalikAvubhau” iti| shAstrAntare cAdau ma~ggalatvena dRuShTo~ayamathashabdaH| yathA- “atha shabdAnushAsanam” (vyA. ma. bhA. a. 1 pA. 1 A. 1), “athAto dharmaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH” (vai . a.1A.1sU.1) ityAdau| abhIShTadevatAnamaskArastu granthAdau shiShTAcAraprAptaH paramashiShTenAgniveshena kRuta eva, anyathA shiShTAcArala~gghanena shiShTatvameva na syAd vyAkhyAnAntarAyabhayashca ; tathA granthAviniveshitasyApi namaskArasya pratyavAyApahatvAcca na granthaniveshanam| yathA ca gurvAj~jAlAbhAnantarametattantrakaraNaM tathA “atha maitrIparaH puNyam” (sU. a. 1) ityAdau sphuTameva| granthakaraNe ca gurvanumatipratipAdanena granthasyopAdeyatA pradarshitA bhavati| yat punaH shiShyaprashnAnantaryArthatvamathashabdasya varNyate tanna mAM dhinoti, nahi shiShyAn puro vyavasthApya shAstraM kriyate; shrotRubuddhisthIkAre tu shAstrakaraNaM yuktaM, na ca buddhisthIkRutAH praShTAro bhavanti| ataH shabdo~adhikAraprAgavadhyupadarshakaH, ata UrdhvaM yadupadekShyAmo dIrgha~jjIvitIyaM taditi; yadi vA hetau, yena brahmAdipraNItAyurvedatantrANAmuktena nyAyenotsambandhatvamiva , ato hetordIrgha~jjIvitIyaM vyAkhyAsyAma iti yojanIyam| dIrgha~jjIvitIyamityatra dIrgha~jjIvitashabdo~asminnastIti matvarthe “adhyAyAnuvAkayorluk ca” (pA. a. 5/2/60) iti chapratyayaH| yadi vA dIrgha~jjIvitashabdamadhikRutya kRuto grantho~adhyAyarUpastantrarUpo vA, ityasyAM vivakShAyAm “adhikRutya kRute granthe” (pA. a. 4/3/87) ityadhikArAt “shishukrandayamasabha” (pA. a. 4/3/88) ityAdinA chaH| evamanyatrApyeva~jjAtIye mantavyam| atra ca satyapi shabdAntare dIrgha~jjIvitashabdenaiva sa~jj~jA kRutA, dIrgha~jjIvitashabdasyaiva pravacanAdau niveshAt prashastatvAcca| ‘dIrgha~jjIvitashabdo~asminnasti’ iti, dIrgha~jjIvitashabdamadhikRutya kRuto vA, ityanayA vyutpattyA dIrgha~jjIvitIyashabdastantre~adhyAye ca pravartanIyaH| tena dIrgha~jjIvitIyaM vyAkhyAsyAma ityanena tantraM prati vyAkhyAnapratij~jA labdhA bhavati, punardIrgha~jjIvitIyamiti padamAvartyAdhyAyapadasamabhivyAhRutamadhyAyavyAkhyAnapratij~jAM lambhayati| dRuShTaM cAvRutya padasya yojanaM, yathA- apAmArgataNDulIye “gaurave shirasaH shUle pInase” (sU. a. 2) ityAdau ‘shirasa’ iti padaM ‘gaurave’ ityanena yujyate, AvRutya ‘shUle’ ityanena ca| atashca yaducyate- akRutatantrapratij~jasyAdhyAyapratij~jA UnakAyamAneti, tannirastaM bhavati| yadi vA, adhyAyapratij~jaivAstu, tayaiva tantrapratij~jA~apyarthalabdhaiva, na hyadhyAyastantravyatiriktaH, tenAvayavavyAkhyAne tantrasyApyavayavino vyAkhyA bhavatyeva; yathA- a~ggulIgrahaNena devadatto~api gRuhIto bhavati| avayavAntaravyAkhyAnapratij~jA tu na labhyate, tAM tu pratyadhyAyameva kariShyati| adhyAyamiti adhipUrvAdi~gaH “i~gashca” (pA. a. 2/4/47) iti karmaNi gha~jA sAdhyam| tena adhIyate ityadhyAyaH| na cAnayA vyutpattyA prakaraNacatuShkasthAnAdiShvatiprasa~ggaH, yato yogarUDheyamadhyAyasa~jj~jA~adhyAyasya prakaraNasamUhavisheSha eva dIrgha~jjIvitIyAdilakShaNe pa~gkajashabdavadvartate na yogamAtreNa vartate| vakShyati hi- “adhikRutyeyamadhyAyanAmasa~jj~jA pratiShThitA” (sU. a. 30) iti; nAmasa~jj~jA yogarUDhasa~jj~jetyarthaH| yadi vA karaNAdhikaraNayorarthayoH “adhyAyanyAyodyAvasaMhArAshca” (pA. a. 3/3/112) itisUtreNa nipAtanAdadhyAyapadasiddhiH| adhIyate~asminnanena vA~arthavisheSha ityadhyAyaH| atiprasaktiniShedhastUktanyAyaH| vyAkhyAsyAma iti vyA~gpUrvAt khyAterlRuTA sAdhyam| cakShi~go hi prayoge~anicchato~api vyAkhyAtuH kriyAphalasambandhasya durnivAratvena “svarita~jita” (pA. a. 1/3/72) ityAdinA~a~atmanepadaM syAditi| ‘vi’ iti visheShe, visheShAshca vyAsasamAsAdayaH| A~gayaM kriyAyoge, ye tu maryAdAyAmabhividhau vA A~gprayogaM manyante teShAmabhiprAyaM na vidmaH| yato maryAdAyAmabhividhau cA~gaH prAtipadikena yogaH syAt; yathA- “AsamudrakShitIshAnAM” (ra. vaM. a. 1) “ApATalIputrAdvRuShTo deva” ityAdau, ihApi ca tathA| kriyAyogavirahe “upasargAH kriyAyoge” (pA. a. 1/4/59) iti niyamAdA~ga upasargatvaM na syAt; tatashcAnupasargeNA~gA vyavadhAnAd verupasargasya prayogo na syAt| yenAvyavahitaH sajAtIyavyavahito vA dhAtorupasargo bhavati| vyA~gorubhayorapyanupasargatve tatsambandhocitabhUriprAtipadikakalpanAgauravaprasa~ggaH syAt; tasmAt kriyAyogitvamevA~go nyAyyam| atha, ataH, dIrghaM, jIvitIyam, adhyAyaM, vi, A, khyAsyAma ityaShTapadatvam||1||

1.sanskrit: iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
1.commentary: nanu kathamagniveshaH sakalapadArthAsheShavisheShaj~jAnavyAkhyeyamAyurvedaM vyAkhyAsyati; yato na tAvadbheShajAdInAmasheShavisheShaH pratyakShaj~jeyaH, sarvapadArthAnAM visheShANAM pratyakShAviShayatvAt; anvayavyatirekAbhyAM tu sarvapadArthAvadhAraNaM duShkarameva , yata ekameva madhu svarUpeNa jIvayati, mArayati coShNaM samaghRutaM ca, kaphaprakRuterhitamahitaM vAtaprakRuteH, anUpe sAtmyamasAtmyaM marau, shIte sevyamasevyaM grIShme, hitamavRuddhe vRuddhe cAhitam, alpaM guNakaramAbAdhakaramatyupayuktam, AmatAM gatamudare upakramavirodhitvAdativibhramakaraM, kAkamAcIyuktaM pakvanikucena ca sahopayuktaM maraNAya athavA balavarNavIryatejaupaghAtAya bhavati, ityevamAdi tattadyuktaM tattacchatashaH karoti; ata evaikasyaiva madhuno rUpaM yadA~anena prakAreNa duradhigamaM, tadA~atra kaiva kathA nikhilapadArthAsheShavisheShaj~jAnasya; ajAnaMshca vyAcakShANaH kathamupAdeyavacana iti kRutvA gurorAptAt pratipannaM pratipAdayiShyAma iti darshayan tAmimAM sha~gkAM nirAcikIrShurgurUktAnuvAdarUpatAM svagranthasya darshayannAha- iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreya iti| atra itishabdo vakShyamANArthaparAmarshakaH, hashabdo~avadhAraNe; yathA- “na ha vai sasharIrasya priyApriyayorapahatirasti” iti, atra na heti naivetyarthaH| atra ‘smAha’ iti smashabdaprayogeNa bhUtamAtra eva liDarthe “laT sme” (pA.a.3pA.2sU.118) iti laT; na bhUtAnadyatanaparokShe, AtreyopadeshasyAgniveshaM pratyaparokShatvAt| yathA ca bhUtamAtre liD bhavati tathAca darshayiShyAmaH| bhagaM pUjitaM j~jAnaM, tadvAn; yathoktam- “utpattiM pralayaM caiva bhUtAnAmAgatiM gatim| vetti vidyAmavidyAM ca sa vAcyo bhagavAniti”; yadi vA bhagashabdaH samastaishvaryamAhAtmyAdivacanaH ; yathoktam- “aishvaryasya samagrasya vIryasya yashasaH shriyaH| j~jAnavairAgyayoshcaiva ShaNNAM bhaga itI~gganAH” iti| atrerapatyamAtreyaH; anena vishuddhavaMshatvaM darshitaM bhavati| atrAnye varNayanti- “caturvidhaM sUtraM bhavati- gurusUtraM, shiShyasUtraM, pratisaMskartRusUtram, ekIyasUtraM ceti”| tatra gurusUtraM yathA- “naitadbuddhimatA draShTavyamagnivesha” (sU.a.4) ityAdi, pratisaMskartRusUtraM yathA- “tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH” (sU.a.4) ityAdi, shiShyasUtraM yathA- “naitAni bhagavan pa~jcakaShAyashatAni pUryante” (sU.a.4) ityAdi, ekIyasUtraM yathA- “kumArasya shiraH pUrvamabhinirvartata iti kumArashirA bharadvAjaH” (shA.a.6) ityAdi| tenAdyaM vyAkhyAnapratij~jAsUtraM guroreva, shiShyasyAgniveshasya vyAkhyAne~anadhikAratvAt| dvitIyaM ca sUtraM pratisaMskartuH| itishabdena ca prakAravAcinA ‘dIrgha~jjIvitIyaM vyAkhyAsyAma’ iti parAmRushyate; tenAhasmeti bhUtAnadyatanaparokSha eva bhavati, pratisaMskartAraM pratyAtreyopadeshasya parokShatvAt| anena ca nyAyena tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreya ityAdAvapi liDvidhirupapanno bhavati| sushrute ca “yathovAca bhagavAn dhanvantariH” (su.sU.a.1) iti pratisaMskartRusUtramiti kRutvA TIkAkRutA “liDvidhirupapAditaH’ iti| atra brUmaH- yattAvaduktaM shiShyasyAgniveshasya vyAkhyAnAnadhikArAdidaM guroH sUtraM; tanna, nahi jAtyA gurutvamasti, yataH sa evAtreyaH svagurumapekShya shiShyaH, agniveshAdInapekShya guruH; evamagnivesho~api granthakaraNakAle svabuddhisthIkRutA~j shiShyAn prati gururiti na kashciddoShaH| yatpunardvitIyasUtrasya pratisaMskartRusUtratayA bhUtAnadyatanaparokShe liDvidhirupapAdyate, tatra vicAryaM- kimidaM dvitIyaM sUtraM pUrvavAkyaikatApannaM na vA? yadyekavAkyatApannaM tadA sushrute- tathA vyAkhyAsyAmo yathovAca dhanvantaririti yojanIyaM, tathAca tathA vyAkhyAsyAma iti kriyaikavAkyatApannamuvAceti padaM na bhinnakartRukaM bhavitumarhati, tathAca kuto liDvidhiH; atha naikatApannaM, tadA gaurashvaH puruSho hastItivannArthasa~ggatiH| ki~jca jatUkarNAdau pratisaMskartRushrutigandho~api nAsti, tat kathaM “nAnAshrutaparipUrNakaNThaH shiShyo jatUkarNaH prA~jjaliradhigamyovAca” ityAdau liDvidhiH| anena nyAyena carake~api pratisaMskartRusUtrapakShe liDvidhirnAsti, tasmAccarake~agniveshaH sushrute sushruta eva sUtrANAM praNetA, kvacit ki~jcidarthaM stotuM nindituM vA~a~akhyAyikArUpaM purAkalpaM darshayan kimapi sUtraM gurUktAnuvAdarUpatayA kimapyekIyamatAnuvAdarUpatayA likhati; pratisaMskartA tvayaM granthaM pUrayati tadAdyagranthakartRutayaiva| liDvidhistu bhUtAnadyatanamAtra eva chandovihito bhAShAyAmapi varNanIyaH, anyathA uvAceti padaM jatUkarNAdau na syAt; tathA ca harivaMshe dhanyopAkhyAne “mAmuvAca” iti, tathA “ahamuvAca” iti ca na syAt; yathA “sa mAmuvAcAmbucaraH kUrmo mAnuShavat svayam| kimAshcaryaM mayi mune dhanyashcAhaM kathaM vibho” (harivaMshe, viShNuparva 2a.110) iti, tathA “svayambhuvacanAt so~ahaM vedAn vai samupasthitaH| uvAca cainAMshcaturaH” iti| yadapi ‘iti ha smAha’ ityatra itishabdena pUrvasUtraM parAmRushyate; tanna, yena dIrgha~jjIvitIyAdisUtramAtrasya tadarthasya vA gurUktatvapratipAdane sati naivottaratrAbhidheyAbhidhAnena nikhilatantrasya gurUktAnuvAdarUpatayA karaNaM shrotRushraddhAkaraNaM pratipAditaM bhavati| bhavati tu bhAvayituM yathA purA vyAkhyAtaM, tasmAttadeva nyAyyamiti| agniveshasya vyAkhyAsyAma iti bahuvacanamekasminnapyasmadaH prayogAdbahuvacanaprayogasya sAdhutvAt; sAdhu hi vadanti vaktAro- ‘vayaM kariShyAmaH’ iti| bhagavAnAtreya ityatra tvekavacananirdeshaH kRutaH, bhagavAnityanenaivAtreyasya gurorgauravasya darshitatvAt||2||

1.sanskrit: dIrghaM jIvitamanvicchanbharadvAja upAgamat| indramugratapA buddhvA sharaNyamamareshvaram||3||
1.commentary: nanu yathA~agniveshasyAyurvedasya duradhigamatvena pratyakShato vA~anvayavyatirekAdvA j~jAnaM na sambhAvyate, evamAtreyasyApi kathamAyurvedaj~jAnaM syAt, yanmUlamagniveshasyAyurvedaj~jAnaM samIcInamucyate, ityAsha~gkyAyurvedasyAviplutAgamatvaM darshayannAha- dIrghaM jIvitamityAdi| jIvitaM sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogaH| tacca dIrghamiti dIrghakAlasambandhi, kAlashabdo~apyatra luptanirdiShTo draShTavyaH| yattantrashailI ceyamAcAryasya yata AdimadhyAntalopAn karoti, ye luptA api gamyanta eva| yathA “grAmyAnUpaudakarasA” (sU.a.21) ityatra mAMsashabdo luptaH, tathA ‘dagdhaviddha’ ityatra viShashabdo lupta ityAdi| anvicchanniti anurUpaM dIrghamicchan| bharadvAja iti gotranAma| ‘ugratapA’ iti visheShaNena bharadvAjasya mAnuShasyApIndrAbhigamanashaktiH, tathA sharaNyatvapratItishaktishcopadarshyate; acintyo hi tapasAM prabhAvo yenAgastyo mahodadhimapi culukanipeyamakarot| naca vAcyamugratapastvenaiva kimityayamAyurvedamapi na budhyate, yatastapaHprabhAvo~api pratiniyataviShayatvAnna sarvatra shaktimAn, shaktishcAsya kAryonneyA; tena gurunirapekShAyurvedaj~jAnalakShaNakAryAdarshanAnna tattapastatra samarthamityavadhArayAmaH; kiMvA gurupUrvakrameNaivAyurvedaj~jAnaM phalatItIndramupAgamadbharadvAjaH| atha kathaM brahmAdiShvAyurvedapUrvaguruShu vidyamAneShvindramevAyamupAgamat? yuktaM ca pradhAnaguroreva shravaNaM, yataH shiShyaparamparAsa~jcAriNI vidyA~asamyaggrahaNAdidoShAt pAtraparamparAsa~jcAryamANamadhuvat kShINA~api sambhAvyeta; ata Aha- buddhvA sharaNyamamareshvaramiti| yasmAdayamevendro~alpAyuH, sa eva bhayatrastAnAM yathA sharaNyo rakShaNahito na tathA brahmAdayaH, tena tamevopAgamat| amareshvara ityanena cendrasya rakShaNopayuktatAM darshayati; rAjA hi prajArakShaNe prayatnAtishayavAn bhavati| nanu dIrghaM jIvitamanvicchannityatra dIrghasyAvyavasthitatvena kiyatkAlaM taddIrghamabhipretaM? tatra yugAnurUpaM varShashataM, yaduktaM- “varShashataM khalvAyuShaH pramANamasmin kAle” (vi.a.3) iti| etacca kalikAlAdau paramAyuHkAlasya yathA yathA kShayastathA~a~ayuShaH kShayaH| yadAha- “saMvatsarashate pUrNe yAti saMvatsaraH kShayam| dehinAmAyuShaH kAle yatra yanmAnamiShyate” (vi.a.3) iti| etadanusAreNa pUrvayugeShvAyuHprakarShaH| yadAha bhagavAn vyAsaH- “puruShAH sarvasiddhAshca caturvarShashatAyuShaH| kRute tretAdike~apyevaM pAdasho hrasati kramAt” iti| karmAnurUpaM cAyurniyataM vA, aniyataM vA bhavati| tatra balavatkarmArabdhaM niyataM, yathA~ayamasmin kAle mriyata eva param; abalavatkarmArabdhaM tvaniyataM, tadyadA dRuShTaM viShAdi mArakaM pratyayamAsAdayati tadA sa~jjAtabalaM mArayati, yadA na prApnoti dRuShTaM mArakaM kAraNaM tadA yugAnurUpAyuHprAptau yugaprabhAvajarjarIkRutasharIraM mArayati| atra dRuShTAntashcAcAryeNa darshitaH “yathA hyakShaH svaguNopapanno vAhyamAno yathAkAlaM svapramANakShayAdevAvasAnaM gacchati, sa evAkSho~atibhArAdhiShThita” ityArabhya yAvat “antarA vyasanamApadyate; tathA~aniyatAyuSho~antarA prANA aparAdhAnnirudhyante” (vi.a.3) ityantena| yadA tvaniyatAyuSho rasAyanamAcaranti tadA tatprabhAvAdyugaprabhAvaniyatAyurla~gghanaM bhavati| yadAha- “tAni yAvanti bhakShayet| jIvedvarShasahasrANi tAvantyAgatayauvanaH” (ci.a.1) ityAdi| na tu balavatkarmaniyatasyAyuSho la~gghanamasti, yadAha- “karma ki~jcit kvacitkAle vipAke niyataM mahat| ki~jcittvakAlaniyataM pratyayaiH pratibodhyate” (vi.a.3) iti| hanta yadyevaM tadA sarvatra karmaiva kAraNaM maraNe jIvite vA tathA vyAdhau vyAdhyapagame vA, tat kimanenAyurvedena karmajanitaphalAnuvidhAyinA; tathAhi- yattAvaducyate- niyataM karma, tatra tAvadAyurvedavyApAro nAsti, yena niyatenaiva karmaNA militamapi dRuShTaM tatra viphalIkriyate; yaccAbalavatkarmArabdhatvenAniyatamAyurucyate tadapi na shraddhAdhInaM, yenAdRuShTashaktiparAbhavena dRuShTasya kAryakAritAM dRuShTvA~api vivAdAdhyAsite viShaye~adRuShTameva kAraNamavadhArayAmaH, dRuShTaM tvadRuShTAkRuShTameva tatra bhavati| naivam, evaM sati sarvAnuShThAnasyoparamaprasa~ggaH; ki~jca kevalakarmavAdino dRuShTamapavadato~adRuShTotpattireva na prApnoti, adRuShTaM hi dRuShTAgniShTomAdijanyaM, dRuShTaM ca kAraNaM karmavAdino~abhimatam; athAdRuShTakAraNaM dRuShTamicchanti hanta tarhi tenaiva nyAyena dahanAdInAmapi kimiti shItApahatvasphoTAdijanakatvAdi na svIkriyate; ki~jca kevalakarmavAdino dRuShTe kAraNe vyAptigrahaNAbhAvAdadRuShTAnumAnameva na syAt, tasmAddRuShTamadRuShTaM ca kAraNam| tatra kvacidadRuShTaM dRuShTena bAdhyate, kvacicca dRuShTamadRuShTeneti; tena yatra puruShe balavanniyatamaraNakAraNamadRuShTaM , tatra jIvitamaraNayoraki~jcitkaro~ayamAyurvedaH, kintu tatrApi niyatamaraNakAlAdarvAgduHkhajanakavyAdhiprashamane vyApriyata eva yadi vyAdhirapi tasya niyatakarmajanyo na syAt; yattu karmAniyatavipAkaM bhavati tatprati sarvathA prayojanavadAyurvedopAdAnam| yattu yuganiyatamAyuH, tannAtibalavatA karmaNA niyamitaM; yena rasAyanaprayogAttadbAdhanaM dRuShTatvAdanumanyante, na tu svasthahitAturahitacikitsAbhyAm| ayaM ca vAdaH shAstrakAreNa svayameva prapa~jcena nirlocanIya iti neha pratanyate||3||

1.sanskrit: brahmaNA hi yathAproktamAyurvedaM prajApatiH| jagrAha nikhilenAdAvashvinau tu punastataH||4|| ashvibhyAM bhagavA~jchakraH pratipede ha kevalam| RuShiprokto bharadvAjastasmAcchakramupAgamat||5||
1.commentary: kathamindra eva sharaNyo na brahmAdaya ityAha- brahmaNA hItyAdi| hi yasmAdarthe| prajApatirdakShanAmA| proktamiti prakarSheNoktaM, prakarShashcAnavasheSheNAbhidhAnam| yathetyanena tathAshabdasya nityasambandhasyAkarShaNAdyAdRushaM proktaM tAdRushameva jagrAha| nikhileneti anavasheSheNa| ashvinau tu tataH prajApaterjagRuhatuH| atrApi yathAproktaM nikhilena cetipadaM tathaiva yojanIyam| evamashvibhyAM bhagavA~jchakraH pratipede hetyatrApi yathAproktamityAdi yojanIyam| hashabdastvavadhAraNe, tena pratipede eva paraM shakro natu kasmaicidAyurvedaM dattavAnityarthaH| anena ca granthenAnyUnAdhikAyurvedAgamopadarshakena yathA brahmaNa Ayurvedaj~jAnaM tathendrasyApIti darshitam| tena brahmaNo vA~a~ayurvedaH shrUyate indrAdveti na ki~jcidarthato visheShaH| indre tvidamadhikaM- yadayamasa~gkrAmitavidyatvena shiShyArthI| yaduktaM- “yo hi gurubhyaH samyagAdAya vidyAM na prayacchatyantevAsibhyaH sa khalvRuNI gurujanasya mahadeno vindati” iti, ato~akRutashiShyatvena shiShyArthitvavisheShayogAdbrahmAdibhyo visheSheNendra eva sharaNya iti| brahmaNastu paramagurorviditasakalavedasya sarvatrAtirohitamaterAyurvedaj~jAnaM svataHsiddhameveti na gurvantarApekShA| etacca brahmAdiguruparamparopadarshanamAyurvedasyAviplutAgamopadarshanArthaM tathA mahApuruShasevitatvenopAdeyatvopadarshanArthaM ca| vacanaM hi- “tatra yanmanyeta mahadyashasvisudhIrapuruShAsevitam” ityAdi yAvat “tadabhiprapadyeta shAstram” (vi.a.8) iti| RuShiprokta iti vakShyamANavRuttAntena RuShiproktaH| tasmAditi yasmAdindra eva visheSheNa sharaNyaH||4-5||

1.sanskrit: vighnabhUtA yadA rogAH prAdurbhUtAH sharIriNAm| tapopavAsAdhyayanabrahmacaryavratAyuShAm ||6|| tadA bhUteShvanukroshaM puraskRutya maharShayaH| sametAH puNyakarmANaH pArshve himavataH shubhe||7||
1.commentary: atha kathamayamRuShiprokta ityAyurvedasya martyalokAgame hetumAha- vighnabhUtA ityAdi| vighnabhUtA ityantarAyasvarUpAH| rujantIti rogAH| prAdurbhUtA ityAvirbhUtAH| ayaM ca rogaprAdurbhAvaH kRutayugAnte boddhavyaH| vakShyati hi- “bhrashyati tu kRutayuge” (vi.a.3) ityAdinA rogaprAdurbhAvaM janapadoddhvaMsanIye| prAdurbhAvashca pUrvasiddhasyaivAvirbhAvaH| tena rogasantAnanityatA~apyaviruddhA bhavatyarthedashamahAmUlIye (sU.a.30) vaktavyA| shIryata iti sharIraM, tadasyAstIti sharIrI| etena sharIraM svata eva shIryamANaM rogasambandhAttu nitarAM shIryata iti sUcayati| keShAM vighnabhUtA ityAha- tapopavAsAdhyayanetyAdi| rogagrastA hi sharIriNastapaHprabhRutIni kartuM na pArayanti vikRutatvAt; tathA, AyuShashca mArakatvena kecidgadA virodhakA bhavanti| atra tapashcAndrAyaNAdi, upavAsaH krodhAdiparityAgaH satyAdyupAdAnaM ca, vacanaM hi- “upAvRuttasya pApebhyaH sahavAso guNe hi yaH| upavAsaH sa vij~jeyo na sharIrasya shoShaNam” iti; adhyayanaM vedAdhyayanaM, brahmaNe mokShAya caryaM brahmacaryamupasthanigrahAdi, vratamIpsitakAmo niyamaH, Ayuruktam| tapopavAseti prayogaH pUrvatrAsiddhavidheranityatvena tapaHsakArasthAnibhUtayalopasya siddhatvAjj~jeyaH, yathA “nopadhAyAH” (pA.a.6pA.4sU.7) iti| bhUteShu prANiShu| anukroshamiti anukampAM, kasmAt? anekArthatvAddhAtUnAm| puraskRutya AdRutya| etena prANirogaharaNameva pradhAnamAyurvedopagamane maharShINAM phalam; AyuHprakarShastvanuSha~ggasiddhasteShAM mahAtmanAmiti bhAvaH| nareShviti vaktavye yadayaM bhUteShviti sAmAnyashabdaM karoti, tena na samAnajIvaprayukteyamanukampA , kintu prANimAtraprayukteti samadarshitAmRuShINAM darshayati| mahAntashca te RuShayashceti maharShayaH; anena caturvidhA api RuShayaH- RuShikA, RuShiputrA, devarShayo, maharShayashca gRuhyante; maharShyanugAmitvAdRuShikAdInAmapi grahaNam| puNyaM pAvanaM karma yeShAM te puNyakarmANaH| parshukAbhistRutaM pArshvaM, tena pArshvamiva (tataM) pArshvam| shubhe iti padaM kartavyasamAdhyanuguNopadarshanArthaM, yataH shubhe hi deshe samAdhayaH prasIdanti||6-7||

1.sanskrit: a~ggirA jamadagnishca vasiShThaH kashyapo bhRuguH| Atreyo gautamaH sA~gkhyaH pulastyo nArado~asitaH||8|| agastyo vAmadevashca mArkaNDeyAshvalAyanau| pArikShirbhikShurAtreyo bharadvAjaH kapi~jja(ShTha)laH||9|| vishvAmitrAshmarathyau ca bhArgavashcyavano~abhijit| gArgyaH shANDilyakauNDilyau(nyau)vArkShirdevalagAlavau||10|| sA~gkRutyo baijavApishca kushiko bAdarAyaNaH| baDishaH sharalomA ca kApyakAtyAyanAvubhau||11|| kA~gkAyanaH kaikasheyo dhaumyo mArIcakAshyapau| sharkarAkSho hiraNyAkSho lokAkShaH pai~ggireva ca||12|| shaunakaH shAkuneyashca maitreyo maimatAyaniH| vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAstathA cAnye maharShayaH||13|| brahmaj~jAnasya nidhayo da(ya)masya niyamasya ca| tapasastejasA dIptA hUyamAnA ivAgnayaH||14|| sukhopaviShTAste tatra puNyAM cakruH kathAmimAm|15|
1.commentary: ke te maharShaya ityAha- a~ggirA ityAdi| bahvRuShINAmatra kIrtanaM granthAdau pApakShayahetutvena, tathA~a~ayurvedasyaivaMvidhamahApuruShasevitatvena sevyatvopadarshanArthaM ceti| eShu ca madhye kecidyAyAvarAH, kecicchAlInAH, kecidayonijAH, evamprakArAshca sarve militA boddhavyAH| bhikShurityAtreyavisheShaNaM, vakShyati hi- “tanneti bhikShurAtreyaH” (sU.a.25) iti| vaikhAnasA iti karmavisheShaprayuktA sa~jj~jA| vAlakhilyAstu svalpapramANAH kecidRuShayaH| nidhaya iva nidhayo~akShayasthAnatvena| damo dAntatvam| imAmiti agre vakShyamANAm||8-14||-

1.sanskrit: dharmArthakAmamokShANAmArogyaM mUlamuttamam||15|| rogAstasyApahartAraH shreyaso jIvitasya ca| prAdurbhUto manuShyANAmantarAyo mahAnayam||16|| kaH syAtteShAM shamopAya ityuktvA dhyAnamAsthitAH| atha te sharaNaM shakraM dadRushurdhyAnacakShuShA||17|| sa vakShyati shamopAyaM yathAvadamaraprabhuH|18|
1.commentary: dhAraNAddharmaH sa cAtmasamavetaH kAryadarshanAnumeyaH, arthaH suvarNAdiH, kAmyata iti kAmo vanitApariShva~ggAdiH, mokShaH saMsAravimokShaH| ArogyaM rogAbhAvAddhAtusAmyam| mUlaM kAraNam| uttamamiti pradhAnaM; tenArogyaM caturvarge pradhAnaM kAraNaM, rogagRuhItasya kvacidapi puruShArthe~asamarthatvAdityuktam| tasyApahartAra iti ArogyasyApahartAraH; idameva ca rogANAmArogyApaharaNaM yadanarthalAbhaH; na punarutpanno rogaH pashcAdArogyamapaharati, bhAvAbhAvayoH parasparAbhAvAtmakatvAt| shreyaso jIvitasya ceti shreyovajjIvitaM hitatvena sukhatvena cArthedashamahAmUlIye (sU.a.30) vakShyamANaM, tasya jIvitasyApahartAra iti yojanIyam; ashreyojIvitamahitatvena duHkhahetutayA cAnupAdeyamiti kRutvA tadapaharaNamiha noktam| atra sukhahitajIvitopaghAto dharmAdyupaghAtenaiva labdhaH; tena vayaM pashyAmaH- shreyaHshabdena sAmAnyenAbhyudayavAcinA dharmAdayo~abhidhIyante, jIvitashabdena ca jIvitamAtraM, yato jIvitaM svarUpeNaiva sarvaprANinAM nirupAdhyupAdeyaM; vacanaM hi- “Acakame ca brahmaNa iyamAtmA AshIH- AyuShmAn bhUyAsam” iti| yattvatyantaduHkhagRuhItasya jIvitaM jihAsitaM, tatra duHkhasyAtyantajihAsitasyAnyathAhAtumashakyatvAt priyamapi jIvitaM tyaktumicchati na svarUpeNa| antarAya iti dharmAdisAdhane boddhavyaH| ayamiti rogaprAdurbhAvarUpaH| teShAmiti rogANAm| sharaNamiti rakShitAram| shaktatvAcchakra ucyate| dhyAnaM samAdhivisheShaH, tadupalabdhisAdhanatvAccakShuriva dhyAnacakShuH, ‘tena sa vakShyati shamopAyaM yathAvadamaraprabhuH’ iti dhyAnacakShuShA dadRushuriti yojanA||15-17||-

1.sanskrit: kaH sahasrAkShabhavanaM gacchet praShTuM shacIpatim||18|| ahamarthe niyujyeyamatreti prathamaM vacaH| bharadvAjo~abravIttasmAdRuShibhiH sa niyojitaH||19|| sa shakrabhavanaM gatvA surarShigaNamadhyagam | dadarsha balahantAraM dIpyamAnamivAnalam||20|| so~abhigamya jayAshIrbhirabhinandya sureshvaram| provAca vinayAddhImAnRuShINAM vAkyamuttamam||21|| vyAdhayo hi samutpannAH sarvaprANibhaya~gkarAH| tadbrUhi me shamopAyaM yathAvadamaraprabho||22|| tasmai provAca bhagavAnAyurvedaM shatakratuH| padairalpairmatiM buddhvA vipulAM paramarShaye||23||
1.commentary: athaiteShu madhye bharadvAjaH kathamindramupAgamadityAha- ka ityAdi| shacIpatimityanena shacIsambhogavyAsaktamapyahamupAsituM kShama iti bharadvAjo darshayati| arthe prayojane| niyujyeyaM vyApArayeyam| atreti prakRutaprayojana eva, atretishabdo yasmAdarthe| yathA- subhikShamityAgataH; yasmAt subhikShaM tasmAdAgata ityarthaH| niyojita iti caurAdiko Nic, na hetau| anena prakaraNena bharadvAjasyAyurvedAgame visheSheNArthitvAnna preraNamiti darshitaM bhavati| provAceti samyaguvAca; na tu prashabdaH prapa~jcArthaH, padairalpairityuktatvAt| kasmAt padairalpairuvAcetyAha- matiM buddhvA vipulAmiti; yasmAdvipulamatiM bharadvAjaM pratipannavAn tasmAt padairalpairuvAceti bhAvaH; matishca bahuviShayatvenopacArAdvipuletyucyate, sA ca matiH shushrUShAshravaNagrahaNadhAraNohApohatattvAbhiniveshavatIha vipulA boddhavyA| atra cendreNa divyadRushA bharadvAjAbhiprAyamagrata eva buddhvA~a~ayurveda upadiShTaH; tena bharadvAjasyendrapRucchAdIha na darshitaM, kiMvA bhUtamapIndrapRucchAdi granthavistarabhayAdiha na likhitam||18-23||

1.sanskrit: hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnaM svasthAturaparAyaNam| trisUtraM shAshvataM puNyaM bubudhe yaM pitAmahaH||24||
1.commentary: yAdRusho~asAvalpapadairupadiShTa AyurvedastamAha- hetvityAdi| hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnamiti hetvAdIni j~jAyante~aneneti hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnaM, yAvaccAyurvedavAcyaM tAvaddhetvAdyantarbhUtamityarthaH| hetugrahaNena sannikRuShTaviprakRuShTavyAdhihetugrahaNaM; li~ggagrahaNena ca vyAdherArogyasya ca kRutsnaM li~ggamucyate, tena vyAdhyArogye api li~ggashabdavAcye, yatastAbhyAmapi hi talli~ggaM li~ggyata eva; vakShyati hi viShamArambhamUlAnAM jvara eko hi lakShaNam| viShamArambhamUlAdyairjvara eko nigadyate (ni.a.8) ityAdi; auShadhagrahaNena ca sarvapathyAvarodhaH| sharIraM cAtra hetau li~gge cAntarbhavati| svasthAturayoH paramutkRuShTamayanaM mArga iti svasthAturaparAyaNam| kimanyo~ayaM hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnarUpa Ayurvedo brahmabuddhAdAyurvedAdutAnanya ityAha- trisUtramityAdi| pitAmaho~api yaM trisUtraM bubudhe tamindraH provAca| trINi hetvAdIni sUtryante yasmin yena vA tattrisUtram| tatra sUcanAt sUtraNAccArthasantateH sUtram| etena taM yathA brahmA trisUtraM bubudhe tathaiva hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnamindraH provAcetyaviplutamAgamaM darshayati| bubudha iti na kRutavAn| ata evoktaM- shAshvataM; nityamityarthaH| tacca nityatvaM sUtrasthAnAnte vyutpAdanIyam||24||

1.sanskrit: so~anantapAraM triskandhamAyurvedaM mahAmatiH| yathAvadacirAt sarvaM bubudhe tanmanA muniH||25|| tenAyuramitaM lebhe bharadvAjaH sukhAnvitam| RuShibhyo~anadhikaM tacca shashaMsAnavasheShayan||26||
1.commentary: athoddiShTamAyurvedaM kathaM gRuhItavAn bharadvAja ityAha- so~anantetyAdi| avidyamAnAvantapArau yasyAsAvanantapAraH, atra pArashabdena gobalIvardanyAyenAdirucyate; pArashabdo hyubhayorapi nadIkUlayorvivakShAvashAdvartate; kiMvA ananto mokShaH, pAramutkRuShTaM phalaM yasyAyurvedasyAsAvanantapAraH| vakShyati hi- cikitsA tu naiShThikI yA vinopadhAm (shA.a.1) iti| atra naiShThikI mokShasAdhanahetuH | trayo hetvAdayaH skandharUpA yasya sa triskandhaH; skandhashca sthUlAvayavaH pravibhAgo vA| tatraivAyurvedagrahaNe mano yasya sa tanmanAH| mananAt j~jAnaprakarShashAlitvAnmuniH | etena yasmAdayaM mahAmatistanmanAH munishca tenAnantapAramapyAyurvedaM hetvAdiskandhatrayamAlambanaM kRutvA yathAvadacirAdeva pratipannavAnityAshayaH| acirAditi acireNa| atra ca yathA brahmA trisUtraM bubudhe yathA cendro hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnaM provAca tathaiva bharadvAjo~api triskandhaM taM bubudhe ityanenAyurvedasyAviplutAgamatvamupadarshyate; tena trisUtratriskandhayorna punaruktiH| teneti indrAdgRuhItenAyurvedena| amitamiti amitamivAmitam, atidIrghatvAt| AyuHshabdashcAyuHkAraNe rasAyanaj~jAne boddhavyaH; yenottarakAlaM hi rasAyanopayogAdayaM bharadvAjo~amitamAyuravApsyati (na RuShibhya AyurvedakathanAt pUrvaM rasAyanamAcarati sma); kiMvA sarvaprANyupakArArthAdhItAyurvedajanitadharmavashAttatkAlamevAmitamAyurlebhe bharadvAja iti boddhavyam| tacceti shrutaM; yadA tamiti pAThaH, tadA tamAyurvedam| anavasheShayanniti kArtsnyenetyarthaH| AyurvedamadhItyAnantaramevAyaM tamRuShibhyo dattavAn||25-26||

1.sanskrit: RuShayashca bharadvAjAjjagRuhustaM prajAhitam| dIrghamAyushcikIrShanto vedaM vardhanamAyuShaH||27|| maharShayaste dadRushuryathAvajj~jAnacakShuShA| sAmAnyaM ca visheShaM ca guNAn dravyANi karma ca||28|| samavAyaM ca tajj~jAtvA tantroktaM vidhimAsthitAH| lebhire paramaM sharma jIvitaM cApyanitvaram ||29||
1.commentary: dIrghamAyushcikIrShanta iti prANinAmAtmanashca| j~jAnArthaM j~jAnarUpaM vA cakShurj~jAnacakShuH, tena j~jAnacakShuShA| gRuhItena tenAyurvedena kiM dadRushurityAha- sAmAnyaM cetyAdi| eShAM cottaratra lakShaNaM ShaNNAM padArthAnAM vishvarUpANAM bhaviShyati; tenaitattatraiva vyAkaraNIyam| taditi sAmAnyAdi| tantroktaM vidhimiti apathyaparihArapathyopAdAnarUpam| sharma sukham| paramiti duHkhAnAkrAntam| anitvaramiti agatvaram||27-29||

1.sanskrit: atha maitrIparaH puNyamAyurvedaM punarvasuH| shiShyebhyo dattavAn ShaDbhyaH sarvabhUtAnukampayA||30|| agniveshashca bhela(Da)shca jatUkarNaH parAsharaH| hArItaH kShArapANishca jagRuhustanmunervacaH||31||
1.commentary: athetyAdinA bharadvAjashiShyasyAtreyasya punarvasvaparanAmno~agniveshAdigurutAM darshayati| atra kecidbharadvAjAtreyayoraikyaM manyante, tanna; bharadvAjasa~jj~jayA Atreyasya kvacidapi tantrapradeshe~akIrtanAt; hArIte cAtreyAdigurutayA bharadvAja uktaH- “shakrAdahamadhItavAn” ityAdinA “mattaH punarasa~gkhyeyAstrisUtraM triprayojanam| atrAtreyAdiparyantA viduH sapta maharShayaH|| AtreyAddhArIta-RuShiH”- ityantena| vAgbhaTena tu yaduktaM “brahmA smRutvA~a~ayuSho vedaM prajApatimajigrahat| so~ashvinau tau sahasrAkShaM so~atriputrAdikAn munIn” (vA.sU.a.1) ityanenAtreyasyendrashiShyatvaM, tadAyurvedasamutthAnIyarasAyanapAde Adishabdena vakShyamANendrashiShyatAyogAt samarthanIyam| tatra hIndreNa punarmaharShINAmAyurveda upadiShTa iti vaktavyam| maitrIparo maitrIpradhAnaH; maitrI ca sarvaprANiShvAtmanIva buddhiH||30-31||

1.sanskrit: buddhervisheShastatrAsInnopadeshAntaraM muneH| tantrasya kartA prathamamagnivesho yato~abhavat||32|| atha bhelAdayashcakruH svaM svaM tantraM kRutAni ca| shrAvayAmAsurAtreyaM sarShisa~gghaM sumedhasaH||33|| shrutvA sUtraNamarthAnAmRuShayaH puNyakarmaNAm| yathAvatsUtritamiti prahRuShTAste~anumenire||34|| sarva evAstuvaMstAMshca sarvabhUtahitaiShiNaH| sAdhu bhUteShvanukrosha ityuccairabruvan samam||35|| taM puNyaM shushruvuH shabdaM divi devarShayaH sthitAH| sAmarAH paramarShINAM shrutvA mumudire param||36|| aho sAdhviti nirghoSho lokAMstrInanvavA(nA)dayat| nabhasi snigdhagambhIro harShAdbhUtairudIritaH||37|| shivo vAyurvavau sarvA bhAbhirunmIlitA dishaH| nipetuH sajalAshcaiva divyAH kusumavRuShTayaH||38|| athAgniveshapramukhAn vivishurj~jAnadevatAH| buddhiH siddhiH smRutirmedhA dhRutiH kIrtiH kShamA dayA||39|| tAni cAnumatAnyeShAM tantrANi paramarShibhiH| bha(bhA)vAya bhUtasa~gghAnAM pratiShThAM bhuvi lebhire||40||
1.commentary: buddhervisheSha utkarShaH| yata iti buddhervisheShAt| svaM svaM tantramiti svasvanAmA~gkitaM bhelatantraM, jatUkarNatantramityAdikam| kRutAni cetyatra ‘tantrANi’ iti sheShaH| puNyamAyurvedatantrakaraNalakShaNaM karma yeShAmagniveshAdInAM te puNyakarmANaH, teShAM puNyakarmaNAm| sarvabhUtahitaiShiNa ityagniveshAdivisheShaNaM; kiMvA RuShisa~gghavisheShaNam| sAdhushabdo~ajahalli~ggatayA napuMsakali~gga eva; yathA- vedAH pramANamiti| kecittu sAdhviti visheShaNasya napuMsakali~ggatAnurodhAdanukroshamityapi napuMsakali~ggaM paThanti| aho iti sAdhviti prashaMsAyAm| snigdha iti anutkaTatvenAhlAdakatvena ca| shivo vAyurvavAvityAdinA shubhalakShaNena prakRutatantrakaraNasya devairapyarthato~anumatatvamupadarshyate| j~jAnadevatA iti j~jAnAbhimAninyo devatAH| tena granthakaraNAt pUrvamevAgniveshAdInAM buddhyAdayo vyavasthitAH, tantrakaraNottarakAlaM tvAdareNa buddhyAdidevatAnupravesha iti| siddhiH sAdhyasAdhanaj~jAnam| kIrtiH kIrtanaM vaktuM j~jAnamityarthaH; natu kIrtiryashorUpA, tasyA aj~jAnarUpatvAt; j~jAnadevatAshcehocyante| bhavAya sthitaye, rogAnupahatajIvitAyeti yAvat| pratiShThA janopAdeyatayA~avasthAnam||32-40||

1.sanskrit: hitAhitaM sukhaM duHkhamAyustasya hitAhitam| mAnaM ca tacca yatroktamAyurvedaH sa ucyate||41||
1.commentary: sampratyAyurvedavyutpattiM kurvannAyurvedAbhidheyaM darshayati- hitAhitamityAdi| hitaM cAhitaM ca hitAhitaM, tathA sukhayuktatvAt sukhaM, duHkhayuktatvAdduHkhaM; etacca catuShprakAramapyAyurarthedashamahAmUlIye “tatra shArIramAnasAbhyAm” ityAdinA granthena “ahitamato viparyayeNa” (sU.a.30) ityantena vakShyati| tasya hitAhitamiti AyuShaH pathyApathyam| mAnaM cetyAyuSha eva, tacca pramANaM mAsikadvimAsikatvAdibhirvikRutilakShaNairindriyasthAne tathA prakRutilakShaNaiH “idamAyuShmatAM kumArANAM lakShaNaM bhavati” (shA.a.8) ityAdinA shArIre vaktavyam| tacceti AyuH svarUpeNa “sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyoga” ityAdinA vakShyamANam| tena hitAhitamityAdinA ‘AyurvedayatItyAyurveda’ ityuktaM bhavati| vidadhAtushceha j~jAnArtha evAbhipretaH| yadvakShyatyarthe dashamahAmUlIye- “tadAyurvedayatItyAyurvedaH” (sU.a.30) iti| lAbhAdayastvarthA videriha noktAH, teShAM sAkShAdAyurvedAjanyatvAditi bhAvaH||41||

1.sanskrit: sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogo dhAri jIvitam| nityagashcAnubandhashca paryAyairAyurucyate||42||
1.commentary: Ayurvedapade pUrvapadavAcyamAyurAha- sharIretyAdi| sharIraM pa~jcamahAbhUtavikArAtmakamAtmano bhogAyatanam, indriyANi cakShurAdIni, sattvaM manaH, AtmA j~jAnapratisandhAtA, eShAM samyagadRuShTayantrito yogaH saMyogaH| yadyapi sharIragrahaNenaiva indriyANyapi labhyante, tathA~api prAdhAnyAttAni punaH pRuthaguktAni| ayaM ca saMyogaH saMyoginaH sharIrasya kShaNikatvena yadyapi kShaNikastathA~api santAnavyavasthito~ayamekatayocyate| tasyAyuShaH paryAyAnAha- dhArItyAdi| dhArayati sharIraM pUtitAM gantuM na dadAtIti dhAri| jIvayati prANAn dhArayatIti jIvitam| nityaM sharIrasya kShaNikatvena gacchatIti nityagaH| anubadhnAtyAyuraparAparasharIrAdisaMyogarUpatayetyanubandhaH| paryAyairAyurucyata iti ekArthAbhidhAyibhiH shabdairucyate| yadyapi ca nityagAnubandhashabdAbhyAM na kvacidapyAyurabhidhIyate, tathA~api nityagatvAnubandhatvadharmakhyApanArthamevaitatsa~jj~jAdvayaM boddhavyaM, dhArisa~jj~jA tvarthedashamahAmUlIye bhaviShyati| nanu, uttaratra “caitanyAnuvRuttirAyuH” (sU.a.30) ityAyurlakShaNaM kariShyati, iha tu sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyoga iti kimarthamuktam? brUmaH- sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogajanyA caitanyAnuvRuttiryathoktasaMyogAvyabhicAritvena vyaktatvena cArthedashamahAmUlIye lakShaNatvenoktA; sharIrAdisaMyogarUpameva tvAyuH paramArthataH; evambhUtasaMyogAbhAve maraNamAyuruparamarUpaM bhavati, mRutasharIre tu cetaso~abhAvAdAyUrUpasaMyogAbhAvaH||42||

1.sanskrit: tasyAyuShaH puNyatamo vedo vedavidAM mataH| vakShyate yanmanuShyANAM lokayorubhayorhitam ||43||
1.commentary: tasyetyAdi| vedayatIti vedaH| vedavidAM mata iti vedavidbhiH pUjitaH| atha kasmAdAyurvedalakShaNo vedaH puNyatamo vedavidAM ca pUjita ityAha- vakShyata ityAdi| yaditi yasmAt; evamuktaM bhavati- yadanye RugvedAdayaH prAyaH paralokahitamevArthaM vadanti tena puNyAH, puNyatamashcAyamAyurvedo yad yasmAnmanuShyANAmubhayorapi lokayoryaddhitamAyurArogyasAdhanaM dharmasAdhanaM ca tadvakShyate, tenAtishayena puNyatamastathA vedavidAM ca pUjita iti| kecit ‘vakShyate yaH’ iti paThanti, tatrApi hetugarbhamiti vyAkhyeyam| jIvitapradAtRutvAdAyurvedasya puNyatamatvaM boddhavyaM, yatashcaturvargasAdhanIbhUtajIvitapradameva sarvottamaM bhavati| ucyate ca- “na hi jIvitadAnAddhi dAnamanyadvishiShyate” (ci.a.1) iti||43||

1.sanskrit: sarvadA sarvabhAvAnAM sAmAnyaM vRuddhikAraNam| hrAsaheturvisheShashca, pravRuttirubhayasya tu||44||
1.commentary: sampratyAyurvedAbhidheyatayA sUtrite sAmAnyAdau sAmAnyasya prathamasUtritatvAttathA sAmAnyaj~jAnamUlatvAccAyurvedapratipAdyasya hetvAdeH sAmAnyamevAgre nirdishati- sarvadetyAdi| sarvadA sarvasmin kAle nityage cAvasthike ca| sarvabhAvAnAmityatra sarvashabdaH kRutsnavAcI;
