bhavanti sattAmanubhavantIti bhAvA dravyaguNakarmANItyarthaH, natu bhavantyutpadyanta iti bhAvAH; tathA sati pRuthivyAdiparamANUnAM nityAnAM sAmAnyasya pArthivadvyaNukAdivRuddhaM kAryamasa~ggRuhItaM syAt| sAmAnyaM ca “sAmAnyamekatvakaraM” ityAdinA vakShyamANalakShaNam| vRuddhiH AdhikyaM, tatkAraNaM vRuddhikAraNam| etacca sAmAnyaM sAmAnyavato mAMsadravyAdervRuddhikAraNasya lakShaNatvena vRuddhikAraNamityuktam| yato na sAmAnyaM mAMsatvAdijAtirUpaM vRuddhau kAraNaM bhavati, tathAhi sati sAmAnyaM mAMsatvarUpaM yathA vardhake bhojyarUpe mAMse~asti tathA sharIradhAturUpe vardhanIye~apyasti, tatashca nityaM mAMsatvasambandhAdamAMsAdAnAmapi mAMsena vardhitavyaM; tasmAdvRuddhikAraNalakShaNatvena sAmAnyaM vRuddhikAraNamityuktam| ata eva vaisheShike~apyuktaM- “trayANAmakAryatvamakAraNatvaM ca” iti| atra trayANAmiti sAmAnyavisheShasamavAyAnAm| ye tu samAnameva sAmAnyamiti kRutvA dravyAdyeva sAmAnyashabdenAbhidadhati, teShAM mate “sAmAnyaM ca visheShaM ca” (sU.a.1) ityAdigranthoktasya sAmAnyasya na ki~jcidanenoktaM syAdityasambandhArthatvaM prakaraNasya syAt| etacca vRuddhikAraNatvaM sAmAnyasya na lakShaNaM, kiM tarhyAyurvedopayoginA dharmeNa nirdeshaH; lakShaNaM tu “sAmAnyamekatvakaram” iti kariShyati| evaM dravyAdAvapi coddeshAnantaraM nirdeshaM kariShyati “khAdInyAtmA” ityAdinA, tato lakShaNaM “yatrAshritAH karmaguNA” ityAdinA kariShyati| sAmAnyasya ca vRuddhikAraNatvaM hyasati virodhikAraNe boddhavyaM, tenAmalakAdigatAnAmamlatvAdInAM pittagatAmlatvAdyavardhakatvamAmalakagatashishiratvaprabhAvavirodhitvAdupapannam| evamanyatrApi tridoShaharadravye boddhavyam| iha ca sAmAnyasya vRuddhikAraNatvamityucyate, natu sAmAnyameva vRuddhikAraNamityucyate, tenAsamAnAdapi ghRutAnmedhAyA vahneshca vRuddhiH prabhAvAdevopapannA, yaduktaM- “ghRutamagnimedhe karoti” iti; tathA cintayA vAtavRuddhiH, tathA sa~gkalpAdvRuShyapAdayugalepAcca shukravRuddhirityAdi prabhAvAdupapannam| sAmAnyaM ceha vRuddhikAraNamityucyamAne samAnasyeti gamyate, na hi shoNitaM prati mAMsatvaM sAmAnyaM, kintu vyAvRuttabuddhijanakatvAdvisheSha eva| atha vaisheShikoktAnAmantyavisheShANAmiha shAstre cikitsAyAmanupayuktatvAttadvisheShadharmavyAvartakatvayogAt sAmAnyavisheShAneva hrAsakAraNatvenAha- hrAsaheturityAdi| atrApi sarvadA sarvabhAvAnAmiti yojanIyam| hrAsaH apacayaH| vishiShyate vyAvartata iti visheShaH| sAmAnyameva gavedhukatvaM mAMsAdIn prati visheShaH; gavedhuko hi gavedhukatvena gavedhukavyaktyantarApekShayA samAnaH, mAMsApekShayA vyAvRuttatvAdvisheShaH; na hi mAMse gavedhukatvamasti| evaM mAMsatvaM mAMsAntarApekShayA~anugatatvAt sAmAnyaM, shoNitAdyapekShayA tu mAMsAnAM vyAvRuttatvAdvisheSha eva| atrApi hrAsahetutvaM hrAsahetudravyAdilakShaNatvena sAmAnyavajj~jeyaM; tathA hrAsahetutvamapyasati virodhake sAmAnyoktanyAyena j~jeyaM; tena mandakanikucAdInAM vAtAdiviruddhAnAmapi snigdhatvAdInAM vAtAdyashamakatvaM dravyasyApathyatvaprabhAvAdeva j~jeyam| visheShashceha viruddhavisheSho~abhipretaH; te(ye)nottaratra viruddhavisheShameva hrAsahetutayA tatra tatropadekShyati; yathA- “vRuddhiH samAnaiH sarveShAM viparItairviparyayaH” (vA.sU.a.1) iti, tathA “viparItaguNairdeshamAtrAkAlopapAditaiH” (sU.a.1) ityAdi, tathA viparItaguNairdravyairmArutaH samprashAmyati (sU.a.1) ityAdi, tathA jatUkarNe~apyuktaM- “samAnaiH sarvabhAvAnAM vRuddhirhAnirviparyayAt” iti| aviruddhavisheShastu yadyapi hrAse vRuddhau vA~apyakAraNaM, yathA- pRuthivyA anuShNAshItasparsho vAtasya shaityaM na vardhayati nApi hrAsayati, tathA~apyagnikShIyamANAnAM dhAtUnAmasamAnatvenAjanakatvAddhrAsakAraNami(me)va bhavati; yato~asamAnadravyopayoge sati hrAso vinashvarANAM bhAvAnAmApUrakahetvabhAvAdupalabhyata eva; yathA- vahato jalasya pUrvadeshasetunottaradeshajalasya hrAsaH| evambhUtaM cAviruddhavisheShopayoge~api hrAsaM pashyatA~a~acAryeNa sAmAnyenaivehoktaM hrAsaheturvisheSha iti| cashabdaH sarvabhAvAnAmiti samuccinoti| atha kimasambaddhAvapi sAmAnyavisheShau vRuddhihrAsakAraNaM netyAha - pravRuttirubhayasya tviti| ‘kAraNaM’ iti sheShaH| ubhayasya sAmAnyasya visheShasya ca, pravRuttiH pravartanaM sharIreNAbhisambandha iti yAvat; evambhUtA pravRuttiH dhAtusAmAnyavisheShayorvRuddhihrAse kAraNamityarthaH| tushabdo~avadhAraNe; tena nAsambaddhau sAmAnyavisheShau svakAryaM kuruta iti darshayati| kiMvA pravRuttiH ucitA dhAtupravRuttirdhAtusAmyamiti yAvat, sA ubhayasya sAmAnyasya visheShasya ca ‘kAryA’ iti sheShaH| tena kevalasamAnopayogAddhAtuvRuddhyA dhAtuvaiShamyaM , kevalavisheShopayogAcca dhAtukShayAddhAtuvaiShamyaM, yugapatsamAnavishiShTadravyopayogAt pravRuttirdhAtusAmyarUpA bhavatItyuktaM bhavati| tushabdaH pUrvapakShAdekadravyopayogalakShaNAdvyAvartayati||44||

1.sanskrit: sAmAnyamekatvakaraM, visheShastu pRuthaktvakRut| tulyArthatA hi sAmAnyaM, visheShastu viparyayaH||45||
1.commentary: atha kiMlakShaNaM tat sAmAnyaM kiMlakShaNo vA sa visheSha ityAha- sAmAnyamityAdi| ekatvakaramiti ekatvabuddhikaraM, sAmAnyaM yadanekAsu bhinnadeshakAlAsu gavAdivyaktiShu ‘ayaM gaurayaM gauH’ ityAdiprakArA ekAkArA buddhistat sAmAnyam| na hi bhinnAsu vyaktiShvabhinnaM sAmAnyamekarUpaM vinA~abhrAntA ekAkArA buddhirbhavatIti bhAvaH| yatrApi ca ‘ayaM pAcako~ayaM pAcakaH’ iti, tathA ayaM ‘shuklo~ayaM shuklaH’ ityAdau kriyAguNAdisAmAnyAdekarUpA buddhistatrApi sAmAnyamekakriyAguNAdigatamekarUpAdhyavasAye hetuH| na hyekasmin pAcake yA kriyA sA pAcakAntare~api, kintarhi tajjAtIyA| ataH kriyAsAmAnyaM tatrApyekatvAdhyavasAye kAraNam| visheShalakShaNaM- pRuthaktvakRuditi|- vyAvRuttabuddhikRut; tena yadgovyaktyantarApekShayaikabuddhikartRutayA gotvaM sAmAnyaM, tadeva gotvamashvAdyapekShayA vyAvRuttabuddhikartRutvAdashvAdIn prati visheSha ityuktaM bhavati| tena mAMsatvaM mAMsaM prati mAMsAntarApekShayA samAnatvAdvRuddhikAraNaM bhavati, tadeva tu mAMsatvaM vAtaM prati visheSharUpatayA hrAsaheturbhavati; shoNitAdIn prati tvavirodhivisheShatvena na tathA hrAsakAraNaM, guNasAmAnyAttu vardhakamapi mAMsaM shoNitAdInAM bhavati| kathamanekAsu vyaktiShu sAmAnyamekabuddhimavyabhicAriNIM karotItyAha- tulyArthatA hItyAdi| tulyArthatA ekasAmAnyarUpArthAnuyogitA| etena yasmAdbhinnAsu vyaktiShu sAmAnyamekarUpasambandhamasti , tatastadanekArthAvalambA satyapi vyaktibhede ekabuddhiryukteti bhAvaH| visheShastu viparyaya iti atulyArthatA hi visheShatvaM , tena gogajayoratulyagotvagajatvarUpArthayoH pRuthagbuddhiryuktaiveti darshitaM bhavati| anye tu vyAkhyAnayanti yat- trividhaM sAmAnyaM, visheShashca trividhaH; yathA- dravyagocaraH, guNagocaraH, karmagocarashca; tatra sarvadetyAdinA dravyasAmAnyamucyate; sAmAnyamekatvakaramityanena guNasAmAnyaM; yathA- payaHshukrayorbhinnajAtIyayorapi madhuratvAdiguNasAmAnyaM tatraikatAM karoti, evaM visheShe~apyudAhAryaM; tulyArthatetyAdinA tu karmasAmAnyaM nigadyate, AsyArUpaM hi karma na shleShmaNA samAnamapi tu pAnIyAdikaphasamAnadravyArthakriyAkAritvAt kaphavardhakarUpatayA AsyA~api kaphasamAnetyucyate; evaM svapnAdAvapi karmaNi boddhavyam| tadetadbhaTTAraharicandreNaiva dUShitaM; yataH sarvadetyAdinaiva lakShaNena trividhimapi sAmAnyaM labhyate, tenAsmin pakShe sAmAnyamekatvakaramityAdyavAcyaM syAditi kRutvA| anye tu pashyanti- yattrividhaM sAmAnyam- atyantasAmAnyaM, madhyasAmAnyam, ekadeshasAmAnyaM ca; tatra sarvadetyAdinA~atyantasAmAnyamucyate, sAmAnyamekatvakaramityanena madhyasAmAnyaM, tulyArthatA hItyAdinaikadeshasAmAnyaM etadapi traividhyakathanaM nAtiprayojanamasa~ggatalakShaNaM ceti nAtishraddhAkaram| kecit sAmAnyaM dvividhamicchanti- ubhayavRutti, tathaikavRutti ca; tatra mAMsaM mAMsavardhakam, ubhayavRuttisAmAnyAt; mAMsatvaM hi poShye poShake ca gatatvAdubhayavRutti; ekavRutti tu yathA- ghRutamagnikaraM, tathA dhAvanAdikarma vAtakaraM, tathA~a~asyAdi kaphakaram; etaddhi sarvaM na vardhanIyena samAnaM, kintu prabhAvAdvardhakaM; prabhAvashca ghRutatvadhAvanatvAdireva; sa caikavRuttisAmAnyarUpaH, tenAtrApi sAmAnyameva vRuddhikAraNamiti bruvate| asmiMstu pakShe~anubhayavRuttisAmAnyaM visheSha eva bhavati, tathA samAnamasamAnaM ca vRuddhikAraNaM bhavatIti na ki~jcit sAmAnyasyoktaM syAt| asmanmate tu sAmAnyaM vRuddhau kAraNameva bhavatIti sAmAnyaM vRuddhikAraNatvena niyamyate; na tu vRuddhiH sAmAnyakAraNikaiveti niyamyate, tenAsamAnAdapi vRuddhirbhavati nirdoShA| yattUcyate- karmasAmAnyaM neha tantre vRuddhikAraNamasti, yato na dhAvanena vAyuH samAna iti; ata evAcAryeNa dravyasAmAnyamuktaM “mAMsamApyAyate mAMsena” (shA.a.6) ityAdinA, tathA “samAnaguNAnAmAhAravikArANAmupayogaH” (shA.a.6) ityAdinA guNasAmAnyamuktaM; naivaM karmasAmAnyamuktaM, vacanaM hi “karmApi ca yadyasya dhAtorvRuddhikaraM tattadAsevyam” (shA.a.6) iti; na tatra sAmAnyopagrahaH kRutaH| atra brUmaH- karmaNAM prAyaH prabhAveNaiva vRuddhihetutvAt sAmAnyAnupagrahaH kRutaH, na tu karmasAmAnyAbhAvAt; yataH kriyAvato vAtasya kriyAvatA vyAyAmAdiyuktena sharIreNa vRuddhiH kriyate, niShkriyatayA cAsya vAtasya hrAsaH| svapnAdayastu “saMyoge ca vibhAge ca” ityanena vakShyamANalakShaNenAnuktA api shAstravyavahArAt karmashabdenocyate| tatra svapnaH svakAraNAdeva cIyamAnasya kaphasya kShayakAraNasharIraparispandAdinirodhakatvena vRuddhikara ucyate, na tu svapnaH sAkShAcchleShmavRuddhiM karoti| evamAsyAdAvapi cintanIyam| yatra tvevaM kAraNaM cintayituM na pAryate tatra prabhAva eva varNanIyaH| nanu mAMsaM mAMsaM vardhayati sAmAnyAt, visheShAcca vAtaM kShapayati, tat kathaM yugapadviruddhArthadvayakartRutvaM mAMsasya; na hi devadatto yadaiva kumbhaM karoti tadaiva kANDamapi| naivaM, kriyAvatAmayaM dharmo nAkriyAvatAmiti ; tathAhi- shabdo yugapadanekAneva shabdAnekakAlamArabhate, tathA~agniH prakAshadAhau yugapat karoti; ata evoktamAcAryeNa- “tasmAdbheShajaM samyagavacAryamANaM yugapadUnAtiriktAnAM dhAtUnAM sAmyakaraM bhavati; adhikamapakarShati, nyUnamApyAyayati” (shA.a.6) iti| yaducyate- kShIyamANadhAtorvRuddhasya tathA bahudoShasya samAnaguNo~apyAhAro na vRuddhihetuH, tathA grIShme ca madhurAdinA samAnenApi na kaphAbhivRuddhirityAdi; tatra pratibandhakAnAM jarA-bahudoShatva-grIShmoShNatvAdInAM vidyamAnatvAnna sAmAnyaM vardhakam; asati ca virodhake sAmAnyaM vRuddhikAraNamiti siddhAntaH; tena na kAcit kShatiH| kiMvA vRuddhAdInAM samAnenAhAreNa kriyata eva vRuddhiH; paramatibalavatA kShayahetunA~a~adhIyamAnakShaye puruShe sA vRuddhirnopalabhyate| atra ca dravyasAmAnyameva dhAtUnAM dravyarUpANAM vardhakaM na guNasAmAnyaM, guNAnAM dravyAnArambhakatvAt| guNasAmAnyAttu tadguNAshrayaM dravyamanumIyate; tacca dravyaM dhAtuvardhakaM bhavati, yathA- rUkShAdIn guNAn dRuShTvA citrako vAyvadhiko yo~anumitaH, sa ca citraka upayukto vAtaM vardhayati, guNAstu guNAneva janayanto~abhivardhayanti| sAmAnyaM ca vRuddhikAraNalakShaNaM na sAkShAdvRuddhikAraNamiti prAgevoktam; evaM visheShe~api| ayaM ca sAmAnyavisheShavAdo granthavistarabhayAdAyurvedopayuktadharmamAtreNoktaH; vistarastvasya vaisheShike boddhavyaH||45||

1.sanskrit: sattvamAtmA sharIraM ca trayametattridaNDavat| lokastiShThati saMyogAttatra sarvaM pratiShThitam||46|| sa pumAMshcetanaM tacca taccAdhikaraNaM smRutam| vedasyAsya, tadarthaM hi vedo~ayaM samprakAshitaH||47||
1.commentary: samprati sAmAnyavisheShAvabhidhAya, uddeshakramAnurodhAdguNe~abhidhAtavye, guNeShu pradhAnabhUtamAyurvedopakAryaM sattvAtmasharIrasaMyogaM vaktumAha- sattvamityAdi; kiMvA sAmAnyavisheShAbhyAmeva hetuli~ggauShadhAni darshitAni, sAmAnyavisheShavata eva sarvatra kAraNatvAlli~ggatvAccaitAvadeva vicAryamANaM tantraM bhavati, adhikaraNaM ca noktam, ataH sattvAdimelakaM hetvAdyadhikaraNamAha- sattvamityAdi| sattvaM manaH| cashabdaH samuccaye| sa~gkhyeyanirdeshAdeva sa~gkhyAyAM labdhAyAM trayamiti padaM militAnAmeva grahaNArtham| etadityanantaroktanirdeshaH| tridaNDaH parasparasaMyogavidhRutaH kumbhAdidhArakastadvat| etena yathA tridaNDe~anyatamApAye nAvasthAnaM, tathA sattvAdInAmanyatamApAye~api na lokasthitirityuktaM bhavati| lokata Alokata iti lokaH, teneha ja~ggamo bhUtagrAma ucyate| saMyogAttiShThatIti parasparopagrAhakAt saMyogAt svArthakriyAM kurvanna vishakalitaM bhavati| atra tu pRuthagindriyagrahaNaM na kRutaM, sharIragrahaNenaiva gRuhItatvAt| tatra sarvaM pratiShThitamiti tasmiMlloke karmaphalAdi vyavasthitaM; yadvakShyati- “atra karmaphalaM cAtra j~jAnaM cAtra pratiShThitam| atra mohaH sukhaM duHkhaM jIvitaM maraNaM svatA” (shA.a.1) iti| sa pumAniti tat sattvAditrayaM pumAniti bhaNyate| tatra yadyapi sattvAditrayaM napuMsakali~ggaM, tathA~api pumAniti vakShyamANali~ggagrahaNAt ‘sa’ iti puMli~gganirdeshaH; yathA- “NeraNau yatkarma Nau cet sa kartAnAdhyAne” (pA.a.1pA.3sU.67) ityAdau| ki~jcaitaditi yadyapi vartamAnanirdeshaH kRutastathA~api tasyaiva ‘sa’ ityatItanirdisho~api sarvanAmnAM sarvakAlanirdeshAdevAviruddho mantavyaH| vadanti hi lAkShaNikAH- “pratyakShe ca parokShe ca sAmIpye dUra eva ca| eteShvartheShu vidvadbhiH sarvanAma prayujyate” iti| cetanamiti j~jAnavat| taccAdhikaraNaM smRutaM tantrasyetyatra hetumAha- tadarthaM hItyAdi| tadarthamiti tadupakArArtham; etena taduddishya pravRuttiradhikaraNArthA nAdhArArtheti darshayati| atra sattvamAdau kRutaM, tadadhInatvAdAtmasharIrakriyAyAH; yaduktaM- “acetanaM kriyAvacca manashcetayitA paraH| yuktasya manasA tasya nirdishantyAtmanaH kriyAm” (shA.a.1) iti| pUrvaM sharIretyAdinA~a~ayuruktaM, sattvamAtmetyAdinA tu tantrAdhikaraNabhUtapuruSha ucyata iti na paunaruktyam| atra cAtmagrahaNena buddhyaha~gkArAdInAM grahaNaM, sharIragrahaNenendriyANAmarthAnAM ca sharIrasambaddhAnAM grahaNaM vyAkhyeyam||46-47||

1.sanskrit: khAdInyAtmA manaH kAlo dishashca dravyasa~ggrahaH| sendriyaM cetanaM dravyaM, nirindriyamacetanam||48||
1.commentary: samprati guNAbhidhAnaM kramaprAptamulla~gghya dravyANi nirdishatA guNAdhAratayA dravyasya prAdhAnyamucyate; sUtre ca “sAmAnyaM ca visheShaM ca” ityAdau guNAnAdau nirdishatA guNAnAmeva rasAdInAM prAyaH shAstre kArmukatvamupadarshyate; ata evAtreyabhadrakApyIye (sU.a.26) madhurAdirasadvArA sarvaguNAn karmANi ca dravyasya vakShyati; ki~jca sarvapradhAnaM yajjIvitaM tadeva saMyogaguNarUpamityagre tatra guNagrahaNaM, sa ca saMyogaguNaH sattvamAtmetyAdinA prathamamukta eva; visheShaguNeShu tu dravyaM pradhAnamiti dravyamucyate- khAdInItyAdi| khAdInItyAdAvAtmA kasmAt pradhAnabhUto~api prathamaM noktaH? ucyate- sharIrasyeha vyAdhyArogyAdhikaraNatayA pradhAnatvAttadArambhakAni khAdInyevocyante nAtmA, tasya nirvikAratvAt; vacanaM hi “nirvikAraH parastvAtmA” (sU.a.1) ityAdi; khAdIni ca “mahAbhUtAni khaM vAyuragnirApaH kShitistathA” (shA.a.1) ityanena krameNoktAni bhUtAnyanAgatAvekShaNenocyante | AtmAdInAM ca yathAbhyarhitasya pUrvanirdeshaH| dravyasa~ggraha iti karacaraNaharItakItrivRutAdyasa~gkhyeyabhedabhinnasya kAryadravyasya kAraNadvArA sa~gkShepa ityarthaH| sarvakAryadravyANAmapi vyavasthAmAha- sendriyamityAdi| nirindriyamityatra niHshabdo~abhAve, nirmakShikamitivat| atra sendriyaM cetanamityevAvataivArthApattyA nirindriyamacetanamiti labdhe~api punastadvacanamevambhUtArthApatteranaikAntikatvAdboddhavyam| yathA navajvare divAsvapnAdi niShiddhaM, arthAjjIrNe jvare tadApadyeta , na caivaM; tatra teShAM divAsvapnAdInAM niShiddhatvAt; tasmAttrividhashiShyabuddhihitatayohyamapi sAkShAdevocyate; vadanti hi nyAyavido- “vyAkhyAnAdvaraM karaNam” iti| yadyapi cAtmaiva cetano na sharIraM, nApi manaH, yaduktaM- “cetanAvAn yatashcAtmA tataH kartA nirucyate” (shA.a.1) iti, tathA~api salilauShNyavat saMyuktasamavAyena sharIrAdyapi cetanam| idameva cAtmanashcetanatvaM yadindriyayoge sati j~jAnashAlitvaM, na kevalasyAtmanashcetanatvaM ; yaduktaM- “AtmA j~jaH, karaNairyogAjj~jAnaM tvasya pravartate” (shA.a.1) iti| atra sendriyatvena vRukShAdInAmapi cetanatvaM boddhavyaM; tathAhi- sUryabhaktAyA yathA yathA sUryo bhramati tathA tathA bhramaNAddRuganumIyate, tathA lavalI meghastanitashravaNAt phalavatI bhavati, bIjapUrakamapi shRugAlAdivasAgandhenAtIva phalavadbhavati, cUtAnAM ca matsyavasAsekAt phalADhyatayA rasanamanumIyate, ashokasya ca kAminIpAdatalAhatisukhinaH stabakitasya sparshanAnumAnaM; smRutishcAnumAnaM draDhayati, yathA- “yo~abhivAditaviprastu nAshiShaM samprayacchati| shmashAne jAyate vRukSho gRudhraka~gkopasevitaH” iti; tathA “vRukShagulmaM bahuvidhaM tatraiva tRuNajAtayaH| tamasA~adharmarUpeNa cchAditAH karmahetunA|| antaHsa~jj~jA bhavantyete sukhaduHkhasamanvitAH| etadantAshca gatayo brahmAdyAH samudAhRutAH” (manusmRuti a.1) iti| tathA tantrakArashca vAnaspatyAnUkAn prANino vakShyati; tenAgamasaMvalitayA yuktyA cetanA vRukShAH||48||

1.sanskrit: sArthA gurvAdayo buddhiH prayatnAntAH parAdayaH| guNAH proktAH ...|49|
1.commentary: samprati guNAnnirdeShTumAha- sArthA ityAdi| anena trividhA api vaisheShikAH sAmAnyA AtmaguNAshcoddiShTAH| tatrArthAH shabdasparsharUparasagandhAH| yaduktam- “arthAH shabdAdayo j~jeyA gocarA viShayA guNAH” (shA.a.1) iti| ete ca vaisheShikAH; yata AkAshasyaiva shabdaH prAdhAnyena, vAyoreva sparshaH prAdhAnyena, evamagnyAdiShu rUpAdayaH| anyaguNAnAM cAnyatra darshanaM bhUtAntarAnupraveshAt | vacanaM hi- “viShTaM hyaparaM pareNa” (nyA.da.a.3A.1sU.66) iti| gurvAdayastu gurulaghushItoShNasnigdharUkShamandatIkShNasthirasaramRudukaThinavishadapicchilashlakShNakharasthUlasUkShmasAndradravA viMshatiH| ete ca sAmAnyaguNAH, pRuthivyAdInAM sAdhAraNatvAt| ete yajjaHpuruShIye prAya AyurvedopayuktatvAt parAdibhyaH pRuthak paThitAH| buddhiH j~jAnam; anena ca smRuticetanAdhRutyaha~gkArAdInAM buddhivisheShANAM grahaNam| prayatno~ante yeShAM nirdeshe te prayatnAntAH; etena cecchAdveShasukhaduHkhaprayatnAnAM grahaNam| vacanaM hi- “icchA dveShaH sukhaM duHkhaM prayatnashcetanA dhRutiH| buddhiH smRutiraha~gkAro li~ggAni paramAtmanaH” (shA.a.1) iti| iha cetanAdInAM buddhigrahaNenaiva grahaNaM, shArIre tu cetanAdInAmapi pRuthagAtmagamakatvena pRuthak pAThaH| etacca tatraiva vyAkaraNIyam| parAdayo yathA- “parAparatve yuktishca sa~gkhyA saMyoga eva ca| vibhAgashca pRuthaktvaM ca parimANamathApi ca|| saMskAro~abhyAsa ityete guNAH proktAH parAdayaH|” (sU.a.26) iti| ete ca sAmAnyaguNA api nAtyupayuktatvAttathA buddhiprAdhAnyAccAnte proktAH| proktA iti prakarSheNa visheShaguNatvAdinoktAH|49|-

1.sanskrit: ...prayatnAdi karma ceShTitamucyate||49||
1.commentary: kramAgataM karma nirdishati- prayatnAdItyAdi| prayatanaM prayatnaH karmaivAdyamAtmanaH; yathA- “tulyAsyaprayatnaM savarNam” (pA.a.1pA.1sU.9) ityatra vyAkhyAtam| AdishabdaH prakAravAcI| tena saMskAragurutvAdijanyakRutsnakriyAvarodhaH| yadyapi ceShTitaM prANivyApAra ucyate, tathA~apIha sAmAnyena kriyA vivakShitA| ceShTitapadenaiva sarvakarmalAbhe siddhe vamanAdikarmaniShedhe ca siddhe prayatnAdIti padaM susUkShmaprayatnarUpakarmavyApitvadyotanArtham | anye tu prayatnAdIti prayatnakAraNamiti bruvate, prayatnagrahaNaM ca kAraNopalakShaNaM vadanti; tena gurutvAdikAryasyApi karmaNo grahaNamiti| prayatnashabdashcAyurvede~api karmavacano dRushyate; “pravRuttistu ceShTA kAryArthA, saiva kriyA prayatnaH kAryasamArambhashca” (vi.a.8) iti vacanAt||49||

1.sanskrit: samavAyo~apRuthagbhAvo bhUmyAdInAM guNairmataH| sa nityo yatra hi dravyaM na tatrAniyato guNaH||50||
1.commentary: samavAyamAha- samavAya ityAdi| samavAyasya cAyaM nirdesha eva lakShaNam| tenottaratra dravyAdilakShaNe punarasya lakShaNaM na kartavyam| samavAya iti lakShyanirdeshaH, apRuthagbhAva iti lakShaNam; apRuthagbhAvaH ayutasiddhiH, sahaivAvasthAnamiti yAvat| yathA- avayavAvayavinoH, guNaguNinoH, karmakarmavatoH, sAmAnyasAmAnyavatoH; nahyavayavAdIn virahayyAvayavyAdaya upalabhyante| apRuthagbhAvameva visheShayannAha- bhUmyAdInAM guNairmata iti| bhUmyAdInAM bhUmiprakArANAM; bhUmishca bhUyasAmAdheyAnAmAdhArA, tenAdhAratvodAharaNArthamuktA; yato bhUmerarthAH sarve gurvAdiparAdyAshca guNAstathA cAvayavisAmAnyaka(dha)rmANyapyAdheyAni, netaradravye yathoktasarvAdheyasampattiH| etena bhUmyAdInAmityAdhArANAM, guNairiti apradhAnairAdheyaiH; Adheyo hyAdhArApekShayA~apradhAnam, apradhAne ca guNashabdo yathA- guNIbhUto~ayamiti, apradhAnamityarthaH; tenAdhArANAmAdheyairyo~apRuthagbhAvaH sa samavAyaH iti| tena pRuthivItvagandhavattvayorapRuthaksiddhayorapyAdhArAdheyabhAvAbhAvAnna samavAya ityuktaM bhavati| ata evoktaM vaisheShike yat- “ayutasiddhAnAmAdhAryAdhArabhUtAnAM yaH sambandha ihetipratyayahetuH sa samavAyaH” (pa.dha.saM.dravyapadArthanirUpaNa) iti| sa nitya iti samavAyo~avinAshI| satyapi samavAyinAM dravyANAM nAshe samavAyo na vinashyati| atra hetumAha- yatra hItyAdi| yatra dravyaM niyataM nityaM, yathA- AkAshaM, na tatra nitya AkAshe~aniyato vinAshI guNaH, ‘kashcit’ iti sheShaH| evaM manyate- nitye vyomni parimANamapi tAvannityaM, tathA dravyatvamapyAkAshagataM nityaM, tathA nityayorAkAshatadguNayoH samavAyalakShaNaH sambandho~api nitya eva| evaM tatra samavAyasya nityatve siddhe ekarUpatvAt samavAyasyAnyatrApi nityatvameva| na cAshrayadravyanAshe samavAyavinAshaH| yathA- govyaktivinAshe~api gotvasya sAmAnyasya na vinAshaH| nityasyaiva samavAyasya te te pArthivadravyAdayastatra tatra vya~jjakA bhavanti sAmAnyasyeva vyaktayaH| anyaistu nityAnityabhedena dvividhaH samavAyo vyAkhyAtaH; ayaM ca grantho bhUmyAdInAM guNaireva yaH sambandhastasyaiva yathAshrutasya pratipAdaka iti vyAkhyAtaM; tattu na vyApakaM nApi vaisheShikamatAnuyAyIti neha prapa~jcitam||50||

1.sanskrit: yatrAshritAH karmaguNAH kAraNaM samavAyi yat| taddravyaM ...|51|
1.commentary: dravyalakShaNamAha- yatretyAdi| yatrAshritA yatra samavetAH, karma ca guNAshca karmaguNAH| kAraNaM samavAyi yaditi samavAyi kAraNaM yat, dravyameva hi dravyaguNakarmaNAM samavAyikAraNam| samavAyikAraNaM ca tad yat svasamavetaM kAryaM janayati; guNakarmaNI tu na svasamavetaM kAryaM janayataH, ato na te samavAyikAraNe| etatkarmavattvaM hi dravyasya guNAdipa~jcapadArthavyAvRuttimAtralakShaNakathanaM, na tu sajAtIyavyApakavijAtIyavyAvartakalakShaNakathanaM; yena karmasamavAyo nAkAshAdInAM vartate , tena lakShaNAnugataM vijAtIyavyAvRuttaM dravyasya lakShaNaM guNavattvaM samavAyikAraNatvaM ca boddhavyam| yadu(ttU)tpannamAtraM dravyaM prathamakShaNe nirguNaM, tadapi dvitIyakShaNAvashyambhAviguNavattayA tadyogyatvAdguNavadeveti mantavyam| vaisheShike~apyucyate- kriyAvadguNavat samavAyikAraNaM dravyam (vai.da.a.1sU.15) iti| tatrApi ca yatheha vyAkhyAtaM tathaiva vyAkhyAtam| 51|-

1.sanskrit: ...samavAyI tu nishceShTaH kAraNaM guNaH||51||
1.commentary: guNalakShaNamAha- samavAyItyAdi| samavAyIti samavAyAdheyaH; tena vyApakadravyebhyo niShkriyebhya AkAshAdibhyo guNasya vyAvRuttiH; nahyAkAshAdayaH samavAyAdheyAH| nirgatashceShTAyAH nishceShTaH; ceShTAnirgatyA ceha ceShTAshUnyatvaM tathA ceShTAvyatiriktatvaM cocyate; tena ceShTArUpAt karmaNo vyAvRuttiH, tathA kriyAdhAratvayogebhyo mUrtadravyebhyo vyAvRuttiH siddhA; guNasya kAraNamityanena cAkAraNebhyaH sAmAnyavisheShasamavAyebhyo vyAvRuttiH siddhA| kAraNatvaM tu vibhudravyaparimANAntyAvayavirUpAdiShu lakShaNIyeShu guNeShu nAsti, tena bhAgAsiddhaM lakShaNaM syAt, ataH kAraNatveneha bhAvarUpakAraNAvyabhicAri sAmAnyavattvaM lakShaNatayA boddhavyam| tacca sAmAnyavattvaM sarvaguNavyApakaM sAmAnyAdivyAvartakaM ca, sAmAnyAdInAM sAmAnyavattvAbhAvAt| athavA vibhudravyaparimANAntyAvayavirUpAdyantarANAM kAraNatvadarshanAdvibhudravyaparimANAntyAvayavirUpAdAvapi kAraNatvayogyatvamastyeveti na bhAgAsiddhatA kAraNatvasya; kiMvA yogipratyakShaj~jAnahetutayA vibhudravyaparimANAdInAmapi kAraNatvaM boddhavyam| evambhUtaM ca kAraNatvaM yadyapi sAmAnyAdiShvapi kvacidanugamyate, tathA~api ‘samavAyI tu’ iti padena samavAyAdhAratA tathA samavAyAdheyatA ca yugapadvipakShitA; tena samavAyakevalAdhArasya vibhudravyasya tathA samavAyakevalAdheyasya sAmAnyAdeshca vyudAsaH siddho bhavati||51||

1.sanskrit: saMyoge ca vibhAge ca kAraNaM dravyamAshritam| kartavyasya kriyA karma karma nAnyadapekShate||52||
1.commentary: karmalakShaNamAha- saMyoga ityAdi| saMyoge ca vibhAge ca yugapat kAraNam| tena saMyoge uttaradeshasaMyogakArake vibhAgAkAraNe, tathA vibhAge ca vibhAgajavibhAgamAtrakAraNe saMyogAkAraNe vyAvRuttiH siddhA| dravyamAshritamiti svarUpamAtrakathanaM vyAkhyeyaM, dravyavyAvRuttistu ‘karma nAnyadapekShate’ ityanenaiva siddhA | asyAyamartho yat- karma utpannaM svAshrayasya dravyasya pUrvadeshavibhAge uttaradeshasaMyoge ca kartavye nAnyatkAraNaM pashcAtkAlabhAvyapekShate; dravyaM tu yadyapi saMyogavibhAgakAraNaM yugapadbhavati, tathA~api tadutpannaM sadyadA karmayuktaM bhavati tadaiva saMyogavibhAgakAraNaM syAt ; karma tUtpannaM karotyeva paraM saMyogavibhAgau na tu kAraNAntaraM pashcAdbhAvyapekShate, saMyogavibhAgAshrayapratyAsattiM tvapekShate, sA ca pUrvasiddhaiveti na caramabhAvikAraNAntarApekShatA karmaNaH| atha karmashabdena vamanAdInAM tathA~adRuShTasya tathA kriyAyAshcAbhidhIyamAnatvAt kasya karmaNa idaM lakShaNamityata Aha- kartavyasya kriyA karmeti| etena kriyArUpasya karmaNa idaM lakShaNaM nAdRuShTAderiti||52||

1.sanskrit: ityuktaM kAraNaM...|53|
1.commentary: prakaraNamupasaMharati- itItyAdi| iti samAptau; tenaitAvadeva sAmAnyAdiShaTkaM sarvasyaiva kAryajAtasya kAraNaM, nAnyat kAraNamasti|53|-

1.sanskrit: ... kAryaM dhAtusAmyamihocyate| dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA tantrasyAsya prayojanam||53||
1.commentary: kAraNaM sAmAnyenAbhidhAyAyurvedopayuktaM kAryamAha- kAryamityAdi| dhAtusAmyam ArogyaM; vakShyati hi- “vikAro dhAtuvaiShamyaM sAmyaM prakRutirucyate| sukhasa~jj~jakamArogyam” (sU.a.9) ityAdi| ihetyAyurvede; tenAnyatrAnyadapi ghaTAdi kAryamucyate| iha tu kimiti tat kAryaM nocyata ityAha- dhAtusAmyetyAdi| cakAro hetau| dhAtusAmyakriyaiva yasmAdAyurvedaprayojanaM, tasmAdAyurvede dhAtusAmyameva kAryamucyate prayojanaM kathyate; anyattvavivakShitatvAttathA~apradhAnatvAcca neha kAryatvenocyate||53||

1.sanskrit: kAlabuddhIndriyArthAnAM yogo mithyA na cAti ca| dvayAshrayANAM vyAdhInAM trividho hetusa~ggrahaH||54||
1.commentary: samprati sAmAnyena kAraNamuktaM tadAyurvedopayuktadvAreNa vaktavyaM; tatra vyAdhikAraNameva tAvadagre~abhidhIyate- kAletyAdinA sUtrakramAnurodhAt| sUtraNaM hi “hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnam” (sU.a.1) iti| kAlaH shItoShNavarShalakShaNaH, buddhiH praj~jA, indriyArthAH shabdasparsharUparasagandhAstatsahacaritAni dravyaguNakarmANIndriyadvAropayujyamAnAni ca; teShAM kAlAdInAM yogaH sambandhaH| tasya visheShaNatrayaM- mithyA na cAti ceti| tena kAlAdInAM mithyAyogaH, naca yogaH ayoga ityarthaH, ati ca yogaH atiyoga ityarthaH| dvayAshrayANAmiti manaHsharIrAshrayANAm| etacca manaHsharIrAdhiShThAnatvaM pRutha~gmilitaM ca boddhavyam| trividha ityayogAtiyogamithyAyogarUpaH| hetusa~ggrahaH hetusa~gkShepaH| ete ca kAlAdInAmatiyogAyogamithyAyogAstisraiShaNIye “tatrAtiprabhAvatAM” (sU.a.11) ityAdinA granthena suvyaktaM vAcyA iti neha vivriyante| kAlagrahaNaM tvihAdau kRutaM, kAlasya duShparihAratvAt| tadanu buddhirucyate, buddhyaparAdhasyaivendriyArthAtiyogAdihetutvAt; vakShyati hi- “praj~jAparAdhAddhyahitAnarthAn pa~jca niShevate” (sU.a.28) iti; evaM ca yadyapyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH praj~jAparAdhe pravishati, tathA~api pratyAsannakAraNatvAdasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogenaivAyaM pRuthak tantre sUcyate, praj~jAparAdhastvasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogavyatiriktakAyavA~gmanaHkriyAparAdhe vartate| atra cAdharmo~api vyAdhiheturasti, yaduktaM- “kriyAghnAH karmajA rogAH” (shA.a.1) ityAdi; tasya cAdharmasya kAlagrahaNenaiva grahaNaM kecinmanyante; tanna, tisraiShaNIye praj~jAparAdhenaivAdharmagrahaNAt| tatra hi, anRutavacanAbhidhyAdivA~gmanomithyAyogarUpaH praj~jAparAdhavisheSha uktaH; natvanRutavacanAdInAM svarUpeNa vyAdhikartRutvaM, kintvadharmotpAdAvAntaravyApArANAmeva; tena praj~jAparAdha evAdharmotpAdAvAntaravyApAraH karmajarogeShu kAraNaM, yAga iva dharmotpAdAvAntaravyApAraH svarge| yattUcyate- kAlapariNAmajAyamAnatvAt karmajavikArANAM kAlajatvaM, yaduktaM- “kAlasya pariNAmena jarAmRutyunimittajAH| rogAH svAbhAvikA dRuShTAH svabhAvo niShpratikriyaH” (shA.a.1) iti; tanna, tathA satyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogajasyApi ki~jcitkAlapariNAmajAyamAnasya kAlajatvaM syAt| naca kAlAtiyogAdyabhidhAyigranthe tisraiShaNIye karmAvarodhaH kathamapi pratibhAti| katidhApuruShIye tu “dhIdhRutismRutivibhraMshaH samprAptiH kAlakarmaNAm| asAtmyendriyasaMyogA vij~jeyA rogahetavaH” (shA.a.1) ityabhidhAya svAbhAvikAnAM rogANAM tathA karmajAnAM ca kAlaja evAvarodhaH kRutaH| uktaM hi tatra- “kAlasya pariNAmena jarAmRutyunimittajAH| rogAH svAbhAvikA dRuShTAH svabhAvo niShpratikriyaH” (shA.a.1) iti, tathA “nirdiShTaM daivasa~jj~jaM tu karma yat paurvadaihikam| hetustadapi kAlena rogANAmupalabhyate” (shA.a.1) iti| atrApi buddhimithyAyogarUpaH praj~jAparAdha eva rogajanakakarmakAraNam| kAlavisheShaprAptyA tu yeShAM vyAdhInAmAgamo bhavati, te kAlamithyAdiyogajanyA vA bhavantu, asAtmyendriyArthapraj~jAparAdhajanyA vA; sarva evAvisheSheNa kAlakRutAbhivyaktimAtraparigrahaNAttatra kAlasamprAptijanyA ityuktA gadAH| tathAhi- tatra santatAdijvarA api kAlajanyA evoktAH| vacanaM hi- “santataH satato~anyedyustRutIyakacaturthakau| sve sve kAle pravartante kAle hyeShAM balAgamaH” (shA.a.1) iti| naca santatAdau kAlasya mithyAyogAdayaH kAraNatvenopalabhyante, kintarhyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogapraj~jAparAdhAveva; tathA svAbhAvikeShu ca rogeShu na kAlamithyAyogAdayaH kAraNatvenopalabhyante; tasmAnna tatra kAlamithyAyogAdijanyAH kAlajatvenAcAryasyAbhipretAH, kintu kAlAbhivya~jjanIyAH kAlajAH; ata eva ca tatra “samprAptiH kAlakarmaNAm” (shA.a.1) iti paThitaM natu “kAlo mithyA na cAti ca” iti paThitam | ki~jca tatrApi kAlamabhidhAyApi karmaNAmiti padaM pRuthak paThitvA kAle jAtaH karmajaH pRuthageva sUcitaH| ki~jca, unmAdanidAne sAkShAdevAcAryeNa karmajasya praj~jAparAdhajatvamuktam| vacanaM hi- “praj~jAparAdhAt sambhUte vyAdhau karmaja AtmanaH| nAbhishaMsedbudho devAnna pitRUnna ca rAkShasAn” (ni.a.7) iti| janapadoddhvaMsanIye~apyuktaM- “tasyamUlamadharmaH, tanmUlaM cAsatkarma pUrvakRutaM, tayoryoniH praj~jAparAdha eva” (vi.a.3)| (tadevaM karmApekShadvayamupadarshitaM,) balAbalaM tu vidvAMsaH svayameva nirlocayiShyanti| idaM tvatra cintyatAM- svAbhAvikAnAM kShutpipAsAdInAM tathA kAlasamyagyoge~api jAyamAnAnAM doShacayaprakopANAM kva pravesho bhavatu; na tAvat kAlaje, yataH kAlo hi tatra samyagyukta eva, kAlasamyagyogashca na vyAdhikAraNamiti siddhAntaH; atha kAlapratiniyatastatrAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga eva kAraNamiShyate, tathA~apyevaM sati kAlamithyAyogAdAvapyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga eva kAraNamiti vaktuM pAryate; tasmAdasminmArge evaM buddhirvalate - yat- sahajAnAM vikArANAM niShpratikriyatvenehAyogAdijanyatvenAvarodho na kRuta eva, kAlasvabhAvajA api sahajA eva; yA tvatra pratikriyA kAlasvabhAvajAnAmanAgatAnAM bhAvAnAM sattvaguNadravyasevAdirUpA tathA svAbhAvikAnAM ca kShutpipAsAjarAdInAM kAlabhojanarasAyanAdirUpA, tasyA akaraNe sati kAlasvabhAvajasya rogasya prAdurbhAvaH praj~jAparAdhajanya eva, ucite hi kAle kartavyAkaraNaM praj~jAparAdha eva; uktaM hi katidhApuruShIye~api praj~jAparAdhasa~ggrahe- “karmakAlAtipAtashca mithyArambhashca karmaNAm” (shA.a.1) iti| anye tu mithyAyogAdishUnyakAlavidyamAnatvena kAla evAvarodha eShAM vikArANAmiti katidhApuruShIye vakShyamANagranthasya yathAshrutArthaparigrahAdvarNayanti| naceti cakArAddhInayogaM gRuhNAti| vakShyati hi- “mithyAtihInali~ggebhyo yo vyAdhirupajAyate” (shA.a.1) iti| hInayogasya tu sAkShAdapaThanamayogaprabhedatvAt; svalpayoge(go)~apyayogo bhavati, yathaikataNDulAbhyavahAre~anashanamucyate||54||

1.sanskrit: sharIraM sattvasa~jj~jaM ca vyAdhInAmAshrayo mataH| tathA sukhAnAM, yogastu sukhAnAM kAraNaM samaH||55||
1.commentary: dvayAshrayANAmityanenoktamAshrayaM darshayati- sharIramityAdi| atra sharIramAdau kRutaM, sharIrarogAdhikAreNaivAsya tantrasya pravRuttatvAt| sattvasa~jj~jashabdena mana ucyate; kiMvA sattvashabdenaiva manasi labdhe sa~jj~jAshabdenAtmasharIrasambaddhaM mana ucyate, sharIrAdyasambandhasya manaso vyAdhyanAshrayatvAt| asamAsena ca pRuthagapi sharIramanasorvyAdhyAshrayatvaM darshayati| yataH kuShThAdayaH shArIrA eva, kAmAdayastu mAnasAH, unmAdAdayashca dvayAshrayAH| ArogyasyAshrayaM hetuM cAha- tathA sukhAnAmityAdi| sukhAnAmiti ArogyANAm| vacanaM hi- “sukhasa~jj~jakamArogyaM vikAro duHkhameva tu” (sU.a.9) iti| tatheti sharIraM manashca, tatra sharIrarogAbhAvarUpasyArogyasya sharIramAshrayaH, mAnasarogAbhAvasya tu manaH| yogastu samaH kAlabuddhIndriyArthAnAM samyagyogarUpastathA sukhAnAmArogyANAM kAraNam| sukhAnAmiti sukhapadAbhidheyAnAM ca rogAbhAvAnAM bahutvaM niShedhyarogabahutvAdeva boddhavyam| idameva hyabhAvAnAM bahutvaM yanniShedhyabhAvabahutvam| nanu “AyurvedAgamo hetuH” (sU.a.1) ityAdAvadhyAyArthasa~ggrahe vyAdhyAshrayo na sa~ggRuhItaH, tat kimidamanArShaM? na, hetavashcetyanena vyAdhyAshrayarUpasyApi hetostatra sa~ggrahaNam||55||

1.sanskrit: nirvikAraH parastvAtmA sattvabhUtaguNendriyaiH| caitanye kAraNaM nityo draShTA pashyati hi kriyAH||56||
1.commentary: sattvamAtmA sharIraM ceti vacanena trayamupAttam, atra sharIramanasI vyAdhyAshrayatayokte , Atmanastu kA vyavasthetyAha- nirvikAra ityAdi| nirvikAro nirvikRutiH, tena nIrogatvamAtmanaH| para iti sUkShmaH shreShTho vA, tena sattvasharIrAtmamelakarUpo ya Atmashabdenocyate taM vyAvartayati; yaduktaM- “saMyogapuruShasyeShTo visheSho vedanAkRutaH” (shA.a.1) iti| saMyoge~api cAtmAdInAM manasyeva vedanA bhavati, sA tu manaHsaMyukte Atmanyapi sambaddhetyucyate, tena “nirvyathe cAntarAtmani” (sU.a.22) iti vacanaM nirvyathe manasIti syAt ; tathA sharIrAdAvapyAtmashabdo vartate, tadvyavacchedArthaM para iti padam| uktaM hyanyatra- “brahmendravAyvagnimanodhRutInAM dharmasya kIrteryashasaH shriyashca| tathA sharIrasya sharIriNashca syAddvAdashasvi~ggita AtmashabdaH” iti| nanu, yadyAtmA nirvikArastat kiM j~jAnarUpo~apyasya vikAro~asti vA nAstItyAha- sattvetyAdi| sattvaM manaH, bhUtaguNAH shabdAdayaH, indriyANi cakShurAdIni, etaiH karaNabhUtaishcaitanye kAraNaM bhavatyAtmA| caitanyaM cAtmani jAyate vyajyate vA| ata eva ca sattvAdInAM j~jAnakAraNAnAM sarvatrAsambhavAt sarvagate~apyAtmani na sarvatra pradeshe j~jAnaM bhavati| nanu yadi caitanyavAnAtmA, tadA kadAcijj~jAnavAn kadAcidaj~ja ityanityaH syAdityAha- nitya iti| nityasyApyAtmano j~jAnamanityaM; naca dharmAnityatve dharmiNo~apyanityatvaM, nahyAkAshaguNashabdAnityatve~apyAkAshasyApyanityatvamiti bhAvaH| nityatvaM cAtmanaH pUrvAparAvasthAnubhUtArthapratisandhAnAt; nahyanitye j~jAtari pUrvAnubhUtamarthamuttaro j~jAtA pratisandhatte ; nahi devadattabuddhamarthaM yaj~jadatto~avagatatvena pratisandadhAti| nanu, dRushyate j~jAnavataH sukhopalabdhAvanurAgalakShaNo vikArastathA duHkhopalabdhau ca dveShalakShaNaH, tat kathaM sukhaduHkhopalabdhAvayamAtmA nirvikAra ityAha- draShTA pashyati hi kriyA iti| draShTA sAkShI; tena yatiryathA paramashAntaH sAkShI sa~jjagataH kriyAH sarvAH pashyanna rAgadveShAdinA yujyate, tathA~a~atmA~api sukhaduHkhAdyupalabhamAno~api na rAgAdinA yujyate; dRushyamAnarAgAdivikArastu manasi, prAkRutabuddhau vA sA~gkhyadarshanaparigrahAdbhavatIti bhAvaH| sA~gkhyamate ca manaHshabdena buddhirantaHkaraNaM ca gRuhyate||56||

1.sanskrit: vAyuH pittaM kaphashcoktaH shArIro doShasa~ggrahaH| mAnasaH punaruddiShTo rajashca tama eva ca||57||
1.commentary: samprati vikArAshrayaM tathA vikArasya vyavahitaM ca hetumabhidhAya pratyAsannaM doSharUpahetumAha- vAyurityAdi| atra pradhAnatvAdagre vAyuruktaH, prAdhAnyaM cAshubhUridAruNavikArakartRutvAt; vacanaM hi- ‘AshukArI muhushcArI’ (su. ni. a. 1) iti; tathA ashItiM vAtajAn vikArAn, catvAriMshat pittavikArAn, viMshatiM ca kaphajAn vakShyati hi mahArogAdhyAye (sU. a. 2)| vAtamanu pittaM pradhAnaM, sharIramUlabhUtAgnihetutvAttathA kaphAdhikavikArakartRutvAttathA kaphApekShayA cAshukAritvAt| asamAsakaraNaM tu pRuthagapi vAyvAdInAM rogakartRutvopadarshanArtham| shArIra iti mAnasadoShavyavacchedArtham| sa~ggraha iti “dvyulbaNaikolbaNaiH ShaT syurhInamadhyAdhikaishca ShaT” (sU.a.17) ityAdivakShyamANaprapa~jcasya sa~gkShepaH| nanu, shoNitasyApi doShatvAnnAyaM sa~ggrahaH sAdhuH, yato raktasyApi vAtAdivadvishiShTahetulakShaNavikAracikitsitanirdeshaH kRutaH; tatra hetunirdesho yathA- “kAle cAnavasecanAt” (sU.a.24/9) ityAdi, lakShaNaM ca yathA- “tapanIyendragopAbhaM padmAlaktakasannibham” (sU.a.24/22) ityAdi, raktavikArAshca raktArshaHpradararaktapittAdaya uktAH, upakramashca “srAvaNaM shoNitasya tu” (sU.a.24/18) ityAdinoktaH, tathA doShasa~jj~jA ca carake kRutA, yaduktaM- “kaphe vAte jitaprAye pittaM shoNitameva vA| yadi kupyati vAtasya kriyamANe cikitsite|| yatholbaNasya doShasya tatra kAryaM bhiShagjitam” (ci.a.5/27) iti; tathA ca tantrAntare~api shalye shoNitaM doShatvenoktaM- “tairetaiH shoNitacaturthaiH” (su.sU.a.21) iti vacanAt| naivaM, doSho hi svatantradUShaNAtmaka ucyate; yato na vAtAdayo vRuddhAH ki~jcidapekShya dUShayanti kintu svata eva, shoNitaM tu duShTavAtAdisaMsargamapekShyaiva dUShakaM bhavati, na hi shoNitaM vikRutavAtAdisambandhamantareNa vikRutaM bhavati; sarvadA vAtAdijanakaireva shoNitaduShTeH; tathA sarvadA vAtAdilakShaNayuktasyaiva shoNitasya duShTatvAt; yashca hetvAdivisheSha uktaH sa vAtAdiyuktasyaiva shoNitasya bhavati; tena vAtAdaya eva tatrApi dUShaNAtmakAH, shoNitaM tu svapramANAtiriktamapi dUShyameva; na ca dUShyasya hetvAdayo vishiShTA na bhavanti, yato mAMsAdInAmapi hetvAdivisheSho~asti; yathA mAMsaduShTau- “mAMsavAhIni duShyanti bhuktvA ca svapatAM divA” (vi.a.5) ityAdi vakShyati; mAMsaduShTilakShaNaM “shRuNu mAMsapradoShajAn” (sU.a.28) ityAdinA vividhAshitapItIye vakShyati yAn vikArAste j~jeyAH, yata etAneva mAMsadoShavikArAn srotovimAne mAMsaduShTilakShaNatvenAtideshAdabhidhAsyati, duShTamAMsavikArAshcAdhimAMsArbudAdaya uktAH; upakramashca “mAMsajAnAM tu saMshuddhiH shastrakShArAgnikarma ca” (sU.a.28) ityuktaH| tasmAddUShyAdhikAre doShakRute kArye dUShyeNa vyapadeshaH- raktajo~ayaM, mAMsajo~ayamityAdi; yathA- snehAdhAreNa vahninA dagdhe snehadagdha iti vyapadeshaH| doShasa~jj~jA tu pIDAkartRutvasAmAnyAdadoShe~api syAt ; yathA- “svayaM pravRuttaM taM doShamupekSheta hitAshanaiH” (ci.a.5/46) ityatra purIShameva doShatvenoktam| sushrute tu shoNitasya doShatvaM vraNeShu prAyaH shoNitaduShTidarshanAdupacaritamevoktam| yataH pradeshAntare vraNaprashne vAtAdayastraya eva tatrApyuktAH- “vAtapittashleShmANa eva devasambhavahetavo bhavanti” (su.sU.a.21) ityAdinA| ki~jca yadi shoNitaM doShaH syAttadA vAtAdivatprakRutyArambhakaM syAt, nacArabhate; tasmAttraya eva doShA iti siddham| mAnasadoShamAha- mAnasaH punarityAdi| punaHshabdo~avadhAraNe, tena mAnasa uddiShTa eva paraM na shArIradoShavat prapa~jcitaH, mAnasadoShANAmasmiMstantre kAyacikitsArUpe~aprAstAvikatvAditi bhAvaH| Adau raja uktaM prAdhAnyAt; vacanaM hi- “nArajaskaM tamaH pravartate” (vi.a.6) iti| evashabdena sattvAkhyaguNasyAdoShatvamavadhArayati, sattvaM hyavikAri||57||

1.sanskrit: prashAmyatyauShadhaiH pUrvo daivayuktivyapAshrayaiH| mAnaso j~jAnavij~jAnadhairyasmRutisamAdhibhiH||58||
1.commentary: samprati doShaprashamakAraNamAha- prashAmyatItyAdi| pUrva iti shArIraH| doShagrahaNena tajjanyA vyAdhayo~api gRuhyante, vikRutadoShAdananyatvAdvyAdhInAm| daivamadRuShTaM, tadAshritya yadvyAdhipratIkAraM karoti taddaivavyapAshrayaM balima~ggalAdi; etacca prathamamuktaM sadyo~akleshena ca vyAdhiprashamakatvAt| yuktiH yojanA; sharIrabheShajayorhito yo yogastadapekShaM saMshodhanasaMshamanAdi yuktivyapAshrayamucyate| j~jAnam adhyAtmaj~jAnaM, vij~jAnaM shAstraj~jAnaM , dhairyam anunnatishcetasaH, smRutiH anubhUtArthasmaraNaM, samAdhiH viShayebhyo nivartyAtmani manaso niyamanam||58||

1.sanskrit: rUkShaH shIto laghuH sUkShmashcalo~atha vishadaH kharaH| viparItaguNairdravyairmArutaH samprashAmyati||59|| sasnehamuShNaM tIkShNaM ca dravamamlaM saraM kaTu| viparItaguNaiH pittaM dravyairAshu prashAmyati||60|| gurushItamRudusnigdhamadhurasthirapicchilAH| shleShmaNaH prashamaM yAnti viparItaguNairguNAH||61||
1.commentary: samprati sharIrarogAdhikArapravRuttatvAdasya tantrasya shArIrarogajanakavAtAdilakShaNaM bheShajaM cAha- rUkSha ityAdi| pradhAnatvAdagre vAyorabhidhAnam| rUkShAdInAM jyAyastvAdabhidhAnaM, tena dAruNAdayo~api guNA boddhavyAH; rUkShatvaM ca vAyAvadhikaM, snehasAdhyatvAdvAyoH; ato rUkShatvamagre~abhihitam| yadyapi vaisheShike~anuShNAshIto vAyuH, tathA~apIha shItena vRuddhidarshanAduShNena ca prashamadarshanAttathA kevalavAtArabdhe roge shItadarshanAcca shIta eva vAyuH; yacca pittayuktasyoShNatvaM, tadyogavAhitvAt; yathA pAShANasya yena dravyeNa shItenoShNena vA yogo bhavati tadguNAnuvidhAnaM, tathA vAyorapi| viparItA vAtaguNapratipakShA guNA yasya tadviparItaguNaM; guNashabdena ceha dharmavAcinA rasavIryavipAkaprabhAvAH sarva eva gRuhyante, tena prabhAvAdapi yadvAtaviparItaM tadapi gRuhyate| anye tvekaviparItashabdalopAdviparItaM viparItaguNaM ca grAhayanti; tena viparItagrahaNAt prabhAvaviparItaM gRuhyate, guNavaiparItyAdvipAkAdayo gRuhyante| nanu viparItaguNabhUyiShThairapi vAtAdInAM prashamo bhavati, yato na hi sarvaM bheShajaM vAtAdInAM sarvAtmanA viruddhaM bhavati; uktaM hi- “viruddhaguNasannipAte hi bhUyasA~alpamavajIyate” (vi.a.1) iti; tat kimiti viruddhaguNabhUyiShThasyAgrahaNam? ucyate- viruddhaguNabhUyiShThasyApi viparItaguNashabdenaiva grahaNAt| viparItaguNabhUyiShThe~api ye viparItA alpA abalA vA guNAste svakAryAkartRutvAdavyapadeshyA eva; kiMvA sarvathA viparItaguNairadhikA prashastA ca shAntirbhavati, ata eva samprashabdau shIghrasamyakprashamArthAbhidhAyakau kRutau; viparItaguNabhUyiShThairna tathA shAntirbhavati, ata eva samprashabdAbhyAM na tat sAkShAduktam| evaM ca vyAkhyAnaM pittashleShmaNorapi kartavyam| sasnehamiti IShatsnehaM, tena pitte sarpiShaH snigdhasya bheShajatvamupapannam| amlarasatA ceha pittasyocyate, aptejaHsamArabdhatvAt pittasya; sushrute tu kaTutvameva pittasyoktam, amlatA ca vidagdhasya pittasyoktA| yaduktaM- “vidagdhaM cAmlameva ca” (su.sU.a.21) iti| evaM sasnehatAyAmapi pittasya sushrutasvaraso nAsti| etacca snigdhatvamamlatvaM ca jalAnalArabdhatvAt pittasyopapannameva, sushrute tu tejorUpapittAbhiprAyeNaiva tannirastaM bhavati| shleShmaNo viparItaguNairguNAnAM prashama ucyate, na punaH shleShmaNaH prashamo~abhidhIyate; kasmAdevamucyate? guNaprashamanena ca guNiprashamo guNavRuddhyA ca guNivRuddhirbhavatIti sUcanArtham| yata uShNena shItaprashame kriyamANe shItAdhArasyodakabhAgasyAvashyameva prashamaH kriyate||59-61||

1.sanskrit: viparItaguNairdeshamAtrAkAlopapAditaiH| bheShajairvinivartante vikArAH sAdhyasammatAH||62|| sAdhanaM na tvasAdhyAnAM vyAdhInAmupadishyate|63|
1.commentary: viparItaguNairapyalpamAtraistathA~aviparItadeshakAlAdipratibaddhaishca na prashamo bhavatItyAha- viparItetyAdi| desho bhUmirAturashca, mAtrA anapAyiparimANaM, kAlo nityagaH RutvAdirAvasthiko bAlyAdishca; deshAdyapekShayA yathocitatvena kalpito deshamAtrAkAlopapAditaH| upapAditairiti caurAdiko Nic; kiMvA vaidyenopapAditaiH| atra deshagrahaNAdbalasharIrAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutInAM grahaNaM, kAlagrahaNAdvayaso~api grahaNaM, doShastu prashamanIyatayaiva gRuhItaH, bheShajaM tu sAkShAdevoktam; evaM doShabheShajadeshakAlabalasharIrAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutivayasAM parIkShyANAM dashavidhAnAM sarveShAmeva grahaNaM bhavati| sAdhyatvena prAmANikAnAM sammatAH sAdhyasammatAH; etenAj~jenAj~jAnAdye sAdhyatvena gRuhItAste nirAkriyante| yattu samyaggrahaNena yApyayApanamucyate tannAtisundaraM, vinivartanta iti vacanAt; na ca yApyayApanaM vinivRuttiH| asAdhye bheShajanivRuttimAha- sAdhanamityAdi| nanvasAdhyAnAmapi sAdhanaM dRuShTaM, yato~ariShTavAMstAvadavashyaM mRutyugRuhItatvenAsAdhyaH; yaduktaM- “ariShTaM cApi tannAsti yadvinA maraNaM bhavet| maraNaM cApi tannAsti yannAriShTapuraHsaram” (iM.a.2); utpannAriShTasAdhanaM ca sushrute proktaM- “dhruvaM tvariShTe maraNaM brAhmaNaistat kilAmalaiH| rasAyanatapojapyatatparairvA nivAryate” (su.sU.a.28) iti; tathA cAha bhagavAnagastyaH- “rasAyanatapojapyayogasiddhairmahAtmabhiH| kAlamRutyurapi prAj~jairjIyate nAlasairnaraiH” iti; tathA~anyatrApyuktaM- “jAtA~ariShTo~api jIvati” iti| atrAhureke- dvividhamariShTaM niyatamaniyataM ca; tatra yanniyataM tadasAdhyameva, ata evoktaM “na tvariShTasya jAtasya nAsho~asti maraNAdRute” (iM.a.2); atra jAtasyeti vacanAnniyatasyeti gamyate; yattvaniyatamariShTaM tatprati sushrutAgastyavacanayorarthavattA| carake~apyaniyatamariShTamuktaM; yathA- saMshayaprAptamAtreyo jIvitaM tasya manyate (iM.a.9) iti| anye tu bruvate- saMshayaprAptamiti uktibhedamAtramatra; tena sarvAriShTaM mArakamevAsati rasAyanAdau, rasAyanatapaHprabhRutayastu prabhAvAtishayayogAditarakriyayA~asAdhyamapi sAdhayanti; taccAriShTanivAraNaM viraleShveva puruShAtishayeShu nandikeshvarAdiShu dRuShTaM, na sarvapuruShaistacchakyamato jAtAriShTAnAmasAdhyataiva tantre procyate| yattu kaishciducyate- niyatAyuSho mRutyurariShTapUrvo bhavati, aniyatAyuShastvariShTaM vinaiva mRutyurbhavati| tanna, “maraNaM cApi tannAsti yannAriShTapuraHsaram” (iM.a.2) iti vacanAt| yaducyate- aniyatAyuShaH satyapi riShTaprAdurbhAve samyakkriyopapAdanAjjIvitena bhavitavyaM, yato~aniyatAyuShaH puruShakArAparAdhAdeva paraM mRutyurbhavati, samyakkriyAyAM ca puruShakArAparAdho nAsti| tanna, nahyaniyatAyuShaH sarvadaiva puruShakArasAdhyAH, kintu yathocitakAlakriyamANasvasthAturahitasevArUpapuruShakArasAdhyAH; tena yathocitakAle hitAsevanAdasAdhyatvayukte vyAdhau riShTe jAte kiM bheShajamatItakAlakriyamANamapakrAnte salila iva setubandhaH kariShyatIti| tasmAdasAdhyAnAM sAdhanaM nopadishyata iti sAdhu||62||-

1.sanskrit: bhUyashcAto yathAdravyaM guNakarmANi vakShyate||63||
1.commentary: kimetAnyeva guNakarmANi, utAparANyapItyAha- bhUyashcetyAdi| guNAnAM karmANi guNakarmANi| yathAdravyamiti yasmin yasmin dravye yadyadguNakarma tattattasmiMstasmin dravye~annapAnAdau kRutsne vA tantre vakShyate ‘AcArya’ iti sheShaH; vakShyate iti brU~jo vacirAdeshAt prayogaH| kiMvA yathAdravyamiti yathAhetuM; tadyathA- gurukharakaThinAdiguNabahulaM pArthivadravyaM, teShAM ca pArthivAnAM guNAnAM karma upacayasa~gghAtagauravAdIti||63||

1.sanskrit: rasanArtho rasastasya dravyamApaH kShitistathA| nirvRuttau ca visheShe ca pratyayAH khAdayastrayaH||64||
1.commentary: samprati doShAnabhidhAya tatprashamanapradhAnAn rasAn vaktumudyato rasalakShaNapUrvakaM rasotpattikramamAha- rasanArtha ityAdi| rasyata AsvAdyata iti rasaH| rasanArtha iti jihvAgrAhyaH| etacca ShaNNAmapi rasAnAmanugataM rUpAdiShu ca vyAvRuttatvAt sAdhulakShaNam| tasyeti rasasya| dravyamiti AdhArakAraNam| dravyashabdo hyAdhArakAraNavAcI; yathA- “pa~jcendriyadravyANi” (sU.a.8) iti| kShitistatheti yathA Apa AdhArakAraNaM tathA kShitirapi| ‘apkShitI’ iti vaktavye kShitistathetivacanAt kShiterAdhArakAraNatvamamukhyamiti darshayati| yenApo hi nisargeNa rasavatyaH| tathA hyAtreyabhadrakApyIye “saumyAH khalvApaH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA jala eva rasasya vyaktiriti darshayati| sushrute~apyuktaM- “tasmAdApyo rasaH” (su.sU.a.42) iti| kShitistvapAmeva rasena nityAnuShaktena rasavatItyucyate| yato nityaH kShitijalasambandhaH; vacanaM hi- “viShTaM hyaparaM pareNa” (nyA.da.3/1/60) iti| asyArthaH- khavAyvagnijalakShitInAmuttarottare bhUte pUrvapUrvabhUtasya nityamanupraveshaH, tatkRutashca khAdiShu guNotkarShaH| rasasya kiM vyaktAvapkShitI kAraNaM kiMvA visheShe ityAha- nirvRuttAvityAdi| nirvRuttau ceti abhivyaktau| etena raso~abhivyajyamAno jalakShityAdhAra eva vyajyata iti darshayati| cakArAdvisheShe~api madhurAdilakShaNe apkShitI pratyayau| tena “somaguNAtirekAnmadhuraH, pRuthivyagniguNAtirekAdamlaH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA jalapRuthivyorapi visheShakAraNatvaM vakShyamANamupapannam| visheShe ca pratyayAH khAdaya iti madhurAdivisheShanirvRuttau nimittakAraNaM khavAyvanalAH, na tvAdhArakAraNabhUtAH| khAdaya ityanenaiva tritve labdhe punastraya iti vacanaM teShAmeva vyastasamastAnAmapi pratyayatvadarshanArtham; ata eva vyastasamastAkAshAdisaMsargabhedAdrasAnAM madhurataramadhuratamAdyavAntarabheda upapannaH| visheShe ceti cakArAdabhivyaktAvapyAkAshAdInAM nimittakAraNatvaM darshayati| vakShyati hi- tAstvantarIkShAdbhrashyamAnA bhraShTAshca pa~jcamahAbhUtavikAraguNasamanvitA ja~ggamasthAvarANAM bhUtAnAM mUrtIrabhiprINayanti; tAsu ShaDabhimUrcchanti rasAH (sU.a.26) iti| anye tu visheShe ceti cakAraM khAdayashcetyatra yojayanti; tena cakArAt kAlo~api visheShe~abhivyaktau ca kAraNaM labhyate| sAkShAttu kAlasyAvacanena khAdibhyo~apyapakRuShTaM kAlasya kAraNatvaM darshyate| kiMvA rasasyApo dravyaM kShitistatheti pUrvavadeva; nirvRuttau ceti kShitireva nirvRuttAvabhivyaktau pratyayo nApaH; yata Apo hyavyaktarasA eva, kShitisambandhAdeva ca raso~abhivyakta upalabhyate| uktaM ca- “ja~ggamasthAvarANAM bhUtAnAM mUrtIrabhiprINayanti, tAsu ShaDabhimUrcchanti rasAH” (sU.a.26) iti| tena pArthivadravyasambandhAdevApAM raso vyajyate, nAnyathA| visheShe ceti cakArAdapkShitI visheShe kAraNe| yadyapi cApkShitI visheShe kAraNe, tathA~api “somaguNAtirekAnmadhuraH”- (sU.a.26) ityAdau tu khAdaya eva tathA sannivishanti yathA somo~atirikto bhavati, tena tatrApyUnatvena sanniviShTAH khAdaya eva visheShahetava iti| yadyapicAbhivyaktirmadhurAdivisheSharahitA kvacidbhavati, tathA~api sAmAnyena sarvatra yadabhivyaktaye~anugataM kAraNamupalabhyate kShitirUpaM jalakShitirUpaM vA tadabhivyaktikAraNaM; yadanugamAttu madhurAdivisheShopalabdhistadvisheShakAraNamucyate||64||

1.sanskrit: svAduramlo~atha lavaNaH kaTukastikta eva ca| kaShAyashceti ShaTko~ayaM rasAnAM sa~ggrahaH smRutaH||65||
1.commentary: rasavisheShAnAha- svAdurityAdi| atra sarvaprANinAmiShTatvAdAdau madhura uktaH; tadanu ca prANyabhIShTotkarShakrameNaivAmlAdinirdeshakramo boddhavyaH| ShaTka iti punaH sa~gkhyAkaraNaM paravAdimatasaptasa~gkhyatvAdiniShedhArtham| ayaM sa~ggraha ityanenAvAntarabhedabahutvaM tathA vakShyamANarasasaMsargabahutvaM ca darshayati||65||

1.sanskrit: svAdvamlalavaNA vAyuM, kaShAyasvAdutiktakAH| jayanti pittaM, shleShmANaM kaShAyakaTutiktakAH||66|| (kaTvamlalavaNAH pittaM, svAdvamlalavaNAH kapham| kaTutiktakaShAyAshca kopayanti samIraNam ||1||)|
1.commentary: rasAnAmupayuktataraM kAryamAha- svAdvamletyAdi| atra ca vAyornIrasasyApi rasasahacaritasnigdhatvAdiguNairviparItaiH prashamo j~jeyaH| evaM madhurarasasyApi shleShmaNo~amlalavaNAbhyAM snigdhatvAbhiShyanditvAdisahacaritaguNayogAdeva vRuddhiH| atra ca ye prashamakatvena rasA vAtAdInAM noktAste vardhakA boddhavyAH| yadAha vAgbhaTaH- “tatrAdyA mArutaM ghnanti trayastiktAdayaH kapham| kaShAyatiktamadhurAH pittamanye tu kurvate” (vA.sU.a.1) iti| rasakarmAtideshenaiva guNavIryavipAkAnAmapi karmanirdeshaH kRuta eva| yato madhurAdirasenaiva sarvaguNAn vIryavipAkAMshca nirdekShyatyAtreyabhadrakApyIye- “tatra svAduH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA; tathA “kaTutiktakaShAyANAM vipAkaH prAyashaH kaTuH” (sU.a.26); tathA “amlo~amlaM pacyate svAdurmadhuraM lavaNastathA” (sU.a.26) tathA “shItaM vIryeNa yaddravyaM madhuraM rasapAkayoH| tayoramlaM yaduShNaM ca yaccoShNaM kaTukaM tayoH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA||66||

1.sanskrit: ki~jciddoShaprashamanaM ki~jciddhAtupradUShaNam| svasthavRuttau mataM ki~jcittrividhaM dravyamucyate||67||
1.commentary: ato~avashiShTaM dravyakAryaM prabhAvakRutaM vaktuM prabhAvabhedena dravyabhedamAha- ki~jcidityAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| doShasya doShayordoShANAM vA prashamanaM doShaprashamanam| doShagrahaNena duShTA rasAdayo~api gRuhyante| tena dravyamahimnA yaddoShANAM duShTAnAM rasAdInAM dhAtUnAM vA shamakamAmalakadurAlabhAdi tadgRuhyate| AmalakaM hi shivatvAttridoShaharaM; durAlabhA cApi vAtapittashleShmaharI| yadyapi cAmalakasya “hanti vAtaM tadamlatvAt” (su.sU.a.46) ityAdinA guNadvArA tridoShaharatvamucyate, tathA~api tatprabhAvabRuMhitameva boddhavyam| yatastatrAmlatvAdinA pittAdiko~api yujyate, sa tvAmalakaprabhAvAnna bhavati| dhAtupradUShaNamiti vAtAdInAM samatvena sharIradhAraNAtmakAnAM tathA rasAdInAM ca dUShaNaM ki~jcit, yathA- yavakamandakaviShAdi| suShThu avatiShThate nIrogatveneti svasthaH, tasya vRuttiH svastharUpatayA~anuvartanaM, tatra svasthavRuttau matamabhimataM pUjitamiti yAvat| sa~gkhyeyanirdeshAdeva tritve labdhe trividhagrahaNaM niyamArtham| tena saMshodhanasaMshamanAdInAmanekavidhAnAmapyatraivAvarodhaH| rasAyanavAjIkaraNe tu svasthavRuttimAtra eva| yaduktaM- “svasthasyojaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam” (ci.a.1pA.1) iti| pratipAde ki~jcidgrahaNaM doShaharatvAdikarmaNAM vibhinnadravyAshrayitvopadarshanArtham; ekaki~jcidgrahaNe tvekameva dravyaM doShaharaM dhAtupradUShakaM svasthavRuttimataM ca syAt, na ca tadabhimatam| nanu, svasthavRuttimatAnAM raktashAliShaShTikayavAdInAM doShaprashamanatvamapi dRushyate, yato vakShyati tatra tatra raktashAlyAdInAM jvarAdau prayogaM; tathA prakRutisharIradeshakAlamAtrAbhi(di)yuktaM doShaprashamanamapi doShakaraM bhavati, yathA- AmalakamatimAtramagnimAndyAyetyAdi j~jeyaM; tathA dhAtupradUShaNamapi doShashamanaM dRushyate, yathA- viShamudaraharaM, tathA yadeva mandakAdi doShakaraM tadeva kShINadoShaM prati doShavRuddhyA sAmyApAdanena doShaprashamanaM bhavati; tadevamavyavasthitatvAt ki~jciddoShaprashamanamityAdi viruddham| atrocyate- svasthavRuttimataM raktashAlyAdi doShaprashamanamapi bhavati, paraM tat prAyaH svasthavRuttihitatvAt svasthavRuttimatatvena gRuhyate| vacanaM hi- “svasthasyorjaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam| prAyaH, prAyeNa rogANAM dvitIyaM shamane hitam|| prAyaHshabdo visheShArtha ubhayaM hyubhayArthakRut” (ci.a.1) iti| doShaprashamanAni dravyANi viguNaprakRutyAdipratibandhakAbhAve doShaprashamanamAcarantyeva, pratibandhakasadbhAve tu na kurvanti, na caitAvatA teShAM sa svabhAvo na bhavati; nahyagnirmantrAdipratibandhAt kadAcinna dahatIti dAhakatvena nopadishyate; evaM dhAtupradUShakasyApi kadAciddhAtuprashamakatvaM nimittAntarayogAdbhavanna dhAtupradUShakasvarUpatAM hanti, yathA salilasyAgnisambandhAduShNatvam| tasmAdyadyasya prAyikamananyopAdhikRutaM ca rUpaM, tenaiva vyapadesho yuktaH| yacca mandakAdInAM kShINadoShavardhakatvena doShaprashamakatvaM tadvidyamAnamapi kAdAcitkatvAttathA hyuttarakAlaM doShAvahatvAcca na vyapadishyate doShaprashamakatvena| nanu, yadyapyevaM tathA~api yadekadoShaharamaparadoShakaraM yathA maricaM shleShmaharaM pittakaraM cetyAdi bahudravyajAtaM tat kutra pravishatu? atraike vadanti- yadubhayAtmakaM taddoShaharaM doShakaraM ca, nacaitAvatA dravyatritvakShatiH; yato na vAtAdisaMsargajavyAdhisadbhAve vAtAdijanyatvena yattraividhyaM rogANAmucyate tat khaNDitaM bhavati; kiMvA maricAdInAM yadubhayakartRutvaM na taddravyaprabhAvakRutaM, kiM tarhi rasAdikRutaM, tena na dravyaprabhAvaprastAve tadudAharaNIyaM; naca ki~jciddravyaM tAdRushamasti yat prabhAvAdeva ki~jciddoShaM karoti ki~jcicchamayatIti na doShaprashamanatvAdiprabhAvaM prati niyamaH; ayameva ca pakShaH sAdhuH| nanu ‘ki~jciddoShaprashamanaM ki~jciddoShapradUShaNam’ iti vA kriyatAM, ‘ki~jciddhAtuprashamanaM ki~jciddhAtupradUShaNam’ iti vA| naivaM, tathA sati doShashabdasya mukhyavRuttyA vAtAdiShveva vRuttitvAttathA dhAtushabdasya ca rasAdivRuttitvAdubhayagrahaNaM na prApyate; ubhayapadopAdAnena dvayaM nipuNakArI tantrakAro dUShaNatvadhAraNatvayogaparigrahAddoShaprashamanena duShTarasAdiprashamanamapi bheShajaM vividhAshitapItIyAdivakShyamANaM, tathA dhAtupradUShaNena vAtAdipradUShakamapi nidAnAdivakShyamANaM grAhayati| prashabdo~atra prakAre; tena prakAreNa mRudumadhyAdinA prakopaNaM, tathA prakAreNa saMshodhanasaMshamanAdinA shamanamucyate; kiMvA dhAtvarthAnuvRuttAveva imau prashabdau, yathA- ‘cyutAMshaH paridhAvati’ ityatra dhAvatItyarthaH| Adau doShaprashamanagrahaNaM tasyaivehAbhipretatvAt| nanu svasthavRuttimataM dravyaM bhAvidoShaharatvena doShaprashamanameva| naivaM, nahi svAsthyAnuvRuttijanakatvAddoShanivRuttikaraM doShaharaNamucyate, kiM tarhi samadhAtUnAmavardhakatvenAkShayakaratvena ca rasAdisrotasAM cAnuguNatvena dhAtusAmyAnuvRuttikaramucyate| vacanaM hi- “pathyaM patho~anapetaM yat” (sU.a.25) iti||67||

1.sanskrit: tat punastrividhaM proktaM ja~ggamaudbhidapArthivam | madhUni gorasAH pittaM vasA majjA~asRugAmiSham||68|| viNmUtracarmareto~asthisnAyushRu~gganakhAH khurAH| ja~ggamebhyaH prayujyante keshA lomAni rocanAH||69|| suvarNaM samalAH pa~jca lohAH sasikatAH sudhA| manaHshilAle maNayo lavaNaM gairikA~jjane||70|| bhaumamauShadhamuddiShTamaudbhidaM tu caturvidham| vanaspatistathA vIrudvAnaspatyastathauShadhiH||71|| phalairvanaspatiH puShpairvAnaspatyaH phalairapi| oShadhyaH phalapAkAntAH pratAnairvIrudhaH smRutAH||72|| mUlatvaksAraniryAsanAla(Da)svarasapallavAH| kShArAH kShIraM phalaM puShpaM bhasma tailAni kaNTakAH||73|| patrANi shu~ggAH kandAshca prarohAshcaudbhido gaNaH|74|
1.commentary: sampratyanyathA dravyabhedamAha- tat punarityAdi| taditi dravyam| gacchatIti ja~ggamam, udbhidya pRuthivIM jAyata iti audbhidaM vRukShAdi, uktaprakAradvayAtiriktaH pRuthivIvikAraH pArthivam| saMsvedajasyeha krimyAderja~ggame~avarodhaH, kukuNDakAdeshca audbhide| iha ca dravyashabdena pArthivadravyamevocyate; tena jalAnilAgnyAdInAmagrahaNAdavyAptirna vAcyA| ja~ggamashabdena ja~ggamaprabhavaM gorasamadhvAdyapi grAhyam| evamaudbhidapArthivayorapi grahaNaM vAcyam| rocanA gorocanA| etacca madhvAdi prAya upayogitvAt prAdhAnyAduktaM; tenANDabastyAdInAM ca grahaNaM boddhavyam| yadyapi ja~ggamAnantaraM bahuprapa~jcatvena pradhAnatvAdaudbhidamupadiShTaM, tathA~apyabahuvaktavyatvAt pArthivameva ja~ggamAnantaraM vivriyate; tadanu bahuvaktavyamaudbhidam| suvarNamityAdi| pa~jca lohA iti tAmrarajatatrapushIsakRuShNalohAnAM grahaNam| samalA iti malashabdena shilAjatUni lohamalarUpANi gRuhyante, tacca sushrutadarshanAt suvarNarajatAdibhavaM ShaDvidhameva gRuhyate; sushrute hi ShaDvidhameva shilAjatUktam, iha tu rasAyane caturvidhamuktaM- “caturbhyo dhAtubhyastasya sambhavaH| hemno~atha rajatAttAmrAdvaraM kRuShNAyasAdapi” (ci.a.1) iti vacanAt| etacca vacanaM rasAyanAdhikAritAM caturvidhasya shilAjatuno darshayati, natu ShaDvidhashilAjatupratiShedhaparamiti na sushrutena samaM virodhaH| kiMvA suvarNaM nirmalaM, samalAstu rajatatAmratrapushIsalohAH (iti militvA pa~jca lohAH|) shilAjatupAShANapa~gkaprabhRutInAM tu grahaNamuddiShTashabdena sUcitam; uddesho hyalpakathanam| sudhA gA~ggeyikA| AlaM haritAlam| a~jjanaM sauvIrA~jjanam| phalairvanaspatiriti vinApuShpaiH phalairyuktA vaTodumbarAdayaH| yaduktaM hArIte- “teShAmapuShpAH phalino vanaspataya iti smRutAH” iti| puShpairvAnaspatyaH phalairapIti puShpAnantaraM phalabhAja ityarthaH| phalasya pAkAdanto vinAsho yeShAM tilamudgAdInAM te phalapAkAntAH; atra kecit phalapAkAntAH pAkAntAshcauShadhya iti vadanti; tena vinA~api phalaM pAkenaivAnto yeShAM dUrvAdInAM te~api gRuhyante| pratAnashabdena latA gulmAshca gRuhyante| yaduktaM hArItena- “latA gulmAshca vIrudhaH” iti| mUlatvagityAdau niryAso lAkShAsarjarasAdiH| audbhido gaNa ityaudbhidasamudbhUto gaNaH||68-73||-

1.sanskrit: mUlinyaH ShoDashaikonA phalinyo viMshatiH smRutAH||74|| mahAsnehAshca catvAraH pa~jcaiva lavaNAni ca| aShTau mUtrANi sa~gkhyAtAnyaShTAveva payAMsi ca||75|| shodhanArthAshca ShaD vRukShAH punarvasunidarshitAH| ya etAn vetti saMyoktuM vikAreShu sa vedavit||76||
1.commentary: sampratyatraiva ja~ggamaudbhidapArthivadravye yat prashastaM tadAha- mUlinya ityAdi| mUlaM prashastatamaM yAsAM tA mUlinyaH; evaM phalinyo~api| ShoDasheti cchedaH| mahAsnehA iti kShIramAMsAdInAmapi snehatayA snehAdhyAye vakShyamANatvena teShu sarpirAdInAM bhUrisnehavattvena mahattvam| pa~jcaiva lavaNAnIti vimAne (vi.a.8) vakShyamANalavaNabahutve pa~jcAnAmeva prashastatvena darshanArtham| evaM mUtrAdiShvapi prAdhAnyamunneyaM sajAtIyeShu| vedaviditi Ayurvedavit||74-76||

1.sanskrit: hastidantI haimavatI shyAmA trivRudadhoguDA| saptalA shvetanAmA ca pratyakshreNI gavAkShyapi||77|| jyotiShmatI ca bimbI ca shaNapuShpI viShANikA| ajagandhA dravantI ca kShIriNI cAtra ShoDashI||78|| shaNapuShpI ca bimbI ca cchardane haimavatyapi| shvetA jyotiShmatI caiva yojyA shIrShavirecane||79|| ekAdashAvashiShTA yAH prayojyAstA virecane| ityuktA nAmakarmabhyAM mUlinyaH...|80|
1.commentary: hastidantItyAdi| hastidantI bRuhatphalA goDumbA, ‘iyameva nAgadantI bhaNyate’ ityeke| haimavatI vacA| shyAmA shyAmamUlA trivRut| adhoguDA praddhadArakaH| saptalA carmakaShA| shvetanAmA shvetA~aparAjitA| pratyakshreNI dantI| bimbI oShThopamaphalA| shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA| viShANikA AvartanI| ajagandhA ‘phokAndI’ iti khyAtA| dravantI dantyeva cIritapatrA| kShIriNI dugdhikA| mUlinInAM vamanAdiviniyogamAha- shaNapuShpItyAdi||77-79||-

1.sanskrit: ...phalinIH shRuNu||80|| sha~gkhinyatha viDa~ggAni trapuShaM madanAni ca| dhAmArgavamathekShvAku jImUtaM kRutavedhanam| AnUpaM sthalajaM caiva klItakaM dvividhaM smRutam||81|| prakIryA codakIryA ca pratyakpuShpA tathA~abhayA| antaHkoTarapuShpI ca hastiparNyAshca shAradam||82|| kampillakAragvadhayoH phalaM yat kuTajasya ca| dhAmArgavamathekShvAku jImUtaM kRutavedhanam||83|| madanaM kuTajaM caiva trapuShaM hastiparNinI| etAni vamane caiva yojyAnyAsthApaneShu ca||84|| nastaH pracchardane caiva pratyakpuShpA vidhIyate| dasha yAnyavashiShTAni tAnyuktAni virecane||85|| nAmakarmabhiruktAni phalAnyekonaviMshatiH|86|
1.commentary: sha~gkhinI shvetabuhnA(dhna)| klItakaM yaShTImadhu; asya tu yadyapi sushrute mUlaM prashastaM, mUlenaiva vyavahAraH, tathA~api virecanaM prati yaShTImadhudvayasyApi phalameva prashastaM j~jeyam| dhAmArgavaH pItaghoShakaH| ikShvAkuH tiktAlAbuH| jImUto ghoShakabhedaH| kRutavedhanaM jyotsnikA| prakIryodakIrye kara~jjadvayam| pratyakpuShpA apAmArgaH| antaHkoTarapuShpI nIlabudhnA| hastiparNI moraTaH, asyAshca sharatkAlabhavameva phalaM grAhyaM; ata uktaM- hastiparNyAshca shAradamiti| kampillakaM guNDArocanikA| Aragvadhasya yadyapi sushrute patraM pradhAnamuktaM, tathA~apIha phalaM gRuhyate pradhAnatamatvAt| dhAmArgavamityAdinA pa~jcakarmaviniyoga ucyate| nastaH pracchardana iti shirovirecane||80-85||-

1.sanskrit: sarpistailaM vasA majjA sneho diShTashcaturvidhaH ||86|| pAnAbhya~jjanabastyarthaM nasyArthaM caiva yogataH| snehanA jIvanA varNyA balopacayavardhanAH||87|| snehA hyete ca vihitA vAtapittakaphApahAH|88|
1.commentary: mahAsneheShu sarpirAdau paThitaM, prAdhAnyAt; vacanaM hi- “nAnyaH snehastathA kashcit saMskAramanuvartate| yathA sarpirataH sarpiH sarvasnehottamaM matam” (ni.a.1) iti||86-87||-

1.sanskrit: sauvarcalaM saindhavaM ca viDamaudbhidameva ca||88|| sAmudreNa sahaitAni pa~jca syurlavaNAni ca| snigdhAnyuShNAni tIkShNAni dIpanIyatamAni ca||89|| AlepanArthe yujyante snehasvedavidhau tathA| adhobhAgordhvabhAgeShu nirUheShvanuvAsane||90|| abhya~jjane bhojanArthe shirasashca virecane| shastrakarmaNi vartyarthama~jjanotsAdaneShu ca||91|| ajIrNAnAhayorvAte gulme shUle tathodare| uktAni lavaNA(ni)...|92|
1.commentary: lavaNeShu yadyapi saindhavaM pradhAnaM, yato vakShyati- “saindhavaM lavaNAnAm” (sU.a.25) ityagryAdhikAre, tathA~api sauvarcalasya rocanatvaprakarShAttathA saindhavamanu prAdhAnyakhyApanArthamagre pAThaH| audbhidam autkArikAlavaNaM, kecicchAmbharilavaNamAhuH| sAmudraM dakShiNasamudrabhavaM ‘karakaca’ iti khyAtam| abhya~jjana iti snehAbhya~gge| vartyarthamiti phalavartyartham||88-91||-

1.sanskrit: ... nyU(U)rdhvaM mUtrANyaShTau nibodha me||92|| mukhyAni yAni diShTAni sarvANyAtreyashAsane| avimUtramajAmUtraM gomUtraM mAhiShaM ca yat ||93|| hastimUtramathoShTrasya hayasya ca kharasya ca| uShNaM tIkShNamatho~arUkShaM kaTukaM lavaNAnvitam||94|| mUtramutsAdane yuktaM yuktamAlepaneShu ca| yuktamAsthApane mUtraM yuktaM cApi virecane||95|| svedeShvapi ca tadyuktamAnAheShvagadeShu ca| udareShvatha cArshaHsu gulmikuShThikilAsiShu ||96|| tadyuktamupanAheShu pariSheke tathaiva ca| dIpanIyaM viShaghnaM ca krimighnaM copadishyate||97|| pANDurogopasRuShTAnAmuttamaM sharma cocyate| shleShmANaM shamayet pItaM mArutaM cAnulomayet||98|| karShet pittamadhobhAgamityasmin guNasa~ggrahaH| sAmAnyena mayoktastu pRuthaktvena pravakShyate||99|| avimUtraM satiktaM syAt snigdhaM pittAvirodhi ca| AjaM kaShAyamadhuraM pathyaM doShAnnihanti ca||100|| gavyaM samadhuraM ki~jciddoShaghnaM krimikuShThanut| kaNDUM ca shamayet pItaM samyagdoShodare hitam||101|| arshaHshophodaraghnaM tu sakShAraM mAhiShaM saram| hAstikaM lavaNaM mUtraM hitaM tu krimikuShThinAm||102|| prashastaM baddhaviNmUtraviShashleShmAmayArshasAm| satiktaM shvAsakAsaghnamarshoghnaM cauShTramucyate||103|| vAjinAM tiktakaTukaM kuShThavraNaviShApaham| kharamUtramapasmAronmAdagrahavinAshanam||104|| itIhoktAni mUtrANi yathAsAmarthyayogataH|105|
1.commentary: avimUtramityAdau strImUtrameva prashastamiti li~ggaparigrahAddarshayati; yataH strINAM laghva~ggatvAnmUtramapi laghu; vacanaM hi- “lAghavaM jAtisAmAnye strINAM puMsAM ca gauravam” (sU.a.27) iti| yattUcyate- puMsAM mUtraM shukrasambandhAdguru; tanna, shukrasambandhasya strINAmapi shukravattvena tulyatvAt; vacanaM hi- “yadA nArI hi nAryA tu maithunAyopapadyate| mu~jcataH shukramanyo~anyamanasthistatra jAyate ” ityAdi; napuMsakamUtraM tvama~ggalatvAnna gRuhyate| agadeShvityanenAgadaprayogayaugikatvaM, viShaghnamityanena ca kevalasyaiva viShahantRutvamiti na paunaruktyam| sharma cocyata iti ArogyarUpasukhakartRutvAt| adhobhAgamiti adhomArgeNa pittaM karShet; kiMvA yadevAdhogataM pittaM tadeva virecayati nordhvagam| yathAsAmarthyayogata iti yAdRushaH shaktiyogo mUtrANAM tathA||92-104||-

1.sanskrit: ataH kShIrANi vakShyante karma caiShAM guNAshca ye||105|| avikShIramajAkShIraM gokShIraM mAhiShaM ca yat| uShTrINAmatha nAgInAM vaDavAyAH striyAstathA||106|| prAyasho madhuraM snigdhaM shItaM stanyaM payo matam| prINanaM bRuMhaNaM vRuShyaM medhyaM balyaM manaskaram||107|| jIvanIyaM shramaharaM shvAsakAsanibarhaNam| hanti shoNitapittaM ca sandhAnaM vihatasya ca||108|| sarvaprANabhRutAM sAtmyaM shamanaM shodhanaM tathA| tRuShNAghnaM dIpanIyaM ca shreShThaM kShINakShateShu ca||109|| pANDuroge~amlapitte ca shoShe gulme tathodare| atIsAre jvare dAhe shvayathau ca visheShataH ||110|| yonishukrapradoSheShu mUtreShvapracureShu ca| purIShe grathite pathyaM vAtapittavikAriNAm||111|| nasyAlepAvagAheShu vamanAsthApaneShu ca| virecane snehane ca payaH sarvatra yujyate||112|| yathAkramaM kShIraguNAnekaikasya pRuthak pRuthak| annapAnAdike~adhyAye bhUyo vakShyAmyasheShataH||113||
1.commentary: prAyasho madhuramiti prAdhAnyena madhuram| tena kShIramuShTrINAmIShallavaNaM tathA chAgaM kaShAyamityAdau rasAntarasyAprAdhAnyenAnubandho~api kShIre bhavatIti darshayati| prAyasha iti bRuMhaNaM snigdhamityetAbhyAM tathA shItamityanena ca sambadhyate; tenauShTrasya rUkShoShNatvAbhidhAnaM na virodhi| stanyamiti stanyavRuddhikaram| manaskaramiti prabhAvAdojaskaratvAcca; ojovRuddhyA hi tadanuvidhAyino manaso~api svakarmasAmarthyaM bhavati| etadeva ca nityasyeha manasaH karaNaM yanmanasaH prakarShabuddhyutkarShAdiguNakaraNam| hanti shoNitapittamiti avasthAvisheShApannameva shoNitapittaM hanti| vacanaM hi- “kaShAyayogairvividhairyathoktairdIpte~anale shleShmaNi nirjite ca| yadraktapittaM prashamaM na yAti tatrAnilaH syAdanu, tatra kAryam|| chAgaM payaH syAt paramaM prayoge gavyaM shRutaM pa~jcaguNe jale vA” (ci.a.4) iti| evaM ca yaducyate- adhobhAge raktapitte saratvAt kShIramayaugikam, Urdhvage ca kaphakartRutayA~ayaugikamiti, tannirastam| sarvaprANabhRutAM sAtmyamityatra sarvashabdashcikitsyatayA prakRutasarvamanuShyeShveva vartate, tena kShIrasya saMsvedajAdiprANyasAtmyatvaM nodbhAvanIyaM; kiMvA sarvashabdo~ayaM bhUrivacanaH||105-113||

1.sanskrit: athApare trayo vRukShAH pRuthagye phalamUlibhiH| snuhyarkAshmantakAsteShAmidaM karma pRuthak pRuthak||114|| vamane~ashmantakaM vidyAt snuhIkShIraM virecane| kShIramarkasya vij~jeyaM vamane savirecane||115||
1.commentary: phalamUlibhiriti pRuthakshabdayogAdapAdAne tRutIyA| ashmantako mAluyAsadRushapatro vRukShaH||114-115||

1.sanskrit: imAMstrInaparAn vRukShAnAhuryeShAM hitAstvacaH| pUtIkaH kRuShNagandhA ca tilvakashca tathA taruH||116|| virecane prayoktavyaH pUtIkastilvakastathA| kRuShNagandhA parIsarpe shotheShvarshaHsu cocyate||117|| dadruvidradhigaNDeShu kuShTheShvapyalajIShu ca| ShaDvRukShA~jchodhanAnetAnapi vidyAdvicakShaNaH||118|| ityuktAH phalamUlinyaH snehAshca lavaNAni ca| mUtraM kShIrANi vRukShAshca ShaD ye diShTapayastvacaH||119||
1.commentary: pUtIkaH kaNTakIkara~jjaH| tilvako lodhraH; tasya taruriti visheShaNena paTTikAlodhraM vyudasyati, shAbaralodhraM ca mahApramANaM tarushabdayogyaM grAhayati; kiMvA taruvisheShaNena bAlaM lodhraM vyudasyati| ShaDvRukShA~j shodhanAnityatra yadyapi kRuShNagandhAyAH pa~jcakarmaNyanabhidhAnAnna shodhanatvaM, tathA~api bAhyAlepanena bahiHsthitadoShasaMshodhanatvaM boddhavyaM; kiMvA apishabdAt kRuShNagandhAyA ashodhanatvamapi sUcyate||116-119||

1.sanskrit: oShadhIrnAmarUpAbhyAM jAnate hyajapA vane| avipAshcaiva gopAshca ye cAnye vanavAsinaH||120|| na nAmaj~jAnamAtreNa rUpaj~jAnena vA punaH| oShadhInAM parAM prAptiM kashcidveditumarhati||121|| yogavittvapyarUpaj~jastAsAM tattvaviducyate| kiM punaryo vijAnIyAdoShadhIH sarvathA bhiShak||122|| yogamAsAM tu yo vidyAddeshakAlopapAditam| puruShaM puruShaM vIkShya sa j~jeyo bhiShaguttamaH||123||
1.commentary: uktAnAmoShadhInAM yogaj~jAnasya prAdhAnyaM darshayannAha- oShadhIrityAdi| parAM prAptimiti utkRuShTaM vyAdhisharIrAdyapekShaM samyagyogam| yogo vyAdhisharIrAdyapekShA samyagyojanA bheShajasya| sarvatheti nAmarUpayogaiH| yogameva vishiShTaM darshayannAha- yogamityAdi| deshakAlopapAditamiti deshakAlakRutam| puruShaM puruShaM vIkShyeti vIpsAyAM, pratipuruShaM prakRutyAdibhedena yogasya prAyo bhedo bhavatIti darshayati| puruShashabdena ceha saMyogapuruSho~abhipretaH||120-123||

1.sanskrit: yathA viShaM yathA shastraM yathA~agnirashaniryathA| tathauShadhamavij~jAtaM vij~jAtamamRutaM yathA||124|| auShadhaM hyanabhij~jAtaM nAmarUpaguNaistribhiH| vij~jAtaM cApi duryuktamanarthAyopapadyate||125||
1.commentary: yogasyauShadhaj~jAnAdhInatvAdauShadhAj~jAnasya mahAnarthakAritAM bahubhirdRuShTAntairdarshayati- yathA viShamityAdi| viShAdibahudRuShTAntenAj~jAtaM bheShajaM ki~jcidviShavat sa~jj~jAnAshaM kRutvA mArayati, ki~jcicca shastravanmarmacchedaM kRutvA mArayati, ki~jciccAgnivat sphoTAdikaM kRutvA mArayati, ki~jciccAshanivat sadyo mArayatIti darshayati| nAmarUpaguNairityanena tritve labdhe punastribhiriti vacanamekaikaj~jAnapratiShedhArthaM; tena tribhireva militairj~jAtaM bheShajaM prashastamiti darshayati||124-125||

1.sanskrit: yogAdapi viShaM tIkShNamuttamaM bheShajaM bhavet| bheShajaM cApi duryuktaM tIkShNaM sampadyate viSham||126|| tasmAnna bhiShajA yuktaM yuktibAhyena bheShajam| dhImatA ki~jcidAdeyaM jIvitArogyakA~gkShiNA||127|| kuryAnnipatito mUrdhni sasheShaM vAsavAshaniH| sasheShamAturaM kuryAnnatvaj~jamatamauShadham||128|| duHkhitAya shayAnAya shraddadhAnAya rogiNe| yo bheShajamavij~jAya prAj~jamAnI prayacchati||129|| tyaktadharmasya pApasya mRutyubhUtasya durmateH| naro narakapAtI syAttasya sambhAShaNAdapi||130|| varamAshIviShaviShaM kvathitaM tAmrameva vA| pItamatyagnisantaptA bhakShitA vA~apyayoguDAH||131|| natu shrutavatAM veshaM bibhratA sharaNAgatAt| gRuhItamannaM pAnaM vA vittaM vA rogapIDitAt||132|| bhiShagbubhUShurmatimAnataH svaguNasampadi| paraM prayatnamAtiShThet prANadaH syAdyathA nRuNAm||133||
1.commentary: yogaM stauti- yogAdapItyAdi| viShaM ca samyagyogAdbheShajaM bhavatIti “tilaM dadyAdviShasya tu” (ci.a.1) ityAdiprayoge boddhavyam| na kevalamAtureNaivAbhiShajo bheShajaM nAdeyaM, kintu bhiShajA~api yuktibAhyena bheShajamAturAya na deyamityAha- duHkhitAyetyAdi||126-133||

1.sanskrit: tadeva yuktaM bhaiShajyaM yadArogyAya kalpate| sa caiva bhiShajAM shreShTho rogebhyo yaH pramocayet||134||
1.commentary: atha samyagyuktasya bheShajasya kiM lakShaNaM kiMvA upAdeyasya shreShThavaidyasya lakShaNamityAha- tadevetyAdi| rogebhyo yaH pramocayedityanena ca j~jAnapUrvaM bheShajaprayogeNa rogahArakatvamucyate; tena yAdRucchikasiddhyA kuvaidyavyavahAro na vAcyaH; yAdRucchikasiddhau hi vaidyo na rogapramokShe kAraNaM, kintu ghuNAkSharanyAyena daivAgato bheShajasya samyagyoga iti||134||

1.sanskrit: samyakprayogaM sarveShAM siddhirAkhyAti karmaNAm| siddhirAkhyAti sarvaishca guNairyuktaM bhiShaktamam||135||
1.commentary: kathamArogyAt samyagyogo bheShajasya j~jAyate ityAha- samyakprayogamityAdi| sarveShAmityanenAnyeShAmapi karmaNAM pratimAkaraNAdInAM siddhiH samyagyogaM tatkAraNatAM khyApayati; na hyasamyakprayukte kAraNe samyak kAryaM bhavati| siddhirAkhyAtIti uktA prAtiniyamikI siddhiH, na yAdRucchikI| sarvairguNairiti shrute paryavadAtatvAdibhiH khuDDAkacatuShpAda (sU.a.10) vakShyamANaiH||135||

1.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- AyurvedAgamo heturAgamasya pravartanam| sUtraNasyAbhyanuj~jAnamAyurvedasya nirNayaH||136|| sampUrNaM kAraNaM kAryamAyurvedaprayojanam| hetavashcaiva doShAshca bheShajaM sa~ggraheNa ca||137|| rasAH sapratyayadravyAstrividho dravyasa~ggrahaH| mUlinyashca phalinyashca snehAshca lavaNAni ca||138|| mUtraM kShIrANi vRukShAshca ShaD ye kShIratvagAshrayAH| karmANi caiShAM sarveShAM yogAyogaguNAguNAH||139|| vaidyApavAdo yatrasthAH sarve ca bhiShajAM guNAH| sarvametat samAkhyAtaM pUrvAdhyAye maharShiNA||140||
1.commentary: tatra shlokA iti tantrakArasya rItiriyaM yat- yatroktamarthaM sa~ggraheNAbhidhatte tatra ‘tatra shlokA’ iti karoti; yatra tUktAdanadhikamucyate tatra ‘bhavati cAtra’ iti karoti; na cAsya niShprayojanatvaM, tantradharmatvAt| adhyAyoktamarthamadhyAyAnte sa~ggraheNAbhidhatte- AyurvedAgama ityAdinA| sa~ggrahakathanaM ca pUrvoktArthasya sa~gkShepeNa grahaNArthaM tathA durj~jAnapratiShedhArthaM ca| yato yatki~jcidatra durj~jAnaM syAttadiha pratipAditArthasaMvAdenAvadhAryate| vacanaM hi- “gadyokto yaH punaH shlokairarthaH samanugIyate| tadvyaktivyavasAyArthaM dviruktiH sA na garhyate” (ni.a.1) iti| atra ca gadyokta iti vistaroktopalakShaNam| tena shlokoktasyApyAragvadhIyAdyarthasya punaH shlokena sa~ggrahaNamaviruddham| vyaktiH spaShTatA, vyavasAyaH avadhAraNam| Agama iti “dIrgha~jjIvitamanvicchan” ityAdinA, heturiti AyurvedAgamahetuH, sa ca “vighnabhUtA yadA rogA” ityAdinA rogaprAdurbhAva uktaH; kiMvA “dIrgha~jjIvitamanvicchan” ityAdishloko visheSheNAyurvedAgamasya tathA~a~ayurvedAgamahetoshca piNDasUtrarUpaH, “brahmaNA hi” ityAdigranthastvAyurvedAgamapratipAdakaH, hetupratipAdakastu “vighnabhUtA” ityAdigrantho yathokta eva| Agamasya pravartanamiti indrAdAnIya bharadvAjena martyaloke pravartanamAyurvedagrahaNaparyantam| sUtraNamityAyurvedatantrakaraNamagniveshAdInAm| abhyanuj~jAnamiti “tAni cAnumatAni” ityAdi| sheShaM sugamam||136-140||

1.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute sUtrasthAne dIrgha~jjIvitIyo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
1.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAkhyAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM sUtrasthAne dIrgha~jjIvitIyo nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

2.sanskrit: athAto~apAmArgataNDulIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2|| apAmArgasya bIjAni pippalIrmaricAni ca| viDa~ggAnyatha shigrUNi sarShapAMstumburUNi ca||3|| ajAjIM cAjagandhAM ca pIlUnyelAM hareNukAm| pRuthvIkAM surasAM shvetAM kuTherakaphaNijjhakau||4|| shirIShabIjaM lashunaM haridre lavaNadvayam| jyotiShmatIM nAgaraM ca dadyAcchIrShavirecane||5|| gaurave shirasaH shUle pInase~ardhAvabhedake| krimivyAdhAvapasmAre ghrANanAshe pramohake||6||
2.commentary: dIrgha~jjIvitIye mUlinyashca phalinyashca pa~jcakarmA~ggabhUtA uktAH, aparANyapi ca pippalImaricaprabhRutIni pa~jcakarmasAdhanAni santi, tathA pa~jcakarmaprabhRutiviShayo~api tatra noktaH, tenAnantaraM sheShapa~jcakarmopayogidravyapa~jcakarmapravRuttiviShayAbhidhAyako~apAmArgataNDulIyo~abhidhIyate| pUrvoktAnyapi cApAmArgAdIni yat punarihAbhidhIyante tadAcArya evAdhyAyAnte ‘pUrvaM mUlaphala’ ityAdinA shlokadvayena samAdhAsyati| apAmArgabIjIya iti sa~jj~jAyAM prAptAyAmapAmArgataNDulIya iti sa~jj~jAkaraNamapAmArgAdibIjAnAM nistuShANAmeva grahaNArtham| adhyAyasa~jj~jAM taNDulena kRutvA~apAmArgasya bIjAnIti yadbIjashabdaM karoti tada~gkurajananasamarthabIjabhavAnAmeva taNDulAnAM grahaNArtham| yadyapi cehotsargataH pa~jcakarmapravRuttirvamanapUrvikaiva bhavati, yaduktaM- “sAdhAraNeShvRutuShu vamanAdInAM pravRuttirbhavati” (vi.a.8) ityAdi, tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “avAntasya hi samyagviriktasyApyadhaHsrastaH shleShmA grahaNImAcchAdayati” (su.ci.a.33) ityAdi; tathA~api kvacit prabaladoShApekShayA~anyathA~api kramo bhavati, yathA sharadyudrikte pitte virecanAdi, tathA prAvRuShi prabalavAte bastyAdirityaniyamArthamiha shirovirecanamAdAvabhihitaM; yadi vA, pradhAnA~ggashiraHshodhanatvAcchirovirecanamAdau kRutam| yaduktaM- “yaduttamA~ggama~ggAnAM shirastadabhidhIyate” (sU.a.17) iti| shAlAkye~apyuktaM- “anAmaye yathA mUle vRukShaH samyak pravardhate | anAmaye shirasyevaM dehaH samyak pravardhate” iti| apAmArgAbhidhAnamAdau shirovirecanaprAdhAnyAt| yaduktaM- “pratyakpuShpA shirovirecanAnAm” iti (sU.a.25)| ajagandhA ajamodA, “phophAndhI” iti kecit| pIlu auttarApathikaM phalam| lavaNadvayaM lavaNavargAdipaThitaM sauvarcalaM saindhavaM ca| ayaM vargo vyastaH samastashca shirovirecane prayojyo gaNatvAt| yaduktaM- “parisa~gkhyAtamapi hi yaddravyamayaugikaM manyeta tadapaharet” (vi.a.8) iti| anyatrApyuktaM- “samastaM vargamardhaM vA yathAlAbhamathApi vA” (su.sU.a.37) iti| shirasa iti gaurava ityanena shUla ityanena ca sambadhyate| krimivyAdhiriha shirogata eva boddhavyaH, tatraiva shirovirecanasya samarthatvAt| pramohako mUrcchA, indriyApaTutvaM vA||1-6||

2.sanskrit: madanaM madhukaM nimbaM jImUtaM kRutavedhanam| pippalIkuTajekShvAkUNyelAM dhAmArgavANi ca||7|| upasthite shleShmapitte vyAdhAvAmAshayAshraye| vamanArthaM prayu~jjIta bhiShagdehamadUShayan||8||
2.commentary: vamanadravye Adau madanamuktaM prAdhAnyAt; uktaM hi- “vamanadravyeShu madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate~anapAyitvAt” iti (ka.a.1)| upasthita iti AmAshayordhvabhAge shleShmaNaH sthAnaM gatvotkleshaM gata iti vyAkhyeyam| shleShmapitta iti shleShmapitte shleShmaNi pitte ca| pittaM ca yadyapi sAkShAnna vamanaviShayaM tathA~api shleShmasthAnagatatvena shleShmasambandhAdvamanaviShayam| yaduktaM- “doShasthAnagataM doShaM sthAnivat samupAcaret” iti| dehamadUShayanniti yadyapi vamane proktaM tathA~api virecanAdiShvapi boddhavyaM, tatrApyatiyogAyogamithyAyogairdehaduShTisha~gkAyAH samAnatvAt| ucyate ca nyAyavidbhiryat- “samAneShvartheShvekatrAbhihito vidhiranyatrApyanuSha~jjanIyaH” iti||7-8||

2.sanskrit: trivRutAM triphalAM dantIM nIlinIM saptalAM vacAm| kampillakaM gavAkShIM ca kShIriNImudakIryakAm||9|| pIlUnyAragvadhaM drAkShAM dravantIM niculAni ca| pakvAshayagate doShe virekArthaM prayojayet||10||
2.commentary: vamanamanu virecanAbhidhAnaM shiraHpUrvakadehashodhanAbhidhAnAnukrameNAmAshayordhvabhAgashodhanAnantaramAmAshayAdhobhAgasthitapittaharatvena| evaM virecanAnantaraM bastyabhidhAne~api vAcyam| trivRudAdAvucyate, virecanadravyeShu shreShThatvAt| uktaM hi- “trivRut sukhavirecanAnAm” (sU.a.25) iti| nIlikA nIlabuhnA | kShIriNI dugdhikA| dravantI dantIbhedaH| niculaM hijjalamiti prasiddham| pakvashcAsAvAshayagatashceti pakvAshayagataH| tena pittAshaye evAmAshayAdhobhAgalakShaNe doSho virecanaviShayo bhavati, na pakvAshayagataH| doShashabdena ceha virecananirharaNayogyatvAt pittaM kaphapittaM vA gRuhyate| yaduktaM- “pittaM vA kaphapittaM vA pittAshayagataM haret| sraMsanaM, trIn malAn bastirharet pakvAshayasthitAn” (ci.a.3) iti| yadi vA pakvAshayasamIpagatatvenAdhaHpravRuttyunmukho doShaH pakvAshayagata ityucyate; yathA- ga~ggAyAM ghoSha iti||9-10||

2.sanskrit: pATalAM cAgnimanthaM ca bilvaM shyonAkameva ca| kAshmaryaM shAlaparNIM ca pRushniparNIM nidigdhikAm||11|| balAM shvadaMShTrAM bRuhatImeraNDaM sapunarnavam| yavAn kulatthAn kolAni guDUcIM madanAni ca||12|| palAshaM kattRuNaM caiva snehAMshca lavaNAni ca| udAvarte vibandheShu yu~jjyAdAsthApaneShu ca||13|| ata evauShadhagaNAt sa~gkalpyamanuvAsanam| mArutaghnamiti proktaH sa~ggrahaH pA~jcakarmikaH||14||
2.commentary: pATalAmityAdinA~anuvAsanAt prA~gnirUhAbhidhAnaM, nirUhasya doShaharaNapradhAnatvAt| kattRuNaM gandhatRuNam| snehAH sarpistailavasAmajjAnaH| lavaNAni saindhavAdIni rogabhiShagjitIye (vi.a.8) bastyarthaM mukhyAnyuktAni gaNena| ata eveti nirUhoktapATalAdigaNAt| sa~gkalpyamanuvAsanamityanena snehasAdhanaM brUte; anuvAsanaM hi sneha eva bhavati| anuvAsanArthaM snehasAdhanadravyaM pRutha~gnoktaM, nirUhArthoktabheShajagaNenaiva tatsiddheH| mArutaghnamityanenAnuvAsanapravRuttiviShayaM darshayati; mArute hantavye~anuvAsanaM prakalpyamityarthaH| yadi vA pATalAdermArutaharAdgaNAnmArutaghnamanuvAsanaM prakalpyam; anyatra tu pittaharAdgaNAt pittaghnaM, tathA shleShmaharAdgaNAcchleShmaghnamiti sUcayati| sa~ggraha ityanena rogabhiShagjitIye (vi.a.8) kalpe siddhau ca vakShyamANapa~jcakarmaprapa~jcaM sUcayati||11-14||

2.sanskrit: tAnyupasthitadoShANAM snehasvedopapAdanaiH| pa~jcakarmANi kurvIta mAtrAkAlau vicArayan||15||
