2.commentary: pa~jcakarma yathA kartavyaM tathA tAnItyAdinA darshayati| tAnIti pUrvoktAni| snehasvedopapAdanairiti bahuvacanaM nAnAvidhasnehasvedopadarshanArtham| upasthitadoShANAmiti shAkhAM tyaktvA koShThagamanena tathA lInatvaparityAgena pradhAnAvasthAprAptadoShANAm | tatra pa~jcakarmapravRuttAvupasthitadoShatvameva hetuH, tadyadi snehasvedopapAdanamantarA~api syAt, yathA jvare “kaphapradhAnAnutkliShTAn doShAnAmAshayasthitAn| buddhvA jvarakarAn kAle vamyAnAM vamanairharet” (ci.a.3) iti; tatra snehasvedAvantareNApi vamanapravRuttirbhavatyeva| snehasvedopapAdanaM tu prAyikatvena tathA~anyathopasthitadoShe~api stokamAtrayA pa~jcakarmapravRuttikShobhajanyavAtajayArthaM kriyamANatvenoktam| mAtrAkAlayorvicAryatvena grahaNaM prAdhAnyAt, tena doShabheShajAdayo~api vicAryatveneha boddhavyAH; yadi vA pUrvavat kAlagrahaNAdeva sheShANAM doShAdInAmavarodho vyAkhyeyaH| tAnItyukte~api punaH pa~jcagrahaNaM pa~jcAnAmapyupasthitadoShatve sati pravRuttyupadeshArtham| iha vamanAdiShu karmalakShaNaM bahvitikartavyatAyogidoShanirharaNashaktijyAyastvam| tena tantrAntare snehasvedau prakShipya saptakarmANIti yaducyate tanna bhavati, nahi snehasvedau doShabahirniHsaraNaM kurutaH, doShasaMshamanaM tu tau kurutaH; pa~jcakarmA~ggatvena vyApriyamANau tu snehasvedau doShopasthAna eva paraM vyApriyete, na doShanirharaNe vamanAdisampAdye| anuvAsanaM tu yadyapi vamanAdivanna bahudoShanirharaNakAraNaM bhavati, tathA~api purIShasya pakvAshayagatavAtasya ca bahirnirhArakatvAt karmalakShaNaprAptameva| niShThIvananetrA~jjanAdau tu na snehasvedAdivadbahvitikartavyatAyogo naca bahudoShanirhArakatvaM, tena na tat karmashabdavAcyam| uttarabastistu sneharUpo nirUhaH snehabastAvevAntarbhavati| yadi veha vamanAdiShu pa~jcakarmasu pa~gkajashabdavadyogarUDheyaM sa~jj~jA; tena snehasvedaniShThIvanAdiShu na pravartate||15||

2.sanskrit: mAtrAkAlAshrayA yuktiH, siddhiryuktau pratiShThitA| tiShThatyupari yuktij~jo dravyaj~jAnavatAM sadA||16||
2.commentary: mAtrAkAlavicAraphalamAha- mAtrAkAletyAdi| yuktiH yojanA bheShajasya dehadoShAdyapekShayA| yuktiM stauti- siddhirityAdinA| siddhiriha vikAropashamasya sAdhyasya niShpattiH||16||

2.sanskrit: ata UrdhvaM pravakShyAmi yavAgUrvividhauShadhAH| vividhAnAM vikArANAM tatsAdhyAnAM nivRuttaye||17||
2.commentary: idAnIM vamanAdInAmayogAnmandIbhUtasya vahneH sandhukShaNArthaM tathA vamanAdiShvaprayogajanitasya shUlAdeH prashamArthaM pratij~jApUrvakaM yavAgUrabhidhatte- ata UrdhvamityAdi| uktaM hi “yathA~aNuragnistRuNagomayAdyaiH sandhukShyamANo bhavati krameNa| mahAn sthiraH sarvapacastathaiva shuddhasya peyAdibhirantaragniH” (si.a.1) iti| pippalyAdiyavAgUnirdeshe upasAdhiteti vacanaM bheShajapAnIyataNDulAdiprakRutidravyANAmucitaparimANagrahaNArtham | sAkShAdbheShajAdInAM pramANamiha noktaM, mAtrAyA agnyAdibhedenAnavasthitatvAt | yaduktaM- “mAtrAyA nAstyavasthAnaM doShamagniM balaM vayaH| vyAdhiM dravyaM ca koShThaM ca vIkShya mAtrAM prayojayet” iti| yadyapyevaM tathA~api paribhAShAdarshanAdvRuddhavaidyavyavahAradarshanAcca yathA kartavyaM taducyate- yavAgUsAdhanadravyaM tAvaddvividhaM- vIryapradhAnamauShadhadravyaM, tathA rasapradhAnamAhAradravyaM ca| tatrApyauShadhadravyaM trividhaM, vIryabhedAt; tIkShNavIryaM yathA shuNThyAdi, madhyavIryaM bilvAgnimanthAdi, mRuduvIryaM cAmalakAdi; tatra tIkShNAnAM karShaH, madhyAnAmardhapalaM, mRudUnAM palamityutsargaH| yaduktamagniveshena- “karShArdhaM vA kaNAshuNThyoH kalkadravyasya vA palam| vinIya pAcayedyuktyA vAriprasthena cAparAm” iti| atra madhyavIryANAmardhapalamAtrA noktA sA madhyapramANagrahaNAdboddhavyA| tathA “jIvantyajAjIshaTIpuShkarAhvaiH” (ci.a.12) ityAdikAyAM peyAyAM navabhirdravyaiH kolapramANairmilitvA palamadUrAntaraM bhavati, tacca mRuduvIryAbhiprAyeNaiva; “kvAthyadravyA~jjaliM kShuNNaM shrapayitvA jalADhake| ardhashRutena tenAtha yavAgvAdyupakalpayet” ityatra catuShpaladravyAbhidhAnaM rasapradhAnadravyAbhiprAyeNaiva; tena “siddhA varAhaniryUhe yavAgUrbRuMhaNI matA” ityAdAviyaM paribhAShA boddhavyA| ShaDa~ggasAdhanaparibhAShAyAM “yadapsu shRutashItAsu ShaDa~ggAdi prayujyate| karShamAtraM tato dravyaM sAdhayet prAsthike~ambhasi|| ardhashRutaM prayoktavyaM pAne peyAdisaMvidhau” ityatra peyAM prati karShadravyAbhidhAnaM madhyavIryasyApi ShaDa~ggasya mandAnalapuruShAbhiprAyeNa boddhavyam| vArimAnaM tu ShaDa~ggArthaparibhAShAyAM karShadravye vAriprastho~abhihitaH, tadanusAreNAnyatrApi jalotkarSho boddhavyaH| kalkasAdhyA tu yavAgUryatra bhavati, tatra sUdashAstroktaparimANAjjalaM grAhyam| yaduktaM- “annaM pa~jcaguNe sAdhyaM vilepI ca caturguNe| maNDashcaturdashaguNe yavAgUH ShaDguNe~ambhasi” iti| etacca pa~jcaguNe ityAdi taNDulabheShajasamudAyAdboddhavyam| yavAgUprakRutibhUtataNDulamAnaM tu sushrutavacanAdboddhavyam| yaduktaM- “vilepImucitAdbhaktAccaturbhAgakRutAM bhiShag” (su.ci.a.39) ityAdi| tathA “yavAgUH svalpataNDulA” iti||17||

2.sanskrit: pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakanAgaraiH| yavAgUrdIpanIyA syAcchUlaghnI copasAdhitA||18|| dadhitthabilvacA~ggerItakradADimasAdhitA| pAcanI grAhiNI, peyA savAte pA~jcamUlikI||19|| shAlaparNIbalAbilvaiH pRushniparNyA ca sAdhitA| dADimAmlA hitA peyA pittashleShmAtisAriNAm||20|| payasyardhodake cchAge hrIverotpalanAgaraiH| peyA raktAtisAraghnI pRushniparNyA ca sAdhitA||21|| dadyAt sAtiviShAM peyAM sAme sAmlAM sanAgarAm| shvadaMShTrAkaNTakArIbhyAM mUtrakRucchre saphANitAm||22|| viDa~ggapippalImUlashigrubhirmaricena ca| takrasiddhA yavAgUH syAt krimighnI sasuvarcikA||23|| mRudvIkAsArivAlAjapippalImadhunAgaraiH| pipAsAghnI, viShaghnI ca somarAjIvipAcitA||24|| siddhA varAhaniryUhe yavAgUrbRuMhaNI matA| gavedhukAnAM bhRuShTAnAM karshanIyA samAkShikA||25|| sarpiShmatI bahutilA snehanI lavaNAnvitA| kushAmalakaniryUhe shyAmAkAnAM virUkShaNI||26|| dashamUlIshRutA kAsahikkAshvAsakaphApahA| yamake madirAsiddhA pakvAshayarujApahA||27|| shAkairmAMsaistilairmAShaiH siddhA varco nirasyati| jambvAmrAsthidadhitthAmlabilvaiH sA~ggrAhikI matA||28|| kShAracitrakahi~ggvamlavetasairbhedinI matA| abhayApippalImUlavishvairvAtAnulomanI ||29|| takrasiddhA yavAgUH syAddhRutavyApattinAshinI| tailavyApadi shastA syAttakrapiNyAkasAdhitA||30|| gavyamAMsarasaiH sAmlA viShamajvaranAshinI| kaNThyA yavAnAM yamake pippalyAmalakaiH shRutA||31|| tAmracUDarase siddhA retomArgarujApahA| samAShavidalA vRuShyA ghRutakShIropasAdhitA||32|| upodikAdadhibhyAM tu siddhA madavinAshinI| kShudhaM hanyAdapAmArgakShIragodhArasaiH shRutA||33||
2.commentary: pa~jcakolasAdhitA yavAgUrAdAvucyate, pa~jcakarmakShINAgnivRuddhihetutvena| dadhitthaH kapitthaH| takramiha jalArthakArakam| grAhiNIti chedaH| savAte iti savAte~atIsAre| pa~jcamUlamatra sthirAdipa~jcamUlaM; yaduktaM jatUkarNe- “dhruvAdyairvAyvatIsAre” iti; dhruvAdiH vidArigandhAdiH| pRushniparNI vartulapatrA siMhapucchI| dADimAmleti vacanena yAvatA dADimenAmlatvaM syAttAvanmAnaM dADimaM darshayati| payasyardhodake ityAdau nAgaraM mustaM; yaduktaM jatUkarNe- “raktAtIsAre~ajAkShIrajale ghanajalotpalaiH” iti| pRushniparNyA ceti raktAtIsAraghnayavAgvAmeva| sAmlAmiti dADimAmlAmiti boddhavyam| shvadaMShTretyAdau jatUkarNaH- “pRushnigokaNTakaguDairmUtrArtibastishUlanut” iti| suvarcikA sarjikAkShAraH| pipAsAghnIti chedaH| somarAjI avalgujaH | gavedhuko ghulu~jcaH; gavedhukAshca taNDulasthAne| shyAmAkaH tRuNavisheShaH; tasya ca bIjataNDulA grAhyAH| yamake ghRutataile| madirA dravasthAne| shAkAdibhiH samAnairyavAgUrmantavyA| dadhitthAmlashabdena kapitthasyAmlAvasthAyAmeva grahaNaM darshayati| kShAro yavakShAraH| takrasiddheti takrakRutodakakAryA| piNyAkaH tilakalkaH| yamaka ityanena yamakena paribharjanaM darshayati| samAShavidaletyAdau taNDulena mAShavidalasya tulyamAnatA, kShIraM ca jalasthAne, ghRutaM ca paribharjane; kiMvA mAShaprakRutikaiveyam| madashabdena viShaja-raudhira-madyamadAnAM trayANAmapi grahaNam, avisheShAbhidhAnAt| kShudhaM hanyAdityAdAvapAmArgataNDulAstaNDulasthAne; kShIragodhAmAMsarasau tu jalasthAne||18-33||

2.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- aShTAviMshatirityetA yavAgvaH parikIrtitAH| pa~jcakarmANi cAshritya prokto bhaiShajyasa~ggrahaH||34||
2.commentary: pratilomatantrayuktyA~adhyAyasa~ggrahaM karoti- aShTAviMshatirityAdi||34||

2.sanskrit: pUrvaM mUlaphalaj~jAnahetoruktaM yadauShadham| pa~jcakarmAshrayaj~jAnahetostat kIrtitaM punaH||35||
2.commentary: dIrgha~jjIvitIye mUlinIphalinIgaNapaThitAnAmapAmArgajImUtAdInAM punarvacane upapattimAha- pUrvamityAdi| mUlaphalaj~jAnahetoriti asya mUlena vyavahAraH, asya phalena vyavahAraH, iti j~jAtumityarthaH| pa~jcakarmaNAmAshrayaH, Ashrayashabdashca bhAvapradhAnaH; tena pa~jcakarmAshrayatve j~jAnArthamiti phalati| yadyapi mUlinyashca phalinyashca dIrgha~jjIvitIye~api “shaNapuShpI ca bimbI ca” (sU.a.1) ityAdinA granthena pa~jcakarmAshrayatvenApyuktAH, tathA~apIha mukhyaprapa~jcenAbhidhIyamAnapa~jcakarmAshrayadravyagaNe~anabhidhAnAt pa~jcakarmAshrayatvenAprAdhAnyaM vA~apAmArgAdInAM sha~gketa, ata uktaM- pa~jcakarmAshrayaj~jAnahetostat kIrtitaM punariti||35||

2.sanskrit: smRutimAn hetuyuktij~jo jitAtmA pratipattimAn| bhiShagauShadhasaMyogaishcikitsAM kartumarhati||36||
2.commentary: etadadhyAyapratipAditAyAH pa~jcakarmapravRutterdurj~jeyatvena yathAbhUtena vaidyena cikitsA kartavyAM tAdRushaM vaidyamAha- smRutimAnityAdi| pratipattirutpannAyAmApadi jhaTiti yathAkartavyatAj~jAnaM, tadvAn pratipattimAn||36||

2.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne~apAmArgataNDulIyo nAma dvitIyo~adhyAyaH||2||
2.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne prathame bheShajacatuShke~apAmArgataNDulIyo nAma dvitIyo~adhyAyaH||2||

3.sanskrit: athAta AragvadhIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
3.commentary: dvividhaM hi bheShajamantaHparimArjanaM bahiHparimArjanaM ca; tatrApAmArgataNDulIyena pa~jcakarmayavAgUrUpamantaHparimArjanamabhidhAyAvashiShTaM bahiHparimArjanaM pralepAdyAragvadhIyenAha- athAta AragvadhIyamityAdi| yadyapi kuShThacikitsitaM pRuthageva cikitsAsthAne bhaviShyati, tatraiva cAvasaraprAptA ete AragvadhAdayo vaktumucitAH; tathA~apIha pRuthak kuShThayogAnAmabhidhAnena kuShThasyAnubandhitvena ca mahArogatvaM khyApayati; abhyarhito hyarthaH punaH punarabhidhIyate| iyaM ca kuShThacikitsA~a~anAgatAvekShaNatantrayuktyA nidAnasthAne hetulakShaNAdibhirlakShitaM kuShThamuddishyoktA; tenAlakShitasya cikitsA~abhidhIyamAnA~aj~jAtaviShayatvena na yujyata iti yaducyate tannirastaM bhavati| yadyapi rAjayakShmaprabhRutayo~api mahArogAH santi, tathA~api na te bhUribahiHparimArjanaviShayA yathA kuShThamiti kuShThaviShayA eva bahiHparimArjanayogA abhidhIyante| kuShThaharabahiHparimArjanopodghAtena ca vAtApahAH “kolaM kulatthA” ityAdayo~abhidhAsyante| ki~jca kuShThaharabahiHparimArjanaprayogANAmidaM svarUpaM yacchodhanAnantaraM prayujyamAnAH siddhibhAjo bhavanti; yaduktaM- “ye lepAH kuShThAnAM prayujyante nirhRutAsradoShANAm| saMshodhitAshayAnAM sadyaH siddhirbhavetteShAm” (ci.a.7) iti; tat pUrvAdhyAye saMshodhanamabhidhAyeha kuShThaprayogAnavasaraprAptAnabhidadhatA~a~acAryeNa sAdhu granthaniveshaH kRutaH| yadyapi ca “khadiraH kuShThaharANAm” (sU.a.25) iti vacanena khadiraH kuShThaharabheShajeShu pradhAnaM, tathA~api khadiraM parityajyAragvadhamAdAvupadishati, kuShThaharabahiHparimArjanabheShajeShvAragvadhasyaiva pradhAnatvakhyApanArtham||1-2||

3.sanskrit: AragvadhaH saiDagajaH kara~jjo vAsA guDUcI madanaM haridre| shryAhvaH surAhvaH khadiro dhavashca nimbo viDa~ggaM karavIrakatvak||3|| granthishca bhaurjo lashunaH shirIShaH salomasho guggulukRuShNagandhe| phaNijjhako vatsakasaptaparNau pIlUni kuShThaM sumanaHpravAlAH||4|| vacA hareNustrivRutA nikumbho bhallAtakaM gairikama~jjanaM ca| manaHshilAle gRuhadhUma elA kAshIsalodhrArjunamustasarjAH||5|| ityardharUpairvihitAH ShaDete gopittapItAH punareva piShTAH| siddhAH paraM sarShapatailayuktAshcUrNapradehA bhiShajA prayojyAH||6|| kuShThAni kRucchrANi navaM kilAsaM sureshaluptaM kiTibhaM sadadru| bhagandarArshAMsyapacIM sapAmAM hanyuH prayuktAstvacirAnnarANAm||7|| kuShThaM haridre surasaM paTolaM nimbAshvagandhe suradArushigrU| sasarShapaM tumburudhAnyavanyaM caNDAM ca cUrNAni samAni kuryAt||8|| taistakrapiShTaiH prathamaM sharIraM tailAktamudvartayituM yateta| tenAsyakaNDUH piDakAH sakoThAH kuShThAni shophAshca shamaM vrajanti||9|| kuShThAmRutAsa~ggakaTa~gkaTerIkAsIsakampillakamustalodhrAH| saugandhikaM sarjaraso viDa~ggaM manaHshilAle karavIrakatvak||10|| tailAktagAtrasya kRutAni cUrNAnyetAni dadyAdavacUrNanArtham| dadrUH sakaNDUH kiTibhAni pAmA vicarcikA caiva tathaiti shAntim||11|| manaHshilAle maricAni tailamArkaM payaH kuShThaharaH pradehaH| tutthaM viDa~ggaM maricAni kuShThaM lodhraM ca tadvat samanaHshilaM syAt||12|| rasA~jjanaM saprapunnADabIjaM yuktaM kapitthasya rasena lepaH| kara~jjabIjaiDagajaM sakuShThaM gomUtrapiShTaM ca paraH pradehaH||13|| ubhe haridre kuTajasya bIjaM kara~jjabIjaM sumanaHpravAlAn| tvacaM samadhyAM hayamArakasya lepaM tilakShArayutaM vidadhyAt||14|| manaHshilA tvak kuTajAt sakuShThAt salomashaH saiDagajaH kara~jjaH| granthishca bhaurjaH karavIramUlaM cUrNAni sAdhyAni tuShodakena||15|| palAshanirdAharasena cApi karShoddhRutAnyADhakasammitena| darvIpralepaM pravadanti lepametaM paraM kuShThanisUdanAya||16|| parNAni piShTvA catura~ggulasya takreNa parNAnyatha kAkamAcyAH| tailAktagAtrasya narasya kuShThAnyudvartayedashvahanacchadaishca||17||
3.commentary: tAneva kuShThaharayogAnAha- Aragvadha ityAdi| shryAhvo ‘navanItakhoTiH’ iti prasiddhaH| granthishca bhaurja iti bhUrjapatragranthiH| salomasho dhAtukAsIsam| phaNijjhakaH parNAsabhedaH| sumanaHpravAlA jAtIpallavAH| nikumbho dantI| AlaM haritAlam| ardharUpairiti ardhashlokaiH| gopittapItA iti pItagopittAH, mayUravyaMsakAditvena pUrvanipAtaniyamAt; yadi vA gopittabhAvanayA pItavarNA gopittapItAH| paramatyarthaM siddhAH; yadyapi sarvaprayogA maharShipraNItAH svaviShaye siddhAstathA~apIha bahUnAM dushcikitsyAnAM rogANAmAshuharaNAt paraM siddhA ityucyante| cUrNAni ca pradehAshca cUrNapradehAH; yadi vA cUrNIkRutAnAM pradehAshcUrNapradehA; pradeho lepaH, pradehatAkaraNaM caiShAM yogAnAM kuShThaharagomUtragopittAdinA boddhavyam| sureshaluptam indraluptam| kuShThagrahaNena labdhAnAmapi kiTibhadadrupAmAdInAM punarabhidhAnaM prayogANAM visheSheNa taddharaNashaktikhyApanArtham| tumburu svanAmaprasiddham| vanyaM kaivartamustakam| caNDA corapuShpI| prathamamiti tailAktamityanena sambadhyate| tailaM ceha kuShThaharaprakaraNe sArShapaM boddhavyam| amRutAsa~ggaH tutthakam| kaTa~gkaTerI dAruharidrA| saugandhikaM gandhatRuNaM gandhako vA| ArkaM payaH arkakShIram| tadvaditi pradehaH kuShThaharaH | prapunnADa eDagajaH| hayamArakaH karavIraH; tasya tvag grAhyA, madhyaM ca pRuthagbhAvena grAhyam| tuShodakaM satuShairyavaiH sandhAnavisheShAt kRutaM kA~jjikam| palAshasya nirdAhena gRuhIto rasaH palAshanirdAharasaH; sa ca palAshasya pradhAnamUle cchinne~adhaH kumbhaM dattvopari vRukShadAhAdyo galati svarasaH sa gRuhyate| catura~ggulaH svarNahAliH| ashvahanaH karavIraH| catura~ggulakAkamAcyashvahanacchadairekaH prayogaH, dvitve hyasya dvAtriMshatsa~gkhyA vakShyamANA virudhyate||3-17||

3.sanskrit: kolaM kulatthAH suradArurAsnAmAShAtasItailaphalAni kuShTham| vacA shatAhvA yavacUrNamamlamuShNAni vAtAmayinAM pradehaH||18|| AnUpamatsyAmiShavesavArairuShNaiH pradehaH pavanApahaH syAt| snehaishcaturbhirdashamUlamishrairgandhauShadhaishcAnilahaH pradehaH||19|| takreNa yuktaM yavacUrNamuShNaM sakShAramartiM jaThare nihanyAt| kuShThaM shatAhvAM savacAM yavAnAM cUrNaM satailAmlamushanti vAte||20|| ubhe shatAhve madhukaM madhUkaM balAM priyAlaM ca kasherukaM ca| ghRutaM vidArIM ca sitopalAM ca kuryAt pradehaM pavane sarakte||21|| rAsnA guDUcI madhukaM bale dve sajIvakaM sarShabhakaM payashca| ghRutaM ca siddhaM madhusheShayuktaM raktAnilArtiM praNudet pradehaH||22|| vAte sarakte saghRutaM pradeho godhUmacUrNaM chagalIpayashca|23|
3.commentary: tailayoniphalAnyeraNDaphalatilAdIni| amlamiti kA~jjikAdiyogAt| AnUpAnAM khaDgAdInAM matsyAnAM cAmiShaM mAMsamAnUpamatsyAmiSham| vesavAraH- “nirasthi pishitaM piShTaM svinnaM guDaghRutAnvitam| kRuShNAmaricasaMyuktaM vesavAra iti smRutaH”| gandhapradhAnAnyauShadhAni gandhauShadhAni, tAni cAgurvAdIni jvarAdhyAye pratipAdyAni; gandhauShadhaishca siddhairiti yojanIyaM; tena dashamUlagandhauShadhAbhyAM snehAH sAdhanIyAH (kiMvA gandhauShadhairdashamUlasiddhaiH snehapRuktairayaM pradehaH )| ushanti kathayanti| vidArI vidArIkandaH| sitopalA sitasharkarA| madhusheShaH sikthakam| siddhamiti ghRutadugdhayuktaM sat ki~jcidevAgnau sAdhitam||18-22||-

3.sanskrit: natotpalaM candanakuShThayuktaM shirorujAyAM saghRutaM pradehaH||23|| prapauNDarIkaM suradAru kuShThaM yaShTyAhvamelA kamalotpale ca| shirorujAyAM saghRutaH pradeho lohairakApadmakacorakaishca||24|| rAsnA haridre naladaM shatAhve dve devadArUNi sitopalA ca| jIvantimUlaM saghRutaM satailamAlepanaM pArshvarujAsu koShNam||25|| shaivAlapadmotpalavetratu~ggaprapauNDarIkANyamRuNAlalodhram| priya~ggukAleyakacandanAni nirvApaNaH syAt saghRutaH pradehaH||26|| sitAlatAvetasapadmakAni yaShTyAhvamaindrI nalinAni dUrvA| yavAsamUlaM kushakAshayoshca nirvApaNaH syAjjalamerakA ca||27|| shaileyamelAguruNI sakuShThe caNDA nataM tvak suradAru rAsnA| shItaM nihanyAdacirAt pradeho viShaM shirIShastu sasindhuvAraH||28|| shirIShalAmajjakahemalodhraistvagdoShasaMsvedaharaH pragharShaH| patrAmbulodhrAbhayacandanAni sharIradaurgandhyaharaH pradehaH||29||
3.commentary: nataM tagarapAdikA, tadabhAve shIulIcoppaDako gRuhyate| prapauNDarIkaH puNDarIkam| loham aguru| erakA hoggalaH| ayaM prapauNDarIkAdibhishcorakaishcetyanta ekaH prayogaH| corakaH corapuShpikA svanAmaprasiddhaH| naladaM mAMsI| shatAhve iti shatapuShpAmadhurike| tu~ggaH punnAgaH| amRuNAlam ushIram| kAleyakaM kAliyAkAShTham| latA ma~jjiShThA| aindrI gorakShakarkaTI| nalinaM kamalam| yavAsamUlaM durAlabhAmUlam| kushakAshayoshca mUlam| ayaM sitAdirerakA cetyanta eko yogaH| jalaM vAlakam| sindhuvAraH nirguNDI| viShamityAdiraparaH prayogaH| lAmajjakam ushIram| hema nAgakesharam| abhayam ushIram||23-29||

3.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- ihAtrijaH siddhatamAnuvAca dvAtriMshataM siddhamaharShipUjyaH| cUrNapradehAn vividhAmayaghnAnAragvadhIye jagato hitArtham||30||
3.commentary: adhyAyArthasa~ggrahaH- ihAtrija ityAdi| cUrNapradehAniti pUrvavadvyAkhyeyam| dvAtriMshatamiti sa~gkhyAkaraNaM nyUnAdhikasa~gkhyA durbodhanirAkaraNArtham||30||

3.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne AragvadhIyo nAma tRutIyo~adhyAyaH||3||
3.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne prathame bheShajacatuShke AragvadhIyo nAma tRutIyo~adhyAyaH||3||

4.sanskrit: athAtaH ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2|| iha khalu ShaD virecanashatAni bhavanti, ShaD virecanAshrayAH, pa~jca kaShAyayonayaH, pa~jcavidhaM kaShAyakalpanaM, pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyAH, pa~jca kaShAyashatAni, iti sa~ggrahaH||3||
4.commentary: apAmArgataNDulIye~antaHparimArjanamuktam, AragvadhIye ca bahiHparimArjanamuktaM; samprati pUrvAdhyAyadvayApratipAditabheShajacatuShkAvashyavaktavyamavashiShTamubhayaparimArjanabheShajamabhidhAtuM ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyo~abhidhIyate| AshrIyata ityAshritamAshraya ityarthaH| ShaTsa~gkhyAvacchinnAni virecanashatAnyAshritAni cAdhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyaH ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyaH, etenaitaduktaM- ShaDvirecanashatAni, ShaDvirecanAshrayAH, etaddvayamadhikRutya sa~jj~jeyaM praNIteti mantavyam| yadyapi cAdhyAyAdAviha khalviti padaM shrUyate, tathA~api tadapradhAnatvAnnAdhyAyasa~jj~jApraNayane niveshitam| iheti agniveshatantre~anatisa~gkShepavistare| etena vakShyamANavirecanaShaTshatAnAM tathA pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyANAM tathA pa~jcakaShAyashatAnAM vistarakalpanAyAmadhikatvamapi bhavatIti sUcyate| ata eva vakShyati kalpe- “uddeshamAtrametAvaddraShTavyamiha ShaTshatam| svabuddhyaivaM sahasrANi koTirvA samprakalpayet” (ka.a.12) iti| tathA~atraiva vakShyati- “na hi vistarasya pramANamasti” ityAdi| khalushabdaH prakAshane| virecanashabdeneha vamanaM virecanaM ca gRuhyate| yato vakShyati kalpe- “ubhayaM vA doShamalavirecanAdvirecanashabdaM labhate” (ka.a.1) iti| na ca vAcyaM doShamalavirecanAccedvirecanasa~jj~jA, tena bastishirovirecanayorapi virecanasa~jj~jApravRuttiH; yatastantrakArasiddheyaM sa~jj~jA na pAcakavadyogamAtrapravRuttA; tantrakArashca vamanavirecanayoreva yogarUDhAM sa~jj~jAM vidadhAti nAnyatra, tat kuto~anyatra prasaktiH| ShaDvirecanashatAnItyAdi svayamevAcAryo vyAkhyAsyati| pa~jca kaShAyashatAnItyatra kaShAyashabdena madhurAdInAM lavaNavarjAnAM rasAnAM kaShAyatvena paribhAShitAnAmAshrayatvenauShadhadravyamucyate| kaShAyayonayaH kaShAyajAtayaH| kaShAyANAM yathoktadravyANAM kalpanamupayogArthaM saMskaraNaM kaShAyakalpanam| mahAkaShAyA iti dashasa~gkhyAvacchinnasyaikakAryakaraNArthopAttasyauShadhagaNasya sa~jj~jA; yadvakShyati- “dashemAni jIvanIyAni” ityAdinA||1-3||

4.sanskrit: ShaD virecanashatAni, iti yaduktaM tadiha sa~ggraheNodAhRutya vistareNa kalpopaniShadi vyAkhyAsyAmaH; (tatra ) trayastriMshadyogashataM praNItaM phaleShu, ekonacatvAriMshajjImUtakeShu yogAH, pa~jcacatvAriMshadikShvAkuShu, dhAmArgavaH ShaShTidhA bhavati yogayuktaH, kuTajastvaShTAdashadhA yogameti, kRutavedhanaM ShaShTidhA bhavati yogayuktaM, shyAmAtrivRudyogashataM praNItaM dashApare cAtra bhavanti yogAH, catura~ggulo dvAdashadhA yogameti, lodhraM vidhau ShoDashayogayuktaM, mahAvRukSho bhavati viMshatiyogayuktaH, ekonacatvAriMshat saptalAsha~gkhinyoryogAH, aShTacatvAriMshaddantIdravantyoH, iti ShaDvirecanashatAni||4||
4.commentary: sa~ggraheNa uddeshamAtreNa| kalpa evopaniShat kalpopaniShat; upaniShadityatyupayuktarahasyavidyopadeshasthAnamucyate vede; tadvadihApi kalpasyAtyupayuktatvena rahasyavamanavirecanaprayogopadeshakatvAt kalpa evopaniShadityucyate| na ca vAcyaM kalpa eva vistareNa ShaDvirecanashatAnyabhidhAsyante, tena tadevAstu, alamanena sa~gkShepAbhidhAnena samyagavabodhAnupAyatvAt; yatastantradharmo~ayaM- yat prathamaM sUtraNaM bhavati, tadanu tadvivaraNaM prapa~jcena; ucyate ca nyAyavidbhiH- “te vai viShayAshca susa~ggRuhItA bhavanti yeShAM samAso vyAsashca” iti| trayastriMshatA~adhikaM yogashataM trayastriMshadyogashatam| kRutavedhanayogAntA yogA vamanasya, sheShA virecanasya| atreti shyAmAtrivRutoreva| shyAmeti shyAmamUlA trivRut, trivRuditi aruNamUlA trivRut||4||

4.sanskrit: ShaD virecanAshrayA iti kShIramUlatvakpatrapuShpaphalAnIti||5||
4.commentary: ShaDityAdi| ShaDeva virecanAshrayA virecanAdhikaraNAni| atra hi kShIramAdau kRutaM tIkShNavirecanatvAt; uktaM hi- “snukpayastIkShNavirecanAnAm” (sU.a.25) iti| tvagityanena lodhratvaggRuhyate| patramityanena ikShvAkvAdipatram| yadvakShyati kalpe- “apuShpasya pravAlAnAM muShTiM prAdeshasammitAm| kShIraprasthe shRutaM dadyAt pittodrikte kaphajvare” (ka.a.3) iti| yadyapi cairaNDatailatAmrapAradAdInAM kShIrAdyadhikAnAmapi virecanAshrayatvaM sambhavati, tathA~api teShAmiha tantre kalpasthAne virecanAshrayatvenAnabhidhAnAdadhyAyAdipratipAditenehashabdena yogAdiha ShaDAshrayA ityaviruddhameva||5||

4.sanskrit: pa~jca kaShAyayonaya iti madhurakaShAyo~amlakaShAyaH kaTukaShAyastiktakaShAyaH kaShAyakaShAyashceti tantre sa~jj~jA||6||
4.commentary: pa~jca kaShAyashatAni mahAkaShAyavyAkhyayA vyAkhyAtavyAni, atastadulla~gghya pa~jca kaShAyayonayo~abhidhIyante| madhurashcAsau kaShAyashceti madhurakaShAyaH, evaM sheSheShvapi| tantre sa~jj~jetyanena lavaNarasaM varjayitvA madhurAdayo rasAH kaShAyasa~jj~jayA vyavahriyante ityayaM svatantrasamaya iti sUcayati, nAtra paratantravyavahAra iti| atha kimarthaM punarAcAryeNa kaShAyasa~jj~jApraNayane lavaNasya madhurAderiva guNAdibhiruddiShTasya tathA prayogeShu citrakaguDikAdau “dvau kShArau lavaNAni ca” (ci.a.15) ityAdinoddiShTasya rogabhiShagjitIye (vi.a.8) ca skandhenopadiShTasya rasAdhikAreShu ca teShu teShu madhurAdivadupadiShTasya parityAgaH kriyate? ucyate- kaShAyasa~jj~jeyaM bheShajatvena vyApriyamANeShu raseShvAcAryeNa niveshitA| atra ca kevalasya lavaNasya prayogo nAsti, madhurAdInAM tu kevalAnAmapi prayogo~asti, lavaNaM tu dravyAntarasaMyuktamevopayujyate| madhurAdiShu svarasakalkAdilakShaNA kalpanA sambhavati, na lavaNe| yato na tAvallavaNasya svaraso~asti; kalko~api dravyasya draveNa peShaNAt kriyate, tacca na sambhavati lavaNe, lavaNaM hi pAnIyayogAt pAnIyameva bhavati; yadyapi kalkasyaiva bhedashcUrNaM, cUrNatA ca lavaNasya sambhavati, tathA~api lavaNasya cUrNarUpatA na pUrvasmAdacUrNarUpAt ki~jcicchaktivisheShamApAdayati, shaktivisheShakalpanArthaM ca kalpanA kriyata ityuttaratra pratipAdayiShyAmaH, tasmAccUrNatvamapi lavaNasya kalpanakalpanamiva; shRutashItaphANTakaShAyAstu dravyasya kArtsnyenAnupayojyasya tattatsaMskAravashAddraveShu dravyasya stokAvayavAnupraveshArthamupadishyante; lavaNe caitanna sambhavati, lavaNaM hi dravasambandhe sarvAtmanaiva dravamanugataM bhavati; tasmAllavaNaM pRuthakprayogAbhAvAt kalpanA~asambhavAccAcAryeNa kaShAyasa~jj~jApraNayane nirastamiti na niShprayojaneyamAcAryapravRuttiH||6||

4.sanskrit: pa~jcavidhaM kaShAyakalpanamiti tadyathA- svarasaH, kalkaH, shRutaH, shItaH, phANTaH, kaShAya iti| (yantraniShpIDitAddravyAdrasaH svarasa ucyate | yaH piNDo rasapiShTAnAM sa kalkaH parikIrtitaH || vahnau tu kvathitaM dravyaM shRutamAhushcikitsakAH | dravyAdApotthitAttoye pratapte nishi saMsthitAt || kaShAyo yo~abhiniryAti sa shItaH samudAhRutaH | kShiptvoShNatoye mRuditaM tat phANTaM parikIrtitam ||) teShAM yathApUrvaM balAdhikyam; ataH kaShAyakalpanA vyAdhyAturabalApekShiNI; na tvevaM khalu sarvANi sarvatropayogIni bhavanti||7||
4.commentary: kalpanamupayogArthaM prakalpanaM saMskaraNamiti yAvat svarasAdibahulakShaNaM; yathA- “svo rasaH svarasaH proktaH, kalko dRuShadi peShitaH| kvathitastu shRutaH, shItaH sharvarImuShito mataH|| kShiptoShNatoye mRuditaH phANTa ityabhidhIyate” iti| atra shaunakavacanaM tu “dravyAdApothitAttoye pratapte nishi saMsthitAt| kaShAyo yo~abhiniryAti sa shItaH samudAhRutaH” iti| phANTaH kaShAya iti kaShAyashabdo~ayaM svarasAdibhirapi sambadhyate, tena svarasaH kaShAyaH, kalkaH kaShAyaH, ityAdyapi boddhavyam| teShAM svarasAdInAM yathApUrvaM balAdhikyamiti phANTAcchIto guruH, shItAcchRuto gururityAdi| yato yathApUrvaM gurvI kaShAyakalpanA, ata eva vyAdhyAturabalApekShiNI; vyAdherAturasya ca balamapekShata ityarthaH| atropapattimAha- na tvevamityAdi| balavati puruShe vyAdhau ca dravyasArabhAgamayatvenAtyarthaM gururbahukAryakaraH svaraso yujyate, nAyamalpabale puruShe roge vA yogavAn bhavati, balabhraMshabheShajAtiyogadoShakartRutvAditi bhAvaH; evamanyatrApi vyAkhyeyam| tathA na sarvANi svarasAdIni sarvatra puruShe yogyAni bhavanti; yataH kecit svarasadviShaH, kecit svarasapriyA itarakalpanAdviSha evamAdi| na cAtyarthaM dviShTabheShajasya prayoga iShyate, tatkShaNavamanArucyAdidoShakartRutvAt | tathA kaShAyakalpanA vyAdhyAturabalApekShiNItyetadudAharaNArthaM, tena dravyApekShiNItyetadapi boddhavyam| yato dravyaniyamena kalpanAniyamaM vakShyati rasAyane; yathA- “maNDUkaparNyAH svarasaH prayojyaH, kShIreNa yaShTImadhukasya cUrNam| raso guDUcyAstu samUlapuShpyAH, kalkaH prayojyaH khalu sha~gkhapuShpyAH” (ci.a.1) iti| cUrNaM kalka evAntarbhAvanIyaM, dvividho hi kalkaH sadravo~adravashceti kRutvA; tena “nishi sthitA vA svarasIkRutA vA kalkIkRutA cUrNamatho shRutA vA” (ci.a.4) ityAdau pRuthak cUrNapAThenAdhikakalpanAprasa~ggo nodbhAvanIyaH||7||

4.sanskrit: ‘pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyA’ iti yaduktaM tadanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tadyathA- jIvanIyo bRuMhaNIyo lekhanIyo bhedanIyaH sandhAnIyo dIpanIya iti ShaTkaH kaShAyavargaH; balyo varNyaH kaNThyo hRudya iti catuShkaH kaShAyavargaH; tRuptighno~arshoghnaH kuShThaghnaH kaNDUghnaH krimighno viShaghna iti ShaTkaH kaShAyavargaH; stanyajananaH stanyashodhanaH shukrajananaH shukrashodhana iti catuShkaH kaShAyavargaH; snehopagaH svedopago vamanopago virecanopaga AsthApanopago~anuvAsanopagaH shirovirecanopaga iti saptakaH kaShAyavargaH; chardinigrahaNastRuShNAnigrahaNo hikkAnigrahaNa iti trikaH kaShAyavargaH; purIShasa~ggrahaNIyaH purIShavirajanIyo mUtrasa~ggrahaNIyo mUtravirajanIyo mUtravirecanIya iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH; kAsaharaH shvAsaharaH shothaharo jvaraharaH shramahara iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH; dAhaprashamanaH shItaprashamana udardaprashamano~a~ggamardaprashamanaH shUlaprashamana iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH; shoNitasthApano vedanAsthApanaH sa~jj~jAsthApanaH prajAsthApano vayaHsthApana iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH; iti pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyA mahatAM ca kaShAyANAM lakShaNodAharaNArthaM vyAkhyAtA bhavanti| teShAmekaikasmin mahAkaShAye dasha dashAvayavikAn kaShAyAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tAnyeva pa~jca kaShAyashatAni bhavanti||8||
4.commentary: mahAkaShAyAnudAharati- pa~jcAshadityAdi| jIvane hito jIvanIyaH; evamanyatrApi| ShaDbhirniShpAditaH ShaTkaH, evaM catuShkAdiShvapi bodhyam| atra ca ShaTkAdirmahAkaShAyANAM paricchedaH kasyacidarthasyAnugamena boddhavyaH; yathA- jIvanIyAdau ShaTke IyAntatvaM, balyAdau yapratyayAntatvaM, tRuptighnAdau ghnAntatvaM, stanyajananAdau stanyashukraviShayatvam, evamAdyUhyam | etacca IyapratyayAntatvAdinA bahubhedakathanaM vaicitryeNa granthasya puShkalAbhidhAnatAkaraNArtham| etacca shAstre~avashyaM kartavyam| yaduktamihaiva shAstraguNakathane yathA- “anavapatitashabdamakaShTashabdaM puShkalAbhidhAnam” (vi.a.8) ityAdi| jIvanIyashabdenehAyuShyatvamabhipretam| yatra ca madhurarasaguNe “AyuShyo jIvanIyaH” (sU.a.26) iti ca kariShyati tatra mUrcchitasya sa~jj~jAjanakatvena jIvanIyatvaM vyAkhyeyam| tRuptiH shleShmavikAro yena tRuptamivAtmAnaM manyate, tadghnaM tRuptighnam| snehopagAnIti snehasya sarpirAdeH snehanakriyAyAM sahAyatvenopagacchantIti snehopagAni, mRudvIkAdisnehopagayuktasya sarpirAdeH snehane prakarShavatI shaktirbhavatItyarthaH; tathA vamanopagAnItyatra madanaphalAdInAM vamanadravyANAM madhumadhukAdIni sahAyAni bhavantIti; evaM svedopagAdau vyAkhyeyam| shirovirecanopage tu shirovirecanapradhAnAnyeva dravyANi boddhavyAni| purIShasya virajanaM doShasambandhanirAsaM karotIti purIShavirajanIyaH| evaM mUtravirajanIye vyAkhyeyam| mUtrasya virecanaM karotIti mUtravirecanIyaH| udardo varaTIdaShTAkAraH shothaH, tatprashamana udardaprashamanaH; na punariha mahArogAdhyAye paThito vAtavikAro gRuhyate, tindukAdInAmudardaprashamanAnAM vAtaM pratyananukUlatvAt| shoNitasya duShTasya duShTimapahRutya prakRutau shoNitaM sthApayatIti shoNitasthApanam| vedanAyAM sambhUtAyAM tAM nihatya sharIraM prakRutau sthApayatIti vedanAsthApanam| sa~jj~jAM j~jAnaM ca sthApayatIti sa~jj~jAsthApanam| prajopaghAtakaM doShaM hRutvA prajAM sthApayatIti prajAsthApanam| vayastaruNaM sthApayatIti vayaHsthApanam| upasaMharati- itItyAdi| mahatAM kaShAyANAM pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyA bhavantItyanenoddiShTAnAM, lakShaNaM svarUpaM jIvanIyAdi, tasyodAharaNaM prapa~jcena kathanaM, tadarthaM vyAkhyAtA nirdeshena kathitA ityarthaH; yadi vA mahatAM kaShAyANAM yallakShaNamanekaiH kaShAyairmilitvaikArthajIvanIyAdisampAdanaM, tasyodAharaNArthaM dRuShTAntArtham| etenAnyAnyapi mahAkaShAyANi vAtaprashamanapittaprashamanAdInyekakAryasampAdakAnekadravyamayAni bhavantIti sUcayati| mahatAM ceti cakAra udAharaNArthaM cetyatra boddhavyaH, tenAlpabuddhInAM vyavahArArthaM ceti samuccinoti; etaccottaratra sphuTaM bhaviShyati| uttaratra yadvakShyati- “mahatAM ca kaShAyANAM lakShaNodAharaNArthaM vyAkhyAtA bhavanti” iti, tat tadyathetyAdigranthasyArthaM vyAkartuM; kiMvA~atra vyAkhyAtA iti padaM sa~jj~jAmAtreNa mahAkaShAyakathane vartate, tatra tu vyAkhyAtA iti padaM prati prati jIvakAdidravyakathane vartate, tena na paunaruktyam| avayavA evAvayavikAH, tAnyeva pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyANi dashAvayavaguNitAnyekaikadravyarUpANi pa~jca kaShAyashatAni bhavantItyarthaH||8||

4.sanskrit: tadyathA- jIvakarShabhakau medA mahAmedA kAkolI kShIrakAkolI mudgaparNImAShaparNyau jIvantI madhukamiti dashemAni jIvanIyAni bhavanti (1), kShIriNI rAjakShavakAshvagandhAkAkolIkShIrakAkolIvATyAyanIbhadraudanIbhAradvAjIpayasyarShyagandhA iti dashemAni bRuMhaNIyAni bhavanti (2), mustakuShThaharidrAdAruharidrAvacAtiviShAkaTurohiNIcitrakacirabilvahaimavatya iti dashemAni lekhanIyAni bhavanti (3), suvahArkorubukAgnimukhIcitrAcitrakacirabilvasha~gkhinIshakulAdanIsvarNakShIriNya iti dashemAni bhedanIyAni bhavanti (4), madhukamadhuparNIpRushniparNyambaShThakIsama~ggAmocarasadhAtakIlodhrapriya~ggukaTphalAnIti dashemAni sandhAnIyAni bhavanti (5), pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakashRu~ggaverAmlavetasamaricAjamodAbhallAtakAsthihi~gguniryAsA iti dashemAni dIpanIyAni bhavanti (6), iti ShaTkaH kaShAyavargaH||9||
4.commentary: jIvanIyamAdAvucyate sarveShAM jIvanahitasyaivAtyarthamabhipretatvAt| mudgamAShaparNyantaM sugamam| jIvantI svanAmakhyAtA suvarNavarNAbhA, madhukaM yaShTImadhukam (1)| kShIriNI kShIralatA, rAjakShavako dugdhikA, vATyAyanI shvetabalA, bhadraudanI pItabalA, bhAradvAjI vanakArpAsI, payasyA vidArIkandaH, RuShyagandhA RuShyajA~ggalakaH (2)| kaTukA kaTurohiNI, cirabilvaH kara~jjaH, haimavatI shvetavacA (3)| suvahA trivRut, agnimukhI ‘lA~ggaliyA’ iti khyAtA, citrA dantI, sha~gkhinI shvetabuhnA, shakulAdanI kaTurohiNI, svarNakShIriNI a~gguShThaprabhA (4)| ambaShThakI akarNaviddhA, sama~ggA varAhakrAntA, kaTphalaM svanAmaprasiddhaM, sandhAnIyaH sa~ggrahaNaH sAmAnyena; purIShasya sa~ggrahaNastu bhinnamalamAtrasa~ggrahaNaH (5)| shRu~ggaveraH shuNThI, hi~gguniryAso hi~ggu||9||

4.sanskrit: aindryRuShabhyatirasarShyaproktApayasyAshvagandhAsthirArohiNIbalAtibalA iti dashemAni balyAni bhavanti (7), candanatu~ggapadmakoshIramadhukama~jjiShThAsArivApayasyAsitAlatA iti dashemAni varNyAni bhavanti (8), sArivekShumUlamadhukapippalIdrAkShAvidArIkaiTaryahaMsapAdIbRuhatIkaNTakArikA iti dashemAni kaNThyAni bhavanti (9), AmrAmrAtakalikucakaramardavRukShAmlAmlavetasakuvalabadaradADimamAtulu~ggAnIti dashemAni hRudyAni bhavanti (10), iti catuShkaH kaShAyavargaH||10||
4.commentary: aindrI gorakShakarkaTI, RuShabhI shUkashimbA, atirasA shatAvarI RuddhirvA, RuShyaproktA mAShaparNI, atibalA pItabalA, payasyeha kShIravidArI kAkolI vA (7)| tu~ggaH punnAgaH, sitA shvetadUrvA, latA shyAmadUrvA (8)| sArivA anantamUlam, ikShumUlamatrekShormUlaM moraTo vA, vidArI vidArIkandaH, kaiTaryaM kaTphalaM, haMsapAdI svanAmaprasiddhA (9)| AmrAtaka AmrADakaH, vRukShAmlaM bRuhadamlam (10)||10||

4.sanskrit: nAgaracavyacitrakaviDa~ggamUrvAguDUcIvacAmustapippalIpaTolAnIti dashemAni tRuptighnAni bhavanti (11), kuTajabilvacitrakanAgarAtiviShAbhayAdhanvayAsakadAruharidrAvacAcavyAnIti dashemAnyarshoghnAni bhavanti (12), khadirAbhayAmalakaharidrAruShkarasaptaparNAragvadhakaravIraviDa~ggajAtIpravAlA iti dashemAni kuShThaghnAni bhavanti (13), candananaladakRutamAlanaktamAlanimbakuTajasarShapamadhukadAruharidrAmustAnIti dashemAni kaNDUghnAni bhavanti (14), akShIvamaricagaNDIrakebukaviDa~gganirguNDIkiNihIshvadaMShTrAvRuShaparNikAkhuparNikA iti dashemAni krimighnAni bhavanti (15), haridrAma~jjiShThAsuvahAsUkShmailApAlindIcandanakatakashirIShasindhuvArashleShmAtakA iti dashemAni viShaghnAni bhavanti (16), iti ShaTkaH kaShAyavargaH||11||
4.commentary: tRuptighno vyaktaH (11)| dhanvayAso durAlabhA (12)| aruShkaro bhallAtakaH (13)| naladaM mAMsI, kRutamAlaH suvarNahaliH, naktamAlaH kara~jjaH (14)| akShIvo~abdakaH shobhA~jjano vA, gaNDIraH shamaThashAkaM, nirguNDI sindhuvAraH, kiNihI kaTabhI, AkhuparNI mUShikaparNI, vRuShaparNI ca tadbhedaH ‘pha~jjipatrikA’ iti khyAtA (15)| suvahA rAsnA hApharamAlI vA, pAlindI shyAmalatA, shleShmAtako bahuvAraH (16)||11||

4.sanskrit: vIraNashAliShaShTikekShuvAlikAdarbhakushakAshagundretkaTakattRuNamUlAnIti dashemAni stanyajananAni bhavanti (17), pAThAmahauShadhasuradArumustamUrvAguDUcIvatsakaphalakirAtatiktakakaTurohiNIsArivA iti dashemAni stanyashodhanAni bhavanti (18), jIvakarShabhakakAkolIkShIrakAkolImudgaparNImAShaparNImedAvRuddharuhAjaTilAkuli~ggA iti dashemAni shukrajananAni bhavanti (19), kuShThailavAlukakaTphalasamudraphenakadambaniryAsekShukANDekShvikShurakavasukoshIrANIti dashemAni shukrashodhanAni bhavanti (20), iti catuShkaH kaShAyavargaH||12||
4.commentary: ikShuvAlikA khAgAlikA, darbha uluyAtRuNaM, gundrA gulu~jca (17)| stanyashodhano vyaktaH (18)| vRuddharuhA shatAvarI, vRukSharuhApAThapakShe bandAkaH, jaTilA uccaTA, kuli~gga uccaTAbhedaH (19)| kadambo bahuphalastasya niryAsaH, ikShurakaH kokilAkShaH, vasuko vasuhaTTakaH, atra jatUkarNaH paThatyelavAlukaM kaTphalasthAne (20)||12||

4.sanskrit: mRudvIkAmadhukamadhuparNImedAvidArIkAkolIkShIrakAlolIjIvakajIvantIshAlaparNya iti dashemAni snehopagAni bhavanti (21), shobhA~jjanakairaNDArkavRushcIrapunarnavAyavatilakulatthamAShabadarANIti dashemAni svedopagAni bhavanti (22), madhumadhukakovidArakarbudAranIpavidulabimbIshaNapuShpIsadApuShpApratyakpuShpA iti dashemAni vamanopagAni bhavanti (23), drAkShAkAshmaryaparUShakAbhayAmalakabibhItakakuvalabadarakarkandhupIlUnIti dashemAni virecanopagAni bhavanti (24), trivRudbilvapippalIkuShThasarShapavacAvatsakaphalashatapuShpAmadhukamadanaphalAnIti dashemAnyAsthApanopagAni bhavanti (25), rAsnAsuradArubilvamadanashatapuShpAvRushcIrapunarnavAshvadaMShTrAgnimanthashyonAkA iti dashemAnyanuvAsanopagAni bhavanti (26), jyotiShmatIkShavakamaricapippalIviDa~ggashigrusarShapApAmArgataNDulashvetAmahAshvetA iti dashemAni shirovirecanopagAni bhavanti (27), iti saptakaH kaShAyavargaH||13||
4.commentary: snehopago vyaktaH (21)| vRushcIraH shvetapunarnavA (22)| kovidAraH svanAmaprasiddhaH, karbudAraH shvetakA~jcanaH, vidulo hijjalaH, shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA, sadApuShpA arkaH, pratyakpuShpA apAmArgaH (23)| badarItrayam (24)| vyaktaH (25)| vyaktaH (26)| kShavakaH chikkAkArakaH, shvetA aparAjitA, mahAshvetA tadbhedaH kaTabhI vA (27)||13||

4.sanskrit: jambvAmrapallavamAtulu~ggAmlabadaradADimayavayaShTikoshIramRullAjA iti dashemAni chardinigrahaNAni bhavanti (28), nAgaradhanvayavAsakamustaparpaTakacandanakirAtatiktakaguDUcIhrIveradhAnyakapaTolAnIti dashemAni tRuShNAnigrahaNAni bhavanti (29), shaTIpuShkaramUlabadarabIjakaNTakArikAbRuhatIvRukSharuhAbhayApippalIdurAlabhAkulIrashRu~ggya iti dashemAni hikkAnigrahaNAni bhavanti (30), iti trikaH kaShAyavargaH||14||
4.commentary: vyaktaH (28)| vyaktaH (29)| vyaktaH (30)||14||

4.sanskrit: priya~ggvanantAmrAsthikaTva~ggalodhramocarasasama~ggAdhAtakIpuShpapadmApadmakesharANIti dashemAni purIShasa~ggrahaNIyAni bhavanti (31), jambushallakItvakkacchurAmadhUkashAlmalIshrIveShTakabhRuShTamRutpayasyotpalatilakaNA iti dashemAni purIShavirajanIyAni bhavanti (32), jambvAmraplakShavaTakapItanoDumbarAshvatthabhallAtakAshmantakasomavalkA iti dashemAni mUtrasa~ggrahaNIyAni bhavanti (33), padmotpalanalinakumudasaugandhikapuNDarIkashatapatramadhukapriya~ggudhAtakIpuShpANIti dashemAni mUtravirajanIyAni bhavanti (34), vRukShAdanIshvadaMShTrAvasukavashirapAShANabhedadarbhakushakAshagundretkaTamUlAnIti dashemAni mUtravirecanIyAni bhavanti (35), iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH||15||
4.commentary: anantA anantamUlaM, kaTva~ggaH shyonAkaH, mocarasaH shAlmalIveShTakaH, padmA brAhmaNayaShTikA (31)| shallakI svanAmaprasiddhA, kacchurA shUkashimbA, shAlmalIveShTakaH shimalIAThA, shrIveShTako navanItakhoTI (32)| kapItano gandhamuNDaH, ashmantakaH amlaloTaH, somavalkaH khadiraH (33)| padmabhedAshcatvAraH, saugandhikaH shundhI (34)| vRukShAdanI bandAko vidArikando vA, vashiraH sUryAvartaH (35) ||15||

4.sanskrit: drAkShAbhayAmalakapippalIdurAlabhAshRu~ggIkaNTakArikAvRushcIrapunarnavAtAmalakya iti dashemAni kAsaharANi bhavanti (36), shaTIpuShkaramUlAmlavetasailAhi~ggvagurusurasAtAmalakIjIvantIcaNDA iti dashemAni shvAsaharANi bhavanti (37), pATalAgnimanthashyonAkabilvakAshmaryakaNTakArikAbRuhatIshAlaparNIpRushniparNIgokShurakA iti dashemAni shvayathuharANi bhavanti (38), sArivAsharkarApAThAma~jjiShThAdrAkShApIluparUShakAbhayAmalakabibhItakAnIti dashemAni jvaraharANi bhavanti (39), drAkShAkharjUrapriyAlabadaradADimaphalguparUShakekShuyavaShaShTikA iti dashemAni shramaharANi bhavanti (40), iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH||16||
4.commentary: tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI (36)| caNDA corahulI (37)| vyaktaH (38)| vyaktaH (39)| phalguH kAShThodumbarakaH (40)||16||

4.sanskrit: lAjAcandanakAshmaryaphalamadhUkasharkarAnIlotpaloshIrasArivAguDUcIhrIberANIti dashemAni dAhaprashamanAni bhavanti (41), tagarAgurudhAnyakashRu~ggaverabhUtIkavacAkaNTakAryagnimanthashyonAkapippalya iti dashemAni shItaprashamanAni bhavanti (42), tindukapriyAlabadarakhadirakadarasaptaparNAshvakarNArjunAsanArimedA iti dashemAnyudardaprashamanAni bhavanti (43), vidArIgandhApRushniparNIbRuhatIkaNTakArikairaNDakAkolIcandanoshIrailAmadhukAnIti dashemAnya~ggamardaprashamanAni bhavanti (44), pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakashRu~ggaveramaricAjamodAjagandhAjAjIgaNDIrANIti dashemAni shUlaprashamanAni bhavanti (45), iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH||17||
4.commentary: lAjAdau jatUkarNapAThAt guDUcIsthAne padmakaH, yadi vA “arkAguruguDUcInAM tiktAnAM cauShNyamiShyate” (sU.a.26), iti vacanAdyadyapyuShNA guDUcI, tathA~api tasyA dAhaprashamakatvaM prabhAvAdboddhavyam (41)| bhUtIko yavAnikA (42)| tindukaH ‘kenduH’ iti prasiddhaH, kadaro viTkhadiraH, arimedaH khadirabhedaH (43)| vyaktaH (44)| ajagandhA phokAndI (45)||17||

4.sanskrit: madhumadhukarudhiramocarasamRutkapAlalodhragairikapriya~ggusharkarAlAjA iti dashemAni shoNitasthApanAni bhavanti (46), shAlakaTphalakadambapadmakatumbamocarasashirIShava~jjulailavAlukAshokA iti dashemAni vedanAsthApanAni bhavanti (47), hi~ggukaiTaryArimedAvacAcorakavayasthAgolomIjaTilApala~gkaShAshokarohiNya iti dashemAni sa~jj~jAsthApanAni bhavanti (48), aindrIbrAhmIshatavIryAsahasravIryA~amoghA~avyathAshivA~ariShTAvATyapuShpIviShvaksenakAntA iti dashemAni prajAsthApanAni bhavanti (49), amRutA~abhayAdhAtrImuktAshvetAjIvantyatirasAmaNDUkaparNIsthirApunarnavA iti dashemAni vayaHsthApanAni bhavanti (50), iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH||18||
4.commentary: rudhiraM ku~gkumam (46)| va~jjulo vetasaH (47)| kaiTaryaH parvatanimbaH, vayaHsthA brAhmI, golomI bhUtakeshI, pala~gkaShA gugguluH jaTAmAMsI vA (48)| shatavIryAsahasravIrye dUrve; amoghA pATalA, AmalakI vA, lakShmaNA vA; avyathA kadalI, guDUcI vA, harItakI vA; ariShTA kaTurohiNI; viShvaksenakAntA priya~gguH (49)| muktA rAsnA; shvetAsthAne ‘shreyasI’ iti kecit, sA rAsnAbhedaH (50)||18||

4.sanskrit: iti pa~jcakaShAyashatAnyabhisamasya pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyA mahatAM ca kaShAyANAM lakShaNodAharaNArthaM vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||19||
4.commentary: sampratyetAnyeva jIvakAdInyuktAni pratyekasho dravyagaNanayA pa~jcakaShAyashatAni syuH, dashakagaNanayA ca pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyAH shRu~ggagrAhikayoktA bhavantIti darshayannupasaMharati- itItyAdi| abhisamasyeti dashakasa~gkhyayaikavargIkRutya| lakShaNasyodAharaNaM (lakShaNodAharaNaM ), pUrvaM jIvanIyAdisa~jj~jA lakShaNamabhipretyoktA; lakShaNodAharaNArthamiti samprati jIvakarShabhakAdInyudAharaNArthaM vyAkhyAtAni; jIvakAdibhirdashabhirlakShyate j~jAyate jIvanIyo mahAkaShAyaH| mahatAM ceti cakAraH pa~jcakaShAyashatAnAM ca lakShaNasyodAharaNArthamiti samuccinoti| tatra jIvakAdayaH pratyekaM pa~jcakaShAyashatAnAmekaikadravyarUpANAM lakShaNasvarUpA bhavanti| yadi vA lakShaNArthamudAharaNArthaM ceti; tatra mandabuddhInAM lakShaNArthaM pa~jcakaShAyashatapa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyaj~jAnArthamityarthaH, buddhimatAM tUdAharaNArthaM dRuShTAntArtham||19||

4.sanskrit: nahi vistarasya pramANamasti, na cApyatisa~gkShepo~alpabuddhInAM sAmarthyAyopakalpate, tasmAdanatisa~gkShepeNAnativistareNa copadiShTAH| etAvanto hyalamalpabuddhInAM vyavahArAya, buddhimatAM ca svAlakShaNyAnumAnayuktikushalAnAmanuktArthaj~jAnAyeti||20||
4.commentary: nanu kaShAyadravyANi yAvanti santi tAvanti vA~abhidhIyantAM, dRuShTAntArthaM dvitrANi vA; tat kimarthamayaM nAtivistaro nAtisa~gkShepa ityatrAha- nahItyAdi| na hi vistarasya pramANamiyattAparicchedo~asti, tena vistaro nAbhidhIyata ityarthaH| atisa~gkShepo~api dvitralakShaNAbhidhAnarUpo nAlpabuddhInAmanumAnAkushalAnAM sAmarthyAya cikitsAvyavahArAyopakalpate| etAvanto yathoktAH| alaM samarthAH| vyavahArAyeti cikitsAvyavahArAya| svalakShaNasya bhAvaH svAlakShaNyaM, tenAnumAnaM, tatra kushalA abhij~jA ityarthaH| buddhimanto hi, jIvakAdayo hi snigdhashItamadhuravRuShyAdiguNayuktAH santo jIvanaM kurvantIti bhUyodarshanAdavadhArya tadguNayukte~anyatrApi drAkShApayovidAryAdau tajjAtIyatvena jIvanAnItyanumimate, yathA jIvakAdInAmekajIvanakAryakartRutvena mahAkaShAyatvaM, tadvat pAThAsama~ggAprabhRutInAmapyatIsAraharANAmatIsAraharamahAkaShAyatvamityanumAnena kRutsnameva kaShAyaM pratipadyanta iti bhAvaH||20||

4.sanskrit: evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- naitAni bhagavan! pa~jca kaShAyashatAni pUryante, tAni tAni hyevA~ggAnyupaplavante teShu teShu mahAkaShAyeShviti||21|| tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- naitadevaM buddhimatA draShTavyamagnivesha| eko~api hyanekAM sa~jj~jAM labhate kAryAntarANi kurvan, tadyathA- puruSho bahUnAM karmaNAM karaNe samartho bhavati, sa yadyat karma karoti tasya tasya karmaNaH kartRu-karaNa-kAryasamprayuktaM tattadgauNaM nAmavisheShaM prApnoti, tadvadauShadhadravyamapi draShTavyam| yadi caikameva ki~jciddravyamAsAdayAmastathAguNayuktaM yat sarvakarmaNAM karaNe samarthaM syAt, kastato~anyadicchedupadhArayitumupadeShTuM vA shiShyebhya iti||22||
4.commentary: pUrvapakShamutthApayati- evamityAdi| tAni tAnIti jIvakakShIrakAkolIprabhRutIni, teShu teShu jIvanIyabRuMhaNIyashukrajananAdiShu, upaplavante punaH punastAnyeva paThyante; ekaM dravyamanekeShu paThyamAnamekameva, tatashca na sa~gkhyA pUryata iti pUrvapakShaH| siddhAntayati- naitadevamityAdi| ekasyAnekatvenAbhidhAne dRuShTAntamAha- yathetyAdi| ekaH puruShaH karmaNAM vyApArANAmodanapacanakumbhakaraNakhanitrakaraNabhUmikhananAnAM karaNe samartho bhavati, ya ityadhyAhAryaM, sa ityuktaguNaM puruShaM pratyavamRuShati; yadyat karmeti odanapAkAdi, yadyat karma karoti tasya tasya karmaNaH kartRusamprayuktaM ‘pAcaka’ iti, karaNasamprayuktaM ‘khAnitrika’ iti, kAryasamprayuktaM ‘kumbhakAra’ iti nAmavisheShaM; guNayogapravRuttaM gauNaM; guNayogashca ‘pAcaka’ ityatra pacikriyAyAM kartRutvaM, ‘khAnitrika’ ityatra khanitrakaraNakakhananaM prati kartRutvaM, kumbhakAra ityatra kumbhopahitaM kartRutvamityebhistribhirguNairabhinno bhinno~abhidhIyate vyavahriyate ceti bhAvaH| tadvat puruShavadauShadhadravyamapi; ekamapi sat kShIrakAkolIdravyaM jIvanabRuMhaNashukrajananalakShaNanAnAguNayogAnnAnAjIvanIyAdishabdenAbhidhIyate vyavahriyate cetyarthaH| atha kimarthaM punarekameva dravyaM bahujIvanIyAdiguNayogAttatra tatra paThyate, santi tAvadbahUni dravyANyekaikajIvanIyAdiguNAni svarUpato bhinnAni, tAnyeva pRuthakkasmAnna paThyanta ityAha- yadi caikamevetyAdi| yathA bahudravyANyekaikajIvanIyAdikAryakaraNasamarthAni bhavanti, tathaikameva dravyamanekajIvanIyAdikAryakaraNasamarthamasti, tatraikameva dravyaM bahukAryakartRu shiShyebhya upadeShTumupadhArayituM ca yujyate~alpaprayatnabodhyatvAdalpaprayatnadhAryatvAcca; na bahUnyekakAryaniyatAni, bahuprayAsopapAdyatvAdbahuprayAsabodhyatvAdbahuprayAsadhAryatvAcca ; kAryaM ca jIvanabRuMhaNAdyubhayorapi pakShayoravishiShTamiti vAkyArthaH| tathAguNayuktam anekajIvanIyAdikAryasamartham| tathAguNayuktatvameva vivRuNoti- yat sarvakarmaNAM jIvanIyAdInAM karaNe samarthaM syAt, tato bahukAryakArakAdekasmAt, anyadbahu pratiniyatakarmakArakaM, ka icchet? na ko~apIcchedityarthaH| upadhArayitum Avartanena smRutyArUDhaM kartum| kastata ityasyAdau ‘tadA’ ityadhyAhAryam||21-22||

4.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- yato yAvanti yairdravyairvirecanashatAni ShaT| uktAni sa~ggraheNeha tathaivaiShAM ShaDAshrayAH||23|| rasA lavaNavarjyAshca kaShAya iti sa~jj~jitAH| tasmAt pa~jcavidhA yoniH kaShAyANAmudAhRutA||24|| tathA kalpanamapyeShAmuktaM pa~jcavidhaM punaH| mahatAM ca kaShAyANAM pa~jcAshat parikIrtitA||25|| pa~jca cApi kaShAyANAM shatAnyuktAni bhAgashaH| lakShaNArthaM, pramANaM hi vistarasya na vidyate||26|| na cAlamatisa~gkShepaH sAmarthyAyopakalpate| alpabuddherayaM tasmAnnAtisa~gkShepavistaraH||27|| mandAnAM vyavahArAya, budhAnAM buddhivRuddhaye| pa~jcAshatko hyayaM vargaH kaShAyANAmudAhRutaH||28|| teShAM karmasu bAhyeShu yogamAbhyantareShu ca| saMyogaM ca prayogaM ca yo veda sa bhiShagvaraH||29||
4.commentary: adhyAyArthasa~ggrahamAha- yata ityAdi| yataH madanaphalAdeH| yAvanti trayastriMshadyogashatamityAdIni| yairdravyairvirecanashatAni ShaDiti yaireva madanaphalAdibhirmilitairuktAni virecanashatAni ShaDiti| lakShaNArthamityAdigrantho~anatisa~gkShepavistareNoktapa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyopapattisa~ggrAhakaH| alamiti samarthaH| alpabuddherayamityatrAyamitipadamatisa~gkShepa ityanena sambadhyate; yadyapi cehAtisa~gkShepo nAsti, tathA~api buddhisthirIkRutaH pratyavamRushyate| pa~jcAshatko hyayamityatrAyamiti padaM sughaTameva | bAhyeShu pralepAdiShu| AbhyantareShu vamanapAcanAdiShu| saMyogaM dravyANAmucitaM melana(ka)m| prayogaM kAlaprakRutyAdyapekShA yojanA||23-29||

4.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyo nAma caturtho~adhyAyaH||4|| iti bheShajacatuShkaH||1||
4.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne prathame bheShajacatuShke ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyashcaturtho~adhyAyaH||4||

5.sanskrit: athAto mAtrAshitIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
5.commentary: dvitayamiha shAstraprayojanaM yadAturavyAdhiharaNaM svasthasya svAsthyarakShaNaM ca; yadAha- svasthAturaparAyaNam (sU.a.1) iti; tenotpannavyAdhipratIkAradvArA~a~aturarakShaNaM bheShajacatuShkamabhidhAya svasthacatuShko~abhidhAtavyaH; tatrApi svAsthyaparipAlanahetuShu mAtrAvadannaM pradhAnaM; yadAha- prANinAM punarmUlamAhAro balavarNaujasAM ca (su.sU.a.1) iti; tacceha mAtrAvadannaM vidhIyata ityAdau mAtrAshitIya evAbhidhIyate| mAtrAshitamadhikRutya kRutyo~adhyAyo mAtrAshitIyaH| yadyapyadhyAyAdau ‘mAtrAshI’ iti padamanushrUyate, tathA~api ‘mAtrAshIyaH’ iti sa~jj~jApraNayane kaShToccAraNabhayAttadarthaparaparyAyashabdeneyaM sa~jj~jA kRutA; yathA “navegAndhAraNIya” (sU.a.7) ityAdikA sa~jj~jA||1-2||

5.sanskrit: mAtrAshI syAt| AhAramAtrA punaragnibalApekShiNI||3||
5.commentary: mAtrAM mAtrAvadannamashituM bhoktuM shIlaM yasyAsau mAtrAshI, yadi vA mAtrayA~ashituM bhoktuM shIlaM yasya sa tathA| tatreha mAtrA anapAyiparimANam| ashirayamihAvisheSheNa khAdyaprAshyalehyapeyAnAmabhyavahAre vartate| tena mAtrAshI syAdityuktaM khAdyaprAshyalehyapeyAnAM mAtrayA~abhyavaharaNaM noktamiti yaccocyate, tannirastaM bhavati| dRuShTashcAyamashiH khAdyAdyabhyavahAre; yathA- dashamUlaharItakyAM- “ekAbhayAM prAshya tatashca lehAcchuktiM nihanti shvayathuM pravRuddham” (ci.a.12); tathA- “kShIrAshI tat prayojayet” (ci.a.1) iti| itashcAvagantavyamashirayaM sarvAbhyavahAre vartate, yenaitadvivaraNaM sAmAnyenaiva kRutam- AhAramAtrA punariti, na punarashitamAtrA punariti| mAtrAM vyAkaroti- AhAretyAdi| agnerbalamutkRuShTaM madhyamalpaM vA~apekShyotkRuShTA madhyA~alpA vA mAtrA bhavatItyagnibalApekShiNI| punaHshabdo bheShajAdimAtrAM vyAyAmamAtrAM ca vyAvartayati; tena na sarvamAtrA~agnibalApekShiNI; yato bheShajamAtrA vyAdhyAturabalApekShiNI vaktavyA, vyAyAmasya tu doShakShayAgnivRuddhyAdyutpAdashramaklamAdyanutpAdApekShiNI, vyavasthApayitavyA| yadi vA punaHshabdaH paunaHpunye, tenAhAramAtrA punaH punaragnibalamapekShate| etaduktaM bhavati- yadekasmin puruShe ekadA yA~agnibalena vyavasthApitA mAtrA sA na sarvakAlaM bhavati, yata Rutubhedena vayobhedena ca tasyaivAgniH kadAcidvivRuddho bhavati, yathA- hemante yauvane ca, kadAcinmando bhavati, yathA- varShAsu vArdhakye ca; tenAgnibalabhedAnmAtrA~apyekarUpA na bhavati, kintu tatkAlabhavamagnibalamapekShya punaH punarmAtrA~api bhidyata iti||3||

5.sanskrit: yAvaddhyasyAshanamashitamanupahatya prakRutiM yathAkAlaM jarAM gacchati tAvadasya mAtrApramANaM veditavyaM bhavati||4||
5.commentary: agnibalApekShitvameva vivRuNoti- yAvaddhItyAdi| yAvaditi yAvatparimANam| hishabdo hetau| asyeti bhoktuH| ashanaM caturvidhamapi bhojyam| ashitaM bhuktam| prakRutiM vAtAdInAM rasAdInAM ca sAmyAvasthAm| anupahatya vikAramakRutvetyarthaH| yathAkAlamiti nishAsheShe| tAvaditi pUrvapramANAvacchinnamashanaM pratyavamRushati| dvitIyamasyeti grahaNamanyatra pratiShedhArtham| tena yasyaiva yAvatI mAtrA nirvikArA, tasyaiva sA mantavyA nAnyeShAM, pratipuruShamagnibalasya bhinnatvAt| yadyapi caikasminnapi puruShe kAlAdibhedenAgnibalabhedo bhavati, tathA~apyekapuruSha ekamAtrAmavadhArya kiyantamapi kAlaM tayaiva mAtrayA agnibalabhedahetvabhAve sati vyavahAro bhavatyeva| mAtrApramANaM mAtreyattA; mAtrApramANashabdena ceha mAtrApramANavaditi boddhavyam; anyathA, tAvacchabdenAvacchinnAshanavAcinA mAtrApramANashabdasya guNavAcinaH sAmAnAdhikaraNyaM na syAt| nanu, prakRutimanupahatyeti na kartavyaM visheShaNaM, na hyAhAro yo yathAkAlaM jarAM yAti sa mAtrAdoShAdvikAraM karoti, karoti tu dravyasvabhAvasaMskArAdidoShAt; yathA mandakalakucAdayo yathAkAlaM jarAM gacchanto~api doShajanakA bhavantyeva; na tAvatA~api tatra mAtrA duShyati, yathA vakShyati trividhakukShIye- “na ca kevalaM mAtrAvattvAdevAhArasya kRutsnamAhAraphalasauShThavamavAptuM shakyaM, prakRutyAdInAmaShTAnAmAhAravidhivisheShAyatanAnAM bhinnaphalatvAt” (vi.a.2) iti| naivaM, dvividhA hi mAtrA rasavimAne vaktavyA- sarvagraharUpA, parigraharUpA ca; tatra samuditasyAhArasya parimANaM sarvagrahaH, madhurAmlAdInAmAhArAvayavAnAM pratyekaM mAtrayA grahaNaM parigrahaH; tena yatrAhArasamudAyaparimANaM samucitameva gRuhyate, AhArAvayavAnAM tu madhurAdInAM svabhAvahitAnAmapyayathoktamAnaM syAt, tatrAhArAvayavamAtrAvaiShamyAddhAtuvaiShamyaM bhavatyeva, ayathAkAlaM jarAgamanaM ca syAt; taduktaM- prakRutimanupahatyeti visheShaNam| anye tu vyAkhyAnayanti- ‘asya’ iti, ‘ashanam’ iti, ashitam iti ca padatrayaM prakaraNAdeva labhyate; yat punaH kriyate tadvisheShapratipAdanArtham| tena, asyetyanena parIkShako bhoktA~adhikriyate, ashanamityanena ca prashastamashanaM prakRutikaraNasaMyogadeshakAlAviruddhamucyate, ashitamityanena ca yathAvidhibhojanamucyate; tadevaM sarvaguNasampanna AhAro mAtrAvAnucyate||4||

5.sanskrit: tatra shAliShaShTikamudgalAvakapi~jjalaiNashashasharabhashambarAdInyAhAradravyANi prakRutilaghUnyapi mAtrApekShINi bhavanti| tathA piShTekShukShIravikRutitilamAShAnUpaudakapishitAdInyAhAradravyANi prakRutigurUNyapi mAtrAmevApekShante||5||
5.commentary: mAtrAlakShaNamupadishya vyavahAropayoginaM dravyabhedena mAtrAbhedaM darshayati- tatra shAlItyAdi| tatra laghuvarga eva prathamaM paThyate, pathyatamatvAt; tatrApyAdau raktashAlirAhAradravyapradhAnatvAt| kapi~jjalo gauratittiriH, eNaH kRuShNasAraH, sharabho mahAshRu~ggI hariNaH, shambarastadvisheShaH| annapAnavidhau “shItaH snigdho~aguruH svAduH” (sU.a.27) iti ShaShTikaguNakathane “aguruH” ityakAraprashleSho draShTavyaH, teneha ShaShTikasya laghutvapratipAdanaM na virudhyate| api samuccaye, tena prakRutilaghUni karaNalaghUni ca lAjAdIni mAtrApekShINi bhavantIti labhyate| evaM prakRutigurUNyapItyatrApi saMskAragurushaktupiNDAdigrahaNaM vAcyam| Adishabdo~atra prakAravAcI, shAliShaShTikAdigaNAbhAvAt| vikRutishabdaH piShTekShukShIraiH sambadhyate, kShIravikRutiH kShIrakRutA bhakShyAH; pishitamAnUpaudakAbhyAM sambadhyate||5||

5.sanskrit: na caivamukte dravye gurulAghavamakAraNaM manyeta, laghUni hi dravyANi vAyvagniguNabahulAni bhavanti; pRuthvIsomaguNabahulAnItarANi, tasmAt svaguNAdapi laghUnyagnisandhukShaNasvabhAvAnyalpadoShANi cocyante~api sauhityopayuktAni, gurUNi punarnAgnisandhukShaNasvabhAvAnyasAmAnyAt, atashcAtimAtraM doShavanti sauhityopayuktAnyanyatra vyAyAmAgnibalAt; saiShA bhavatyagnibalApekShiNI mAtrA||6||
5.commentary: nanu, yadi laghu hitamapi svaguNakaraNe mAtrAmapekShate, guru cAhitamapi mAtrAparigRuhItaM hitameva syAt, tat kiM gauravalAghavopadeshenetyAsha~gkyAha- na caivamityAdi| laghUni yadyapyAkAshavAyvagniguNabahulAni bhavanti, tathA~apyAkAshasyAgnidIpanaM prati tathAvidhasAmarthyAbhAvAt vAyvagnyostvagnidIpakatvAd vAyvagniguNabahulAnItyuktam| tasmAt kAraNAllaghUni mAtrayA tAvadagniM dIpayanti; svaguNAdapi vAyvagniguNabAhulyAdagnisandhukShaNasvabhAvAni syuH| mAtrAvyatikrame samAne~api laghugurudravyayorlaghudravyasya visheShaM darshayati- alpadoShANi cocyante~api sauhityopayuktAni; sauhityaM mAtrAtikrameNa tRuptiH| gurUNItyAdau punaHshabdo vyAvRuttyarthaH| asAmAnyAditi virodhArthe na~j, asitamiti yathA; tenAsAmAnyAditi agniviruddhapRuthvItoyaguNabAhulyAdityarthaH| ‘anyasAmAnyAt’ itipAThapakShe~apyanyashabdo viruddhavacana eva, tena tathA~api sa evArthaH| atashcetyAdinA mAtrAvyatikrame gurau garIyAMsaM doShaM darshayati| nanu, dRushyante kecana bhArikAdayaH puruShA sauhityopayuktagurudravyAhAre~api nirdoShAH, tat kimucyate~atimAtraM doShavantItyAsha~gkyAha- anyatretyAdi| vyAyAmakRutamagnibalaM vyAyAmAgnibalam| yadyapi kAlAhitabalo~agnirmAtrA~adhikagurudravyakShamo bhavati, yaduktaM- “paktA bhavati hemante mAtrAdravyagurukShamaH” (sU.a.6) iti, tathA~api vyAyAmAhitabalo vahnirnitarAM balavAn bhavatItyayameva pradhAnaparigrahAduktaH| ye tu vyAyAmAditi cAgnibalAditi hetudvayaM varNayanti, teShAmevaM sati vyAyAmApekShiNyashanamAtrA syAditi prakaraNaviruddho~arthaH syAt| pratij~jAtamarthaM nyAyasampAditamupasaMharati- saiShetyAdi| seti agnibalApekShiNI pratij~jAtA mAtrA, eSheti nyAyenAgnyapekShitvena nirvAhitA||6||

5.sanskrit: na ca nApekShate dravyaM; dravyApekShayA ca tribhAgasauhityamardhasauhityaM vA gurUNAmupadishyate, laghUnAmapi ca nAtisauhityamagneryuktyartham||7||
5.commentary: nanu, yadyapyagnibalApekShiNI mAtrA, tat kasmAdekarUpa evAgnau laghUnAM dravyANAM bhUyasI mAtrA bhavati, gurUNAM tatastribhAgocitA ardhA vetyAha- na cetyAdi| dravyamapekShata ityarthaH| tribhAgasauhityaM manAggurubhiH| evaM gauravaprakarShApakarShAdanyadapi kalpanIyam| laghUnAmapi nAtisauhityamityatra sauhityashabdastRuptimAtre vartate, tena laghUni tRuptyatikrameNa na bhoktavyAni, evaM hi teShAM mAtrAtikramo na syAt | agneryuktiH svamAnAvasthitiH, tadartham| nanu, gurUNAM tAvadatimAtropayogo~agniparipAlanArthaM niShidhyatAM, yena gurUNyagnyasamAnAni; laghUni punaragnisamAnAni, tatteShAM kathamatimAtropayogo vahnimAndyamAvahatIti? brUmaH- laghUnAM dravyANAM sAmAnyamabhibhUyAtimAtratvamevAgnimAndyaM karoti, yathA- cakShustaijasaM, tejaHsahakRutaM ca pashyati, tadeva tejotiyogAdupahanyate; tathA shastramashmasambhavam, ashmayogAcca tIkShNaM sampadyate, ashmanyeva ca mithyAyogAt pratihataM bhavati; taduktaM shAlAkye- yattejo jyotiShAM dIptaM shArIraM prANinAM ca yat| saMyuktaM tejasA tejastaddhi rUpANi pashyati|| tadeva cakShustAnyeva jyotIMShyati tu pashyataH| vikAraM bhajate~atyarthamathavA~api vinashyati|| shastrasyAshmA yathA yonirnishitaM ca tadashmani| tIkShNaM bhavatyatiyogAttatraiva pratihanyate iti||7||

5.sanskrit: mAtrAvaddhyashanamashitamanupahatya prakRutiM balavarNasukhAyuShA yojayatyupayoktAramavashyamiti||8||
5.commentary: evaM tAvadvyutpAditA~agnibaladravyApekShiNI mAtrA, mAtrAnvitaM ca bhojyaM bhoktavyamityuktaM, mAtrAshitatve ko guNa ityAha- mAtrAvaddhItyAdi| ihAvashyamiti niyamo virodhikAraNAntarAbhAve sati boddhavyaH; yato yadyapi pUrvavadashanAshitopayoktRupadaiH prashastabhojanAdivAcibhiH prakRutikaraNAdiguNasampannamannaM labhyate, tathA~api kAlaviparyayapraj~jAparAdhAsAtmyashabdasparsharUparasagandhAH santyevAhArajanyabalAdivirodhakAH; yadAha- “santi hyRute~apyahitAhArAdanyA rogaprakRutayaH” (sU.a.28) iti; tena mAtrAparigRuhItAH shubhA api prakRutyAdayaH prAyo balAdihetavo bhavantIti mAtrAvadAhArastutyarthamavashyamiti kRutam| sukhayuktamAyuH sukhAyuH, yadi vA sukhaM cAyushceti mantavyaM; svarUpeNApi cAyurmRugyamiti prAk pratipAditameva||8||

5.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- guru piShTamayaM tasmAttaNDulAn pRuthukAnapi| na jAtu bhuktavAn khAdenmAtrAM khAdedbubhukShitaH||9||
5.commentary: bhavanti cAtreti| tantrakArasya samayo~ayaM- yat pUrvavyAkhyAtArthasa~ggrahArthaM yadA shlokena vaktumArabhate tadA ‘bhavati cAtra’ iti karoti| piShTamayaM piShTavikAraH| tasmAditi gurutvAt| pRuthukAH ‘cippiTA’ iti lokaprasiddhAH| na jAtu na kadAcit| mAtrAM khAdediti anapAyiparimANavantaM khAdet||9||

5.sanskrit: vallUraM shuShkashAkAni shAlUkAni bisAni ca| nAbhyasedgauravAnmAMsaM kRushaM naivopayojayet||10|| kUrcikAMshca kilATAMshca shaukaraM gavyamAhiShe| matsyAn dadhi ca mAShAMshca yavakAMshca na shIlayet||11||
5.commentary: vallUraM shuShkamAMsam| nAbhyasenna nirantaramupayu~jjyAt| anabhyAsahetumAha- gauravAditi| mAMsaM kRusham apuShTaM rogAduparatamRugAdisambhavamityarthaH | etaccApathyatvAdeva niShiddhaM, na gauravAditi bruvate| kUrcikaH kShIreNa samaM dadhi takraM vA pakvaM; kilATaH kUrcikapiNDaH, naShTakShIrasya ghano bhAga ityanye| shaukaramiti shUkaramAMsaM, shaukarasAhacaryAdgavyamAhiShe api mAMse eva boddhavye| yavakaH shUkadhAnyavisheShaH| vakShyati hi- “yavakaH shUkadhAnyAnAmapathyatamatve prakRuShTatamo bhavati” (sU.a.25) iti||10-11||

5.sanskrit: ShaShTikA~jchAlimudgAMshca saindhavAmalake yavAn| AntarIkShaM payaH sarpirjA~ggalaM madhu cAbhyaset||12||
5.commentary: abhyasyAn darshayati- ShaShTikAnityAdi| iha ShaShTika Adau paThyate raktashAlimanu pradhAnatvakhyApanArtham| AntarIkShamiti AntarIkShaM pAnIyam| payaH kShIram| jA~ggalamiti jA~ggaladeshabhavaM mRugAdimAMsam| iha saindhavAbhyAso~annasaMskAratvena mAtrayA~abhipretaH; tena, “trINi dravyANi nAtyupayu~jjIta pippalyo lavaNaM kShAraH” (vi.a.1) iti yadvakShyati tena samaM virodho na bhavati, tatra lavaNAtiyogasya pratiShiddhatvAt||12||

5.sanskrit: tacca nityaM prayu~jjIta svAsthyaM yenAnuvartate| ajAtAnAM vikArANAmanutpattikaraM ca yat||13||
5.commentary: mAtrAshItyAdinA svAsthyaparipAlanopAya ucyate, atibahu ca svasthaparipAlanaM tantre vaktavyaM, taccehAbhidhIyamAnaM granthagauravamAvahati, anabhidhIyamAnaM ca granthasya nyUnatAmApAdayati; atastatsUtramAtreNoddeShTumAha- taccetyAdi| suShThu nirvikAratvenAvatiShThata iti svasthaH, tasya bhAvaH svAsthyam; udvejakadhAtuvaiShamya virahitadhAtusAmyamityarthaH| tacca svAsthyamubhayathA paripAlyate vishuddhAhArAcArAbhyAM sadA kShIyamANasharIrapoShaNena, pratyavAyahetuparihAreNa ca; yathA- dIpaparipAlanaM snehavartidAnAt poShaNena kriyate, tathA shalabhavAtAdinirvApakahetuparihAreNa ca| sharIrapratyavAyahetushca dvividhaH- buddhidoShAdviShamasharIranyAsAdirvAtAdikArakaH, duShpariharashca kAlavisheShaH svabhAvAdiha hemantAdiH kaphacayAdikArakaH| tatra shlokapUrvArdhena svAsthyapoShakahetumAha, uttarArdhena tu ajAtAnAmityAdinA svAsthyavighAtakahetuparihAramAha| yadyapi cAjAtAnAM vikArANAmanutpattiH svabhAvasiddhA vidyata eva, vidyamAne ca karotyartho mukhyo nAsti, tathA~apIdamevAjAtavikArANAmanutpattikaraNaM yattadvikArahetupariharaNaM tathA duShpariharakAlavisheShajanitadoShaharaNaM , yathA vakShyati- “mAdhavaprathame mAsi nabhasyaprathame punaH| sahasyaprathame caiva vAhayeddoShasa~jcayam ” (sU.a.7) iti; tathA hetvantaranirapekShotpadyamAnacakShuHshleShmaharaNArthama~jjanam; evamAdi||13||

5.sanskrit: ata UrdhvaM sharIrasya kAryamakShya~jjanAdikam| svasthavRuttimabhipretya guNataH sampravakShyate||14||
5.commentary: ata UrdhvamityAdi| ataH svAsthyAnuvRuttikAraNakathanAdUrdhvaM, kAryam avashyakAryaM, svasthavRuttimabhipretya svasthavRuttAnuShThAne, akShya~jjanAdyavashyaM kAryamityarthaH; a~jjanashabdo~abhya~jjane~api vartate, tadarthamakShya~jjanamityuktam| a~jjanamevAdAvupAhitaM pradhAnAvayavacakShuHparipAlakatvAt| uktaM ca- “cakShuH pradhAnaM sarveShAmindriyANAM vidurbudhAH| ghananIhArayuktAnAM jyotiShAmiva bhAskaraH” iti| yadi vA svasthavRuttamadhikRutya yada~jjanAdi, taducyate; rogeShu tu yada~jjanAdi, tadrogacikitsAsu vaktavyam| yadyapi caitada~jjanAdi rogaharamapi vaktavyaM, tathA~api prAyaH svasthavRuttamatametaditi svasthavRuttamabhipretyetyuktam||14||

5.sanskrit: sauvIrama~jjanaM nityaM hitamakShNoH prayojayet| pa~jcarAtre~aShTarAtre vA srAvaNArthe rasA~jjanam||15||
5.commentary: sauvIramityAdi| suvIrAnadIbhavaM sauvIram| nityaM pratyaham| akShNoriti dvivacanamakShigolakadvaye~apya~jjanavidhAnArtham| pa~jcarAtrAShTarAtragrahaNamadUrAntarakAle niyamadarshanArtham| tena doShakAlamapekShyArvA~gmadhye UrdhvaM ca kartavyaM srAvaNama~jjanamiti bhavati||15||

5.sanskrit: cakShustejomayaM tasya visheShAcchleShmato bhayam| tataH shleShmaharaM karma hitaM dRuShTeH prasAdanam||16|| divA tanna prayoktavyaM netrayostIkShNama~jjanam| virekadurbalA dRuShTirAdityaM prApya sIdati||17|| tasmAt srAvyaM nishAyAM tu dhruvama~jjanamiShyate|18|
5.commentary: srAvaNA~jjanaprakaraNopapattimAha- cakShurityAdi| cakShurindriyasya taijasasya shleShmata ApyAttaijasaviruddhatvena hetunA, visheShAditi vAtApittabhayAdadhikatvena bhayaM bhavati| shleShmajaye ca srAvaNaM pradhAnaM, tasmAt srAvyamityarthaH| srAvaNA~jjanakAlaM niyamayati- nishAyAmityAdi| dhruvamavashyaM nishAyAmeva, a~jjanaM pratyAsannatvAt srAvaNA~jjanam| jatUkarNenApi srAvaNarasA~jjanaM nishAyAmeva vihitaM; yaduktaM- “saptAhAdrasA~jjanaM naktam” iti| shAlAkye~apyuktaM- “virekadurbalA dRuShTirAdityaM prApya sIdati | rAtrau svapnaguNAccAkShi puShyatya~jjanakarShi(rshi)tam” iti| sauvIrA~jjanaM tu virecanaM na bhavati, cakShuHprasAdamAtraM karoti, tena taddivAkriyamANaM na virodhi| anye tu vyAkhyAnayanti- dhruvaM nityakartavyaM sauvIrA~jjanaM yattannishi kartavyaM, srAvaNA~jjanaM tu shleShmodrekaviShaye(yi) vamanavat pUrvAhNa eva kartavyam||16-17||-

5.sanskrit: yathA hi kanakAdInAM malinAM vividhAtmanAm||18|| dhautAnAM nirmalA shuddhistailacelakacAdibhiH| evaM netreShu martyAnAma~jjanAshcyotanAdibhiH||19|| dRuShTirnirAkulA bhAti nirmale nabhasInduvat|20|
5.commentary: a~jjanaguNamAha- yathA hItyAdi| shuddhiH svAbhAvikI; sA~a~agantudhUlyAdyapanayanena nirmalA sati bhAti| AshcyotanaM netravirekArthaM dravauShadhadAnaM, taccehAnabhihitamapi phalaikyAdabhihitam, Adishabdena puTapAkAdInAM grahaNam||18-19||-

5.sanskrit: hareNukAM priya~gguM ca pRuthvIkAM kesharaM nakham||20|| hrIveraM candanaM patraM tvageloshIrapadmakam| dhyAmakaM madhukaM mAMsI guggulvagurusharkaram||21|| nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthaplakShalodhratvacaH shubhAH| vanyaM sarjarasaM mustaM shaileyaM kamalotpale||22|| shrIveShTakaM shallakIM ca shukabarhamathApi ca| piShTvA limpecchareShIkAM tAM vartiM yavasannibhAm||23|| a~gguShThasammitAM kuryAdaShTA~ggulasamAM bhiShak| shuShkAM nigarbhAM tAM vartiM dhUmanetrArpitAM naraH||24|| snehAktAmagnisampluShTAM pibet prAyogikIM sukhAm|25|
5.commentary: ihaivA~jjanAnte dhUmapAnaM vidhAsyati- “nAvanA~jjananidrAnte” ityAdinA; ato~a~jjanAnantaraM dhUmo~abhidhIyate; uktaM ca shAlAkye- “tIkShNA~jjanenA~jjitalocanasya yaH sampraduShTo na nireti netrAt| shleShmA shiraHsthaH sa tu pItamAtre dhUme prashAntiM labhate kShaNena” iti| hareNukAmityAdi| hareNukA reNukA| pRuthvIkA kRuShNajIrakam| kesharaM nAgakesharam| padmakaM padmakAShTham| dhyAmakaM gandhatRuNam| nyagrodhAdInAM plakShAntAnAM tvacaH, tAsAM visheShaNaM shubhA iti| vanyaM kaivartamustakam| shukabarhaM granthiparNakam| shareShIkA sharapuShpasya nAlI ‘sharikA’ iti prasiddhA| atra vidhAnaM- piShTairbheShajaiH sharikA tathA veShTayitavyA yathA aShTA~ggulAyatA a~gguShThapariNAhA ca vartiH syAt, tasyAM ca shuShkAyAM satyAM shareShIkAmAkRuShya snehenAbhyajyAgninaikasminnagre~avadahya vakShyamANadhUmapAnanalikAyAmagrarandhre niveshyAto dhUmaH peyaH | prAyogikI ca nityapeyadhUmavartisa~jj~jA| sukhAmityanenAkaTukatvamanatyayatvaM ca darshayati||20-24||-

5.sanskrit: vasAghRutamadhUcchiShTairyuktiyuktairvarauShadhaiH||25|| vartiM madhurakaiH kRutvA snaihikIM dhUmamAcaret|26|
5.commentary: snaihikadhUmavartimAha- vasetyAdi| madhUcchiShTaM sikthakam| varauShadhairiti madhurakavisheShaNaM; madhurakANi jIvanIyAni jIvakarShabhakAdIni| yuktiyuktairityanena tathA vasAdigrahaNaM kartavyaM, yathA vartiH kartuM pAryata iti darshayati| vartikaraNaM ca pUrvavat| snaihikI snehanakArikA||25||-

5.sanskrit: shvetA jyotiShmatI caiva haritAlaM manaHshilA||26|| gandhAshcAgurupatrAdyA dhUmaM mUrdhavirecane |27|
5.commentary: vairecanikadhUmapAnavartiM darshayati- shvetetyAdi| shvetA aparAjitA| gandhAH sugandhadravyANi, teShAM visheShaNamagurupatrAdyAH, aguru ca patrAdyAshca agurupatrAdyAH; agurupatrAdyAshca jvare vakShyamANaH “agurukuShThatagarapatra” (ci.a.3) ityAdigaNo mantavyaH| agurvAdyA iti na kRutaM, kuShThatagarayoratitIkShNatvena mastulu~ggakasrAvabhayAt parihArArtham| vakShyati ca trimarmIye- “dhUmavartiM pibedgandhairakuShThatagaraistathA” (si.a.9) iti, shAlAkye~apyuktaM- “natakuShThe srAvayato dhUmavartiprayojite| mastulu~ggaM visheSheNa tasmAtte naiva yojayet” iti; sushrute~apyuktaM- “elAdinA tagarakuShThavarjyena” (sU.ci.a.40) iti||26||-

5.sanskrit: gauravaM shirasaH shUlaM pInasArdhAvabhedakau||27|| karNAkShishUlaM kAsashca hikkAshvAsau galagrahaH| dantadaurbalyamAsrAvaH shrotraghrANAkShidoShajaH||28|| pUtirghrANAsyagandhashca dantashUlamarocakaH| hanumanyAgrahaH kaNDUH krimayaH pANDutA mukhe||29|| shleShmapraseko vaisvaryaM galashuNDyupajihvikA| khAlityaM pi~jjaratvaM ca keshAnAM patanaM tathA||30|| kShavathushcAtitandrA ca buddhermoho~atinidratA| dhUmapAnAt prashAmyanti balaM bhavati cAdhikam||31|| shiroruhakapAlAnAmindriyANAM svarasya ca| na ca vAtakaphAtmAno balino~apyUrdhvajatrujAH||32|| dhUmavaktrakapAnasya vyAdhayaH syuH shirogatAH|33|
5.commentary: dhUmapAnaguNAn darshayati- gauravamityAdi| shiroruhAH keshAH; kapAlAshca shirasa eva| balino~apIti balavatkAraNA apItyarthaH| Urdhvajatrujatvenaiva shirogatA api labdhAste punarabhidhIyante visheShavidhAnArtham||27-32||-

5.sanskrit: prayogapAne tasyAShTau kAlAH samparikIrtitAH||33|| vAtashleShmasamutkleshaH kAleShveShu hi lakShyate| snAtvA bhuktvA samullikhya kShutvA dantAnnighRuShya ca| nAvanA~jjananidrAnte cAtmavAn dhUmapo bhavet| tathA vAtakaphAtmAno na bhavantyUrdhvajatrujAH||35|| rogAstasya tu peyAH syurApAnAstristrayastrayaH|36|
5.commentary: dhUmapAnakAlaM darshayati- prayogetyAdi| prayogapAne prAyogikadhUmapAne ete~aShTau kAlAH, snaihikapAne tu vAtavRuddhyupalakShitaH kAlaH, vairecanikapAne tu shleShmavRuddhyupalakShito mantavyaH| prAyogika eva prAyaH svasthavRuttAdhikAre, tena tatkAla eva kaNTharaveNAbhidhIyate; yadi vA prayogapAne satatapAne svasthAdhikAra iti yAvat; tena dhUmatrayasyApyete kAlA bhavanti| vAtakaphAtmashabdena vAtAtmAnaH kaphAtmAno vAtakaphAtmAnashca gRuhyante| peyAH syurityAdAvApAnA dhUmAbhyavahAramokShAH; ekaikasmin snAnAdidhUmapAnakAle tririti AvRuttitrayaM kartavyAH; te cAvRuttitraye~api tridhA tridhA kartavyAH; ekaikasmin dhUmapAnakAle nava dhUmAbhyavahAramokShAH kartavyAH; trIMstrInabhyavahArAn kRutvA vishrAmo~antarA kartavya ityarthaH||33-35||-

5.sanskrit: paraM dvikAlapAyI syAdahnaH kAleShu buddhimAn||36|| prayoge, snaihike tvekaM, vairecyaM tricatuH pibet| hRutkaNThendriyasaMshuddhirlaghutvaM shirasaH shamaH||37|| yatheritAnAM doShANAM samyakpItasya lakShaNam|38|
5.commentary: aShTasu kAleShvekasminnekasmin divase yasmin dhUme yAvAn yAvAn pAnakAlaniyamastaM darshayati- paramityAdi| kAleShu snAtvetyAdikAleShu| prayoge prAyogikadhUme| snaihike tvekamiti snaihikadhUme ekameva kAlaM vyApya dhUmaM pibediti yojyam| tricaturiti vairecye doShabalApekSho vikalpaH||36-37||-

5.sanskrit: bAdhiryamAndhyamUkatvaM raktapittaM shirobhramam||38|| akAle cAtipItashca dhUmaH kuryAdupadravAn| tatreShTaM sarpiShaH pAnaM nAvanA~jjanatarpaNam||39|| snaihikaM dhUmaje doShe vAyuH pittAnugo yadi| shItaM tu raktapitte syAcchleShmapitte virUkShaNam||40||
5.commentary: bAdhiryetyAdi| dhUmaja ityavidhiprayuktadhUmakRute yadi vAyuH pittAnugo vRuddhastadA nAvanA~jjanatarpaNaM snaihikaM snehakRutaM kartavyaM, shItaM shItadravyakRutaM kartavyaM nAvanAdyeva, virUkShaNamapi nAvanAdyeva||38-40||

5.sanskrit: paraM tvataH pravakShyAmi dhUmo yeShAM vigarhitaH| na viriktaH pibeddhUmaM na kRute bastikarmaNi||41|| na raktI na viSheNArto na shocanna ca garbhiNI| na shrame na made nAme na pitte na prajAgare||42|| na mUrcchAbhramatRuShNAsu na kShINe nApi ca kShate| na madyadugdhe pItvA ca na snehaM na ca mAkShikam||43|| dhUmaM na bhuktvA dadhnA ca na rUkShaH kruddha eva ca| na tAlushoShe timire shirasyabhihite na ca||44|| na sha~gkhake na rohiNyAM na mehe na madAtyaye| eShu dhUmamakAleShu mohAt pibati yo naraH||45|| rogAstasya pravardhante dAruNA dhUmavibhramAt|46|
5.commentary: na virikta ityAdau pratiniShedhyaM nakArakaraNaM niShedhagauravadarshanArtham| dhUmaM na bhuktveti punardhUmagrahaNaM dadhnA bhuktavato visheShapratiShedhArtham||41-45||-

5.sanskrit: dhUmayogyaH pibeddoShe shiroghrANAkShisaMshraye||46|| ghrANenAsyena kaNThasthe mukhena ghrANapo vamet| Asyena dhUmakavalAn piban ghrANena nodvamet||47|| pratilomaM gato hyAshu dhUmo hiMsyAddhi cakShuShI|48|
5.commentary: dhUmayogya ityAdau ghrANeneti chedaH| pratilomaM gata AsyapIto ghrANaM gata ityarthaH| hishabdadvayaM ca hetau| tenAyamarthaH- yasmAt pratilomaM vimArgaM gato dhUmastasmAccakShuShI hiMsyAt, yasmAddhiMsyAt tasmAd ghrANena nodvamediti||46-47||-

5.sanskrit: Rujva~ggacakShustaccetAH sUpaviShTastriparyayam||48|| pibecchidraM pidhAyaikaM nAsayA dhUmamAtmavAn|49|
5.commentary: samyagupaviShTaH sUpaviShTaH| triparyayamiti tu yadyapi pUrvamevoktam ‘ApAnAstristrayastrayaH’ ityanena, tathA~api triparyayadhUmapAnaparyantamRujva~ggacakShurAdi kartavyaM nopakramamAtra eveti punarabhidhAnena darshayati| nAsikayA~api randhraikacchidraM pidhAya pibenna punarnAsikayaiva pibediti niyamaH||48||-

5.sanskrit: caturviMshatikaM netraM svA~ggulIbhirvirecane||49|| dvAtriMshada~ggulaM snehe prayoge~adhyardhamiShyate| Ruju trikoShAphalitaM kolAsthyagrapramANitam||50|| bastinetrasamadravyaM dhUmanetraM prashasyate|51|
5.commentary: netraM nalikA| caturviMshatikaM caturviMshatya~ggulam| adhyardhaM sArdhamityarthaH; iha vairecanikanetrameva caturviMshatya~ggulapramANaM sArdhaM sat ShaTtriMshada~ggulapramANaM prAyogikadhUmapAne; tattu jatUkarNapratyayAdboddhavyam| yadAha- “sArdhastryaMshayutaH pUrNo hastaH prAyogikAdiShu” iti| trikoShAphalitamiti tribhiH parvabhirbhinnaiH samanvitam||49-50||-

5.sanskrit: dUrAdvinirgataH parvacchinno nADItanUkRutaH||51|| nendriyaM bAdhate dhUmo mAtrAkAlaniShevitaH|52|
5.commentary: yathAbhihitanalikayA pAne guNaM darshayati- dUrAdityAdi||51||-

5.sanskrit: yadA corashca kaNThashca shirashca laghutAM vrajet||52|| kaphashca tanutAM prAptaH supItaM dhUmamAdishet| avishuddhaH svaro yasya kaNThashca sakapho bhavet||53|| stimito mastakashcaivamapItaM dhUmamAdishet| tAlu mUrdhA ca kaNThashca shuShyate paritapyate||54|| tRuShyate muhyate jantU raktaM ca sravate~adhikam| shirashca bhramate~atyarthaM mUrcchA cAsyopajAyate||55|| indriyANyupatapyante dhUme~atyarthaM niShevite|56|
5.commentary: keciddhUmasamyakpAnAdilakShaNaM granthaM paThanti| tatra, yadA corashcetyAdi samyagdhUmapAnalakShaNam, avishuddha ityAdyayogalakShaNaM, tAlvityAdyatiyogalakShaNam||52-55||-

5.sanskrit: varShe varShe~aNutailaM ca kAleShu triShu nA caret||56|| prAvRuTsharadvasanteShu gatameghe nabhastale| nasyakarma yathAkAlaM yo yathoktaM niShevate||57|| na tasya cakShurna ghrANaM na shrotramupahanyate| na syuH shvetA na kapilAH keshAH shmashrUNi vA punaH||58|| na ca keshAH pramucyante vardhante ca visheShataH| manyAstambhaH shiraHshUlamarditaM hanusa~ggrahaH||59|| pInasArdhAvabhedau ca shiraHkampashca shAmyati| sirAH shiraHkapAlAnAM sandhayaH snAyukaNDarAH||60|| nAvanaprINitAshcAsya labhante~abhyadhikaM balam| mukhaM prasannopacitaM svaraH snigdhaH sthiro mahAn||61|| sarvendriyANAM vaimalyaM balaM bhavati cAdhikam| na cAsya rogAH sahasA prabhavantyUrdhvajatrujAH||62|| jIryatashcottamA~ggeShu jarA na labhate balam|63|
5.commentary: dhUmanasyayornAsAdvArasAmAnyAddhUmamanu nasyaM brUte- varSha ityAdi| aNUnAM srotasAM hitamityaNutailaM, taccAgre vakShyamANam| shiraHkapAlAnAmeva sirAH sandhayaH snAyukaNDarAshca| uttamA~ggeShviti bahuvacanaM shiraso~abhyarhitatvAt; yadi vA jarA valIpalitAdilakShaNA yA sA uttamA prakarShaprAptA~a~ggeShu mastakAdiShu niShidhyate||56-62||-

5.sanskrit: candanAguruNI patraM dArvItva~gmadhukaM balAm||63|| prapauNDarIkaM sUkShmailAM viDa~ggaM bilvamutpalam| hrIberamabhayaM vanyaM tva~gmustaM sArivAM sthirAm||64|| jIvantIM pRushniparNIM ca suradAru shatAvarIm| hareNuM bRuhatIM vyAghrIM surabhIM padmakesharam||65|| vipAcayecchataguNe mAhendre vimale~ambhasi| tailAddashaguNaM sheShaM kaShAyamavatArayet||66|| tena tailaM kaShAyeNa dashakRutvo vipAcayet| athAsya dashame pAke samAMshaM chAgalaM payaH||67|| dadyAdeSho~aNutailasya nAvanIyasya saMvidhiH| asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta tailasyArdhapalonmitAm||68|| snigdhasvinnottamA~ggasya picunA nAvanaistribhiH| tryahAttryahAcca saptAhametat karma samAcaret||69|| nivAtoShNasamAcArI hitAshI niyatendriyaH| tailametattridoShaghnamindriyANAM balapradam||70|| prayu~jjAno yathAkAlaM yathoktAnashnute guNAn|71|
5.commentary: candanetyAdau dArvyAstvak dArvItvak, jIvantI suvarNanAlA svanAmaprasiddhA, surabhI shUkashimbA, padmasya kesharaM padmakesharam| mAhendre AntarikShe| shataguNe tailAditi yojyam| dashaguNamityetadapi tailAditi yojanIyam| atra tu kvAthyabheShajaM tAvanmAnaM grAhyaM yAvatA kvAthArthopAttaM pAnIyaM bheShajacaturguNaM bhavati, “kvAthyAccaturguNaM vAri” ityasyAbAdhitatvAt, na tu bheShajAcchataguNe~ambhasItyevaM vyAkhyeyaM; yadAha jatUkarNaH- “paktvA~athAmbushataprasthe dashabhAgasthitena tu| tailaprasthaM pacettena chAgIkShIreNa saMyutam” iti| yadi vA, tailapramANAnumAnenaiva “snehAccaturguNaM kvAthyaM” iti paribhAShayA kvAthyadravyaparimANaM vyavasthApanIyam| picuneti tUlakapiNDikayA| nAvanaistribhiH vAratrayeNetyarthaH| tryahAttryahAditi ekaikaM dinamantarIkRutya, saptAhamiti antaritadinAni varjayitvA; tenaikaikasmin Rutau trayodashAhAnnasyaprayogaH samApyate||63-70||-

5.sanskrit: ApothitAgraM dvau kAlau kaShAyakaTutiktakam||71|| bhakShayeddantapavanaM dantamAMsAnyabAdhayan| nihanti gandhaM vairasyaM jihvAdantAsyajaM malam||72|| niShkRuShya rucimAdhatte sadyo dantavishodhanam| kara~jjakaravIrArkamAlatIkakubhAsanAH||73|| shasyante dantapavane ye cApyevaMvidhA drumAH| suvarNarUpyatAmrANi trapurItimayAni ca||74|| jihvAnirlekhanAni syuratIkShNAnyanRujUni ca| jihvAmUlagataM yacca malamucchvAsarodhi ca||75|| daurgandhyaM bhajate tena tasmAjjihvAM vinirlikhet|76|
5.commentary: sthAnapratyAsattyA dantakAShThaguNAn darshayati- ApothitetyAdi| dvikAlaM sAyaM prAtariti| dantAn punAtIti dantapavanaM dantakAShTham| niShkRuShya malamiti sambandhaH| kakubhaH arjunaH| evaMvidhA evaMrasA ityarthaH||71-75||-

5.sanskrit: dhAryANyAsyena vaishadyarucisaugandhyamicchatA||76|| jAtIkaTukapUgAnAM lava~ggasya phalAni ca| kakkolasya phalaM patraM tAmbUlasya shubhaM tathA| tathA karpUraniryAsaH sUkShmailAyAH phalAni ca||77||
5.commentary: kaTukaM latAkastUrI| yadyapi lava~ggasya vRuntamabhipretaM tathA~api bahUnAM phalasya grAhyatvAcchatriNo gacchantIti nyAyena sAmAnyena phalamityuktam||76-77||

5.sanskrit: hanvorbalaM svarabalaM vadanopacayaH paraH| syAt paraM ca rasaj~jAnamanne ca ruciruttamA||78|| na cAsya kaNThashoShaH syAnnauShThayoH sphuTanAdbhayam| na ca dantAH kShayaM yAnti dRuDhamUlA bhavanti ca||79|| na shUlyante na cAmlena hRuShyante bhakShayanti ca| parAnapi kharAn bhakShyAMstailagaNDUShadhAraNAt||80|| nityaM snehArdrashirasaH shiraHshUlaM na jAyate| na khAlityaM na pAlityaM na keshAH prapatanti ca||81|| balaM shiraHkapAlAnAM visheSheNAbhivardhate| dRuDhamUlAshca dIrghAshca kRuShNAH keshA bhavanti ca||82|| indriyANi prasIdanti sutvagbhavati cAnanam | nidrAlAbhaH sukhaM ca syAnmUrdhni tailaniShevaNAt||83|| na karNarogA vAtotthA na manyAhanusa~ggrahaH| noccaiH shrutirna bAdhiryaM syAnnityaM karNatarpaNAt||84|| snehAbhya~ggAdyathA kumbhashcarma snehavimardanAt| bhavatyupA~ggAdakShashca dRuDhaH kleshasaho yathA||85|| tathA sharIramabhya~ggAddRuDhaM sutvak ca jAyate| prashAntamArutAbAdhaM kleshavyAyAmasaMsaham||86|| sparshane~abhyadhiko vAyuH sparshanaM ca tvagAshritam| tvacyashca paramabhya~ggastasmAttaM shIlayennaraH||87|| na cAbhighAtAbhihataM gAtramabhya~ggasevinaH| vikAraM bhajate~atyarthaM balakarmaNi vA kvacit||88|| susparshopacitA~ggashca balavAn priyadarshanaH| bhavatyabhya~gganityatvAnnaro~alpajara eva ca||89||
5.commentary: hanvorityAdi snehagaNDUShaguNAH| nityamityAdi niShevaNAdityantaM shirastailaguNAH| mUrdhni tailaniShevaNAdityukte~api snehArdrashirasa iti yat karoti, tena yAvatA tailenArdrashirAH syAttAvanmUrdhni tailaM sevyamiti darshayati| snehAbhya~ggAdityAdi| upA~ggasnehadAnAt, akSho rathasya cakranibandhanakAShTham| bahudRuShTAntakaraNaM tu kasyacit ki~jcit prasiddhaM bhaviShyati na hi sarvaM sarvatra prasiddhamityabhiprAyeNa; yadi vA snehasya nAnAkAryakaraNashaktyupadarshanArtham| sparshane sparshanendriye vAyuradhikaH; vaidyakadarshane pA~jcabhautikatvAdindriyasyetyarthaH| tvacyashca paramabhya~gga iti cakArAdvAtahitashca, etenAshritasya vAtAdhikasya sparshanendriyasya, Ashrayasya ca tvaco hita ityuktaM bhavati| balena sampAdyaM karma balakarma gurubhAraharaNAdi||78-89||

5.sanskrit: kharatvaM stabdhatA raukShyaM shramaH suptishca pAdayoH| sadya evopashAmyanti pAdAbhya~gganiShevaNAt||90|| jAyate saukumAryaM ca balaM sthairyaM ca pAdayoH| dRuShTiH prasAdaM labhate mArutashcopashAmyati||91|| na ca syAdgRudhrasIvAtaH pAdayoH sphuTanaM na ca| na sirAsnAyusa~gkocaH pAdAbhya~ggena pAdayoH||92||
5.commentary: kharatvamityAdi pAdAbhya~ggaguNAH| prathamaM pAdayoriti padaM kharatvAdivisheShaNArthaM, dvitIyaM tu balAdeH kAlAntarotpAdasUcanArthaM, tRutIyaM tu sphuTanavisheShaNArthaM, caturthaM tu sirAsnAyuvisheShaNArthaM, shiShTaM tu pAdAbhya~ggeneti padaM dUrAntaritasya pAdAbhya~ggasya smaraNArtham||90-92||

5.sanskrit: daurgandhyaM gauravaM tandrAM kaNDUM malamarocakam| svedabIbhatsatAM hanti sharIraparimArjanam||93|| pavitraM vRuShyamAyuShyaM shramasvedamalApaham | sharIrabalasandhAnaM snAnamojaskaraM param||94||
5.commentary: abhya~ggapUrvakatvAdudvartanasya tamanu parimArjanamudvartanaM brUte- daurgandhyamityAdi| svedena bIbhatsatA svedabIbhatsatA| sharIrasya balena sandhAnaM yojanaM karotItyarthaH||93-94||
