8.sanskrit: nAtisamayaM jahyAt, na niyamaM bhindyAt, na naktaM nAdeshe caret, na sandhyAsvabhyavahArAdhyayanastrIsvapnasevI syAt, na bAlavRuddhalubdhamUrkhakliShTaklIbaiH saha sakhyaM kuryAt, na madyadyUtaveshyAprasa~ggaruciH syAt, na guhyaM vivRuNuyAt, na ka~jcidavajAnIyAt, nAhammAnI syAnnAdakSho nAdakShiNo nAsUyakaH, na brAhmaNAn parivadet, na gavAM daNDamudyacchet, na vRuddhAnna gurUnna gaNAnna nRupAn vA~adhikShipet, na cAtibrUyAt, na bAndhavAnuraktakRucchradvitIyaguhyaj~jAn bahiShkuryAt||25||
8.commentary: atisamayo militvA bahubhiH kRuto niyamaH| na sandhyAsvityAdau punaH strIniShedhaH sandhyAsu yAvadakartavyasya nyUnatAparihArArthamuktaH, pUrvaM tu strI yathA na sevyA tannikhilenopadishatA na sandhyayorityuktam, iti prakaraNabhedAnna paunaruktyam| klIbo hInasattvaH| kliShTo nindito rogAdinA| gaNAn militAn| kRucchradvitIya Apadi sahAyaH| bahiShkuryAt avajAnIyAt||25||

8.sanskrit: nAdhIro nAtyucchritasattvaH syAt, nAbhRutabhRutyaH, nAvishrabdhasvajanaH, naikaH sukhI, na duHkhashIlAcAropacAraH, na sarvavishrambhI, na sarvAbhisha~gkI, na sarvakAlavicArI||26||
8.commentary: naikaH sukhI syAditi na sukhahetUnyAmraphalAdInyeka evAvibhajyopayu~jjyAdityarthaH| shIlaM svAbhAvikaM vRuttam, AcAraH shAstropadeshAnurUpo vyavahAraH, upacAraH paricchadaH, eteShAM ca duHkhatvaM duHkhahetutvAt| sarvavishrambhI sarveShu vishvAsI||26||

8.sanskrit: na kAryakAlamatipAtayet, nAparIkShitamabhinivishet, nendriyavashagaH syAt, na ca~jcalaM mano~anubhrAmayet, na buddhIndriyANAmatibhAramAdadhyAt, na cAtidIrghasUtrI syAt, na krodhaharShAvanuvidadhyAt, na shokamanuvaset, na siddhAvutsekaM yacchennAsiddhau dainyaM, prakRutimabhIkShNaM smaret, hetuprabhAvanishcitaH syAddhetvArambhanityashca, na kRutamityAshvaset, na vIryaM jahyAt, nApavAdamanusmaret||27||
8.commentary: ca~jcalamiti kriyAvisheShaNaM, yadi vA manovisheShaNam| buddherindriyANAM buddhIndriyANAm| atidIrghasUtrI shataikavinipAtAsha~gkI, kiMvA dIrghasUtrI cirakriyaH| na shokamanuvasediti na ciraM shokavashagaH syAt| utsekam atigarvam | prakRutim utpattikAraNaM smaret; prakRutiM pa~jcabhUtasamudAyalakShaNAmanityAM smaranna rAgadveShAdibhirabhibhUyate| hetuprabhAvanishcita iti asti shubhAshubhahetUnAM shubhAshubhaphalasambandha iti nishcayamupeyAt, nAtra kathaM tAvAn syAdityarthaH| hetvArambhanityaH shubhahetuyo(yA)gAdyArambhaparaH||27||

8.sanskrit: nAshuciruttamAjyAkShatatilakushasarShapairagniM juhuyAdAtmAnamAshIrbhirAshAsAnaH, agnirme nApagaccheccharIrAdvAyurme prANAnAdadhAtu viShNurme balamAdadhAtu indro me vIryaM shivA mAM pravishantvApa ApohiShThetyapaH spRushet, dviH parimRujyoShThau pAdau cAbhyukShya mUrdhani khAni copaspRushedadbhirAtmAnaM hRudayaM shirashca||28||
8.commentary: uttamAjyaM gosarpiH| AshIrbhirAshAsAna iti cchedaH| ‘agnirme’ ityAdinA ‘ApohiShThA’ ityantaH snAnamantraH||28||

8.sanskrit: brahmacaryaj~jAnadAnamaitrIkAruNyaharShopekShAprashamaparashca syAditi||29||
8.commentary: maitrI sarvabhUteShvAtmanIvApratikUlA pravRuttiH| nanu maitrIparaH syAditi viruddhametat, yena shAstrakAra evAyaM digdhaviddhasvayammRutAdimAMsaparityAgena vayasthatvAdiguNayuktAnAM mRugAdInAM sadyaskaM mAMsaM sevyatvenopadishan sAkShAnmaitrIviruddhAM hiMsAmevAha; naivaM, rAgata eva prANinAM hiMsApUrvakamAMsabhakShaNe prApte~ayamAyurvedopadeShTA mAMsasya kvacidroge kasyaciddhitatvaM kvaciccAhitatvamupadishati, natu mAMsabhakShaNaM hiMsAM vA vidadhAti; na hyayaM madirAyA api svasthavRutte rogivRutte vA hitatvamupadishan madirApAnaM pratyupadeShTA bhavati; evaM ca rogAdhikAre rAjayakShmAdau mAMsopadeshastathA sharadRutucaryAdau “lAvAn kapi~jjalAneNAn” (sU.a.6) ityAdigrantho lAvAdimAMsahitatvopadeshArtho na hiMsAvidhAyakaH; tena rogiNaH svasthAshca hiMsAphalabhAjo bhavantyeva; yathA- “shyenenAbhicaran yajeta” ityatrAbhicArasya kAmata eva prAptatvAcchyenasyAbhicArasAdhanatvamAtrameva vidhirbrUte, tena shyenenAbhicArakaraNe~adharmo bhavatyeva; ayaM tvatra visheShaH- yadi hiMsopArjitamAMsopayogaM vinA puruSho na jIvati, ato hiMsAM karoti, tadA “sarvatrAtmAnaM gopAyIta” iti vedavacanavihitatvAttathAvidhahiMsA na pratyavAyahetuH, jIvanopAyAntarasambhave tu puShTyAdiprayojanA hiMsA pratyavAyahetureva; ki~jca bhavatu vA~a~ayurvedavihitA hiMsA, tathA~api hiMsA doShArthamucyate; na hyAyurvedavidhayo dharmasAdhanamevopadishanti, kiM tarhyArogyasAdhanaM “dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA tantrasyAsya prayojanam” (sU.a.1) ityukteH||29||

8.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- pa~jcapa~jcakamuddiShTaM mano hetucatuShTayam| indriyopakrame~adhyAye sadvRuttamakhilena ca||30|| svasthavRuttaM yathoddiShTaM yaH samyaganutiShThati| sa samAH shatamavyAdhirAyuShA na viyujyate||31|| nRulokamApUrayate yashasA sAdhusammataH| dharmArthAveti bhUtAnAM bandhutAmupagacchati||32|| parAn sukRutino lokAn puNyakarmA prapadyate| tasmAdvRuttamanuShTheyamidaM sarveNa sarvadA||33||
8.commentary: sa~ggrahe hetucatuShTayaM samAtihInamithyAyogAH| samAH shataM varShashataM; yadyapi sadvRuttAnuShThAne~api daivaviparyayeNAntarA maraNaM vyAdhayo vA bhavanti, tathA~api prAdhAnyAddaivakRutavyAdheH puruShAparAdhAviShayatvAduktaM samAH shatamityAdi; yaduktaM- “parihAryANi yatnena sadA pariharannaraH| bhavatyanRuNatAM prAptaH sAdhUnAmiha paNDitaH” (sU.a.28) iti||30-33||

8.sanskrit: yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdanuktamiha pUjitam| vRuttaM tadapi cAtreyaH sadaivAbhyanumanyate||34||
8.commentary: anuktasadvRuttopasa~ggrahArthamAha- yaccAnyadapItyAdi| vRuttam AcAraH| ihAyurvede~anuktamapyAcAropadeshakeShu dharmashAstreShu pUjitaM, yathA- “nAkasmAdvikaco bhavenna parashasyeShu gAM carantIM dhAvantIM vA parasya brUyAt” ityAdi, sarvamAtreyasyAnumataM sAkShAdAyurvedAviShayatvena granthavistarabhayAcca na proktamityabhiprAyaH|||34||

8.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne indriyopakramaNIyo nAmAShTamo~adhyAyaH||8|| iti svasthacatuShko dvitIyaH||2||
8.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne dvitIye svasthacatuShke indriyopakramaNIyo nAmAShTamo~adhyAyaH||8||

9.sanskrit: athAtaH khuDDAkacatuShpAdamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
9.commentary: svasthacatuShkAnantaraM svasthAturayorubhayorapi hitatvena nirdeshacatuShko~abhidhIyate| svasthAturahitaM vaidyabheShajAdi nirdishatIti nirdeshacatuShkaH, tatrApi svasthAturahiteShu pradhAnabhUtacikitsA~ggavaidyAdipAdacatuShTayAbhidhAyakatvena khuDDAkacatuShpAdo~abhidhIyate| khuDDAkashabdo~alpavacanaH; yathA- khuDDikA garbhAvakrAntiH, alpetyarthaH| vaidyauShadhaparicArakarogiNashcikitsAyAshcatvAraH pAdAH, catuShpAdaM taM khuDDAkamabhidheyatayA~adhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyaH khuDDAkacatuShpAdaH| atrotpannasya tu pratyayasya “adhyAyAnuvAkayorluk ca” (pA.a.5pA.2sU.60) iti luk| khuDDAkatvaM cAsya vakShyamANamahAcatuShpAdamapekShya||1-2||

9.sanskrit: bhiShagdravyANyupasthAtA rogI pAdacatuShTayam| guNavat kAraNaM j~jeyaM vikAravyupashAntaye||3||
9.commentary: atra bhiShagAdAvuktaH pradhAnatvAt, vakShyati hi- “pradhAnaM bhiShagatra tu” iti; tadanu bheShajaM, cikitsAyAM pradhAnakAraNabhUtatvAt; tadanu paricArakaH, bheShajaprayogasya kalkakvAthAdisAdhyasya tadadhInatvAt| yadyapyAturAdhikaraNamArogyaM pAdaiH sampAdyate , sa eva ca vaidyAdInAmupakAryaH, upakAryashca pradhAnaM bhavati, tathA~apIha vyAdhiprashame sAdhye yathA vaidyAdipAdatrayasya vyApAro na tathA~a~aturasyetyaprAdhAnyavivakShayA pashcAduktaH| pAdashcaturtho bhAgaH, shlokAdipAdavadvaidyAdiShu pAdasa~jj~jAkaraNenAnyataravaikalyenApi cikitsA na bhavatIti darshayati| guNavaditi vakShyamANa-shruteparyavadAtatvAdiguNavat| iha ca vaidyAdayo vyApriyamANA eva vikAraprashamane kAraNaM bhavanti, yataH kAraNatvaM kArye vyApAravatAmeva bhavati; tathA hi- devadattaH pAcaka ityukte tuShabusaprakShepAdikriyayaiva pAkaM karotIti gamyate; etena yaducyate- “caturNAM bhiShagAdInAM” ityAdinA shlokena vaidyAdInAM pravRuttishcikitsA vyAdhiprashamaheturabhidhAtavyA, iha tu vaidyAdaya eveti pUrvAparavirodhaH; tanna bhavati, iha vaidyAdipravRuttervaidyAdigrahaNenaiva grahaNAt| caturNAmityAdau shloke vaidyAdInAM dharmiNAM dharmarUpAyAshca pravRutterbhedaM puraskRutya cikitsAyAH kriyArUpAyAH kathanam| ete vaidyAdayo vikArashamane kAraNameveti niyamaH, na punaretaireva vikAraprashamanamiti niyamaH, yato vaidyAdIn pratyAkhyAyApi rogashAntirbhavati; vakShyati hi mahAcatuShpAde- “ye hyAturAH kevalAdbheShajAdRute samuttiShThante” (sU.a.10) ityAdinA||3||

9.sanskrit: vikAro dhAtuvaiShamyaM, sAmyaM prakRutirucyate| sukhasa~jj~jakamArogyaM, vikAro duHkhameva ca||4||
9.commentary: atra vikAravyupashAntaya ityuktaM, tena vikArasvarUpaj~jAnArthamAha- vikAro dhAtuvaiShamyamityAdi| dhAtavo vAtAdayo rasAdayashca tathA rajaHprabhRutayashca, teShAM vaiShamyaM vyavahriyamANasvAsthyahetoH svamAnAnnyUnatvamadhikatvaM vA| sAmyaM dhAtusAmyaM; prakRutiH Arogyam| ucyategrahaNAdvaidyakasiddhAnte hIyaM prakRutivikAravyavasthA, anyadarshanasiddhAntaparigrahe tu vikAraH ShoDashakaH, prakRutirguNAnAM sAmyAvasthA bhavatIti darshayati| nanu, rAtridinabhojanAnAM tAsu tAsvavasthAsu shleShmaprakopAdinA nityaM dhAtuvaiShamyamasti, tatkuto dhAtusAmyamityAha- sukhasa~jj~jakamityAdi| sukhahetuH sukham, evaM duHkhaheturduHkhaM; yato na duHkhaM vyAdhiH, tathA hi sati na jvarAdInAM vyAdhitvaM syAt; ata eva sushrute~apyuktaM- “tattu saptavidhe vyAdhAvupanipatati” (su.sU. a.24) iti; sa~jj~jakagrahaNAt paramArthato~asukhamapi loke sukhamiti yad vyavahriyate, tadiha gRuhyata iti darshayati; tena, divArAtribhojanAvasthAdijanitaM dhAtuvaiShamyamudvejakavikArAkartRutvena sukhamiti vyavahriyate, tena yo hyalpaH sa nAstyeveti kRutvA~alpe~api dhAtuvaiShamye dhAtusAmyavyavahAraH siddho bhavati; tathA sa~jj~jakagrahaNena laukikasukhaM na paramArthataH sukhamiti darshayati, yato vakShyati “sarvaM kAraNavadduHkhaM” (shA. a.1) ityAdi; ‘eva ca’ grahaNena duHkhaM paramArthato~api duHkhameveti darshayati, na sukhamiva vyavahAramAtreNa| atra ca dhAtuvaiShamyeNa kAraNenopacArAttatkAryajvarAdayo~abhidhIyante, yato dhAtuvaiShamyajo hi vikAro na dhAtuvaiShamyamAtraM, yadvakShyati- “svadhAtuvaiShamyanimittajA ye vikArasa~gghA bahavaH sharIre” (sU. a.19) ityAdi, tathA “vikRutimApannA nAnAvidhairvikAraiH sharIramupatapanti” (vi. a.1) ityAdi, tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “vAtapittakaphashoNitasannipAtavaiShamyanimittAH ” (sU.a.1) iti| atra pakShe dhAtuvaiShamyajashcedvikArastadA janitavikAraM dhAtuvaiShamyaM kva pravishatu; kiM vikAre, uta Arogye? na tAvadArogye, yataH “ityuktaM kAraNaM kAryaM dhAtusAmyamihocyate| dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA tantrasyAsya prayojanam” (sU. a.1) ityanena granthenArogyaM dhAtusAmyamityuktaM; na ca roge pravishati, rogahetutvenaiva kathitatvAt; atha mataM dhAtuvaiShamyaM bhavati, vikAro na bhavatIti; eShA dashA nAstyeva; yato~avashyaM pramANAdhiko doShaH svali~ggAdhiko bhavati, kShINo vA kShINasvalakShaNa iti; iha tarhi dhAtuvaiShamyameva vikAro~astu, evamayaM grantho~api mukhyo bhavati; dhAtuvaiShamyajavikArapratipAdakastu grantha AviShkRutatamajvarAdipratipAdakatvena vyavasthApyatAM, tena dhAtuvaiShamyaM ca dhAtuvaiShamyajAshca jvarAdayo vikArA bhavanti; dhAtuvaiShamyajAteShvapi hi jvarAdiShu dhAtuvaiShamyarUpatA~astyeva; ki~jca svamAnakShINA doShAH ki~jcidvikAraM na janayanti, kShINalakShaNaM vaiShamyameva paraM yAnti; vacanaM hi- “kShINA jahati li~ggaM svaM samAH svaM karma kurvate” (sU.a.7) iti; nAtra dhAtuvaiShamyamAtraM vikAra iti bruvatAmayaM panthAH; ye tu dhAtuvaiShamyajo vikAra iti vyavasthitAH, te tvajanitavyapadeshyavikAraM dhAtuvaiShamyaM rAtridinAvasthAdikRutadhAtuvaiShamyavadalpatvenAvyapadeshyatayA dhAtusAmya eva prakShipantIti; tilakAlakamaShakaprabhRutInAM tu dhAtuvaiShamyajatveneha carake rogatvaM suvyaktameva, duHkhahetutvaM ca teShAM j~jAtAnAM manoduHkhakartRutvena||4||

9.sanskrit: caturNAM bhiShagAdInAM shastAnAM dhAtuvaikRute| pravRuttirdhAtusAmyArthA cikitsetyabhidhIyate||5||
9.commentary: vikAralakShaNAnantaraM vikAraprashamahetoshcikitsAyA lakShaNamAha- caturNAmityAdi| caturNAmiti padaM vaidyAdInAM militAnAmeva grAhakam| shastAnAmiti vakShyamANashrute paryavadAtatvamityAdiguNayogena prashastAnAm| dhAtuvaikRute roge cikitsAdhikaraNabhUte| dhAtusAmyArthA ArogyakaraNArthetyarthaH| dhAtuvaikRuta iti padaM spaShTArthaM, yena dhAtusAmyArthA pravRuttirdhAtuvaikRute eva vaidyAdInAM bhavati| pravRuttirvaidyasya idaM kartavyamidaM na kartavyamityAdikopadesharUpA, dravyasya tUpayoge sati svakAryArambharUpA, paricArakapravRuttirbheShajasaMskaraNAturaparicaryAdirUpA, AturapravRuttirvaidyoktAnuShThAnavyAdhisvarUpakathanAdikA||5||

9.sanskrit: shrute paryavadAtatvaM bahusho dRuShTakarmatA| dAkShyaM shaucamiti j~jeyaM vaidye guNacatuShTayam||6||
9.commentary: pUrvasUtritavaidyaguNAn darshayati- shruta ityAdi| shrutamAdau shreShThavaidyaguNatvAt, evamanyatrApi vyAkhyeyam| paryavadAtatvaM vishuddhaj~jAnavattvaM gurushAstrasevanAdinA| shaucamadRuShTadvAropakArakam| jitahastatvAdayo~apare~api vaidyaguNA atraiva guNacatuShTaye~antarbhAvanIyAH||6||

9.sanskrit: bahutA tatrayogyatvamanekavidhakalpanA| sampacceti catuShko~ayaM dravyANAM guNa ucyate||7||
9.commentary: bahutA bheShajaguNaH, alpaM hi bheShajaM guNavadapyavidyamAnamiva, asAdhakatvAt| tatra pratikartavye vyAdhau yogyatvaM tatrayogyatvam| anekavidhakalpanA nAnAprakArasvarasAdyupayuktakalpanAyogyatvamityarthaH; yataH prANinaH kecit svarasadviShaH, kecit kalkadviSha evamAdi; evaM vyAdhisvabhAvAdapi kAcit kalpanA hitA bhavati, yathA- jvare kaShAya ityAdi; tenAnekakalpanAyogyatvAdyadyatra yujyate tattatra kriyate| sampaditi krimisalilAdyanupahatatvena rasAdisampat||7||

9.sanskrit: upacAraj~jatA dAkShyamanurAgashca bhartari| shaucaM ceti catuShko~ayaM guNaH paricare jane||8||
9.commentary: upacAraj~jatA yUSharasAdikaraNasaMvAhanasvApanAdij~jatA||8||

9.sanskrit: smRutirnirdeshakAritvamabhIrutvamathApi ca| j~jApakatvaM ca rogANAmAturasya guNAH smRutAH||9||
9.commentary: nirdeshakAritvaM vaidyopadiShTArthakartRutvam| abhIrutvaM guNaH, bhIrutvasya rogakartRutvAt; yaduktaM- “viShAdo rogavardhanAnAM” (sU.a.25) iti| athApi cetishabdena kvacidbhIrutvamapyasmRutirapi guNo bhavatIti darshayati; yathonmAde “sarpeNoddhRutadaMShTreNa” ityAdinA trAsanamuktaM cikitsAyAM, tatra yadyapyabhIruH syAdrogI tadA cikitsA na phalati; asmRutistu jvaravegAgamanakAlAsmaraNe~abhipretA, yaduktaM- “jvaravegaM ca kAlaM ca cintaya~jjvaryate tu yaH| tasyeShTaishca vicitraishca prayogairnAshayet smRutim” (ci.a.3) iti||9||

9.sanskrit: kAraNaM ShoDashaguNaM siddhau pAdacatuShTayam| vij~jAtA shAsitA yoktA pradhAnaM bhiShagatra tu||10||
9.commentary: evaM vaidyAdInAM caturNAmapi kAraNatve siddhe vaidyasya prAdhAnyaM darshayati- kAraNamityAdi| vij~jAtA auShadhasya| shAsitA paricArakasya- evaM kurvevaM mA kurviti| yoktA Aturasya| etena vaidyaparAdhInA bheShajAdInAM pravRuttiH, vaidyastu svatantraH, tatashca vaidyaH pradhAnamiti vAkyArthaH||10||

9.sanskrit: paktau hi kAraNaM pakturyathA pAtrendhanAnalAH| vijeturvijaye bhUmishcamUH praharaNAni ca||11|| AturAdyAstathA siddhau pAdAH kAraNasa~jj~jitAH| vaidyasyAtashcikitsAyAM pradhAnaM kAraNaM bhiShak||12||
9.commentary: etadevAbhyarhitatvAddRuShTAntadvayena darshayati- paktAvityAdi| paktau pAke kartavye, pAtrasthAnIya AturaH, paricAraka indhanarUpaH, analo bheShajarUpaH| kAraNamiti upakaraNam| bhUmiH yuddhAnuguNo deshaH| atrApi pUrvavadevAturAdisthAnIyatvaM bhUmyAdInAm||11-12||

9.sanskrit: mRuddaNDacakrasUtrAdyAH kumbhakArAdRute yathA| nAvahanti guNaM vaidyAdRute pAdatrayaM tathA||13||
9.commentary: samprati vyatirekadRuShTAntena vaidyaprAdhAnyaM darshayati- mRuddaNDetyAdinA| nAvahanti na niShpAdayanti| guNaM sAdhyamityarthaH||13||

9.sanskrit: gandharvapuravannAshaM yadvikArAH sudAruNAH| yAnti yaccetare vRuddhimAshUpAyapratIkShiNaH||14|| sati pAdatraye j~jAj~jau bhiShajAvatra kAraNam|15|
9.commentary: anvayena vyatirekeNa ca pRuthagdRuShTAntaM darshayitvA kaushalenaikatraiva dRuShTAnte gandharvapuretyAdinA~anvaye guNaM vyatireke ca doShaM darshayati| ekatrapakShe nAshamAshu yAntIti sambandhaH, itare apare~anabhij~javaidyopakrAntA gandharvapuravadAshu vRuddhiM yAntIti sambandhaH| upAyapratIkShiNa iti vRuddhau shAntau ca| Ashu vikArashAntau j~jo bhiShakkAraNam, AshuvRuddhau cAj~jaH||14||-

9.sanskrit: varamAtmA huto~aj~jena na cikitsA pravartitA||15|| pANicArAdyathA~acakShuraj~jAnAdbhItabhItavat| naurmArutavashevAj~jo bhiShak carati karmasu||16||
9.commentary: aj~javaidyasya cikitsApravRuttiM niShedhayati- varamityAdi| na varam anucitameva| pravartitetibhAShayA aj~javaidyena balAt kRuteti darshayati| pANicArAt hastaparAmarshAt| karmasu cikitsAsu||15-16||

9.sanskrit: yadRucchayA samApannamuttArya niyatAyuSham| bhiSha~gmAnI nihantyAshu shatAnyaniyatAyuShAm||17||
9.commentary: yadRucchayeti vaidyasamyagj~jAnapUrvakapravRuttiM vinA karmavashAdityarthaH| samApannaM samyagupakrAntam| niyatAyuShamityanenAyurbalenaiva vyAdhimuttIryamANamityarthaH | AtmAnamabhiShajaM bhiShaktvena manyata iti bhiSha~gmAnI| aniyatAyuShAmiti yatrAyuHkAraNaM balavat karma nAsti, tatra puruShakArAparAdhena vaidyadoShAnmaraNaM bhavatIti darshayati||17||

9.sanskrit: tasmAcchAstre~arthavij~jAne pravRuttau karmadarshane| bhiShak catuShTaye yuktaH prANAbhisara ucyate||18||
9.commentary: shAstre shAstrAvadhAraNe | arthavij~jAne shAstrArthAvabodhe| pravRuttau svayaM karmakaraNe| yukta udyukta udyoganiShpAditaguNaprakarSha iti yAvat| prANAn gacchato vyAvartayatIti prANAbhisaraH||18||

9.sanskrit: hetau li~gge prashamane rogANAmapunarbhave| j~jAnaM caturvidhaM yasya sa rAjArho bhiShaktamaH||19|| shastraM shAstrANi salilaM guNadoShapravRuttaye| pAtrApekShINyataH praj~jAM cikitsArthaM vishodhayet||20|| vidyA vitarko vij~jAnaM smRutistatparatA kriyA| yasyaite ShaDguNAstasya na sAdhyamativartate||21|| vidyA matiH karmadRuShTirabhyAsaH siddhirAshrayaH| vaidyashabdAbhiniShpattAvalamekaikamapyataH||22|| yasya tvete guNAH sarve santi vidyAdayaH shubhAH| sa vaidyashabdaM sadbhUtamarhan prANisukhapradaH||23||
9.commentary: pAtrApekShINIti guNavati pAtre saguNAni, doShavati pAtre doShavanti bhavantItyarthaH| vishodhayet sadgurusacchAstrasevAdibhirityarthaH| vidyA vaidyakashAstraj~jAnam| vitarkaH shAstramUla UhApohaH| vij~jAnaM shAstrAntaraj~jAnaM; kiMvA sahajaM vishuddhaM j~jAnam| tatparateha vyAdhicikitsAyAM prayatnAtishayatvam| kriyA punaH punashcikitsAkaraNam| matiH sahajavishuddhamatiH| abhyAsaH karmAbhyAsaH| siddhiH prAyasho vyAdhiprashamakatvam| AshrayaH sadgurvAshraya ityarthaH| vaidyashabdAbhiniShpattAvityanena pAramArthikavaidyatvaniShpattAviti darshayati| eta ityanenaiva labdhe~api vidyAdaya iti vacanaM pUrvoktaguNavyudAsArthaM, tadvyudAsashca vidyAdiShvevAntarbhAvanIyaH; etacca prabandhena pRuthak pRuthagguNakathanaM vaidyasya guNotpAdane yatnAtishayaM kArayituM tathA dravyAdibhyaH pAdebhyo vaidyasyaiva pradhAnatopadarshanArthaM; vaidyo hi pAdatrayaM viguNamapi kalpanayA shikShayA mantraNena ca sampAdya cikitsituM pArayati, natu guNavadvaidyaM vinA dravyAdayaH pAdA guNavanto~api kShamAH||19-23||

9.sanskrit: shAstraM jyotiH prakAshArthaM darshanaM buddhirAtmanaH| tAbhyAM bhiShak suyuktAbhyAM cikitsannAparAdhyati||24|| cikitsite trayaH pAdA yasmAdvaidyavyapAshrayaH| tasmAt prayatnamAtiShThedbhiShak svaguNasampadi||25||
9.commentary: shAstrashabdena shAstrAbhyAsakRutA matiH, sA hi jyotiH bAhyAloka iva, prakAshArthaM vastUnAM grahaNayogyatAM kartumityarthaH| darshanamiva darshanaM cakShurivetyarthaH| yadyapi buddhirAtmana eva bhavati, tathA~apyAtmana ityanena sahajAM buddhiM darshayati, yataH sahajAM buddhiM vinA shAstrajA buddhiryA vainAyakItyabhidhIyate, sA na samyakcikitsAsamarthA bhavatIti| tAbhyAmiti sahajavishuddhabuddhishAstrAbhyAM sahajavainAyakabuddhibhyAm||24-25||

9.sanskrit: maitrI kAruNyamArteShu shakye prItirupekShaNam| prakRutistheShu bhUteShu vaidyavRuttishcaturvidheti||26||
9.commentary: vaidyena ca yAdRushyA buddhyA vyavahartavyaM, tAM darshayati- maitrItyAdi| maitrI pUrvameva vyAkRutA| ArteShu ArtiyukteShu| kAruNyaM paraduHkhaprahANecchA| shakye sAdhayituM shakye, sAdhyavyAdhigRuhIta iti yAvat| prakRutiriha maraNaM, prakRutirucyate svabhAvaH; tathA- “idamasmAnmuhUrtAt....svabhAvamApatsyate” (sU.a.30), maraNamityarthaH; maraNasamIpagatatvAducyate “prakRutisthe” iti| tasminnupekShA kartavyA; na tatra bheShajadAnAdi kartavyaM, yashohAnyAdibhayAt||26||

9.sanskrit: tatra shlokau- bhiShagjitaM catuShpAdaM pAdaH pAdashcaturguNaH| bhiShak pradhAnaM pAdebhyo yasmAdvaidyastu yadguNaH||27|| j~jAnAni buddhirbrAhmI ca bhiShajAM yA caturvidhA| sarvametaccatuShpAde khuDDAke samprakAshitamiti||28||
9.commentary: sa~ggrahe brAhmI buddhiH caturvidhA maitrIkAruNyAdikA||27-28||

9.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne khuDDAkacatuShpAdo nAma navamo~adhyAyaH||9||
9.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne tRutIye nirdeshacatuShke khuDDAkacatuShpAdo nAma navamo~adhyAyaH||9||

10.sanskrit: athAto mahAcatuShpAdamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
10.commentary: pUrvAdhyAye vaidyAdayo vyAdhiprashamakAraNamityuktaM, tadihAkShipya vyavasthApyata ityanantaraM mahAcatuShpAdo~abhidhIyate| mahattvaM cAsya pUrvAdhyAyApekShayA, bahugranthatvena pUrvapakShasiddhAntarUpabahuprameyAbhidhAyakatvena ca||1-2||

10.sanskrit: catuShpAdaM ShoDashakalaM bheShajamiti bhiShajo bhAShante, yaduktaM pUrvAdhyAye ShoDashaguNamiti, tadbheShajaM yuktiyuktamalamArogyAyeti bhagavAn punarvasurAtreyaH||3||
10.commentary: ShoDashakalaM ShoDashaguNaM, kalAshabdo guNavacanaH| bhiShajo bhAShanta iti bruvate| prakRute~arthe shAstrAntarasammatiM darshayati- yuktiyuktamiti| yunaktIti yuktiH pravRuttirucyate; yuktiyuktaM pravRuttimadityarthaH; pravRuttishca vaidyAdInAM cikitsArUpA pUrvAdhyAye vyAkRutA| alaM samartham| iti bhagavAnAtreyo ‘brUte’ iti sheShaH||3||

10.sanskrit: neti maitreyaH, kiM kAraNaM? dRushyante hyAturAH kecidupakaraNavantashca paricArakasampannAshcAtmavantashca kushalaishca bhiShagbhiranuShThitAH samuttiShThamAnAH, tathAyuktAshcApare mriyamANAH; tasmAdbheShajamaki~jcitkaraM bhavati, tadyathA- shvabhre sarasi ca prasiktamalpamudakaM, nadyAM vA syandamAnAyAM pAMsudhAne vA pAMsumuShTiH prakIrNa iti; tathA~apare dRushyante~anupakaraNAshcAparicArakAshcAnAtmavantashcAkushalaishca bhiShagbhiranuShThitAH samuttiShThamAnAH, tathAyuktA mriyamANAshcApare| yatashca pratikurvan sidhyati, pratikurvan mriyate; apratikurvan sidhyati, apratikurvan mriyate; tatashcintyate bheShajamabheShajenAvishiShTamiti ||4||
10.commentary: uktamAkShipati- netItyAdi| upakaraNaM bheShajam| anuShThitAH cikitsitumupakrAntAH| tathAyuktAH pUrvavaccikitsitumupakrAntA ityarthaH| aki~jcitkaramiti bheShaje satyapi yadA~a~arogyaM na bhavati; tena, yatrApi sati bheShaje ArogyaM bhavati, tatrApi bheShajavyatiriktaM karmaiva daivasa~jj~jakaM kAraNaM, bheShajaM tu tatra daivAgatasannidhAnamakAraNamevetyarthaH| atraivArthe dRuShTAntadvayaM darshayati- tadyathetyAdi| shvabhre garte yathA~alpaM jalamaki~jcitkaramevaM mriyamANe~api bheShajaM, yathA ca sarasi anyata eva pUrNe~alpamudakamaki~jcitkaraM bhavatyevamanyata evArogyahetoH karmaNo rogaprashamane jAyamAne bheShajamaki~jcitkaraM bhavatIti sarodRuShTAntena darshayati; evaM nadyAM syandamAnAyAM vahamAnAyAM pAMsumuShTiriti nidarshanaM shvabhravat, pAMsudhAne pAMshurAshau pAMshumuShTiriti sarodRuShTAntavadvyAkhyeyam| atra ca toyadRuShTAntaH saMshodhanabheShajAbhiprAyeNa, pAMshudRuShTAntastu saMshamanabheShajAbhiprAyeNa; yadi vA jalaM santarpaNabheShajAbhiprAyeNa, pAMshumuShTistvapatarpaNAbhiprAyeNa boddhavyA| bheShajAnvayavyabhicAraM darshayitvA tadvyatirekavyabhicAraM darshayati- tathA~apare ityAdi| pratikurvannityantarbhAvitaNyarthatvAt pratikArayannityarthaH; yadi vA~a~atura eva vaidyAdInutpAdyAtmAnaM pratikurvanniti mantavyam; etena daivAkhyakarmavashAdevAyaM jIvati mriyate vA, rogI bhavatyarogo vA, na dRuShTabheShajamatra ki~jcitkaramiti pUrvapakShArthaH||4||

10.sanskrit: maitreya ! mithyA cintyata ityAtreyaH; kiM kAraNaM, ye hyAturAH ShoDashaguNasamuditenAnena bheShajenopapadyamAnA mriyanta ityuktaM tadanupapannaM, na hi bheShajasAdhyAnAM vyAdhInAM bheShajamakAraNaM bhavati; ye punarAturAH kevalAdbheShajAdRute samuttiShThante, na teShAM sampUrNabheShajopapAdanAya samutthAnavisheSho nAsti; yathA hi patitaM puruShaM samarthamutthAnAyotthApayan puruSho balamasyopAdadhyAt, sa kShiprataramaparikliShTa evottiShThet, tadvat sampUrNabheShajopalambhAdAturAH; ye cAturAH kevalAdbheShajAdapi mriyante, na ca sarva eva te bheShajopapannAH samuttiShTheran, nahi sarve vyAdhayo bhavantyupAyasAdhyAH, na copAyasAdhyAnAM vyAdhInAmanupAyena siddhirasti, na cAsAdhyAnAM vyAdhInAM bheShajasamudAyo~ayamasti , na hyalaM j~jAnavAn bhiSha~gmumUrShumAturamutthApayituM; parIkShyakAriNo hi kushalA bhavanti, yathA hi yogaj~jo~abhyAsanitya iShvAso dhanurAdAyeShumasyannAtiviprakRuShTe mahati kAye nAparAdhavAn bhavati, sampAdayati ceShTakAryaM, tathA bhiShak svaguNasampanna upakaraNavAn vIkShya karmArabhamANaH sAdhyarogamanaparAdhaH sampAdayatyevAturamArogyeNa; tasmAnna bheShajamabheShajenAvishiShTaM bhavati||5||
10.commentary: siddhAntayati- mithyetyAdi| kevalAt sampUrNAt| na nAstItyubhayanakArakaraNAdasti samutthAnavisheSha ityarthaH| tadvaditi kShiprataramakliShTA evottiShThanta ityarthaH| evaM manyate- yadyapyadRuShTamevotthAne kAraNaM, tathA~api yadi dRuShTamapi tatrAnubalaM bhavati, tadA dRuShTAdRuShTobhayabalAcchIghramevArogyaM bhavati| sarva eveti sAdhyavyAdhayo~asAdhyavyAdhayashca; sampUrNabheShajopapattAvapi satyAmasAdhyavyAdhayo nottiShThante, sAdhyavyAdhaya uttiShThanta iti bhAvaH| yadyapyasAdhyavyAdhiM prati sampUrNabheShajopapattireva nAsti, yaduktaM- “na cAsAdhyAnAM vyAdhInAM bheShajasamudAyo~ayamasti, nahyalaM j~jAnavAn bhiSha~gmumUrShumAturamutthApayitum” iti, tathA~apIha ki~jcidasampUrNabheShajatve~api sampUrNabheShajopapanna ityuktam| ye tu sAdhyavyAdhayaste satyAmeva bheShajasampattau jIvanti, asatyAM tu bheShajasampattau balavajjIvanakarmAbhAve mriyanta eveti darshayannAha- na copAyetyAdi| upAyenaiva dRuShTArthena sAdhyA upAyasAdhyAH| idamatrAkUtaM- yat- dvividhaM karma balavadabalavacca; tatra balavanniyatavipAkakAlaM, yathedaM karmAsminneva kAle mArayati; abalavacca mArakaM karma mArayatveva paraM kAlAniyamena, tadyadA dRuShTasAmagrImanuguNAmapathyasevArUpAmauShadhAbhAvarUpAM ca prApnoti tadA mArayati, yadA tu na prApnoti tadA na mArayati| yaduktaM janapadoddhvaMsanIye- “karma ki~jcit kvacit kAle vipAke niyataM mahat| ki~jcinna kAlaniyataM pratyayaiH pratibodhyate” (vi.a.3) iti| asya tvarthaM prapa~jcena tatraiva darshayiShyAmaH| na ca vAcyam- adRuShTameva sarvatra kAraNaM, tacca niyatakAlavipAkameva, yaducyate- “nAkAle jAyate kashcinnAkAle mriyate tathA| jagat kAlavashaM sarvaM kAlaH sarvatra kAraNam” iti; yataH, yadevAdRuShTaM tadeva dRuShTayAgAdibrahmavadhAdijanyaM ki~jcit| yaddRuShTenAnupapannaM, tatrAdRuShTakalpanA prAmANikI, yattu dAhAdi dRuShTenaivAgnisambandhenopapadyate tatra kA kathA~adRuShTasya dRuShTakAryAnyathAnupapattiparikalpanIyasya; tena ya ime durbalena karmaNA dRuShTabalavadapathyasevAjanitadoShabalAdArabdhA vyAdhayaste balavatA catuShpAdasampannena bheShajena doShakShayakenopAyena paraM sAdhyAH, tadabhAve tu durbalenApi karmaNA dRuShTadoShabalAdArabdhA vyAdhayo na nivartanta iti| yaduktaM- “daivaM puruShakAreNa durbalaM hyupahanyate| daivena cetarat karma vishiShTenopahanyate” (vi.a.3) iti| anupAyena abheShajena| ayaM bheShajasamudAyaH sarvaguNasampanna ityarthaH; asAdhye vyAdhau cikitsAM kurvan vaidya eva yathoktaguNo na bhavatItyarthaH| nahyalaM na samarthaH; yadyasAdhyatAM jAnAti tadA na pravartata eva, atha na jAnAti tadA j~jAnavAneva na bhavatIti bhAvaH| catuShpAdasampadA~avashyaM vyAdhiprashamo bhavatIti dRuShTAntenAha- yathA hItyAdi| iShvAso dhAnuShkaH| asyan kShipan| nAtiviprakRuShTe sannihite| anaparAdha iti lakShyabhraMsharahitaH| iShTaM kAryaM lakShyavedhalakShaNam||5||

10.sanskrit: idaM ca naH pratyakShaM- yadanAtureNa bheShajenAturaM cikitsAmaH , kShAmamakShAmeNa, kRushaM ca durbalamApyAyayAmaH, sthUlaM medasvinamapatarpayAmaH, shItenoShNAbhibhUtamupacarAmaH, shItAbhibhUtamuShNena, nyUnAn dhAtUn pUrayAmaH, vyatiriktAn hrAsayAmaH, vyAdhIn mUlaviparyayeNopacarantaH samyak prakRutau sthApayAmaH; teShAM nastathA kurvatAmayaM bheShajasamudAyaH kAntatamo bhavati||6||
10.commentary: bheShajasya rogaprashamakartRutve upapattyantaramAha- idaM cetyAdi| anAtureNeti AturaguNaviparItena| AturamanAtureNa cikitsAma iti yaduktaM, tasyaiva vivaraNaM- kShAmamakShAmeNetyAdi| kShAmo nirdravaH| kRushaM ca durbalamApyAyayAma iti santarpayAmaH| vyatiriktAniti atiriktAnityarthaH | mUlaviparyayeNeti kAraNaviparyayeNa, tacca prabhAvAditi boddhavyaM; tena viShavikArasya viSheNopacaraNametat pratyakShaM cAnyadupagRuhItaM bhavati| kAntatamo vikAraprashamakatvenAbhIShTatamaH; anye~arthadharmopAyAH kAntAH kAntatarAshca, ayaM tu bheShajasamudAyaH sarvocchedakarogaharatvena kAntatamaH||6||

10.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgaj~jo j~jAnapUrvaM cikitsakaH| kAle cArabhate karma yattat sAdhayati dhruvam||7|| arthavidyAyashohAnimupakroshamasa~ggraham | prApnuyAnniyataM vaidyo yo~asAdhyaM samupAcaret||8||
10.commentary: j~jAnapUrvamiti bheShajAdij~jAnapUrvaM, yat karmArabhate tat karma cikitsitarUpaM, sAdhayati ‘sAdhyaM’ iti sheShaH| asAdhyavyAdhau na pravartitavyamiti shikShayati- arthetyAdi| arthaH arthalAbhaH, hAniH kShatiH| upakrosho janApavAdaH| asa~ggrahaH cikitsArthamanupAdAnaM; yadi ‘vA asadgraha’ iti pAThaH, tadA cAsadgraho rAjadaNDenAsatpuruShaishcANDAlAdibhirgrahaNam||7-8||

10.sanskrit: sukhasAdhyaM mataM sAdhyaM kRucchrasAdhyamathApi ca| dvividhaM cApyasAdhyaM syAdyApyaM yaccAnupakramam ||9|| sAdhyAnAM trividhashcAlpamadhyamotkRuShTatAM prati| vikalpo, na tvasAdhyAnAM niyatAnAM vikalpanA||10||
10.commentary: sAdhye pravRuttiruktA, asAdhye nivRuttishca, tena sAdhyAsAdhyayorbhedakathanapUrvakaM lakShaNaM vaktumAha- sukhasAdhyamityAdi| aki~jcitkaratvenAvidyamAna upakramo yasya tadanupakramaM; yApyaM tvanupakramaM na bhavati, yApanAkartRutvena ki~jcitkaratvAt| tatropakramasyAlpamadhyamotkRuShTatAM pratIti alpamadhyamotkRuShTayogAdityarthaH; tenAlpasAdhyamalpopAyasAdhyaM, madhyasAdhyaM madhyopAyasAdhyam, utkRuShTasAdhyamutkRuShTopAyasAdhyamiti bhedatrayaM sAdhyAnAM bhavati| asAdhyAnAM tu niyatAnAmiti yApyavyatiriktAnAmanupakramANAM, vikalpanA vikalpaH, nAstIti evambhUtA~alpAsAdhyAdirUpA nAsti; prANahara-vaikalyakara-sadyaHprANahara-kAlAntaraprANaharatvAdikalpanA tvasAdhyAnAmastyeva; yadasAdhyaM tadalpena madhyena cotkRuShTena copAyenAsAdhyameva; yApyarUpAsAdhyAnAM tvalpopAyayApyatvAdibhedo~astyeva||9-10||

10.sanskrit: hetavaH pUrvarUpANi rUpANyalpAni yasya ca| na ca tulyaguNo dUShyo na doShaH prakRutirbhavet||11|| na ca kAlaguNastulyo na desho durupakramaH| gatirekA navatvaM ca rogasyopadravo na ca||12|| doShashcaikaH samutpattau dehaH sarvauShadhakShamaH| catuShpAdopapattishca sukhasAdhyasya lakShaNam||13||
10.commentary: na doShaH prakRutirbhavediti vyAdhyArambhako yo doShaH sa tatprakRutAvutkaTo na bhavedityarthaH| desho bhUmirAturashca| desho durupakramo yathA- vAtavyAdhau tulyaguNo maruH, tathA shleShmavyAdhAvanUpaH| dehashca durupakramo yathA- sarvavyAdhInAmeva marmalakShaNo deshaH, tathA vAtavyAdheH pakvAshaya ityAdi| gatirekA eko mArga ityarthaH, mArgAstrayastisraiShaNIye vaktavyAH- “shAkhA marmAsthisandhayaH koShThashca” (sU.a.11) iti| etaccotsarganyAyenoktaM, tena kvacidvyAdhiprabhAvAdanyathA~api sukhasAdhyatvAdilakShaNAbhidhAnena virodho na vaktavyaH| yaduktaM- “jvare tulyartudoShatvaM pramehe tulyadUShyatA| raktagulme purANatvaM sukhasAdhyasya lakShaNam” iti||11-13||

10.sanskrit: nimittapUrvarUpANAM rUpANAM madhyame bale| kAlaprakRutidUShyANAM sAmAnye~anyatamasya ca||14|| garbhiNIvRuddhabAlAnAM nAtyupadravapIDitam| shastrakShArAgnikRutyAnAmanavaM kRucchradeshajam||15|| vidyAdekapathaM rogaM nAtipUrNacatuShpadam| dvipathaM nAtikAlaM vA kRucchrasAdhyaM dvidoShajam||16||
10.commentary: kAlaprakRutidUShyANAmiti nirdhAraNe ShaShThI| sAmAnya iti doSheNa samam| garbhiNIvRuddhabAlAnAM sarva eva vyAdhiH kRucchrasAdhyo boddhavyaH| nAtyupadravapIDitamiti pUrveNa na yojanIyaM, kintu svatantrameva| shastrakShArAgnikRutyAH shastrakShArAgnisAdhyAH; eShAM yo vyAdhistaM kRucchrasAdhyaM vidyAditi sambandhaH| kRucchradeshajaM marmasandhyAdijam| ekapathasya visheShaNaM- nAtipUrNacatuShpadamiti| dvipathamityasya visheShaNaM- nAtikAlamiti||14-16||

10.sanskrit: sheShatvAdAyuSho yApyamasAdhyaM pathyasevayA| labdhAlpasukhamalpena hetunA~a~ashupravartakam||17|| gambhIraM bahudhAtusthaM marmasandhisamAshritam| nityAnushAyinaM rogaM dIrghakAlamavasthitam||18|| vidyAddvidoShajaM,...|19|
10.commentary: yApyatvenaivAsAdhyatve labdhe yadasAdhyamiti padaM tadyApyayApanArthaM kriyamANabheShajatayA sAdhyatvasha~gkAnirAsArtham| sheShatvAdAyuSha iti vacanamAyuHsheShe vidyamAna eva yApyavyAdhiprAdurbhAvo bhavatIti darshanArtham| pathyasevayA bheShajasevayA, labdhamalpaM sukhaM yasmin tallabdhAlpasukham| pravartanaM pravartaH, alpena hetunA~a~ashu shIghraM pravartanaM yasya tadAshupravartakaM; svArthe aN| gambhIraM medaHprabhRutidhAtugatam| nityAnushAyI nityAnubandhaH| vidyAddvidoShajamityantena yApyalakShaNam||17-18||-

10.sanskrit: ...tadvat pratyAkhyeyaM tridoShajam| kriyApathamatikrAntaM sarvamArgAnusAriNam||19|| autsukyAratisammohakaramindriyanAshanam| durbalasya susaMvRuddhaM vyAdhiM sAriShTameva ca||20||
10.commentary: tadvadityAdi tu pratyAkhyeyalakShaNam| tadvadityanena gambhIrAdiyApyalakShaNayuktaM sattridoShajaM pratyAkhyeyamityarthaH| autsukyaM harShodrekaH, aratiranavasthAnalakShaNA, sammoho manaso mohaH||19-20||

10.sanskrit: bhiShajA prAk parIkShyaivaM vikArANAM svalakShaNam| pashcAtkarmasamArambhaH kAryaH sAdhyeShu dhImatA||21|| sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgaj~jo yaH samyakpratipattimAn| na sa maitreyatulyAnAM mithyAbuddhiM prakalpayet||22||
10.commentary: na sa maitreyatulyAnAM mithyAbuddhiM prakalpayediti eva~gguNo vaidyaH pratiniyamena yaM vyAdhimupakramettaM sAdhayatyeva paraM, tato bheShajasya vyAdhiprashamanaM prati karaNatvAvadhAraNe sati bheShajamabheShajena samAnamiti maitreyasadRushAnAM karmavAdinAM mithyAbuddheranutpAda iti bhAvaH||21-22||

10.sanskrit: tatra shlokau- ihauShadhaM pAdaguNAH prabhavo bheShajAshrayaH| AtreyamaitreyamatI matidvaividhyanishcayaH||23|| caturvidhavikalpAshca vyAdhayaH svasvalakShaNAH| uktA mahAcatuShpAde yeShvAyattaM bhiShagjitam||24||
10.commentary: sa~ggrahe iheti ihAdhyAye| auShadhamiti catuShpAdam| pAdaguNA iti yaduktaM pUrvAdhyAye ShoDashaguNamiti| prabhAvo bheShajAshraya iti tadbheShajaM yuktiyuktamalamArogyAyeti||23-24||

10.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne mahAcatuShpAdo nAma dashamo~adhyAyaH||10||
10.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne tRutIye nirdeshacatuShke mahAcatuShpAdo nAma dashamo~adhyAyaH||10||

11.sanskrit: athAtastisraiShaNIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
11.commentary: pUrvAdhyAye catuShpAdamArogyakAraNaM vyavasthApitaM, tatashcatuShpAdasampattyA prAptArogyeNa satA yadanuShTheyaM prANaparipAlanasAdhanaM, tathA dhanArjanasAdhanaM, tathA dharmArjanasAdhanaM, tadihaiShaNAtrayarUpamabhidhIyata ityanantaraM tisraiShaNIyo~abhidhIyate| tisraiShaNAshabdo~asminnastIti matvarthIyashchaH, atrAnukAryAnukaraNayorbhedAvivakShayA yalopAsiddherabhAvAt saMhitayA ‘tisraiShaNIyaH’ iti sa~jj~jAyate, adhyAyAnte “tisraiShaNIye mArgAshca” iti shlokapAdaM kariShyati; yadyapyanye~apyatra shabdAH santi, tathA~api pradhAnatvenAyaM gRuhyate||1-2||

11.sanskrit: iha khalu puruSheNAnupahatasattvabuddhipauruShaparAkrameNa hitamiha cAmuShmiMshca loke samanupashyatA tisra eShaNAH paryeShTavyA bhavanti| tadyathA- prANaiShaNA, dhanaiShaNA, paralokaiShaNeti||3||
11.commentary: iheti bhogArthipuruShAdhikAre, yato mokShArthipuruShaM prati dhanaiShaNA sarvathaivAnupayuktA| puruSheNeti padaM kurvan ya eva puruSha eShaNAtrayamanviShyati sa eva puruSho bhaNyate nAnyaH, pashutulyatvAditi darshayati| pauruShaM shArIraM balaM, parAkramastu shauryAkhyaM mAnasaM balam| iheti iha janmani, amuShminniti janmAntare| iShyate~anviShyate sAdhyate~anayetyeShaNA| prANo jIvitaM, tat sAdhyate dIrghatvena rogAnupahatatvena cAnayeti prANaiShaNA| evaM dhanaiShaNA| paralokopakArakasya dharmasyaiShaNA paralokaiShaNA| kAmaiShaNA tu prANaiShaNAdhanaiShaNayorantarbhAvanIyA, sharIrasampattidhanasampattisAdhyatvAt kAmasya; yadi vA kAmaiShaNAyAM svata eva puruShaH pravRutto bhavati nopadeshamapekShata iti tadeShaNopadesho na kRutaH||3||

11.sanskrit: AsAM tu khalveShaNAnAM prANaiShaNAM tAvat pUrvataramApadyeta| kasmAt? prANaparityAge hi sarvatyAgaH| tasyAnupAlanaM- svasthasya svasthavRuttAnuvRuttiH, Aturasya vikAraprashamane~apramAdaH, tadubhayametaduktaM vakShyate ca; tadyathoktamanuvartamAnaH prANAnupAlanAddIrghamAyuravApnotIti prathamaiShaNA vyAkhyAtA bhavati||4||
11.commentary: prANaiShaNAyAH prathamAnuShThAne upapattimAha- AsAM tvityAdi| trayANAM madhye dve pUrve bhavataH, tRutIyAyAH sarvottaratvenApUrvatvAt; tena dvayostara iti nyAyAt pUrvataraM prANaiShaNeti sAdhustaraprayogaH| prANashabdo jIvitavacana ekavacanAnto~apyasti; yaduktaM- “dashaivAyatanAnyAhuH prANo yeShu pratiShThitaH” (sU.a.30) iti, tena prANapratyavamarshakaM ‘tasya’ iti padamekavacanena yuktameva| vikArAn prashamayatIti vikAraprashamanaM cikitsA, tasmin| apramAdaH avadhAnenAnuShThAnam| vakShyate ceti nikhilena shAstreNa| prANAnupAlanAditi prANAnupAlanasAdhanAt; tena prANAnupAlanadIrghAyuShTvayorarthAbhedAt sAdhyasAdhanabhAvo nAstIti yaccocyate tannirastaM bhavati| prathameti prAdhAnyAt prANaiShaNA||4||

11.sanskrit: atha dvitIyAM dhanaiShaNamApadyeta, prANebhyo hyanantaraM dhanameva paryeShTavyaM bhavati ; na hyataH pApAt pApIyo~asti yadanupakaraNasya dIrghamAyuH, tasmAdupakaraNAni paryeShTuM yateta| tatropakaraNopAyAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tadyathA- kRuShipAshupAlyavANijyarAjopasevAdIni, yAni cAnyAnyapi satAmavigarhitAni karmANi vRuttipuShTikarANi vidyAttAnyArabheta kartuM; tathA kurvan dIrghajIvitaM jIvatyanavamataH puruSho bhavati | iti dvitIyA dhanaiShaNA vyAkhyAtA bhavati||5||
11.commentary: atheti prANaiShaNAnantaram| dvitIyAmiti hetugarbhaM visheShaNaM, yasmAdiyameva dvitIyA prANaiShaNAnantaramavashyopAdeyatvena, tata iyamevocyata ityarthaH| prANaiShaNAmanu cAsyAH prAdhAnyaM darshayati- prANebhyo hItyAdi| pApashabdena pApakAryaM duHkhamucyate| upakaraNam ArogyabhogadharmasAdhanIbhUto dhanaprapa~jcaH, sa yasya nAstyasAvanupakaraNaH| dhanopAyAniti vaktavye upakaraNopAyAniti yataH karoti, tena dhanasya bhogadharmasAdhanArthamevotpAdamicchanti, na punaH kRupaNasyeva viniyogashUnyasya susaMvardhitamAtrakaraNArtham | anyAnyapIti pratigrahAdhyApanAdIni| vRuttiH vartanaM, puShTiH dhanasampattiH| anavamataH anavaj~jAto bahumAnagRuhIta iti yAvat| dIrghaM jIvitaM jIvati dhArayatItyarthaH, anekArthatvAddhAtUnAM; yadi vA dIrghajIvitaM yathA syAttathA jIvatIti kriyAvisheShaNatvena vyAkhyeyam||5||

11.sanskrit: atha tRutIyAM paralokaiShaNAmApadyeta| saMshayashcAtra, kathaM? bhaviShyAma itashcyutA naveti; kutaH punaH saMshaya iti, ucyate- santi hyeke pratyakShaparAH parokShatvAt punarbhavasya nAstikyamAshritAH, santi cAgamapratyayAdeva punarbhavamicchanti; shrutibhedAcca- ‘mAtaraM pitaraM caike manyante janmakAraNam | svabhAvaM paranirmANaM yadRucchAM cApare janAH’ || iti | ataH saMshayaH- kiM nu khalvasti punarbhavo na veti||6||
11.commentary: paralokaiShaNAM vyAkaroti- athetyAdi| atra ca paralokasya durj~jeyatvena cArvAkAdinAstikAsammatatvena ca paralokaM pramANena vyavasthApayituM nirNayArthaM pramANapravRuttiviShayaM saMshayameva tAvat paraloke darshayati- saMshayashcAtretyAdi| itashcyutA iha janmani mRutAH, bhaviShyAmo janmAntara ityarthaH| saMshayahetuM pRucchati- kutaH saMshayaH punariti| vAdivipratipattiM saMshayahetumAha- ucyata ityAdi| pratyakShaparA anumatapratyakShaikapramANAH| parokShatvAta pratyakShAviShayatvAt| punarbhavasya janmAntarasya| nAsti punarbhavo nAsti karmaphalaM nAstyAtmetyAdinAstinA pracaratIti nAstikaH, tasya bhAvo nAstikyam| yata pratyakShapramANenopalabhyate ghaTapaTAdi, tadeva paramasti; nopalabhyate ca pratyakSheNa paralokaH, tasmAnnAsti paraloka iti nAstikAbhiprAyaH| asti punarbhava iti yeShAM mataM tAn darshayati- santItyAdi| santi cetyatra ‘apare’ iti vAkyasheShaH| AgamapratyayAt AgamaprAmANyAt| AgamaM ca punarbhavapratipAdakaM dAnatapoyaj~jetyAdi darshayiShyatyagre| icchantItyatra ‘ye’ iti vAkyasheShaH| evaM tAvadvAdivipratipattirekA saMshayakAraNaM darshitA; saMshayahetvantaramAha- shrutibhedAccetyAdi| shrUyata iti shrutiH; prativAdivacanameva~ggranthanibaddham| etAni ca mAtApitarAveva janmakAraNamityAdIni punarbhavapratikShepakANi vacanAni| AgamapratyayAdasti punarbhava iti yo brUte, tadvacanena samaM vAdivipratipattirUpatayaiva saMshayakAraNaM bhavatItyata uktamupasaMhAre ‘ataH saMshayaH’ iti| eke manyante janmakAraNamiti janmakAraNamiti padaM mAtaraM pitaraM tathA svabhAvaM tathA paranirmANamiti padatrayeNa sambadhyate; yadRucchAM cA~apare janA ityatra manyante janmakAraNamiti padaM sambadhyate| mAtApitarAvevAtmAntaranirapekShAvapatyotpAdane kAraNaM, tena pUrvasharIraM parityajya sharIrAntaraparigraharUpa AtmanaH paraloko nAstIti prathamavAdinaH pakShaH| paridRushyamAnapRuthivyAdibhAvAnAmevAyaM svabhAvo- yat- saMyogavisheShAnmilitAH santashcetanaM puruShAdilakShaNaM kAryavisheShamArabhante, yathA surAbIjAdIni pratyekamamadakarANyapi madakaraM madyamArabhante, nAtra kashcidAtmA vidyate yasya paralokaH syAditi svabhAvavAdino bhAvaH| para aishvaryAdiguNayukta AtmavisheShaH, tena saMsAryAtmanirapekShiNA nirmANaM paranirmANaM, tatrApi parasyaivaishvaryAdiguNayuktasyAtmavisheShasya prabhAvAdbhUtAni cetayante nAtmAntaramastIti paralokAbhAvaH| yadRucchA kAraNApratiniyamenotpAdaH; na kAraNapratiniyamena kAryotpAdo~avadhArayituM shakyate, avadhArakapramANAnAM prAmANyAnavadhAraNAt; tasmAdAtmaiva punarbhavamanubhavatIti na vAcyamiti yAdRucchikasyAbhiprAyaH||6||

11.sanskrit: tatra buddhimAnnAstikyabuddhiM jahyAdvicikitsAM ca| kasmAt? pratyakShaM hyalpam; analpamapratyakShamasti, yadAgamAnumAnayuktibhirupalabhyate; yaireva tAvadindriyaiH pratyakShamupalabhyate, tAnyeva santi cApratyakShANi||7||
11.commentary: punarbhavAstitvapakShaM gRuhItvA prAha- tatretyAdi| buddhimAniti prashastabuddhiyuktaH| nAstyeva paraloka iti viparyayaj~jAnaM nAstikyabuddhiH, tAM jahyAt| paralokaviShayo viparyayo yathA dharmAnuShThAnaM prati virodhakaH, tathA stokakrameNAsti paraloko na veti saMshayo~api dharmAnuShThAnaM prati virodhaka ityAha- vicikitsAM ceti; vicikitsAM jahyAditi sambandhaH, vicikitsA sandehaH, sA ceha prakRutatvAt paralokaviShayaiva| atraiva hetuprashnapUrvakaM hetumAha- kasmAdityAdi| apratyakShatvAt paraloko nAstIti prathamavAdimataM dUShayati- pratyakShamityAdi| yathA, pratyakShaM pramANamavyabhicAripramAjanakatvena; tathA~a~agamAdInyapi tathAbhUtapramAjanakatvAt pramANAnyeva; tatashca pratyakShAviShayatvenaiva yat punarbhavasya nAstitvaM vyavasthApyate tanna yuktamiti prakaraNArthaH| punarbhavasAdhakAni cAgamAdInyagre vakShyamANAni santyeveti bhAvaH| AgamAdIni lakShaNato~agre~abhidhAsyante| pratyakShAviShayatve satyapi yAnyanyapramANasiddhAni santi tAnyAha- yairevetyAdi| pratyakShamiti pratyakShaviShayaM ghaTAdi| santIti indriyopakramaNIyoktAnumAnagamyatvAditi boddhavyam||7||

11.sanskrit: satAM ca rUpANAmatisannikarShAdativiprakarShAdAvaraNAt karaNadaurbalyAnmanonavasthAnAt samAnAbhihArAdabhibhavAdatisaukShmyAcca pratyakShAnupalabdhiH; tasmAdaparIkShitametaducyate- pratyakShamevAsti, nAnyadastIti||8||
11.commentary: itashca pratyakShAnupalabdhirna vastvabhAvanishcayakAriketyAha- satAmityAdi| satAmityagre vakShyamANAtisannikarShAdyabhAve pratyakSheNaiva gRuhyamANatvena satAmityarthaH| pratyakShAnupalabdhirityatisannikarShAdibhiH saha pratyekamabhisambadhyate| atisannikarShAdanupalabdhiryathA- nayanagatakajjalAdeH, ativiprakarShAdyathA- dUrAkAshagatasya pakShiNaH, AvaraNAdyathA- kuDyAdipihitasya ghaTAdeH, karaNadaurbalyAdyathA- kAmalAdyupahatasya cakShuShaH paTashauklyAdyapratibhAnaM, manonavasthAnAdyathA- kAntAmukhanirIkShaNaprahitamanasaH pArshvAgatavacanAnavabodhaH, samAnAbhihArAdyathA- bilvarAshipraviShTasya bilvasyendriyasambaddhasyApi bhedenAgrahaNam, abhibhavAdyathA- madhyandine ulkApAtasya, saukShmyAdyathA- tricaturhastapramANadeshavartinaH krimivisheShalikhyAderagrahaNam||8||

11.sanskrit: shrutayashcaitA na kAraNaM, yuktivirodhAt| AtmA mAtuH piturvA yaH so~apatyaM yadi sa~jcaret| dvividhaM sa~jcaredAtmA sarvovA~avayavena vA||9|| sarvashcet sa~jcarenmAtuH piturvA maraNaM bhavet| nirantaraM, nAvayavaH kashcitsUkShmasya cAtmanaH||10||
11.commentary: samprati shrutibhedavAdimataM dUShayati- shrutayashcetyAdi| na kAraNamiti na punarbhavapratiShedhe kAraNamityarthaH| yuktivirodhAt upapattivirodhAt| apatyasharIre mAtApitroH kAraNatvamanumatameva, yatastathAvidhe mAtApitroH kAraNatve satyapi caitanyahetorAtmanaH paralokAdAgamane pretyabhAvo~akhaNDita eveti| caitanyamapatyasya mAtApitrorapi caitanyaheturya AtmA tata eva bhavatIti yo manyate taM pratyAha- AtmA mAturityAdi| dvividhaM dviprakAram| sarva iti mAtaraM pitaraM parityajyApatyaM gacchet; avayaveneti eko~avayavo vA~a~atmano mAtari pitari vA tiShThet, anyashcaikadesha Atmano~apatyaM gacchet| prathamapakShe dUShaNamAha- sarvashcetyAdi| nirantaramiti cchedaH, nirantaraM tatkAlameva, yadi mAturAtmA~apatyaM sa~jcarettadA tatkAlameva mAturmaraNaM, yadi tu piturAtmA~apatyaM sa~jcarettadA tatkAlameva piturmaraNaM, syAditi| dvitIyaM pakShaM dUShayati- nAvayava ityAdi| sUkShmasyeti asthUlasya; sthUlAnAM pRuthivyAdInAmavayavA bhavanti, na tu sUkShmANAmAkAshakAlamanobuddhiprabhRutInAM; tatashcAvayavAbhAvAdAtmano~avayavena sa~jcaraNaM dUramapAstamityarthaH||9-10||

11.sanskrit: buddhirmanashca nirNIte yathaivAtmA tathaiva te| yeShAM caiShA matisteShAM yonirnAsti caturvidhA||11||
11.commentary: atha sha~gkyate- mA~a~atmA mAtApitroH sa~jcaratu, buddhistu tayormano vA~apatyaM sa~jcaratu, ata evApatyasya caitanyaM bhaviShyatItyAha- buddhirmanashcetyAdi| nirNIte vyavasthApite pramANena, kimbhUtenetyAha- yathaivAtmA niravayavatvenAvayavasa~jcaraNAkShamastathA tatkAlameva mAtApitRuparityAgaprasa~ggena kArtsnyenApi sa~jcaritumakShamaH, tathA te api buddhimanasI niravayavatvAnnaikadeshena sa~jcareyAtAM, mAtApitrostatkAlamevAbuddhimattvAmanaskatvaprasa~ggAcca na kArtsnyena sa~jcareyAtAmiti bhAvaH| dUShaNAntaramAha- yeShAmityAdi| yeShAM matiriti mAtApitarAvevApatye caitanyakAraNamityevaMrUpA| caturvidhA yoniriti jarAyujANDajasaMsvedajodbhijjalakShaNA| evaM manyate- saMsvedajAnAM mashakAdInAM tathodbhijjAnAM gaNDUpadAdInAM cetanAnAM mAtApitarau na vidyete; tatasteShAmacaitanyaM syAt, mAtApitroshcetanakAraNayorabhAvAditi||11||

11.sanskrit: vidyAt svAbhAvikaM ShaNNAM dhAtUnAM yat svalakShaNam| saMyoge ca viyoge ca teShAM karmaiva kAraNam||12||
11.commentary: svAbhAvikavAdino bhUtacaitanyapakShaM dUShayati- vidyAdityAdi| svabhAvakRutaM svAbhAvikam| ShaNNAM dhAtUnAmiti pRuthivyaptejovAyvAkAshAtmanAm, eShAM ca dhAtutvaM sharIradhAraNAjjagaddhAraNAcca| svalakShaNam AtmIyamavyabhicAri lakShaNaM; tacca pRuthivyAH kAThinyAdi, apAM dravatvAdi, tejasa uShNatvAdi, vAyostiryaggamanAdi, AkAshasyApratighAtAdi Atmano j~jAnAdi; etena, etadeva parameShAM lakShaNaM svAbhAvikaM, na tAvadAtmarahitAnAmeShAM caitanyamapi svAbhAvikamastIti darshayati| tatashca yat pratyekaM bhUtAnAM na sambhavati tanmilitAnAmapi na sambhavati caitanyaM; yato bhUtAnAmapi saMyogAccaitanyasambhave bahUni cetanAni syurbAlyAdyavasthAbhedAt, tatashca j~jAtRubhedAt pratisandhAnAnupapattiriti bhAvaH; Atmasambandhena tu caitanyaM sammatameva, paraM tatrApi garbhotpattau bhUtAnAmAtmasambandhe tathA maraNe bhUtAnAmAtmano viyoge karmaiva janmAntarakRutaM kAraNaM, nAnyat| tat bhUtasaMyogavibhAgakAraNajanmAntarakRutakarmasvIkArAt pretyabhAvaH svIkRuto bhavatIti bhAvaH||12||

11.sanskrit: anAdeshcetanAdhAtorneShyate paranirmitiH| para AtmA sa ceddheturiShTo~astu paranirmitiH||13||
11.commentary: paranirmANapakShaM dUShayati- anAderityAdi| atra paranirmANapakShe sharIrasyAtmarahitasya pareNa nirmANaM vA~abhipretaM syAt, Atmano vA~api pareNa nirmANamabhipretaM syAt; AtmanaH paranirmANaM dUShayati- anAderityAdi| nityasya cetanAdhAtoriti AtmanaH; neShyate nityasyotpAdakakAraNAbhAvAditi bhAvaH; nityatvaM cAtmanaH shArIre pratipAdayiShyati| atha sharIramAtrasya paranirmANamabhipretaM, tadanumatameva; pareNA~a~atmanA dharmAdharmasahAyena tasya kriyamANatvAdityAha- para ityAdi| heturiShTa iti sharIrotpAde heturiShTa ityarthaH; astu paranirmitirIdRushI pretyabhAvAvirodhinIti bhAvaH| evaM manyate- pareNaishvaryAdiguNayuktenAtmavisheSheNaitaccetanaM sharIraM kriyamANaM cetanAhetubhUtAtiriktAtmasambandhamantarA (cetanAyuktaM ) kartuM na pAryeta, ghaTAdivadacetanatvaprasa~ggAt; cetanAhetushcAtmA nityatvena na kriyate, tasmAccetanAhetunityatvena janmAntarasambandhinamAtmAnaM gRuhItvA sharIraM cetanaM paraH karotIti svIkaraNIyam; evamapi ceshvaradaridrAdijagadvaicitryadarshanAdAtmano dharmAdharmayogavaicitryaM kalpanIyaM; tathAca satyAtmana eva dharmAdharmasahAyatA~avashyaM svIkaraNIyA, tasmAt sa eva sharIrAdyutpattau kAraNamastu kimapareNehAtmavisheShakalpanena; yadi vA, evamAtmanyanekajanmasambandhini saMsArahetudharmAdharmaguNashAlini siddhe astu so~apyAtmavisheShaH kAraNam, ato na kAcit kShatiriti||13||

11.sanskrit: na parIkShA na parIkShyaM na kartA kAraNaM na ca| na devA narShayaH siddhAH karma karmaphalaM na ca||14|| nAstikasyAsti naivAtmA yadRucchopahatAtmanaH| pAtakebhyaH paraM caitat pAtakaM nAstikagrahaH||15||
11.commentary: yadRucchAvAdimataM dUShayati- na parIkShetyAdi| yadRucchAvAdI khalvekamapi pramANaM nAnumanyate, tatashca tasyAprAmANikatvAt pramANaM vinaiva yatki~jcidbruvato na shraddheyaM vacanaM bhavati, tasmAdupekShaNIya evAyamiti prakaraNAbhiprAyaH| yadRucchayA aparisthitapakShatayA, upahata ihalokaparalokAnupayukta AtmA yasya sa yadRucchopahatAtmA; tasya parIkShA nAstIti parIkShAhetUnAM pramANAnAmabhAvAdityarthaH; parIkShyamapi nAsti, parIkShakapramANAbhAvAdeva; evaM kartA~api nAsti tatkAraNamapi nAsti, pramANAsvIkArAditi bhAvaH; tathA sarvajanasiddhA devAdayo~api na santItyabhidhAnena nAstikasya varjanIyatvaM darshayati| pAtakebhyo brahmAvadhAdibhyaH; paraM shreShThaM; nAsti paraloka ityAdiko graho nAstikagrahaH; nAstikabuddhyA hyucchRu~gkhalaH puruShaH sarvamapi pAtakaM karotIti bhAvaH||14-15||

11.sanskrit: tasmAnmatiM vimucyaitAmamArgaprasRutAM budhaH| satAM buddhipradIpena pashyetsarvaM yathAtatham||16||
11.commentary: nAstikatAparityAgena yathAkartavyatAmAha- tasmAdityAdi| etAmiti nAstikabuddhim| amArge adharme prasRutA amArgaprasRutA| buddhireva pradIpo buddhipradIpaH, tena pratyakShAdipramANena pashyedityarthaH| yathAtathamiti yathAsvarUpam||16||

11.sanskrit: dvividhameva khalu sarvaM saccAsacca; tasya caturvidhA parIkShA- AptopadeshaH, pratyakSham, anumAnaM, yuktishceti||17||
11.commentary: samprati parapakShaM dUShayitvA svapakShaparalokasAdhanAni pramANAnyavatArayati- dvividhamityAdi| sarvamiti yatki~jcit pramANapratIyamAnaM, taddvividhaM; taddvaividhyamAha- saccAsacca; saditi vidhiviShayapramANagamyaM bhAvarUpam, asaditi niShedhaviShayapramANagamyamabhAvarUpam| parIkShyate vyavasthApyate vastusvarUpamanayeti parIkShA pramANAni, AptopadeshAdaya uttaragranthe sphuTA bhaviShyanti||17||

11.sanskrit: AptAstAvat- rajastamobhyAM nirmuktAstapoj~jAnabalena ye| yeShAM trikAlamamalaM j~jAnamavyAhataM sadA||18|| AptAH shiShTA vibuddhAste teShAM vAkyamasaMshayam| satyaM, vakShyanti te kasmAdasatyaM nIrajastamAH ||19||
11.commentary: AptopadeshaM darshayitumAptameva tAvadAha- AptA ityAdi| niHsheSheNa muktA nirmuktAH| tapoj~jAnabaleneti rajastamonirmuktau kAraNatvena yojanIyam| trikAlamiti atItAnAgatavartamAnaviShayam| amalamiti yathArthagrAhitvena| avyAhatamiti kvacidapi viShaye~akuNThitashaktitvena| AptI rajastamorUpadoShakShayaH, tadyuktA AptAH ; shAsati jagatkRutsnaM kAryAkAryapravRuttinivRuttyupadesheneti shiShTAH; boddhavyaM visheSheNa buddhametairiti vibuddhAH; AptAH, shiShTAH, vibuddhA iti sa~jj~jAtrayeNAptAnAM loke prasiddhiM darshayati; teShAmAptAnAM vAkyamasaMshayaM nishcitaM satyaM yathArthamityarthaH| tadvAkyasatyatve hetumAha- vakShanti te kasmAdasatyaM nIrajastamA iti| nIrajastamA iti tamappratyayAntaH shabdaH, tena nIrajastvaprakarSheNa tamo~api vyudastaM bhavati; na hi sarvathA nIrajaske puruShe tamo bhavati; yaduktaM- “nArajaskaM tamaH” (vi.a.6) iti| vakShanti te kasmAdasatyaM na kasmAdapItyarthaH; asatyaM mithyAj~jAnAdvA~abhidhIyate, samyagj~jAne satyapi rAgadveShAbhyAM vA~abhidhIyate, tacca tritayamapi mithyAj~jAnarAgadveSharUpaM rajastamonirmukte sattvaguNodrekAdamalavij~jAne na sambhavatItyarthaH; yadi vA ‘nIrajastamaso mRuShA’ iti pAThaH sugamaH| etaccAptalakShaNaM sahajAptabrahmAdyabhiprAyeNa, laukikAnAM tu puruShANAmAptatvaM prativiShayasamyagj~jAnasambhavane tadviShayarAgadveShAsambhavena ca boddhavyam; etena, Aptopadesha iti shabdarUpapramANalakShaNamuktaM bhavati; buddhipramANapakShe tu, AptopadeshajanitA buddhiH pramANamiti boddhavyam||18-19||

11.sanskrit: AtmendriyamanorthAnAM sannikarShAt pravartate| vyaktA tadAtve yA buddhiH pratyakShaM sa nirucyate||20||
11.commentary: pratyakShalakShaNamAha- AtmendriyetyAdi| sannikarShAditi sambandhAt; sa ca sambandhaH- saMyogaH, samavAyaH, saMyuktasamavAyaH, saMyuktasamavetasamavAyaH, samavetasamavAyaH, visheShaNavisheShyabhAvalakShaNo boddhavyaH| vyaktA ityanena vyabhicAriNImayathArthabuddhiM saMshayaM ca nirAkaroti| tadAtve tatkShaNam; anena ca pratyakShaj~jAnAnantarotpannAnumAnaj~jAnaM smaraNaM ca paramparayA~a~atmendriyamanorthasannikarShajaM vyavacchinatti; AtmAdicatuShTayasannikarShAbhidhAnaM ca pratyakShakAraNAbhidhAnaparaM; tena, ‘indriyArthasannikarShAt pravartate yA’ ityetAvadeva lakShaNaM boddhavyam; etena sukhAdiviShayamapi pratyakShaM gRuhItaM bhavati; tatra hi catuShTayasannikarSho nAsti, AtmasannikarShastu pramANaj~jAnasAdhAraNatvenaiva lakShaNAnupayuktaH | iha ca pratyakShaphalarUpA~api buddhiH pratyakShashabdenAbhidhIyate, tathaiva lokavyavahArAt; paramArthatastu yato bhavatIndriyAderIdRushI buddhistat pratyakSham||20||

11.sanskrit: pratyakShapUrvaM trividhaM trikAlaM cAnumIyate| vahnirnigUDho dhUmena maithunaM garbhadarshanAt||21|| evaM vyavasyantyatItaM bIjAt phalamanAgatam| dRuShTvA bIjAt phalaM jAtamihaiva sadRushaM budhAH||22||
11.commentary: anumAnasvarUpamAha- pratyakShetyAdi| pratyakShagrahaNaM vyAptigrAhakapramANopalakShaNArthaM, tena pratyakShapUrvamiti vyAptigrAhakapramANapUrvakam| trividhamityanenAnumAnatraividdhyaM darshayati; tena, kAryAt kAraNAnumAnaM, yathA- garbhadarshanAnmaithunAnumAnaM; tathA kAraNAt kAryAnumAnaM, yathA- bIjAt sahakArikAraNAntarayuktAt phalAnumAnaM; tathA~akAryakAraNabhUtAnAM ca sAmAnyato darshanAdanumAnaM, yathA- dhUmAdvartamAnakShaNasambandhAdagnyanumAnam; etattrividhamanumAnaM gRuhItaM bhavati| trikAlamityanena trikAlaviShayatvamanumAnasya darshayati| anumIyate ityatra ‘yena tadanumAnam’ iti vAkyasheShaH| tena, vyAptigrahaNAdanu anantaraM mIyate samya~gnishcIyate parokShArtho yena tadanumAnaM, vyAptismaraNasahAyali~ggadarshanamityarthaH| trividhamiti yaduktaM tasyodAharaNaM darshayati- vahnirityAdi| etacca vyAkRutameva | nigUDhaH adRushyamAnaH| evaM vyavasyantyatItamiti vyavacchedaH| bIjAditi sahakArikAraNAntarajalakarShaNAdiyuktAditi boddhavyam| anAgataM phalaM sadRushaM vyavasyantIti sambandhaH| dRuShTvA bIjAt phalaM jAtamityanena bIjaphalayoH kAraNakAryalakShaNAM vyAptiM darshayati; yadyapi ca kAraNaM kAryaM vyabhicarati, yato nAvashyaM bIjasadbhAve phalaM bhavati, tathA~api sahakArikAraNAntarayuktaM bIjaM phalaM na vyabhicaratItyabhiprAyo boddhavyaH; kAraNasAmagrI ca kAryaM na vyabhicaratyeva||21-22||

11.sanskrit: jalakarShaNabIjartusaMyogAt sasyasambhavaH| yuktiH ShaDdhAtusaMyogAdgarbhANAM sambhavastathA||23|| mathyamanthana(ka)manthAnasaMyogAdagnisambhavaH| yuktiyuktA catuShpAdasampadvyAdhinibarhaNI||24||
11.commentary: yukteH pramANasyAnyashAstraprasiddhatvenodAharaNAnyeva tAvaddarshayati, udAharaNe j~jAte yukterlakShaNaM sukhena j~jAyate ityabhiprAyeNa- jalakarShaNetyAdi| karShaNashabdena karShaNasaMskRutA bhUmirgRuhyate, jalakarShaNabIjartusaMyogAt sasyasya sambhavo bhavatIti yajj~jAnaM tadyuktiriti yojanIyam| ShaDdhAtusaMyogAt pa~jcamahAbhUtAtmasaMyogAt| tathAshabdo yuktirityAkarShati| mathyaM manthanakAShThayantrakaM, kAShThaM manthanaM, manthAnaM kAShThabhrAmaNaM; kiMvA ‘manthaka’ iti pAThaH, tatra manthAnaM bhrAmyamANakAShThaM; saMyogAnmelakAditi boddhavyaM, yato manthanasya kriyArUpasya saMyogo na sa~ggacchate; kiMvA manthanashabdena manthanarajjurucyate| yujyate sambadhyate~anayeti yuktiH, tayA yuktA yuktiyuktA| catuShpAda iti vaktavye sampadgrahaNaM guNavaccatuShpAdagrahaNArtham||23-24||

11.sanskrit: buddhiH pashyati yA bhAvAn bahukAraNayogajAn| yuktistrikAlA sA j~jeyA trivargaH sAdhyate yayA||25||
11.commentary: samprati yukterlakShaNamAha- buddhirityAdi| yA buddhirbhAvAn pashyati viShayIkaroti, bahukAraNayogo bahUpapattiyogaH, janishcAyaM j~jAnArthe, tena bahUpapattiyogaj~jAyamAnAnarthAn yA buddhiH pashyati UhalakShaNA sA yuktiriti pramANasahAyIbhUtA| evamanena bhavitavyamityevaMrUpa Uho~atra yuktishabdenAbhidhIyate; sA ca paramArthato~apramANabhUtA~api vastuparicchede pramANasahAyatvena vyApriyamANatvAt, tathA tayaiva UharUpayA prAyo lokAnAM vyavahArAdiha pramANatvenoktA| ata eva pradeshAntare yuktiM vinA yathoktaM pramANatrayaM darshayiShyati- “trividhA vA (parIkShA) sahopadeshena” (vi. a.4) iti vacanAt| tathA, upamAnaM gRuhItvA rogabhiShagjitIye shabdAdIni catvAri pramANAnyabhidhAsyati| trikAlA vartamAnAtItAnAgataviShayA; trikAlaviShayatvaM cAsyAstrikAlAnumAnaviShayopadeshakatvenaiva| trivargasAdhakatvaM ca trivargasAdhanAdeva, Uhenaiva hi prAyastrivargAnuShThAne pravRuttirbhavati; (pramANaparicchedena tu pracAro virala eva|) yattu bahukAraNajalakarShaNabIjartusaMyogAdbhAvisasyaj~jAnaM yuktirucyate, taccAnumAnAnnArthAntarabhUtaM; tatrAnumAnAdbhedo duShkara iti nAdriyAmahe; ki~jca kAraNebhyaH kAryaM pratIyamAnaM na kadA~api vartamAnaM pratIyate, tatashca trikAleti parAhataM syAt| atra shAntarakShitakamalashIlAbhyAM yuktipramANAntarasvIkAre pUrvapakShasiddhAntAvuktau- “yasmin sati bhavatyeva na bhavatyasatIti ca| tasmAdato bhavatyetadyuktireShA~abhidhIyate|| pramANAntaramevedamityAha carakA muniH| nAnumAnamiyaM yasmAddRuShTAnto~atra na vidyate” (ta.saM.kA.1692-93) iti| etacchAntarakShitavacanaM kamalashIlena vyAkhyAtaM- “tadbhAvabhAvitvena yA tatkAryatApratItiriyaM yuktiH; iyaM ca savikalpatvAnna pratyakShaM; nApyanumAnaM dRuShTAntAbhAvAt, tathAhi- dRuShTAnto~api- ata eva tadbhAvabhAvitvAttatkAryatApratipattiH, tatrApi dRuShTAnto~anyo~anveShaNIyaH , tatrApyapara ityanavasthA syAt; tasmAt pramANAntaraM yuktirityAha carako vaidyaH; evaM pUrvapakShamutthApya dUShitaM yat- “kAryakAraNabhAvasya pratipattirna sa~ggatA| tasmAdasyAM na bhedo~asti sAdhyasAdhanayoryataH|| tadbhAvavyavahAre tu yogyatAyAH prasAdhane| sa~gketakAlavij~jAto vidyate~artho nidarshanam” (ta.saM.kA.1696-48)| etadvyAkhyAtaM kamalashIlena- “yuktau na sAdhyasAdhanayorbhedaH; tathAhi- atra tadbhAvabhAvitA hetuH, kAryakAraNatA ca sAdhyA, na cAnayorbheda upalabhyate paryAyatvAttarupAdapavat; atha mataM- na kAryakAraNatA sAdhyate kintarhi tadbhAvavyavahAra iti, tatrAha- tadbhAvavyavahAre ityAdi; tasyA hetuphalatAyA bhAvastadbhAvaH, tatra vyavahAro yaH sa tadbhAvavyavahAraH j~jAnAbhidhAnapravRuttilakShaNamanuShThAnaM, tasmin yogyatA mUDhaM prati sAdhyate; ye yadvyApArAnantaraniyatopalambhasvabhAvAste tatkAryavyavahArayogyAH, tadyathA- sa~gketakAlAnubhUtAH kulAlAdivyApArAnantaropalambhasvabhAvA ghaTAdayaH; tathA ca tAlvAdivyApArAnantaraniyatopalambhasvabhAvAH shabdA iti svabhAvo hetuH; tatashca sa dRuShTAntatvAdanumAnAdabhedo yukteH”| etau ca pUrvapakShasiddhAntau evambhUtayuktyasvIkArAdevApratividheyau ||25||

11.sanskrit: eShA parIkShA nAstyanyA yayA sarvaM parIkShyate| parIkShyaM sadasaccaivaM tayA cAsti punarbhavaH||26||
11.commentary: upasaMharati- eShetyAdi| nAstyanyetivacanenArthApattyasambhavAdInAmanyatantramatAnAM pramANAnAM niShedhaM karoti| prastute parIkShAM prayojayati- tayA cAsti upalabhyate ca punarbhava iti||26||

11.sanskrit: tatrAptAgamastAvadvedaH , yashcAnyo~api kashcidvedArthAdaviparItaH parIkShakaiH praNItaH shiShTAnumato lokAnugrahapravRuttaH shAstravAdaH, sa cA~a~aptAgamaH; AptAgamAdupalabhyatedAnatapoyaj~jasatyAhiMsAbrahmacaryANyabhyudayaniHshreyasakarANIti||27||
11.commentary: tatra shabdasya punarbhavapratipAdakatvaM darshayati- tatrA~a~aptAgama ityAdi| prathamaM vedaM pradarshayan vedasya nirastavibhramAsha~gkaM prAmANyaM darshayati, yashcAnyo~apItyanena granthena vedArthAviparItatvAdibhirhetubhiH paricchedanIyaprAmANyAyurvedasmRutishAstrAdIni darshayati| shAstrarUpo vAdaH shAstravAdaH| AptAgamAditi vedAt| yaj~jaH agniShTomAdiH; brahmAcaryam upasthasaMyamAdi| abhyudayaH svargaH, niHshreyasaM mokShaH; atra yathAyogyatayA svargasya mokShasya ca kAraNamiti boddhavyam| etena janmAntarabhogyasvargAnekajanmalabhyamokShopadeshenAtmanaH paralokaH kathito bhavatIti bhAvaH||27||

11.sanskrit: na cAnativRuttasattvadoShANAmadoShairapunarbhavo dharmadvAreShUpadishyate||28||
11.commentary: AgamAntaramAha- na cetyAdi| anativRuttau avanupashAntau sattvadoShau manodoShau rajastamorUpau yeShAM te tathA, teShAm; punarbhavo mokShaH, dharmadvAreShu dharmashAstreShu, adoShaiH nirmanodoShairmaharShibhiH, upadishyate na, iti sambandhaH; tena punarbhava upadishyate ityarthaH||28||

11.sanskrit: dharmadvArAvahitaishca vyapagatabhayarAgadveShalobhamohamAnairbrahmaparairAptaiH karmavidbhiranupahatasattvabuddhipracAraiH pUrvaiH pUrvatarairmaharShibhirdivyacakShubhirdRuShTvopadiShTaH punarbhava iti vyavasyedevam ||29||
11.commentary: AgamAntaramRuShivacanamAha- dharmadvAretyAdi| brahmA adhyAtmaj~jAnaM, tatparaiH| karmavidbhiH anuShThAtavyayAgAdikarmavidbhiH| anupahatasattvaguNo buddheH pracAro bodhalakShaNo yeShAM te tathA, etena vishuddhabuddhitvaM darshayati| divyamatIndriyArthadarshi cakShuH samAdhirUpaM j~jAnaM yeShAM te divyacakShuShaH, taiH| dRuShTvopadiShTaH svayamanubhUya kathita ityarthaH| itishabdo hetau| evamiti Agamena||29||

11.sanskrit: pratyakShamapi copalabhyate- mAtApitrorvisadRushAnyapatyAni, tulyasambhavAnAM varNasvarAkRutisattvabuddhibhAgyavisheShAH, pravarAvarakulajanma, dAsyaishvaryaM, sukhAsukhamAyuH, AyuSho vaiShamyam, iha kRutasyAvAptiH, ashikShitAnAM ca ruditastanapAnahAsatrAsAdInAM pravRuttiH, lakShaNotpattiH, karmasAdRushye phalavisheShaH, medhA kvacit kvacit karmaNyamedhA, jAtismaraNam- ihAgamanamitashcyutAnAmiti , samadarshane priyApriyatvam||30||
11.commentary: pratyakShaM ca yadyapi punarbhavaM na gRuhNAti, tathA~api tat punarbhavagrAhakAnumAnasya li~ggagrahaNe yathA vyApriyate tathA darshayati- pratyakShamapItyAdi| visadRushAnIti kashcit kurUpaH, kashcit surUpaH| tulyasambhavAnAM tulyotpAdakAraNAnAM kashcidgauraH kashcit kRuShNaH, evaM svarAdAvapi visheSho boddhavyaH| dAsyaishvaryamiti kasyaciddAsyaM kasyacidaishvaryam| evamaparatrApi viparyayaH puruShabhedena boddhavyaH| sukhAsukhamiti AyuSho visheShaNam| ruditAdayo~amI avyutpannabAlagocaratayA boddhavyAH; ete ca ruditAdayo yathAyogamiShTAniShTasmaraNamantarA na bhavanti, smaraNaM ca pUrvaj~jAnaM vinA na bhavatIti pUrvajanmaj~jAnAnumAnAt paralokAnumAyakA bhavanti| pUrvapratipAditaM ca visadRushatvAdivaicitryamuttaratra pratipAdanIyaM ca lakShaNotpattyAdikAraNAntarAdarshane sati pUrvajanmakRutakAraNAnumAyakamiti paralokAnumAyakaM mantavyam| lakShaNotpattiriti sAmudrakalakShaNapratipAditalakShaNotpattiH| karmasAdRushye sevAdisAdRushye| medhA kvacit karmaNi citralekhanAstravidyAdau| jAteratItAyAH smaraNaM jAtismaraNaM; tadeva smaraNaM darshayati- ihAgamanamitashcyutAnAmiti; iha kule jAto~asmi, itashca kulAdAgato~asmItyevamAkAraM jAtismaraNamityarthaH yadi vA, iha janmani cyutAnAmiha janmani punarAgamanam, anena ca nAmabhrAntyA yamapuruShairnItasya punarAgamanaM dRushyate| samadarshane tulyAkAre kvacit puruShe priyatvaM kvacit punarapriyatvamiti samadarshane priyApriyatvam| atra cAvAntarAnumAnabhedo vistarabhayAnna darshitaH||30||

11.sanskrit: ata evAnumIyate- yat- svakRutamaparihAryamavinAshi paurvadehikaM daivasa~jj~jakamAnubandhikaM karma, tasyaitat phalam; itashcAnyadbhaviShyatIti; phaladbIjamanumIyate, phalaM ca bIjAt||31||
11.commentary: evaM pratyakSheNa li~ggagrahaNaM darshayitvA~anumAnamAha- ata evetyAdi| svakRutam AtmanA kRutam| avinAshIti upabhogaM vinA~avinAshi| paurvadehikaM pUrvadehakRutam| janmAntarANyanugacchatItyAnubandhikam| etatphalamiti visadRushApatyotpAdAdi phalam; etacca sa~gkShepAdvyutpAditameva| itashceti iha janmani kRutAt karmaNaH, anyaditi bhAvijanmAntaraM, bhaviShyatItyanumIyata iti sambandhaH| kathamanumIyate ityAha- phalAdityAdi| phalAt phalasadRushApatyadarshanAt , bIjaM pUrvajanmakRutaM karmAdikAraNamanumIyate; tathA phalaM ca bhAvijanmAntare sukhaduHkhAdi, bIjAdihajanmakRutAt karmaNo~anumIyata iti yojanA||31||

11.sanskrit: yuktishcaiShA- ShaDdhAtusamudayAdgarbhajanma, kartRukaraNasaMyogAt kriyA; kRutasya karmaNaH phalaM nAkRutasya, nA~gkurotpattirabIjAt; karmasadRushaM phalaM, nAnyasmAdbIjAdanyasyotpattiH; iti yuktiH||32||
11.commentary: tarkarUpayuktiviShayatAM paralokasya darshayati- yuktishcaiShetyAdi| ShaDdhAtusamudAyAdgarbhajanmeti vadatA AtmasambandhamantarA cetanA garbhasya notpadyate, AtmA ca paralokasambandha eveti paralokasadbhAve yuktirupadarshyate| kartRukaraNasaMyogAt kriyeti AtmAnaM kartAraM vinA kriyA paridRushyamAnA yAgAdilakShaNA na bhavatIti| Atmana UhaM darshayati- kRutasyetyAdinA~abIjAdityantena| paridRushyamAnadAsyaishvaryAdiphalena janmAntarakRutasya karmaNaH kAraNabhAvaM darshayati| karmasadRushaM phalamiti pUrvakRutashubhakarmaNaH shubhaM putradhanAdi phalam| atra dRuShTAntamAha- nAnyasmAdityAdi| nAnyabIjAt shAlibIjAdanyasya yavA~gkurasyotpattirityarthaH| yuktimupasaMharati- iti yuktiriti| atra bahuvaktavye prameye tathAvidhopayogAbhAvAdvistarabhayAcca vistaro na kRutaH||32||

11.sanskrit: evaM pramANaishcaturbhirupadiShTe punarbhave dharmadvAreShvavadhIyeta; tadyathA- gurushushrUShAyAmadhyayane vratacaryAyAM dArakriyAyAmapatyotpAdane bhRutyabharaNe~atithipUjAyAM dAne~anabhidhyAyAM tapasyanasUyAyAM dehavA~gmAnase karmaNyakliShTe dehendriyamanorthabuddhyAtmaparIkShAyAM manaHsamAdhAviti; yAni cAnyAnyapyevaMvidhAni karmANi satAmavigarhitAni svargyANi vRuttipuShTikarANi vidyAttAnyArabheta kartuM; tathA kurvanniha caiva yasho labhate pretya ca svargam| iti tRutIyA paralokaiShaNA vyAkhyAtA bhavati||33||
11.commentary: samprati paralokaM vyutpAdya tadupayuktadharmasAdhanAnyAha- evamityAdi| dharmadvAreShu dharmasAdhanadvAreShu| iha cAtithipUjAdIni sadvRuttoktAnyapi prakaraNaprAptatvenodAharaNArthaM punarabhidhIyante| dehAdiparIkShAyAmavadhIyeteti vacanAdavadhAnopadarshanena dehAdInAM kShayitvAdi dharmanirUpaNenopajAyamAnAM matiM viShayAnabhiSha~ggaM ca jAyamAnamicchanti| viShayeShu prasaktiM manaso vArayitvA~a~atmani samAdhAnaM manaHsamAdhiH| atra ca sarvatra ‘avadhIyeta’ iti sambandhaH| svargyANi svargahitAni svargakarANIti yAvat| vRutterdhanasya puShTiH vRuttipuShTiH, dharmaiShaNAyAM ca vRuttipuShTikarAbhidhAnaM dharmahetUnAM vRuttihetvavirodhenAcaraNopadeshArtham| yasho labhate dhArmiko~ayamityevamAdikhyAtirUpam| paralaukaiShaNA tRutIyaiva, tatashca punastRutIyeti padaM dharmasya prANadhanakAraNatvena dharmaiShaNAyAH prANadhanaiShaNAtvaprasaktipratiShedhArtham||33||

11.sanskrit: atha khalu traya upastambhAH, trividhaM balaM, trINyAyatanAni, trayo rogAH, trayo rogamArgAH, trividhA bhiShajaH, trividhamauShadhamiti||34||
11.commentary: samprati trisa~gkhyAvacchinnopoddhAtenAnyAnyapi trisa~gkhyAvacchinnAni svasthAturahitatveneha vaktavyAnyAha- atha khalvityAdi| prathamamupastambhA abhidhIyante mUlabhUtasharIradhArakatvena, tadanu balamupastambhAhArAdijanyatvAt, tadanu rogAyatanAni balavirodhakartRutvena, tadanu rogAstajjanyatvena, tadanu tanmArgaj~jAnaM suvinyastameva, tadanu rogapratiShedhArthaM pradhAnakAraNavaidyAbhidhAnaM, tadanu tadupakaraNatvena bhaiShajyam||34||

11.sanskrit: traya upastambhA iti- AhAraH, svapno, brahmacaryamiti; ebhistribhiryuktiyuktairupastabdhamupastambhaiH sharIraM balavarNopacayopacitamanuvartate yAvadAyuHsaMskArAt saMskAramahitamanupasevamAnasya , ya ihaivopadekShyate||35||
11.commentary: anyena stabhyamAnaM dhAryamANamupa samIpaM pradhAnakAraNasya gatvA stambhayati dhArayatItyupastambhaH; yathA gRuhadhAraNaniyuktapradhAnastambhasamIpavartI tadbalAdhAyaka upastambhaH, tathehApi sharIrasyAyuHsampravartakena karmaNA dhriyamANasyAhArAdayo dhArakatvenopastambhA ityucyante| AyatanAni kAraNAni ‘rogasya’ iti sheShaH| brahmacaryashabdena indriyasaMyamasaumanasyaprabhRutayo brahmaj~jAnAnuguNA gRuhyante| AhArAdayashceha pradhAnakalpanayA prashastA eva gRuhyante, tena virUDhakAhArAdInAM sharIrAnustambhakatvaM nodbhAvanIyam; ata eva yuktiyuktairiti visheShaNaM kariShyati, yuktyA prashastena yogena yuktA yuktiyuktAH| brahmacaryasyAyuktiranabhyAsAdatimAtrendriyasaMyamanAdirUpA, sA hi manaHkShobhAdiheturbhavati| upacitaM yuktam| AyuHsaMskArAt AyuHkAraNaM dharmAdharmAvasAnaM yAvadityarthaH; saMskArashabdaH kAraNavacanaH| AhArAdayashca prAdhAnyenoktAH; tenAbhya~ggAdInAM sharIradhArakatvamaviruddhameva| nanvAhArAdIni samyagAcarato~api visheShairasAtmendriyArthasaMyogAdijanyairvyAdhibhirantarApi maraNaM dRuShTamityAha- saMskAramityAdi| saMskAraM kAraNam| ahitaM ‘sharIrasya’ iti sheShaH| ya ihaivopadekShyata iti ‘trINyAyatanAni’ ityAdinA granthena||35||

11.sanskrit: trividhaM balamiti- sahajaM, kAlajaM, yuktikRutaM ca| sahajaM yaccharIrasattvayoH prAkRutaM, kAlakRutamRutuvibhAgajaM vayaHkRutaM ca, yuktikRutaM punastadyadAhAraceShTAyogajam||36||
11.commentary: yuktiH AhAraceShTayoH samyak sharIreNa yojanA| sattvaM manaH, manaso balaM vA yat ‘utsAha ’ ucyate| prAkRutamiti janmAdipravRuttaM prAkRutadhAtuvRuddhyA hetvantaranirapekShaM vRuddhaM, dRushyante hi kecit svabhAvAdeva balino durbalAshca kecit| RutuvibhAgajam “AdAvante ca daurbalyaM” (sU.a.6) ityAdyuktam| AhArasya mAMsasarpirAdeH, ceShTAyA ucitavishrAmavyAyAmAderyoga AhAraceShTAyogaH; anye tu yogashabdena rasAyanaprayogaM grAhayanti||36||

11.sanskrit: trINyAyatanAnIti- arthAnAM karmaNaH kAlasya cAtiyogAyogamithyAyogAH| tatrAtiprabhAvatAM dRushyAnAmatimAtraM darshanamatiyogaH, sarvasho~adarshanamayogaH, atishliShTAtiviprakRuShTaraudrabhairavAdbhutadviShTabIbhatsanavikRutavitrAsanAdirUpadarshanaM mithyAyogaH; tathA~atimAtrastanitapaTahotkruShTAdInAM shabdAnAmatimAtraM shravaNamatiyogaH, sarvasho~ashravaNamayogaH, paruSheShTavinAshopaghAtapradharShaNabhIShaNAdishabdashravaNaM mithyAyogaH; tathA~atitIkShNogrAbhiShyandinAM gandhAnAmatimAtraM ghrANamatiyogaH, sarvasho~aghrANamayogaH, pUtidviShTAmedhyaklinnaviShapavanakuNapagandhAdighrANaM mithyAyogaH; tathA rasAnAmatyAdAnamatiyogaH, sarvasho~anAdAnamayogaH, mithyAyogo rAshivarjyeShvAhAravidhivisheShAyataneShUpadekShyate; tathA~atishItoShNAnAM spRushyAnAM snAnAbhya~ggotsAdanAdInAM cAtyupasevanamatiyogaH, sarvasho~anupasevanamayogaH, snAnAdInAM shItoShNAdInAM ca spRushyAnAmanAnupUrvyopasevanaM viShamasthAnAbhighAtAshucibhUtasaMsparshAdayashceti mithyAyogaH||37||
11.commentary: arthAnAm indriyArthAnAm| karmaNaH kAyavA~gmanaHpravRutteH| kAlasya shItoShNavarShalakShaNasya| atiprabhAvatAm AtapAgniprabhRutInAm| atra hInamAtradarshanaM vikAraM na karoti, tena ‘sarvasha’ ityuktam| adarshanaM cAtiprabhAvatAmeva boddhavyam, aprabhAvatAM ca ghaTAdInAM darshanamatiyogAdapi na doShakaram; evamanyatrApi sarvasha iti vyAkhyeyam| atishliShTaM nayanapratyAsannam, ativiprakRuShTam atidUravarti, raudram adbhutakAraNAtmakaM bhayajanakaM, bhairavam anadbhutamapi vyAghrAdi, diShTaM yadyasya dveShyaM, bIbhatsanaM manasa udvegakArakaM, vikRutaM hInA~ggAdi, vitrAsanaM jhaTiti bhayajanakam; AdigrahaNAdamedhyAdInAM grahaNam| raudrAdayo yadyapi na rUpaM kintvAkRutivisheShAH, tathA~api rUpaikArthasamavAyena cakShurarthA eva; na cehendriyArthagrahaNena rUpAdInAmeva paraM grahaNamiti pUrvameva vyAkhyAtaM, yataH sparshanarasanayoH samyagyoge~asamyagyoge ca bahavaH sparsharasavyatiriktAH snAnAbhya~ggAdayaH prakRutisaMyogasaMskArAdayashca kAraNatvena vaktavyAH| atimAtrastanitaM pravRuddho meghadhvaniH, paTahaH paTahashabdaH, utkruShTaM darpAdatimAtraM shabditaM, pradharShaNaM tiraskAraH| tIkShNo gandhashcakShurvirecanakArakaH, yathA- kRuShNajIrakAdInAm; ugro vamanakArako vacAdInAm; abhiShyandI staimityakArako mastusurAsavAdInAM ; pUti atyarthaklinnaM; viShayuktaH pavano viShapavanaH; kuNapaH shavaH| rasAnAmiti rasasahitAnAM dravyANAm| ihAnAdAnamiti kurvan hInayogo~api rasAnAM vikArakara iti darshayati| AhAravidhivisheShAyatanAni rasavimAne vakShyamANAni “prakRutikaraNasaMyogarAshideshakAlopayogasaMsthopayotkraShTamAni” (vi.a.1); tatra rAshivarjyeShvitivacanena rAshiM pRuthakkaroti, rAsherAhArasya parimANarUpasya yo doShaH- hInamAtratvamatimAtratvaM vA, tasyAtiyogAyogAbhyAmeva gRuhItatvAt; na mithyAyogo rAsheH sambhavati; uktaM hi- “rAshiH punarmAtrAmAtrAphalavinishcayArthaH” (vi.a.1.) iti| prakRutyAdInAM tu doShAdAhArasya mithyAyoga eva paraM sambhavati, yataH prakRutiviruddhAnAM mAShAdInAM bhojanaM mithyAyoga evAhArasya bhavati; evaM saMskAraviruddhashaktupiNDike~api mithyAyoga eva, tathA saMyogaviruddhasamadhRutamadhusarpirupayoge~api; evaM kAlAdiviruddhodAharaNamapi rasavimAne pratipAditaM sarvaM mithyAyogarUpameva, teShAmayogAtiyoganirapekShANAmeva doShakartRutvAt| shItoShNAdInAmityAdi| yadyapi shItoShNAdInAmabhya~ggAdInAM ca hInayogo~api rogakarastathA~api sarvasho~anupasevanamiti vacanaM sarvasho~anupasevanasya bhUripravyaktavikArakartRutvAbhiprAyeNa| anAnupUrvyA yathoktakramala~gghanena, yathA- snAtvA utsAdanaM, tathoShNapIDitasya sahasA shItalapAnIyAvagAhanam, evamAdi| abhighAtaH kha~ggahananAdi, bhUtAH prANinaH pishAcaprabhRutayaH| AdigrahaNAdyatki~jcit sparshanasambaddhaM sharIropaghAtakamayogAtiyogavyatiriktaM tadgRuhyate||37||

11.sanskrit: tatraikaM sparshanamindriyANAmindriyavyApakaM , cetaH- samavAyi, sparshanavyAptervyApakamapi ca cetaH; tasmAt sarvendriyANAM vyApakasparshakRuto yo bhAvavisheShaH, so~ayamanupashayAt pa~jcavidhastrividhavikalpo bhavatyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH; sAtmyArtho hyupashayArthaH||38||
11.commentary: nanu cakShurAdIni pa~jcendriyANi, atasteShAM pratiniyatAH pa~jcAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogAH, tat kathameko~asAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga ityAkhyAyata ityAsha~gkya sparshanendriyasya sarvendriyavyApakatvaM darshayitvA sarvendriyAnugataM sparshamarthagrahaNakAraNamekarUpaM darshayati, tatashca tasyaikasyAsAtmyendriyArthena saMyogAdupapanna ekarUpo~asAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga iti darshayati- tatraikamityAdinA sAtmyArtho hyupashayArtha ityantena| ekaM sparshanamiti sparshanendriyameva, nAnyaccakShurAdi| indriyANAmiti nirdhAraNe ShaShThI| indriyANi cakShurAdIni vyApnotItIndriyavyApakaM; sparshanaM hi sarveShvindriyeShvasti, ata eva spRuShTvaivArthamindriyANi gRuhNanti| tarhi kathaM na sarvadA~arthagrahaNaM bhavatItyata Aha- ceta ityAdinA| shrotraM cAsmaddarshane pA~jcabhautikaM karNashaShkulIgatanabhorUpaM, tena tasyApi sparsho~asti; cetaHsamavAyi manaHsambandhi; manaHsambandhakathanena cArthagrahaNaM prati samarthatvaM sparshasya darshayati, mano~adhiShThitAnAmindriyANAmarthagrAhakatvAt| tat kimaNuparimANena manasaikatrasthitenaiva sparshanasya sarvendriyavyApakasya sambandhAt sarvendriyANi pravartante, tathA sati yugapatpa~jcaj~jAnotpattiprasa~gga ityAha- sparshanendriyavyAptervyApakamapi ceta iti| sparshanenendriyANAM vyAptiH sparshanendriyavyAptiH, tasyAshceto~api vyApakam; etaduktaM bhavati- yAvati pradeshe sparshanaM tiShThati tAvantaM deshaM mano~api bhramati pratyakSheNArthagrahaNArthaM, tena yasmin pradeshe yadA mano vartate tadA tena pradeshena cakShurAdirUpeNArthaM gRuhNAtIti na yugapajj~jAnotpattiH| prakRute yojayati- tasmAdityAdi| vyApakashcAsau sparshashceti vyApakasparshaH, tena kRutastannibandhanaH; sarvendriyANAM bhAvavisheShaH svabhAvavisheSho~arthagrahaNakAraNIbhUtaH sparsha ityarthaH; yamadhikRutyoktam- “sparshanendriyasaMsparshaH sparsho mAnasa eva ca| dvividhaH sukhaduHkhAnAM vedanAnAM pravartakaH” (shA. a.1) iti; atra shloke sparshanasambandhakRutaH sarvendriyasparshaH sparshanendriyasaMsparshashabdenoktaH, mAnasastu sparshashcintyena viShayeNa satA~api sambhavatIti tatraiva vyAkhyeyam| visheSha ityatra ‘asti’ iti sheShaH| so~ayamekasyendriyavyApakasya sparshasyaikarUpo~asAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH, anupashayAditi duHkhakartRutvAt, pa~jcavidhaH cakShurasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogo ghrANAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga ityAdirUpaH san, punastrividhavikalpo bhavati- ayogAtiyogamithyAyogeneti bhAvaH| evaM caikaprakArastriprakArastathA pa~jcadashaprakAro~asAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga ukto bhavati| anupashayashabdena cakShurAdyanupashayavisheSho~atrAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogasya pa~jcavidhahetutvopadeshAdboddhavyaH, na hyekarUpo~anupashayaH pa~jcavidhatvamasAtmyendriyArthasya kartuM samarthaH, yatashcakShurAdInAM pratiniyatAnyevopaghAtakAnyatibhAsvararUpAdIni, tatashca sparshendriyavyAptyA~api naikasparshanendriyatvaM cakShurAdInAm, ekatve hyekendriyopaghAtakamanyeShAmapyupaghAtakaM syAditi mantavyam| sAtmyopashayayorekArthatAM darshayati- sAtmyArtho hyupashayArtha iti| etenAnupashayenendriyArthasaMyogaM darshayitvA~asAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga iti sa~jj~jAkaraNamaviruddhamiti darshitaM bhavati||38||

11.sanskrit: karma vA~gmanaHsharIrapravRuttiH| tatra vA~gmanaHsharIrAtipravRuttiratiyogaH; sarvasho~apravRuttirayogaH; vegadhAraNodIraNaviShamaskhalanapatanA~ggapraNidhAnA~ggapradUShaNaprahAramardanaprANoparodhasa~gkleshanAdiH shArIro mithyAyogaH, sUcakAnRutAkAlakalahApriyAbaddhAnupacAraparuShavacanAdirvA~gmithyAyogaH, bhayashokakrodhalobhamohamAnerShyAmithyAdarshanAdirmAnaso mithyAyogaH||39||
11.commentary: arthAnAmayogAtiyogamithyAyogAnabhidhAya karmaNastAnAha- karmetyAdi| atra yadyapi bhUripradhAnasharIrarogakartRutvena pUrvaM shArIrameva karmAsAtmyamabhidhAtuM yujyate, tathA~apyalpatvena vA~gmanase karmaNI pUrvamukte, pratyekamithyAyogakathane tu prAdhAnyAcchArIra eva mithyAyogaH prathamaM darshitaH| atrAtiyogarUpA~atipravRuttistathA~ayogarUpA~apravRuttirvihitAnAM kAyavA~gmanaH karmaNAM boddhavyA, ahitAcaraNasya tu sarvasya mithyAyogatvena vaktavyatvAt| vegodIraNam aprAptavegodIraNam| viShamashabdo~a~ggapraNidhAnAntaiH sabadhyate| a~ggadUShaNam atikaNDUyanAdibhiH| sa~gkleshanaM madyAtapajalasecanAdibhiH| abaddhavacanam asambaddhM yAvattAvatkIrtanam| anupacAravacanam| iha cAnRutavacanAdayo~adharmadvAreNa rogakarAH||39||

11.sanskrit: sa~ggraheNa cAtiyogAyogavarjaM karma vA~gmanaHsharIrajamahitamanupadiShTaM yattacca mithyAyogaM vidyAt||40||
11.commentary: anuktamithyAyogasa~ggrahArthamAha- sa~ggraheNetyAdi| ahitamiha janmani, anupadiShTamityanena paraloke~adharmahetutayA pApakArakaM paradArasevAdi grAhayati; etena yaducyate- adharmasyAgrahaNAnnyUnametadAyatanakathanamiti, tanna bhavati| shArIramAnasikavAcanikakarmamithyAyogenaivAdharmotpAdAvAntaravyApAreNAdharmajanyAnAM vikArANAM kriyamANatvAt, yathA- agniShTomena svargaH kriyate dharmotpAdAvAntaravyApAreNaiva; anye tu kAlamithyAyoge~adharmaM kShipanti, adharmo hi kAlavashAdeva phalati na tatkAlamiti kRutvA; etacca prathamAdhyAya eva prapa~jcitam||40||

11.sanskrit: iti trividhavikalpaM trividhameva karma praj~jAparAdha iti vyavasyet||41||
11.commentary: samprati karmAsamyagyogaH praj~jAparAdhamUlatvAt praj~jAparAdha evocyata iti trividhamityAdinA darshayan, yaduktaM pUrvaM hetutrayakathane “asAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH praj~jAparAdhaH pariNAmashca” ityasyAvirodhaM darshayati; evaM yadagre vakShyati ‘kAlaH punaH pariNAma ucyate’ tatrApi pUrvoktAvirodhopadarshanaM vyAkhyeyamiti| trividhavikalpamihAtiyogAdirUpam||41||

11.sanskrit: shItoShNavarShalakShaNAH punarhemantagrIShmavarShAH saMvatsaraH, sa kAlaH| tatrAtimAtrasvalakShaNaH kAlaH kAlAtiyogaH, hInasvalakShaNaH (kAlaH) kAlAyogaH, yathAsvalakShaNaviparItalakShaNastu (kAlaH) kAlamithyAyogaH| kAlaH punaH pariNAma ucyate||42||
11.commentary: kAlAtishayayogAdIn darshayati- shItoShNetyAdi| atimAtrasvalakShaNaH atimAtrashItAdiH| yathAsvalakShaNAcchItAderviparItalakShaNo yathA- hemante varShaNaM, varShAsu shItamityAdi||42||

11.sanskrit: ityasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH, praj~jAparAdhaH, pariNAmashceti trayastrividhavikalpA hetavo vikArANAM; samayogayuktAstu prakRutihetavo bhavanti||43||
11.commentary: AyatanAnyupasaMharati- itItyAdi| vikArANAM hetavo bhavantIti sambandhaH; tathA samayogayuktAH samyagyogayuktAH prakRutihetavo bhavantIti yojyaM; prakRutiH Arogyam||43||

11.sanskrit: sarveShAmeva bhAvAnAM bhAvAbhAvau nAntareNa yogAyogAtiyogamithyAyogAn samupalabhyete; yathAsvayuktyapekShiNau hi bhAvAbhAvau||44||
11.commentary: idAnIM dhAtusAmyavaiShamyahetutvena samyagyogAyogau ca pratipAdya bAhyAnAmapi vRukShaghaTAdInAM samyaksthitivinAshayoH samyagyogAyogAveva kAraNamiti dRuShTAntArthaM bhAvasvarUpaj~jAnArthaM cAha- sarveShAmityAdi| bhAvaH samyagavasthAnam, abhAvaH, asamyagavasthAnaM vinAsho vA; yogAt samyagyogAdbhAvaH, ayogAdibhyo~abhAvaH; yathAsvaM yuktiryA yasya bhAvasyAbhAvasya vA yuktiH svakAraNayuktiH, tadapekShiNau bhavata iti sambandhaH| yathA- vRukShasya bhAve avasthAne~anatyalpapAnIyayogAdiryuktiH, abhAve tu vRukShasya pAnIyAtapAtiyogAyogau tathA vajrapAtAdiryuktiH; tatastadapekShau vRukShasya bhAvAbhAvau bhavata ityAdi kalpanIyam||44||

11.sanskrit: trayo rogA iti- nijAgantumAnasAH| tatra nijaH shArIradoShasamutthaH, AganturbhUtaviShavAyvagnisamprahArAdisamutthaH, mAnasaH punariShTasya lAbhAllAbhAccAniShTasyopajAyate||45||
