11.commentary: rogAnAha- trayo rogA ityAdi| iShTalAbhAjjAyate kAmaharShAdiH, aniShTapriyaviyogAdilAbhAcca shokAdayaH; yadi vA ‘iShTasyAlAbhAllAbhAccAniShTasya’ iti pAThaH; atra tu pAThe cakArAdiShTalAbho~api heturboddhavyaH||45||

11.sanskrit: tatra buddhimatA mAnasavyAdhiparItenApi satA buddhyA hitAhitamavekShyAvekShya dharmArthakAmAnAmahitAnAmanupasevane hitAnAM copasevane prayatitavyaM, na hyantareNa loke trayametanmAnasaM ki~jcinniShpadyate sukhaM vA duHkhaM vA; tasmAdetaccAnuShTheyaM- tadvidyAnAM copasevane prayatitavyam, AtmadeshakulakAlabalashaktij~jAne yathAvacceti||46||
11.commentary: samprati mAnasavyAdhicikitsAyA alpavaktavyatvenehaiva taccikitsAmAha- tatretyAdi| mAnasavyAdhiparItenApIti apishabdena shArIravyAdhiyuktenApi vakShyamANamanuShTheyamiti sUcayati| trayametaddharmArthakAmarUpaM mAnasaM sukhaM vA mAnasaM duHkhaM vA niShpadyata iti yojyam| tadvidya iha mAnasavyAdhibheShajavedI| AtmadeshetyAdi|- ko~ahaM, kiM me hitamityAtmaj~jAnaM; ko deshaH, asmin kimucitamiti deshaj~jAnam; evaM kAlAdAvapi j~jAnaM boddhavyam||46||

11.sanskrit: bhavati cAtra- mAnasaM prati bhaiShajyaM trivargasyAnvavekShaNam| tadvidyasevA vij~jAnamAtmAdInAM ca sarvashaH||47||
11.commentary: sampratyamumevArthaM sukhagrahaNArthaM shlokenAha- mAnasaM pratItyAdi|- mAnasaM vikAramiti bhAvaH| trivargasya dharmAdeH||47||

11.sanskrit: trayo rogamArgA iti- shAkhA, marmAsthisandhayaH, koShThashca| tatra shAkhA raktAdayo dhAtavastvak ca, sa bAhyo rogamArgaH; marmANi punarbastihRudayamUrdhAdIni, asthisandhayo~asthisaMyogAstatropanibaddhAshca snAyukaNDarAH , sa madhyamo rogamArgaH; koShThaH punarucyate mahAsrotaH sharIramadhyaM mahAnimnamAmapakvAshayashceti paryAyashabdaistantre, sa rogamArga AbhyantaraH||48||
11.commentary: atra rogamArgAnAha - traya ityAdi| marmAsthisandhibhyAmeko mArgaH| atra shAkhetisa~jj~jAkaraNaM vyavahArArthaM, tathA raktAdInAM dhAtUnAM shAkhAbhidheyAnAM vRukShashAkhAtulyatvena bAhyatvaj~jApanArtham| tvakceti tvakshabdena tadAshrayo raso~api gRuhyate; sAkShAttu rasAnabhidhAnaM hRudayasthAyino rasasya shAkhAsa~jj~jAvyavacchedArthaM , tasya hi koShThagrahaNenaiva grahaNam; anena nyAyena yakRutplIhAshritaM ca shoNitaM koShThatvenaivAbhipretamiti boddhavyaM, samAnanyAyatvAt | uktaM ca koShThavivaraNe- “sthAnAnyAmAgnipakvAnAM mUtrasya rudhirasya ca| hRuduNDukaH phuphphusashca koShTha ityabhidhIyate” (su.ci. a.2) iti| asthisandhivivaraNam- asthisaMyogA ityAdi| tatreti asthisandhau| kaNDarA iha tantre sthUlasnAyuH| Amasya pakvasya cAshaya AmapakvAshayaH| etacca mArgabhedakathanaM tadAshritavyAdhInAM sukhasAdhyatvAdij~jAnArtham||48||

11.sanskrit: tatra, gaNDapiDakAlajyapacIcarmakIlAdhimAMsamaShakakuShThavya~ggAdayo vikArA bahirmArgajAshca visarpashvayathugulmArshovidradhyAdayaH shAkhAnusAriNo bhavanti rogAH; pakShavadhagrahApatAnakArditashoSharAjayakShmAsthisandhishUlagudabhraMshAdayaH shirohRudbastirogAdayashca madhyamamArgAnusAriNo bhavanti rogAH; jvarAtIsAracchardyalasakavisUcikAkAsashvAsahikkAnAhodaraplIhAdayo~antarmArgajAshca visarpashvayathugulmArshovidradhyAdayaH koShThAnusAriNo bhavanti rogAH||49||
11.commentary: samprati yanmArgAshrito yo rogo bhavati taM darshayati- tatra gaNDetyAdi| bahirmArgajAshceti visarpAdInAM visheShaNaM visarpAdayo hyantarmArgabhAjo~api sambhavantyatastadvyudAsArtham| pakShashabdo vadhagrahAbhyAM sambadhyate, shoSho dhAtushoShaH| jvaro yadyapi sarvasharIraga eva, tathA~api visheSheNAmAshayasamutthatvAdihocyate| antarmArgajAshceti visarpAdivisheShaNam| arsho bahirvalyAshritaM shAkhAgatam, anyacca koShThagatam| bahirmArgajo gulmo yo bahiruttuNDita upalabhyate bahishca pacyate sa j~jeyaH, anyastu sarvaH koShThagata eva||49||

11.sanskrit: trividhA bhiShaja iti- bhiShakchadmacarAH santi santyeke siddhasAdhitAH| santi vaidyaguNairyuktAstrividhA bhiShajo bhuvi||50|| vaidyabhANDauShadhaiH pustaiH pallavairavalokanaiH| labhante ye bhiShakshabdamaj~jAste pratirUpakAH||51|| shrIyashoj~jAnasiddhAnAM vyapadeshAdatadvidhAH| vaidyashabdaM labhante ye j~jeyAste siddhasAdhitAH||52|| prayogaj~jAnavij~jAnasiddhisiddhAH sukhapradAH| jIvitAbhisarAste syurvaidyatvaM teShvavasthitamiti||53||
11.commentary: bhiShakchadmacarA bhiShagveshacarAH| siddhena prasiddhena sAdhitAH siddhasAdhitAH| vaidyabhANDaM bastinetrAdi| pratirUpakA vaidyasadRushAH| vyapadeshaH anyasambandhena kIrtanam| atadvidhA j~jAnahInAH||50-53||

11.sanskrit: trividhamauShadhamiti- daivavyapAshrayaM, yuktivyapAshrayaM, sattvAvajayashca| tatra daivavyapAshrayaM- mantrauShadhimaNima~ggalabalyupahArahomaniyamaprAyashcittopavAsasvastyayanapraNipAtagamanAdi, yuktivyapAshrayaM- punarAhArauShadhadravyANAM yojanA, sattvAvajayaH- punarahitebhyo~arthebhyo manonigrahaH||54||
11.commentary: daivamadRuShTaM tadvyapAshrayaM, tacca yadadRuShTajananena vyAdhipratyanIkaM mantrAdi; yadi vA daivashabdena devA ucyante, tAnAshritya yadupakaroti tattathA; mantrAdayo hi devaprabhAvAdeva vyAdhiharAH, balyupahArAdiprItAshca devA eva prabhAvAdvyAdhIn ghnanti| atra daivavyapAshrayamAdAvuktamAshuvyAdhiharatvena| praNipAto devAdInAM shArIro namaskAraH, gamanaM vidUradevAdigamanam||54||

11.sanskrit: sharIradoShaprakope khalu sharIramevAshritya prAyashastrividhamauShadhamicchanti- antaHparimArjanaM, bahiHparimArjanaM, shastrapraNidhAnaM ceti| tatrAntaHparimArjanaM yadantaHsharIramanupravishyauShadhamAhArajAtavyAdhIn pramArShTi, yatpunarbahiHsparshamAshrityAbhya~ggasvedapradehapariShekonmardanAdyairAmayAn pramArShTi tadbahiHparimArjanaM, shastrapraNidhAnaM punashchedanabhedanavyadhanadAraNalekhanotpATanapracchanasIvanaiShaNakShArajalaukasashceti||55||
11.commentary: samprati prakArAntareNopayuktaM bheShajatraividhyamAha- sharIretyAdi| prAyaHshabdaH sharIradoShakopa ityanena sambadhyate; tena, mAnasadoShaje~apyunmAdApasmArAdAva~jjanAdi bhavatIti darshayati; yadi vA prAyastrividhamityanena shArIre~api daivavyapAshrayaM svastyayanAdi darshayati||55||

11.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- prAj~jo roge samutpanne bAhyenAbhyantareNa vA| karmaNA labhate sharma shastropakramaNena vA||56|| bAlastu khalu mohAdvA pramAdAdvA na budhyate| utpadyamAnaM prathamaM rogaM shatrumivAbudhaH||57|| aNurhi prathamaM bhUtvA rogaH pashcAdvivardhate| sa jAtamUlo muShNAti balamAyushca durmateH||58|| na mUDho labhate sa~jj~jAM tAvadyAvanna pIDyate| pIDitastu matiM pashcAt kurute vyAdhinigrahe||59|| atha putrAMshca dArAMshca j~jAtIMshcAhUya bhAShate| sarvasvenApi me kashcidbhiShagAnIyatAmiti||60|| tathAvidhaM ca kaH shakto durbalaM vyAdhipIDitam| kRushaM kShINendriyaM dInaM paritrAtuM gatAyuSham||61|| sa trAtAramanAsAdya bAlastyajati jIvitam| godhA lA~ggUlabaddhevAkRuShyamANA balIyasA||62|| tasmAt prAgeva rogebhyo rogeShu taruNeShu vA| bheShajaiH pratikurvIta ya icchet sukhamAtmanaH||63||
11.commentary: vaidyabhedAbhidhAnaprasa~ggenAturabhedamAha- prAj~ja ityAdi| sharma sukhamArogyamiti yAvat| pramAdaH buddhvA~api rogamapratIkAraH| sa~jj~jA samyagj~jAnaM vyAdhirayaM tvarayA pratikartavya evamAkAram| trAtAraM vaidyamanAsAdya; tathAvidhaM hi rogiNaM vaidyo nopasarpatIti bhAvaH| bAlaH aj~jaH| godhAdRuShTAntena jIvanArthaM yatnaM kurvannapi vipadyata iti darshayati| pratikurvIta ‘yatnam’ iti sheShaH||56-63||

11.sanskrit: tatra shlokau- eShaNAH samupastambhA balaM kAraNamAmayAH| tisraiShaNIye mArgAshca bhiShajo bheShajAni ca||64|| tritvenAShTau samuddiShTAH kRuShNAtreyeNa dhImatA| bhAvA, bhAveShvasaktena yeShu sarvaM pratiShThitam||65||
11.commentary: sa~ggrahe dhImatA bhAvA iti chedaH; aShTau bhAvA iti sambandhaH| bhAveShu viShayeShu| asaktena aprasaktena| yeShu eShaNAdiShvaShTasu| sarvamiti dharmArthakAmAH||64-65||

11.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne tisraiShaNIyo nAmaikAdasho~adhyAyaH||11||
11.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyavyAkhyAyAmAyurvedadIpikAkhyAyAM sUtrasthAne nirdeshacatuShke tisraiShaNIyo nAmaikAdasho~adhyAyaH||11||

12.sanskrit: athAto vAtakalAkalIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
12.commentary: pUrvAdhyAye rogAH svarUpamArgabAhyakAraNabheShajairabhihitAH, upayuktaj~jAnAstatkAraNavAtAdayo bahuvAcyatvAnnoktAH, ataH samprati pRuthakprakaraNe te~abhidhIyante vAtakalAkalIye; tatrApi prAdhAnyAdvAyureva prathamamucyate| kalA guNaH, yaduktaM- “ShoDashakalam” (sU.a.10) iti; akalA guNaviruddho doShaH; tena vAtakalAkalIyo vAtaguNadoShIya ityarthaH; yadi vA kalA sUkShmo bhAgaH, tasyApi kalA kalAkalA; tasyApi sUkShmo bhAga ityarthaH||1-2||

12.sanskrit: vAtakalAkalAj~jAnamadhikRutya parasparamatAni jij~jAsamAnAH samupavishya maharShayaH papracchuranyo~anyaM- ki~gguNo vAyuH, kimasya prakopaNam, upashamanAni vA~asya kAni, kathaM cainamasa~gghAtavantamanavasthitamanAsAdya prakopaNaprashamanAni prakopayanti prashamayanti vA, kAni cAsya kupitAkupitasya sharIrAsharIracarasya sharIreShu carataH karmANi bahiHsharIrebhyoveti||3||
12.commentary: atrAnekarShivacanarUpatayA vAtAdiguNavacanaM bahvRuShisammatidarshanArthaM tantradharmaitihyayuktatvakaraNArthaM ca| asa~gghAtamiti pittashleShmavadavayavasa~gghAtarahitam| anavasthitamiti calasvabhAvam| anAsAdyeti calatvenAnibiDAvayatvena ceti mantavyam||3||

12.sanskrit: atrovAca kushaH sA~gkRutyAyanaH- rUkShalaghushItadAruNakharavishadAH ShaDime vAtaguNA bhavanti||4||
12.commentary: rUkShAdayo bhAvapradhAnAH, tena rUkShatvAdayo guNA mantavyAH| dAruNatvaM calatvaM calatvAt, evaM dIrgha~jjIvitIyoktaM calatvamuktaM bhavati; yadi vA, dAruNatvaM shoShaNatvAt kAThinyaM karotIti||4||

12.sanskrit: tacchrutvA vAkyaM kumArashirA bharadvAja uvAca- evametadyathA bhagavAnAha, eta eva vAtaguNA bhavanti, sa tveva~gguNairevandravyairevamprabhAvaishca karmabhirabhyasyamAnairvAyuH prakopamApadyate, samAnaguNAbhyAso hi dhAtUnAM vRuddhikAraNamiti||5||
12.commentary: kumArashirA iti bharadvAjavisheShaNamAtreyagurubharadvAjaniShedhArtham| evamprabhAvairiti prabhAvAdraukShyAdikArakairdhAvanajAgaraNAdibhiH, prabhAvAbhidhAnaM ca karmaNAM nirguNatvAt| abhyasyamAnairiti asakRutprayuktaiH||5||

12.sanskrit: tacchrutvA vAkyaM kA~gkAyano bAhlIkabhiShaguvAca- evametadyathA bhagavAnAha, etAnyeva vAtaprakopaNAni bhavanti; ato viparItAni vAtasya prashamanAni bhavanti, prakopaNaviparyayo hi dhAtUnAM prashamakAraNamiti||6|| tacchrutvA vAkyaM baDisho dhAmArgava uvAca- evametadyathA bhagavAnAha, etAnyeva vAtaprakopaprashamanAni bhavanti| yathA hyenamasa~gghAtamanavasthitamanAsAdya prakopaNaprashamanAni prakopayanti prashamayanti vA, tathA~anuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- vAtaprakopaNAni khalu rUkShalaghushItadAruNakharavishadashuShirakarANi sharIrANAM, tathAvidheShu sharIreShu vAyurAshrayaM gatvA~a~apyAyamAnaH prakopamApadyate; vAtaprashamanAni punaHsnigdhagurUShNashlakShNamRudupicchilaghanakarANi sharIrANAM, tathAvidheShu sharIreShu vAyurasajyamAnashcaran prashAntimApadyate||7||
12.commentary: sharIrANAmiti sharIrAvayavAnAm| shuShirakarANi randhrakarANi| Ashrayamiti samAnaguNasthAnam| ApyAyamAnaH cIyamAnaH| dAruNaviparIto mRuduH, shuShiraviparIto ghanaH| asajyamAnaH anavatiShThamAnaH, kShIyamANAvayava iti yAvat| etenaitaduktaM bhavati- yadyapi vAyunA vAtakAraNAnAM vAtashamanAnAM vA tathA sambandho nAsti, tathA~api sharIrasambaddhaistairvAtasya sharIracAriNaH sambandho bhavati, tatashca vAtasya samAnaguNayogAdvRuddhirviparItaguNayogAcca hrAsa upapanna eveti||6-7||

12.sanskrit: tacchrutvA baDishavacanamavitathamRuShigaNairanumatamuvAca vAryovido rAjarShiH- evametat sarvamanapavAdaM yathA bhagavAnAha| yAni tu khalu vAyoH kupitAkupitasya sharIrAsharIracarasya sharIreShu carataH karmANi bahiHsharIrebhyo vA bhavanti, teShAmavayavAn pratyakShAnumAnopadeshaiH sAdhayitvA namaskRutya vAyave yathAshakti pravakShyAmaH- vAyustantrayantradharaH, prANodAnasamAnavyAnApAnAtmA, pravartakashceShTAnAmuccAvacAnAM, niyantA praNetA ca manasaH, sarvendriyANAmudyojakaH, sarvendriyArthAnAmabhivoDhA, sarvasharIradhAtuvyUhakaraH, sandhAnakaraH sharIrasya, pravartako vAcaH, prakRutiH sparshashabdayoH, shrotrasparshanayormUlaM, harShotsAhayoryoniH, samIraNo~agneH, doShasaMshoShaNaH , kSheptA bahirmalAnAM, sthUlANusrotasAM bhettA, kartAgarbhAkRutInAm, AyuSho~anuvRuttipratyayabhUto bhavatyakupitaH| kupitastu khalu sharIre sharIraM nAnAvidhairvikArairupatapati balavarNasukhAyuShAmupaghAtAya , mano vyAharShayati , sarvendriyANyupahanti, vinihanti garbhAn vikRutimApAdayatyatikAlaM vA dhArayati, bhayashokamohadainyAtipralApA~jjanayati, prANAMshcoparuNaddhi| prakRutibhUtasya khalvasya loke carataH karmANImAni bhavanti; tadyathA- dharaNIdhAraNaM, jvalanojjvAlanam, AdityacandranakShatragrahagaNAnAM santAnagatividhAnaM, sRuShTishca meghAnAm, apAM visargaH, pravartanaM srotasAM, puShpaphalAnAM cAbhinirvartanam, udbhedanaM caudbhidAnAm, RutUnAM pravibhAgaH, vibhAgo dhAtUnAM, dhAtumAnasaMsthAnavyaktiH, bIjAbhisaMskAraH, shasyAbhivardhanamavikledopashoShaNe , avaikArikavikArashceti| prakupitasya khalvasya lokeShu carataH karmANImAni bhavanti; tadyathA- shikharishikharAvamathanam, unmathanamanokahAnAm, utpIDanaM sAgarANAm, udvartanaM sarasAM, pratisaraNamApagAnAm, AkampanaM ca bhUmeH, AdhamanamambudAnAM , nIhAranirhrAdapAMshusikatAmatsyabhekoragakShArarudhirAshmAshanivisargaH, vyApAdanaM ca ShaNNAmRutUnAM, shasyAnAmasa~gghAtaH, bhUtAnAM copasargaH, bhAvAnAM cAbhAvakaraNaM, caturyugAntakarANAM meghasUryAnalAnilAnAM visargaH; sa hi bhagavAn prabhavashcAvyayashca, bhUtAnAM bhAvAbhAvakaraH, sukhAsukhayorvidhAtA, mRutyuH, yamaH, niyantA, prajApatiH, aditiH, vishvakarmA, vishvarUpaH, sarvagaH, sarvatantrANAM vidhAtA, bhAvAnAmaNuH, vibhuH, viShNuH, krAntA lokAnAM, vAyureva bhagavAniti||8||
12.commentary: sharIrAsharIracarasyeti vAtasvarUpakathanaM, tena sharIreShu carata iti bahiH sharIrebhyo veti ca punaruktaM na bhavati| atrAvayavAniti vadan kArtsnyAbhidhAnamashakyaM bahuprapa~jcatvAditi darshayati| sAdhayitvA pratipAdya| vAtakarmasu pratyakShANi vacanAdIni, manaHpreraNAdyanumeyaM, garbhAkRutikaraNAdyAgamagamyam| tantraM sharIraM, yaduktaM- “tantrayantreShu bhinneShu tamo~antyaM pravivikShatAm” (iM. a.12) iti, tadeva yantraM; yadi vA, tantrasya yantraM sandhayaH| prANAdyAtmA prANAdisvarUpaH| ceShTAvisheShaNam- uccAvacAnAM, vividhAnAmityarthaH, kiMvA shubhAshubhAnAmityarthaH| niyantA anIpsite viShaye pravartamAnasya manasaH, praNetA ca manasa evepsite~arthe| udyojakaH prerakaH; kiMvA ‘udyogakAraka’ iti pAThaH, so~apyabhinnArthaH| abhivoDhevAbhivoDhA sarvendriyArthagrAhakatvena; taccAsya vAyumayena sparshanendriyeNa sarvendriyANAM vyApakatvAt pUrvAdhyAyapratipAditena nyAyena boddhavyam| vyUhakaraH sa~gghAtakaro racanAkara iti yAvat | prakRutiH kAraNaM, shabdakAraNatvaM ca vAyornityamAkAshAnupraveshAt; uktaM hi khAdInyabhidhAya- “teShAmekaguNaH pUrvo guNavRuddhiH pare pare” (shA. a.1) iti| tathA punaruktaM khAdInyabhidhAya “viShTaM hyaparaM pareNa” (nyA.da. a.2. A.1.sU.66) iti| shravaNamUlatvaM vAyoH karNashaShkulIracanAvisheShe vyApriyamANatvAt; mUlaM pradhAnakAraNam| utsAhaH kAryeShUdyogo manasaH| yoniH abhivyaktikAraNam| doShasaMshoShaNaH sharIrakledasaMshoShaNaH| bhettA kartA; etacca sharIrotpattikAle| bhUta shabdaH svarUpavacanaH| upaghAtAyeti chedaH| garbhAniti vikRutimApAdayatyatikAlaM dhArayatItyanena ca sambadhyate| AdityAdInAM santAnenAvicchedena gatividhAnaM santAnagatividhAnam| srotasAmiti nadInAm| pravibhAgo vibhaktalakShaNam | dhAtUnAmiti pRuthivyAdInAM, dhAtavaH kAryadravyANi prastarAdIni; mAnaM parimANaM, saMsthAnamAkRutiH, tayorvyaktirabhivyaktiH, tatra kAraNamiti yAvat| bIjasya shAlyAdeH, abhisaMskAro~a~gkurajananashaktiH| avikledaH pAkakAlAdarvAgaviklinnatvam, upashoShaNaM ca pAkena yavAdInAmArdrANAmeva, avikledopashoShaNe shasyAnAmeva| avaikArikavikAreNa sarvasminneva jagati prakRutirUpe kAraNatvaM brUte| shikharI parvataH| anokaho vRukShaH| UrdhvaM vartanamudvartanam| pratisaraNaM pratIpagamanam| visarjanaM visargaH, sa ca pRutha~gnIhArAdibhiH sambadhyate; nIhAraH shishirasamUhaH, nirhrAdo meghaM vinA garjitam, ashaniH vajrabhedo~agniH| asa~gghAtaH anutpAdo~anupacayo vA| upasargaH marakAdiprAdurbhAvaH| meghasUryetyAdau visargaH sRuShTiH| vAyuriha devatArUpo~abhipretaH, tena tasya bhUtarUpacaturyugAntakarAnilakaraNamaviruddham; evaM yadanyadapyanupapadyamAnaM vAyostadapi devatArUpatvenaiva samAdheyam| samprati sAmAnyena punaH kupitAkupitasya vAyoH svarUpamucyate- sa hi bhagavAnityAdi| prabhavaH kAraNam| avyayaH akShayaH| bhUtAnAmityuttareNa sambadhyate| mRutyuyamAdibhedAshcAgame j~jeyAH| sarvatantrANAM sarvakarmaNAM; tantrashabdaH karmavacano~apyasti, yaduktaM- “bastistantrANAM” (sU. a.25); karmaNAmityarthaH||8||

12.sanskrit: tacchrutvA vAryovidavaco marIciruvAca- yadyapyevametat, kimarthasyAsya vacane vij~jAne vA sAmarthyamasti bhiShagvidyAyAM; bhiShagvidyAmadhikRutyeyaM kathA pravRutteti ||9|| vAryovida uvAca- bhiShak pavanamatibalamatiparuShamatishIghrakAriNamAtyayikaM cennAnunishamyet, sahasA prakupitamatiprayataH kathamagre~abhirakShitumabhidhAsyati prAgevainamatyayabhayAt; vAyoryathArthA stutirapi bhavatyArogyAya balavarNavivRuddhaye varcasvitvAyopacayAya j~jAnopapattaye paramAyuHprakarShAya ceti||10||
12.commentary: tacchrutvetyAdi sugamam| varcasvitvaM tejasvitvam||9-10||

12.sanskrit: marIciruvAca- agnireva sharIre pittAntargataH kupitAkupitaH shubhAshubhAni karoti; tadyathA- paktimapaktiM darshanamadarshanaM mAtrAmAtratvamUShmaNaH prakRutivikRutivarNau shauryaM bhayaM krodhaM harShaM mohaM prasAdamityevamAdIni cAparANi dvandvAnIti||11||
12.commentary: pittAntargata iti vacanena sharIre jvAlAdiyuktavahniniShedhena pittoShmarUpasya vahneH sadbhAvaM darshayati; na tu pittAdabhedaM, pittenAgnimAndyasya grahaNyadhyAye vakShyamANatvAt, tathA pittaharasya sarpiSho~agnivardhanatvenoktatvAt| paktimapaktimiti avikRutivikRutibhedena pAcakasyAgneH karma, darshanAdarshane netragatasyAlocakasya, UShmaNo mAtrAmAtratvaM varNabhedau ca tvaggatasya bhrAjakasya, bhayashauryAdayo hRudayasthasya sAdhakasya, ra~jjakasya tu bahiHsphuTakAryAdarshanAdudAharaNaM na kRutam||11||

12.sanskrit: tacchrutvA marIcivacaH kApya uvAca- soma eva sharIre shleShmAntargataH kupitAkupitaH shubhAshubhAni karoti; tadyathA- dArDhyaM shaithilyamupacayaM kArshyamutsAhamAlasyaM vRuShatAM klIbatAM j~jAnamaj~jAnaM buddhiM mohamevamAdIni cAparANi dvandvAnIti||12||
12.commentary: somo jaladevatA, yadi vA candraH||12||

12.sanskrit: tacchrutvA kApyavaco bhagavAn punarvasurAtreya uvAca- sarva eva bhavantaH samyagAhuranyatraikAntikavacanAt; sarva eva khalu vAtapittashleShmANaH prakRutibhUtAH puruShamavyApannendriyaM balavarNasukhopapannamAyuShA mahatopapAdayanti samyagevAcaritA dharmArthakAmA iva niHshreyasena mahatA puruShamiha cAmuShmiMshca loke; vikRutAstvenaM mahatA viparyayeNopapAdayanti Rutavastraya iva vikRutimApannA lokamashubhenopaghAtakAla iti||13|| tadRuShayaH sarva evAnumenire vacanamAtreyasya bhagavato~abhinanandushceti||14|| bhavati cAtra- tadAtreyavacaH shrutvA sarva evAnumenire| RuShayo~abhinanandushca yathendravacanaM surAH||15||
12.commentary: aikAntikavacanAditi avadhAraNAdityarthaH| niHshreyasena sukhena| Rutavastraya iti shItoShNavarShalakShaNAshcaturmAsena RutunA| upaghAtakAla iti deshocchedakAle||13-15||

12.sanskrit: tatra shlokau- guNAH ShaD dvividho heturvividhaM karma yat punaH| vAyoshcaturvidhaM karma pRuthak ca kaphapittayoH||16|| maharShINAM matiryA yA punarvasumatishca yA| kalAkalIye vAtasya tat sarvaM samprakAshitam||17||
12.commentary: sa~ggrahe guNAH ShaDiti rUkShAdayaH| dvividho heturiti vAtaprakopaheturvAtaprashamahetushca| vividhaM nAnAprakAraM sannikhilameva vAyoH karma, yat punashcaturvidhaM kupitAkupitasharIrAsharIracarabhedena bhavati, taduktamiti yojanIyaM; na hi caturvidhavyatirekeNa vAyoH pRuthagvidhaM karmoktam||16-17||

12.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne vAtakalAkalIyo nAma dvAdasho~adhyAyaH samAptaH||12|| iti nirdeshacatuShkaH||3||
12.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne nirdeshacatuShke vAtakalAkalIyo nAma dvAdasho~adhyAyaH||12|| iti nirdeshacatuShkaH||3||

13.sanskrit: athAtaH snehAdhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
13.commentary: nirdeshavAtakalAkalIye vAtAdayo~abhihitAH, teShAM bheShajaM yathA kalpanIyaM tadupadeShTuM kalpanAcatuShko~abhidhIyate| bheShajAnAM kalpanA bheShajakalpanA, sA ca kalpanA AshrayadravyAbhidhAnaM vinA na pAryate kalpayitum ; ataH snehAdidravyagocarA sneha-sveda-vamana-virecanakalpanehAbhidhIyate, bastikalpanA tviha bahuvaktavyatvAnnoktA| atrApi vamanAdipravRuttau snehasyaiva prathamaM vidhIyamAnatayA tathA doShapradhAnasya vAtasya pradhAnabheShajatvAcca tatpratipAdaka eva snehAdhyAyo~abhidhIyate| snehasya pratipAdako~adhyAyaH snehAdhyAyaH||1-2||

13.sanskrit: sA~gkhyaiH sa~gkhyAtasa~gkhyeyaiH sahAsInaM punarvasum| jagaddhitArthaM papraccha vahniveshaH svasaMshayam||3||
13.commentary: sa~gkhyA samyagj~jAnaM, tena vyavaharantIti sA~gkhyAH| sa~gkhyAtaM j~jAtaM sa~gkhyeyaM j~jeyaM yaiste tathA; yadi vA ‘sa~gkhyAtasa~gkhyeyam’ iti pAThaH, tadA punarvasuvisheShaNametat; arthastu samAnaH| sA~gkhyaiH sahAvasthAnopadarshanamAtreyasya kartavyaprashnAnuguNamanaHsamAdhAnopadarshanArtham| saMshayamiti saMshayena viShayiNA viShayaM lakShayati, tena saMshayamiti saMshayaviShayamityarthaH||3||

13.sanskrit: kiMyonayaH kati snehAH ke ca snehaguNAH pRuthak| kAlAnupAne ke kasya kati kAshca vicAraNAH||4|| kati mAtrAH kathammAnAH kA ca keShUpadishyate| kashca kebhyo hitaH snehaH prakarShaH snehane ca kaH||5|| snehyAH ke ke na ca snigdhAsnigdhAtisnigdhalakShaNam| kiM pAnAt prathamaM pIte jIrNe ki~jca hitAhitam||6|| ke mRudukrUrakoShThAH kA vyApadaH siddhayashca kAH| acche saMshodhane caiva snehe kA vRuttiriShyate||7|| vicAraNAH keShu yojyA vidhinA kena tat prabho!| snehasyAmitavij~jAna j~jAnamicchAmi veditum||8||
13.commentary: ko~asau saMshaya ityAha- kiMyonaya ityAdi| kiMyonayaH kimAdhArakAraNAH| kAlashcAnupAnaM ca kAlAnupAne| vicAraNA dravyAntarAsaMyuktasnehapAnaM varjayitvA snehopayogaH| kathammAnA kIdRu~gmAnA| kA ceti mAtrA| prakarShaH kAlaprakarShaH| snehane snehayuktikriyAyAm| ke naceti ke na ca snehyAH| kiM pAnAt snehapAnAt prathamaM pUrvaM hitAhitaM; ki~jca pIte snehe tathA jIrNe ca snehe hitAhitamiti yojyam| siddhayo vyApatsAdhanAni bheShajAni| acche iti saMshodhanapRutha~gnirdeshAdgobalIvardanyAyena saMshamana iti bhavati| vRuttiriti vRuttiH upacAravidhAnam| j~jAnaM shAstram||4-8||

13.sanskrit: atha tatsaMshayacchettA pratyuvAca punarvasuH| snehAnAM dvividhA saumya yoniH sthAvaraja~ggamA||9|| tilaH priyAlAbhiShukau bibhItakashcitrAbhayairaNDamadhUkasarShapAH| kusumbhabilvArukamUlakAtasInikocakAkShoDakara~jjashigrukAH||10|| snehAshayAH sthAvarasa~jj~jitAstathA syurja~ggamA matsyamRugAH sapakShiNaH| teShAM dadhikShIraghRutAmiShaM vasA sneheShu majjA ca tathopadishyate||11||
13.commentary: abhiShuka auttarApathikaH| citrA gorakShakarkaTI, tadbIjamiha; yadi vA citrA lohitairaNDaH| atasI ‘umA’ iti khyAtA | ArukanikocakAkShoDA auttarApathikAH| snehAshayAH snehasthAnAni| ete cAviShkRutatamatvenoktAH, tena nimbatailAdayo boddhavyAH| AmiShaM mAMsam||9-11||

13.sanskrit: sarveShAM tailajAtAnAM tilatailaM vishiShyate| balArthe snehane cAgryamairaNDaM tu virecane||12|| (kaTUShNaM tailamairaNDaM vAtashleShmaharaM guru | kaShAyasvAdutiktaishca yojitaM pittahantrapi ||1||)|
13.commentary: tailajAtAnAmiti jAtashabdaH prakAravacanaH; yathA- “yadAhArajAtamagnivesha” (sU.a.25) ityAdi| atra yadyapi yogAttilabhavameva tailaM, tathA~api rUDhyeha sarva eva sthAvarasnehAstailamityucyante| yaduktaM sushrute- “niShpattestadguNatvAcca tailatvamitareShvapi” (su.sU.a.45) iti| vishiShyate atiricyate| agryamityairaNDena sambadhyate||12||

13.sanskrit: sarpistailaM vasA majjA sarvasnehottamA matAH| eShu caivottamaM sarpiH saMskArasyAnuvartanAt||13||
13.commentary: sarvasnehottamA ityatra sarvashabdena dadhikShIrAdayo gRuhyante; sarvasnehottamatvaM ca sarpirAdInAM snehaguNaprakarShavattvena| saMskAro guNAntarAropaNaM, tasyAnuvartanamanuvidhAnaM svIkaraNamiti yAvat| etaduktaM bhavati- yat- na tathA tailAdayo dravyAntarasaMskRutAH saMskAraguNAn vahanti yathA sarpiriti| ata evoktaM- “nAnyaH snehastathA kashcit saMskAramanuvartate| yathA sarpirataH sarpiH sarvasnehottamaM matam” (ni. a.1)| ata eva saMskArakadravyacitrakAdiguNAnuvidhAne~api sarpirna svaguNAn snehashaityAdIn jahAti, ki~jca svaguNAn tadguNAMshca vahati, yato~anushabdena pashcAdvAcinA svaguNavartanasya pashcAt saMskArakaguNavartanamucyate| ata evoktaM- “snehAdvAtaM shamayati pittaM mAdhuryashaityataH| ghRutaM tulyaguNaM doShaM saMskArAttu jayet kapham” (ni. a.1) iti| na ca vAcyaM rUkShoShNacitrakAdisaMskArAdrUkShoShNaM sarpirbhUtaM, tatashca sarpiShaH snehashaitye tadviruddhe kathaM tiShThataH? iti; yataH sarpiHsambaddhacitrakAvayavAnugataM hi rUkShoShNatvaM, sarpirgate ca snehashaitye iti bhinnAshrayatvAnna virodhaH; idameva ca sarpiShaH saMskArAnuvartanaM yat- svaguNaviruddhasyApi tasyAnupaghAtena dhAraNaM; saMskArakacitrakAdiguNavahane~api sarpiShaH shaityAdayaH kadAcidabhibhUyante saMskArakaguNairuShNAdibhirna punaH snehaguNaH, tasya sneheShu sarvAtmanA vyavasthitasya prabalatvAt; ata eva sarpirAdayaH snehapradhAnatvAt ‘snehA’ ityucyante| anye tu saMskArAnuvartanaM svaguNopaghAtena saMskArakaguNavahanaM bruvate, etacca taile tiShThati na sarpiShIti vadanti; sarpiShi tu saMskArAnuvartanamuktaM yat tat sarpiShi sarvathA kasyacidguNasya saMskAraguNenAnupaghAtAdbhavati ; tathAhi- dAhaprashamanArthaM jvare candanAdishItadravyasAdhitatailamuktaM, yataH shItena sAdhitaM tailamuShNamapi svabhAvAcchItameva bhavatIti||13||

13.sanskrit: ghRutaM pittAnilaharaM rasashukraujasAM hitam| nirvApaNaM mRudukaraM svaravarNaprasAdanam||14|| mArutaghnaM na ca shleShmavardhanaM balavardhanam| tvacyamuShNaM sthirakaraM tailaM yonivishodhanam||15|| viddhabhagnAhatabhraShTayonikarNashiroruji| pauruShopacaye snehe vyAyAme ceShyate vasA||16|| balashukrarasashleShmamedomajjavivardhanaH| majjA visheShato~asthnAM ca balakRut snehane hitaH||17||
13.commentary: snehaguNAnabhidhatte- ghRutamityAdi| nirvApaNaM dAhaprashamanam| mArutaghnamityAdi tailaguNAH| sthirakaram a~ggasthairyakaram| viddhetyAdi vasAguNAH| pauruShopacayaH shukropacayaH| snehe sharIrasnehane kartavye| balashukretyAdi majjaguNAH||14-17||

13.sanskrit: sarpiH sharadi pAtavyaM vasA majjA ca mAdhave| tailaM prAvRuShi nAtyuShNashIte snehaM pibennaraH||18||
13.commentary: sarpirAdipAnakAlamAha- sarpiH sharadItyAdi| mAdhave vaishAkhe| prAvRuDAShADhashrAvaNau, yaduktaM- “prAvRuT shukranabhau j~jeyau” (si.a.6) iti| sharadi bahupittatvena pittaviruddhaM ghRutameva yaugikaM, nAnyastailAdiH| vasAmajj~jostu nAtishItoShNatvAt sAdhAraNe; yatastayoranupAne shItatvena voShNatvena vA nirdesho na kRutaH; “yathAsattvaM tu shaityauShNye vasAmajj~jorvinirdishet” (sU.a.27) iti tu vacanena shaityauShNyAbhidhAnaM sAmAnyena, tailasarpirvadauShNyashaityAnabhidhAnAnna prakarShaprAptashaityoShNatvaprApakam| ata evoktaM- “tailavasAmajjasarpiShAM tu yathApUrvaM shreShThatvaM vAtashleShmavikAreShu bhavati, yathottaraM pittavikAreShu” (vi.a.8) iti| atrottarasya sarpiShaH shaityAt pittaharatvaM, tailasya tUShNatvAdvAtashleShmaharatvaM, vasAmajj~jostu sAdhAraNatvena madhyagatatvamiti sthitam| evaM vasAmajj~joH sAdhAraNatvena tathA balyatvadhAtuvRuddhikaratvAbhyAmanatishItoShNe tathA balakShayadhAtukShayayukte mAdhave prayogo yuktaH| caitrastu mukhyasAdhAraNaguNo~api prabhUtashleShmatayA na snehaviShaya ityanuktaH| sAmAnyena snehopayoge shastaM kAlamAha- nAtyuShNetyAdi| nAtyuShNe grIShme, nAtishIte hemante shishire ca tathA varShajanitashaitye varShAkAle| ayaM cAnAtyayikavikAre sati kAlaniyamo j~jeyaH, agre uShNe shIte ca kAle snehopadeshAt||18||

13.sanskrit: vAtapittAdhiko rAtrAvuShNe cApi pibennaraH| shleShmAdhiko divA shIte pibeccAmalabhAskare||19||
13.commentary: kAlavisheShe doShavisheShe ca pAnakramaM darshayati- vAtetyAdinA| vAtashca pittaM ca vAtapittaM, tadadhiko vAtapittAdhikaH| rAtrAviti sAyam| uShNe grIShme| shleShmAdhikagrahaNamatyantashItavikAragRuhItapuruShopalakShaNArthaM, tena vAtashleShmAdhikaH shleShmAdhikashca gRuhyate; ata eva sushrute~apyuktaM- “vAtapittAdhiko rAtrau vAtashleShmAdhiko divA” (su.ci.31) iti| kevalavAtAdhikasya tathA pittAdhikasya shleShmAdhikasya ca sAdhAraNe sharadAdau kAle utsargasiddha eva pAnakAlo vakShyamANo bhavati| vakShyati hi- “pibet saMshamanaM snehamannakAle” ityAdi| anye tu bruvate- vAtAdhikagrahaNena kevalavAtasyApi grahaNaM, shleShmAdhikavyapadeshAcca vAtashleShma-pittashleShmaNorapi grahaNamiti| shIte hemantAdau| amalaH prabalarashmiryasmin dinasya bhAge bhAskaraH so~amalabhAskaro madhyAhna iti yAvat||19||

13.sanskrit: atyuShNe vA divA pIto vAtapittAdhikena vA| mUrcchAM pipAsAmunmAdaM kAmalAM vA samIrayet||20|| shIte rAtrau piban snehaM naraH shleShmAdhiko~api vA| AnAhamaruciM shUlaM pANDutAM vA samRucchati||21||
13.commentary: uktakAlaniyamaviparyaye doShamAha- atyuShNe vetyAdi| atyuShNe kAle divA pItaH snehaH shlaiShmikasyApi yathoktavikArakaraH, tathA vAtapittAdhikena pItaH shItakAle~api yathoktavikArakaraH; evaM nishApAne~api vAkyArthaH; paraM niShiddhasya kAlasya doShasya ca melake~atyaye coktavikAraprakarShAprakarShau tarkaNIyau||20-21||

13.sanskrit: jalamuShNaM ghRute peyaM yUShastaile~anu shasyate| vasAmajj~jostu maNDaH syAt sarveShUShNamathAmbu vA||22||
13.commentary: anupAnamAha- jalamityAdi| taile~anviti anupAne| anupAnaparimANaM tu samyagbheShajapAkArthaM kriyamANaM bheShajAvaikArikapAkenaivonneyaM, vRuddhavaidyavyavahArAcca||22||

13.sanskrit: odanashca vilepI ca raso mAMsaM payo dadhi| yavAgUH sUpashAkau ca yUShaH kAmbalikaH khaDaH||23|| saktavastilapiShTaM ca madyaM lehAstathaiva ca| bhakShyamabhya~jjanaM bastistathA cottarabastayaH||24|| gaNDUShaH karNatailaM ca nastaHkarNAkShitarpaNam| caturviMshatirityetAH snehasya pravicAraNAH ||25||
13.commentary: vicAraNAH sa~gkhyayA svarUpeNa caikagranthenAha- odanashcetyAdi| vilepI viraladravA yavAgUrbahusikthasamanvitA j~jeyA| sashAkapallavena kRuto yUShaH khaDaH| kAmbaliko dadhilavaNasnehatilAdikRuta IShadamlaH| etayorudAharaNaM yathA- “takre kapitthacA~ggerImaricAjAjicitrakaiH | supakvaH khaDayUSho~ayamayaM kAmbaliko mataH|| dadhyamlo lavaNasnehatilamAShAnvitaH shRutaH” iti| lehaH sharkarAdInAM pAkAt kRutaH; lihyata iti lehaH| pravicAryate avacAryate~anukalpenopayujyate~anayeti pravicAraNA odanAdayaH; odanAdayashca snehapravicAraNAyAM snehayuktA eva boddhavyAH; abhya~jjanAdayastu yadyapi shuddhasnehasampAdyAstathA~api jaTharAgnisambandhe na vyApriyanta iti tantre vicAraNAshabdenocyante||23-25||

13.sanskrit: acchapeyastu yaH sneho na tAmAhurvicAraNAm| snehasya sa bhiShagdRuShTaH kalpaH prAthamakalpikaH||26||
13.commentary: kevalasnehapAnaM tu snehane shaktyatishayavattvena na vicAraNAsa~jj~jayocyate, etadevAha- acchapeya ityAdi| acchashca peyashca acchapeyaH, odanAdyasambandhe sati peya ityarthaH| na tAmAhurvicAraNAmiti vacanena vaidyaparamparAsiddho~ayaM vyavahAra iti darshayati| bhiShagbhirdRuShTo bhiShagdRuShTaH| prathame shreShThe kalpe pakShe bhavatIti prAthamakalpikaH, shreShTha ityarthaH||26||

13.sanskrit: rasaishcopahitaH snehaH samAsavyAsayogibhiH| ShaDbhistriShaShTidhA sa~gkhyAM prApnotyekashca kevalaH||27|| evametAshcatuHShaShTiH snehAnAM pravicAraNA | okartuvyAdhipuruShAn prayojyA jAnatA bhavet||28||
13.commentary: prakArAntareNa vicAraNAbhedamAha- rasaishcetyAdi| samAso rasAnAmanyonyamelakaH, vyAso~amelakaH; samAsavyAsavadbhiH ShaDbhI rasairodanAdigatairupahito yuktaH san snehastriShaShTisa~gkhyAM prApnoti| ekashca kevala ityacchapeyaM varjayitvA~abhya~jjanAdiprayojyaH| triShaShThI rasabhedA AtreyabhadrakApyIye “svAduramlAdibhiryogaM” (sU.a.26) ityAdivAkye vakShyamANA boddhavyAH| evaM snehAnAM rasayuktAnAM catuHShaShTiH pravicAraNA bhavanti| catuHShaShTiriti snehAnAmityanena sambadhyate, tena pravicAraNetyekavacanamupapannaM bhavati| na sarvavicAraNA sarvatra kartavyA, kintu sAtmyartuvyAdhidoShapuruShAn parIkShya yA yatra yujyate sA tatra kartavyetyAha- okartvityAdi| okaH abhyAsaH| puruShagrahaNena kasmin deshe~ayaM puruSho vartata iti parIkShayA desho~apyavaruddho boddhavyaH, vayobalaprabhRutayashca boddhavyAH||27-28||

13.sanskrit: ahorAtramahaH kRutsnamardhAhaM ca pratIkShate| pradhAnA madhyamA hrasvA snehamAtrA jarAM prati||29|| iti tisraH samuddiShTA mAtrAH snehasya mAnataH| tAsAM prayogAn vakShyAmi puruShaM puruShaM prati||30|| prabhUtasnehanityA ye kShutpipAsAsahA narAH| pAvakashcottamabalo yeShAM ye cottamA bale||31|| gulminaH sarpadaShTAshca visarpopahatAshca ye| unmattAH kRucchramUtrAshca gADhavarcasa eva ca||32|| pibeyuruttamAM mAtrAM tasyAH pAne guNA~jchRuNu| vikArA~jchamayatyeShAM shIghraM samyakprayojitA||33|| doShAnukarShiNI mAtrA sarvamArgAnusAriNI| balyA punarnavakarI sharIrendriyacetasAm||34|| aruShkasphoTapiDakAkaNDUpAmAbhirarditAH| kuShThinashca pramIDhAshca vAtashoNitikAshca ye||35|| nAtibahvAshinashcaiva mRudukoShThAstathaiva ca| pibeyurmadhyamAM mAtrAM madhyamAshcApi ye bale||36|| mAtraiShA mandavibhraMshA na cAtibalahAriNI| sukhena ca snehayati shodhanArthe ca yujyate||37|| ye tu vRuddhAshca bAlAshca sukumArAH sukhocitAH| riktakoShThatvamahitaM yeShAM mandAgnayashca ye||38|| jvarAtIsArakAsAshca yeShAM cirasamutthitAH| snehamAtrAM pibeyuste hrasvAM ye cAvarA bale||39|| parihAre sukhA caiShA mAtrA snehanabRuMhaNI| vRuShyA balyA nirAbAdhA ciraM cApyanuvartate||40||
13.commentary: mAtrAyAH sa~gkhyAM pramANaM cAha- ahorAtramityAdi| ahorAtrashabdo~aShTapraharopalakShaNaH, evamahaHshabdArdhAhashabdau catuHpraharadvipraharopalakShaNau, tena praharAdyatIte~apyahani pItA mAtrA yathoktapraharakAlaprAptyA dinAntare rAtrau vA jIryamANA mantavyA; anye tvahorAtrashabdena nyUnenApyahnA yuktA rAtrirahorAtrashabdenocyate , kRutsnArdhAhau tu praharopalakShaNAviti vadanti| atra yadA ahorAtrapariNAminI mAtrA kriyate, tadA tadaharAhAro na kartavyaH; ata evaitatpAnaM puruShavisheShaviShayakathane uktaM- “kShutpipAsAsahAnarAH” iti| prabhUtasnehanityAH prabhUtasnehasAtmyAH| samyagyo jitetivacanena mahAvyApattitvamasyAH sUcayati| sarvamArgAH koShThasandhimarmashAkhAH| punarnavakarI niHsheShadoShaharatvena| aruShketyAdi madhyamamAtrAguNaH; aruShkA arUMShikA| shodhanArtha iti shodhanArtha(~gga)snehakaraNe; etena uttamamAtrA saMshamane eva paraM, na tu shodhanA~ggasnehe kartavyeti darshayati| ye tvityAdi hrasvamAtrAguNaH| parihAre sukheti alpaparihAratvena||29-40||

13.sanskrit: vAtapittaprakRutayo vAtapittavikAriNaH| cakShuHkAmAH kShatAH kShINA vRuddhA bAlAstathA~abalAH||41|| AyuHprakarShakAmAshca balavarNasvarArthinaH| puShTikAmAH prajAkAmAH saukumAryArthinashca ye||42|| dIptyojaHsmRutimedhAgnibuddhIndriyabalArthinaH| pibeyuH sarpirArtAshca dAhashastraviShAgnibhiH||43||
13.commentary: yaH sneho yatra kAryastamAha- vAtapittetyAdi| vAtapittavikAragrahaNenaiva vAtapittaprakRutiShu labdheShu punastadabhidhAnaM vAtapittaprakRutInAM stokashleShmavikAre~api ghRutapAnopadeshArtham; evaM vAtavyAdhibhirAviShTA vAtaprakRutayashca ya ityatra vyAkhyeyam| balArthina ityatra balashabdaH smRutyAdibhiH sambadhyate| ArtAH pIDitAH, dAhAdibhiriti sambandhaH||41-43||

13.sanskrit: pravRuddhashleShmamedaskAshcalasthUlagalodarAH| vAtavyAdhibhirAviShTA vAtaprakRutayashca ye||44|| balaM tanutvaM laghutAM dRuDhatAM sthiragAtratAm | snigdhashlakShNatanutvaktAM ye ca kA~gkShanti dehinaH||45|| kRumikoShThAH krUrakoShThAstathA nADIbhirarditAH| pibeyuH shItale kAle tailaM tailocitAshca ye||46||
13.commentary: tailaviShayamAha- pravRuddhetyAdi| shItale kAla iti tailasyoShNatvena shItale~api kAla ityarthaH; tena sAmAnyapratiShedhaH ‘nAtyuShNashIte snehaM pibennaraH’ iti na virudhyate; yadi vA sarpiHpAnakAlApekShayA shItatvaM boddhavyam||44-46||

13.sanskrit: vAtAtapasahA ye ca rUkShA bhArAdhvakarshitAH| saMshuShkaretorudhirA niShpItakaphamedasaH||47|| asthisandhisirAsnAyumarmakoShThamahArujaH| balavAnmAruto yeShAM khAni cAvRutya tiShThati||48|| mahaccAgnibalaM yeShAM vasAsAtmyAshca ye narAH| teShAM snehayitavyAnAM vasApAnaM vidhIyate||49||
13.commentary: vasAviShayamAha- vAtAtapetyAdi| saMshuShkaniShpItashabdau kShINArthAveva| mahAruja ityasthyAdibhiH sambadhyate| khAni srotAMsi||47-49||

13.sanskrit: dIptAgnayaH kleshasahA ghasmarAH snehasevinaH| vAtArtAH krUrakoShThAshca snehyA majjAnamApnuyuH||50|| yebhyo yebhyo hito yo yaH snehaH sa parikIrtitaH|51|
13.commentary: dIptAgnaya ityAdi majjapAnaviShayaH| ghasmarA bahubhakShakAH| ApnuyuH upayu~jjIran||50||-

13.sanskrit: snehanasya prakarShau tu saptarAtratrirAtrakau||51||
13.commentary: prakarShAviti alpaprakarShabhUyaHprakarShau ; tena, alpatvena trairAtrikaH prakarShaH, bhUyastvena sAptarAtrika iti ca bhavati| etacca vakShyamANasadyaHsnehaprayogAtiriktaprayoge boddhavyaM; yadi vA, sadyaHsnehaprayogA api tryaheNaiva snehayanti, stutyarthaM tu teShu sadya ityuktam| yaduktaM- “tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya iShTaH| nAtaH paraM snehanamAdishanti sAtmyIbhavet saptadinAt paraM tu” (si.a.1.) iti||51||

13.sanskrit: svedyAH shodhayitavyAshca rUkShA vAtavikAriNaH| vyAyAmamadyastrInityAH snehyAH syurye ca cintakAH||52||
13.commentary: sAmAnyena snehyAnAha- svedyA ityAdi| svedyAH svatantrasvedasAdhyA vAtarugArtAdayaH, shodhanA~ggasvedasAdhyAnAM tu shodhayitavyA ityanenaiva gRuhItatvAt| cintakA iti cintAbahulAH||52||

13.sanskrit: saMshodhanAdRute yeShAM rUkShaNaM sampravakShyate| na teShAM snehanaM shastamutsannakaphamedasAm||53|| abhiShyaNNAnanagudA nityamandAgnayashca ye| tRuShNAmUrcchAparItAshca garbhiNyastAlushoShiNaH||54|| annadviShashchardayanto jaTharAmagarArditAH| durbalAshca pratAntAshca snehaglAnA madAturAH||55|| na snehyA vartamAneShu na nasto bastikarmasu| snehapAnAt prajAyante teShAM rogAH sudAruNAH||56||
13.commentary: asnehyAnAha- saMshodhanAdRuta ityAdi| yeShAM rUkShaNaM vakShyate la~gghanabRuMhaNIye- “abhiShyandA mahAdoShA marmasthA vyAdhayashca ye| UrustambhaprabhRutayo rUkShaNIyA nidarshitAH” (sU. a.22) ityanena, teShAM shodhanAdRute snehanaM na shastaM, yadA tu shodhanena virUkShyante tadA paraM shodhanA~gga(rtha)statra snehaH kartavya iti bhAvaH| utsanno vRuddhaH kapho medashca yeShAM te tathA; etacca visheShaNaM virUkShaNIyA evambhUtA eva bhavantIti darshayati | abhiShyaNNaH dravapradhAnashleShmavikArI| garaH kRutrimaM viSham| atipratAntaH atikShINadravadhAtuH| vartamAneShu kriyamANeShvityarthaH||53-56||

13.sanskrit: purIShaM grathitaM rUkShaM vAyurapraguNo mRuduH| paktA kharatvaM raukShyaM ca gAtrasyAsnigdhalakShaNam||57|| vAtAnulomyaM dIpto~agnirvarcaH snigdhamasaMhatam| mArdavaM snigdhatA cA~gge snigdhAnAmupajAyate||58|| pANDutA gauravaM jADyaM purIShasyAvipakvatA| tandrIrarucirutkeshaH syAdatisnigdhalakShaNam||59||
13.commentary: asnigdhalakShaNamAha- purIShamityAdi| mRuduriti pakturvisheShaNam| vAtAnulomyamityAdi snigdhalakShaNam| pANDutetyAdi atisnigdhalakShaNam| jADyam indriyajaDatvam||57-59||

13.sanskrit: dravoShNamanabhiShyandi bhojyamannaM pramANataH| nAtisnigdhamasa~gkIrNaM shvaH snehaM pAtumicchatA||60|| pibet saMshamanaM snehamannakAle prakA~gkShitaH| shuddhyarthaM punarAhAre naishe jIrNe pibennaraH||61||
13.commentary: snehAt pUrvaM yat pathyaM tadAha- dravoShNamityAdi| asa~gkIrNam aviruddhavIryam| shva ityAgAmidine| annakAle dvipraharAdilakShaNe bubhukShA kadAcinna syAdapi tadarthaM visheShaNaM- prakA~gkShita iti| shuddhyarthaM tu snehaM naishe dinAntarakRute AhAre jIrNa eva prAtareva pibedityarthaH| saMshamanArthasneho yadi jaraNAnte prAtareva kriyate tadA koShThopalepakadoShasyAkShayAttena doSheNa sambaddho doShotkleshaM kuryAnna saMshamanaM, saMshodhanArthastu doShotkleshaM karotItyapekShaNIya eveti bhAvaH| etacca kAlakathanamutsargeNa, tena “vAtapittAdhiko rAtrau” ityuktakAlavirodho na bhavati||60-61||

13.sanskrit: uShNodakopacArI syAdbrahmacArI kShapAshayaH | shakRunmUtrAnilodgArAnudIrNAMshca na dhArayet||62|| vyAyAmamuccairvacanaM krodhashokau himAtapau| varjayedapravAtaM ca seveta shayanAsanam||63|| snehaM pItvA naraH snehaM pratibhu~jjAna eva ca| snehamithyopacArAddhi jAyante dAruNA gadAH||64||
13.commentary: kShapAyAmeva svapitIti kShapAshayaH| apravAtaM ceti shayanAsanavisheShaNam| snehaM pratibhu~jjAna iti snehe jIrNe~api snehaprayogAnuguNamanyasnehamaviruddhavIryAdiguNayuktaM bhu~jjAnaH| etena snehe pIte jIrNe ki~jca hitAhitamiti prashnadvayasyottaramidam- uShNodakopacArI syAdityAdi bhavati||62-64||

13.sanskrit: mRudukoShThastrirAtreNa snihyatyacchopasevayA| snihyati krUrakroShThastu saptarAtreNa mAnavaH||65|| guDamikShurasaM mastu kShIramulloDitaM dadhi| pAyasaM kRusharAM sarpiH kAshmaryatriphalArasam||66|| drAkShArasaM pIlurasaM jalamuShNamathApi vA| madyaM vA taruNaM pItvA mRudukoShTho viricyate||67|| virecayanti naitAni krUrakoShThaM kadAcana| bhavati krUrakoShThasya grahaNyatyulbaNAnilA||68|| udIrNapittA~alpakaphA grahaNI mandamArutA| mRudukoShThasya tasmAt sa suvirecyo naraH smRutaH||69||
13.commentary: mRudukoShThAdilakShaNamAha- mRudvityAdi| abhyarhitatvAt koShThaj~jAnasyAnyathA~api tallakShaNamAha- guDamityAdi| ulloDitaM dadhisaraH| kRusharA tilataNDulamAShakRutA yavAgUH; vacanaM hi- “tilataNDulamAShaistu kRusharA trisareti ca”| krUrakoShThAvirecanahetumAha- bhavatItyAdi| grahaNI koShThasthAgnyadhiShThAnabhUtA nADI; yaduktam- “agnyadhiShThAnamannasya grahaNAdgrahaNI matA” (ci.a.15) iti| udIrNapittetyAdi mRudukoShThasvarUpakathanam| krUrakoShThasya grahaNIgato vAyurguDAdInAM saratvaM pratibadhnAti, mRudukoShThasya hi grahaNyAM virodhako vAyurnAsti, stambhako~api shleShmA~alpaH, udbhUtasaratvaguNaM ca pittaM prabalaM; tena guDAdibhiH sukhaM virecanaM bhavatIti bhAvaH||65-69||

13.sanskrit: udIrNapittA grahaNI yasya cAgnibalaM mahat| bhasmIbhavati tasyAshu snehaH pIto~agnitejasA||70|| sa jagdhvA snehamAtrAM tAmojaH prakShArayan balI| snehAgniruttamAM tRuShNAM sopasargAmudIrayet||71|| nAlaM snehasamRuddhasya shamAyAnnaM sugurvapi| sa cet sushItaM salilaM nAsAdayati dahyate| yathaivAshIviShaH kakShamadhyagaH svaviShAgninA||72|| ajIrNe yadi tu snehe tRuShNA syAcchardayedbhiShak| shItodakaM punaH pItvA bhuktvA rUkShAnnamullikhet||73|| na sarpiH kevalaM pitte peyaM sAme visheShataH| sarvaM hyanurajeddehaM hatvA sa~jj~jAM ca mArayet||74|| tandrA sotklesha AnAho jvaraH stambho visa~jj~jatA| kuShThAni kaNDUH pANDutvaM shophArshAMsyarucistRuShA||75|| jaTharaM grahaNIdoShAH staimityaM vAkyanigrahaH| shUlamAmapradoShAshca jAyante snehavibhramAt||76|| tatrApyullekhanaM shastaM svedaH kAlapratIkShaNam| prati prati vyAdhibalaM buddhvA sraMsanameva ca||77|| takrAriShTaprayogashca rUkShapAnAnnasevanam| mUtrANAM triphalAyAshca snehavyApattibheShajam||78||
13.commentary: samprati snehavyApado darshayati- udIrNetyAdi| ojaH sarvadhAtusArabhUtaM hRudi sthitaM, prakShArayan sthAnAdbhraMshayan kShapayaMshca| balItyanena snehendhano vahnirnitarAM balavAn bhavatIti darshayati| vacanaM hi- “nAlaM snehasamRuddhasya shamAyAnnaM sugurvapi” iti| uttamAM mahatIM mAtrAm| sopasargAM sopadravAm| kakShaH kAShThasamUhaH| chardayediti prathamaM snehameva tRuShNAkArakaM chardayitvA punaH shItodakaM pItvA rUkShAnnaM ca bhuktvA ullikhediti yojanIyam| na sarpirityAdi|- na sarpiH sAme pitte peyaM, kevalaM tvasaMskRutaM visheShato na peyaM sAmapitta eveti yojanA; evaM manyate- saMskRutaM tiktakAdibhiryutaM sAme pitte tiktakAdipAcanaguNAnuyogAdyogyaM kadAcidbhavatyapi , asaMskRutaM tu sarvathA viruddhameva; yadivA, kevalamasaMskRutaM sarpiH pitte sAmAnyena sAme nirAme vA na peyaM, sAme pitte visheShata iti yojanA| etena, yatrApi sAmAnyena ghRutaM vihitaM, yathA- “ata UrdhvaM kaphe mande vAtapittottare jvare| paripakveShu doSheShu sarpiHpAnaM yathA~amRutam” (ci.a.3) ityAdau, tatrApyucitabheShajasaMskRutameva boddhavyam| yadivA, na kevalaM pitte sAme sarpirvisheShato na peyaM, kintarhi tailAdInyapi vAtashleShmavihitAni tayoH sAmayorna peyAnItyarthaH| asmin vyAkhyAne~apeyamityakAraprashleSho draShTavyaH| anurajet pittavarNaM kuryAt| sa~jj~jA smRutiH, taddhananaM ceha vyAdhiprabhAvAt| staimityam ArdravastrAguNThitatvamiva| AmapradoShA alasakavisUcikAdayaH| kAlapratIkShaNaM snehajanitadoShakShayaM yAvadabhojanam| takrasyAriShTAnAM ca cikitsAvakShyamANAnAM prayogaH| mUtrANAM triphalAyAshca sevanamiti sambandhaH||70-78||

13.sanskrit: akAle cAhitashcaiva mAtrayA na ca yojitaH| sneho mithyopacArAcca vyApadyetAtisevitaH||79||
13.commentary: mithyopacArAt yathoktavidhyananuShThAnAt| atisevitaH kAlaprakarSheNa sevitaH||79||

13.sanskrit: snehAt praskandanaM jantustrirAtroparataH pibet| snehavaddravamuShNaM ca tryahaM bhuktvA rasaudanam||80||
13.commentary: saMshodhanasnehapAne vRuttipracAramAha- snehAdityAdi| snehAt snehaprayogAt| trirAtroparataH trirAtraM parityaktasnehapAna ityarthaH| praskandanaM virecanam| snehoparamatrirAtra eva bhojanaM darshayati- snehavadityAdi| rasapradhAnamodanaM rasaudanam||80||

13.sanskrit: ekAhoparatastadvadbhuktvA pracchardanaM pibet|81|
13.commentary: vamane snehavRuttimAha- eketyAdi| ekAhoparataH snehAditi yojanA| tadvaditi snehavaddravamuShNaM ca rasaudanaM snehoparamadivasa eva|81|-

13.sanskrit: syAttvasaMshodhanArthIye vRuttiH snehe viriktavat||81||
13.commentary: saMshamanavidhimAha- syAttvityAdi| asaMshodhanArthIye saMshamane| vRuttiH upacAraH| viriktavadityanenAgatAvekShaNenopakalpanIyavakShyamANaM “samyagviriktaM cainaM” (sU. a.15) ityAdigranthapratipAdanIyamupacAramAha, natu peyAdikramamAtram | yadyapi vamanoktA eva tatroccairbhAShyAdayo virecanavRuttAvapyatidiShTAstathA~apIha vamanavidhi parityajya virecanavidhyatidesho dhUmapAnapratiShedhArthaH, virecane hi tatra “dhUmapAnavarjaM” (sU. a.15) iti kRutaM, snehapAne ca dhUmapAnaM niShiddhaM mAtrAshitIye- “na madyadugdhe pItvA ca na snehaM” (sU. a.5) ityAdinA||81||

13.sanskrit: snehadviShaH snehanityA mRudukoShThAshca ye narAH| kleshAsahA madyanityAsteShAmiShTA vicAraNA||82|| lAvataittiramAyUrahAMsavArAhakaukkuTAH| gavyAjaurabhramAtsyAshca rasAH syuH snehane hitAH||83|| yavakolakulatthAshca snehAH saguDasharkarAH| dADimaM dadhi savyoShaM rasasaMyogasa~ggrahaH||84|| snehayanti tilAH pUrvaM jagdhAH sasnehaphANitAH| kRusharAshca bahusnehAstilakAmbalikAstathA||85|| phANitaM shRu~ggaveraM ca tailaM ca surayA saha| pibedrUkSho bhRutairmAMsairjIrNe~ashnIyAcca bhojanam||86|| tailaM surAyA maNDena vasAM majjAnameva vA| piban saphANitaM kShIraM naraH snihyati vAtikaH||87|| dhAroShNaM snehasaMyuktaM pItvA sasharkaraM payaH| naraH snihyati pItvA vA saraM dadhnaH saphANitam||88|| pA~jcaprasRutikI peyA pAyaso mAShamishrakaH| kShIrasiddho bahusnehaH snehayedacirAnnaram||89|| sarpistailavasAmajjAtaNDulaprasRutaiH shRu(kRu)tA| pA~jcaprasRutikI peyA peyA snehanamicchatA||90|| (shaukaro vA rasaH snigdhaH sarpirlavaNasaMyutaH | pIto dvirvAsare yatnAt snehayedacirAnnaram ||1||)|
13.commentary: vicAraNAviShayamAha- snehadviSha ityAdinA| lAvAdirasAnAmuktAnAM saMskAramAha- yavetyAdi| rase snehArthoktarasa ucitaH saMyogo yeShAM te rasasaMyogAH, teShAM sa~ggrahaNaM sa~ggrahaH| pUrvamiti bhojanAt pUrvam| tilapradhAnaH kAmbalikastilakAmbalikaH| phANitamityAdau shRu~ggaveramiti shRu~ggaverarasam| bhRutaiH bhaTitrIkRutaiH| pA~jcaprasRutikI agre vakShyamANA| mAShamishrako mAShataNDulakRutamannam| peyA pAtavyA||82-90||

13.sanskrit: grAmyAnUpaudakaM mAMsaM guDaM dadhi payastilAn| kuShThI shothI pramehI ca snehane na prayojayet||91|| snehairyathArhaM tAn siddhaiH snehayedavikAribhiH| pippalIbhirharItakyA siddhaistriphalayA~api vA||92|| drAkShAmalakayUShAbhyAM dadhnA cAmlena sAdhayet| vyoShagarbhaM bhiShak snehaM pItvA snihyati taM naraH||93|| yavakolakulatthAnAM rasAH kShAraH surA dadhi| kShIrasarpishca tat siddhaM snehanIyaM ghRutottamam||94||
13.commentary: yathArhamiti yo yatra sneho yujyate sarpirAdiH| siddhairiti pippalIbhistathA harItakyA tathA triphalayA ceti pRuthagyojanIyaM; pippalyAdisiddhasnehashca kuShThAdiShu yathAsa~gkhyamiti kecit| yUShashabdaH kvAthavacanaH| vyoShagarbhaM vyoShakalkam| atra tribhirdravyairmilitvA cAturguNyam| yavakolAdau ShaDdravyANi snehasamAni| kShAro yavakShAraH kalkaH||91-94||

13.sanskrit: tailamajjavasAsarpirbadaratriphalArasaiH| yonishukrapradoSheShu sAdhayitvA prayojayet||95||
13.commentary: tailamajjetyAdi|- catuHsneho~akalka eva, tailamajjavasAsarpirityekavadbhAvAddvitIyAntaH prayogaH||95||

13.sanskrit: gRuhNAtyambu yathA vastraM prasravatyadhikaM yathA| yathAgni jIryati snehastathA sravati cAdhikaH||96|| yathA vA~a~akledya mRutpiNDamAsiktaM tvarayA jalam| sravati sraMsate snehastathA tvaritasevitaH||97||
13.commentary: samprati sneha upayukto yathA sharIraM sasnehyAdhiko dRushyate, tadAha- gRuhNAtItyAdi| tacca shiShyeNAdhyAyAdAvapRuShTamapi shiShyahitatayA~abhidhIyate| yathAgnIti agnyanadhika ityarthaH| nanvagnyadhikashcet sravati, tadavadhi ca snehalakShaNamuktaM, yaducyate- “adhastAt snehadarshanam” iti, tenaikadina evAdhikasnehapAnaM kriyatAmityAha- yathA cetyAdi| Akledya IShatkledayitvA| tvaritasevitaH sneho dhAtUnasnehayitvaiva sraMsate~adho yAti yAvAn, na tAvatA snehanaM bhavatIti bhAvaH||96-97||

13.sanskrit: lavaNopahitAH snehAH snehayantyacirAnnaram| taddhyabhiShyandyarUkShaM ca sUkShmamuShNaM vyavAyi ca||98||
13.commentary: snehane sarvasneheShu lavaNaprayogamAha- lavaNopahitA ityAdi| taditi lavaNam| abhiShyandi doShasa~gghAtavicchedakam| vyavAyi akhiladehavyAptipUrvakapAkagAmi||98||

13.sanskrit: snehamagre prayu~jjIta tataH svedamanantaram| snehasvedopapannasya saMshodhanamathetarat ||99||
13.commentary: ato vakShyamANasvedopakalpanAdhyAyayoH sambandhasUcakaM svedAdiShu snehasya prAgbhAvamAha- snehamityAdi||99||

13.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- snehAH snehavidhiH kRutsnavyApatsiddhiH sabheShajA| yathAprashnaM bhagavatA vyAhRutaM cAndrabhAginA||100||
13.commentary: cAndrabhAgI punarvasuH||100||

13.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne snehAdhyAyo nAma trayodasho~adhyAyaH samAptaH||13||
13.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyavyAkhyAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne kalpanAcatuShke snehAdhyAyo nAma trayodasho~adhyAyaH||13||

14.sanskrit: athAtaH svedAdhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
14.commentary: snehapUrvakatvAt svedasya svedAdhyAyo~abhidhIyate| svedapratipAdako~adhyAyaH svedAdhyAyaH||1-2||

14.sanskrit: ataH svedAH pravakShyante yairyathAvatprayojitaiH| svedasAdhyAH prashAmyanti gadA vAtakaphAtmakAH||3|| snehapUrvaM prayuktena svedenAvajite~anile| purIShamUtraretAMsi na sajjanti katha~jcana||4|| shuShkANyapi hi kAShThAni snehasvedopapAdanaiH| namayanti yathAnyAyaM kiM punarjIvato narAn||5||
14.commentary: vAtakaphAtmakA asaMsRuShTavAtakaphajAH, vAtakaphajatve~apyudarAdayaH svedena na shAmyanti, ata Aha- svedasAdhyAH; etenodarAdayo~asvedyA vyAvartyante| snehapUrvamiti kriyAvisheShaNam| na sajjanti apravRuttAni na bhavanti| yathAnyAyaM yathAgamam, etacca snehasvedopapAdanairityanena sambadhyate; yadi vA yathAnyAyaM yathAsahajaM namayantIti sambandhaH||3-5||

14.sanskrit: rogartuvyAdhitApekSho nAtyuShNo~atimRudurna ca| dravyavAn kalpito deshe svedaH kAryakaro mataH||6||
14.commentary: rogamRutuM vyAdhitaM ca balavattvAdinA~apekShata iti rogartuvyAdhitApekShaH| nAtyuShNo nAticaNDatApaH| dravyavAniti snigdharUkShAdidravyavAn| kalpita iti rogAdInapekShya yathocitena dravyeNa deshe cAmAshayAdau yathAyogyatayA sampAdita iti mantavyam||6||

14.sanskrit: vyAdhau shIte sharIre ca mahAn svedo mahAbale| durbale durbalaH svedo madhyame madhyamo hitaH||7|| vAtashleShmaNi vAte vA kaphe vA sveda iShyate| snigdharUkShastathA snigdho rUkShashcApyupakalpitaH||8||
14.commentary: rogAdyapekShayoktakalpanAM darshayati- vyAdhAvityAdi| vyAdhau mahAbale tathA shIte kAlakRute mahAbale| mahAniti caNDatApa eva punaH punaH kriyamANatvena mRudusvedApekShayA~adhikatApatvena j~jeyaH| durbala iti tathA madhyama iti ca vyAdhyAdiShu pUrvavadyojanIyam| snigdharUkShadravyakRutaH snigdharUkShaH, snigdharUkShadravyAdayo vAtashleShmAdiShu yathAsa~gkhyaM mantavyAH; etacca snigdharUkShAdikathanaM dravyApekShakalpanodAharaNaM; vAte snigdhaH, kaphe rUkShaH||7-8||

14.sanskrit: AmAshayagate vAte kaphe pakvAshayAshrite| rUkShapUrvo hitaH svedaH snehapUrvastathaiva ca||9||
14.commentary: taM deshavisheShasambandhena vyabhicArayan deshApekShAM kalpanAmAha- AmAshayetyAdi| AmAshayagate vAte rUkShapUrvaH sthAnApekShayA pUrvaM rUkShaM kRutvA pashcAdvAtApekShaH snigdhaH kAryaH, evaM pakvAshayagate kaphe snehapUrvo vyAkhyeyaH; AmAshayashabdena kaphasthAnaM j~jeyaM, kaphasthAnApekShayA hi prathamaM rUkShaH kriyate, yaduktaM- “sthAnaM jayeddhi pUrvaM tu sthAnasthasyAviruddhataH” iti||9||

14.sanskrit: vRuShaNau hRudayaM dRuShTI svedayenmRudu naiva vA| madhyamaM va~gkShaNau sheShama~ggAvayavamiShTataH||10||
14.commentary: mRudu naiva veti svedaikasAdhye vRuShaNAdigate vyAdhau mRudusvedaH, svedavyatiriktopAyAntarasambhave tu na veti boddhavyam| iShTata ityAturecchAto vaidyecchAtashca| iShTata iti bhAvAdicchAvacanaH||10||

14.sanskrit: sushuddhairnaktakaiH piNDyA godhUmAnAmathApi vA| padmotpalapalAshairvA svedyaH saMvRutya cakShuShI||11||
14.commentary: svede kriyamANe cakShuShaH svedaparihAropAyamAha- sushuddhairityAdi| naktakaH karpaTAvayavaH ||11||

14.sanskrit: muktAvalIbhiH shItAbhiH shItalairbhAjanairapi| jalArdrairjalajairhastaiH svidyato hRudayaM spRushet||12||
14.commentary: svede kriyamANe hRudayarakShaNArthamAha- muktAvalIbhirityAdi| jalajAni pa~gkajAdIni| evamasvedyatvasAmAnyatvAdvRuShaNarakShA~apyunnetavyA, prAdhAnyAddhRudayacakShuHpAlanamuktam||12||

14.sanskrit: shItashUlavyuparame stambhagauravanigrahe| sa~jjAte mArdave svede svedanAdviratirmatA||13||
14.commentary: shItashUletyAdi| sveda iti svedabhave gharme| svedanAdviratirmatetyupadishan shItAdivyuparame sati svedo nivartanIyaH, shItAdyanuparame ca svedaH kartavya iti dvayamupadishati; tatashca ita eva svedanivRuttiviShayashItAdivyuparamotpAdaH svedasya samyagyogalakShaNaM tathA shItAdivyuparamAnutpAdashca svedAnivRuttiviShayo~ayogalakShaNamuktaM bhavatIti nAyogalakShaNAnabhidhAnamudbhAvanIyam||13||

14.sanskrit: pittaprakopo mUrcchA ca sharIrasadanaM tRuShA| dAhaH svarA~ggadaurbalyamatisvinnasya lakShaNam||14|| uktastasyAshitIye yo graiShmikaH sarvasho vidhiH| so~atisvinnasya kartavyo madhuraH snigdhashItalaH||15||
14.commentary: atisvinnacikitsitamAha- ukta ityAdi| graiShmiko vidhirityanena labdhe punarmadhuraH snigdhashItala ityAdivacanaM “madyamalpaM na vA peyaM” (sU.a.6) ityatropadiShTamadyapAnasya pratiShedhArthaM, madhurashItAdiyogavisheShavidhAnArthaM ca||14-15||

14.sanskrit: kaShAyamadyanityAnAM garbhiNyA raktapittinAm| pittinAM sAtisArANAM rUkShANAM madhumehinAm||16|| vidagdhabhraShTabradhnAnAM viShamadyavikAriNAm| shrAntAnAM naShTasa~jj~jAnAM sthUlAnAM pittamehinAm||17|| tRuShyatAM kShudhitAnAM ca kruddhAnAM shocatAmapi| kAmalyudariNAM caiva kShatAnAmADhyarogiNAm||18|| durbalAtivishuShkANAmupakShINaujasAM tathA| bhiShak taimirikANAM ca na svedamavatArayet||19||
14.commentary: asvedyAnAha- kaShAyetyAdi| kaShAyadravyakRutaM madyaM kaShAyamadyaM; kiMvA kaShAyashabdo~amadhuravacanaH, na tena yaducyate- kaShAyanityasya vAtapradhAnatA syAt kaShAyasya vAtakAritvAt, vAte ca svedo vihita eva, tat kathaM kaShAyanityaM prati svedaniShedha iti, tannirastaM bhavati| kiMvA, kaShAyanityA rUkShAtistabdhagAtrA bhavanti, kaShAyasya virUkShakastambhakatvena; tatashca teShAM svedaH parvabhedamAvahatItyataH kaShAyanityaniShedhaH| raktapittinAmavidhAnAdeva svede niShiddhe, punaH svedaniShedho raktapittinAM yadyanyo~api svedasAdhyo vAtashleShmajo vikAro bhavati tatrApi svedaniShedhArthaM, tathA raktapittinAM vamanavirecanA~ggatayA prAptasvedapratiprasavaniShedhArthaM ca; evaM pittamehikAmalyAdiShvapi vyAkhyeyam| pittinAmiti pittaprakRutInAm| madhumehashabdena sarva evaM mehA gRuhyante, madhumehashabdo hi sarveShveva meheShu vartata iti kiyantaHshirasIye darshanIyaM, meheShu ca sarveShveva sharIrashaithilyapravRutteShu visheShataH sharIrashaithilyahetutvena svedo na yujyate; pittamehinAmiti tu punarabhidhAnaM pittasambandhena visheShapratiShedhatAdarshanArtham| bradhnaH gudaH| madyavikAriNAmiti madyanityasya vAtakaphajamadAtyaye svedaniShedhArtham| ADhyarogIha vAtaraktI| eShu cAsvedaviShayeShu yadi svedaikasAdhyaH sannyAsAdirbhavati tadA mahApratyavAyabhayAdalpapratyavAyamupekShyApi svedo vidheya iti nyAyasiddhameva; yadAhurnyAyavidaH- “bhUyovirodhe svalpamanyAyyam” iti||16-19||

14.sanskrit: pratishyAye ca kAse ca hikkAshvAseShvalAghave| karNamanyAshiraHshUle svarabhede galagrahe||20|| arditaikA~ggasarvA~ggapakShAghAte vinAmake| koShThAnAhavibandheShu mUtrAghAte vijRumbhake||21|| pArshvapRuShThakaTIkukShisa~ggrahe gRudhrasIShu ca| mUtrakRucchre mahattve ca muShkayora~ggamardake||22|| pAdajAnUruja~gghArtisa~ggrahe shvayathAvapi| khallIShvAmeShu shIte ca vepathau vAtakaNTake||23|| sa~gkocAyAmashUleShu stambhagauravasuptiShu | sarvA~ggeShu vikAreShu svedanaM hitamucyate||24||
14.commentary: pratishyAye cetyAdinA svedyAn darshayati| vinAmakaH sharIravinamanakArI vAtaH| vijRumbhako bahirAyAmaH, jRumbhAbahutvaM vA| pAdajAnUruja~gghAbhirartiH sa~ggrahashca pRuthak sambadhyate| khallI hastapadAvamoTanam| vAtakaNTako gulphAshrito vAtaH| alAghava iti pUrvamukte~api punargauravavacanama~ggAnAM gurutaratvapratipAdanArtham, alAghavavacanaM tu lAghavapratiShedhamAtraprayojanaM nAtigurutvaM brUte, yataH sarvatra na~j viruddhe na vartate, yathA “arUkShamanabhiShyandi tvAsInapracalAyitam” (sU.a.21) ityatra na hyarUkShashabdena snigdhatvamabhipretaM, kiM tarhi rUkShatApratiShedhamAtrameva||20-24||

14.sanskrit: tilamAShakulatthAmlaghRutatailAmiShaudanaiH| pAyasaiH kRusharairmAMsaiH piNDasvedaM prayojayet||25|| gokharoShTravarAhAshvashakRudbhiH satuShairyavaiH| sikatApAMshupAShANakarIShAyasapUTakaiH||26|| shlaiShmikAn svedayet pUrvairvAtikAn samupAcaret| dravyANyetAni shasyante yathAsvaM prastareShvapi||27||
14.commentary: vakShyamANAnAM sa~gkarAdisvedAnAM dravyANyAha- tilamAShetyAdi| piNDarUpaH svedaH piNDasvedaH| karIShaH shuShkagomayaH; AyasaH ayovikAraH, sa ceha puTakaraNayogyo boddhavyaH| pUrvairiti tilamAShAdibhiH| yathAsvamityanena tilamAShAdayo vAte, gokharAdigranthoktAshca shleShmaNi, prastarasvede kartavyA iti darshayati||25-27||

14.sanskrit: bhUgRuheShu ca jentAkeShUShNagarbhagRuheShu ca| vidhUmA~ggAratapteShu svabhyaktaH svidyate sukham||28||
14.commentary: bhUgRuheShviti bhUsvedArtheShu gRuheShu| uShNagarbhagRuheShviti kuTIsvedaM darshayati| svabhyakta iti samyagabhyaktaH||28||

14.sanskrit: grAmyAnUpaudakaM mAMsaM payo bastashirastathA| varAhamadhyapittAsRuk snehavattilataNDulAH||29|| ityetAni samutkvAthya nADIsvedaM prayojayet| deshakAlavibhAgaj~jo yuktyapekSho bhiShaktamaH||30|| vAruNAmRutakairaNDashigrumUlakasarShapaiH| vAsAvaMshakara~jjArkapatrairashmantakasya ca||31|| shobhA~jjanakasaireyamAlatIsurasArjakaiH | patrairutkvAthya salilaM nADIsvedaM prayojayet||32|| bhUtIkapa~jcamUlAbhyAM surayA dadhimastunA| mUtrairamlaishca sasnehairnADIsvedaM prayojayet||33||
14.commentary: bastashiraH chAgamastakam| snehavantashcairaNDabIjAdayaH tilAshca taNDulAshca snehavattilataNDulAH| grAmyetyAdinA vAtApaho nADIsveda uktaH, vAruNetyAdinA kaphApahaH, bhUtIketyAdinA vAtashleShmApahaH| vAruNo varuNaH amRutakA guDUcI, sarShapairityatra patrairiti sambadhyate| vaMsho veNuH| punaH shobhA~jjanagrahaNAddvitIyo viTapashobhA~jjano gRuhyate, saireyaH jhiNTI||29-33||

14.sanskrit: eta eva ca niryUhAH prayojyA jalakoShThake| svedanArthaM ghRutakShIratailakoShThAMshca kArayet||34||
14.commentary: eta eveti nADIsvedoktAstrayo~api| jalakoShThaH avagAhArthaM kRutaM mahajjalapAtram; evaM ghRutakShIratailakoShThAshca vyAkhyAtAH||34||

14.sanskrit: godhUmashakalaishcUrNairyavAnAmamlasaMyutaiH| sasnehakiNvalavaNairupanAhaH prashasyate||35|| gandhaiH surAyAH kiNvena jIvantyA shatapuShpayA| umayA kuShThatailAbhyAM yuktayA copanAhayet||36|| carmabhishcopanaddhavyaH salomabhirapUtibhiH| uShNavIryairalAbhe tu kausheyAvikashATakaiH||37||
14.commentary: godhUmashakalaiH godhUmacUrNaiH| kiNvaH surAbIjam| upanAhaH bahalaM lepaM dattvA carmAdibhirAvRutya vyAdhiyuktasyA~ggasya bandhanam; carmabhishcopanaddhavya ityatra upanAho~anagnisvedo grAhyaH| gandhaiH sugandhidravyairupanAho bandhanIyaH| uShNavIryairiti uShNavIryamRugAdiprANiprabhavaiH | AvikashATakaH kambalaH||35-37||

14.sanskrit: rAtrau baddhaM divA mu~jcenmu~jcedrAtrau divA kRutam| vidAhaparihArArthaM, syAt prakarShastu shItale||38||
14.commentary: upanAhasvede bandhamokShAvadhiM darshayati- rAtrau baddhamityAdi| divAkRutamityatra ‘bandhaM’ iti sheShaH| vidAhaH raktAdividAhaH| shItale ityatra “kAle” iti sheShaH| prakarSha uktAdbandhanakAlAdadhikakAlatvaM bandhanasya||38||

14.sanskrit: sa~gkaraH prastaro nADI pariSheko~avagAhanam| jentAko~ashmaghanaH karShUH kuTI bhUH kumbhikaiva ca||39|| kUpo holAka ityete svedayanti trayodasha| tAn yathAvat pravakShyAmi sarvAnevAnupUrvashaH||40||
14.commentary: samprati sAgnisvedAnAM sa~gkarAdInAM lakShaNamabhidhAtuM sa~gkarAdIn svedAn nAmatastAvaduddishati- sa~gkara ityAdi| sa~gkarAdishabdAshcAyurvedaparamparAsiddhAH; tatra kvacinnADIsvedAdau nADyA praNIyata ityanvayo~apyanusaraNIyaH, jentAkAdayashcAnvayanirapekShA eva||39-40||

14.sanskrit: tatra vastrAntaritairavastrAntaritairvA piNDairyathoktairupasvedanaM sa~gkarasveda iti vidyAt||41||
14.commentary: piNDairyathoktairiti tilamAShAdipiNDaistathA gokharAdigranthoktapuTakarUpaishca piNDaiH; svedanamevopasvedanam||41||

14.sanskrit: shUkashamIdhAnyapulAkAnAM veshavArapAyasakRusharotkArikAdInAM vA prastare kausheyAvikottarapracchadepa~jcA~ggulorubUkArkapatrapracchade vA svabhyaktasarvagAtrasya shayAnasyopasvedanaM prastarasveda iti vidyAt||42||
14.commentary: pulAkaH tucchadhAnyam| utkArikA mAShAdikRutotkArAkRutivya~jjanavisheShaH | prastIryata iti prastaraH shayanapramANena svedavastUnAM vistaraNaM, tasmin prastare| kausheyAvikottarapracchade kausheyAvikapihita ityarthaH| pa~jcA~ggula eraNDabhedaH||42||

14.sanskrit: svedanadravyANAM punarmUlaphalapatrashu~ggAdInAM mRugashakunapishitashiraspadAdInAmuShNasvabhAvAnAM vA yathArhamamlalavaNasnehopasaMhitAnAM mUtrakShIrAdInAM vA kumbhyAM bAShpamanudvamantyAmutkvathitAnAM nADyA shareShIkAvaMshadalakara~jjArkapatrAnyatamakRutayA gajAgrahastasaMsthAnayA vyAmadIrghayA vyAmArdhadIrghayA vA vyAmacaturbhAgAShTabhAgamUlAgrapariNAhasrotasA sarvato vAtaharapatrasaMvRutacchidrayA dvistrirvA vinAmitayA vAtaharasiddhasnehAbhyaktagAtro bAShpamupaharet; bAShpo hyanRujugAmI vihatacaNDavegastvacamavidahan sukhaM svedayatIti nADIsvedaH||43||
14.commentary: svedanetyAdinA nADIsvedamAha| svedanadravyANi svedopagagaNoktAni iha ca nADIsvedakvAthArthamuktAni| shiraHpadaM mastakam| bAShpamanudvamantyAmityanena kvathanakAle bAShpo yathA na niryAti tathA kartavyamiti darshayati| utkvathitAnAM bAShpaM snehAktagAtraH san nADyA upaharediti sambandhaH| nADIkaraNavidhimAha- shareShIketyAdi| vaMshadalo vaMshavidalaH | gajAgrahastasaMsthAnatvaM nADyA agra eva boddhavyam| vyAmaH tiryagvistRutabAhudvayapramANaM; vyAmadIrghatvaM nADyA bahalasvede kartavyam| vyAmacaturthabhAgena vyAmAShTabhAgena ca mUle agre ca yathAsa~gkhyaM mAnaM nADyA veditavyaM; pariNAhena veShTanena sroto randhraM yasyAH sA tathA| yathoktanADIkaraNe guNamAha- bAShpo hItyAdi| vihatacaNDavegatvaM nADIkAyA dIrghatvena vakratvena ca boddhavyam||43||

14.sanskrit: vAtikottaravAtikAnAM punarmUlAdInAmutkvAthaiH sukhoShNaiH kumbhIrvarShaNikAH pranADIrvA pUrayitvA yathArhasiddhasnehAbhyaktagAtraM vastrAvacchannaM pariShecayediti pariShekaH||44||
14.commentary: pariShekavidhimAha- vAtiketyAdi| vAtikAni vAtaharANi, uttaravAtikAni uttaravAte pradhAnavAte vAtashleShmaNi hitAnIha grAhyANi| varShaNikA alpaghaTI, ‘sahasradhArA’ ityanye; praNADI veNunalanADyAdyAH||44||

14.sanskrit: vAtaharotkvAthakShIratailaghRutapishitarasoShNasalilakoShThakAvagAhastu yathokta evAvagAhaH||45||
14.commentary: yathokta eveti lokaprasiddha eva| avagAhaH avagAhasvedaH||45||

14.sanskrit: atha jentAkaM cikIrShurbhUmiM parIkSheta- tatra pUrvasyAM dishyuttarasyAM vA guNavati prashaste bhUmibhAge kRuShNamadhuramRuttike suvarNamRuttike vA parIvApapuShkariNyAdInAM jalAshayAnAmanyatamasya kUle dakShiNe pashcime vA sUpatIrthe samasuvibhaktabhUmibhAge saptAShTau vA~aratnIrupakramyodakAt prA~gmukhamuda~gmukhaM vA~abhimukhatIrthaM kUTAgAraM kArayet, utsedhavistArataH paramaratnIH ShoDasha, samantAt suvRuttaM mRutkarmasampannamanekavAtAyanam; asya kUTAgArasyAntaH samantato bhittimaratnivistArotsedhAM piNDikAM kArayedAkapATAt, madhye cAsya kUTAgArasya catuShkiShkumAtraM puruShapramANaM mRunmayaM kandusaMsthAnaM bahusUkShmacchidrama~ggArakoShThakastambhaM sapidhAnaM kArayet; taM ca khAdirANAmAshvakarNAdInAM vA kAShThAnAM pUrayitvA pradIpayet; sa yadA jAnIyAt sAdhu dagdhAni kAShThAni gatadhUmAnyavataptaM ca kevalamagninA tadagnigRuhaM svedayogyena coShmaNA yuktamiti, tatrainaM puruShaM vAtaharAbhyaktagAtraM vastrAvacchannaM praveshayet, praveshayaMshcainamanushiShyAt- saumya! pravisha kalyANAyArogyAya ceti, pravishya cainAM piNDikAmadhiruhya pArshvAparapArshvAbhyAM yathAsukhaM shayIthAH, na ca tvayA svedamUrcchAparItenApi satA piNDikaiShA vimoktavyA~a~aprANocchvAsAt, bhrashyamAno hyataH piNDivakAvakAshAddvAramanadhigacchan svedamUrcchAparItatayA sadyaH prANA~jjahyAH, tasmAt piNDikAmenAM na katha~jcana mu~jcethAH; tvaM yadA jAnIyAH- vigatAbhiShyandamAtmAnaM samyakprasrutasvedapicchaM sarvasrotovimuktaM laghUbhUtamapagatavibandhastambhasuptivedanAgauravamiti, tatastAM piNDikAmanusaran dvAraM prapadyethAH, niShkramya ca na sahasA cakShuShoH paripAlanArthaM shItodakamupaspRushethAH, apagatasantApaklamastu muhUrtAt sukhoShNena vAriNA yathAnyAyaM pariShikto~ashnIyAH; iti jentAkasvedaH||46||
14.commentary: jentAkavidhimAha- athetyAdi| athashabdo ma~ggale Anantarye vA| pUrvasyAmuttarasyAM veti grAmAdbAddhavyam| guNavatIti sasyaprarohAdiyuktatvena; prashastabhUmibhAgatvaM tuShA~ggArAdirahitatvena| parIvApaH dIrghikA| suShThu upa samIpe tIrthaM yasya tasmin sUpatIrthe| aratniH hastaH| prA~gmukhamiti pashcime, uda~gmukhamiti dakShiNe; evaM hyabhimukhaM tIrthaM bhavati| kUTAgAramiti vartulAgAram| AkapATAdityanena dvAraparyantaM lakShayati| kiShkuH hastaH| puruShapramANamiti UrdhvataH| kanduH kandvAkArAgnisthAnam| a~ggArArthaM koShTho~avakAsho vidyate yasmin so~a~ggArakoShThakaH, sa eva stambha itya~ggArakoShThakastambhaH| khAdirANAmiti pUraNe ShaShThI| sa ityatra ‘tvaM’ ityadhyAhAryaM, jAnIyA ityarthaH; kiMvA, ‘jAnIyAt’ iti pAThaH, uttaratrApi ‘praveshayet’ iti pAThaH; evaM ca sugamam| picchA svedasyaiva picchilo bhAgaH| sarveShu srotaHsu vimuktaM sarvasrotovimuktam apagatavibandhastu apagatamalavibandho boddhavyaH| cakShuShoH paripAlanArthamiti atropataptasya sahasA shItajalapraveshe shItajalaparAhata UShmA nayanopaghAtaM karotItyabhiprAyaH| atra ca jentAke bhUmivisheShaparigrahajalasAnnidhyAdayo ma~ggalArthAH; jalasAnnidhyaM tu svidyamAnasya darshanena dRuShTeH paripAlanArthaM ca, tathA svedAtiyogapratikriyArthaM kUTAgArasya jalasAnnidhye sukhena karaNArthaM ca||46||

14.sanskrit: shayAnasya pramANena ghanAmashmamayIM shilAm| tApayitvA mArutaghnairdArubhiH sampradIpitaiH||47|| vyapojjhya sarvAna~ggArAn prokShya caivoShNavAriNA| tAM shilAmatha kurvIta kauSheyAvikasaMstarAm||48|| tasyAM svabhyaktasarvA~ggaH svapan svidyati nA sukham| kauravAjinakauSheyaprAvArAdyaiH susaMvRutaH ||49|| ityakto~ashmaghanasvedaH,...|50|
14.commentary: kauravaM kArpAsam||47-49||-

14.sanskrit: ...karShUsvedaH pravakShyate| khAnayecchayanasyAdhaH karShUM sthAnavibhAgavit||50|| dIptairadhUmaira~ggAraistAM karShUM pUrayettataH| tasyAmupari shayyAyAM svapan svidyati nA sukham||51||
14.commentary: karShUH abhyantaravistIrNaH svalpamukho gartaH||50-51||

14.sanskrit: anatyutsedhavistArAM vRuttAkArAmalocanAm| ghanabhittiM kuTIM kRutvA kuShThAdyaiH sampralepayet||52|| kuTImadhye bhiShak shayyAM svAstIrNAmupakalpayet| prAvArAjinakausheyakuthakambalagolakaiH||53|| hasantikAbhira~ggArapUrNAbhistAM ca sarvashaH| parivAryAntarArohedabhyaktaH svidyate sukham||54|| ya evAshmaghanasvedavidhirbhUmau sa eva tu| prashastAyAM nivAtAyAM samAyAmupadishyate||55||
14.commentary: anatyutsedhavistArAmiti svalpapramANocchrAyavistArAm| alocanAM nirjAlakAm| kuShThAdyairiti atrAdishabdaH prakAravacanaH, tenoShNasugandhidravyairiti bhavati| hasantikA a~ggAradhAni(ri)kA, parivAryeti hasantikAbhirityanena sambadhyate| tAmiti upakalpitashayyAM kuTIm, Arohediti sambandhaH||52-55||

14.sanskrit: kumbhIM vAtaharakvAthapUrNAM bhUmau nikhAnayet| ardhabhAgaM tribhAgaM vA shayanaM tatra copari||56|| sthApayedAsanaM vA~api nAtisAndraparicchadam| atha kumbhyAM susantaptAn prakShipedayaso guDAn||57|| pAShANAn voShmaNA tena tatsthaH svidyati nA sukham| susaMvRutA~ggaH svabhyaktaH snehairanilanAshanaiH||58||
14.commentary: shayanaM tatra coparIti atra kumbhIkopari shayanaM khaTTAdi tathA kartavyaM yathA kumbhIkA na bhajyate| tatstha iti yathoktashayanAsanasthaH||56-58||

14.sanskrit: kUpaM shayanavistAraM dviguNaM cApi vedhataH| deshe nivAte shaste ca kuryAdantaHsumArjitam||59|| hastyashvagokharoShTrANAM karIShairdagdhapUrite| svavacchannaH susaMstIrNe~abhyaktaH svidyati nA sukham||60||
14.commentary: kUpamiti kUpamiva kUpaM gabhIratvena| dviguNamiti vistArAdboddhavyam| vedhata ityadhaHkhananapramANena| susaMstIrNa iti suShThu saMstIrNe AcchAdite, shayyayA khaTvoparisthitayA AcchAdite kUpe iti boddhavyam||59-60||

14.sanskrit: dhItIkAM tu karIShANAM yathoktAnAM pradIpayet| shayanAntaHpramANena shayyAmupari tatra ca||61|| sudagdhAyAM vidhUmAyAM yathoktAmupakalpayet| svavacchannaH svapaMstatrAbhyaktaH svidyati nA sukham||62|| holAkasveda ityeSha sukhaH prokto maharShiNA| iti trayodashavidhaH svedo~agniguNasaMshrayaH||63||
14.commentary: dhItIkAmityAdinA holAkasvedaH| dhItIkA shuShkagomayAdikRuto~agnyAshrayavisheShaH| yathoktAnAmiti pUrvoktahastyashvAdibhavAnAm| shayanAntaHpramANena dhItIkAM ‘kRutvA’ ityadhyAhArya yojyam| yathoktAmiti nAtisAndraparicchadAm| upasaMharati- itItyAdi| sAkShAdagnerguNamuShNatvamAshritya svedayatItyagniguNasaMshrayaH||61-63||

14.sanskrit: vyAyAma uShNasadanaM guruprAvaraNaM kShudhA| bahupAnaM bhayakrodhAvupanAhAhavAtapAH||64|| svedayanti dashaitAni naramagniguNAdRute|65|
14.commentary: sampratyanagnisvedAnAha- vyAyAma ityAdi| uShNasadanamiti agnisantApavyatirekeNa nirjAlakatayA ghanabhittitayA ca yadgRuhaM svedayati tadboddhavyam| bahupAnamiti bahumadyapAnam| upanAho dvividhaH- sAgniranagnishca; tatra yaH sAgnirupanAhaH sa sa~gkara eva boddhavyaH, yaduktaM- “kolaM kulatthAH suradArurAsnAH” (sU.a.3) ityAdinA~a~aragvadhIye; yastvanagnirbahalatvena sharIroShmarodhaM kRutvA svedayati sa iha boddhavyaH| Atapashca yadyapyuShNaH, tathA~apyagnikRutaM tasyoShNatvaM na bhavatItyanagnisveda uktaH| agniguNAdRute iti sAkShAdagnisambandhena kRutAduShNatvAdvinA||64||-

14.sanskrit: ityukto dvividhaH svedaH saMyukto~agniguNairna ca||65|| ekA~ggasarvA~ggagataH snigdho rUkShastathaiva ca| ityetattrividhaM dvandvaM svedamuddishya kIrtitam||66||
14.commentary: sarvasvedamupasaMharati- ityukta ityAdi| ekA~ggagatAH sa~gkaranADyAdayaH, sarvA~ggagatAH prastarajentAkAdayaH| snigdho vAtavihitaH svedaH| rUkShaH kaphavihitaH| snigdharUkShastu vAtashleShmavihito~anayorna bhidyata iti pRutha~ggoktaH| dvandvaM parasparaM viruddhaM yugmam||65-66||

14.sanskrit: snigdhaH svedairupakramyaH svinnaH pathyAshano bhavet| tadahaH svinnagAtrastu vyAyAmaM varjayennaraH||67||
14.commentary: svinnena yathA kartavyaM tadAha- snigdha ityAdi| pathyAshano bhavedityatra yadyapi shRu~ggagrAhikayA pathyaM noktaM, tathA~api svedapravRuttiviShayadoShasya yat pathyaM tadeva boddhavyam||67||

14.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- svedo yathA kAryakaro hito yebhyashca yadvidhaH| yatra deshe yathA yogyo desho rakShyashca yo yathA||68|| svinnAtisvinnarUpANi tathA~atisvinnabheShajam| asvedyAH svedayogyAshca svedadravyANi kalpanA||69|| trayodashavidhaH svedo vinA dashavidho~agninA| sa~ggraheNa ca ShaT svedAH svedAdhyAye nidarshitAH||70|| svedAdhikAre yadvAcyamuktametanmaharShiNA | shiShyaistu pratipattavyamupadeShTA punarvasuH||71||
14.commentary: sa~ggrahe svedo yathA kAryakara iti snehapUrvaM prayuktenetyAdi| yebhyashca yadvidha iti vAte snigdha ityAdi sa~ggRuhNAti| yatra deshe yathA yogya iti AmAshayagate vAte rUkShapUrva ityAdi| sheShaM sugamam||68-71||

14.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne svedAdhyAyo nAma caturdasho~adhyAyaH||14||
14.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattakRutAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAkhyAyAM sUtrasthAne nirdeshacatuShke svedAdhyAyashcaturdashaH||14||

15.sanskrit: athAta upakalpanIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
15.commentary: snehasvedopapannasya saMshodhanamanantaramityanenaivoktAt sambandhAt svedAdhyAyAnantaraM shodhanavidherabhidhAyakamupakalpanIyamAha| upakalpanIyamiti shodhanopakalpanAmadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAya upakalpanIyaH||1-2||

15.sanskrit: iha khalu rAjAnaM rAjamAtramanyaM vA vipuladravyaM vamanaM virecanaM vA pAyayitukAmena bhiShajA prAgevauShadhapAnAt sambhArA upakalpanIyA bhavanti samyakcaiva hi gacchatyauShadhe pratibhogArthAH, vyApanne cauShadhe vyApadaH parisa~gkhyAya pratIkArArthAH; na hi sannikRuShTe kAle prAdurbhUtAyAmApadi satyapi krayAkraye sukaramAshu sambharaNamauShadhAnAM yathAvaditi||3|| evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- nanu bhagavan! AdAveva j~jAnavatA tathA pratividhAtavyaM yathA prativihite sidhyedevauShadhamekAntena, samyakprayoganimittA hi sarvakarmaNAM siddhiriShTA, vyApaccAsamyakprayoganimittA; atha samyagasamyak ca samArabdhaM karma siddhyati vyApadyate vA~aniyamena, tulyaM bhavati j~jAnamaj~jAneneti||4||
15.commentary: rAj~ja iva mAtrA paricchado yasya sa rAjamAtraH| vipuladravyastu vaNigAdiH| parisa~gkhyAyeti j~jAtvA| krayaH paNyam, Akrayo mUlyam| aniyameneti samyagArabdhaM sidhyati vyApadyate ca||3-4||

15.sanskrit: tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- shakyaM tathA pratividhAtumasmAbhirasmadvidhairvA~apyagnivesha! yathA prativihite sidhyedevauShadhamekAntena, tacca prayogasauShThavamupadeShTuM yathAvat; nahi kashcidasti ya etadevamupadiShTamupadhArayitumutsaheta, upadhArya vA tathA pratipattuM prayoktuM vA; sUkShmANi hi doShabheShajadeshakAlabalasharIrAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutivayasAmavasthAntarANi, yAnyanucintyamAnAni vimalavipulabuddherapi buddhimAkulIkuryuH kiM punaralpabuddheH; tasmAdubhayametadyathAvadupadekShyAmaH- samyakprayogaM cauShadhAnAM, vyApannAnAM ca vyApatsAdhanAni siddhiShUttarakAlam||5||
15.commentary: prayogasauShThavaM prayogasuShThutvaM, yathAvadupadeShTuM shakyamasmAbhirasmadvidhairveti yojanA| etaditi prayogasauShThavam| evamiti yathAvad| upadhArayitumiti granthena dhArayitum| pratipattumiti arthato grahItum| sUkShmANItyAdi sUkShmANIva sUkShmANi durbodhatvena; tatra doShasyAvasthAntarANi- kShayastathA vRuddhistathA samatvaM, evamUrdhvadehagamanaM tathA~adhodehagamanaM tiryaggamanaM vA, tathA shAkhAshrayitvaM koShThAshrayitvaM madhyamArgAshrayitvaM, tathA svadeshagamanaM paradeshagamanaM, tathA svatantratvaM paratantratvaM, tathAM~ashAMshavikalpaH, tathA dhAtuvisheShAshrayitvaM, tathA kAlaprakRutidUShyAnuguNatvAdikRutsnatantrapratipAditAni j~jeyAni; evaM bheShajasyAvasthAntarANi- taruNatvaM, vRuddhatvam, ArdratvaM, shuShkatvaM, dravyAntarasaMyuktatvaM, svarasAdikalpanAyogitvaM, rasavIryavipAkaiH prabhAvaishca tasmin dehe doShAdau tattatkAryakartRutvamevamAdIni; deshastvAnUpajA~ggalasAdhAraNaprashastAdibhedabhinnaH; kAlAvasthAntarANi tu RutubhedAH, pUrvAhNAdishca tathA vyAdhyavasthA jvarAShTAhAdaya ityevamAdIni; balaM tu sahajaM yuktikRutaM tathA kAlakRutamutkRuShTApakRuShTamadhyAdibhedabhinnaM; sharIraM tu sthUlatvakRushatvasAravattvaniHsAravattvAdi, tathA paripAlanIyadRuShTimarmAdyavayavavisheShAdibhishca bhinnam; AhArastu prakRutikaraNasaMyogarAshibhedAdibhirbhinnaH; sAtmyaM tu deshataH kAlato vyAdhitaH prakRutitaH svabhAvato~abhyAsatashca bhinnaM bhavati; sattvaM tu bhayashauryaviShAdaharShAdiyogabhinnaM bhavati; prakRutibhedAstvanekaprakArabhinnavAtAdyArabdhatvena boddhavyAH; vayobhedAstu bAlyayauvanavArdhakyatadavAntarabhedAH ; etAni doShAdyavasthAntarANi cikitsAprayoge yathAyathA~apekShyante, tadudAharaNaM shAstre~anusaraNIyam, iha likhyamAnaM tu vistaratvaM granthasyAvahatIti noktam| ubhayametaduttarakAlaM siddhiShUpadekShyAma iti yojanA||5||

15.sanskrit: idAnIM tAvat sambhArAn vividhAnapi samAsenopadekShyAmaH; tadyathA- dRuDhaM nivAtaM pravAtaikadeshaM sukhapravicAramanupatyakaM dhUmAtapajalarajasAmanabhigamanIyamaniShThAnAM ca shabdasparsharasarUpagandhAnAM sodapAnodUkhalamusalavarcaHsthAnasnAnabhUmimahAnasaM vAstuvidyAkushalaH prashastaM gRuhameva tAvat pUrvamupakalpayet||6||
15.commentary: vividhAnapIti apishabdaH samAsenApItyevaMrUpo j~jeyaH; tena gRuhAdayo~api vistareNocyante, sa~ggrahaNIyAdayashca samAseneti dvayamapi susthaM syAt; yadi vA ‘dvividhAnapi’ iti pAThaH, tena bhogArthAni tathA vyApatsAdhanAni gRuhyante| anupatyakaM yad vidUramanyasya mahato gRuhasya| udakaM pIyate yena tadudapAnam||6||

15.sanskrit: tataH shIlashaucAcArAnurAgadAkShyaprAdakShiNyopapannAnupacArakushalAn sarvakarmasu paryavadAtAn sUpaudanapAcakasnApakasaMvAhakotthApakasaMveshakauShadhapeShakAMshca paricArakAn sarvakarmasvapratikUlAn, tathA gItavAditrollApakashlokagAthAkhyAyiketihAsapurANakushalAnabhiprAyaj~jAnanumatAMshca deshakAlavidaH pAriShadyAMshca, tathA lAvakapi~jjilashashahariNaiNakAlapucchakamRugamAtRukorabhrAn, gAM dogdhrIM shIlavatImanAturAM jIvadvatsAM suprativihitatRuNasharaNapAnIyAM, pAtryAcamanIyodakoShThamaNikaghaTapiTharaparyogakumbhIkumbhakuNDasharAva- darvIkaToda~jcanaparipacanamanthAnacarmacelasUtrakArpAsorNAdIni ca, shayanAsanAdIni copanyastabhRu~ggArapratigrahANi suprayuktAstaraNottarapracchadopadhAnAni sopAshrayANi saMveshanopaveshanasnehasvedAbhya~ggapradehapariShekAnulepanavamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsana- shirovirecanamUtroccArakarmaNAmupacArasukhAni, suprakShAlitopadhAnAshca sushlakShNakharamadhyamA dRuShadaH, shastrANi copakaraNArthAni, dhUmanetraM ca, bastinetraM cottarabastikaM ca, kushahastakaM ca, tulAM ca, mAnabhANDaM ca, ghRutatailavasAmajjakShaudraphANitalavaNendhanodakamadhusIdhusurAsauvIrakatuShodaka- maireyamedakadadhidadhimaNDodasviddhAnyAmlamUtrANi ca, tathA shAliShaShTikamudgamAShayavatilakulatthabadaramRudvIkAkAshmaryaparUShakAbhayAmalakabibhItakAni, nAnAvidhAni ca snehasvedopakaraNAni dravyANi, tathaivordhvaharAnulomikobhayabhA~jji, sa~ggrahaNIyadIpanIyapAcanIyopashamanIyavAtaharAdisamAkhyAtAni cauShadhAni; yaccAnyadapi ki~jcihyApadaH parisa~gkhyAya pratIkArArthamupakaraNaM vidyAt, yacca pratibhogArthaM, tattadupakalpayet||7||
15.commentary: prAdakShiNyam AnukUlyam| ullApakaM stotram, itihAsaH aj~jAyamAnakartRukAptopadeshaH| mRugamAtRukA pRuthUdaro hariNaH| sharaNaM gRuham| AcamanIyodakoShTham AcamAnArthamudakakoShThaM; kiMvA Acamyate yena pAtreNa tadAcamanaM; maNiko golakaH , piTharaH sthAlI, paryogaH kaTAhaH, kumbho dRuDhAvayavo~alpamukho ghaTaH, kaTaH tRuNAdiracitamAsanam, uda~jcanaM pidhAnasharAvaH, paripacanaM tailapAcanikA| UrNA gaDDararomANi| suprakShAlitetyAdau upadhAnaH shilAputra iti prasiddhaH, dRuShadaH pAShANapaTTakAH| shastrANi copakaraNArthAnIti kuddAlakartarIprabhRutIni| kushahastakaM sammArjanI; anye tu Ardradravyaparipacanamabhidadhati| mAnabhANDaM pratimAnam||7||

15.sanskrit: tatastaM puruShaM yathoktAbhyAM snehasvedAbhyAM yathArhamupapAdayet, taM cedasminnantare mAnasaH shArIro vA vyAdhiH kashcittIvrataraH sahasA~abhyAgacchettameva tAvadasyopAvartayituM yateta, tatastamupAvartya tAvantamevainaM kAlaM tathAvidhenaiva karmaNopAcaret||8|| tatastaM puruShaM snehasvedopapannamanupahatamanasamabhisamIkShya sukhoShitaM suprajIrNabhaktaM shiraHsnAtamanuliptagAtraM sragviNamanupahatavastrasaMvItaM devatAgnidvijaguruvRuddhavaidyAnarcitavantamiShTe nakShatratithikaraNamuhUrte kArayitvA brAhmaNAn svastivAcanaM prayuktAbhirAshIrbhirabhimantritAM madhumadhukasaindhavaphANitopahitAM madanaphalakaShAyamAtrAM pAyayet||9||
15.commentary: taM cetyAdau asminnantara iti snehasvedakaraNasamaye| tAvantameva kAlamiti yAvatA kAlenAgatavyAdhiprashamaH kRutastAvantam| iShTa iti shodhanakartRupuruShanakShatrAdyanuguNe auShadhaprayogArthaM vihita ityarthaH; yaduktaM jyotiSha- “puShyo hastastathA jyeShThA rohiNI shravaNAshvinau| svAti saumyaM ca bhaiShajye kuryAdanyatra varjayet” ityAdi| kArayitveti svastivAcanaM kArayitvA||8-9||

15.sanskrit: madanaphalakaShAyamAtrApramANaM tu khalu sarvasaMshodhanamAtrApramANAni ca pratipuruShamapekShitavyAni bhavanti; yAvaddhi yasya saMshodhanaM pItaM vaikArikadoShaharaNAyopapadyate na cAtiyogAyogAya, tAvadasya mAtrApramANaM veditavyaM bhavati||10|| pItavantaM tu khalvenaM muhUrtamanukA~gkSheta, tasya yadA jAnIyAt svedaprAdurbhAveNa doShaM pravilayanamApadyamAnaM, lomaharSheNa ca sthAnebhyaH pracalitaM, kukShisamAdhmApanena ca kukShimanugataM, hRullAsAsyasravaNAbhyAmapi cordhvamukhIbhUtam, athAsmai jAnusamamasambAdhaM suprayuktAstaraNottarapracchadopadhAnaM sopAshrayamAsanamupaveShTuM prayacchet, pratigrahAMshcopacArayet, lAlATapratigrahe pArshvopagrahaNe nAbhiprapIDane pRuShThonmardane cAnapatrapaNIyAH suhRudo~anumatAH prayateran||11||
15.commentary: pratipuruShamapekShitavyAnItyanena pratipuruShaM shodhanamAtrAbhedaM darshayati| yAvaddhItyAdi mAtrAshitIyoktaH ‘yAvaddhyasyAshanaM’ (sU.a.5) ityAdigranthavyAkhyAnAnusAreNa vyAkhyeyam| anukA~gkSheteti parIkShayan dhArayet| asambAdhamiti asa~gkIrNam| pratigRuhNantIti pratigrahaH patadgrahAH| lalATapratigrahAdaya anapatrapaNIyA alajjAviShayAH||10-11||
