15.sanskrit: athainamanushiShyAt- vivRutoShThatAlukaNTho nAtimahatA vyAyAmena vegAnudIrNAnudIrayan ki~jcidavanamya grIvAmUrdhvasharIramupavegamapravRuttAn pravartayan suparilikhitanakhAbhyAma~ggulibhyAmutpalakumudasaugandhikanAlairvA kaNThamabhispRushan sukhaM pravartayasveti, sa tathAvidhaM kuryAt; tato~asya vegAn pratigrahagatAnavekShetAvahitaH, vegavisheShadarshanAddhi kushalo yogAyogAtiyogavisheShAnupalabheta, vegavisheShadarshI punaH kRutyaM yathArhamavabudhyeta lakShaNena; tasmAdvegAnavekShetAvahitaH||12||
15.commentary: upavegaM vegasamIpam; etena sarvathA~apravRutte vege pravartanaM niShedhayati| vegavisheShadarshanAddhItyAdigranthasya bhAvino yogAyogAdIn vegaviShayAnupalabhya tarkayatItyarthaH; kiMvA, siddhau vaigikI shuddhirabhidhAtavyA “jaghanyamadhyapravare tu vegAshcatvAra iShTA vamane ShaDaShTau” (si.a.1) ityAdinA, tAmanena darshayati||12||

15.sanskrit: tatrAmUnyayogayogAtiyogavisheShaj~jAnAni bhavanti; tadyathA- apravRuttiH kutashcit kevalasya vA~apyauShadhasya vibhraMsho vibandho vegAnAmayogalakShaNAni bhavanti; kAle pravRuttiranatimahatI vyathA yathAkramaM doShaharaNaM svayaM cAvasthAnamiti yogalakShaNAni bhavanti, yogena tu doShapramANavisheSheNa tIkShNamRudumadhyavibhAgo j~jeyaH; yogAdhikyena tu phenilaraktacandrikopagamanamityatiyogalakShaNAni bhavanti| tatrAtiyogAyoganimittAnimAnupadravAn vidyAt- AdhmAnaM parikartikA parisrAvo hRudayopasaraNama~ggagraho jIvAdAnaM vibhraMshaH stambhaH klamashcetyupadravAH||13||
15.commentary: apravRuttiH kutashciditi sarvasyaivApravRuttiH; tathA kevalasya kRutsnasya shodhanIyadoShasyApravRuttiH; tathauShadhasya vibhraMshaH prAtilomyena gamanaM; yathA- vamanasyAdha UrdhvaM ca virecanasya, etadeva siddhAvuktaM- “ayogaH prAtilomyena nacA~alpaM vA pravartanam” (si. a.6) iti| kiMvA, kutashciddhA~apravRuttiH stokadoShapravRuttirityarthaH, tathA kevalasya cApyauShadhasya pravRuttiriti yojanA| yathAkramamiti vamane prathamaM shleShmA, tadanu pittaM, tadanu vAyuH; yaduktaM- “kramAt kaphaH pittamathAnilashca yasyaiti samyagvamitaH sa iShTaH” (si. a.1) iti| samyagyogo~api hartavyadoShasyAlpatvamadhyatvotkRuShTatvena trividho bhavatIti darshayannAha- yogena tvityAdi| tushabdo~avadhAraNe, tena yogenaiva yaH pramANavisheSho~alpAdistena, na tvayogAtiyogAbhyAmityarthaH; ayaM ca tIkShNAdiyogavibhAgaH peyAkramotkarShArthaH, tathAhi vakShyati siddhau- “peyAM vilepIM” (si. a.1.) ityAdi| tatrAtiyogetyAdau AdhmAnAdayaH shodhanasiddhau “bahudoShasya rUkShasya” (si. a.6) ityAdinA granthena prapa~jcena vaktavyAH, atastatraiShAM yogAtiyogajanyo yashcAyogajanyaH sa sphuTo j~jeyaH||13||

15.sanskrit: yogena tu khalvenaM charditavantamabhisamIkShya suprakShAlitapANipAdAsyaM muhUrtamAshvAsya, snaihikavairecanikopashamanIyAnAM dhUmAnAmanyatamaM sAmarthyataH pAyayitvA, punarevodakamupasparshayet||14|| upaspRuShTodakaM cainaM nivAtamAgAramanupraveshya saMveshya cAnushiShyAt- uccairbhAShyamatyAshanamatisthAnamatica~gkramaNaM krodhashokahimAtapAvashyAyAtipravAtAn yAnayAnaM grAmyadharmamasvapanaM nishi divA svapnaM viruddhAjIrNAsAtmyAkAlapramitAtihInaguruviShamabhojanavegasandhAraNodIraNamiti bhAvAnetAnmanasA~apyasevamAnaH sarvamaho gamayasveti | sa tathA kuryAt||15||
15.commentary: snaihikAdidhUmapAnavikalpaH puruShaprakRutyapekShaH; ata eva sAmarthyata ityuktaM, yadyasya yujyata ityarthaH| atisthAnamiti atyarthaM daNDAyamAnatvenAvasthitiH| pramitabhojanam ekarasAbhyAsaH| atihInaM naShTashaktikaM dhAnyAdi| gurushabdena svabhAvagurulaTTukacipiTakAderyathoktamAtrayA~api bhojananiShedhaH||14-15||

15.sanskrit: athainaM sAyAhne pare vA~ahni sukhodakapariShiktaM purANAnAM lohitashAlitaNDulAnAM svavaklinnAM maNDapUrvAM sukhoShNAM yavAgUM pAyayedagnibalamabhisamIkShya, evaM dvitIye tRutIye cAnnakAle, caturthe tvannakAle tathAvidhAnAmeva shAlitaNDulAnAmutsvinnAM vilepImuShNodakadvitIyAmasnehalavaNAmalpasnehalavaNAM vA bhojayet, evaM pa~jcame ShaShThe cAnnakAle, saptame tvannakAle tathAvidhAnAmeva shAlInAM dviprasRutaM susvinnamodanamuShNodakAnupAnaM tanunA tanusnehalavaNopapannena mudgayUSheNa bhojayet, evamaShTame navame cAnnakAle, dashame tvannakale lAvakapi~jjalAdInAmanyatamasya mAMsarasenaudakalAvaNikena nAtisAravatA bhojayeduShNodakAnupAnam; evamekAdashe dvAdashe cAnnakAle; ata UrdhvamannaguNAn krameNopabhu~jjAnaH saptarAtreNa prakRutibhojanamAgacchet||16||
15.commentary: sAyAhna ityAdau samyagagnishuddhilakShaNabhUte sAyAhne, ki~jcittvavishuddhAvapare~ahni| yaduktaM siddhau- “vamitaM la~gghayet samyagjIrNali~ggAnyavekShayan| tAni dRuShTvA tu peyAdikramaM kuryAnna la~gghanam” (si. a.6) iti| maNDapUrvAM maNDapradhAnAm| ayaM ca dvAdashakAlanivartanIyaH kramaH pradhAnashuddhishuddhe j~jeyaH, madhye tvaShTAnukAlikaH, tathA~alpe caturanukAlikaH; uktaM hi- “peyAM vilepIM” (si. a.1) ityAdi| annaguNAn madhurAdIn gurukaThinAdIMshca| etacca saMsarjanakramAdUrdhvaM saptarAtreNa prakRutibhojanagamanaM tadA kartavyaM yadi vamanAnantaraM virecanaM na kartavyaM bhavati, tatkaraNe tu saMsarjanakramAdUrdhvameva snehapAnaM; yaduktaM- “saMsRuShTabhaktaM navame~ahni sarpistaM pAyayedvA~apyanuvAsayedvA” (si. a.1) iti| tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “pakShAdvireko vAntasya” (su.ci. a.36) iti| yadi saMsarjanakramaM tathA~anuguNAbhyAsaM ca kRutvA snehaH kriyate, tadA pakShAdvireko vAntasya na syAt||16||

15.sanskrit: athainaM punareva snehasvedAbhyAmupapAdyAnupahatamanasamabhisamIkShya sukhoShitaM suprajIrNabhaktaM kRutahomabalima~ggalajapaprAyashcittamiShTe tithinakShatrakaraNamuhUrte brAhmaNAn svasti vAcayitvA trivRutkalkamakShamAtraM yathArhAloDanaprativinItaM pAyayet prasamIkShya doShabheShajadeshakAlabalasharIrAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutivayasAmavasthAntarANi vikArAMshca, samyak viriktaM cainaM vamanoktena dhUmavarjena vidhinopapAdayedAbalavarNaprakRutilAbhAt, balavarNopapannaM cainamanupahatamanasamabhisamIkShya sukhoShitaM suprajIrNabhaktaM shiraHsnAtamanuliptagAtraM sragviNamanupahatavastrasaMvItamanurUpAla~gkArAla~gkRutaM suhRudAM darshayitvA j~jAtInAM darshayet, athainaM kAmeShvavasRujet||17|| bhavanti cAtra- anena vidhinA rAjA rAjamAtro~athavA punaH| yasya vA vipulaM dravyaM sa saMshodhanamarhati||18||
15.commentary: athainamiti kRutasaMsarjanakramam| prativinItam AloDitam| doShAdayaH pUrvavadvyAkhyeyAH| vikArAMshceti kuShThajvarAdIn virecanasAdhyAn; pUrvaM tu “sUkShmANi hi” ityAdau vikAro noktaH, tasya parIkShyatvenaiva grahaNAt; kiMvA doShagrahaNenaiva tatra vikAragrahaNam| kAmeShu IpsiteShu, avasRujet niryantraNaM kuryAt||17-18||

15.sanskrit: daridrastvApadaM prApya prAptakAlaM vishodhanam| pibet kAmamasambhRutya sambhArAnapi durlabhAn||19|| na hi sarvamanuShyANAM santi sarve paricchadAH| na ca rogA na bAdhante daridrAnapi dAruNAH||20|| yadyacchakyaM manuShyeNa kartumauShadhamApadi| tattat sevyaM yathAshakti vasanAnyashanAni ca||21||
15.commentary: samprati daridrasya yathoktaM sambhAramakRutvA~api saMshodhanakaraNamAha- daridra ityAdi| durlabhAniti vacanena sulabhAni daridreNA~apyutpAdanIyAni||19-21||

15.sanskrit: malApahaM rogaharaM balavarNaprasAdanam| pItvA saMshodhana samyagAyuShA yujyate ciram||22||
15.commentary: saMshodhanakaraNaguNamAha- malApahamityAdi||22||

15.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- IshvarANAM vasumatAM vamanaM savirecanam| sambhArA ye yadarthaM ca samAnIya prayojayet||23|| yathA prayojyA mAtrA yA yadayogasya lakShaNam| yogAtiyogayoryacca doShA ye cApyupadravAH||24|| yadasevyaM vishuddhena yashca saMsarjanakramaH| tat sarvaM kalpanAdhyAye vyAjahAra punarvasuH||25||
15.commentary: sa~ggrahe- IshvarAH savilAsAH; tena rAj~jo rAjamAtrasya ca grahaNam| prayojayediti ‘sambhArAn’ iti sheShaH||23-25||

15.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne upakalpanIyo nAma pa~jcadasho~adhyAyaH||15||
15.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne nirdeshacatuShke pa~jcadasho~adhyAyaH||15||

16.sanskrit: athAtashcikitsAprAbhRutIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
16.commentary: pUrvAdhyAyoktavamanavirecanayorvistareNa samyagyogAdilakShaNaM, tathA tatpravRuttiviShayabahudoShapuruShAdyabhidhAtuM cikitsAprAbhRutIyo~abhidhIyate| cikitsA prabhRutarUpA sadA yatnena AturopaDhaukanIyatvena ca yasya vidyate sa cikitsAprAbhRutIyaH||1-2||

16.sanskrit: cikitsAprAbhRuto dhImAn shAstravAn karmatatparaH| naraM virecayati yaM sa yogAt sukhamashnute||3|| yaM vaidyamAnI tvabudho virecayati mAnavam| so~atiyogAdayogAcca mAnavo duHkhamashnute||4||
16.commentary: yogAt samyagyogAt| sukham Arogyam| virecayatItyatra vAmayatItyapi boddhavyaM, virecanashabdasya vamane~api pravRutteH| so~atiyogAdityAdi| duHkhaM vikAraM; yaduktaM- “vikAro duHkhameva tu” (sU. 9)| nanu vamanAdau kasmAnmithyAyogo nocyate, yAvatA yasya vastuna ucito yogaH sa yogaH, tasya svalpo vA yogaH sarvathA vA ayogo ayoga ucyate, tasyaivAtimAtrayogo vikArakaro~atiyogaH, anucitasambandhena tu vastuno mithyAyogaH; tenehApyutkliShTashleShmAdidharmaprayukte puruShe virecanaM sarvathA~ayaugikameva, tacca prayuktaM pratIpagamanenaiva yAti, virecane mithyAyogo~ayamucitaH, evaM vamanAdiShvapi j~jeyam| naivam, evambhUtamithyAyogasyAyogenaiva grahaNAt, uktaM hi- “prAtilomyena doShANAM haraNAtte hyakRutsnashaH| ayogasa~jj~je kRucchreNa yadA gacchati cAlpashaH” (si. 6) iti| duShTavirecanauShadhasya rasanayopayujyamAnasya hInamAtratvAtimAtratvAbhyAM vinA yadvyAdhikaraNatvaM tanmithyAyogAdeva paraM bhavati; yaduktaM tisraiShaNIye- “mithyAyogo rAshivarjeShvAhAravidhivisheShAyataneShUpadekShyate” (sU. 11) iti| satyaM bheShajasya mithyAyogo~ayaM, vamanasya tu doShaharaNarUpasyAyoga iti; evaM ca virecanAdAvapi j~jeyam| yadyapyatrApi mithyAyogaH katha~jcit pAryate kalpayituM, tathA~api prayojanashUnyatvAdAcAryeNa pRutha~gna kRutaH, shabdAdiShu tu mithyAyoginAM sambandhamAtrasyApi parihArArthaM pRuthakkRuta iti||3-4||

16.sanskrit: daurbalyaM lAghavaM glAnirvyAdhInAmaNutA ruciH| hRudvarNashuddhiH kShuttRuShNA kAle vegapravartanam||5|| buddhIndriyamanaHshuddhirmArutasyAnulomatA| samyagviriktali~ggAni kAyAgneshcAnuvartanam ||6|| ShThIvanaM hRudayAshuddhirutkleshaH shleShmapittayoH| AdhmAnamarucishchardiradaurbalyamalAghavam||7|| ja~gghorusadanaM tandrA staimityaM pInasAgamaH| lakShaNAnyaviriktAnAM mArutasya ca nigrahaH||8|| viTpittakaphavAtAnAmAgatAnAM yathAkramam| paraM sravati yadraktaM medomAMsodakopamam||9|| niHshleShmapittamudakaM shoNitaM kRuShNameva vA| tRuShyato mArutArtasya so~atiyogaH pramuhyataH||10||
16.commentary: daurbalyamityAdIni virecanasya samyagyuktAyuktAtiyuktasya lakShaNAni| adaurbalyaM sthaulyAnapagamaH | yathAkramamiti paThan krameNaiveti darshayati; yaduktaM- “prAptishca viTpittakaphAnilAnAM samyagviriktasya bhavet krameNa” (si. 1) iti| AgatAnAM paramUrdhvamiti yojanA||5-10||

16.sanskrit: vamane~atikRute li~ggAnyetAnyeva bhavanti hi| UrdhvagA vAtarogAshca vAggrahashcAdhiko bhavet||11|| cikitsAprAbhRutaM tasmAdupeyAccharaNaM naraH| yu~jjyAd ya enamatyantamAyuShA ca sukhena ca||12||
16.commentary: atiyogalakShaNaM vamane~atidishati- vamana ityAdi| vamanAtiyoge viTpittakaphavAtAnAmiti na yojanIyaM, yena vamanaprayoge kaphapittAnilAgamarUpaH kramo bhavet| yaduktaM- “kramAt kaphaH pittamathAnilashca yasyaiti samyagvamitiH sa iShTaH” (si. a. 1) iti||11-12||

16.sanskrit: avipAko~aruciH sthaulyaM pANDutA gauravaM klamaH| piDakAkoThakaNDUnAM sambhavo~aratireva ca||13|| AlasyashramadaurbalyaM daurgandhyamavasAdakaH| shleShmapittasamutklesho nidrAnAsho~atinidratA||14|| tandrA klaibyamabuddhitvamashastasvapnadarshanam| balavarNapraNAshashca tRupyato bRuMhaNairapi||15|| bahudoShasya li~ggAni tasmai saMshodhanaM hitam| UrdhvaM caivAnulomaM ca yathAdoShaM yathAbalam||16|| evaM vishuddhakoShThasya kAyAgnirabhivardhate| vyAdhayashcopashAmyanti prakRutishcAnuvartate||17|| indriyANi manobuddhirvarNashcAsya prasIdati| balaM puShTirapatyaM ca vRuShatA cAsya jAyate||18|| jarAM kRucchreNa labhate ciraM jIvatyanAmayaH| tasmAt saMshodhanaM kAle yuktiyuktaM pibennaraH||19||
16.commentary: saMshodhanaviShayabahudoShalakShaNamAha- avipAka ityAdi| anAyAsakRutaH shramaH klamaH; shramastviha svalpenAyAsena j~jeyaH| avasAdako mano~avasAdaH| nidrAnAsho vAtapradhAnena doSheNa; atinidratA shleShmapradhAnena||13-19||

16.sanskrit: doShAH kadAcit kupyanti jitA la~gghanapAcanaiH| jitAH saMshodhanairye tu na teShAM punarudbhavaH||20|| doShANAM ca drumANAM ca mUle~anupahate sati| rogANAM prasavAnAM ca gatAnAmAgatirdhruvA||21||
16.commentary: samUladoShApahArakatvaM saMshodhanasya, la~gghanapAcanayostu doShApaharatve satyapi na saMshodhanavaddoShahantRutvamityAha- doShA ityAdi| kadAciditi anyahetuprAptyA| na teShAM punarudbhava iti balavaddoShakAraNatvaM vineti mantavyam| ukte~arthe dRuShTAntamAha- doShANAmityAdi| la~gghanapAcanAbhyAM rogakAraNIbhUtadoShaprakopaharaNamAtre kRute rogo yo nivRuttaH sa mUlabhUtAshayavyavasthitadoShAnucchedAdyatki~jcidanuguNakAlAdiprAptyA punaH kupitadoSheNa bhavatIti bhAvaH||20-21||

16.sanskrit: bheShajakShapite pathyamAhAraireva bRuMhaNam| ghRutamAMsarasakShIrahRudyayUShopasaMhitaiH||22|| abhya~ggotsAdanaiH snAnairnirUhaiH sAnuvAsanaiH| tathA sa labhate sharma yujyate cAyuShA ciram||23||
16.commentary: samprati shodhanena yathA doShakShayastathA dhAtukShayo~api bhavati, tena tatra pratIkAramAha- bheShajetyAdi| AhAraireveti evAvadhAraNe; tena bheShajena bRuMhaNaM niShedhati, bheShajasya vIryapradhAnasya tadA duHsahatvAt| sAnuvAsanairityatra cakAro boddhavyaH, tenAbhya~ggAdibhishca bRuMhaNaM pathyam||22-23||

16.sanskrit: atiyogAnubaddhAnAM sarpiHpAnaM prashasyate| tailaM madhurakaiH siddhamathavA~apyanuvAsanam||24|| yasya tvayogastaM snigdhaM punaH saMshodhayennaram| mAtrAkAlabalApekShI smaran pUrvamanukramam||25|| snehane svedane shuddhau rogAH saMsarjane ca ye| jAyante~amArgavihite teShAM siddhiShu sAdhanam||26||
16.commentary: atiyogAdicikitsAmAha- atiyogetyAdi| smaran pUrvamanukramamityanena yaH pUrvamayoge hetubhUtastaM pariharanniti shikShayati| amArgavihite avidhivihite| sAdhanamityatra ‘vakShyate’ iti sheShaH||24-26||

16.sanskrit: jAyante hetuvaiShamyAdviShamA dehadhAtavaH| hetusAmyAt samAsteShAM svabhAvoparamaH sadA||27||
16.commentary: samprati yadetat siddhau vakShyamANaM rogANaM sAdhanaM tadanuSha~ggeNa ca sarvabheShajAnAmeva kShaNabha~ggibhAve pakShe~api rogashamakatvaM pratipAdayituM prakaraNamArabhate- jAyanta ityAdi| teShAmiti viShamANAM dhAtUnAM samAnAM ca| svabhAvAt vinAshakAraNanirapekShAduparamo vinAshaH svabhAvoparamaH| sadeti avilambena; tenotpannamAtrA eva vinashyantItyarthaH||27||

16.sanskrit: pravRuttiheturbhAvAnAM na nirodhe~asti kAraNam| kecittatrApi manyante hetuM hetoravartanam||28||
16.commentary: atraivArthe upapattimAha- pravRuttItyAdi| pravRuttihetuH utpattiheturbhAvAnAmasti, nirodhe vinAshe heturbhAvAnAM kAraNaM nAsti; yasmAt sarva eva bhAvAH pradIpArcirvadutpattau kAraNApekShiNaH, vinAshe tu dvitIyakShaNAvidyamAnatvalakShaNe sahajasiddhe na hetvantaramapekShante; yato na svAbhAvikarUpe hetvantarApekShA bhavati, nahyutpannaH kha~ggaH svAbhAvike lauhamayatve kAraNAntaramapekShate; tadevaM sarveShAmeva bhAvAnAM svAbhAvike nAshe viShamadhAtUnAmapi nAshaH svAbhAvika eveti bhAvaH| vyAdhiprashame ca cikitsApekShakaM pakShAntaramAha- kecidityAdi| tatrApi vinAshe~api, hetuM kAraNaM, hetoravartanamiti utpAdakahetorabhAvaM, manyanta iti yojanA| evamapi hetuparamparAyAH kShaNikatvena tatkAryANAmapi svabhAvAdeva nityaM sannihitasvahetuvinAsharUpavinAshahetUnAM na vinAshahetucikitsApekSheti bhAvaH||28||

16.sanskrit: evamuktArthamAcAryamagnivesho~abhyabhAShata| svabhAvoparame karma cikitsAprAbhRutasya kim||29|| bheShajairviShamAn dhAtUn kAn samIkurute bhiShak| kA vA cikitsA bhagavan! kimarthaM vA prayujyate||30||
16.commentary: evamutthitAyAM sha~gkAyAM guruM pRucchati- evamityAdi| kimiti AkShepe| karma sAdhyaM; svabhAvoparame sati na kimapi sAdhyaM pashyAmIti bhAvaH| kAn samIkurute iti viShamANAmasthiratvena sAmyaM tatra kartuM na pAryata ityAshayaH| kA vA cikitseti rogaprashamaM pratyakAraNatvena cikitsA nAstItyarthaH| kimarthaM vA prayujyata iti yannivRuttyarthaM cikitsA prayujyate taddhAtuvaiShamyaM svata eva nivRuttamiti cikitsAprayojanaM nAsti||29-30||

16.sanskrit: tacchiShyavacanaM shrutvA vyAjahAra punarvasuH| shrUyatAmatra yA somya! yuktirdRuShTA maharShibhiH||31|| na nAshakAraNAbhAvAdbhAvAnAM nAshakAraNam| j~jAyate nityagasyeva kAlasyAtyayakAraNam||32|| shIghragatvAdyathA bhUtastathA bhAvo vipadyate|33|
16.commentary: pUrvoktahetuvinAshaM dRuShTAntena hetumantamAha- na nAshetyAdi| bhAvAnAM nAshakAraNaM na j~jAyate, tat kimabhAvAdeva, yathA- shashaviShANam, uta vA j~jAnAyogyatvAt pRuthivyAM nikhAtamUlakIlakAdivat sadapi na j~jAyate, ityAha- nAshakAraNAbhAvAditi; na j~jAnAyogyatvena, kintarhyabhAvAdevetyarthaH| atra dRuShTAntamAha- nityagasyetyAdi| nimeShAdirUpatvena nityagasya| evaM manyate- nityagaH kAlo yathA vinashvaratvena na hetvantaraM vinAshe~apekShate, tathA sarva eva bhAvAH; yaddhi yasya hetvantarApekShaM na tasya tadavashyambhAvi, yathA- paTasya rAgaH; hetvantarApekShI cedvinAshaH syAt, nAvashyambhAvI syAt; etadviparyayAccAnapekShatvaM vinAshasya siddham| sampratyahetuko vinAsha utpattyanantarameva bhavati, pashcAdasthiratvena saMskArAdhAnamapi bhAveShu na pAryate kartumityAha- shIghragatvAdityAdi| yathA bhUta iti yAdRusha utpannaH, tatheti tAdRusha eva vipadyate; kutaH? shIghragatvAt asthiratvAt||31-32||

16.sanskrit: nirodhe kAraNaM tasya nAsti naivAnyathAkriyA||33||
16.commentary: pUrvasAdhitamahetuvinAshitvaM tathA shIghragatvahetusAdhitaM cAsaMskAryatvamupasaMharati- nirodha ityAdi| tasyeti bhAvasya| anyathAkriyA anyathAkaraNaM, saMskArAdhAnamiti yAvat; etena viShame dhAtau sAmyaM saMskAra AdhIyatAmityevaMrUpA~api cikitsA nirastA mantavyA||33||

16.sanskrit: yAbhiH kriyAbhirjAyante sharIre dhAtavaH samAH| sA cikitsA vikArANAM karma tadbhiShajAM smRutam||34|| kathaM sharIre dhAtUnAM vaiShamyaM na bhavediti| samAnAM cAnubandhaH syAdityarthaM kriyate kriyA||35|| tyAgAdviShamahetUnAM samAnAM copasevanAt| viShamA nAnubadhnanti jAyante dhAtavaH samAH||36||
16.commentary: evaM vyavasthite pUrvAkShiptaM cikitsitaM samAdadhati- yAbhirityAdi| ‘sA cikitsA’ ityanena ‘kA vA cikitsA’ ityAkShepaH parihRutaH| ‘karma tad’ ityanena prathamoddiShTa AkShepaH parihRutaH| ‘ityarthaM kriyate kriyA’ ityanena ‘kimarthaM vA’ ityAkShepaH parihRutaH| ‘kAn samIkurute’ ityAkShepastu ‘samaistu hetubhiryasmAd’ ityAdinA parihRutaH| viShameShu dhAtuShu yAbhiH kriyAbhiH sAmA dhAtavo janyante sA cikitsA| evaM manyate- yadyapi dhAtuvaiShamyaM kShaNikatvena vinashvaraM, tathA~api vinashyadapi taddhAtuvaiShamyaM svakAryaM viShamameva dhAtumArabhate, evaM so~apyaparaM viShamamiti na dhAtuvaiShamyasantAnanivRuttirdhAtusAmyajanakahetuM vinA; yadA tu dhAtusAmyaheturupayukto bhavati, tadA tena sahitaM vaiShamyasantatipatitamapi kAraNaM samameva dhAtusantAnamArabhate, yathA- mudgaraprahArasahito ghaTaparamANusantAno visadRushaM kapAlasantAnamArabhate; evaM vyavasthite ‘kathaM sharIre’ ityAdigrantho vyAkhyeyaH| vaiShamyaM na bhavet notpadyata ityarthaH| samAnAM cAnubandha iti santatyotpAdaH| viShamA nAnubadhnantIti hetvabhAvAdviShamasantAnasyotpAdo na bhavati| samAnAM copasevanAditi samahetUnAM sevanAt||34-36||

16.sanskrit: samaistu hetubhiryasmAddhAtUn sa~jjanayet samAn| cikitsAprAbhRutastasmAddAtA dehasukhAyuShAm||37|| dharmasyArthasya kAmasya nRulokasyobhayasya ca| dAtA sampadyate vaidyo dAnAddehasukhAyuShAm||38||
16.commentary: dehasukhAyuShAM dAnAt dharmAdInAM dAtA bhavati, dehasampattisAdhyatvAddharmAdInAmiti bhAvaH||37-38||

16.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- cikitsAprAbhRutaguNo doSho yashcetarAshrayaH| yogAyogAtiyogAnAM lakShaNaM shuddhisaMshrayam||39|| bahudoShasya li~ggAni saMshodhanaguNAshca ye| cikitsAsUtramAtraM ca siddhivyApattisaMshrayam||40|| yA ca yuktishcikitsAyAM yaM cArthaM kurute bhiShak| cikitsAprAbhRute~adhyAye tat sarvamavadanmuniH||41||
16.commentary: sa~ggrahe siddhisaMshrayaM ca vyApattisaMshrayaM ca siddhivyApattisaMshrayaM; tatra siddhisaMshrayaM siddhisthAnasaMshrayeNa , vyApattisaMshrayaM ‘atiyogAnubaddhAnAM’ ityAdinoktam||39-41||

16.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne cikitsAprAbhRutIyo nAma ShoDasho~adhyAyaH||16|| samAptaH kalpanAcatuShkaH||4||
16.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne caturthe kalpanAcatuShke cikitsAprAbhRutIyo nAma ShoDasho~adhyAyaH||16||

17.sanskrit: athAtaH kiyantaHshirasIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
17.commentary: pUrvacatuShkacatuShTayena bheShajamabhihitaM, samprati tadviShayarogAbhidhAnArthaM rogacatuShko~abhidhAtavyaH, cikitsA ca vidheyatvenaiva pradhAnamataH prathamamuktA, ki~jca darshitashcAyaM prathamAdhyAya eva sambandhaH, evaM cA~ggeShu marmasu ca pradhAnabhUtashirohRudayarogAbhidhAyakatvena kiyantaH shirasIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

17.sanskrit: kiyantaH shirasi proktA rogA hRudi ca dehinAm| kati cApyanilAdInAM rogA mAnavikalpajAH||3|| kShayAH kati samAkhyAtAH piDakAH kati cAnagha!| gatiH katividhA coktA doShANAM doShasUdana!||4|| hutAshaveshasya vacastacchrutvA gururabravIt| pRuShTavAnasi yat saumya! tanme shRuNu savistaram||5|| dRuShTAH pa~jca shirorogAH pa~jcaiva hRudayAmayAH| vyAdhInAM hyadhikA ShaShTirdoShamAnavikalpajA||6|| dashAShTau ca kShayAH sapta piDakA mAdhumehikAH| doShANAM trividhA coktA gatirvistarataH shRuNu||7||
17.commentary: kShayasthAnavRuddhayo doShamAnaM, tasya vikalpo doShAntarasambandhAsambandhakRuto bhedaH| mAdhumehikA ityatra madhumehashabdaH sAmAnyena pramehavacanaH| yato~atraiva sAmAnyena brUte- “vinA pramehamapyetA jAyante duShTamedasaH” iti; anyathA hi ‘vinA madhumehaM’ iti kRutaM syAt; tathA cikitsite vakShyati sAmAnyenaiva yat- “pramehiNAM yAH piDakA mayoktA rogAdhikAre pRuthageva sapta” (ci. 6) ityAdi| tathA madhumehapiDakAnAM cikitsitopadeshAcca sarvamehabhavatvaM piDakAnAM, madhumehabhavatve hi madhumehasyaivAsAdhyatvAnna tadbhavapiDakAnAmupakramaNIyatvamasti; ki~jca pradeshAntare~api madhumehashabdenAyaM sarvapramehAnuktavAn, yathA- “gulmI ca madhumehI ca rAjayakShmI ca yo naraH| acikitsyA bhavantyete balamAMsaparikShaye” (iM. 9) iti| atra hi yadi vAtiko madhumeho~abhipretaH syAttadA tasya svarUpata evAsAdhyatvena ‘balamAMsaparikShaye sati’ iti visheShaNamanarthakaM syAt| sushrutenApi ca sAmAnyena pramehe evaitAH piDakA darshitAH, yaduktaM- “tatra vasAmedobhyAmabhipannasharIrasya tribhirdoShaishcAnugatadhAtoH pramehiNo dasha piDakA jAyante” (su. ni. 6) ityAdi| sarva eva pramehA yasmAddehaM madhurIkRutya jAyante tasmAnmadhumehA ityucyante, vacanaM hi- “ShaTpadapippIlikAbhishca sharIramUtrAbhisaraNam” (ni. 4) iti, tathA ca vAgbhaTaH- “madhuraM yacca sarveShu prAyo madhviva mehati| sarve hi madhumehAkhyA mAdhuryAcca tanorataH” (vA. ni. 10) iti| vistarata iti shRuNvityanena sambadhyate||3-7||

17.sanskrit: sandhAraNAddivAsvapnAdrAtrau jAgaraNAnmadAt| uccairbhAShyAdavashyAyAt prAgvAtAdatimaithunAt||8|| gandhAdasAtmyAdAghrAtAdrajodhUmahimAtapAt| gurvamlaharitAdAnAdati shItAmbusevanAt||9|| shiro~abhighAtAdduShTAmAdrodanAdbAShpanigrahAt | meghAgamAnmanastApAddeshakAlaviparyayAt||10|| vAtAdayaH prakupyanti shirasyasraM ca duShyati| tataH shirasi jAyante rogA vividhalakShaNAH||11||
17.commentary: sandhAraNAditi vegasandhAraNAt| haritam ArdrakAdi| atIti pUrveNa pareNa ca shItAmbusevanAdityanena sambadhyate| duShTAdAmAt duShTAmAt; kiMvA ‘uShNAmAt’ iti pAThaH, tatroShNAccAmAccetyarthaH| deshakAlaviparyayAdityatra deshaviparyaya upasargagRuhItatvaM deshasya| asraM ca praduShyatItyabhidadhAnaH sarvashirorogeShu raktaduShTiM darshayati||8-11||

17.sanskrit: prANAH prANabhRutAM yatra shritAH sarvendriyANi ca| yaduttamA~ggamA~ggAnAM shirastadabhidhIyate||12||
17.commentary: prANA ityAdinA~a~ggeShu shiraHprAdhAnyaM darshayan prakRutashirorogANAmevAtyahitatvaM darshayati; tena notsUtraM shiraHprAdhAnyAbhidhAnam| shritA iva shritAH, shira-upaghAte upaghAtAt| upariShTAda~ggamuttamA~ggam||12||

17.sanskrit: ardhAvabhedako vA syAt sarvaM vA rujyate shiraH| pratishyAmukhanAsAkShikarNarogashirobhramAH||13|| arditaM shirasaH kampo galamanyAhanugrahaH| vividhAshcApare rogA vAtAdikrimisambhavAH||14||
17.commentary: prakRutA~jchirorogAnAha- ardhetyAdinA krimisambhavA ityantena| etacca ‘jAyante rogA vividhalakShaNAH’ ityasya vivaraNam||13-14||

17.sanskrit: pRuthagdiShTAstu ye pa~jca sa~ggrahe paramarShibhiH| shirogadAMstA~jchRuNu me yathAsvairhetulakShaNaiH||15|| uccairbhAShyAtibhAShyAbhyAM tIkShNapAnAt prajAgarAt| shItamArutasaMsparshAdvyavAyAdveganigrahAt||16|| upavAsAdabhIghAtAdvirekAdvamanAdati| bAShpashokabhayatrAsAdbhAramArgAtikarshanAt||17|| shirogatAH sirA vRuddho vAyurAvishya kupyati| tataH shUlaM mahattasya vAtAt samupajAyate||18|| nistudyete bhRushaM sha~gkau ghATA sambhidyate tathA| sabhrUmadhyaM lalATaM ca tapatIvAtivedanam||19|| vadhyete svanataH shrotre niShkRuShyete ivAkShiNI| ghUrNatIva shiraH sarvaM sandhibhya iva mucyate||20|| sphuratyati sirAjAlaM stabhyate ca shirodharA| snigdhoShNamupashete ca shiroroge~anilAtmake||21||
17.commentary: shirogatatvena nAsAdirogeShvapi prApteShu tAn vihAyaivAShTodarIye proktAMstAneva shiraHshUlalakShaNAn rogAn prapa~jcena vaktumAha- pRuthagityAdi| sa~ggrahe aShTodarIye; tena nArUMShikAdayo~atraprakaraNe shirorogashabdenocyante; shirorogashabdasya shUla eva rujAkare vRuttatvAt | tIkShNapAnaM tIkShNamadyapAnaM; kiMvA, tIkShNaM maricAdi| vadhyete iva vadhyete, atyarthapIDAyuktatvena||15-21||

17.sanskrit: kaTvamlalavaNakShAramadyakrodhAtapAnalaiH| pittaM shirasi sanduShTaM shirorogAya kalpate||22|| dahyate rujyate tena shiraH shItaM suShUyate | dahyete cakShuShI tRuShNA bhramaH svedashca jAyate||23||
17.commentary: shItaM suShUyate shItamicchati||22-23||

17.sanskrit: AsyAsukhaiH svapnasukhairgurusnigdhAtibhojanaiH| shleShmA shirasi sanduShTaH shirorogAya kalpate||24|| shiro mandarujaM tena suptaM stimitabhArikam| bhavatyutpadyate tandrA tathA~a~alasyamarocakaH||25|| vAtAcchUlaM bhramaH kampaH pitAddAho madastRuShA| kaphAdgurutvaM tandrA ca shiroroge tridoShaje||26||
17.commentary: svapnasukhamanucitadivAsvapnena j~jeyam| suptamiva suptaM, prabodharahitatvena| bhArAkrAntamiva bhArikam||24-26||

17.sanskrit: tilakShIraguDAjIrNapUtisa~gkIrNabhojanAt| kledo~asRukkaphamAMsAnAM doShalasyopajAyate||27|| tataH shirasi sa~gkledAt krimayaH pApakarmaNaH| janayanti shirorogaM jAtA bIbhatsalakShaNam||28|| vyadhacchedarujAkaNDUshophadaurgatyaduHkhitam | krimirogAturaM vidyAt krimINAM darshanena ca||29||
17.commentary: sa~gkIrNabhojanaM viruddhAharaH| doShalasya bahudoShasya| pApakarmaNa ityanenAdharmavata evAyamatiduHkhakrimirogo bhavatIti darshayati| bIbhatsalakShaNamiti ghrANAdibhyaH pUyAdipravRutteH||27-29||

17.sanskrit: shokopavAsavyAyAmarUkShashuShkAlpabhojanaiH | vAyurAvishya hRudayaM janayatyuttamAM rujam||30|| vepathurveShTanaM stambhaH pramohaH shUnyatA daraH | hRudi vAtAture rUpaM jIrNe cAtyarthavedanA||31|| uShNAmlalavaNakShArakaTukAjIrNabhojanaiH| madyakrodhAtapaishcAshu hRudi pittM prakupyati||32|| hRuddAhastiktatA vakre tiktAmlodgiraNaM klamaH| tRuShNA mUrcchA bhramaH svedaH pittahRudrogalakShaNam||33|| atyAdAnaM gurusnigdhamacintanamaceShTanam| nidrAsukhaM cAbhyadhikaM kaphahRudrogakAraNam||34|| hRudayaM kaphahRudroge suptaM stimitabhArikam| tandrAruciparItasya bhavatyashmAvRutaM yathA||35|| hetulakShaNasaMsargAducyate sAnnipAtikaH| (hRudrogaH kaShTadaH kaShTasAdhya ukto maharShibhiH) tridoShaje tu hRudroge yo durAtmA niShevate||36|| tilakShIraguDAdIni granthistasyopajAyate| marmaikadeshe sa~gkledaM rasashcAsyopagacchati||37|| sa~gkledAt krimayashcAsya bhavantyupahatAtmanaH| marmaikadeshe te jAtAH sarpanto bhakShayanti ca||38|| tudyamAnaM sa hRudayaM sUcIbhiriva manyate| chidyamAnaM yathA shastrairjAtakaNDUM mahArujam||39|| hRudrogaM krimijaM tvetairli~ggairbuddhvA sudAruNam| tvareta jetuM taM vidvAn vikAraM shIghrakAriNam||40||
17.commentary: shokopavAsetyAdi hRudrogalakShaNam| veShTanam udveShTanamiva| daraH daradarikA| acintanam alpacintanam| ashmAvRutam ashmAkrAntam| granthiriva granthiH, sa ca rasadoShakRutaH| marmaikadeshe hRudayaikadeshe| dvitIyaM marmetipadaM karmatApannam||30-40||

17.sanskrit: dvyulbaNaikolbaNaiH ShaT syurhInamadhyAdhikaishca ShaT| samaishcaiko vikArAste sannipAtAstrayodasha||41|| saMsarge nava ShaT tebhya ekavRuddhyA samaistrayaH| pRuthak trayashca tairvRuddhairvyAdhayaH pa~jcaviMshatiH||42|| yathA vRuddhaistathA kShINairdoSheH syuH pa~jcaviMshatiH| vRuddhikShayakRutashcAnyo vikalpa upadekShyate||43|| vRuddhirekasya samatA caikasyaikasya sa~gkShayaH| dvandvavRuddhiH kShayashcaikasyaikavRuddhirdvayoH kShayaH ||44||
17.commentary: ‘kati cApyanilAdInAm’ ityAdyuktasyottaraM- dvyulbaNairityAdi| hInamadhyAdhikairiti vRuddhavRuddhataravRuddhatamaiH| saMsarge naveti cchedaH| asyaiva vivaraNaM- ShaT tebhya ityAdi| samaisraya iti vRuddhaiH samaiH| vRuddhikShayakRuta ityasya vivaraNaM- vRuddhirekasyetyAdi| atra ca yadyapi samatA~api vRuddhikShayavikalpe paThyate, tathA~api samatAyAH svAtantryeNa vikArAkartRutvAt ‘vRuddhikShayakRuta’ ityuktam| vRuddhirekasya samatA caikasyaikasya sa~gkShaya ityanena ShaDvikArAH| dvandvavRuddhiH kShayashcaikasyetyanena trayaH| ekavRuddhirdvayoH kShayaH , tena trayaH| evaM dviShaShTiprakArA bhavanti||41-44||

17.sanskrit: prakRutisthaM yadA pittaM mArutaH shleShmaNaH kShaye| sthAnAdAdAya gAtreShu yatra yatra visarpati||45|| tadA bhedashca dAhashca tatra tatrAnavasthitaH| gAtradeshe bhavatyasya shramo daurbalyameva ca||46|| prakRutisthaM kaphaM vAyuH kShINe pitte yadA balI| karShet kuryAttadA shUlaM sashaityastambhagauravam||47|| yadA~anilaM prakRutigaM pittaM kaphaparikShaye| saMruNaddhi tadA dAhaH shUlaM cAsyopajAyate||48|| shleShmANaM hi samaM pittaM yadA vAtaparikShaye| sannirundhyAttadA kuryAt satandrAgauravaM jvaram||49|| pravRuddho hi yadA shleShmA pitte kShINe samIraNam| rundhyAttadA prakurvIta shItakaM gauravaM rujam ||50|| samIraNe parikShINe kaphaH pittaM samatvagam| kurvIta sannirundhAno mRudvagnitvaM shirograham ||51|| nidrAM tandrAM pralApaM ca hRudrogaM gAtragauravam| nakhAdInAM ca pItatvaM ShThIvanaM kaphapittayoH||52|| hInavAtasya tu shleShmA pittena sahitashcaran| karotyarocakApAkau sadanaM gauravaM tathA||53|| hRullAsamAsyasravaNaM pANDutAM dUyanaM madam| virekasya ca vaiShamyaM vaiShamyamanalasya ca||54|| hInapittasya tu shleShmA mArutenopasaMhitaH| stambhaM shaityaM ca todaM ca janayatyanavasthitam||55|| gauravaM mRudutAmagnerbhaktAshraddhAM pravepanam| nakhAdInAM ca shuklatvaM gAtrapAruShyameva ca||56|| mArutastu kaphe hIne pittaM ca kupitaM dvayam| karoti yAni li~ggAni shRuNu tAni samAsataH||57|| bhramamudveShTanaM todaM dAhaM sphuTanavepane| a~ggamardaM parIshoShM dUyanaM dhUpanaM tathA||58|| vAtapittakShaye shleShmA srotAMsyapidadhadbhRusham| ceShTApraNAshaM mUrcchAM ca vAksa~ggaM ca karoti hi||59|| vAtashleShmakShaye pittaM dehaujaH sraMsayaccaret| glAnimindriyadaurbalyaM tRuShNAM mUrcchAM kriyAkShayam||60|| pittashleShmakShaye vAyurmarmANyatinipIDayan| praNAshayati sa~jj~jAM ca vepayatyathavA naram||61||
17.commentary: vRuddhirekasyetyAderudAharaNam- prakRutisthaM yadA pittamityAdi| atra kecidetadeva paramudAharaNaM dRuShTAntArthaM paThanti, sheShodAharaNaM tu kRutsne tantre boddhavyaM; kecittu vRuddhikShayavikalpasya durbodhatvena sarveShAmeva dvAdashAnAmapi vikalpAnAmAcAryeNa lakShaNaM kRutamiti kRutvA sarvameva paThanti| nanu prakRutisthe pitte kathaM tadA dAhashceti sa~ggataM bhavati, na hi prakRutistho doSho vikArakArI, na ca vAyordAhaH sambhavati| ucyate- yatra yatreti vacanAd yatra kupitena vAyunA pittaM nItaM, tatra sharIrAvayave prakRutimAnasthitamapi pittaM vRuddhameva, yatastasmin pradeshe tAvAn pittasambandha ucito na bhavatyevetyadhikena tatra pittena dAha upapanna eva, evamanyatrApi prakRutisthasyApi doShasya vikAre vyAkhyeyam| anye tu bruvate- prakRutisthAnAmapi doShANAM duShTadoShasambandhAdvikArakAritvaM bhavati; yathA- raktAdInAm| hInavAtasyetyAdi ‘dvandvavRuddhiH kShayashcaikasya’ ityasyodAharaNam| dehaujo dehasAraH; kiMvA dehashca ojashca dehaujaH||45-61||

17.sanskrit: doShAH pravRuddhAH svaM li~ggaM darshayanti yathAbalam| kShINA jahati li~ggaM svaM, samAH svaM karma kuvete||62||
17.commentary: doShANAM vRuddhisAmyakShayalakShaNAni pRuthagAha- doShA ityAdi| svaM li~ggamiti vaikArikam| yathAbalamiti ativRuddhairativRuddhaM, madhyavRuddhairmadhyavRuddhamityAdi| li~ggaM svaM jahatItyanena kShINAnAM prakRutili~ggakShayavyatiriktaM vikArakartRutvaM nAstIti darshayati; yato vRuddhA unmArgagAmino doShA dUShyaM dUShayanto jvarAdIn kurvanti na kShINAH, svayameva duHsthitatvAt| svaM karmeti prAkRutaM karma| ete ca dviShaShTirbhedA AviShkRutatamatvenoktAH; tenaikadoShakShaye dvidoShavRuddhau ca vRuddhavRuddhatarabhedAdibhyo~adhikatvamudbhAvanIyam | nanu bhavatvevaM sa~gkhyA yadi sannipAto doShANAM syAt, sa tu na bhavitumarhati, yato vAtAdInAM parasparaM viruddhAH santi guNAH, viruddhaguNAnAM tu parasparopaghAto bhavati, yathA- vahnitoyayoH| naivaM, virodho hi bhAvAnAM kAryonneyaH, nAnyato dRuShTamAtreNa kalpayituM pAryate; yato~anyatra toyadahanayorbheda upalabdhaH, tat kiM pA~jcabhautikadravyArambhe~api tayorvirodhAt pA~jcabhautikaM dravyaM na syAt, toyAgniguNAtirekAdvA~amlaraso na syAt , tasmAdanupalabdhatvAddoShasaMsarge virodhasya svabhAvaparyanuyogo na yujyate| atha manyase- evaM viruddhaguNAnAmapi doShANAmavirodhe “viruddhaguNasannipAte bhUyasA~alpamavajIyate” (vi. 1) iti, tathA “hrAsaheturvisheShastu” (sU. 1) iti vacane tarhi nirarthake| na, anayoH prabhAvAt pratipAditaviShayavyatireke caritArthatvAt| prabhAvastu tayorvirodhako bhavatyeva; yathA- tridoShakaranikucagatA guNAH samAn doShAn kurvanti paraM, na tu viruddhatvena doShaharaNaM kurvate tridoShakartRutvaprabhAvAt; tathA Amalake~amlatvaM vAtaM hanti, mAdhuryashaitye tu pittaM, shleShmANaM ca kaTutvatiktatve; nikuce tvamlatvaM kaShAyashaityAbhibhUtaM vAtaM na nihanti, mAdhuryashaitye cAmlatvAbhibhUte pittaM na jayata evamAdi| tasmAddoShANAM prabhAvo~ayaM dRuShTatvAdavadhAryate- yat- na te parasparamupaghnanti| evambhUtaprabhAvatve tu teShAmadRuShTameva kAraNaM, prANinAM duHkhajanakena hyadRuShTena te~avirodhena niveshyante, ata eva vakShyati- “viruddhairapi na tvete guNairghnanti parasparam| doShAH sahajasAtmyatvAddhoraM viShamahIniva” (ci. 26) iti| sahajaM daivavashAt svAbhAvikaM sAtmyatvaM sahajasAtmyatvam| anena ca vyAkhyAnena ‘yathA doShA anyonyaM nopaghnanti, tathA rasaraktAdInapi nopahanyuH’ ityAdi yaducyate kaishcit, tat sarvaM nirastam| nanu, “kAladUShyaprakRutibhirdoShastulyo hi santatam| niShpratyanIkaH kurute” (ci. 3) iti cikitsite vakShyati, tena prakRutirdoShasya pratipakShA bhavatItyuktaM, prakRutishca janmaprabhRutivRuddho vAtAdirucyate, “doShAnushayitA hyeShAM dehaprakRutirucyate” (sU. 7) ityAdivacanAt; tadayaM prAkRutena doSheNa doShasya virodhaH kathaM tarhyupapannaH? ucyate- tatra prakRuteH pratyanIkatA ananuguNatvena mantavyA, samAnAM hi prakRutiM prApya doShaH pravRuddhabalo bhavati, asamAnAM tu prApya tathA balavAnna bhavati, nAsamAnayA prakRutyA hanyate; evamanyatrApyunneyam| ativRuddhena vAyunAshleShmaNo durbalasya duShTatvAdvirodho bhavatyeva kvacit, naitAvatA saMsargasannipAtAsambhavaH||62||

17.sanskrit: vAtAdInAM rasAdInAM malAnAmojasastathA| kShayAstatrAnilAdInAmuktaM sa~gkShINalakShaNam ||63|| ghaTTate sahate shabdaM noccairdravati shUlyate| hRudayaM tAmyati svalpaceShTasyApi rasakShaye||64|| paruShA sphuTitA mlAnA tvagrUkShA raktasa~gkShaye| mAMsakShaye visheSheNa sphiggrIvodarashuShkatA||65|| sandhInAM sphuTanaM glAnirakShNorAyAsa eva ca| lakShaNaM medasi kShINe tanutvaM codarasya ca||66|| keshalomanakhashmashrudvijaprapatanaM shramaH| j~jeyamasthikShaye li~ggaM sandhishaithilyameva ca||67|| shIryanta iva cAsthIni durbalAni laghUni ca| pratataM vAtarogINi kShINe majjani dehinAm||68|| daurbalyaM mukhashoShashca pANDutvaM sadanaM shramaH| klaibyaM shukrAvisargashca kShINashukrasya lakShaNam||69|| kShINe shakRuti cAntrANi pIDayanniva mArutaH| rUkShasyonnamayan kukShiM tiryagUrdhvaM ca gacchati||70|| mUtrakShaye mUtrakRucchraM mUtravaivarNyameva ca| pipAsA bAdhate cAsya mukhaM ca parishuShyati||71|| malAyanAni cAnyAni shUnyAni ca laghUni ca| vishuShkANi ca lakShyante yathAsvaM malasa~gkShaye||72||
17.commentary: sampratyaShTAdashakShayAnAha- vAtAdInAmityAdi| atra malAnAmityanena mUtrapurIShayoH pa~jcendriyamalAnAM ca grahaNam| visheSheNetivacanAdanyagAtrANAmapi shuShkatA labhyate| sandhInAmityAdi bhedaH- kShayalakShaNam, keshetyAdi asthikShayasya| bAdhate cAsyeti karmaNi sheShalakShaNA ShaShThI| malAyanAnItyanena pa~jcendriyAdhiShThAnAnAM mukhanAsikAcakShuHkarNAnAM tvagindriyAdhiShThAnabhUtAnAM ca lomakUpaprajananAnAM yathAsvaM malAyanAni gRuhyante| yaduktaM jatUkarNe- “doShANAM dhAtUnAmojomUtrashakRudindriyamalAnAm| aShTAdashakShayAste lakShyAH svaguNakriyAnAshAt” iti||63-72||

17.sanskrit: bibheti durbalo~abhIkShNaM dhyAyati vyathitendriyaH| dushchAyo durmanA rUkShaH kShAmashcaivaujasaH kShaye||73|| hRudi tiShThati yacchuddhaM raktamIShatsapItakam| ojaH sharIre sa~gkhyAtaM tannAshAnnA vinashyati||74|| prathamaM jAyate hyojaH sharIre~asmi~jcharIriNAm| sarpirvarNaM madhurasaM lAjagandhi prajAyate||75|| (bhramaraiH phalapuShpebhyo yathA sambhriyate madhu| tadvadojaH svakarmabhyo guNaiH sambhriyate nRuNAm||1||)|
17.commentary: ojaHkShayalakShaNamAha- bibhetItyAdi| durmanA manobalavihInaH| ojaso durj~jeyatvena lakShaNamAha- hRudItyAdi| shuddhamiti shuklaM, raktamIShaditi ki~jcidraktaM, sapItakamiti IShatpItakaM; tena shuklavarNamojaH, raktapItau tu varNAvatrAnugatau; kiMvA, IShadityalpapramANaM, tenAShTabindukamoja iti darshayati| yaduktaM tantrAntare- “prANAshrayasyaujaso~aShTau bindavo hRudayAshrayAH” iti| etaccAShTabindukaM paramojo j~jeyam, ardhA~jjaliparimANaM tu yadojastadapradhAnaM; yacchArIre vakShyati- “tAvaccaiva shlaiShmikasyaujasaH pramANam” (shA. 7) ityanena; tasmAddvividhamihaujaH| ata evArthe dashamahAmUlIye vakShyati- “tat parasyaujasaH sthAnaM” (sU. 30) iti; parasya shreShThasyAShTabindukasyetyarthaH| iha ca kShayalakShaNamardhA~jjalimAnasyaiva j~jaiyam, aShTabindukasya tvavayavanAshe~api mRutyurbhavatIti hRudItyAdinA granthena darshayati| etaccaujaH sarvadhAtusamudAyarUpaM, tena saptadhAtuShvevAvaruddhamiti nAShTamadhAtutvAtiprasaktiH ; ata eva sushrute~apyuktaM- “rasAdInAM shukrAntAnAM dhAtUnAM yat paraM tejastat khalvojaH” (su. sU. 15) iti| anyatrApyuktaM- “bhramaraiH phalapuShpebhyo yathA saMhriyate madhu| tadvadojaH sharIrebhyo guNaiH saMhriyate nRuNAm” iti| ‘prathamaM jAyate’ ityAdipAThastu nAtiprasiddhaH| ete cAShTAdasha kShayA AviShkRutatamatvenoktAH; tena udakakShayasvarakShayAdyanabhidhAnaM nodbhAvanIyam; uktaM hi- “svarakShayamurorogaM” iti; tathodakakShayalakShaNaM yathA- “jihvAtAlvoShThakaNThaklomasaMshoShaM pipAsAM cAtivRuddhAM dRuShTvA udakavahAnyasya srotAMsi praduShTAnIti jAnIyAt” (vi. 5) iti||73-75||

17.sanskrit: vyAyAmo~anashanaM cintA rUkShAlpapramitAshanam| vAtAtapau bhayaM shoko rUkShapAnaM prajAgaraH||76|| kaphashoNitashukrANAM malAnAM cAtivartanam| kAlo bhUtopaghAtashca j~jAtavyAH kShayahetavaH||77||
17.commentary: sAmAnyena kShayANAM hetumAha- vyAyAma ityAdi| pramitAshanam ekarasAbhyAsaH| ativartanam atipravRuttiH, bahirgamanamiti yAvat| kAlo vArdhakyamAdAnaM ca| bhUtopaghAtaH pishAcAdyupaghAtaH| atra vAtakShayaheturnokto vilakShaNatvAt, sa cAcintanadivAsvapanAdirj~jeyaH; kiMvA, anashanAt kiTTAbhAvaH, tatashca kiTTarUpasya vAtasyApyanutpAdAt kShayo j~jeyaH||76-77||

17.sanskrit: gurusnigdhAmlalavaNAnyatimAtraM samashnatAm| navamannaM ca pAnaM ca nidrAmAsyAsukhAni ca||78|| tyaktavyAyAmacintAnAM saMshodhanamakurvatAm| shleShmA pittaM ca medashca mAMsaM cAtipravardhate||79|| tairAvRutagatirvAyuroja AdAya gacchati| yadA bastiM tadA kRucchro madhumehaH pravartate||80|| sa mArutasya pittasya kaphasya ca muhurmuhuH| darshayatyAkRutiM gatvA kShayamApyAyate punaH||81|| upekShayA~asya jAyante piDakAH sapta dAruNAH| mAMsaleShvavakAsheShu marmasvapi ca sandhiShu||82|| sharAvikA kacchapikA jAlinI sarShapI tathA| alajI vinatAkhyA ca vidradhI ceti saptamI||83|| antonnatA madhyanimnA shyAvA kledaruganvitA| sharAvikA syAt piDakA sharAvAkRutisaMsthitA||84|| avagADhArtinistodA mahAvAstuparigrahA| shlakShNA kacchapapRuShThAbhA piDakA kacchapI matA||85|| stabdhA sirAjAlavatI snigdhAsrAvA mahAshayA| rujAnistodabahulA sUkShmacchidrA ca jAlinI||86|| piDakA nAtimahatI kShiprapAkA mahArujA| sarShapI sarShapAbhAbhiH piDakAbhishcitA bhavet||87|| dahati tvacamutthAne tRuShNAmohajvarapradA| visarpatyanishaM duHkhAddahatyagnirivAlajI||88|| avagADharujAkledA pRuShThe vA~apyudare~api vA| mahatI vinatA nIlA piDakA vinatA matA||89||
17.commentary: samprati saptapiDakA vaktavyAH, atastAsAM pradhAnahetutvena pramehAneva tAvannidAnAdikrameNAha- gurvityAdi| navaM pAnamiti navaM madyam| nidrAmAsyAsukhAni cetyatrAnte ‘bhajatAM’ iti sheShaH| ojaH prasAdo dhAtUnAmiti yAvat| kRucchr iti kRucchrasAdhyaH| upekShayA acikitsayA| sharAvikAdisa~jj~jAnvayo vivaraNe sphuTaH| alajIsa~jj~jA rUDhA| etAshca prAdhAnyAduktAH| tena sushrute~api piDakAdhikyamuktaM yat, tanna virodhi| sirAjAlaM sirAsamUhaH| citA adhiShThitA||78-89||

17.sanskrit: vidradhiM dvividhAmAhurbAhyAmAbhyantarIM tathA| bAhyA tvaksnAyumAMsotthA kaNDarAbhA mahArujA||90|| shItakAnnavidAhyuShNarUkShashuShkAtibhojanAt| viruddhAjIrNasa~gkliShTaviShamAsAtmyabhojanAt||91|| vyApannabahumadyatvAdvegasandhAraNAcchramAt| jihmavyAyAmashayanAdatibhArAdhvamaithunAt||92|| antaHsharIre mAMsAsRugAvishanti yadA malAH| tadA sa~jjAyate granthirgambhIrasthaH sudAruNaH||93|| hRudaye klomni yakRuti plIhni kukShau ca vRukkayoH| nAbhyAM va~gkShaNayorvA~api bastau vA tIvravedanaH||94|| duShTaraktAtimAtratvAt sa vai shIghraM vidahyate| tataH shIghravidAhitvAdvidradhItyabhidhIyate||95|| vyadhacchedabhramAnAhashabdasphuraNasarpaNaiH| vAtikIM, paittikIM tRuShNAdAhamohamadajvaraiH||96|| jRumbhotkleshArucistambhashItakaiH shlaiShmikIM viduH| sarvAsu ca mahacchUlaM vidradhIShUpajAyate||97|| shastrAstrairbhidyata iva colmukairiva dahyate| vidradhI vyamlatA yAtA vRushcikairiva dashyate||98|| tanu rUkShAruNaM shyAvaM phenilaM vAtavidradhI| tilamAShakulatthodasannibhaM pittavidradhI||99|| shlaiShmikI sravati shvetaM picchilaM bahalaM bahu| lakShaNaM sarvamevaitadbhajate sAnnipAtikI||100||
17.commentary: vidradhiM dvividhAmityanenAbhyantaravidradherapi vidradhitvena piDakAnAM saptatve~avirodha iti darshayati| kaNDarAbhA sthUlasnAyvAkArA| antarvidradhergarIyastvena nidAnAnyAha- shItaketyAdi| sa~gkliShTaM doShalam| vyApannaM ca bahu ca madyamupayu~gkte yaH sa vyApannabahumadyaH| antaHsharIra iti koShThe| malA doShAH| granthiriva granthiH| sa iti granthiH| vyadhAdayo vyathAprakArAH | shItameva shItakam| vyamlatAM yAtA vidAhaM prAptA| tamakaH shvAsabhedaH||90-100||

17.sanskrit: athAsAM vidradhInAM sAdhyAsAdhyatvavisheShaj~jAnArthaM sthAnakRutaM li~ggavisheShamupadekShyAmaH- tatra pradhAnamarmajAyAM vidradhyAM hRuddhaTTanatamakapramohakAsashvAsAH, klomajAyAM pipAsAmukhashoShagalagrahAH, yakRujjAyAM shvAsaH, plIhajAyAmucchvAsoparodhaH, kukShijAyAM kukShipArshvAntarAMsashUlaM, vRukkajAyAM pRuShThakaTigrahaH, nAbhijAyAM hikkA, va~gkShaNajAyAM sakthisAdaH, bastijAyAM kRucchrapUtimUtravarcasatvaM ceti||101|| pakvaprabhinnAsUrdhvajAsu mukhAt srAvaH sravati, adhojAsu gudAt, ubhayatastu nAbhijAsu||102|| AsAM hRunnAbhibastijAH paripakvAH sAnnipAtikI ca maraNAya; sheShAH punaH kushalamAshupratikAriNaM cikitsakamAsAdyopashAmyanti| tasmAdacirotthitAM vidradhIM shastrasarpavidyudagnitulyAM snehavirecanairAshvevopakramet sarvasho gulmavacceti||103||
17.commentary: kukShipArshvAntarAMsashUlamiti kukShipArshvAntarAMseShu shUlam | hRunnAbhibastijAsu sAnnipAtikIM pRuthak paThan sAnnipAtikIM pakvAmapakvAM cAsAdhyAM darshayati| shastrAdidRuShTAntatrayAcchastravanmarmacchedakatvaM, sarpavadAshusa~jj~jAhAritvaM, vidyudagnivadAshumArakatvaM j~jeyam||101-103||

17.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- vinA pramehamapyetA jAyante duShTamedasaH| tAvaccaitA na lakShyante yAvadvAstuparigrahaH||104|| sharAvikA kacchapikA jAlinI ceti duHsahAH| jAyante tA hyatibalAH prabhUtashleShmamedasaH||105|| sarShapI cAlajI caiva vinatA vidradhI ca yAH| sAdhyaH pittolbaNAstAstu sambhavantyalpamedasaH||106|| marmasvaMse gude pANyoH stane sandhiShu pAdayoH| jAyante yasya piDikAH sa pramehI na jIvati||107||
17.commentary: pramehaM vinA~apyuktapiDakAsambhavaM darshayati- vinetyAdi| etena ca piDakAnAM mAdhumehikatvaM yat pUrvamuktaM tat prAyikatvena j~jeyam| vAstu sthAnam| vidradhI ceti bAhyavidradhI||104-107||

17.sanskrit: tathA~anyAH piDakAH santi raktapItAsitAruNAH| pANDurAH pANDuvarNAshca bhasmAbhA mecakaprabhAH||108|| mRudvyashca kaThinAshcAnyAH sthUlAH sUkShmAstathA~aparAH| mandavegA mahAvegAH svalpashUlA mahArujaH||109|| tA buddhvA mArutAdInAM yathAsvairhetulakShaNaiH| brUyAdupacareccAshu prAgupadravadarshanAt||110|| tRuTshvAsamAMsasa~gkothamohahikkAmadajvarAH| vIsarpamarmasaMrodhAH piDakAnAmupadravAH||111||
17.commentary: pramehapiDakAprasa~ggenAnyAsAmapi piDakAnAmAviShkRutAnAM lakShaNaM brUte- tathA~anyA ityAdi| pANDurA dhUsarAH, pANDuvarNAstu rUkShapANDuvarNA j~jeyAH| mecakaprabhAH snigdhakRuShNavarNAH| upacarecceti mArutAdInAM bheShajairityarthAdbhavati| prAgupadravadarshanAdityanena upadravayuktA piDakA asAdhyeti darshayati| sa~gkothaH pUtibhAvaH||108-111||

17.sanskrit: kShayaH sthAnaM ca vRuddhishca doShANAM trividhA gatiH| UrdhvaM cAdhashca tiryakca vij~jeyA trividhA~aparA||112|| trividhA cAparA koShThashAkhAmarmAsthisandhiShu| ityuktA vidhibhedena doShANAM trividhA gatiH||113||
17.commentary: samprati doShANAM gatiM vivRuNoti- kShaya ityAdi| sthAnaM svamAnavasthAnam| gatiH prakAro~avasthA vA| caya ityatra prashabdo luptanirdiShTaH, tena prakRuShTacayaH; evaM prakRuShTaH kopaH prakopaH; evaM prashamo~api| etena varShAdiShu pittAdInAM prakRuShTashcayo bhavatIti darshyate, itaradoShasyApi ca stokamAtreNa cayo yathAsambhavaM sUcyate; tena sharadyanubalatvena kaphaprakopo bhavatItyAdi gRuhItaM bhavati||112-113||

17.sanskrit: cayaprakopaprashamAH pittAdInAM yathAkramam| bhavantyekaikashaH ShaTsu kAleShvabhrAgamAdiShu||114|| gatiH kAlakRutA caiShA cayAdyA punarucyate|115|
17.commentary: yathAkramamiti varShAsharaddhemantavasantagrIShmaprAvRuTkrameNa; kiMvA yathAkramamiti yathAyogyatayA| pittAdInAmiti pittashleShmavAtAnAm| ekaikasha iti ayaugapadyena| etacca prAdhAnyenaiva j~jeyaM, tena prAvRuShi shleShmapittakopenApradhAnena na vyabhicAraH| yaduktaM- “varShAsvagnibale hIne kupyanti pavanAdayaH” (sU.a.6) iti| atra hi pavanAdaya iti pavanapradhAnAH; evaM vasante vAtapittaprakope vyAkhyeyam| atra ca ShaTsu RutuShu pittashleShmavAtAnAM prabalacayAdayo vibhajyamAnatvena; tena pittacayakAle vAtasya kopaH, sharadi pittasya prakopakAle vAtaprashamaH, hemante pittaprashamaH kaphasya cayaH, vasante tu kaphaprakopa eva paraM, tathA kaphaprashamake grIShme vAtacaya iti ca syAt| vAtaM parityajya pittAdInAmityabhidhAnAM visargasyAbhipretatvenAgre vaktavyatvAt kRutaM, visarge ca pittacaya eva bhavatIti kRutvA||114||-

17.sanskrit: gatishca dvividhA dRuShTA prAkRutI vaikRutI ca yA||115|| pittAdevoShmaNaH paktirnarANAmupajAyate| tacca pittaM prakupitaM vikArAn kurute bahUn||116|| prAkRutastu balaM shleShmA vikRuto mala ucyate| sa caivaujaH smRutaH kAye sa ca pApmopadishyate||117|| sarvA hi ceShTA vAtena sa prANaH prANInAM smRutaH| tenaiva rogA jAyante tena caivoparudhyate||118||
17.commentary: gatibhedAntaramAha- gatishcetyAdi| atra pittamAdau kRutaM sharIrasthitihetvagnikartRutvena| paktiH pAkaH| balamiti balahetutvena| mala iti sharIramalinIkaraNAt| oja iti sArabhUtaM; yadi vA dvitIyashlaiShmikaujohetutvenaujaH| vakShyati hi shArIre- “tAvaccaiva shlaiShmikasyaujasashca pramANam” (shA.a.7) iti| duHkhahetutvAt pApmA| sarvA hi ceShTA iti avikRutagamanAdyAH| uparudhyate mriyate||115-118||

17.sanskrit: nityaM sannihitAmitraM samIkShyAtmAnamAtmavAn| nityaM yuktaH paricaredicchannAyuranitvaram||119||
17.commentary: AtmavAniti prashaMsAyAM matuppratyayaH| yukta ityudyuktaH| anitvaram agatvaram||119||

17.sanskrit: tatra shlokau- shirorogAH sahRudrogA rogA mAnavikalpajAH| kShayAH sapiDakAshcoktA doShANAM gatireva ca||120|| kiyantaHshirasIye~asminnadhyAye tattvadarshinA| j~jAnArthaM bhiShajAM caiva prajAnAM ca hitaiShiNA||121||
17.commentary: tatra shlokAvityAdi||120-121||

17.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne kiyantaHshirasIyo nAma saptadasho~adhyAyaH||17||
17.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne rogacatuShke kiyantaHshirasIyo nAma saptadasho~adhyAyaH||17||

18.sanskrit: athAtastrishothIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
18.commentary: pUrvAdhyAye piDakA uktAH, tAshca shotharUpAH, ataH shothAdhikArAt trishothIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

18.sanskrit: trayaH shothA bhavanti vAtapittashleShmanimittAH, te punardvividhA nijAgantubhedena||3||
18.commentary: vakShyamANadvividhAdibhede vidyamAne~api vAtAdikRutatritvAbhidhAnamagre vAtAdikRutasyaiva prAdhAnyakhyApanArtham||3||

18.sanskrit: tatrAgantavashchedanabhedanakShaNanabha~jjanapicchanotpeShaNaprahAravadhabandhanaveShTanavyadhanapIDanAdibhirvA bhallAtakapuShpaphalarasAtmaguptAshUkakrimishUkAhitapatralatAgulmasaMsparshanairvA svedanaparisarpaNAvamUtraNairvA viShiNAM saviShaprANidaMShTrAdantaviShANanakhanipAtairvA sAgaraviShavAtahimadahanasaMsparshanairvA shothAH samupajAyante||4||
18.commentary: bhedanam AshayavidAraNaM, kShaNanam asthicUrNanaM, bha~jjanaM jarjarIkaraNaM, picchnam atyarthapIDanam, utpeShaNaM shilotpeShaNamiva, veShTanam agranthibandhanaM sarpAdibhiH| shUkavatAM krimINAM shUkaH shUkakrimishUkaH| svedanAdibhirviShiNAmiti yojyam||4||

18.sanskrit: te punaryathAsvaM hetuvya~jjanairAdAvupalabhyante nijavya~jjanaikadeshaviparItaiH; bandhamantrAgadapralepapratApanirvApaNAdibhishcopakramairupakramyamANAH prashAntimApadyante||5||
18.commentary: AdAvupalabhyanta iti vacanAduttarakAlamAgantorapi nijatulyatAM brUte| yaduktam- “Aganturanveti nijaM vikAraM” (sU.a.19) iti| nijavya~jjanaikadeshaviparItairiti nijalakShaNebhya AgantUnAmekadesho viparIto bhavati, sa ca vAtAdijanyashyAvAdivarNavikAratvAjj~jeyaH; kiMvA AganturvyathApUrvo bhavati pashcAdvAtAdibhiranubadhyate, nijastu pUrvaM vAtAdilakShaNairyujyate pashcAdvedanAvAn bhavatItyekadeshavaiparItyam| bandhaH ariShTAbandho vraNabandhashca| bandhAdayashca yathAyogyatayA boddhavyAH||5||

18.sanskrit: nijAH punaH snehasvedavamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsanashirovirecanAnAmayathAvatprayogAnmithyAsaMsarjanAdvA chardyalasakavisUcikAshvAsakAsAtisArashoShapANDurogodarajvarapradarabhagandarArshovikArAtikarshanairvA kuShThakaNDUpiDakAdibhirvA chardikShavathUdgArashukravAtamUtrapurIShavegadhAraNairvA karmarogopavAsAdhvakarshitasya vA sahasA~atigurvamlalavaNapiShTAnnaphalashAkarAgadadhiharitakamadyamandakavirUDhanavashUkashamIdhAnyAnUpaudaka- pishitopayogAnmRutpa~gkaloShTabhakShaNAllavaNAtibhakShaNAdgarbhasampIDanAdAmagarbhaprapatanAt prajAtAnAM ca mithyopacArAdudIrNadoShatvAcca shophAH prAdurbhavanti; ityuktaH sAmAnyo hetuH||6||
18.commentary: chardyAdayaH svarUpata eva shothahetavaH| karmAdyatikarshitasya tu sahasA~atigurvAdisevanaM shothahetuH; karmeti pa~jcakarma| virUDhanavashabdau shUkashamIdhAnyavisheShaNau| prajAtAnAmiti aciraprasUtAnAm||6||

18.sanskrit: ayaM tvatra visheShaH- shItarUkShalaghuvishadashramopavAsAtikarshanakShapaNAdibhirvAyuH prakupitastva~gmAMsashoNitAdInyabhibhUya shophaM janayati; sa kShiprotthAnaprashamo bhavati, tathA shyAmAruNavarNaH prakRutivarNo vA, calaH spandanaH kharaparuShabhinnatvagromA chidyata iva bhidyata iva pIDyata iva sUcIbhiriva tudyate pipIlikAbhiriva saMsRupyate sarShapakalkAvalipta iva cimicimAyate sa~gkucyata Ayamyata iveti vAtashothaH (1); uShNatIkShNakaTukakShAralavaNAmlAjIrNabhojanairagnyAtapapratApaishca pittaM prakupitaM tva~gmAMsashoNitAnyabhibhUya shothaM janayati; sa kShiprotthAnaprashamo bhavati, kRuShNapItanIlatAmrAvabhAsa uShNo mRuduH kapilatAmraromA uShyate dUyate dhUpyate UShmAyate svidyate klidyate na ca sparshamuShNaM ca suShUyata iti pittashothaH (2); gurumadhurashItasnigdhairatisvapnAvyAyAmAdibhishca shleShmA prakupitastva~gmAMsashoNitAdInyabhibhUya shothaM janayati; sa kRucchrotthAnaprashamo bhavati, pANDushvetAvabhAso guruH snigdhaH shlakShNaH sthiraH styAnaH shuklAgraromA sparshoShNasahashceti shleShmashothaH (3); yathAsvakAraNAkRutisaMsargAddvidoShajAstrayaH shothA bhavanti; yathAsvakAraNAkRutisannipAtAt sAnnipAtika ekaH; evaM saptavidho bhedaH||7|| prakRutibhistAbhistAbhirbhidyamAno dvividhastrividhashcaturvidhaH saptavidho~aShTavidhashca shotha upalabhyate, punashcaika evotsedhasAmAnyAt||8||
18.commentary: kShapaNaM vamanAdibhiH| prakRutivarNaH dehasamAnavarNaH| calaH sa~gkramaNavAn| spandanaH kampanaH| uShyate pArshvastheneva vahninA dahyate| dhUpyate dhUmamivodvamati| UShmAyate bahiH parairapyuShNatvenopalabhyate| svidyate svedavAn bhavati| na suShUyate na sahate; sparshanaM ca na sahate, uShNaM ca na sahate| sa kRucchrotthAnaprashama iti cirotthAnaprashamaH| prakRutibhiriti kAraNaiH| utsedha unnatatvam||7-8||

18.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- shUyante yasya gAtrANi svapantIva rujanti ca| pIDitAnyunnamantyAshu vAtashothaM tamAdishet||9|| yashcApyaruNavarNAbhaH shotho naktaM praNashyati| snehoShNamardanAbhyAM ca praNashyet sa ca vAtikaH||10|| yaH pipAsAjvarArtasya dUyate~atha vidahyate| svidyati klidyate gandhI sa paittaH svayathuH smRutaH||11|| yaH pItanetravaktratvak pUrvaM madhyAt prashUyate| tanutvak cAtisArI ca pittashothaH sa ucyate||12|| shItaH saktagatiryastu kaNDUmAn pANDureva ca| nipIDito nonnamati shvayathuH sa kaphAtmakaH||13|| yasya shastrakushacchinnAcchoNitaM na pravartate| kRucchreNa picchA sravati sa cApi kaphasambhavaH||14|| nidAnAkRutisaMsargAcchvayathuH syAddvidoShajaH| sarvAkRutiH sannipAtAcchotho vyAmishrahetujaH||15||
18.commentary: shUyanta ityAdi| punaH shlokena lakShaNAbhidhAnaM prAyobhAvilakShaNadarshanArtham| svapantIveti nirvedanaH| etena vAyoshcalatvena kShaNAcca ruk, kShaNAcca tadabhAva iti j~jeyam| madhyAditi sharIramadhyAt| saktagatiH avisArI| shastrakushacchinnAditi shastrakushakRutAcchedAt||9-15||

18.sanskrit: yastu pAdAbhinirvRuttaH shothaH sarvA~ggago bhavet| jantoH sa ca sukaShTaH syAt prasRutaH strImukhAcca yaH||16|| yashcApi guhyaprabhavaH striyA vA puruShasya vA| sa ca kaShTatamo j~jeyo yasya ca syurupadravAH||17||
18.commentary: pAdAbhinirvRuttaH shothaH puruShANAM laghAvadhodeshe jAtaH san yadA na jIyate tadA gurumUrdhvadeshaM gataH sa na pAryate jetuM, yo hi laghau pradeshe jetuM na pAryate sa gurupradeshagato nitarAmeva na pAryate; evaM prasRutaH strImukhAcca ya ityapi j~jeyam| vacanaM hi- “adhobhAgo guruH strINAmUrdhvaH puMsAM gurustathA” (su.sU.a.46) iti||16-17||

18.sanskrit: chardiH shvAso~arucistRuShNA jvaro~atIsAra eva ca| saptako~ayaM sadaurbalyaH shophopadravasa~ggrahaH||18||
18.commentary: uktAnupadravAnAha- chardirityAdi||18||

18.sanskrit: yasya shleShmA prakupito jihvAmUle~avatiShThate| Ashu sa~jjanayecchothaM jAyate~asyopajihvikA||19|| yasya shleShmA prakupitaH kAkale vyavatiShThate| Ashu sa~jjanayecchophaM karoti galashuNDikAm||20|| yasya shleShmA prakupito galabAhye~avatiShThate| shanaiH sa~jjanayecchophaM galagaNDo~asya jAyate||21|| yasya shleShmA prakupitastiShThatyantargale sthiraH| Ashu sa~jjanayecchophaM jAyate~asya galagrahaH||22|| yasya pittaM prakupitaM saraktaM tvaci sarpati| shophaM sarAgaM janayedvisarpastasya jAyate||23|| yasya pittaM prakupitaM tvaci rakte~avatiShThate| shothaM sarAgaM janayet piDakA tasya jAyate||24|| yasya prakupitaM pittaM shoNitaM prApya shuShyati| tilakA piplavo vya~ggA nIlikA tasya jAyate||25|| yasya pittaM prakupitaM sha~gkhayoravatiShThate| shvayathuH sha~gkhako nAma dAruNastasya jAyate||26|| yasya pittaM prakupitaM karNamUle~avatiShThate| jvarAnte durjayo~antAya shothastasyopajAyate||27|| vAtaH plIhAnamuddhUya kupito yasya tiShThati| shanaiH paritudan pArshvaM plIhA tasyAbhivardhate||28|| yasya vAyuH prakupito gulmasthAne~avatiShThate| shophaM sashUlaM janayan gulmastasyopajAyate||29|| yasya vAyuH prakupitaH shophashUlakarashcaran| va~gkShaNAdvRuShaNau yAti vRuddhistasyopajAyate||30|| yasya vAtaH prakupitastva~gmAMsAntaramAshritaH| shothaM sa~jjanayet kukShAvudaraM tasya jAyate||31|| yasya vAtaH prakupitaH kukShimAshritya tiShThati| nAdho vrajati nApyUrdhvamAnAhastasya jAyate||32|| rogAshcotsedhasAmAnyadadhimAMsArbudAdayaH| vishiShTA nAmarUpAbhyAM nirdeshyAH shothasa~ggrahe||33|| vAtapittakaphA yasya yugapat kupitAstrayaH| jihvAmUle~avatiShThante vidahantaH samucchritAH||34|| janayanti bhRushaM shothaM vedanAshca pRuthagvidhAH| taM shIghrakAriNaM rogaM rohiNIti vinirdishet||35|| trirAtraM paramaM tasya jantorbhavati jIvitam| kushalena tvanukrAntaH kShipraM sampadyate sukhI||36||
18.commentary: sampratyutsedhasAmAnyAt prAdeshikA~jchothAnAha- yasyetyAdi| kAkalaM tAlumUlam| shanairitivacanena galagaNDakAriNo doShAshcirakriyA bhavantIti darshayati; galagrahAdau cAshukAriNo doShA bhavanti| visarpasya piDakAyAshca tulyakAraNatve~api visarpe sarpaNashIlo doShaH, piDakAyAM ca sthiro j~jeyaH; ata eva piDakAsamprAptau ‘avatiShThate’ ityuktam| yasya pittamityAdau pittaM prApya shoNitaM kartRu shuShyatIti yojanIyam| piplavaH ‘jaTulA’ iti prasiddhaH| dAruNaH anupakramAdAshumArakaH| durjayo~antAyeti durjayo vA yathAkramamupakramyamANaH , antAya vA mithyopakramAdveti mantavyam| ayameva shotho~anyatrApyuktaH- “sannipAtajvarasyAnte karNamUle sudAruNAH| shothaH sa~jjAyate tena kashcideva pramucyate” iti| gulmAdayo vistaravaktavyA api ihotsedhasAmAnyAlleshata ucyante| shothasa~ggraha iti shothatvenotsedharUpeNa sa~ggrahaH shothasa~ggrahaH|| samucchritA atiriktapramANAH| bhRusham atyarthaduHkhakAriNam| kShipramityanukrAnta ityanena sambadhyate, tena trirAtraghAtitvaM yasya tasya kathaM shIghraprashama iti codyaM nottiShThate; kiMvA kShipraM sampadyate sukhIti vyAdhimahimnA bhavati| vyAdherevaitat svarUpaM yacchIghraM hanti, shIghraM prashAmyatIti| yaduktaM- “sa shIghraM shIghrakAritvAt prashamaM yAti hanti vA” (ci. 3) iti||19-36||

18.sanskrit: santi hyevaMvidhA rogAH sAdhyA dAruNasammatAH| ye hanyuranupakrAntA mithyAcAreNa vA punaH||37|| sAdhyAshcApyapare santi vyAdhayo mRudusammatAH| yatnAyatnakRutaM yeShu karma sidhyatyasaMshayam||38|| asAdhyAshcApare santi vyAdhayo yApyasa~jj~jitAH| susAdhvapi kRutaM yeShu karma yAtrAkaraM bhavet||39|| santi cApyapare rogA yeShu karma na sidhyati| api yatnakRutaM bAlairna tAn vidvAnupAcaret||40|| sAdhyAshcaivApyasAdhyAshca vyAdhayo dvividhAH smRutAH| mRududAruNabhedena te bhavanti caturvidhAH||41||
18.commentary: etadeva shIghrakAritvamanyeShvapi jvarAntakarNashothavalayAdiShvastItyAha- santItyAdi| dAruNA iti sammatA dAruNasammatAH| dAruNatvaprasa~ggena mRudvAdibhedAnapyAha- sAdhyAshcetyAdi| yAtrAkaraM yApanAkaram| bAlaiH aj~jaiH, asAdhye aj~jA evotsAhAt pravartanta ityarthaH| asAdhyasya mRududAruNatvaM yApyapratyAkhyeyabhedena, tathA sadyaHprANaharakAlAntaraprANaharatvAdinA ca||37-41||

18.sanskrit: ta evAparisa~gkhyeyA bhidyamAnA bhavanti hi| rujAvarNasamutthAnasthAnasaMsthAnanAmabhiH ||42|| vyavasthAkaraNaM teShAM yathAsthUleShu sa~ggrahaH| tathA prakRutisAmAnyaM vikAreShUpadishyate||43||
18.commentary: ta evetyAdi| samutthAnabhedA hetubhedAH; rUkShabhojanarAtrijAgaraNAdibhinnahetujanyo hi vAto bhinnopakramasAdhyashca bhavatIti bhAvaH| sthAnabhedA AmAshayAdayo rasAdayashca| saMsthAnam AkRutiH, yathA- gulmArbudAdiH| nAmabhedo yathA- ekasminneva rAjayakShmaNi rAjayakShmashoShAdisa~jj~jA| nanvevamaparisa~gkhyeyatve kathaM vyavahAra ityAha- vyavasthetyAdi| vyavasthAkaraNaM cikitsAvyavahArArthaM sa~gkhyAkathanam| yathAsthUleShviti ye ye sthUlA udaramUtrakRucchrAdayasteShu; sa~ggrahaH aShTodarIyarogasa~ggrahe (udishyate) ityarthaH| asthUleShu vikAreShu aShTodarIye sa~jj~jayA~anukteShu kathaM vyavasthAkaraNamityAha- tathetyAdi| prakRutisAmAnyaM samAnakAraNatA; tenAnukteShu sAkShAddhyAdhiShu vAtajo~ayaM shleShmajo~ayamiti, tathA rasajo~ayaM raktajo~ayamityAdikA cikitsAvyavahArArthaM vyavasthA kartavyeti bhAvaH| ata evAShTodarIye vakShyati- “sarve vikArA vAtapittakaphAnnAtivartante” (sU. 19) iti||42-43||

18.sanskrit: vikAranAmAkushalo na jihrIyAt kadAcana| na hi sarvavikArANAM nAmato~asti dhruvA sthitiH||44|| sa eva kupito doShaH samutthAnavisheShataH| sthAnAntaragatashcaiva janayatyAmayAn bahUn ||45|| tasmAdvikAraprakRutIradhiShThAnAntarANi ca| samutthAnavisheShAMshca buddhvA karma samAcaret||46|| yo hyetattritayaM j~jAtvA karmANyArabhate bhiShak| j~jAnapUrvaM yathAnyAyaM sa karmasu na muhyati||47||
18.commentary: jvararaktapittAdivannAmAj~jAne~api vAtAdijanyatvaj~jAnenaiva pracaritavyamityAha- vikAretyAdi| sthAnAntaragatashcetyatra cakAra ekasthAnagato~api bahuvikAraM karotIti samuccinoti| yato vakShyati- “karoti galamAshritaH| kaNThoddhvaMsaM ca kAsaM ca svarabhedamarocakam” (ci. 8) iti| adhiShThAnAntarANi AshayAntarANi| j~jAnapUrvamiti cikitsAj~jAnapUrvakam| yathAnyAyaM yathAgamam| evaM manyate- yadvAtArabdhatvAdij~jAnameva kAraNaM rogANAM cikitsAyAmupakAri, nAmaj~jAnaM tu vyavahAramAtraprayojanArthaM na svarUpeNa cikitsAyAmupakArIti||44-47||

18.sanskrit: nityAH prANabhRutAM dehe vAtapittakaphAstrayaH| vikRutAH prakRutisthA vA tAn bubhutseta paNDitaH||48||
18.commentary: samprati vAtAdij~jAnena rogaj~jAnamuddiShTaM tenopoddhAtena vAtAdInAM prakRutisthAnAmaprakRutisthAnAM ca lakShaNaM vaktumAha- nityA ityAdi| bubhutseta j~jAtumicchet||48||

18.sanskrit: utsAhocchvAsaniH shvAsaceShTA dhAtugatiH samA| samo mokSho gatimatAM vAyoH karmAvikArajam||49|| darshanaM paktirUShmA ca kShuttRuShNA dehamArdavam| prabhA prasAdo medhA ca pittakarmAvikArajam||50|| sneho bandhaH sthiratvaM ca gauravaM vRuShatA balam| kShamA dhRutiralobhashca kaphakarmAvikArajam||51||
18.commentary: ceShTeti avikRutA ceShTA| dhAtugatiriti rasAdInAM poShyaM dhAtuM prati gamanam| gatimatAmiti purIShAdInAM bahirniHsaratAm| prasAdaH manaHprasAdaH| bandhaH sandhibandhaH| sthiratvam ashaithilyam| gauravaM prAkRutaM sharIragauravam| kShamA sahiShNutA| dhRutiH manaso~acA~jcalyam| kShamAdayashca shleShmaNaH prabhAvAt kriyante; evamanyatrApi j~jeyam||49-51||

18.sanskrit: vAte pitte kaphe caiva kShINe lakShaNamucyate| karmaNaH prAkRutAddhAnirvRuddhirvA~api virodhinAm||52||
18.commentary: kShayalakShaNamAha- vAte ityAdi| karmaNaH prAkRutAditi vAtAdiprakRutikarmatvenoktAdutsAhAdeH| hAniH apacayaH| vRuddhirvA~api virodhinAmiti uktaprAkRutalakShaNavirodhinAM karmaNAM vRuddhiH; yathA vAtakShaye utsAhavirodhino viShAdasya vRuddhiH, pittakShaye~adarshanApaktyAdInAM, shleShmakShaye raukShyAdInAM vRuddhiH| iha prAkRutakarmahAnau satyAM nAvashyaM virodhikarmavRuddhirata uktaM- vRuddhirvetyAdi; na hyavashyamutsAhahAnAvalpamAtrAyAM satyAM viShAdo vardhate, alobhanyUnatve vA manAglobho vardhate; kiMvA, utsAhAdyabhAvenAbhAvamukhena j~jAnArthaM ‘karmaNaH prAkRutAddhAniH’ ityuktaM, viShAdAdivRuddhyA tu vidhimukhena j~jAnArthaM ‘vRuddhirvA~api virodhinAm’ ityuktam| yaducyate- vRuddhirvA~api virodhinAmiti virodhidoShANAM, yathA- pittavRuddhau shleShmakShayo jAyate, ityevamAdi; tanna, yato~anyadoShavRuddhAvanyasyAvashyaM na hyapAyo bhavati, tathAhi sati pittavRuddhau satyAM sarvadA shleShmakShyaH syAt; na ca doShAH parasparaghAtakA iti prAgeva pratipAditaM; pradeshAntare~api doShANAM svalakShaNahAnireva paraM kShayalakShaNaM- “kShINA jahati li~ggaM svaM” (sU.a.17) ityanenoktam||52||

18.sanskrit: doShaprakRutivaisheShyaM niyataM vRuddhilakShaNam| doShANAM prakRutirhAnirvRuddhishcaivaM parIkShyate||53||
18.commentary: vRuddhilakShaNamAha- doShetyAdi| prakRutiH svabhAvaH, tasya vaisheShyamAdhikyaM; shleShmaNaH snehashaityamAdhuryAdiryA prakRutistasyA atisnigdhAtishaityAtimAdhuryAdivaisheShyaM vRuddhilakShaNam| niyatamiti pratiniyataM, yadyasya prakRutilakShaNaM tadvRuddhaM saptasyaiva vRuddhilakShaNamityarthaH; anye tu nishcitamityAhuH||53||

18.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- sa~gkhyAM nimittaM rUpANi shothAnAM sAdhyatAM na ca| teShAM teShAM vikArANAM shothAMstAMstAMshca pUrvajAn||54|| vidhibhedaM vikArANAM trividhaM bodhyasa~ggraham| prAkRutaM karma doShANAM lakShaNaM hAnivRuddhiShu||55|| vItamoharajodoShalobhamAnamadaspRuhaH| vyAkhyAtavAMstrishothIye rogAdhyAye punarvasuH||56||
18.commentary: sa~ggrahe shothAnAM sAdhyatAmiti bheShajavisheShasAdhyatvam, upashaya ityarthaH; tacca ‘snehauShNyamardanAbhyAM ca praNashyet sa ca vAtika’ ityuktaM j~jeyam| na ceti na ca sAdhyatAM, yathA- ‘yashca pAdAbhinirvRuttaH’ ityAdi| teShAM teShAmiti upajihvAdInAm| shothAn pUrvajAnityabhidadhAna upajihvAdiShu pUrvaM shotho bhavati, pashcAdupajihvAdirogavyaktiriti darshayati| ata eva ‘Ashu sa~jjanayecchothaM’ ityuktvA ‘jAyate~asyopajihvikA’ ityuktam| bodhyaH boddhavyo vikAraprakRutyAdiH| tasya trividhaM sa~ggrahamiti ‘tasmAdvikAraprakRutIH’ ityAdyuktaM trayam||54-56||

18.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne trishothIyo nAmAShTAdasho~adhyAyaH||18||
18.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAkhyAyAM sUtrasthAne rogacatuShke trishothIyo nAmAShTAdasho~adhyAyaH||18||

19.sanskrit: athAto~aShTodarIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
19.commentary: pUrvAdhyAye proktaM “vyavasthAkaraNaM teShAM yathAsthUleShu sa~ggrahaH” (sU. 18) iti, tadanu jij~jAsAyAmaShTAvudarANItyAdiM yathAsthUlaM sa~ggraho~abhidhIyate| aShTodarIya iti cArthaparA sa~jj~jA||1-2||

19.sanskrit: iha khalvaShTAvudarANi, aShTau mUtrAghAtAH, aShTau kShIradoShAH, aShTau retodoShAH; sapta kuShThAni, sapta piDakAH, sapta vIsarpAH; ShaDatIsArAH, ShaDudAvartAH; pa~jca gulmAH, pa~jca plIhadoShAH, pa~jca kAsAH, pa~jca shvAsAH, pa~jca hikkAH, pa~jca tRuShNAH, pa~jca chardayaH, pa~jca bhaktasyAnashanasthAnAni, pa~jca shirorogAH, pa~jca hRudrogAH, pa~jca pANDurogAH, pa~jconmAdAH, catvAro~apasmArAH, catvAro~akShirogAH, catvAraH karNarogAH, catvAraH pratishyAyAH, catvAro mukharogAH, catvAro grahaNIdoShAH, catvAro madAH, catvAro mUrcchAyAH, catvAraH shoShAH, catvAri klaibyAni; trayaH shophAH, trINi kilAsAni, trividhaM lohitapittaM; dvau jvarau, dvau vraNau, dvAvAyAmau, dve gRudhrasyau, dve kAmale, dvividhamAmaM, dvividhaM vAtaraktaM, dvividhAnyarshAMsi; eka UrustambhaH, ekaH sannyAsaH, eko mahAgadaH; viMshatiH krimijAtayaH, viMshatiH pramehAH, viMshatiryonivyApadaH; ityaShTacatvAriMshadrogAdhikaraNAnyasmin sa~ggrahe samuddiShTAni||3||
19.commentary: udarAbhidhAnamAdau pUrvAdhyAyoktashothasAmAnyAt; udArANyutsedhasAmAnyAcchothaprabhedA eva||3||

19.sanskrit: etAni yathoddeshamabhinirdekShyAmaH- aShTAvudarANIti vAtapittakaphasannipAtaplIhabaddhacchidradakodarANi, aShTau mUtrAghAtA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtAshmarIsharkarAshukrashoNitajAH, aShTau kShIradoShA iti vaivarNyaM vaigandhyaM vairasyaM paicchilyaM phenasa~gghAto raukShyaM gauravamatisnehashca, aShTau retodoShA iti tanu shuShkaM phenilamashvetaM pUtyatipicchalamanyadhAtUpahitamavasAdi ca (1); sapta kuShThAnIti kapAlodumbaramaNDalarShyajihvapuNDarIkasidhmakAkaNAni, sapta piDakA iti sharAvikA kacchapikA jAlinI sarShapyalajI vinatA vidradhI ca, sapta visarpA iti vAtapittakaphAgnikardamakagranthisannipAtAkhyAH (2); ShaDatIsArA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtabhayashokajAH, ShaDudAvartA iti vAtamUtrapurIShashukracchardikShavathujAH (3); pa~jca gulmA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtashoNitajAH, pa~jca plIhadoShA iti gulmairvyAkhyAtAH, pa~jca kAsA iti vAtapittakaphakShatakShayajAH, pa~jca shvAsA iti mahordhvacchinnatamakakShudrAH, pa~jca hikkA iti mahatI gambhIrA vyapetA kShudrA~annajA ca, pa~jca tRuShNA iti vAtapittAmakShayopasargAtmikAH, pa~jca chardaya iti dviShTArthasaMyogajA vAtapittakaphasannipAtodrekotthAshca , pa~jca bhaktasyAnashanasthAnAnIti vAtapittakaphasannipAtadveShAH, pa~jca shirorogA iti pUrvoddeshamabhisamasya vAtapittakaphasannipAtakrimijAH, pa~jca hRudrogA iti shirorogairvyAkhyAtAH, pa~jca pANDurogA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtamRudbhakShaNajAH, pa~jconmAdA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtAgantunimittAH (4); catvAro~apasmArA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtanimittAH, catvAro~akShirogAshcatvAraH karNarogAshcatvAraH pratishyAyAshcatvAro mukharogAshcatvAro grahaNIdoShAshcatvAro madAshcatvAro mUrcchAyA ityapasmArairvyAkhyAtAH, catvAraH shoShA iti sAhasasandhAraNakShayaviShamAshanajAH, catvAri klaibyAnIti bIjopaghAtAddhvajabha~ggAjjarAyAH shukrakShayAcca (5); trayaH shothA iti vAtapittashleShmanimittAH, trINi kilAsAnIti raktatAmrashuklAni, trividhaM lohitapittamiti UrdhvabhAgamadhobhAgamubhayabhAgaM ca (6); dvau jvarAviti uShNAbhiprAyaH shItasamutthashca shItAbhiprAyashcoShNasamutthaH, dvau vraNAviti nijashcAgantujashca, dvAvAyAmAviti bAhyashcAbhyantarashca, dve gRudhrasyAviti vAtAdvAtakaphAcca, dve kAmale iti koShThAshrayA shAkhAshrayA ca, dvividhamAmamiti alasako visUcikA ca, dvividhaM vAtaraktamiti gambhIramuttAnaM ca, dvividhAnyarshAMsIti shuShkANyArdrANi ca (7); eka Urustambha ityAmatridoShasamutthaH, ekaH sannyAsa iti tridoShAtmako manaHsharIrAdhiShThAnaH, eko mahAgada iti atattvAbhiniveshaH (8); viMshatiH krimijAtaya iti yUkA pipIlikAshceti dvividhA bahirmalajAH, keshAdA lomAdA lomadvIpAH saurasA audumbarA jantumAtarashceti ShaT shoNitajAH, antrAdA udarAveShTA hRudayAdAshcuravo darbhapuShpAH saugandhikA mahAgudAshceti sapta kaphajAH, kakerukA makerukA lelihAH sashUlakAH sausurAdAshceti pa~jca purIShajAH; viMshatiH pramehA ityudakamehashcekShubAlikArasamehashca sAndramehashca sAndraprasAdamehashca shuklamehashca shukramehashca shItamehashca shanairmehashca sikatAmehashca lAlAmehashceti dasha shleShmanimittAH, kShAramehashca kAlamehashca nIlamehashca lohitamehashca ma~jjiShThAmehashca haridrAmehashceti ShaT pittanimittAH, vasAmehashca majjAmehashca hastimehashca madhumehashceti catvAro vAtanimittAH, iti viMshatiH pramehAH; viMshatiryonivyApada iti vAtikI paittikI shleShmikI sAnnipAtikI ceti catasro doShajAH, doShadUShyasaMsargaprakRutinirdeshairavashiShTAH ShoDasha nirdishyante, tadyathA- raktayonishcArajaskA cAcaraNA cAticaraNA ca prAkcaraNA copaplutA ca pariplutA codAvartinI ca karNinI ca putraghnI cAntarmukhI ca sUcImukhI ca shuShkA ca vAminI ca ShaNDhayonishca mahAyonishceti viMshatiryonivyApado bhavanti (9); kevalashcAyamuddesho yathoddeshamabhinirdiShTo bhavati||4||
19.commentary: ihaikAdi sa~gkhyAparityAgAdaShTasa~gkhyAgrahaNamAdau kRutam, aShTasa~gkhyAyA bahutvena prAdhAnyAt; viMshatisa~gkhyamehAdInAmUnaviMshatyAdyadhaHsa~gkhyAnupUrvIprAptyabhAvAnna kRutaH prathamaM niveshaH| yadyapi cikitsite~aShTAdasha kuShThAni, tathA~apIha mahAkuShThAbhiprAyeNa saptocyante| ShaDudAvartA ityatra navegAndhAraNIyoktanyAyenoccArAdinirodhajAdaya udAvartA ihocyante| gulmairvyAkhyAtA iti yathA gulmabhedAstathA plIhadoShAH| pa~jca tRuShNeti sambhojanasnehAdijanitAnAmapi vAtAdijAsvevAvarodhAt| sthAnamiva sthAnaM kAraNaM; tena, anashanasthAnAnyarocakAni; anena kAraNena kAryANyarocakAni lakShyante ; tena rogasa~ggrahe kAraNAbhidhAnamanyAyyamiti na bhavati| pUrvoddeshamabhisamasyeti kiyantaHshirasIye vistaroktAn sa~gkShipya; kiMvA kiyantaHshirasIya eva “ardhAvabhedako vA syAt” (sU. 17) ityAdyuddiShTAnabhisamasya parityajya shirasyeva rujArUpA ye pa~jca ta ucyante| ‘sAhasaM sandhAraNaM kShayo viShamAshanam’ iti pAThe kAraNena kAryaM caturvidhaH shoSha ucyate| dvau jvarAvityAdau shItasamutthatvenaivoShNAbhiprAyatA labdhA, yato nidAnaviparItamicchati jvarI; tadihoShNAbhiprAyatAvisheShaNaM shItartusamutthatvena paittikasyApi jvarasya shItasamutthatvanirAsArtham; evaM shItAbhiprAye~api vAcyam| dvividhamAmamiti AmaviShasya trividhakukShIye vakShyamANasyAlasaka evAntarbhAvAt; anye tvAmaviShasya viShatvenAnyaviShatantraviShayatvAdihAgrahaNamiti bruvate| atattvAbhinivesho mAnaso vikAraH, sa ca sarvasaMsAriduHkhahetutayA gada ityucyate| krimINAM sa~jj~jA prAyo rUDhA j~jAtavyA| pipIlikA likhyAH| doShasya dUShyeNa raktAdinA saMsargo doShadUShyasaMsargaH, prakRutiH kAraNam; tatra doShadUShyasaMsarganirdeshena raktayonyAdayaH, prakRutinirdeshena prAkcaraNAdayo yonivyApatticikitsitaM vIkShya vyAkartavyAH| atra madA eva madAtyayarUpatAM yAntIti kRutvA madAtyayAH pRutha~gnoktAH| iha coktAnAM rogANAM yadyapi prakArAntareNAnyathA~api sa~gkhyA bhavati; tathA hi- aShTau jvarAH, dvAvunmAdau nijAgantukabhedenetyAdi, tathA~api pradhAnavivakShayA eta eva bhedA gRuhItAH; prAdhAnyaM ca svAdhikAre rogANAmanusaraNIyam||4||

19.sanskrit: sarva eva nijA vikArA nAnyatra vAtapittakaphebhyo nirvartante, yathAhi- shakuniH sarvaM divasamapi paripatan svAM chAyAM nAtivartate, tathA svadhAtuvaiShamyanimittAH sarve vikArA vAtapittakaphAnnAtivartante| vAtapittashleShmaNAM punaH sthAnasaMsthAnaprakRutivisheShAnabhisamIkShya tadAtmakAnapi ca sarvavikArAM stAnevopadishanti buddhimantaH||5||
19.commentary: sampratyaShTodarAdInAM tathA vakShyamANAnAM mahAroge tathA~anuktAnAmiha tantre rogANAM nijAnAM vAtapittashleShmANa eva vyastAH samastA vA kAraNaM bhavantItyetadrUpaM rogANAM cikitsopayogi sUtraM darshayitumAha- sarva ityAdi| sarva ityuktA anuktAshca| yadyapyAgantuShvapi doShasambandho na vyabhicarati, tathA~apyAgantau roge doShApekShayA na cikitsetyAgantuvyudAsArthaM nijA ityuktam| svashabdenAgantukRutaM dhAtuvaiShamyaM nirAkaroti| nanu, yadi vAtAdijanyA eva sarvavikArAstat kimarthamanyathA~apyudarAdayaH plIhajatvAdibhirnirdishyanta ityAha- vAtapittetyAdi| sthAnaM rasAdayo bastyAdayashca, saMsthAnam AkRutirlakShaNamiti yAvat, prakRutiH kAraNam, eShAM visheShAnabhisamIkShya tAMstAnupadishantIti ‘aShTAvudarANi’ ityevammAdyupadishanti| tadAtmakAnapIti vAtAdijanitAnapi| tatra, sthAnavisheShAdupadesho yathA- UrustambharaktayonikAmalAprabhRutayaH; saMsthAnavisheShAt piDakAgulmaprabhRutayaH; prakRutivisheShAcchleShmaplIhodaraprabhRutayaH| anye tu vyAkhyAnayanti- yatastAneveti vAtAdijAneveti vyapadishanti; tadAtmakAnapIti yathoktAShTAdisa~gkhyAyuktAnapi| yadyapi plIhAdikAraNAntareNa bhinnA api rogAstathA~api vAtAdisthAnajanyatvena tathA vAtAdilakShaNayuktatvena tathA vAtAdikAraNajAtatvena vAtAdijA eva sarvavikArA iti vAkyArthaH||5||

19.sanskrit: bhavatashcAtra- svadhAtuvaiShamyanimittajA ye vikArasa~gghA bahavaH sharIre| na te pRuthak pittakaphAnilebhya Agantavastveva tato vishiShTAH||6||
19.commentary: amumevArthaM shlokenAha- svadhAtvityAdi| svashabdo~agre vakShyamANasharIrApekShaH; tena sharIradhAtuvaiShamyaM gRuhyate, mAnasaM tu pratikShipyate| dhAtavashca na svarUpeNa rogakAraNamiti vaiShamyapadaM kRutam| Agantavo hi rogA abhighAtajvarAdayo dhAtuvaiShamyajA bhavanti, atastahyudAsArthaM nimittapadam; AgantuShu vaiShamyaM vidyamAnamapi kAraNatvena na vyapadishyate, apradhAnatvAt; kintvAgantureva laguDAdiprahArastatra cikitsAvisheShaprayojakaH kAraNaM, nije tu vaiShamyameva cikitsAprayojakam| nimittajA iti ca svadhAtuvaiShamyapadasya karmadhArayatvena, bahuvrIhipakShe tvanarthakameva syAt| vikArasa~gghA iti ‘aShTAvudarANi’ ityAdayaH| bahuvacanenaiva bahutve labdhe punaH ‘bahavaH’ iti vacanaM bahuvacanasya tritvamAtreNaiva caritArthatvaniShedhArtham| na te pittakaphAnilebhyaH pRuthagiti pittakaphAnilA eva te dUShyAdivisheShabhAja ityarthaH| iha pittamAdau kRutaM chando~anurodhAt; kiMvA prAdhAnyAniyamaj~jApanArthaM kRutam| atra ca dhAtuvaiShamyamAtraM vikAro noktaH, tasya vAtAdivaiShamyarUpatvena siddhatvAdeva; yastu dhAtuvaiShamyavisheSho dhAtuvaiShamyajAto jvarAdirUpaH, sa iha shiShyaM prati vikRutavAtAdyabhedena pratipAdyate| tata iti pUrvoktavikArasa~gghAt| vishiShTA iti pittakaphAnilavyatiriktAH||6||

19.sanskrit: Aganturanveti nijaM vikAraM nijastathA~a~agantumapi pravRuddhaH| tatrAnubandhaM prakRutiM ca samyag j~jAtvA tataH karma samArabheta||7||
19.commentary: samprati bhinnayornijAgantvoH sambandhamAha- AganturityAdi| nijaM prathamasamutpannaM vikAramAganturbhUtAdijanyo vikAraH anveti anugato bhavati, yathA- doShaja eva jvare unmAde vA pashcAdbhUtanivesho~api bhavati; tathA~a~agantumutpannamabhighAtajaM jvaraM bhUtajaM conmAdaM pashcAddhetumAsAdya nijo~api tatra doShalakShaNalakShito gado bhavati| ‘api pravRuddhaH’ iti vacanena AgantvavasthAyAmapi nijadoSho vRuddho~astyeva, paraM pravRuddho~asau na bhavati svalakShaNAkartRutveneti darshayati| apishabdena nijasya nijena tathA~agantorapyAgantunA~anubandhaH sUcyate| atra nijAgantvoranubandhe kAryamAhatatretyAdi| anubandhaH pashcAtkAlajAtaH| prakRutiH mUlabhUtaH| samyagj~jAtveti balavattvAbalavattvAdinA; kiMvA, anubandhaH apradhAnaH; prakRutiH anubandhyaH pradhAnamityarthaH| yaduktaM- “svatantro vyaktali~ggo yathoktasamutthAnaprashamo bhavatyanubandhyaH, ato viparItastvanubandhaH” (vi. 6) iti||7||

19.sanskrit: tatra shlokau- viMshakAshcaikakAshcaiva trikAshcoktAstrayastrayaH| dvikAshcAShTau, catuShkAshca dasha, dvAdasha pa~jcakAH||8|| catvArashcAShTakA vargAH, ShaTkau dvau, saptakAstrayaH| aShTodarIye rogANAM rogAdhyAye prakAshitAH||9||
ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne~aShTodarIyo nAmonaviMsho~adhyAyaH||19||
19.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyavyAkhyAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne rogacatuShke~aShTodarIyo nAmonaviMsho~adhyAyaH||19||

20.sanskrit: athAto mahArogAdhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
20.commentary: pUrvaM sAmAnyena vAtAdijanyA gadA uktAH, sampratyavashiShTAn kevalavAtAdijanyAnabhidhAtuM mahArogAdhyAdhyo~abhidhIyate ||1-2||

20.sanskrit: catvAro rogA bhavanti- AgantuvAtapittashleShmanimittAH; teShAM caturNAmapi rogANAM rogatvamekavidhaM bhavati, ruksAmAnyAt; dvividhA punaH prakRutireShAm, AgantunijavibhAgAt; dvividhaM caiShAmadhiShThAnaM, manaHsharIravisheShAt ; vikArAH punaraparisa~gkhyeyAH, prakRutyadhiShThAnali~ggAyatanavikalpavisheShAparisa~gkhyeyatvAt ||3||
20.commentary: AgantoruktasyApi trishothIye punariha visheSheNa lakShaNAdyabhidhAnArthamabhidhAnam| prakRutiriha svabhAvaH| manaHsharIravisheShAditi Agantorapi manaH sharIraM cAdhiShThAnam, evaM nijasyApi; AgantugrahaNena ca mAnaso~api kAmAdirgRuhyate| evaM caturvidhatvAdi pratipAdya punaH prakArAntareNAparisa~gkhyeyatAM rogANAmAha- vikArA ityAdi| punariti vakShyamANaprakArAntareNa| prakRutiH pratyAsannaM kAraNaM vAtAdi, adhiShThAnaM dUShyaM, li~ggAni lakShaNAni, AyatanAni bAhyahetavo duShTAhArAcArAH; eShAM vikalparUpo visheSho vikalpavisheShaH, teShAmaparisa~gkhyeyatvAditi| atra doShAH saMsargAMshAMshavikalpAdibhirasa~gkhyeyAH, dUShyAstu sharIrAvayavA aNushaH parasparamelakena vibhajyamAnA asa~gkhyeyAH, li~ggAni kRutsnavikAragatAnyasa~gkhyeyAnyeva, AviShkRutAni tu tantre kathitAni, hetavashcAvAntaravisheShAdasa~gkhyeyAH pravyaktA eva| kecit punaH ‘eShAM vikArAH’ iti paThanti, sa tu pATho nAnumatastAvat; yadi ca syAttadA dehamanaHpratyavamarshakam eShAm iti padaM, bahuvacanaM tu manaHsharIrayorbahutvavivakShayA||3||

20.sanskrit: mukhAni tu khalvAgantornakhadashanapatanAbhicArAbhishApAbhiSha~ggAbhighAtavyadha- bandhanaveShTanapIDanarajjudahanashastrAshanibhUtopasargAdIni, nijasya tu mukhaM vAtapittashleShmaNAM vaiShamyam||4||
20.commentary: mukhAni kAraNAni; yathA “rajasvalAgamanamalakShmImukhAnAm” (sU. 25) iti||4||

20.sanskrit: dvayostu khalvAgantunijayoH preraNamasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH, praj~jAparAdhaH, pariNAmashceti||5||
20.commentary: preraNamiti kAraNam, anekArthatvAddhAtUnAm||5||

20.sanskrit: sarve~api tu khalvete~abhipravRuddhAshcatvAro rogAH parasparamanubadhnanti, na cAnyonyena saha sandehamApadyante ||6||
20.commentary: anubadhnanti anugacchanti| na sandehamApadyanta iti na sandehaviShayatAmApadyante; mishrIbhUtA api pratisvaM bhinnairlakShaNairbhedena j~jAyanta ityarthaH||6||

20.sanskrit: Aganturhi vyathApUrvaM samutpanno jaghanyaM vAtapittashleShmaNAM vaiShamyamApAdayati; nije tu vAtapittashleShmANaH pUrvaM vaiShamyamApadyante jaghanyaM vyathAmabhinirvartayanti||7||
20.commentary: AgantunijayorbhedakaM lakShaNamAha- AganturhItyAdi| AganturutpannaH san, vyathApUrvamiti pIDAM prathamaM kRutvA, pashcAddoShANAM vaiShamyamiti doShavaiShamyalakShaNamuktaM; svalakShaNakArakaM tu vaiShamyamAgantorAditaHprabhRuti vidyamAnamapyaki~jcitkaramiti bhAvaH||7||

20.sanskrit: teShAM trayANAmapi doShANAM sharIre sthAnavibhAga upadekShyate; tadyathA- bastiH purIShAdhAnaM kaTiH sakthinI pAdAvasthIni pakvAshayashca vAtasthAnAni, tatrApi pakvAshayo visheSheNa vAtasthAnaM; svedo raso lasIkA rudhiramAmAshayashca pittasthAnAni, tatrApyAmAshayo visheSheNa pittasthAnam; uraH shiro grIvA parvANyAmAshayo medashca shleShmasthAnAni, tatrApyuro visheSheNa shleShmasthAnam||8||
20.commentary: AgantunijayorbhedakaM lakShaNamabhidhAya nijavikArakarANAM vAtAdInAM bhedaj~jAnArthamAha- teShAmityAdi| purIShAdhAnaM pakvAshayaH| yadyapi prANAdibhedabhinnasya vAyoH pRuthageva sthAnAni vakShyati; yathA- “sthAnaM prANasya shIrShoraHkaNThajihvAsyanAsikAH ” (ci. 28) ityAdi; tathA~apIdaM vaisheShikaM sthAnaM j~jeyaM, yato~atra prAyo vAtavikArA bhavanti, bhUtAshca durjayAH; atra ca vijite vAte sarvavAtavikArAvajaya iti| lasIkA udakasya picchAbhAgaH| pittasthAneShu AmAshaya iti AmAshayAdhobhAgAH, shleShmasthAneShvAmAshaya AmAshayordhvabhAgaH||8||
