26.sanskrit: ShANDhyAndhyavIsarpadakodarANAM visphoTakonmAdabhagandarANAm| mUrcchAmadAdhmAnagalagrahANAM pANDvAmayasyAmaviShasya caiva||102|| kilAsakuShThagrahaNIgadAnAM shothAmlapittajvarapInasAnAm | santAnadoShasya tathaiva mRutyorviruddhamannaM pravadanti hetum||103||
26.commentary: ShANDhyaM napuMsakatA| santAnadoSho mRutavatsatvAdiH| etacca vairodhikakathanaM visheShavacanena bAdhyate; tena lashunasya kShIreNa pAnaM kvacinna virodhi; yaduktaM- “sAdhayecchuddhashuShkasya lashunasya catuShpalam| kShIrodake~aShTaguNite kShIrasheShaM ca pAyayet” (ci.a.5), tathA “mUlakasvarasaM kShIraM” ityAdiprayogeShUnneyam| kiMvA, anekadravyasaMyogAdatra virodhinAmavirodhaH; virodhimAtrasaMyoga eva virodhI bhavati| yatu madhuna uShNena vamanena saMyuktasya satyapi madanaphalAdidravyasaMyoge~avirodhArthamuktamapakvagamanAdi, tanmadhuno dravyAntarasaMyoge~apyuShNasambandhatve virodhitvopadarshanArthaM; yato viShAnvayaM madhu, viShasya coShNavirodhi| lashunAdInAM tu dravyAntarAsaMyoge satyeva melako viruddha iti shAstravacanAdunnIyate||102-103||

26.sanskrit: eShAM khalvapareShAM ca vairodhikanimittAnAM vyAdhInAmime bhAvAH pratikArA bhavanti| tadyathA- vamanaM virecanaM ca, tadvirodhinAM ca dravyANAM saMshamanArthamupayogaH, tathAvidhaishca dravyaiH pUrvamabhisaMskAraH sharIrasyeti||104|| bhavatashcAtra- viruddhAshanajAn rogAn pratihanti vivecanam| vamanaM shamanaM caiva pUrvaM vA hitasevanam||105|| sAtmyato~alpatayA vA~api dIptAgnestaruNasya ca| snigdhavyAyAmabalinAM viruddhaM vitathaM bhavet||106||
26.commentary: tadvirodhinAmiti ShADhyAdiharANAm| tathAvidhairiti viruddhAhArajavyAdhiviruddhaiH| abhisaMskAra iti satatopayogena sharIrabhAvanam| kiMvA tathAvidhairiti rasAyanaprayogaiH| etaccAnAgatAbAdhacikitsitaM j~jeyam||104-106||

26.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- matirAsInmaharShINAM yA yA rasavinishcaye| dravyANi guNakarmabhyAM dravyasa~gkhyA rasAshrayA||107|| kAraNaM rasasa~gkhyAyA rasAnurasalakShaNam| parAdInAM guNAnAM ca lakShaNAni pRuthakpRuthak||108|| pa~jcAtmakAnAM ShaTtvaM ca rasAnAM yena hetunA| UrdhvAnulomabhAjashca yadguNAtishayAdrasAH||109|| ShaNNAM rasAnAM ShaTtve ca savibhaktA vibhaktayaH| uddeshashcApavAdashca dravyANAM guNakarmaNi||110|| pravarAvaramadhyatvaM rasAnAM gauravAdiShu| pAkaprabhAvayorli~ggaM vIryasa~gkhyAvinishcayaH||111|| ShaNNAmAsvAdyamAnAnAM rasAnAM yat svalakShaNam| yadyadvirudhyate yasmAdyena yatkAri caiva yat||112|| vairodhikanimittAnAM vyAdhInAmauShadhaM ca yat| AtreyabhadrakApyIye tat sarvamavadanmuniH||113||
26.commentary: sa~ggrahe dravyasa~gkhyA rasAshrayA iti ‘bhedashcaiShAM’ ityAdinA; rasasa~gkhyA hi paramArthato dravyasa~gkhyaiva, nirguNatvAdrasAnAmiti bhAvaH| kAraNaM rasasa~gkhyAyA iti ‘rasAnAM tatra yogyatvAt’ ityAdinA| vibhaktayo bhedaH ‘tatra madhura’ ityAdinA| uddesho dravyANAM ‘shItaM vIryeNa’ ityAdinA, apavAdo dravyANAM ‘madhuraM ki~jcit’ ityAdinA||107-113||

26.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne AtreyabhadrakApyIyo nAma ShaDviMsho~adhyAyaH||26||
26.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne annapAnacatuShke AtreyabhadrakApyIyo nAma ShaDviMshatitamo~adhyAyaH||26||

27.sanskrit: athAto~annapAnavidhimadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
27.commentary: samprati sAmAnyenoktAnAM guNakarmabhyAM prativyaktyanuktAnAM prativyaktiprAya upayogidravyasya vishiShTaguNakarmakathanArthamannapAnavidhiradhyAyo~abhidhIyate| atrotpannasya chapratyayasya luk| atrAnne kAThinyasAmAnyAt khAdyaM, pAne ca dravatvasAmAnyAllehyamavaruddhaM j~jeyam| annapAnaM vidhIyate vishiShTaguNakarmayogitayA pratipAdyate~anenetyannapAnavidhiH; dravyANAM guNakarmakathanameva cAnnapAnavidhiH, yatastaddhi j~jAtvA~annapAnaM vidhIyate||1-2||

27.sanskrit: iShTavarNagandharasasparshaM vidhivihitamannapAnaM prANinAM prANisa~jj~jakAnAM prANamAcakShate kushalAH, pratyakShaphaladarshanAt; tadindhanA hyantaragneH sthitiH; tat sattvamUrjayati, taccharIradhAtuvyUhabalavarNendriyaprasAdakaraM yathoktamupasevyamAnaM, viparItamahitAya sampadyate||3||
27.commentary: kiM tadannapAnaM karotItyAha- iShTetyAdi| iShTamiti abhimataM hitaM ca; kiMvA iShTaM priyaM, hitaM tu vidhivihitashabdenaiva prApyate| vidhirvakShyamANarasavimAne “tadetadAhAravidhAnama” (vi. 1) ityAdigranthavAcyaH, tathendriyopakramaNIye ca “nAratnapANiH” (sU. 8) ityAdinoktaM vidhAnaM; tena vidhinA vihitaM vidhivihitam| atra varNAdiShu shabdAgrahaNamannapAne prAyaH shabdasyAvidyamAnatvAt| varNAdiShu yadyat prathamamannapAne guhyate, tattat pUrvamuktam| rasastu sparshasya pashcAdgRuhyamANo~api prAdhAnyakhyApanArthaM sparshasyAgre kRutaH| prANinAmityanenaiva labdhe~api “prANisa~jj~jakAnAm” iti vacanaM sthAvaraprANipratiShedhArthaM; vRukShAdayo hi vanaspatisattvAnukAropadeshAcchAstre prANina uktAH; natu loke prANisa~jj~jakAH, kintarhi ja~ggamA eva| iha ca manuShyasyaivAdhikRutatve~api sAmAnyena sakalaprANiprANahetutayA~a~ahArakathanaM manuShyavyatirikte~api prANinyAhArasya prANajanakatvopadarshanArtham| prANamiti prANahetutvAt; yathA- AyurghRutam| atha kathaM tat prANamAcakShata ityAha- pratyakShaphaladarshanAditi |- pratyakSheNaiva hyAhAraM vidhinA kurvatAM prANA anuvartanta iti, tathA nirAhArANAM prANA nahyavatiShThanta iti dRushyata ityarthaH| pratyakShashabdashceha sphuTapramANe vartate, yataH prANAnAmannakAryatvamanumAnagamyameva| annakAryatva eva prANAnAM hetumAha- tadindhanA hItyAdinA| yasmAdantaragnisthitishcAnnapAnahetunA, agnisthitishca prANahetuH, tato~annaM prANA iti bhAvaH; uktaM hi- “balamArogyamAyushca prANAshcAgnau pratiShThitAH”| kiMvA, pUrvamannapAnasya prANahetutvamuktaM, tadindhanA hItyAdinA~agnihetutvaM varNyate| sattvamUrjayatIti manobalaM karoti| dhAtuvyUho dhAtusa~gghAtaH| viparItam avidhisevitam||3||

27.sanskrit: tasmAddhitAhitAvabodhanArthamannapAnavidhimakhilenopadekShyAmo~agnivesha! tat svabhAvAdudaktaM kledayati, lavaNaM viShyandayati, kShAraH pAcayati, madhu sandadhAti, sarpiH snehayati, kShIraM jIvayati, mAMsaM bRuMhayati, rasaH prINayati, surA jarjarIkaroti, shIdhuravadhamati, drAkShAsavo dIpayati, phANitamAcinoti, dadhi shophaM janayati, piNyAkashAkaM glapayati, prabhUtAntarmalo mAShasUpaH, dRuShTishukraghnaH kShAraH, prAyaH pittalamamlamanyatra dADimAmalakAt, prAyaH shleShmalaM madhuramanyatra madhunaH purANAcca shAliShaShTikayavagodhUmAt, prAyastikaM vAtalamavRuShyaM cAnyatra vegAgrAmRutApaTolapatrAt, prAyaH kaTukaM vAtalamavRuShyaM cAnyatra pippalIvishvabheShajAt||4||
27.commentary: annapAnaM vidhIyate yena taM vidhiM dravyaguNakarmarUpaM, tathA carasharIrAvayavAdirUpaM cAkhilena kArtsnyenopadekShyAmaH| yadyapi ceha dravyaM prati prati guNakarmabhyAM na nirdekShyati, vakShyati hi- “annapAnaikadesho~ayamuktaH prAyopayogikaH” iti, tathA~apyanuktAnAmapi dravyANAM carasharIrAvayavAdyupadeshena, tathA pUrvAdhyAyoktapArthivAdidravyaguNakarmakathanena ca tadvidhAnamapyuktaM bhavatItyata uktam- akhilenaneti; vakShyati hi- “yathA nAnauShadhaM kiM ciddeshajAnAM vaco yathA| dravyaM tu tattathA vAcyamanuktamiha yadbhavet”, tathA “caraH sharIravayavAH” ityAdi; kiMvA, vidhishabdo~ashitapItalIDhakhAditaprakAravAcI, tena cAshitAdayaH sarva evAkhilena vAcyaH, tatkAraNabhUtAni tu dravyANi raktashAlyAdInyekadeshenoktAni, ato vakShyati- ‘annapAnaikadesho~ayamuktaH’ iti| annapAne ca vaktavye yaddravyaM prAya upayujyate, tasya sAmAnyaguNamabhidhAya vargasa~ggraheNa guNamupadekShyati| udakAbhidhAnaM cAgre kRutam, udakasyAnne pAne ca vyApriyamANatvAt| tadityudAharaNaM; kiMvA sa svabhAvo yasya sa tatsvabhAvaH, tasmAt kledanasvabhAvAdityarthaH| yadyapi ‘udakamAshvAsakarANAM, jalaM stambhanAnAm’ (sU. 26) ityuktaM, tathA~apIhAnuktakledanakarmAbhidhAnArthaM punarucyate| iha jalalavaNAdInAM yat karmocyate tatteShAmitarakarmabhyaH pradhAnaM j~jeyam, agryAdhikAre tu tatkarmakartRudravyAntaraprashastatA j~jeyA| kShAraH pacantamagniM pAcayati, tena pAcayatIti hetau Nic| snehayatItyAdau tu “tatkaroti tadAcaShTe” iti Nic| sandadhAtIti vishliShTAni tva~gmAMsAdIni saMshleShayati| rasaH mAMsarasaH| prINayatIti kShINAn puShNAti, natvatibRuhattvaM karoti; tena mAMsakarmaNA bRuMhaNena samaM naikyam| jarjarIkarotIti shlathamAMsAdyupacayaM karoti; yaduktaM hArIte- “surA jarjarIkarotyasRu~gmedobAhulyAt” iti, tathA hyatraivoktaM- “surA kRushAnAM puShTyartham” iti| avadhamayatIti vilikhatItyarthaH, anekArthatvAddhAtUnAM; vacanaM hi- ‘lekhanaH shItarasikaH’ iti, tathA hArIte~apyuktaM- “shIdhuravadhamayati vAyvagniprabodhanAt” iti| Acinoti ‘doShAn’ iti sheShaH, tantrAntaravacanaM hi- “vAtapittakaphAMstasmAdAcinoti ca phANitam” iti| piNyAkaH tilakalkaH; nighaNTukArastvAha- piNyAko haritashigruH| glapayati harShakShayaM karoti| prabhUtAntarmalasya purIShasya kartA prabhUtAntarmalaH; yadyapi ‘mASho bahumalaH’ iti vakShyati, tathA~api mAShavikRuteH sUpasyeha guNakathanaM, tena na punaruktaM; na cAvashyaM prakRutidharmo vikRutimanugacchati, yataH saktUnAM siddhapiNDikA gurvI eva bhavati, tasmAnmAShavikRutAvapi malavRuddhidarshanArthametadabhidhAnam| kShArasya pAcanatvaM guNo~abhihitaH, iha tu dRuShTishukraghnatvaM doSha iti pRuthagucyate| prAyaH pittalamiti visheSheNAnyebhyo lavaNakaTukebhyo~amlaM pittalam| evamanyatrApi prAyaHshabdo visheShArtho vAcyaH; kiMvA prAyaHshabdo~amlena sambadhyate| atra pittamAdAvamlajanyatayoktaM, doShaprAdhAnyasyAniyatatvAt; uktaM hi- “na te pRuthak pittakaphAnilebhya” (sU. 19) iti, tathA “samapittAnilakaphA” (sU. 7) iti; kiMvA pittoShmA vahniH, sa cehAnnapAnapacane pradhAnaM; yaduktaM- “yadannaM dehadhAtvojobalavarNAdipoShakam| tatrAgnirheturAhArAnnahyapakvAdrasAdayaH” (ci. 15) iti; teneha vahnikAraNapittajanakamevAdAvucyate; yatashca pittajanakamagre vaktavyam, ato rasapradhAnamapi madhuro nAdAvuktaH| madhuna iti vicchedapAThena navAnavasya madhunaH kaphAkartRutvaM darshayati| iha ca ShaDrasasyaiva kathanametattrayeNaiva, anuktAnAM lavaNatiktaShAyANAmapi pAkadvArA grahaNAt; yato lavaNaH pAkAt prAyo madhuraH, tiktakaShAyau kaTukau pAkato bhavataH| ‘prAyaH sarvaM tiktaM’ ityAdistu grantho hArItIyaH, iha kenApi pramAdAllikhitaH||4||

27.sanskrit: paramato vargasa~ggraheNAhAradravyANyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH ||5|| shUkadhAnyashamIdhAnyamAMsashAkaphalAshrayAn| vargAn haritamadyAmbugorasekShuvikArikAn||6|| dasha dvau cAparau vargau kRutAnnAhArayoginAm| rasavIryavipAkaishca prabhAvaishca pracakShmahe||7||
27.commentary: vargeNa shUkadhAnyAdInAM AhAradravyANAM sa~ggraho vargasa~ggrahaH| rasavIryetyAdau prabhAvo~alpaviShayatayA pRuthakpaThitaH| rasAdinirdeshashca yathAyogyatayA j~jeyaH, tena na sarvadravye sarvarasAdyabhidhAnaM bhaviShyati| atra shUkadhAnyamAdAvAhArapradhAnatvAt; shUkavanti dhAnyAni shUkadhAnyAni||5-7||

27.sanskrit: atha shUkadhAnyavargaH- raktashAlirmahAshAliH kalamaH shakunAhRutaH | tUrNako dIrghashUkashca gauraH pANDukalA~ggulau||8|| sugandhako lohavAlaH sArivAkhyaH pramodakaH| pata~ggastapanIyashca ye cAnye shAlayaH shubhAH||9|| shItA rase vipAke ca madhurAshcAlpamArutAH| baddhAlpavarcasaH snigdhA bRuMhaNAH shukramUtralAH||10|| raktashAlirvarasteShAM tRuShNAghnastrimalApahaH | mahAMstasyAnu kalamastasyApyanu tataH pare||11|| yavakA hAyanAH pAMsuvApyanaiShadhakAdayaH | shAlInAM shAlayaH kurvantyanukAraM guNAguNaiH||12||
27.commentary: iha ca dravyanAmAni nAnAdeshaprasiddhAni, tena nAmaj~jAne sAmarthyaM tathAbhUtaM nAstyevAnyeShAmapi TIkAkRutAM, tena deshAntaribhyo nAma prAyasho j~jeyaM, yattu pracarati gauDe tallekhiShyAmo~anyadeshaprasiddhaM ca ki~jcit| kalamo vedAgrahAreShu svanAmaprasiddhaH| shakunAhRutaH shrAvastyAM vakranAmnA prasiddhaH| raktashAliH prasiddha eva| mahAshAlirmagadhe prasiddhaH| atra ca shAlirhaimantikaM dhAnyaM, ShaShTikAdayashca graiShmikAH, vrIhayaH shAradA iti vyavasthA| raktashAlyAdInAM madhurapAkitve~api baddhavarcastvaM prabhAvAdeva| mahAMstasyAnviti raktashAleranu, tena raktashAliguNA mahAshAlermanAgalpAH; evaM tasyAnu kalama ityatrApi vAcyam| tasyeti mahAshAleH| tataH pare iti shakunAhRutAdayaH, uttarottaramalpaguNA ityarthaH| guNAguNairiti shAlInAM raktashAlyAdInAM ye guNAstRuShNAghnatvatrimalApahatvAdayaH, teShAmaguNaistadguNaviparItairdoShairyavakAdayo~anukAraM kurvanti, tatashca yavakAstRuShNAtrimalAdikarA iti| guNashabdashceha prashaMsAyAm ||8-12||

27.sanskrit: shItaH snigdho~aguruH svAdustridoShaghnaH sthirAtmakaH| ShaShTikaH pravaro gauraH kRuShNagaurastato~anu ca||13|| varakoddAlakau cInashAradojjvaladardurAH| gandhanAH kuruvindAshca ShaShTikAlpAntarA guNaiH||14|| madhurashcAmlapAkashca vrIhiH pittakaro guruH| bahumUtrapurIShoShmA tridoShastveva pATalaH||15||
27.commentary: ShaShTikaguNe~akAraprashleShAdagururiti boddhavyaM, mAtrAshitIye (sU. 5) ShaShTiko laghuH paThitaH| tato~anu ceti gauraShaShTikAdalpAntaraguNaH| varakoddAlakAdayaH ShaShTikavisheShAH; kecit kudhAnyAni varakAdIni vadanti| vrIhiriti shAradAshudhAnyasya sa~jj~jA| pATalo vrIhivisheShaH| tantrAntare~api paThyate- “tridoShastveva pATalaH” iti, sushrute pATalashabdenaitadvyatirikto dhAnyavisheSho j~jeyaH, tena tadguNakathanena neha virodhaH||13-15||

27.sanskrit: sakoradUShaH shyAmAkaH kaShAyamadhuro laghuH| vAtalaH kaphapittaghnaH shItaH sa~ggrAhishoShaNaH||16|| hastishyAmAkanIvAratoyaparNIgavedhukAH| prashAntikAmbhaHshyAmAkalauhityANupriya~ggavaH ||17|| mukundo jhiNTigarmUTI varukA varakAstathA| shibirotkaTajUrNAhvAH shyAmAkasadRushA guNaiH||18||
27.commentary: koradUShAdayaH kudhAnyavisheShAH| koradUShaH kodravaH, koradUShasya kevalasya shleShmapittaghnatvaM, tena yaduktaM raktapittanidAne- “yadA janturyavakoddAlakakoradUShaprAyANyannAni bhu~gkte” (ni. 2) ityAdinA pittakartRutvaM koradUShasya, tattatraivoktaniShpAvakA~jjikAdiyuktasya saMyogamahimnA boddhavyam| shyAmAkAdayo~api tRuNadhAnyavisheShAH| hastishyAmAkaH shyAmAkabheda eva; nIvAra uDikA; gavedhuko ghulu~jcaH, sa grAmyAraNyabhedena dvividhaH| prashAtikA uDikaiva sthalajA raktashUkA; ambhaHshyAmAkA jalajA oDikA loke ‘De’ ityucyate; priya~gguH ‘kA~gganI’ iti prasiddhA| mukundo ‘vAkasatRuNa’ iti; varukaH shaNabIjaM; varakaH shyAmabIjaM; shivirastIrabhuktau ‘siddha(ktA)ka’ ityucyate; jUrNAhvo ‘jonAra’ iti khyAtaH||16-18||

27.sanskrit: rUkShaH shIto~aguruH svAdurbahuvAtashakRudyavaH| sthairyakRut sakaShAyashca balyaH shleShmavikAranut||19|| rUkShaH kaShAyAnuraso madhuraH kaphapittahA| medaHkrimiviShaghnashca balyo veNuyavo mataH||20||
27.commentary: yavasya gurorapi bahuvAtatvaM rUkShatvAt; kiMvA sushrute yavo laghuH paThitaH, tenAtrApyagururiti mantavyaM; balyashca srotaH- shuddhikaratvAt prabhAvAdvA| asya ca shItamadhurakaShAyatvenAnuktamapi pittahantRutvaM labhyata eva, tena sushrute “kaphapittahantA” (su. sU. 46) ityuktamupapannam||19-20||

27.sanskrit: sandhAnakRudvAtaharo godhUmaH svAdushItalaH| jIvano bRuMhaNo vRuShyaH snigdhaH sthairyakaro guruH||21|| nAndImukhI madhUlI ca madhurasnigdhashItale| ityayaM shUkadhAnyAnAM pUrvo vargaH samApyate||22|| iti shUkadhAnyavargaH prathamaH|
27.commentary: godhUmasya svAdushItasnigdhAdiguNopayogAcchleShmakartRutvaM bhavatyeva, ata eva sushrute “shleShmakara” (su. sU. 46) ityuktam| yattu vasante kaphapradhAne “yavagodhUmabhojanaH” (sU. 6) ityuktaM tat purANagodhUmAbhiprAyeNa; purANashca godhUmaH kaphaM na karotItyuktameva ‘prAyaH shleShmalaM madhuram’ ityAdinA granthenAtraivAdhyAye| nandImukhI yavikA, madhUlI godhUmabhedaH| ityayamatra ‘iti’ prakArArthaH| samApta iti vaktavye samApyata iti yat karoti, tena j~jApayati- yat- bahudravyatvAnnAyaM samApto gaNaH, kintu yathAkatha~jcit prasiddhaguNakathanena samApyate| evamanyatrApi ShaShTho vargaH samApyata ityAdau vyAkhyeyam||21-22||

27.sanskrit: atha shamIdhAnyavargaH- kaShAyamadhuro rUkShaH shItaH pAke kaTurlaghuH| vishadaH shleShmapittaghno mudgaH sUpyottamo mataH||23|| vRuShyaH paraM vAtaharaH snigdhoShNo madhuro guruH| balyo bahumalaH puMstvaM mAShaH shIghraM dadAti ca||24|| rAjamAShaH saro rucyaH kaphashukrAmlapittanut| tatsvAdurvAtalo rUkShaH kaShAyo vishado guruH||25|| uShNAH kaShAyAH pAke~amlAH kaphashukrAnilApahAH| kulatthA grAhiNaH kAsahikkAshvAsArshasAM hitAH||26|| madhurA madhurAH pAke grAhiNo rUkShashItalAH| makuShThakAH prashasyante raktapittajvarAdiShu||27|| caNakAshca masUrAshca khaNDikAH sahareNavaH| laghavaH shItamadhurAH sakaShAyA virUkShaNAH||28|| pittashleShmaNi shasyante sUpeShvAlepaneShu ca| teShAM masUraH sa~ggrAhI kalAyo vAtalaH param||29|| snigdhoShNo madhurastiktaH kaShAyaH kaTukastilaH| tvacyaH keshyashca balyashca vAtaghnaH kaphapittakRut||30|| madhurAH shItalA gurvyo balaghnyo rUkShaNAtmikAH| sasnehA balibhirbhojyA vividhAH shimbijAtayaH||31|| shimbI rUkShA kaShAyA ca koShThe vAtaprakopinI| na ca vRuShyA na cakShuShyA viShTabhya ca vipacyate||32|| ADhakI kaphapittaghnI vAtalA, kaphavAtanut| avalgujaH saiDagajo, niShpAvA vAtapittalAH||33|| kAkANDomA(lA)tmaguptAnAM mAShavat phalamAdishet| dvitIyo~ayaM shamIdhAnyavargaH prokto maharShiNA||34|| iti shamIdhAnyavargo dvitIyaH|
27.commentary: dhAnyatvena shamIdhAnyavarge~abhidhAtavye pradhAnatvAnmudgo nirucyate| sUpyaM sUpayogyaM shamIdhAnyaM, tatrottamaH sUpyottamaH | vRuShya ityAdimAShaguNe srigdhoShNamadhuratvAdiguNayogAdeva vAtaharatve labdhe punastadabhidhAnaM visheShavAtahantRutvapratipAdanArtham, evamanyatrApyeva~jjAtIye vyAkhyeyam| puMstvaM shukram| shIghramitivacanena shukrasrutikaratvalakShaNamapi vRuShyatvaM mAShasya darshayati, shukrasrutikaraM ca vRuShyashabdenocyata eva, vacanaM hi- “shukrasrutikaraM ki~jcit ki~jcit shukravivardhanam| srutivRuddhikaraM ki~jcittrividhaM vRuShyamucyate” iti; tadevaM sampUrNavRuShyatvaM mAShe boddhavyam| rAjamAShaguNakathane tatsvAduriti mAShavatsvAduH; kiMvA rUkShashcetyAdi pAThAntaram| uShNa ityAdinA kulatthaguNaH, kulatthashca shuklakRuShNacitralohitabhedena caturvidho bhavati, tathA grAmyavanyabhedena ca dvividho~api; ata eva tantrAntare “vanyaH kulatthastadvacca visheShAnnetraroganut” ityuktam| makuShTako ‘moTha’ iti khyAtaH| caNakaH prasiddhaH| khaNDikA tripuTakalAyaH, hareNuH vartulakalAyaH| kalAyo vAtala iti tripuTakalAyaH| tilaguNo yadyapi visheSheNa noktaH, tathA~api pradhAne kRuShNatile j~jeyaH; uktaM hi sushrute- “tileShu sarveShvasitaH pradhAno, madhyaH sito, hInatarAstato~anye” (su. 46) iti | vividhAH shimbIjAtaya iti kRuShNapItaraktashvetakushimbIbhedA ityarthaH| ‘shimbI rUkShA’ ityAdi kecit paThanti| ADhakI tuvarI vAtaleti cchedaH| kaphavAtanudityavalgujaiDagajayorbIjasya guNaH| niShpAvo vallaH| kAkANDaH shUkarashimbiH , umA atasI, UrNApAThapakShe tasyaivorNA| shamIdhAnyavarga ityatra shamI shimbiH, tadantargataM dhAnyam||23-34||

27.sanskrit: atha mAMsavargaH- gokharAshvataroShTrAshvadvIpisiMharkShavAnarAH| vRuko vyAghrastarakShushca babhrumArjAramUShikAH||35|| lopAko jambukaH shyeno vAntAdashcAShavAyasau| shashaghnI madhuhA bhAso gRudhrolUkakuli~ggakAH||36|| dhUmikA kurarashceti prasahA mRugapakShiNaH|37|
27.commentary: sUpyAnantaraM mAMsasya vya~jjanatvena prAdhAnyAnmAMsavargAbhidhAnam| kharaH gardabhaH; ashvataraH vegasaraH, sa cAshvAyAM kharAjjAtaH; dvIpiH citravyAghraH; RukShaH bhallUkaH| vRukaH kukkurAnukArI pashushatruH; tarakShuH vyAghrabhedaH ‘taraccha’ iti khyAtaH; babhruH atilomashaH kukkuraH parvatopakaNThe bhavati, kecidbRuhannakulamAhuH| lopAkaH svalpashRugAlo mahAlA~ggUlaH| shyenaH pakShI prasiddhaH| vAntAdaH kukkuraH| cAsaH(ShaH) ‘kanakavAyasa ’ iti khyAtaH| shashaghnI ‘pA~jjiH’ iti khyAtA| bhAsaH bhasmavarNaH pakShI shikhAvAn prasahavarge| kuli~ggaH kAlacaTakaH||35-36||-

27.sanskrit: shvetaH shyAmashcitrapRuShThaH kAlakaH kAkulImRugaH||37|| kUrcikA cillaTo bheko godhA shallakagaNDakau| kadalI nakulaH shvAviditi bhUmishayAH smRutAH||38||
27.commentary: kAkulImRugaH ‘mAluyAsarpa’ iti khyAtaH, tasya shveta ityAdayashcatvAro bhedAH| kUrcikA sa~gkucaH| cillaTaH ciyAraH| shallakaH mahAshakalI, ‘shalaka’ iti khyAtaH; gaNDakaH godhAbhedaH| kadalI ‘kadalIhaTTa’ iti khyAtaH| shvAvit ‘sejjaka’ iti khyAtaH| bhUmishayA bileshayAH||37-38||

27.sanskrit: sRumarashcamaraH kha~ggo mahiSho gavayo gajaH| nya~gkurvarAhashcAnUpA mRugAH sarve rurustathA||39||
27.commentary: sRumaraH mahAshUkaraH| camaraH keshamRutyuH| kha~ggaH gaNDakaH| gavayaH gavAkAraH| nya~gkuH nya~gkusho hariNaH| ruruH bahushRu~ggo hariNaH||39||

27.sanskrit: kUrmaH karkaTako matsyaH shishumArastimi~ggilaH| shuktisha~gkhodrakummIraculukImakarAdayaH||40|| iti vArishayAH proktA...|41|
27.commentary: shishumAraH gotuNDanakraH| timi~ggilaH sAmudro mahAmatsyaH| shuktiH muktAprabhavo jantuH, UdraH jalabiDAlaH, kumbhIraH ghaTikAvAn, culukI ‘shushu’ iti khyAtaH| shishumArAdInAM matsyagrahaNena grahaNe prApte visheShavyavahArArthaM punarabhidhAnam||40||-

27.sanskrit: ...vakShyante vAricAriNaH| haMsaH krau~jco balAkA ca bakaH kAraNDavaH plavaH||41|| sharAriH puShkarAhvashca kesharI maNituNDakaH | mRuNAlakaNTho madgushca kAdambaH kAkatuNDakaH||42|| utkroshaH puNDarIkAkSho megharAvo~ambakukkuTI| ArA nandImukhI vATI sumukhAH sahacAriNaH||43|| rohiNI kAmakAlI ca sAraso raktashIrShakaH| cakravAkastathA~anye ca khagAH santyambucAriNaH||44||
27.commentary: haMsashcaturvidho~api rAjahaMsAdirgrAhyaH| krau~jcaH ‘ko~jca’ iti khyAtaH| bakaH pANDurapakShaH| balAkA shuklA| kAraNDavaH kAkavaktraH| plavaH svanAmaprasiddhaH prasevagalaH| sharAriH ‘sharAlI’ iti loke| madguH pAnIyakAkaH| kAdambaH kalahaMsaH| kAkatuNDakaH shvetakAraNDavaH| utkroshaH ‘kurala’ iti khyAtaH| puNDarIkAkShaH puNDaraH| megharAvaH meghanAdaH; megharAvashcAtaka ityanye, tanna tasya vAricaratvAbhAvAt| ambukukkuTI jalakukkuTI| ArA svanAmakhyAtA| nandImukhI patrATI| sArasaH prasiddhaH| raktashIrShakaH sArasabhedo lohitashirAH| ambucAriNa iti jale plavanta ityarthaH||41-44||

27.sanskrit: pRuShataH sharabho rAmaH shvadaMShTro mRugamAtRukA| shashoraNau kura~ggashca gokarNaH koTTakArakaH||45|| cAruShko hariNaiNau ca shambaraH kAlapucchakaH| RuShyashca varapotashca vij~jeyA jA~ggalA mRugAH||46||
27.commentary: pRuShataH citrahariNaH| sharabhaH aShTApada uShTrapramANo mahAshRu~ggaH pRuShThagatacatuShpAdaH kAshmIre prasiddhaH| rAmaH himAlaye mahAmRugaH| shvadaMShTraH caturdaMShTraH kArtikapure prasiddhaH| mRugamAtRukA svalpA pRuthUdarA hariNajAtiH| kura~ggaH hariNabhedaH| gokarNaH gomukhahariNavisheShaH | hariNaH tAmravarNaH, eNaH kRuShNasAraH| RuShyaH nIlANDo hariNaH| cAruShkAdayo~api hariNabhedA eva| shashastu sushrute bileshayeShu paThitaH, tadadUrAntarArtham||45-46||

27.sanskrit: lAvo vartIrakashcaiva vArtIkaH sakapi~jjalaH| cakorashcopacakrashca kukkubho raktavartmakaH||47|| lAvAdyA viShkirAstvete vakShyante vartakAdayaH| vartako vartikA caiva barhI tittirikukkuTau||48|| ka~gkashArapadendrAbhagonardagirivartakAH| krakaro~avakarashcaiva vAraDashceti viShkirAH||49||
27.commentary: lAvaH prasiddhaH| vartIraH kapi~jjalabhedaH| kapi~jjalaH gauratittiriH| vArtIkaH caTakabhedaH sa~gghAtacArI| upacakraH cakorabhedaH| kukkubhaH prasiddhaH; raktavartmaka iti kukkubhavisheShaNaM, tena sthUlakukkubho gRuhyate| vartakaH ‘vaTTahI’ iti khyAtaH| vArtikA svalpapramANA jAtyantarameva, kecittu vartakastriyaM vartikAM vadanti; asyAshca grahaNaM strIli~ggabhede~api visheShalAghavapratiShedhArtham, anyathA strItvena vartikAdvartikAyA lAghavaM syAt| barhI mayUraH| shArapadendrAbhaH mallaka~gkaH| gonardo ‘ghoDAka~gka’ iti khyAtaH| krakaraH prasiddhaH| lAvAdivartikAdiviShkiragaNadvayakaraNaM guNabhedakathanArtham||47-49||

27.sanskrit: shatapatro bhRu~ggarAjaH koyaShTirjIvajIvakaH| kairAtaH kokilo~atyUho gopAputraH priyAtmajaH||50|| laTTA laTTa(TU)Shako babhrurvaTahA DiNDimAnakaH| jaTI dundubhipAkkAralohapRuShThakuli~ggakAH ||51|| kapotashukashAra~ggAshciraTIka~gkuyaShTikAH| sArikA kalavi~gkashca caTako~a~ggAracUDakaH||52|| pArAvataH pANDa(na)vika ityuktAH pratudA dvijAH|53|
27.commentary: shatapatraH kAShThakukkuTakaH| bhRu~ggarAjaH prasiddho bhramaravarNaH| koyaShTiH ‘koDA’ iti khyAtaH| jIva~jjIvakaH viShadarshanamRutyuH| atyUhaH DAhukaH, ‘dAtyUha’ iti vA pAThaH, sa ca prasiddhaH| laTTA phe~jcAko raktapucchAdhobhAgaH, laTUShako~api tadbhedaH| DiNDimAnakaH DiNDimavadutkaTadhvaniH| kuli~gga iti vanacaTakAkAraH pItamastakaH ‘vAai’ iti loke| kalavi~gkaH grAmyacaTakaH| caTakastu devakulacaTakaH svalpapramANaH| yAnyatrAnuktAnyaprasiddhAni tAni tadvidbhyo deshAntaribhyashca j~jeyAni||50-52||-

27.sanskrit: prasahya bhakShayantIti prasahAstena sa~jj~jitAH||53|| bhUshayA bilavAsitvAdAnUpAnUpasaMshrayAt | jale nivAsAjjalajA jalecaryAjjalecarAH||54|| sthalajA jA~ggalAH proktA mRugA jA~ggalacAriNaH| vikIrya viShkirAshceti pratudya pratudAH smRutAH||55|| yoniraShTavidhA tveShA mAMsAnAM parikIrtitA|56|
27.commentary: prasahAdisa~jj~jAniruktyA lakShaNamAha| prasahyeti haThAt| AnUpAnUpasaMshrayAditi pUrvatrAsiddhavidheranityatvenAnUpA ityatra yalopasya siddhatvenaiva saMhitA j~jeyA| jalecaryAditi jalavAsinAmeva haMsAdInAM jale caraNamAtratvaM boddhavyam| ‘sthalajA’ ityukte gajAdiShvapi sthalajAteShu prasaktiH syAdityAha- jA~ggalacAriNa iti| vikIryetyatra ‘bhakShayanti’ iti sheShaH; evaM pratudyetyatrApi, pratudyeti bahudhA~abhihatya||53-55||-

27.sanskrit: prasahA bhUshayAnUpavArijA vAricAriNaH||56|| gurUShNasnigdhamadhurA balopacayavardhanAH| vRuShyAH paraM vAtaharAH kaphapittavivardhanAH||57|| hitA vyAyAmanityebhyo narA dIptAgnayashca ye| prasahAnAM visheSheNa mAMsaM mAMsAshinAM bhiShak||58|| jIrNArshograhaNIdoShashoShArtAnAM prayojayet| lAvAdyo vaiShkiro vargaH pratudA jA~ggalA mRugAH||59|| laghavaH shItamadhurAH sakaShAyA hitA nRuNAm| pittottare vAtamadhye sannipAte kaphAnuge||60|| viShkirA vartakAdyAstu prasahAlpAntarA guNaiH|61|
27.commentary: prasahA dvividhA mAMsAdA vyAghrashyenAdayaH, tathA amAMsAdAshca gavAdayaH; tena mAMsAdAnAM visheShamAha- prasahAnAmityAdi| jIrNatvenArshaHprabhRutInAM cirAnubandhaM darshayati| pratudA ityatra tathA jA~ggalA ityatra cakAro luptanirdiShTaH| kaphAnuge iti cchedaH||56-60||-

27.sanskrit: nAtishItagurusnigdhaM mAMsamAjamadoShalam||61|| sharIradhAtusAmAnyAdanabhiShyandi bRuMhaNam| mAMsaM madhurashItatvAdguru bRuMhaNamAvikam||62|| yonAvajAvike mishragocaratvAdanishcite|63|
27.commentary: sharIradhAtusAmAnyAditi manuShyamAMsasamAnatvAt| etena shItagurusnigdhatvena yuktamapyAjamAMsaM sharIradhAtusAmyAt kaphaM na karotItyuktaM bhavati| AvikaM mAMsaM madhurashItatvena pittaharamapi boddhavyam, ata eva sharadvidhAvapyuktam- “urabhrasharabhAn” (sU. 6) iti| raktapittanidAne (ni. 2) tu varAhamahiShetyAdinA dravyAntarasaMyuktasyaivAvikamAMsasya raktapittakartRutvaM j~jeyam| yonAviti prasahAdyaShTavidhajAtau| mishragocaratvAditi kadAcidanUpasevanAt, kadAciddhanvasevanAt, kadAcidubhayasevanAdajAvyoranishcitayonitvamityarthaH| atra, ‘anishcite’ iti yonivisheShaNaM, kiMvA ajA ca avI ca ete anishcite| nanu yadyevaM tadA tittirirapi dhanvAnUpasevanAnna viShkiragaNe paThanIyaH| naivaM, tittirijAtivisheShasya dhanvAnUpayorniyamena niShevaNAdguNaniyamaH pAryate kartum; avyajayostu niyamo~ayaM nAsti, yataH kecidajAvI dhanvamAtracare, keciccAnUpamAtracare, keciccobhayAmAtracare; tena tayorniyamacarakRuto yonibhedaH kartuM na pAryate||61-62||-

27.sanskrit: sAmAnyenopadiShTAnAM mAMsAnAM svaguNaiH pRuthak||63|| keShA~jcidguNavaisheShyAdvisheSha upadekShyate| darshanashrotramedhAgnivayovarNasvarAyuShAm||64|| barhI hitatamo balyo vAtaghno mAMsashukralaH| gurUShNasnigdhamadhurAH svaravarNabalapradAH||65|| bRuMhaNAH shukralAshcoktA haMsA mArutanAshanAH| snigdhAshcoShNAshca vRuShyAshca bRuMhaNAH svarabodhanAH||66|| balyAH paraM vAtaharAH svedanAshcaraNAyudhAH| gurUShNo madhuro nAtidhanvAnUpaniShevaNAt||67|| tittiriH sa~jjayecchIghraM trIn doShAnanilolbaNAn| pittashleShmavikAreShu sarakteShu kapi~jjalAH||68|| mandavAteShu shasyante shaityamAdhuryalAghavAt| lAvAH kaShAyamadhurA laghavo~agnivivardhanAH||69|| sannipAtaprashamanAH kaTukAshca vipAkataH| godhA vipAke madhurA kaShAyakaTukA rase||70|| vAtapittaprashamanI bRuMhaNI balavardhanI| shallako madhurAmlashca vipAke kaTukaH smRutaH||71|| vAtapittakaphaghnashca kAsashvAsaharastathA| kaShAyavishadAH shItA raktapittanibarhaNAH||72|| vipAke madhurAshcaiva kapotA gRuhavAsinaH| tebhyo laghutarAH ki~jcit kapotA vanavAsinaH ||73|| shItAH sa~ggrAhiNashcaiva svalpamUtrakarAshca te| shukamAMsaM kaShAyAmlaM vipAke rUkShashItalam||74|| shoShakAsakShayahitaM sa~ggrAhi laghu dIpanam| caTakA madhurAH snigdhA balashukravivardhanAH||75|| sannipAtaprashamanAH shamanA mArutasya ca| kaShAyo vishado rUkShaH shItaH pAke kaTurlaghuH||76|| shashaH svAduH prashastashca sannipAte~anilAvare| madhurA madhurAH pAke tridoShashamanAH shivAH||77|| laghavo baddhaviNmUtrAH shItAshcaiNAH prakIrtitAH| snehanaM bRuMhaNaM vRuShyaM shramaghnamanilApaham||78|| varAhapishitaM balyaM rocanaM svedanaM guru| gavyaM kevalavAteShu pInase viShamajvare||79|| shuShkakAsashramAtyagnimAMsakShayahitaM ca tat| snigdhoShNaM madhuraM vRuShyaM mAhiShaM guru tarpaNam||80|| dArDhyaM bRuhattvamutsAhaM svapnaM ca janayatyapi| gurUShNA madhurA balyA bRuMhaNAH pavanApahAH||81|| matsyAH snigdhAshca vRuShyAshca bahudoShAH prakIrtitAH| shaivAlashaShpabhojitvAtsvapnasya ca vivarjanAt||82|| rohito dIpanIyashca laghupAko mahAbalaH| varNyo vAtaharo vRuShyashcakShuShyo balavardhanaH||83|| medhAsmRutikaraH pathyaH shoShaghnaH kUrma ucyate| kha~ggamAMsamabhiShyandi balakRunmadhuraM smRutam||84|| snehanaM bRuMhaNaM varNyaM shramaghnamanilApaham| dhArtarAShTracakorANAM dakShANAM shikhinAmapi||85|| caTakAnAM ca yAni syuraNDAni ca hitAni ca| kShINaretaHsu kAseShu hRudrogeShu kShateShu ca||86|| madhurANyavidAhIni sadyobalakarANi ca| sharIrabRuMhaNe nAnyat khAdyaM mAMsAdvishiShyate||87|| iti vargastRutIyo~ayaM mAMsAnAM parikIrtitaH| iti mAMsavargastRutIyaH|
27.commentary: keShA~jciditi vakShyamANamayUrAdInAm| guNavaisheShyAditi vishiShTaguNashAlitvAt| mayUrasya gurutvasnigdhatvaM vartakAdigaNapaThitatvenaiva labdhaM sat punarucyate visheShArtham| evamanyatrApi gaNoktaguNakathanena labdhasya punaH kathane vyAkhyeyam| caraNAyudhaH kukkuTaH| dhanvAnUpaniShevaNAditi hetukathanena ya eva dhanvAnUpaniShevI tittiriH sa eva yathoktaguNa iti j~jeyam| evamanye~api ye gavAdayo dhanvAnUpaniSheviNaste~api tittirisamAnaguNA bhavanti, tittiristu visheSheNeti tittiriH sAkShAduktaH| kiMvA, tittirereva eva~gguNatve dhanvAnUpaniShevaNaM hetuH, nAnyatra gavAderanUpadeshAderiti j~jeyam| kapotA gRuhavAsina iti pArAvatAH| caTakA madhurA ityAdi kecit paThantyeva, ye tu na paThanti teShAM mate caTakasya pratudasAmAnyaguNalabdhaM vRuShyatvaM “tRuptiM caTakamAMsAnAM gatvA yo~anupibet payaH” (ci. 2) ityAdivRuShyaprayogAdeva labhyate| mayUrAdInAM tu bahavo guNA gaNoktaguNAdhikA iti pRuthak pAThaH kRutaH| “mAMsaM bRuMhaNAnAm” (sU. 25) ityanenaivAgryAdhikAravacanena mAMsasya bRuMhaNatve labdhe ‘sharIrabRuMhaNe nAnyat’ ityAdivacanaM prakaraNaprAptatvena tathA tasyaivArthasya dArDhyArthaM ca j~jeyam||63-87||-

27.sanskrit: atha shAkavargaH- pAThAshuShAshaTIshAkaM vAstukaM suniShaNNAkam||88|| vidyAdgrAhi tridoShaghnaM bhinnavarcastu vAstukam| tridoShashamanI vRuShyA kAkamAcI rasAyanI||89|| nAtyuShNashItavIryA ca bhedinI kuShThanAshinI| rAjakShavakashAkaM tu tridoShashamanaM laghu||90|| grAhi shastaM visheSheNa grahaNyarshovikAriNAm| kAlashAkaM tu kaTukaM dIpanaM garashophajit||91|| laghUShNaM vAtalaM rUkShaM kAlAyaM shAkamucyate| dIpanI coShNavIryA ca grAhiNI kaphamArute||92|| prashasyate~amlacA~ggerI grahaNyarshohitA ca sA| madhurA madhurA pAke bhedinI shleShmavardhanI||93|| vRuShyA snigdhA ca shItA ca madaghnI cApyupodikA| rUkSho madaviShaghnashca prashasto raktapittinAm||94|| madhuro madhuraH pAke shItalastaNDulIyakaH| maNDUkaparNI vetrAgraM kucelA vanatiktakam||95|| karkoTakAvalgujakau paTolaM shakulAdanI| vRuShapuShpANi shAr~ggeShTA kembUkaM sakaThillakam||96|| nADI kalAyaM gojihvA vArtAkaM tilaparNikA| kaulakaM kArkashaM naimbaM shAkaM pArpaTakaM ca yat||97|| kaphapittaharaM tiktaM shItaM kaTu vipacyate|98|
27.commentary: shAkAnAmapi vya~jjanatvenAnantaramupadeshaH| shuShA kAsamardaH| shaTI svanAmaprasiddhA| vAstukaM Ta~gkavAstukam| nAtyuShNashItavIryeti noShNatvaM prakarShaprAptamasyA nApi shItatvamityarthaH| yattu sushrute “tiktA kAkamAcI vAtaM shamayati, uShNavIryatvAt” (su. sU. 40) ityuktaM tadvIryavAdimatena, ata eva dravyaguNe sushrute~api “nAtyuShNashItA” (su. sU. 46) ityevameva paThitam| rAjakShavakaH dugdhikA| kAlashAkaM ‘kAliyA’ iti khyAtaM, kAlAkhyamiti kAlashAkamevocyate punaH; anye tu ‘kAlAyaM’ iti paThanti| maNDUkaparNI maNimaNIti khyAtA| kucelA akarNaviddhakAbhedaH| vanatiktakaM pathyasundaram| avalgujo vAlgujI| shakulAdanI kaTurohiNI| shAr~ggeShTA kAkatiktA| kaThillakaH punarnavA| nADI nADIcaH| kalAyo vartulakalAyaH| tilaparNikA hulahulikA| gojihvA dArvipatrikA| kulakaH kAravellakaH, kecittu kulakaM paTolabhedamAhuH| karkashaH svalpakarkoTakaH||88-97||-

27.sanskrit: sarvANi sUpyashAkAni pha~jjI cillI kutumbakaH||98|| AlukAni ca sarvANi sapatrANi kuTi~jjaram | shaNashAlmalipuShpANi karbudAraH suvarcalA||99|| niShpAvaH kovidArashca patturashcuccuparNikA| kumArajIvo loTTAkaH pAla~gkyA mAriShastathA||100|| kalambanAlikAsUryaH kusumbhavRukadhUmakau| lakShmaNA ca prapunnADo nalinIkA kuTherakaH||101|| loNikA yavashAkaM ca kUShmANDakamavalgujam| yAtukaH shAlakalyANI triparNI pIluparNikA||102|| shAkaM guru ca rUkShaM ca prAyo viShTabhya jIryati| madhuraM shItavIryaM ca purIShasya ca bhedanam||103|| svinnaM niShpIDitarasaM snehADhyaM tat prashasyate| shaNasya kovidArasya karbudArasya shAlmaleH||104|| puShpaM grAhi prashastaM ca raktapitte visheShataH| nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthaplakShapadmAdipallavAH||105|| kaShAyAH stambhanAH shItA hitAH pittAtisAriNAm| vAyuM vatsAdanI hanyAt kaphaM gaNDIracitrakau||106|| shreyasI bilvaparNI ca bilvapatraM tu vAtanut| bhaNDI shatAvarIshAkaM balA jIvantikaM ca yat||107|| parvaNyAH parvapuShpyAshca vAtapittaharaM smRutam| laghu bhinnashakRuttiktaM lA~ggalakyurubUkayoH||108|| tilavetasashAkaM ca shAkaM pa~jcA~ggulasya ca| vAtalaM kaTutiktAmlamadhomArgapravartanam||109|| rUkShAmlamuShNaM kausumbhaM kaphaghnaM pittavardhanam| trapusairvArukaM svAdu guru viShTambhi shItalam||110|| mukhapriyaM ca rUkShaM ca mUtralaM trapusaM tvati| ervArukaM ca sampakvaM dAhatRuShNAklamArtinut||111|| varcobhedInyalAbUni rUkShashItagurUNi ca| cirbhaTairvAruke tadvadvarcobhedahite tu te||112|| sakShAraM pakvakUShmANDaM madhurAmlaM tathA laghu| sRuShTamUtrapurIShaM ca sarvadoShanibarhaNam||113||
27.commentary: sUpyashAkAni mAShaparNyAdIni| pha~jjI brAhmaNayaShTikA| cillI gauDavAstukaH| kutumbakaH droNapuShpikA| AlukAni piNDAlukAdIni| karbudAraH kA~jcanaH| suvarcalA sUryabhaktikA, kecit phappukamAhuH| pattUraH shAli~jcaH| cuccuparNikA nADIcabhedaH| kumArajIvaH jIvashAkam| loTTAkaH loTTAmAriShaH| nAlikA gonADIcaH| AsurI rAjikA maNDako vA| vRukadhUmakaH bhUmishirIShaH| lakShmaNA svanAmakhyAtA| nalinI padmamRuNAlaM, nIlinItipAThapakShe buhnA| yavashAkaM kShetravAstukam| kUShmANDaH sarpacchatram| avalgujamiti avalgujabhedaH| yAtukaH shuklA shAlaparNI| shAlakalyANI shAli~jcabhedaH| triparNI haMsapAdikA| pIluparNI moraTakaH| gaNDIraH shamaThaH| bilvaparNI bilvArjakam| bhaNDI svanAmakhyAtA| parvaNI parvashAkam| parvapuShpI kukkuTI| pa~jcA~ggulaH citrairaNDaH| ervArukaM rAjakarkaTI| kUShmANDakaM sushrute bAlyAdyavasthAbhedena paThitaM tadapyaviruddhabheva, yato bAlamadhyayostatra pittaharatvaM kaphakaratvaM coktaM, tadapIha pittottare kaphottare sannipAte boddhavyam||98-113||

27.sanskrit: kelUTaM ca kadambaM ca nadImAShakamaindukam| vishadaM guru shItaM ca samabhiShyandi cocyate||114|| utpalAni kaShAyANi raktapittaharANi ca| tathA tAlapralambaM syAduraHkShatarujApaham||115|| kharjUraM tAlashasyaM ca raktapittakShayApaham| tarUTabisashAlUkakrau~jcAdanakasherukam||116|| shRu~ggATakA~gkaloDyaM ca guru viShTambhi shItalam| kumudotpalanAlAstu sapuShpAH saphalAH smRutAH||117|| shItAH svAdukaShAyAstu kaphamArutakopanAH| kaShAyamIShadviShTambhi raktapittaharaM smRutam||118|| pauShkaraM tu bhavedbIjaM madhuraM rasapAkayoH| balyaH shIto guruH snigdhastarpaNo bRuMhaNAtmakaH||119|| vAtapittaharaH svAdurvRuShyo mu~jjAtakaH param| jIvano bRuMhaNo vRuShyaH kaNThyaH shasto rasAyane||120|| vidArikando balyashca mUtralaH svAdushItalaH| amlikAyAH smRutaH kando grahaNyarshohito laghuH||121|| nAtyuShNaH kaphavAtaghno grAhI shasto madAtyaye| tridoShaM baddhaviNmUtraM sArShapaM shAkamucyate||122|| (tadvat syAdraktanAlasya rUkShamamlaM visheShataH|) tadvat piNDAlukaM vidyAt kandatvAcca mukhapriyam| sarpacchatrakavarjyAstu bahvyo~anyAshchatrajAtayaH||123|| shItAH pInasakartryashca madhurA gurvya eva ca| caturthaH shAkavargo~ayaM patrakandaphalAshrayaH||124|| iti shAkavargashcaturthaH|
27.commentary: keluTe hArItavacanaM- “keluTaM svAdu viTapaM tatkandaH svAdushItalaH” iti| kadambaM kadambikAM vadanti, kecittu svalpakadambakamAhuH| nadImAShakaH ‘udImAnaka’ iti khyAtaH| aindukaM nikShAraH| tAlapralambaH tAlA~gkuraH| shasyashabdeneha mastakamajjA gRuhyate| taruTaH kahlArakandaH| krau~jcAdanaM dhi~jculikA| kasherukashabdena ci~jcoDakA rAjakasherukashca gRuhyate| a~gkAloDyaM hrasvotpalakandaH| mu~jjAtaka auttarApathikakandaH| amlikA svalpaviTapA prAyaH kAmarUpAdau bhavati| sarpacchatraM sarpaphaNAkAraM chatrakam| anyAshchatrajAtayaH karIShapalAlAdijA bahulA j~jeyAH| patrakandaphalAshraya iti prAdhAnyena, tena puShpAdyAshrayatvamapi shAkavargasya j~jeyam||114-124||

27.sanskrit: atha phalavargaH- tRuShNAdAhajvarashvAsaraktapittakShatakShayAn| vAtapittamudAvartaM svarabhedaM madAtyayam||125|| tiktAsyatAmAsyashoShaM kAsaM cAshu vyapohati| mRudvIkA bRuMhaNI vRuShyA madhurA snigdhashItalA||126|| madhuraM bRuMhaNaM vRuShyaM kharjUraM guru shItalam| kShaye~abhighAte dAhe ca vAtapitte ca taddhitam||127|| tarpaNaM bRuMhaNaM phalgu guru viShTambhi shItalam| parUShakaM madhUkaM ca vAtapitte ca shasyate||128|| madhuraM bRuMhaNaM balyamAmrAtaM tarpaNaM guru| sasnehaM shleShmalaM shItaM vRuShyaM viShTabhya jIryati||129|| tAlashasyAni siddhAni nArikelaphalAni ca| bRuMhaNasnigdhashItAni balyAni madhurANi ca||130|| madhurAmlakaShAyaM ca viShTambhi guru shItalam| pittashleShmakaraM bhavyaM grAhi vakravishodhanam||131|| amlaM parUShakaM drAkShA badarANyArukANi ca| pittashleShmaprakopINi karkandhunikucAnyapi||132|| nAtyuShNaM guru sampakvaM svAduprAyaM mukhapriyam| bRuMhaNaM jIryati kShipraM nAtidoShalamArukam||133|| dvividhaM shItamuShNaM ca madhuraM cAmlameva ca| guru pArAvataM j~jeyamarucyatyagninAshanam||134|| bhavyAdalpAntaraguNaM kAshmaryaphalamucyate| tathaivAlpAntaraguNaM tUdamamlaM parUShakAt||135|| kaShAyamadhuraM Ta~gkaM vAtalaM guru shItalam| kapitthamAmaM kaNThaghnaM viShaghnaM grAhi vAtalam ||136|| madhurAmlakaShAyatvAt saugandhyAcca rucipradam| paripakvaM ca doShaghnaM viShaghnaM grAhi gurvapi||137|| bilvaM tu durjaraM pakvaM doShalaM pUtimArutam| snigdhoShNatIkShNaM tadbAlaM dIpanaM kaphavAtajit||138|| raktapittakaraM bAlamApUrNaM pittavardhanam| pakvamAmraM jayedvAyuM mAMsashukrabalapradam||139|| kaShAyamadhuraprAyaM guru viShTambhi shItalam| jAmbavaM kaphapittaghnaM grAhi vAtakaraM param||140|| badaraM madhuraM snigdhaM bhedanaM vAtapittajit| tacchuShkaM kaphavAtaghnaM pitte na ca virudhyate||141|| kaShAyamadhuraM shItaM grAhi simbi(~jci)tikAphalam| gA~ggerukI karIraM ca bimbI todanadhanvanam||142|| madhuraM sakaShAyaM ca shItaM pittakaphApaham| sampakvaM panasaM mocaM rAjAdanaphalAni ca||143|| svAdUni sakaShAyANi snigdhashItagurUNi ca| kaShAyavishadatvAcca saugandhyAcca rucipradam||144|| avadaMshakShamaM hRudyaM vAtalaM lavalIphalam| nIpaM shatAhvakaM pIlu tRuNashUnyaM vika~gkatam||145|| prAcInAmalakaM caiva doShaghnaM garahAri ca| ai~ggudaM tiktamadhuraM snigdhoShNaM kaphavAtajit||146|| tindukaM kaphapittaghnaM kaShAyaM madhuraM laghu| vidyAdAmalake sarvAn rasAMllavaNavarjitAn||147|| rUkShaM svAdu kaShAyAmlaM kaphapittaharaM param| rasAsRu~gmAMsamedojAndoShAn hanti bibhItakam||148|| svarabhedakaphotkledapittarogavinAshanam| amlaM kaShAyamadhuraM vAtaghnaM grAhi dIpanam||149|| snigdhoShNaM dADimaM hRudyaM kaphapittAvirodhi ca| rUkShAmlaM dADimaM yattu tat pittAnilakopanam||150|| madhuraM pittanutteShAM pUrvaM dADimamuttamam| vRukShAmlaM grAhi rUkShoShNaM vAtashleShmaNi shasyate||151|| amlikAyAH phalaM pakvaM tasmAdalpAntaraM guNaiH| guNaistaireva saMyuktaM bhedanaM tvamlavetasam||152|| shUle~arucau vibandhe ca mande~agnau madyaviplave | hikkAshvAse ca kAse ca vamyAM varcogadeShu ca||153|| vAtashleShmasamuttheShu sarveShvevopadishyate| kesaraM mAtulu~ggasya laghu sheShamato~anyathA||154|| rocano dIpano hRudyaH sugandhistvagvivarjitaH| karcUraH kaphavAtaghnaH shvAsahikkArshasAM hitaH||155|| madhuraM ki~jcidamlaM ca hRudyaM bhaktaprarocanam| durjaraM vAtashamanaM nAgara~ggaphalaM guru ||156|| vAtAmAbhiShukAkShoTamukUlakanikocakAH| gurUShNasnigdhamadhurAH sorumANA balapradAH||157|| vAtaghnA bRuMhaNA vRuShyAH kaphapittAbhivardhanAH| priyAlameShAM sadRushaM vidyAdauShNyaM vinA guNaiH||158|| shleShmalaM madhuraM shItaM shleShmAtakaphalaM guru| shleShmalaM guru viShTambhi cA~gkoTaphalamagnijit||159|| gurUShNaM madhuraM rUkShaM keshaghnaM ca shamIphalam| viShTambhayati kAra~jjaM vAtashleShmAvirodhi ca||160|| AmrAtakaM dantashaThamamlaM sakaramardakam| raktapittakaraM vidyAdairAvatakameva ca||161|| vAtaghnaM dIpanaM caiva vArtAkaM kaTu tiktakam| vAtalaM kaphapittaghnaM vidyAt parpaTakIphalam||162|| pittashleShmaghnamamlaM ca vAtalaM cAkShikIphalam| madhurANyamlapAkIni pittashleShmaharANi ca||163|| ashvatthodumbaraplakShanyagrodhAnAM phalAni ca| kaShAyamadhurAmlAni vAtalAni gurUNi ca||164|| bhallAtakAsthyagnisamaM tanmAMsaM svAdu shItalam| pa~jcamaH phalavargo~ayamuktaH prAyopayogikaH||165|| iti phalavargaH|
27.commentary: phalAnAmapi keShA~jcicchAkavadupayogAt phalavargamAha| mRudvIkA~agre~abhidhIyate shreShThaguNatvAt| phalgu audumbaram| madhUkashabdena samAnaguNatvAt phalaM kusumaM ca j~jeyam| parUShakaM ceha madhuraparUShakaM j~jeyam| AmrAtam ‘AmaDA’ iti khyAtamAmraphalasadRushamiti candrikA; etacca dvividhaM madhuramamlaM ca; atra madhurasyaiva guNaH, amlasya vakShyamANatvAt| tAlashasyAnIti tAlaphalAni, yathA “harItakInAM shasyAni” (ci. 1) ityatra phalameva shasyamucyate| siddhAni pakvAni; tena pakvatAlasya grahaNam| bhavyaM karmara~ggaphalaM; kecittvaksaMhatimAtraphalaM vadanti| ArukaM kArtikeyapure prasiddham| karkandhUH shRugAlabadarI, karkandhUnikucayorvicchidya pAThena nityaM pittashleShmakartRutvaM tayordarshayati| parUShakAdInAM tu madhurAmlabhedena dvirUpANAM ya eva parUShakAdayo~amlAsta eva pittashleShmakarA iti| pArAvataH kAmarUpaprasiddhaH| atra yo madhuraH sa shItaH, yashcAmlaH sa uShNa iti j~jeyam| evaM rasanirdeshenaiva vIrye labdhe~api punarvIryAkhyAnamamlasyAmalakasya shItatAdarshanAdboddhavyam| Ta~gkaM kAshmIraprasiddham| siddhamiti kAlavashAt pakvam| kapitthabilvAmrANAmavasthAbhedena guNakathanaM sarvAvasthAsu teShAmupayojyatvAt| badaraM madhyapramANaM; taddhi madhurameva bhavati| gA~ggerukaM nAgabalAphalam| karIro marujo drumaH| todanaM dhanvanabhedaH| rAjAdanaM kShIrI| avadaMshakShamamiti lavalIphalaM prAshya dravyAntare rucirbhavati| nIpaM kadambakam| shatAhvakaphalaM ‘seha’ iti khyAtam| pIlu auttarApathikam| tRuNashUnyaM ketakIphalam| prAcInAmalakaM pAnIyAmalakam| tindukaM kenduH| dADimaguNe kaphapittAvirodhIti amladADimaM pittAvirodhi, madhuraM tu kaphAvirodhi, evaM ca tridoShaharatvamasyopapannaM; yaduktaM sushrute- “dvividhaM tattu vij~jeyaM madhuraM cAmlameva ca| tridoShaghnaM tu madhuramamlaM vAtakaphApaham” (su. sU. 46) iti| vRukShAmlaM mahArdrakam| amlikA tintiDI| sheShamiti tva~gmAMsam, ato~anyatheti guru; kiMvA, shUle~arucAvityAdyuktakesharaguNaviparItam| vAtAmAdaya auttarApathikAH| priyAlo~ayaM magadhaprasiddhaH| dantashaThaH jambIraH; kecidamloTaM vadanti| ihAmrAtakamamlaM grAhyaM, pUrvaM tu madhuramAmrAtakamuktam| karamardaM dvividhaM grAmajaM vanajaM ca| airAvatam amlAtakaM; kiMvA nAgara~ggam| vArtAkaM dakShiNApathe phalavat khAdyate yadgoShThavArtAkasa~jj~jakaM, tasyeha guNaH; kiMvA phalavadasiddhasyaiva vArtAkasyopayojyasyAyaM guNaH| AkShikI latA tasyAH phalamAkShikam| anupAki ‘anuyA’ iti khyAtA| agnisamamiti sphoTAdijanakatvAt||125-165||

27.sanskrit: atha haritavargaH- rocanaM dIpanaM vRuShyamArdrakaM vishvabheShajam| vAtashleShmavibandheShu rasastasyopadishyate||166|| rocano dIpanastIkShNaH sugandhirmukhashodhanaH| jambIraH kaphavAtaghnaH krimighno bhaktapAcanaH||167|| bAlaM doShaharaM, vRuddhaM tridoShaM, mArutApaham| snigdhasiddhaM, vishuShkaM tu mUlakaM kaphavAtajit||168|| hikkAkAsaviShashvAsapArshvashUlavinAshanaH| pittakRut kaphavAtaghnaH surasaH pUtigandhahA||169|| yavAnI cArjakashcaiva shigrushAleyamRuShTakam| hRudyAnyAsvAdanIyAni pittamutkleshayanti ca||170|| gaNDIro jalapippalyastumbaruH shRu~ggaverikA| tIkShNoShNakaTurUkShANi kaphavAtaharANi ca||171|| puMstvaghnaH kaTurUkShoShNo bhUstRuNo vakrashodhanaH| kharAhvA kaphavAtaghnI bastirogarujApahA||171|| dhAnyakaM cAjagandhA ca sumukhashceti rocanAH| sugandhA nAtikaTukA doShAnutkleshayanti ca||173|| grAhI gRu~jjanakastIkShNo vAtashleShmArshasAM hitaH| svedane~abhyavahAre ca yojayettamapittinAm||174|| shleShmalo mArutaghnashca palANDurna ca pittanut | AhArayogI balyashca gururvRuShyo~atha rocanaH||175|| krimikuShThakilAsaghno vAtaghno gulmanAshanaH| snigdhashcoShNashca vRuShyashca lashunaH kaTuko guruH||176|| shuShkANi kaphavAtaghnAnyetAnyeShAM phalAni ca| haritAnAmayaM caiSha ShaShTho vargaH samApyate||177|| iti haritavargaH|
27.commentary: haritAnAmapyArdrakAdInAM phalavadagnipAkamantareNa bhojanasya prAk pashcAccopayogAt phalamanu haritakathanaM, phalebhyastu pashcAdabhidhAnaM haritasya tRuptyanAdhAyakatvAt| Ardrakamiti visheShaNaM shuNThIvyavRuttyarthaM, shuNThIguNashcAhArasaMyogivarge bhaviShyati| jambIraH parNAsabhedaH, jambIraphalaM sugandhi| bAlaM doShaharamiti taruNAvasthAyAmavyaktarasAyAM tridoShaharam| tantrAntaravacanaM hi- “yAvaddhi cAvyaktarasAnvitAni navaprarUDhAni ca mUlakAni| bhavanti tAvallaghudIpanAni pittAnilashleShmaharANi caiva”| vRuddhaM tridoShamiti tadeva pravRuddham, enAmeva mUlakAvasthAmabhipretya coktaM- “mUlakaM kandAnAmapathyatve prakRuShTatamam” (sU. 25) iti| mArutApahaM snigdhasiddhamiti sAmAnyena bAlaM vRuddhaM ca| ‘shuShkANi kaphavAtaghnAnyetAni’ iti vakShyamANagranthenaiva shuShkamUlakasya kaphavAtahantRutve labdhe punarvacanaM prakarShaprAptyartham| pUtigandhaheti sharIrasya tathA vya~jjanArthaM mAMsasya ca pUtigandhatAM hanti| arjakaH shvetaparNAsaH| shigruH viTapashobhA~jjanaH; shAleyashcANakyamUlaM marau prasiddhaM, kiMvA shAleyamiti misteyaM pATakaprasiddhaM, vacanaM hi- “cANakyamUlamisteye shAleyAbhikhyayA jaguH” iti; mRuShTakaM rAjikA| gaNDIro dvividho raktaH shuklashca; tatra yo raktaH sa hi kaTutvena haritavarge paThyate, yastu shuklo jalajaH sa shAkavarge paThita iti naikasya vargadvaye pAThaH| jalapippalI jale pippalyAkArA bhavati| shRu~ggaverI gojihvikA, kiMvA ArdrakAkRutiH shRu~ggaverI; yaduktaM- “shRu~ggaveravadAkRutyA shRu~ggaverIti bhAShitA| kustumburusamAkRutyA tumburUNi vadanti ca” iti| bhUstRuNo gandhatRuNaH| kharAhvA kRuShNajIrakam| ajagandhA vanayavAnI| sumukhaH parNAsabhedaH| ayaM ca dhAnyakAdInAmArdrANAM guNaH, shuShkANAM tvAhArayogigaNe “kAravI ku~jcikA” ityAdinA guNaM nirdekShyati| gRu~jjanakaH svalpanAlapatraH palANDureva| etAnIti haritavargoktAni| shuShkANItyAdinA yadyapi shuShkANAmapi shuNThIprabhRutInAM guNa ukto bhavati, tathA~api visheShaguNAntarakathanArthaM punastadabhidhAnamAhArasaMyogivarge bhaviShyatIti na paunaruktyam||166-177||

27.sanskrit: atha madyavargaH- prakRutyA madyamamloShNamamlaM coktaM vipAkataH| sarvaM sAmAnyatastasya visheSha upadekShyate||178||
27.commentary: annamabhidhAya pAnaM vaktavyaM, tatrApi pAnapradhAnamapi pAnIyamulla~gghya harShAdikartRutvAjjanAnAM mukhyapeyatvAcca madyamAha| prakRutyeti svabhAvAt| yadyapi ca madye pIyamAne nAmlarasatA pratIyate vyaktA, tathA~api dantaharShamukhasrAvAdyamlakAryakartRutvAdamlameva| vacanaM hi- “madhurANi madhuraprabhAvANi madhurANyeva kRutvopadekShyAmaH, tathetarANyapi” (vi. 8) iti| tena, amlaprabhAvasya madyasyAmlarasatvameva; ata evoktaM- “sarveShAM madyamamlAnAmuparyupari vartate” (ci. 24) iti| vipAkata iti tRutIyAyAM tasiH||178||

27.sanskrit: kRushAnAM saktamUtrANAM grahaNyarshovikAriNAm| surA prashastA vAtaghnI stanyaraktakShayeShu ca||179|| hikkAshvAsapratishyAyakAsavarcograhArucau| vamyAnAhavibandheShu vAtaghnI madirA hitA||180|| shUlapravAhikATopakaphavAtArshasAM hitaH| jagalo grAhirUkShoShNaH shophaghno bhaktapAcanaH||181|| shoShArshograhaNIdoShapANDurogArucijvarAn| hantyariShTaH kaphakRutAn rogAnrocanadIpanaH ||182|| mukhapriyaH sukhamadaH sugandhirbastiroganut | jaraNIyaH pariNato hRudyo varNyashca shArkaraH||183|| rocano dIpano hRudyaH shoShashophArshasAM hitaH| snehashleShmavikAraghno varNyaH pakvaraso mataH||184|| jaraNIyo vibandhaghnaH svaravarNavishodhanaH| lekhanaH shItarasiko hitaH shophodarArshasAm||185|| sRuShTabhinnashakRudvAto gauDastarpaNadIpanaH| pANDurogavraNahitA dIpanI cAkShikI matA ||186|| surAsavastIvramado vAtaghno vadanapriyaH| chedI madhvAsavastIkShNo maireyo madhuro guruH||187|| dhAtakyA~abhiShuto hRudyo rUkSho rocanadIpanaH| mAdhvIkavanna cAtyuShNo mRudvIkekShurasAsavaH||188|| rocanaM dIpanaM hRudyaM balyaM pittAvirodhi ca| vibandhaghnaM kaphaghnaM ca madhu laghvalpamArutam||189|| surA samaNDA rUkShoShNA yavAnAM vAtapittalA| gurvI jIryati viShTabhya shleShmalA tu madhUlikA||190|| dIpanaM jaraNIyaM ca hRutpANDukrimiroganut| grahaNyarshohita bhedi sauvIrakatuShodakam||191|| dAhajvarApahaM sparshAt pAnAdvAtakaphApaham| vibandhaghnamavasraMsi dIpanaM cAmlakA~jjikam||192|| prAyasho~abhinavaM madyaM gurudoShasamIraNam| srotasAM shodhanaM jIrNaM dIpanaM laghu rocanam||193|| harShaNaM prINanaM madyaM bhayashokashramApaham| prAgalbhyavIryapratibhAtuShTipuShTibalapradam||194|| sAttvikairvidhivadyuktyA pItaM syAdamRutaM yathA| vargo~ayaM saptamo madyamadhikRutya prakIrtitaH||195|| iti madyavargaH saptamaH|
27.commentary: surA anuddhRutamaNDA| madirA tu surAmaNDaH| jagalaH bhaktakiNvakRutA surA| ariShTa auShadhakvAthamadhvAdisampAdito vakShyamANo dantyabhayAriShTAdiH| shArkaraH sharkarAprakRutika AsavaH| pakvarasaH yaH kvathitenekShurasena kriyate| shItarasikastu shItekShurasakRutaH| gauDaH guDaprakRutikaH| surAsavaH yatra surayaiva toyakAryaM kriyate| madhUkapuShpakRuto madhvAsavaH| maireyalakShaNaM yathA- “Asavasya surAyAshca dvayorekatra bhAjane| sandhAnaM tadvijAnIyAnmaireyamubhayAshrayam” iti| dhAtakyA~abhiShuto dhAtakIphalAsavaH| mAdhvIkaM madhupradhAnaM ‘rocanaM dIpanaM’ ityAdinA vakShyamANaM; tadvanmRudvIkekShurasAbhyAM militAbhyAM kRuta Asavo j~jeyaH| madhviti madhupradhAna AsavaH| surA samaNDeti yavataNDulakRutA boddhavyA| viShTabhyeti vicchedaH| madhUlakaH godhUmabhedaH, tatkRutaM madyaM madhUlakam; anye tu medakamAhuH| dIpanamityAdi sauvIratuShodakaguNaH| amlakA~jjikamiti kA~jjikamevAmlaguNam||179-195||

27.sanskrit: atha jalavargaH- jalamekavidhaM sarvaM patatyaindraM nabhastalAt|196|
27.commentary: samprati pAnapradhAnasya jalasya guNamAha- jalamityAdi| sarvamiti sushrutapratipAditadhArakArahaimatauShAramapi| ekavidhamiti “shivAH khalvApaH” (sU. 26) ityAdinoktaguNaM, tathA ‘shItaM shuci’ ityAdivakShyamANaguNam| aindramiti prANyadRuShTavashenendrapreritam|196|-

27.sanskrit: tat patat patitaM caiva deshakAlAvapekShate||196||
27.commentary: ekavidhatve~api tasya bhedahetumAha- tat patadityAdi| patad deshamAkAshagatabhUtarUpaM, kAlaM ca shItoShNAdirUpaM; tathapatitaM ca bhUmivisheSharUpaM deshaM, kAlaM ca tathaivApekShate; ‘guNadoShA sambandhe ’ iti sheShaH||196||

27.sanskrit: khAt patat somavAyvarkaiH spRuShTaM kAlAnuvartibhiH| shItoShNasnigdharUkShAdyairyathAsannaM mahIguNaiH||197||
27.commentary: enameva deshakAlasambandhamAha- khAdityAdi| somagrahaNena saumyatvAt pRuthivyA api gaganagatadhUlIrUpAyAstathA meghasahacaritalUtAdiviShAdirUpAyAshca grahaNaM vaktavyaM; kiMvA vAyugrahaNAdeva vAyunA nIyamAnAyAH pRuthivyA grahaNam| spRuShTaM ‘bhavati’ itisheShaH| kAlAnuvartibhiriti kAlaparAdhInaiH; etena kAlakRuta eva somAdisambandhavisheSho jale visheShaM karoti, tena na kAlasyAki~jcitkaratA| patitajalasya deshakAlasambandhamAha- shItoShNetyAdi| yathAsannamiti yasmin kAle yasyAM mahyAM ye guNAH shItAdaya udriktA bhavanti, taiH spRuShTaM jalaM bhavati| etena sushrute pratipAditagA~ggasAmudrabhedo guNadoShasambandhamAtrakRuta eva divyajalasyeti darshayati| tena, yadviShAdijuShTaM tat sAmudrasamAnaguNatvAt sAmudraM, yaddhUlyAdinA viShAdinA ca rahitaM tattadguNatvAdgA~ggamityuktaM sushrute| Ashvine tu mAsi divyajalasya dhUlIviShAdisambandho na bhavatyeva, kAlamahimnA bhavannapi vA na jalaM tathA dUShayati; ata uktaM sUshrute- “sAmudraM tanna pAtavyaM mAsAdAshvayujAdvinA” (su. sU. 45) iti| atra hArItavacanAt kArtikAgrahAyaNayorapyAntarIkShaM jalaM grAhyameva bhavati; yadAha- “pravRuttAyAM sharadyasmAt pashcAdvAte pravAti ca| hemante cApi gRuhnIyAttajjalaM mRunmayairghaTaiH” iti| tena ‘AshvayujAdvinA’ iti vacanaM AshvayujAt prabhRuti jalopAdeyatopadarshanArthaM, na tvAshvina evopAdeyatopadarshanaparam| anye tvAhuH- Ashvina eva paramAntarIkShaM grAhyamiti| jatUkarNavacanaM hi- “varShAsu caranti ghanaiH sahoragA viyati kITalUtAshca| tadviShajuShTamapeyaM khajalamagastyodayAt pUrvam” iti||197||

27.sanskrit: shItaM shuci shivaM mRuShTaM vimalaM laghu ShaDguNam| prakRutyA divyamudakaM,...|198|
27.commentary: divyajalasya prAkRutaguNamAha- shItamityAdi| shivamiti kalyANakaratvena| mRuShTamiti vadanapriyatvena|198|-

27.sanskrit: ...bhraShTaM pAtramapekShate||198|| shvete kaShAyaM bhavati pANDare syAttu tiktakam| kapile kShArasaMsRuShTamUShare lavaNAnvitam||199|| kaTu parvatavistAre madhuraM kRuShNamRuttike| etat ShADguNyamAkhyAtaM mahIsthasya jalasya hi| tathA~avyaktarasaM vidyAdaindraM kAraM himaM ca yat||200|| yadantarIkShAt patatIndrasRuShTaM coktaishca pAtraiH parigRuhyate~ambhaH| tadaindramityeva vadanti dhIrA narendrapeyaM salilaM pradhAnam ||201|| IShatkaShAyamadhuraM susUkShmaM vishadaM laghu| arUkShamanabhiShyandi sarvaM pAnIyamuttamam||202|| gurvabhiShyandi pAnIyaM vArShikaM madhuraM navam| tanu laghvanabhiShyandi prAyaH sharadi varShati||203|| tattu ye sukumArAH syuH snigdhabhUyiShThabhojanAH| teShAM bhojye ca bhakShye ca lehye peye ca shasyate||204|| hemante salilaM snigdhaM vRuShyaM balahitaM guru| ki~jcittato laghutaraM shishire kaphavAtajit||205|| kaShAyamadhuraM rUkShaM vidyAdvAsantikaM jalam| graiShmikaM tvanabhiShyandi jalamityeva nishcayaH| RutAvRutAvihAkhyAtAH sarva evAmbhaso guNAH||206|| vibhrAnteShu tu kAleShu yat prayacchanti toyadAH| salilaM tattu doShAya yujyate nAtra saMshayaH||207|| rAjabhI rAjamAtraishca sukumAraishca mAnavaiH| sugRuhItAH sharadyApaH prayoktavyA visheShataH||208||
27.commentary: vakShyamANaguNavisheShahetumAha- bhraShTamityAdi| pAtramapekShata iti nadyAdipAtravisheShasambandhamapekShya guNavisheShavadbhavati| etacca yadyApi ‘deshakAlAvapekShata’ ityanena pUrvamevoktaM, tathA~api kAlApekShayA deshavisheShasya prakarSheNa guNavisheShe hetutApradarshanArthaM punaruktam| kecittu “shvete kaShAyaM bhavati” ityAdigranthaM paThanti, sa tu nAtiprasiddhaH||198-208||

27.sanskrit: nadyaH pAShANavicchinnavikShubdhAbhihatodakAH | himavatprabhavAH pathyAH puNyA devarShisevitAH||209|| nadyaH pAShANasikatAvAhinyo vimalodakAH| malayaprabhavA yAshca jalaM tAsvamRutopamam||210|| pashcimAbhimukhA yAshca pathyAstA nirmalodakAH| prAyo mRuduvahA gurvyo yAshca pUrvasamudragAH||211|| pAriyAtrabhavA yAshca vindhyasahyabhavAshca yAH| shirohRudrogakuShThAnAM tA hetuH shlIpadasya ca||212||
27.commentary: AdhAravisheShe guNavisheShamAha- nadya ityAdi| pAShANairvicchinnaM vikShubdhamabhihataM codakaM yAsAM tAstathA; etena, adhityakAprabhavA eva himAlaye nadyaH pathyA uktA bhavanti nopatyakAprabhavAH, yato~adhityakAprabhavAsveva pAShANavicchinnatvAdi; atashca sushrute yaduktaM- “himavatprabhavA hRudrogAdIn janayanti” (su. sU. 45) iti, tadupatyakAprabhavAbhiprAyeNeti na virodhaH| yattu tatroktaM “malayaprabhavAH krimI~jjanayanti” (su. sU. 45) tadapAShANasikatAvAhinadyabhiprAyeNa, iha pAShANasikatAvAhinadIShvamRutopamiti na virodhaH| yattu, pAriyAtrabhavAnAM shirorogAdikartRutvaM, tat pAriyAtradarIbhavanadIjalAbhiprAyeNa, sushrute tu pAriyAtrataDAgabhavanadIjalAbhiprAyeNoktaM- “pAriyAtrabhavAH pathyAH” (su. sU. 45) iti| taduktaM vishvAmitreNa- “taDAgajaM darIjaM ca taDAgAdyat sarijjalam| balArogyakaraM tat syAddarIjaM doShalaM matam” iti| prAyograhaNAt pUrvasamudragamane~api gA~ggaM pathyaM bhavati; kiMvA yathoktalakShaNahimAlayabhavatvAdeva gA~ggaM jalaM pathyam| pAriyAtrAdayaH parvatAH svanAmaprasiddhAH||209-212||

27.sanskrit: vasudhAkITasarpAkhumalasandUShitodakAH| varShAjalavahA nadyaH sarvadoShasamIraNAH||213|| vApIkUpataDAgotsasaraHprasravaNAdiShu| AnUpashailadhanvAnAM guNadoShairvibhAvayet||214|| picchilaM krimilaM klinnaM parNashaivAlakardamaiH| vivarNaM virasaM sAndraM durgandhaM na hitaM jalam||215|| visraM tridoShaM lavaNamambu yadvaruNAlayam| ityambuvargaH prokto~ayamaShTamaH suvinishcitaH||216|| iti jalavargo~aShTamaH|
27.commentary: varShAsu jalaM vahantIti varShAjalavahAH; yaduktamagryAdhikAre “varShAnAdeyamudakAnAm” (sU. 25) iti, tasyehApathyatve upapattivarNanamiti na paunaruktyam| prasravaNAdiShvityatra ‘jalaM’ iti sheShaH| vApyAdayo~anUpadeshe dhanvani himAliyAdiparvateShu ca bhaveyuH, tatashcAnUpAdijalaguNaireva tadguNanirdeshaH kartavyaH; pashcimAbhimukhanadIjalapUrvAbhimukhanadIjalAnUpajalakhadhanvajalaparvatajalaguNAshcoktA eva, tena tadguNAtidesho vApyAdiShu boddhavyaH| uktaM ca hArItena- “anUpadeshe yadvAri guru tacchleShmavardhanam| viparItamato mukhyaM jA~ggalaM laghu cocyate” iti| sushrute~api vApyAdInAM pRuthageva guNa uktaH; sa ceha kUpAdInAM sakShAratvAdiH pratyakShadRuShTo granthavistarabhayAnnokta iti mantavyam| vApI iShTakAdibaddhatIrthA dIrghikA; kUpaH prasiddhaH; taTAdAgo gatiryasya sa taDAgaH, sa punaruccadeshAdAgacchajjalabandhanAdbhavati, anye tu puShkarINIM taDAgamAhuH; utsA nimnAduttiShThajjalasthAnaM; saro divyakhAtaM puruShavyApAraM vinA, tatpunaH pampAdi; prasravaNaH nirjharaH| anye tu ‘hradadhArAjalAdiShu’ iti paThanti; tatra hradaH nadIsthajalapradesho gambhIro jalAshayaH, dhArA tu parvatAdeva jaladhArArUpA patantI; AdigrahaNAt kedAracuNDAdInAM grahaNam| klinnaM parNAdibhiryutaM sadityarthaH| varuNAlaye samudre| visram Amagandhi| suvinishcita iti sarvajalaguNakathanAt||213-216||

27.sanskrit: atha gorasavargaH- svAdu shItaM mRudu snigdhaM bahalaM shlakShNapicchilam| guru mandaM prasannaM ca gavyaM dashaguNaM payaH||217|| tadeva~gguNamevaujaH sAmAnyAdabhivardhayet| pravaraM jIvanIyAnAM kShIramuktaM rasAyanam||218|| mahiShINAM gurutaraM gavyAcchItataraM payaH| snehAnyUnamanidrAya hitamatyagnaye ca tat||219|| rUkShoShNaM kShIramuShTrINAmIShatsalavaNaM laghu| shastaM vAtakaphAnAhakrimishophodarArshasAm||220|| balyaM sthairyakaraM sarvamuShNaM caikashaphaM payaH| sAmlaM salavaNaM rUkShaM shAkhAvAtaharaM laghu||221|| chAgaM kaShAyamadhuraM shItaM grAhi payo laghu| raktapittAtisAraghnaM kShayakAsajvarApaham||222|| hikkAshvAsakaraM tUShNaM pittashleShmalamAvikam| hastinInAM payo balyaM guru sthairyakaraM param||223|| jIvanaM bRuMhaNaM sAtmyaM snehanaM mAnuShaM payaH| nAvanaM raktapitte ca tarpaNaM cAkShishUlinAm||224||
27.commentary: jIvanIyasAmAnyAjjalamanu kShIramucyate , kShIrajatvAddadhyAdayashcocyante| prasannamiti nirdoShaM, nirdoShatA tu prashastatvena guNa ityucyate; kiMvA guNAnAmasa~gkhyeyatvena prasannatvaM gurvAdyapaThitamapi guNa eveti j~jeyam| eva~gguNameveti svAdvAdidashaguNam| sAmAnyAditi samAnatvAt| mahiShIkShIraguNe snehAdUnamiti mahiShIkShIraM gavyakShIrAt snehonaM, gauravashaityAbhyAM tu tadadhikamiti kecidbruvate; tanna, pratyakShameva hi mahiShIkShIrAdadhikameva ghRutaM dRushyate; tathA jatUkarNe~apyuktaM- “guru shItaM snigdhataraM mAhiShamatibalyaM bRuMhaNaM cAgryam” iti, sushrute~apyuktaM- “gavyAt snigdhataraM” (sU. 45) iti; tasmAt ‘snehAnyUnaM’ iti pAThaH; tena snehAdadhikamityarthaH; kiMvA snehAnyUnamiti snehapUrNamityarthaH| uShTrIkShIrAdInAM salavaNatvAdi madhurAnurasatvena boddhavyaM; madhurastu rasaH pradhAna eva, dIrgha~jjIvitIye ‘prAyasho madhuraM’ (sU. 1) ityuktaM, na tu sarvathA madhurameva| aikashaphamiti vaDavAyAH | kecittu sarvashabdena kharavegasarayorapi kShIrasyAyaM guNa iti vadanti| uShNamiti kShIrAntarApekShayA, tena sAmAnyaguNe shItatvamuktamaviruddhaM bhavati, yato laghUttamAttiktarasAdgururapi kaTu laghurevocyate madhurAdyapekShayA, evaM shItatamAditarakShIrAduShNamapi vaDavAyAH kShIraM shItameva mUtramadhvAdyapekShayA bhavati; evaM rUkShamityetadapi vyAkhyeyam| yadyapi ca hastinIkShIrAdIni shAstre prayogeShu noktAni, tathA~api kathitaguNaM buddhvA tatra tatra prayojyAni||217-224||

27.sanskrit: rocanaM dIpanaM vRuShyaM snehanaM balavardhanam| pAke~amlamuShNaM vAtaghnaM ma~ggalyaM bRuMhaNaM dadhi||225|| pInase cAtisAre ca shItake viShamajvare| arucau mUtrakRucchre ca kArshye ca dadhi shasyate||226|| sharadgrIShmavasanteShu prAyasho dadhi garhitam| raktapittakaphottheShu vikAreShvahitaM ca tat||227||
27.commentary: dadhiguNamAha- rocanamityAdi| atra rocanamityuktvA~api arucAviti vacanamarucirogaharatvena, rocanatA tUpayogakAla eva dravyAntararucikaratvenoktA| bRuMhaNamiti rogAdikRushasya bRuMhaNaM, kArshye ceti sahaje kArshye shasyata iti boddhavyaM; tena na paunaruktyam| pInase caturvidhe~api prabhAvAddhitaM; kiMvA pInasapAcakatvAt sarvatra hitam| yacca vRuShyashItakahitatvAdi dadhiguNaparyAlocanayA~anupapadyamAnamiha dRushyate, tat prabhAvAdboddhavyam| yacca guNAntarAdevAmlatvoShNatvasnigdhatvAllabhyamAnamapi vAtaghnatvaM punarucyate tat prakarShArthaM, tathA amlatvAdiyuktasyApi vAtahantRutAdivyabhicAradarshanAditi boddhavyam| vyabhicArodAharaNAni ca mandakamandajAtamadyAdInyanusartavyAni| nyAyashcAyaM sarvAnnapAnaguNakathane yathAsambhavaM varNanIyaH, granthapracurataratAbhItyA sarvaM vastu vayamatra nodbhAvayAmaH| prAyasha iti vacanAt kAlAntare~api garhitatvaM sharadAdAvapi ca prakRutyAdivashAddhitatvaM darshayati||225-227||

27.sanskrit: tridoShaM mandakaM, jAtaM vAtaghnaM dadhi, shukralaH| saraH, shleShmAnilaghnastu maNDaH srotovishodhanaH||228||
27.commentary: mandakaM yadA kShIraM vikriyAmApannaM ghanatvaM na yAti tadA tanmandakam| jAtaM vAtaghnamiti yadA tu mandakAvasthAmutsRujya ghanatayA jAtaM sanmadhuramIShadamlaM ca bhavati, tadA vAtaghnaM visheSheNa bhavatItyarthaH| pUrve tu dadhiguNAH sujAtasya vyaktAmlasya boddhavyAH| shukralaH sara iti cchedaH| saro dadhyuparisnehaH, shukralaH shukrasrutivRuddhikaraH; ata eva sushrute saraguNe “vRuShyaH shukravivardhanaH” (su. sU. 45) iti padadvayopAdAnaM kRutam| maNDa iti prakaraNAddadhimaNDo mastvityarthaH||228||

27.sanskrit: shophArshograhaNIdoShamUtragrahodarArucau| snehavyApadi pANDutve takraM dadyAdgareShu ca||229||
27.commentary: shophetyAdinA takraguNaH| mUtragraho mUtrakRucchrAdi| garo~atra kRutrimaviSham||229||

27.sanskrit: sa~ggrAhi dIpanaM hRudyaM navanItaM navoddhRutam| grahaNyarshovikAraghnamarditArucinAshanam||230||
27.commentary: sa~ggrAhItyAdi navanItaguNaH| navoddhRutaM sadyaskaM; navoddhRutamiti vacanAdabhinavasyaiva navanItasya yathoktaguNAH prakarShavanto bhavanti, purANasya tu naite balavanto guNA bhavantIti||230||

27.sanskrit: smRutibuddhyagnishukraujaHkaphamedovivardhanam| vAtapittaviShonmAdashoShAlakShmIjvarApaham ||231|| sarvasnehottamaM shItaM madhuraM rasapAkayoH| sahasravIryaM vidhibhirghRutaM karmasahasrakRut||232|| madApasmAramUrcchAyashoShonmAdagarajvarAn| yonikarNashiraHshUlaM ghRutaM jIrNamapohati||233|| sarpIMShyajAvimahiShIkShIravat svAni nirdishet|234|
27.commentary: utpAdakramAgatasya ghRutasya guNamAha- smRutItyAdi| sahasravIryamiti bhUrishaktikam| kathaM sahasravIryamityAha- vidhivaditi| vidhivad vidhiyuktaM sadityarthaH, vidhishca nAnAkarmakAribhirdravyaiH saMskAraH saMyogashca, ata evoktaM- “nAnyaH snehastathA kashcit saMskAramanuvartate” (ni. 1) iti, tathA tantrAntare “ghRutaM yogavAhi” iti; tasmAt sahasravIryataH karmasahasrakRuditi yojyam| yattu sushrutaTIkAkRutaH sushrutoktaghRutaguNeShu “tridoShApakarShaNaM” iti paThanti, tat saMskAreNa kaphaharaNAditi j~jeyam| madetyAdi| jIrNaM tu dashavarShAtItaM; vacanaM hi- “purANaM dashavarShaM syAt prapurANamataH param” iti| yathA yathA ca jIrNatvaprakarShastathA tathA guNotkarSho j~jeyaH| uktaM hi hArIte- “yathA yathA jarAM yAti guNavat syAttathA tathA” iti| anuktasarpirguNAnatidishati- sarpIMShItyAdi| sarpIMShi svAnIti sambandhaH; tena, ajAkShIravadajAsarpirnirdishediti| evaM sheShayorapi vAcyam| anena ca nyAyena hastinyAdisarpirapi boddhavyaM, hastinyAdisarpirvyavahArAbhAvAt sAkShAnnoktam||231-233||-

27.sanskrit: pIyUSho moraTaM caiva kilATA vividhAshca ye||234|| dIptAgnInAmanidrANAM sarva eva sukhapradAH| guravastarpaNA vRuShyA bRuMhaNAH pavanApahAH||235|| vishadA guravo rUkShA grAhiNastakrapiNDakAH| gorasAnAmayaM vargo navamaH parikIrtitaH||236|| iti gorasavargo navamaH|
27.commentary: pIyUShaH sadyaHprasUtAyAH kShIram| tadeva yAvanna parataH prasannatAM yAti tAvat ‘moraTa’ ityucyate| kilATo naShTakShIrabhAgaH, yaM lokAH kShIrasAmityAhuH| vishada ityAdistakrapiNDakaguNaH, takrapiNDaH takrakUrcikAyA eva srutadravo ghano bhAgaH| gorasAnAmityatra Adishabdo luptanirdiShTo draShTavyaH, tena mahiShIkShIrAdInAmapi grahaNaM; kiMvA prAdhAnyAdgorasanirdeshaH; gorasabhAShayA gorasaniShpannAH sarva eva kShIradadhitakrAdayo gRuhyante; loke hi sarveShvevaiShu gorasasa~jj~jA||234-236||

27.sanskrit: athekShuvargaH- vRuShyaH shItaH saraH snigdho bRuMhaNo madhuro rasaH| shleShmalo bhakShitasyekShoryAntrikastu vidahyate||237|| shaityAt prasAdAnmAdhuryAt pauNDrakAdvaMshako varaH|238|
27.commentary: mAdhuryasAmAnyAdikShuvikRutiprAyo varga ucyate| bhakShitasyeti dantapIDitasya| yAntrika iti yantrapIDitaH| vidAhashcAsya prAyashastvaggranthiyuktasya yantreNa pIDanAt, tathA kAlAntarAvasthAnAcca| vacanaM hi- “mUlatvaggranthisaMyogAdyAntrikastu vidahyate”; uktaM ca hArIte- “vyApitvAt sukumAro hi raso yantranipIDitaH| saukShmyAt spRuShTo~anilArkAbhyAM bhRushaM kAye vidahyate” iti| atra vyApitvAditi tvagAdiyuktekShukANDabhavatvAt| yaducyate- vidAhitve yAntrikasya raktapittahantRutvamuktaM virudhyate, yathA “madhUdakasyekShurasasya caiva pAnAcchamaM gacchati raktapittam” (ci.a.4) iti; tanna, yato dantaniShpIDitasyaivAvidAhino raktapitte grahaNaM bhaviShyati, kiMvA yAntrike~api vidAhakArakatvagAdisaMyogasya tathA kAlAntarAvasthAnasya ca tyAgaM kRutvopayogaH kartavyaH; ‘yAntrikastu vidahyate’ iti vacanaM prAyovAdamAshritya bodhyam| anye tvetaddoShabhayAdvidahyata iti shIghraM pacyata iti vyAkhyAnayanti||237||-

27.sanskrit: prabhUtakrimimajjAsRu~gmedomAMsakaro guDaH||238|| kShudro guDashcaturbhAgatribhAgArdhAvasheShitaH| raso gururyathApUrvaM dhautaH svalpamalo guDaH||239|| tato matsyaNDikAkhaNDasharkarA vimalAH param| yathA yathaiShAM vaimalyaM bhavecchaityaM tathA tathA||240|| vRuShyA kShINakShatahitA sasnehA guDasharkarA| kaShAyamadhurA shItA satiktA yAsasharkarA||241|| rUkShA vamyatisAraghnI cchedanI madhusharkarA| tRuShNAsRukpittadAheShu prashastAH sarvasharkarAH||242||
27.commentary: prabhUtakrimyAdikAraNatvAt prabhUtakrimyAdikaro guDa ucyate| kShudraguDastathA caturbhAgatribhAgArdhAvasheShito rasa ityatra cakAralopo draShTavyaH; tena kShudraguDashcaturbhAgAvasheShitAdrasAdguruH, tathA tribhAgAccaturbhAgAvasheShito gururityAdi j~jeyam| kShudraguDo~asitaguDa ityucyate| phANitaM ca tantulIbhAvAdbhavati| dhautaH svalpamala iti malAvasekena dhauto~alpamalo bhavati, tenAlpakrimyAdirbhavatIti bhAvaH| tata iti dhautaguDAt| matsyaNDikA khaNDamadhye pAkAdghanIbhUtA matsyANDanibhA bhavati| vimalAH paramityuttarottaraM vimalAH| bhavecchaityaM tathA tatheti matsyaNDikAyAshca khaNDaH shItataraH, tatashca sharkarA shItatametyarthaH| guDasharkareti yAsamadhusharkarayorvyavacchedArtham| yAsasharkarA durAlabhAkvAthakRutA sharkarA| madhusharkarA tu madhubhANDeShu sharkarAkArA bhavati||238-242||

27.sanskrit: mAkShikaM bhrAmaraM kShaudraM pauttikaM madhujAtayaH| mAkShikaM pravaraM teShAM visheShAdbhrAmaraM guru||243|| mAkShikaM tailavarNaM syAdghRutavarNaM tu pauttikam| kShaudraM kapilavarNaM syAcchvetaM bhrAmaramucyate||244|| vAtalaM guru shItaM ca raktapittakaphApaham| sandhAtRu cchedanaM rUkShaM kaShAyaM madhuraM madhu ||245|| hanyAnmadhUShNamuShNArtamathavA saviShAnvayAt| gururUkShakaShAyatvAcchaityAccAlpaM hitaM madhu||246||
27.commentary: madhusharkarAprasa~ggena madhvabhidhAnam| makShikAH pi~ggalAH, tadbhavaM mAkShikam| bhramaraH prasiddhaH| kShudramakShikAbhavaM kShaudram| pi~ggalA makShikA mahatyaH puttikAH, tadbhavaM pauttikam| chatrAdayashcApare catvAro madhubhedAH sushrutoktAH sAmAnyamadhuguNA eva j~jeyAH; kiMvA aprashastatvAdiha noktAH| kecit ‘mAkShikaM tailavarNaM syAt’ ityAdishlokaM paThanti| uShNArtamathaveti bhAShayA, yathA uShNaM madhu hanyAnna tathA uShNArtamiti sUcayati| tatraiva hetumAha- saviShAnvayAditi|- saviShANi nAnApuShpANi, kiMvA saviShA eva makShikAdayaH, anvayA utpattisthAnAni yasya tat saviShAnvayaM madhu; tena viShAnugatasyoShNavirodhitvasyaiva madhuno~anugamo bhavati, na tu saviShatvasya; tathA satyuShNamapi mArakaM syAt; kiMvA athaveti saviShAnvayAdityanena sambadhyate, tena saviShAnvayAdanyatashca shaityAt saukumAryAccoShNena madhu virudhyata ityartho bhavati| uktaM hi hArIte- “nAnApuShpaprakArANAM rasasArAtmakaM madhu| tacchaityAt saukumAryAcca sarvairuShNairvirudhyate” iti; sushrute~apyuktaM- “tat saukumAryAcca tathaiva shaityAt” (su. sU. 45) ityAdi| alpasya madhuno hitatve hetumAha- gurvityAdi| gurutvAnmadhvAmakArakaM bhavati, rUkShaM kaShAyashItaM tu mahAtyayavAtakaramiti bhAvaH||243-246||

27.sanskrit: nAtaH kaShTatamaM ki~jcinmadhvAmAttaddhi mAnavam| upakramavirodhitvAt sadyo hanyAdyathA viSham||247|| Ame soShNA kriyA kAryA sA madhvAme virudhyate| madhvAmaM dAruNaM tasmAt sadyo hanyAdyathA viSham||248||
27.commentary: madhvAmasya mahAtyayatAmAha- nAta ityAdi| upakramavirodhitvaM madhvAme yathA- Ame tUShNaM pathyaM, tanmadhuni viruddhaM; yattu madhuhitaM shItaM, tadAme viruddham||247-248||

27.sanskrit: nAnAdravyAtmakatvAcca yogavAhi paraM madhu| itIkShuvikRutiprAyo vargo~ayaM dashamo mataH||249|| itIkShuvargo dashamaH|
27.commentary: madhuno yogavAhitvamAha- nAnetyAdi| yasmAnnAnArasavIryAdibhyaH puShpebhya utpannaM tanmadhu, tenAnabhivyaktanAnAshaktikameva| tatashca yena dravyeNa vAmanIyena vA~a~asthApanIyena vA vRuShyeNa kAryAntarakArakeNa vA yujyate tasyaiva karma karoti, samAnAnukAridravyaprabodhitashaktitvAditi bhAvaH| cakAro~atra hetvantarasamuccaye, tena prabhAvAcceti boddhavyam| tena satyapi nAnauShadhisambhavatve prabhAvAnna kShIramadyAdayo yogavAhinaH; tathA, anAnAtmakA api shilAjatutailAdayo yogavAhino bhavanti| yogavAhitve~api madhu snehane na prayujyate vAte, rUkShAdiguNayuktatvAt| nAnAdravyAtmakatve~api madhu rUkShakaShAyatvAbhyAmevAvirbhUtaM bhavati, prAyeNa rUkShakaShAyaguNAdhike eva puShpe madhumakShikANAM caraNAditi boddhavyam| anena ca nyAyena nAnAdravyAtmakatvena sarvaguNatAprasa~ggo madhuno nirasto bhavati| sushrute~apyevameva yogavAhitvaM “tacca nAnA” (su.sU.a.45) ityAdinA granthena madhuna uktam| ikShuvikRutiprAya iti ikShuvikRutipradhAnaH, tena yAsasharkarAdikathanamapyatrAviruddhamiti bhAvaH||249||

27.sanskrit: atha kRutAnnavargaH- kShuttRuShNAglAnidaurbalyakukShirogajvarApahA| svedAgnijananI peyA vAtavarconulomanI||250|| tarpaNI grAhiNI laghvI hRudyA cApi vilepikA| maNDastu dIpayatyagniM vAtaM cApyanulomayet||251|| mRudUkaroti srotAMsi svedaM sa~jjanayatyapi| la~gghitAnAM viriktAnAM jIrNe snehe ca tRuShyatAm||252|| dIpanatvAllaghutvAcca maNDaH syAt prANadhAraNaH| lAjapeyA shramaghnI tu kShAmakaNThasya dehinaH||253|| tRuShNAtIsArashamano dhAtusAmyakaraH shivaH| lAjamaNDo~agnijanano dAhamUrcchAnivAraNaH ||254|| mandAgniviShamAgnInAM bAlasthavirayoShitAm| deyashca sukumArANAM lAjamaNDaH susaMskRutaH||255|| kShutpipAsApahaH pathyaH shuddhAnAM ca malApahaH| shRutaH pippalishuNThIbhyAM yukto lAjAmladADimaiH||256|| kaShAyamadhurAH shItA laghavo lAjasaktavaH|257|
27.commentary: samprati shUkadhAnyAdivargauryathAsambhavaM sampAditasya kRutAnnasya peyAderguNAn vaktuM kRutAnnavarga ucyate | te ca peyAdInAM guNAH kecit saMskArasaMyogAdijAH, kecit prAkRutA api j~jeyAH| na ca vAcyaM- peyAdInAmeva guNena bAdhitatvAcchUkadhAnyAdInAM pRuthagguNo na vAcya iti; yataH peyAdayo hi prakRutiguNAnuvidhAyinaH santaH svaguNamAvahanti, tena kRutAnnasya yo guNa ucyate sa yadi raktashAlyAdiprakRutAvapi bhavati tadA balavAn bhavati, atha prakRutau viparIto guNo bhavati tadA kRutAnnaguNasyAlpatvaM bhavatIti mantavyam| atra svasthAturahitatvenAdau peyocyate; peyA bahudravA yavAgUH, vilepI viraladravA yavAgUH| peyAdikrameNAnne vaktavye annAt prathamotpadyamAnatvena maNDaguNakathanam| dIpanalaghutvAbhyAmagniM yasmAt karoti, tasmAlla~gghitAdInAM prANadhAraNa iti j~jeyam| susaMskRuta iti dhAnyakapippalyAdisusaMskRutaH| shuddhAnAM malApaha iti samyakshuddhAnAmapi koShThopalepakadoShApaharatvena; yaducyate- shuddhAnAmiti IShacchuddhAnAM; tena, IShacchuddhyA sheShadoShasambandhAnmalApaha ityupapannaM, sushrute~api (su.sU.a.46) “lAjamaNDo~avishuddhAnAM” ityakAraprashleShAdIShadvishuddhAnAmiti bodhyam| tanna sat, IShadvishuddhe peyA niShiddhaiva, vacanaM hi- “kaphapitte vishuddhe~alpe madyape vAtapaittike| tarpaNAdikramaH kAryaH peyA~abhiShyandayeddhi tAn” (si.a.6) iti||250-256||-

27.sanskrit: sudhautaH prasrutaH svinnaH santaptashcaudano laghuH||257|| bhRuShTataNDulamicchanti garashleShmAmayeShvapi| adhauto~aprasruto~asvinnaH shItashcApyodano guruH||258|| mAMsashAkavasAtailaghRutamajjaphalaudanAH| balyAH santarpaNA hRudyA guravo bRuMhayanti ca||259|| tadvanmAShatilakShIramudgasaMyogasAdhitAH|260|
27.commentary: svinna ityutsvinnadhAnyataNDulakRutaH, kiMvA samyaksvinnatvena mRudubhUtaH| santapta iti sahajenoShmaNA, na tu punastApanena; vacanaM hi- “vivarjayet sthiraM shItamannamuShNIkRutaM punaH” iti| bhRuShTataNDulakRuta odano bhRuShTataNDulaH| adhAtaH adhautataNDulakRutaH| atra sudhautatvAdiguNavishiShTasyAdanasya laghutvaMvacanena tadviparItAnAmadhautAdInAM gurutvamarthataH siddhamapi yat punarucyate tat spaShTArtham| santarpaNA iti tadAtve~api balakarAH| mAMsAdisaMyogasAdhitAshcaudanA eva boddhavyAH| atra rUkShAbhyAM shAkamudgAbhyAmapi saMyuktasyaudanasya balyatvAdi saMyogamahimnA tathA ghRutAdisaMskArAcca lokavyavahArakriyamANatvAdboddhavyam ||257-259||-

27.sanskrit: kulmAShA guravo rUkShA vAtalA bhinnavarcasaH||260|| svinnabhakShyAstu ye kicit saupyagaudhUmayAvikAH| bhiShak teShAM yathAdravyamAdishedgurulAghavam||261||
27.commentary: yavapiShTamuShNodakasiktamIShatsvinnamapUpIkRutaM kulmAShamAhuH| svinnabhakShyA ityutsvedanamAtrakRutA haNDarikAdayaH| yathAdravyamiti vadatA nAtra prakRutiguNopamardena lAjAdAviva guNAntarodaya iti darshayati||260-261||

27.sanskrit: akRutaM kRutayUShaM ca tanuM sAMskArikaM rasam| sUpamamlamanamlaM ca guruM vidyAdyathottaram||262||
27.commentary: akRutakRutayUShalakShaNam- “asnehalavaNaM sarvamakRutaM kaTukairvinA| vij~jeyaM lavaNasnehakaTukaiH saMskRutaM kRutam” (su. sU. 46) iti| tanumiti svalpamAMsatvenAghanaM, sAMskArikamiti bahumAMsasnehAdisaMskRutatvAdghanam||262||

27.sanskrit: saktavo vAtalA rUkShA bahuvarconulominaH| tarpayanti naraM sadyaH pItAH sadyobalAshca te||263|| madhurA laghavaH shItAH saktavaH shAlisambhavAH| grAhiNo raktapittaghnAstRuShNAcchardijvarApahAH||264||
27.commentary: saktUnAM rUkShatve~api vAtalatvAbhidhAnaM takrasya rUkShasyApi vAtahAritvadarshanAt| pItA ityanena saktUnAM piNDopayoge niShedhaM darshayati| tarpayanti tRuptiM janayanti| sadyobalAH tadAtvenaiva vAjIkaraNavadbalakarAH; etena pariNAme balApahatvamapyuktaM bhavati||263-264||

27.sanskrit: hanyAdvyAdhIn yavApUpo yAvako vATya eva ca| udAvartapratishyAyakAsamehagalagrahAn||265|| dhAnAsa~jj~jAstu ye bhakShyAH prAyaste lekhanAtmakAH| shuShkatvAttarpaNAshcaiva viShTambhitvAcca durjarAH||266|| virUDhadhAnA shaShkulyo madhukroDAH sapiNDakAH| pUpAH pUpalikAdyAshca guravaH paiShTikAH param||267||
27.commentary: yavakRuto vATyo yAvako vATyaH, vATyashca bhRuShTayavaudanaH| dhAnA bhRuShTayavAH| a~gkuritasya yavasya dhAnA virUDhadhAnAH| shaShkulyaH shAlipiShTaiH satilaistailapakvAH kriyante| madhukroDAH pAkaghanIbhUtamadhugarbhAH| sapiNDakA iti madhukroDA eva sapiShTakapiNDAH; nalastvAha- “vimardya samitAcUrNaM mRudupAkaM guDAnvitam| ghRutAvagAhe guDikAM vRuttAM pakvAM sakesharAm|| saugandhikAdhivAsAM ca kuryAt pUpalikAM budhaH| sa eva khaNDasaMyAvaH sitAmrAtakapUritaH|| mAtulu~ggatvacA caiva veShTito madhushIrShakaH” iti| madhushIrShaka eva madhukroDaH| pUpAH piShTikAH| pUpalikA cApaDiketi khyAtA||265-267||

27.sanskrit: phalamAMsavasAshAkapalalakShaudrasaMskRutAH| bhakShyA vRuShyAshca balyAshca guravo bRuMhaNAtmakAH||268|| veshavAro guruH snigdho balopacayavardhanaH| guravastarpaNA vRuShyAH kShIrekShurasapUpakAH ||269|| saguDAH satilAshcaiva sakShIrakShaudrasharkarAH| bhakShyA vRuShyAshca balyAshca paraM tu guravaH smRutAH||270||
27.commentary: palalaM tilacUrNam| veshavAraH sUdashAstre- “mAMsaM nirasthi susvinnaM punardRuShadi peShitam| pippalIshuNThimaricaguDasarpiHsamanvitam|| aikadhyaM vipacet samyagveshavAra iti smRutaH”| kShIrapradhAnAH pUpAH kShIrapUpAH| saguDA ityAdau ‘sakShIrAH’ iti kShIrayogamAtraM, na kShIrapradhAnateti na paunaruktyam||268-270||

27.sanskrit: sasnehAH snehasiddhAshca bhakShyA vividhalakShaNAH| guravastarpaNA vRuShyA hRudyA gaudhUmikA matAH||271|| saMskArAllaghavaH santi bhakShyA gaudhUmapaiShTikAH| dhAnAparpaTapUpAdyAstAn buddhvA nirdishettathA||272||
27.commentary: sasnehA iti piShTAvasthAyAmeva snehayogAt| gurutvenoktAnAmapi bhUryagnisaMyogAdinA saMskArAllAghavaM bhavatItyAha- saMskArAllaghava ityAdi| buddhvA nirdishediti saMskAraguNaM tathA prakRutiguNaM ca buddhvA yathocitaM guNaM nirdishet||271-272||

27.sanskrit: pRuthukA guravo bhRuShTAn bhakShayedalpashastu tAn| yAvA viShTabhya jIryanti sarasA bhinnavarcasaH||273||
27.commentary: pRuthukAH cipiTAH| yAvA iti yavacipiTAH, anye tu gAndhAradeshaprasiddhAn sampiShTasa~jj~jAnAhuH | sarasA abhRuShTAH||273||

27.sanskrit: sUpyAnnavikRutA bhakShyA vAtalA rUkShashItalAH| sakaTusnehalavaNAnalpasho bhakShayettu tAn||274||
27.commentary: sUpyavikRutA iti mudramAShAdivikArAH||274||

27.sanskrit: mRudupAkAshca ye bhakShyAH sthUlAshca kaThinAshca ye| guravaste vyatikrAntapAkAH puShTibalapradAH||275||
27.commentary: mRudupAkAH stokAgnisaMyogasAdhyAH| vyatikrAntapAkA iti cireNa jarAM gacchanti||275||

27.sanskrit: dravyasaMyogasaMskAraM dravyamAnaM pRuthak tathA| bhakShyANAmAdishedbuddhvA yathAsvaM gurulAghavam||276||
27.commentary: anuktabhakShyaguNAtideshArthamAha- dravyasaMyogetyAdi | dravyamAnaM pRuthagiti bhakShyakaraNe saMyuktAnAM dravyANAM madhye kasya kiyanmAnamiti buddhvA| yathAsvamiti yasya dravyasya gauravaM lAghavaM vA balavadbhavati taM nirdishet||276||

27.sanskrit: (nAnAdravyaiH samAyuktaH pakvAmaklinnabharjitaiH| vimardako gururhRudyo vRuShyo balavatAM hitaH)||277|| rasAlA bRuMhaNI vRuShyA snigdhA balyA rucipradA| snehanaM tarpaNaM hRudyaM vAtaghnaM saguDaM dadhi||278||
27.commentary: rasAlAlakShaNaM- “sacaturjAtakAjAji sasitArdrakanAgaram| rasAlA syAcchikhariNI sa~gghRuShTaM sasaraM dadhi” iti| rasAlAprasa~ggena saguDadadhiguNamAha- snehanamityAdi||277-278||

27.sanskrit: drAkShAkharjUrakolAnAM guru viShTambhi pAnakam| parUShakANAM kShaudrasya yaccekShuvikRutiM prati||279|| teShAM kaTvamlasaMyogAn pAnakAnAM pRuthak pRuthak| dravyaM mAnaM ca vij~jAya guNakarmANi cAdishet||280|| kaTvamlasvAdulavaNA laghavo rAgaShADavAH| mukhapriyAshca hRudyAshca dIpanA bhaktarocanAH||281|| AmrAmalakalehAshca bRuMhaNA balavardhanAH| rocanAstarpaNAshcoktAH snehamAdhuryagauravAt||282|| buddhvA saMyogasaMskAraM dravyamAnaM ca tacchritam| guNakarmANi lehAnAM teShAM teShAM tathA vadet||283||
27.commentary: pAnakAnAmapi kRutAnnabhedatvAttadguNamAha- drAkShetyAdi| yaccekShuvikRutiM prati pAnakamiti sambandhaH| rAgaShADavaM kecidevaM vadanti- “kvathitaM tu guDopetaM sahakAraphalaM navam| tailanAgarasaMyuktaM vij~jeyo rAgaShADavaH” iti; kiMvA , “sitArucakasindhUtthaiH savRukShAmlaparUShakaiH| jambUphalarasairyukto rAgo rAjikayA~anvitaH” iti| ShADavastu madhurAmladravyakRutaH| AmrAmalakalehAstu tayoH pRuthakkvAthena sasharkareNa ghanAH kriyante| anuktapAnakaguNAtideshArthamAha- buddhvetyAdi| asya dravyasaMyogetyAdivadvyAkhyAnam||279-283||

27.sanskrit: raktapittakaphotkledi shuktaM vAtAnulomanam| kandamUlaphalAdyaM ca tadvadvidyAttadAsutam||284|| shiNDAkI cAsutaM cAnyat kAlAmlaM rocanaM laghu| vidyAdvargaM kRutAnnAnAmekAdashatamaM bhiShak||285|| iti kRutAnnavarga ekAdashaH|
27.commentary: shuktalakShaNaM- “yanmastvAdi shucau bhANDe saguDakShaudrakA~jjikam| dhAnyarAshau trirAtrasthaM shukraM cukraM taducyate” iti| tadAsutamiti shuktamadhyasthitaM mUlakakUShmANDAdi| shiNDAkI svanAmaprasiddhA tIrabhuktau| AsutaM cAnyaditi sandhAnAntaram| kAlAmlamiti cirakAlAvasthAnAdamlaM, natvamladravyasaMyogAt| kRutAnnAnAmiti karaNaniShpAditamaNDapeyAdInAm||284-285||
