27.sanskrit: kaShAyAnurasaM svAdu sUkShmamuShNaM vyavAyi ca| pittalaM baddhaviNmUtraM na ca shleShmAbhivardhanam||286|| vAtaghneShUttamaM balyaM tvacyaM medhAgnivardhanam| tailaM saMyogasaMskArAt sarvarogApahaM matam||287|| tailaprayogAdajarA nirvikArA jitashramAH| AsannatibalAH sa~gkhye daityAdhipatayaH purA||288|| airaNDatailaM madhuraM guru shleShmAbhivardhanam| vAtAsRuggulmahRudrogajIrNajvaraharaM param||289|| kaTUShNaM sArShapaM tailaM raktapittapradUShaNam| kaphashukrAnilaharaM kaNDUkoThavinAshanam ||290|| priyAlatailaM madhuraM guru shleShmAbhivardhanam| hitamicchanti nAtyauShNyAtsaMyoge vAtapittayoH||291|| AtasyaM madhurAmlaM tu vipAke kaTukaM tathA| uShNavIryaM hitaM vAte raktapittaprakopaNam||292|| kusumbhatailamuShNaM ca vipAke kaTukaM guru| vidAhi ca visheSheNa sarvadoShaprakopaNam||293|| phalAnAM yAni cAnyAni tailAnyAhArasaMvidhau | yujyante guNakarmabhyAM tAni brUyAdyathAphalam||294||
27.commentary: AhAramabhidhAya tadyogidravyaM brUte| tatra sarpiSha uktatvAttailamevAnnasaMskArakapradhAnatvAdAha- kaShAyetyAdi| saMyogAcca saMskArAcceti saMyogasaMskArAt; saMskArastailasya bheShajaiH pAkaH, saMyogastvavacAraNAyAM j~jeyaH| sa~gkhye yuddhe| Atasyam umAtailam| anuktatailaguNanirdeshArthamAha- phalAnAmityAdi| phalAnAmityupalakShaNaM; tena sArasnehA api sushrutoktA boddhavyAH| yathAphalamiti yAdRushaguNaM phalaM tAdRusha eva tatsneho~apItyarthaH||286-294||

27.sanskrit: madhuro bRuMhaNo vRuShyo balyo majjA tathA vasA| yathAsattvaM tu shaityoShNe vasAmajj~jorvinirdishet||295||
27.commentary: yathAsattvamiti yaH prANI AnUpAdiruShNastasyoShNaH, yastu prANI jA~ggalAdiH shItastasya shIta ityarthaH| sAmAnyatastu vasAmajj~joranuShNAshItatvaM yathA bhavati tathA snehAdhyAye eva proktam||295||

27.sanskrit: sasnehaM dIpanaM vRuShyamuShNaM vAtakaphApaham| vipAke madhuraM hRudyaM rocanaM vishvabheShajam||296|| shleShmalA madhurA cArdrA gurvI snigdhA ca pippalI| sA shuShkA kaphavAtaghnI kaTUShNA vRuShyasammatA ||297|| nAtyarthamuShNaM maricamavRuShyaM laghu rocanam| cheditvAcchoShaNatvAcca dIpanaM kaphavAtajit ||298|| vAtashleShmavibandhaghnaM kaTUShNaM dIpanaM laghu| hi~ggu shUlaprashamanaM vidyAt pAcanarocanam||299|| rocanaM dIpanaM vRuShyaM cakShuShyamavidAhi ca| tridoShaghnaM samadhuraM saindhavaM lavaNottamam||300|| saukShmyAdauShNyAllaghutvAcca saugandhyAcca rucipradam| sauvarcalaM vibandhaghnaM hRudyamudgArashodhi ca||301|| taikShNyAdauShNyAdvyavAyitvAddIpanaM shUlanAshanam| UrdhvaM cAdhashca vAtAnAmAnulomyakaraM biDam||302|| satiktakaTu sakShAraM tIkShNamutkledi caudbhidam| na kAlalavaNe gandhaH sauvarcalaguNAshca te||303|| sAmudrakaM samadhuraM, satiktaM kaTu pAMshujam| rocanaM lavaNaM sarvaM pAki sraMsyanilApaham||304||
27.commentary: saukShmyAdityAdinA sauvarcalaguNaH| taikShNyAdityAdinA biDaguNaH| audbhidam utkArikAlavaNam | kAlalavaNaM sauvarcalamevAgandham| dakShiNasamudrasamIpe bhavatIti sAmudraM karakacam| pAMshujaM pUrvasamudrajam||296-304||

27.sanskrit: hRutpANDugrahaNIrogaplIhAnAhagalagrahAn| kAsaM kaphajamarshAMsi yAvashUko vyapohati||305|| tIkShNoShNo laghurUkShashca kledI paktA vidAraNaH| dAhano dIpanashchettA sarvaH kShAro~agnisannibhaH ||306||
27.commentary: kShArANAmapi lavaNasattvAt kShAraguNamAha- hRudityAdi| yavakShAraguNaH| sarvaH kShAra iti svarjikAkShAraTa~gkanakShArAdiH||305-306||

27.sanskrit: kAravI ku~jcikA~ajAjI yavAnI dhAnyatumburu| rocanaM dIpanaM vAtakaphadaurgandhyanAshanam||307||
27.commentary: kAravI kRuShNajIrakam| ku~jcikA sthUlajIrakam| ajAjI jIrakam||307||

27.sanskrit: AhArayoginAM bhaktinishcayo na tu vidyate| samApto dvAdashashcAyaM varga AhArayoginAm||308|| ityAhArayogivargo dvAdashaH|
27.commentary: uktAttailAderanyadapyAhArasaMskArakatvenAhArayogi bhavatItyAha- AhAretyAdi| bhaktiH vibhAga iyatteti yAvat; kiMvA bhaktiH icchA; tena puruShecchAnAmaniyamAduktamapi ki~jcit prAya AhArayogi na bhavati, tathA anuktamapi rasonAmrapeShikAdyAhArasaMyogi bhavatItyuktaM bhavati||308||

27.sanskrit: shUkadhAnyaM shamIdhAnyaM samAtItaM prashasyate| purANaM prAyasho rUkShaM prAyeNAbhinavaM guru ||309|| yadyadAgacchati kShipraM tattallaghutaraM smRutam| nistuShaM yuktibhRuShTaM ca sUpyaM laghu vipacyate||310||
27.commentary: sampratyuktAnAM shUkadhAnyAdInAM yadanuktaguNaM tadvaktumAha- shUkadhAnyamityAdi| samAtItamiti ekavarShAtItam| prashasyata iti lAghavAt; hemante navadhAnyavidhAnaM tvapavAdaH| Agacchati kShipramiti uptaM sacchIghraM bhavati; tena ShaShTikAH sarvadhAnyeShu laghavaH, te hi ShaShTirAtreNa bhavanti| asmiMshca vyAkhyAne, vrIheH shAradasya ca haimantaM shAliM pratyalpakAlatvena laghutvaM prApnoti, tasmAt sajAtIya eva shIghragamanaM lAghavaheturiti vAcyam| kiMvA, Agacchati kShipramiti bhuktaM sat kShipraM pacyate| yuktibhRuShTam IShadbhRuShTamiti yAvat| sUpyaM sUpAya yogyaM mudgamAShAdi||309-310||

27.sanskrit: mRutaM kRushaM cAtimedyaM vRuddhaM bAlaM viShairhatam| agocarabhRutaM vyAlasUditaM mAMsamutsRujet||311|| ato~anyathA hitaM mAMsaM bRuMhaNaM balavardhanam|312|
27.commentary: mRutamiti svayaM mRutam| medyaM meduram| kRushagrahaNena shuShkamapi grAhyam| agocarabhRutaM yathA- AnUpaM dhanvadeshe puShTam| vyAlA vyAghrAdayaH; kiMvA vyAlaH sarpaH| viShahataM tu viShadigdhashastraviddham||311||-

27.sanskrit: prINanaH sarvabhUtAnAM hRudyo mAMsarasaH param||312|| shuShyatAM vyAdhimuktAnAM kRushAnAM kShINaretasAm| balavarNArthinAM caiva rasaM vidyAdyathAmRutam||313|| sarvarogaprashamanaM yathAsvaM vihitaM rasam| vidyAt svaryaM balakaraM vayobuddhIndriyAyuShAm||314|| vyAyAmanityAH strInityA madyanityAshca ye narAH| nityaM mAMsarasAhArA nAturAH syurna durbalAH||315||
27.commentary: mAMsarasaguNAH- prINana ityAdi| sarvarogaprashamanamiti sarvashabdo bhUrivacanaH; etena unmAdAdau mAMsaniShedho na virodhavAn bhavati; uktaM hi unmAde- “nivRuttAmiShamadyo yaH” (ci. 9) ityAdi| yathAsvamiti yasya vyAdheryo vihitaH, tAdRushaM rasam||312-315||

27.sanskrit: krimivAtAtapahataM shuShkaM jIrNamanArtavam| shAkaM niHsnehasiddhaM ca varjyaM yaccAparisrutam||316|| purANamAmaM sa~gkliShTaM krimivyAlahimAtapaiH| adeshakAlajaM klinnaM yatsyAtphalamasAdhu tat||317|| haritAnAM yathAshAkaM nirdeshaH sAdhanAdRute| madyAmbugorasAdInAM sve sve varge vinishcayaH||318||
27.commentary: snehena vinA siddhaM niHsnehasiddham| Amamiti apakvam; etacca bilvAdIn vihAya boddhavyam| adeshajamiti anucitadeshabhavam| akAlajam anArtavam| sAdhanAdRuta iti haritAnAmArdrakapalANDuprabhRutInAM niHsnehasiddhAnAmapi tathA aparisrutAnAmapi nirdoShatvamityarthaH| vinishcayaH ‘kRuta’ iti sheShaH; tathAca madyAnAM ‘prAyasho~abhinavam’ ityAdinA guNadoShakathanaM kRutameva, evaM jale~api ‘picchilaM krimilam’ ityAdinA, gorasakRutAnnAhArayogivargeShu tu yathoktakartRuguNavadviparIte viparItaguNamanumeyamiti bhAvaH||316-318||

27.sanskrit: yadAhAraguNaiH pAnaM viparItaM tadiShyate| annAnupAnaM dhAtUnAM dRuShTaM yanna virodhi ca||319|| AsavAnAM samuddiShTAmashItiM caturuttarAm| jalaM peyamapeyaM ca parIkShyAnupibeddhitam||320|| snigdhoShNaM mArute shastaM pitte madhurashItalam| kaphe~anupAnaM rUkShoShNaM kShaye mAMsarasaH param||321|| upavAsAdhvabhAShyastrImArutAtapakarmabhiH| klAntAnAmanupAnArthaM payaH pathyaM yathA~amRutam||322|| surA kRushAnAM puShTyarthamanupAnaM vidhIyate| kArshyArthaM sthUladehAnAmanu shastaM madhUdakam||323|| alpAgnInAmanidrANAM tandrAshokabhayaklamaiH| madyamAMsocitAnAM ca madyamevAnushasyate||324||
27.commentary: samprati yeShAM yadanupAnaM kartavyaM tadevAha- yadityAdi| AhAraguNairiti shItasnehamadhurAdibhiH; viparItamiti viparItaguNamanupeyam| evaM ca dadhno~amlasya madhuraM kShIraM tathA pAyasasya kA~jjikAnupAnaM syAdityAha- dhAtUnAM yanna virodhi ceti| evaM cAmle payo~anupIyamAnaM viruddhatvAddhAtuvirodhena pratyuktaM bhavati, evamanyadapi viruddhaM boddhavyam| samuddiShTamiti yajjaHpuruShIye (sU. 25)| peyamapeyaM ceti sahajaguNadoShavattvAt tathopayuktabhojanApekShayA| snigdhoShNamityAdinA doShabhedenApyanupAnamAha| anushastamiti anupAnaM shastam||319-324||

27.sanskrit: athAnupAnakarmaguNAn pravakShyAmaH- anupAnaM tarpayati, prINayati, Urjayati, bRuMhayati, paryAptimabhinirvartayati, bhuktamavasAdayati, annasa~gghAtaM bhinatti, mArdavamApAdayati, kledayati, jarayati, sukhapariNAmitAmAshuvyavAyitAM cAhArasyopajanayatIti||325|| bhavati cAtra- anupAnaM hitaM yuktaM tarpayatyAshu mAnavam| sukhaM pacati cAhAramAyuShe ca balAya ca||326||
27.commentary: anupAnaguNAnAha- athetyAdi| paryAptiH tRuptiH| ||325-326||

27.sanskrit: nordhvA~ggamArutAviShTA na hikkAshvAsakAsinaH| na gItabhAShyAdhyayanaprasaktA norasi kShatAH||327|| pibeyurudakaM bhuktvA taddhi kaNThorasi sthitam| snehamAhArajaM hatvA bhUyo doShAya kalpate||328||
27.commentary: yairanupAnaM na kartavyaM tAnAha- nordhvA~ggetyAdi| kaNThorasi sthitamiti anenordhvA~ggamArutAdInAmanupAnaM kaNThorasi sthitameva bhavati, nAdho yAtIti darshayati| snehamAhArajaM hatveti AhArajAtaM snehamabhibhUya bhUyo doShAya kalpate, vAtalakShaNaM doShaM karotItyarthaH| AhArasnehena yo vAtaprashamaH kartavyastaM shaityaprakarShAt pAnIyamabhibhavatItyarthaH| etena yaducyate- apAM snigdhatvena snehanamupapannamiti, tanna bhavati| ye tu bruvate- ‘hana’ hiMsAgatyoriti vacanAt snehaM hatveti snehaM gatvetyarthaH; tadapi na bhavati, yataH snehayuktatvenordhvA~ggamArutAdihananameva yuktaM, na tu karaNam| kiMvA snehamiti sAraM, yathA- “dehaH snehaparikShayAt” (ci. 8) iti dehasAraparikShayAdityarthaH, sArahananaM ca jalenAhArasnehaM gRuhItvA kaNThorasyavasthAnAdapAkAt kriyate ||327-328||

27.sanskrit: annapAnaikadesho~ayamuktaH prAyopayogikaH| dravyANi na hi nirdeShTuM shakyaM kArtsnyena nAmabhiH||329|| yathA nAnauShadhaM ki~jciddeshajAnAM vaco yathA| dravyaM tattattathA vAcyamanuktamiha yadbhavet||330||
27.commentary: annapAnadravyaikadeshakathanaM sahetukamAha- annetyAdi| annapAnaikadeshaH prAyopayogika iti bAhulyena yadupayujyate; etena yadbAhulyenopayujyate tasya shRu~ggagrAhikayA kathanaM, prAyo~anupayujyamAnAnAM shRu~ggagrAhikayA~akathanamalpadoShamiti darshayati; tathA alpadoShasyApi parihArArthaM tadapi kimiti nocyata ityAha- dravyANItyAdi| dravyANi kArtsnyeneti sAkalyena nirdeShTuM; nAmabhiriti nAmabhirapi na shakyaM, ‘kenacit’ iti sheShaH; hishabdo yasmAdarthe, etena yasmAt sarvANi dravyANi nAmamAtreNApi vaktuM kashcinna pArayatyatibahutvAt, tat kA kathA asheShAnnapAnadravyasya shRu~ggagrAhikayA guNakathanaM pratIti bhAvaH| kiMvA, nAmabhirnirdiShTAni kArtsnyena nirdeShTumiti guNataH kathayituM na shakyaM kenaciditi yojanA| atha kathaM hyatrAkIrtitAnnapAnasya tarhi guNA nirdeShTavyA ityAha- yathetyAdi| yathA yena prakAreNa “nAnauShadhaM ki~jcit” (sU. 26) iti pUrvAdhyAye proktaM tathA tena prakAreNAnuktaM dravyaM vAcyaM; ‘guNataH’ iti sheShaH| pUrvAdhyAye hi “tatra dravyANi gurukhara” (sU. 26) ityAdinA granthena pArthivAdibhedena vishiShTena ca karmaNA proktAni dravyANi, tatashcAnuktaM dravyaM tenaiva gurukharAdinA guNena pArthivatvAdi pratipAdya yathoktopacayAdikarmakartRukatayA vyapadeShTavyamityarthaH| tadevAnirdiShTadravyasya gurukharatvAdi kathaM j~jeyamityAha- deshajAnAM vaco yatheti; deshajA deshAntarIyAH, taddeshIyavacanAtte te gurukharatvAdayo j~jeyA ityarthaH; kiMvA, deshajA yathA tattaddravyaM vyavaharanti ‘idaM madhuram, idamamlam’ ityAdi, tat pratipAdya madhuratvAmlatvAdipratipannapRuthivyAdyasya kAraNamiti pRuthivyAdInAM gurvAdiguNagaNena karmaNA ca rasoktena tadvaktavyamityarthaH||329-330||

27.sanskrit: caraH sharIrAvayavAH svabhAvo dhAtavaH kriyA| li~ggaM pramANaM saMskAro mAtrA cAsmin parIkShyate||331||
27.commentary: aparamapyanuktAnnapAnaguNaj~jAnakAraNamAha- cara ityAdi| caryata iti caro deshaH bhakShyashca sAmAnyena gRuhyate| kriyA vyApAraH| pramANaM mAnam| atreti annapAnaguNAdhikaraNe||331||

27.sanskrit: caro~anUpajalAkAshadhanvAdyo bhakShyasaMvidhiH| jalajAnUpajAshcaiva jalAnUpacarAshca ye||332|| gurubhakShyAshca ye sattvAH sarve te guravaH smRutAH| laghubhakShyAstu laghavo dhanvajA dhanvacAriNaH||333||
27.commentary: caraM vivRuNoti- caro~anUpetyAdi| bhakShyasya saMvidhiH bhakShyabhakShaNam| tatrAnUpajalAkAshadhanvAdya ityanena gatirUpashcara ucyate, bhakShyasaMvidhivacanena ca bhakShyarUpashcara ucyate| atraivodAharaNamAha- jalajetyAdi| atra jalajatvenAnUpajatvena ca jale vA~anUpe vA gatireva dRushyate, na hi jalAdau ye jAtAste prAyo~anyatrAvatiShThante; ye tvanyatra jAtA apyanyatra tiShThante prAyaH kAkamadguprabhRutayastadgrahaNArthamAha- jalAnUpacarAshca ye iti| etena sAmAnyena jale prAyo~avasthAnAdiha jalacaratvam; evamanUpacaratvAdyapi j~jeyam| bhakShyarUpacarakRutaM guNamAha- gurubhakShyA ityAdi| dhanvajA dhanvacAriNa ityatra cakAro luptanirdiShTo draShTavyaH; tena, AkAshacAriNAmapi shyenAdInAmanuktamapi lAghavaM svajAtiprasahAntarApekShayA boddhavyam, AkAshasya laghutvAt| ye tu bruvate- AkAshacAriNAM gauravalAghavAniyamAdakathanamiti; tanna, tathA satyAkAshasyAprayojakatvena ‘caro~anUpajalAkAshadhanvAdyaH’ ityatrAkAshakathanaM niShprayojanaM syAt||332-333||

27.sanskrit: sharIrAvayavAH sakthishiraHskandhAdayastathA| sakthimAMsAdguruH skandhastataH kroDastataH shiraH||334|| vRuShaNau carma meDhraM ca shroNI vRukkau yakRudgudam| mAMsAdgurutaraM vidyAdyathAsvaM madhyamasthi ca||335||
27.commentary: mAMsAdgurutaraM vidyAditi gurutvena pratipAditasakthyAdimAMsAdvRuShaNAdi gurutaraM vidyAditi| yathAsvamiti ekasharIrasakthyAdInAmevaitadgauravAdi, natvanyasharIrApekShayA| madhyamiti antarAdhiH| asthi iti asthisthitaM mAMsam| anye tu madhyamiti asthimadhyagataM majjAnaM bruvate; tannAtisundaraM, tasyottarottaradhAtugauravakathanenaiva labdhatvAt||334-335||

27.sanskrit: svabhAvAllaghavo mudgAstathA lAvakapi~jjalAH| svabhAvAdguravo mAShA varAhamahiShAstathA||336|| dhAtUnAM shoNitAdInAM guruM vidyAdyathottaram| alasebhyo vishiShyante prANino ye bahukriyAH||337||
27.commentary: svabhAvAditi prakRutyA| kriyodAharaNam- alasebhya ityAdi; alasebhya iti alpakriyebhyaH| vishiShyanta iti vishiShTA bhavanti, laghavo bhavantItyarthaH||336-337||

27.sanskrit: gauravaM li~ggasAmAnye puMsAM strINAM tu lAghavam| mahApramANA guravaH svajAtau laghavo~anyathA||338||
27.commentary: li~ggyante j~jAyante gavAdayo~aneneti li~ggaM jAtiH, tena li~ggasAmAnye jAtisAmAnye; etacca catuShpAdAbhiprAyeNa boddhavyaM, pakShiShu viparyayaH; yadAha hArItaH- “catuShpAdeShu laghvI strI vihageShu laghuH pumAn” iti, atrApyuktaM- “striyashcatuShpAtsu pumAn vihageShu laghuH” iti| puMsAM ca gaurave atyarthaguroH shukrasyArambhakasya bhUyastvaM hetuM bruvate; kintu svabhAvastatra heturapavAda iti pashyAmaH, viha~ggeShu viparyayadarshanAditi||338||

27.sanskrit: gurUNAM lAghavaM vidyAt saMskArAt saviparyayam| vrIherlAjA yathA ca syuH saktUnAM siddhapiNDikAH||339||
27.commentary: saviparyayamiti saMskArAllaghUnAmapi gauravaM vidyAdityarthaH| tadeva saMskArajanyaM lAghavaM gauravaM cAha- vrIherityAdi| gurorapi vrIheH saMskArAllAjA laghava ityarthaH| saktUnAM ca laghUnAM siddhapiNDikA gurvyaH, siddhapiNDikA agnipAcitAH piNDAH||339||

27.sanskrit: alpAdAne gurUNAM ca laghUnAM cAtisevane| mAtrA kAraNamuddiShTaM dravyANAM gurulAghave||340|| gurUNAmalpamAdeyaM laghUnAM tRuptiriShyate| mAtrAM dravyANyapekShante mAtrA cAgnimapekShate||341||
27.commentary: alpAdAna ityAdi| gurUNAM dravyANAmalpasya stokamAtrasyAdAne yallAghavaM, tasmin lAghave mAtrA kAraNaM; na dravyaM, tasya gurutvAt| evaM laghUnAmatisevane gauravaM mAtrAkRutam| uddiShTamiti mAtrAshitIye (sU. 5), asmAbhirapi ca tatraivaitat saprapa~jcaM vyAkhyAtam; prakaraNAgatatvena abhyarhitatvAcca punaruktam | dravyANi mAtrAmapekShante iti yathocitamAtrAvanti sukhaM pacyanta ityarthaH| mAtrA cAgnimapekShata iti pratipuruShaM pratidinaM cAgnibhedamapekShya mAtrA mahatI svalpA vA bhavati, na pratiniyatA mAtrA vidyata iti bhAvaH||340-341||

27.sanskrit: balamArogyamAyushca prANAshcAgnau pratiShThitAH| annapAnendhanaishcAgnirjvalati vyeti cAnyathA ||342||
27.commentary: kutaH punaragnyapekShA mAtrA kriyata ityAha- balamityAdi| agnimapekShya mAtrayA prayuktayA~agnyanAshAdvalAdayo bhavantIti bhAvaH| agnau pratiShThitA iti agnyadhInAH; yathA- rAjAshritAH prajA iti| prANA iti vAyavaH; kiMvA, prANAshrayAH sha~gkhAdayo dasha prANAH| indhanaM kAShTham, indhanamivendhanaM, taiH; kiMvA agnidAhyamindhanamucyate| anyatheti anindhanam||342||

27.sanskrit: gurulAghavacinteyaM prAyeNAlpabalAn prati| mandakriyAnanArogyAn sukumArAnsukhocitAn||343||
27.commentary: iyaM carAdikRutA gurulAghavacintA~alpAgniM prati prAya iti darshayannAha- gurvityAdi| atrApyabalatvena mandakAdyairapi vahnimAndyameva lakShaNIyam||343||

27.sanskrit: dIptAgnayaH kharAhArAH karmanityA mahodarAH| ye narAH prati tAMshcintyaM nAvashyaM gurulAghavam||344||
27.commentary: kharAhArA iti kaThinAhArasAtmyAH| mahodaratvenApi medovarodhAnmahAgnitvaM darshayati| nAvashyaM cintyamiti anena dIptAgnInAmapi prati stokaprayojanA gurulAghavacintA vidyata eveti darshayati| yato dIptAgnyAdInAmapi gurudravyamagneH pratipakShamAvahatyeva, svabhAvato~agniviruddhatvAt||344||

27.sanskrit: hitAbhirjuhuyAnnityamantaragniM samAhitaH| annapAnasamidbhirnA mAtrAkAlau vicArayan||345|| AhitAgniH sadA pathyAnyantaragnau juhoti yaH| divase divase brahma japatyatha dadAti ca||346|| naraM niHshreyase yuktaM sAtmyaj~jaM pAnabhojane| bhajante nAmayAH kecidbhAvino~apyantarAdRute||347||
27.commentary: annaM samidha iva samidhaH| AhitAgniriti sAtmyena vyavasthApitAgniH; kiMvA AhitAgnirivAhitAgniH; tena AhitAgniryathA prAtaH sAyaM juhoti, tathA~ayamapi prAtaH sAyaM ca pathyAnyantaragnau juhoti| brahma japatIti praNavAdimantramAvartayati| dadAti ceti yathAshakti dAnamAcarati| taM naraM niHshreyase kalyANe yuktamAmayA na bhajante| bhAvino~apIti janmAntare~api; iha janmani pathyAshitvAnna bhavanti gadAH, janmAntare~api brahmajapadAnAbhyAmarjitadharmaprabhAvAdeva na bhavanti| ata evAha- antarAdRuta iti; antarAditi kAraNAt, Rute vinA; apathyasya tathA adharmasya rogakaraNasyAbhAvAdgadA na bhavantIti bhAvaH||345-347||

27.sanskrit: ShaDtriMshataM sahasrANi rAtrINAM hitabhojanaH| jIvatyanAturo janturjitAtmA sammataH satAm||348||
27.commentary: varShashatAyuShTvamapi hitAdbhojanAdbhavatItyAha- ShaTtriMshatamityAdi| etAvatIbhI rAtribhirvarShashatameva bhavati| jitAtmA jitendriyaH| sammataH pUjitaH||348||

27.sanskrit: prANAH prANabhRutAmannamannaM loko~abhidhAvati| varNaH prasAdaH sausvaryaM jIvitaM pratibhA sukham||349|| tuShTiH puShTirbalaM medhA sarvamanne pratiShThitam| laukikaM karma yadvRuttau svargatau yacca vaidikam||350|| karmApavarge yaccoktaM taccApyanne pratiShThitam|351|
27.commentary: kimarthamannapAnavidhAvetat parIkShyamityAha- prANA ityAdi| abhidhAvatIti prArthayati| pratibhA praj~jA| medhA dhAraNAvatI dhIH| laukikamiti aparIkShakaloke bhavam; aparIkShakA eva hi vartamAnamAtre pravartante, parIkShakAstu janmAntaropakAriNyeva| karma yadvRuttAviti vartamAne sAdhye yat karma kRuShyAdi| svargatAviti svargagamane| vaidikamiti yaj~jAdi| apavarga iti mokShe| etAshca nimittasaptamyaH| yaccoktamiti mokShashAstre satyabrahmacaryAdi| anne pratiShThitamiti nirannasya dehasthityabhAvena sarvArambhAbhAvAt| yasmAdannaM sarvatra kAraNaM, tatastatrAvadhAtavyamiti||349-350||-

27.sanskrit: tatra shlokaH- annapAnaguNAH sAgryA vargA dvAdasha nishcitAH||351|| saguNAnyanupAnAni gurulAghavasa~ggrahaH| annapAnavidhAvuktaM tat parIkShyaM visheShataH||352||
27.commentary: sa~ggrahe~annapAnaguNA iti ‘iShTavarNa’ ityAdinoktAH| sAgryA iti udakaM kledayati ityAdinA; udakAdayo hi kledanAdiShu agryAH shreShThA ityarthaH||351-352||

27.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne~annapAnavidhirnAma saptaviMsho~adhyAyaH||27||
27.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyavyAkhyAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAmannapAnacatuShke~annapAnavidhirnAma saptaviMsho~adhyAyaH||27||

28.sanskrit: athAto vividhAshitapItIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
28.commentary: pUrvAdhyAye ‘annaM prANAH’ (sU. 27) ityuktaM, tadyena prakAreNAnnaM prANaheturbhavati tadabhidhAnArthaM vividhAshitapItIyo~abhidhIyate| iyamapyarthaparA sa~jj~jA||1-2||

28.sanskrit: vividhamashitaM pItaM lIDhaM khAditaM jantorhitamantaragnisandhukShitabalena yathAsvenoShmaNA samyagvipacyamAnaM kAlavadanavasthitasarvadhAtupAkamanupahatasarvadhAtUShmamArutasrotaH kevalaM sharIramupacayabalavarNasukhAyuShA yojayati sharIradhAtUnUrjayati ca| dhAtavo hi dhAtvAhArAH prakRutimanuvartante||3||
28.commentary: vividhamityAdi| vividhamiti anenAshitAdInAmavAntarabhedaM darshayati; ashitAdiShu yo yaH prAya upayujyate sa pUrvamuktaH| jantorhitamiti vacanamahitasyAshitAderbalavarNAdikartRutvAbhAvAt| antaragninA jAThareNa vahninA sandhukShitaM balaM yasya tenAntaragnisandhukShitabalena| yathAsvenoShmaNeti pRuthivyAdirUpAshitAderyasya ya UShmA pArthivAgnyAdirUpastena; vacanaM hi- “bhaumApyAgneyavAyavyAH pa~jcoShmANaH sanAbhasAH| pa~jcAhAraguNAn svAn svAn pArthivAdIn pacanti hi” (ci. 15) iti| samyagvipacyamAnamiti ashitAdi| kiMvA yathAsvenoShmaNeti yasya rudhirAderya UShmA dhAtvagnirUpastena samyagvipacyamAnamashitAdi rasatAmApannaM yadA raktAdidhAtUn pratipadyate tadA raktAdyUShmaNaiva pacyate; evaM vipacyamAnamashitAdi sharIramupacayAdinA yojayatyUrjayati vardhayatIti yojanA| kiMvishiShTaM sharIramityAha- kAlavadityAdi|- yathA kAlo nityagatvenAnavasthitaH, tathA~anavasthitaH avishrAntaH sarvadhAtUnAM pAko yasmin sharIre tattathA; etena sarvadA svAgnipAkakShIyamANadhAtoH sharIrasyAshitAdinopacayAdiyojanamupapannamiti darshayati, yadi hi pAkakShIyamANaM sharIraM na syAttadA svataH siddhe upacayAdau kimashitAdi kuryAditi bhAvaH| kiMvA kAlavadityashitAdivisheShaNaM; tena yathoktakAlakRutamashitAdItyarthaH , akAlabhojanasyopacayAdyakArakatvAt| tathA, anavasthitasarvadhAtupAkamityetadapi ashitAdivisheShaNaM, tena anavasthitaH sarvadhAtuShu pAko yasyAshitAdestattathA; etena kvacidapi dhAtau sthagitasyAshitAde rasarUpasya pAkavigamanAnnopacayAdirbhavatIti darshayati| etacca vyAkhyAnaM nAtisundaram, asyArthasya anupahatetyAdisharIravisheShaNenaiva labdhatvAt punaH sharIravisheShaNamanupapannam| anupahatetyAdi anupahatAni sarvadhAtUnAmUShmamArutasrotAMsi yasya tattathA;, yadA hi eko~api dhAtupAcako~agnirupahataH mAruto vA dhAtupoShakarasavAhI vyAnarUpaH kvacidupahato bhavati, tathA sroto vA dhAtupoShakarasavahamupahataM syAt, tadA ashitAdikaM dhAtUnAmavardhakatvAnnopacayAdikArakamiti bhAvaH| kevalamiti kRutsnaM sharIraM; kiMvA kevalamiti adharmarahitam, adharmayukte hi sharIre viphalamashitAdi bhavatIti| nanu sharIradhAtUnAM prakRutisthitAnAM svata evopacayAdyasti, tat kimashitAdinA kriyata ityAha- dhAtavo hItyAdi| dhAturAhAro yeShAM te dhAtvAhArAH; dhAtavo rasAdayo nityaM kShIyamANA ashitAdijanitadhAtvAhArA eva santaH paraM svAsthyamanuvartante, nAnyathetyarthaH||3||

28.sanskrit: tatrAhAraprasAdAkhyo rasaH kiTTaM ca malAkhyamabhinirvartate| kiTTAt svedamUtrapurIShavAtapittashleShmANaH karNAkShinAsikAsyalomakUpaprajananamalAH keshashmashrulomanakhAdayashcAvayavAH puShyanti| puShyanti tvAhArarasAdrasarudhiramAMsamedosthimajjashukraujAMsi pa~jcendriyadravyANi dhAtuprasAdasa~jj~jakAni sharIrasandhibandhapicchAdayashcAvayavAH| te sarva eva dhAtavo malAkhyAH prasAdAkhyAshca rasamalAbhyAM puShyantaH svaM mAnamanuvartante yathAvayaHsharIram| evaM rasamalau svapramANAvasthitAvAshrayasya samadhAtordhAtusAmyamanuvartayataH| nimittatastu kShINavRuddhAnAM prasAdAkhyAnAM dhAtUnAM vRuddhikShayAbhyAmAhAramUlAbhyAM rasaH sAmyamutpAdayatyArogyAya, kiTTaM ca malAnAmevameva| svamAnAtiriktAH punarutsargiNaH shItoShNaparyAyaguNaishcopacaryamANA malAH sharIra dhAtusAmyakarAH samupalabhyante||4||
28.commentary: yo~asau dhAtUnAmAhArastamAha- tatretyAdi| tatreti ashitAdau| rasaH kiTTaM cAbhinivartata ityanvayaH| AhAraprasAda ityAkhyA yasya sa tathA; prasAdaH sAraH| kiTTam asArabhAgaH| kiTTAditi kiTTAMshAt ; tena annAdyaH kiTTAMshastato mUtrapurIShe bhavato vAyushca, rasAt pacyamAnAnmalaH kaphaH, evamAdi grahaNyadhyAye vakShyamANamanusartavyaM; vakShyati hi- “kiTTamannasya viNmUtraM rasasya tu kapho~asRujaH| pittaM mAMsasya khamalo malaH svedastu medasaH|| syAt kiTTaM keshalomAsthno majj~jaH sneho~akShiviT tvacAm” (ci. 15) iti| AdigrahaNAdakShisnehAdi grAhyam| yadyapi ca vAto~anashanAdapyupalabhyate, tathA~api rUkShakiTTAdibhojanamalAMshAdapyutpadyata eveti kiTTAdvAtotpattiryuktaiva; na cAyaM niyamo yanmalAdevotpadyata iti, vyAyAmAdavagAhAderapi ca vAtAdisadbhAvAt| prajananaM li~ggam| rasapoShyamAha- puShyanti tvityAdi| pa~jcendriyadravyANIti pRuthivyAdIni ghrANAdIndriyakAraNAni| dhAtuprasAdasa~jj~jakAnIti atyarthashuddhenaiva dhAtuprasAdenendriyANyArabhyanta iti darshayati| sharIraM badhnAtIti sharIrabandhaH snAyusirAdiH| AdigrahaNAdArtavastanyAdigrahaNam| atrAhArarasAd raktAdipoShaNe kecidbruvate- yat- raso raktarUpatayA pariNamati, raktaM ca mAMsarUpatayA, evaM mAMsAdayo~apyuttarottaradhAturUpatayA pariNamanti| atrApi ca pakShe kecidbruvate- kShIrAdyathA sarvAtmanA dadhi bhavati, tathA kRutsno raso raktaM bhavati; evaM raktAdayo~api mAMsAdirUpA bhavanti| anye tvAhuH- kedArIkulyAnyAyena rasasya dhAtupoShaNaM; tatrAnnAdutpanno raso dhAturUpaM rasamadhigamya kiyatA~apyaMshena taM rasaM vardhayati; aparashca rasarAshistatra gataH san shoNitagandhavarNayuktatvAcchoNitamiva bhUtvA kiyatA~api shoNitasamAnenAMshena dhAturUpaM shoNitaM puShNAti, sheShashca bhAgo mAMsaM yAti, tatrApi shoNitavadvyavasthA; tathA medaHprabhRutiShvapIti| ata eva ca mukhyArtho~ayaM grantho bhavati; yathA- “rasAdraktaM tato mAMsaM mAMsAnmedastato~asthi ca| asthno majjA tataH shukraM shukrAdgarbhaH prasAdajaH ” (ci. 15) iti; tathA hArIte~apyuktaM- “rasaH saptAhAdarvAk parivartamAnaH shvetakapotaharitahAridrapadmakiMshukAlaktakarasaprakhyashcAyaM yathAkramaM divasaparivartAdvarNaparivartamApadyamAnaH pittoShmoparAgAcchoNitatvamApadyate” iti; tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “sa khalvApyo rasa ekaikasmin dhAtau trINi trINi kalAsahasrANi pa~jcadasha ca kalA avatiShThate, evaM mAsena rasaH shukrIbhavati” (su. sU. 14) iti| anye tvAhuH- khalekapotanyAyenAyamannarasaH pRuthakpRuthagdhAtumArge gataH san rasAdIn poShayati, na tvasya dhAtupoShako rasabhAgo dhAtvantareNa samaM sambandhamapyanubhavati, rasAdipoShakANi srotAMsyuttarottaraM sUkShmamukhAni dIrghANi ca, tenaiva rasapoShakarasabhAgo rasamArgacAritvAdrasaM poShayati, evaM rasapoShaNakAlAduttarakAlaM (raktapoShakamArgacAritvAt ) raktapoShako rasabhAgo raktaM poShayati, tathA shoNitapoShaNakAlAduttarakAlaM mAMsapoShako rasabhAgo mAMsaM poShayati, vidUrasUkShmamArgacAritvAt; evaM medaHprabhRutipoShaNe~api j~jeyam| tena, “rasAdraktaM tato mAMsaM” ityAderayamarthaH- yat- rasapuShTikAlAduttarakAlaM raktaM jAyate, tathA raktapuShTikAlAduttarakAlaM mAMsaM prajAyate ityAdi| evaM sushrutahArItavacane api vyAkhyeye| yacca “raktaM vibaddhamArgatvAnmAMsAdInna prapadyate” (ci.a.8) iti rAjayakShmaNi vakShyati, taddhRudayacArishoNitAbhiprAyeNa, na tu poShakashoNitAbhiprAyeNa | ki~jca, pariNAmapakShe vRuShyaprayogasya raktAdirUpatApattikrameNAticireNa shukraM bhavatIti, kShIrAdayashca sadya eva vRuShyA dRushyante; khalekapotapakShe tu vRuShyotpanno rasaH prabhAvAcchIghrameva shukreNa sambaddhaH san tatpuShTiM karotIti yuktaM; tathA rasaduShTau satyAM pariNAmapakShe tajjanmanAM shoNitAdInAM sarveShAmeva duShTiH syAt, duShTakAraNajAtatvAt| khalekapotapakShe tu yaddhAtupoShako rasabhAgo duShTaH sa eva duShyati na sarve, taditareShAmaduShTakAraNatvAt; tathA medovRuddhau satyAM bhUrikAraNatvenAsthnA~api bhUyasA bhavitavyaM, dRushyate ca bhUrimedasa itaradhAtuparikShayaH; vacanaM ca- “medasvino meda evopacIyate, na tathetare dhAtavaH” (sU.a.21) iti; evamAdi pariNAmavAde dUShaNam| eShu ca pakSheShu sarvAtmapariNAmavAdo viruddha eva, yena sarvAtmapariNAme tricaturopavAsenaiva nIrasatvAccharIrasya maraNaM syAt, mAsopavAse ca kevalaM shukramayaM sharIraM syAt| kedArIkulyAnyAyastu tulyabala eva khalekapotanyAyena; yato yaduktaM vRuShyaprabhAvaM prati tat kedArIkulyApakShe~api prabhAvAdeva shIghraM raktAdidhAtUnabhigamya shukraM janayiShyati vRuShyaM, yathA khalekapotapakShe~api prabhavAditi| yattu rasaduShTau shoNitadUShaNaM; tanna bhavati, dhAtubhUtashoNitAMshapoShakasya rasabhAgasyAduShTatvAt; iti samAnaM pUrveNa| atrApi hi pakShe na sarvo raso dhAturUpashoNitatAmApadyate, kiM tarhi kashcideva shoNitasamAno bhAgaH; sheShastu shoNitasthAnagatatvena ki~jcicchoNitasamAnavarNAditvAcca shoNitamucyate; anena nyAyena medovRuddhau satyAmasthivRuddhirapi nirastA, yato na medasA asthi poShyate, api tarhi medaHsthAnagatenaiva rasena medonukAriNA| evamanayoH pakShayormahAjanAdRutatvena tulyanyAyatvena ca naikamapi nishcitaM brUmaH, buddhivibhavAnna pakShabalAbalam, atra na kashcit kAryavirodha ityuparamyate| nanvAhArarasAdrasAdayaH puShyantIti vadatA dhAturasAdAhArarasotpAdaH pRuthak svIkriyate, tatashca tasya kiM sthAnaM kiMvA pramANamiti kimiti noktam? ucyate- na tasyAhArotkarShApakarShAvevaMvidhau, utkarShApakarShasya nishcitapramANatvAbhAvAt; sthAnaM tu dhamanya eva| poShakAhArarasasya tasya ca pRuthagrasAdidhAtubhyaH pradeshAntaragrahaNaM na kriyate, rasAdikAraNarUpatayA rasAdigrahaNenaiva grahaNAt| atra yadyapyojaH saptadhAtusArarUpaM, tena dhAtugrahaNenaiva labhyate, tathA~api prANadhAraNakartRutvena pRuthak paThitaM; ye tu shukrajanyamoja icchanti, teShAmaShTamo dhAturojaH syAditi pakShe cAtideshaM kRutvA vakShyati- “rasAdInAM shukrAntAnAM yat paraM tejaH, tat khalvojaH” (su.sU.a.15) iti| upapAditapoShaNAnAM dhAtumalAnAM prakRutyanuvidhAnamupasaMharati- te sarva ityAdi| malAkhyA api svedamUtrAdayaH svamAnAvasthitA dehadhAraNAddhAtavo bhavantItyuktaM- dhAtavo malAkhyA iti| yathAvayaHsharIramiti yasmin vayasi bAlyAdau yAdRushaM mAnaM dhAtUnAM tAdRushaM puShyantaH, tathA yasmi~j sharIre prakRutyA dIrghe hrasve kRushe vA sthUle vA yAdRushaM mAnaM dhAtUnAM tAdRushaM puShyanta iti yojanA| evamityAdau svapramANAvasthitAviti anatiriktAvanyUnau ca| Ashrayasyeti sharIrasya; yathAvatpakvau sarvAshrayaM pashcAddhamanIbhiH prapadyete, sarvasharIramityarthaH| samadhAtoriti samarasAdeH samasvedamUtrAdeshca| nimittata ityAdi| nimittata ityanenAnimitte ariShTarUpe kShayavRuddhI nirAkaroti| vRuddhikShayAbhyAmAhAramUlAbhyAmiti yathAsa~gkhyaM vRuddhakShINAhArakRutAbhyAm, etenAhAravisheShakRutavRuddhikShayo rasaH sAmyaM karotItyarthaH | dhAtusAmyasyArogyatve siddhe~api yadArogyAyeti brUte tena prAkRutadhAtUnAM kShayeNa vA~ativRuddhyA vA sAmyaM nirAkaroti, asya sAmyasya rogakartRutvAdeva| kiTTaM ca malAnAmevameveti yathA rasastathA kiTTamapyArogyAya malAnAM sAmyaM pratipAditarasakrameNa karoti| vRuddhamalAnAM cikitsAntaramAha- svamAnetyAdi| utsargo bahirniHsaraNaM saMshodhanarUpameShAM shAstroktamasti, utsargaM vA vahantItyutsargiNaH | vRuddhAnAM malAnAM cikitsAntaramAha- shItoShNetyAdi| paryayaH viparyayaH; tena shItoShNaviparItaguNairityarthaH; tena, shItasamutthe male uShNaM tathoShNasamutthe shItamupacAro bhavati| AdishabdashcAtra luptanirdiShTaH; tena snigdharUkShAdInAmapi viparItaguNAnAM grahaNam| kiMvA paryayaguNA dvandvaguNAH snigdharUkShamRudutIkShNAdayaH, taishca yathAyogyatayopacaryamANA iti j~jeyam| etena, vRuddhamalAnAM trividho~apyupakramo nidAnavarjanashodhanashamanarUpa ukto bhavati; tatra nidAnavarjanaM vRuddhamale malavRuddhihetvAhAraparityAgAdalpamalAhAropayogAdvA boddhavyaM, saMshodhanaM ca utsargiNa ityanenoktaM, shamanaM ca shItoShNetyAdigranthenoktam||4||

28.sanskrit: teShAM tu malaprasAdAkhyAnAM dhAtUnAM srotAMsyayanamukhAni| tAni yathAvibhAgena yathAsvaM dhAtUnApUrayanti| evamidaM sharIramashitapItalIDhakhAditaprabhavam| ashitapItalIDhakhAditaprabhavAshcAsmi~j sharIre vyAdhayo bhavanti| hitAhitopayogavisheShAstvatra shubhAshubhavisheShakarA bhavantIti||5||
28.commentary: ayanAni ca tAni mukhAni cetyayanamukhAni, atra AyAntyanenetyayanAni mArgANi, mukhAni tu yaiH pravishanti; etena malAnAM dhAtUnAM ca yadevAyanaM tadeva praveshamukhamiti nAnyena pravesho nAnyena ca gamanamityuktaM bhavati| rasAdInAM yathAsvanAma srotomukhaM cAyanaM ca| kiMvA, ayanasya gamanasya mukhAni mArgANi; tena, ayanamukhAni gatimArgANItyarthaH| tAni ca srotAMsi malaprasAdapUritAni dhAtUn yathAsvamiti yadyasya poShyaM tacca tat pUrayati| yathAvibhAgeneti yasya dhAtoryo vibhAgaH pramANaM tenaiva pramANena pUrayati, tAdRukpramANAnyeva puShyanti, nAdhikanyUnAnItyarthaH| etacca prakRutisthAnAM karma, vikRutAnAM tu nyUnAtiriktadhAtukaraNamastyeveti boddhavyam| uktaM cAnyatra- “srotasA ca yathAsvena dhAtuH puShyati dhAtunA” (ci. 8) iti| upasaMharati- evamityAdi| kathamashitAderviruddhayoH sharIratadupaghAtakarogayorutpAda ityAha- hitAhitetyAdi| hitarUpo~ashitAdivisheShaH shubharUpavisheShakArakaH, ahitarUpastvashitAdivisheSho~ashubharUpavisheShakaro bhavati; tena naikarUpAt kAraNAdviruddhakAryodaya iti bhAvaH||5||

28.sanskrit: evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- dRushyante hi bhagavan! hitasamAkhyAtamapyAhAramupayu~jjAnA vyAdhimantashcAgadAshca, tathaivAhitasamAkhyAtam; evaM duShTe kathaM hitAhitopayogavisheShAtmakaM shubhAshubhavisheShamupalabhAmaha iti||6||
28.commentary: dRushyante hi bhagavannityAdau tathaivAhitasamAkhyAtamupayu~jjAnA vyAdhimantashcAgadAshceti sambandhaH| visheShAtmakamiti visheShodbhavam||6||

28.sanskrit: tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- na hitAhAropayoginAmagnivesha! tannimittA vyAdhayo jAyante, na ca kevalaM hitAhAropayogAdeva sarvavyAdhibhayamatikrAntaM bhavati, santi hyRute~apyahitAhAropayogAdanyA rogaprakRutayaH, tadyathA- kAlaviparyayaH, praj~jAparAdhaH, shabdasparsharUparasagandhAshcAsAtmyA iti| tAshca rogaprakRutayo rasAn samyagupayu~jjAnamapi puruShamashubhenopapAdayanti; tasmAddhitAhAropayogino~api dRushyante vyAdhimantaH| ahitAhAropayoginAM punaH kAraNato na sadyo doShavAn bhavatyapacAraH| na hi sarvANyapathyAni tulyadoShANi, na ca sarve doShAstulyabalAH, na ca sarvANi sharIrANi vyAdhikShamatve samarthAni bhavanti| tadeva hyapathyaM deshakAlasaMyogavIryapramANAtiyogAdbhUyastaramapathyaM sampadyate| sa eva doShaH saMsRuShTayonirviruddhopakramo gambhIrAnugatashcirasthitaH prANAyatanasamuttho marmopaghAtI kaShTatamaH kShiprakAritamashca sampadyate| sharIrANi cAtisthUlAnyatikRushAnyaniviShTamAMsashoNitAsthIni durbalAnyasAtmyAhAropacitAnyalpAhArANyalpasattvAni ca bhavantyavyAdhisahAni, viparItAni punarvyAdhisahAni| ebhyashcaivApathyAhAradoShasharIravisheShebhyo vyAdhayo mRudavo dAruNAH kShiprasamutthAshcirakAriNashca bhavanti| ta eva vAtapittashleShmANaH sthAnavisheShe prakupitA vyAdhivisheShAnabhinirvartayantyagnivesha!||7||
28.commentary: tannimittA iti hitAhAranimittAH| na kevalamiti na param| rogaprakRutaya iti rogakAraNAni| ahitAhAropayoginAmityAdi| kAraNata iti nimittAntarAt pratibandhakAt; tacca kAraNaM ‘tadeva hyapathyaM’ ityAdivakShyamANagranthaviparItaM boddhavyam| sadya iti tatkAlam| anenApathyasya rogajananaM prati kAlAntaravikArakartRutvaM prAyo bhavatIti darshayati; anyathA sadya ityanarthakaM syAt, kAlAntare~api doShAkartRutvAt| doShavAniti vyAdhijanakaH| apacAra iti ahitAhAropayogaH| ukte kAraNamAha- nahItyAdi| tulyadoShANIti tulyadoShakarANi| vyAdhikShamatvaM vyAdhibalavirodhitvaM vyAdhyutpAdapratibandhakatvamiti yAvat| tadevApathyatulyadoShatAdi vivRuNoti- tadevetyAdi| atra yadyapi prastutatvAdapathyapratibandhakAni kAraNAni vaktavyAni, tathA~api samAnanyAyatayA~apathyashaktivardhakAnyucyante| tatra deshAdInAM yogAditi anuguNadeshAdiyogAt; yathA- vrIhiH pittakartRutvenApathyaH, sa cAnUpadeshayogAdbhUyastaramapathyo bhavati, dhanvadeshe tu hInabalo bhavati; tathA sharatkAlasyAnuguNasya yogAdbalavAn bhavati, hemante durbalaH; saMyogAdyathA- sa vrIhirdadhiphANitAdiyukto balavAn , madhvAdiyuktashca durbalaH; vIryAdyathA- sa evoShNIkRuto balavAn, shItastu durbalaH; sa eva ca prAmANAtiyogAdbalI, hInamAtrastvabalaH; ityAdyanusartavyam| doShatulyabalatAmAha- sa eva doSha ityAdi| saMsRuShTA militA bahavo yonayaH kAraNAni yasya sa tathA, kiMvA saMsRuShTayoniriti anuguNadUShyaH; yathA- pittasya raktaM dUShyamAsAdya kaShTatvaM kShiprakAritvaM ca bhavati| viruddhopakramo yathA- pittaM mehArambhakaM, vacanaM hi- “pittamehAH sarva eva yApyAH, viruddhopakramatvAt” (ni.a.4) iti; viruddhatA copakramasyAtra yat pittaharaM madhurAdi tanmehapradhAnadUShyamedaso viruddhaM, medonuguNaM tu kaTvAdi pitte viruddhamiti| gambhIrAnugata iti gambhIramajjAdidhAtugataH; vacanaM hi- “tva~gmAMsAshrayamuttAnaM gambhIraM tvantarAshrayam” (ci.a.39) iti| cirasthita iti dehe cirakAlAvasthAnena kRutamUlatvAt kaShTasAdhyaH| prANAyatanasamuttha iti agre~adhyAye (sU.a.29) vakShyamANasha~gkhAdidashaprANAyatanAshrayI| marmopaghAtIti prANAyatanavyatiriktakShipratalahRudayAdimarmopaghAtakArI| marmaghAtitvenaiva marmavisheShaprANAyatanasamutthatve labdhe punastadvacanaM prANAyatanamarmAshrayiNo visheSheNa kaShTatvapratipAdanArtham| kaShTatama iti bahuduHkhakartRutvenAsAdhyatvena ca| kShiprakAritama iti AshuvikArakAritamaH| cakArAt saMsRuShTayonitvAdihetUnAmalpatvena kaShTa-kaShTatara-kShiprakAri-kShiprakAritarAdivisheShAshca bhavantIti darshayati; yathoktasarvahetumelake kaShTatamaH kShiprakAritamashca bhavatIti j~jeyaM, kaShTatamatvAdi ca yathAyogyatayA j~jeyaM; viruddhopakramo doShaH kaShTa eva bhavati na kShiprakArI| vyAdhyakShamasharIrANyAha- sharIrANi cetyAdi| aniviShTAni shlathAni mAMsAdIni yeShAM sharIrANAM tAni tathA; kiMvA, aniviShTAnIti viShamANi| upacitAnIti saMvardhitAni; asAtmyapuShTaM hi sharIraM bhUridoShabhAvitameva bhavatIti bhAvaH| viparItAnIti anatisthUlatvAdiyuktAni| vyAdhisahAnIti vyAdhyutpAdakapratibandhakAni| etacca sharIramadhikRutya vaiparItyaM vyAdhisahatve udAharaNArthamupanyastaM, tena yathoktApathyabalavaiparItyaM doShabalavaiparItyaM ca na sadyo vyAdhikArakaM bhavatItyetadapyuktaM boddhavyam| etadevApathyAhAradoShasharIrANAmevAbalavattvabalavattvAbhyAM lakShaNavisheShaM yathAyogyatayA mRudvAdivyAdhikAraNatvenopasaMharannAha- ebhyashcaivetyAdi| visheShA yathoktA uktaviparItAshca; tatroktaviparItavisheShAnmRudavastathA cirakAriNashca bhavanti, yathoktApathyAdivisheShAttu dAruNAH kShiprakAriNashca bhavantIti mantavyam| anena prasa~ggena vAtAdInAM rasAdisthAnavisheSheShu kupitAnAM ye vyAdhayo bhavanti tAn darshayitumAha- ta evetyAdi||7||

28.sanskrit: tatra rasAdiShu sthAneShu prakupitAnAM doShANAM yasmin sthAne ye ye vyAdhayaH sambhavanti tAMstAn yathAvadanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||8||
28.commentary: tatra rasetyAdau prakupitAnAM doShANAmiti aniyamena rase kupito vAyurvA pittaM vA shleShmA vA saMsRuShTA vA ashraddhAdIni kurvanti| satyapi doShabhede~atrAshrayasyAbhedAdAshrayaprabhAveNaivAshraddhAdayo bhavanti, paraM doShabhede ashraddhAdAveva vAtAdili~ggaM vishiShTaM bhavati| kiMvA yathAyogyatayA rasAshrayiNA vAtAdinA ashraddhAdikaraNaM boddhavyaM, yato na gauravaM vAtaduShTarase bhavitumarhati; etacca nAtisundaraM, tena pUrva eva pakSho jyAyAn||8||

28.sanskrit: ashraddhA cArucishcAsyavairasyamarasaj~jatA| hRullAso gauravaM tandrA sA~ggamardo jvarastamaH ||9|| pANDutvaM srotasAM rodhaH klaibyaM sAdaH kRushA~ggatA| nAsho~agnerayathAkAlaM valayaH palitAni ca||10|| rasapradoShajA rogA,...|11|
28.commentary: ashraddhAyAM mukhapraviShTasyAhArasyAbhyavaharaNaM bhavatyeva paraM tvanicchA , arucau tu mukhapraviShTaM nAbhyavaharatIti bhedaH| Asyavairasyam ucitAdAsyarasAdanyathAtvam | arasaj~jatA rasApratipattiH| sAdaH a~ggAvasAdaH||9-10||-

28.sanskrit: ...vakShyante raktadoShajAH| kuShThavIsarpapiDakA raktapittamasRugdaraH||11|| gudameDhrAsyapAkashca plIhA gulmo~atha vidradhiH| nIlikA kAmalA vya~ggaH pipplavastilakAlakAH||12|| dadrushcarmadalaM shvitraM pAmA koThAsramaNDalam| raktapradoShAjjAyante,...|14|
28.commentary: raktapradoShajeShu kuShThagrahaNAdeva dadrvAdilAbhe siddhe punastadvacanaM visheShaprAdurbhAvapradarshanArtham| tilakAlakAH tilAkRutayaH| asramaNDalaM lohitamaNDalam||11-12||-

28.sanskrit: ...shRuNu mAMsapradoShajAn||13|| adhimAMsArbudaM kIlaM galashAlUkashuNDike| pUtimAMsAlajIgaNDagaNDamAlopajihvikAH||14|| vidyAnmAMsAshrayAn,...|15|
28.commentary: kIlashabdenAtrArsha ucyate||13-14||-

28.sanskrit: ... medaHsaMshrayAMstu pracakShmahe| ninditAni pramehANAM pUrvarUpANi yAni ca||15||
28.commentary: ninditAni pramehapUrvarUpANIti keshajaTilatvAdIni, teShAmeva ninditatvAt; natvAsyavairasyamadhuratvAdIni| kiMvA, ninditAnIti atisthUlagatAnyAyurhrAsAdInyaShTauninditIyoktAni, teShAM ca ninditatvaM ninditAtisthUlasambaddhatvena| evaM pUrvasmin vyAkhyAne ‘yAni ca’ iti cakAro niyame, uttaravyAkhyAne tu samuccaye||15||

28.sanskrit: adhyasthidantau dantAsthibhedashUlaM vivarNatA| keshalomanakhashmashrudoShAshcAsthipradoShajAH||16||
28.commentary: adhyasthidantashabdena adhyasthyadhidantayorgrahaNam| shUlamiti asthishUlameva boddhavyam||16||

28.sanskrit: ruk parvaNAM bhramo mUrcchA darshanaM tamasastathA| aruShAM sthUlamUlAnAM parvajAnAM ca darshanam||17|| majjapradoShAt, ...|18|
28.commentary: rugityAdi majjadoShAjj~jeyam| aruMShIti vraNAni||17||-

28.sanskrit: ...shukrasya doShAt klaibyamaharShaNam| rogi vA klIbamalpAyurvirUpaM vA prajAyate||18|| na cAsya jAyate garbhaH patati prasravatyapi| shukraM hi duShTaM sApatyaM sadAraM bAdhate naram||19||
28.commentary: klaibyamiti dhvajAnucchrAyaH| aharShaNaM ca satyapi dhvajotthAne maithunAshaktiH | shukraM hi duShTaM sApatyaM sadAraM bAdhate naramiti atrApatyabAdhA rogiklIbAdyapatyajanakatvena, dArabAdhA tu srAvigarbhAdijanakatvena||18-19||

28.sanskrit: indriyANi samAshritya prakupyanti yadA malAH| upaghAtopatApAbhyAM yojayantIndriyANi te||20||
28.commentary: upaghAtetyAdau upaghAto vinAshaH, upatApastu ki~jcidvaikalyam||20||

28.sanskrit: snAyau sirAkaNDarAbhyo duShTAH klishnanti mAnavam| stambhasa~gkocakhallIbhirgranthisphuraNasuptibhiH||21||
28.commentary: kaNDArAbhya iti saptamyarthe pa~jcamI| khallI karapadAvamoTanam| granthiH snAyvAdigranthireva||21||

28.sanskrit: malAnAshritya kupitA bhedashoShapradUShaNam| doShA malAnAM kurvanti sa~ggotsargAvatIva ca||22||
28.commentary: malAnityAdau bhedashoShapradUShaNamiti yathAsambhavaM j~jeyaM; tatra bhedaH purIShasya, shoShastu visheSheNa sarvamaleShu sambhavati, pradUShaNaM tu praduShTavarNAdiyuktatvena prAkRutavarNAdyupaghAtaH| sa~ggotsargAvatIva ceti atIva sa~ggaH apravRuttiH, atyutsargastu atipravRuttiH||22||

28.sanskrit: vividhAdashitAt pItAdahitAllIDhakhAditAt| bhavantyete manuShyANAM vikArA ya udAhRutAH||23|| teShAmicchannanutpattiM seveta matimAn sadA| hitAnyevAshitAdIni na syustajjAstathA~a~amayAH||24|| rasajAnAM vikArANAM sarvaM la~gghanamauShadham| vidhishoNitike~adhyAye raktajAnAM bhiShagjitam||25|| mAMsajAnAM tu saMshuddhiH shastrakShArAgnikarma ca| aShTauninditike~adhyAye medojAnAM cikitsitam||26|| asthyAshrayANAM vyAdhInAM pa~jcakarmANi bheShajam| bastyaH kShIrasarpIMShi tiktakopahitAni ca||27|| majjashukrasamutthAnAmauShadhaM svAdutiktakam| annaM vyavAyavyAyAmau shuddhiH kAle ca mAtrayA||28|| shAntirindriyajAnAM tu trimarmIye pravakShyate| snAyvAdijAnAM prashamo vakShyate vAtarogike||29|| navegAndhAraNe~adhyAye cikitsAsa~ggrahaH kRutaH| malajAnAM vikArANAM siddhishcoktA kvacitkvacit||30||
28.commentary: sampratyahitAhArajanitAn doShAn darshayan yathAkartavyamupadishati- vividhAdityAdi| bhiShagjitam ‘uktam’ iti sheShaH| pa~jcakarmANItyabhidhAyApi bastaya iti vacanaM tiktopahitabastervisheSheNa hitatvopadarshanArtham| shuddhiriti vamanAdinA| siddhiH proktA kvaciditi atIsAragrahaNyAdau||23-30||

28.sanskrit: vyAyAmAdUShmaNastaikShNyAddhitasyAnavacAraNAt| koShThAcchAkhA malA yAnti drutatvAnmArutasya ca||31|| tatrasthAshca vilambante kadAcinna samIritAH| nAdeshakAle kupyanti bhUyo hetupratIkShiNaH||32||
28.commentary: samprati rasAdInAM shAkhArUpatvAt koShThAshrayiNo doShA yathA shAkhAM yAnti tadAha- vyAyAmetyAdi| tatra vyAyAmakShobhAt koShThaM parityajya shAkhAM malA yAnti, UShmaNo vahnestIkShNatvAdvilAyitA doShAH shAkhAM yAnti, hitasyAnavacAraNayA~ahitasevayA~atisevayA~atimAtravRuddho doSho jalApUravadvRuddhaH svasthAnamAplAvya sthAnAntaraM yAtIti yuktam| drutatvAnmArutasyeti calatvAdvAyorvAyunA kShipto yAtItyarthaH; vAyvantareNa ca vAyorAkShepaNamupapannameveti, anyathA malA iti bahuvacanamasAdhu| atha shAkhAgatAH kiM kurvantItyAha- tatrasthAshcetyAdi| vilambante kadAciditi kadAcidvyAdhikaraNe vilambaM kurvanti| kuto vilambanta ityAha- na samIritAH| ye doShA alpatvenAbalavantaste hetvantareNa samIritAH santaH kupyanti; tathA ta eva nAdesha ityananuguNadeshe, tathA nAkAla ityananuguNakAle kupyantIti yojanA| atraiva hetumAha- bhUya ityAdi| yasmAdbhUyo hetupratIkShiNaste~alpabalA doShAstasmAdIraNAdyapekShante; etena bhUyo ye~ahetupratIkShiNo bhavanti balavattvAnna te IraNAdyapekShante, ata evoktaM kadAciditi||31-32||

28.sanskrit: vRuddhyA viShyandanAt pAkAt srotomukhavishodhanAt| shAkhA muktvA malAH koShThaM yAnti vAyoshca nigrahAt||33||
28.commentary: samprati shAkhAbhyaH koShThAgamanahetuM doShANAmAha- vRuddhyetyAdi| viShyandanAditi vilayanAt, vilInashca dravatvAdeva koShThe nimnaM yAti| pAkAditi pakvo doSho~abaddhatvenaiva nimnaM koShThaM yAti | srotomukhavishodhanAditi avarodhakApagamAt| vAyornigrahAditi kShepturvAyornigrahAt prAkRutaM sthAnaM koShThaM yAti||33||

28.sanskrit: ajAtAnAmanutpattau jAtAnAM vinivRuttaye| rogANAM yo vidhirdRuShTaH sukhArthI taM samAcaret||34|| sukhArthAH sarvabhUtAnAM matAH sarvAH pravRuttayaH| j~jAnAj~jAnavisheShAttu mArgAmArgapravRuttayaH||35||
28.commentary: idAnIM sa~gkShepeNAkhilavyAdhipratIkAraM sUtrayati- ajAtAnAmityAdi | yo vidhirdRuShTa iti kRutsne tantre| nanu, yadi sukhArthA sarvaprANinAM pravRuttistatkathaM ko~api amArge pravartata ityAha- j~jAnetyAdi| aj~jAnAdeva sukhasAdhanamidamiti kRutvA aparIkShakAH pravartante, na tu duHkhakartRutAsandhAnAditi bhAvaH||34-35||

28.sanskrit: hitamevAnurudhyante praparIkShya parIkShakAH| rajomohAvRutAtmAnaH priyameva tu laukikAH||36|| shrutaM buddhiH smRutirdAkShyaM dhRutirhitaniShevaNam| vAgvishuddhiH shamo dhairyamAshrayanti parIkShakam||37|| laukikaM nAshrayantyete guNA moharajaHshritam | tanmUlA bahavo yanti rogAH shArIramAnasAH||38||
28.commentary: hitameveti Ayativishuddhameva tadAtve duHkhakaramapi| priyameveti tadAtve sukhakaramAyativiruddham| laukikA aparIkShakAH| parIkShakaM stauti- shrutamityAdi| parIkShakamAshrayantIti parIkShake bhavanti; kiMvA, buddhyAdidevatAH parIkShakamAshrayante, yaduktaM- “vivishurj~jAnadevatAH” (sU. 1) iti| tanmUlA iti rajastamomUlAH||36-38||

28.sanskrit: praj~jAparAdhAddhyahitAnarthAn pa~jca niShevate| sandhArayati vegAMshca sevate sAhasAni ca||39|| tadAtvasukhasa~jj~jeShu bhAveShvaj~jo~anurajyate| rajyate na tu vij~jAtA vij~jAne hyamalIkRute||40||
28.commentary: yathA aparIkShake rajastamomUlA rogA bhavanti tadAha- praj~jAparAdhAdityAdi| ahitArthasevAdi ca rogaM karotIti bhAvaH| tadAtvasukheShviti vaktavye, yat ‘sukhasa~jj~jeShu’ iti karoti, tattadAtvasukhasyApathyasya duHkhAnubandhasukhakartRutayA paramArthatastadAtve~apyasukhatvaM darshayati; yathA ‘sukhasa~jj~jakamArogyaM’ (sU.a.9) ityatroktam| vij~jAteti parIkShakaH||39-40||

28.sanskrit: na rAgAnnApyavij~jAnAdAhArAnupayojayet| parIkShya hitamashnIyAddeho hyAhArasambhavaH||41||
28.commentary: na rAgAdityAdi| ahitatvena jAnannapi rAgAdeva kashcidduShTaH pravartate, aj~jAnAccAhitatvAj~jAnAdeva kashciddhitAdhyavasAyena pravartate; etaddvayamapi niShidhyate||41||

28.sanskrit: AhArasya vidhAvaShTau visheShA hetusa~jj~jakAH| shubhAshubhasamutpattau tAn parIkShya prayojayet||42||
28.commentary: kathamAhAraH parIkShya ityAha- AhArasyetyAdi| AhArasya vidhau vidhAne~aShTau visheShAH prakRutikaraNasaMyogAdayo rasavimAne (vi.a.1) vaktavyA hetusa~jj~jakAH; kva hetusa~jj~jakA ityAha- shubhetyAdi| shubhAshubhasamutpattau iti te ca prakRutyAdayaH shubhAH shubhakarAH, ashubhA ashubhakarAH, iti j~jeyam||42||

28.sanskrit: parihAryANyapathyAni sadA pariharannaraH| bhavatyanRuNatAM prAptaH sAdhUnAmiha paNDitaH||43|| yattu rogasamutthAnamashakyamiha kenacit| parihartuM na tat prApya shocitavyaM manIShibhiH||44||
28.commentary: nanu pathyasevAyAM kriyamANAyAmapi balavatprAktanAdharmavashAdapi vyAdhayo bhavanti, tat kimanena pathyasevanenetyAha- parihAryANItyAdi| anRuNatAmiva prApto~anRuNatAM prAptaH; etena parihAryaparihAreNa puruShakAre~anaparAdhaH puruSho bhavatIti darshayati| yastu daivAgatastasya vyAdhistatra sAdhavo naivaM pathyasevinaM garhayanti, etadevAha- yattvityAdi| ashakyaM parihartumiti balavatkarmajanyatvAdityarthaH| na shocitavyamiti puruShakArasya daivajanye~avashyambhAvini vyAdhAvaki~jcitkaratvAdityarthaH||43-44||

28.sanskrit: tatra shlokAH- AhArasambhavaM vastu rogAshcAhArasambhavAH| hitAhitavisheShAcca visheShaH sukhaduHkhayoH||45|| sahatve cAsahatve ca duHkhAnAM dehasattvayoH | visheSho rogasa~gghAshca dhAtujA ye pRuthakpRuthak||46|| teShAM caiva prashamanaM koShThAcchAkhA upetya ca| doShA yathA prakupyanti shAkhAbhyaH koShThametya ca||47|| prAj~jAj~jayorvisheShashca svasthAturahitaM ca yat| vividhAshitapItIye tat sarvaM samprakAshitam||48||
28.commentary: sa~ggrahe vastviti sharIram| sahatve cAsahatve cetyAdinA sharIrANi cAtisthUlAni ityAdi ‘viparItAni punarvyAdhisahAni’ ityantaM granthaM j~jApayati||45-48||

28.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute sUtrasthAne vividhAshitapItIyo nAmAShTAviMsho~adhyAyaH||28|| ityannapAnacatuShkaH||7||
28.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyavyAkhyAyAM sUtrasthAne annapAnacatuShke vividhAshitapItIyo nAmAShTAviMsho~adhyAyaH||28||

29.sanskrit: athAto dashaprANAyatanIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
29.commentary: sampratyadhyAyadvaye~avashiShTe vaktavye pUrvAdhyAye ‘prANAyatanasamutthaH’ iti prANAyatanashabdakIrtanAddashaprANAyatanIya ucyate; kiMvA, ayaM dashaprANAyatanIyaH sUtrasthAnopasa~ggrahaH, sheShAdhyAyastu sarvatantrasa~ggraha iti pashcAducyate| iyamapyarthaparA sa~jj~jA, na shabdAnukAriNI| AyatanAnIva AyatanAni, tadupaghAte prANopaghAtAt, tannAshe ca prANanAshAdityarthaH| na prANasya jIvitAkhyasya sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogarUpasya sha~gkhAdaya eva paramAshayAH, tasya kRutsnasharIrAdyAshrayatvAt||1-2||

29.sanskrit: dashaivAyatanAnyAhuH prANA yeShu pratiShThitAH | sha~gkhau marmatrayaM kaNTho raktaM shukraujasI gudam||3|| tAnIndriyANi vij~jAnaM cetanAhetumAmayAn| jAnIte yaH sa vai vidvAn prANAbhisara ucyate||4||
29.commentary: marmatrayamiti hRudayabastishirAMsi| tAnIti sha~gkhAdIni| vij~jAnaM buddhiH | cetanAhetuH AtmA, cetanAsamavAyikAraNatvAt; kiMvA cetanAshabdenAtmA, hetushabdena tu vyAdhInAM janako heturnidAnarUpastathA shamako heturbheShajarUpa ucyate; Amayashabdena ca li~ggamucyate| tena, AdhyAtmikAnIndriyAdIni bAhyAni ca hetuli~ggauShadhAni yo jAnIta ityuktaM bhavati; etAvaccaitacchAstraM yat- AdhyAtmikAnIndriyANi tathA hetuli~ggauShadhAni ca| prANAbhisarA mahAcatuShpAde uktAH||3-4||

29.sanskrit: dvividhAstu khalu bhiShajo bhavantyagnivesha! prANAnAmeke~abhisarA hantAro rogANAM, rogANAmeke~abhisarA hantAraH prANAnAmiti||5||
29.commentary: sarvacikitsAyA vaidyAdhInatvena yAdRusho vaidya upAdeyo yAdRushashcAnupAdeyastaddarshanakaushalAt sUtrasthAnArthasa~ggrahaM darshayati- dvividhA ityAdi| rogANAmabhisarA iti rogANAmAnetAraH||5||

29.sanskrit: evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- bhagavaMste kathamasmAbhirveditavyA bhaveyuriti||6|| bhagavAnuvAca- ya ime kulInAH paryavadAtashrutAH paridRuShTakarmANo dakShAH shucayo jitahastA jitAtmAnaH sarvopakaraNavantaH sarvendriyopapannAH prakRutij~jAH pratipattij~jAshca te j~jeyAH prANAnAmabhisarA hantAro rogANAM; tathAvidhA hi kevale sharIraj~jAne sharIrAbhinirvRuttij~jAne prakRutivikAraj~jAne ca niHsaMshayAH, sukhasAdhyakRucchrasAdhyayApyapratyAkhyeyAnAM ca rogANAM samutthAnapUrvarUpali~ggavedanopashayavisheShaj~jAne vyapagatasandehAH, trividhasyAyurvedasUtrasya sasa~ggrahavyAkaraNasya satrividhauShadhagrAmasya pravaktAraH , pa~jcatriMshato mUlaphalAnAM caturNAM ca snehAnAM pa~jcAnAM ca lavaNAnAmaShTAnAM ca mUtrANAmaShTAnAM ca kShIrANAM kShIratvagvRukShANAM ca ShaNNAM shirovirecanAdeshca pa~jcakarmAshrayasyauShadhagaNasyAShTAviMshateshca yavAgUnAM dvAtriMshatashcUrNapradehAnAM ShaNNaM ca virecanashatAnAM pa~jcAnAM ca kaShAyashatAnAM prayoktAraH, svasthavRuttavihitabhojanapAnaniyamasthAnaca~gkramaNashayanAsanamAtrAdravyA~jjanadhUmanAvanAbhya~jjana- parimArjanavegAvidhAraNavidhAraNavyAyAmasAtmyendriyaparIkShopakramaNasadvRuttakushalAH , catuShpAdopagRuhIte ca bheShaje ShoDashakale savinishcaye satriparyeShaNe savAtakalAkalaj~jAne vyapagatasandehAH, caturvidhasya ca snehasya caturviMshatyupanayasyopakalpanIyasya catuHShaShTiparyantasya ca vyavasthApayitAraH, bahuvidhavidhAnayuktAnAM ca snehyasvedyavamyavirecyavividhauShadhopacArANAM ca kushalAH, shirorogAderdoShAMshavikalpajasya ca vyAdhisa~ggrahasya sakShayapiDakAvidradhestrayANAM ca shophAnAM bahuvidhashophAnubandhAnAmaShTacatvAriMshatashca rogAdhikaraNAnAM catvAriMshaduttarasya ca nAnAtmajasya vyAdhishatasya tathA vigarhitAtisthUlAtikRushAnAM sahetulakShaNopakramANAM svapnasya ca hitAhitasyAsvapnAtisvapnasya ca sahetUpakramasya ShaNNAM ca la~gghanAdInAmupakramANAM santarpaNApatarpaNajAnAM ca rogANAM sarUpaprashamanAnAM shoNitajAnAM ca vyAdhInAM madamUrcchAyasannyAsAnAM ca sakAraNarUpauShadhopacArANAM kushalAH, kushalAshcAhAravidhivinishcayasya prakRutyA hitAhitAnAmAhAravikArANAmagryasa~ggrahasyAsavAnAM ca caturashIterdravyaguNakarmavinishcayasya rasAnurasasaMshrayasya savikalpavairodhikasya dvAdashavargAshrayasya cAnnapAnasya saguNaprabhAvasya sAnupAnaguNasya navavidhasyArthasa~ggrahasyAhAragateshca hitAhitopayogavisheShAtmakasya ca shubhAshubhavisheShasya dhAtvAshrayANAM ca rogANAM sauShadhasa~ggrahANAM dashAnAM ca prANAyatanAnAM yaM ca vakShyAmyarthedashamahAmUlIye triMshattamAdhyAye tatra ca kRutsnasya tantroddeshalakShaNasya tantrasya ca grahaNadhAraNavij~jAnaprayogakarmakAryakAlakartRukaraNakushalAH , kushalAshca smRutimatishAstrayuktij~jAnasyAtmanaH shIlaguNairavisaMvAdanena ca sampAdanena sarvaprANiShu cetaso maitrasya mAtApitRubhrAtRubandhuvat, evaMyuktA bhavantyagnivesha! prANAnAmabhisarA hantAro rogANAmiti||7||
29.commentary: pratipattij~jA iti tadAtve kartavyaj~jAH| sharIrAbhinirvRuttij~jAnaM yathA sharIraM shukrashoNitasaMyogAdibhya upajAyate, tathA j~jAnam| prakRutivikAraj~jAnaM sA~gkhyanayena shArIre vakShyamANam| trividhasyAyurvedasUtrasyeti “hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnaM” (sU. 1) ityasya| itaH prabhRuti ca tantroddeshalakShaNasyetyantena sUtrasthAnArthasa~ggraho yathAkramamanusAraNIyaH| sasa~ggrahavyAkaraNasyeti “sAmAnyaM ca visheShaM ca” (sU. 1) ityAdinA dIrgha~jjIvitIye sa~ggrahaH, vyAkaraNaM ca “sAmAnyamekatvakaraM” (sU. 1) ityAdi| satriparyeShaNa iti eShaNAtrayayukte| navavidhasyeti “caraH sharIrAvayavAH” (sU. 27) ityAdeH| AhAragateriti “vividhamashitaM pItaM” (sU. 28) ityAdinA| tantroddeshalakShaNasyeti tatra tantroddeshaH “aShTau sthAnAni” (sU. 30) ityAdinA, tantralakShaNaM tu AyuSho vedasya ca yanniruktau lakShaNaM vakShyati| atra sthAnArthaj~jAnekaushalamabhidhAyAnyathApyAha- tantrasyetyAdi| gRuhItasyottarakAlasmaraNaM dhAraNaM, vij~jAnam arthato j~jAnaM, prayogaH cikitsAprayogaH, karma anekadhA cikitsAkaraNaM, kAryaM dhAtusAmyaM, kAlaH kriyAkAlaH, karteha bhiShak, karaNaM bheShajam| shAstrayuktiH shAstrayojanA| yuktij~jAnasyeti kushalayogAt karaNe ShaShThI| Atmana ityAdi|- AtmanaH shIlaguNaiH karaNabhUtaiH mAtRupitRubandhuvat sarvaprANiShu cetaso maitrasya sampAdanena tathA avisaMvAdanena ca kushalA iti granthasambandho boddhavyaH||6-7||

29.sanskrit: ato viparItA rogANAmabhisarA hantAraH prANAnAM, bhiShakchadmapraticchannAH kaNTakabhUtA lokasya pratirUpakasadharmANo rAj~jAM pramAdAccaranti rAShTrANi||8|| teShAmidaM visheShavij~jAnaM bhavati- atyarthaM vaidyaveshena shlAghamAnA vishikhAntaramanucaranti karmalobhAt, shrutvA ca kasyacidAturyamabhitaH paripatanti, saMshravaNe cAsyAtmano vaidyaguNAnuccairvadanti, yashcAsya vaidyaH pratikarma karoti tasya ca doShAnmuhurmuhurudAharanti, AturamitrANi ca praharShaNopajApopasevAdibhiricchantyAtmIkartuM, svalpecchutAM cAtmanaH khyApayanti, karma cAsAdya muhurmuhuravalokayanti dAkShyeNAj~jAnamAtmanaH pracchAdayitukAmAH, vyAdhiM cApAvartayitumashaknuvato vyAdhitamevAnupakaraNamaparicArakamanAtmavantamupadishanti , antagataM cainamabhisamIkShyAnyamAshrayanti deshamapadeshamAtmanaH kRutvA, prAkRutajanasannipAte cAtmanaH kaushalamakushalavadvarNayanti, adhIravacca dhairyamapavadanti dhIrANAM, vidvajjanasannipAtaM (cAbhisamIkShya) pratibhayamiva kAntAramadhvagAH pariharanti dUrAt, yashcaiShAM kashcit sUtrAvayavo bhavatyupayuktastamaprakRute prakRutAntare vA satatamudAharanti, na cAnuyogamicchantyanuyoktuM vA, mRutyoriva cAnuyogAdudvijante, na caiShAmAcAryaH shiShyaH sabrahmacArI vaivAdiko vA kashcit praj~jAyata iti||9||
29.commentary: bhiShakchadmacaro va~jcanArthakRutabhiShagveshaH| pratirUpakaH anyathArUpakArI drohakAraka (?) ityucyate loke | rAj~jAM pramAdAditi rAj~jA hi te kuvaidyAH shAsanIyAH| vishikhA rathyA, kiMvA karmamArgaH| saMshravaNe cAsyeti Aturasya shravaNayogye pradeshe| antagatamiti mumUrShum| apadeshaM vyAjam| akushalavaditi yathA akushalAH parasparaviruddhamAtmakaushalaM varNayanti tathetyarthaH| adhIravaditi uccATaravAH santaH| upayukta iti j~jAtaH| anuyogaM pRucchAm||8-9||

29.sanskrit: bhavanti cAtra- bhiShakchadma pravishyaivaM vyAdhitAMstarkayanti ye| vItaMsamiva saMshritya vane shAkuntikA dvijAn||10|| shrutadRuShTakriyAkAlamAtrAj~jAnabahiShkRutAH| varjanIyA hi te mRutyoshcarantyanucarA bhuvi||11|| vRuttihetorbhiSha~gmAnapUrNAn mUrkhavishAradAn| varjayedAturo vidvAn sarpAste pItamArutAH||12|| ye tu shAstravido dakShAH shucayaH karmakovidAH| jitahastA jitAtmAnastebhyo nityaM kRutaM namaH||13|| tatra shlokaH- dashaprANAyatanike shlokasthAnArthasa~ggrahaH| dvividhA bhiShajashcoktAH prANasyAyatanAni ca||14||
29.commentary: vItaMsaH pakShibandhanam| shrutaM shAstre shravaNam| dRuShTaM karmadarshanam| kriyA cikitsAj~jAnaM, j~jAnaM shAstrajanyaM, shrutaM tu shravaNamAtram| tebhyo nityaM kRutaM nama ityanena prANAbhisaraM stauti||10-14||

29.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute shlokasthAne dashaprANAyatanIyo nAmonatriMsho~adhyAyaH||29||
29.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM sUtrasthAne dashaprANAyatanIyo nAmaikonatriMsho~adhyAyaH||29||

30.sanskrit: athAto~arthedashamahAmUlIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
30.commentary: pArisheShyAt kiMvA sUtrasthAnamabhidhAya tantrasa~ggrahaM vaktumarthedashamahAmUlIya ucyate| atra ‘adhikRutya kRute granthe’ (pA. a. 4/3/87) ityanuvartamAne “adhyAyAnuvAkayorluk ca” (pA. a. 5/2/60) iti cchaH||1-2||

30.sanskrit: arthe dasha mahAmUlAH samAsaktA mahAphalAH| mahaccArthashca hRudayaM paryAyairucyate budhaiH||3|| ShaDa~ggama~ggaM vij~jAnamindriyANyarthapa~jcakam| AtmA ca saguNashcetashcintyaM ca hRudi saMshritam||4||
30.commentary: arthe iti hRudaye, mahAmUlA iti mahaddhRudayaM mUlaM yAsAM dhamanInAM tAstathA, samAsaktA ityAshritAH| tasya hRudayasya paryAyAnAha- mahaccetyAdi| mahatsa~jj~jA tathA arthasa~jj~jA ca hRudayasya vaidyavyavahArasiddhA na sarvatra shAstrAntareShu| hRudayasya yathA yanmahattvaM yathA vA arthyamAnatvenArthatvaM taddhRudayasyAbhyarhitatvAt| abhyarhitatvamAha- ShaDa~ggamityAdi| ShaDa~ggAni bAhudvayaja~gghAdvayashirontarAdhirUpANi yasya tat ShaDa~ggama~ggam| a~ggaM ca ShaDa~ggAdatiriktaM samudAyarUpamavayavirUpaM vA| a~ggamiti vaktavye ShaDa~ggavisheShaNaM ShaNNAma~ggAnAmapi hRudayAshritatvapratipAdanArthaM; kiMvA, a~ggashabdasyAvayavavAcino niShedhArtham| vij~jAnaM ca yadyapi ‘AtmA ca saguNaH’ iti vacanAdeva AtmaguNatvena labdhaM, tathA~apyAtmaguNeShu prAdhAnyAt punaH pRuthagucyate; vacanaM hi “sukhaM samagraM vij~jAnaM visarge ca pratiShThitam” iti| indriyANi cakShurAdIni pa~jca| arthapa~jcakaM shabdAdi| saguNa ityanena sukhAdigrahaNam| cetaH manaH| cintyaM manoviShayaH| ete ca ShaDa~ggavij~jAnAdayaH prati prati paThitAH pratyekamevopAdeyatvena; tenAtra kasyacidarthalabdhatvenopAdAnaM kartavyamiti nodbhAvanIyam, arthalabdho hyarthaH sAkShAdanabhidhIyamAnatvAdapradhAnaM bhavati||3-4||

30.sanskrit: pratiShThArthaM hi bhAvAnAmeShAM hRudayamiShyate| gopAnasInAmAgArakarNikevArthacintakaiH||5|| tasyopaghAtAnmUrcchAyaM bhedAnmaraNamRucchati|6|
30.commentary: atha kathamamI ShaDa~ggAdayo hRudayAshrayAH, yAvatA “hRudayaM dvya~ggulaM” (vi. 8) iti vakShyati, a~ggaM ca ShaDa~ggAshrayaM mahat, indriyANyapi ca svAshraya cakShurAdisthitAni, arthAshca bAhyadravyAshrayiNaH, AtmA cAnAshrita eva vyApakaH, tadguNashca vij~jAnamAtmanyevAshritaM, mano~apyanAshritamAtmagataM, cintyaM ca dhyeyAdi na hRudi, ityAsha~gkyAha- pratiShThetyAdi|- pratiShThA kAryakaraNAvirodhenAvasthAnam | bhAvAnAmeShAmiti ShaDa~ggAdInAm| hRudayamiShyate ‘kAraNam’ iti sheShaH| atraiva dRuShTAntamAha gopAnasInAmityAdi| gopAnasyaH gRuhAcchAdanAdhArakAShThAni | AgArakarNikA gRuhAcchAdanamadhye gRuhAcchAdanakAShThanibandhanI loke ‘ADakam’ ityucyate| arthacintakairiti hRudayacintakaiH| tena, ShaDa~ggAdInAM hRudayAshritatvaM nAdhArAdheyabhAvena, kiM tarhi tadanvayavyatirekAnuvidhAyitveneti darshitaM bhavati| hRudayAshritatvaM hRudaye prakRutisthe ShaDa~ggAdibhAvAnAM prakRutisthatvaM, hRudayopaghAte tadupaghAta ityarthaH| yadyapi ca, Atmavij~jAnamanasAM hRudayAshritatvamAdhArAdheyabhAvAdapi kaShTasRuShTyA pAryate vaktuM, tathA~api sarvavyApakatvAnnopAdeyamAdhAradheyatvam| naivam, AtmA hyatra saMsArI bhogAyatanatvenAbhipretaH, sa ca hRudayapradesha eva sukhaduHkhAdyupalabhata ityanubhavasiddhaM, tena hRudayAshrita ivAtmA| tathA mano~api prAyeNa hRudyeva tiShThati, yata uparatakriyaM mano hRudyeva tiShThati, tathA dhyAne yoge ca hRudisthameva mano bhavati| yadapyuktam- “Atmasthe manasi sthire” (shA. 1) iti, tadapyAtmasthatvaM manaso hRudayasthatvameva| evaM j~jAnasukhaduHkhAni ca hRudayasthAnyeva lakShyante, tathA hyaticintanAttathA duHkhAveshAdvA hRudayameva pIDyate, nAnyada~ggam| bhavatvanenAvyApakenAshrayAshrayibhAvena vyutpAditena | tameva hRudayopaghAte ShaDa~ggAdibhAvopaghAtamAha- tasyopaghAtAdityAdi| tasyeti hRudayasya| upaghAtaH ki~jcidupahananam| bhedAditi mahopaghAtAt| maraNaM ca ShaDa~ggAdInAM sarveShAmeva yathoktapratiShThAnAsha iti bhAvaH||5||-

30.sanskrit: yaddhi tat sparshavij~jAnaM dhAri tattatra saMshritam||6|| tat parasyaujasaH sthAnaM tatra caitanyasa~ggrahaH| hRudayaM mahadarthashca tasmAduktaM cikitsakaiH ||7||
30.commentary: kathametadbhavatItyAha- yaddhItyAdi| sparsho vij~jAyate~aneneti sparshaM vA vijAnAtIti sparshavij~jAnaM; tasyaiva visheShaNaM- dhArIti, dhAri tu sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogaH; yaduktaM- “sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogo dhAri jIvitam” (sU. 1) iti; etena yaH sharIrAdisaMyogaH sparshanena vijAnAti sarvaM j~jeyaM, yashcAyaM sharIradhAraNAddhArItyucyate, sa hRudi sthitaH| tena, tadupaghAtAnmUrcchA tathA tadbhedAnmaraNaM caitanyAnanuvRuttilakShaNamupapannam| sparsho hi dvividha aindriyako mAnasashca, etatsparshadvayaM vinA na ki~jcijj~jAnaM bhavati; yaduktaM- “yashcaivaindriyakaH sparshaH sparsho mAnasa eva ca| dvividhaH sukhaduHkhAnAM vedanAnAM pravartakaH” (shA. 1) iti| mAnasaM ca sparshanaM shArIre yathAsthAnameva darshayiShyAmaH| sparsho vij~jAyata iti niruktipakShe tu sparshashabdena lakShaNayA spRushyamAno~artho~abhipretaH, tena sarvaj~jeyAvarodhaH; yaM prApyaivArthamindriyANi sparshenArthaM prakAshayanti, yaduktaM- “spRushyate nAnupAdAno nA~aspRuShTo vetti vedanAH” (shA. 1) iti| yadyapi sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogaH sharIrapradeshAntare~apyasti, tathA~api nAsau sharIradhAraNe tathA j~jAnotpattau vA pradhAnaM, tadupaghAte~api sharIradhAraNaj~jAnayordRuShTatvAt; hRudgatastu saMyogaH pradhAnaM, tadanvayavyatirekAnuvidhAyitvAt sparshaj~jAnasharIradhAraNayoH; tena sUktaM- tattatra saMshritamiti| hRudayAbhyarhitatve dharmAntaramAha- tat parasyetyAdi| parasya shreShThasya| etena dvividhamojo darshayati- paramaparaM ca; tatrA~jjaliparimANamaparaM, yaduktaM- “tAvadeva parimANaM shlaiShmikasyaujasaH” (shA. 7) iti; alpapramANaM tu paraM, yadabhipretyoktaM- “hRudi tiShThati yacchuddhaM raktamIShatsapItakam” (sU. 17) iti, tantrAntare~apyuktaM- “prANAshrayasyaujaso~aShTau bindavo hRudayAshritAH” iti; ki~jca, sati hi pare cApare caujasi ‘parasya’ iti visheShaNaM sArthakaM bhavati, natvekarUpe| ardhA~jjaliparimitasyaujaso dhamanya eva hRudayAshritAH sthAnam| tathA pramehe~ardhA~jjaliparimitamevaujaH kShIyate nAShTabindukam, asya hi ki~jcitkShaye~api maraNaM bhavati; pramehe tu ojaHkShaye jIvatyeva tAvat; ojaHkShayalakShaNamapyardhA~jjalyojaHkShaya eva boddhavyam| ojaHshabdashca yadyapi rase~api vartate, yaduktaM- “rasashcaujasa~gkhyAtaH” (ni. 4) iti, tathA “malIbhavati tat prAyaH kalpate ki~jcidojase” (ci. 8) iti; tathA~apIha sarvadhAtusAramojo~abhidhIyate| etaccauja upadhAturUpaM kecidAhuH; dhAturhi dhAraNapoShaNayogAdbhavati, ojastu dehadhArakaM sadapi na dehapoShakaM, tena nAShTamo dhAturojaH| kecittu shukravisheShamojaH prAhuH, tacca na manaH prINAti| ye tu bruvate- sarvadhAtUnAM sArasamudayabhUtamojaH, te rasAdisArarUpatayA rasAdibhyo~abhinnamoja iti pRuthagdhAtutvenopadhAtutvena vA na nirdeshyamiti pashyanti; vacanaM ca- “bhramaraiH phalapuShpebhyo yathA sa~jcIyate madhu| tadvadojaH sharIrebhyo guNaiH sambhriyate nRuNAm” (sU. 17) iti; atra sharIrebhya iti dhAtubhyaH, guNairiti sArabhAgaiH| tatra caitanyasa~ggraha iti tatra hRudi AtmA caitanyasya svaviShaye prasRutasya sa~ggrahaNaM karoti, tena prasRutaM mano hRudaye nigRuhya yogaj~jo bhavatyAtmetyuktaM bhavati; tatashca yogasya mokShasAdhanatvenopAdeyasyApi hRudayameva sthAnamiti hRudayamabhyarhitaM bhavati| yasmAdeva~gguNaM hRudayam, ato hRudayaM ‘mahad’ iti ca, tathA ‘artha’ iti cocyate cikitsakaiH||6-7||

30.sanskrit: tena mUlena mahatA mahAmUlA matA dasha| ojovahAH sharIre~asmin vidhamyante samantataH||8||
30.commentary: samprati dhamanInAM mahAmUlatvaM pratipAdayati- tenetyAdi| teneti hRudayena mahatA, ‘yuktAH’ iti sheShaH| vidhamyante visarpante ||8||

30.sanskrit: yenaujasA vartayanti prINitAH sarvadehinaH | yadRute sarvabhUtAnAM jIvitaM nAvatiShThate||9|| yat sAramAdau garbhasya yattadgarbharasAdrasaH | saMvartamAnaM hRudayaM samAvishati yat purA ||10|| yasya nAshAttu nAsho~asti dhAri yaddhRudayAshritam | yaccharIrarasasnehaH prANA yatra pratiShThitAH||11|| tatphalA bahudhA vA tAH phalantIva(ti) mahAphalAH|12|
30.commentary: samprati dhamanInAmuktaM mahAphalatvaM vyutpAdayannAha- yenaujasetyAdi| yenaujaseti sAmAnyena dvividhamapyojo grAhyam| vartayanti jIvanti, vartayantIti caurAdiko Nic| prINitA iti tarpitAH| yat sAramAdau garbhasyeti shukrashoNitasaMyoge jIvAdhiShThitamAtre yat sArabhUtaM, tatrApi tiShThati| yattadgarbharasAdrasa iti garbharasAcchukrashoNitasaMyogapariNAmena kalalarUpAt, rasa iti sArabhUtam| saMvartamAnaM hRudayaM samAvishati yat pureti yadA hRudayaM niShpadyamAnaM, tadaiva vyaktalakShaNaM saddhRudayamadhitiShThati yadityarthaH| etena, garbhAvasthAtraye~api tadojastiShThatItyucyate; paraM garbhAdau shukrashoNitasArarUpatayA, kalalAvasthAyAM tu rasasArarUpatayA, avayavaniShpattau tu svalakShaNayuktameva bhavatyoja ityojasaH sarvAvasthAvyApakatvena mahattvamucyate| yasya nAshAttu nAsho~astIti dhAtvantarAkShaye~api satyojaHkShaye maraNamityarthaH| dhArIti jIvadhArakasaMyogibhyaH pradhAnatvAt| sharIrarasasneha iti sharIrasArasAraM; rasashabdaH snehashabdashca sAravacanaH, tena sharIrarasAnAM dhAtUnAmapi sAra ityarthaH| etacca prakArAntareNAbhyarhitAnekakarmakathanamojaso~abhyarhitatvakhyAtyartham| tatphalA ojaHphalA ojovahA iti yAvat| etena, yathoktaguNashAlitvenaujo mahat; etadvahanena phalantIveti mahAphalA dhamanya uktAH| dvitIyAM niruktimAha- bahudhA vA tAH phalantIti, ‘tA hRudayAshritA dasha dhamanyo bahudhA anekaprakAraM phalantIti’ niShpadyante; etena, mUle hRudaye dasharUpAH satyo mahAsa~gkhyAH sharIre pratAnabhedAdbhavantItyuktam||9-11||-

30.sanskrit: dhmAnAddhamanyaH sravaNAt srotAMsi saraNAtsirAH||12||
30.commentary: dhamanIshabdAdiniruktimAha- dhmAnAdityAdi| dhmAnAt pUraNAd vAhyena rasAdinetyarthaH| sravaNAditi rasAdereva poShyasya sravaNAt| saraNAd deshAntaragamanAt||12||

30.sanskrit: tanmahat tA mahAmUlAstaccojaH parirakShatA| parihAryA visheSheNa manaso duHkhahetavaH||13|| hRudyaM yat syAdyadaujasyaM srotasAM yat prasAdanam| tattat sevyaM prayatnena prashamo j~jAnameva ca||14||
30.commentary: samprati hRudisthasya manasaH paripAlanahetumAha- tanmahadityAdi| tanmahaditi ShaDa~ggAdisthAnaM hRudayam| tA mahAmUlA iti ojovahA dhamanyaH| taccauja iti yenaujasetyAdinoktaguNamojaH| prashamaH shAntiH| j~jAnaM tattvaj~jAnam||13-14||

30.sanskrit: atha khalvekaM prANavardhanAnAmutkRuShTatamamekaM balavardhanAnAmekaM bRuMhaNAnAmekaM nandanAnAmekaM harShaNAnAmekamayanAnAmiti | tatrAhiMsA prANinAM prANavardhanAnAmutkRuShTatamaM, vIryaM balavardhanAnAM, vidyA bRuMhaNAnAm, indriyajayo nandanAnAM, tattvAvabodho harShaNAnAM, brahmacaryamayanAnAmiti ; evamAyurvedavido manyante||15||
30.commentary: sevyaprastAvena prANavardhanAdyutkRuShTAnyahiMsAdInyapyAha- atha khalvityAdi| ekamiti ekameva, na dvitIyamutkRuShTatamamastItyarthaH| ayanAnAmiti mArgANAm| yadyapyannaM prANavardhanaM tathA~apyahiMsaivotkRuShTA, ahiMsayA hi dharmajananAttatkRutamavicAlyaM bhavati| yadyapi mAMsaM bRuMhaNapradhAnaM, tathA~api taccharIramAtrabRuMhaNaM, vidyA tu sharIramanobRuMhaNIyA~atiricyate||15||

30.sanskrit: tatrAyurvedavidastantrasthAnAdhyAyaprashnAnAM pRuthaktvena vAkyasho vAkyArthasho~arthAvayavashashca pravaktAro mantavyAH| tatrAha- kathaM tantrAdIni vAkyasho vAkyArthasho~arthAvayavashashcoktAni bhavantIti||16|| atrocyate- tantramArShaM kArtsnyena yathAmnAyamucyamAnaM vAkyasho bhavatyuktam||17|| buddhyA samyaganupravishyArthatattvaM vAgbhirvyAsasamAsapratij~jAhetUdAharaNopanayanigamanayuktAbhistrividhashiShyabuddhigamyAbhirucyamAnaM vAkyArthasho bhavatyuktam||18|| tantraniyatAnAmarthadurgANAM punarvibhAvanairuktamarthAvayavasho bhavatyuktam||19||
30.commentary: AyurvedashravaNaprasa~ggenAyurvedaniruktyA~a~ayuShastathA~a~ayurvedasya ca nirUpakaM prakaraNaM brUte- tatretyAdi| vAkyasha ityAdi svayameva vyAkariShyati| ArSham RuShikRutam| tantraM shAstram| yathAmnAyamucyamAnamiti yathApAThakrameNocyamAnam| udAharaNaM dRuShTAntaH; upanayaH siddhAntopapAditasya sAdhanadharmasya sAdhye punaH kathanaM, yathA- tathA cAyaM dhUmavAniti; nigamanaM hetusAdhitasAdhyadharmakathanaM, yathA- tasmAdagnimAniti| tantraniyatAnAmiti tantragatAnAm| vibhAvanairuktamiti vyAkhyAnaiH kathanam; uktamiti bhAve ‘ktaH’| asyodAharaNaM yathA- “sharIraceShTA yA ceShTA sthairyArthA balavardhinI” (sU. 7) ityatra ‘iShTA yA ceShTA’ ityetAvanmAtramucyate, tena dvitIyaceShTApadasya durgasya vyAkaraNaM paraM bhavati||16-19||

30.sanskrit: tatra cet praShTAraH syuH- caturNAmRuksAmayajuratharvavedAnAM kaM vedamupadishantyAyurvedavidaH?, kimAyuH?, kasmAdAyurvedaH?, kimarthamAyurvedaH?, shAshvato~ashAshvato vA?, kati kAni cAsyA~ggAni?, kaishcAyamadhyetavyaH?, kimarthaM ca? iti||20||
30.commentary: idAnImAyurvedavidaH prashnenaiva nirNetavyA ityataH prashnAnAha- tatra cedityAdi| kaM vedamupadishanti ‘Ayurvedam’ iti sheShaH||20||

30.sanskrit: tatra bhiShajA pRuShTenaivaM caturNAmRuksAmayajuratharvavedAnAmAtmano~atharvavede bhaktirAdeshyA, vedo hyAtharvaNo dAnasvastyayanabalima~ggalahomaniyamaprAyashcittopavAsamantrAdiparigrahAccikitsAM prAha; cikitsA cAyuSho hitAyopadishyate||21||
30.commentary: atharvavede bhaktiH sevetyarthaH; etena bhiShaksevyatvenAtharvavedasyAyurvedatvamuktaM bhavati| AyurvedasyAtharvavedAbhedahetumAhavedo hItyAdi| etenaikaprayojanatvAdatharvavedaikadesha evAyurveda ityuktaM bhavati||21||

30.sanskrit: vedaM copadishyAyurvAcyaM ; tatrAyushcetanAnuvRuttirjIvitamanubandho dhAri cetyeko~arthaH||22||
30.commentary: prashnakrameNa vedaM pratipAdyAyureva pratipAdanIyaM bhavatItyAha- vedaM copadishyetyAdi| cetanAnuvRuttiriti caitanyasantAnaH; etacca garbhAvadhimaraNaparyantaM boddhavyaM, tadUrdhvaM cetanAnanuvRutteH; sAkShAdanupalabdhatvenaivAnanuvRuttiriti bhAvaH| na ca vAcyaM prasuptasya caitanyavicchedo bhavatIti, yatastatrApi ‘sukhamahamasvApsam’ ityuttarakAlInapratisandhAnadarshanAt sUkShmaj~jAnamastyeva| yadyapi dIrgha~jjIvitIye sharIrAdisaMyoga AyurityuktaM, tathA~api tatkAryatvAdiha caitanyAnuvRuttiH kAryakAraNayorabhedavivakShayA Ayurucyate| anubandhadhArishabdau prathamAdhyAye vyAkRutau||22||

30.sanskrit: tadAyurvedayatItyAyurvedaH ; kathamiti cet? ucyate- svalakShaNataH sukhAsukhato hitAhitataH pramANApramANatashca; yatashcAyuShyANyanAyuShyANi ca dravyaguNakarmANi vedayatyato~apyAyurvedaH| tatrAyuShyANyanAyuShyANi ca dravyaguNakarmANi kevalenopadekShyante tantreNa||23||
30.commentary: kasmAdAyurvedaH? ityasyottaraM- tadAyurityAdi| vedayati bodhayati| ye tvatra tantrAntare viderlAbhAdayo~arthA vyAkhyAtAH, te na sAkShAttadarthajanyA itIha noktAH| svalakShaNata ityAdi svamayevodAhariShyati| AyuShyAnAyuShye AyuHkAraNatvena AyuHshabdena vaktavye, tenAyuShyAnAyuShyavedapakShe gauNI niruktiH ‘AyurvedaH’ iti; ata evAtra apishabdaH kRutaH- ato~apyAyurveda iti| anAyuShyamapi ca j~jAtamasevyatvenAvyavahriyamANamAyuH kAraNaM bhavatyeva, tenAnAyuShyamapyAyuHkAraNatayA AyuHshabdavAcyaM, nAtrAparAdhaH||23||

30.sanskrit: tatrAyuruktaM svalakShaNato yathAvadihaiva pUrvAdhyAye ca| tatra shArIramAnasAbhyAM rogAbhyAmanabhidrutasya visheSheNa yauvanavataH samarthAnugatabalavIryayashaHpauruShaparAkramasya j~jAnavij~jAnendriyendriyArthabalasamudaye vartamAnasya paramarddhiruciravividhopabhogasya samRuddhasarvArambhasya yatheShTavicAriNaH sukhamAyurucyate; asukhamato viparyayeNa; hitaiShiNaH punarbhUtAnAM parasvAduparatasya satyavAdinaH shamaparasya parIkShyakAriNo~apramattasya trivargaM paraspareNAnupahatamupasevamAnasya pUjArhasampUjakasya j~jAnavij~jAnopashamashIlasya vRuddhopasevinaH suniyatarAgaroSherShyAmadamAnavegasya satataM vividhapradAnaparasya tapoj~jAnaprashamanityasyAdhyAtmavidastatparasya lokamimaM cAmuM cAvekShamANasya smRutimatimato hitamAyurucyate; ahitamato viparyayeNa||24||
30.commentary: ihaiveti ‘tatrAyushcetanAnuvRuttiH’ ityAdinA| tatra shArIretyAdinA sukhamAyurabhidhatte| pauruSham utkRuShTaM karma| j~jAnavij~jAnendriyairbalashabdaH, indriyArthena ca samudayashabdaH sambadhyate; kiMvA j~jAnAdibhiH sarvaireva samudayashabdaH sambadhyate; kiMvA j~jAnAdibhiH sarvaireva ‘balasamudaye’ iti yojyaM; balasya samudayo balasamudayaH| paramA atyarthA Ruddhiryasya sa paramarddhiH| samRuddhA niShpAditasAdhyAH sarvArambhA yasya sa tathA| hitaiShiNo bhUtAnAmiti sambandhaH| tatparasyeti adhyAtmaparasya, adhyAtmam AtmAdisvarUpam| amuM ceti paralokam||24||

30.sanskrit: pramANamAyuShastvarthendriyamanobuddhiceShTAdInAM vikRutilakShaNairupalabhyate~animittaiH, ayamasmAt kShaNAnmuhUrtAddivasAt tripa~jcasaptadashadvAdashAhAt pakShAnmAsAt ShaNmAsAt saMvatsarAdvA svabhAvamApatsyata iti; tatra svabhAvaH pravRutteruparamo maraNamanityatA nirodha ityeko~arthaH; ityAyuShaH pramANam; ato viparItamapramANamariShTAdhikAre; dehaprakRutilakShaNamadhikRutya copadiShTamAyuShaH pramANamAyurvede ||25|| prayojanaM cAsya svasthasya svAsthyarakShaNamAturasya vikAraprashamanaM ca||26||
30.commentary: vikRutirUpairlakShaNaiH vikRutilakShaNaiH; teShAmeva visheShaNam- animittaiH; AkasmikaiH ariShTairityarthaH; animittA hi vikRutirarthendriyANAmariShTam| tatrArthavikRutiryathA- “nAnApuShpopamagandho yasya vAti divAnisham” (iM. 2) ityAdi, indriyavikRutiryathA- “yashca pashyatyadRushyAn” (iM. 4) ityAdi, manovikRutiryathA- “yaiH purA vindate bhAvaiH sametaiH paramAM ratim| tairevAramamANasya glAsnormaraNamAdishet” (iM.a.8) iti, buddhivikRutiryathA- “buddhirbalamahetukam” ityAdi, ceShTAvikRutiryathA- “vikarShanniva yaH pAdau cyutAMsaH paridhAvati” (iM. 12) ityAdi| AdigrahaNAt parijanavikRutyAdayo j~jeyAH| atra ca riShTaprastAve kShaNAdivarShAntakAlakathanaM varShAdUrdhvaM riShTajanyamaraNAbhAvAt| ato viparItamapramANamiti riShTahInaM na nishcitapramANamAyurariShTAdhikAra ityarthaH| anyadapi cAyuHpramANaj~jAnamAhadehaprakRutItyAdi | dehashca prakRutishca lakShaNaM ca dehaprakRutilakShaNam| tatra dehamadhikRutyAyuHpramANaM yathA- “sarvaiH sArairupetAH” ityArabhya yAvat “cirajIvinashca bhavanti” (vi. 8) iti; prakRutito yathA- “shlaiShmikA balavanto vasumanto vidyAvanta ojasvinaH shAntA AyuShmantashca bhavanti” (vi. 8) iti; lakShaNato yathA- “tatremAnyAyuShmatAM kumArANAM lakShaNAni bhavanti” (shA. 8) ityAdi| kiMvA, dehasya sahajalakShaNaM dehaprakRutilakShaNaM, tacca sarvaM sAraprakRutyAdilakShaNaM boddhavyam||25-26||

30.sanskrit: so~ayamAyurvedaH shAshvato nirdishyate, anAditvAt, svabhAvasaMsiddhalakShaNatvAt, bhAvasvabhAvanityatvAcca| na hi nAbhUt kadAcidAyuShaH santAno buddhisantAno vA, shAshvatashcAyuSho veditA, anAdi ca sukhaduHkhaM sadravyahetulakShaNamaparAparayogAt| eSha cArthasa~ggraho vibhAvyate AyurvedalakShaNamiti| gurulaghushItoShNasnigdharUkShAdInAM dravyANAM sAmAnyavisheShAbhyAM vRuddhihrAsau, yathoktaM- gurubhirabhyasyamAnairgurUNAmupacayo bhavatyapacayo laghUnAM, evamevetareShAmiti, eSha bhAvasvabhAvo nityaH, svalakShaNaM ca dravyANAM pRuthivyAdInAM; santi tu dravyANi guNAshca nityAnityAH| na hyAyurvedasyAbhUtvotpattirupalabhyate, anyatrAvabodhopadeshAbhyAm; etadvai dvayamadhikRutyotpattimupadishantyeke| svAbhAvikaM cAsya lakShaNamakRutakaM, yaduktamihAdye~adhyAye ca; yathA- agnerauShNyam, apAM dravatvam| bhAvasvabhAvanityatvamapi cAsya, yathoktaM- gurubhirabhyasyamAnairgurUNAmupacayo bhavatyapacayo laghUnAmiti||27||
30.commentary: anAditvAditi hetutrayamatra| prathamasya vivaraNaM- na hItyAdi| iha vyavahAranityatvamAyurvede sAdhyaM, taccArtharUpasyAyurvedasya na shabdarUpasya; kiMvA, vyavahAranityAyurvedArthAbhidhAyakasyAyurvedasya pAramparyayogAnnityatvaM sAdhyate| tatrAyuShastAvadAyurvedapratipAdyasya nityatvam| na hi nAbhUt kadAcidAyuHsantAna iti sarvadaivAyuraparAparasantAnanyAyena vidyate, AyuryuktAnAM prANinAmanucchedAdityarthaH| evaM buddhisantAno~api nahi kadAcinnAbhUditi yojanA| etena tasyApi santAnena nityasyAyuSho vedanamapi nityam| shAshvatashcAyuSho vediteti anenAyurvedaveditRunityatvamuktam| etena vedyavedanaveditRUNAmanAditvAdAyurvedasya nityatvam| na cAyuHsvarUpeNaivAyurvedaviShayaH, kiM tarhi rogAdigRuhItamityAha- anAdi cetyAdi| sukhaduHkhamiti ArogyaM sukhaM, vyAdhirduHkham| sadravyahetulakShaNamiti sahetucikitsitali~ggama| hetushabdo hi dravyashabdenaiva vyAdhikAraNasyoktatvAt prashamahetumAha; kecittu ‘sahetulakShaNam’ iti paThanti, tatrApi hetushabdena janakaH shamakashca rogaheturvAcyaH; yadi vA sukhaheturbheShajaM duHkhahetushca nidAnamiti j~jeyaM, lakShaNaM ca vyAdhyArogyayorubhayorapi; etena duHkhaM tAvat kadAcidapyajihAsitaM na bhavati, jihAsitamanupAyaM na bhavati, upAyashcAyurveda eva, sa ca sarvaduHkhaparihArArthamupAdeyaH; tasmAdduHkhaprashamanopAyopadesharUpAyurvedasyAnAditeti bhAvaH| evaM sukhasya nityopAdeyasyAnAditvaM j~jeyaM, tadupAyasyAyurvedasya ca| kathamanAdi sukhaduHkhamityAha- aparAparayogAditi; santAnAdityarthaH| svabhAvasaMsiddhalakShaNatvaM dvitIyaM hetumAha- eva cetyAdi| eSha iti AyurbuddhiveditRusukhaduHkhAni| arthasa~ggrahaH abhidheyasa~ggrahaH; etena AyurAdirAyurvedapratipAdya iti darshayati| ayaM cAyurAdiratrAyurvedalakShaNamiti vibhAvyate j~jAyata ityarthaH| AyurAdinA~abhidheyenAyurvedo lakShyate, vacanaM hi- “hitAhitaM sukhaM duHkhaM” (su. 1) ityAdyAyurvedalakShaNam| etena, AyurAderarthasyAyurvedalakShaNasyAnAditayA yathoktayA svabhAvasaMsiddhalakShaNatvaM vyAkRutaM bhavati| svabhAvasaMsiddhamiti sarvadA santAnanyAyena siddhatvamabhipretam| bhAvasvabhAvanityatvAditi tRutIyaM hetuM vyAkaroti- gurvityAdi| gurulaghusnigdharUkShashItoShNAdInAM dravyANAM sAmAnyavisheShAbhyAM yathAkramaM vRuddhihrAsau bhavataH| tadeva pUrvoktaM ghaTayati- gurubhirityAdinA evamevetareShAmityantena| evamevetareShAmiti laghubhirabhyasyamAnairlaghUnAmupacayo bhavati, apacayo gurUNAmityAdi draShTavyam| eSha ityevamprakAraH; bhAvasvabhAvo nitya iti naiSha sAmAnyavisheShAbhyAM vRuddhihrAsarUpo bhAvasvabhAvaH kadAcidanyathA bhavatItyarthaH| na kevalamayaM bhAvasvabhAvo nityaH, kintarhyanyo~apItyAha- svalakShaNaM cetyAdi| svalakShaNaM pRuthivyAdInAM kharadravatvAdi| kathaM pRuthivyAdisvalakShaNaM nityamityAha- santi tvityAdi| dravyANi yasmAt sarvadA santi, guNAshca nityAH santi sarvadA, cakArAddravyANi cAnityAni santi| tatrAkAshAdi dravyaM nityaM, pRuthivyAdi kAryaM cAnityam| eva~gguNA AkAshaparimANAdayo nityAH, anityAshra kAryaguNA rasAdayaH, anityA api ca sajAtIyAparAparasantAnanyAyena sarvadA tiShThantIti yuktamanityAnAmapi santAnanityatvamiti bhAvaH| atra bhAvasvabhAvanityatvena hetunA bhAvasvabhAvasya vyAdhijanakasya tathA vyAdhiprashamakasya nityatvena tatpratipAdakasyAyurvedasyApi nityatvamuktaM bhavatIti mantavyam| athAyurvedasya yatra tatrotpattishravaNAt kathaM nityatvamityAha- na hyAyurvedasyetyAdi| abhUtvotpattiH pUrvamasata utpattiH| anyatrAvabodhopadeshAbhyAmiti yatra yatrAyurvedasyotpattiruktA, tatra tatrAvabodhAdupadeshAdvA; avabodhAdutpattiryathA- brahmaNa AyurvedotpattiH, upadeshAccotpattiryathA- indropadeshAdbharadvAjena martyaloke Ayurveda utpAdita ityAdi| etaddvayamiti avabodhopadeshau | nanu, svabhAvasaMsiddhalakShaNatvAditi yo heturuktaH, tatra svAbhAvikaM ca lakShaNaM bhaviShyatyanityaM ca, yathA- ghaTe kambugrIvAkAratAdi, na hi tat svAbhAvikamapi ghaTasya nityatAM sAdhayatItyAha- svAbhAvikaM cetyAdi| akRutakamiti nAsmadAdinA kRutam| yaduktamiha- ‘svalakShaNataH sukhAsukhataH’ ityAdinA, Adye cAdhyAye dIrgha~jjIvitIye “hitAhitaM sukhaM duHkhaM” (sU. 1) ityAdinA| atraivAkRutakatve dRuShTAntamAha- yathA~agnerauShNyamityAdi| etena svalakShaNasyAkRutakatvena vyavahAranityatvAttatpratipAdakasyAyurvedasyApi vyavahAranityatvamiti bhAvaH| na kevalaM svAbhAvikaM lakShaNamakRutakaM, kiM tarhi bhAvasvabhAvanityatvamapi na kenacidIshvarAdinA kRutamityAha- bhAvasvabhAvanityatvamapi ceti;
