7.commentary: eShAmityAdau shubhaphalA visheShA ashubhaphalAshca parasparopakArakA bhavantIti j~jeyam| tatra prakRutyA lAghavAdiH shubhaphalaH, gurvAdishcAshubhaphalaH| karaNAdyAdheyo~api visheShaH shAstroktaH shubhaH, niShiddhastvashubhaH| deshAsAtmyaM ninditadeshabhavatvAdi ca dravyasyAshubhaphalam| evaM kAlAsAtmyamashubhaphalaM cAjIrNabhojanAdi, tathA okAsAtmyaM cAshubhamashubhaphalamiti j~jeyaM; viparItaM tu shubhaphalam| mohAditi aj~jAnAt, pramAdAditi j~jAtvA~api rAgAdityarthaH| priyamiti tadAtvamAtrapriyam| ahitamityasya vivaraNam- asukhodarkamiti|- asukhaM duHkharUpam, udarka uttarakAlInaM phalaM, yasya sa tathA| anyadveti bheShajavihArAdi||23||

7.sanskrit: tatredamAhAravidhividhAnamarogANAmAturANAM cApi keShA~jcit kAle prakRutyaiva hitatamaM bhu~jjAnAnAM bhavati- uShNaM, snigdhaM, mAtrAvat, jIrNe vIryAviruddham, iShTe deshe, iShTasarvopakaraNaM, nAtidrutaM, nAtivilambitam, ajalpan, ahasan, tanmanA bhu~jjIta, AtmAnamabhisamIkShya samyak||24||
7.commentary: tatretyAdau idamiti vakShyamANam| AhAravidhirvidhIyate yenoShNasnigdhAdinA vakShyamANena tadAhAravidhividhAnam| AturANAM ca keShA~jciditi padena raktapittinAM shItameva, kapharogiNAM rUkShameva hitamityAdiviparyayaM darshayati| keShA~jcidbhu~jjAnAnAmidamAhAravidhividhAnaM hitatamaM bhavatIti yojanA| prakRutyaiveti svabhAvenaiva hitatamaM hitatamamityuktaM; tena yat prakRutyA hitaM tat kadAcideva ka~jcideva puruShamAsAdyAhitaM bhavati, tacca kAdAcitkatvAdanAdRutaM; tena prAyikatvAdenaM hitatamaM vakShyAma iti bhAvaH| uShNamityAdau samyagiti chedaH|| 24||

7.sanskrit: tasya sAdguNyamupadekShyAmaH- uShNamashnIyAt; uShNaM hi bhujyamAnaM svadate, bhuktaM cAgnimaudaryamudIrayati, kShipraM jarAM gacchati, vAtamanulomayati, shleShmANaM ca parihrAsasayati ; tasmAduShNamashnIyAt (1)|25| snigdhamashnIyAt; snigdhaM hi bhujyamAnaM svadate, bhuktaM cAnudIrNamagnimudIrayati , kShipraM jarAM gacchati, vAtamanulomayati, sharIramupacinoti, dRuDhIkarotIndriyANi, balAbhivRuddhimupajanayati, varNaprasAdaM cAbhinirvartayati; tasmAt snigdhamashnIyAt (2)|25|
7.commentary: tasyeti uShNAdiguNayuktasyAnnasya| sAdguNyamiti prashastaguNayogitAm| parihrAsayatIti bhinnasa~gghAtaM karoti||25(1-2)||

7.sanskrit: mAtrAvadashnIyAt; mAtrAvaddhi bhuktaM vAtapittakaphAnapIDayadAyureva vivardhayati kevalaM, sukhaM gudamanuparyeti, na coShmANamupahanti, avyathaM ca paripAkameti; tasmAnmAtrAvadashnIyAt (3)|25|
7.commentary: mAtrAvaditi prashaMsAyAM matup; tena prashastamAtramityarthaH| apIDayaditi anatimAtratvena svasthAnasthitaM sadvAtAdIn sthAnApIDanAdaprakopayat| gudamanuparyetIti pariNataM sadanurUpatayA niHsaratItyarthaH| UShmANaM vahnim||25(3)||

7.sanskrit: jIrNe~ashnIyAt; ajIrNe hi bhu~jjAnasyAbhyavahRutamAhArajAtaM pUrvasyAhArasya rasamapariNatamuttareNAhArarasenopasRujat sarvAn doShAn prakopayatyAshu, jIrNe tu bhu~jjAnasya svasthAnastheShu doSheShvagnau codIrNe jAtAyAM ca bubhukShAyAM vivRuteShu ca srotasAM mukheShu vishuddhe codgAre hRudaye vishuddhe vAtAnulomye visRuShTeShu ca vAtamUtrapurIShavegeShvabhyavahRutamAhArajAtaM sarvasharIradhAtUnapradUShayadAyurevAbhivardhayati kevalaM; tasmAjjIrNe~ashnIyAt (4)|25|
7.commentary: pUrvasyeti dinAntarakRutasya| apariNatamiti asamyagjAtam| AhAraraseneti AhArapariNAmagatena madhurAdinA; kiMvA AhArajena rasena| svasthAnastheShu doSheShvityAdi jIrNAhArasya lakShaNam||25(4)||

7.sanskrit: vIryAviruddhamashnIyAt; aviruddhavIryamashnan hi viruddhavIryAhArajairvikArairnopasRujyate; tasmAdvIryAviruddhamashnIyAt (5)|25|
7.commentary: viruddhavIryAhArajairiti kuShThAndhyavisarpAdyairAtreyabhadrakApyIyoktaiH||25(5)||

7.sanskrit: iShTe deshe iShTasarvopakaraNaM cAshnIyAt; iShTe hi deshe bhu~jjAno nAniShTadeshajairmanovighAtakarairbhAvairmanovighAtaM prApnoti, tathaiveShTaiH sarvopakaraNaiH; tasmAdiShTe deshe tatheShTasarvopakaraNaM cAshnIyAt (6)|25|
7.commentary: manovighAtakarairbhAvairiti trividhakukShIye (vi.a.2) vakShyamANaiH kAmAdibhishcittopatApakaraishcittavikArairityarthaH| tatheShTaishca sarvopakaraNairbhu~jjAno manovighAtaM na prApnotIti yojanA; aniShTabhojanAdermanovighAto bhavati||25(6)||

7.sanskrit: nAtidrutamashnIyAt; atidrutaM hi bhu~jjAnasyotsnehanamavasAdanaM bhojanasyApratiShThAnaM ca, bhojyadoShasAdgaNyopalabdhishca na niyatA; tasmAnnAtidrutamashnIyAt (7)|25|
7.commentary: utsnehanam unmArgagamanam| avasadanam avasAdaH| apratiShThAnaM hRudayasthatvena koShThApraveshaH| bhojyagatAnAM doShANAM keshAdInAM, sAdguNyasya ca svAdutvAdeH, upalabdhirna niyatA bhavati kadAcidupalabhyate kadAcinneti| tatra doShAnupalabdhyA sadoShasyaiva bhakShaNaM, sAdguNyAnupalabdhyA ca prItyabhAvaH||25(7)||

7.sanskrit: nAtivilambitamashnIyAt; ativilambitaM hi bhu~jjAno na tRuptimadhigacchati, bahu bhu~gkte, shItIbhavatyAhArajAtaM, viShamaM ca pacyate; tasmAnnAtivilambitamashnIyAt (8)|25|
7.commentary: viShamaM ca pacyata iti cirakAlabhojanenAgnisambandhasya vaiShamyAditi bhAvaH||25(8)||

7.sanskrit: ajalpannahasan tanmanA bhu~jjIta; jalpato hasato~anyamanaso vA bhu~jjAnasya ta eva hi doShA bhavanti, ya evAtidrutamashnataH; tasmAdajalpannahasaMstanmanA bhu~jjIta (9)|25|
7.commentary: ya evAtidrutamashnato doShA iti utsnehanAdayaH||25(9)||

7.sanskrit: AtmAnamabhisamIkShya bhu~jjIta samyak; idaM mamopashete idaM nopasheta ityevaM viditaM hyasyAtmana AtmasAtmyaM bhavati; tasmAdAtmAnamabhisamIkShya bhu~jjIta samyagiti||25||
7.commentary: nopasheta itItyatra itishabdena sAtmyAsAtmyavidhAnopadarshakena vicAraphalamokasAtmyasevanaM darshayati| Atmana iti padenAtmanaivAtmasAtmyaM pratipuruShaM j~jAyate, na shAstropadesheneti darshayati||25||

7.sanskrit: bhavati cAtra- rasAn dravyANi doShAMshca vikArAMshca prabhAvataH| veda yo deshakAlau ca sharIraM ca sa no bhiShak||26||
7.commentary: adhyAyoktarasaprabhAvAdij~jAnaM stauti- rasAnityAdi| sa no bhiShagiti no~asmAkaM sammata ityarthaH||26||

7.sanskrit: tatra shlokau- vimAnArtho rasadravyadoSharogAH prabhAvataH| dravyANi nAtisevyAni trividhaM sAtmyameva ca||27|| AhArAyatanAnyaShTau bhojyasAdguNyameva ca| vimAne rasasa~gkhyAte sarvametat prakAshitam||28||
7.commentary: doShavikArau ca yadyapi trividhakukShIye (vi.a.2) prabhAvavistAreNa vaktavyau, tathA~apIha sa~gkShepeNoktAveva; tena doShavikAraprabhAvAvapyuktAviti yaducyate sa~ggrahe tat sAdhu| tailAdidravyatrayakathanaM ca dravyaprabhAvagRuhItamiti kRutvA na pRuthak sa~ggrahe paThitam||27-28||

7.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute vimAnasthAne rasavimAnaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
7.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM vimAnasthAne rasavimAnaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||

8.sanskrit: athAto rasavimAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1|| iti ha smAha bhagavAnAtreyaH||2||
8.commentary: nidAne j~jAtahetvAdipa~jcakasya cikitsopayogitayA doShabheShajAdivisheShaj~jAnamapekShitaM bhavati, ato vakShyamANadoShabheShajAdivisheShaj~jApakaM vimAnasthAnaM brUte| tatrApi ca doShabheShajayoH prAdhAnyAttadvisheShaj~jApakaM rasavimAnaM prathamaM brUte| imaM ca sthAnasambandhaM svayameva darshayiShyati| visheSheNa mIyate j~jAyate doShabheShajAdyaneneti vimAnaM, doShabheShajAdInAM prabhAvAdivisheSha ityarthaH; evambhUtaM vimAnamabhidheyatayA yatra tiShThati tadvimAnasthAnam| rasavimAnamadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyo rasavimAnam||1-2||

8.sanskrit: iha khalu vyAdhInAM nimittapUrvarUparUpopashayasa~gkhyAprAdhAnyavidhivikalpa balakAlavisheShAnanupravishyAnantaraM doShabheShajadeshakAlabalasharIrasArAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutivayasAM mAnamavahitamanasA yathAvajj~jeyaM bhavati bhiShajA, doShAdimAnaj~jAnAyattatvAt kriyAyAH| na hyamAnaj~jo doShAdInAM bhiShag vyAdhinigrahasamartho bhavati| tasmAddoShAdimAnaj~jAnArthaM vimAnasthAnamupadekShyAmo~agnivesha!||3||
8.commentary: iha khalvityAdinA sthAnasambandhamAha| iha samprAptibhedasa~gkhyAprAdhAnyAdigrahaNenaiva samprAptimupadishan sa~gkhyAdibhedena sarvaiva samprAptiH kathitA bhavatIti darshayati| nimittAdInAM tu na tAdRusho bhedo~alpagranthavaktavyo~asti, yena bhedena te~apIha kathyeran, ataste sAmAnyenaivoktAH| anupravishyeti buddhvA | doShAdayaH sUtrasthAna eva prapa~jcitAH| mAnamiti prabhAvAdivisheShaH| etajj~jAne hetumAha- doShAdItyAdi| kriyAyA iti cikitsAyAH||3||

8.sanskrit: tatrAdau rasadravyadoShavikAraprabhAvAn vakShyAmaH| rasAstAvat ShaT- madhurAmlalavaNakaTutiktakaShAyAH| te samyagupayujyamAnAH sharIraM yApayanti, mithyopayujyamAnAstu khalu doShaprakopAyopakalpante||4||
8.commentary: adhyAyArthaM vaktuM pratijAnIte- tatrAdAvityAdi| yadyapi ca doShabheShajetyAdau doShApekShatvAdbheShajasya doSha Adau kRutaH, tathA~apIha rasadravyarUpabheShajasyApekShitarogaprashamakartRutvena tathA doShasyApi ca rasadravyayoreva kAraNatvena bheShajashabdasUcite rasadravye evAgre kRute, pashcAttu doShagrahaNagRuhItau doShavikArau| prakRuShTo bhAvaH prabhAvaH shaktirityarthaH; sa cehAcintyashcintyashca grAhyaH| yena, ‘tatra khalvanekaraseShu’ ityAdinA dravyavikArayoH prabhAvaM rasadvArA doShadvArA ca cintyamapi vakShyati| yApayantIti sAmyenAvasthApayanti| mithyAshabda ihAyogAtiyogamithyAyogeShu vartate||4||

8.sanskrit: doShAH punastrayo vAtapittashleShmANaH| te prakRutibhUtAH sharIropakArakA bhavanti, vikRutimApannAstu khalu nAnAvidhairvikAraiH sharIramupatApayanti||5||
8.commentary: doShA iti shArIradoShAH| punaHshabdo mAnasadoShaM vyAvartayati||5||

8.sanskrit: tatra doShamekaikaM trayastrayo rasA janayanti, trayastrayashcopashamayanti| tadyathA- kaTutiktakaShAyA vAtaM janayanti, madhurAmlalavaNAstvenaM shamayanti; kaTvamlalavaNAH pittaM janayanti, madhuratiktakaShAyAstvenacchmayanti; madhurAmlalavaNAH shleShmANaM janayanti, kaTutiktakaShAyAstvenaM shamayanti||6||
8.commentary: rasAnAmasaMsRuShTAnAM karmAha- tatretyAdi| anena ca rasakarmopadeshena doShANAmapi tattadrasotpAdyatvaM tathA tattadrasopashamanIyatvamuktaM bhavati| kaTutiktakaShAyA vAtaM janayantIti asati paripanthinIti j~jeyaM, tenArkAguruguDUcyAdInAM tiktAnAmapi vAtAjanakatve na doShaH| tatra hyuShNavIryatA paripanthinI vidyate, tena na te vAtaM janayantItyAdyanusaraNIyam| enamiti padena yashca kaTvAdijo vAyustameva madhurAdayaH sarvAtmavaiparItyAdvisheSheNa shamayantIti darshayati; jAgaraNAdije hi vAyau jAgaraNAdiviparItAH svapnAdaya eva visheSheNa pathyAH| evaM pittashleShmaNorapi enadenaMshabdayostAtparyaM darshayati||6||

8.sanskrit: rasadoShasannipAte tu ye rasA yairdoShaiH samAnaguNAH samAnaguNabhUyiShThA vA bhavanti te tAnabhivardhayanti, viparItaguNA viparItaguNabhUyiShThA vA shamayantyabhyasyamAnA iti| etadvyavasthAhetoH ShaTtvamupadishyate rasAnAM paraspareNAsaMsRuShTAnAM, tritvaM ca doShANAm||7||
8.commentary: atha kayA yuktyA rasA doShA~jjanayanti shamayanti cetyAha rasadoShetyAdi| sannipAte iti antaHsharIramelake| tushabdo visheShe, tena viparItaguNA eva visheSheNa viparItaguNabhUyiShThApekShayA shamayantIti darshayati| rasAnAM tu yathA upacArAdguNA bhavanti tadabhihitaM “guNAguNAshrayA noktAH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA sUtre| abhyasyamAnA iti na sakRudupayujyamAnAH| atha kasmAdrasadoShasaMsargabhUyastvaM parityajya rasaShaTtvaM doShatritvaM cocyate? ityAha- ityetadityAdi| vyavastheti rasadoShasaMsargaprapa~jcasa~gkShepaH | paraspareNAsaMsRuShTAnAmiti padaM doShANAmityanenApi yojyam||7||

8.sanskrit: saMsargavikalpavistaro hyeShAmaparisa~gkhyeyo bhavati, vikalpabhedAparisa~gkhyeyatvAt||8||
8.commentary: rasadoShasaMsargaprapa~jcAnabhidhAne hetumAha- saMsargetyAdi| yasmAt saMsargabhedavistaro~aparisa~gkhyeyastasmAt ShaTtvaM tritvaM cocyate| vikalpabhedAparisa~gkhyeyatvAditi saMsargavikalpasya bhedo vijAtIyaprakAraH, tasyAparisa~gkhyeyatvAt| etena, yathA rasAnAmavAntaravyaktibhede~api madhuratvAdisAmAnyayogAnmadhurAdivyapadeshena ShaTtvamucyate; tathA madhurAmlamadhuralavaNAdisaMsargANAmapi satyapyavAntarabhede sAmAnyenopasa~ggrahaM kRutvA triShaShTitvasa~gkhyAniyamo bhaviShyatIti nirasyate, yato madhurAmlAdisaMsarge~api vijAtIyo madhurataramadhuratamAdibhedakRuto bhedo~aparisa~gkhyeyo bhavati| vacanaM hi- “rasAstaratamAbhyAM tAM sa~gkhyAmatipatanti hi” (sU.a.26) iti||8||

8.sanskrit: tatra khalvanekaraseShu dravyeShvanekadoShAtmakeShu ca vikAreShu rasadoShaprabhAvamekaikashyenAbhisamIkShya tato dravyavikArayoH prabhAvatattvaM vyavasyet||9||
8.commentary: atha kathaM tarhi saMsRuShTAnAM rasAnAM doShANAM ca prabhAvo j~jeya ityAha- tatra khalvityAdi| tatra cAnekarasadravyasyAnekadoShavikArasya ca pratyekarasadoShaprabhAvamelakena prabhAvaM kathayan rasasaMsargadoShasaMsargayorapi tAdRushameva prabhAvaM kathayati, yato rasadoShasaMsargaprabhAvAvatra dravyavikArAshrayitvAdrasadoShayordravyavikAraprabhAvatvenocyete | anena nyAyena sAkShAdanukto~api ekarasadravyaikadoShavikArayorapi prabhAvo~asaMsRuShTarasadoShaprabhAvakathanAdukta eva j~jeyaH| ekaikashyenAbhisamIkShyeti pratyekamuktarasAdiprabhAveNAnekarasaM dravyamanekadoShaM ca vikAraM samuditaprabhAvamabhisamIkShya||9||

8.sanskrit: na tvevaM khalu sarvatra| na hi vikRutiviShamasamavetAnAM nAnAtmakAnAM paraspareNa copahatAnAmanyaishca vikalpanairvikalpitAnAmavayavaprabhAvAnumAnenaiva samudAyaprabhAvatattvamadhyavasAtuM shakyam||10||
8.commentary: ayaM ca rasadoShaprabhAvadvArA dravyavikAraprabhAvanishcayo na sarvatra dravye vikAre cetyAha- na tvevaM khalu sarvatreti| atraiva hetumAha- nahItyAdinA~adhyavasAtuM shakyamityantena| vikRutiviShamasamavetAnAmiti vikRutisamavetAnAM tathA viShamasamavetAnAM ceti vikRutiviShamasamavetAnAm| samavetAnAmiti militAnAM rasAnAM doShANAM ca| tatra rasasya vikRutisamavAyo yathA- madhure taNDulIyake; madhuro hi prakRutyA snehavRuShyatvAdikaraH, taNDulIyake tu vikRutisamavetatvena tanna karoti| viShamasamavetAstu tile kaShAyakaTutiktamadhurAH; yadi hIme rasAH samayA mAtrayA samavetAH syustatastilo~api pittashleShmaharastridoShaharo vA syAt, pittakaphakarastvayaM; tenAtra rasAnAM kvacit kartRutvamakartRutvaM ca kvaciditi vaiShamyamunnIyate| nAnAtmakAnAmityAdihetutrayaM tu vikRutisamavAyaviShamasamavAyayorevopalambhakam | tena, nAnAtmakatvAdibhirvikRutisamavAyaviShamasamavAyau bhavataH| nAnAtmakAnAmiti nAnArUpahetujanitAnAM ; tena hetubhedabalAdeva rasadoShayorvikRuto viShamo vA melako bhavatItyarthaH| kiMvA, nAnAtmakAnAmiti nAnApramANAnAm| evaM ca nAnApramANatvaM viShamasamavAye hetuH| paraspareNa copahatAnAmiti anyonyamupaghAtitaguNAnAm| parasparaguNopaghAtastu yadyapi doShANAM prAyo nAstyeva, tathA~apyadRuShTavashAt kvacidbhavatIti j~jeyaM; rasAnAM tu prabalenAnyopaghAto bhavatyeva| anyaishca vikalpanairiti anyaishca bhedakaiH, tatra rasasya bhedakAH svarasakalkAdayaH; ekasyaiva hi dravyasya kalpanAvisheSheNa guNAntarANi bhavanti| doShasya tu dUShyAntarANyeva guNAntarayogAdbhedakAni bhavanti| yaduktaM- “sa eva kupito doShaH samutthAnavisheShataH| sthAnAntaragatashcaiva vikArAn kurute bahUn” (sU.a.18) iti| asmin vyAkhyAne rasAnAM doShANAM ca ya utkarShApakarShakRuto viShamasamavAyaH pRuthagucyate, sa na yujyate; yato viShamasamavAye~apyutkRuShTasya rasasya tathA doShasya cotkRuShTA guNA apakRuShTasya cApakRuShTA guNA bhavantIti kRutvA~avayavaprabhAvAnanumAnenaiva samudAyaprabhAvAnumAnaM shakyam| athocyeta- viShamamelake rasasya doShasya ca na ta eva guNA utkRuShTA apakRuShTA vA bhavanti kintu guNAntarameva bhavati, hanta tarhi vikRuta evAyaM samavAyo visadRushakAryakAraNatvAt| tadevaM dUShaNadarshanAdanyathA vyAkhyAyate- yat- dvividho melako bhavati rasAnAM doShANAM ca prakRutyanuguNaH, prakRutyananuguNashca; tatra yo militAnAM prAkRutaguNAnupamardena melako bhavati, sa prakRutisamasamavAyashabdenocyate; yastu prAkRutaguNopamardena bhavati, sa vikRutiviShamasamavAyo~abhidhIyate; vikRutyA hetubhUtayA viShamaH prakRutyananuguNaH samavAyo vikRutiviShamasamavAya ityarthaH| atraiva vikRutiviShamasamavAye nAnAtmakatvAdihetutrayaM yathAvivRutameva yojanIyam| ye tu vikRutiviShamasamavAyau pRuthageva kurvanti, viShamasamavAyasya vaiShamyatAratamyenAtibahuprapa~jcitatvAd viShamAvayavaguNAnumAnaM duHshakamiti kRutvA, tadapi dravyavikAraprabhAveNaiva vyapadishanti||10||

8.sanskrit: tathAyukte hi samudaye samudAyaprabhAvatattvamevamevopalabhya tato dravyavikAraprabhAvatattvaM vyavasyet||11||
8.commentary: atha kathaM tarhi vikRutiviShamasamavAyaprabhAvaj~jAnamityAha- tathAyukte hItyAdi| tathAyukte samudaya iti vikRutiviShamasamavAye| samudayaprabhAvatattvamiti melakaprabhAvatattvam| samadhRute hi madhusarpiShi sUryAvartAkhye vA doShasamudaye na saMyujyamAnamadhughRutaguNakramAgataM mArakatvaM, na ca vAtAdidoShaprabhAvagataM sUryavRuddhyA vardhiShNutvaM sUryAvartasya, kiM tu saMyogamahimakRutamevetyarthaH| yacca gatidvayaM doSharasamelakasya, tena prakRutisamasamavAyarUpaM sannipAtaM jvaranidAne doShali~ggamelakenaivoktavAn| yaduktaM- “pRuthaguktalakShaNasaMsargAddvAndvikamanyatamaM sAnnipAtikaM vA jvaraM vidyAt” (ni.a.1) iti| yastu vikRutiviShamasamavetastridoShakRuto jvarastasya cikitsite- “kShaNe dAhaH kShaNe shItaM” (ci.a.3) ityAdinA lakShaNamuktam| na hi shyAvaraktakoThotpattyAdi tatroktaM vAtAdijvare kvacidasti| evaM rase~api yatrAmrAte madhuratvaM prakRutisamasamavetaM, tatrAmrAtaM madhurametanmAtramevoktaM; tena, madhurasAmAnyaguNAgataM tasya vAtapittaharatvamapi labhyata eva| yatra vArtAke kaTutiktatvena vAtakaratvaM prAptamapi ca vikRutiviShamasamavAyAttanna bhavati, tatrAcAryeNa “vArtAkaM vAtaghnaM” (sU.a.27) ityuktameva| evamityAdi tattadudAharaNaM shAstraprasRutamanusaraNIyam| yattu prakRutisamasamavAyakRutarasadoShaguNadvArA prAptamapi dravyaguNaM vikAralakShaNaM ca brUte, tat prakarShArthaM spaShTArthaM ceti j~jeyam||11||

8.sanskrit: tasmAdrasaprabhAvatashca dravyaprabhAvatashca doShaprabhAvatashca vikAraprabhAvatashca tattvamupadekShyAmaH||12||
8.commentary: upasaMharati- tasmAdityAdi| tattvamiti rasAdiprabhAvatattvam| yattu pUrvaM “tatrAdau rasadravyadoShavikAraprabhAvAnupadekShyAmaH” ityanena rasAdiprabhAvavyAkhyAnapratij~jAnaM kRutaM, tattu rasaprabhAvAnumAnenaiva dravyaprabhAvakathanAt, tathA doShaprabhAveNa ca vikAraprabhAvakathanAccaritArthaM syAt| iha tu vikRutiviShamasamavAyAtmake dravye vikAre vA rasadoShaprabhAvAnumAnena na dravyavikAraprabhAvAnumAnamastIti kRutvA pRuthak pRuthagrasAdiprabhAvatattvAbhidhAnapratij~jAnamiti na paunaruktyam| iha dravyANAM vIryaprabhAva-vipAkaprabhAvau ca dravyaprabhAve rasaprabhAve vA~antarbhAvanIyau| tatra yau rasAnuguNau vIryavipAkaprabhAvau, tau rase; yau tu rasakramoktavIryavipAkaviparItau vIryavipAkau, tau dravyaprabhAve boddhavyau| upadekShyAma iti nikhilena tantreNa rasAdiprabhAvatattvaM pRuthagupadekShyAma ityarthaH; rasAdiprabhAvaH prapa~jcena nikhile tantra eva vaktavyaH||12||

8.sanskrit: tatraiSha rasaprabhAva upadiShTo bhavati| dravyaprabhAvaM punarupadekShyAmaH| tailasarpirmadhUni vAtapittashleShmaprashamanArthAni dravyANi bhavanti||13||
8.commentary: sa~gkShepAbhidhAnametadeveti darshayannAha- tatraiSha ityAdi| eSha iti ‘rasAH ShaD’ ityAdinA ‘tattvamupadekShyAmaH’ ityantena granthenokta ityarthaH| upadiShTo bhavatIti sa~gkShepeNa kathito bhavati| anye tu ‘tatraiSha rasaprabhAva uddiShTo bhavati’ iti paThanti| asmin pakShe dravyadoShavikAraprabhAvo~api yo~atra uddiShTaH so~api rasadvArA, tena rasasyaiva prapa~jcAbhihitatvAttasyaivAbhidhAnamupasaMharati na dravyAdInAmiti j~jeyam| dravyaprabhAvamityAdau punariti sAmAnyena dravyaprabhAvakathanAt punaH shRu~ggagrAhikayA tailAdidravyaprabhAvaM kathayiShyAma ityarthaH| prashamanArthAnIti prashamanaprayojanAni||13||

8.sanskrit: tatra tailaM snehauShNyagauravopapannatvAdvAtaM jayati satatamabhyasyamAnaM; vAto hi raukShyashaityalAghavopapanno viruddhaguNo bhavati, viruddhaguNasannipAte hi bhUyasA~alpamavajIyate, tasmAttailaM vAtaM jayati satatamabhyasyamAnam| sarpiH khalvevameva pittaM jayati, mAdhuryAcchaityAnmandatvAcca ; pittaM hyamadhuramuShNaM tIkShNaM ca| madhu ca shleShmANaM jayati, raukShyAttaikShNyAt kaShAyatvAcca; shleShmA hi snigdho mando madhurashca | yaccAnyadapi ki~jciddravyamevaM vAtapittakaphebhyo guNato viparItaM syAttaccaitA~jjayatyabhyasyamAnam||14||
8.commentary: satatamabhyasyamAnamiti avicchedenopayujyamAnam| viruddhaguNa iti tailaguNebhyo viparItaguNaH| viruddhaguNasannipAte iti viruddhaguNayormelake| nanu viruddhaguNayormadhye bhUyasA~alpaM jIyate, tat kathaM tailaM vAtaM jayati? na hyasya vAtaM prati bhUyastvaM yuktamityAha- satatamabhyasyamAnamiti| satatopayogena hi tailaM vAtAdadhikaM bhavati, tena vAtaM jayatItyarthaH| sarpiH khalvevameveti sarpirapi satatamabhyasyamAnamityarthaH| amadhuramiti raukShyalAghavAvRuShyatvAdinA madhuraviparItaM kaTurasamityarthaH| iha ca prabhAvashabdena sAmAnyena dravyashaktirucyate, nAcintyashaktiH; tena tailAdInAM snehauShNyAdiguNAdapi vAtAdishamanaM dravyaprabhAvAdeva bhavati| sarpiShi ca yadyapi madhuro rasaH pittaprashame vyApriyate, tathA~api mAdhuryashaityamandatvaiH pittashamanaM sarpiHkAryameva, tena dravyaprabhAva eva vAcyaH | yadA tu rasadvArA kAryaM dravyasya cintyate, tadA rasaprabhAva iti vyapadesho bhavati| evaM kaShAyAnurase madhuni ca samAdhAnaM vAcyam| anye tu bruvate- yat- tailAdInAM vAtAdishamanatvaM pratyacintya eva prabhAvo~ayamucyate; tatra ca tailavAtashamanatvaM pratyacintya eva prabhAvo~ayamucyate; tatra ca tailavAtayorviruddhaguNayormelake tailameva vAtaM jayati, na tu vAtastailamiti tailasyAcintyaprabhAvaH; evaM sarpirmadhunorapi pittashleShmaharaNe prabhAvAjj~jeye| etaccAnye necchanti, yatastailAdInAM satatamabhyasyamAnamiti padenAdhikyameva vAtAdijayakAraNamuktaM; tathA yaccAnyadapi ki~jciddravyamityAdigranthena dravyAcintyaprabhAvaM parityajya sAmAnyena guNavaiparItyamevAbhyAsAdvAtAdijayaheturucyate||14||

8.sanskrit: atha khalu trINi dravyANi nAtyupayu~jjItAdhikamanyebhyo dravyebhyaH; tadyathA- pippalI, kShAraH, lavaNamiti||15||
8.commentary: abhyasyadravyaM prabhAvodAharaNArthamabhidhAyAnabhyasyAnAha- athetyAdi| adhikamanyebhya iti vacanAdanyadapi citrakabhallAtakAdyeva~jjAtIyaM nAtyupayoktavyaM, pippalyAdidravyaM tvanyebhyo~apyadhikamatyupayoge varjanIyamiti darshayati||15||

8.sanskrit: pippalyo hi kaTukAH satyo madhuravipAkA gurvyonAtyarthaM snigdhoShNAH prakledinyo bheShajAbhimatAshcatAH sadyaH; shubhAshubhakAriNyo bhavanti; ApAtabhadrAH, prayogasamasAdguNyAt; doShasa~jcayAnubandhAH;- satatamupayujyamAnA hi guruprakleditvAcchleShmANamutkleshayanti, auShNyAt pittaM, na ca vAtaprashamanAyopakalpante~alpasnehoShNabhAvAt; yogavAhinyastu khalu bhavanti; tasmAt pippalIrnAtyupayu~jjIta||16||
8.commentary: ‘kaTukAH satyo madhuravipAkAH’ ityAdi pippalIguNakathanamanabhyAsaprayoge doShavaiparItyena doShaprashamanopadarshanArthaM; tathA, atyabhyAse ‘guruprakleditvAcchleShmANamutkleshayanti’ ityAdigranthavaktavyadoShakaraNayogyatopadarshanArthaM ca| bheShajAbhimatAshca sadya iti cchedaH| sadya iti anabhyAse| shubhAshubhakAriNyo bhavantIti sadyaH shubhakAriNyaH, atyabhyAsaprayoge tvashubhakAriNyaH| etadeva shubhAshubhakAritvaM darshayati- ApAtabhadrA ityAdinA| prayogasamasAdguNyAditi samasya prayogasya sadguNatvAt, same~alpakAle alpamAtre ca pippalyAdiprayoge sadguNA bhavantItyarthaH| doShasa~jcayAnubandho~atyupayogo yAsAM tA doShasa~jcayAnubandhAH| etadeva doShasa~jcayAnubandhatvaM vivRuNoti- satatamityAdi| pippalIdharmakathanaprastAvAdguNAntaramAha- yogavAhinyastvityAdi| yogavAhitvena kaTukAnAmapi pippalInAM vRuShyaprayogeShu yogaH, tathA jvaragulmakuShThaharAdiprayogeShu jvarAdIn hanti pippalI| ayaM ca pippalyatiyoganiShedho~apavAdaM parityajya j~jeyaH| tena, pippalIrasAyanaprayogastathA gulmAdiShu ca pippalIvardhamAnakaprayogo na virodhamAvahati| ukte hi viShaye yathoktavidhAnena nirdoShA eva pippalya iti RuShivacanAdunnIyate| anye tu, annasaMskaraNe pippalyAdInAmatiprayogo niShidhyate, na tu svAtantrayeNeti bruvate| satatamupayujyamAnA iti atimAtratvena tathA satataprayogeNa ceti j~jeyam||16||

8.sanskrit: kShAraH punarauShNyataikShNayalAghavopapannaH kledayatyAdau pashcAdvishoShayati , sa pacanadahanabhedanArthamupayujyate; so~atiprayujyamAnaH keshAkShihRudayapuMstvopaghAtakaraH sampadyate| ye hyenaM grAmanagaranigamajanapadAH satatamupayu~jjate ta AndhyaShANDhyakhAlityapAlityabhAjo hRudayApakartinashca bhavanti, tadyathA- prAcyAshcInAshca; tasmAt kShAraM nAtyupayu~jjIta||17||
8.commentary: hRudayApakartina iti hRudayaparikartanarUpavedanAyuktAH||17||

8.sanskrit: lavaNaM punarauShNyataikShNyopapannam, anatiguru, anatisnigdham, upakledi, visraMsanasamartham, annadravyarucikaram, ApAtabhadraM prayogasamasAdguNyAt, doShasa~jcayAnubandhaM, tadrocanapAcanopakledanavisraMsanArthamupayujyate| tadatyarthamupayujyamAnaM glAnishaithilyadaurbalyAbhinirvRuttikaraM sharIrasya bhavati| ye hyenadgrAmanagaranigamajanapadAH satatamupayu~jjate, te bhUyiShThaM glAsnavaH shithilamAMsashoNitA aparikleshasahAshca bhavanti| tadyathA- bAhlIkasaurAShTrikasaindhavasauvIrakAH; te hi payasA~api saha lavaNamashnanti| ye~apIha bhUmeratyUSharA deshAsteShvoShadhivIrudvanaspativAnaspatyA na jAyante~alpatejaso vA bhavanti, lavaNopahatatvAt| tasmAllavaNaM nAtyupayu~jjIta| ye hyatilavaNasAtmyAH puruShAsteShAmapi khAlityapAlityAni valayashcAkAle bhavanti||18||
8.commentary: glAniH mAMsApacayo harShakShayo vA| na kevalaM lavaNAtiyogasharIropaghAtakaraH; kintu bhUmerapyupaghAtakara ityAha- ye~apIhetyAdi| USharA iti lavaNapradhAnAH| lavaNaM nAtyupayu~jjIteti nAtimAtraM lavaNaM satatamupayu~jjIta, annadravyasaMskArakaM tu stokamAtramabhyAsenApyupayojanIyameva| bAhlIkAdivyatirikte~api deshe ye~atilavaNamashnanti teShAmapi doShAnAha- ye hItyAdi| etena cAnyatrApi deshe~atimAtralavaNasAtmyAnAM lavaNAtyupayogakRuta eva shaithilyAdidoSha unnIyate, na deshasvabhAvakRutaH||18||

8.sanskrit: tasmAtteShAM tatsAtmyataH krameNApagamanaM shreyaH| sAtmyamapi hi krameNopanivartyamAnamadoShamalpadoShaM vA bhavati||19||
8.commentary: teShAmiti atikShAralavaNasAtmyAnAm| tatsAtmyata iti atimAtrakShArAdatimAtralavaNAcca sAtmyAt| krameNeti navegAndhAraNIyoktasAtmyaparityAgakrameNa| iha ca sAtmyashabdenaukasAtmyamabhipretam| alpadoShamadoShaM veti pakShadvaye~atyarthasAtmyamalpadoShaM bhavati, anyattvadoShamiti vyavasthA||19||

8.sanskrit: sAtmyaM nAma tad yadAtmanyupashete; sAtmyArtho hyupashayArthaH| tattrividhaM pravarAvaramadhyavibhAgena; saptavidhaM tu rasaikaikatvena sarvarasopayogAcca| tatra sarvarasaM pravaram, avaramekarasaM, madhyaM tu pravarAvaramadhyastham| tatrAvaramadhyAbhyAM sAtmyAbhyAM krameNaiva pravaramupapAdayet sAtmyam| sarvarasamapi ca sAtmyamupapannaH prakRutyAdyupayoktraShTamAni sarvANyAhAravidhivisheShAyatanAnyabhisamIkShya hitamevAnurudhyeta||20||
8.commentary: sAtmyaM nAmeti okasAtmyaM nAmetyarthaH| (okAditi abhyAsAt |) upashayArtha iti upashayashabdAbhidheya ityarthaH| taditi okasAtmyam| trividhamiti pravarAvaramadhyabhedena| saptavidhantu ekaikarasena ShaT, saMsRuShTarasopayogAccaikam, evaM saptavidham| saMsRuShTashabdena dvirasAdayaH ShaDrasaparyantA gRuhyante| pravarAvaramadhyasthamiti dvirasAdipa~jcarasaparyantam| avaramadhyamAbhyAM lakShitaH puruShaH| pravaramiti sarvarasam| sAtmyamupapAdayet abhyasedityarthaH| krameNeti yathoktAbhyAsakrameNa| upapAditasarvarasasAtmyenApi cAhAraH prashastaprakRutyAdisampanna eva kartavya ityAha- sarvarasamityAdi| abhisamIkShyeti hitAhitatvena vicArya| hitameveti padena yadeva prakRutyAdinA hitaM tadevAnurudhyeta sevetetyarthaH||20||

8.sanskrit: tatra khalvimAnyaShTAvAhAravidhivisheShAyatanAni bhavanti; tadyathA- prakRutikaraNasaMyogarAshideshakAlopayogasaMsthopayoktraShTamAni (bhavanti)||21||
8.commentary: AhArasya vidhiH prakAro vidhAnaM vA ityAhAravidhiH, tasya visheSho hitatvamahitatvaM ca, tasyAyatanAni hetUnItyAhAravidhivisheShAyatanAni| AhAraprakArasya hitatvamahitatvaM ca prakRutyAdihetukamityarthaH| upayoktA aShTamo yeShAM tAnyupayoktraShTamAni||21||

8.sanskrit: tatra prakRutirucyate svabhAvo yaH, sa punarAhArauShadhadravyANAM svAbhAviko gurvAdiguNayogaH; tadyathA mAShamudgayoH, shUkaraiNayoshca (1)|22|
8.commentary: uktAni prakRutyAdInA vibhajate- tatretyAdinA| svAbhAvika iti saMskArAdyakRutaH| mAShamudgayoriti prakRutyA mAShe gurutvaM, mudge ca laghutvaM; shUkare gurutvaM, eNe ca laghutvam||22(1)||

8.sanskrit: karaNaM punaH svAbhAvikAnAM dravyANAmabhisaMskAraH| saMskAro hi guNAntarAdhAnamucyate| te guNAstoyAgnisannikarShashaucamanthanadeshakAlavAsanabhAvanAdibhiH kAlaprakarShabhAjanAdibhishcAdhIyante (2)|22|
8.commentary: dravyANAmiti vaktavye svAbhAvikAnAmiti yat karoti, tenotpattikAle janakabhUtaiH svaguNAropaNaM, saMskArastUtpannasyaiva toyAdinA guNAntarAdhAnamiti darshayati| tacca prAkRutaguNopamardenaiva kriyate, yathA- toyAgnisannikarShashaucaistaNDulasthaM gauravamupahatya lAghavamanne kriyate| yaduktaM- “sudhautaH prasrutaH svinnaH santaptashcaudano laghuH” (sU.a.27)| tathA raktashAlyAderlaghorapyagnisaMyogAdinA lAghavaM vardhate| manthanAdguNAdhAnaM yathA “shothakRuddadhi shothaghnaM sasnehamapi manthanAt” iti| deshena yathA “bhasmarAsheradhaH sthApayet” (ci.a.1pA.1) ityAdau| vAsanena guNAdhAnaM yathA- apAmutpalAdivAsanena sugandhAnukaraNam| bhAvanayA ca svarasAdikRutayA sthitasyaivAmalakAderguNasyotkarSho bhavati| kAlaprakarShadyathA- “pakShAjjAtarasaM pibet” (ci.a.15) ityAdi| bhAjanena yathA- “traiphalenAyasIM pAtrIM kalkenAlepayet” (ci.a.1,pA.3) ityAdau| AdigrahaNAt peShaNAbhimantraNAdi gRuhyate| nanu, saMskArAdheyena guNena kathaM svAbhAvikaguNanAshaH kriyate, yataH “svabhAvo niShpratikriyaH” ityuktaM; yadi hi saMskAreNa svAbhAvikagurutvaM pratikriyate, tadA “svabhAvo niShpratikriyaH” iti kathaM? brUmaH- “svabhAvo niShpratikriyaH” iti svabhAvo bhAvAnAmutpattau nAnyathA kriyate| tena, jAtipratibaddhaM mAShAdInAM gurutvaM na tajjAtau sphoTayituM pAryate, saMskAreNa tu tadanyathAkaraNamanumatameva dRuShTatvAt| kashcittu guNo dravyANAM saMskArAdinA~api nAnyathA kriyate, yathA- vahnerauShNyaM, vAyoshcalatvaM, tailasya sneha ityAdi| ete hi yAvaddravyabhAvina eva guNAH| gauravAdayastu purANadhAnyAdiShvapyapagamadarshanAnna yAvaddravyabhAvinaH| uktaM hi- “guNo dravyavinAshAdvA vinAshamupagacchati| guNAntaropadhAnAdvA” iti| yatra tu saMskAreNa vrIherlAjalakShaNaM dravyAntarameva janyate, tatra guNAntarotpAdaH suShThveva ||22(2)||

8.sanskrit: saMyogaH punardvayorbahUnAM vA dravyANAM saMhatIbhAvaH, sa visheShamArabhate, yaM punarnaikaikasho dravyANyArabhante; tadyathA- madhusarpiShoH, madhumatsyapayasAM ca saMyogaH (3)|22|
8.commentary: saMyogamAha- saMyogastvityAdi| sa visheShamArabhata iti saMyujyamAnadravyaikadeshe~adRuShTaM kAryamArabhata ityarthaH| yaM naikaikasha iti yaM visheShaM pratyekamasaMyujyamAnAni dravyANi nArabhanta ityarthaH| madhusarpiShI hi pratyekamamArake milite tu mArake bhavataH, kShIramatsyAdisaMyogashca kuShThAdikaro bhavati| saMyogastviha pradhAnyenaivopalabhyamAnadravyamelako vivakShitaH , tena bhAvanAdiShvapi yadyapi saMyogo~asti, tathA~api tatra bhAvanAdravyANAM prAdhAnyenAnupalabdherna saMyogena grahaNam||22(3)||

8.sanskrit: rAshistu sarvagrahaparigrahau mAtrAmAtraphalavinishcayArthaH| tatra sarvasyAhArasya pramANagrahaNamekapiNDena sarvagrahaH, parigrahaH punaH pramANagrahaNamekaikashyenAhAradravyANAm| sarvasya hi grahaH sarvagrahaH, sarvatashca grahaH parigraha ucyate (4)|22|
8.commentary: rAshiH pramANam| mAtrAmAtraphalavinishcayArthaM iti mAtrAvadAhArasyauShadhasya ca yat phalaM shubham, amAtrasya hInasyAtiriktasya vA yat phalamashubham| yaduktaM- “tasya j~jAnArthamucitapramANamanucitapramANaM ca rAshisa~jj~jaM bhavati”| sarvagrahaM vivRuNoti- tatretyAdi| sarvasyeti mishrIkRutasyAnnamAMsasUpAderekapiNDena mAnam| parigrahaM vivRuNoti- parigrahaH punarityAdi| ekaikashyeneti annasya kuDavaH, sUpasya palaM, mAMsasya dvipalamityAdyavayavamAnapUrvakaM samudAyamAnam| sarvagrahe pratyavayavamAnaniyamo nAsti; tena yena kenacidAhAreNa pratyekamaniyatamAnena sampUrNAhAramAtrAniyamanaM sarvagrahaH| etadeva shabdavyutpattyA darshayati- sarvasya hItyAdi| sarvata iti pratyekAvayavata ityarthaH||22(4)||

8.sanskrit: deshaH punaH sthAnaM; sa dravyANAmutpattipracArau deshasAtmyaM cAcaShTe (5)|22|
8.commentary: deshaM vibhajate- desha ityAdi| sthAnagrahaNenAhAradravyasya tathA bhoktushca sthAnaM darshayati| AcaShTa iti dravyasyotpattipracArAdikRutaguNaj~jAnaheturbhavati| tatrotpattyA- himavati jAtaM guNavadbhavati , marau jAtaM laghu bhavati, ityAdi| pracAreNa laghubhakShyANAM prANinAM tathA dhanvapracAriNAM bahukriyANAM ca lAghavaM, viparyaye ca gauravaM gRuhyate| deshasAtmyena ca deshaviparItaguNaM sAtmyaM gRuhyate; yathA- AnUpe uShNarUkShAdi, dhanvani ca shItasnigdhAdi, okasAtmyaM tu upayoktRugrahaNena gRuhItam||22(5)||

8.sanskrit: kAlo hi nityagashcAvasthikashca; tatrAvasthiko vikAramapekShate, nityagastu RutusAtmyApekShaH (6)|22|
8.commentary: nityaga iti ahorAtrAdirUpaH| Avasthika iti rogitvabAlyAdyavasthAvisheShita ityarthaH| vikAramapekShata iti bAlyAdikRutaM tu shleShmavikAraM jvarAdikaM cAhAraniyamArthamapekShata ityarthaH| RutusAtmyaM hi RutumapekShata iti RutusAtmyApekShaH||22(6)||

8.sanskrit: upayogasaMsthA tUpayoganiyamaH; sa jIrNalakShaNApekShaH (7)|22|
8.commentary: evamAhAropayogaH kartavya evaM na kartavya ityupayoganiyamaH, sa jIrNalakShaNApekSha iti prAdhAnyenoktaH| teneha ‘ajalpannahasannAtidrutaM nAtivilambitam’ ityAdyupayoganiyamamapyapekShata eva; ajIrNabhojane tu mahAMstridoShakopalakShaNo doSho bhavatItyayamevodAhRutaH||22(7)||

8.sanskrit: upayoktA punaryastamAhAramupayu~gkte, yadAyattamokasAtmyam| ityaShTAvAhAravidhivisheShAyatanAni vyAkhyAtAni bhavanti||22||
8.commentary: yadAyattamokasAtmyamiti bhoktRupuruShApekShaM hyabhyAsasAtmyaM bhavati; kasyaciddhi ki~jcidevAbhyAsAt pathyamapathyaM vA sAtmyaM bhavati||22||

8.sanskrit: eShAM visheShAH shubhAshubhaphalAH parasparopakArakA bhavanti; tAn bubhutseta, buddhvA ca hitepsureva syAt; naca mohAt pramAdAdvA priyamahitamasukhodarkamupasevyamAhArajAtamanyadvA ki~jcit||23||
8.commentary: eShAmityAdau shubhaphalA visheShA ashubhaphalAshca parasparopakArakA bhavantIti j~jeyam| tatra prakRutyA lAghavAdiH shubhaphalaH, gurvAdishcAshubhaphalaH| karaNAdyAdheyo~api visheShaH shAstroktaH shubhaH, niShiddhastvashubhaH| deshAsAtmyaM ninditadeshabhavatvAdi ca dravyasyAshubhaphalam| evaM kAlAsAtmyamashubhaphalaM cAjIrNabhojanAdi, tathA okAsAtmyaM cAshubhamashubhaphalamiti j~jeyaM; viparItaM tu shubhaphalam| mohAditi aj~jAnAt, pramAdAditi j~jAtvA~api rAgAdityarthaH| priyamiti tadAtvamAtrapriyam| ahitamityasya vivaraNam- asukhodarkamiti|- asukhaM duHkharUpam, udarka uttarakAlInaM phalaM, yasya sa tathA| anyadveti bheShajavihArAdi||23||

8.sanskrit: tatredamAhAravidhividhAnamarogANAmAturANAM cApi keShA~jcit kAle prakRutyaiva hitatamaM bhu~jjAnAnAM bhavati- uShNaM, snigdhaM, mAtrAvat, jIrNe vIryAviruddham, iShTe deshe, iShTasarvopakaraNaM, nAtidrutaM, nAtivilambitam, ajalpan, ahasan, tanmanA bhu~jjIta, AtmAnamabhisamIkShya samyak||24||
8.commentary: tatretyAdau idamiti vakShyamANam| AhAravidhirvidhIyate yenoShNasnigdhAdinA vakShyamANena tadAhAravidhividhAnam| AturANAM ca keShA~jciditi padena raktapittinAM shItameva, kapharogiNAM rUkShameva hitamityAdiviparyayaM darshayati| keShA~jcidbhu~jjAnAnAmidamAhAravidhividhAnaM hitatamaM bhavatIti yojanA| prakRutyaiveti svabhAvenaiva hitatamaM hitatamamityuktaM; tena yat prakRutyA hitaM tat kadAcideva ka~jcideva puruShamAsAdyAhitaM bhavati, tacca kAdAcitkatvAdanAdRutaM; tena prAyikatvAdenaM hitatamaM vakShyAma iti bhAvaH| uShNamityAdau samyagiti chedaH|| 24||

8.sanskrit: tasya sAdguNyamupadekShyAmaH- uShNamashnIyAt; uShNaM hi bhujyamAnaM svadate, bhuktaM cAgnimaudaryamudIrayati, kShipraM jarAM gacchati, vAtamanulomayati, shleShmANaM ca parihrAsasayati ; tasmAduShNamashnIyAt (1)|25| snigdhamashnIyAt; snigdhaM hi bhujyamAnaM svadate, bhuktaM cAnudIrNamagnimudIrayati , kShipraM jarAM gacchati, vAtamanulomayati, sharIramupacinoti, dRuDhIkarotIndriyANi, balAbhivRuddhimupajanayati, varNaprasAdaM cAbhinirvartayati; tasmAt snigdhamashnIyAt (2)|25|
8.commentary: tasyeti uShNAdiguNayuktasyAnnasya| sAdguNyamiti prashastaguNayogitAm| parihrAsayatIti bhinnasa~gghAtaM karoti||25(1-2)||

8.sanskrit: mAtrAvadashnIyAt; mAtrAvaddhi bhuktaM vAtapittakaphAnapIDayadAyureva vivardhayati kevalaM, sukhaM gudamanuparyeti, na coShmANamupahanti, avyathaM ca paripAkameti; tasmAnmAtrAvadashnIyAt (3)|25|
8.commentary: mAtrAvaditi prashaMsAyAM matup; tena prashastamAtramityarthaH| apIDayaditi anatimAtratvena svasthAnasthitaM sadvAtAdIn sthAnApIDanAdaprakopayat| gudamanuparyetIti pariNataM sadanurUpatayA niHsaratItyarthaH| UShmANaM vahnim||25(3)||

8.sanskrit: jIrNe~ashnIyAt; ajIrNe hi bhu~jjAnasyAbhyavahRutamAhArajAtaM pUrvasyAhArasya rasamapariNatamuttareNAhArarasenopasRujat sarvAn doShAn prakopayatyAshu, jIrNe tu bhu~jjAnasya svasthAnastheShu doSheShvagnau codIrNe jAtAyAM ca bubhukShAyAM vivRuteShu ca srotasAM mukheShu vishuddhe codgAre hRudaye vishuddhe vAtAnulomye visRuShTeShu ca vAtamUtrapurIShavegeShvabhyavahRutamAhArajAtaM sarvasharIradhAtUnapradUShayadAyurevAbhivardhayati kevalaM; tasmAjjIrNe~ashnIyAt (4)|25|
8.commentary: pUrvasyeti dinAntarakRutasya| apariNatamiti asamyagjAtam| AhAraraseneti AhArapariNAmagatena madhurAdinA; kiMvA AhArajena rasena| svasthAnastheShu doSheShvityAdi jIrNAhArasya lakShaNam||25(4)||

8.sanskrit: vIryAviruddhamashnIyAt; aviruddhavIryamashnan hi viruddhavIryAhArajairvikArairnopasRujyate; tasmAdvIryAviruddhamashnIyAt (5)|25|
8.commentary: viruddhavIryAhArajairiti kuShThAndhyavisarpAdyairAtreyabhadrakApyIyoktaiH||25(5)||

8.sanskrit: iShTe deshe iShTasarvopakaraNaM cAshnIyAt; iShTe hi deshe bhu~jjAno nAniShTadeshajairmanovighAtakarairbhAvairmanovighAtaM prApnoti, tathaiveShTaiH sarvopakaraNaiH; tasmAdiShTe deshe tatheShTasarvopakaraNaM cAshnIyAt (6)|25|
8.commentary: manovighAtakarairbhAvairiti trividhakukShIye (vi.a.2) vakShyamANaiH kAmAdibhishcittopatApakaraishcittavikArairityarthaH| tatheShTaishca sarvopakaraNairbhu~jjAno manovighAtaM na prApnotIti yojanA; aniShTabhojanAdermanovighAto bhavati||25(6)||

8.sanskrit: nAtidrutamashnIyAt; atidrutaM hi bhu~jjAnasyotsnehanamavasAdanaM bhojanasyApratiShThAnaM ca, bhojyadoShasAdgaNyopalabdhishca na niyatA; tasmAnnAtidrutamashnIyAt (7)|25|
8.commentary: utsnehanam unmArgagamanam| avasadanam avasAdaH| apratiShThAnaM hRudayasthatvena koShThApraveshaH| bhojyagatAnAM doShANAM keshAdInAM, sAdguNyasya ca svAdutvAdeH, upalabdhirna niyatA bhavati kadAcidupalabhyate kadAcinneti| tatra doShAnupalabdhyA sadoShasyaiva bhakShaNaM, sAdguNyAnupalabdhyA ca prItyabhAvaH||25(7)||

8.sanskrit: nAtivilambitamashnIyAt; ativilambitaM hi bhu~jjAno na tRuptimadhigacchati, bahu bhu~gkte, shItIbhavatyAhArajAtaM, viShamaM ca pacyate; tasmAnnAtivilambitamashnIyAt (8)|25|
8.commentary: viShamaM ca pacyata iti cirakAlabhojanenAgnisambandhasya vaiShamyAditi bhAvaH||25(8)||

8.sanskrit: ajalpannahasan tanmanA bhu~jjIta; jalpato hasato~anyamanaso vA bhu~jjAnasya ta eva hi doShA bhavanti, ya evAtidrutamashnataH; tasmAdajalpannahasaMstanmanA bhu~jjIta (9)|25|
8.commentary: ya evAtidrutamashnato doShA iti utsnehanAdayaH||25(9)||

8.sanskrit: AtmAnamabhisamIkShya bhu~jjIta samyak; idaM mamopashete idaM nopasheta ityevaM viditaM hyasyAtmana AtmasAtmyaM bhavati; tasmAdAtmAnamabhisamIkShya bhu~jjIta samyagiti||25||
8.commentary: nopasheta itItyatra itishabdena sAtmyAsAtmyavidhAnopadarshakena vicAraphalamokasAtmyasevanaM darshayati| Atmana iti padenAtmanaivAtmasAtmyaM pratipuruShaM j~jAyate, na shAstropadesheneti darshayati||25||

8.sanskrit: bhavati cAtra- rasAn dravyANi doShAMshca vikArAMshca prabhAvataH| veda yo deshakAlau ca sharIraM ca sa no bhiShak||26||
8.commentary: adhyAyoktarasaprabhAvAdij~jAnaM stauti- rasAnityAdi| sa no bhiShagiti no~asmAkaM sammata ityarthaH||26||

8.sanskrit: tatra shlokau- vimAnArtho rasadravyadoSharogAH prabhAvataH| dravyANi nAtisevyAni trividhaM sAtmyameva ca||27|| AhArAyatanAnyaShTau bhojyasAdguNyameva ca| vimAne rasasa~gkhyAte sarvametat prakAshitam||28||
8.commentary: doShavikArau ca yadyapi trividhakukShIye (vi.a.2) prabhAvavistAreNa vaktavyau, tathA~apIha sa~gkShepeNoktAveva; tena doShavikAraprabhAvAvapyuktAviti yaducyate sa~ggrahe tat sAdhu| tailAdidravyatrayakathanaM ca dravyaprabhAvagRuhItamiti kRutvA na pRuthak sa~ggrahe paThitam||27-28||

8.sanskrit: ityagniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute vimAnasthAne rasavimAnaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
8.commentary: iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM vimAnasthAne rasavimAnaM nAma prathamo~adhyAyaH||1||
